   * tunnel map's limits when the current map has no tunnel).
   */
  Arena.tunnelEligible = function (st) {
    if (!st || st.air || st.building || st.tower) return false;
    const T = Arena.TUNNEL || ((CR.RULES.arena.maps.tunnel || {}).tunnel) || {};
    const maxM = typeof T.maxMass === 'number' ? T.maxMass : 8, maxR = typeof T.maxRadius === 'number' ? T.maxRadius : 0.65;
    const m = typeof st.mass === 'number' ? st.mass : 1, r = typeof st.radius === 'number' ? st.radius : (typeof st.r === 'number' ? st.r : 0.5);
    return m <= maxM + 1e-9 && r <= maxR + 1e-9;
  };
  /** Index of the hole whose centre is within its radius + pad of (x, y), else -1. */
  Arena.holeAt = function (x, y, pad) {
    const T = Arena.TUNNEL;
    if (!T) return -1;
    for (let i = 0; i < T.holes.length; i++) {
      const h = T.holes[i];
      if (CR.dist(x, y, h.x, h.y) <= h.r + (pad || 0) + 1e-9) return i;
    }
    return -1;
  };
  /** Hole on `side`'s own half (the one that leads towards the enemy), -1 without a tunnel. */
  Arena.ownHole = function (side) {
    const T = Arena.TUNNEL;
    if (!T) return -1;
    const mid = Arena.H / 2;
    for (let i = 0; i < T.holes.length; i++) if ((T.holes[i].y < mid) === (side !== 1)) return i;
    return -1;
  };
  /** Distance from (x, y) to the rim square of hole i (0 inside). */
  Arena.holeGap = function (i, x, y) {
    const h = Arena.TUNNEL.holes[i];
    return CR.boxDist(x, y, h.x - h.r, h.y - h.r, h.x + h.r, h.y + h.r);
  };
  /** Clamp an underground position of a troop of radius r into the corridor (writes out). */
  Arena.clampTunnel = function (x, y, r, out) {
    const T = Arena.TUNNEL;
    out.x = x; out.y = y;
    if (!T) return out;
    const rr = Math.min(r, T.halfWidth * 0.9);
    out.x = CR.clamp(x, T.x0 + rr, T.x1 - rr);
    out.y = CR.clamp(y, T.y0, T.y1);
    return out;
  };
  /**
   * Where a troop of radius r comes up at hole `to` after walking the tunnel from hole `from`:
   * on the far side of the rim, continuing in the walking direction (writes out {x, y}).
   */
  Arena.tunnelExit = function (to, from, r, out) {
    const T = Arena.TUNNEL, h = T.holes[to], f = T.holes[from];
    const dx = h.x - f.x, dy = h.y - f.y, d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) || 1;
    const k = h.r + r + 0.05;
    out.x = CR.clamp(h.x + dx / d * k, r, Arena.W - r);
    out.y = CR.clamp(h.y + dy / d * k, r, Arena.H - r);
    return out;
  };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Placement
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  function cardOf(card) {
    if (!card) return null;
    if (typeof card === 'string') return CR.Sim && CR.Sim.cardById ? CR.Sim.cardById(card) : null;
    return card;
  }

  /** Footprint (tiles) of a building card's main unit, 0 for non-buildings. */
  Arena.footprintOf = function (card) {
    const c = cardOf(card);
    if (!c) return 0;
    if (c.type !== 'building') return 0;
    const sm = c.summon && c.summon[0];
    const u = sm && CR.DATA && CR.DATA.units ? CR.DATA.units[sm.unit] : null;
    const f = (u && (u.footprint || u.size)) || c.footprint || 2;
    return f;
  };

  /** Placement category: 'own' (troops), 'building', 'anywhere' (spells), 'anywhere-ground' (Miner, Goblin Drill). */
  Arena.placementKind = function (card) {
    const c = cardOf(card);
    if (!c) return 'own';
    if (c.placement) return c.placement;
    if (c.type === 'spell') return 'anywhere';
    // Tunnelling units (Miner, Goblin Drill) deploy anywhere on land.
    const sm = c.summon && c.summon[0];
    const u = sm && CR.DATA && CR.DATA.units ? CR.DATA.units[sm.unit] : null;
    const sp = u && u.special;
    if (sp && (sp.deploy_anywhere || sp.deployAnywhere || sp.tunnel || sp.tunnel_speed_raw !== undefined || sp.tunnel_speed_tiles_per_s !== undefined)) return 'anywhere-ground';
    if (c.type === 'building') return 'building';
    return 'own';
  };

  /** Snap like the real game: troops/spells to tile centres, buildings to their footprint grid. */
  Arena.snap = function (x, y, card) {
    const W = Arena.W, H = Arena.H;
    const f = Arena.footprintOf(card);
    if (f > 0) {
      const half = f / 2;
      let sx, sy;
      if (f % 2 === 0) { sx = Math.round(x); sy = Math.round(y); }
      else { sx = Math.floor(x) + 0.5; sy = Math.floor(y) + 0.5; }
      sx = CR.clamp(sx, half, W - half);
      sy = CR.clamp(sy, half, H - half);
      return { x: sx, y: sy };
    }
    const tx = CR.clamp(Math.floor(x), 0, Arena.COLS - 1) + 0.5;
    const ty = CR.clamp(Math.floor(y), 0, Arena.ROWS - 1) + 0.5;
    return { x: tx, y: ty };
  };

  /** Is the enemy Princess Tower in `lane` (as seen by `side`) destroyed? */
  Arena.pocketOpen = function (side, lane, sim) {
    if (Arena.touchdown || !sim || !sim.towers) return false;
    const ts = sim.towers;
    for (let i = 0; i < ts.length; i++) {
      const t = ts[i];
      // Sim towers carry `towerKind`, view / pseudo-sim towers carry `kind`.
      const k = t.towerKind || t.kind;
      if (t.side !== side && k === 'princess' && t.lane === lane) return t.alive === false || t.hp <= 0;
    }
    return false;
  };

  /**
   * Raw (unblocked) zone rects for `side`: own half + open pockets. With `noPocket`
   * (buildings, unless RULES.arena.buildingsInPocket) only the own half.
   */
  Arena.zoneRects = function (side, sim, noPocket) {
    const A = CR.RULES.arena;
    const W = Arena.W, H = Arena.H, rv = Arena.RIVER;
    const rects = [];
    if (side === 0) rects.push({ x0: 0, y0: 0, x1: W, y1: Math.min(A.ownRows, rv.y0) });
    else rects.push({ x0: 0, y0: Math.max(H - A.ownRows, rv.y1), x1: W, y1: H });
    if (noPocket) return rects;
    for (let lane = 0; lane < 2; lane++) {
      if (!Arena.pocketOpen(side, lane, sim)) continue;
      const x0 = lane === 0 ? 0 : Arena.LANE_X, x1 = lane === 0 ? Arena.LANE_X : W;
      if (side === 0) rects.push({ x0: x0, y0: rv.y1, x1: x1, y1: Math.min(H, rv.y1 + A.pocketRows), pocket: lane });
      else rects.push({ x0: x0, y0: Math.max(0, rv.y0 - A.pocketRows), x1: x1, y1: rv.y0, pocket: lane });
    }
    return rects;
  };

  function inRects(rects, x, y) {
    for (let i = 0; i < rects.length; i++) {
      const r = rects[i];
      if (x >= r.x0 && x < r.x1 && y >= r.y0 && y < r.y1) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  /** Rects that block placement / ground movement: alive towers, buildings (optionally), obstacles. */
  Arena.blockRects = function (sim, includeBuildings) {
    const out = [];
    if (Arena.touchdown) { /* the touchdown field has no towers */ }
    else if (sim && sim.towers) {
      for (const t of sim.towers) if (t.alive) out.push(t);
    } else {
      // No sim: the static layout, blocking the hit box tiles (same tiles as the footprint).
      for (const t of Arena.towerLayout()) out.push({ x0: t.hx0, y0: t.hy0, x1: t.hx1, y1: t.hy1, kind: t.kind, side: t.side });
    }
    if (includeBuildings && sim && sim.units) {
      for (const u of sim.units) if (u.building && !u.dead && !u.tunnel && u.x1 !== undefined) out.push(u);
    }
    for (const o of Arena.OBSTACLES) out.push(o);
    return out;
  };

  /** A tile (centre cx, cy) is blocked when its centre lies inside a rect or on its edge: the
   *  3x3 king tower (half-tile edges) therefore blocks every tile it touches. Rects on the tile
   *  grid (princess hit boxes, snapped buildings) block exactly the tiles they cover. */
  function tileBlocked(blocks, cx, cy) {
    for (let i = 0; i < blocks.length; i++) {
      const b = blocks[i];
      if (cx >= b.x0 && cx <= b.x1 && cy >= b.y0 && cy <= b.y1) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  // --- Touchdown placement ---------------------------------------------------
  /** Touchdown placement zone of a card: 'quarter' (troops, buildings, Royal Delivery), 'half'
   *  (Miner, Goblin Drill, The Log, Graveyard, Barbarian Barrel, Goblin Barrel), 'anywhere' (spells). */
  Arena.tdZoneKind = function (card) {
    const c = cardOf(card);
    const TD = CR.RULES.touchdown;
    const id = c ? c.id : (typeof card === 'string' ? card : '');
    if (TD.halfLineCards.indexOf(id) >= 0) return 'half';
    if (TD.quarterLineSpells.indexOf(id) >= 0) return 'quarter';
    const kind = Arena.placementKind(c);
    if (kind === 'anywhere') return 'anywhere';
    if (kind === 'anywhere-ground') return 'half';
    return 'quarter';
  };
  /** Deploy limit (y) of a touchdown zone kind for `side`: side 0 deploys at y < line, side 1 at y >= line. */
  Arena.tdLine = function (side, kind) {
    const TD = CR.RULES.touchdown;
    const l = kind === 'half' ? TD.halfLine : (kind === 'anywhere' ? Arena.H : TD.quarterLine);
    return side === 1 ? Arena.H - l : l;
  };
  function tdInZone(side, kind, y) {
    if (kind === 'anywhere') return true;
    const l = Arena.tdLine(side, kind);
    return side === 1 ? y >= l : y < l;
  }
  /** Touchdown check of one tile centre: zone, plateau (troops / buildings only), blocking buildings. */
  function tdTileOk(side, kind, spell, tunnel, cx, cy, blocks) {
    if (!tdInZone(side, kind, cy)) return 'zone';
    if (spell) return null;
    if (!tunnel && Arena.RIDGE && Arena.inRiverBand(cy)) return 'hill';
    if (tileBlocked(blocks, cx, cy)) return 'blocked';
    return null;
  }
  function tdGrid(side, sim, card) {
    const c = cardOf(card);
    const C = Arena.COLS, Rw = Arena.ROWS;
    const grid = new Uint8Array(C * Rw);
    const kind = Arena.tdZoneKind(c), spell = !!(c && c.type === 'spell');
    const blocks = spell ? null : Arena.blockRects(sim, true);
    const tunnel = Arena.placementKind(c) === 'anywhere-ground';
    const bld = !spell && !!(c && c.type === 'building');
    for (let ty = 0; ty < Rw; ty++) for (let tx = 0; tx < C; tx++) grid[ty * C + tx] = tdTileOk(side, kind, spell, tunnel, tx + 0.5, ty + 0.5, blocks) || (bld && nearHole(tx + 0.5, ty + 0.5)) ? 0 : 1;
    return grid;
  }
  function tdCheck(side, x, y, c, sim) {
    const p = Arena.snap(x, y, c);
    const kind = Arena.tdZoneKind(c), spell = !!(c && c.type === 'spell');
    const blocks = spell ? null : Arena.blockRects(sim, true);
    const tunnel = Arena.placementKind(c) === 'anywhere-ground';
    const f = !spell && c && c.type === 'building' ? Arena.footprintOf(c) : 0;
    if (f > 0) {
      const x0 = p.x - f / 2, y0 = p.y - f / 2;
      for (let iy = 0; iy < f; iy++) for (let ix = 0; ix < f; ix++) {
        const r = tdTileOk(side, kind, false, false, x0 + ix + 0.5, y0 + iy + 0.5, blocks) || (nearHole(x0 + ix + 0.5, y0 + iy + 0.5) ? 'blocked' : null);
        if (r) return { ok: false, reason: r, x: p.x, y: p.y };
      }
      return { ok: true, reason: null, x: p.x, y: p.y };
    }
    const r = tdTileOk(side, kind, spell, tunnel, p.x, p.y, blocks);
    return r ? { ok: false, reason: r, x: p.x, y: p.y } : { ok: true, reason: null, x: p.x, y: p.y };
  }

  /** Deployability of every tile for a card category. Uint8Array(COLS*ROWS), index y*COLS+x. */
  Arena.deployGrid = function (side, sim, card) {
    if (Arena.touchdown) return tdGrid(side, sim, card);
    const kind = Arena.placementKind(card);
    const C = Arena.COLS, Rw = Arena.ROWS;
    const grid = new Uint8Array(C * Rw);
    if (kind === 'anywhere') { grid.fill(1); return grid; }
    const blocks = Arena.blockRects(sim, true);
    const zone = kind === 'anywhere-ground' ? null : Arena.zoneRects(side, sim, kind === 'building' && !CR.RULES.arena.buildingsInPocket);
    for (let ty = 0; ty < Rw; ty++) {
      for (let tx = 0; tx < C; tx++) {
        const cx = tx + 0.5, cy = ty + 0.5;
        let ok;
        if (kind === 'anywhere-ground') ok = !Arena.isWater(cx, cy);
        else ok = inRects(zone, cx, cy) && !Arena.inRiverBand(cy);
        if (ok && tileBlocked(blocks, cx, cy)) ok = false;
        if (ok && kind === 'building' && nearHole(cx, cy)) ok = false;
        grid[ty * C + tx] = ok ? 1 : 0;
      }
    }
    return grid;
  };

  /** Deployable area as a union of disjoint tile rects (rows merged into runs, runs merged vertically). */
  Arena.deployZones = function (side, sim, card) {
    const grid = Arena.deployGrid(side, sim, card);
    const C = Arena.COLS, Rw = Arena.ROWS;
    const done = [];
    let prev = new Map();
    for (let ty = 0; ty < Rw; ty++) {
      const cur = new Map();
      let tx = 0;
      while (tx < C) {
        if (!grid[ty * C + tx]) { tx++; continue; }
        let ex = tx;
        while (ex < C && grid[ty * C + ex]) ex++;
        const key = tx + ',' + ex;
        const r = prev.get(key);
        if (r) { r.y1 = ty + 1; cur.set(key, r); prev.delete(key); }
        else cur.set(key, { x0: tx, y0: ty, x1: ex, y1: ty + 1 });
        tx = ex;
      }
      prev.forEach(function (r) { done.push(r); });
      prev = cur;
    }
    prev.forEach(function (r) { done.push(r); });
    done.sort(function (a, b) { return a.y0 - b.y0 || a.x0 - b.x0; });
    return done;
  };

  /**
   * v12 tunnel map: buildings keep a lane free next to every hole (no tile centre within
   * HOLE_CLEAR of a hole square), so a building and a hole never form a dead end troops cannot pass.
   */
  const HOLE_CLEAR = 1.6;
  function nearHole(cx, cy) {
    const T = Arena.TUNNEL;
    if (!T) return false;
    for (let i = 0; i < T.holes.length; i++) {
      const h = T.holes[i];
      if (CR.boxDist(cx, cy, h.x - h.r, h.y - h.r, h.x + h.r, h.y + h.r) <= HOLE_CLEAR + 1e-9) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  Arena.nearHole = nearHole;

  /** Reason for the middle band: river (classic), hill (plateau) or plain zone (flat tunnel map). */
  function bandReason() { return Arena.hasRiver ? 'river' : (Arena.RIDGE ? 'hill' : 'zone'); }

  /**
   * Full placement check. Returns {ok, reason, x, y} with the snapped position.
   * reason: 'bounds' | 'zone' | 'river' | 'hill' (plateau band of the hill map) | 'blocked'
   */
  Arena.checkDeploy = function (side, x, y, card, sim) {
    const c = cardOf(card);
    if (!(x >= 0 && x <= Arena.W && y >= 0 && y <= Arena.H) || !isFinite(x) || !isFinite(y)) return { ok: false, reason: 'bounds', x: x, y: y };
    if (Arena.touchdown) return tdCheck(side, x, y, c, sim);
    const p = Arena.snap(x, y, c);
    const kind = Arena.placementKind(c);
    if (kind === 'anywhere') return { ok: true, reason: null, x: p.x, y: p.y };
    const blocks = Arena.blockRects(sim, true);
    if (kind === 'anywhere-ground') {
      if (Arena.isWater(p.x, p.y)) return { ok: false, reason: 'river', x: p.x, y: p.y };
      if (tileBlocked(blocks, p.x, p.y)) return { ok: false, reason: 'blocked', x: p.x, y: p.y };
      return { ok: true, reason: null, x: p.x, y: p.y };
    }
    const zone = Arena.zoneRects(side, sim, kind === 'building' && !CR.RULES.arena.buildingsInPocket);
    const f = kind === 'building' ? Arena.footprintOf(c) : 0;
    if (f > 0) {
      // Every footprint tile must be inside the zone, off the river and unblocked.
      const x0 = p.x - f / 2, y0 = p.y - f / 2;
      for (let iy = 0; iy < f; iy++) {
        for (let ix = 0; ix < f; ix++) {
          const cx = x0 + ix + 0.5, cy = y0 + iy + 0.5;
          if (Arena.inRiverBand(cy)) return { ok: false, reason: bandReason(), x: p.x, y: p.y };
          if (!inRects(zone, cx, cy)) return { ok: false, reason: 'zone', x: p.x, y: p.y };
          if (tileBlocked(blocks, cx, cy) || nearHole(cx, cy)) return { ok: false, reason: 'blocked', x: p.x, y: p.y };
        }
      }
      return { ok: true, reason: null, x: p.x, y: p.y };
    }
    if (Arena.inRiverBand(p.y)) return { ok: false, reason: bandReason(), x: p.x, y: p.y };
    if (!inRects(zone, p.x, p.y)) return { ok: false, reason: 'zone', x: p.x, y: p.y };
    if (tileBlocked(blocks, p.x, p.y)) return { ok: false, reason: 'blocked', x: p.x, y: p.y };
    return { ok: true, reason: null, x: p.x, y: p.y };
  };

  Arena.isDeployable = function (side, x, y, card, sim) {
    return Arena.checkDeploy(side, x, y, card, sim).ok;
  };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Ground routing
  //
  // Stateless geometry plus an optional per-troop memory `nav` (see Arena.newNav) that adds
  // hysteresis: a troop commits to one bridge and to one side of every obstacle it walks
  // around, so it never flip-flops between two nearly equal routes (the v2 "units jitter /
  // get stuck behind the princess tower" bug: big troops oscillated forever at a corner).
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const tmpA = { x: 0, y: 0 };
  // Scratch buffers of the corner search (no allocations per call).
  const CX = new Float64Array(4), CY = new Float64Array(4);
  const CVALID = new Uint8Array(4), CFROM = new Uint8Array(4), CTO = new Uint8Array(4);
  const SIDE_COST = new Float64Array(3), SIDE_FIRST = new Int8Array(3);

  /** Fresh routing memory for a troop (stored on the entity, owned by the router). */
  Arena.newNav = function () { return { rect: null, side: 0, bridge: -1 }; };

  function bridgeCost(b, px, py, r, gx, gy) {
    const lo = b.x0 + Math.min(r, (b.x1 - b.x0) / 2), hi = b.x1 - Math.min(r, (b.x1 - b.x0) / 2);
    const ex = CR.clamp(px, lo, hi), xx = CR.clamp(gx, lo, hi);
    const north = gy > py;
    const ey = north ? b.y0 : b.y1, oy = north ? b.y1 : b.y0;
    return CR.dist(px, py, ex, ey) + Math.abs(oy - ey) + CR.dist(xx, oy, gx, gy);
  }

  /** Pick the bridge minimising |p - entry| + |exit - g| (with hysteresis when nav is given). */
  function bestBridge(px, py, r, gx, gy, nav) {
    let best = null, bestCost = Infinity;
    const bs = Arena.BRIDGES;
    for (let i = 0; i < bs.length; i++) {
      const cost = bridgeCost(bs[i], px, py, r, gx, gy);
      if (cost < bestCost - 1e-9) { bestCost = cost; best = bs[i]; }
    }
    if (nav && best) {
      const cur = nav.bridge >= 0 && nav.bridge < bs.length ? bs[nav.bridge] : null;
      if (cur && cur !== best && bridgeCost(cur, px, py, r, gx, gy) <= bestCost + CR.RULES.routing.bridgeHysteresis) best = cur;
      nav.bridge = best.index;
    }
    return best;
  }
  Arena.bestBridge = bestBridge;

  /**
   * Next waypoint for a ground troop of radius r at p heading to goal g.
   * jumps: troop can leap the river (Hog Rider etc.) -> no bridge constraint. On a map without a
   * river (hill) nobody needs a bridge: the ridge is crossed anywhere.
   * rects: static rects to walk around (alive tower footprints, buildings) - may be null.
   * nav: optional per-troop memory from Arena.newNav() (bridge + detour side hysteresis).
   */
  Arena.waypoint = function (px, py, r, gx, gy, jumps, rects, out, nav) {
    let wx = gx, wy = gy;
    const rv = Arena.RIVER;
    if (!jumps && Arena.hasRiver) {
      const hp = Arena.halfOf(py), hg = Arena.halfOf(gy);
      const margin = 0.05;
      if (hp === -1) {
        // On a bridge (or pushed into the band): head for the far bank inside the corridor.
        const on = Arena.bridgeAt(px);
        const b = on || bestBridge(px, py, r, gx, gy, nav);
        if (nav) nav.bridge = b.index;
        const lo = b.x0 + Math.min(r, (b.x1 - b.x0) / 2), hi = b.x1 - Math.min(r, (b.x1 - b.x0) / 2);
        // Walk straight across (own x inside the corridor): a troop pushed sideways on the bridge
        // is never pulled back behind the troop in front of it.
        if (hg === 1) { wx = CR.clamp(px, lo, hi); wy = rv.y1 + margin; }
        else if (hg === 0) { wx = CR.clamp(px, lo, hi); wy = rv.y0 - margin; }
        else { wx = CR.clamp(gx, lo, hi); wy = gy; }
        // Displaced over the water: move straight back onto the bridge first.
        if (!on && (px < lo - 1e-6 || px > hi + 1e-6)) { wx = CR.clamp(px, lo, hi); wy = py; }
        out.x = wx; out.y = wy;
        if (nav) nav.rect = null;
        return out;
      }
      const crossing = (hp === 0 && hg !== 0) || (hp === 1 && hg !== 1);
      if (crossing) {
        let b;
        if (hg === -1) b = Arena.bridgeAt(gx) || bestBridge(px, py, r, gx, gy, nav);
        else b = bestBridge(px, py, r, gx, gy, nav);
        if (nav) nav.bridge = b.index;
        const lo = b.x0 + Math.min(r, (b.x1 - b.x0) / 2), hi = b.x1 - Math.min(r, (b.x1 - b.x0) / 2);
        wx = CR.clamp(px, lo, hi);
        wy = hp === 0 ? rv.y0 + margin : rv.y1 - margin;
      } else if (nav) nav.bridge = -1;
    }
    if (rects && rects.length) detour(px, py, r, wx, wy, rects, out, nav);
    else { out.x = wx; out.y = wy; if (nav) nav.rect = null; }
    return out;
  };

  function insideAny(rects, skip, x, y, ri) {
    for (let i = 0; i < rects.length; i++) {
      const b = rects[i];
      if (b === skip) continue;
      if (x > b.x0 - ri && x < b.x1 + ri && y > b.y0 - ri && y < b.y1 + ri) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  // Blocking rects along the current path, in path order (scratch, no allocations).
  const HIT_R = [null, null, null], HIT_T = new Float64Array(3), HIT_E = new Float64Array(3);

  /**
   * If p->w is blocked by a rect (inflated by r), replace w by the next corner of the
   * shortest way around the FIRST blocking rect along the path. Both ways round (counter-
   * clockwise / clockwise) are costed as p -> visible corner -> corners along that side ->
   * corner that sees w -> w; with `nav` the troop keeps its side (RULES.routing.sideHysteresis).
   * Corners off the arena, in the water or inside another obstacle are never used; when the
   * first rect has no way round at all (e.g. a building flush against a tower), the next
   * blocking rect along the path is routed around instead, so the troop never walks into
   * the dead end.
   */
  function detour(px, py, r, wx, wy, rects, out, nav) {
    const RT = CR.RULES.routing;
    const ri = r - RT.shrink;
    let nh = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < rects.length; i++) {
      const b = rects[i];
      const x0 = b.x0 - ri, y0 = b.y0 - ri, x1 = b.x1 + ri, y1 = b.y1 + ri;
      // Goal inside this rect (e.g. the target building itself) -> walking straight is right.
      if (wx > x0 && wx < x1 && wy > y0 && wy < y1) continue;
      let t, e = ri;
      if (px > x0 && px < x1 && py > y0 && py < y1) {
        // Pushed into the clearance band: blocked only if the path cuts deeper into the rect.
        // The band is measured per axis (the box inflated by e must not contain p).
        const ox = px < b.x0 ? b.x0 - px : (px > b.x1 ? px - b.x1 : 0);
        const oy = py < b.y0 ? b.y0 - py : (py > b.y1 ? py - b.y1 : 0);
        const d = ox > oy ? ox : oy;
        if (d < 1e-3) continue;   // centre inside the rect itself: collision resolves it
        e = d - 0.01;
        if (!CR.segRect(px, py, wx, wy, b.x0 - e, b.y0 - e, b.x1 + e, b.y1 + e)) continue;
        t = 0;
      } else {
        t = CR.segRectT(px, py, wx, wy, x0, y0, x1, y1);
        if (t < 0) continue;
      }
      // Keep the 3 earliest hits sorted by t.
      let k = nh < 3 ? nh++ : 3;
      if (k === 3) { if (t >= HIT_T[2]) continue; k = 2; }
      while (k > 0 && HIT_T[k - 1] > t) { HIT_T[k] = HIT_T[k - 1]; HIT_R[k] = HIT_R[k - 1]; HIT_E[k] = HIT_E[k - 1]; k--; }
      HIT_T[k] = t; HIT_R[k] = b; HIT_E[k] = e;
    }
    for (let h = 0; h < nh; h++) {
      const hit = HIT_R[h];
      HIT_R[h] = null;
      if (aroundRect(px, py, r, ri, wx, wy, rects, hit, HIT_E[h], out, nav)) {
        for (let j = h + 1; j < nh; j++) HIT_R[j] = null;
        return out;
      }
    }
    if (nav) nav.rect = null;
    out.x = wx; out.y = wy;
    return out;
  }

  /** Way round one blocking rect (see detour). Returns false when neither side is passable. */
  function aroundRect(px, py, r, ri, wx, wy, rects, hit, hitE, out, nav) {
    const RT = CR.RULES.routing;
    const pad = r + RT.cornerPad;
    const W = Arena.W, H = Arena.H;
    const x0 = hit.x0 - ri, y0 = hit.y0 - ri, x1 = hit.x1 + ri, y1 = hit.y1 + ri;
    const ex0 = hit.x0 - hitE, ey0 = hit.y0 - hitE, ex1 = hit.x1 + hitE, ey1 = hit.y1 + hitE;
    // Corners in counter-clockwise order (y up): bottom-left, bottom-right, top-right, top-left.
    CX[0] = hit.x0 - pad; CY[0] = hit.y0 - pad;
    CX[1] = hit.x1 + pad; CY[1] = hit.y0 - pad;
    CX[2] = hit.x1 + pad; CY[2] = hit.y1 + pad;
    CX[3] = hit.x0 - pad; CY[3] = hit.y1 + pad;
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      const cx = CX[i], cy = CY[i];
      const ok = cx >= r - 1e-6 && cx <= W - r + 1e-6 && cy >= r - 1e-6 && cy <= H - r + 1e-6 &&
        !Arena.isWater(cx, cy) && !insideAny(rects, hit, cx, cy, ri);
      CVALID[i] = ok ? 1 : 0;
      // Standing on a corner: it is not a waypoint any more (go on to the next one).
      CFROM[i] = ok && CR.dist2(px, py, cx, cy) > 0.0025 && !CR.segRect(px, py, cx, cy, ex0, ey0, ex1, ey1) ? 1 : 0;
      CTO[i] = ok && !CR.segRect(cx, cy, wx, wy, x0, y0, x1, y1) ? 1 : 0;
    }
    // Standing on a corner that already sees the goal: just walk on (the collision slide
    // handles a grazing touch) - never send the troop the long way round instead.
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      if (CVALID[i] && CTO[i] && !CFROM[i] && CR.dist2(px, py, CX[i], CY[i]) <= 0.0025) {
        if (nav) nav.rect = null;
        out.x = wx; out.y = wy; return true;
      }
    }
    // Shortest way round on each side: s = +1 counter-clockwise, s = -1 clockwise (index s + 1).
    for (let s = -1; s <= 1; s += 2) {
      let best = Infinity, first = -1;
      for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
        if (!CFROM[k]) continue;
        let acc = CR.dist(px, py, CX[k], CY[k]), j = k;
        for (let m = 0; m < 4; m++) {
          if (CTO[j]) {
            const c = acc + CR.dist(CX[j], CY[j], wx, wy);
            if (c < best - 1e-9) { best = c; first = k; }
            break;
          }
          const nj = (j + s + 4) & 3;
          if (!CVALID[nj]) break;
          acc += CR.dist(CX[j], CY[j], CX[nj], CY[nj]);
          j = nj;
        }
      }
      SIDE_COST[s + 1] = best; SIDE_FIRST[s + 1] = first;
    }
    let side = 0;
    const ccw = SIDE_COST[2], cw = SIDE_COST[0];
    if (nav && nav.rect === hit && nav.side !== 0 && SIDE_FIRST[nav.side + 1] >= 0 &&
        SIDE_COST[nav.side + 1] <= SIDE_COST[1 - nav.side] + RT.sideHysteresis) side = nav.side;
    else if (SIDE_FIRST[2] >= 0 || SIDE_FIRST[0] >= 0) side = ccw <= cw ? 1 : -1;
    if (side === 0) return false;
    if (nav) { nav.rect = hit; nav.side = side; }
    const k = SIDE_FIRST[side + 1];
    out.x = CX[k]; out.y = CY[k];
    return true;
  }
  Arena.detour = detour;

  /** Push a circle out of a rect; returns true if moved. Writes into out {x,y}. */
  Arena.pushOutOfRect = function (x, y, r, b, out) {
    CR.boxClosest(x, y, b.x0, b.y0, b.x1, b.y1, tmpA);
    let dx = x - tmpA.x, dy = y - tmpA.y;
    const d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    if (d2 >= r * r) return false;
    if (d2 > 1e-12) {
      const d = Math.sqrt(d2), k = (r - d) / d;
      out.x = x + dx * k; out.y = y + dy * k;
      return true;
    }
    // Centre inside the rect: leave through the nearest edge.
    const l = x - b.x0, rr = b.x1 - x, dn = y - b.y0, up = b.y1 - y;
    const m = Math.min(l, rr, dn, up);
    out.x = x; out.y = y;
    if (m === l) out.x = b.x0 - r; else if (m === rr) out.x = b.x1 + r; else if (m === dn) out.y = b.y0 - r; else out.y = b.y1 + r;
    return true;
  };

  Arena.rebuild();
})(globalThis.CR || (globalThis.CR = {}));

</script>
<script>
/* src/03-sim.js */
/* Chaos Royale - 03-sim.js (engine)
 * CR.Sim: deterministic battle simulation (1v1 or 2v2). Fixed tick of CR.DT seconds.
 *
 *   const sim = new CR.Sim({ seed, mode: 'classic'|'chaos'|'touchdown', map: 'classic'|'hill'|'tunnel',
 *     players: [{ name, deck, side: 0|1, bot }],     // 2 (1v1) or 4 (2v2) players
 *     // legacy 1v1 form: decks: [deck0, deck1], names: [n0, n1]  (player i = side i)
 *     options });
 *   sim.tick(); sim.command(player, cmd); sim.canPlay(player, hand, x, y); sim.view(); sim.drainEvents();
 *   sim.over; sim.winner (team side 0 | 1 | 'draw' | null)
 *
 * v5 players / teams (docs/V5.md): every PLAYER (index i) has its own deck, hand, queue, elixir
 * and C.H.A.O.S upgrades; the SIDE (team colour 0 blue / 1 red) owns towers, crowns, deploy zone
 * and decides friend / foe. In 1v1 player index == side, so every legacy code path is unchanged.
 * 2v2: two players per side share the side's towers and crowns (players[i].crowns = team crowns,
 * sim.crowns[side]). Units carry `side` (team) and `owner` (player index, view `owner`); owners are
 * tracked through an acting-player context (sim._owner, see ownerFor) so death spawns, spawner
 * waves, projectiles, areas and C.H.A.O.S effects keep the player who played the card.
 * When the side lists do not balance (1+1 / 2+2), sides fall back to i % 2.
 * Map: cfg.map -> CR.Arena.setMap (global arena state, re-asserted at every tick / canPlay).
 *
 * Tick order (per tick): commands -> elixir -> clock -> deploy completions ->
 * units/towers AI (+ collision) -> projectiles -> areas -> deaths/death effects ->
 * crowns/king activation -> win check -> events.
 *
 * Time semantics: tick k advances sim.time from (k-1)*dt to k*dt. Commands are applied
 * at the start of the tick (time (k-1)*dt). A unit placed then with deploy time D acts for
 * the first time in the tick covering (t0 + D, t0 + D + dt].
 *
 * C.H.A.O.S hooks on sim.chaos (all optional): paused() -> bool (pick pause: ticks count, game
 *   time is frozen, sim.pausedTicks), tick(), tierOf(side, cardId), castSpell(side, card, x, y, tier)
 *   -> true when handled, summon(side, card, x, y, tier) -> units | null, validate(side, cmd), view(side).
 *
 * Options (tests/app): { startElixir, clockScale, shuffle: false, infiniteElixir,
 *   kingsActive, regulation, overtime, speed, bots: [playerIndex...], elixirBoost }
 *   v13 elixirBoost ("Schnelles Elixier", menu / host lobby): elixir regenerates that many times
 *   faster in every phase (number 1..3, default 1; the app sends 1.5). sim.elixirBoost; it
 *   multiplies the phase rate (sim.elixirMult: 1x / 2x / 3x) and the C.H.A.O.S +50 %
 *   (06-chaos.js scales its extra by sim.elixirBoost), so all three combine multiplicatively.
 *
 * v6 TOUCHDOWN (docs/TOUCHDOWN.md, CR.RULES.touchdown in 02-arena.js): mode 'touchdown' (1v1 / 2v2,
 *   maps 'classic' = Touchdown field, 'hill' = field + v5 ridge). No crown towers (sim.towers = [],
 *   view.towers = []); a troop (air too, never a building) whose centre reaches the enemy end zone
 *   scores a touchdown = a crown: events {t:'touchdown', side, player, unitId, unit, card, x, y, score}
 *   + {t:'crown'}; the field is cleared at once (troops, buildings, projectiles, areas; no death
 *   effects), elixir kept, pending plays cancelled (card stays in hand), event {t:'td_reset', resetIn,
 *   score}; plays are refused ('td_reset') for RULES.touchdown.resetPause s, then {t:'td_resume'}.
 *   First to `target` (3) wins at once ('touchdown'); after regulation the higher score wins
 *   ('time'); tied -> overtime where the next touchdown wins ('sudden_death'); still tied -> 'draw'.
 *   C.H.A.O.S upgrades only with options.chaos === true (sim.chaosOn). Banned cards:
 *   Sim.cardAllowed(cardId, mode) (also used by sanitizeDeck(deck, mode) and canPlay: 'card_banned').
 *   view.mode; view.touchdown = { score: [s0, s1], target, lastScore: {side, player, unitId, x, y} |
 *   null, resetIn, endZones: [rect side 0, rect side 1] }. sim.launchOrigin(side) = where spells /
 *   tunnels start (King Tower, or the middle of the own back line in touchdown);
 *   sim.touchdownGoal(u, out) = where a troop without target walks (straight into the end zone).
 *
 * v7 CHAMPIONS (docs/V7-CARDS.md, Clash Royale champion rules): a card with rarity 'champion' (its
 *   main unit has special.ability) puts ONE champion on the field per player; while it lives the
 *   card does not cycle (it leaves hand + queue and returns to the back of the queue when the
 *   champion dies or is removed by a touchdown reset), a second champion card cannot be played
 *   ('champion_active'), a deck holds at most one champion (sanitizeDeck). The owner may activate
 *   the ability: command {type:'champion_ability'} (validated: champion alive and deployed, no
 *   ability running, cooldown over, elixir incl. queued plays; reasons no_champion,
 *   champion_deploying, champion_busy, champion_cooldown, not_enough_elixir, chaos_pause), applied
 *   next tick: pays `ability.cost` elixir, starts the cooldown (game seconds, frozen in C.H.A.O.S
 *   pauses) and calls CR.Units.championAbility (events {t:'ability', kind:'champion_slash',
 *   phase:'windup'|'launch', unitId, x, y, tx, ty, ...}). sim.players[i].champion = { unit, unitId,
 *   card, cooldownLeft } | null. view.players[i].champion = { unitId, card, unit, name, ready, cost,
 *   cooldown, cooldownLeft, active, deploying, canUse } | null (ready = deployed, nothing running,
 *   cooldown over; canUse = ready + enough elixir). view.units[k].champion = true for it,
 *   .ability = kind while the wind-up runs. Events {t:'champion', player, side, unitId, card,
 *   phase:'deploy'|'down'}.
 *
 * v12 TUNNEL map (docs/V12-TUNNEL.md, geometry CR.Arena.TUNNEL, behaviour CR.Units): mode 'classic' =
 *   classic rules without C.H.A.O.S (also on 'tunnel'); every mode runs on every map. Troops in the
 *   tunnel carry u.underground (+ u.tunnelTo = exit hole); view.units[k].tunnel = true, projectiles /
 *   areas made underground carry .tunnel = true; view.towers[k].depth (king 2.5). Events
 *   {t:'tunnel', phase:'enter'|'exit', unitId, side, unit, hole, x, y}. Spawns of an underground
 *   troop start underground (spawnUnit), areas created underground act underground (addArea +
 *   _updateAreas), death effects of underground troops stay underground; underground troops never
 *   score a touchdown.
 *
 * Helpers used by the other engine modules / C.H.A.O.S:
 *   sim.spawnUnit(side, unitId, x, y, opts) -> entity    sim.addArea(area) -> area
 *   sim.addElixir(player, amount, src) (src.owner wins when src is a unit)  sim.kingOf(side)
 *   sim.activateKing(side, reason)  sim.ownerFor(side)  sim.playersOf(side) -> [player indices]
 *   sim.damage(target, amount, src, kind)  sim.emit(type, data)  sim.newId()
 *   sim.units (troops+buildings), sim.towers, sim.projectiles, sim.areas, sim.players, sim.rng
 *   sim.staticRects (this tick's movement obstacles: tower footprints `t.col`, buildings, obstacles)
 *   sim.hooks = { onUnitSpawn, onAttack, onDamage, onDeath, onTick, modifyStats } (lists)
 */
(function (CR) {
  'use strict';

  const EPS = 1e-6;

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Card lookup
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  let cardSrc = null, cardMap = null;
  function cardsList() {
    const D = CR.DATA || {};
    let cards = D.cards || [];
    if (!Array.isArray(cards) && typeof cards === 'object') cards = Object.keys(cards).map(function (k) { return cards[k]; });
    return cards;
  }
  function cardIndex() {
    const D = CR.DATA || {};
    if (cardMap && cardSrc === D.cards) return cardMap;
    cardMap = new Map();
    for (const c of cardsList()) if (c && c.id) cardMap.set(c.id, c);
    cardSrc = D.cards;
    return cardMap;
  }

  const REASONS = {
    game_over: 'Das Spiel ist vorbei',
    not_enough_elixir: 'Nicht genug Elixier!',
    invalid_zone: 'Hier kannst du das nicht platzieren',
    invalid_river: 'Nicht auf den Fluss',
    invalid_hill: 'Nicht auf den Hügel',
    blocked_place: 'Hier ist kein Platz',
    out_of_bounds: 'Außerhalb der Arena',
    bad_hand_slot: 'Karte nicht verfügbar',
    card_changed: 'Karte nicht verfügbar',
    card_disabled: 'Karte nicht verfügbar',
    card_unknown: 'Karte nicht verfügbar',
    hand_slot_pending: 'Einen Moment …',
    bad_side: 'Ungültiger Spieler',
    bad_command: 'Ungültiger Befehl',
    chaos_unavailable: 'Nur im C.H.A.O.S-Modus',
    chaos_pause: 'Upgrade-Auswahl läuft …',
    chaos_no_offer: 'Gerade gibt es kein Upgrade-Angebot',
    card_banned: 'In Touchdown nicht erlaubt',
    champion_active: 'Dein Champion ist schon im Feld',
    no_champion: 'Kein Champion im Feld',
    champion_deploying: 'Dein Champion kommt gerade erst an',
    champion_busy: 'Die Fähigkeit läuft gerade',
    champion_cooldown: 'Die Fähigkeit lädt noch',
    td_reset: 'Touchdown! Gleich geht es weiter …',
  };

  class Sim {
    constructor(cfg) {
      cfg = cfg || {};
      const opt = cfg.options || {};
      this.cfg = cfg;
      this.options = opt;
      this.seed = cfg.seed === undefined ? 1 : cfg.seed;
      this.mode = cfg.mode === 'touchdown' ? 'touchdown' : (cfg.mode === 'chaos' ? 'chaos' : 'classic');
      // C.H.A.O.S upgrades: always in 'chaos', in 'touchdown' only with options.chaos === true.
      this.chaosOn = this.mode === 'chaos' || (this.mode === 'touchdown' && (opt.chaos === true || (opt.chaos === undefined && CR.RULES.touchdown.chaosDefault === true)));
      this.arenaMode = this.mode === 'touchdown' ? 'touchdown' : 'standard';
      this.map = CR.Arena.setMap(cfg.map || CR.RULES.arena.defaultMap || 'classic', this.arenaMode);
      this.rng = CR.rng(this.seed);
      this._owner = -1;       // acting player context (see ownerFor)
      this.dt = CR.DT;
      this.tickNo = 0;
      this.pausedTicks = 0;   // C.H.A.O.S pick pauses: ticks that did not advance game time
      this.time = 0;
      this.tickStart = -this.dt;
      this._id = 100;
      this.seq = 0;
      this.pendingEvents = [];
      this.tickEvents = [];
      this.lastTickEvents = [];
      this.cmdQueue = [];
      this.over = false;
      this.winner = null;
      this.endReason = null;
      this.hooks = { onUnitSpawn: [], onAttack: [], onDamage: [], onDeath: [], onTick: [], modifyStats: [] };
      this.units = [];
      this.projectiles = [];
      this.areas = [];
      this.staticRects = [];
      this.stats = [{ elixirSpent: 0, elixirLeaked: 0, played: 0, damage: 0 }, { elixirSpent: 0, elixirLeaked: 0, played: 0, damage: 0 }];

      // Rules for this battle (clock scaled for tests).
      const RC = CR.RULES.clock, RE = CR.RULES.elixir, TD = CR.RULES.touchdown;
      const isTd = this.mode === 'touchdown';
      const cs = typeof opt.clockScale === 'number' && opt.clockScale > 0 ? opt.clockScale : 1;
      this.clockCfg = {
        regulation: (typeof opt.regulation === 'number' ? opt.regulation : (isTd ? TD.regulation : RC.regulation)) * cs,
        overtime: (typeof opt.overtime === 'number' ? opt.overtime : (isTd ? TD.overtime : RC.overtime)) * cs,
        segments: RC.segments.map(function (s) { return { from: s.from * cs, phase: s.phase, mult: s.mult }; }),
        otSegments: RC.overtimeSegments.map(function (s) { return { from: s.from * cs, phase: s.phase, mult: s.mult }; }),
      };
      this.overtime = false;
      this.phase = this.clockCfg.segments[0].phase;
      this.elixirMult = this.clockCfg.segments[0].mult;
      this.elixirBoost = Sim.elixirBoostOf(opt.elixirBoost);   // v13 Schnelles Elixier

      // Touchdown state (null in the tower modes).
      this.touchdown = isTd ? {
        score: [0, 0],
        target: typeof opt.tdTarget === 'number' && opt.tdTarget > 0 ? opt.tdTarget : TD.target,
        resetPause: typeof opt.tdResetPause === 'number' && opt.tdResetPause >= 0 ? opt.tdResetPause : TD.resetPause,
        resetLeft: 0,
        lastScore: null,
        rounds: 1,
      } : null;

      // Towers (none in touchdown).
      this.towers = isTd ? [] : CR.Arena.towerLayout().map((L) => CR.Units.createTower(this, L));
      if (opt.kingsActive) for (const t of this.towers) if (t.towerKind === 'king') t.active = true;

      // Players + card cycle (in player order: the 1v1 rng stream is unchanged).
      const pcfg = Sim.normalizePlayers(cfg);
      this.teamSize = pcfg.length >= 4 ? 2 : 1;
      this.crowns = [0, 0];
      this.sidePlayers = [[], []];
      this.players = pcfg.map((pc, i) => {
        const deck = Sim.sanitizeDeck(pc.deck, this.mode);
        const order = deck.slice();
        if (opt.shuffle !== false) this.rng.shuffle(order);
        const hs = CR.RULES.cards.handSize;
        this.sidePlayers[pc.side].push(i);
        return {
          index: i,
          side: pc.side,
          name: pc.name,
          deck: deck,
          hand: order.slice(0, hs),
          queue: order.slice(hs),
          elixir: typeof opt.startElixir === 'number' ? opt.startElixir : RE.start,
          crowns: 0,
          chaos: null,
          champion: null,   // v7: { unit, unitId, card, cooldownLeft } while the champion lives
          bot: !!pc.bot,
          stats: { elixirSpent: 0, played: 0 },
        };
      });
      for (const t of this.towers) t.owner = this.sidePlayers[t.side][0];

      // C.H.A.O.S module attaches itself (it fills sim.hooks and owns sim.chaos).
      this.chaos = null;
      if (this.chaosOn && CR.Chaos) {
        const C = CR.Chaos;
        let r = null;
        if (typeof C.attach === 'function') r = C.attach(this);
        else if (typeof C.init === 'function') r = C.init(this);
        else if (typeof C.create === 'function') r = C.create(this);
        else if (typeof C === 'function') r = new C(this);
        if (r && typeof r === 'object' && !this.chaos) this.chaos = r;
        // Stat hooks registered by the mode also apply to the (still untouched) crown towers.
        if (this.hooks.modifyStats.length && this.tickNo === 0 && !isTd) {
          this.towers = CR.Arena.towerLayout().map((L) => CR.Units.createTower(this, L));
          if (opt.kingsActive) for (const t of this.towers) if (t.towerKind === 'king') t.active = true;
          for (const t of this.towers) t.owner = this.sidePlayers[t.side][0];
        }
      }
    }

    /**
     * Player list of a config: cfg.players (2 or 4 entries {name, deck, side, bot}) or the legacy
     * 1v1 form {decks, names}. Returns [{name, deck, side, bot}] with balanced sides (else i % 2).
     */
    static normalizePlayers(cfg) {
      cfg = cfg || {};
      const out = [];
      if (Array.isArray(cfg.players) && cfg.players.length >= 2) {
        const n = cfg.players.length >= 4 ? 4 : 2;
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          const p = cfg.players[i] || {};
          out.push({ name: String(p.name === undefined || p.name === null ? 'Spieler ' + (i + 1) : p.name), deck: p.deck, side: p.side === 1 ? 1 : (p.side === 0 ? 0 : -1), bot: !!p.bot });
        }
        let c0 = 0, c1 = 0;
        for (const p of out) { if (p.side === 0) c0++; else if (p.side === 1) c1++; }
        if (c0 !== n / 2 || c1 !== n / 2) for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) out[i].side = i % 2;
        return out;
      }
      const names = cfg.names || ['Spieler 1', 'Spieler 2'];
      const decks = cfg.decks || [];
      for (let side = 0; side < 2; side++) {
        out.push({ name: String(names[side] === undefined ? 'Spieler ' + (side + 1) : names[side]), deck: decks[side], side: side, bot: false });
      }
      return out;
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Static helpers
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    static cardById(id) { return cardIndex().get(id) || null; }
    static cards() { return cardsList(); }
    static enabledCards(mode) { return cardsList().filter(function (c) { return c && c.id && !c.disabled && Sim.cardAllowed(c.id, mode); }); }
    /** v13: valid elixir boost factor (finite 1..3, else 1). */
    static elixirBoostOf(v) { return typeof v === 'number' && v >= 1 && v <= 3 ? v : 1; }
    static reasonText(code) { return REASONS[code] || 'Hier nicht möglich'; }

    /**
     * May `cardId` be used in `mode` ('chaos' | 'touchdown' | 'classic')? False for unknown and
     * disabled cards and, in touchdown, for RULES.touchdown.banned (deck builder greys them out).
     */
    static cardAllowed(cardId, mode) {
      const c = Sim.cardById(cardId);
      if (!c || c.disabled) return false;
      if (mode === 'touchdown' && CR.RULES.touchdown.banned.indexOf(cardId) >= 0) return false;
      return true;
    }
    /** German reason why a card is not allowed in `mode` (null when allowed). */
    static cardBanReason(cardId, mode) {
      const c = Sim.cardById(cardId);
      if (!c || c.disabled) return REASONS.card_disabled;
      if (!Sim.cardAllowed(cardId, mode)) return REASONS.card_banned;
      return null;
    }

    /** 8 unique allowed card ids; unknown/disabled/duplicate ids (and, with mode 'touchdown', the
     *  banned cards) are replaced deterministically. */
    static sanitizeDeck(deck, mode) {
      const size = CR.RULES.cards.deckSize;
      const out = [];
      const seen = new Set();
      let champs = 0;   // v7: at most one champion per deck (Clash Royale rule)
      if (Array.isArray(deck)) {
        for (const id of deck) {
          if (!Sim.cardAllowed(id, mode) || seen.has(id) || out.length >= size) continue;
          if (Sim.isChampionCard(id)) { if (champs) continue; champs++; }
          out.push(id); seen.add(id);
        }
      }
      const pool = Sim.enabledCards(mode);
      for (let i = 0; i < pool.length && out.length < size; i++) {
        if (seen.has(pool[i].id)) continue;
        if (Sim.isChampionCard(pool[i].id)) { if (champs) continue; champs++; }
        out.push(pool[i].id); seen.add(pool[i].id);
      }
      return out;
    }

    /** v7: is `cardId` a champion card (rarity 'champion')? */
    static isChampionCard(cardId) {
      const c = typeof cardId === 'string' ? Sim.cardById(cardId) : cardId;
      return !!(c && c.rarity === 'champion');
    }
    /** v7: champion ability data of a card ({kind, name, cost, cooldown, ...}) or null. */
    static championAbility(cardId) {
      const c = typeof cardId === 'string' ? Sim.cardById(cardId) : cardId;
      if (!c || c.rarity !== 'champion' || !Array.isArray(c.summon) || !c.summon.length) return null;
      const u = CR.DATA.units[c.summon[0].unit];
      return u && u.special && u.special.ability ? u.special.ability : null;
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Module helpers
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    newId() { return ++this._id; }

    emit(type, data) {
      const e = Object.assign({ seq: ++this.seq, t: type, tick: this.tickNo }, data || {});
      // Bounded backlog when nobody drains (consumers dedupe by seq; view().events always has the latest tick).
      if (this.pendingEvents.length >= Sim.MAX_PENDING_EVENTS) this.pendingEvents.splice(0, this.pendingEvents.length >> 1);
      this.pendingEvents.push(e);
      this.tickEvents.push(e);
      return e;
    }

    /** Is `player` a valid player index of this battle? */
    isPlayer(player) { return typeof player === 'number' && player >= 0 && player < this.players.length && Math.floor(player) === player; }

    /** Player indices of a side (team). */
    playersOf(side) { return this.sidePlayers[side] || []; }

    /** Owner (player index) of an entity created now for `side`: the acting player when it
     *  belongs to that side, else the side's first player (in 1v1 always == side). */
    ownerFor(side) {
      const o = this._owner;
      if (o >= 0 && this.players && this.players[o] && this.players[o].side === side) return o;
      const l = this.sidePlayers && this.sidePlayers[side];
      return l && l.length ? l[0] : side;
    }

    /** Where spells / tunnels of `side` start: its King Tower, in touchdown (no towers) the middle
     *  of its own back line. */
    launchOrigin(side) {
      const k = this.kingOf(side);
      if (k) return k;
      if (this.touchdown) return { x: CR.Arena.W / 2, y: side === 1 ? CR.Arena.H : 0 };
      return null;
    }

    /**
     * Touchdown: where troop u walks without a target - straight ahead (own x) into the end zone
     * of the enemy (middle of its depth). Writes out {x, y}; false outside touchdown.
     */
    touchdownGoal(u, out) {
      if (!this.touchdown) return false;
      const z = CR.Arena.END_ZONES[1 - u.side];
      const r = u.r || 0.5;
      out.x = CR.clamp(u.x, r, CR.Arena.W - r);
      out.y = (z.y0 + z.y1) / 2;
      return true;
    }

    kingOf(side) {
      for (let i = 0; i < this.towers.length; i++) {
        const t = this.towers[i];
        if (t.side === side && t.towerKind === 'king') return t;
      }
      return null;
    }

    activateKing(side, reason) {
      const k = this.kingOf(side);
      if (!k || k.active || !k.alive) return false;
      k.active = true;
      k.activeAt = this.time + (k.s.activationDelay || 0);
      this.emit('king_active', { side: side, id: k.id, reason: reason || 'damage' });
      return true;
    }

    /** Give `amount` elixir to a player. With a unit `src` the unit's owner receives it (callers
     *  often pass the unit's side; in 2v2 the owner is the player who played the card). */
    addElixir(player, amount, src) {
      if (src && typeof src.owner === 'number' && this.isPlayer(src.owner)) player = src.owner;
      const p = this.players[player];
      if (!p || !(amount > 0)) return 0;
      const max = CR.RULES.elixir.max;
      const before = p.elixir;
      p.elixir = Math.min(max, p.elixir + amount);
      const gained = p.elixir - before;
      if (gained < amount) this.stats[p.side].elixirLeaked += amount - gained;
      // Production feedback as a zero-damage 'hit' of kind 'elixir' (renderer shows "+1").
      if (src) this.emit('hit', { id: src.id, src: src.id, side: p.side, player: player, x: CR.round(src.x, 2), y: CR.round(src.y, 2), dmg: 0, kind: 'elixir', elixir: amount, gained: CR.round(gained, 3) });
      return gained;
    }

    spawnUnit(side, unitId, x, y, opts) {
      if (!CR.DATA || !CR.DATA.units || !CR.DATA.units[unitId]) return null;
      const u = CR.Units.create(this, side, unitId, x, y, opts);
      // v12 tunnel: whatever an underground troop spawns (death spawns, spawner waves, clones)
      // starts underground too, heading for the same exit (else for the enemy-side hole).
      if (CR.Units.layer === 1 && CR.Arena.TUNNEL && !u.building && !u.air) {
        const src = CR.Units.layerSrc;
        const own = CR.Arena.ownHole(side);
        u.underground = true;
        u.tunnelPlan = -1;
        u.tunnelTo = src && src.underground && src.tunnelTo >= 0 ? src.tunnelTo : (own === 0 ? 1 : 0);
        const p = CR.Arena.clampTunnel(u.x, u.y, u.r, { x: 0, y: 0 });
        u.x = p.x; u.y = p.y;
      }
      this.units.push(u);
      const hs = this.hooks.onUnitSpawn;
      for (let i = 0; i < hs.length; i++) hs[i](u);
      return u;
    }

    /** Troop/building/tower by id (null if gone). */
    entity(id) {
      for (let i = 0; i < this.towers.length; i++) if (this.towers[i].id === id) return this.towers[i];
      for (let i = 0; i < this.units.length; i++) if (this.units[i].id === id) return this.units[i];
      return null;
    }

    addArea(a) {
      const area = Object.assign({ id: this.newId(), kind: 'area', side: 0, x: 0, y: 0, radius: 1, left: 1, mode: 'visual', done: false }, a);
      if (typeof area.owner !== 'number') area.owner = this.ownerFor(area.side);
      // v12 tunnel: an area made underground (death bomb, heal pulse ...) only acts underground.
      if (area.layer === undefined && CR.Units.layer === 1) area.layer = 1;
      this.areas.push(area);
      return area;
    }

    damage(target, amount, src, kind) {
      return CR.Units.damage(this, target, amount, src || null, kind || 'spell', src ? src.side : undefined);
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Commands
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    /** Placement validation without side effects: {ok, reason, x, y, card, cost}. */
    canPlay(player, handIndex, x, y, reserved) {
      if (this.over) return { ok: false, reason: 'game_over' };
      if (!this.isPlayer(player)) return { ok: false, reason: 'bad_side' };
      this._assertArena();
      if (this.touchdown && this.touchdown.resetLeft > EPS) return { ok: false, reason: 'td_reset' };
      const p = this.players[player];
      const side = p.side;
      const hi = Number(handIndex);
      if (!(hi >= 0 && hi < p.hand.length) || Math.floor(hi) !== hi) return { ok: false, reason: 'bad_hand_slot' };
      const id = p.hand[hi];
      const card = Sim.cardById(id);
      if (!card) return { ok: false, reason: 'card_unknown' };
      if (card.disabled) return { ok: false, reason: 'card_disabled' };
      if (!Sim.cardAllowed(id, this.mode)) return { ok: false, reason: 'card_banned', card: id };
      if (card.rarity === 'champion' && p.champion) return { ok: false, reason: 'champion_active', card: id };
      const cost = typeof card.elixir === 'number' ? card.elixir : 0;
      const avail = this.options.infiniteElixir ? Infinity : p.elixir - (reserved || 0);
      const nx = Number(x), ny = Number(y);
      if (!isFinite(nx) || !isFinite(ny)) return { ok: false, reason: 'out_of_bounds' };
      const d = CR.Arena.checkDeploy(side, nx, ny, card, this);
      if (!d.ok) {
        const map = { bounds: 'out_of_bounds', zone: 'invalid_zone', river: 'invalid_river', hill: 'invalid_hill', blocked: 'blocked_place' };
        return { ok: false, reason: map[d.reason] || 'invalid_zone', x: d.x, y: d.y, card: id, cost: cost };
      }
      if (avail + EPS < cost) return { ok: false, reason: 'not_enough_elixir', x: d.x, y: d.y, card: id, cost: cost };
      return { ok: true, reason: null, x: d.x, y: d.y, card: id, cost: cost };
    }

    /** Queue a command of player `player` (== side in 1v1) for the next tick. Returns {ok, reason}. */
    command(player, cmd) {
      if (this.over) return { ok: false, reason: 'game_over' };
      if (!this.isPlayer(player)) return { ok: false, reason: 'bad_side' };
      const side = player;   // queue entries are keyed by player index (`side` kept as the legacy field name)
      if (!cmd || typeof cmd !== 'object') return { ok: false, reason: 'bad_command' };
      switch (cmd.type) {
        case 'play': {
          if (this.isPaused()) return { ok: false, reason: 'chaos_pause' };
          let reserved = 0;
          for (const q of this.cmdQueue) {
            if (q.side !== side) continue;
            if (q.cmd.type === 'play' && q.cmd.hand === cmd.hand) return { ok: false, reason: 'hand_slot_pending' };
            reserved += q.cost || 0;   // queued plays and champion abilities
          }
          // A stale hand (the guest saw an older snapshot) is reported before anything else.
          const hand = this.players[side].hand;
          const hi = Number(cmd.hand);
          if (cmd.card && hi >= 0 && hi < hand.length && hand[hi] !== cmd.card) return { ok: false, reason: 'card_changed' };
          const r = this.canPlay(side, cmd.hand, cmd.x, cmd.y, reserved);
          if (!r.ok) return r;
          this.cmdQueue.push({ side: side, cmd: { type: 'play', hand: Number(cmd.hand), x: Number(cmd.x), y: Number(cmd.y), card: r.card }, cost: r.cost });
          return { ok: true, reason: null, x: r.x, y: r.y, card: r.card };
        }
        case 'chaos_pick':
        case 'chaos_use': {
          if (!this.chaosOn) return { ok: false, reason: 'chaos_unavailable' };
          const C = this.chaos;
          if (C && typeof C.validate === 'function') {
            const v = C.validate(side, cmd);
            if (v && v.ok === false) return v;
          }
          this.cmdQueue.push({ side: side, cmd: Object.assign({}, cmd) });
          return { ok: true, reason: null };
        }
        case 'champion_ability': {
          if (this.isPaused()) return { ok: false, reason: 'chaos_pause' };
          let reserved = 0;
          for (const q of this.cmdQueue) {
            if (q.side !== side) continue;
            if (q.cmd.type === 'champion_ability') return { ok: false, reason: 'champion_busy' };
            reserved += q.cost || 0;
          }
          const r = this.canUseChampion(side, reserved);
          if (!r.ok) return r;
          this.cmdQueue.push({ side: side, cmd: { type: 'champion_ability' }, cost: r.cost });
          return { ok: true, reason: null, cost: r.cost };
        }
        case 'emote': {
          this.cmdQueue.push({ side: side, cmd: { type: 'emote', id: cmd.id } });
          return { ok: true, reason: null };
        }
        default:
          return { ok: false, reason: 'bad_command' };
      }
    }

    _applyCommands(paused) {
      const q = this.cmdQueue;
      this.cmdQueue = [];
      for (const item of q) {
        const side = item.side, cmd = item.cmd;   // item.side = player index (== side in 1v1)
        if (this.over) break;
        // During a C.H.A.O.S pick pause plays queued before the pause wait for the battle to resume.
        if (paused && cmd.type === 'play') { this.cmdQueue.push(item); continue; }
        if (cmd.type === 'play') {
          const r = this.canPlay(side, cmd.hand, cmd.x, cmd.y, 0);
          if (!r.ok) { this.emit('reject', { side: this.players[side].side, player: side, reason: r.reason, hand: cmd.hand }); continue; }
          if (cmd.card && cmd.card !== r.card) { this.emit('reject', { side: this.players[side].side, player: side, reason: 'card_changed', hand: cmd.hand }); continue; }
          this._play(side, cmd.hand, r.x, r.y);
        } else if (cmd.type === 'champion_ability') {
          if (paused) { this.cmdQueue.push(item); continue; }
          const r = this.canUseChampion(side, 0);
          if (!r.ok) { this.emit('reject', { side: this.players[side].side, player: side, reason: r.reason, ability: true }); continue; }
          this._championAbility(side);
        } else if (cmd.type === 'chaos_pick' || cmd.type === 'chaos_use') {
          this._chaosCommand(side, cmd);
        } else if (cmd.type === 'emote') {
          this.emit('emote', { side: this.players[side].side, player: side, id: cmd.id });
        }
      }
    }

    _chaosCommand(side, cmd) {
      const C = this.chaos;
      const G = CR.Chaos;
      if (C && typeof C.command === 'function') { C.command(side, cmd); return; }
      if (cmd.type === 'chaos_pick') {
        if (C && typeof C.pick === 'function') C.pick(side, cmd.option);
        else if (G && typeof G.pick === 'function') G.pick(this, side, cmd.option);
      } else {
        if (C && typeof C.use === 'function') C.use(side, cmd.id, cmd.x, cmd.y);
        else if (G && typeof G.use === 'function') G.use(this, side, cmd.id, cmd.x, cmd.y);
      }
    }

    /** Execute a validated play of player `player`: pay, cycle, deploy/cast. */
    _play(player, slot, x, y) {
      const p = this.players[player];
      const side = p.side;
      const id = p.hand[slot];
      const card = Sim.cardById(id);
      const cost = typeof card.elixir === 'number' ? card.elixir : 0;
      if (!this.options.infiniteElixir) p.elixir = Math.max(0, p.elixir - cost);
      this.stats[side].elixirSpent += cost;
      this.stats[side].played++;
      p.stats.elixirSpent += cost;
      p.stats.played++;
      const prevOwner = this._owner;
      this._owner = player;
      // Card cycle: next card fills the slot, the played card goes to the back of the queue.
      // v7: a champion card is held out of the cycle while its champion lives (see _registerChampion).
      const champ = card.rarity === 'champion';
      if (p.queue.length) {
        p.hand[slot] = p.queue.shift();
        if (!champ) p.queue.push(id);
      } else if (champ) {
        p.hand.splice(slot, 1);
      }
      const C = this.chaos;
      const tier = C && typeof C.tierOf === 'function' ? (C.tierOf(player, id) || 0) : 0;
      let ids = [];
      if (card.type === 'spell') {
        // C.H.A.O.S spell upgrades may take over the cast (returns true when handled).
        if (!(tier > 0 && C && typeof C.castSpell === 'function' && C.castSpell(side, card, x, y, tier))) CR.Spells.cast(this, side, card, x, y, { tier: tier });
      } else {
        // C.H.A.O.S troop upgrades may replace the summon (returns the units, or null).
        let us = tier > 0 && C && typeof C.summon === 'function' ? C.summon(side, card, x, y, tier) : null;
        if (!Array.isArray(us)) us = this._summon(side, card, x, y, tier);
        ids = us.map(function (u) { return u.id; });
        if (champ) this._registerChampion(player, card, us);
      }
      this._owner = prevOwner;
      this.emit('deploy', { side: side, player: player, card: id, x: x, y: y, units: ids, cost: cost });
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // v7 champions
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    /** Remember the champion of a just played champion card (no unit -> the card cycles normally). */
    _registerChampion(player, card, units) {
      const p = this.players[player];
      const main = card.summon && card.summon[0] ? card.summon[0].unit : null;
      let u = null;
      for (let i = 0; i < units.length && !u; i++) if (units[i] && !units[i].dead && units[i].unit === main && units[i].s.special.ability) u = units[i];
      for (let i = 0; i < units.length && !u; i++) if (units[i] && !units[i].dead && units[i].s.special.ability) u = units[i];
      if (!u) { this._returnCard(p, card.id); return null; }
      u.champOwner = player;
      p.champion = { unit: u, unitId: u.id, card: card.id, cooldownLeft: 0 };
      this.emit('champion', { side: p.side, player: player, unitId: u.id, card: card.id, unit: u.unit, phase: 'deploy' });
      return u;
    }

    /** A held champion card goes back into the cycle (back of the queue). */
    _returnCard(p, cardId) {
      if (p.hand.length < CR.RULES.cards.handSize) p.hand.push(cardId);
      else p.queue.push(cardId);
    }

    /** The champion of `player` is gone (death, touchdown reset): release its card. */
    _releaseChampion(player, why) {
      const p = this.players[player];
      const ch = p && p.champion;
      if (!ch) return;
      p.champion = null;
      if (ch.unit) ch.unit.champOwner = -1;
      this._returnCard(p, ch.card);
      this.emit('champion', { side: p.side, player: player, unitId: ch.unitId, card: ch.card, unit: ch.unit ? ch.unit.unit : null, phase: 'down', reason: why || 'death' });
    }

    /**
     * May `player` activate the champion ability now? `reserved` = elixir already bound by queued
     * commands. {ok, reason, cost}.
     */
    canUseChampion(player, reserved) {
      if (this.over) return { ok: false, reason: 'game_over' };
      if (!this.isPlayer(player)) return { ok: false, reason: 'bad_side' };
      const p = this.players[player];
      const ch = p.champion;
      const u = ch && ch.unit;
      if (!u || u.dead) return { ok: false, reason: 'no_champion' };
      const ab = u.s.special.ability || {};
      const cost = typeof ab.cost === 'number' ? ab.cost : 0;
      if (!u.deployDone || u.tunnel) return { ok: false, reason: 'champion_deploying', cost: cost };
      if (CR.Units.abilityActive(u)) return { ok: false, reason: 'champion_busy', cost: cost };
      if (ch.cooldownLeft > EPS) return { ok: false, reason: 'champion_cooldown', cost: cost };
      const avail = this.options.infiniteElixir ? Infinity : p.elixir - (reserved || 0);
      if (avail + EPS < cost) return { ok: false, reason: 'not_enough_elixir', cost: cost };
      return { ok: true, reason: null, cost: cost };
    }

    /** Execute a validated champion ability: pay, start the cooldown, trigger the unit. */
    _championAbility(player) {
      const p = this.players[player];
      const ch = p.champion, u = ch.unit;
      const ab = u.s.special.ability || {};
      const cost = typeof ab.cost === 'number' ? ab.cost : 0;
      if (!this.options.infiniteElixir) p.elixir = Math.max(0, p.elixir - cost);
      this.stats[p.side].elixirSpent += cost;
      p.stats.elixirSpent += cost;
      ch.cooldownLeft = Math.max(0, typeof ab.cooldown === 'number' ? ab.cooldown : 10);
      const prev = this._owner;
      this._owner = player;
      CR.Units.championAbility(this, u);
      this._owner = prev;
    }

    _championCooldowns() {
      for (let i = 0; i < this.players.length; i++) {
        const ch = this.players[i].champion;
        if (ch && ch.cooldownLeft > 0) ch.cooldownLeft = Math.max(0, ch.cooldownLeft - this.dt);
      }
    }

    _championView(i) {
      const p = this.players[i], ch = p.champion;
      if (!ch || !ch.unit) return null;
      const u = ch.unit;
      const ab = u.s.special.ability || {};
      const cost = typeof ab.cost === 'number' ? ab.cost : 0;
      const deploying = !u.deployDone || !!u.tunnel;
      const active = CR.Units.abilityActive(u);
      const ready = !u.dead && !deploying && !active && !(ch.cooldownLeft > EPS);
      return {
        unitId: ch.unitId, card: ch.card, unit: u.unit, kind: ab.kind || null, name: ab.name || null,
        ready: ready, cost: cost, cooldown: typeof ab.cooldown === 'number' ? ab.cooldown : 0,
        cooldownLeft: Math.round(Math.max(0, ch.cooldownLeft) * 1000) / 1000, active: active, deploying: deploying,
        canUse: ready && (this.options.infiniteElixir || p.elixir + EPS >= cost),
      };
    }

    /** Summon the units of a troop/building card at (x,y). */
    _summon(side, card, x, y, tier) {
      const out = [];
      const summon = Array.isArray(card.summon) ? card.summon : [];
      const f = side === 0 ? 1 : -1;
      for (const entry of summon) {
        const unitId = entry.unit;
        if (!CR.DATA.units[unitId]) continue;
        const st = CR.Units.stats(unitId);
        const count = Math.max(1, entry.count || 1);
        const form = entry.formation && typeof entry.formation === 'object' ? entry.formation : null;
        const offs = CR.Units.formation(count, typeof entry.radius === 'number' ? entry.radius : CR.RULES.deploy.defaultFormationRadius,
          form ? form.type : entry.formation, typeof entry.width === 'number' ? entry.width : (form ? (form.width !== undefined ? form.width : form.width_tiles) : undefined));
        const ox = typeof entry.dx === 'number' ? entry.dx : 0, oy = typeof entry.dy === 'number' ? entry.dy : 0;
        const baseDeploy = typeof entry.deployTime === 'number' ? entry.deployTime : (typeof card.deployTime === 'number' ? card.deployTime : st.deployTime);
        const stagger = typeof entry.stagger === 'number' ? entry.stagger : (count > 1 ? CR.RULES.deploy.defaultStagger : 0);
        const tunnel = st.special && st.special.tunnel;
        for (let i = 0; i < offs.length; i++) {
          const px = CR.clamp(x + (ox + offs[i][0]) * f, 0.3, CR.Arena.W - 0.3);
          const py = CR.clamp(y + (oy + offs[i][1]) * f, 0.3, CR.Arena.H - 0.3);
          const u = this.spawnUnit(side, unitId, st.building ? x : px, st.building ? y : py, { card: card.id, deployTime: baseDeploy + stagger * i, tier: tier });
          if (!u) continue;
          if (tunnel) {
            const k = this.launchOrigin(side);
            CR.Units.startTunnel(this, u, k ? k.x : px, k ? k.y : py, typeof tunnel.speed === 'number' ? tunnel.speed : 10);
          }
          out.push(u);
        }
      }
      return out;
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Tick
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    /** True while a C.H.A.O.S upgrade pick pauses the battle (game time frozen). */
    isPaused() {
      const C = this.chaos;
      return !!(C && typeof C.paused === 'function' && C.paused());
    }

    /** The arena is global state: make it match this battle's map and mode. */
    _assertArena() {
      if (CR.Arena.map !== this.map || CR.Arena.mode !== this.arenaMode) CR.Arena.setMap(this.map, this.arenaMode);
    }

    tick() {
      if (this.over) return;
      this._assertArena();
      this._owner = -1;
      CR.Units.layer = 0; CR.Units.layerSrc = null;
      this.tickEvents = [];
      this.tickNo++;
      // C.H.A.O.S pick pause: tick numbers keep counting (network snapshots), game time does
      // not; only pick/emote commands are applied and the chaos module counts its timer down.
      if (this.isPaused()) {
        this.pausedTicks++;
        this._applyCommands(true);
        if (typeof this.chaos.tick === 'function') this.chaos.tick();
        this._finishTick();
        return;
      }
      // 1. commands
      this._applyCommands(false);
      if (this.over) { this._finishTick(); return; }
      // 2. elixir (multiplier of the phase at the start of the tick)
      this._elixir();
      // 3. clock
      this.time = (this.tickNo - this.pausedTicks) * this.dt;
      this.tickStart = this.time - this.dt;
      this._clock();
      this._championCooldowns();
      if (this.touchdown) this._touchdownPause();
      const ot = this.hooks.onTick;
      for (let i = 0; i < ot.length; i++) ot[i](this);
      this._owner = -1;
      if (this.chaos && typeof this.chaos.tick === 'function') this.chaos.tick();
      // 4. deploy completions (+ tunnels)
      this._deployPhase();
      // 5. units / towers
      this._unitsPhase();
      // 6. projectiles
      CR.Units.updateProjectiles(this);
      this._owner = -1;
      // 7. areas
      this._updateAreas();
      this._owner = -1;
      // 8. deaths
      const downed = this._deathPhase();
      this._owner = -1;
      // 9. crowns / king activation (touchdown: scoring + field reset)
      if (this.touchdown) this._touchdownPhase();
      else this._crownPhase(downed);
      // 10. win check
      this._winCheck();
      // 11. events
      this._finishTick();
    }

    _elixir() {
      const RE = CR.RULES.elixir;
      const inc = this.dt * this.elixirMult * this.elixirBoost / RE.regenSeconds;
      for (let i = 0; i < this.players.length; i++) {
        const p = this.players[i], st = this.stats[p.side];
        if (p.elixir >= RE.max - 1e-9) { p.elixir = RE.max; st.elixirLeaked += inc; continue; }
        let e = p.elixir + inc;
        const r = Math.round(e);
        if (Math.abs(e - r) < 1e-9) e = r;
        if (e > RE.max) { st.elixirLeaked += e - RE.max; e = RE.max; }
        p.elixir = e;
      }
    }

    _segmentAt(list, t) {
      let seg = list[0];
      for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) if (t >= list[i].from - EPS) seg = list[i];
      return seg;
    }

    _clock() {
      const C = this.clockCfg;
      let seg;
      if (!this.overtime) seg = this._segmentAt(C.segments, Math.min(this.time, C.regulation - EPS * 10));
      else seg = this._segmentAt(C.otSegments, Math.max(0, this.time - C.regulation));
      if (seg.phase !== this.phase || seg.mult !== this.elixirMult) {
        this.phase = seg.phase;
        this.elixirMult = seg.mult;
        this.emit('phase', { phase: this.phase, elixirMult: this.elixirMult, overtime: this.overtime });
      }
    }

    clockRemaining() {
      const C = this.clockCfg;
      if (this.over) return 0;
      if (!this.overtime) return Math.max(0, C.regulation - this.time);
      return Math.max(0, C.regulation + C.overtime - this.time);
    }

    _deployPhase() {
      const us = this.units;
      for (let i = 0; i < us.length; i++) {
        const u = us[i];
        if (u.dead) continue;
        this._owner = u.owner;
        if (u.tunnel) { CR.Units.stepTunnel(this, u); continue; }
        if (!u.deployDone && u.deployEnd <= this.time + EPS) {
          u.deployDone = true;
          CR.Units.onDeployed(this, u);
        }
      }
      this._owner = -1;
    }

    /** Static movement obstacles of this tick: alive tower footprints (`col`, smaller than the
     *  hit box), buildings, arena obstacles. Read by routing (CR.Arena.waypoint) and collision. */
    _rebuildStatic() {
      const r = this.staticRects;
      r.length = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < this.towers.length; i++) { const t = this.towers[i]; if (t.alive) r.push(t.col || t); }
      for (let i = 0; i < this.units.length; i++) { const u = this.units[i]; if (u.building && !u.dead && !u.tunnel) r.push(u); }
      for (let i = 0; i < CR.Arena.OBSTACLES.length; i++) r.push(CR.Arena.OBSTACLES[i]);
    }

    _unitsPhase() {
      this._rebuildStatic();
      const U = CR.Units;
      for (let i = 0; i < this.towers.length; i++) {
        const t = this.towers[i];
        if (!t.alive) continue;
        if (!t.active || this.time < t.activeAt - EPS) { t.state = 'idle'; continue; }
        this._owner = -1;
        U.think(this, t);
      }
      const us = this.units;
      const n = us.length;
      const ready = this.tickStart + EPS;
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const u = us[i];
        if (u.dead) continue;
        this._owner = u.owner;
        U.tickStatus(this, u);
        if (u.tunnel) continue;
        if (u.deployEnd > ready) { u.state = 'deploying'; continue; }
        U.think(this, u);
      }
      this._owner = -1;
      U.collide(this);
    }

    /** Area update; on the tunnel map the underground areas (area.layer 1) run in layer 1. */
    _updateAreas() {
      const all = this.areas;
      let ug = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < all.length; i++) if (all[i].layer === 1) ug++;
      if (!ug) { CR.Spells.updateAreas(this); return; }
      const top = [], down = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < all.length; i++) (all[i].layer === 1 ? down : top).push(all[i]);
      this.areas = top;
      CR.Spells.updateAreas(this);
      const top2 = this.areas;
      this.areas = down;
      CR.Units.layer = 1;
      CR.Spells.updateAreas(this);
      CR.Units.layer = 0;
      const down2 = this.areas;
      for (let i = 0; i < down2.length; i++) top2.push(down2[i]);
      this.areas = top2;
    }

    _deathPhase() {
      const hooks = this.hooks.onDeath;
      for (let iter = 0; iter < 8; iter++) {
        let any = false;
        const us = this.units;
        for (let i = 0; i < us.length; i++) {
          const u = us[i];
          if (!u.dead || u.deathDone) continue;
          u.deathDone = true;
          u.alive = false;
          any = true;
          this._owner = u.owner;
          if (u.champOwner >= 0) this._releaseChampion(u.champOwner, 'death');
          // v12 tunnel: death effects of an underground troop stay underground.
          if (u.underground) { CR.Units.layer = 1; CR.Units.layerSrc = u; }
          CR.Units.onDeath(this, u);
          for (let h = 0; h < hooks.length; h++) hooks[h](u);
          CR.Units.layer = 0; CR.Units.layerSrc = null;
          this._owner = -1;
          const de = this.emit('death', { id: u.id, side: u.side, unit: u.unit, card: u.card, x: CR.round(u.x, 2), y: CR.round(u.y, 2), air: u.air, building: u.building, by: u.killer, reason: u.kamikazeDone ? 'kamikaze' : (u.silentDeath ? 'transform' : (u.killer === -1 ? 'expired' : 'killed')) });
          if (u.underground) de.tunnel = true;   // v12: died in the tunnel
        }
        if (!any) break;
      }
      let w = 0;
      const us = this.units;
      for (let i = 0; i < us.length; i++) if (!us[i].deathDone) us[w++] = us[i];
      us.length = w;
      const downed = [];
      for (const t of this.towers) {
        if (t.alive && t.hp <= 0) {
          t.alive = false; t.dead = true; t.hp = 0; t.target = null;
          downed.push(t);
          for (let h = 0; h < hooks.length; h++) hooks[h](t);
        }
      }
      return downed;
    }

    _crownPhase(downed) {
      for (const t of downed) {
        const other = 1 - t.side;
        this.emit('tower_down', { id: t.id, side: t.side, kind: t.towerKind, lane: t.lane, x: t.x, y: t.y, by: other });
        if (t.towerKind === 'king') {
          this.crowns[other] = 3;
          // All remaining towers of the loser fall with the king.
          for (const o of this.towers) {
            if (o.side !== t.side || !o.alive) continue;
            o.alive = false; o.dead = true; o.hp = 0; o.target = null;
            this.emit('tower_down', { id: o.id, side: o.side, kind: o.towerKind, lane: o.lane, x: o.x, y: o.y, by: other, cascade: true });
          }
        } else {
          this.crowns[other] = Math.min(3, this.crowns[other] + 1);
          if (CR.RULES.kingActivation.onPrincessDown) this.activateKing(t.side, 'princess_down');
        }
        // Crowns belong to the team: every player of the side shows them.
        for (let i = 0; i < this.players.length; i++) this.players[i].crowns = this.crowns[this.players[i].side];
        this.emit('crown', { side: other, crowns: [this.crowns[0], this.crowns[1]], tower: t.id });
      }
    }

    _end(winner, reason) {
      this.over = true;
      this.winner = winner;
      this.endReason = reason;
      this.phase = 'ended';
      this.emit('phase', { phase: 'ended', winner: winner, reason: reason, crowns: [this.crowns[0], this.crowns[1]], elixirMult: this.elixirMult, overtime: this.overtime });
    }

    _lowestTowerHp(side) {
      let m = Infinity;
      for (const t of this.towers) if (t.side === side && t.alive && t.hp < m) m = t.hp;
      return m === Infinity ? 0 : m;
    }

    _winCheck() {
      if (this.over) return;
      if (this.touchdown) { this._tdWinCheck(); return; }
      const C = this.clockCfg;
      const k0 = this.kingOf(0), k1 = this.kingOf(1);
      const d0 = !k0.alive, d1 = !k1.alive;
      if (d0 || d1) {
        this._end(d0 && d1 ? 'draw' : (d0 ? 1 : 0), 'three_crown');
        return;
      }
      const c0 = this.crowns[0], c1 = this.crowns[1];
      if (!this.overtime) {
        if (this.time >= C.regulation - EPS) {
          if (c0 !== c1) { this._end(c0 > c1 ? 0 : 1, 'time'); return; }
          if (!(C.overtime > EPS)) { this._tiebreak(); return; }
          this.overtime = true;
          const seg = this._segmentAt(C.otSegments, 0);
          this.phase = seg.phase;
          this.elixirMult = seg.mult;
          this.emit('phase', { phase: this.phase, elixirMult: this.elixirMult, overtime: true });
        }
        return;
      }
      if (CR.RULES.clock.suddenDeath && c0 !== c1) { this._end(c0 > c1 ? 0 : 1, 'sudden_death'); return; }
      if (this.time >= C.regulation + C.overtime - EPS) {
        if (c0 !== c1) { this._end(c0 > c1 ? 0 : 1, 'time'); return; }
        this._tiebreak();
      }
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Touchdown
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    /** Counts the kick-off pause after a touchdown down (game time runs, elixir keeps filling). */
    _touchdownPause() {
      const T = this.touchdown;
      if (!(T.resetLeft > EPS)) return;
      T.resetLeft -= this.dt;
      if (T.resetLeft <= EPS) {
        T.resetLeft = 0;
        T.rounds++;
        this.emit('td_resume', { round: T.rounds, score: [T.score[0], T.score[1]] });
      }
    }

    /** May unit u score right now? Troops only (air too), deployed, not underground / mid-leap. */
    _canScore(u) {
      if (u.dead || u.building || u.tower || u.tunnel || u.underground || u.jump || u.hidden) return false;
      if (!u.deployDone) return false;
      if (u.air && !CR.RULES.touchdown.scoreAir) return false;
      if (u.kamikazeDone || u.untargetable) return false;
      return true;
    }

    /** Detect a touchdown (first scoring troop in unit order), award it and reset the field. */
    _touchdownPhase() {
      const T = this.touchdown;
      if (T.resetLeft > EPS) return;
      let scorer = null;
      const us = this.units;
      for (let i = 0; i < us.length; i++) {
        const u = us[i];
        if (!this._canScore(u)) continue;
        if (CR.Arena.inEndZone(1 - u.side, u.x, u.y)) { scorer = u; break; }
      }
      if (!scorer) return;
      const side = scorer.side;
      T.score[side]++;
      this.crowns[side] = T.score[side];
      for (let i = 0; i < this.players.length; i++) this.players[i].crowns = this.crowns[this.players[i].side];
