      const owner = typeof scorer.owner === 'number' ? scorer.owner : this.ownerFor(side);
      T.lastScore = { side: side, player: owner, unitId: scorer.id, unit: scorer.unit, card: scorer.card, x: CR.round(scorer.x, 2), y: CR.round(scorer.y, 2), time: CR.round(this.time, 3) };
      this.emit('touchdown', { side: side, player: owner, unitId: scorer.id, unit: scorer.unit, card: scorer.card, x: T.lastScore.x, y: T.lastScore.y, air: !!scorer.air, score: [T.score[0], T.score[1]] });
      this.emit('crown', { side: side, crowns: [this.crowns[0], this.crowns[1]], touchdown: true });
      // The deciding touchdown ends the battle (first to target, or any touchdown in overtime):
      // the field stays as it is for the result screen.
      if (T.score[side] >= T.target || this.overtime) return;
      this._touchdownReset();
    }

    /** Clear the field after a touchdown: troops, buildings, projectiles, areas; pending plays cancelled. */
    _touchdownReset() {
      const T = this.touchdown;
      const removed = this.units.length;
      for (let i = 0; i < this.players.length; i++) if (this.players[i].champion) this._releaseChampion(i, 'reset');
      for (let i = 0; i < this.units.length; i++) {
        const u = this.units[i];
        u.dead = true; u.deathDone = true; u.alive = false; u.noDeathEffects = true; u.silentDeath = true; u.target = null;
      }
      this.units.length = 0;
      this.projectiles.length = 0;
      this.areas.length = 0;
      this.staticRects.length = 0;
      // Plays queued but not applied yet never happen: nothing paid, the card stays in the hand.
      const keep = [];
      for (const q of this.cmdQueue) {
        if (q.cmd.type === 'play') this.emit('reject', { side: this.players[q.side].side, player: q.side, reason: 'td_reset', hand: q.cmd.hand });
        else keep.push(q);
      }
      this.cmdQueue = keep;
      T.resetLeft = T.resetPause;
      this.emit('td_reset', { resetIn: T.resetPause, removed: removed, score: [T.score[0], T.score[1]], round: T.rounds });
      if (!(T.resetPause > EPS)) { T.rounds++; this.emit('td_resume', { round: T.rounds, score: [T.score[0], T.score[1]] }); }
    }

    _tdWinCheck() {
      const T = this.touchdown, C = this.clockCfg;
      const s0 = T.score[0], s1 = T.score[1];
      if (s0 >= T.target || s1 >= T.target) { this._end(s0 >= T.target ? 0 : 1, 'touchdown'); return; }
      if (!this.overtime) {
        if (this.time >= C.regulation - EPS) {
          if (s0 !== s1) { this._end(s0 > s1 ? 0 : 1, 'time'); return; }
          if (!(C.overtime > EPS)) { this._end('draw', 'time'); return; }
          this.overtime = true;
          const seg = this._segmentAt(C.otSegments, 0);
          this.phase = seg.phase;
          this.elixirMult = seg.mult;
          this.emit('phase', { phase: this.phase, elixirMult: this.elixirMult, overtime: true });
        }
        return;
      }
      if (s0 !== s1) { this._end(s0 > s1 ? 0 : 1, 'sudden_death'); return; }
      if (this.time >= C.regulation + C.overtime - EPS) this._end('draw', 'time');
    }

    _tiebreak() {
      const h0 = this._lowestTowerHp(0), h1 = this._lowestTowerHp(1);
      if (Math.abs(h0 - h1) < 1e-9) this._end('draw', 'tiebreak');

    }

    _finishTick() {
      this.lastTickEvents = this.tickEvents;
    }

    drainEvents() {
      const e = this.pendingEvents;
      this.pendingEvents = [];
      return e;
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // View (renderer / UI / network contract; plain JSON-safe data, fresh object)
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    view() {
      const r3 = function (v) { return Math.round(v * 1000) / 1000; };
      const now = this.time;
      const t0 = this.tickStart + EPS;
      const players = this.players.map((p, i) => ({
        index: i,
        side: p.side,
        name: p.name,
        bot: p.bot,
        elixir: r3(p.elixir),
        hand: p.hand.slice(),
        next: p.queue.length ? p.queue[0] : null,
        crowns: this.crowns[p.side],
        chaos: this._chaosView(i),
        champion: this._championView(i),
      }));
      const towers = this.towers.map(function (t) {
        let fx = 0;
        if (t.stunUntil > now + EPS) fx |= 1;
        if (t.freezeUntil > now + EPS) fx |= 2;
        if (t.slowUntil > now + EPS) fx |= 4;
        if (t.rageUntil > now + EPS) fx |= 8;
        return {
          id: t.id, side: t.side, kind: t.towerKind, lane: t.lane, x: t.x, y: t.y,
          hp: Math.ceil(t.hp), maxHp: t.maxHp, active: !!t.active, alive: !!t.alive,
          size: t.size, depth: t.depth, targetId: t.target && t.alive ? t.target.id : 0, fx: fx,
          attackProg: t.atk > t.s.loadTime && t.s.firstHit > 0 ? r3(Math.min(1, (t.atk - t.s.loadTime) / t.s.firstHit)) : 0,
        };
      });
      const units = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < this.units.length; i++) {
        const u = this.units[i];
        if (u.dead) continue;
        const s = u.s;
        let fx = 0;
        if (u.stunUntil > now + EPS) fx |= 1;
        if (u.freezeUntil > now + EPS) fx |= 2;
        if (u.slowUntil > now + EPS) fx |= 4;
        if (u.rageUntil > now + EPS) fx |= 8;
        if (u.charging) fx |= 16;
        if (u.hidden || u.tunnel) fx |= 32;
        if (u.shield > 0) fx |= 64;
        if (u.chaos || u.tier > 0) fx |= 128;
        let deployLeft = 0;
        if (u.tunnel) deployLeft = CR.dist(u.x, u.y, u.tunnel.tx, u.tunnel.ty) / Math.max(0.01, u.tunnel.speed) + u.deployTotal;
        else if (u.deployEnd > now + EPS) deployLeft = u.deployEnd - now;
        const deploying = deployLeft > EPS || u.deployEnd > t0;
        const v = {
          id: u.id, side: u.side, owner: u.owner, unit: u.unit, card: u.card,
          x: r3(u.x), y: r3(u.y),
          hp: Math.ceil(u.hp), maxHp: u.maxHp, shield: Math.ceil(u.shield), maxShield: u.maxShield,
          air: !!u.air, building: !!u.building, radius: u.r,
          state: deploying ? 'deploying' : u.state,
          deployLeft: r3(deployLeft),
          fx: fx,
          dir: r3(u.dir),
          attackProg: (u.atk > s.loadTime && s.firstHit > 0 && u.state === 'attacking') ? r3(Math.min(1, (u.atk - s.loadTime) / s.firstHit)) : 0,
          targetId: u.target && !u.target.dead ? u.target.id : 0,
          tier: u.tier || 0,
        };
        if (u.z) v.z = r3(u.z);
        if (u.champOwner >= 0) v.champion = true;
        if (u.underground) v.tunnel = true;   // v12: in the tunnel (not targetable from above)
        if (u.ability) v.ability = u.ability.kind;
        if (u.building) v.size = s.footprint;
        if (u.building && s.lifetime > 0) v.life = r3(u.hp / u.maxHp);
        units.push(v);
      }
      const projectiles = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < this.projectiles.length; i++) {
        const p = this.projectiles[i];
        if (p.done || p.delay > EPS) continue;
        const pv = { id: p.id, kind: p.kind, side: p.side, x: r3(p.x), y: r3(p.y), air: !!p.air, tx: r3(p.mode === 'roll' ? p.x + p.dx : p.tx), ty: r3(p.mode === 'roll' ? p.y + p.dy : p.ty) };
        if (p.layer === 1) pv.tunnel = true;
        projectiles.push(pv);
      }
      const areas = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < this.areas.length; i++) {
        const a = this.areas[i];
        if (a.done) continue;
        const av = { id: a.id, kind: a.kind, side: a.side, x: r3(a.x), y: r3(a.y), radius: a.radius, left: r3(Math.max(0, a.left)) };
        if (a.layer === 1) av.tunnel = true;
        areas.push(av);
      }
      const T = this.touchdown;
      return {
        tick: this.tickNo,
        time: r3(this.time),
        mode: this.mode,
        chaosOn: this.chaosOn,
        touchdown: T ? {
          score: [T.score[0], T.score[1]], target: T.target,
          lastScore: T.lastScore ? { side: T.lastScore.side, player: T.lastScore.player, unitId: T.lastScore.unitId, unit: T.lastScore.unit, x: T.lastScore.x, y: T.lastScore.y } : null,
          resetIn: r3(Math.max(0, T.resetLeft)), round: T.rounds,
          endZones: [CR.Arena.endZones(0)[0], CR.Arena.endZones(1)[0]],
        } : null,
        map: this.map,
        teamSize: this.teamSize,
        crowns: [this.crowns[0], this.crowns[1]],
        clock: { remaining: r3(this.clockRemaining()), phase: this.over ? 'ended' : this.phase, elixirMult: this.elixirMult, overtime: this.overtime },
        players: players,
        towers: towers,
        units: units,
        projectiles: projectiles,
        areas: areas,
        events: this.lastTickEvents.slice(),
        over: this.over,
        winner: this.winner,
      };
    }

    _chaosView(player) {
      const C = this.chaos;
      if (!this.chaosOn) return null;
      if (C && typeof C.view === 'function') return C.view(player);
      if (CR.Chaos && typeof CR.Chaos.view === 'function') return CR.Chaos.view(this, player);
      return this.players[player].chaos || null;
    }

<script>
/* src/04-units.js */
/* Chaos Royale - 04-units.js (engine)
 * Troop / building / tower behaviour: stats normalisation, targeting (sight range,
 * ground/air/buildings-only filters, lock-on), default lane walking, attack cycle
 * (load time + first hit = hit speed), melee/ranged/projectiles, splash, status
 * effects (stun, freeze, slow, rage, knockback, pull, heal), charge, death damage and
 * death spawns, spawners, building decay, inferno ramp, hidden Tesla, chains, river
 * jumps, Mega Knight jump, Bandit dash, Miner tunnel, Elixir Collector, Sparky,
 * Executioner axe, Bowler boulder, Firecracker sparks, Battle Healer, Phoenix egg,
 * Electro Giant reflect, shields, and collision/push with mass.
 *
 * Pure simulation code (no DOM, no Date, no Math.random). All timing uses the sim's
 * absolute clock: tick J covers (sim.tickStart, sim.time]; effects applied "now" last
 * until an absolute time, which makes stun/deploy/attack timings tick-exact.
 *
 * Attack cycle model (cards-troops.json: hit_speed = load_time + first_hit): one clock
 * `atk` per unit runs 0 -> loadTime (reload, also while walking) -> hitSpeed (wind-up =
 * firstHit, only while the target is in range). The hit happens when atk reaches
 * hitSpeed. Fresh units spawn loaded (atk = loadTime) unless `loadFirstHit` (Sparky).
 * Stun / freeze / knockback reset atk to 0 (Zap reset); a retarget restarts the wind-up.
 *
 * v3 movement (user report "units do not walk cleanly past the princess towers, it lags"):
 * ground troops route with CR.Arena.waypoint + per-troop memory u.nav (detour side / bridge
 * hysteresis) and keep their speed round corners; they stop RULES.routing.rangeMargin inside
 * their range; walking troops only retarget to a clearly closer target. Collision runs on a
 * uniform grid with order-independent (Jacobi), capped, mass-weighted pushes; attacking troops
 * hold their ground (never pushed away from their target, friends that are not heavier slide
 * round them). Crown tower entities: x0..y1 = hit box (ranges unchanged), col = footprint.
 *
 * v5 hill map (docs/V5.md item 3): ground troops walking up a slope are slowed (CR.Arena.uphillMult,
 * x0.65 straight up); the plateau is the level of air units: a ground troop standing on it may
 * target and hit air units even if it normally targets ground only, and a ground-only attacker
 * anywhere may hit an air unit above the plateau (canTarget). Non-spell ground effects (splash,
 * rolling shots) also reach air units above the plateau (missesLayer). Units carry `owner`
 * (player index, 2v2) besides `side` (team).
 *
 * v7 (docs/V7-CARDS.md): special.shotgun (Cyborg-Jäger cone blast, Units.shotgunBlast) + special.pump
 * (visible pump reload: ability event 'pump' `pump.delay` s after each shot), special.endoskeleton
 * (death spawn that rises after `rise` s, ability event 'endoskeleton'), special.sphere (Wirbel-Ninja
 * spinning sphere: homing throw, area damage, knockback along the throw, events 'sphere' throw /
 * impact; hooks may set hit.sphereScale), special.ability (champion ability, started by the sim's
 * champion system through Units.championAbility: wind-up u.ability, then Units.slashWave = a rolling
 * wave in a straight line hitting every enemy once, event 'champion_slash' windup / launch).
 *
 * v12 extra abilities of the custom cards (docs/V7-CARDS.md "v12", all automatic, base ability
 * events): special.dodge (Kung-Fu-Legende dodges the next ranged hit every `cooldown` s, Units.evade,
 * event 'dodge'), special.whirl (Kung-Fu-Legende spinning kick when >= `min` enemy ground troops are
 * close, Units.whirlKick, event 'whirlwind'), special.lockOn (Cyborg-Jäger: +`step` damage per further
 * shot at the same target, up to `max` stacks, reset by retarget / stun / knockback, event 'lock_on'),
 * special.parry (Schwarzklingen-Meister parries the next troop melee hit every `cooldown` s and
 * ripostes, Units.evade, event 'parry'), special.shadowClones (Wirbel-Ninja: shadow clones on deploy,
 * Units.shadowClones, fade after `life` s via u.fadeAt in tickStatus, event 'shadow_clone').
 *
 * v12 tunnel map (docs/V12-TUNNEL.md, geometry in CR.Arena.TUNNEL): Units.think plans / enters /
 * leaves the tunnel for eligible troops (CR.Arena.tunnelEligible: ground, mass <= 8, radius <= 0.65)
 * that finish deploying near their own hole; underground troops (u.underground, u.tunnelTo) walk
 * straight to the exit hole, collide only with each other, stay in the corridor and live in layer 1:
 * Units.layer / Units.offLayer make isTargetable, forEachEnemy, splash, chains and projectiles skip
 * the other layer, so nothing above can hit them and they hit nothing above. Units.tunnelEnter /
 * tunnelExit (events {t:'tunnel', phase}).
 *
 * Exports (CR.Units): normalize, stats, instanceStats, create, createTower, edgeDist,
 * shapeGap, gap, isTargetable, canTarget, findTarget, defaultTower, selectTarget, stun,
 * freeze, slow, rage, knockback, pull, heal, damage, ctFor, applyEffect, formation,
 * spawnGroup, launch, updateProjectiles, performAttack, healPulse, moveToward, tickStatus,
 * think, onDeployed, startTunnel, stepTunnel, onDeath, collide, forEachEnemy, rangeStop,
 * shotgunBlast, shotgunTargets, throwSphere, slashWave, championAbility, abilityDir, evade,
 * whirlKick, shadowClones.
 */
(function (CR) {
  'use strict';

  const Units = {};
  CR.Units = Units;

  const EPS = 1e-6;
  const sqrt = Math.sqrt;
  const WP = { x: 0, y: 0 };
  const TMP = { x: 0, y: 0 };
  const TN_OUT = { x: 0, y: 0 };

  // v12 tunnel map (docs/V12-TUNNEL.md): the layer the code running right now acts in, 0 = above
  // ground, 1 = in the tunnel. Set by think (the unit's own layer), updateProjectiles (the shot's),
  // the sim's death phase / area update; everything else (spells, towers, C.H.A.O.S) runs in 0.
  // Targeting (isTargetable), forEachEnemy, splash and every enemy scan skip entities of the other
  // layer, so underground troops only fight each other. layerSrc = the acting underground unit.
  Units.layer = 0;
  Units.layerSrc = null;
  function offLayer(t) { return (t.underground ? 1 : 0) !== Units.layer; }
  Units.offLayer = offLayer;

  // Deterministic separation directions for exactly overlapping troops.
  const DIRS = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) DIRS.push([Math.cos(i * Math.PI / 8), Math.sin(i * Math.PI / 8)]);

  function num(v, d) { return (typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v)) ? v : d; }
  function obj(v) { return v && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v) ? v : null; }
  function first() { for (let i = 0; i < arguments.length; i++) if (arguments[i] !== undefined && arguments[i] !== null) return arguments[i]; return undefined; }

  // ===========================================================================
  // Stats normalisation (CR.DATA.units[id] -> engine stats)
  // ===========================================================================
  function parseTargets(raw) {
    let g = true, a = false, b = !!(raw.buildingsOnly || raw.buildings_only);
    const t = raw.targets;
    if (typeof t === 'string') {
      const s = t.toLowerCase();
      if (s === 'none' || s === '') { g = false; a = false; }
      else if (s.indexOf('building') >= 0 && s.indexOf('ground') < 0 && s.indexOf('air') < 0) { b = true; g = true; a = false; }
      else {
        g = s === 'both' || s === 'all' || s.indexOf('ground') >= 0;
        a = s === 'both' || s === 'all' || s.indexOf('air') >= 0;
        if (s.indexOf('building') >= 0) b = true;
      }
    } else if (Array.isArray(t)) {
      g = t.indexOf('ground') >= 0; a = t.indexOf('air') >= 0;
      if (t.indexOf('buildings') >= 0 || t.indexOf('building') >= 0) { b = true; if (!a) g = true; }
    } else if (t && typeof t === 'object') {
      g = !!t.ground; a = !!t.air;
      if (t.buildings_only || t.buildingsOnly) b = true;
    }
    return { ground: g, air: a, buildingsOnly: b };
  }

  function normSlow(v) {
    const o = obj(v);
    if (!o) return null;
    const pct = num(first(o.pct, o.percent, o.slowPct), 0);
    if (!(pct > 0)) return null;
    return { pct: pct, dur: num(first(o.dur, o.duration, o.durationS, o.seconds), 0) };
  }

  function normDeathDamage(raw) {
    const d = raw.deathDamage;
    if (d === null || d === undefined || d === 0) return null;
    if (typeof d === 'number') return { damage: d, radius: num(raw.deathRadius, 1), ct: null, delay: 0, knockback: 0, air: true, ground: true, slow: null, stun: 0, kind: 'death' };
    const o = obj(d);
    if (!o || !(num(o.damage, 0) > 0)) return null;
    const ct = first(o.ct, o.ctDamage, o.crownTowerDamage, o.towerDamage);
    return {
      damage: num(o.damage, 0),
      radius: num(o.radius, 1),
      ct: typeof ct === 'number' ? ct : null,
      delay: num(first(o.delay, o.delayS), 0),
      knockback: num(first(o.knockback, o.pushback), 0),
      air: o.air !== false,
      ground: o.ground !== false,
      slow: normSlow(o.slow),
      stun: num(o.stun, 0),
      kind: o.kind || 'death',
    };
  }

  function normSpawnList(v) {
    if (!v) return [];
    const list = Array.isArray(v) ? v : [v];
    const out = [];
    for (const s of list) {
      if (!s || !s.unit) continue;
      out.push({
        unit: CR.toId(s.unit), count: num(s.count, 1), radius: num(s.radius, 0.6),
        deployTime: (typeof s.deployTime === 'number') ? s.deployTime : null, formation: s.formation || null,
      });
    }
    return out;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Research-shaped data adapter: docs/research/cards-troops.json style snake_case
  // fields and `special` / `death` objects are translated to the engine's camelCase
  // shape, so data regenerated from docs/data/cards.json works either way.
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const TOP_ALIASES = {
    hit_speed: 'hitSpeed', first_hit: 'firstHit', load_time: 'loadTime', sight_range: 'sightRange',
    sight_clip: 'sightClip', min_range: 'minRange', collision_radius: 'radius', is_air: 'air',
    flying_height: 'flyingHeight', shield_hp: 'shield', splash_radius: 'splashRadius', aoe_center: 'splashCenter',
    crown_tower_damage: 'ctDamage', deploy_time: 'deployTime', jumps_river: 'jumpsRiver',
    ignore_pushback: 'ignorePushback', speed_tiles_per_s: 'speed', buildings_only: 'buildingsOnly',
    projectile_speed: 'projectileSpeed', death_damage: 'deathDamage', death_spawn: 'deathSpawn',
    lifetime_s: 'lifetime', load_first_hit: 'loadFirstHit',
  };
  function sec(v, d) { return num(v, d); }
  function rawSpeed(v) { return typeof v === 'number' ? v / 60 : undefined; }
  /** Returns raw itself when it is already engine-shaped, else an adapted shallow copy. */
  function adaptRaw(raw) {
    let snake = false;
    for (const k in raw) if (k.indexOf('_') >= 0) { snake = true; break; }
    const rs = obj(raw.special);
    if (rs) for (const k in rs) if (k.indexOf('_') >= 0) { snake = true; break; }

    const fwd = u.side === 0 ? 1 : -1;
    const us = sim.units, ts = sim.towers;
    const nu = us.length, n = nu + ts.length;
    const lo = minGap > 0 ? minGap - EPS : -Infinity;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const t = i < nu ? us[i] : ts[i - nu];
      if (t === exclude || !canTarget(u, t) || deployingBlocked(t, sim)) continue;
      const d = gap(u, t);
      if (d > maxGap + EPS || d < lo) continue;
      // Sight clip: buildings-targeting troops ignore targets far behind them.
      if (clip > 0 && !u.building && (t.y - u.y) * fwd < -clip) continue;
      if (d < bestD - 1e-9 || (Math.abs(d - bestD) <= 1e-9 && best && t.id < best.id)) { bestD = d; best = t; }
    }
    return best;
  }
  Units.findTarget = findTarget;

  /** Calls fn(t) for every live enemy of `side` (troops, buildings, alive crown towers). */
  Units.forEachEnemy = function (sim, side, fn) {
    const us = sim.units, ts = sim.towers;
    const nu = us.length, n = nu + ts.length;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const t = i < nu ? us[i] : ts[i - nu];
      if (t.side === side || t.dead || (t.tower && !t.alive) || offLayer(t)) continue;
      fn(t);
    }
  };

  /** Crown tower a troop walks to when nothing is in sight: lane princess tower, else king. */
  Units.defaultTower = function (sim, u) {
    const lane = CR.Arena.laneOf(u.x, u.side);
    let king = null, pr = null;
    for (let i = 0; i < sim.towers.length; i++) {
      const t = sim.towers[i];
      if (t.side === u.side || !t.alive) continue;
      if (t.towerKind === 'king') king = t;
      else if (t.lane === lane) pr = t;
    }
    return pr || king;
  };

  function setTarget(u, t) {
    if (u.target === t) return;
    u.target = t;
    u.locked = false;
    u.rampT = 0;
    // A new target restarts the wind-up (the unit stays loaded).
    if (u.atk > u.s.loadTime) u.atk = u.s.loadTime;
  }
  Units.setTarget = setTarget;

  /**
   * Re-evaluate the target. Troops retarget to the closest target in sight until they
   * started attacking (locked), then keep it while it stays in range. Buildings and crown
   * towers lock onto a target until it dies or leaves their range.
   */
  function selectTarget(sim, u) {
    const s = u.s;
    let t = u.target;
    if (t && (!canTarget(u, t) || deployingBlocked(t, sim))) { setTarget(u, null); t = null; }
    if (u.building) {
      if (t) {
        const g = gap(u, t);
        if (g <= s.range + EPS && !(s.minRange > 0 && g < s.minRange - EPS)) return t;
      }
      const n = findTarget(sim, u, s.range, s.minRange, null);
      setTarget(u, n);
      return n;
    }
    if (t && u.locked && gap(u, t) <= s.range + EPS) return t;
    const n = findTarget(sim, u, s.sightRange, 0, null);
    // Keep chasing the current target (still in sight) unless the new one is clearly closer:
    // no retarget thrashing between two nearly equidistant targets (RULES.routing).
    if (n && t && n !== t) {
      const gt = gap(u, t);
      const clipped = s.sightClip > 0 && (t.y - u.y) * (u.side === 0 ? 1 : -1) < -s.sightClip;
      if (!clipped && gt <= s.sightRange + EPS && gap(u, n) > gt - CR.RULES.routing.retargetHysteresis) return t;
    }
    setTarget(u, n);
    return n;
  }
  Units.selectTarget = selectTarget;

  // ===========================================================================
  // Status effects
  // ===========================================================================
  function resetAttack(u) {
    u.atk = 0;
    u.locked = false;
    u.rampT = 0;
    u.charging = false;
    u.chargeDist = 0;
    u.combo = 0;        // v6 Kung-Fu-Legende: stun / freeze / knockback break the punch combo
    u.lockStacks = 0;   // v12 Cyborg-Jäger: ... and the target lock
  }
  Units.resetAttack = resetAttack;

  Units.isStunned = function (sim, u) { return u.stunUntil > sim.tickStart + EPS || u.freezeUntil > sim.tickStart + EPS; };

  /** Stun for dur seconds from now: no movement/attacks; resets the attack (Zap reset). */
  Units.stun = function (sim, u, dur) {
    if (u.dead || !(dur > 0) || u.immune || u.tunnel) return;
    const until = sim.time + dur;
    if (until > u.stunUntil) u.stunUntil = until;
    if (CR.RULES.combat.resetOnStun) resetAttack(u);
  };
  /** Freeze for dur seconds from now (like stun, also pauses spawners/production). */
  Units.freeze = function (sim, u, dur) {
    if (u.dead || !(dur > 0) || u.immune || u.tunnel) return;
    const until = sim.time + dur;
    if (until > u.freezeUntil) u.freezeUntil = until;
    if (CR.RULES.combat.resetOnStun) resetAttack(u);
  };
  /** Slow by pct percent for dur seconds (strongest slow wins while active). */
  Units.slow = function (sim, u, pct, dur) {
    if (u.dead || !(dur > 0) || !(pct > 0) || u.immune || u.tunnel) return;
    const mult = Math.max(0, 1 - pct / 100);
    const active = u.slowUntil > sim.time + EPS;
    if (!active || mult <= u.slowMult) u.slowMult = mult;
    const until = sim.time + dur;
    if (until > u.slowUntil) u.slowUntil = until;
  };
  /** Rage: +pct percent move/attack/spawn speed until time+dur. */
  Units.rage = function (sim, u, pct, dur) {
    if (u.dead || !(dur > 0)) return;
    const mult = 1 + pct / 100;
    const active = u.rageUntil > sim.time + EPS;
    if (!active || mult >= u.rageMult) u.rageMult = mult;
    const until = sim.time + dur;
    if (until > u.rageUntil) u.rageUntil = until;
  };
  /** Knockback away from (fx,fy) by dist tiles (fast slide). Heavy troops/buildings are immune. */
  Units.knockback = function (sim, u, fx, fy, dist) {
    if (u.dead || !(dist > 0) || u.s.ignorePushback || u.building || u.tunnel || u.immune) return;
    let dx = u.x - fx, dy = u.y - fy;
    let d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    if (d < 1e-6) { dx = 0; dy = u.side === 0 ? -1 : 1; d = 1; }
    const T = Math.max(sim.dt, CR.RULES.combat.knockbackTime);
    u.kbVx = dx / d * dist / T;
    u.kbVy = dy / d * dist / T;
    u.kbLeft = T;
    if (CR.RULES.combat.resetOnKnockback) resetAttack(u);
    if (u.jump) { u.jump = null; u.untargetable = false; u.noCollide = false; u.z = 0; }
  };
  /** Pull toward (tx,ty) by at most step tiles this tick (Tornado). */
  Units.pull = function (sim, u, tx, ty, step) {
    if (u.dead || u.building || u.tunnel || u.immune || !(step > 0)) return false;
    const dx = tx - u.x, dy = ty - u.y;
    const d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    if (d < 1e-6) return false;
    const m = Math.min(step, d);
    u.x += dx / d * m;
    u.y += dy / d * m;
    u.charging = false;
    u.chargeDist = 0;
    return true;
  };
  Units.heal = function (sim, u, amount) {
    if (u.dead || !(amount > 0) || u.tower) return 0;
    const h = Math.min(amount, u.maxHp - u.hp);
    if (h > 0) u.hp += h;
    return h;
  };

  // ===========================================================================
  // Damage
  // ===========================================================================
  /**
   * Deal damage to t. kind: 'melee'|'ranged'|'splash'|'spell'|'death'|'charge'|'reflect'|'jump'.
   * Runs onDamage hooks (may change hit.amount), handles shields (no spill-over), king
   * activation, Electro Giant reflect and emits a 'hit' event. Returns damage dealt.
   */
  Units.damage = function (sim, t, amount, src, kind, srcSide) {
    if (!t || t.dead || !(amount > 0) || t.immune || (t.tower && !t.alive)) return 0;
    const side = srcSide !== undefined ? srcSide : (src ? src.side : -1);
    const hit = { amount: amount, src: src || null, kind: kind || 'melee', side: side, target: t };
    // v12: Kung-Fu-Legende dodge (ranged) / Schwarzklingen-Meister parry (troop melee).
    const tsp = t.s && t.s.special;
    if (tsp && (tsp.dodge || tsp.parry) && !t.tower && side !== t.side && Units.evade(sim, t, hit)) return 0;
    const hooks = sim.hooks.onDamage;
    for (let i = 0; i < hooks.length; i++) hooks[i](t, hit);
    const a = hit.amount;
    if (!(a > 0)) return 0;
    let shieldHit = false;
    if (t.shield > 0) {
      shieldHit = true;
      if (CR.RULES.combat.shieldSpill && a > t.shield) { t.hp -= a - t.shield; t.shield = 0; }
      else t.shield = Math.max(0, t.shield - a);
    } else {
      t.hp -= a;
    }
    if (t.hp <= 0) {
      t.hp = 0;
      if (!t.dead) { t.dead = true; t.killer = side; }
    }
    if (t.side === 0 || t.side === 1) {
      const st = sim.stats && sim.stats[1 - t.side];
      if (st && side === 1 - t.side) st.damage += a;
    }
    if (t.tower && t.towerKind === 'king' && !t.active && CR.RULES.kingActivation.onDamage) sim.activateKing(t.side, 'damage');
    // Electro Giant style reflect: attackers within the radius get zapped.
    const rf = t.s.special && t.s.special.reflect;
    if (rf && src && !src.dead && src.side !== t.side && (kind === 'melee' || kind === 'ranged' || kind === 'charge') && !t.dead) {
      if (shapeGap(src, t) <= num(rf.radius, 2) + EPS) {
        const rd = src.tower ? num(rf.ct, num(rf.damage, 0)) : num(rf.damage, 0);
        Units.damage(sim, src, rd, t, 'reflect', t.side);
        Units.stun(sim, src, num(rf.stun, 0.5));
      }
    }
    sim.emit('hit', { id: t.id, src: src ? src.id : 0, side: side, x: CR.round(t.x, 2), y: CR.round(t.y, 2), dmg: Math.round(a), kind: hit.kind, shield: shieldHit || undefined });
    return a;
  };

  function ctFor(t, dmg, ct) {
    return t.tower && ct !== null && ct !== undefined ? ct : dmg;
  }
  Units.ctFor = ctFor;

  /**
   * Apply an effect at (x,y) for `side`: area (radius > 0) or single target.
   * e: { damage, ct, radius, air, ground, buildings, towers, stun, freeze, slow:{pct,dur},
   *      knockback, kind, buildingMult, towerMult, spell, exclude:Set }
   * Returns the list of entities affected.
   */
  Units.applyEffect = function (sim, side, x, y, target, e, src) {
    const hitList = [];
    const radius = num(e.radius, 0);
    const kind = e.kind || 'splash';
    if (radius > 0) {
      const us = sim.units, ts = sim.towers;
      const nu = us.length, n = nu + ts.length;
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const t = i < nu ? us[i] : ts[i - nu];
        if (t.side === side || t.dead || (t.tower && !t.alive)) continue;
        if (t.tunnel || offLayer(t) || t.immune) continue;
        // Untargetable (mid-jump / dash) and hidden units dodge troop splash, not spells;
        // river-jumpers are airborne and dodge ground-only effects.
        if ((t.untargetable || t.hidden) && !e.spell) continue;
        if (t.jumping && e.air === false) continue;
        if (missesLayer(e, t)) continue;
        if (t.tower && e.towers === false) continue;
        if (t.building && !t.tower && e.buildings === false) continue;
        if (e.exclude && e.exclude.has(t.id)) continue;
        if (edgeDist(x, y, t) > radius + EPS) continue;
        hitList.push(t);
      }
    } else if (target && !target.dead && !(target.tower && !target.alive) && !offLayer(target)) {
      hitList.push(target);
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < hitList.length; i++) {
      const t = hitList[i];
      let dmg = num(e.damage, 0);
      if (t.building && !t.tower && e.buildingMult) dmg *= e.buildingMult;
      if (t.tower && e.towerMult) dmg *= e.towerMult;
      dmg = ctFor(t, dmg, e.ct);
      if (dmg > 0) Units.damage(sim, t, dmg, src || null, kind, side);
      if (e.exclude) e.exclude.add(t.id);
      if (t.dead) continue;
      if (e.stun) Units.stun(sim, t, e.stun);
      if (e.freeze) Units.freeze(sim, t, e.freeze);
      if (e.slow && e.slow.pct > 0) Units.slow(sim, t, e.slow.pct, e.slow.dur);
      if (e.knockback && !t.building) Units.knockback(sim, t, x, y, e.knockback);
    }
    return hitList;
  };

  // ===========================================================================
  // Spawning helpers
  // ===========================================================================
  /** Formation offsets (side-0 orientation, forward = +y). */
  Units.formation = function (count, radius, type, width) {
    const out = [];
    if (count <= 1) { out.push([0, 0]); return out; }
    if (type === 'line') {
      const w = num(width, radius * 2 * (count - 1));
      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) out.push([CR.round(-w / 2 + w * i / (count - 1), 4), 0]);
      return out;
    }
    if (count === 2) { out.push([-radius, 0], [radius, 0]); return out; }
    if (count <= 6) {
      const start = count === 4 ? Math.PI / 4 : Math.PI / 2;
      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const a = start + i * 2 * Math.PI / count;
        out.push([CR.round(Math.cos(a) * radius, 4), CR.round(Math.sin(a) * radius, 4)]);
      }
      return out;
    }
    // Large groups (Skeleton Army): centre + rings.
    out.push([0, 0]);
    let left = count - 1, ring = 1;
    while (left > 0) {
      const cap = ring * 6 + (ring > 1 ? 2 : 0);
      const n = Math.min(cap, left);
      const rr = radius * ring;
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const a = Math.PI / 2 + i * 2 * Math.PI / n + (ring % 2 ? 0 : Math.PI / n);
        out.push([CR.round(Math.cos(a) * rr, 4), CR.round(Math.sin(a) * rr, 4)]);
      }
      left -= n;
      ring++;
    }
    return out;
  };

  /**
   * Spawn `count` units of unitId around (x,y) for side; returns the entities.
   * opts: { card, tier, deployTime (null = unit's own), stagger, formation, width }
   */
  Units.spawnGroup = function (sim, side, unitId, x, y, count, radius, opts) {
    opts = opts || {};
    if (!CR.DATA || !CR.DATA.units || !CR.DATA.units[unitId]) return [];
    const offs = Units.formation(count, radius, opts.formation, opts.width);
    const out = [];
    const f = side === 0 ? 1 : -1;
    let base = (typeof opts.deployTime === 'number') ? opts.deployTime : null;
    if (base === null && !CR.RULES.deploy.spawnUsesUnitDeployTime) base = 0;
    const stagger = num(opts.stagger, 0);
    for (let i = 0; i < offs.length; i++) {
      const px = CR.clamp(x + offs[i][0] * f, 0.3, CR.Arena.W - 0.3);
      const py = CR.clamp(y + offs[i][1] * f, 0.3, CR.Arena.H - 0.3);
      const own = base === null ? Units.stats(unitId).deployTime : base;
      const u = sim.spawnUnit(side, unitId, px, py, { card: opts.card || null, tier: opts.tier || 0, deployTime: own + stagger * i });
      if (u) out.push(u);
    }
    return out;
  };

  // ===========================================================================
  // Projectiles
  // ===========================================================================
  /**
   * Launch a projectile. def: { kind, side, x, y, target, tx, ty, speed, homing, air,
   *   effect (see applyEffect; single target if radius 0), src, delay,
   *   mode: 'normal'|'roll'|'axe'|'chain', onArrive(sim,p), onEnd(sim,p), ... }
   */
  Units.launch = function (sim, def) {
    const p = Object.assign({
      id: sim.newId(), kind: 'shot', side: 0, x: 0, y: 0, z: 0, target: null, tx: null, ty: null, speed: 10,
      homing: false, air: false, effect: null, src: null, delay: 0, mode: 'normal', done: false,
      traveled: 0, hits: null, dx: 0, dy: 0, layer: Units.layer,
    }, def);
    if (typeof p.owner !== 'number') p.owner = p.src && typeof p.src.owner === 'number' && p.src.side === p.side ? p.src.owner : (typeof sim.ownerFor === 'function' ? sim.ownerFor(p.side) : p.side);
    if (p.tx === null || p.ty === null) {
      if (p.target) { p.tx = p.target.x; p.ty = p.target.y; }
      else { p.tx = p.x; p.ty = p.y; }
    }
    sim.projectiles.push(p);
    return p;
  };

  function arrive(sim, p) {
    if (p.onArrive) { p.onArrive(sim, p); return; }
    const e = p.effect || {};
    const t = p.homing && p.target && !p.target.dead && !(p.target.tower && !p.target.alive) && !offLayer(p.target) ? p.target : null;
    const src = p.src || null;
    if (num(e.radius, 0) > 0) {
      const list = Units.applyEffect(sim, p.side, p.x, p.y, null, e, src);
      // The aimed target is always hit by a homing splash shot (large footprints).
      if (t && list.indexOf(t) < 0) Units.applyEffect(sim, p.side, t.x, t.y, t, Object.assign({}, e, { radius: 0 }), src);
    } else if (t) {
      Units.applyEffect(sim, p.side, p.x, p.y, t, e, src);
    }
    if (e.chain && t) startChain(sim, p, t);
  }

  /** Rolling projectile (Log, Barbarian Barrel, Bowler boulder, sparks): hits each enemy once along its path. */
  function stepRoller(sim, p) {
    const step = p.speed * sim.dt;
    const remain = p.range - p.traveled;
    const m = Math.min(step, Math.max(0, remain));
    p.x += p.dx * m; p.y += p.dy * m;
    p.traveled += m;
    const e = p.effect;
    if (!p.hits) p.hits = new Set();
    const us = sim.units, ts = sim.towers;
    const nu = us.length, n = nu + ts.length;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const t = i < nu ? us[i] : ts[i - nu];
      if (t.side === p.side || t.dead || (t.tower && !t.alive) || p.hits.has(t.id) || t.tunnel || offLayer(t) || t.immune) continue;
      if (missesLayer(e, t)) continue;
      if ((t.hidden || t.untargetable) && !e.spell) continue;
      if (t.jumping && e.air === false) continue;
      // Swept rectangle: across the travel axis within half width, along the axis within reach.
      const rx = t.x - p.x, ry = t.y - p.y;
      const along = rx * p.dx + ry * p.dy;
      const across = Math.abs(rx * -p.dy + ry * p.dx);
      const tr = t.x1 !== undefined ? Math.max(t.x1 - t.x0, t.y1 - t.y0) / 2 : t.r;
      if (across > p.width + tr + EPS) continue;
      if (along > p.reach + tr + EPS || along < -(p.reach + tr) - EPS - m) continue;
      p.hits.add(t.id);
      const dmg = ctFor(t, num(e.damage, 0), e.ct);
      if (dmg > 0) Units.damage(sim, t, dmg, p.src && !p.src.dead ? p.src : null, e.kind || 'splash', p.side);
      if (!t.dead) {
        if (e.knockback && !t.building) Units.knockback(sim, t, t.x - p.dx, t.y - p.dy, e.knockback);
        if (e.stun) Units.stun(sim, t, e.stun);
        if (e.slow) Units.slow(sim, t, e.slow.pct, e.slow.dur);
      }
    }
    if (p.traveled >= p.range - EPS) {
      p.done = true;
      if (p.onEnd) p.onEnd(sim, p);
    }
  }

  /** Executioner axe: flies out to p.range, then back to the thrower; hits once per direction. */
  function stepAxe(sim, p) {
    const step = p.speed * sim.dt;
    let tx, ty;
    if (!p.back) {
      tx = p.ox + p.dx * p.range; ty = p.oy + p.dy * p.range;
    } else {
      const s = p.src;
      if (s && !s.dead) { tx = s.x; ty = s.y; } else { tx = p.ox; ty = p.oy; }
    }
    const dx = tx - p.x, dy = ty - p.y;
    const d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    const m = Math.min(step, d);
    if (d > 1e-9) { p.x += dx / d * m; p.y += dy / d * m; }
    const e = p.effect;
    const set = p.back ? (p.hitsB || (p.hitsB = new Set())) : (p.hits || (p.hits = new Set()));
    const us = sim.units, ts = sim.towers;
    const nu = us.length, n = nu + ts.length;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const t = i < nu ? us[i] : ts[i - nu];
      if (t.side === p.side || t.dead || (t.tower && !t.alive) || set.has(t.id) || t.tunnel || offLayer(t) || t.immune || t.hidden || t.jumping) continue;
      if (missesLayer(e, t)) continue;
      if (edgeDist(p.x, p.y, t) > p.width + EPS) continue;
      set.add(t.id);
      Units.damage(sim, t, ctFor(t, num(e.damage, 0), e.ct), p.src && !p.src.dead ? p.src : null, 'ranged', p.side);
    }
    if (d <= step + EPS) {
      if (!p.back) p.back = true;
      else p.done = true;
    }
  }

  /** Electro Spirit chain: hop to the closest unhit enemy within radius every hopDelay. */
  function startChain(sim, p, firstT) {
    const c = p.effect.chain;
    return Units.launch(sim, {
      kind: 'chain', side: p.side, x: firstT.x, y: firstT.y, speed: 0, mode: 'chain',
      effect: { damage: p.effect.damage, ct: p.effect.ct, stun: num(c.stun, 0) || p.effect.stun || 0, air: p.effect.air, ground: p.effect.ground, kind: 'splash' },
      chain: { left: Math.max(0, num(c.maxTargets, 1) - 1), radius: num(c.radius, 3), hop: num(c.hopDelay, 0.25), last: firstT, hit: new Set([firstT.id]), next: num(c.hopDelay, 0.25) },
      src: p.src,
    });
  }

  function stepChain(sim, p) {
    const c = p.chain;
    c.next -= sim.dt;
    if (c.next > EPS) return;
    if (c.left <= 0) { p.done = true; return; }
    const lx = c.last ? c.last.x : p.x, ly = c.last ? c.last.y : p.y;
    let best = null, bestD = Infinity;
    const e = p.effect;
    const us = sim.units, ts = sim.towers;
    const nu = us.length, n = nu + ts.length;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const t = i < nu ? us[i] : ts[i - nu];
      if (t.side === p.side || !isTargetable(t) || c.hit.has(t.id)) continue;
      if (missesLayer(e, t)) continue;
      const d = edgeDist(lx, ly, t);
      if (d > c.radius + EPS) continue;
      if (d < bestD - 1e-9 || (Math.abs(d - bestD) <= 1e-9 && best && t.id < best.id)) { bestD = d; best = t; }
    }
    if (!best) { p.done = true; return; }
    c.hit.add(best.id);
    c.last = best;
    c.left--;
    p.x = best.x; p.y = best.y;
    Units.damage(sim, best, ctFor(best, num(e.damage, 0), e.ct), null, 'splash', p.side);
    if (!best.dead && e.stun) Units.stun(sim, best, e.stun);
    c.next += c.hop;
  }

  Units.updateProjectiles = function (sim) {
    const ps = sim.projectiles;
    const dt = sim.dt;
    // Projectiles launched during this update (chains, sparks) start next tick.
    const n = ps.length;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const p = ps[i];
      if (p.done) continue;
      sim._owner = p.owner;
      Units.layer = p.layer === 1 ? 1 : 0;
      if (p.delay > EPS) { p.delay -= dt; if (p.delay > EPS) continue; p.delay = 0; }
      if (p.mode === 'roll') { stepRoller(sim, p); continue; }
      if (p.mode === 'axe') { stepAxe(sim, p); continue; }
      if (p.mode === 'chain') { stepChain(sim, p); continue; }
      if (p.homing && p.target) {
        if (!p.target.dead && !(p.target.tower && !p.target.alive)) { p.tx = p.target.x; p.ty = p.target.y; }
        else if (!CR.RULES.combat.projectileFollowDead) { p.done = true; continue; }
      }
      const dx = p.tx - p.x, dy = p.ty - p.y;
      const d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
      const step = p.speed * dt;
      if (d <= step + EPS) {
        p.x = p.tx; p.y = p.ty;
        p.done = true;
        arrive(sim, p);
      } else {
        p.x += dx / d * step;
        p.y += dy / d * step;
      }
    }
    Units.layer = 0;
    // Compact (stable order).
    let w = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < ps.length; i++) if (!ps[i].done) ps[w++] = ps[i];
    ps.length = w;
  };

  // ===========================================================================
  // Attacks
  // ===========================================================================
  /** Build the on-hit effect of a unit's normal attack. */
  function attackEffect(u, dmg, kindOverride) {
    const s = u.s, sp = s.special;
    const e = {
      damage: dmg, ct: s.ct, radius: s.splashRadius, air: s.targetsAir || (s.targetsGround && levelled(u)), ground: s.targetsGround,
      kind: kindOverride || ((s.projectile || sp.instantHit) ? 'ranged' : 'melee'),
    };
    const oh = sp.onHit;
    if (oh) {
      if (oh.stun) e.stun = oh.stun;
      if (oh.freeze) e.freeze = oh.freeze;
      const sl = normSlow(oh.slow);
      if (sl) e.slow = sl;
      if (oh.knockback) e.knockback = oh.knockback;
    }
    if (sp.chain) {
      e.chain = { maxTargets: num(sp.chain.maxTargets, 1), radius: num(sp.chain.radius, 3), hopDelay: num(sp.chain.hopDelay, 0.25), stun: num(sp.chain.stun, 0) };
      if (e.chain.stun > 0 && !e.stun) e.stun = e.chain.stun;
    }
    return e;
  }

  function currentDamage(u) {
    const s = u.s;
    if (s.ramp) {
      let t = u.rampT;
      for (let i = 0; i < s.ramp.length; i++) {
        const st = s.ramp[i];
        if (t < st.duration - EPS || i === s.ramp.length - 1) return st.damage;
        t -= st.duration;
      }
    }
    return s.damage;
  }
  Units.currentDamage = currentDamage;

  /** v6 chain lightning targets: first, then the closest unhit enemy within radius of the last one. */
  function chainTargets(sim, u, first, max, radius, e) {
    const out = [first];
    let last = first;
    const us = sim.units, ts = sim.towers;
    const nu = us.length, n = nu + ts.length;
    while (out.length < max) {
      let best = null, bestD = Infinity;
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const c = i < nu ? us[i] : ts[i - nu];
        if (c.side === u.side || !isTargetable(c) || c.tunnel || offLayer(c) || c.immune || out.indexOf(c) >= 0) continue;
        if (deployingBlocked(c, sim) || missesLayer(e, c)) continue;
        const d = edgeDist(last.x, last.y, c);
        if (d > radius + EPS) continue;
        if (d < bestD - 1e-9 || (Math.abs(d - bestD) <= 1e-9 && best && c.id < best.id)) { bestD = d; best = c; }
      }
      if (!best) break;
      out.push(best);
      last = best;
    }
    return out;
  }
  Units.chainTargets = chainTargets;

  /** v6 base-card ability event (Elektrodrache chain, Kung-Fu-Legende combo / one-inch / dash).
   *  Shape like the C.H.A.O.S ability events but `base: true` and no rarity. */
  function abilityEvent(sim, u, kind, x, y, radius, extra) {
    const ev = { side: u.side, player: u.owner, unitId: u.id, unit: u.unit, card: u.card || u.unit, kind: kind, x: CR.round(x, 2), y: CR.round(y, 2), radius: radius, base: true };
    if (extra) for (const k in extra) if (extra[k] !== undefined) ev[k] = typeof extra[k] === 'number' ? CR.round(extra[k], 2) : extra[k];
    sim.emit('ability', ev);
  }
  Units.abilityEvent = abilityEvent;

  /** Perform one attack of u on t (the hit moment of the cycle). */
  function performAttack(sim, u, t, isCharge) {
    const s = u.s, sp = s.special;
    let dmg = isCharge && s.charge ? s.charge.damage : currentDamage(u);
    // v6 Kung-Fu-Legende punch combo: every `every`-th hit on the same target is the one-inch punch.
    let combo = 0, finisher = false;
    if (sp.combo && !isCharge) {
      if (u.comboTarget !== t.id) { u.combo = 0; u.comboTarget = t.id; }
      combo = (u.combo | 0) + 1;
      const every = Math.max(1, Math.round(num(sp.combo.every, 3)));
      finisher = combo >= every;
      u.combo = finisher ? 0 : combo;
      if (finisher) dmg += num(sp.combo.bonus, 0);
    }
    const hit = { amount: dmg, charge: !!isCharge, kind: (s.projectile || sp.instantHit) ? 'ranged' : 'melee', combo: combo || undefined, finisher: finisher || undefined };
    const hooks = sim.hooks.onAttack;
    for (let i = 0; i < hooks.length; i++) hooks[i](u, t, hit);
    dmg = hit.amount;
    const e = attackEffect(u, dmg, isCharge ? 'charge' : null);
    if (isCharge && s.charge && s.charge.splashRadius > 0) e.radius = s.charge.splashRadius;
    u.dir = Math.atan2(t.y - u.y, t.x - u.x);

    if (sp.chainLightning) {
      // v6 Electro Dragon: instant chain lightning - the target, then each closest unhit enemy
      // within `radius` of the previous one (up to maxTargets); every hit stuns (Zap reset).
      const cl = sp.chainLightning;
      const list = chainTargets(sim, u, t, Math.max(1, Math.round(num(cl.maxTargets, 3))), num(cl.radius, 4), e);
      const single = Object.assign({}, e, { radius: 0 });
      if (num(cl.stun, 0) > 0 && !(single.stun > 0)) single.stun = cl.stun;
      const ids = [], pts = [];
      for (let k = 0; k < list.length; k++) {
        const c = list[k];
        ids.push(c.id); pts.push(CR.round(c.x, 2), CR.round(c.y, 2));
        Units.applyEffect(sim, u.side, c.x, c.y, c, single, u);
      }
      if (sp.abilityEvents) abilityEvent(sim, u, 'chain', u.x, u.y, num(cl.radius, 4), { tx: t.x, ty: t.y, target: t.id, units: ids, pts: pts, dmg: Math.round(dmg), hops: list.length });
    } else if (sp.boulder) {
      const dx = t.x - u.x, dy = t.y - u.y, d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) || 1;
      const half = num(sp.boulder.radius, 1.8) * 0.5;
      Units.launch(sim, {
        kind: 'boulder', side: u.side, x: u.x + dx / d * u.r, y: u.y + dy / d * u.r, speed: s.projectile ? s.projectile.speed : 3,
        mode: 'roll', dx: dx / d, dy: dy / d, range: num(sp.boulder.range, 7), width: half, reach: half, src: u,
        effect: { damage: dmg, ct: s.ct, air: false, ground: true, knockback: num(sp.boulder.knockback, 1), kind: 'ranged' },
      });
    } else if (sp.axe) {
      const dx = t.x - u.x, dy = t.y - u.y, d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) || 1;
      const range = CR.clamp(d, num(sp.axe.minRange, 4.5), num(sp.axe.range, 7));
      Units.launch(sim, {
        kind: 'axe', side: u.side, x: u.x, y: u.y, ox: u.x, oy: u.y, dx: dx / d, dy: dy / d, range: range,
        speed: s.projectile ? s.projectile.speed : 9, mode: 'axe', width: num(sp.axe.radius, 1), src: u, air: true,
        effect: { damage: dmg, ct: s.ct, air: s.targetsAir, ground: s.targetsGround },
      });
    } else if (sp.sparks) {
      // Firecracker: the shell bursts at the target point into sparks that fly on along the shot direction.
      const dx = t.x - u.x, dy = t.y - u.y, d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) || 1;
      const sk = sp.sparks;
      const ux = dx / d, uy = dy / d;
      const self = u;
      Units.launch(sim, {
        kind: 'firecracker', side: u.side, x: u.x, y: u.y, tx: t.x, ty: t.y, speed: s.projectile ? s.projectile.speed : 8, homing: false, src: u, air: true,
        effect: { damage: 0 },
        onArrive: function (sim2, p) {
          const cnt = num(sk.count, 5), spread = num(sk.spread, 0.35);
          for (let k = 0; k < cnt; k++) {
            const a = (k - (cnt - 1) / 2) * spread / Math.max(1, (cnt - 1) / 2) * 0.5;
            const ca = Math.cos(a), sa = Math.sin(a);
            const vx = ux * ca - uy * sa, vy = ux * sa + uy * ca;
            Units.launch(sim2, {
              kind: 'spark', side: p.side, x: p.x, y: p.y, dx: vx, dy: vy, speed: num(sk.speed, 9), mode: 'roll',
              range: num(sk.travel, 5), width: num(sk.radius, 0.4), reach: num(sk.radius, 0.4), src: self, air: true,
              effect: { damage: num(sk.damage, dmg), ct: s.ct, air: s.targetsAir, ground: s.targetsGround, kind: 'ranged' },
            });
          }
        },
      });
      if (sp.recoil) Units.knockbackSelf(sim, u, t, sp.recoil);
    } else if (sp.shotgun) {
      // v7 Cyborg-Jäger: pump-action shotgun, cone blast (then the visible pump reload).
      if (sp.lockOn) {
        // v12 target lock: every further shot at the same target hits it harder.
        if (u.lockTarget !== t.id) { u.lockTarget = t.id; u.lockStacks = 0; }
        else u.lockStacks = Math.min(Math.max(0, Math.round(num(sp.lockOn.max, 3))), (u.lockStacks | 0) + 1);
        if (sp.abilityEvents) abilityEvent(sim, u, 'lock_on', t.x, t.y, t.r, { target: t.id, stacks: u.lockStacks, mult: 1 + num(sp.lockOn.step, 0.2) * u.lockStacks, tx: u.x, ty: u.y });
      }
      Units.shotgunBlast(sim, u, t, dmg, e, hit);
      if (sp.pump) u.pumpAt = sim.time + num(sp.pump.delay, 0.55);
    } else if (sp.sphere) {
      // v7 Wirbel-Ninja: thrown spinning energy sphere (area damage + knockback on impact).
      Units.throwSphere(sim, u, t, dmg, e, hit);
    } else if (sp.multiTarget) {
      // Electro Wizard: bolts to `count` different targets in range (a single target takes all).
      const cnt = Math.max(1, Math.round(num(sp.multiTarget.count, 2)));
      const targets = [t];
      while (targets.length < cnt) {
        let best = null, bestD = Infinity;
        const us = sim.units, ts = sim.towers;
        const nu = us.length, n = nu + ts.length;
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          const c = i < nu ? us[i] : ts[i - nu];
          if (targets.indexOf(c) >= 0 || !canTarget(u, c)) continue;
          const g = gap(u, c);
          if (g > s.range + EPS) continue;
          if (g < bestD - 1e-9 || (Math.abs(g - bestD) <= 1e-9 && best && c.id < best.id)) { bestD = g; best = c; }
        }
        if (!best) break;
        targets.push(best);
      }
      const single = Object.assign({}, e, { radius: 0 });
      for (let k = 0; k < cnt; k++) {
        const bt = targets[Math.min(k, targets.length - 1)];
        if (bt.dead) continue;
        Units.applyEffect(sim, u.side, bt.x, bt.y, bt, single, u);
      }
    } else if (s.projectile && !sp.instantHit) {
      Units.launch(sim, {
        kind: u.unit, side: u.side, x: u.x, y: u.y, target: t, tx: t.x, ty: t.y,
        speed: s.projectile.speed, homing: s.projectile.homing, air: u.air || t.air, src: u, effect: e,
      });
      if (sp.recoil) Units.knockbackSelf(sim, u, t, sp.recoil);
    } else {
      // Melee (or instant ranged: Tesla, Inferno beam): damage now.
      if (e.radius > 0) {
        const cx = s.splashSelf ? u.x : t.x, cy = s.splashSelf ? u.y : t.y;
        const hitList = Units.applyEffect(sim, u.side, cx, cy, null, e, u);
        // The primary target is always hit even if the splash circle misses it (large buildings).
        if (hitList.indexOf(t) < 0 && !t.dead) Units.applyEffect(sim, u.side, t.x, t.y, t, Object.assign({}, e, { radius: 0 }), u);
      } else {
        Units.applyEffect(sim, u.side, t.x, t.y, t, e, u);
      }
      if (sp.recoil) Units.knockbackSelf(sim, u, t, sp.recoil);
    }
    if (combo) {
      // One-inch punch: short knockback away from the fighter (buildings / heavy troops stay).
      if (finisher && !t.dead && !t.tower) Units.knockback(sim, t, u.x, u.y, num(sp.combo.knockback, 0.75));
      if (sp.abilityEvents) abilityEvent(sim, u, finisher ? 'one-inch' : 'combo', t.x, t.y, finisher ? 0.9 : 0.5, { tx: u.x, ty: u.y, target: t.id, hit: combo, dmg: Math.round(dmg) });
    }
    if (sp.healOnAttack) Units.healPulse(sim, u, sp.healOnAttack);
    if (s.kamikaze) { u.hp = 0; u.dead = true; u.killer = u.side; u.kamikazeDone = true; }
    if (!isCharge) { u.chargeDist = 0; u.charging = false; }
  }
  Units.performAttack = performAttack;

  // ===========================================================================
  // v7 card mechanics (docs/V7-CARDS.md)
  // ===========================================================================
  /** Half size of an entity seen from outside (circle radius, or half the larger box side). */
  function halfSize(t) { return t.x1 !== undefined ? Math.max(t.x1 - t.x0, t.y1 - t.y0) / 2 : t.r; }

  /**
   * Cyborg-Jäger cone: the aimed target plus every enemy whose shape lies in the cone of half
   * angle `sg.angle` around the aim line within range + `sg.reach` (edge to edge). Filters like
   * troop splash (no hidden / untargetable / underground, air by the effect's layer).
   */
  Units.shotgunTargets = function (sim, u, t, sg, e) {
    const out = [t];
    const ax = t.x - u.x, ay = t.y - u.y, ad = sqrt(ax * ax + ay * ay) || 1;
    const ux = ax / ad, uy = ay / ad;
    const reach = u.s.range + num(sg.reach, 0.6);
    const half = num(sg.angle, 0.5);
    const us = sim.units, ts = sim.towers;
    const nu = us.length, n = nu + ts.length;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const c = i < nu ? us[i] : ts[i - nu];
      if (c === t || c.side === u.side || c.dead || (c.tower && !c.alive) || c.tunnel || offLayer(c) || c.immune || c.untargetable || c.hidden) continue;
      if (c.jumping && e.air === false) continue;
      if (missesLayer(e, c)) continue;
      if (gap(u, c) > reach + EPS) continue;
      const dx = c.x - u.x, dy = c.y - u.y, d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
      if (d > 1e-6) {
        const cos = CR.clamp((dx * ux + dy * uy) / d, -1, 1);
        if (Math.acos(cos) > half + Math.atan2(halfSize(c), d) + EPS) continue;
      }
      out.push(c);
    }
    return out;
  };

  /** One shotgun blast of u aimed at t: full damage within `close` tiles, `farMult` beyond. */
  Units.shotgunBlast = function (sim, u, t, dmg, e, hit) {
    const sg = u.s.special.shotgun || {};
    if (!e) e = attackEffect(u, dmg, null);
    const list = Units.shotgunTargets(sim, u, t, sg, e);
    const close = num(sg.close, 2), far = num(sg.farMult, 0.6);
    const single = Object.assign({}, e, { radius: 0 });
    const ids = [];
    const lo = u.s.special.lockOn;
    const lock = lo && u.lockTarget === t.id && u.lockStacks > 0 ? 1 + num(lo.step, 0.2) * u.lockStacks : 1;
    for (let k = 0; k < list.length; k++) {
      const c = list[k];
      if (c.dead) continue;
      const g = gap(u, c);
      single.damage = (g <= close + EPS ? dmg : dmg * far) * (c === t ? lock : 1);
      ids.push(c.id);
      Units.applyEffect(sim, u.side, c.x, c.y, c, single, u);
    }
    u.dir = Math.atan2(t.y - u.y, t.x - u.x);
    if (u.s.special.abilityEvents) {
      abilityEvent(sim, u, 'shotgun', u.x, u.y, u.s.range + num(sg.reach, 0.6) + u.r, {
        tx: t.x, ty: t.y, target: t.id, angle: num(sg.angle, 0.5), units: ids, dmg: Math.round(dmg),
        second: hit && hit.second ? true : undefined, lock: lock > 1 ? u.lockStacks : undefined,
      });
    }
    return list;
  };

  /** Wirbel-Ninja throw: homing sphere; on impact area damage + knockback along the throw. */
  Units.throwSphere = function (sim, u, t, dmg, e, hit) {
    const so = u.s.special.sphere || {};
    if (!e) e = attackEffect(u, dmg, null);
    const scale = hit && hit.sphereScale > 0 ? hit.sphereScale : 1;
    const radius = num(so.radius, u.s.splashRadius || 1.2) * scale;
    const kb = num(so.knockback, 0.7) * scale;
    const speed = u.s.projectile ? u.s.projectile.speed : num(so.speed, 7.5);
    const dx = t.x - u.x, dy = t.y - u.y, d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) || 1;
    const ux = dx / d, uy = dy / d, fx = u.x, fy = u.y;
    const self = u;
    const eff = Object.assign({}, e, { radius: radius, knockback: 0 });
    Units.launch(sim, {
      kind: 'spiral-sphere', side: u.side, x: u.x, y: u.y, target: t, tx: t.x, ty: t.y, speed: speed, homing: true,
      air: u.air || t.air, src: u, effect: eff, scale: scale,
      onArrive: function (sim2, p) {
        const src = self.dead ? null : self;
        const list = Units.applyEffect(sim2, p.side, p.x, p.y, null, eff, src);
        const tt = p.target && !p.target.dead && !(p.target.tower && !p.target.alive) ? p.target : null;
        if (tt && list.indexOf(tt) < 0) { Units.applyEffect(sim2, p.side, tt.x, tt.y, tt, Object.assign({}, eff, { radius: 0 }), src); list.push(tt); }
        const ids = [];
        for (let k = 0; k < list.length; k++) {
          const c = list[k];
          ids.push(c.id);
          if (!c.dead && !c.building && kb > 0) Units.knockback(sim2, c, c.x - ux, c.y - uy, kb);
        }
        if (self.s.special.abilityEvents) abilityEvent(sim2, self, 'sphere', p.x, p.y, radius, { phase: 'impact', tx: fx, ty: fy, units: ids, scale: scale !== 1 ? scale : undefined });
      },
    });
    u.dir = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
    if (u.s.special.abilityEvents) abilityEvent(sim, u, 'sphere', u.x, u.y, radius, { phase: 'throw', tx: t.x, ty: t.y, target: t.id, dur: d / Math.max(0.1, speed), speed: speed, scale: scale !== 1 ? scale : undefined });
  };

  /**
   * Direction of a champion ability: towards the current target when it has one, else straight
   * ahead (towards the enemy side). Writes {x, y} (unit vector) into out.
   */
  Units.abilityDir = function (u, out) {
    const t = u.target;
    if (t && !t.dead && !(t.tower && !t.alive)) {
      const dx = t.x - u.x, dy = t.y - u.y, d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
      if (d > 1e-6) { out.x = dx / d; out.y = dy / d; return out; }
    }
    out.x = 0; out.y = u.side === 0 ? 1 : -1;
    return out;
  };

  /** Distance from (x,y) along unit vector (dx,dy) to the arena border. */
  function toBorder(x, y, dx, dy) {
    let m = Infinity;
    if (dx > 1e-9) m = Math.min(m, (CR.Arena.W - x) / dx); else if (dx < -1e-9) m = Math.min(m, -x / dx);
    if (dy > 1e-9) m = Math.min(m, (CR.Arena.H - y) / dy); else if (dy < -1e-9) m = Math.min(m, -y / dy);
    return m === Infinity ? 0 : Math.max(0, m);
  }

  /**
   * Schwarzklingen-Meister slash wave from u along angle `ang`: a rolling wave (projectile mode
   * 'roll', kind 'slash-wave') hitting every enemy troop, building and crown tower in its path
   * once (air too), crown towers take `ct`. o: { mult (damage factor), range, halfWidth }.
   */
  Units.slashWave = function (sim, u, ang, o) {
    o = o || {};
    const ab = u.s.special.ability || {};
    const dx = Math.cos(ang), dy = Math.sin(ang);
    const x0 = CR.clamp(u.x + dx * u.r, 0, CR.Arena.W), y0 = CR.clamp(u.y + dy * u.r, 0, CR.Arena.H);
    const range = Math.max(0.5, Math.min(num(o.range, num(ab.range, 16)), toBorder(x0, y0, dx, dy)));
    const mult = num(o.mult, 1);
    const ct = typeof ab.ct === 'number' ? ab.ct * mult : null;
    return Units.launch(sim, {
      kind: 'slash-wave', side: u.side, x: x0, y: y0, dx: dx, dy: dy, mode: 'roll', range: range,
      width: num(o.halfWidth, num(ab.halfWidth, 1)), reach: 0.6, speed: num(ab.speed, 10), src: u, air: true,
      effect: { damage: num(ab.damage, 400) * mult, ct: ct, air: true, ground: true, spell: true, kind: 'splash' },
    });
  };

  /**
   * Start the champion ability of u (validated + paid by the sim): u.ability = wind-up state;
   * stepAbility launches the effect when the wind-up ends. Emits 'champion_slash' (phase 'windup').
   */
  Units.championAbility = function (sim, u) {
    const ab = u.s.special.ability;
    if (!ab || u.dead || u.ability) return false;
    const dir = Units.abilityDir(u, TMP);
    const ang = Math.atan2(dir.y, dir.x);
    const waves = Math.max(1, Math.round(num(ab.waves, 1)));
    const spread = num(ab.spread, 0.35);
    const angs = [];
    for (let k = 0; k < waves; k++) angs.push(ang + (k - (waves - 1) / 2) * spread);
    u.ability = { t: 0, windup: Math.max(0, num(ab.windup, 0.35)), kind: ab.kind || 'slash', angs: angs };
    u.abilityProj = null;
    // The swing replaces the current wind-up (the champion stays loaded).
    if (u.atk > u.s.loadTime) u.atk = u.s.loadTime;
    u.dir = ang;
    u.state = 'attacking';
    if (u.s.special.abilityEvents !== false) {
      const x0 = u.x + dir.x * u.r, y0 = u.y + dir.y * u.r;
      const len = Math.min(num(ab.range, 16), toBorder(x0, y0, dir.x, dir.y));
      abilityEvent(sim, u, 'champion_slash', u.x, u.y, num(ab.halfWidth, 1), {
        phase: 'windup', tx: x0 + dir.x * len, ty: y0 + dir.y * len, delay: u.ability.windup, speed: num(ab.speed, 10),
        range: len, waves: waves > 1 ? waves : undefined, spread: waves > 1 ? spread : undefined, ang: ang,
      });
    }
    if (!(u.ability.windup > EPS)) stepAbility(sim, u, true);
    return true;
  };

  function stepAbility(sim, u, now) {
    const a = u.ability;
    if (!now) a.t += sim.dt;
    u.state = 'attacking';
    if (a.t < a.windup - EPS) return;
    u.ability = null;
    let last = null;
    const all = [];
    for (let k = 0; k < a.angs.length; k++) { last = Units.slashWave(sim, u, a.angs[k], null); all.push(last); }
    u.abilityProj = last;
    u.abilityProjs = all.length > 1 ? all : null;
    u.atk = u.s.loadTime;
    if (u.s.special.abilityEvents !== false) {
      const ab = u.s.special.ability || {};
      abilityEvent(sim, u, 'champion_slash', last ? last.x : u.x, last ? last.y : u.y, num(ab.halfWidth, 1), {
        phase: 'launch', tx: last ? last.x + last.dx * last.range : u.x, ty: last ? last.y + last.dy * last.range : u.y,
        speed: num(ab.speed, 10), range: last ? last.range : 0, proj: last ? last.id : 0, waves: a.angs.length > 1 ? a.angs.length : undefined,
      });
    }
  }
  Units.stepAbility = stepAbility;
  /** Is a champion ability of u still running (wind-up or a wave in flight)? */
  Units.abilityActive = function (u) {
    if (!u || u.dead) return false;
    if (u.ability) return true;
    if (u.abilityProjs) { for (let i = 0; i < u.abilityProjs.length; i++) if (!u.abilityProjs[i].done) return true; return false; }
    return !!(u.abilityProj && !u.abilityProj.done);
  };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // v12 extra abilities of the custom cards (docs/V7-CARDS.md "v12")
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  /**
   * Dodge / parry check for a hit on t (called by Units.damage before the onDamage hooks).
   * Kung-Fu-Legende (special.dodge): the next ranged hit (troop shots, crown tower shots; never
   * spells, splash of spells or death damage) every `cooldown` s misses. Schwarzklingen-Meister
   * (special.parry): the next melee / charge hit of a troop every `cooldown` s is parried and
   * answered with a riposte of `riposte` x sword damage at the attacker (when still in reach).
   * Returns true when the hit is cancelled.
   */
  Units.evade = function (sim, t, hit) {
    const sp = t.s.special, k = hit.kind, now = sim.time, src = hit.src;
    if (t.dead || t.deployEnd > now + EPS) return false;
    if (sp.dodge && k === 'ranged' && now >= t.dodgeAt - EPS) {
      t.dodgeAt = now + Math.max(0.1, num(sp.dodge.cooldown, 5));
      if (sp.abilityEvents) abilityEvent(sim, t, 'dodge', t.x, t.y, t.r, { src: src ? src.id : 0, tx: src ? src.x : t.x, ty: src ? src.y : t.y, dmg: Math.round(hit.amount) });
      return true;
    }
    if (sp.parry && (k === 'melee' || k === 'charge') && src && !src.tower && !src.building && now >= t.parryAt - EPS) {
      t.parryAt = now + Math.max(0.1, num(sp.parry.cooldown, 4));
      const rd = t.s.damage * num(sp.parry.riposte, 0.5);
      const reach = !src.dead && shapeGap(t, src) <= t.s.range + 0.5 + EPS && canTarget(t, src);
      if (sp.abilityEvents) abilityEvent(sim, t, 'parry', t.x, t.y, t.r, { src: src.id, tx: src.x, ty: src.y, dmg: Math.round(hit.amount), riposte: reach ? Math.round(rd) : 0 });
      if (reach && rd > 0) {
        t.dir = Math.atan2(src.y - t.y, src.x - t.x);
        Units.damage(sim, src, rd, t, 'splash', t.side);
      }
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  };

  /** Kung-Fu-Legende spinning kick: when >= whirl.min enemy ground troops (no buildings / towers)
   *  stand within whirl.radius of u, all of them take whirl.damage and are pushed away. */
  Units.whirlKick = function (sim, u) {
    const w = u.s.special.whirl;
    const radius = num(w.radius, 1.6), us = sim.units;
    let cnt = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < us.length; i++) {
      const c = us[i];
      if (c.air || c.building || c.tunnel || offLayer(c) || c.immune || !canTarget(u, c) || deployingBlocked(c, sim)) continue;
      if (edgeDist(u.x, u.y, c) <= radius + EPS) cnt++;
    }
    if (cnt < Math.max(1, Math.round(num(w.min, 2)))) return false;
    u.whirlAt = sim.time + Math.max(0.1, num(w.cooldown, 6));
    const list = Units.applyEffect(sim, u.side, u.x, u.y, null, {
      damage: num(w.damage, 140), ct: null, radius: radius, air: false, ground: true, towers: false, buildings: false,
      knockback: num(w.knockback, 0.6), kind: 'splash',
    }, u);
    if (u.s.special.abilityEvents) abilityEvent(sim, u, 'whirlwind', u.x, u.y, radius, { units: list.map(function (c) { return c.id; }), dmg: Math.round(num(w.damage, 140)) });
    return true;
  };

  /** Wirbel-Ninja shadow clones: `count` copies of u beside it with `hp` x HP, `damage` x damage,
   *  no shield, deployed at once; they fade after `life` s (u.fadeAt, Units.tickStatus). */
  Units.shadowClones = function (sim, u) {
    const sc = u.s.special.shadowClones;
    u.shadowDone = true;
    const n = Math.max(0, Math.round(num(sc.count, 2)));
    const off = num(sc.offset, 1.1), hpF = num(sc.hp, 0.3), dmgF = num(sc.damage, 0.5), life = num(sc.life, 8);
    const ids = [], pos = [];
    for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
      const sgn = k % 2 ? 1 : -1, ring = 1 + (k >> 1);
      let x = u.x + sgn * off * ring;
      if (x < u.r || x > CR.Arena.W - u.r) x = u.x - sgn * off * ring;
      x = CR.clamp(x, u.r, CR.Arena.W - u.r);
      const y = u.y - (u.side === 0 ? 0.3 : -0.3);
      const w = sim.spawnUnit(u.side, u.unit, x, y, { card: u.card, tier: u.tier, deployTime: 0, owner: u.owner, shadowClone: true });
      if (!w) continue;
      w.shadowClone = true; w.shadowDone = true; w.spawnedBy = u.id;
      w.hp = w.maxHp = Math.max(1, Math.round(w.maxHp * hpF));
      w.shield = w.maxShield = 0;
      w.s.damage *= dmgF;
      if (typeof w.s.ct === 'number') w.s.ct *= dmgF;
      w.fadeAt = sim.time + life;
      w.dir = u.dir;
      ids.push(w.id);
      pos.push({ id: w.id, x: CR.round(w.x, 2), y: CR.round(w.y, 2) });
    }
    if (u.s.special.abilityEvents && ids.length) abilityEvent(sim, u, 'shadow_clone', u.x, u.y, off, { phase: 'spawn', units: ids, clones: pos, life: life });
    return ids;
  };

  /** Recoil: push the shooter back away from its target (Sparky, Firecracker). */
  Units.knockbackSelf = function (sim, u, t, dist) {
    if (u.building || !(dist > 0) || u.dead) return;
    const dx = u.x - t.x, dy = u.y - t.y, d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) || 1;
    const T = Math.max(sim.dt, CR.RULES.combat.knockbackTime);
    u.kbVx = dx / d * dist / T; u.kbVy = dy / d * dist / T; u.kbLeft = T;
  };

  /** Battle Healer heal: pulses over time around the healer (friendly troops, not buildings/self/other healers). */
  Units.healPulse = function (sim, u, h) {
    const pulses = Math.max(1, Math.round(num(h.pulses, 4)));
    sim.addArea({
      kind: 'heal', side: u.side, x: u.x, y: u.y, radius: num(h.radius, 3), left: pulses * num(h.interval, 0.25),
      pulses: pulses, interval: num(h.interval, 0.25), amount: num(h.total, 100) / pulses,
      next: 0, srcId: u.id, srcUnit: u.unit, follow: u, mode: 'heal',
    });
  };

  // ===========================================================================
  // Movement
  // ===========================================================================
  /**
   * Walk toward goal g for one tick (ground troops follow CR.Arena.waypoint with the troop's
   * routing memory). stopAt: max distance to cover on the final, straight leg (range stop).
   * Reaching a detour corner / bridge entry mid-tick continues on the next leg with the rest
   * of the step, so the speed stays constant around corners (no stop-and-go stutter).
   * Returns the distance moved.
   */
  function moveToward(sim, u, gx, gy, stopAt) {
    const s = u.s;
    let speed = s.speed;
    if (u.charging && s.charge) speed = s.charge.speed;
    speed *= u.rate;
    if (!(speed > 0)) return 0;
    if (!u.air && s.jumpsRiver && s.jumpSpeed > 0 && CR.Arena.isWater(u.x, u.y)) speed = s.jumpSpeed * u.rate;
    let budget = speed * sim.dt, moved = 0;
    const hasStop = stopAt !== undefined && stopAt >= 0;
    for (let leg = 0; leg < 3 && budget > 1e-9; leg++) {
      let wx, wy;
      if (u.air || u.underground) { wx = gx; wy = gy; }
      else {
        CR.Arena.waypoint(u.x, u.y, u.r, gx, gy, s.jumpsRiver, sim.staticRects, WP, u.nav || (u.nav = CR.Arena.newNav()));
        wx = WP.x; wy = WP.y;
      }
      const isFinal = Math.abs(wx - gx) < 1e-9 && Math.abs(wy - gy) < 1e-9;
      const dx = wx - u.x, dy = wy - u.y;
      const d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
      if (d < 1e-9) break;
      // Hill map: walking up a slope is slower (the budget is in flat-ground tiles).
      const k = !u.air && CR.Arena.RIDGE !== null ? CR.Arena.uphillMult(u.x, u.y, dx / d, dy / d) : 1;
      let step = budget * k;
      // The gap shrinks by at most the distance walked, so (stopAt - moved) never overshoots.
      if (isFinal && hasStop && stopAt - moved < step) step = Math.max(0, stopAt - moved);
      if (step > d) step = d;
      if (step > 0) {
        u.x += dx / d * step;
        u.y += dy / d * step;
        u.dir = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
      }
      moved += step;
      budget -= step / k;
      if (isFinal || step < d - 1e-9) break;
    }
    u.moved = moved > 1e-9;
    if (s.jumpsRiver) riverJumpState(u);
    return moved;
  }
  Units.moveToward = moveToward;

  /** Distance to walk toward a target at gap g so that it ends up `rangeMargin` inside range. */
  function rangeStop(g, range) {
    const m = Math.min(CR.RULES.routing.rangeMargin, Math.max(0, range) * 0.25);
    return Math.max(0, g - range + Math.max(m, 1e-4));
  }
  Units.rangeStop = rangeStop;

  // ===========================================================================
  // Per-tick update
  // ===========================================================================
  /** Status/physics part of the update (runs for every live unit, also while deploying). */
  Units.tickStatus = function (sim, u) {
    const dt = sim.dt;
    u.moved = false;
    if (u.fadeAt > 0 && sim.time >= u.fadeAt - EPS) {
      // v12 shadow clone fades away (no death effects; death reason 'expired').
      u.fadeAt = 0; u.hp = 0; u.dead = true; u.killer = -1; u.noDeathEffects = true;
      if (u.s.special.abilityEvents) abilityEvent(sim, u, 'shadow_clone', u.x, u.y, u.r, { phase: 'fade' });
      return;
    }
    if (u.kbLeft > EPS) {
      const m = Math.min(dt, u.kbLeft);
      u.x += u.kbVx * m;
      u.y += u.kbVy * m;
      u.kbLeft -= m;
      if (u.kbLeft <= EPS) { u.kbLeft = 0; u.kbVx = 0; u.kbVy = 0; }
    }
    riverJumpState(u);
  };

  /** River jump state (Hog Rider & co): airborne, untargetable and without collision over water. */
  function riverJumpState(u) {
    if (u.air || !u.s.jumpsRiver || u.tunnel) return;
    const w = CR.Arena.isWater(u.x, u.y);
    u.jumping = w;
    u.untargetable = w || !!u.jump || !!(u.dash && u.dash.immune);
    u.z = w ? CR.RULES.combat.riverJumpHeight : 0;
  }
  Units.riverJumpState = riverJumpState;

  /**
   * Full AI/behaviour update for a ready (deployed) unit, building or active tower. On the v12
   * tunnel map troops also walk into / out of the tunnel (tunnelBefore / tunnelAfter) and think
   * in their own layer.
   */
  Units.think = function (sim, u) {
    if (!CR.Arena.TUNNEL || u.building || u.air) { think(sim, u); return; }
    tunnelBefore(sim, u);
    if (u.underground) { Units.layer = 1; Units.layerSrc = u; }
    think(sim, u);
    Units.layer = 0; Units.layerSrc = null;
    tunnelAfter(sim, u);
  };

  // ===========================================================================
  // v12 tunnel map (CR.Arena.TUNNEL): plan, enter, walk underground, exit
  // ===========================================================================
  /**
   * First think of a troop: it plans to use the tunnel when it may (CR.Arena.tunnelEligible) and
   * it stands within catchRadius of its own hole's rim (the hole on its half, leading towards the
   * enemy). A plan is dropped when a fight pulls the troop more than dropRadius away.
   */
  function tunnelBefore(sim, u) {
    const T = CR.Arena.TUNNEL;
    if (u.underground) return;
    if (u.tunnelPlan === undefined) {
      u.tunnelPlan = -1;
      if (CR.Arena.tunnelEligible(u.s)) {
        const i = CR.Arena.ownHole(u.side);
        if (i >= 0 && CR.Arena.holeGap(i, u.x, u.y) <= T.catchRadius + EPS) u.tunnelPlan = i;
      }
    } else if (u.tunnelPlan >= 0 && CR.Arena.holeGap(u.tunnelPlan, u.x, u.y) > T.dropRadius) u.tunnelPlan = -1;
  }
  /** After moving: a walking troop with a plan that reached the hole goes down; an underground
   *  troop that reached the exit hole comes up on its far side. */
  function tunnelAfter(sim, u) {
    if (u.dead) return;
    const T = CR.Arena.TUNNEL;
    if (u.underground) {
      const h = T.holes[u.tunnelTo];
      if (CR.dist(u.x, u.y, h.x, h.y) <= h.r + EPS) Units.tunnelExit(sim, u);
      return;
    }
    if (u.tunnelPlan >= 0 && u.state === 'moving' && !u.jump && !u.dash && CR.Arena.holeGap(u.tunnelPlan, u.x, u.y) <= u.r + 0.12) {
      Units.tunnelEnter(sim, u, u.tunnelPlan);
    }
  }
  /** Put troop u into the tunnel at hole `hole` (event {t:'tunnel', phase:'enter'}). */
  Units.tunnelEnter = function (sim, u, hole) {
    const T = CR.Arena.TUNNEL;
    if (!T || u.underground) return false;
    const h = T.holes[hole];
    u.underground = true;
    u.tunnelPlan = -1;
    u.tunnelTo = hole === 0 ? 1 : 0;
    setTarget(u, null);
    u.charging = false; u.chargeDist = 0;
    u.nav = null;
    // Step down at the rim: the troop keeps its sideways place (a crowd does not pile up on one point).
    CR.Arena.clampTunnel(u.x, u.y, u.r, TN_OUT);
    u.x = TN_OUT.x; u.y = TN_OUT.y;
    sim.emit('tunnel', { phase: 'enter', unitId: u.id, side: u.side, unit: u.unit, hole: hole, x: CR.round(h.x, 2), y: CR.round(h.y, 2) });
    return true;
  };
  /** Bring an underground troop up at its exit hole (event {t:'tunnel', phase:'exit'}). */
  Units.tunnelExit = function (sim, u) {
    const T = CR.Arena.TUNNEL;
    if (!u.underground) return false;
    const to = u.tunnelTo, from = to === 0 ? 1 : 0;
    u.underground = false;
    u.tunnelPlan = -1;            // never back in on the way out
    setTarget(u, null);
    u.nav = null;
    if (T) {
      // Up on the far rim, keeping the sideways offset inside the tunnel (crowds spread out).
      const h = T.holes[to], f = T.holes[from];
      const dx = h.x - f.x, dy = h.y - f.y, d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) || 1;
      const nx = -dy / d, ny = dx / d;
      const side = CR.clamp((u.x - h.x) * nx + (u.y - h.y) * ny, -h.r, h.r);
      CR.Arena.tunnelExit(to, from, u.r, TN_OUT);
      u.x = CR.clamp(TN_OUT.x + nx * side, u.r, CR.Arena.W - u.r);
      u.y = CR.clamp(TN_OUT.y + ny * side, u.r, CR.Arena.H - u.r);
    }
    sim.emit('tunnel', { phase: 'exit', unitId: u.id, side: u.side, unit: u.unit, hole: to, x: CR.round(u.x, 2), y: CR.round(u.y, 2) });
    return true;
  };

  function think(sim, u) {
    const s = u.s, sp = s.special, dt = sim.dt, t0 = sim.tickStart;
    if (u.dead) return;   // v12: a shadow clone may fade in tickStatus of the same tick
    const frozen = u.freezeUntil > t0 + EPS;
    const stunned = u.stunUntil > t0 + EPS;
    let rate = 1;
    if (u.slowUntil > t0 + EPS) rate *= u.slowMult;
    if (u.rageUntil > t0 + EPS) rate *= u.rageMult;
    u.rate = rate;

    // Building lifetime decay (continues while frozen/stunned).
    if (u.building && !u.tower && s.lifetime > 0 && CR.RULES.combat.buildingDecay) {
      u.hp -= u.maxHp / s.lifetime * dt;
      if (u.hp <= EPS) { u.hp = 0; u.dead = true; u.killer = -1; return; }
    }
    // v7 champion ability wind-up: the swing finishes even through stuns / knockback.
    if (u.ability) { stepAbility(sim, u, false); if (u.ability) return; }
    if (u.kbLeft > EPS) { u.state = 'idle'; return; }
    if (frozen || stunned) { u.state = 'idle'; return; }
    // v7 Cyborg-Jäger pump reload (visible): the event fires once the reload reaches the pump.
    if (u.pumpAt > 0 && sim.time >= u.pumpAt - EPS) {
      u.pumpAt = 0;
      if (sp.abilityEvents) abilityEvent(sim, u, 'pump', u.x, u.y, 0.5, { dur: sp.pump ? num(sp.pump.dur, 0.6) : 0.6, tx: u.x + Math.cos(u.dir), ty: u.y + Math.sin(u.dir) });
    }

    // Egg hatching (Phoenix egg).
    if (sp.hatch) {
      u.hatchLeft -= dt;
      if (u.hatchLeft <= EPS) {
        sim.spawnUnit(u.side, CR.toId(sp.hatch.into), u.x, u.y, { card: u.card, tier: u.tier });
        u.hp = 0; u.dead = true; u.silentDeath = true; u.noDeathEffects = true; u.killer = -1;
        return;
      }
    }
    // Elixir production (Elixir Collector).
    if (sp.elixir) {
      u.elixLeft -= dt;
      while (u.elixLeft <= EPS) {
        sim.addElixir(u.owner, num(sp.elixir.amount, 1), u);
        u.elixLeft += Math.max(0.1, num(sp.elixir.interval, 10));
      }
    }
    // Spawner.
    if (s.spawn) {
      u.spawnLeft -= dt * rate;
      while (u.spawnLeft <= EPS) {
        spawnWave(sim, u);
        u.spawnLeft += s.spawn.interval;
      }
    }

    if (u.jump) { stepJump(sim, u); return; }
    if (u.dash) { stepDash(sim, u); return; }
    if (u.jumpCd > 0) u.jumpCd = Math.max(0, u.jumpCd - dt);
    if (u.dashCd > 0) u.dashCd = Math.max(0, u.dashCd - dt);

    // Non-combat buildings/objects.
    const fights = (s.damage > 0 || s.ramp || sp.multiTarget) && (s.targetsGround || s.targetsAir);
    if (!fights) {
      u.state = 'idle';
      if (s.speed > 0 && !u.building) walkDefault(sim, u);
      return;
    }

    const t = selectTarget(sim, u);
    // v12 Kung-Fu-Legende spinning kick (free extra attack, the punch cycle goes on).
    if (sp.whirl && sim.time >= u.whirlAt - EPS) Units.whirlKick(sim, u);
    if (u.dead) return;
