    // Hidden Tesla: underground until an enemy is in range; reveal takes revealTime; hides after hideDelay idle.
    if (sp.hidden) {
      if (u.hidden) {
        if (t) {
          u.revealLeft = u.revealLeft > 0 ? u.revealLeft - dt : num(sp.hidden.revealTime, 0.5) - dt;
          if (u.revealLeft <= EPS) { u.hidden = false; u.revealLeft = 0; u.idleT = 0; }
          else { u.state = 'idle'; return; }
        } else { u.revealLeft = 0; u.state = 'idle'; return; }
      } else if (!t) {
        u.idleT += dt;
        if (u.idleT >= num(sp.hidden.hideDelay, 1) - EPS) { u.hidden = true; u.idleT = 0; u.atk = s.loadTime; u.state = 'idle'; return; }
      } else u.idleT = 0;
    }

    if (t) {
      const g = gap(u, t);
      // Mega Knight jump / Bandit dash triggers (target between min and max range, cooldown ready).
      if (sp.jump && !t.air && u.jumpCd <= 0 && g >= num(sp.jump.minRange, 3.5) - EPS && g <= num(sp.jump.maxRange, 5) + EPS) {
        startJump(sim, u, t); return;
      }
      if (sp.dash && !t.air && u.dashCd <= 0 && g >= num(sp.dash.minRange, 3.5) - EPS && g <= num(sp.dash.maxRange, 6) + EPS) {
        startDash(sim, u, t); return;
      }
      const inRange = g <= s.range + EPS && (s.minRange <= 0 || g >= s.minRange - EPS);
      if (inRange) {
        if (u.charging && s.charge) {
          performAttack(sim, u, t, true);
          u.charging = false; u.chargeDist = 0; u.atk = 0; u.locked = true; u.state = 'attacking';
          return;
        }
        u.state = 'attacking';
        u.dir = Math.atan2(t.y - u.y, t.x - u.x);
        u.atk += dt * rate;
        if (u.atk > s.loadTime + EPS) u.locked = true;
        if (s.ramp && u.locked) u.rampT += dt * rate;
        if (u.atk >= s.hitSpeed - EPS) {
          u.atk -= s.hitSpeed;
          if (u.atk < EPS) u.atk = 0;
          performAttack(sim, u, t, false);
          u.locked = true;
        }
        return;
      }
      // Out of range (or inside min range): cancel wind-up, keep reloading.
      if (u.atk > s.loadTime) u.atk = s.loadTime;
      else u.atk = Math.min(s.loadTime, u.atk + dt * rate);
      u.locked = false;
      if (s.speed > 0 && !u.building) {
        const m = moveToward(sim, u, t.x, t.y, rangeStop(g, s.range));
        u.state = m > 0 ? 'moving' : 'idle';
        accumulateCharge(u, m);
      } else u.state = 'idle';
      return;
    }
    // No target in sight: reload and walk the lane.
    u.atk = Math.min(s.loadTime, u.atk + dt * rate);
    u.locked = false;
    if (s.speed > 0 && !u.building) walkDefault(sim, u);
    else u.state = 'idle';
  };

  function accumulateCharge(u, m) {
    const c = u.s.charge;
    if (!c || !(m > 0)) return;
    u.chargeDist += m;
    if (!u.charging && u.chargeDist >= c.distance - EPS) u.charging = true;
  }

  const TD_GOAL = { x: 0, y: 0 };
  function walkDefault(sim, u) {
    // v12 tunnel: underground straight on to the exit hole; with a plan into the own hole.
    const TN = CR.Arena.TUNNEL;
    if (TN && (u.underground || u.tunnelPlan >= 0)) {
      const h = TN.holes[u.underground ? u.tunnelTo : u.tunnelPlan];
      const m = moveToward(sim, u, h.x, h.y);
      u.state = m > 0 ? 'moving' : 'idle';
      return;
    }
    const tw = Units.defaultTower(sim, u);
    if (!tw) {
      // v6 Touchdown (no towers): walk straight ahead into the enemy end zone (sim.touchdownGoal).
      if (sim.touchdown && sim.touchdownGoal(u, TD_GOAL)) {
        const m = moveToward(sim, u, TD_GOAL.x, TD_GOAL.y);
        u.state = m > 0 ? 'moving' : 'idle';
        accumulateCharge(u, m);
        return;
      }
      u.state = 'idle'; return;
    }
    const g = gap(u, tw);
    const m = moveToward(sim, u, tw.x, tw.y, rangeStop(g, Math.max(u.s.range, 0.1)));
    u.state = m > 0 ? 'moving' : 'idle';
    accumulateCharge(u, m);
  }

  function spawnWave(sim, u) {
    const sw = u.s.spawn;
    const n = sw.count;
    const x = u.x;
    let y = u.y;
    if (u.building) {
      // Buildings spawn just in front of themselves (towards the enemy).
      const f = u.side === 0 ? 1 : -1;
      y = CR.clamp(u.y + f * ((u.s.footprint || 2) / 2 + 0.5), 0.5, CR.Arena.H - 0.5);
    }
    const list = Units.spawnGroup(sim, u.side, sw.unit, x, y, n, u.building && n === 1 ? 0 : sw.radius, {
      card: u.card, tier: u.tier, deployTime: sw.deployTime, stagger: 0,
    });
    for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) list[i].spawnedBy = u.id;
  }

  // --- Mega Knight jump -------------------------------------------------------
  function startJump(sim, u, t) {
    const j = u.s.special.jump;
    u.jump = { t: 0, air: num(j.airborne, 0.8), land: num(j.landing, 0.3), fx: u.x, fy: u.y, target: t, tx: t.x, ty: t.y, landed: false };
    u.untargetable = true; u.noCollide = true;
    u.state = 'attacking';
    u.dir = Math.atan2(t.y - u.y, t.x - u.x);
  }
  function stepJump(sim, u) {
    const j = u.jump, sj = u.s.special.jump;
    j.t += sim.dt;
    u.state = 'attacking';
    if (!j.landed) {
      if (j.target && !j.target.dead) { j.tx = j.target.x; j.ty = j.target.y; }
      const k = Math.min(1, j.t / j.air);
      // Land at the target's edge, not inside it.
      const dx = j.tx - j.fx, dy = j.ty - j.fy, d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) || 1;
      const tr = j.target ? (j.target.x1 !== undefined ? Math.max(j.target.x1 - j.target.x0, j.target.y1 - j.target.y0) / 2 : j.target.r) : 0;
      const reach = Math.max(0, d - tr - u.r * 0.5);
      u.x = j.fx + dx / d * reach * k;
      u.y = j.fy + dy / d * reach * k;
      u.z = 4 * k * (1 - k) * num(sj.height, 3);
      if (j.t >= j.air - EPS) {
        j.landed = true; u.z = 0;
        u.untargetable = false; u.noCollide = false;
        const hit = { amount: num(sj.damage, u.s.damage), charge: false, kind: 'jump' };
        const hooks = sim.hooks.onAttack;
        for (let i = 0; i < hooks.length; i++) hooks[i](u, j.target, hit);
        Units.applyEffect(sim, u.side, u.x, u.y, null, { damage: hit.amount, ct: u.s.ct, radius: num(sj.radius, 2.2), air: false, ground: true, knockback: num(sj.knockback, 1), kind: 'jump' }, u);
        j.t = 0;
      }
    } else if (j.t >= j.land - EPS) {
      u.jump = null;
      u.jumpCd = num(sj.cooldown, 0.9);
      u.atk = u.s.loadTime;
    }
  }

  // --- Bandit dash ------------------------------------------------------------
  function startDash(sim, u, t) {
    const sd = u.s.special.dash;
    u.dash = { t: 0, target: t, immune: false, fx: u.x, fy: u.y, dur: Math.max(0.15, gap(u, t) / Math.max(0.1, num(sd.speed, 8.33))) };
    u.noCollide = true;
    u.state = 'attacking';
    u.dir = Math.atan2(t.y - u.y, t.x - u.x);
    // v6: immuneAfter <= 0 -> invulnerable from the very first moment (Kung-Fu-Legende flying kick).
    if (sd.immune !== false && num(sd.immuneAfter, 0.1) <= EPS) { u.dash.immune = true; u.immune = true; u.untargetable = true; }
    if (u.s.special.abilityEvents) abilityEvent(sim, u, 'dash', t.x, t.y, 0.8, { tx: u.x, ty: u.y, target: t.id, phase: 'start', kick: sd.kick ? true : undefined, dur: u.dash.dur });
  }
  function stepDash(sim, u) {
    const d = u.dash, sd = u.s.special.dash;
    d.t += sim.dt;
    u.state = 'attacking';
    if (!d.immune && sd.immune !== false && d.t >= num(sd.immuneAfter, 0.1) - EPS) { d.immune = true; u.immune = true; u.untargetable = true; }
    const t = d.target;
    if (!t || t.dead || !isTargetable(t)) { endDash(u, sd); return; }
    const g = gap(u, t);
    const spd = num(sd.speed, 8.33) * sim.dt;
    if (g <= u.s.range + EPS) {
      const hit = { amount: num(sd.damage, u.s.damage * 2), charge: true, kind: 'charge' };
      const hooks = sim.hooks.onAttack;
      for (let i = 0; i < hooks.length; i++) hooks[i](u, t, hit);
      Units.applyEffect(sim, u.side, t.x, t.y, t, { damage: hit.amount, ct: u.s.ct, radius: 0, kind: 'charge' }, u);
      if (u.s.special.abilityEvents) abilityEvent(sim, u, 'dash', t.x, t.y, 0.8, { tx: d.fx, ty: d.fy, target: t.id, phase: 'impact', kick: sd.kick ? true : undefined, dmg: Math.round(hit.amount) });
      endDash(u, sd);
      return;
    }
    const dx = t.x - u.x, dy = t.y - u.y, dd = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) || 1;
    const m = Math.min(spd, Math.max(0, g - u.s.range + 1e-4));
    u.x += dx / dd * m; u.y += dy / dd * m;
    u.dir = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
    // Flying kick (v6): a low jump arc over the dash (view z, cosmetic only).
    if (sd.kick) { const k = Math.min(1, d.t / d.dur); u.z = CR.round(4 * k * (1 - k) * num(sd.height, 1.2), 3); }
    if (d.t >= num(sd.maxTime, 1.2) - EPS) endDash(u, sd);
  }
  function endDash(u, sd) {
    if (sd.kick) u.z = 0;
    u.dash = null; u.immune = false; u.untargetable = false; u.noCollide = false;
    u.dashCd = num(sd.cooldown, 0.8);
    u.atk = u.s.loadTime;
  }

  // ===========================================================================
  // Deploy completion & tunnel
  // ===========================================================================
  /** Called once when a unit finishes deploying (spawn damage, spawn heal). */
  Units.onDeployed = function (sim, u) {
    const sp = u.s.special;
    u.state = 'idle';
    if (sp.spawnDamage) {
      const sd = sp.spawnDamage;
      const ct = (typeof sd.ct === 'number') ? sd.ct : null;
      Units.applyEffect(sim, u.side, u.x, u.y, null, {
        // Crown tower damage may be 0 (Electro / Ice Wizard): towers still get stunned / slowed.
        damage: num(sd.damage, 0), ct: ct, radius: num(sd.radius, 2), air: sd.air !== false, ground: sd.ground !== false,
        stun: num(sd.stun, 0), knockback: num(sd.knockback, 0),
        slow: normSlow(sd.slow), kind: 'splash',
      }, u);
      sim.emit('spell', { side: u.side, card: u.card, kind: 'spawn', x: CR.round(u.x, 2), y: CR.round(u.y, 2), radius: num(sd.radius, 2), phase: 'impact', unit: u.unit });
    }
    if (sp.spawnHeal) Units.healPulse(sim, u, sp.spawnHeal);
    if (sp.hidden) u.hidden = true;
    // v12 Wirbel-Ninja: shadow clones (not for Clone spell copies, clones or C.H.A.O.S mirrors).
    if (sp.shadowClones && !u.clone && !u.shadowClone && !u.shadowDone && !u.chxShadow && !u.chxMirror) Units.shadowClones(sim, u);
  };

  /** Miner-style tunnel: travel underground from (fx,fy) to the unit's position; deploy timer starts on arrival. */
  Units.startTunnel = function (sim, u, fx, fy, speed) {
    u.tunnel = { tx: u.x, ty: u.y, speed: Math.max(0.1, speed) };
    u.x = fx; u.y = fy;
    u.untargetable = true; u.immune = true; u.noCollide = true; u.hidden = false;
    u.deployEnd = Infinity;
    u.state = 'deploying';
  };
  Units.stepTunnel = function (sim, u) {
    const tn = u.tunnel;
    const dx = tn.tx - u.x, dy = tn.ty - u.y, d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    const step = tn.speed * sim.dt;
    if (d <= step + EPS) {
      u.x = tn.tx; u.y = tn.ty;
      u.tunnel = null;
      u.untargetable = false; u.immune = false; u.noCollide = false;
      u.deployEnd = sim.time + u.deployTotal;
      u.z = 0;
      if (u.building) {
        // Goblin-Drill-type buildings: the footprint moves with the tunnel exit.
        const f = u.s.footprint || 2;
        u.x0 = u.x - f / 2; u.y0 = u.y - f / 2; u.x1 = u.x + f / 2; u.y1 = u.y + f / 2;
      }
    } else {
      u.x += dx / d * step; u.y += dy / d * step;
      u.dir = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
    }
  };

  // ===========================================================================
  // Death
  // ===========================================================================
  /** Death effects of a unit/building (called once by the sim's death phase). */
  Units.onDeath = function (sim, u) {
    if (u.noDeathEffects) return;
    const s = u.s, sp = s.special;
    const dd = s.deathDamage;
    if (dd) {
      const e = { damage: dd.damage, ct: dd.ct, radius: dd.radius, air: dd.air, ground: dd.ground, knockback: dd.knockback, stun: dd.stun, slow: dd.slow, kind: 'death' };
      if (dd.delay > EPS) {
        sim.addArea({ kind: dd.kind === 'death' ? 'bomb' : dd.kind, side: u.side, x: u.x, y: u.y, radius: dd.radius, left: dd.delay, effect: e, mode: 'delayed', srcUnit: u.unit, card: u.card });
      } else {
        Units.applyEffect(sim, u.side, u.x, u.y, null, e, null);
        sim.emit('spell', { side: u.side, card: u.card, kind: 'death', x: CR.round(u.x, 2), y: CR.round(u.y, 2), radius: dd.radius, phase: 'impact', unit: u.unit });
      }
    }
    // Elixir Collector: +onDeath elixir when destroyed or expired (cr-api mana_on_death 1).
    if (sp.elixir && sp.elixir.onDeath > 0 && !u.clone) sim.addElixir(u.owner, sp.elixir.onDeath, u);
    if (sp.deathRage) {
      const r = sp.deathRage;
      sim.addArea({
        kind: 'rage', side: u.side, x: u.x, y: u.y, radius: num(r.radius, 3), left: num(r.duration, 5.5) + num(r.delay, 0),
        delay: num(r.delay, 0), boost: num(r.boost, 30), linger: num(r.linger, CR.RULES.combat.rageLinger), mode: 'rage',
        impact: r.damage ? { damage: num(r.damage, 0), ct: (typeof r.ct === 'number') ? r.ct : null, radius: num(r.damageRadius, num(r.radius, 3)), air: true, ground: true, kind: 'spell', spell: true } : null,
        srcUnit: u.unit, card: u.card,
      });
    }
    if (sp.endoskeleton && !u.clone && CR.DATA.units[sp.endoskeleton.unit]) {
      // v7 Cyborg-Jäger: the metal endoskeleton rises from the wreck and keeps fighting.
      const en = sp.endoskeleton;
      const rise = num(en.rise, 1);
      const w = sim.spawnUnit(u.side, en.unit, u.x, u.y, { card: u.card, tier: u.tier, deployTime: rise });
      if (w) {
        w.dir = u.dir;
        w.spawnedBy = u.id;
        if (sp.abilityEvents) abilityEvent(sim, w, 'endoskeleton', u.x, u.y, w.r, { from: u.id, dur: rise, tx: u.x, ty: u.y });
      }
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < s.deathSpawn.length; i++) {
      const ds = s.deathSpawn[i];
      Units.spawnGroup(sim, u.side, ds.unit, u.x, u.y, ds.count, ds.radius, { card: u.card, tier: u.tier, deployTime: ds.deployTime, formation: ds.formation });
    }
  };

  // ===========================================================================
  // Collision
  // ===========================================================================
  function collides(u) {
    return !u.dead && !u.noCollide && !u.tunnel && !u.jump && !u.jumping && !u.dash;
  }

  // Scratch buffers of the collision pass (grown on demand, no per-tick allocations).
  let C_IDX = new Int32Array(128), C_NEXT = new Int32Array(128), C_CELL = new Int32Array(128);
  let C_PX = new Float64Array(128), C_PY = new Float64Array(128), C_M = new Float64Array(128), C_ATK = new Uint8Array(128);
  let C_HEAD = new Int32Array(256);
  function growCollision(n) {
    let cap = C_IDX.length;
    if (n <= cap) return;
    while (cap < n) cap *= 2;
    C_IDX = new Int32Array(cap); C_NEXT = new Int32Array(cap); C_CELL = new Int32Array(cap);
    C_PX = new Float64Array(cap); C_PY = new Float64Array(cap); C_M = new Float64Array(cap); C_ATK = new Uint8Array(cap);
  }

  /**
   * Side a troop slides to (+1 = left of its heading, -1 = right) around an attacking friend
   * it cannot push; (px,py) = push direction away from that friend. Chosen once - away from the
   * friend's centre, avoiding water / the arena edge - and kept; flipped once when the troop
   * made no headway for 1 s (dead end).
   */
  function slideSideOf(u, px, py) {
    let side = u.slideSide;
    if (!side) {
      const lx = -Math.sin(u.dir), ly = Math.cos(u.dir);   // left of the heading
      const d = lx * px + ly * py;
      side = d > 1e-3 ? 1 : (d < -1e-3 ? -1 : ((u.id & 1) ? 1 : -1));
      if (!u.air && slideBlocked(u, lx * side, ly * side) && !slideBlocked(u, -lx * side, -ly * side)) side = -side;
      u.slideSide = side; u.slideN = 0; u.slideX = u.x; u.slideY = u.y;
    } else if (++u.slideN >= 20) {
      if (CR.dist2(u.x, u.y, u.slideX, u.slideY) < 0.04) side = u.slideSide = -side;
      u.slideN = 0; u.slideX = u.x; u.slideY = u.y;
    }
    return side;
  }
  /** Would sliding u one radius along (tx,ty) end in the water or off the arena? */
  function slideBlocked(u, tx, ty) {
    const x = u.x + tx * (u.r + 0.3), y = u.y + ty * (u.r + 0.3);
    if (x < u.r || x > CR.Arena.W - u.r || y < u.r || y > CR.Arena.H - u.r) return true;
    return !u.s.jumpsRiver && CR.Arena.isWater(x, y);
  }

  /**
   * Resolve troop-troop overlaps and push troops out of static rects and water.
   * Troop pairs come from a uniform grid (cell >= the largest diameter, O(n) instead of
   * O(n^2)). Each iteration accumulates, for every overlapping pair, a mass-weighted push of
   * RULES.collision.resolve x overlap on both troops (Jacobi: independent of pair order, so
   * crowds settle instead of oscillating), caps every troop's summed push and applies it.
   * Attacking troops hold their ground: friends that are not heavier cannot push them at all
   * (they take the whole push plus a sideways drift `slide` on a committed side and flow around),
   * everybody else pushes them as if holdMassMult times heavier, and never away from their own
   * target (only sideways), so the crowd never cancels a wind-up. Knockback is not affected.
   * Towers/buildings are immovable and
   * resolved fully afterwards, then water and the arena bounds.
   */
  Units.collide = function (sim) {
    const us = sim.units;
    const n = us.length;
    const C = CR.RULES.collision;
    const k = C.resolve;
    const iters = Math.max(1, C.iterations | 0);
    const maxP = C.maxPushPerTick / iters;
    const hold = C.holdMassMult > 0 ? C.holdMassMult : 1;
    const W = CR.Arena.W, H = CR.Arena.H;
    growCollision(n);
    let m = 0, maxR = 0.5;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const a = us[i];
      if (a.building || !collides(a)) continue;
      C_IDX[m] = i;
      C_M[m] = a.mass;
      // Forget the slide side some time after the troop stopped sliding.
      if (a.slideSide && ++a.slideT > 10) { a.slideSide = 0; a.slideT = 0; a.slideN = 0; }
      C_ATK[m] = a.state === 'attacking' ? 1 : 0;
      if (a.r > maxR) maxR = a.r;
      m++;
    }
    if (m > 1) {
      const cell = 2 * maxR;
      const cols = Math.ceil(W / cell) + 1, rows = Math.ceil(H / cell) + 1, cells = cols * rows;
      if (C_HEAD.length < cells) C_HEAD = new Int32Array(cells * 2);
      for (let it = 0; it < iters; it++) {
        for (let c = 0; c < cells; c++) C_HEAD[c] = -1;
        for (let q = 0; q < m; q++) {
          const a = us[C_IDX[q]];
          let cx = Math.floor(a.x / cell), cy = Math.floor(a.y / cell);
          cx = cx < 0 ? 0 : (cx >= cols ? cols - 1 : cx);
          cy = cy < 0 ? 0 : (cy >= rows ? rows - 1 : cy);
          const c = cy * cols + cx;
          C_CELL[q] = c;
          C_NEXT[q] = C_HEAD[c];
          C_HEAD[c] = q;
          C_PX[q] = 0; C_PY[q] = 0;
        }
        let any = false;
        for (let q = 0; q < m; q++) {
          const a = us[C_IDX[q]];
          const ccx = C_CELL[q] % cols, ccy = (C_CELL[q] - ccx) / cols;
          const ma = C_M[q];
          for (let oy = -1; oy <= 1; oy++) {
            const ny = ccy + oy;
            if (ny < 0 || ny >= rows) continue;
            for (let ox = -1; ox <= 1; ox++) {
              const nx = ccx + ox;
              if (nx < 0 || nx >= cols) continue;
              for (let w = C_HEAD[ny * cols + nx]; w >= 0; w = C_NEXT[w]) {
                if (w <= q) continue;                 // every pair once
                const b = us[C_IDX[w]];
                if (a.air !== b.air || !a.underground !== !b.underground) continue;   // v12: tunnel layer
                const rr = a.r + b.r;
                let dx = b.x - a.x;
                if (dx >= rr || dx <= -rr) continue;
                let dy = b.y - a.y;
                if (dy >= rr || dy <= -rr) continue;
                const d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
                if (d2 >= rr * rr) continue;
                let d = sqrt(d2);
                const ov = (rr - d) * k;
                if (d < 1e-6) { const v = DIRS[(a.id * 7 + b.id * 13) % 16]; dx = v[0]; dy = v[1]; d = 1; }
                let ea = ma, eb = C_M[w];
                const aa = C_ATK[q], ab = C_ATK[w];
                let wa, wb, slider = null, sdir = 0;
                if (aa !== ab && a.side === b.side && (aa ? eb <= ea : ea <= eb)) {
                  // A friend that is not heavier never shoves an attacking troop out of range: it
                  // takes the whole push plus a sideways drift (committed side) and slides around it.
                  if (aa) { wa = 0; wb = 1; slider = b; sdir = 1; } else { wa = 1; wb = 0; slider = a; sdir = -1; }
                } else {
                  if (aa && !ab) ea *= hold; else if (ab && !aa) eb *= hold;
                  if (!isFinite(ea) && !isFinite(eb)) { wa = 0.5; wb = 0.5; }
                  else if (!isFinite(ea)) { wa = 0; wb = 1; }
                  else if (!isFinite(eb)) { wa = 1; wb = 0; }
                  else { wa = eb / (ea + eb); wb = ea / (ea + eb); }
                }
                const nx2 = dx / d * ov, ny2 = dy / d * ov;
                C_PX[q] -= nx2 * wa; C_PY[q] -= ny2 * wa;
                C_PX[w] += nx2 * wb; C_PY[w] += ny2 * wb;
                if (slider && ov > 1e-9) {
                  // Sideways drift across the slider's own heading (same direction for every
                  // attacker it touches, so it moves along a whole row of them to its end).
                  const side = slideSideOf(slider, nx2 * sdir / ov, ny2 * sdir / ov);
                  slider.slideT = 0;
                  const f = C.slide * ov * side;
                  const lx = -Math.sin(slider.dir) * f, ly = Math.cos(slider.dir) * f;
                  if (sdir > 0) { C_PX[w] += lx; C_PY[w] += ly; } else { C_PX[q] += lx; C_PY[q] += ly; }
                }
                any = true;
              }
            }
          }
        }
        if (!any) break;
        for (let q = 0; q < m; q++) {
          let px = C_PX[q], py = C_PY[q];
          if (px === 0 && py === 0) continue;
          const a = us[C_IDX[q]];
          const t = C_ATK[q] ? a.target : null;
          if (t && !t.dead) {
            // Never pushed away from its own target while attacking (no wind-up cancelled by
            // the crowd): drop the outward component, keep the sideways part.
            let ox, oy;
            if (t.x1 !== undefined) { CR.boxClosest(a.x, a.y, t.x0, t.y0, t.x1, t.y1, TMP); ox = a.x - TMP.x; oy = a.y - TMP.y; }
            else { ox = a.x - t.x; oy = a.y - t.y; }
            const ol = sqrt(ox * ox + oy * oy);
            if (ol > 1e-9) {
              const out = (px * ox + py * oy) / ol;
              if (out > 0) { px -= ox / ol * out; py -= oy / ol * out; }
            }
          }
          const l2 = px * px + py * py;
          if (l2 > maxP * maxP) { const f = maxP / sqrt(l2); px *= f; py *= f; }
          a.x += px; a.y += py;
        }
      }
    }
    const rects = sim.staticRects;
    const water = CR.Arena.WATER;
    const wcap = C.waterRadiusCap;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const a = us[i];
      if (a.dead || a.building) continue;
      if (a.underground) {
        // v12: underground troops stay inside the tunnel corridor (no towers / water down there).
        CR.Arena.clampTunnel(a.x, a.y, a.r, TMP);
        a.x = TMP.x; a.y = TMP.y;
        continue;
      }
      if (collides(a) && !a.air) {
        for (let j = 0; j < rects.length; j++) {
          const b = rects[j];
          if (b === a) continue;
          if (CR.Arena.pushOutOfRect(a.x, a.y, a.r, b, TMP)) { a.x = TMP.x; a.y = TMP.y; }
        }
        if (!a.s.jumpsRiver) {
          for (let j = 0; j < water.length; j++) {
            if (CR.Arena.pushOutOfRect(a.x, a.y, Math.min(a.r, wcap), water[j], TMP)) { a.x = TMP.x; a.y = TMP.y; }
          }
        }
      }
      if (a.tunnel) continue;
      if (a.x < a.r) a.x = a.r; else if (a.x > W - a.r) a.x = W - a.r;
      if (a.y < a.r) a.y = a.r; else if (a.y > H - a.r) a.y = H - a.r;
    }
  };
})(globalThis.CR || (globalThis.CR = {}));

</script>
<script>
/* src/05-spells.js */
/* Chaos Royale - 05-spells.js (engine)
 * Spell casting and lasting areas. Spells are data-driven by card.spell:
 *
 *   kind: 'projectile'  thrown from the caster's King Tower at `speed` tiles/s (Fireball,
 *                       Rocket, Arrows (waves), Giant Snowball, Goblin Barrel (spawn on landing))
 *         'instant'     resolves on the spot (Zap, Freeze)
 *         'area'        lasting zone: mode 'pulse' (Poison, Earthquake), 'tornado' (pull),
 *                       'rage' (friendly boost) or 'graveyard' (spawns)
 *         'roll'        rolling log/barrel along the lane (The Log, Barbarian Barrel)
 *         'lightning'   strikes the `count` highest-HP enemies in the radius
 *         'delivery'    delayed drop: damage + spawn (Royal Delivery)
 *         'clone'       duplicates friendly troops in the radius with 1 HP (Clone)
 *   common fields: radius, damage, ct (crown tower damage), knockback, stun, freeze,
 *   slow {pct, dur}, targets ('all'|'ground'|'air'), spawn {unit, count, radius, deployTime},
 *   duration, interval, firstTick, ticks, tickDamage, tickCt, buildingMult, pullSpeed, boost,
 *   linger, waves, waveDelay, range, width, reach, backOffset, count, delay, from ('king'|'point').
 *
 * Every damaging spell applies its crown tower damage (`ct`, `tickCt`) to crown towers.
 * Lasting areas (also death bombs, Lumberjack rage, Battle Healer heal) are updated by
 * CR.Spells.updateAreas(sim) in the sim's "areas" phase.
 */
(function (CR) {
  'use strict';

  const Spells = {};
  CR.Spells = Spells;
  const EPS = 1e-6;

  function num(v, d) { return (typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v)) ? v : d; }

  function filters(sp) {
    const t = String(sp.targets || 'all').toLowerCase();
    return { air: t !== 'ground', ground: t !== 'air' };
  }

  function normSlow(v) {
    if (!v || typeof v !== 'object') return null;
    const pct = num(v.pct, num(v.percent, 0));
    if (!(pct > 0)) return null;
    return { pct: pct, dur: num(v.dur, num(v.duration, 0)) };
  }

  /** Effect object of a spell impact (see CR.Units.applyEffect). */
  function impactEffect(sp, overrides) {
    const f = filters(sp);
    const e = {
      damage: num(sp.damage, 0), ct: (typeof sp.ct === 'number') ? sp.ct : null, radius: num(sp.radius, 0),
      air: f.air, ground: f.ground, stun: num(sp.stun, 0), freeze: num(sp.freeze, 0),
      slow: normSlow(sp.slow), knockback: num(sp.knockback, 0), buildingMult: num(sp.buildingMult, 0) || null,
      kind: 'spell', spell: true,
    };
    if (overrides) Object.assign(e, overrides);
    return e;
  }
  Spells.impactEffect = impactEffect;

  function forward(side) { return side === 0 ? 1 : -1; }

  /** Spawn the units a spell drops (Goblin Barrel goblins, Barbarian Barrel barbarian, ...). */
  function dropSpawn(sim, side, card, sw, x, y, tier) {
    if (!sw || !sw.unit) return [];
    return CR.Units.spawnGroup(sim, side, CR.toId(sw.unit), x, y, num(sw.count, 1), num(sw.radius, 0.6), {
      card: card.id, tier: tier || 0, deployTime: (typeof sw.deployTime === 'number') ? sw.deployTime : null,
      formation: sw.formation, stagger: num(sw.stagger, 0),
    });
  }
  Spells.dropSpawn = dropSpawn;

  /**
   * Cast spell `card` for `side` at (x,y) (already validated + snapped).
   * Returns a short description object.
   */
  Spells.cast = function (sim, side, card, x, y, opts) {
    opts = opts || {};
    const sp = card.spell || {};
    const kind = sp.kind || 'instant';
    const tier = opts.tier || 0;
    // v6: in touchdown (no towers) spells start from the middle of the own back line.
    const king = typeof sim.launchOrigin === 'function' ? sim.launchOrigin(side) : sim.kingOf(side);
    const fromX = king ? king.x : x, fromY = king ? king.y : y;
    sim.emit('spell', { side: side, card: card.id, kind: kind, x: x, y: y, radius: num(sp.radius, 0), phase: 'cast' });

    switch (kind) {
      case 'projectile': {
        const waves = Math.max(1, Math.round(num(sp.waves, 1)));
        const waveDelay = num(sp.waveDelay, 0);
        const sx = sp.from === 'point' ? x : fromX, sy = sp.from === 'point' ? y : fromY;
        for (let w = 0; w < waves; w++) {
          const e = impactEffect(sp);
          const wave = w;
          CR.Units.launch(sim, {
            kind: card.id, side: side, x: sx, y: sy, tx: x, ty: y, speed: num(sp.speed, 10), homing: false, air: true,
            delay: wave * waveDelay, effect: e, card: card.id,
            onArrive: function (sim2, p) {
              sim2.emit('spell', { side: side, card: card.id, kind: kind, x: p.x, y: p.y, radius: e.radius, phase: 'impact', wave: wave });
              if (e.radius > 0) CR.Units.applyEffect(sim2, side, p.x, p.y, null, e, null);
              if (sp.spawn && wave === waves - 1) dropSpawn(sim2, side, card, sp.spawn, p.x, p.y, tier);
              if (sp.area) Spells.addArea(sim2, side, card, p.x, p.y, sp.area, tier);
            },
          });
        }
        break;
      }
      case 'instant': {
        const e = impactEffect(sp);
        // Resolves on the spot: the 'cast' event above is its impact for renderers.
        CR.Units.applyEffect(sim, side, x, y, null, e, null);
        if (sp.spawn) dropSpawn(sim, side, card, sp.spawn, x, y, tier);
        // Visual zone for lasting effects (Freeze shows its circle for the freeze duration).
        const vis = num(sp.visual, num(sp.freeze, 0));
        if (vis > 0) sim.addArea({ kind: card.id, side: side, x: x, y: y, radius: e.radius, left: vis, mode: 'visual', card: card.id });
        break;
      }
      case 'area': {
        Spells.addArea(sim, side, card, x, y, sp, tier);
        break;
      }
      case 'roll': {
        const f = forward(side);
        const fl = filters(sp);
        const startY = y - f * num(sp.backOffset, 0);
        CR.Units.launch(sim, {
          kind: card.id, side: side, x: x, y: startY, dx: 0, dy: f, speed: num(sp.speed, 5), mode: 'roll',
          range: num(sp.range, 10), width: num(sp.width, 1.95), reach: num(sp.reach, 0.5), card: card.id,
          effect: { damage: num(sp.damage, 0), ct: (typeof sp.ct === 'number') ? sp.ct : null, air: fl.air, ground: fl.ground, knockback: num(sp.knockback, 0), stun: num(sp.stun, 0), slow: normSlow(sp.slow), kind: 'spell', spell: true },
          onEnd: sp.spawn ? function (sim2, p) { dropSpawn(sim2, side, card, sp.spawn, p.x, CR.clamp(p.y, 0.5, CR.Arena.H - 0.5), tier); } : null,
        });
        break;
      }
      case 'lightning': {
        Spells.lightning(sim, side, card, x, y, sp);
        break;
      }
      case 'clone': {
        Spells.clone(sim, side, card, x, y, sp, tier);
        break;
      }
      case 'delivery': {
        sim.addArea({
          kind: card.id, side: side, x: x, y: y, radius: num(sp.radius, 3), left: num(sp.delay, 2), mode: 'delayed', card: card.id,
          effect: impactEffect(sp), spawn: sp.spawn || null, spawnCard: card, tier: tier,
        });
        break;
      }
      default:
        CR.Units.applyEffect(sim, side, x, y, null, impactEffect(sp), null);
    }
    return { kind: kind };
  };

  /** Lightning: the `count` highest-HP enemies (troops, buildings, towers) in the radius, one strike each. */
  Spells.lightning = function (sim, side, card, x, y, sp) {
    const radius = num(sp.radius, 3.5);
    const cand = [];
    CR.Units.forEachEnemy(sim, side, function (t) {
      if (t.tunnel || t.immune) return;
      if (CR.Units.edgeDist(x, y, t) > radius + EPS) return;
      cand.push(t);
    });
    cand.sort(function (a, b) { return (b.hp + b.shield) - (a.hp + a.shield) || a.id - b.id; });
    const n = Math.min(cand.length, Math.max(1, Math.round(num(sp.count, 3))));
    const interval = num(sp.interval, 0);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const t = cand[i];
      const e = impactEffect(sp, { radius: 0 });
      if (interval > EPS && i > 0) {
        sim.addArea({ kind: 'strike', side: side, x: t.x, y: t.y, radius: 0.5, left: interval * i, mode: 'delayed', effect: e, target: t, card: card.id });
      } else {
        CR.Units.applyEffect(sim, side, t.x, t.y, t, e, null);
        sim.emit('spell', { side: side, card: card.id, kind: 'strike', x: CR.round(t.x, 2), y: CR.round(t.y, 2), radius: 0.5, phase: 'impact' });
      }
    }
  };

  /**
   * Clone: duplicates every friendly troop (not buildings) in the radius. Clones have
   * `cloneHp` hitpoints (1) and no shield, appear `offset` tiles beside the original and act
   * after `deployTime`. Clones of clones are allowed (as in the live game).
   */
  Spells.clone = function (sim, side, card, x, y, sp, tier) {
    const radius = num(sp.radius, 3), off = num(sp.offset, 0.6), hp = Math.max(1, num(sp.cloneHp, 1));
    const src = [];
    const us = sim.units;
    for (let i = 0; i < us.length; i++) {
      const u = us[i];
      if (u.side !== side || u.dead || u.building || u.tunnel || u.tower) continue;
      if (CR.Units.edgeDist(x, y, u) > radius + EPS) continue;
      src.push(u);
    }
    const out = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < src.length; i++) {
      const o = src[i];
      const dir = side === 0 ? 1 : -1;
      const cx = CR.clamp(o.x + off * dir, 0.3, CR.Arena.W - 0.3);
      const c = sim.spawnUnit(side, o.unit, cx, o.y, { card: o.card, tier: Math.max(o.tier || 0, tier || 0), deployTime: num(sp.deployTime, 0) });
      if (!c) continue;
      c.hp = Math.min(hp, c.maxHp); c.maxHp = c.hp;
      c.shield = 0; c.maxShield = 0;
      c.clone = true;
      out.push(c);
    }
    sim.emit('spell', { side: side, card: card.id, kind: 'clone', x: x, y: y, radius: radius, phase: 'impact', count: out.length });
    return out;
  };

  /** Create a lasting spell area from spell data. */
  Spells.addArea = function (sim, side, card, x, y, sp, tier) {
    const f = filters(sp);
    const a = {
      kind: card.id, side: side, x: x, y: y, radius: num(sp.radius, 3), left: num(sp.duration, 4),
      card: card.id, mode: sp.mode || 'pulse', tier: tier || 0,
      interval: Math.max(0.05, num(sp.interval, 1)), next: num(sp.firstTick, 0), ticks: 0, maxTicks: num(sp.ticks, Infinity),
      tickDamage: num(sp.tickDamage, 0), tickCt: (typeof sp.tickCt === 'number') ? sp.tickCt : null,
      buildingMult: num(sp.buildingMult, 0) || null, air: f.air, ground: f.ground,
      slow: normSlow(sp.slow),
      stun: num(sp.stun, 0),
      pullSpeed: num(sp.pullSpeed, CR.RULES.combat.defaultPullSpeed),
      boost: num(sp.boost, 30), linger: num(sp.linger, CR.RULES.combat.rageLinger),
      spawn: sp.spawn || null, spawnCard: card, spawnInterval: Math.max(0.05, num(sp.spawnInterval, 0.5)), spawnFirst: num(sp.spawnFirst, 0),
      spawnCount: num(sp.spawnCount, 0), spawned: 0, spawnMinRadius: num(sp.spawnMinRadius, 0),
      delay: 0,
    };
    if (a.mode === 'graveyard') a.next = a.spawnFirst;
    // Impact damage on cast (Rage spell damage, Tornado/Earthquake none by default).
    if (a.mode === 'rage' && num(sp.damage, 0) > 0) {
      CR.Units.applyEffect(sim, side, x, y, null, impactEffect(sp, { radius: a.radius }), null);
    }
    if (sp.impact) CR.Units.applyEffect(sim, side, x, y, null, impactEffect(sp.impact, { radius: num(sp.impact.radius, a.radius) }), null);
    return sim.addArea(a);
  };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Areas update (spell zones, death bombs, rage bottles, heal pulses)
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  function enemiesIn(sim, a, includeBuildings, includeTowers, cb) {
    CR.Units.forEachEnemy(sim, a.side, function (t) {
      if (t.tunnel || t.immune) return;
      if (t.air ? !a.air : !a.ground) return;
      if (t.jumping && !a.air) return;
      if (t.tower ? !includeTowers : (t.building && !includeBuildings)) return;
      if (CR.Units.edgeDist(a.x, a.y, t) > a.radius + EPS) return;
      cb(t);
    });
  }

  function friendsIn(sim, a, cb) {
    const arr = sim.units;
    for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
      const t = arr[i];
      if (t.side !== a.side || t.dead || t.tunnel) continue;
      if (CR.Units.edgeDist(a.x, a.y, t) > a.radius + EPS) continue;
      cb(t);
    }
  }

  function pulse(sim, a) {
    enemiesIn(sim, a, true, true, function (t) {
      let dmg = a.tickDamage;
      if (t.building && !t.tower && a.buildingMult) dmg *= a.buildingMult;
      dmg = CR.Units.ctFor(t, dmg, a.tickCt);
      if (dmg > 0) CR.Units.damage(sim, t, dmg, null, 'spell', a.side);
      if (!t.dead && a.stun) CR.Units.stun(sim, t, a.stun);
    });
  }

  function areaStep(sim, a) {
    const dt = sim.dt;
    switch (a.mode) {
      case 'delayed': {
        a.left -= dt;
        if (a.left <= EPS) {
          a.done = true;
          if (a.target) {
            if (!a.target.dead && !(a.target.tower && !a.target.alive)) {
              CR.Units.applyEffect(sim, a.side, a.target.x, a.target.y, a.target, a.effect, null);
              sim.emit('spell', { side: a.side, card: a.card || a.kind, kind: a.kind, x: CR.round(a.target.x, 2), y: CR.round(a.target.y, 2), radius: 0.5, phase: 'impact' });
            }
          } else {
            if (a.effect) CR.Units.applyEffect(sim, a.side, a.x, a.y, null, a.effect, null);
            sim.emit('spell', { side: a.side, card: a.card || a.kind, kind: a.kind, x: a.x, y: a.y, radius: a.radius, phase: 'impact' });
            if (a.spawn) dropSpawn(sim, a.side, a.spawnCard || { id: a.card }, a.spawn, a.x, a.y, a.tier);
          }
        }
        return;
      }
      case 'visual': {
        a.left -= dt;
        if (a.left <= EPS) a.done = true;
        return;
      }
      case 'pulse': {
        // Continuous slow while inside (Poison/Earthquake), damage ticks every interval.
        if (a.slow) enemiesIn(sim, a, true, false, function (t) { CR.Units.slow(sim, t, a.slow.pct, Math.max(a.slow.dur, dt * 2)); });
        while (a.next <= EPS && a.ticks < a.maxTicks && a.left > EPS) {
          pulse(sim, a);
          a.ticks++;
          a.next += a.interval;
        }
        a.next -= dt;
        a.left -= dt;
        if (a.left <= EPS || a.ticks >= a.maxTicks) a.done = true;
        return;
      }
      case 'tornado': {
        const step = a.pullSpeed * dt;
        enemiesIn(sim, a, false, false, function (t) {
          if (t.building) return;
          CR.Units.pull(sim, t, a.x, a.y, step);
          if (CR.RULES.kingActivation.tornadoPull) checkKingPull(sim, a.side, t);
        });
        while (a.next <= EPS && a.ticks < a.maxTicks && a.left > EPS) {
          pulse(sim, a);
          a.ticks++;
          a.next += a.interval;
        }
        a.next -= dt;
        a.left -= dt;
        if (a.left <= EPS) a.done = true;
        return;
      }
      case 'rage': {
        if (a.delay > EPS) {
          a.delay -= dt; a.left -= dt;
          if (a.delay <= EPS) {
            a.delay = 0;
            if (a.impact) CR.Units.applyEffect(sim, a.side, a.x, a.y, null, a.impact, null);
            sim.emit('spell', { side: a.side, card: a.card || a.kind, kind: 'rage', x: a.x, y: a.y, radius: a.radius, phase: 'impact' });
          }
          return;
        }
        const linger = a.linger;
        friendsIn(sim, a, function (t) { CR.Units.rage(sim, t, a.boost, linger); });
        a.left -= dt;
        if (a.left <= EPS) a.done = true;
        return;
      }
      case 'graveyard': {
        if (a.spawn) {
          while (a.next <= EPS && (a.spawnCount <= 0 || a.spawned < a.spawnCount) && a.left > EPS) {
            // Random point inside the ring [spawnMinRadius, radius - 0.5] (uniform by area), on land.
            let px = a.x, py = a.y;
            for (let tries = 0; tries < 8; tries++) {
              const ang = sim.rng() * Math.PI * 2;
              const rmin = a.spawnMinRadius, rmax = Math.max(rmin, a.radius - 0.5);
              const rr = Math.sqrt(rmin * rmin + sim.rng() * (rmax * rmax - rmin * rmin));
              px = CR.clamp(a.x + Math.cos(ang) * rr, 0.5, CR.Arena.W - 0.5);
              py = CR.clamp(a.y + Math.sin(ang) * rr, 0.5, CR.Arena.H - 0.5);
              if (!CR.Arena.isWater(px, py)) break;
            }
            if (!CR.Arena.isWater(px, py)) dropSpawn(sim, a.side, a.spawnCard || { id: a.card }, Object.assign({}, a.spawn, { count: 1 }), px, py, a.tier);
            a.spawned++;
            a.next += a.spawnInterval;
          }
          a.next -= dt;
        }
        a.left -= dt;
        if (a.left <= EPS) a.done = true;
        return;
      }
      case 'heal': {
        if (a.follow && !a.follow.dead) { a.x = a.follow.x; a.y = a.follow.y; }
        while (a.next <= EPS && a.pulses > 0) {
          friendsIn(sim, a, function (t) {
            if (t.building || t.id === a.srcId || t.unit === a.srcUnit) return;
            CR.Units.heal(sim, t, a.amount);
          });
          a.pulses--;
          a.next += a.interval;
        }
        a.next -= dt;
        a.left -= dt;
        if (a.pulses <= 0) a.done = true;
        return;
      }
      default:
        a.left -= dt;
        if (a.left <= EPS) a.done = true;
    }
  }

  /** Tornado King activation: an enemy troop pulled into the caster's King Tower range wakes it. */
  function checkKingPull(sim, side, t) {
    const king = sim.kingOf(side);
    if (!king || king.active || !king.alive || t.dead) return;
    if (CR.Units.gap(king, t) <= king.s.range + EPS) sim.activateKing(side, 'tornado');
  }

  Spells.updateAreas = function (sim) {
    const as = sim.areas;
    // Areas added during this update (e.g. by a death in a pulse) start next tick.
    const n = as.length;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const a = as[i];
      if (a.done) continue;
      sim._owner = typeof a.owner === 'number' ? a.owner : -1;   // 2v2: spawns keep the caster
      areaStep(sim, a);
    }
    sim._owner = -1;
    let w = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < as.length; i++) if (!as[i].done) as[w++] = as[i];
    as.length = w;
  };
})(globalThis.CR || (globalThis.CR = {}));

</script>
<script>
/* src/06-chaos.js */
/* Chaos Royale - 06-chaos.js (chaos)
 * C.H.A.O.S mode, modelled on Clash Royale's C.H.A.O.S event (March 2026, Chaos 2.0 July 2026,
 * Chaos 3.0 October 2026; sources and confidence: docs/research/chaos.md, rules: docs/CHAOS.md).
 *
 * Mode rules (attached by CR.Sim when mode === 'chaos'):
 *   - crown towers have double hitpoints, elixir is generated 50 % faster (all phases);
 *   - upgrade offers at the match clock 2:56, 2:11, 1:26, 0:26 and at the overtime clock 1:26:
 *     the battle PAUSES, each player gets 3 upgrades (v12; real mode: 2) of the same rarity
 *     (rarity odds per offer 90/10/0, 20/80/0, 0/50/50, 0/20/80, 0/0/100 common/rare/epic) for
 *     cards of their own deck and picks one within 7 s (timeout: random pick). A choice is final
 *     and applied at once; the battle resumes when both are done.
 *   - "Auswahl überspringen" (Chaos 3.0): skip a pick and choose TWO of the three upgrades of the
 *     next offer (a "bonus offer" stays open until both picks are made; real mode: both of two).
 *   - v12 (user: "every card three different abilities"): every playable card has three modifiers
 *     with different effects (common / rare / epic); cards without real C.H.A.O.S modifiers got own
 *     designs (def.own, see "v12: own designs" in the catalog; docs/CHAOS.md lists them all).
 *   - an upgrade is permanent for the match and applies to every later play of that card; a card
 *     holds one upgrade, a later (higher) upgrade of the same card replaces it; a modifier is never
 *     offered twice in a match. Upgrades are free.
 *
 * Engine integration: sim.hooks (modifyStats for the towers, onUnitSpawn, onAttack, onDamage,
 * onDeath, onTick) plus sim.chaos = state with paused(), tick(), tierOf(), castSpell(), summon(),
 * validate(), command(), view(). Unit stats are per-instance copies (u.s), CR.DATA is never touched.
 *
 * View: view.players[i].chaos = { offers: null | [{id, card, rarity, title, text, taken?}], offerTimeLeft, picksLeft,
 *   offerTotal, owned: [{id, card, rarity, title, text}], pending, info, decided, paused, round,
 *   rounds, nextIn, canSkip, skipBanked, auto, waiting } (details: docs/CHAOS.md).
 * Commands: {type:'chaos_pick', option: 0..n-1 | CR.Chaos.SKIP}.
 * Events: {t:'chaos_offer', side, round, n}, {t:'chaos_pick', side, card, rarity, title, id},
 *   {t:'chaos_skip', side}, {t:'chaos_resume'}, {t:'ability', side, unitId, card, rarity, kind,
 *   x, y, radius, tx?, ty?, dur?}.
 * Bots: players in sim.options.bots (array of player indices), players created with `bot: true`
 * or driven by a CR.AI instance pick automatically (CR.Chaos.botPick); everybody else is human
 * and waits for input.
 *
 * v5 2v2: everything per-player is indexed by PLAYER index (== side in 1v1): offers, picks, owned
 * upgrades, skip bank, views (view.players[i].chaos). Every player of both teams gets an offer;
 * the battle resumes when all players decided. tierOf(player, card) is asked with the player who
 * plays the card; castSpell / summon get the team side (they spawn for the team, the sim's owner
 * context keeps the player). Events chaos_offer / chaos_pick / chaos_skip carry `side` (team)
 * and `player`.
 *
 * Pure simulation code: no DOM, no Date, no Math.random (own CR.rng stream).
 */
(function (CR) {
  'use strict';

  const EPS = 1e-6;
  const RARITIES = ['common', 'rare', 'epic'];
  const TIER = { common: 1, rare: 2, epic: 3 };
  const SKIP = 9;

  const RULES = {
    towerHpMult: 2,              // "All Crown Towers have double the health" (fandom, trophycoach, 6,104 HP observed)
    elixirMult: 1.5,             // "Elixir generation is 50% faster" (fandom, trophycoach)
    offerClock: [176, 131, 86, 26], // regulation clock (seconds left) of offers 1-4: 2:56 2:11 1:26 0:26
    overtimeClock: 86,           // offer 5 at overtime clock 1:26 (Epic only)
    // Rarity odds per offer [common, rare, epic] (fandom table, trophycoach Season 3)
    odds: [[0.9, 0.1, 0], [0.2, 0.8, 0], [0, 0.5, 0.5], [0, 0.2, 0.8], [0, 0, 1]],
    options: 3,                  // v12 (user: "about three abilities to choose from"): three upgrades per offer
                                 // (real Chaos 3.0: two), same rarity, different cards where the deck allows
    skipPicks: 2,                // after a skip: pick two of the next offer (real mode: both of two)
    pickSeconds: 7,              // real seconds to choose (Chaos 3.0; 10 s in Season 1)
    pickGameSeconds: 10,         // used when the sim does not know the game speed (options.speed)
    botDelay: [0.9, 2.4],        // bot "thinking" time, real seconds
    autoShowSeconds: 1.8,        // pause length for an auto-granted offer (after a skip)
    skip: true,                  // "Auswahl überspringen" (Chaos 3.0 trial feature)
  };
  const RARITY_COLORS = { common: '#9fb4c7', rare: '#ff9a2e', epic: '#b44cff' };
  const RARITY_NAMES = { common: 'Gewöhnlich', rare: 'Selten', epic: 'Episch' };

  function num(v, d) { return (typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v)) ? v : d; }
  function r2(v) { return Math.round(v * 100) / 100; }
  function cardOf(id) { return CR.Sim && CR.Sim.cardById ? CR.Sim.cardById(id) : null; }
  function castName(id) {
    const c = CR.CAST && CR.CAST.cards && CR.CAST.cards[id];
    if (c && c.name) return c.name;
    const d = cardOf(id);
    return d && d.name ? d.name : id;
  }
  function alive(u) { return u && !u.dead && !(u.tower && !u.alive); }

  // ===========================================================================
  // Modifier catalog (filled by defineMods below)
  // ===========================================================================
  const MODS = Object.create(null);      // id -> def
  const BY_CARD = Object.create(null);   // cardId -> {common, rare, epic}
  const EXCLUDED = [];                   // real modifiers that cannot work here (never offered)
  const REPLACED = [];                   // v12: such real modifiers whose slot is filled by an own design

  function mod(card, rarity, def) {
    def.card = card;
    def.rarity = rarity;
    def.tier = TIER[rarity];
    def.id = card + ':' + rarity;
    def.power = num(def.power, 2);
    MODS[def.id] = def;
    (BY_CARD[card] || (BY_CARD[card] = {}))[rarity] = def;
    return def;
  }
  function exclude(card, rarity, name, reason) { EXCLUDED.push({ card: card, rarity: rarity, name: name, reason: reason }); }
  function replaced(card, rarity, name, reason) { REPLACED.push({ card: card, rarity: rarity, name: name, reason: reason }); }

  /** Modifier of a card for a tier (1..3), only when the card exists and the def is usable. */
  function modFor(cardId, tier) {
    const m = BY_CARD[cardId];
    if (!m) return null;
    const def = m[RARITIES[(tier | 0) - 1]];
    return def && usable(def) ? def : null;
  }
  const usableCache = Object.create(null);
  function usable(def) {
    if (usableCache[def.id] !== undefined) return usableCache[def.id];
    const c = cardOf(def.card);
    let ok = !!c && !c.disabled;
    const need = def.needs || [];
    const units = (CR.DATA && CR.DATA.units) || {};
    for (let i = 0; i < need.length && ok; i++) if (!units[need[i]]) ok = false;
    if (ok && def.needCards) for (let i = 0; i < def.needCards.length && ok; i++) { const k = cardOf(def.needCards[i]); if (!k) ok = false; }
    usableCache[def.id] = ok;
    return ok;
  }
  function publicDef(def) {
    return { id: def.id, card: def.card, rarity: def.rarity, tier: def.tier, title: def.title, text: def.text, name: def.name, approx: !!def.approx, own: !!def.own };
  }

  // ===========================================================================
  // Per-battle state
  // ===========================================================================
  class ChaosState {
    constructor(sim) {
      this.sim = sim;
      const opt = sim.options || {};
      this.opt = opt;
      this.rng = CR.rng(((sim.seed === undefined ? 1 : CR.hashSeed(sim.seed)) ^ 0x2c1b3c6d) >>> 0);
      this.speed = typeof opt.speed === 'number' && opt.speed > 0 ? opt.speed : null;
      this.elixirMult = num(opt.chaosElixir, RULES.elixirMult);
      const np = Math.max(2, (sim.players && sim.players.length) || 2);
      this.np = np;                         // players (2 in 1v1, 4 in 2v2); index = player
      this.owned = [];                      // [{def}] per player
      this.offered = [];
      this.skipBank = [];
      this.aiSides = [];
      this.viewCache = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < np; i++) { this.owned.push([]); this.offered.push(new Set()); this.skipBank.push(false); this.aiSides.push(false); this.viewCache.push(null); }
      this.offer = null;                    // open offer (battle paused)
      this.round = 0;                       // offers opened so far
      this.schedule = this._schedule();
      this.next = 0;                        // index into schedule
      this.version = 0;
      // runtime
      this.spawnStack = [];
      this.tickers = [];
      this.areas = [];
      this.chains = [];
      this.timers = [];
      this.healers = [];
      this.projWatch = [];
      this.permanent = Object.create(null);  // e.g. permanent poison per side
      this.lastAbility = Object.create(null);
      this.A = makeApi(this);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ schedule
    _schedule() {
      const sim = this.sim, C = sim.clockCfg || {};
      const opt = this.opt;
      if (Array.isArray(opt.chaosSchedule)) {
        return opt.chaosSchedule.map(function (t, i) { return { at: num(t, 0), overtime: false, round: i }; });
      }
      const reg = num(C.regulation, 180), ot = num(C.overtime, 0);
      const cs = reg / 180;
      const out = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < RULES.offerClock.length; i++) {
        const at = reg - RULES.offerClock[i] * cs;
        if (at >= 0) out.push({ at: at, overtime: false, round: out.length });
      }
      if (ot > EPS) {
        const cso = ot / 120;
        out.push({ at: reg + Math.max(0, ot - RULES.overtimeClock * cso), overtime: true, round: out.length });
      }
      return out;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ sim interface
    paused() { return !!this.offer; }

    tierOf(side, cardId) {
      const o = this.owned[side];
      if (!o) return 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < o.length; i++) if (o[i].card === cardId) return o[i].tier;
      return 0;
    }

    ownedDef(side, cardId) {
      const o = this.owned[side];
      for (let i = 0; i < o.length; i++) if (o[i].card === cardId) return o[i];
      return null;
    }

    isBot(player) {
      const b = this.opt.bots;
      if (Array.isArray(b) && b.indexOf(player) >= 0) return true;
      const p = this.sim.players && this.sim.players[player];
      if (p && p.bot) return true;
      return !!this.aiSides[player];
    }

    markBot(player) { if (typeof player === 'number' && player >= 0 && player < this.np && !this.aiSides[player]) { this.aiSides[player] = true; this.version++; } }

    /** Team side of a player index. */
    sideOf(player) { const p = this.sim.players && this.sim.players[player]; return p ? p.side : player; }

    /** Called by the sim every tick (normal ticks after the clock, paused ticks after commands). */
    tick() {
      const sim = this.sim;
      if (this.offer) { this._pausedTick(); return; }
      if (sim.over) return;
      while (this.next < this.schedule.length) {
        const w = this.schedule[this.next];
        if (w.overtime && !sim.overtime) {
          // the overtime offer only exists when the match goes to overtime
          if (sim.time + EPS < w.at || sim.time < sim.clockCfg.regulation - EPS) break;
        }
        if (sim.time + EPS < w.at) break;
        this.next++;
        if (w.overtime && !sim.overtime) continue;
        if (this._open(w)) break;
      }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ offers
    _durationTicks() {
      const dt = this.sim.dt;
      const secs = this.speed ? RULES.pickSeconds * this.speed : RULES.pickGameSeconds;
      return Math.max(1, Math.round(num(this.opt.chaosPickSeconds, secs) / dt));
    }
    _realToTicks(sec) { return Math.max(1, Math.round(sec * (this.speed || 1.5) / this.sim.dt)); }
    _botTicks() { return this._realToTicks(RULES.botDelay[0] + this.rng() * (RULES.botDelay[1] - RULES.botDelay[0])); }

    _open(w) {
      const sim = this.sim;
      const round = Math.min(w.round, RULES.odds.length - 1);
      const entries = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < this.np; i++) entries.push(null);
      let any = false;
      for (let side = 0; side < this.np; side++) {
        const opts = this._buildOptions(side, round);
        if (!opts.length) continue;
        for (let i = 0; i < opts.length; i++) this.offered[side].add(opts[i].id);
        const banked = this.skipBank[side];
        if (banked) this.skipBank[side] = false;
        // after a skip: choose RULES.skipPicks of this offer; with no more options than that, all are granted
        const picks = banked ? Math.min(RULES.skipPicks, opts.length) : 1;
        const auto = banked && picks >= opts.length;
        entries[side] = {
          options: opts, pending: null, done: false, auto: auto, picks: picks, taken: [], bonus: banked,
          botAt: this.isBot(side) ? this._botTicks() : -1,
        };
        any = true;
      }
      this.round = w.round + 1;
      if (!any) { this.version++; return false; }
      const total = this._durationTicks();
      this.offer = { round: w.round + 1, entries: entries, total: total, left: total, elapsed: 0, minTicks: 0 };
      for (let side = 0; side < this.np; side++) {
        const e = entries[side];
        if (!e) continue;
        sim.emit('chaos_offer', { side: this.sideOf(side), player: side, round: w.round + 1, n: e.options.length, auto: e.auto || undefined });
        if (e.auto) {
          // After a skip with no more options than picks: all of them are granted right away.
          this.offer.minTicks = Math.max(this.offer.minTicks, this._realToTicks(RULES.autoShowSeconds));
          e.done = true; e.pending = 'both'; e.how = 'auto';
          for (let i = 0; i < e.options.length; i++) { e.taken.push(i); this._grant(side, e.options[i]); }
        }
      }
      this.version++;
      return true;
    }

    _candidates(side, rarity) {
      const sim = this.sim;
      const deck = (sim.players[side] && sim.players[side].deck) || [];
      const out = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < deck.length; i++) {
        const def = BY_CARD[deck[i]] && BY_CARD[deck[i]][rarity];
        if (!def || !usable(def) || this.offered[side].has(def.id)) continue;
        const own = this.ownedDef(side, def.card);
        if (own && own.tier >= def.tier) continue;
        out.push(def);
      }
      return out;
    }

    _buildOptions(side, round) {
      const odds = RULES.odds[round] || RULES.odds[RULES.odds.length - 1];
      let x = this.rng(), ri = 0;
      for (ri = 0; ri < 3; ri++) { if (x < odds[ri]) break; x -= odds[ri]; }
      if (ri > 2) { ri = 0; for (let k = 2; k >= 0; k--) if (odds[k] > 0) { ri = k; break; } }
      // Same rarity for both options; fall back to the nearest rarities when the deck lacks them.
      const order = [ri].concat(ri === 0 ? [1, 2] : (ri === 1 ? [2, 0] : [1, 0]));
      const picked = [];
      const cards = new Set();
      const lists = [];
      for (let k = 0; k < order.length; k++) lists.push(this.rng.shuffle(this._candidates(side, RARITIES[order[k]])));
      // pass 1: different cards (nearest rarity first); pass 2 (small decks): the other abilities
      // of cards already shown - every option is a different ability
      for (let pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {
        for (let k = 0; k < lists.length && picked.length < RULES.options; k++) {
          const list = lists[k];
          for (let i = 0; i < list.length && picked.length < RULES.options; i++) {
            const def = list[i];
            if (picked.indexOf(def) >= 0 || (pass === 0 && cards.has(def.card))) continue;
            cards.add(def.card);
            picked.push(def);
          }
        }
      }
      return picked;
    }

    _pausedTick() {
      const o = this.offer;
      o.elapsed++;
      o.left = Math.max(0, o.left - 1);
      for (let side = 0; side < this.np; side++) {
        const e = o.entries[side];
        if (!e || e.done) continue;
        if (e.botAt >= 0 && o.elapsed >= e.botAt) {
          this._choose(side, botChoice(this, side, e.options, e.taken), 'bot');
          if (!e.done) e.botAt = o.elapsed + this._botTicks();
        } else if (o.left <= 0) {
          let guard = 0;
          while (!e.done && guard++ < 8) { const free = openOptions(e); this._choose(side, free[this.rng.int(free.length)], 'timeout'); }
        }
      }
      let all = true;
      for (let side = 0; side < this.np; side++) if (o.entries[side] && !o.entries[side].done) all = false;
      if (all && o.elapsed >= o.minTicks) this._resolve();
    }

    /** Final choice of a side (player tap, bot or timeout): applied immediately, exactly once. */
    _choose(side, option, how) {
      const o = this.offer;
      const e = o && o.entries[side];
      if (!e || e.done) return false;
      e.how = how;
      if (option === SKIP) {
        e.done = true;
        e.pending = option;
        this.skipBank[side] = true;
        this.sim.emit('chaos_skip', { side: this.sideOf(side), player: side, round: o.round });
      } else {
        let i = option | 0;
        if (!(i >= 0 && i < e.options.length) || e.taken.indexOf(i) >= 0) i = openOptions(e)[0];
        if (i === undefined) { e.done = true; this.version++; return true; }
        e.taken.push(i);
        e.pending = i;
        this._grant(side, e.options[i]);
        // a bonus offer (after a skip) stays open until `picks` options are taken
        if (e.taken.length >= e.picks || !openOptions(e).length) e.done = true;
      }
      this.version++;
      return true;
    }

    _resolve() {
      const o = this.offer;
      this.offer = null;
      this.sim.emit('chaos_resume', { round: o.round });
      this.version++;
    }

    _grant(side, def) {
      const list = this.owned[side];
      for (let i = list.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (list[i].card === def.card) list.splice(i, 1);
      list.push(def);
      this.sim.emit('chaos_pick', { side: this.sideOf(side), player: side, card: def.card, rarity: def.rarity, title: def.title, id: def.id });
      this.version++;
    }

    canSkip(side) {
      if (!RULES.skip || this.skipBank[side] || !this.offer) return false;
      const e = this.offer.entries[side];
      if (e && (e.bonus || e.taken.length)) return false;   // not during a bonus offer / after a pick
      // Never on the last scheduled offer (nothing would follow).
      return this.offer.round < this.schedule.length;
    }

    validate(side, cmd) {
      if (cmd.type === 'chaos_use') return { ok: false, reason: 'chaos_unavailable' };
      const o = this.offer;
      const e = o && o.entries[side];
      if (!e || e.auto || e.done) return { ok: false, reason: 'chaos_no_offer' };
      const opt = Number(cmd.option);
      if (opt === SKIP) return this.canSkip(side) ? { ok: true, reason: null } : { ok: false, reason: 'chaos_no_offer' };
      if (!(opt >= 0 && opt < e.options.length) || Math.floor(opt) !== opt) return { ok: false, reason: 'bad_command' };
      if (e.taken.indexOf(opt) >= 0) return { ok: false, reason: 'chaos_no_offer' };
      return { ok: true, reason: null };
    }

    command(side, cmd) {
      if (cmd.type !== 'chaos_pick') return;
      const v = this.validate(side, cmd);
      if (!v.ok) return;
      // The battle resumes once everybody is done (checked by the paused tick right after).
      this._choose(side, Number(cmd.option), 'player');
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ view
    view(side) {
      const o = this.offer;
      const sim = this.sim;
      const sp = this.speed || 1;
      const leftQ = o ? Math.ceil(o.left * sim.dt / sp * 4) / 4 : 0;
      let nextAt = null;
      if (!o && this.next < this.schedule.length) {
        const w = this.schedule[this.next];
        if (!w.overtime || sim.overtime) nextAt = w.at;
      }
      const nextIn = nextAt === null ? null : Math.max(0, Math.ceil(nextAt - sim.time - EPS));
      const key = this.version + '|' + leftQ + '|' + nextIn + '|' + (sim.over ? 1 : 0);
      const c = this.viewCache[side];
      if (c && c.key === key) return c.v;
      const e = o ? o.entries[side] : null;
      // Somebody else still choosing? (1v1: the opponent; 2v2: any of the other three)
      let other = null;
      if (o) for (let i = 0; i < this.np; i++) { const x = o.entries[i]; if (i !== side && x && (!other || !x.done)) other = x; }
      const team = this.np > 2;
      const owned = (this.owned[side] || []).map(ownedView);
      let info;
      if (sim.over) info = owned.length ? owned.length + ' Upgrade' + (owned.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' in diesem Kampf' : 'C.H.A.O.S';
      else if (e && e.auto) info = 'Dank Überspringen bekommst du alle Upgrades!';
      else if (e && !e.done) info = e.picks > 1 ? (e.taken.length ? 'Wähle noch ein Upgrade!' : 'Dank Überspringen: wähle ' + e.picks + ' Upgrades!') : 'Wähle ein Upgrade!';
      else if (e && e.done) info = e.pending === SKIP ? 'Übersprungen – nächstes Mal wählst du zwei.' : (other && !other.done ? (team ? 'Gewählt – die anderen überlegen noch …' : 'Gewählt – der Gegner überlegt noch …') : 'Gewählt!');
      else if (o) info = team ? 'Die anderen wählen ein Upgrade …' : 'Der Gegner wählt ein Upgrade …';
      else if (this.skipBank[side]) info = nextIn !== null ? 'Nächstes Mal wählst du zwei Upgrades (in ' + nextIn + ' s)' : 'Ausgewählt: nächstes Mal zwei Upgrades';
      else if (nextIn !== null) info = (this.round === 0 ? 'Erstes' : 'Nächstes') + ' Upgrade in ' + nextIn + ' s';
      else info = owned.length ? 'Alle Upgrades verteilt' : 'C.H.A.O.S';
      const open = !!(e && !e.done);
      const taken = e ? e.taken : null;
      const mark = function (def, i) { const ov = offerView(def); if (taken && taken.indexOf(i) >= 0) ov.taken = true; return ov; };
      const v = {
        offers: open ? e.options.map(mark) : null,
        offerTimeLeft: o ? leftQ : 0,
        offerTotal: o ? Math.round(o.total * sim.dt / sp * 4) / 4 : 0,
        owned: owned,
        pending: e && e.done ? (e.pending === SKIP ? 'skip' : e.pending) : null,
        decided: e && e.done ? { options: e.options.map(offerView), pick: e.pending === SKIP ? 'skip' : e.pending, picks: e.pending === SKIP ? [] : e.taken.slice(), how: e.how } : null,
        picksLeft: open ? e.picks - e.taken.length : 0,   // v12: 2 during a bonus offer after a skip
        info: info,
        paused: !!o,
        round: this.round,
        rounds: this.schedule.length,
        nextIn: nextIn,
        canSkip: !!(open && this.canSkip(side)),
        skipBanked: this.skipBank[side],
        auto: !!(e && e.auto),
        waiting: !!(e && e.done && other && !other.done),
      };
      this.viewCache[side] = { key: key, v: v };
      return v;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ casting / summoning
    castSpell(side, card, x, y, tier) {
      const def = modFor(card.id, tier);
      if (!def || typeof def.spell !== 'function') return false;
      def.spell(this.A, def, side, card, x, y, tier);
      return true;
    }

    summon(side, card, x, y, tier) {
      const def = modFor(card.id, tier);
      if (!def || typeof def.summon !== 'function') return null;
      const r = def.summon(this.A, def, side, card, x, y, tier);
      return Array.isArray(r) ? r : null;
    }
  }

  /** Indices of the options of an offer entry that are still free. */
  function openOptions(e) { const out = []; for (let i = 0; i < e.options.length; i++) if (e.taken.indexOf(i) < 0) out.push(i); return out; }
  function offerView(def) { return { id: def.id, card: def.card, rarity: def.rarity, title: def.title, text: def.text }; }
  function ownedView(def) { return { id: def.id, card: def.card, rarity: def.rarity, title: def.title, text: def.text }; }

  // ===========================================================================
  // Bot choice
  // ===========================================================================
  function botChoice(st, side, options, taken) {
    const p = st.sim.players[side];
    let best = -1, bestS = -Infinity;
    for (let i = 0; i < options.length; i++) {
      if (taken && taken.indexOf(i) >= 0) continue;
      const d = options[i];
      let s = d.tier * 3 + d.power + st.rng() * 1.5;
      if (p && (p.hand.indexOf(d.card) >= 0 || (p.queue.length && p.queue[0] === d.card))) s += 1;
      if (s > bestS) { bestS = s; best = i; }
    }
    return best < 0 ? 0 : best;
  }

  // ===========================================================================
  // Hooks (registered once per sim) and the helper API used by modifiers
  // ===========================================================================
  function registerHooks(st) {
    const sim = st.sim, H = sim.hooks;
    const towerMult = num(st.opt.chaosTowerHp, RULES.towerHpMult);
    H.modifyStats.push(function (s, side, cardId, unitId) {
      if ((unitId === 'princess-tower' || unitId === 'king-tower') && !cardId && towerMult !== 1) s.hp = s.hp * towerMult;
    });
    H.onUnitSpawn.push(function (u) { onSpawn(st, u); });
    H.onAttack.push(function (u, t, hit) {
      const c = u.chx;
      if (c && c.h.attack) c.h.attack(u, t, hit);
    });
    H.onDamage.push(function (t, hit) {
      const s = hit.src;
      if (s && s !== t) t.chxLast = s;
      const c = t.chx;
      if (c && c.h.damaged) c.h.damaged(t, hit);
      if (s && s.chx && s.chx.h.dealt) s.chx.h.dealt(s, t, hit);
    });
    H.onDeath.push(function (u) { onDeath(st, u); });
    H.onTick.push(function () { onTick(st); });
  }

  function onSpawn(st, u) {
    if (u.tower) return;
    const n = st.spawnStack.length;
    if (n) {
      const ctx = st.spawnStack[n - 1];
      if (ctx.tier !== undefined) u.tier = ctx.tier;
      if (ctx.setup) ctx.setup(u);
      return;
    }
    if (!(u.tier > 0) || !u.card) return;
    const def = modFor(u.card, u.tier);
    if (!def || !def.units) return;
    const fn = def.units[u.unit] || def.units['*'];
    if (fn) fn(st.A, def, u);
  }

  function onDeath(st, u) {
    const c = u.chx;
    if (c && c.h.death) c.h.death(u);
    const k = u.chxLast;
    if (k && k.chx && k.chx.h.kill && k.side !== u.side && !k.dead) k.chx.h.kill(k, u);
    if (st.healers.length && !u.tower && !u.building && !u.clone && !u.silentDeath && !u.noDeathEffects) {
      for (let i = 0; i < st.healers.length; i++) {
        const h = st.healers[i];
        if (h.dead || h.side !== u.side || h === u || !h.chx || !h.chx.h.allyDeath) continue;
        h.chx.h.allyDeath(h, u);
      }
    }
  }

  function onTick(st) {
    const sim = st.sim, dt = sim.dt;
    // 50 % faster elixir: the engine adds the base rate, the mode adds the rest.
    if (st.elixirMult !== 1 && !sim.options.infiniteElixir) {
      // v13: times the "Schnelles Elixier" boost, so chaos x boost x phase multiply
      const extra = dt * sim.elixirMult * (sim.elixirBoost || 1) * (st.elixirMult - 1) / CR.RULES.elixir.regenSeconds;
      for (let s = 0; s < sim.players.length; s++) if (sim.players[s].elixir < CR.RULES.elixir.max - 1e-9) sim.addElixir(s, extra);
    }
    // timers (game time)
    if (st.timers.length) {
      const list = st.timers;
      st.timers = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
        const t = list[i];
        t.left -= dt;
        if (t.left <= EPS) { if (!sim.over) { sim._owner = t.owner; t.fn(); sim._owner = -1; } }
        else st.timers.push(t);
      }
    }
    // unit tickers
    if (st.tickers.length) {
      let w = 0;
      const tk = st.tickers;
      for (let i = 0; i < tk.length; i++) {
        const u = tk[i];
        if (u.dead || !u.chx) continue;
        sim._owner = u.owner;
        if (u.chx.h.tick) u.chx.h.tick(u);
        tk[w++] = u;
      }
      sim._owner = -1;
      tk.length = w;
    }
    // areas driven by this module
    if (st.areas.length) {
      let w = 0;
      const as = st.areas;
      for (let i = 0; i < as.length; i++) {
        const a = as[i];
        if (a.done) continue;
        sim._owner = typeof a.owner === 'number' ? a.owner : -1;
        if (a.chxTick) a.chxTick(a);
        if (!a.done) as[w++] = a;
      }
      sim._owner = -1;
      as.length = w;
    }
    // chains
    if (st.chains.length) stepChains(st);
    // projectile watchers (boulders, axes, sparks of upgraded units)
    if (st.projWatch.length) watchProjectiles(st);
    let w = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < st.healers.length; i++) if (!st.healers[i].dead) st.healers[w++] = st.healers[i];
    st.healers.length = w;
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------- chains
  /**
   * Chain lightning: hops from enemy to enemy (nearest not yet hit `per` times) every `hop` s.
   * opts: { side, src, from: entity|null, x, y, hops, radius, damage, ct, stun, hop, delay,
   *         per (max hits per enemy, default 1), towers (default true), first (hit `from` too),
   *         kind ('chain'|'strike'), def, splash }
   */
  function startChain(st, o) {
    const c = {
      side: o.side, src: o.src || null, last: o.from || null, lx: num(o.x, o.from ? o.from.x : 0), ly: num(o.y, o.from ? o.from.y : 0),
      left: Math.max(0, o.hops | 0), radius: num(o.radius, 3.5), damage: num(o.damage, 0), ct: o.ct === undefined ? null : o.ct,
      stun: num(o.stun, 0), hop: num(o.hop, 0.15), next: num(o.delay, 0), per: Math.max(1, o.per | 0 || 1), towers: o.towers !== false,
      hits: new Map(), kind: o.kind || 'chain', def: o.def || null, splash: num(o.splash, 0), air: o.air !== false, ground: o.ground !== false,
    };
    if (o.from) {
      if (o.first) { c.pendingFirst = o.from; }
      else c.hits.set(o.from.id, 1);
    }
    st.chains.push(c);
    return c;
  }

  function stepChains(st) {
    const sim = st.sim, dt = sim.dt, U = CR.Units;
    let w = 0;
    const cs = st.chains;
    for (let i = 0; i < cs.length; i++) {
      const c = cs[i];
      c.next -= dt;
      let guard = 0;
      while (c.next <= EPS && !c.done && guard++ < 4) {
        let t = null;
        if (c.pendingFirst) { t = alive(c.pendingFirst) ? c.pendingFirst : null; c.pendingFirst = null; if (!t) { c.next += c.hop; continue; } }
        else {
          if (c.left <= 0) { c.done = true; break; }
          let best = null, bestD = Infinity;
          U.forEachEnemy(sim, c.side, function (e) {
            if (e === c.last || e.tunnel || e.underground || e.immune || e.hidden || e.untargetable) return;
            if (e.tower && !c.towers) return;
            if (e.air ? !c.air : !c.ground) return;
            const n = c.hits.get(e.id) || 0;
            if (n >= c.per) return;
            const d = U.edgeDist(c.lx, c.ly, e);
            if (d > c.radius + EPS) return;
            const score = d + n * 1000;
            if (score < bestD - 1e-9 || (Math.abs(score - bestD) <= 1e-9 && best && e.id < best.id)) { bestD = score; best = e; }
          });
          if (!best) { c.done = true; break; }
          t = best;
          c.left--;
        }
        c.hits.set(t.id, (c.hits.get(t.id) || 0) + 1);
        const fx = c.lx, fy = c.ly;
        c.last = t; c.lx = t.x; c.ly = t.y;
        const dmg = U.ctFor(t, c.damage, c.ct);
        const src = c.src && !c.src.dead ? c.src : null;
        if (c.splash > 0) U.applyEffect(sim, c.side, t.x, t.y, null, { damage: c.damage, ct: c.ct, radius: c.splash, stun: c.stun, kind: 'splash' }, src);
        else {
          if (dmg > 0) U.damage(sim, t, dmg, src, 'splash', c.side);
          if (!t.dead && c.stun > 0) U.stun(sim, t, c.stun);
        }
        if (c.def) ability(st, c.def, c.side, c.src, c.kind, t.x, t.y, c.splash || 0.6, { tx: fx, ty: fy });
        c.next += c.hop;
      }
      if (!c.done) cs[w++] = c;
    }
    cs.length = w;
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------- projectile watch
  function watchProjectiles(st) {
    const ps = st.sim.projectiles;
    for (let i = 0; i < ps.length; i++) {
      const p = ps[i];
      if (p.chxSeen || p.done) continue;
      p.chxSeen = true;
      const s = p.src;
      if (!s || !s.chx || !s.chx.h.projectile) continue;
      s.chx.h.projectile(s, p);
    }
    let w = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < st.projWatch.length; i++) if (!st.projWatch[i].dead) st.projWatch[w++] = st.projWatch[i];
    st.projWatch.length = w;
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------- abilities
  function ability(st, def, side, unit, kind, x, y, radius, extra) {
    const e = { side: side, unitId: unit && unit.id ? unit.id : 0, card: def.card, rarity: def.rarity, kind: kind, x: r2(x), y: r2(y), radius: r2(num(radius, 1)) };
    if (extra) for (const k in extra) if (extra[k] !== undefined) e[k] = typeof extra[k] === 'number' ? r2(extra[k]) : extra[k];
    st.sim.emit('ability', e);
  }

  /** Ability event at most every `every` seconds per (unit, kind). */
  function abilityRL(st, def, u, kind, x, y, radius, every, extra) {
    const key = (u ? u.id : def.id) + ':' + kind + (extra && extra.targetId ? ':' + extra.targetId : '');
    const now = st.sim.time;
    const last = st.lastAbility[key];
    if (last !== undefined && now - last < every - EPS) return;
    st.lastAbility[key] = now;
    ability(st, def, u ? u.side : 0, u, kind, x, y, radius, extra);
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------- helper API
  function makeApi(st) {
    const sim = st.sim;
    const U = CR.Units;
    const A = {
      st: st, sim: sim, rng: st.rng,
      /** Attach per-unit hooks: {attack, damaged, dealt, kill, death, tick, projectile, allyDeath}. */
      hook: function (u, def, h, state) {
        const c = u.chx || (u.chx = { def: def, h: {} });
        c.def = def;
        for (const k in h) {
          const f = h[k];
          if (!f) continue;
          const prev = c.h[k];
          c.h[k] = prev ? function (a, b, x) { prev(a, b, x); f(a, b, x); } : f;
        }
        if (state) for (const k in state) c[k] = state[k];
        if (h.tick && st.tickers.indexOf(u) < 0) st.tickers.push(u);
        if (h.projectile && st.projWatch.indexOf(u) < 0) st.projWatch.push(u);
        if (h.allyDeath && st.healers.indexOf(u) < 0) st.healers.push(u);
        return c;
      },
      ability: function (def, side, unit, kind, x, y, radius, extra) { ability(st, def, side, unit, kind, x, y, radius, extra); },
      abilityRL: function (def, u, kind, x, y, radius, every, extra) { abilityRL(st, def, u, kind, x, y, radius, every, extra); },
      after: function (sec, fn) { st.timers.push({ left: Math.max(sim.dt * 0.5, sec), fn: fn, owner: sim._owner }); },
      chain: function (o) { return startChain(st, o); },

      // ---- stats (per instance) ----
      scaleHp: function (u, f) { u.s.hp *= f; u.maxHp *= f; u.hp = u.maxHp; },
      scaleDamage: function (u, f) {
        const s = u.s;
        s.damage *= f;
        if (typeof s.ct === 'number') s.ct *= f;
        if (s.charge) s.charge.damage *= f;
        if (s.ramp) for (let i = 0; i < s.ramp.length; i++) s.ramp[i].damage *= f;
        const sp = s.special;
        if (sp.jump) sp.jump.damage = num(sp.jump.damage, s.damage) * f;
        if (sp.dash) sp.dash.damage = num(sp.dash.damage, s.damage) * f;
        if (sp.combo) sp.combo.bonus = num(sp.combo.bonus, 0) * f;
        if (sp.spawnDamage) sp.spawnDamage.damage = num(sp.spawnDamage.damage, 0) * f;
        if (s.deathDamage) s.deathDamage.damage *= f;
      },
      speed: function (u, f) { u.s.speed *= f; if (u.s.charge) u.s.charge.speed *= f; },
      hitSpeed: function (u, hs) {
        const s = u.s;
        const ratio = hs / s.hitSpeed;
        s.firstHit = Math.min(hs, s.firstHit * ratio);
        s.hitSpeed = hs;
        s.loadTime = hs - s.firstHit;
        if (u.atk > s.loadTime) u.atk = s.loadFirstHit ? 0 : s.loadTime;
      },
      range: function (u, r) {
        const s = u.s;
        s.range = r;
        s.sightRange = u.building ? Math.max(s.sightRange, r) : Math.max(s.sightRange, r + 0.5);
      },
      splash: function (u, r) { u.s.splashRadius = r; },
      onHit: function (u, o) { u.s.special.onHit = Object.assign({}, u.s.special.onHit || {}, o); },

      /** Spawn without modifier handlers (spawn context); tier keeps the rarity aura. */
      spawn: function (side, unitId, x, y, o) {
        o = o || {};
        if (!CR.DATA.units[unitId]) return null;
        st.spawnStack.push({ tier: o.tier, setup: o.setup || null });
        let u = null;
        try {
          u = sim.spawnUnit(side, unitId, CR.clamp(x, 0.3, CR.Arena.W - 0.3), CR.clamp(y, 0.3, CR.Arena.H - 0.3),
            { card: o.card || null, tier: o.tier || 0, deployTime: typeof o.deployTime === 'number' ? o.deployTime : undefined });
        } finally { st.spawnStack.pop(); }
        if (u && o.hp) { u.hp = Math.min(o.hp, u.maxHp); u.maxHp = u.hp; u.shield = 0; u.maxShield = 0; }
        if (u && o.clone) u.clone = true;
        return u;
      },
      /** 1-HP clone of unit `o` (like the Clone spell). */
      clone: function (o, x, y, def, extra) {
        return A.spawn(o.side, o.unit, x, y, { card: o.card, tier: def ? def.tier : o.tier, deployTime: extra && typeof extra.deployTime === 'number' ? extra.deployTime : 0, hp: 1, clone: true, setup: extra && extra.setup });
      },
      /** Summon a card with a replaced summon list (handlers apply to the new units). */
      summonAs: function (side, card, x, y, tier, summon) {
