        const c2 = Object.assign({}, card, { summon: summon });
        return sim._summon(side, c2, x, y, tier);
      },
      /** Cast a spell with patched data; returns {proj, areas} created by the cast. */
      cast: function (side, card, x, y, tier, patch) {
        const c2 = patch ? Object.assign({}, card, { spell: Object.assign(CR.clone(card.spell || {}), patch) }) : card;
        const np = sim.projectiles.length, na = sim.areas.length;
        CR.Spells.cast(sim, side, c2, CR.clamp(x, 0, CR.Arena.W), CR.clamp(y, 0, CR.Arena.H), { tier: tier });
        return { proj: sim.projectiles.slice(np), areas: sim.areas.slice(na) };
      },
      /** Wrap a projectile's arrival (after the original impact). */
      onImpact: function (p, fn) {
        const prev = p.onArrive || null;
        p.onArrive = function (s2, pp) {
          if (prev) prev(s2, pp);
          else defaultArrive(s2, pp);
          fn(pp);
        };
      },
      onEnd: function (p, fn) {
        const prev = p.onEnd || null;
        p.onEnd = function (s2, pp) { if (prev) prev(s2, pp); fn(pp); };
      },
      /** Lasting area driven by this module (mode 'chaos', rendered from view.areas). */
      area: function (o, tickFn) {
        const a = sim.addArea(Object.assign({ mode: 'chaos', left: 1, radius: 1 }, o));
        a.chxTick = tickFn || null;
        st.areas.push(a);
        return a;
      },
      effect: function (side, x, y, e, src) { return U.applyEffect(sim, side, x, y, null, Object.assign({ kind: 'splash' }, e), src || null); },
      enemiesNear: function (side, x, y, radius, filter) {
        const out = [];
        U.forEachEnemy(sim, side, function (t) {
          if (t.tunnel || t.underground || t.immune) return;
          if (filter && !filter(t)) return;
          if (U.edgeDist(x, y, t) > radius + EPS) return;
          out.push(t);
        });
        return out;
      },
      nearestEnemy: function (side, x, y, maxD, filter) {
        let best = null, bd = Infinity;
        U.forEachEnemy(sim, side, function (t) {
          if (t.tunnel || t.underground || t.immune || !U.isTargetable(t)) return;
          if (filter && !filter(t)) return;
          const d = U.edgeDist(x, y, t);
          if (d > maxD + EPS) return;
          if (d < bd - 1e-9 || (Math.abs(d - bd) <= 1e-9 && best && t.id < best.id)) { bd = d; best = t; }
        });
        return best;
      },
      /** Pull every enemy troop inside the circle towards (x,y) (tornado-like). */
      pull: function (side, x, y, radius, speed, airToo) {
        const step = speed * sim.dt;
        U.forEachEnemy(sim, side, function (t) {
          if (t.building || t.tower || t.tunnel || t.underground || t.immune) return;
          if (t.air && airToo === false) return;
          if (U.edgeDist(x, y, t) > radius + EPS) return;
          U.pull(sim, t, x, y, step);
        });
      },
      /** Push enemy ground troops out of a circle. */
      push: function (side, x, y, radius, speed) {
        const step = speed * sim.dt;
        U.forEachEnemy(sim, side, function (t) {
          if (t.building || t.tower || t.tunnel || t.underground || t.immune || t.air || t.s.ignorePushback) return;
          const dx = t.x - x, dy = t.y - y, d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
          if (d > radius + EPS) return;
          const ux = d > 1e-6 ? dx / d : 0, uy = d > 1e-6 ? dy / d : (t.side === 0 ? -1 : 1);
          t.x = CR.clamp(t.x + ux * step, t.r, CR.Arena.W - t.r);
          t.y = CR.clamp(t.y + uy * step, t.r, CR.Arena.H - t.r);
          t.charging = false; t.chargeDist = 0;
        });
      },
      /** CR level reduction (each level ~10 % of hitpoints and damage), troops & buildings only. */
      levelDown: function (t, n) {
        if (!t || t.dead || t.tower) return 0;
        const cur = t.chxLevel || 0;
        const k = Math.max(0, Math.min(n, 8 - cur));
        if (!k) return 0;
        t.chxLevel = cur + k;
        const f = Math.pow(1 / 1.1, k);
        const s = t.s;
        A.scaleDamage(t, f);
        s.hp *= f;
        t.maxHp *= f; t.hp *= f;
        if (t.maxShield > 0) { t.maxShield *= f; t.shield *= f; }
        return k;
      },
      /** Shot continuing through the target (Magic-Archer style), starting when the shot lands. */
      pierce: function (u, t, dmg, o) {
        o = o || {};
        const dx = t.x - u.x, dy = t.y - u.y, d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) || 1;
        const spd = u.s.projectile ? u.s.projectile.speed : 12;
        const hits = new Set([t.id]);
        const p = U.launch(sim, {
          kind: o.kind || u.unit, side: u.side, x: t.x, y: t.y, dx: dx / d, dy: dy / d, speed: o.speed || spd, mode: 'roll',
          range: num(o.range, 4), width: num(o.width, 0.4), reach: num(o.width, 0.4), src: u, air: true,
          delay: u.s.special.instantHit ? 0 : d / spd,
          effect: { damage: dmg, ct: o.ct === undefined ? u.s.ct : o.ct, air: u.s.targetsAir, ground: u.s.targetsGround, kind: 'ranged' },
        });
        p.hits = hits;
        return p;
      },
      /** Internal per-tick watcher: fn() returns true when finished (not a sim area). */
      watch: function (fn) { st.areas.push({ done: false, chxTick: function (w) { if (fn()) w.done = true; } }); },
      /** Straight bullet that stops at its first hit. */
      bullet: function (u, angle, dmg, range) {
        const p = U.launch(sim, {
          kind: u.unit, side: u.side, x: u.x, y: u.y, dx: Math.cos(angle), dy: Math.sin(angle), speed: u.s.projectile ? u.s.projectile.speed : 14,
          mode: 'roll', range: range, width: 0.25, reach: 0.25, src: u, air: true,
          effect: { damage: dmg, ct: u.s.ct, air: u.s.targetsAir, ground: u.s.targetsGround, kind: 'ranged' },
        });
        p.chxStop = true;
        p.chxSeen = true;
        if (!st.bulletSweep || st.bulletSweep.done) startBulletSweep(st);
        return p;
      },
      liveCount: function (pred) {
        let n = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < sim.units.length; i++) { const x = sim.units[i]; if (!x.dead && pred(x)) n++; }
        return n;
      },
      flight: function (u, t, speed) {
        const d = CR.dist(u.x, u.y, t.x, t.y);
        const sp = speed || (u.s.projectile ? u.s.projectile.speed : 0);
        return sp > 0 && !u.s.special.instantHit ? d / sp : 0;
      },
      kill: function (u, silent) {
        if (!u || u.dead) return;
        u.hp = 0; u.dead = true; u.killer = -1;
        if (silent) { u.silentDeath = true; u.noDeathEffects = true; }
      },
      forward: function (side) { return side === 0 ? 1 : -1; },
    };
    return A;
  }

  // Bullets that stop at their first hit: one shared watcher checks them each tick.
  function startBulletSweep(st) {
    const sweep = {
      done: false,
      chxTick: function () {
        const ps = st.sim.projectiles;
        let any = false;
        for (let i = 0; i < ps.length; i++) {
          const p = ps[i];
          if (!p.chxStop || p.done) continue;
          any = true;
          if (p.hits && p.hits.size > 0) p.done = true;
        }
        if (!any) sweep.idle = (sweep.idle || 0) + 1;
        else sweep.idle = 0;
        if (sweep.idle > 40) sweep.done = true;
      },
    };
    st.bulletSweep = sweep;
    st.areas.push(sweep);
  }

  /** The engine's default projectile arrival (for projectiles without onArrive). */
  function defaultArrive(sim, p) {
    const e = p.effect || {};
    const t = p.homing && p.target && alive(p.target) ? p.target : null;
    if (num(e.radius, 0) > 0) CR.Units.applyEffect(sim, p.side, p.x, p.y, null, e, p.src || null);
    else if (t) CR.Units.applyEffect(sim, p.side, p.x, p.y, t, e, p.src || null);
  }

  // ===========================================================================
  // Public API
  // ===========================================================================
  let aiPatched = false;
  function patchAI() {
    if (aiPatched || !CR.AI || !CR.AI.prototype || typeof CR.AI.prototype.update !== 'function') return;
    aiPatched = true;
    const orig = CR.AI.prototype.update;
    CR.AI.prototype.update = function (sim) {
      if (sim && sim.chaos && typeof sim.chaos.markBot === 'function') sim.chaos.markBot(typeof this.player === 'number' ? this.player : this.side);
      return orig.apply(this, arguments);
    };
  }

  const Chaos = {
    RULES: RULES,
    SKIP: SKIP,
    RARITIES: RARITIES,
    RARITY_COLORS: RARITY_COLORS,
    RARITY_NAMES: RARITY_NAMES,
    MODS: MODS,
    EXCLUDED: EXCLUDED,
    REPLACED: REPLACED,
    /** Called by CR.Sim for mode 'chaos'; returns the per-battle state (sim.chaos). */
    attach: function (sim) {
      patchAI();
      const st = new ChaosState(sim);
      sim.chaos = st;
      registerHooks(st);
      return st;
    },
    /** Public info of a modifier id ('knight:rare'). */
    describe: function (id) { const d = MODS[id]; return d && usable(d) ? publicDef(d) : null; },
    /** All usable modifiers (public info). */
    list: function () {
      const out = [];
      for (const id in MODS) if (usable(MODS[id])) out.push(publicDef(MODS[id]));
      return out;
    },
    /** {common, rare, epic} public infos of a card (missing rarities are absent). */
    forCard: function (cardId) {
      const m = BY_CARD[cardId], out = {};
      if (!m) return out;
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { const d = m[RARITIES[i]]; if (d && usable(d)) out[RARITIES[i]] = publicDef(d); }
      return out;
    },
    hasUpgrades: function (cardId) { const f = Chaos.forCard(cardId); return !!(f.common || f.rare || f.epic); },
    modFor: function (cardId, tier) { const d = modFor(cardId, tier); return d ? publicDef(d) : null; },
    /**
     * Bot decision for player `side` (player index; == side in 1v1): picks the best open option of its offer by issuing the command.
     * Returns the option index or -1. (Automatically used for sim.options.bots and CR.AI sides.)
     */
    botPick: function (sim, side) {
      const st = sim && sim.chaos;
      if (!st || !(st instanceof ChaosState) || !st.offer) return -1;
      const e = st.offer.entries[side];
      if (!e || e.auto || e.done) return -1;
      const opt = botChoice(st, side, e.options, e.taken);
      const r = sim.command(side, { type: 'chaos_pick', option: opt });
      return r && r.ok ? opt : -1;
    },
    view: function (sim, side) { return sim && sim.chaos instanceof ChaosState ? sim.chaos.view(side) : null; },
    rarityColor: function (r) { return RARITY_COLORS[typeof r === 'number' ? RARITIES[r - 1] : r] || RARITY_COLORS.common; },
    // German rules for the in-game rules screen (plain strings).
    rules: [
      'C.H.A.O.S ist ein eigener Modus (ohne C.H.A.O.S gelten die normalen Regeln): Kronentürme haben doppelte Trefferpunkte und Elixier lädt 50 % schneller.',
      'Bei 2:56, 2:11, 1:26 und 0:26 (und in der Verlängerung bei 1:26) pausiert der Kampf: Jeder bekommt drei verschiedene Fähigkeiten für Karten aus seinem Deck zur Auswahl.',
      'Jede Karte hat drei unterschiedliche Fähigkeiten – eine gewöhnliche, eine seltene und eine epische.',
      'Tippe eine an – du hast 7 Sekunden. Läuft die Zeit ab, wird zufällig gewählt. Der Kampf geht weiter, sobald alle gewählt haben (im 2 gegen 2 wählt jeder Spieler für sein eigenes Deck).',
      'Die Seltenheit steigt: Gewöhnlich (silbern), Selten (orange), Episch (lila). Alle Angebote einer Runde haben dieselbe Seltenheit; in der Verlängerung ist das Angebot immer episch.',
      'Fähigkeiten kosten nichts und gelten bis Kampfende für jedes weitere Ausspielen der Karte. Eine Karte trägt eine Fähigkeit – eine seltenere ersetzt die alte. Keine wird zweimal angeboten.',
      'Überspringen: Du verzichtest jetzt und wählst beim nächsten Angebot zwei der drei Fähigkeiten (nicht beim letzten Angebot).',
      'Aufgewertete Einheiten leuchten in der Farbe ihrer Seltenheit. Deine Fähigkeiten stehen links, die des Gegners rechts – gedrückt halten zeigt, was sie bewirken.',
    ],

    _State: ChaosState,
    _internal: { modFor: modFor, usable: usable, exclude: exclude, mod: mod },
  };
  CR.Chaos = Chaos;
  // Legacy lookup used by older UI code: CR.Chaos.UPGRADES[id] -> {title, text, ...}
  Chaos.UPGRADES = MODS;

  // ===========================================================================
  // Modifier catalog. Every entry: official name (name), German title/text, power (bot
  // preference 1..5), approx (numbers not published -> best estimate, see docs/research/chaos.md),
  // and behaviour: units[unitId](A, def, u) at spawn, summon(A, def, side, card, x, y, tier),
  // spell(A, def, side, card, x, y, tier). Per-unit hooks via A.hook(u, def, {...}).
  // ===========================================================================
  (function defineMods() {
    const DEG = Math.PI / 180;
    const U = CR.Units;
    function spell(id) { const c = cardOf(id); return (c && c.spell) || {}; }
    function ct0(sp) { return typeof sp.ct === 'number' ? sp.ct : sp.damage; }
    function countSummon(unit, count, radius) {
      return function (A, d, side, card, x, y, tier) { return A.summonAs(side, card, x, y, tier, [{ unit: unit, count: count, radius: radius }]); };
    }
    function friends(A, u, r, fn) {
      const us = A.sim.units;
      for (let i = 0; i < us.length; i++) {
        const f = us[i];
        if (f.side !== u.side || f.dead || f.building || f.tunnel || f.underground) continue;
        if (CR.dist(f.x, f.y, u.x, u.y) > r + f.r) continue;
        fn(f);
      }
    }
    function fireballShots(A, d, u) {
      const fb = spell('fireball');
      u.s.damage = num(fb.damage, 689);
      u.s.ct = typeof fb.ct === 'number' ? fb.ct : null;
      A.splash(u, num(fb.radius, 2.5));
      A.onHit(u, { knockback: num(fb.knockback, 1) });
      if (u.s.projectile) u.s.projectile = { speed: Math.max(u.s.projectile.speed, num(fb.speed, 10)), homing: true };
      A.hook(u, d, { attack: function (w, t) { A.abilityRL(d, w, 'fireball', t.x, t.y, num(fb.radius, 2.5), 0.4, { delay: A.flight(w, t), tx: w.x, ty: w.y }); } });
    }
    function jumpFx(A, d, u) {
      A.hook(u, d, {
        tick: function (m) {
          const c = m.chx;
          if (m.jump && !m.jump.landed && c.jumpSeen !== m.jump) { c.jumpSeen = m.jump; A.ability(d, m.side, m, 'jump', m.jump.tx, m.jump.ty, num(m.s.special.jump && m.s.special.jump.radius, 2.2), { tx: m.x, ty: m.y, dur: num(m.jump.air, 0.8) }); }
        },
        attack: function (m, t, hit) { if (hit.kind === 'jump') A.ability(d, m.side, m, 'slam', m.x, m.y, num(m.s.special.jump && m.s.special.jump.radius, 2.2)); },
      });
    }
    function dashFx(A, d, u) {
      A.hook(u, d, {
        tick: function (b) {
          const c = b.chx;
          if (b.dash && c.dashSeen !== b.dash) { c.dashSeen = b.dash; const t = b.dash.target; A.ability(d, b.side, b, 'dash', t ? t.x : b.x, t ? t.y : b.y, 0.8, { tx: b.x, ty: b.y }); }
        },
      });
    }
    function bomb(A, d, side, x, y, dmg, ct, radius, delay, ground, air) {
      A.sim.addArea({ kind: 'bomb', side: side, x: x, y: y, radius: radius, left: delay, mode: 'delayed', card: d.card,
        effect: { damage: dmg, ct: ct, radius: radius, air: air !== false, ground: ground !== false, kind: 'death' } });
    }
    function pulseArea(A, d, side, kind, x, y, radius, dur, every, eff, follow) {
      const a = A.area({ kind: kind, side: side, x: x, y: y, radius: radius, left: dur, card: d.card }, function (ar) {
        if (follow) { if (follow.dead) { ar.done = true; return; } ar.x = follow.x; ar.y = follow.y; }
        ar.chxNext = (ar.chxNext === undefined ? 0 : ar.chxNext) - A.sim.dt;
        if (ar.chxNext > EPS) return;
        ar.chxNext += every;
        A.effect(side, ar.x, ar.y, Object.assign({ radius: ar.radius }, eff), null);
      });
      return a;
    }
    function snowstorm(A, d, side, x, y) {
      A.ability(d, side, null, 'snowstorm', x, y, 3, { dur: 5 });
      pulseArea(A, d, side, 'snowstorm', x, y, 3, 5, 0.5, { damage: 22, ct: 7, slow: { pct: 35, dur: 0.7 }, kind: 'spell', spell: true });
    }
    function chainSpirit(A, d, u, o) {
      delete u.s.special.chain;
      A.onHit(u, { stun: 0.5 });
      A.hook(u, d, {
        attack: function (s, t, hit) {
          A.chain({ side: s.side, src: null, from: t, first: !!o.first, hops: o.hops, radius: o.radius, damage: num(o.damage, hit.amount),
            ct: o.ct !== undefined ? o.ct : s.s.ct, stun: 0.5, hop: o.hop, per: o.per, delay: A.flight(s, t) + 0.02, kind: o.kind || 'chain', def: d });
        },
      });
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------------- Knight
    mod('knight', 'common', { name: 'Truly of the Round Table', title: 'Tafelrunde', text: '+200 % Trefferpunkte, dafür halbes Lauftempo.', power: 2,
      units: { knight: function (A, d, u) { A.scaleHp(u, 3); A.speed(u, 0.5); } } });
    mod('knight', 'rare', { name: 'An Absolute Stunner', title: 'Betäubungsschlag', text: 'Seine Schwerthiebe betäuben das Ziel 0,5 s lang.', power: 3,
      units: { knight: function (A, d, u) { A.onHit(u, { stun: 0.5 }); A.hook(u, d, { attack: function (k, t) { A.abilityRL(d, k, 'stun', t.x, t.y, 0.8, 0.5, { targetId: t.id }); } }); } } });
    mod('knight', 'epic', { name: 'Not This Guy Again!', title: 'Nicht der schon wieder!', text: 'Statt des Ritters landet ein Mega-Ritter.', power: 5, needs: ['mega-knight'],
      summon: function (A, d, side, card, x, y, tier) { A.ability(d, side, null, 'transform', x, y, 2.2); return A.summonAs(side, card, x, y, tier, [{ unit: 'mega-knight', count: 1 }]); } });

    mod('mega-knight', 'common', { name: 'Power Jump', title: 'Kraftsprung', text: 'Sein Sprungangriff macht doppelten Schaden.', power: 2,
      units: { 'mega-knight': function (A, d, u) { const j = u.s.special.jump; if (j) j.damage = num(j.damage, u.s.damage) * 2; jumpFx(A, d, u); } } });
    mod('mega-knight', 'rare', { name: 'Mega Power Jump', title: 'Mega-Kraftsprung', text: 'Springt Gegner in jeder Entfernung an – auch Türme.', power: 4,
      units: { 'mega-knight': function (A, d, u) { const j = u.s.special.jump; if (j) j.maxRange = 40; u.s.sightRange = 40; jumpFx(A, d, u); } } });
    mod('mega-knight', 'epic', { name: 'Ultra Mega Power Jump', title: 'Ultra-Mega-Sprung', text: 'Greift nur noch mit Sprüngen an – immer und immer wieder.', power: 5,
      units: { 'mega-knight': function (A, d, u) { const j = u.s.special.jump; if (j) { j.minRange = 0; j.maxRange = 7; j.cooldown = 0.15; } u.s.sightRange = Math.max(u.s.sightRange, 7); jumpFx(A, d, u); } } });

    mod('pekka', 'common', { name: '2 Fast 2 Ferocious', title: 'Turbo-P.E.K.K.A', text: 'Läuft dreimal so schnell.', power: 3,

    mod('pekka', 'rare', { name: 'Miniature P.E.K.K.As', title: 'Mini-Armee', text: 'Kommt als drei Mini-P.E.K.K.As.', power: 4, needs: ['mini-pekka'],
      summon: countSummon('mini-pekka', 3, 0.8) });
    replaced('pekka', 'epic', 'Dig Deep', 'Platzierung überall wie der Bergarbeiter: braucht eine Platzierungsregel, die Gast- und Host-Oberfläche nicht kennen');

    // --------------------------------------------------------------- Giant
    mod('giant', 'common', { name: '2 Fast 4 You', title: 'Riesen-Sprint', text: 'Läuft viermal so schnell.', power: 3,
      units: { giant: function (A, d, u) { A.speed(u, 4); } } });
    mod('giant', 'rare', { name: 'Large & In Charge', title: 'Groß und geladen', text: 'Stürmt per Sprint-Angriff auf Gebäude zu – sogar über den Fluss.', power: 4, approx: true,
      units: { giant: function (A, d, u) { u.s.special.dash = { damage: u.s.damage * 2, minRange: 2, maxRange: 7.5, speed: 7, maxTime: 1.6, cooldown: 1.2, immune: false }; dashFx(A, d, u); } } });
    mod('giant', 'epic', { name: "World's Largest Barrel", title: 'Größtes Fass der Welt', text: 'Rollt als Riesenfass los, walzt alles platt und entlässt dann den Riesen.', power: 5, approx: true,
      summon: function (A, d, side, card, x, y, tier) {
        const f = A.forward(side);
        A.ability(d, side, null, 'barrel', x, y, 1.6, { tx: x, ty: y + f * 7 });
        U.launch(A.sim, {
          kind: 'barbarian-barrel', side: side, x: x, y: y, dx: 0, dy: f, speed: 4.5, mode: 'roll', range: 7, width: 1.6, reach: 0.8, card: card.id,
          effect: { damage: 1500, ct: 300, air: false, ground: true, knockback: 1, kind: 'spell', spell: true },
          onEnd: function (s2, p) {
            let gy = CR.clamp(p.y, 0.8, CR.Arena.H - 0.8);
            if (CR.Arena.isWater(p.x, gy)) gy -= f * 1.6;
            A.spawn(side, 'giant', p.x, gy, { card: card.id, tier: tier, deployTime: 0.3 });
            A.ability(d, side, null, 'spawn', p.x, gy, 1.2);
          },
        });
        return [];
      } });

    mod('golem', 'common', { name: 'Paint It Pink!', title: 'Alles in Pink', text: 'Zerfällt er, bekommst du 4 Elixier zurück.', power: 3,
      units: { golem: function (A, d, u) { A.hook(u, d, { death: function (g) { if (g.clone) return; A.sim.addElixir(g.side, 4, g); A.ability(d, g.side, g, 'elixir', g.x, g.y, 1.5, { amount: 4 }); } }); } } });
    mod('golem', 'rare', { name: 'Twin Tanks', title: 'Doppel-Golem', text: 'Zerfällt in zwei Golems statt in Golemiten.', power: 5,
      units: { golem: function (A, d, u) {

        A.hook(u, d, { death: function (g) {
          if (g.clone) { U.spawnGroup(A.sim, g.side, 'golemite', g.x, g.y, 2, 1.5, { card: g.card, tier: g.tier }); return; }
          for (let k = -1; k <= 1; k += 2) A.spawn(g.side, 'golem', g.x + k * 0.9, g.y, { card: g.card, tier: d.tier, deployTime: 1 });
          A.ability(d, g.side, g, 'split', g.x, g.y, 2);

    mod('golem', 'epic', { name: 'Not Today!', title: 'Heute nicht!', text: 'Wirft Geschosse auf den Schützen zurück; Nahkampftreffer halbiert.', power: 5, approx: true,
      units: { golem: function (A, d, u) {

            A.abilityRL(d, g, 'deflect', g.x, g.y, 1.2, 0.3, { tx: s.x, ty: s.y });
          } else if (hit.kind === 'melee' || hit.kind === 'charge') hit.amount *= 0.5;

    mod('musketeer', 'common', { name: 'Shots Fired!', title: 'Streufeuer', text: 'Feuert fünf Kugeln im Fächer – jede mit vollem Schaden.', power: 3,

    // --------------------------------------------------------------- Firecracker
    mod('firecracker', 'common', { name: 'Jump! Jump! Jump Around!', title: 'Spring! Spring!', text: 'Viel stärkerer Rückstoß – mit einem großen Hüpfer.', power: 2,
      units: { firecracker: function (A, d, u) {
        u.s.special.recoil = num(u.s.special.recoil, 1) * 2.5;
        A.hook(u, d, {
          attack: function (f) { f.chx.hop = true; A.abilityRL(d, f, 'jump', f.x, f.y, 0.6, 0.5); },
          tick: function (f) {
            if (!f.chx.hop) return;
            const T = Math.max(A.sim.dt, CR.RULES.combat.knockbackTime || 0.3);
            if (f.kbLeft > EPS) { const k = CR.clamp(1 - f.kbLeft / T, 0, 1); f.z = Math.sin(Math.PI * k) * 1.4; }
            else { f.z = 0; f.chx.hop = false; }
          },
        });
      } } });
    mod('firecracker', 'rare', { name: 'Furious Fireworks', title: 'Wütendes Feuerwerk', text: 'Jeder ihrer Funken zerplatzt in drei weitere Funken.', power: 3,
      units: { firecracker: function (A, d, u) {
        A.hook(u, d, { projectile: function (f, p) {
          if (p.kind !== 'spark' || p.chxTert) return;
          A.onEnd(p, function (pp) {
            const base = Math.atan2(pp.dy, pp.dx);
            for (let k = -1; k <= 1; k++) {
              const a = base + k * 28 * DEG;
              const q = U.launch(A.sim, { kind: 'spark', side: pp.side, x: pp.x, y: pp.y, dx: Math.cos(a), dy: Math.sin(a), speed: pp.speed, mode: 'roll',
                range: 2.5, width: 0.35, reach: 0.35, src: pp.src, air: true, effect: pp.effect });
              q.chxTert = true; q.chxSeen = true;
            }
            A.abilityRL(d, f, 'burst', pp.x, pp.y, 1.2, 0.25);
          });
        } });
      } } });
    mod('firecracker', 'epic', { name: 'A Pack of the Clones', title: 'Klon-Kommando', text: 'Jeder Angriff erschafft zwei Klone (1 TP) neben ihr.', power: 4,
      units: { firecracker: function (A, d, u) {
        A.hook(u, d, { attack: function (f, t) {
          if (f.clone) return;
          let n = A.liveCount(function (x) { return x.chxCloneOf === f.id; });
          const ang = Math.atan2(t.y - f.y, t.x - f.x) + Math.PI / 2;
          for (let k = -1; k <= 1 && n < 6; k += 2) {
            const c = A.clone(f, f.x + Math.cos(ang) * 0.9 * k, f.y + Math.sin(ang) * 0.9 * k, d, { deployTime: 0.2 });
            if (c) { c.chxCloneOf = f.id; n++; }
          }
          A.ability(d, f.side, f, 'clone', f.x, f.y, 1.2);
        } });
      } } });

    mod('baby-dragon', 'common', { name: 'Baby Fly, Fly, Fly', title: 'Flieg, Baby, flieg!', text: 'Fliegt dreimal so schnell.', power: 2,

    mod('baby-dragon', 'rare', { name: 'Gargantuan Flameballs', title: 'Riesen-Flammenbälle', text: 'Spuckt echte Feuerbälle mit Rückstoß.', power: 4, needCards: ['fireball'],
      units: { 'baby-dragon': function (A, d, u) { fireballShots(A, d, u); } } });
    mod('baby-dragon', 'epic', { name: "Baby's Got a Baby!", title: 'Ein Baby fürs Baby', text: 'Hinterlässt ein Ei – daraus schlüpft ein entwickelter Drache (Feuer, Blitz oder Inferno).', power: 5, approx: true, needs: ['phoenix-egg'],
      units: { 'baby-dragon': function (A, d, u) {
        A.hook(u, d, { death: function (b) {
          if (b.clone || b.chxHatched) return;
          const side = b.side, card = b.card;
          const egg = A.spawn(side, 'phoenix-egg', b.x, b.y, { card: card, tier: d.tier, deployTime: 0, setup: function (e) { e.s.special.hatch = null; } });
          if (!egg) return;
          A.ability(d, side, egg, 'egg', egg.x, egg.y, 0.8, { dur: 3.8 });
          A.hook(egg, d, { tick: function (e) {
            e.chx.left = (e.chx.left === undefined ? 3.8 : e.chx.left) - A.sim.dt;
            if (e.chx.left > EPS) return;
            const traits = ['fire', 'electro', 'inferno'];
            const trait = traits[A.rng.int(3)];
            A.spawn(side, 'baby-dragon', e.x, e.y, { card: card, tier: d.tier, deployTime: 0.5, setup: function (bd) { bd.chxHatched = true; evoDragon(A, bd, trait); } });
            A.ability(d, side, e, 'hatch', e.x, e.y, 1.2, { trait: trait });
            A.kill(e, true);
          } });
        } });
      } } });
    function evoDragon(A, u, trait) {
      const s = u.s;
      if (trait === 'electro') { s.splashRadius = 0; s.special.chain = { maxTargets: 3, radius: 4, hopDelay: 0.1, stun: 0.5 }; }
      else if (trait === 'inferno') {
        s.splashRadius = 0; s.special.instantHit = true;
        s.ramp = [{ damage: 60, duration: 2 }, { damage: 200, duration: 2 }, { damage: 450, duration: Infinity }];
        s.damage = 60; A.hitSpeed(u, 0.4);
      } else { s.splashRadius = 2.2; A.speed(u, 1.3); }
    }

    mod('battle-healer', 'epic', { name: 'Second Wind', title: 'Zweites Leben', text: 'Fällt eine verbündete Truppe in ihrer Nähe, kehrt sie als Klon zurück.', power: 4,

    mod('bowler', 'common', { name: 'Strike!', title: 'Kegelprofi', text: '30 % mehr Reichweite und Angriffstempo.', power: 2,
      units: { bowler: function (A, d, u) { A.range(u, u.s.range * 1.3); A.hitSpeed(u, u.s.hitSpeed / 1.3); } } });
    mod('bowler', 'rare', { name: 'Chain Bowl', title: 'Kettenkugel', text: 'Die Kugel springt nach dem Rollen bis zu dreimal zum nächsten Gegner weiter.', power: 3, approx: true,
      units: { bowler: function (A, d, u) {
        function bounce(b, pp, left) {
          if (left <= 0) return;
          const nx = A.nearestEnemy(pp.side, pp.x, pp.y, 5, function (t) { return !t.air && !(pp.hits && pp.hits.has(t.id)); });
          if (!nx) return;
          const dx = nx.x - pp.x, dy = nx.y - pp.y, dd = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) || 1;
          const q = U.launch(A.sim, { kind: 'boulder', side: pp.side, x: pp.x, y: pp.y, dx: dx / dd, dy: dy / dd, speed: pp.speed, mode: 'roll',
            range: dd + 1.5, width: pp.width, reach: pp.reach, src: pp.src, effect: pp.effect });
          q.hits = new Set(pp.hits || []);
          q.chxSeen = true;
          A.onEnd(q, function (qq) { bounce(b, qq, left - 1); });
          A.ability(d, pp.side, b, 'bounce', pp.x, pp.y, pp.width, { tx: nx.x, ty: nx.y });
        }
        A.hook(u, d, { projectile: function (b, p) { if (p.kind === 'boulder') A.onEnd(p, function (pp) { bounce(b, pp, 3); }); } });
      } } });
    mod('bowler', 'epic', { name: 'Explosive Boulders', title: 'Sprengkugel', text: 'Seine Kugeln explodieren beim ersten Aufprall.', power: 4, approx: true,

        A.hook(u, d, { projectile: function (b, p) {
          if (p.kind !== 'boulder') return;
          const side = b.side, dmg = b.s.damage, ct = b.s.ct;
          A.watch(function () {
            if (p.chxBoomed) return true;
            if ((p.hits && p.hits.size > 0) || p.done) {
              p.chxBoomed = true;
              A.effect(side, p.x, p.y, { damage: dmg, ct: ct, radius: 2, ground: true, air: false, knockback: 1 }, b.dead ? null : b);
              A.ability(d, side, b, 'explosion', p.x, p.y, 2);
              return true;
            }
            return false;
          });
        } });
      } } });

    mod('executioner', 'common', { name: 'Stronger Than Ever', title: 'Stärker als je zuvor', text: 'Doppelte Trefferpunkte.', power: 2,

    mod('executioner', 'rare', { name: "Let's Axe a Dud!", title: 'Vier Äxte', text: 'Wirft vier Äxte auf einmal.', power: 4,
      units: { executioner: function (A, d, u) {

          const range = CR.clamp(dd, num(sp.minRange, 4.5), num(sp.range, 7));
          const c = x.chx; c.flip = !c.flip;
          const offs = [-18, 18, c.flip ? 36 : -36];
          for (let i = 0; i < offs.length; i++) {
            const a = Math.atan2(dy, dx) + offs[i] * DEG;
            U.launch(A.sim, { kind: 'axe', side: x.side, x: x.x, y: x.y, ox: x.x, oy: x.y, dx: Math.cos(a), dy: Math.sin(a), range: range,

          }
          A.abilityRL(d, x, 'multishot', x.x, x.y, 1, 1, { tx: t.x, ty: t.y });
        } });
      } } });
    mod('executioner', 'epic', { name: 'Axed with the Wind', title: 'Vom Winde verweht', text: 'Seine Axt wirbelt wie ein Tornado und zieht Gegner mit.', power: 4, approx: true,

    mod('archers', 'rare', { name: 'Evo Firecracker Duo', title: 'Knallerduo', text: 'Statt Bogenschützinnen kommen zwei Feuerwerkerinnen, deren Funken glühende Wolken hinterlassen.', power: 4, approx: true, needs: ['firecracker'],

    // --------------------------------------------------------------- Miner
    mod('miner', 'common', { name: 'Sharp Shovel', title: 'Scharfe Schaufel', text: 'Jeder weitere Treffer auf dasselbe Ziel macht 25 % mehr Schaden.', power: 3,
      units: { miner: function (A, d, u) {
        const base = u.s.damage, baseCt = u.s.ct;
        A.hook(u, d, { attack: function (m, t, hit) {
          const c = m.chx;
          if (c.lastT === t.id) c.stack = Math.min(c.stack + 1, 20); else { c.stack = 0; c.lastT = t.id; }
          const f = 1 + 0.25 * c.stack;
          hit.amount = base * f;
          if (typeof baseCt === 'number') m.s.ct = baseCt * f;
          if (c.stack > 0) A.abilityRL(d, m, 'stack', t.x, t.y, 0.6, 0.4, { stack: c.stack });
        } }, { stack: 0, lastT: 0 });
      } } });
    mod('miner', 'rare', { name: 'Nerf Miner', title: 'Schwacher Bergarbeiter', text: 'Fünffacher Schaden gegen Truppen – aber seine Treffer heilen Kronentürme.', power: 3,
      units: { miner: function (A, d, u) {
        const baseCt = num(u.s.ct, u.s.damage);
        A.hook(u, d, { attack: function (m, t, hit) {
          if (t.tower) {
            hit.amount = 0; m.s.ct = 0;
            t.hp = Math.min(t.maxHp, t.hp + baseCt);
            A.abilityRL(d, m, 'heal', t.x, t.y, 1.2, 0.5, { amount: baseCt });
          } else if (!t.building) hit.amount *= 5;
        } });
      } } });
    mod('miner', 'epic', { name: 'Burrower', title: 'Wühlmaus', text: 'Sein Tunnel hinterlässt eine Spur, die Gegner 5 s lang verletzt und wegstößt.', power: 4, approx: true,
      units: { miner: function (A, d, u) {
        A.hook(u, d, { tick: function (m) {

          if (!m.tunnel) { if (c.lx !== undefined) c.h.tick = null; return; }
          if (c.lx === undefined) { c.lx = m.x; c.ly = m.y; }
          if (CR.dist(c.lx, c.ly, m.x, m.y) < 1.1) return;
          c.lx = m.x; c.ly = m.y;
          if (CR.Arena.isWater(m.x, m.y)) return;
          const side = m.side, hitAt = new Map();
          A.area({ kind: 'burrow', side: side, x: m.x, y: m.y, radius: 0.9, left: 5, card: d.card }, function (ar) {
            const now = A.sim.time;
            const list = A.enemiesNear(side, ar.x, ar.y, ar.radius, function (t) { return !t.air && !t.building && !t.tower; });
            for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
              const t = list[i];
              const last = hitAt.get(t.id);
              if (last !== undefined && now - last < 1 - EPS) continue;
              hitAt.set(t.id, now);
              U.damage(A.sim, t, 60, null, 'spell', side);
              if (!t.dead) U.knockback(A.sim, t, ar.x, ar.y, 1);
            }
          });
          A.abilityRL(d, m, 'trail', m.x, m.y, 0.9, 0.4, { dur: 5 });
        } });
      } } });

    mod('skeleton-army', 'common', { name: 'Restless Dead', title: 'Ruhelose Tote', text: 'Beim Ausspielen öffnet sich zusätzlich ein Friedhof.', power: 3, needCards: ['graveyard'],

    mod('skeleton-army', 'epic', { name: 'Undying Hordes', title: 'Untote Horden', text: 'Zur Armee kommt ein endloser Friedhof: Skelette steigen bis Kampfende auf.', power: 5,
      summon: function (A, d, side, card, x, y, tier) {
        const key = 'horde' + side;
        const old = A.st.permanent[key];
        if (old && !old.done) old.done = true;
        const a = A.area({ kind: 'graveyard', side: side, x: x, y: y, radius: 3.5, left: 9999, card: card.id }, function (ar) {
          ar.chxNext = (ar.chxNext === undefined ? 1.5 : ar.chxNext) - A.sim.dt;
          if (ar.chxNext > EPS) return;
          ar.chxNext += 0.5;
          const n = A.liveCount(function (s) { return s.chxFrom === ar.id; });
          if (n >= 20) return;
          for (let tries = 0; tries < 6; tries++) {
            const ang = A.rng() * Math.PI * 2, rr = Math.sqrt(A.rng()) * (ar.radius - 0.5);
            const px = CR.clamp(ar.x + Math.cos(ang) * rr, 0.5, CR.Arena.W - 0.5), py = CR.clamp(ar.y + Math.sin(ang) * rr, 0.5, CR.Arena.H - 0.5);
            if (CR.Arena.isWater(px, py)) continue;
            A.spawn(side, 'skeleton', px, py, { card: card.id, tier: tier, deployTime: 0.5, setup: function (s) { s.chxFrom = ar.id; } });
            break;
          }
        });
        A.st.permanent[key] = a;
        A.ability(d, side, null, 'graveyard', x, y, 3.5, { dur: 9999 });
        return null;
      } });

    mod('royal-hogs', 'rare', { name: 'Hog... Rider?', title: 'Schwein … Reiter?', text: 'Auf jedem Schwein reitet eine Bogenschützin mit; fällt das Schwein, kämpft sie weiter.', power: 4, approx: true, needs: ['archer'],

    mod('royal-hogs', 'epic', { name: 'Hog Dynasty', title: 'Schweine-Dynastie', text: 'Vier Mini-Schweinereiter – fällt einer, wird er zum Königsschwein.', power: 4, approx: true, needs: ['hog-rider'],

    mod('witch', 'epic', { name: 'Skelebrate Good Times', title: 'Skelett-Party', text: 'Beschwört Evo-Skelette, die sich bei jedem Schlag vermehren (bis zu 8).', power: 4, approx: true,
      units: { skeleton: function (A, d, u) { evoSkeleton(A, d, u); } } });
    function evoSkeleton(A, d, u) {
      A.hook(u, d, { attack: function (s) {
        const g = s.chxGroup || s.spawnedBy || 0;
        if (!g) return;
        const n = A.liveCount(function (x) { return x.unit === 'skeleton' && (x.chxGroup === g || x.spawnedBy === g); });
        if (n >= 8) return;
        const c = A.spawn(s.side, 'skeleton', s.x + (A.rng() - 0.5) * 0.8, s.y - A.forward(s.side) * 0.6, { card: s.card, tier: d.tier, deployTime: 0.2,
          setup: function (k) { k.chxGroup = g; evoSkeleton(A, d, k); } });
        if (c) A.abilityRL(d, s, 'spawn', c.x, c.y, 0.6, 0.3);
      } });
    }

    mod('valkyrie', 'common', { name: 'More Momentum', title: 'Schwung', text: 'Jeder Folgetreffer macht sie schneller – bis zu 50 % schnellere Angriffe.', power: 2, approx: true,
      units: { valkyrie: function (A, d, u) {

            c.lastHit = now;

            if (c.stack > 0) A.abilityRL(d, v, 'buff', v.x, v.y, 0.8, 0.6, { stack: c.stack });
          },
          tick: function (v) { const c = v.chx; if (c.stack > 0 && A.sim.time - c.lastHit > base + 1.2) { c.stack = 0; A.hitSpeed(v, base); } },

    mod('bandit', 'rare', { name: 'Dash Chain', title: 'Sprint-Kette', text: 'Besiegt ihr Sprint einen Gegner, sprintet sie sofort zum nächsten.', power: 3,
      units: { bandit: function (A, d, u) {

    mod('bandit', 'epic', { name: 'Copy Dash', title: 'Klon-Sprint', text: 'Bei jedem Sprint jagt für jedes weitere Ziel in Reichweite ein Klon los.', power: 4,

          list.sort(function (p, q) { return CR.dist(b.x, b.y, p.x, p.y) - CR.dist(b.x, b.y, q.x, q.y) || p.id - q.id; });

            A.ability(d, b.side, c, 'dash', t.x, t.y, 0.8, { tx: c.x, ty: c.y });
          }
        } });
        dashFx(A, d, u);
      } } });

      const pulses = Math.round(dur / 0.5);
      pulseArea(A, d, side, 'fireball-burn', x, y, r, dur, 0.5, { damage: total / pulses, ct: totalCt / pulses, air: false, ground: true, kind: 'spell', spell: true });
      A.ability(d, side, null, 'burn', x, y, r, { dur: dur });
    }

    mod('zap', 'common', { name: 'E.M.P', title: 'E.M.P.', text: 'Senkt das Level aller getroffenen Gegner um 3.', power: 3,
      spell: function (A, d, side, card, x, y, tier) {

    mod('zap', 'rare', { name: 'Storm Strike', title: 'Sturmschlag', text: 'Zusätzlich trifft ein Blitz die stärkste Truppe in der Nähe.', power: 4, needCards: ['lightning'],
      spell: function (A, d, side, card, x, y, tier) {
        A.cast(side, card, x, y, tier);
        const L = spell('lightning');
        let best = null;
        A.enemiesNear(side, x, y, 4, function (t) { return !t.tower && !t.building && !t.dead; }).forEach(function (t) { if (!best || t.hp + t.shield > best.hp + best.shield) best = t; });
        if (!best) return;
        U.applyEffect(A.sim, side, best.x, best.y, best, { damage: num(L.damage, 1001), ct: ct0(L), stun: 0.5, kind: 'spell', spell: true }, null);
        A.sim.emit('spell', { side: side, card: 'lightning', kind: 'strike', x: r2(best.x), y: r2(best.y), radius: 0.5, phase: 'impact' });
        A.ability(d, side, null, 'strike', best.x, best.y, 1, { targetId: best.id });
      } });
    mod('zap', 'epic', { name: "Gotta Zap 'Em All", title: 'Zapp sie alle!', text: 'Der Zapp springt als Kettenzapp auf Gegnergruppen in der Nähe über.', power: 4,
      spell: function (A, d, side, card, x, y, tier) {
        A.cast(side, card, x, y, tier);
        const r = num(card.spell && card.spell.radius, 2.5);
        const hit = new Set(A.enemiesNear(side, x, y, r).map(function (t) { return t.id; }));
        (function hop(px, py, left) {
          if (left <= 0) return;
          const t = A.nearestEnemy(side, px, py, 6, function (e) { return !hit.has(e.id); });
          if (!t) return;
          const tx = t.x, ty = t.y;
          A.after(0.2, function () {
            A.enemiesNear(side, tx, ty, r).forEach(function (e) { hit.add(e.id); });
            A.cast(side, card, tx, ty, 0);
            A.ability(d, side, null, 'chain', tx, ty, r, { tx: px, ty: py });
            hop(tx, ty, left - 1);
          });
        })(x, y, 4);
      } });

    mod('tornado', 'epic', { name: 'Superspell', title: 'Superzauber', text: 'Der Tornado wandert 15 s durch die Arena und zappt alle 2 s.', power: 5, needCards: ['zap'],
      spell: function (A, d, side, card, x, y, tier) {
        const sp = card.spell || {};
        const r = A.cast(side, card, x, y, tier, { duration: 15, ticks: Math.round(15 / num(sp.interval, 0.35)) });
        const a = r.areas[0];
        if (!a) return;
        const zap = cardOf('zap');
        let zt = 2;
        A.ability(d, side, null, 'roam', x, y, a.radius, { dur: 15 });
        A.watch(function () {
          if (a.done) return true;
          const t = A.nearestEnemy(side, a.x, a.y, 12, function (e) { return !e.building && !e.tower; });
          let gx, gy, spd;
          if (t) { gx = t.x; gy = t.y; spd = 1.2; } else { const k = A.sim.kingOf(1 - side); gx = k ? k.x : a.x; gy = k ? k.y : a.y; spd = 0.8; }
          const dx = gx - a.x, dy = gy - a.y, dd = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
          if (dd > 0.3) { const st = Math.min(dd, spd * A.sim.dt); a.x = CR.clamp(a.x + dx / dd * st, 1, CR.Arena.W - 1); a.y = CR.clamp(a.y + dy / dd * st, 1, CR.Arena.H - 1); }
          zt -= A.sim.dt;
          if (zt <= EPS && zap) { zt += 2; A.cast(side, zap, a.x, a.y, 0); A.ability(d, side, null, 'zap', a.x, a.y, num(zap.spell && zap.spell.radius, 2.5)); }
          return false;
        });
      } });

    mod('earthquake', 'epic', { name: 'Fault Line', title: 'Verwerfungslinie', text: 'Das Beben wandert bis zum nächsten gegnerischen Turm.', power: 4,
      spell: function (A, d, side, card, x, y, tier) {
        const a = A.cast(side, card, x, y, tier, { duration: 6, ticks: 6 }).areas[0];
        if (!a) return;
        let target = null, bd = Infinity;
        for (let i = 0; i < A.sim.towers.length; i++) { const t = A.sim.towers[i]; if (t.side === side || !t.alive) continue; const dd = CR.dist(x, y, t.x, t.y); if (dd < bd) { bd = dd; target = t; } }
        A.ability(d, side, null, 'quake', x, y, a.radius, { tx: target ? target.x : x, ty: target ? target.y : y, dur: 6 });
        A.watch(function () {
          if (a.done) return true;
          if (!target || !target.alive) return false;
          const dx = target.x - a.x, dy = target.y - a.y, dd = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
          if (dd > 1) { const st = Math.min(dd - 1, 1.8 * A.sim.dt); a.x += dx / dd * st; a.y += dy / dd * st; }
          return false;
        });
      } });

    mod('graveyard', 'epic', { name: "They're Skeverywhere!", title: 'Überall Skelette!', text: 'Zufällige Skelett-Truppen: Skelette, Wachen und Bomber.', power: 4, approx: true, needs: ['guard', 'bomber'],
      spell: function (A, d, side, card, x, y, tier) {
        const a = A.cast(side, card, x, y, tier).areas[0];
        if (!a) return;
        const pool = ['skeleton', 'guard', 'bomber'];
        A.watch(function () {
          if (a.done) return true;
          if (a.spawned !== a.chxN) { a.chxN = a.spawned; a.spawn = Object.assign({}, a.spawn, { unit: pool[A.rng.int(pool.length)] }); }
          return false;
        });
      } });

    function lightningTargets(A, side, x, y, sp) {
      const radius = num(sp.radius, 3.5);
      const cand = [];
      U.forEachEnemy(A.sim, side, function (t) { if (t.tunnel || t.underground || t.immune) return; if (U.edgeDist(x, y, t) > radius + EPS) return; cand.push(t); });
      cand.sort(function (a, b) { return (b.hp + b.shield) - (a.hp + a.shield) || a.id - b.id; });
      return cand;
    }
    function strike(A, d, side, t, dmg, ct) {
      U.applyEffect(A.sim, side, t.x, t.y, t, { damage: dmg, ct: ct, stun: 0.5, radius: 0, kind: 'spell', spell: true }, null);
      A.sim.emit('spell', { side: side, card: 'lightning', kind: 'strike', x: r2(t.x), y: r2(t.y), radius: 0.5, phase: 'impact' });
    }
    mod('lightning', 'common', { name: 'Aftershock', title: 'Nachbeben', text: 'Überlebt ein Ziel, schlägt ein zweiter Blitz mit 50 % Schaden ein.', power: 3,
      spell: function (A, d, side, card, x, y, tier) {
        const sp = card.spell || {};
        const list = lightningTargets(A, side, x, y, sp).slice(0, Math.max(1, Math.round(num(sp.count, 3))));
        A.cast(side, card, x, y, tier);
        A.after(num(sp.interval, 0.15) * list.length + 0.35, function () {
          list.forEach(function (t) {
            if (!alive(t)) return;
            strike(A, d, side, t, num(sp.damage, 1001) * 0.5, ct0(sp) * 0.5);
            A.ability(d, side, null, 'strike', t.x, t.y, 1, { targetId: t.id });
          });
        });
      } });
    mod('lightning', 'rare', { name: 'High Voltage', title: 'Hochspannung', text: 'Hinterlässt 5 s lang ein Stromfeld, das Gegner laufend trifft.', power: 3, approx: true,
      spell: function (A, d, side, card, x, y, tier) {
        const sp = card.spell || {};
        A.cast(side, card, x, y, tier);
        pulseArea(A, d, side, 'storm', x, y, num(sp.radius, 3.5), 5, 0.5, { damage: 60, ct: 18, kind: 'spell', spell: true });
        A.ability(d, side, null, 'storm', x, y, num(sp.radius, 3.5), { dur: 5 });
      } });
    mod('lightning', 'epic', { name: 'Thunderstorm', title: 'Gewittersturm', text: 'Bis zu sechs Blitze – ungenutzte warten 6 s lang auf neue Gegner.', power: 5,
      spell: function (A, d, side, card, x, y, tier) {
        const sp = card.spell || {};
        const radius = num(sp.radius, 3.5);
        A.sim.emit('spell', { side: side, card: card.id, kind: 'lightning', x: x, y: y, radius: radius, phase: 'cast' });
        let left = 6, next = 0;
        const struck = new Set();
        A.area({ kind: 'storm', side: side, x: x, y: y, radius: radius, left: 6, card: card.id }, function (ar) {
          next -= A.sim.dt;
          if (next > EPS) return;
          const list = lightningTargets(A, side, x, y, sp);
          let t = null;
          for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) if (!struck.has(list[i].id) && alive(list[i])) { t = list[i]; break; }
          if (!t) { next = 0.1; return; }
          struck.add(t.id);
          strike(A, d, side, t, num(sp.damage, 1001), ct0(sp));
          A.ability(d, side, null, 'strike', t.x, t.y, 1, { targetId: t.id });
          left--;
          next = num(sp.interval, 0.15);
          if (left <= 0) ar.done = true;
        });
        A.ability(d, side, null, 'storm', x, y, radius, { dur: 6, count: 6 });
      } });

    mod('rocket', 'common', { name: 'Knows No Bounds', title: 'Grenzenlos', text: 'Dreifacher Explosionsradius.', power: 3,

    mod('rocket', 'rare', { name: 'Party On, Goblin!', title: 'Party-Rakete', text: 'Alle Truppen im Radius werden zu Goblins – auch deine eigenen!', power: 4, needs: ['goblin'],
      spell: function (A, d, side, card, x, y, tier) {
        const sp = card.spell || {};
        const R = 3;
        const r = A.cast(side, card, x, y, tier, { radius: R, damage: 0, knockback: 0 });
        r.proj.forEach(function (p) {
          A.onImpact(p, function (pp) {
            const us = A.sim.units.slice();
            for (let i = 0; i < us.length; i++) {
              const u = us[i];
              if (u.dead || u.tunnel || u.tower) continue;
              if (U.edgeDist(pp.x, pp.y, u) > R + EPS) continue;
              if (u.building) { if (u.side !== side) U.damage(A.sim, u, num(sp.damage, 1484), null, 'spell', side); continue; }
              if (u.shield > 0) { u.shield = 0; continue; }
              const ux = u.x, uy = u.y, us2 = u.side;
              A.kill(u, true);
              A.spawn(us2, 'goblin', ux, uy, { card: 'goblins', tier: 0, deployTime: 0.15 });
            }
            A.ability(d, side, null, 'transform', pp.x, pp.y, R);
          });
        });
      } });
    mod('rocket', 'epic', { name: 'Bouncing Bomb', title: 'Hüpfende Bombe', text: 'Die Rakete springt weiter und explodiert noch zweimal.', power: 4,
      spell: function (A, d, side, card, x, y, tier) {
        const k = A.sim.kingOf(side);
        let ux = 0, uy = A.forward(side);
        if (k) { const dx = x - k.x, dy = y - k.y, dd = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy); if (dd > 0.5) { ux = dx / dd; uy = dy / dd; } }
        const r = A.cast(side, card, x, y, tier);
        r.proj.forEach(function (p) {
          A.onImpact(p, function (pp) {
            for (let n = 1; n <= 2; n++) {
              const bx = CR.clamp(pp.x + ux * 3 * n, 0.5, CR.Arena.W - 0.5), by = CR.clamp(pp.y + uy * 3 * n, 0.5, CR.Arena.H - 0.5);
              A.after(0.3 * n, function () {
                A.effect(side, bx, by, CR.Spells.impactEffect(card.spell || {}), null);
                A.sim.emit('spell', { side: side, card: card.id, kind: 'projectile', x: r2(bx), y: r2(by), radius: num(card.spell && card.spell.radius, 2), phase: 'impact', wave: n });
                A.ability(d, side, null, 'bounce', bx, by, num(card.spell && card.spell.radius, 2));
              });
            }
          });
        });
      } });

    mod('royal-delivery', 'epic', { name: 'Random Delivery', title: 'Zufallslieferung', text: 'Statt eines Rekruten wird eine zufällige Truppe geliefert.', power: 2,

    // =============================================================== v12: own designs
    // User request (v12): "each card about three different abilities". Every card of this game
    // that had fewer than three real C.H.A.O.S modifiers gets own designs (flag `own`, numbers are
    // estimates like `approx`), so every playable card offers three DIFFERENT abilities - one per
    // rarity, each a different effect (not just a bigger number). Real modifiers that need a unit or
    // rule this game lacks stay documented in CR.Chaos.REPLACED.
    function own(card, rarity, def) { def.own = true; def.approx = true; return mod(card, rarity, def); }
    function landY(x, y, side) {
      let gy = CR.clamp(y, 0.8, CR.Arena.H - 0.8);
      for (let k = 0; k < 8 && CR.Arena.isWater(x, gy); k++) gy += side === 0 ? -0.5 : 0.5;
      return gy;
    }
    /** Damage over time on one target: `total` damage in `n` pulses every 0.5 s (towers 30 %). */
    function dot(A, d, src, t, total, n, kind) {
      const side = src.side;
      for (let k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
        A.after(0.5 * k, function () {
          if (!alive(t) || t.tunnel || t.underground) return;
          U.damage(A.sim, t, U.ctFor(t, total / n, total / n * 0.3), alive(src) ? src : null, 'splash', side);
        });
      }
      A.abilityRL(d, src, kind || 'burn', t.x, t.y, 0.6, 1, { targetId: t.id, dur: 0.5 * n });
    }
    /** Every `every`-th attack also hits every enemy ground troop around the attacker. */
    function spinEvery(A, d, u, every, radius, mult, kb, kind) {
      A.hook(u, d, { attack: function (w, t, hit) {
        w.chx.spins = (w.chx.spins | 0) + 1;
        if (w.chx.spins % every) return;
        A.effect(w.side, w.x, w.y, { damage: hit.amount * mult, ct: null, radius: radius, knockback: kb || 0, air: false, ground: true, towers: false, kind: 'splash', exclude: new Set([t.id]) }, w);
        A.ability(d, w.side, w, kind || 'spin', w.x, w.y, radius);
      } });
    }
    /** On death: `n` copies of `unitId` with `hpScale` hitpoints (spawn context: they never split again). */
    function splitOnDeath(A, d, u, unitId, n, hpScale) {
      A.hook(u, d, { death: function (g) {
        if (g.clone || g.shadowClone) return;
        const side = g.side, card = g.card, x = g.x, y = g.air ? g.y : landY(g.x, g.y, g.side);
        for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
          const a = (k + 0.5) / n * Math.PI * 2;
          A.spawn(side, unitId, x + Math.cos(a) * 0.5, y + Math.sin(a) * 0.4, { card: card, tier: d.tier, deployTime: 0.3, setup: function (w) { if (hpScale !== 1) A.scaleHp(w, hpScale); } });
        }
        A.ability(d, side, g, 'split', x, y, 1, { count: n });
      } });
    }
    /** Extra straight shots in a fan (multishot) next to the real one. */
    function fan(A, d, u, degs, mult) {
      A.hook(u, d, { attack: function (m, t, hit) {
        const base = Math.atan2(t.y - m.y, t.x - m.x);
        for (let i = 0; i < degs.length; i++) A.bullet(m, base + degs[i] * DEG, hit.amount * (mult || 1), m.s.range + 1.5);
        A.abilityRL(d, m, 'multishot', m.x, m.y, 0.6, 0.8, { tx: t.x, ty: t.y });
      } });
    }
    function lifeSteal(A, d, u, f) {
      A.hook(u, d, { dealt: function (b, t, hit) { if (hit.amount > 0 && U.heal(A.sim, b, hit.amount * f) > 0) A.abilityRL(d, b, 'heal', b.x, b.y, 0.5, 1.2); } });
    }
