      spell: function (A, d, side, card, x, y, tier) {
        const f = A.forward(side);
        A.cast(side, card, x, y, tier);
        for (let k = 1; k <= 2; k++) {
          const py = CR.clamp(y + f * 3 * k, 0.5, CR.Arena.H - 0.5);
          A.after(0.45 * k, function () { A.cast(side, card, x, py, tier); A.ability(d, side, null, 'volley', x, py, num(card.spell && card.spell.radius, 3.5), { tx: x, ty: y }); });
        }
      } });
    own('goblin-barrel', 'epic', { name: 'Furious Goblins', title: 'Wütende Kobolde', text: 'Die Kobolde landen mit 6 s Wut und 50 % mehr Trefferpunkten.', power: 4,
      units: { goblin: function (A, d, u) { A.scaleHp(u, 1.5); U.rage(A.sim, u, 35, num(u.s.deployTime, 1) + 6); A.abilityRL(d, u, 'buff', u.x, u.y, 1, 6); } } });
    own('royal-delivery', 'rare', { name: 'Double Delivery', title: 'Doppellieferung', text: 'Liefert zwei Rekruten statt einem.', power: 3,
      spell: function (A, d, side, card, x, y, tier) {
        const sp = card.spell || {};
        A.cast(side, card, x, y, tier, { spawn: Object.assign({}, sp.spawn || { unit: 'royal-recruit' }, { count: 2, radius: 0.8 }) });
        A.ability(d, side, null, 'double', x, y, num(sp.radius, 3), { delay: num(sp.delay, 2) });
      } });

    // --------------------------------------------------------------- Frost
    own('freeze', 'common', { name: 'Shatter', title: 'Splitterfrost', text: 'Endet der Frost, zersplittert das Eis und trifft alle Gegner im Bereich erneut.', power: 3,
      spell: function (A, d, side, card, x, y, tier) {
        const sp = card.spell || {};
        A.cast(side, card, x, y, tier);
        A.after(num(sp.freeze, 4), function () {
          A.effect(side, x, y, { damage: num(sp.damage, 115) * 1.5, ct: ct0(sp) * 1.5, radius: num(sp.radius, 3), kind: 'spell', spell: true }, null);
          A.ability(d, side, null, 'break', x, y, num(sp.radius, 3));
        });
      } });
    own('freeze', 'rare', { name: 'Permafrost', title: 'Permafrost', text: 'Danach bleibt 4 s lang Eisboden, der Gegner um 50 % verlangsamt.', power: 3,
      spell: function (A, d, side, card, x, y, tier) {
        const sp = card.spell || {}, r = num(sp.radius, 3);
        A.cast(side, card, x, y, tier);
        A.after(Math.max(0.5, num(sp.freeze, 4) - 0.5), function () {
          A.ability(d, side, null, 'snowstorm', x, y, r, { dur: 4 });
          pulseArea(A, d, side, 'snowstorm', x, y, r, 4, 0.5, { damage: 0, slow: { pct: 50, dur: 0.7 }, kind: 'spell', spell: true });
        });
      } });
    own('freeze', 'epic', { name: 'Frost Chain', title: 'Frostkette', text: 'Der Frost springt auf bis zu drei Gegnergruppen in der Nähe über (je 2 s).', power: 4,
      spell: function (A, d, side, card, x, y, tier) {
        const sp = card.spell || {}, r = num(sp.radius, 3);
        A.cast(side, card, x, y, tier);
        const hit = new Set(A.enemiesNear(side, x, y, r).map(function (t) { return t.id; }));
        (function hop(px, py, left) {
          if (left <= 0) return;
          const t = A.nearestEnemy(side, px, py, 7, function (e) { return !hit.has(e.id); });
          if (!t) return;
          const tx = t.x, ty = t.y;
          A.after(0.25, function () {
            A.enemiesNear(side, tx, ty, 1.8).forEach(function (e) { hit.add(e.id); });
            A.effect(side, tx, ty, { damage: num(sp.damage, 115) * 0.5, ct: ct0(sp) * 0.5, radius: 1.8, freeze: 2, kind: 'spell', spell: true }, null);
            A.ability(d, side, null, 'freeze', tx, ty, 1.8, { tx: px, ty: py, dur: 2 });
            hop(tx, ty, left - 1);
          });
        })(x, y, 3);
      } });

    // --------------------------------------------------------------- Klonen
    function cloneCast(A, side, card, x, y, patch) {
      const before = new Set();
      A.sim.units.forEach(function (w) { before.add(w.id); });
      A.cast(side, card, x, y, 0, patch);   // tier 0: clones keep the tier of their original
      return A.sim.units.filter(function (w) { return w.clone && !w.dead && !before.has(w.id); });
    }
    own('clone', 'common', { name: 'Sturdy Clones', title: 'Zähe Klone', text: 'Klone haben 25 % der Trefferpunkte statt nur 1.', power: 3,
      spell: function (A, d, side, card, x, y, tier) {
        const cl = cloneCast(A, side, card, x, y);
        cl.forEach(function (w) { const hp = Math.max(1, w.s.hp * 0.25); w.hp = w.maxHp = hp; });
        if (cl.length) A.ability(d, side, null, 'clone', x, y, num(card.spell && card.spell.radius, 3), { count: cl.length });
      } });
    own('clone', 'rare', { name: 'Raging Clones', title: 'Wütende Klone', text: 'Klone und Originale bekommen 6 s Wut (+35 % Tempo).', power: 3,
      spell: function (A, d, side, card, x, y, tier) {
        const r = num(card.spell && card.spell.radius, 3);
        const orig = A.sim.units.filter(function (w) { return w.side === side && !w.dead && !w.building && !w.tower && U.edgeDist(x, y, w) <= r + EPS; });
        const cl = cloneCast(A, side, card, x, y);
        orig.concat(cl).forEach(function (w) { U.rage(A.sim, w, 35, 6); });
        A.ability(d, side, null, 'buff', x, y, r, { dur: 6 });
      } });
    own('clone', 'epic', { name: 'Double Clone', title: 'Doppelklon', text: 'Klont zweimal hintereinander – auch die neuen Klone werden geklont.', power: 4,
      spell: function (A, d, side, card, x, y, tier) {
        cloneCast(A, side, card, x, y);
        cloneCast(A, side, card, x, y, { offset: -num(card.spell && card.spell.offset, 0.6) });
        A.ability(d, side, null, 'double', x, y, num(card.spell && card.spell.radius, 3));
      } });
  })();
})(globalThis.CR || (globalThis.CR = {}));

</script>
<script>
/* src/07-ai.js */
/* Chaos Royale - 07-ai.js (ai)
 * Bot opponent. Plays exactly like a player: it only reads sim.view() and issues
 * sim.command(player, ...) – no access to hidden state, same elixir and deploy rules.
 *
 * All reasoning happens in the bot's own frame ("my side is the bottom half"):
 * positions of side 1 are rotated 180° with CR.Arena.mirror before and after.
 *
 *   const bot = new CR.AI({ player, side, level: 'leicht' | 'normal' | 'schwer', seed });
 *   bot.update(sim);   // once per tick
 *
 * v5: `player` = player index (any of the 4 in 2v2, teammates included), `side` = team (read from
 * the sim when only `player` is given; `side` alone = player in 1v1, legacy). In 2v2 the two bots
 * of a team share the lanes a little: each has a home lane (left for the side's first player,
 * right for the second), reacts later to threats in the mate's lane (the mate answers first),
 * and joins a push the mate has started instead of opening a second one. 1v1 behaviour (and its
 * random stream) is unchanged.
 *
 * v6 Touchdown (view.mode === 'touchdown', docs/TOUCHDOWN.md): no towers; the bot defends its end
 * zone (y 0..4 in its frame) and pushes into the enemy's (y 28..32). thinkTouchdown(): pause while
 * the field resets; stop the most dangerous enemy troop (closest to the own goal line) with a
 * spell that kills it, a building in its path, or a counter troop placed between it and the end
 * zone (air-capable against air); punish clumps; else push with fast runners / tanks at the
 * front of the deploy zone (quarter line y < 10) in the emptier lane, support behind a tank.
 *
 * v12 tunnel map (view.map === 'tunnel', docs/V12-TUNNEL.md): enemies in the tunnel (view unit
 * .tunnel) are never spell targets and count as threats at the own hole where they will come up;
 * tryPush sends a tunnel-capable troop (CR.Arena.tunnelEligible) behind the own hole now and then
 * (35 % of the pushes, fastest first; this.tunnelPlays counts them).
 *
 * v7 champions (docs/V7-CARDS.md): tryChampion() runs first on every think in both modes. When
 * view.players[me].champion is ready and affordable, the bot predicts the slash wave (towards the
 * champion's target, else straight ahead; ability data from CR.Sim.championAbility) and fires
 * {type:'champion_ability'} when the line holds enough value (sum of min(hp, damage) of enemy troops
 * and buildings + the reduced crown tower damage) or at least 3 enemies; the threshold falls with
 * the level and when the champion is about to die. The new cards are played by the generic logic
 * (Cyborg-Jäger / Wirbel-Ninja hit air -> anti-air defenders, the champion is a push tank).
 */
(function (CR) {
  'use strict';

  const LEVELS = {
    leicht: { think: 1.4, react: 1.6, pushAt: 10, spellMin: 4, mistakes: 0.35, abilityValue: 800 },
    normal: { think: 0.6, react: 0.8, pushAt: 8.5, spellMin: 3, mistakes: 0.12, abilityValue: 600 },
    schwer: { think: 0.3, react: 0.35, pushAt: 7, spellMin: 3, mistakes: 0, abilityValue: 450 },
  };

  function cardOf(id) {
    const cards = (CR.DATA && CR.DATA.cards) || [];
    for (let i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) if (cards[i].id === id) return cards[i];
    return null;
  }

  function unitOf(card) {
    if (!card || !card.summon || !card.summon.length) return null;
    const u = CR.DATA.units && CR.DATA.units[card.summon[0].unit];
    return u || null;
  }

  /** Rough "how much this card can take" value used to pick tanks for pushes. */
  function cardHp(card) {
    const u = unitOf(card);
    if (!u) return 0;
    const n = card.summon.reduce(function (a, s) { return a + (s.count || 1); }, 0);
    return (u.hp || 0) * n + (u.shield || 0) * n;
  }

  class AI {
    constructor(opts) {
      opts = opts || {};
      const hasPlayer = typeof opts.player === 'number' && opts.player >= 0;
      this.player = hasPlayer ? opts.player : (opts.side === 0 ? 0 : 1);
      // Team side: given, else read from the sim on the first update (1v1: == player).
      this.side = opts.side === 0 || opts.side === 1 ? opts.side : (hasPlayer ? null : this.player);
      this.levelName = LEVELS[opts.level] ? opts.level : 'normal';
      this.cfg = LEVELS[this.levelName];
      this.rng = CR.rng(opts.seed === undefined ? 7331 : opts.seed);
      this.t = 0;
      this.nextThink = 1.5; // a short opening pause, like a human looking at the hand
      this.threatSince = -1;
      this.pushLane = this.rng() < 0.5 ? 0 : 1;
    }

    /** Convert between sim coordinates and the bot's own frame (own half at the bottom). */
    toMine(x, y) { return this.side === 0 ? { x: x, y: y } : CR.Arena.mirror(x, y); }
    toSim(x, y) { return this.side === 0 ? { x: x, y: y } : CR.Arena.mirror(x, y); }

    update(sim) {
      if (!sim || sim.over) return;
      if (this.side === null) {
        const p = sim.players && sim.players[this.player];
        this.side = p && (p.side === 0 || p.side === 1) ? p.side : (this.player & 1);
      }
      this.t += CR.DT;
      if (this.t + 1e-9 < this.nextThink) return;
      this.nextThink = this.t + this.cfg.think * (0.75 + this.rng() * 0.5);
      try { this.think(sim); } catch (e) { /* a bot error must never stop the match */ }
    }

    think(sim) {
      const view = sim.view();
      const me = view.players[this.player];
      if (!me || !me.hand) return;
      this.teamInfo(view);
      if (this.tryChampion(sim, view, me)) return;
      if (view.mode === 'touchdown') { this.thinkTouchdown(sim, view, me); return; }
      const enemySide = 1 - this.side;
      const enemies = [];
      const hole = view.map === 'tunnel' ? this.ownHoleMine() : null;
      for (const u of view.units) {
        if (u.side !== enemySide) continue;
        let p = this.toMine(u.x, u.y);
        // v12 tunnel: an enemy in the tunnel cannot be hit; it comes up at the own hole.
        if (u.tunnel) { if (!hole) continue; p = { x: hole.x, y: hole.y + hole.r + 0.6 }; }
        enemies.push({ u: u, x: p.x, y: p.y, under: !!u.tunnel });
      }
      const threats = enemies.filter(function (e) { return e.y < 19; });

      // 1) Defend: something is coming at us (after a human-like reaction delay). In 2v2 a
      //    threat only in the mate's lane gets extra reaction time (the mate answers first).
      if (threats.length) {
        if (this.threatSince < 0) this.threatSince = this.t;
        let react = this.cfg.react;
        if (this.mate >= 0 && me.elixir < 8 - 1e-6) {
          const home = this.homeLane;
          if (!threats.some(function (e) { return (e.x < 9 ? 0 : 1) === home; })) react += 0.9;
        }
        if (this.t - this.threatSince >= react) {
          if (this.trySpellOnCluster(sim, me, threats, true)) return;
          if (this.tryDefend(sim, me, threats)) return;
        }
      } else {
        this.threatSince = -1;
      }

      // 2) Punish clumps anywhere with a damaging spell.
      if (enemies.length >= this.cfg.spellMin && me.elixir >= 6 && this.trySpellOnCluster(sim, me, enemies, false)) return;

      // 3) Finish a low enemy tower with a spell.
      if (this.tryFinishTower(sim, me, view)) return;

      // 4) Push when elixir is high (and never leak at 10).
      if (me.elixir >= this.cfg.pushAt - 1e-6) this.tryPush(sim, me, view);
    }

    play(sim, handIndex, mx, my) {
      if (this.cfg.mistakes && this.rng() < this.cfg.mistakes * 0.3) {
        mx += (this.rng() - 0.5) * 3; my += (this.rng() - 0.5) * 2;
      }
      const tries = [[0, 0], [0, -1], [0, 1], [-1, 0], [1, 0], [0, -2], [0, -3], [-2, -1], [2, -1]];
      for (const d of tries) {
        const p = this.toSim(mx + d[0], my + d[1]);
        const can = sim.canPlay(this.player, handIndex, p.x, p.y);
        if (can && can.ok) {
          const r = sim.command(this.player, { type: 'play', hand: handIndex, x: p.x, y: p.y, card: sim.players[this.player].hand[handIndex] });
          return !!(r && r.ok);
        }
        if (can && can.reason === 'not_enough_elixir') return false;
      }
      return false;
    }

    /** 2v2: teammate index (-1 in 1v1) and this bot's home lane (own frame). */
    teamInfo(view) {
      this.mate = -1;
      this.homeLane = -1;
      if (!(view.teamSize > 1) || !view.players) return;
      const mine = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < view.players.length; i++) if (view.players[i] && view.players[i].side === this.side) mine.push(i);
      const k = mine.indexOf(this.player);
      this.homeLane = k === 1 ? 1 : 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < mine.length; i++) if (mine[i] !== this.player) this.mate = mine[i];
    }

    /** 2v2: lane (own frame) the mate is pushing in right now, or -1. */
    mateLane(view) {
      if (this.mate < 0) return -1;
      const n = [0, 0];
      for (const u of view.units) {
        if (u.side !== this.side || u.owner !== this.mate || u.building) continue;
        const p = this.toMine(u.x, u.y);
        if (p.y >= 9) n[p.x < 9 ? 0 : 1]++;
      }
      if (!n[0] && !n[1]) return -1;
      return n[1] > n[0] ? 1 : 0;
    }

    affordable(me) {
      const out = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < me.hand.length; i++) {
        const c = cardOf(me.hand[i]);
        if (c && !c.disabled && (c.elixir || 0) <= me.elixir + 1e-6) out.push({ i: i, c: c });
      }
      return out;
    }

    trySpellOnCluster(sim, me, list, defensive) {
      list = list.filter(function (e) { return !e.under; });   // v12: spells never reach the tunnel
      const spells = this.affordable(me).filter(function (h) {
        return h.c.type === 'spell' && h.c.spell && (h.c.spell.damage || 0) > 0 && (h.c.spell.radius || 0) > 0;
      });
      if (!spells.length) return false;
      let best = null;
      for (const h of spells) {
        const r = h.c.spell.radius;
        for (const a of list) {
          let n = 0, value = 0;
          for (const b of list) {
            if ((b.x - a.x) * (b.x - a.x) + (b.y - a.y) * (b.y - a.y) <= r * r) {
              n++;
              value += Math.min(b.u.hp, h.c.spell.damage);
            }
          }
          const need = defensive ? 3 : this.cfg.spellMin;
          if (n >= need && value >= h.c.elixir * 120 && (!best || value / h.c.elixir > best.score)) {
            best = { h: h, x: a.x, y: a.y, score: value / h.c.elixir };
          }
        }
      }
      if (!best) return false;
      return this.play(sim, best.h.i, best.x, best.y);
    }

    tryDefend(sim, me, threats) {
      threats.sort(function (a, b) { return a.y - b.y; });
      const th = threats[0];
      const lane = th.x < 9 ? 0 : 1;
      const air = threats.some(function (e) { return e.u.air; });
      const options = this.affordable(me).filter(function (h) { return h.c.type !== 'spell'; });
      if (!options.length) return false;
      // Prefer units that can hit what is coming (air!), then cheaper ones.
      options.sort(function (a, b) {
        const ua = unitOf(a.c), ub = unitOf(b.c);
        const ha = ua && ua.targets && ua.targets.indexOf('air') >= 0 ? 0 : 1;
        const hb = ub && ub.targets && ub.targets.indexOf('air') >= 0 ? 0 : 1;
        if (air && ha !== hb) return ha - hb;
        return (a.c.elixir || 0) - (b.c.elixir || 0);
      });
      const pick = options[0];
      const u = unitOf(pick.c);
      // (v12 tunnel map: buildings keep their distance to the hole at (9, 8))
      if (pick.c.type === 'building') return this.play(sim, pick.i, 9, sim.map === 'tunnel' ? 12 : 9);
      if (u && u.buildingsOnly) return false; // never defend with a building-only unit
      const x = lane === 0 ? Math.max(2, Math.min(8, th.x + 1)) : Math.min(16, Math.max(10, th.x - 1));
      const y = Math.max(5, Math.min(11, th.y - 4));
      return this.play(sim, pick.i, x, y);
    }

    tryFinishTower(sim, me, view) {
      const spells = this.affordable(me).filter(function (h) { return h.c.type === 'spell' && h.c.spell && (h.c.spell.damage || 0) > 0; });
      if (!spells.length) return false;
      for (const t of view.towers) {
        if (t.side === this.side || !t.alive) continue;
        for (const h of spells) {
          const ct = h.c.spell.crownTowerDamage || Math.round(h.c.spell.damage * 0.3);
          if (t.hp <= ct) {
            const p = this.toMine(t.x, t.y);
            return this.play(sim, h.i, p.x, p.y);
          }
        }
      }
      return false;
    }

    tryPush(sim, me, view) {
      const troops = this.affordable(me).filter(function (h) { return h.c.type === 'troop'; });
      if (!troops.length) return false;
      // Attack the lane whose enemy princess tower is weaker (or already down).
      let weak = this.pushLane, low = Infinity;
      for (const t of view.towers) {
        if (t.side === this.side || t.kind !== 'princess') continue;
        const p = this.toMine(t.x, t.y);
        const lane = p.x < 9 ? 0 : 1;
        const hp = t.alive ? t.hp : -1;
        if (hp < low) { low = hp; weak = lane; }
      }
      if (this.mate >= 0) {
        // 2v2: join the mate's push, else open in the home lane unless a tower already fell.
        const ml = this.mateLane(view);
        if (ml >= 0) weak = ml;
        else if (low >= 0) weak = this.homeLane;
      }
      this.pushLane = weak;
      // v12 tunnel map: now and then send a small / medium troop through the tunnel.
      if (view.map === 'tunnel' && this.rng() < 0.35 && this.tryTunnel(sim, troops)) return true;
      troops.sort(function (a, b) { return cardHp(b.c) - cardHp(a.c); });
      const tank = troops[0];
      const bx = weak === 0 ? 3.5 : 14.5;
      const u = unitOf(tank.c);
      // Heavy tanks start in the back to build a push, fast building-hunters go to the bridge.
      if (u && u.buildingsOnly && (u.speed || 1) >= 1.5) return this.play(sim, tank.i, bx, 13.5);
      if (cardHp(tank.c) >= 2500) return this.play(sim, tank.i, weak === 0 ? 6 : 12, 1.5);
      return this.play(sim, tank.i, bx, 12.5);
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Tunnel map (v12)
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  /** The own hole in the bot's frame ({x, y, r}; the hole on the lower half), null without a tunnel. */
  AI.prototype.ownHoleMine = function () {
    const T = CR.Arena.TUNNEL;
    if (!T) return null;
    for (const h of T.holes) if (h.y < CR.Arena.H / 2) return h;
    return null;
  };
  /**
   * Put the fastest tunnel-capable troop (CR.Arena.tunnelEligible) right behind the own hole: it
   * walks in, through the tunnel and comes up between the enemy towers.
   */
  AI.prototype.tryTunnel = function (sim, troops) {
    const h = this.ownHoleMine();
    if (!h || !CR.Arena.tunnelEligible) return false;
    const ok = troops.filter(function (t) { const u = unitOf(t.c); return u && CR.Arena.tunnelEligible(u); });
    if (!ok.length) return false;
    ok.sort(function (a, b) { return speedOf(b.c) - speedOf(a.c) || cardHp(b.c) - cardHp(a.c); });
    const side = this.rng() < 0.5 ? -0.5 : 0.5;
    if (this.play(sim, ok[0].i, h.x + side, h.y - h.r - 1.6)) { this.tunnelPlays = (this.tunnelPlays || 0) + 1; return true; }
    return false;
  };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Touchdown (v6)
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const TD_QUARTER = 9.5;   // front row of the touchdown deploy zone (own frame, tile centre)

  function speedOf(card) { const u = unitOf(card); return u ? (u.speed || 0) : 0; }
  function targetsAir(card) { const u = unitOf(card); return !!(u && u.targets && (u.targets === 'both' || u.targets === 'all' || String(u.targets).indexOf('air') >= 0)); }

  AI.prototype.thinkTouchdown = function (sim, view, me) {
    const td = view.touchdown || {};
    if (td.resetIn > 1e-6) { this.threatSince = -1; return; }
    const enemySide = 1 - this.side;
    const enemies = [], mine = [];
    for (const u of view.units) {
      const p = this.toMine(u.x, u.y);
      if (u.side === enemySide) enemies.push({ u: u, x: p.x, y: p.y });
      else if (!u.building) mine.push({ u: u, x: p.x, y: p.y });
    }
    // Threat = enemy troop in the own half; the closer to the goal line (y 4), the worse.
    const threats = enemies.filter(function (e) { return !e.u.building && e.y < 17; });
    threats.sort(function (a, b) { return a.y - b.y; });
    if (threats.length) {
      if (this.threatSince < 0) this.threatSince = this.t;
      let react = this.cfg.react;
      if (threats[0].y < 9) react *= 0.4;   // about to score: answer at once
      if (this.mate >= 0 && me.elixir < 8 - 1e-6 && threats[0].y > 9) {
        const home = this.homeLane;
        if (!threats.some(function (e) { return (e.x < 9 ? 0 : 1) === home; })) react += 0.7;
      }
      if (this.t - this.threatSince >= react) {
        if (this.tdSpellKill(sim, me, threats)) return;
        if (this.trySpellOnCluster(sim, me, threats, true)) return;
        if (this.tdDefend(sim, me, threats)) return;
      }
    } else this.threatSince = -1;
    if (enemies.length >= this.cfg.spellMin && me.elixir >= 6 && this.trySpellOnCluster(sim, me, enemies, false)) return;
    // Support an own push that is already under way.
    const pushing = mine.filter(function (m) { return m.y >= 10; });
    if (pushing.length && me.elixir >= 6 - 1e-6 && this.tdSupport(sim, me, pushing, view)) return;
    if (me.elixir >= this.cfg.pushAt - 1e-6 || (me.elixir >= 9.5 - 1e-6)) this.tdPush(sim, me, view, enemies);
  };

  /** Kill the leading threat with a damaging spell when it would die (or is about to score). */
  AI.prototype.tdSpellKill = function (sim, me, threats) {
    const spells = this.affordable(me).filter(function (h) { return h.c.type === 'spell' && h.c.spell && (h.c.spell.damage || 0) > 0; });
    if (!spells.length) return false;
    for (const th of threats) {
      if (th.y > 11) break;
      let best = null;
      for (const h of spells) {
        const dmg = h.c.spell.damage;
        if (th.u.hp + (th.u.shield || 0) > dmg) continue;
        if (!best || h.c.elixir < best.c.elixir) best = h;
      }
      if (best) {
        // Lead the target a little (it walks toward the own end zone).
        const lead = th.u.air ? 0.6 : 0.9;
        return this.play(sim, best.i, th.x, Math.max(0.5, th.y - lead));
      }
    }
    return false;
  };

  /** Stop the leading threat: building in its path vs building-hunters, else a counter troop in front of it. */
  AI.prototype.tdDefend = function (sim, me, threats) {
    const th = threats[0];
    const air = th.u.air || threats.some(function (e) { return e.u.air && e.y < th.y + 4; });
    const options = this.affordable(me).filter(function (h) { return h.c.type !== 'spell'; });
    if (!options.length) return false;
    const thCard = cardOf(th.u.card);
    const thUnit = thCard ? unitOf(thCard) : null;
    const hunter = !!(thUnit && thUnit.buildingsOnly);
    options.sort(function (a, b) {
      const sa = (air && !targetsAir(a.c) ? 10 : 0) + (a.c.type === 'building' ? (hunter ? -3 : 2) : 0) + (a.c.elixir || 0) * 0.5;
      const sb = (air && !targetsAir(b.c) ? 10 : 0) + (b.c.type === 'building' ? (hunter ? -3 : 2) : 0) + (b.c.elixir || 0) * 0.5;
      return sa - sb;
    });
    let pick = options[0];
    const u = unitOf(pick.c);
    if (air && !targetsAir(pick.c) && pick.c.type !== 'building') return false;
    if (u && u.buildingsOnly) {
      // A building-hunter cannot defend: use it to counter-attack in the other lane instead.
      const lane = th.x < 9 ? 1 : 0;
      return this.play(sim, pick.i, lane === 0 ? 3.5 : 14.5, TD_QUARTER);
    }
    const x = Math.max(1.5, Math.min(16.5, th.x));
    if (pick.c.type === 'building') {
      const y = Math.max(1.5, Math.min(8, th.y - 4));
      return this.play(sim, pick.i, x, y);
    }
    // Melee counters right in front of the threat, ranged ones a bit further back.
    const ranged = u && (u.range || 0) >= 3;
    const y = Math.max(0.5, Math.min(TD_QUARTER, th.y - (ranged ? 4.5 : 2)));
    return this.play(sim, pick.i, x, y);
  };

  /** Back an own push: a support troop behind the front troop. */
  AI.prototype.tdSupport = function (sim, me, pushing, view) {
    const troops = this.affordable(me).filter(function (h) { return h.c.type === 'troop'; });
    if (!troops.length) return false;
    pushing.sort(function (a, b) { return b.u.hp - a.u.hp; });
    const lead = pushing[0];
    if (lead.y > 22) return false;   // too far ahead to catch up
    troops.sort(function (a, b) { return cardHp(a.c) - cardHp(b.c); });
    const pick = troops[0];
    return this.play(sim, pick.i, Math.max(1.5, Math.min(16.5, lead.x)), TD_QUARTER);
  };

  /** Start a push in the lane with fewer enemies: fast runners straight to the end zone, tanks first. */
  AI.prototype.tdPush = function (sim, me, view, enemies) {
    const troops = this.affordable(me).filter(function (h) { return h.c.type === 'troop'; });
    if (!troops.length) return false;
    const n = [0, 0];
    for (const e of enemies) n[e.x < 9 ? 0 : 1] += 1;
    let lane = n[0] === n[1] ? this.pushLane : (n[0] < n[1] ? 0 : 1);
    if (this.mate >= 0) { const ml = this.mateLane(view); if (ml >= 0) lane = ml; else if (n[0] === n[1]) lane = this.homeLane; }
    this.pushLane = lane;
    const r = this.rng();
    troops.sort(function (a, b) {
      // Value: survivability per elixir plus speed (a runner that reaches the end zone scores).
      const va = cardHp(a.c) / Math.max(1, a.c.elixir) / 300 + speedOf(a.c) * 1.5;
      const vb = cardHp(b.c) / Math.max(1, b.c.elixir) / 300 + speedOf(b.c) * 1.5;
      return vb - va;
    });
    // v12 tunnel map: sometimes straight through the tunnel (comes up 4 rows before the end zone).
    if (view.map === 'tunnel' && this.rng() < 0.25 && this.tryTunnel(sim, troops)) return true;
    const pick = troops[r < 0.75 ? 0 : Math.min(troops.length - 1, 1)];
    const x = lane === 0 ? 2.5 + this.rng() * 3 : 12.5 + this.rng() * 3;
    // Slow tanks start a little further back so support can join; everything else at the line.
    const y = cardHp(pick.c) >= 2500 && speedOf(pick.c) < 1 ? 6.5 : TD_QUARTER;
    return this.play(sim, pick.i, x, y);
  };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Champion ability (v7)
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  /**
   * Value of the champion's slash wave right now (sim coordinates): enemy troops / buildings in the
   * corridor count min(hp + shield, damage), crown towers the reduced damage. Returns {value, n}.
   */
  AI.prototype.championLine = function (view, cu, ab) {
    let tx = null, ty = null;
    if (cu.targetId) {
      for (const u of view.units) if (u.id === cu.targetId) { tx = u.x; ty = u.y; break; }
      if (tx === null) for (const t of view.towers) if (t.id === cu.targetId && t.alive) { tx = t.x; ty = t.y; break; }
    }
    let dx = 0, dy = cu.side === 0 ? 1 : -1;
    if (tx !== null) {
      const d = Math.sqrt((tx - cu.x) * (tx - cu.x) + (ty - cu.y) * (ty - cu.y));
      if (d > 1e-6) { dx = (tx - cu.x) / d; dy = (ty - cu.y) / d; }
    }
    const half = ab.halfWidth || 1, range = ab.range || 16, dmg = ab.damage || 400;
    const ct = typeof ab.ct === 'number' ? ab.ct : dmg * 0.3;
    let value = 0, n = 0;
    const inLine = function (x, y, r) {
      const rx = x - cu.x, ry = y - cu.y;
      const along = rx * dx + ry * dy;
      if (along < -r - 0.3 || along > range + r) return false;
      return Math.abs(-rx * dy + ry * dx) <= half + r;
    };
    for (const u of view.units) {
      if (u.side === cu.side || (u.fx & 32) || u.tunnel) continue;
      if (!inLine(u.x, u.y, u.radius || 0.5)) continue;
      value += Math.min((u.hp || 0) + (u.shield || 0), dmg);
      n++;
    }
    for (const t of view.towers) {
      if (t.side === cu.side || !t.alive) continue;
      if (!inLine(t.x, t.y, (t.size || 3) / 2)) continue;
      value += Math.min(t.hp, ct) * (t.hp <= ct ? 4 : 1);
      n++;
    }
    return { value: value, n: n };
  };

  /** Fire the champion ability when the wave would pay off. */
  AI.prototype.tryChampion = function (sim, view, me) {
    const ch = me.champion;
    if (!ch || !ch.ready || !(ch.canUse === undefined ? me.elixir + 1e-6 >= ch.cost : ch.canUse)) return false;
    let cu = null;
    for (const u of view.units) if (u.id === ch.unitId) { cu = u; break; }
    if (!cu || cu.state === 'deploying') return false;
    const ab = (CR.Sim.championAbility && CR.Sim.championAbility(ch.card)) || {};
    const line = this.championLine(view, cu, ab);
    if (!line.n) return false;
    let need = this.cfg.abilityValue || 600;
    if (cu.maxHp > 0 && cu.hp < cu.maxHp * 0.3) need *= 0.5;   // use it before the champion falls
    if (line.value < need && line.n < 3) return false;
    const r = sim.command(this.player, { type: 'champion_ability' });
    return !!(r && r.ok);
  };

  AI.LEVELS = LEVELS;
  CR.AI = AI;
})(globalThis.CR || (globalThis.CR = {}));

</script>
<script>
/* src/08-net.js */
/* Bust War - 08-net.js (net)
 *
 * Host-authoritative online play for 2 (1v1) or 4 (2v2) phones. Only the host runs CR.Sim; the
 * guests send commands and render snapshots. Star topology: every guest talks to the host only
 * (same code, same transports); the host keeps one record, one seat and one send lane per guest.
 * Every transport carries the same model: each peer publishes a latest-wins JSON blob (<=
 * CR.Net.BLOB_MAX bytes serialized; the host one per guest) and reads the newest blob of the
 * other side.
 *
 * Transports (one small channel interface, see "Channel interface" below):
 *   RoomTransport      claude.ai Artifact: claude.use('room') -> join('cr-<code>'); the blob is
 *                      published as presence({cr: [chunks of <= 1000 chars]}) at <= 20/s, the
 *                      other side is read from onPeers()/peers() (viewers that are not this tab).
 *                      Follows room.d.ts: merged presence <= 4 KiB (checked before publishing;
 *                      an oversized blob makes the session shrink its budget), a named room that
 *                      ends (upstream_error / limit_reached) is joined again with backoff,
 *                      not_permitted and the page-terminal codes fail the channel.
 *                      The Artifact must declare the capability: capabilities: { room: {} }.
 *                      Presence is one value per peer: the host's per-guest blobs take turns
 *                      (one lane queue, each lane latest-wins).
 *   PeerTransport      PeerJS 1.5 (WebRTC data channel, reliable, 'raw' strings). Host peer id
 *                      'chaosroyale-<CODE>', guest 'chaosroyale-<CODE>-<random>'. ICE: STUN
 *                      (Google, Cloudflare) + optional TURN from CR.Net.config.turn / turnUrl /
 *                      window.CR_NET_CONFIG (the old public TURN servers are dead, see CFG).
 *                      Timeouts, retries, new peer ids, ICE watch, network-change nudges: see
 *                      the class comment. Snapshots are skipped while the data channel is backed
 *                      up (latest wins). PeerJS is loaded again on demand (jsdelivr, then cdnjs).
 *   LoopbackTransport  in-memory hub (tests; latency/jitter/loss/duplication/outage simulation)
 *                      and BroadcastChannel (two tabs on one machine).
 * CR.Net.pickTransport() -> Promise<'room'|'peer'|'broadcast'|'none'>. A normal web page (the
 * standalone GitHub Pages build) always plays over PeerJS / WebRTC; the claude room is only
 * considered inside claude.ai (Artifact frame with window.claude, see roomEligible) or when the
 * allow-list names it: then room if claude.use('room') resolves within 2.5 s, else PeerJS, else
 * BroadcastChannel. Inside the claude.ai frame WebRTC is blocked: the PeerJS channel fails with a
 * German hint to open the public link (config.publicUrl) instead of PeerJS' raw error.
 * Sessions open the picked transport first. A host on the room also listens on PeerJS, and a
 * guest that finds no host in the room within 2.5 s (or whose room channel fails) also dials
 * PeerJS; BroadcastChannel is always added for local tabs (it never makes a host 'waiting' while
 * its network channel is still connecting).
 * config.allow (or the page parameter ?crnet=peer,room) restricts the kinds (tests/e2e-net.html).
 * Status: onStatus({state, transport, message, code}); message is German for every step
 * ('Verbinde mit dem Server …', 'Verbinde mit dem Gastgeber …', 'Server nicht erreichbar – neuer
 * Versuch …', 'Direktverbindung wird aufgebaut – neuer Versuch …', errors) and never a raw code.
 * The session binds to the counterpart by its instance id, reads the newest blob (revision n)
 * from any channel and sends its snapshots on the channel where the counterpart was heard most
 * recently. onStatus(s).transport names the channel in use; transportLabel(kind) is German.
 *
 * V5 API (2v2, ARCHITECTURE/V5.md "Network contract"):
 *   host  hs = await hostGame({ code, name, deck, mode, teamSize: 1|2, map: 'classic'|'hill'|'tunnel', onStatus })
 *         hs.lobby -> { phase, mode, map, teamSize, slots: [{ slot, name, team: 0 Blau|1 Rot,
 *                       kind: 'host'|'guest'|'bot'|'empty', ready, online, rematch, req }],
 *                       canStart: { ok, reason: 'missing'|'offline'|'teams'|'ready'|'phase', message (German) } }
 *         hs.onLobby = lobby => {}            every change (replayed on assignment)
 *         hs.setTeamSize(1|2) -> bool, hs.setMap(id), hs.setMode(m), hs.setTeam(slot, team) -> bool
 *         hs.swapTeams(slotA, slotB) -> bool (drag & drop), hs.declineTeam(slot) (slot.req: a
 *         guest's open team wish the host has to decide, -1 = none)
 *         hs.addBot({ team?, name?, level?, deck? }) -> slot | -1, hs.removeBot(slot) -> bool
 *         hs.canStart(), hs.lobbyPlayers() -> [{ slot, name, side, kind, bot, deck, level }]
 *         hs.startBattle({ seed, mode, speed, map, players: [{ name, side, deck, bot, slot? }] })
 *           (player index = array index, the same array goes to new CR.Sim({players}); players[i]
 *           is lobby slot players[i].slot, default i; legacy 1v1 { decks, names } still works)
 *         hs.tick(sim) applies each guest's commands as sim.command(itsPlayerIndex, cmd)
 *         hs.endBattle(result), hs.onRematch = info => {} ({ slot, name, all, votes }; once per
 *         guest and battle; hs.rematchBid === hs.bid once every seated human asked),
 *         hs.setRematch(bool) (host's own wish, shown to the guests), hs.backToLobby(),
 *         hs.localPlayer / hs.localSide, legacy hs.onGuest / hs.guest (first seated guest), hs.close()
 *   guest gs = await joinGame({ code, name, deck, team?, onStatus })
 *         gs.lobby (as above + { hostName, me: own slot | -1, team, full }), gs.onLobby = fn,
 *         gs.requestTeam(0|1) (the host decides), gs.setReady(bool), gs.setName(name) (live)
 *         gs.onBattleStart = info => {}: { mode, names[], seed, localPlayer, localSide, bid, speed,
 *           map, teamSize, players: [{ name, side, bot, online }], decks? } (1v1: localPlayer =
 *           localSide = 1); gs.localPlayer / gs.localSide
 *         gs.sendCommand(cmd), gs.frame(nowMs) (all players' public state, own hand only),
 *         gs.onBattleEnd, gs.requestRematch(), gs.resync(), gs.close()
 *   Seats: a newcomer takes an empty slot (lobby), else a bot's slot (lobby), else the seat of a
 *   guest that left or went stale (any phase, same name first: a reloaded phone gets its own
 *   seat back, also mid-battle); otherwise it is told 'full'. 1v1 teams are fixed (slot i =
 *   team i = side i = player i); in 2v2 guests ask for a team and get it when that team has room
 *   or a bot to swap with; hs.setTeam may swap anyone. Start: all slots filled, teams 1+1 / 2+2,
 *   guests connected and ready.
 *
 * Blobs (v = CR.Net.PROTOCOL):
 *   host  { v, role:'host', hid, n, phase:'lobby'|'battle'|'result', mode, name, gid, bid, seed,
 *           names, spd, decks?, snap?, ack, result?, rematch, dh, bye?,
 *           tm, map, me, full?, slots? (lobby/result), pl? [[side, bot, online] per player], lp }
 *   guest { v, role:'guest', gid, n, name, deck, ready, cmds:[[seq, cmd, bid, lp], ...], rematch,
 *           bid, ea, cv, dh, team, bye? }
 *   One host blob per guest: gid = its addressee (null = announcement for guests the host has
 *   not heard yet; a guest ignores blobs addressed to another guest on shared channels), me =
 *   the addressee's slot, full = no seat for it, lp = its player index in the battle, snap = the
 *   snapshot with its own hand, ack/ea/cv = its acknowledgements. lp in a command = the player
 *   the guest believes it is; the host applies a command only for the player of the sender's
 *   seat (by gid) and consumes mismatches unapplied.
 *   n: sender revision (latest wins, also the heartbeat: every blob is re-sent at least 1/s with
 *   a new n, so "no fresh blob for 5 s" = 'lost'); hid/gid: random session instance ids; bid:
 *   battle number; spd: game speed of the
 *   battle (ARCHITECTURE v2 3: startBattle({speed}) -> onBattleStart(info.speed)); ack: highest
 *   guest command seq the host applied; ea: highest event seq the guest received (the host then
 *   only resends newer events); cv: chaos state revisions the guest holds (the host then sends
 *   only the revision number); dh: hash of the codec string table (same build/data on both
 *   sides); rematch (guest): bid it asks a rematch for, (host): that request was seen.
 *   A phase change, a new battle and the first snapshot of a battle bypass the send rate limits.
 *
 * Commands: the guest keeps every unacknowledged command and sends the oldest 16 in every blob
 * ([seq, cmd, bid, lp]); the host applies each seq exactly once and in order via
 * sim.command(playerOfTheSender, cmd) inside hs.tick(sim) and echoes ack; acknowledged entries are dropped by the guest. Commands of
 * another battle (bid) are acknowledged but not applied. Untrusted input: every blob and command
 * is validated and rebuilt field by field. A play the sim rejects is reported to the guest as a
 * 'reject' event (sim.emit), like a local rejection.
 *
 * Snapshot codec (format 3): encodeSnapshot(view, forPlayer, opts) -> printable ASCII without
 * quotes/backslashes (embeds in JSON for free; length = wire bytes): a char-varint header
 * (format, string table hash, bit count, checksum) and a bit-packed body (Exp-Golomb integers,
 * 9/10-bit positions, per-snapshot unit type table, schema-coded events). decodeSnapshot(str,
 * ctx) -> View with the shape of sim.view() (2 or 4 players, each with its side; only
 * forPlayer's own hand/next, the others' hand []/null; unit owner kept). Quantisation: positions and z 0.05 tile, dir 2*PI/64, attackProg 1/40, elixir 0.01,
 * deployLeft 0.01 s, area left 0.05 s; hp/maxHp/ids/ticks/seq/fx/tier exact; all other numbers
 * exact to 3 decimals. Unit/card ids and common strings go through an index table built from
 * CR.DATA. Unknown fields and event types are carried generically, so new renderer fields
 * (ability / chaos_pick / chaos_offer events, building size/life, unit z ...) need no change
 * here. Typical battle: ~1 KB for 70 units; 120 units + 30 projectiles + 32 events < 3.5 KB.
 * Over budget it degrades gracefully: oldest hit events first, then older other events, oldest
 * areas, oldest projectiles, finally units (flagged as truncated).
 *
 * Guest rendering: gs.frame(nowMs) -> {prev, cur, alpha} renders behind the newest snapshot on
 * a host-tick clock (host ticks map to real time with tickRate * speed; low-percentile offset
 * estimate; slewed playout clock that never runs backwards and snaps forward after a stall).
 * The delay adapts: >= 100 ms, up to 250 ms under jitter or bursty hosts. The elixir bars are
 * extrapolated to "host now"; every event is handed exactly once (ascending seq) in cur.events
 * when the render time reaches it.
 *
 * v6 (Touchdown): the game mode is 'classic' | 'chaos' | 'touchdown' everywhere (hostGame /
 * setMode / startBattle / host blob / lobby / onBattleStart), plus options ({ chaos: bool } =
 * Touchdown with C.H.A.O.S upgrades) as `opt` in the host blob and `options` in the lobby and
 * the start info. view.mode and view.touchdown ({score, target, lastScore, resetIn}) travel as
 * view extras and survive even the last-resort degradation; 'touchdown' events and the new
 * ability kinds ('chain', 'dash', 'combo', 'one-inch') have compact schemas / table strings.
 *
 * v13: options may carry { elixirBoost: 1.5 } ("Schnelles Elixier") in EVERY mode (non-Touchdown
 * modes: options = { elixirBoost } instead of null only while it is on); it travels in `opt` /
 * `options` like the Touchdown flags (older phones ignore the extra key) and the guest's elixir
 * extrapolation multiplies by it. Emote ids stay plain string ids (v13: ten emoji emotes in the UI).
 *
 * v12: mode 'classic' (Klassisch, ohne C.H.A.O.S) is a regular menu choice and travels like the
 * others; map 'tunnel' joins 'classic' | 'hill' (lobby, host blob, start info). The unit flag
 * `tunnel` (underground), 'tunnel' events ({phase: 'enter'|'exit'}) and the new ability kinds
 * (e.g. 'shadow_clone') travel through the generic extras; their strings are in the table.
 *
 * Load time is pure (no DOM/window access outside functions): jsc loads this file in tests.
 */
(function (CR) {
  'use strict';

  const G = globalThis;
  const Net = CR.Net || (CR.Net = {});
  const hasOwn = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty;

  // ============================================================================ constants

  const PROTOCOL = 1;
  const FORMAT = 3;                         // snapshot format version (2: bit-packed body, 3: up to 4 players, unit owner)
  const BLOB_MAX = 3800;                    // bytes of one serialized blob (room presence 4 KiB)
  const CODE_ALPHABET = 'ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789'; // no I, L, O, 0, 1
  const CODE_LEN = 5;
  const ROOM_PREFIX = 'cr-';
  const PEER_PREFIX = 'chaosroyale-';
  const BC_PREFIX = 'chaosroyale-';
  const ID_RE = /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.-]{0,47}$/i;
  const INST_RE = /^[a-z0-9]{4,24}$/;
  const PHASES = ['lobby', 'draft', 'battle', 'result'];   // v7: 'draft' = Touchdown draft before the battle
  const ROOM_CHUNK = 1000;                  // presence strings are split into <= 1000 chars

  /** Tunables (exposed as CR.Net.config; tests and the app may adjust them). */
  const CFG = {
    snapHz: 20,                // host snapshot rate (every tick at 20 Hz, every 2nd tick above)
    lostMs: 5000,              // no fresh blob for this long -> 'lost'
    heartbeatMs: 1000,         // every blob is re-sent at least this often
    primaryStaleMs: 1500,      // host switches the snapshot channel after this much silence
    goneLobbyMs: 12000,        // guest silent this long in the lobby -> forgotten ('waiting')
    goneBattleMs: 60000,       // ... during a battle
    goneResultMs: 30000,       // ... on the result screen
    notFoundMs: 25000,         // guest never found a host -> 'error'
    fullMs: 9000,              // host stays bound to another guest this long -> 'error' (full)
    kickMs: 5000,              // guest re-dials PeerJS at most this often while 'lost'
    guestPeerFallbackMs: 2500, // guest on the room also dials PeerJS after this without a host
    roomPickMs: 2500,          // claude.use('room') slower than this -> not picked
    sendMinMs: 40,             // min gap between two sends on one channel (trailing send kept)
    guestAckMs: 200,           // guest re-publishes ack-only changes at most this often
    loopMs: 250,               // session housekeeping timer
    interpDelayMs: 100,        // guest renders at least this far behind the newest snapshot
    interpMaxDelayMs: 250,     // ... and at most this far when the network jitters
    eventWindowS: 1.0,         // host resends unacknowledged events of the last second
    maxCmdsPerBlob: 16,
    maxPendingCmds: 64,
    maxApplyPerTick: 8,
    maxBufferedBytes: 24 * 1024, // PeerJS: skip a snapshot while the data channel holds more
    peerRetryMaxMs: 8000,      // cap of the PeerJS retry backoff (signalling / re-dial)
    peerOpenMs: 10000,         // no answer from the signalling server this long -> new peer
    dialMs: 8000,              // guest: data channel not open this long -> dial again
    dialsPerPeer: 2,           // guest: after this many failed dials -> new peer id (fresh broker session)
    iceDisconnectMs: 2500,     // ICE 'disconnected' this long -> treat the data channel as dead
    hostIdRetries: 2,          // host: 'unavailable-id' at the first registration -> retry (stale id)
    connIdleMs: 20000,         // host: close a data channel that never opened / went silent this long
    signallingGiveUpMs: 45000, // guest: no signalling server and no host for this long -> 'error'
    turnFetchMs: 4000,         // max wait for turnUrl credentials before dialling without them
    debug: false,
    // Transport kinds sessions may open (null = all): e.g. ['peer'] forces WebRTC (tests/e2e).
    allow: null,
    // STUN (Google, Cloudflare). Measured 2026-11: the formerly public TURN servers do not work
    // any more (eu-0/us-0.turn.peerjs.com have no DNS record, openrelay.metered.ca resolves to the
    // TEST-NET sinkhole 192.0.2.1, staticauth.openrelay.metered.ca refuses 80/443/3478), so no
    // TURN is configured by default: P2P via STUN (incl. IPv6) covers WLAN <-> 4G/5G in most
    // cases. A TURN relay (needed only behind symmetric carrier NAT) is added by `turn` (static
    // list) or `turnUrl` (credential endpoint, e.g. Metered/ExpressTURN/Cloudflare, answering an
    // iceServers array), both settable by the page via window.CR_NET_CONFIG before joining.
    iceServers: [
      { urls: ['stun:stun.l.google.com:19302', 'stun:stun1.l.google.com:19302'] },
      { urls: 'stun:stun.cloudflare.com:3478' },
    ],
    turn: [],                  // [{ urls, username, credential }] appended to iceServers
    turnUrl: '',               // GET -> [{urls, username, credential}] | { iceServers: [...] }
    iceTransportPolicy: 'all', // 'relay' forces TURN (diagnostics)
    // Public address of the standalone game (GitHub Pages); named in the message shown inside the
    // claude.ai preview, where WebRTC is blocked.
    publicUrl: '',
    // Extra PeerJS options (host, port, path, secure, key, ...); default = PeerJS cloud server.
    peer: {},
  };

  /**

      if (!hasOwn.call(CFG, k) || k === 'allow') return;
      const cur = CFG[k], v = pc[k];

  }

  const MSG = {
    host_left: 'Der Gastgeber hat das Spiel verlassen.',
    full: 'Dieses Spiel ist bereits voll.',
    not_found: 'Kein Spiel mit diesem Code gefunden.',
    not_found_hint: 'Spiel noch nicht gefunden – prüfe den Code …',
    version: 'Unterschiedliche Spielversionen – bitte beide die Seite neu laden.',
    unavailable_id: 'Dieser Code ist schon vergeben – bitte einen neuen Code erstellen.',
    no_transport: 'Online-Spiel ist in diesem Browser nicht möglich – bitte den Spiel-Link in Safari oder Chrome öffnen.',
    signalling: 'Keine Verbindung zum Server – bitte Internetverbindung prüfen.',
    signalling_retry: 'Server nicht erreichbar – neuer Versuch …',
    to_server: 'Verbinde mit dem Server …',
    to_host: 'Verbinde mit dem Gastgeber …',
    ice_retry: 'Direktverbindung wird aufgebaut – neuer Versuch …',
    ice_hard: 'Direktverbindung klappt nicht – versucht es, wenn einer von euch ins WLAN wechselt.',
    webrtc: 'Online-Spiel ist in diesem Browser nicht möglich – bitte den Spiel-Link in Safari oder Chrome öffnen.',
    webrtc_frame: 'In der claude.ai-Vorschau ist kein Online-Spiel möglich. Öffnet beide den GitHub-Link des Spiels direkt im Browser (Safari/Chrome).',
    room: 'Der claude-Raum ist nicht verfügbar.',
    room_signin: 'Der claude-Raum geht nur mit Anmeldung. Öffnet besser beide den GitHub-Link des Spiels im Browser.',
    bad_code: 'Ungültiger Spiel-Code.',
    peerjs_missing: 'Das Online-Modul konnte nicht geladen werden – bitte Internetverbindung prüfen und die Seite neu laden.',
  };
  /** German message for a WebRTC failure: inside the claude.ai frame it points to the public link. */
  function webrtcMsg() {
    if (!inClaudeFrame()) return MSG.webrtc;

  }

  // ============================================================================== helpers

  function dt() { return typeof CR.DT === 'number' && CR.DT > 0 ? CR.DT : 1 / (CR.TICK_RATE || 20); }

    if (!CFG.debug) return;
    try { if (G.console && G.console.log) G.console.log.apply(G.console, ['[net]'].concat([].slice.call(arguments))); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
  }
  const warned = new Set();
  function warnOnce(key, msg, err) {
    if (warned.has(key)) return;

  }

  }

    now: function () { return G.performance && typeof G.performance.now === 'function' ? G.performance.now() : Date.now(); },
    setTimeout: function (fn, ms) { return G.setTimeout(fn, ms); },

  class VirtualEnv {
    constructor(startMs) { this.t = typeof startMs === 'number' ? startMs : 1000; this.q = []; this.ids = 0; }
    now() { return this.t; }

      this.q.push({ id: id, at: this.t + Math.max(0, +ms || 0), fn: fn });

    }

    }

      for (;;) {
        let bi = -1;
        for (let i = 0; i < this.q.length; i++) {

          if (e.at <= end && (bi < 0 || e.at < this.q[bi].at || (e.at === this.q[bi].at && e.id < this.q[bi].id))) bi = i;
        }

  }

    if (!isObj(r)) return null;
    const w = r.winner === 0 || r.winner === 1 || r.winner === 'draw' ? r.winner : null;
    const c = Array.isArray(r.crowns) ? r.crowns : [];
    const out = { winner: w, crowns: [intIn(c[0], 0, 9) || 0, intIn(c[1], 0, 9) || 0], overtime: r.overtime === true };
    if (typeof r.reason === 'string' && r.reason) out.reason = cleanText(r.reason, 40);

    if (!isObj(c)) return null;
    const W = (CR.RULES && CR.RULES.arena && CR.RULES.arena.width) || 18;
    const H = (CR.RULES && CR.RULES.arena && CR.RULES.arena.height) || 32;
    const hs = Math.max(4, (CR.RULES && CR.RULES.cards && CR.RULES.cards.handSize) || 4);
    switch (c.type) {
      case 'play': {
        const hand = intIn(c.hand, 0, hs - 1);
        if (hand === null || !finite(c.x) || !finite(c.y)) return null;
        if (c.x < -2 || c.x > W + 2 || c.y < -2 || c.y > H + 2) return null;

    'building', 'by', 'reason', 'radius', 'wave', 'lane', 'crowns', 'tower', 'winner', 'elixirMult', 'option',
    'options', 'offers', 'offer', 'picks', 'pick', 'picked', 'owned', 'upgrades', 'name', 'tier', 'level',
    'rarity', 'value', 'values', 'hand', 'type', 'label', 'desc', 'text', 'emoji', 'icon', 'active', 'left',
    'count', 'duration', 'mult', 'pct', 'amount', 'target', 'state', 'offerTimeLeft', 'next', 'round', 'rounds',
    'pending', 'stats', 'key', 'cards', 'common', 'rare', 'epic', 'legendary', 'champion', 'stun', 'freeze',
    'slow', 'knockback', 'shield', 'hp', 'speed', 'hitSpeed', 'range', 'stack', 'stacks', 'bonus', 'title',
    // v2: abilities, chaos upgrades, renderer-facing event fields
    'ability', 'chaos_ability', 'timeLeft', 'tx', 'ty', 'gained', 'cascade', 'clone', 'spawn', 'impact', 'wave',
    'upgrade', 'upgradeId', 'effect', 'effects', 'stat', 'mod', 'mods', 'cardId', 'unitId', 'pickTimeLeft',
    'available', 'chosen', 'history', 'revealed', 'cooldown', 'charges', 'uses', 'ready', 'abilities',
    'description', 'short', 'color', 'targetId', 'aura', 'dash', 'leap', 'pull', 'push', 'burn', 'poison',
    'heal_pulse', 'summon', 'shockwave', 'stomp', 'freeze_aura', 'slow_aura', 'teleport', 'invisible',
    // v5: 2v2 (players, owners, teams) and maps
    'owner', 'player', 'team', 'teamSize', 'map', 'hill', 'bot', 'players', 'height', 'plateau', 'slope', 'uphill',
    // v6: Touchdown (view.mode / view.touchdown, events) and the new cards' abilities
    'mode', 'touchdown', 'score', 'lastScore', 'resetIn', 'unitId', 'endzone', 'end_zone', 'field_reset', 'reset',
    'targets', 'combo', 'one-inch', 'step', 'hits', 'electro-dragon', 'kung-fu-legend', 'kick', 'punch', 'kiai',
    'td_reset', 'td_resume', 'removed', 'endZones', 'chaosOn', 'card_banned', 'sudden_death', 'standard',
    // v7: champion abilities (view.players[i].champion, 'ability' events) and the new cards' kinds

  function cardIdsOf(cards) {
    const ids = [];
    if (Array.isArray(cards)) {
      for (let i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) if (cards[i] && typeof cards[i].id === 'string') ids.push(cards[i].id);
    } else if (isObj(cards)) {
      for (const k in cards) if (hasOwn.call(cards, k)) ids.push(cards[k] && typeof cards[k].id === 'string' ? cards[k].id : k);
    }
    return ids;
  }

  /** The string table (cached per CR.DATA identity) and its 16-bit hash. */
  function strTable() {
    const D = CR.DATA || null;
    const units = D ? D.units : null;
    const cards = D ? D.cards : null;
    const chaos = D && isObj(D.chaos) ? D.chaos : null;
    if (TBL && TBL.D === D && TBL.units === units && TBL.cards === cards && TBL.chaos === chaos) return TBL;
    const list = [];
    const index = new Map();
    const add = function (s) {
      if (typeof s === 'string' && s.length > 0 && s.length <= 64 && !index.has(s)) { index.set(s, list.length); list.push(s); }
    };
    COMMON.forEach(add);
    if (isObj(units)) Object.keys(units).sort().forEach(add);
    cardIdsOf(cards).sort().forEach(add);
    // Static C.H.A.O.S catalogue (upgrade ids, names, descriptions) when the data carries one.
    const chaosStr = [];
    (function walk(v, depth) {
      if (depth > 6 || chaosStr.length > 4000) return;
      if (typeof v === 'string') { if (v.length > 0 && v.length <= 160) chaosStr.push(v); return; }
      if (Array.isArray(v)) { for (let i = 0; i < v.length; i++) walk(v[i], depth + 1); return; }
      if (isObj(v)) for (const k in v) if (hasOwn.call(v, k)) { chaosStr.push(k); walk(v[k], depth + 1); }
    })(chaos, 0);
    const extra = [];
    chaosStr.forEach(function (s) { if (s.length <= 160 && !index.has(s)) { index.set(s, -1); extra.push(s); } });
    extra.forEach(function (s) { index.delete(s); });
    extra.sort().forEach(function (s) { if (!index.has(s)) { index.set(s, list.length); list.push(s); } });
    const all = 'cr-net/' + PROTOCOL + '/' + FORMAT + '\n' + list.join('\n');
    let h = 2166136261 >>> 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < all.length; i++) { h ^= all.charCodeAt(i); h = Math.imul(h, 16777619) >>> 0; }
    TBL = { D: D, units: units, cards: cards, chaos: chaos, list: list, index: index, bits: bitsFor(list.length), hash: (h ^ (h >>> 16)) & 0xffff };
    return TBL;
  }

  // ============================================================================ bit stream
  //
  // The snapshot body is a little-endian bit stream packed into 32-bit words. Every word is
  // written as 5 base-90 digits over ALPHA (90^5 > 2^32); the last, partial word uses only as
  // many digits as its bit count needs. Integers use Exp-Golomb codes of a small order k
  // (ug), signed values zig-zag first (si). The body never contains " ' \ or `, so it embeds
  // in JSON without escapes and its length is its wire size.

  const P32 = 4294967296;
  const MASK = (function () {
    const m = new Array(33);
    for (let n = 0; n <= 32; n++) m[n] = n === 32 ? 0xffffffff : Math.pow(2, n) - 1;
    return m;
  })();
  const POW2 = (function () { const p = new Array(54); for (let i = 0; i < 54; i++) p[i] = Math.pow(2, i); return p; })();
  const D90 = (function () {
    const d = new Int8Array(128);
    d.fill(-1);
    for (let i = 0; i < ALPHA.length; i++) d[ALPHA.charCodeAt(i)] = i;
    return d;
  })();
  const TAIL_BITS = [0, 6, 12, 19, 25];          // bits that 0..4 trailing digits can hold
  function tailDigits(k) { return k <= 0 ? 0 : (k <= 6 ? 1 : (k <= 12 ? 2 : (k <= 19 ? 3 : (k <= 25 ? 4 : 5)))); }
  function charsForBits(n) { return Math.floor(n / 32) * 5 + tailDigits(n % 32); }
  function bitsForChars(c) { return c > 0 ? Math.floor(c / 5) * 32 + TAIL_BITS[c % 5] : 0; }
  /** Bits needed for the values 0..n-1 (0 for n <= 1). */
  function bitsFor(n) {
    if (!(n > 1)) return 0;
    if (n <= P32) return 32 - Math.clz32((n - 1) >>> 0);
    let b = 32;
    while (b < 53 && POW2[b] < n) b++;
    return b;
  }
  function log2floor(x) { return x < P32 ? 31 - Math.clz32(x) : 63 - Math.clz32(Math.floor(x / P32)); }
  function gammaLen(x) { return 2 * log2floor(x) + 1; }
  function hash16(s) {
    let h = 2166136261 >>> 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) { h ^= s.charCodeAt(i); h = Math.imul(h, 16777619) >>> 0; }
    return (h ^ (h >>> 16)) & 0xffff;
  }

  class BitOut {
    constructor() { this.w = []; this.cur = 0; this.n = 0; this.len = 0; }
    reset() { this.w.length = 0; this.cur = 0; this.n = 0; this.len = 0; return this; }
    /** n (0..53) low bits of the non-negative integer v. */
    bits(v, n) {
      if (n <= 0) return;
      if (n > 32) { this.bits(v % P32, 32); this.bits(Math.floor(v / P32), n - 32); return; }
      v = n === 32 ? (v >>> 0) : (((v >>> 0) & MASK[n]) >>> 0);
      const s = this.n, t = s + n;
      if (t < 32) { this.cur = (this.cur | (v << s)) >>> 0; this.n = t; }
      else {
        this.w.push((this.cur | (v << s)) >>> 0);
        this.cur = t === 32 ? 0 : (v >>> (32 - s));
        this.n = t - 32;
      }
      this.len += n;
    }
    bit(b) { this.bits(b ? 1 : 0, 1); }
    /** Elias gamma of x >= 1. */
    gamma(x) {
      const L = log2floor(x);
      if (L) this.bits(0, L);
      this.bits(1, 1);
      if (L) this.bits(x - POW2[L], L);
    }
    /** Exp-Golomb code of order k for an unsigned integer (clamped to 0..2^52-1). */
    ug(n, k) {
      n = n > 0 ? (n < MAXU ? Math.floor(n) : MAXU) : 0;
      if (k > 0) {
        const hi = Math.floor(n / POW2[k]);
        this.gamma(hi + 1);
        this.bits(n - hi * POW2[k], k);
      } else this.gamma(n + 1);
    }
    /** Signed integer (rounded, zig-zag) with order k. */
    si(n, k) {
      n = Math.round(n) || 0;
      if (n > MAXI) n = MAXI; else if (n < -MAXI) n = -MAXI;
      this.ug(zz(n), k);
    }
    append(o) {
      for (let i = 0; i < o.w.length; i++) this.bits(o.w[i], 32);
      if (o.n) this.bits(o.cur, o.n);
    }
    toChars() {
      let s = '';
      const w = this.w;
      for (let i = 0; i < w.length; i++) s += digits90(w[i], 5);
      if (this.n) s += digits90(this.cur, tailDigits(this.n));
      return s;
    }
  }
  function digits90(v, d) {
    let s = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < d; i++) { const q = Math.floor(v / 90); s += ALPHA[v - q * 90]; v = q; }
    return s;
  }

  class BitIn {
    /** Reads nbits bits from the base-90 digits str[start..]; the digit count must match. */
    constructor(str, start, nbits) {
      const nw = Math.floor(nbits / 32), tail = nbits % 32, td = tailDigits(tail);
      if (str.length - start !== nw * 5 + td) throw corrupt('length');
      const w = new Array(nw + (td ? 1 : 0));
      let p = start;
      for (let i = 0; i < w.length; i++) {
        const d = i < nw ? 5 : td;
        let v = 0, m = 1;
        for (let k = 0; k < d; k++) {
          const c = str.charCodeAt(p++);
          const x = c < 128 ? D90[c] : -1;
          if (x < 0) throw corrupt('digit');
          v += x * m;
          m *= 90;
        }
        if (v >= (i < nw ? P32 : POW2[tail])) throw corrupt('word');
        w[i] = v;
      }
      this.w = w;
      this.pos = 0;
      this.nbits = nbits;
    }
    get left() { return this.nbits - this.pos; }
    bits(n) {
      if (n <= 0) return 0;
      if (n > 32) { const lo = this.bits(32); return this.bits(n - 32) * P32 + lo; }
      if (this.pos + n > this.nbits) throw corrupt('end');
      const wi = this.pos >>> 5, bi = this.pos & 31;
      let v = this.w[wi] >>> bi;
      if (bi + n > 32) v = (v | (this.w[wi + 1] << (32 - bi))) >>> 0;
      this.pos += n;
      return n === 32 ? v >>> 0 : ((v & MASK[n]) >>> 0);
    }
    bit() { return this.bits(1) === 1; }
    gamma() {
      let L = 0;
      while (this.bits(1) === 0) { if (++L > 52) throw corrupt('gamma'); }
      return L ? POW2[L] + this.bits(L) : 1;
    }
    ug(k) { const hi = this.gamma() - 1; return k > 0 ? hi * POW2[k] + this.bits(k) : hi; }
    si(k) { const z = this.ug(k); return z % 2 === 0 ? z / 2 : -(z + 1) / 2; }
  }

  // ---- typed values on the bit stream ------------------------------------------------------

  /** String: 2-bit tag (0 null, 1 table entry, 2 literal: 7-bit chars, 127 escapes a 16-bit unit). */
  function putStr(o, s) {
    if (s === null || s === undefined) { o.bits(0, 2); return; }
    if (typeof s !== 'string') s = String(s);
    const idx = TBL.index.get(s);
    if (idx !== undefined) { o.bits(1, 2); o.bits(idx, TBL.bits); return; }
    o.bits(2, 2);
    o.ug(s.length, 3);
    for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
      const c = s.charCodeAt(i);
      if (c < 127) o.bits(c, 7); else { o.bits(127, 7); o.bits(c, 16); }
    }
  }
  function getStr(r) {
    const tag = r.bits(2);
    if (tag === 0) return null;
    if (tag === 1) {
      const t = TBL.list[r.bits(TBL.bits)];
      if (t === undefined) throw corrupt('table');
      return t;
    }
    if (tag !== 2) throw corrupt('string');
    const len = r.ug(3);
    if (len * 7 > r.left) throw corrupt('string');
    const codes = new Array(len);
    for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
      const c = r.bits(7);
      codes[i] = c === 127 ? r.bits(16) : c;
    }
    let s = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < len; i += 512) s += String.fromCharCode.apply(null, codes.slice(i, i + 512));
    return s;
  }
  /** Number: integers exact, everything else to 3 decimals. */
  function putNum(o, v) {
    if (!finite(v)) v = 0;
    if (Number.isInteger(v) && v <= MAXI && v >= -MAXI) { o.bits(0, 1); o.si(v, 3); return; }
    let k = Math.round(v * 1000);
    if (k > MAXI) k = MAXI; else if (k < -MAXI) k = -MAXI;
    o.bits(1, 1);
    o.si(k, 7);
  }
  function getNum(r) { return r.bits(1) ? r.si(7) / 1000 : r.si(3); }
  /** Generic JSON value: 3-bit tag null/false/true/number/string/array/object (depth-limited). */
  function putGv(o, v, depth) {
    if (v === null || v === undefined) { o.bits(0, 3); return; }
    if (v === false) { o.bits(1, 3); return; }
    if (v === true) { o.bits(2, 3); return; }
    const t = typeof v;
    if (t === 'number') { if (!isFinite(v)) { o.bits(0, 3); return; } o.bits(3, 3); putNum(o, v); return; }
    if (t === 'string') { o.bits(4, 3); putStr(o, v); return; }
    if (t !== 'object' || depth > 12) { o.bits(0, 3); return; }
    if (Array.isArray(v)) {
      o.bits(5, 3);
      o.ug(v.length, 2);
      for (let i = 0; i < v.length; i++) putGv(o, v[i], depth + 1);
      return;
    }
    const keys = [];
    for (const k in v) {
      if (!hasOwn.call(v, k)) continue;
      const x = v[k];
      if (x === undefined || typeof x === 'function' || typeof x === 'symbol') continue;
      keys.push(k);
    }
    o.bits(6, 3);
    o.ug(keys.length, 2);
    for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) { putStr(o, keys[i]); putGv(o, v[keys[i]], depth + 1); }
  }
  function getGv(r, depth) {
    if (depth > 16) throw corrupt('depth');
    switch (r.bits(3)) {
      case 0: return null;
      case 1: return false;
      case 2: return true;
      case 3: return getNum(r);
      case 4: return getStr(r);
      case 5: {
        const n = r.ug(2);
        if (n > 2048 || n * 3 > r.left) throw corrupt('array');
        const a = new Array(n);
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = getGv(r, depth + 1);
        return a;
      }
      case 6: {
        const n = r.ug(2);
        if (n > 512 || n * 5 > r.left) throw corrupt('object');
        const o = {};
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          const k = getStr(r);
          const v = getGv(r, depth + 1);
          if (k !== null && k !== '__proto__') o[k] = v;
        }
        return o;
      }
      default: throw corrupt('value');
    }
  }

  // ======================================================================= snapshot codec
  //
  // Format 2. Header (char varints, see Out): MAGIC, FORMAT, string table hash, body bit count,
  // body checksum (16 bit). Body (bit stream):
  //   head | players | towers (+ unit count) | unit types + units | projectiles | areas |
  //   events | view extras
  // Positions: 0.05 tile in 9 (x) / 10 (y) bits, offset 2 tiles, the all-ones code escapes to
  // a signed value; dir 6 bits; attackProg 6 bits (1/40); ids and seqs as deltas with a
  // per-section Exp-Golomb order; hp as "full" bit or index below maxHp of the unit type.

  const STATE_CODE = { idle: 0, moving: 1, attacking: 2, deploying: 3 };
  const STATE_NAME = ['idle', 'moving', 'attacking', 'deploying'];
  const VIEW_KEYS = new Set(['tick', 'time', 'clock', 'players', 'towers', 'units', 'projectiles', 'areas', 'events', 'over', 'winner']);
  const CLOCK_KEYS = new Set(['remaining', 'phase', 'elixirMult', 'overtime']);
  const PLAYER_KEYS = new Set(['name', 'elixir', 'hand', 'next', 'crowns', 'chaos', 'side']);
  const TOWER_KEYS = new Set(['id', 'side', 'kind', 'lane', 'x', 'y', 'hp', 'maxHp', 'active', 'alive', 'size', 'targetId', 'fx', 'attackProg']);
  const UNIT_KEYS = new Set(['id', 'side', 'unit', 'card', 'x', 'y', 'hp', 'maxHp', 'shield', 'maxShield', 'air', 'building', 'radius', 'state', 'deployLeft', 'fx', 'dir', 'attackProg', 'targetId', 'tier', 'z', 'size', 'life', 'owner']);
  const MAX_PLAYERS = 4;         // 1v1 = 2, 2v2 = 4 (V5)
  const PROJ_KEYS = new Set(['id', 'kind', 'side', 'x', 'y', 'air', 'tx', 'ty']);
  const AREA_KEYS = new Set(['id', 'kind', 'side', 'x', 'y', 'radius', 'left']);
  const POS = 0.05;              // position quantum (tiles)
  const POS_OFF = 40;            // codes start 2 tiles outside the arena
  const X_BITS = 9;              // -2 .. 23.5 tiles
  const Y_BITS = 10;             // -2 .. 49.1 tiles
  const AP_Q = 40;               // attackProg steps
  const DIR_Q = 64;              // facing steps per turn
  const CHAOS_INLINE_BITS = 400; // chaos state larger than this goes by revision (with ctx)
  const CHAOS_FULL_TICKS = 20;   // without acks: resent in full for 1 s after a change ...
  const CHAOS_REFRESH_TICKS = 40; // ... and every 2 s
  const HEAD_CHARS = 11;         // upper bound of the char header
  const DEFAULT_SNAP_MAX = BLOB_MAX - 400;

  // Event types with a 4-bit code (15 = literal type string follows).
  const EVT = ['hit', 'death', 'deploy', 'spell', 'tower_down', 'crown', 'king_active', 'phase', 'emote', 'reject',
    'chaos_offer', 'chaos_pick', 'chaos_use', 'ability', 'chaos_ability'];
  const EVT_IDX = new Map();
  EVT.forEach(function (t, i) { EVT_IDX.set(t, i); });

  // Event schemas (fields after seq/t/tick). Codecs: R entity ref, SIDE 0/1, I small int,
  // D larger int (damage), X/Y position, N number, S string, B bool, RL ref list, IL int
  // list, V any value. Fields that do not match their codec, and unknown fields, travel in a
  // generic extras object, so every event round-trips; schemas only make them small.
  const SCHEMAS = Object.create(null);
  function schema(type, fields) {
    const idx = Object.create(null);
    for (let i = 0; i < fields.length; i++) idx[fields[i][0]] = i;
    SCHEMAS[type] = { f: fields, idx: idx };
  }
  schema('hit', [['id', 'R'], ['src', 'R'], ['side', 'SIDE'], ['x', 'X'], ['y', 'Y'], ['dmg', 'D'], ['kind', 'S'], ['elixir', 'N'], ['shield', 'N'], ['gained', 'N']]);
  schema('death', [['id', 'R'], ['side', 'SIDE'], ['unit', 'S'], ['card', 'S'], ['x', 'X'], ['y', 'Y'], ['air', 'B'], ['building', 'B'], ['by', 'R'], ['reason', 'S']]);
  schema('deploy', [['side', 'SIDE'], ['card', 'S'], ['x', 'X'], ['y', 'Y'], ['units', 'RL'], ['cost', 'N'], ['tier', 'I'], ['player', 'I']]);
  schema('spell', [['side', 'SIDE'], ['card', 'S'], ['kind', 'S'], ['x', 'X'], ['y', 'Y'], ['radius', 'N'], ['phase', 'S'], ['wave', 'I'], ['unit', 'S'], ['count', 'I'], ['tier', 'I'], ['id', 'R'], ['tx', 'X'], ['ty', 'Y'], ['player', 'I']]);
  schema('tower_down', [['id', 'R'], ['side', 'SIDE'], ['kind', 'S'], ['lane', 'I'], ['x', 'X'], ['y', 'Y'], ['by', 'I'], ['cascade', 'B']]);
  schema('crown', [['side', 'SIDE'], ['crowns', 'IL'], ['tower', 'R']]);
  schema('king_active', [['side', 'SIDE'], ['id', 'R'], ['reason', 'S']]);
  schema('phase', [['phase', 'S'], ['elixirMult', 'N'], ['overtime', 'B'], ['winner', 'V'], ['reason', 'S'], ['crowns', 'IL']]);
  schema('emote', [['side', 'SIDE'], ['id', 'V'], ['player', 'I']]);
  schema('reject', [['side', 'SIDE'], ['reason', 'S'], ['hand', 'I'], ['player', 'I']]);
  schema('chaos_offer', [['side', 'SIDE'], ['round', 'I'], ['timeLeft', 'N'], ['options', 'V'], ['player', 'I']]);
  schema('chaos_pick', [['side', 'SIDE'], ['option', 'I'], ['id', 'S'], ['tier', 'I'], ['card', 'S'], ['name', 'S'], ['kind', 'S'], ['rarity', 'V'], ['upgrade', 'V'], ['label', 'S'], ['x', 'X'], ['y', 'Y'], ['player', 'I']]);
  schema('chaos_use', [['side', 'SIDE'], ['id', 'V'], ['kind', 'S'], ['x', 'X'], ['y', 'Y'], ['radius', 'N'], ['tier', 'I'], ['card', 'S'], ['player', 'I']]);
  schema('ability', [['id', 'R'], ['side', 'SIDE'], ['unit', 'S'], ['card', 'S'], ['kind', 'S'], ['ability', 'S'], ['x', 'X'], ['y', 'Y'], ['radius', 'N'], ['tier', 'I'],
    ['tx', 'X'], ['ty', 'Y'], ['target', 'R'], ['dmg', 'D'], ['phase', 'S'], ['units', 'RL'], ['upgrade', 'V'], ['name', 'S'], ['label', 'S'], ['rarity', 'V'],
    // v6: chain lightning targets (Elektrodrache); other new fields travel as extras
    ['targets', 'RL']]);
  // v6: Touchdown scored (literal type string; the score list makes the HUD update robust)
  schema('touchdown', [['side', 'SIDE'], ['player', 'I'], ['unitId', 'R'], ['unit', 'S'], ['card', 'S'], ['x', 'X'], ['y', 'Y'], ['air', 'B'], ['score', 'IL'], ['id', 'R']]);
  schema('td_reset', [['resetIn', 'N'], ['removed', 'I'], ['score', 'IL'], ['round', 'I']]);
  schema('td_resume', [['round', 'I'], ['score', 'IL']]);
  schema('chaos_ability', [['id', 'R'], ['side', 'SIDE'], ['unit', 'S'], ['card', 'S'], ['kind', 'S'], ['x', 'X'], ['y', 'Y'], ['radius', 'N'], ['tier', 'I'], ['target', 'R']]);
  const NO_SCHEMA = { f: [], idx: Object.create(null) };

  function fits(codec, v) {
    switch (codec) {
      case 'R': return Number.isInteger(v) && v >= 0 && v <= MAXI;
      case 'SIDE': return v === 0 || v === 1;
      case 'I': case 'D': return Number.isInteger(v) && v <= MAXI && v >= -MAXI;
      case 'X': case 'Y': case 'N': return finite(v);
      case 'S': return typeof v === 'string';
      case 'B': return typeof v === 'boolean';
      case 'RL': case 'IL': {
        if (!Array.isArray(v) || v.length > 64) return false;
        for (let i = 0; i < v.length; i++) {
          const x = v[i];
          if (!Number.isInteger(x) || x > MAXI || x < (codec === 'RL' ? 0 : -MAXI)) return false;
        }
        return true;
      }
      case 'V': return v !== undefined && typeof v !== 'function';
      default: return false;
    }
  }

  // Entity references (target ids, event ids): 1 bit + index into [towers..., units...] of the
  // snapshot when present, else 0 + the absolute id. Decoded as even (index) / odd (id) codes.
  const REFS = new Map();
  let REF_BITS = 0;
  function setRefs(towers, units) {
    REFS.clear();
    for (let i = 0; i < towers.length; i++) if (towers[i] && !REFS.has(towers[i].id)) REFS.set(towers[i].id, i);
    for (let i = 0; i < units.length; i++) if (units[i] && !REFS.has(units[i].id)) REFS.set(units[i].id, towers.length + i);
    REF_BITS = bitsFor(towers.length + units.length);
  }
  function putRef(o, id) {
    const i = REFS.get(id);
    if (i !== undefined) { o.bits(1, 1); o.bits(i, REF_BITS); }
    else { o.bits(0, 1); o.ug(id, 10); }
  }
  function getRef(r, refBits) { return r.bit() ? r.bits(refBits) * 2 : r.ug(10) * 2 + 1; }

  function putPos(o, v, nb) {
    const q = finite(v) ? Math.round(v / POS) : 0;
    const c = q + POS_OFF;
    if (c >= 0 && c < MASK[nb]) o.bits(c, nb);
    else { o.bits(MASK[nb], nb); o.si(q, 8); }
  }
  function getPos(r, nb) {
    const c = r.bits(nb);
    return r3((c === MASK[nb] ? r.si(8) : c - POS_OFF) * POS);
  }
  /** hp relative to maxHp: 1 = full; 01 + index below maxHp; 00 + signed value. */
  function putHp(o, hp, maxHp, hb) {
    if (hp === maxHp) { o.bits(1, 1); return; }
    if (hp >= 0 && hp < maxHp) { o.bits(2, 2); o.bits(hp, hb); return; }
    o.bits(0, 2);
    o.si(hp, 8);
  }
  function getHp(r, maxHp, hb) {
    if (r.bit()) return maxHp;
    return r.bit() ? r.bits(hb) : r.si(8);
  }

  function putField(o, codec, v) {
    switch (codec) {
      case 'R': putRef(o, v); break;
      case 'SIDE': o.bits(v, 1); break;
      case 'I': o.si(v, 0); break;
      case 'D': o.si(v, 5); break;
      case 'X': putPos(o, v, X_BITS); break;
      case 'Y': putPos(o, v, Y_BITS); break;
      case 'N': putNum(o, v); break;
      case 'S': putStr(o, v); break;
      case 'B': o.bit(v); break;
      case 'RL': o.ug(v.length, 2); for (let i = 0; i < v.length; i++) putRef(o, v[i]); break;
      case 'IL': o.ug(v.length, 1); for (let i = 0; i < v.length; i++) o.si(v[i], 1); break;
      default: putGv(o, v, 0);
    }
  }

  function extrasOf(obj, known) {
    let ex = null;
    for (const k in obj) {
      if (!hasOwn.call(obj, k) || known.has(k)) continue;
      const v = obj[k];
      if (v === undefined || typeof v === 'function' || typeof v === 'symbol') continue;
      (ex || (ex = {}))[k] = v;
    }
    return ex;
  }
  function assignSafe(dst, src) {
    if (!isObj(src)) return;
    for (const k in src) if (hasOwn.call(src, k) && k !== '__proto__') dst[k] = src[k];
  }
  function uint(v) { return finite(v) && v > 0 ? Math.floor(v) : 0; }
  function idNum(v) { return finite(v) && v >= 0 ? Math.floor(v) : 0; }

  function sortedBy(list, key) {
    let sorted = true;
    for (let i = 1; i < list.length; i++) {
      if (!(idNum(list[i - 1] && list[i - 1][key]) <= idNum(list[i] && list[i][key]))) { sorted = false; break; }
    }
    if (sorted) return list;
    return list.slice().sort(function (a, b) { return idNum(a && a[key]) - idNum(b && b[key]); });
  }

  function dirQuant(d) {
    if (!finite(d)) return 0;
    let q = Math.round(d / (2 * Math.PI) * DIR_Q) % DIR_Q;
    if (q < 0) q += DIR_Q;
    return q;
  }
  function dirValue(q) {
    let a = q * 2 * Math.PI / DIR_Q;
    if (a > Math.PI + 1e-9) a -= 2 * Math.PI;
