  }
  function apQuant(v) { return finite(v) ? Math.round(clamp(v, 0, 1) * AP_Q) : 0; }

  /** Cheapest Exp-Golomb order (0..7) for a list of unsigned deltas. */
  function bestK(d) {
    let best = 0, bestCost = Infinity;
    for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
      let c = 0;
      const p = POW2[k];
      for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) c += gammaLen(Math.floor(d[i] / p) + 1) + k;
      if (c < bestCost) { bestCost = c; best = k; }
    }
    return best;
  }

  // ---- sections --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  function encTowers(towers, nu) {
    const o = new BitOut();
    o.ug(towers.length, 2);
    o.ug(nu, 4);
    let prev = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < towers.length; i++) {
      const t = towers[i] || {};
      const id = idNum(t.id);
      o.si(id - prev, 3); prev = id;
      putStr(o, t.kind === undefined ? null : t.kind);
      const laneCode = t.lane === -1 ? 0 : (t.lane === 0 ? 1 : (t.lane === 1 ? 2 : 3));
      const tid = t.targetId;
      const hasT = Number.isInteger(tid) && tid > 0;
      const ap = apQuant(t.attackProg);
      const fx = uint(t.fx);
      const hasSize = finite(t.size);
      const ex = extrasOf(t, TOWER_KEYS);
      const exx = laneCode === 3 ? Object.assign(ex || {}, { lane: t.lane }) : ex;
      o.bits((t.side === 1 ? 1 : 0) | (laneCode << 1) | (t.active ? 8 : 0) | (t.alive ? 16 : 0) |
        (hasT ? 32 : 0) | (ap > 0 ? 64 : 0) | (fx ? 128 : 0) | (exx ? 256 : 0) | (hasSize ? 512 : 0), 10);
      putPos(o, t.x, X_BITS); putPos(o, t.y, Y_BITS);
      const maxHp = Math.round(t.maxHp) || 0;
      o.ug(maxHp, 10);
      putHp(o, Math.round(t.hp) || 0, maxHp, bitsFor(maxHp));
      if (hasSize) putNum(o, t.size);
      if (hasT) putRef(o, tid);
      if (ap > 0) o.bits(ap, 6);
      if (fx) o.ug(fx, 4);
      if (exx) putGv(o, exx, 0);
    }
    return o;
  }

  const TYPES = new Map();
  function encUnits(units) {
    TYPES.clear();
    const types = [];
    const n = units.length;
    const tix = new Array(n);
    const deltas = new Array(n);
    let prev = 0;
    for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
      const u = units[k] || {};
      const maxHp = Math.round(u.maxHp) || 0;
      const maxShield = Math.round(u.maxShield) || 0;
      const side = u.side === 1 ? 1 : 0;
      const tier = uint(u.tier);
      const hasLife = finite(u.life);
      const hasSize = finite(u.size);
      const radius = finite(u.radius) && u.radius > 0 ? Math.round(u.radius * 1000) : 0;
      const owner = Number.isInteger(u.owner) && u.owner >= 0 && u.owner < 64 ? u.owner : -1;
      const key = u.unit + '|' + u.card + '|' + side + (u.air ? 1 : 0) + (u.building ? 1 : 0) + (hasLife ? 1 : 0) +
        '|' + radius + '|' + maxHp + '|' + maxShield + '|' + tier + '|' + (hasSize ? u.size : '') + '|' + owner;
      let ti = TYPES.get(key);
      if (ti === undefined) {
        ti = types.length;
        TYPES.set(key, ti);
        types.push({ unit: u.unit, card: u.card, pk: side | (u.air ? 2 : 0) | (u.building ? 4 : 0) | (hasLife ? 8 : 0) | (hasSize ? 16 : 0) | (owner >= 0 ? 32 : 0),
          tier: tier, radius: radius, maxHp: maxHp, maxShield: maxShield, hb: bitsFor(maxHp), size: hasSize ? u.size : 0, hasSize: hasSize, owner: owner });
      }
      tix[k] = ti;
      const id = idNum(u.id);
      deltas[k] = id >= prev ? id - prev : 0;
      prev = id;
    }
    const o = new BitOut();
    o.ug(types.length, 3);
    for (let i = 0; i < types.length; i++) {
      const t = types[i];
      putStr(o, t.unit === undefined ? null : t.unit);
      putStr(o, t.card === undefined ? null : t.card);
      o.bits(t.pk, 6);
      if (t.owner >= 0) o.ug(t.owner, 0);
      o.ug(t.tier, 0);
      o.ug(t.radius, 8);
      o.ug(t.maxHp, 8);
      if (t.maxShield) { o.bits(1, 1); o.ug(t.maxShield, 6); } else o.bits(0, 1);
      if (t.hasSize) putNum(o, t.size);
    }
    const tb = bitsFor(types.length);
    const idK = n ? bestK(deltas) : 0;
    o.bits(idK, 3);
    for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
      const u = units[k] || {};
      const T = types[tix[k]];
      o.bits(tix[k], tb);
      o.ug(deltas[k], idK);
      putPos(o, u.x, X_BITS); putPos(o, u.y, Y_BITS);
      const st = STATE_CODE[u.state];
      const std = st !== undefined;
      o.bits(std ? st : 0, 2);
      o.bits(dirQuant(u.dir), 6);
      putHp(o, Math.round(u.hp) || 0, T.maxHp, T.hb);
      const tid = u.targetId;
      const hasT = Number.isInteger(tid) && tid > 0;
      if (hasT) { o.bits(1, 1); putRef(o, tid); } else o.bits(0, 1);
      const ap = apQuant(u.attackProg);
      if (ap > 0) { o.bits(1, 1); o.bits(ap, 6); } else o.bits(0, 1);
      let more = 0;
      const fx = uint(u.fx); if (fx) more |= 1;
      const dl = finite(u.deployLeft) && u.deployLeft > 0 ? Math.round(u.deployLeft * 100) : 0; if (dl > 0) more |= 2;
      const sh = Math.round(u.shield) || 0; if (sh !== T.maxShield) more |= 4;
      if (finite(u.z)) more |= 8;
      if (!std) more |= 16;
      const ex = extrasOf(u, UNIT_KEYS); if (ex) more |= 32;
      if (!more) { o.bits(0, 1); continue; }
      o.bits(1, 1);
      o.bits(more, 6);
      if (more & 1) o.ug(fx, 4);
      if (more & 2) o.ug(dl, 6);
      if (more & 4) o.si(sh, 6);
      if (more & 8) o.si(Math.round(u.z / POS), 3);
      if (more & 16) putStr(o, u.state === undefined ? null : String(u.state));
      if (more & 32) putGv(o, ex, 0);
    }
    return o;
  }

  function projBody(o, p) {
    putStr(o, p.kind === undefined ? null : p.kind);
    const hasT = finite(p.tx) && finite(p.ty);
    const ex = extrasOf(p, PROJ_KEYS);
    o.bits((p.side === 1 ? 1 : 0) | (p.air ? 2 : 0) | (hasT ? 4 : 0) | (ex ? 8 : 0), 4);
    putPos(o, p.x, X_BITS); putPos(o, p.y, Y_BITS);
    if (hasT) { putPos(o, p.tx, X_BITS); putPos(o, p.ty, Y_BITS); }
    if (ex) putGv(o, ex, 0);
  }
  function areaBody(o, a) {
    putStr(o, a.kind === undefined ? null : a.kind);
    const ex = extrasOf(a, AREA_KEYS);
    o.bits((a.side === 1 ? 1 : 0) | (ex ? 2 : 0), 2);
    putPos(o, a.x, X_BITS); putPos(o, a.y, Y_BITS);
    o.ug(finite(a.radius) && a.radius > 0 ? Math.round(a.radius * 1000) : 0, 10);
    o.ug(finite(a.left) && a.left > 0 ? Math.round(a.left * 20) : 0, 5);
    if (ex) putGv(o, ex, 0);
  }
  function eventBody(o, e, tick) {
    const ti = typeof e.t === 'string' ? EVT_IDX.get(e.t) : undefined;
    if (ti !== undefined) o.bits(ti, 4);
    else { o.bits(15, 4); putStr(o, typeof e.t === 'string' ? e.t : null); }
    const hasTick = finite(e.tick);
    if (hasTick) { o.bits(1, 1); o.si(Math.round(tick - e.tick), 2); } else o.bits(0, 1);
    const sch = (typeof e.t === 'string' && SCHEMAS[e.t]) || NO_SCHEMA;
    const f = sch.f;
    let mask = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < f.length; i++) if (hasOwn.call(e, f[i][0]) && fits(f[i][1], e[f[i][0]])) mask |= 1 << i;
    let ex = null;
    for (const k in e) {
      if (!hasOwn.call(e, k) || k === 't' || (k === 'seq' && finite(e.seq)) || (k === 'tick' && hasTick)) continue;
      const si = sch.idx[k];
      if (si !== undefined && (mask & (1 << si))) continue;
      const v = e[k];
      if (v === undefined || typeof v === 'function' || typeof v === 'symbol') continue;
      (ex || (ex = {}))[k] = v;
    }
    if (ex) mask |= 1 << f.length;
    o.bits(mask, f.length + 1);
    for (let i = 0; i < f.length; i++) if (mask & (1 << i)) putField(o, f[i][1], e[f[i][0]]);
    if (ex) putGv(o, ex, 0);
  }
  const PROJ_LIST = { body: projBody, key: 'id' };
  const AREA_LIST = { body: areaBody, key: 'id' };
  const EVENT_LIST = { body: eventBody, key: 'seq' };

  /** A list section: count, id-delta order, then per item its id delta and body. */
  function encList(items, L, tick) {
    const o = new BitOut();
    const n = items.length;
    o.ug(n, 3);
    if (!n) return o;
    const d = new Array(n);
    let prev = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const id = idNum(items[i] && items[i][L.key]);
      d[i] = id >= prev ? id - prev : 0;
      prev = id;
    }
    const k = bestK(d);
    o.bits(k, 3);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { o.ug(d[i], k); L.body(o, items[i] || {}, tick); }
    return o;
  }
  /** Budgeted subset (bits): lower priority value first, then newest first (items ascend). */
  function fitList(items, L, tick, budget, priority) {
    const n = items.length;
    const empty = encList([], L, tick);
    if (!n || budget <= empty.len + 3) return { out: empty, kept: [] };
    const cost = new Array(n), order = new Array(n);
    const t = new BitOut();
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      t.reset();
      L.body(t, items[i] || {}, tick);
      cost[i] = t.len + 8;
      order[i] = i;
    }
    order.sort(function (a, b) {
      const pa = priority ? priority(items[a]) : 0, pb = priority ? priority(items[b]) : 0;
      return pa !== pb ? pa - pb : b - a;
    });
    const keep = new Uint8Array(n);
    const rank = [];
    let used = empty.len + 3;
    for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
      const i = order[k];
      if (used + cost[i] <= budget) { keep[i] = 1; used += cost[i]; rank.push(i); }
    }
    for (;;) {
      const kept = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) if (keep[i]) kept.push(items[i]);
      const out = encList(kept, L, tick);
      if (out.len <= budget || !rank.length) return { out: out, kept: kept };
      keep[rank.pop()] = 0;
    }
  }
  function eventPriority(e) { return e && e.t === 'hit' ? 1 : 0; }

  /** v6: view extras that always travel (mode, map, teamSize, Touchdown state) or null. */
  function essentialExtras(view) {
    let out = null;
    const keys = ['mode', 'map', 'teamSize', 'chaosOn'];
    for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
      const v = view[keys[i]];
      if (typeof v === 'string' || finite(v) || typeof v === 'boolean') (out || (out = {}))[keys[i]] = v;
    }
    const td = view.touchdown;
    if (isObj(td)) {
      const t = {};
      if (Array.isArray(td.score)) t.score = [uint(td.score[0]), uint(td.score[1])];
      if (finite(td.target)) t.target = td.target;
      if (finite(td.resetIn)) t.resetIn = r3(td.resetIn);
      if (finite(td.round)) t.round = td.round;
      if (td.lastScore === null) t.lastScore = null;
      else if (isObj(td.lastScore)) {
        const l = td.lastScore, o = {};
        ['side', 'player', 'unitId', 'x', 'y'].forEach(function (k) { if (finite(l[k])) o[k] = r3(l[k]); });
        if (typeof l.unit === 'string') o.unit = l.unit;
        t.lastScore = o;
      }
      (out || (out = {})).touchdown = t;
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** Number of player entries a view carries: 2 (1v1) or up to MAX_PLAYERS (2v2). */
  function playerCount(view) { return clamp(arr(view.players).length, 2, MAX_PLAYERS); }
  function encPlayers(view, side, ctx, tick, withChaos) {
    const o = new BitOut();
    const ps = arr(view.players);
    const np = playerCount(view);
    o.ug(np - 2, 0);
    for (let i = 0; i < np; i++) {
      const p = isObj(ps[i]) ? ps[i] : {};
      const hand = i === side && Array.isArray(p.hand);
      const ex = extrasOf(p, PLAYER_KEYS);
      const hasSide = p.side === 0 || p.side === 1;
      o.ug(uint(p.crowns), 1);
      o.bits((hand ? 1 : 0) | (ex ? 2 : 0) | (hasSide ? 4 : 0) | (p.side === 1 ? 8 : 0), 4);
      putStr(o, p.name === undefined || p.name === null ? null : String(p.name));
      o.ug(finite(p.elixir) && p.elixir > 0 ? Math.round(p.elixir * 100) : 0, 7);
      if (hand) {
        o.ug(p.hand.length, 1);
        for (let k = 0; k < p.hand.length; k++) putStr(o, p.hand[k] === undefined ? null : p.hand[k]);
        putStr(o, p.next === undefined ? null : p.next);
      }
      encChaos(o, i, withChaos ? p.chaos : null, ctx, tick);
      if (ex) putGv(o, ex, 0);
    }
    return o;
  }
  /**
   * Chaos state per player: 0 none | 1 inline value | 2 revision only | 3 revision + value.
   * With an encoder context, states above CHAOS_INLINE_BITS go by revision: in full until the
   * receiver acknowledged the revision (ctx.ack[i], from the guest blob), or - without acks -
   * for 1 s after every change and every 2 s.
   */
  function encChaos(o, i, chaos, ctx, tick) {
    if (chaos === null || chaos === undefined) { o.bits(0, 2); return; }
    const t = new BitOut();
    putGv(t, chaos, 0);
    if (!ctx || t.len <= CHAOS_INLINE_BITS) { o.bits(1, 2); o.append(t); return; }
    const all = ctx.chaos || (ctx.chaos = []);
    const st = all[i] || (all[i] = { sig: null, rev: 0, changed: -1e9, full: -1e9 });
    const sig = t.len + ':' + t.w.join(',') + ':' + t.cur;
    if (st.sig !== sig) { st.sig = sig; st.rev++; st.changed = tick; }
    const ack = Array.isArray(ctx.ack) ? ctx.ack : null;
    const full = ack ? ack[i] !== st.rev
      : (tick - st.changed < CHAOS_FULL_TICKS || tick - st.full >= CHAOS_REFRESH_TICKS || tick <= st.full);
    o.bits(full ? 3 : 2, 2);
    o.ug(st.rev, 3);
    if (full) { o.append(t); st.full = tick; }
  }

  function winnerCode(w) { return w === 0 ? 1 : (w === 1 ? 2 : (w === 'draw' ? 3 : 0)); }

  function encHead(view, side, truncated, hasVex) {
    const o = new BitOut();
    const c = isObj(view.clock) ? view.clock : {};
    const cex = extrasOf(c, CLOCK_KEYS);
    const tick = uint(view.tick);
    o.ug(side + 1, 0);
    o.bits((view.over ? 1 : 0) | (c.overtime ? 2 : 0) | (winnerCode(view.winner) << 2) | (truncated ? 16 : 0) | (hasVex ? 32 : 0) | (cex ? 64 : 0), 7);
    o.ug(tick, 10);
    o.si((finite(view.time) ? Math.round(view.time * 1000) : 0) - Math.round(tick * dt() * 1000), 4);
    o.ug(finite(c.remaining) && c.remaining > 0 ? Math.round(c.remaining * 1000) : 0, 12);
    putStr(o, c.phase === undefined || c.phase === null ? null : String(c.phase));
    putNum(o, finite(c.elixirMult) ? c.elixirMult : 1);
    if (cex) putGv(o, cex, 0);
    return o;
  }

  /**
   * Encode a View for one receiving player (player index; in 1v1 player index = side): only that
   * player's hand/next travel. opts: { maxLen (chars = wire bytes, default ~3.4 KB),
   * events (override view.events), ctx (encoder context of a host session: chaos revisions and
   * acks) }. Stats of the last call: CR.Net.lastEncodeStats.
   */
  function encodeSnapshot(view, forSide, opts) {
    if (!isObj(view)) throw new TypeError('encodeSnapshot: view required');
    opts = opts || {};
    TBL = strTable();
    const side = Number.isInteger(forSide) && forSide >= 0 && forSide < MAX_PLAYERS ? forSide : -1;
    const maxLen = opts.maxLen > 0 ? opts.maxLen : DEFAULT_SNAP_MAX;
    const budget = bitsForChars(Math.max(0, maxLen - (maxLen > 14000 ? HEAD_CHARS + 2 : HEAD_CHARS)));
    const ctx = opts.ctx || null;
    const tick = uint(view.tick);
    const towers = arr(view.towers);
    let units = sortedBy(arr(view.units), 'id');
    const projs = sortedBy(arr(view.projectiles), 'id');
    const areas = sortedBy(arr(view.areas), 'id');
    const events = sortedBy(opts.events ? arr(opts.events) : arr(view.events), 'seq');
    const stats = {
      bytes: 0, units: units.length, events: events.length, projectiles: projs.length, areas: areas.length,
      droppedEvents: 0, droppedAreas: 0, droppedProjectiles: 0, droppedUnits: 0, droppedChaos: false,
    };
    const vex = extrasOf(view, VIEW_KEYS);
    let tail = new BitOut();
    if (vex) putGv(tail, vex, 0);
    const head = encHead(view, side, false, !!vex);  // size does not depend on the flags
    let players = encPlayers(view, side, ctx, tick, true);
    setRefs(towers, units);
    let tS = encTowers(towers, units.length);
    let uS = encUnits(units);
    let pS = encList(projs, PROJ_LIST, tick);
    let aS = encList(areas, AREA_LIST, tick);
    let eS = encList(events, EVENT_LIST, tick);
    let truncated = false;
    const total = function () { return head.len + players.len + tS.len + uS.len + pS.len + aS.len + eS.len + tail.len; };

    if (total() > budget) {
      // 1. events: keep the newest, non-hit events preferred
      const r = fitList(events, EVENT_LIST, tick, budget - (total() - eS.len), eventPriority);
      stats.droppedEvents = events.length - r.kept.length;
      eS = r.out;
    }
    if (total() > budget) {
      // 2. areas (oldest first)
      const r = fitList(areas, AREA_LIST, tick, budget - (total() - aS.len), null);
      stats.droppedAreas = areas.length - r.kept.length;
      aS = r.out;
    }
    if (total() > budget) {
      // 3. projectiles (oldest first)
      const r = fitList(projs, PROJ_LIST, tick, budget - (total() - pS.len), null);
      stats.droppedProjectiles = projs.length - r.kept.length;
      pS = r.out;
    }
    if (total() > budget) {
      // 4. units: keep as many as fit (in id order); refs must follow the kept list
      truncated = true;
      eS = encList([], EVENT_LIST, tick);
      stats.droppedEvents = events.length;
      const fixed = head.len + players.len + pS.len + aS.len + eS.len + tail.len;
      let lo = 0, hi = units.length;
      while (lo < hi) {
        const mid = Math.ceil((lo + hi) / 2);
        const part = units.slice(0, mid);
        setRefs(towers, part);
        if (fixed + encTowers(towers, mid).len + encUnits(part).len <= budget) lo = mid; else hi = mid - 1;
      }
      stats.droppedUnits = units.length - lo;
      units = units.slice(0, lo);
      setRefs(towers, units);
      tS = encTowers(towers, units.length);
      uS = encUnits(units);
      if (total() > budget) {
        // 5. last resort: no chaos state, no view extras - except the battle mode and the
        // Touchdown score (v6: the HUD and the result need them)
        players = encPlayers(view, side, null, tick, false);
        stats.droppedChaos = true;
        if (ctx && Array.isArray(ctx.chaos)) ctx.chaos.forEach(function (st) { if (st) st.full = -1e9; });
        tail = new BitOut();
        const keep = essentialExtras(view);
        if (keep) putGv(tail, keep, 0);
      }
    }
    const body = new BitOut();
    body.append(encHead(view, side, truncated, tail.len > 0));
    body.append(players);
    body.append(tS);
    body.append(uS);
    body.append(pS);
    body.append(aS);
    body.append(eS);
    body.append(tail);
    const chars = body.toChars();
    const h = new Out();
    h.s = MAGIC;
    h.u(FORMAT);
    h.u(TBL.hash);
    h.u(body.len);
    h.u(hash16(chars));
    const out = h.s + chars;
    stats.bytes = out.length;
    Net.lastEncodeStats = stats;
    return out;
  }

  /** Decoder context of a guest session: keeps chaos objects stable (identity) across snapshots. */
  function newDecodeCtx() { return { chaos: [] }; }
  /** Encoder context of a host session: chaos revisions; ack = revisions the guest holds. */
  function newEncodeCtx() { return { chaos: [], ack: null }; }
  /** Chaos revisions a decoder context holds ([rev0, rev1, ...] per player, 0 = none): the guest's ack. */
  function chaosRevs(ctx) {
    const c = ctx && ctx.chaos ? ctx.chaos : [];
    const n = clamp(c.length, 2, MAX_PLAYERS);
    const out = new Array(n);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) out[i] = c[i] && c[i].rev > 0 ? c[i].rev : 0;
    return out;
  }

  function keepChaos(ctx, i, v, rev) {
    if (!ctx) return v;
    let key;
    try { key = JSON.stringify(v); } catch (e) { key = null; }
    const c = ctx.chaos[i];
    if (c && key !== null && c.key === key) { c.rev = rev; return c.value; }
    ctx.chaos[i] = { key: key, rev: rev, value: v };
    return v;
  }
  function decChaos(r, i, ctx) {
    const mode = r.bits(2);
    if (mode === 0) return null;
    if (mode === 1) return keepChaos(ctx, i, getGv(r, 0), -1);
    const rev = r.ug(3);
    if (mode === 3) return keepChaos(ctx, i, getGv(r, 0), rev);
    // Revision only: keep the last known state until the full one arrives.
    const c = ctx && ctx.chaos[i];
    return c ? c.value : null;
  }

  function readField(r, codec, refBits, refId) {
    switch (codec) {
      case 'R': return refId(getRef(r, refBits));
      case 'SIDE': return r.bits(1);
      case 'I': return r.si(0);
      case 'D': return r.si(5);
      case 'X': return getPos(r, X_BITS);
      case 'Y': return getPos(r, Y_BITS);
      case 'N': return getNum(r);
      case 'S': return getStr(r);
      case 'B': return r.bit();
      case 'RL': case 'IL': {
        const n = r.ug(codec === 'RL' ? 2 : 1);
        if (n > 64) throw corrupt('list');
        const v = new Array(n);
        for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) v[j] = codec === 'RL' ? refId(getRef(r, refBits)) : r.si(1);
        return v;
      }
      default: return getGv(r, 0);
    }
  }

  /** Decode a snapshot string into a View. Throws on malformed input (callers catch). */
  function decodeSnapshot(str, ctx) {
    if (typeof str !== 'string' || str.length < 6 || str.length > 65536 || str[0] !== MAGIC) throw corrupt('header');
    TBL = strTable();
    const h = new In(str);
    h.p = 1;
    if (h.u() !== FORMAT) throw corrupt('format');
    const hash = h.u();
    if (hash !== TBL.hash) {
      const e = new Error('snapshot table mismatch (different build or data)');
      e.code = 'table_mismatch';
      throw e;
    }
    const nbits = h.u();
    const check = h.u();
    if (h.p > str.length || charsForBits(nbits) !== str.length - h.p) throw corrupt('length');
    if (hash16(str.slice(h.p)) !== check) throw corrupt('checksum');
    const r = new BitIn(str, h.p, nbits);
    // head
    r.ug(0); // receiving player + 1 (informational)
    const flags = r.bits(7);
    const tick = r.ug(10);
    const time = (Math.round(tick * dt() * 1000) + r.si(4)) / 1000;
    const clock = { remaining: r.ug(12) / 1000, phase: getStr(r), elixirMult: getNum(r), overtime: !!(flags & 2) };
    if (flags & 64) assignSafe(clock, getGv(r, 0));
    // players
    const players = [];
    const npl = r.ug(0) + 2;
    if (npl > MAX_PLAYERS) throw corrupt('players');
    for (let i = 0; i < npl; i++) {
      const crowns = r.ug(1);
      const pf = r.bits(4);
      const p = { name: getStr(r), elixir: r.ug(7) / 100, hand: [], next: null, crowns: crowns, chaos: null };
      if (pf & 4) p.side = (pf & 8) ? 1 : 0;
      if (p.name === null) p.name = '';
      if (pf & 1) {
        const n = r.ug(1);
        if (n > 16) throw corrupt('hand');
        for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) p.hand.push(getStr(r));
        p.next = getStr(r);
      }
      p.chaos = decChaos(r, i, ctx || null);
      if (pf & 2) assignSafe(p, getGv(r, 0));
      players.push(p);
    }
    // towers (+ unit count for entity references)
    const nt = r.ug(2);
    if (nt > 64) throw corrupt('towers');
    const nu = r.ug(4);
    if (nu > 4096 || nu * 30 > r.left) throw corrupt('units');
    const refBits = bitsFor(nt + nu);
    const towers = new Array(nt);
    const trefs = new Array(nt);
    let prev = 0;
    for (let k = 0; k < nt; k++) {
      const id = prev + r.si(3); prev = id;
      const kind = getStr(r);
      const pk = r.bits(10);
      const lc = (pk >> 1) & 3;
      const t = { id: id, side: pk & 1, kind: kind, lane: lc === 0 ? -1 : lc - 1, x: getPos(r, X_BITS), y: getPos(r, Y_BITS), hp: 0, maxHp: r.ug(10), active: !!(pk & 8), alive: !!(pk & 16) };
      t.hp = getHp(r, t.maxHp, bitsFor(t.maxHp));
      if (pk & 512) t.size = getNum(r);
      trefs[k] = (pk & 32) ? getRef(r, refBits) : -1;
      t.targetId = 0;
      t.fx = 0;
      t.attackProg = (pk & 64) ? r3(r.bits(6) / AP_Q) : 0;
      if (pk & 128) t.fx = r.ug(4);
      if (pk & 256) assignSafe(t, getGv(r, 0));
      towers[k] = t;
    }
    // unit types + units
    const ntypes = r.ug(3);
    if (ntypes > 4096 || ntypes > nu + 1) throw corrupt('types');
    const types = new Array(ntypes);
    for (let k = 0; k < ntypes; k++) {
      const unit = getStr(r), card = getStr(r);
      const pk = r.bits(6);
      const owner = (pk & 32) ? r.ug(0) : -1;
      const T = { unit: unit, card: card, side: pk & 1, air: !!(pk & 2), building: !!(pk & 4), hasLife: !!(pk & 8), hasSize: !!(pk & 16), owner: owner, tier: r.ug(0), radius: r.ug(8) / 1000, maxHp: r.ug(8), maxShield: 0, size: 0, hb: 0 };
      if (r.bit()) T.maxShield = r.ug(6);
      if (T.hasSize) T.size = getNum(r);
      T.hb = bitsFor(T.maxHp);
      types[k] = T;
    }
    const tb = bitsFor(ntypes);
    const idK = r.bits(3);
    const units = new Array(nu);
    const urefs = new Array(nu);
    prev = 0;
    for (let k = 0; k < nu; k++) {
      const T = types[r.bits(tb)];
      if (!T) throw corrupt('type ref');
      const id = prev + r.ug(idK); prev = id;
      const x = getPos(r, X_BITS), y = getPos(r, Y_BITS);
      let state = STATE_NAME[r.bits(2)];
      const dq = r.bits(6);
      const hp = getHp(r, T.maxHp, T.hb);
      urefs[k] = r.bit() ? getRef(r, refBits) : -1;
      const ap = r.bit() ? r.bits(6) : 0;
      let fx = 0, dl = 0, shield = T.maxShield, z, ex = null;
      if (r.bit()) {
        const m = r.bits(6);
        if (m & 1) fx = r.ug(4);
        if (m & 2) dl = r.ug(6);
        if (m & 4) shield = r.si(6);
        if (m & 8) z = r3(r.si(3) * POS);
        if (m & 16) state = getStr(r);
        if (m & 32) ex = getGv(r, 0);
      }
      const u = {
        id: id, side: T.side, unit: T.unit, card: T.card, x: x, y: y, hp: hp, maxHp: T.maxHp,
        shield: shield, maxShield: T.maxShield, air: T.air, building: T.building, radius: T.radius,
        state: state, deployLeft: dl / 100, fx: fx, dir: dirValue(dq), attackProg: r3(ap / AP_Q),
        targetId: 0, tier: T.tier,
      };
      if (z !== undefined) u.z = z;
      if (T.owner >= 0) u.owner = T.owner;
      if (T.hasSize) u.size = T.size;
      if (T.hasLife) u.life = T.maxHp > 0 ? r3(hp / T.maxHp) : 0;
      if (ex) assignSafe(u, ex);
      units[k] = u;
    }
    const refId = function (ref) {
      if (ref < 0) return 0;
      if (ref % 2 === 1) return (ref - 1) / 2;
      const i = ref / 2;
      if (i < nt) return towers[i].id;
      return i - nt < nu ? units[i - nt].id : 0;
    };
    for (let k = 0; k < nt; k++) if (trefs[k] >= 0) towers[k].targetId = refId(trefs[k]);
    for (let k = 0; k < nu; k++) if (urefs[k] >= 0) units[k].targetId = refId(urefs[k]);
    // projectiles
    const np = r.ug(3);
    if (np > 4096 || np * 20 > r.left) throw corrupt('projectiles');
    const projectiles = new Array(np);
    let k3 = np ? r.bits(3) : 0;
    prev = 0;
    for (let k = 0; k < np; k++) {
      const id = prev + r.ug(k3); prev = id;
      const kind = getStr(r);
      const pk = r.bits(4);
      const p = { id: id, kind: kind, side: pk & 1, x: getPos(r, X_BITS), y: getPos(r, Y_BITS), air: !!(pk & 2) };
      if (pk & 4) { p.tx = getPos(r, X_BITS); p.ty = getPos(r, Y_BITS); }
      if (pk & 8) assignSafe(p, getGv(r, 0));
      projectiles[k] = p;
    }
    // areas
    const na = r.ug(3);
    if (na > 1024 || na * 20 > r.left) throw corrupt('areas');
    const areas = new Array(na);
    k3 = na ? r.bits(3) : 0;
    prev = 0;
    for (let k = 0; k < na; k++) {
      const id = prev + r.ug(k3); prev = id;
      const kind = getStr(r);
      const pk = r.bits(2);
      const a = { id: id, kind: kind, side: pk & 1, x: getPos(r, X_BITS), y: getPos(r, Y_BITS), radius: r.ug(10) / 1000, left: r3(r.ug(5) / 20) };
      if (pk & 2) assignSafe(a, getGv(r, 0));
      areas[k] = a;
    }
    // events
    const ne = r.ug(3);
    if (ne > 4096 || ne * 7 > r.left) throw corrupt('events');
    const events = new Array(ne);
    k3 = ne ? r.bits(3) : 0;
    prev = 0;
    for (let k = 0; k < ne; k++) {
      const seq = prev + r.ug(k3); prev = seq;
      const ti = r.bits(4);
      const t = ti === 15 ? getStr(r) : EVT[ti];
      if (t === undefined) throw corrupt('event type');
      const e = { seq: seq, t: t };
      if (r.bit()) e.tick = tick - r.si(2);
      const sch = (t !== null && SCHEMAS[t]) || NO_SCHEMA;
      const f = sch.f;
      const mask = r.bits(f.length + 1);
      for (let i = 0; i < f.length; i++) if (mask & (1 << i)) e[f[i][0]] = readField(r, f[i][1], refBits, refId);
      if (mask & (1 << f.length)) assignSafe(e, getGv(r, 0));
      events[k] = e;
    }
    const view = {
      tick: tick, time: time, clock: clock, players: players, towers: towers, units: units,
      projectiles: projectiles, areas: areas, events: events, over: !!(flags & 1),
      winner: [null, 0, 1, 'draw'][(flags >> 2) & 3],
    };
    if (flags & 32) {
      const ex = getGv(r, 0);
      if (isObj(ex)) for (const k in ex) if (hasOwn.call(ex, k) && !VIEW_KEYS.has(k) && k !== '__proto__') view[k] = ex[k];
    }
    if (r.pos !== nbits) throw corrupt('trailing data');
    return view;
  }

  // =================================================================== interpolation buffer

  /**
   * Snapshot buffer of the guest. push(view, recvMs) adds a snapshot (older/duplicate ticks are
   * ignored); frame(nowMs) -> {prev, cur, alpha, tick, prevEntry, curEntry} | null (a reused
   * object). Host ticks are mapped to local time with an offset that tracks a low percentile
   * of (receive time - tick * dt): it falls quickly and rises slowly, and three samples in a row
   * more than 250 ms late re-anchor it (host stall). The playout clock advances in real time and
   * slews towards "newest - delay" (0.5x..1.5x), never runs backwards, never runs more than one
   * tick ahead of the data and snaps forward when it lags more than 0.5 s behind.
   * The render delay adapts to the network: max(delayMs, peak arrival lateness + snapshot
   * spacing), at most maxDelayMs (cellular jitter, hosts that tick in bursts at low frame
   * rates); the lateness peak halves every 4 s and ignores outages (> 300 ms, re-anchored).
   */
  class InterpBuffer {
    constructor(opts) {
      opts = opts || {};
      this.dtMs = opts.dtMs > 0 ? opts.dtMs : 1000 * dt();
      this.delayMs = finite(opts.delayMs) ? opts.delayMs : CFG.interpDelayMs;
      this.maxDelayMs = Math.max(this.delayMs, finite(opts.maxDelayMs) ? opts.maxDelayMs : CFG.interpMaxDelayMs);
      this.max = opts.maxItems > 1 ? opts.maxItems : 40;
      this.late = 0;
      this.lateAt = 0;
      this.gap = this.dtMs;
      this.items = [];
      this.out = { prev: null, cur: null, alpha: 1, tick: 0, prevEntry: null, curEntry: null };
      this.off = null;
      this.highRun = 0;
      this.rt = null;
      this.lastNow = null;
    }
    reset(keepNewest) {
      const n = this.items.length;
      this.items = keepNewest && n ? [this.items[n - 1]] : [];
      this.off = null;
      this.highRun = 0;
      this.rt = null;
      this.lastNow = null;
      this.late = 0;
      this.gap = this.dtMs;
    }
    /** Current render delay (ms). */
    get delay() { return clamp(Math.max(this.delayMs, this.late + this.gap), this.delayMs, this.maxDelayMs); }
    get size() { return this.items.length; }
    get newest() { return this.items.length ? this.items[this.items.length - 1] : null; }
    push(view, recvMs, extra) {
      const tick = view && finite(view.tick) ? view.tick : NaN;
      if (!(tick >= 0) || !finite(recvMs)) return null;
      const n = this.items.length;
      if (n && tick <= this.items[n - 1].tick) return null;
      const e = { tick: tick, view: view, recv: recvMs, extra: extra || null };
      if (n) { const g = (tick - this.items[n - 1].tick) * this.dtMs; this.gap += (Math.min(g, 300) - this.gap) * 0.15; }
      this.items.push(e);
      if (this.items.length > this.max) this.items.shift();
      const sample = recvMs - tick * this.dtMs;
      if (this.off === null) { this.off = sample; this.highRun = 0; }
      else if (sample < this.off) { this.off += (sample - this.off) * 0.25; this.highRun = 0; }
      else {
        this.off += (sample - this.off) * 0.02;
        if (sample - this.off > 250) {
          if (++this.highRun >= 3) { this.off = sample; this.highRun = 0; }
        } else this.highRun = 0;
      }
      const late = sample - this.off;
      this.late *= Math.pow(0.5, Math.max(0, recvMs - this.lateAt) / 4000);
      this.lateAt = recvMs;
      if (late > this.late && late < 300) this.late = late;
      return e;
    }
    /** Estimated host tick "now" (without the render delay), or null. */
    hostTick(nowMs) { return this.off === null ? null : (nowMs - this.off) / this.dtMs; }
    frame(nowMs) {
      const items = this.items;
      const n = items.length;
      if (!n) return null;
      const newest = items[n - 1];
      const target = this.off === null ? newest.tick : (nowMs - this.off - this.delay) / this.dtMs;
      let rt;
      if (this.rt === null) rt = target;
      else {
        const adv = this.lastNow === null ? 0 : Math.max(0, (nowMs - this.lastNow) / this.dtMs);
        rt = this.rt + adv;
        const err = target - rt;
        const snap = 500 / this.dtMs;
        if (err > snap) rt = target;                 // far behind: snap forward
        else if (err < -snap) rt = this.rt;          // far ahead of the data clock: hold
        else {
          const c = err * 0.1, lim = adv * 0.5;
          rt += c > lim ? lim : (c < -lim ? -lim : c);
        }
        if (rt < this.rt) rt = this.rt;
      }
      const cap = newest.tick + 1;
      if (rt > cap) rt = cap;
      if (this.rt !== null && rt < this.rt) rt = this.rt;
      this.rt = rt;
      this.lastNow = nowMs;
      const o = this.out;
      if (n === 1 || rt >= newest.tick) {
        o.prevEntry = n > 1 ? items[n - 2] : newest; o.curEntry = newest; o.alpha = 1; o.tick = newest.tick;
      } else if (rt <= items[0].tick) {
        o.prevEntry = items[0]; o.curEntry = items[0]; o.alpha = 1; o.tick = items[0].tick;
      } else {
        let i = n - 2;
        while (i > 0 && items[i].tick > rt) i--;
        const a = items[i], b = items[i + 1];
        o.prevEntry = a; o.curEntry = b;
        o.alpha = clamp((rt - a.tick) / (b.tick - a.tick), 0, 1);
        o.tick = a.tick + o.alpha * (b.tick - a.tick);
      }
      o.prev = o.prevEntry.view;
      o.cur = o.curEntry.view;
      return o;
    }
  }

  // =========================================================================== transports
  //
  // Channel interface (all transports):
  //   ch.kind                      'room' | 'peer' | 'loopback' | 'broadcast'
  //   ch.state                     'connecting' | 'ready' | 'nohost' | 'failed'
  //   ch.start(h)                  h = { blob(ch, endpoint, wire), left(ch, endpoint),
  //                                      state(ch, state, info) }
  //   ch.send(wire, endpoint|null) latest-wins publish (endpoint: preferred receiver)
  //   ch.poll()                    optional pull (room peers()), called by the session timer
  //   ch.kick()                    optional: re-dial now (PeerJS guest)
  //   ch.close(byeWire)            send the bye blob if given, then close

  function setChState(ch, st, info) {
    if (ch.state === st && !info) return;
    ch.state = st;
    if (ch.h && typeof ch.h.state === 'function') safeCall(ch.h.state, null, [ch, st, info || null]);
  }

  // ---- loopback: in-memory hub -----------------------------------------------------------

  /**
   * In-memory message hub (tests). opts: { env, latency, jitter, drop, dup, rand }. Delivery is
   * asynchronous via env timers; jitter reorders, `drop` loses, `dup` duplicates messages;
   * hub.up = false simulates an outage. hub.endpoint(kind) -> LoopbackTransport.
   */
  class LoopbackHub {
    constructor(opts) {
      opts = opts || {};
      this.env = opts.env || defaultEnv;
      this.latency = finite(opts.latency) ? opts.latency : 0;
      this.jitter = finite(opts.jitter) ? opts.jitter : 0;
      this.drop = finite(opts.drop) ? opts.drop : 0;
      this.dup = finite(opts.dup) ? opts.dup : 0;
      this.rand = typeof opts.rand === 'function' ? opts.rand : (CR.rng ? CR.rng(opts.seed || 7) : Math.random);
      this.up = true;
      this.ends = [];
      this.sent = 0;
      this.delivered = 0;
    }
    endpoint(kind) {
      const t = new LoopbackTransport(this, kind);
      this.ends.push(t);
      return t;
    }
    _deliver(from, wire) {
      for (let i = 0; i < this.ends.length; i++) {
        const to = this.ends[i];
        if (to === from || to.closed) continue;
        this.sent++;
        if (!this.up || this.rand() < this.drop) continue;
        const copies = this.rand() < this.dup ? 2 : 1;
        for (let c = 0; c < copies; c++) {
          const delay = this.latency + this.rand() * this.jitter;
          const self = this;
          this.env.setTimeout(function () {
            if (to.closed || !to.h || !self.up) return;
            self.delivered++;
            to.h.blob(to, from.id, wire);
          }, delay);
        }
      }
    }
    _left(from) {
      for (let i = 0; i < this.ends.length; i++) {
        const to = this.ends[i];
        if (to === from || to.closed || !to.h) continue;
        const self = this;
        this.env.setTimeout(function () { if (!to.closed && to.h && self.up) to.h.left(to, from.id); }, this.latency);
      }
    }
  }

  class LoopbackTransport {
    constructor(hub, kind) {
      this.hub = hub;
      this.kind = kind || 'loopback';
      this.id = 'lb' + randomId(6);
      this.state = 'connecting';
      this.h = null;
      this.closed = false;
      this.bc = null;
    }
    start(h) {
      this.h = h;
      setChState(this, 'ready');
    }
    send(wire) {
      if (this.closed) return;
      this.hub._deliver(this, wire);
    }
    close(bye) {
      if (this.closed) return;
      if (bye) this.hub._deliver(this, bye);
      this.hub._left(this);
      this.closed = true;
    }
    /** Two connected in-memory endpoints. */
    static pair(opts) {
      const hub = new LoopbackHub(opts);
      return [hub.endpoint('loopback'), hub.endpoint('loopback'), hub];
    }
    static hub(opts) { return new LoopbackHub(opts); }
    /** BroadcastChannel endpoint for game `code` (two tabs of one browser). */
    static broadcast(code) { return new BroadcastTransport(code); }
  }

  // ---- loopback: BroadcastChannel ----------------------------------------------------------

  class BroadcastTransport {
    constructor(code) {
      this.kind = 'broadcast';
      this.code = code;
      this.id = 'bc' + randomId(8);
      this.state = 'connecting';
      this.h = null;
      this.bc = null;
      this.closed = false;
    }
    start(h) {
      this.h = h;
      const BC = G.BroadcastChannel;
      if (typeof BC !== 'function') { setChState(this, 'failed', { code: 'unsupported', message: 'BroadcastChannel fehlt' }); return; }
      try {
        this.bc = new BC(BC_PREFIX + this.code);
        const self = this;
        this.bc.onmessage = function (e) {
          const d = e && e.data;
          if (self.closed || !d || typeof d.wire !== 'string' || typeof d.from !== 'string' || d.from === self.id) return;
          if (d.left) self.h.left(self, d.from);
          else self.h.blob(self, d.from, d.wire);
        };
        setChState(this, 'ready');
      } catch (e) {
        setChState(this, 'failed', { code: 'unsupported', message: String(e && e.message || e) });
      }
    }
    send(wire) {
      if (this.closed || !this.bc) return;
      try { this.bc.postMessage({ from: this.id, wire: wire }); } catch (e) { /* closed */ }
    }
    close(bye) {
      if (this.closed) return;
      this.closed = true;
      if (!this.bc) return;
      try {
        if (bye) this.bc.postMessage({ from: this.id, wire: bye });
        this.bc.postMessage({ from: this.id, wire: '', left: true });
      } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
      try { this.bc.close(); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
      this.bc = null;
    }
  }

  // ---- claude room ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  //
  // Contract (artifact-capabilities room.d.ts): presence is one object per peer, merged, at most
  // 4 KiB of JSON text (UTF-8), strings at most 1 KiB and free of control characters, sent
  // coalesced ~30/s (emits + presence share ~40/s); peers() is a frozen snapshot whose
  // unchanged entries keep their identity. A named room ends for its listeners with one error
  // (upstream_error / limit_reached / not_permitted) - join the name again unless not_permitted.
  // revoked / not_granted / capability_* / transform_error end the whole page's room access.

  const ROOM_PAGE_TERMINAL = new Set(['revoked', 'not_granted', 'capability_disabled', 'capability_removed', 'transform_error']);
  const ROOM_ENDED = new Set(['upstream_error', 'limit_reached', 'not_permitted']);
  const ROOM_PRESENCE_MAX = 4096;     // merged presence JSON (UTF-8 bytes)
  const ROOM_MIN_GAP_MS = 50;         // <= 20 presence updates per second
  const ROOM_JOIN_RETRIES = 6;
  // One NamedRoom per page and name (join() returns the same object): sessions share it by
  // reference count and leave only when the last one closes. Keyed by namespace, then name.
  const roomRefs = new WeakMap();
  function roomRefsOf(ns) {
    let m = roomRefs.get(ns);
    if (!m) { m = new Map(); roomRefs.set(ns, m); }
    return m;
  }

  /** Blob JSON is full of '"'; swapped with '\'' it needs no escapes inside the presence JSON. */
  function swapQuotes(s) { return s.replace(/["']/g, function (c) { return c === '"' ? '\'' : '"'; }); }
  /** UTF-8 bytes of the presence object the room measures. */
  /** German message for a room failure (never the raw platform code). */
  function roomMsg(code) {
    if (code === 'not_permitted' || code === 'not_granted') return MSG.room_signin;
    return inClaudeFrame() ? webrtcMsg() : MSG.room;
  }
  function presenceBytes(obj) { return utf8Bytes(JSON.stringify(obj)); }

  class RoomTransport {
    constructor(ns, code, env) {
      this.kind = 'room';
      this.ns = ns;
      this.name = ROOM_PREFIX + String(code).toLowerCase();
      this.env = env || defaultEnv;
      this.state = 'connecting';
      this.h = null;
      this.room = null;
      this.closed = false;
      this.unsubs = [];
      this.seen = new Map();
      this.lastPeers = null;
      this.queue = new Map();   // lane -> newest wire (host: one lane per guest, published in turn)
      this.lastPub = -1e9;
      this.timer = 0;
      this.joinTimer = 0;
      this.retries = 0;
      this.connected = false;
      this.maxWire = BLOB_MAX;
      this._ref = null;
    }
    start(h) {
      this.h = h;
      this._join();
    }
    _join() {
      if (this.closed) return;
      const self = this;
      if (!this.ns || typeof this.ns.join !== 'function') { setChState(this, 'failed', { code: 'unsupported', message: MSG.room }); return; }
      const refs = roomRefsOf(this.ns);
      const ref = refs.get(this.name);
      let p;
      if (ref) { ref.refs++; this._ref = ref; p = Promise.resolve(ref.room); }
      else {
        try { p = Promise.resolve(this.ns.join(this.name)); } catch (e) { p = Promise.reject(e); }
      }
      p.then(function (room) {
        if (!self._ref) {
          const r2 = refs.get(self.name);
          if (r2 && r2.room === room) { r2.refs++; self._ref = r2; }
          else { self._ref = { room: room, refs: 1 }; refs.set(self.name, self._ref); }
        }
        if (self.closed) { self._release(); return; }
        if (!room || typeof room.presence !== 'function') { self._release(); setChState(self, 'failed', { code: 'unsupported', message: MSG.room }); return; }
        self.room = room;
        self.retries = 0;
        const onErr = function (e) { self._onError(e, room); };
        try {
          self.unsubs.push(room.onPeers(function (ch) { self._onPeers(ch); }, onErr));
          if (typeof room.onConnection === 'function') self.unsubs.push(room.onConnection(function (c) { self._onConn(c); }, onErr));
        } catch (e) { self._onError(e, room); return; }
        // Joined: presence set now is applied locally and (re-)asserted by the platform on every
        // (re)connect, so the channel is usable from here on; connected() only informs.
        self.connected = typeof room.connected === 'function' ? !!room.connected() : true;
        self.seen.clear();
        setChState(self, 'ready');
        self.poll();
        if (self.queue.size) self._flush();
      }, function (e) {
        self._joinFailed(e && e.code);
      });
    }
    _joinFailed(code) {
      if (this.closed) return;
      if (this._ref) this._release();
      if (code === 'not_permitted' || code === 'invalid_argument' || ROOM_PAGE_TERMINAL.has(code) || ++this.retries > ROOM_JOIN_RETRIES) {
        setChState(this, 'failed', { code: code || 'join_failed', message: roomMsg(code) });
        return;
      }
      // upstream_error (no answer within 10 s, transient) / limit_reached: try again.
      if (this.state === 'ready') setChState(this, 'connecting');
      const self = this;
      this.joinTimer = this.env.setTimeout(function () { self.joinTimer = 0; self._join(); }, Math.min(15000, 1000 * Math.pow(2, this.retries - 1)));
    }
    _onConn(c) {
      if (this.closed) return;
      this.connected = !!c;
      if (c && this.queue.size) this._flush();
    }
    _onError(e, room) {
      if (this.closed || (room && room !== this.room)) return;
      const code = e && e.code;
      if (ROOM_PAGE_TERMINAL.has(code)) {
        warnOnce('room:' + code, 'room ended: ' + code, e);
        this._teardown();
        this._drop();
        setChState(this, 'failed', { code: code, message: roomMsg(code) });
      } else if (ROOM_ENDED.has(code) || !code) {
        // This named room ended (e.g. not re-joined after a reconnect): join the name again.
        warnOnce('room-ended:' + code, 'room lost: ' + code, e);
        this._teardown();
        this._drop();
        this._joinFailed(code || 'upstream_error');
      }
    }
    /** Forget the (dead) room object without leaving it. */
    _drop() {
      const ref = this._ref;
      this._ref = null;
      this.room = null;
      this.seen.clear();
      if (!ref) return;
      ref.refs--;
      const refs = roomRefsOf(this.ns);
      if (refs.get(this.name) === ref) refs.delete(this.name);
    }
    /**
     * Presence is one latest-wins value per peer: blobs of different lanes (the host's per-guest
     * blobs) are queued and published in turn, each lane latest-wins.
     */
    send(wire, ep, lane) {
      if (this.closed) return;
      // A queued lane keeps its place (only its blob is replaced): every lane gets its turn.
      this.queue.set(lane || '', wire);
      this._flush();
    }
    _flush() {
      if (this.closed || !this.room || !this.queue.size) return;
      const now = this.env.now();
      const wait = this.lastPub + ROOM_MIN_GAP_MS - now;
      if (wait > 0) {
        if (!this.timer) {
          const self = this;
          this.timer = this.env.setTimeout(function () { self.timer = 0; self._flush(); }, wait);
        }
        return;
      }
      const k = this.queue.keys().next().value;
      const wire = this.queue.get(k);
      this.queue.delete(k);
      this.lastPub = now;
      this._publish(wire);
      if (this.queue.size && !this.timer) {
        const self = this;
        this.timer = this.env.setTimeout(function () { self.timer = 0; self._flush(); }, ROOM_MIN_GAP_MS);
      }
    }
    _publish(wire) {
      const s = swapQuotes(wire);
      const chunks = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i += ROOM_CHUNK) chunks.push(s.slice(i, i + ROOM_CHUNK));
      const obj = { cr: chunks };
      if (presenceBytes(obj) > ROOM_PRESENCE_MAX) {
        // Would be rejected as a whole: ask the session for a smaller blob instead.
        warnOnce('room:size', 'presence over 4 KiB (' + presenceBytes(obj) + ' bytes), shrinking');
        if (this.h && typeof this.h.oversize === 'function') this.h.oversize(this);
        return;
      }
      const self = this, room = this.room;
      try {
        const p = room.presence(obj);
        if (p && typeof p.catch === 'function') {
          p.catch(function (e) {
            const code = e && e.code;
            if (code === 'invalid_argument') { warnOnce('room:invalid', 'room presence rejected', e); if (self.h && typeof self.h.oversize === 'function') self.h.oversize(self); }
            else if (code !== 'upstream_error') self._onError(e, room);   // upstream_error: safe to drop
          });
        }
      } catch (e) { this._onError(e, room); }
    }
    poll() {
      if (this.closed || !this.room || typeof this.room.peers !== 'function') return;
      let ps;
      try { ps = this.room.peers(); } catch (e) { return; }
      if (ps && ps !== this.lastPeers) { this.lastPeers = ps; this._scan(ps, null); }
    }
    _onPeers(change) {
      if (this.closed || !change) return;
      this.lastPeers = change.peers;
      this._scan(change.peers || [], change.left || null);
    }
    _scan(peers, left) {
      for (let i = 0; i < peers.length; i++) {
        const p = peers[i];
        if (!p || p.sameTab || (p.kind && p.kind !== 'viewer')) continue;
        const pres = p.presence;
        if (!pres || this.seen.get(p.peer) === pres) continue;
        this.seen.set(p.peer, pres);
        const c = pres.cr;
        if (!Array.isArray(c) || !c.length || c.length > 8) continue;
        let s = '';
        let ok = true;
        for (let k = 0; k < c.length; k++) { if (typeof c[k] !== 'string') { ok = false; break; } s += c[k]; }
        if (!ok || s.length > 8192) continue;
        this.h.blob(this, String(p.peer), swapQuotes(s));
      }
      if (left) {
        for (let i = 0; i < left.length; i++) {
          const p = left[i];
          if (!p || p.sameTab) continue;
          this.seen.delete(p.peer);
          this.h.left(this, String(p.peer));
        }
      }
    }
    _teardown() {
      for (let i = 0; i < this.unsubs.length; i++) { try { this.unsubs[i](); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ } }
      this.unsubs = [];
      if (this.timer) { this.env.clearTimeout(this.timer); this.timer = 0; }
      if (this.joinTimer) { this.env.clearTimeout(this.joinTimer); this.joinTimer = 0; }
    }
    _release() {
      const ref = this._ref;
      this._ref = null;
      if (!ref) return;
      ref.refs--;
      if (ref.refs > 0) return;
      const refs = roomRefsOf(this.ns);
      if (refs.get(this.name) === ref) refs.delete(this.name);
      try {
        const room = ref.room;
        // Clear our presence; leaving clears it as well.
        const p = room && typeof room.leave === 'function' ? room.leave() : null;
        if (p && typeof p.catch === 'function') p.catch(function () { /* ignore */ });
      } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    }
    close(bye) {
      if (this.closed) return;
      this.closed = true;
      this._teardown();
      if (this.room && bye) {
        try { this._publish(bye); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
      }
      const self = this;
      // Give the coalesced presence send (~30/s) a moment to carry the bye, then leave.
      if (this.room) this.env.setTimeout(function () { self._release(); }, bye ? 250 : 0);
      else this._release();
    }
  }

  // ---- PeerJS ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  /** Hostname of a claude.ai page / Artifact frame. */
  const CLAUDE_HOST_RE = /(^|\.)(claude\.ai|claudeusercontent\.com|claude\.site|anthropic\.com)$/i;
  function hostOf(url) { const m = /^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:\/\/([^/:?#]+)/i.exec(String(url || '')); return m ? m[1] : ''; }
  /** True when the page runs as (or inside) a claude.ai Artifact. */
  function inClaudeFrame() {
    try { if (G.location && CLAUDE_HOST_RE.test(G.location.hostname || '')) return true; } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    try {
      const ao = G.location && G.location.ancestorOrigins;
      if (ao) for (let i = 0; i < ao.length; i++) if (CLAUDE_HOST_RE.test(hostOf(ao[i]))) return true;
    } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    try { if (G.document && CLAUDE_HOST_RE.test(hostOf(G.document.referrer))) return true; } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    return false;
  }

  let rtcProbe = null;   // '' = WebRTC usable, else the German reason
  /**
   * null when WebRTC data channels look usable, else the German reason (the claude.ai Artifact
   * sandbox blocks RTCPeerConnection; PeerJS would say 'browser-incompatible'). Only probed in a
   * browser page; headless tests run against a mocked PeerJS.
   */
  function webrtcBlocked() {
    if (!G.document) return null;
    if (rtcProbe === null) {
      const RTC = G.RTCPeerConnection || G.webkitRTCPeerConnection;
      let ok = false;
      if (typeof RTC === 'function') {
        try {
          const pc = new RTC({ iceServers: [] });
          ok = typeof pc.createDataChannel === 'function';
          if (ok) pc.createDataChannel('probe');
          pc.close();
        } catch (e) { ok = false; }
      }
      rtcProbe = ok ? '' : 'blocked';
    }
    return rtcProbe ? webrtcMsg() : null;
  }

  /** One validated RTCIceServer entry or null. */
  function iceEntry(s) {
    if (!isObj(s)) return null;
    const urls = [].concat(s.urls || s.url || []).filter(function (u) { return typeof u === 'string' && /^(stuns?|turns?):/i.test(u); });
    if (!urls.length) return null;
    const o = { urls: urls.length === 1 ? urls[0] : urls };
    if (typeof s.username === 'string') o.username = s.username;
    if (typeof s.credential === 'string') o.credential = s.credential;
    return o;
  }
  // TURN credentials loaded from CFG.turnUrl (refreshed after 10 minutes).
  const turnCache = { url: '', at: -1e15, list: null, p: null };
  /** iceServers of a new connection: STUN + CFG.turn + credentials from CFG.turnUrl. */
  function iceServers() {
    const out = [];
    const add = function (s) { const e = iceEntry(s); if (e && out.length < 10) out.push(e); };
    arr(CFG.iceServers).forEach(add);
    arr(CFG.turn).forEach(add);
    if (turnCache.list && turnCache.url === CFG.turnUrl) turnCache.list.forEach(add);
    return out;
  }
  /** Promise that settles once CFG.turnUrl was fetched (or failed / timed out); null = no wait. */
  function loadTurn() {
    const url = CFG.turnUrl;
    if (!url || typeof url !== 'string' || typeof G.fetch !== 'function') return null;
    const now = Date.now();
    if (turnCache.url === url && turnCache.list && now - turnCache.at < 600000) return null;
    if (turnCache.p && turnCache.url === url) return turnCache.p;
    turnCache.url = url;
    const p = new Promise(function (resolve) {
      let done = false;
      const fin = function () { if (!done) { done = true; resolve(); } };
      G.setTimeout(fin, CFG.turnFetchMs);
      Promise.resolve().then(function () { return G.fetch(url, { cache: 'no-store', credentials: 'omit' }); })
        .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
        .then(function (j) {
          const l = Array.isArray(j) ? j : (isObj(j) && Array.isArray(j.iceServers) ? j.iceServers : null);
          if (l) { turnCache.list = l.slice(0, 8); turnCache.at = Date.now(); }
        }, function (e) { warnOnce('turn', 'TURN credentials not loaded', e); })
        .then(function () { if (turnCache.p === p) turnCache.p = null; fin(); });
    });
    turnCache.p = p;
    return p;
  }

  function peerOptions() {
    const o = Object.assign({ debug: 0 }, CFG.peer || {});
    o.config = Object.assign({ sdpSemantics: 'unified-plan' }, (CFG.peer && CFG.peer.config) || {}, { iceServers: iceServers() });
    if (CFG.iceTransportPolicy === 'relay') o.config.iceTransportPolicy = 'relay';
    return o;
  }

  /**
   * PeerJS transport. role 'host': registers 'chaosroyale-<CODE>' and accepts connections;
   * role 'guest': registers a random id and dials the host ({reliable: true, serialization:
   * 'raw'}).
   * Resilience (phones switching WLAN <-> 4G/5G, sleeping tabs, flaky signalling):
   *   - signalling: no 'open' within peerOpenMs -> new peer; 'disconnected' -> reconnect at once,
   *     then with backoff (1-8 s); the host keeps its id, a guest simply takes a new random id.
   *     Failures are reported as 'connecting' + German retry text, never as a dead end.
   *   - host code collision: 'unavailable-id' on the first registration is retried
   *     hostIdRetries times (stale registration of a reloaded page), then fails ('unavailable-id').
   *   - guest dial: data channel not open within dialMs -> dial again; after dialsPerPeer failed
   *     dials a fresh peer (new id, new broker session); 'peer-unavailable' -> 'nohost' + re-dial.
   *   - ICE watch on every data channel: 'failed', or 'disconnected' for iceDisconnectMs, closes
   *     it at once (the guest re-dials within 300 ms) instead of waiting for SCTP timeouts.
   *   - window 'online' / 'pageshow' / visibility back -> reconnect + re-dial immediately.
   *   - host: a re-dial of the same guest replaces its old channels; channels that never open or
   *     stay silent for connIdleMs are closed.
   *   - WebRTC unavailable (claude.ai Artifact sandbox, PeerJS 'browser-incompatible'): fails
   *     with a German explanation pointing to the public link (code 'webrtc-blocked').
   */
  class PeerTransport {
    constructor(role, code, env) {
      this.kind = 'peer';
      this.role = role === 'host' ? 'host' : 'guest';
      this.code = String(code).toUpperCase();
      this.env = env || defaultEnv;
      this.state = 'connecting';
      this.h = null;
      this.peer = null;
      this.closed = false;
      this.everOpen = false;
      this.fails = 0;
      this.idTaken = 0;
      this.conns = new Map();   // host: endpoint -> { conn, open, ep, t, lastData }
      this.conn = null;         // guest
      this.connOpen = false;
      this.connSeq = 0;
      this.lastWire = null;
      this.timers = new Set();
      this.lastDial = -1e9;
      this.dialTimer = 0;
      this.renewTimer = 0;
      this.createTimer = 0;
      this.dialFails = 0;       // guest: consecutive dials that never opened (current peer)
      this.iceFails = 0;        // guest: dials the host answered but ICE never connected
      this.lastNudge = -1e9;
      this.unlisten = null;
    }
    _later(fn, ms) {
      if (this.closed) return 0;
      const self = this;
      const id = this.env.setTimeout(function () { self.timers.delete(id); if (!self.closed) fn(); }, ms);
      this.timers.add(id);
      return id;
    }
    _cancel(id) { if (id) { this.env.clearTimeout(id); this.timers.delete(id); } return 0; }
    _backoff() { return Math.min(CFG.peerRetryMaxMs, 1000 * Math.pow(2, Math.min(4, Math.max(0, this.fails - 1)))); }
    _connecting(message, code) {
      if (this.state === 'failed' || this.closed) return;
      setChState(this, 'connecting', { code: code || 'connecting', message: message });
    }
    start(h) {
      this.h = h;
      const blocked = webrtcBlocked();
      if (blocked) { setChState(this, 'failed', { code: 'webrtc-blocked', message: blocked, prefer: true }); return; }
      this._listen();
      this._connecting(MSG.to_server);
      const wait = loadTurn();
      const self = this;
      if (wait) wait.then(function () { self._create(); }); else this._create();
    }
    _createLater(ms) {
      if (this.closed || this.createTimer) return;
      const self = this;
      this.createTimer = this._later(function () { self.createTimer = 0; self._create(); }, ms);
    }
    _create() {
      if (this.closed || this.peer) return;
      this.createTimer = this._cancel(this.createTimer);
      const P = G.Peer;
      if (typeof P !== 'function') { setChState(this, 'failed', { code: 'unsupported', message: webrtcMsg() }); return; }
      const id = this.role === 'host' ? PEER_PREFIX + this.code : PEER_PREFIX + this.code + '-' + randomId(10);
      let peer;
      try { peer = new P(id, peerOptions()); } catch (e) {
        setChState(this, 'failed', { code: 'unsupported', message: webrtcMsg() });
        return;
      }
      this.peer = peer;
      this.dialFails = 0;
      const self = this;
      let opened = false;
      // Signalling watchdog: no answer from the server -> start over with a new peer object.
      this._later(function () {
        if (opened || peer !== self.peer) return;
        log('peer open timeout');
        self.fails++;
        self._noteFailure();
        self._destroyPeer();
        self._create();
      }, CFG.peerOpenMs);
      peer.on('open', function () {
        if (peer !== self.peer || self.closed) return;
        opened = true;
        self.everOpen = true;
        self.fails = 0;
        self.idTaken = 0;
        if (self.role === 'host') setChState(self, 'ready');
        else {
          if (self.state !== 'ready' && self.state !== 'nohost') self._connecting(self._dialMsg());
          if (!self.connOpen) self._dial();
        }
      });
      peer.on('connection', function (conn) {
        if (peer !== self.peer || self.closed || self.role !== 'host') { try { conn.close(); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ } return; }
        self._adopt(conn);
      });
      peer.on('disconnected', function () {
        if (peer !== self.peer || self.closed) return;
        // Signalling lost (network switch, server restart); open data channels keep working.
        self.fails++;
        if (self.role === 'host' && self._openConns() === 0) self._connecting(MSG.to_server);
        if (self.role === 'guest') {

    /**
     * Watch the ICE state of a data connection: onDead() when it failed, or stayed

    _watchIce(conn, onDead) {

        if (st === 'checking' || st === 'connected' || st === 'completed' || (pc.remoteDescription && pc.signalingState === 'stable')) {

      const self = this;

      this.conns.forEach(function (r) {

  // ======================================================================== room / pick

  let roomPromise = null;

    roomFor = c;
    roomNs = null;
    if (!c || typeof c.use !== 'function') { roomPromise = Promise.resolve(null); return roomPromise; }
    let p;
    try { p = c.use('room'); } catch (e) { p = null; }
    const mine = Promise.resolve(p).then(function (ns) {
      const v = ns && typeof ns.join === 'function' ? ns : null;
      if (roomPromise === mine) roomNs = v;
      return v;
    }, function () { return null; });
    roomPromise = mine;
    return mine;
  }

  /**

   * debug query parameter `crnet=peer,room,broadcast` (forces e.g. real WebRTC between two
   * tabs of one browser, which would otherwise meet over BroadcastChannel), else all.

      const m = /[?&]crnet=([a-z,]+)/i.exec(q);

    } catch (e) { /* no location */ }

  }

   * standalone GitHub Pages build - always plays over PeerJS / WebRTC.

  /**

        else if (typeof G.BroadcastChannel === 'function' && allowed('broadcast', opts)) resolve('broadcast');
        else resolve('none');

  const PEERJS_URLS = [
    'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/peerjs@1.5.4/dist/peerjs.min.js',
    'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/peerjs/1.5.4/peerjs.min.js',
  ];
  let peerJsPromise = null;
  /** window.Peer, loading the pinned PeerJS build once if the page's own script tag failed. */

    if (typeof G.Peer === 'function') return Promise.resolve(true);
    if (peerJsPromise) return peerJsPromise;
    const doc = G.document;
    if (!doc || typeof doc.createElement !== 'function') return Promise.resolve(false);
    // The pinned build from jsdelivr, then the same version from cdnjs (mobile CDN hiccups).
    const tryUrl = function (i) {
      return new Promise(function (resolve) {

        const finish = function () { if (done) return; done = true; resolve(typeof G.Peer === 'function'); };
        try {

  function transportLabel(kind) {
    switch (kind) {
      case 'room': return 'claude-Raum';
      case 'peer': return 'WebRTC (PeerJS)';
      case 'broadcast': return 'Browser-Tabs';
      case 'loopback': return 'Lokal';

  // ============================================================================= sessions

  const KIND_RANK = { room: 0, peer: 1, loopback: 2, broadcast: 3 };

  /** Shared machinery of host and guest sessions (channels, receive, publish, status). */
  class Session {

    addTransport(ch, primary) {

        key: '', lanes: null,

          left: function (c, ep) { self._onLeft(rec, ep); },
          state: function (c, st, info) { self._onChState(rec, st, info); },
          // The channel refused a blob as too large (room presence limit): shrink its budget.
          oversize: function () { rec.maxWire = Math.max(1600, rec.maxWire - 300); self._requestPublish(0); },
        });
      } catch (e) {

      if (!this.loopTimer) this._loop();
