      const ts = this.ts, f = this._fonts;
      f.towerHp = '900 ' + Math.max(9, Math.round(ts * 0.44)) + 'px ' + FONT_UI;
      f.kingHp = '900 ' + Math.max(10, Math.round(ts * 0.5)) + 'px ' + FONT_UI;
      f.zzz = '900 ' + Math.max(9, Math.round(ts * 0.5)) + 'px ' + FONT_UI;
      f.banner = Math.max(18, Math.round(Math.min(ts * 1.45, this.cssW / 10.5))) + 'px ' + FONT_DISPLAY;
      f.bannerSub = '800 ' + Math.max(11, Math.round(Math.min(ts * 0.62, this.cssW / 26))) + 'px ' + FONT_UI;
      f.count = Math.max(44, Math.round(ts * 5.4)) + 'px ' + FONT_DISPLAY;
      f.small = '900 ' + Math.max(9, Math.round(ts * 0.52)) + 'px ' + FONT_UI;
      f.bang = Math.max(16, Math.round(ts * 1.5)) + 'px ' + FONT_DISPLAY;
      f.bannerPx = Math.max(18, Math.round(Math.min(ts * 1.45, this.cssW / 10.5)));
    }

    resize(cssW, cssH, dpr) {
      let w = +cssW, h = +cssH;
      const cv = this.canvas;
      if (!(w > 0)) w = (cv && cv.clientWidth) || 360;
      if (!(h > 0)) h = (cv && cv.clientHeight) || 640;
      let d = +dpr;
      if (!(d > 0)) d = G.devicePixelRatio || 1;
      d = clamp(d, 1, MAX_DPR);
      if (w * h * d * d > PIXEL_BUDGET) d = Math.max(1, Math.sqrt(PIXEL_BUDGET / (w * h)));
      const bw = Math.max(1, Math.round(w * d)), bh = Math.max(1, Math.round(h * d));
      const same = w === this.cssW && h === this.cssH && d === this.dpr && cv && cv.width === bw && cv.height === bh;
      if (same && !this._staticDirty) return;
      this.cssW = w; this.cssH = h; this.dpr = d;
      if (cv && (cv.width !== bw || cv.height !== bh)) { cv.width = bw; cv.height = bh; }
      this._readArena();
      this._fit();
      this._staticDirty = true;
      this._overlayDirty = true;
      this._clearSpriteCaches();
    }

    /** CSS px relative to the canvas -> sim coords (handles the 180 degree view of side 1). */
    screenToSim(px, py, side) {
      if (side === 0 || side === 1) {
        const ts = this.ts;
        const x = (px - this.ax) / ts, yy = this.H - (py - this.ay) / ts;
        return side === 1 ? { x: this.W - x, y: this.H - yy } : { x: x, y: yy };
      }
      return { x: (px - this._bx) / this._mx, y: (py - this._by) / this._my };
    }

    /** Sim coords -> CSS px relative to the canvas. */
    simToScreen(x, y, side) {
      if (side === 0 || side === 1) {
        const ts = this.ts;
        const sx = side === 1 ? this.W - x : x, sy = side === 1 ? this.H - y : y;
        return { px: this.ax + sx * ts, py: this.ay + (this.H - sy) * ts };
      }
      return { px: this._bx + x * this._mx, py: this._by + y * this._my };
    }

    arenaRect() {
      return { x: this.ax, y: this.ay, w: this.W * this.ts, h: this.H * this.ts };
    }

    /** Tile size in CSS px (convenience for the UI). */
    tileSize() { return this.ts; }

    _team(side) {
      if (this.options.colorMode === 'absolute') return side === 1 ? 1 : 0;
      return side === this.localSide ? 0 : 1;
    }

    _resetT() {
      const d = this.dpr;
      this.ctx.setTransform(d, 0, 0, d, d * this._shx, d * this._shy);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- caches
    _clearSpriteCaches() {
      this._glyphCache.forEach(freeCanvas);
      this._glyphCache.clear();
      this._cacheGen++;
      for (let i = 0; i < this._towerSpr.length; i++) if (this._towerSpr[i]) freeCanvas(this._towerSpr[i].cv);
      this._towerSpr.length = 0;
      this._glowCache.forEach(freeCanvas);
      this._glowCache.clear();
    }

    _scratchCanvas(i, S) {
      let c = this._scratch[i];
      if (!c) { c = makeCanvas(S, S); this._scratch[i] = c; }
      else if (c.width < S || c.height < S) { c.width = Math.max(c.width, S); c.height = Math.max(c.height, S); }
      return c;
    }

    /** v8: high-res unit portrait (CR.GFX.portrait, transparent PNG) for a unit id and colour
     *  side, or null while loading / when the 3D kit is unavailable. A finished load bumps the
     *  sprite generation so every memo picks it up. */
    _portrait(unitId, team) {
      const X = CR.GFX;
      if (!unitId || !X || X.ready === false || typeof X.portrait !== 'function' || typeof G.Image !== 'function') return null;
      if (typeof X.hasModel === 'function') { try { if (!X.hasModel(unitId)) return null; } catch (e) { return null; } }
      const key = unitId + '|' + team;
      let e = this._ports.get(key);
      if (e) return e.state === 1 ? e.img : null;
      e = { img: null, state: 0 };
      this._ports.set(key, e);
      const self = this;
      let p = null;
      try { p = X.portrait(unitId, { w: PORTRAIT_W, h: PORTRAIT_H, side: team, pose: 'idle' }); } catch (err) { p = null; }
      if (!p || typeof p.then !== 'function') { e.state = 2; return null; }
      p.then(function (url) {
        if (!url || self._destroyed) { e.state = 2; return; }
        const im = new G.Image();
        im.onload = function () { e.img = im; e.state = 1; self._cacheGen++; };
        im.onerror = function () { e.state = 2; };
        im.src = url;
      }, function () { e.state = 2; });
      return null;
    }

    /** Pre-rendered emoji glyph (device px font size `px`) with outline variant. Returns a canvas.
     *  v8: `glyph` may also be a loaded image (unit portrait), drawn in place of the text. */
    _glyph(glyph, px, variant, flip) {
      let gid = this._glyphIds.get(glyph);
      if (gid === undefined) { gid = this._glyphIds.size + 1; this._glyphIds.set(glyph, gid); }
      const key = ((gid * 1024 + px) * 16 + variant) * 2 + (flip ? 1 : 0);
      let cv = this._glyphCache.get(key);
      if (cv === undefined) {
        if (this._glyphCache.size >= GLYPH_CACHE_MAX) {
          this._glyphCache.forEach(freeCanvas);
          this._glyphCache.clear();
          this._cacheGen++;
        }
        cv = this._makeGlyph(glyph, px, variant, flip);
        this._glyphCache.set(key, cv);
      }
      return cv;
    }

    _makeGlyph(glyph, px, variant, flip) {
      const o = variant === V_PLAIN ? 0 : Math.max(1, Math.round(px * 0.055));
      const pad = o + 2 + Math.ceil(px * 0.14);
      const S = px + pad * 2;
      const cv = makeCanvas(S, S);
      if (!cv) return null;
      const g = cv.getContext('2d');
      const A = this._scratchCanvas(0, S);
      const ga = A.getContext('2d');
      ga.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
      ga.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
      ga.globalAlpha = 1;
      ga.clearRect(0, 0, A.width, A.height);
      ga.font = px + 'px ' + FONT_EMOJI;
      ga.textAlign = 'left';
      ga.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
      ga.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      const mt = ga.measureText(glyph);
      let gx, gy;
      const asc = mt && mt.actualBoundingBoxAscent, desc = mt && mt.actualBoundingBoxDescent;
      if (typeof asc === 'number' && isFinite(asc) && typeof desc === 'number' && asc + desc > px * 0.3) {
        const l = mt.actualBoundingBoxLeft || 0, r = typeof mt.actualBoundingBoxRight === 'number' ? mt.actualBoundingBoxRight : mt.width;
        gx = S / 2 - (r - l) / 2;
        gy = S / 2 + (asc - desc) / 2;
      } else {
        gx = S / 2 - ((mt && mt.width) || px) / 2;
        gy = S / 2 + px * 0.36;
      }
      if (flip) ga.setTransform(-1, 0, 0, 1, S, 0);
      if (typeof glyph === 'string') ga.fillText(glyph, gx, gy);
      else {
        // portrait: fit its height to ~1.2 glyph sizes, centred (smooth high-quality downscale)
        const ih = glyph.naturalHeight || glyph.height || 1, iw = glyph.naturalWidth || glyph.width || 1;
        const dh = Math.min(S - 2, px * 1.2), dw = dh * iw / ih;
        ga.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
        if ('imageSmoothingQuality' in ga) ga.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high';
        ga.drawImage(glyph, (S - dw) / 2, (S - dh) / 2, dw, dh);
      }
      ga.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
      if (o > 0) {
        const B = this._scratchCanvas(1, S);
        const gb = B.getContext('2d');
        gb.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
        const outline = variant === V_GHOST ? '#ffffff' : (variant === V_BAD ? '#ff3b30' : TEAM[variant & 1].main);
        for (let pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {
          gb.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
          gb.clearRect(0, 0, B.width, B.height);
          gb.drawImage(A, 0, 0);
          gb.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-in';
          gb.fillStyle = pass === 0 ? OUTLINE_DARK : outline;
          gb.fillRect(0, 0, B.width, B.height);
          gb.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
          const rr = pass === 0 ? o + 1 : o;
          const steps = 12;
          for (let j = 0; j < steps; j++) {
            const an = j / steps * TAU;
            g.drawImage(B, Math.round(Math.cos(an) * rr), Math.round(Math.sin(an) * rr));
          }
        }
      }
      g.drawImage(A, 0, 0);
      if (variant === V_ICE0 || variant === V_ICE0 + 1) {
        g.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-atop';
        g.fillStyle = 'rgba(150,220,255,0.55)';
        g.fillRect(0, 0, S, S);
      } else if (variant === V_GHOST) {
        g.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-atop';
        g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.38)';
        g.fillRect(0, 0, S, S);
      } else if (variant === V_BAD) {
        g.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-atop';
        g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,50,40,0.55)';
        g.fillRect(0, 0, S, S);
      }
      g.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
      return cv;
    }

    /** Glyph sprite for an entity memo (cached on the memo; no allocation when unchanged). */
    _unitSprite(m, cssSize, variant, flip) {
      let px = Math.round(cssSize * this.dpr);
      px = px <= 64 ? (px + 1) & ~1 : (px + 2) & ~3;
      if (px < 8) px = 8;
      if (px > 400) px = 400;
      if (m.spr && m.sprGen === this._cacheGen && m.sprPx === px && m.sprVar === variant && m.sprFlip === flip) return m.spr;
      // v8: a high-res 3D portrait of the unit (CR.GFX) replaces the glyph once it is loaded
      const img = this._portrait(m.ukey, variant === V_TEAM0 + 1 || variant === V_ICE0 + 1 ? 1 : 0);
      const cv = this._glyph(img || m.glyph, px, variant, flip);
      m.spr = cv; m.sprPx = px; m.sprVar = variant; m.sprFlip = flip; m.sprGen = this._cacheGen;
      return cv;
    }

    /** Soft radial glow sprite (64 device px) for a colour. */
    _glow(color) {
      let c = this._glowCache.get(color);
      if (c !== undefined) return c;
      c = makeCanvas(64, 64);
      if (c) {
        const g = c.getContext('2d');
        const gr = g.createRadialGradient(32, 32, 0, 32, 32, 32);
        gr.addColorStop(0, color);
        gr.addColorStop(0.45, color);
        gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
        g.globalAlpha = 1;
        g.fillStyle = gr;
        g.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64);
        // fade the plateau so the glow reads soft
        g.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-in';
        const gm = g.createRadialGradient(32, 32, 0, 32, 32, 32);
        gm.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,1)');
        gm.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
        g.fillStyle = gm;
        g.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64);
        g.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
      }
      this._glowCache.set(color, c);
      return c;
    }

    _drawGlow(color, x, y, r, alpha) {
      if (!(r > 0.5) || !(alpha > 0.01)) return;
      const c = this._glow(color);
      if (!c) return;
      const ctx = this.ctx;
      ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
      ctx.drawImage(c, x - r, y - r, r * 2, r * 2);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- static layer
    _buildStatic() {
      this._staticDirty = false;
      const d = this.dpr;
      const cw = Math.max(1, Math.round(this.cssW * d)), ch = Math.max(1, Math.round(this.cssH * d));
      let cv = this._static;
      if (!cv) { cv = makeCanvas(cw, ch); this._static = cv; }
      else if (cv.width !== cw || cv.height !== ch) { cv.width = cw; cv.height = ch; }
      if (!cv) return;
      const g = cv.getContext('2d');
      g.setTransform(d, 0, 0, d, 0, 0);
      g.globalAlpha = 1;
      g.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
      this._paintStatic(g);
    }

    _paintStatic(g) {
      const W = this.W, H = this.H, ts = this.ts, ax = this.ax, ay = this.ay;
      const cw = this.cssW, ch = this.cssH;
      const aw = W * ts, ah = H * ts;
      // surroundings
      const bg = g.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, ch);
      bg.addColorStop(0, '#2b5821');
      bg.addColorStop(0.5, '#3a6c29');
      bg.addColorStop(1, '#2b5821');
      g.fillStyle = bg;
      g.fillRect(0, 0, cw, ch);
      this._paintSurroundings(g);
      // stone curb + dark grass rim around the field
      rrect(g, ax - 0.3 * ts, ay - 0.3 * ts, aw + 0.6 * ts, ah + 0.6 * ts, 0.4 * ts);
      g.fillStyle = '#7d776a';
      g.fill();
      rrect(g, ax - 0.3 * ts, ay - 0.3 * ts, aw + 0.6 * ts, ah + 0.6 * ts, 0.4 * ts);
      g.strokeStyle = '#4e4a41';
      g.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 0.05 * ts);
      g.stroke();
      rrect(g, ax - 0.16 * ts, ay - 0.16 * ts, aw + 0.32 * ts, ah + 0.32 * ts, 0.25 * ts);
      g.fillStyle = '#4f8a2f';
      g.fill();
      // checkerboard (screen-space parity)
      const ov = 0.6;
      for (let r = 0; r < H; r++) {
        for (let c = 0; c < W; c++) {
          g.fillStyle = ((r + c) & 1) ? GRASS_B : GRASS_A;
          g.fillRect(ax + c * ts, ay + r * ts, ts + (c < W - 1 ? ov : 0), ts + (r < H - 1 ? ov : 0));
        }
      }
      // soft large-scale light variation
      for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        const x = ax + hash01(i * 31 + 5) * aw, y = ay + hash01(i * 17 + 9) * ah;
        const rr = (2 + hash01(i * 7 + 1) * 3) * ts;
        g.fillStyle = (i & 1) ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.035)' : 'rgba(0,40,0,0.035)';
        fillEllipse(g, x, y, rr, rr * 0.7);
      }
      // grass blades
      g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(40,90,20,0.28)';
      g.lineWidth = Math.max(0.7, 0.04 * ts);
      g.beginPath();
      for (let r = 0; r < H; r++) {
        for (let c = 0; c < W; c++) {
          const s = r * 131 + c * 17;
          for (let b = 0; b < 2; b++) {
            const bx = ax + (c + 0.15 + hash01(s + b * 7) * 0.7) * ts, by = ay + (r + 0.3 + hash01(s + b * 11 + 3) * 0.6) * ts;
            const hh = (0.1 + hash01(s + b * 13) * 0.08) * ts;
            g.moveTo(bx - hh * 0.4, by - hh);
            g.lineTo(bx, by);
            g.lineTo(bx + hh * 0.4, by - hh);
          }
        }
      }
      g.stroke();
      // field edge shading
      g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.12)';
      g.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 0.12 * ts);
      g.strokeRect(ax + 0.06 * ts, ay + 0.06 * ts, aw - 0.12 * ts, ah - 0.12 * ts);

      this._paintRiver(g);
      this._paintPlatforms(g);

      // vignette
      const vg = g.createRadialGradient(cw / 2, ch / 2, Math.min(cw, ch) * 0.35, cw / 2, ch / 2, Math.max(cw, ch) * 0.78);
      vg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
      vg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.26)');
      g.fillStyle = vg;
      g.fillRect(0, 0, cw, ch);
    }

    _paintSurroundings(g) {
      const ts = this.ts, cw = this.cssW, ch = this.cssH;
      const fx0 = this.ax - 0.35 * ts, fx1 = this.ax + this.W * ts + 0.35 * ts;
      const fy0 = this.ay - 0.35 * ts, fy1 = this.ay + this.H * ts + 0.35 * ts;
      const cell = 1.5 * ts;
      const nx = Math.ceil(cw / cell) + 1, ny = Math.ceil(ch / cell) + 1;
      for (let j = -1; j < ny; j++) {
        for (let i = -1; i < nx; i++) {
          const s = i * 7919 + j * 104729 + 17;
          const h1 = hash01(s);
          const cx = (i + 0.2 + hash01(s + 1) * 0.6) * cell;
          const cy = (j + 0.2 + hash01(s + 2) * 0.6) * cell;
          const rad = (0.4 + hash01(s + 3) * 0.45) * ts;
          if (cx + rad * 1.3 > fx0 && cx - rad * 1.3 < fx1 && cy + rad * 1.3 > fy0 && cy - rad * 1.3 < fy1) continue;
          if (h1 < 0.3) paintBush(g, cx, cy, rad);
          else if (h1 < 0.48) paintTree(g, cx, cy, rad * 1.25);
          else if (h1 < 0.58) paintRock(g, cx, cy, rad * 0.62);
          else if (h1 < 0.72) paintFlowers(g, cx, cy, rad, s & 1023);
          // else: open grass
        }
      }
    }

    _paintRiver(g) {
      const ts = this.ts, ax = this.ax, aw = this.W * ts;
      const ya = this._by + this.river.y0 * this._my, yb = this._by + this.river.y1 * this._my;
      const top = Math.min(ya, yb), bot = Math.max(ya, yb), hgt = bot - top;
      // banks
      g.fillStyle = '#b99b63';
      g.fillRect(ax, top - 0.24 * ts, aw, hgt + 0.48 * ts);
      g.fillStyle = '#8c7242';
      g.fillRect(ax, top - 0.08 * ts, aw, hgt + 0.16 * ts);
      // pebbles on the banks
      g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)';
      for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
        const x = ax + hash01(i * 3 + 1) * aw;
        const y = (i & 1) ? top - 0.17 * ts : bot + 0.17 * ts;
        fillEllipse(g, x, y, (0.05 + hash01(i * 5) * 0.05) * ts, 0.035 * ts + 0.4);
      }
      // water
      const wg = g.createLinearGradient(0, top, 0, bot);
      wg.addColorStop(0, '#2a7fd0');
      wg.addColorStop(0.5, '#4aa9f2');
      wg.addColorStop(1, '#2a7fd0');
      g.fillStyle = wg;
      g.fillRect(ax, top, aw, hgt);
      // static ripples
      g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.16)';
      g.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 0.05 * ts);
      g.beginPath();
      for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
        const x = ax + hash01(i * 7 + 2) * aw, y = top + (0.2 + hash01(i * 11 + 4) * 0.6) * hgt;
        const l = (0.4 + hash01(i * 13) * 0.6) * ts;
        g.moveTo(x - l, y);
        g.quadraticCurveTo(x, y - 0.12 * ts, x + l, y);
      }
      g.stroke();
      // foam lines along the banks
      g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)';
      g.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 0.06 * ts);
      g.beginPath();
      const seg = 0.6 * ts;
      for (let x = ax; x < ax + aw; x += seg) {
        g.moveTo(x, top + 0.07 * ts);
        g.quadraticCurveTo(x + seg / 2, top + 0.15 * ts, x + seg, top + 0.07 * ts);
        g.moveTo(x, bot - 0.07 * ts);
        g.quadraticCurveTo(x + seg / 2, bot - 0.15 * ts, x + seg, bot - 0.07 * ts);
      }
      g.stroke();
      // bridges
      for (let i = 0; i < this.bridges.length; i++) {
        const b = this.bridges[i];
        const xa = this._bx + b.x0 * this._mx, xb = this._bx + b.x1 * this._mx;
        const l = Math.min(xa, xb), w = Math.abs(xb - xa);
        const y0 = top - 0.34 * ts, y1 = bot + 0.34 * ts;
        g.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.25)';
        g.fillRect(l + 0.14 * ts, top, w, hgt + 0.12 * ts);
        rrect(g, l, y0, w, y1 - y0, 0.12 * ts);
        g.fillStyle = '#b8864f';
        g.fill();
        // planks
        g.strokeStyle = '#7f5530';
        g.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 0.05 * ts);
        g.beginPath();
        for (let y = y0 + 0.3 * ts; y < y1 - 0.1 * ts; y += 0.3 * ts) {
          g.moveTo(l + 0.12 * ts, y);
          g.lineTo(l + w - 0.12 * ts, y);
        }
        g.stroke();
        g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.14)';
        for (let y = y0 + 0.05 * ts; y < y1 - 0.2 * ts; y += 0.6 * ts) g.fillRect(l + 0.14 * ts, y, w - 0.28 * ts, 0.08 * ts);
        // rails
        g.fillStyle = '#6a4425';
        g.fillRect(l, y0, 0.16 * ts, y1 - y0);
        g.fillRect(l + w - 0.16 * ts, y0, 0.16 * ts, y1 - y0);
        g.fillStyle = '#8d5e35';
        for (let y = y0; y <= y1 - 0.2 * ts; y += 0.75 * ts) {
          g.fillRect(l - 0.05 * ts, y, 0.26 * ts, 0.22 * ts);
          g.fillRect(l + w - 0.21 * ts, y, 0.26 * ts, 0.22 * ts);
        }
        g.strokeStyle = '#4f321b';
        g.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 0.04 * ts);
        rrect(g, l, y0, w, y1 - y0, 0.12 * ts);
        g.stroke();
      }
    }

    _paintPlatforms(g) {
      const ts = this.ts;
      for (let i = 0; i < this.layout.length; i++) {
        const L = this.layout[i];
        const king = L.kind === 'king';
        const size = L.size > 0 ? L.size : (king ? 4 : 3);
        const px = this._bx + L.x * this._mx, py = this._by + L.y * this._my;
        const half = (size / 2 + (king ? 0.35 : 0.22)) * ts;
        if (king) {
          // outer plaza ring
          rrect(g, px - half - 0.25 * ts, py - half - 0.25 * ts, (half + 0.25 * ts) * 2, (half + 0.25 * ts) * 2, 0.6 * ts);
          g.fillStyle = 'rgba(120,110,90,0.35)';
          g.fill();
        }
        rrect(g, px - half, py - half, half * 2, half * 2, 0.4 * ts);
        const gr = g.createLinearGradient(0, py - half, 0, py + half);
        gr.addColorStop(0, '#b3b6bd');
        gr.addColorStop(1, '#8a8f98');
        g.fillStyle = gr;
        g.fill();
        g.strokeStyle = '#626771';
        g.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 0.06 * ts);
        g.stroke();
        // slab joints
        g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(60,64,72,0.25)';
        g.lineWidth = Math.max(0.6, 0.03 * ts);
        g.beginPath();
        const n = Math.round(size);
        for (let k = 1; k < n; k++) {
          const o = -half + (half * 2) * k / n;
          g.moveTo(px + o, py - half + 0.1 * ts); g.lineTo(px + o, py + half - 0.1 * ts);
          g.moveTo(px - half + 0.1 * ts, py + o); g.lineTo(px + half - 0.1 * ts, py + o);
        }
        g.stroke();
      }
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- tower sprites
    _towerSprite(king, team, state) {
      const key = (king ? 6 : 0) + team * 3 + state;
      let s = this._towerSpr[key];
      if (s) return s;
      const ts = this.ts, d = this.dpr;
      const bx0 = king ? -2.4 : -1.75, bx1 = king ? 2.45 : 1.95;
      const by0 = king ? -4.25 : -3.75, by1 = king ? 2.25 : 1.75;
      const w = (bx1 - bx0) * ts, h = (by1 - by0) * ts;
      const cv = makeCanvas(w * d, h * d);
      if (!cv) return null;
      const g = cv.getContext('2d');
      g.setTransform(d * ts, 0, 0, d * ts, -bx0 * ts * d, -by0 * ts * d);
      g.lineJoin = 'round';
      paintTower(g, king, TEAM[team], state);
      s = { cv: cv, ox: -bx0 * ts, oy: -by0 * ts, w: w, h: h };
      this._towerSpr[key] = s;
      return s;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- events
    feedEvents(events) {
      if (!events || !events.length || this._destroyed) return;
      const now = this.now || perfNow();
      const ring = this._seqRing;
      for (let i = 0; i < events.length; i++) {
        const ev = events[i];
        if (!ev || typeof ev !== 'object') continue;
        const s = ev.seq;
        if (typeof s === 'number' && isFinite(s)) {
          const si = s | 0;
          if (this._maxSeq >= 0 && si < this._maxSeq - SEQ_MASK) continue;   // stale resend
          const slot = si & SEQ_MASK;
          if (ring[slot] === si) continue;                                    // duplicate
          ring[slot] = si;
          if (si > this._maxSeq) this._maxSeq = si;
        }
        try { this._onEvent(ev, now); } catch (e) { /* a malformed event must never break rendering */ }
      }
    }

    _spawn(type, x, y, r, dur, team, c, now) {
      const e = this._fx[this._fxNext];
      this._fxNext = (this._fxNext + 1) % FX_N;
      e.on = true; e.type = type; e.x = +x || 0; e.y = +y || 0; e.r = r; e.dur = dur; e.team = team; e.c = c | 0;
      e.t0 = now; e.lift = 0; e.seed = (Math.imul(this._fxNext + 1, 2654435761) ^ (now * 1000 | 0)) | 0;
      e.s = ''; e.n = 0; e.x2 = e.x; e.y2 = e.y; e.tier = 0;
      return e;
    }

    _shake(amp, dur, now) {
      if (!this.options.shake) return;
      const left = this._shakeT0 + this._shakeDur - now;
      if (left > 0 && this._shakeAmp * (left / this._shakeDur) > amp) return;
      this._shakeT0 = now; this._shakeDur = dur; this._shakeAmp = amp;
    }

    _entityPos(id) {
      const u = this._curUnits.get(id);
      if (u) return u;
      return this._curTowers.get(id) || null;
    }

    _kingPos(side) {
      let k = null;
      this._curTowers.forEach(function (t) { if (!k && t.side === side && t.kind === 'king') k = t; });
      if (k) return k;
      for (let i = 0; i < this.layout.length; i++) if (this.layout[i].side === side && this.layout[i].kind === 'king') return this.layout[i];
      return { x: this.W / 2, y: side === 1 ? this.H - 3 : 3 };
    }

    _onEvent(ev, now) {
      const t = ev.t;
      const side = ev.side === 1 ? 1 : 0;
      switch (t) {
        case 'hit': {
          const kind = ev.kind;
          if (kind === 'elixir') {
            const e = this._spawn(F_ELIXIR, ev.x, ev.y, 1, 1000, this._team(side), 0, now);
            e.n = typeof ev.elixir === 'number' ? ev.elixir : 1;
            e.lift = 1.2;
            return;
          }
          const tgt = this._entityPos(ev.id);
          const um = this._unitMemo.peek(ev.id);
          if (um) um.hitMs = now;
          else { const tm = this._towerMemo.peek(ev.id); if (tm) tm.hitMs = now; }
          if (kind === 'decay') return;
          let c = 0, r = 1;
          if (kind === 'splash' || kind === 'death') c = 1;
          else if (kind === 'reflect') c = 2;
          else if (kind === 'jump') { c = 3; r = 1.8; }
          else if (kind === 'charge') r = 1.5;
          else if (kind === 'spell') { c = 4; r = 0.8; }
          const e = this._spawn(F_PUFF, ev.x, ev.y, r, kind === 'spell' ? 160 : 230, this._team(side), c, now);
          if (tgt) {
            if (tgt.air) e.lift = AIR_LIFT;
            else if (tgt.kind === 'king' || tgt.kind === 'princess') e.lift = 1.6;
            else e.lift = 0.45;
          } else e.lift = 0.45;
          // instant-hit attackers: zap / beam line from the source
          if (ev.src) {
            const su = this._curUnits.get(ev.src);
            const ls = su ? lineStyle(su.unit) : 0;
            if (ls === 1 || ls === 3) {
              const l = this._spawn(F_LINE, su.x, su.y, 1, ls === 1 ? 200 : 140, this._team(su.side), ls, now);
              l.x2 = +ev.x || 0; l.y2 = +ev.y || 0;
              l.lift = su.air ? AIR_LIFT : (su.building ? 1.0 : 0.6);
              l.n = tgt && tgt.air ? AIR_LIFT : 0.5;
            }
          }
          return;
        }
        case 'death': {
          const um = this._unitMemo.peek(ev.id);
          const rad = um ? um.dist : 0.5;
          const building = !!ev.building;
          const e = this._spawn(F_SMOKE, ev.x, ev.y, building ? Math.max(1, rad) : Math.max(0.35, rad), building ? 700 : 520, this._team(side), building ? 1 : 0, now);
          e.lift = ev.air ? AIR_LIFT : 0.3;
          return;
        }
        case 'spell': {
          this._onSpell(ev, side, now);
          return;
        }
        case 'tower_down': {
          const team = this._team(side);
          const king = ev.kind === 'king';
          const d = this._spawn(F_DEBRIS, ev.x, ev.y, king ? 2.2 : 1.6, 1200, team, 0, now);
          d.lift = 0.6;
          const byTeam = this._team(ev.by === 0 || ev.by === 1 ? ev.by : 1 - side);
          const cr = this._spawn(F_CROWN, ev.x, ev.y, 1, 1600, byTeam, 0, now);
          cr.lift = 2.4;
          this._shake(king ? 9 : 6, king ? 600 : 420, now);
          return;
        }
        case 'king_active': {
          const k = (ev.id && this._curTowers.get(ev.id)) || this._kingPos(side);
          const e = this._spawn(F_WAKE, k.x, k.y, 1, 1000, this._team(side), 0, now);
          e.lift = 2.2;
          const tm = ev.id ? this._towerMemo.peek(ev.id) : null;
          if (tm) tm.hitMs = now;
          return;
        }
        case 'phase': {
          this._onPhase(ev, now);
          return;
        }
        case 'emote': {
          if (!this._emotesEnabled()) return;
          const k = this._kingPos(side);
          const e = this._spawn(F_EMOTE, k.x, k.y, 1, 2500, this._team(side), 0, now);
          e.s = this._emoteGlyph(ev.id);
          // replace an older bubble of the same side
          for (let i = 0; i < FX_N; i++) {
            const o = this._fx[i];
            if (o !== e && o.on && o.type === F_EMOTE && o.team === e.team) o.on = false;
          }
          return;
        }
        case 'deploy': {
          if (!ev.units || !ev.units.length) return;
          this._spawn(F_RING, ev.x, ev.y, 1, 420, this._team(side), 0, now);
          return;
        }
        case 'chaos_pick': {
          const k = this._kingPos(side);
          const up = ev.upgrade || ev.option || ev.pick || null;
          const tier = rarityTier((up && (up.rarity || up.tier)) || ev.rarity || ev.tier || 1);
          const e = this._spawn(F_SPARKLE, k.x, k.y, 2.2, 1100, this._team(side), 0, now);
          e.tier = tier;
          e.lift = 1.8;
          return;
        }
        default:
          return;
      }
    }

    _onSpell(ev, side, now) {
      const card = ev.card || '';
      const kind = ev.kind || '';
      const phase = ev.phase || 'impact';
      const team = this._team(side);
      const R = typeof ev.radius === 'number' && ev.radius > 0 ? ev.radius : 0;
      let st = SPELL_FX[card];
      if (st === undefined) st = SPELL_FX[kind];
      if (phase === 'cast') {
        // instant spells resolve on cast; area spells show a cast ring; thrown spells show nothing yet
        if (kind === 'instant') {
          if (st === undefined || st === S_NONE || st === S_CAST) st = R > 0 ? S_BOOM : S_NONE;
        } else if (kind === 'area') st = S_CAST;
        else return;
      } else if (st === undefined) st = R > 0 ? S_BOOM : S_SPARK;
      const r = R > 0 ? R : 1.2;
      switch (st) {
        case S_FIRE: this._spawn(F_BOOM, ev.x, ev.y, r, 650, team, 0, now); this._shake(3, 200, now); break;
        case S_ROCKET: this._spawn(F_BOOM, ev.x, ev.y, r * 1.1, 760, team, 1, now); this._shake(6, 320, now); break;
        case S_BOOM: this._spawn(F_BOOM, ev.x, ev.y, r, 600, team, card === 'bomb' || card === 'death' ? 3 : 2, now); break;
        case S_ARROWS: this._spawn(F_DUST, ev.x, ev.y, r, 520, team, 1, now); break;
        case S_ZAP: this._spawn(F_ZAP, ev.x, ev.y, r, 420, team, 0, now); break;
        case S_ICE: this._spawn(F_ICE, ev.x, ev.y, r, 620, team, 0, now); break;
        case S_SNOW: this._spawn(F_SNOW, ev.x, ev.y, r, 560, team, 0, now); break;
        case S_BOLT: this._spawn(F_BOLT, ev.x, ev.y, 1, 460, team, 0, now); this._shake(2.5, 160, now); break;
        case S_WOOD: this._spawn(F_WOOD, ev.x, ev.y, Math.max(1, r), 560, team, 0, now); break;
        case S_DUST: this._spawn(F_DUST, ev.x, ev.y, r, 560, team, 0, now); this._spawn(F_WOOD, ev.x, ev.y, 1, 520, team, 1, now); break;
        case S_CAST: {
          const e = this._spawn(F_CAST, ev.x, ev.y, r, 460, team, 0, now);
          e.s = CAST_COL[card] || TEAM[team].light;
          break;
        }
        case S_SPARK: {
          const e = this._spawn(F_SPARKLE, ev.x, ev.y, r, 700, team, 0, now);
          e.tier = card === 'rage' ? 0 : (card === 'clone' || card === 'mirror' ? 1 : 3);
          e.c = 1;
          break;
        }
        default: break;
      }
    }

    _onPhase(ev, now) {
      const ph = String(ev.phase || '');
      let text = '', sub = '', color = '#ffffff';
      // v4 QA: wordless banners (no words in battle) - only numbers / symbols.
      if (typeof ev.banner === 'string' && ev.banner && !/[A-Za-z\u00c0-\u024f]/.test(ev.banner)) { text = ev.banner; color = '#ffe14d'; }
      else if (ph === 'double') { text = '\u00d72'; color = '#f07bff'; }
      else if (ph === 'overtime') { text = '0:00 +'; color = '#ffb13b'; }
      else if (ph === 'triple') { text = '\u00d73'; color = '#ff5fd2'; }
      else if (ph === 'last10' || ph === 'final10' || ph === 'last_10' || ph === 'final' || ph === 'countdown' ||
        ev.last10 === true || ev.final10 === true || ev.lastSeconds === 10) { text = '10'; color = '#ff6b5e'; }
      if (!text) return;
      this._banner(text, sub, color, now);
    }

    _banner(text, sub, color, now) {
      const bs = this._banners;
      let start = now, free = null;
      for (let i = 0; i < bs.length; i++) {
        const b = bs[i];
        if (b.on) {
          if (b.text === text && now - b.t0 < 800) return;   // duplicate trigger
          const end = b.t0 + b.dur;
          if (end - 250 > start) start = end - 250;
        } else if (!free) free = b;
      }
      if (!free) {
        free = bs[0];
        for (let i = 1; i < bs.length; i++) if (bs[i].t0 < free.t0) free = bs[i];
      }
      free.on = true; free.text = text; free.sub = sub; free.color = color; free.t0 = start; free.dur = 2400;
    }

    _emotesEnabled() {
      const o = this.options.emotes;
      if (o === true || o === false) return o;
      return this._emotesOn;
    }

    _emoteGlyph(id) {
      const UI = CR.UI;
      if (UI && Array.isArray(UI.EMOTES)) {
        for (let i = 0; i < UI.EMOTES.length; i++) if (UI.EMOTES[i] && UI.EMOTES[i].id === id && UI.EMOTES[i].emoji) return UI.EMOTES[i].emoji;
      }
      if (typeof id === 'string' && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(EMOTE_GLYPHS, id)) return EMOTE_GLYPHS[id];
      if (typeof id === 'string' && id.length > 0 && id.length <= 4 && id.charCodeAt(0) > 255) return id;
      return '💬';
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- frame
    draw(prev, cur, alpha, opts) {
      const ctx = this.ctx;
      if (!ctx || this._destroyed) return;
      opts = opts || NO_OPTS;
      const now = typeof opts.nowMs === 'number' && isFinite(opts.nowMs) ? opts.nowMs : perfNow();
      this.now = now;
      this.frame++;
      if (!(this.cssW > 0)) this.resize(opts.w, opts.h, opts.dpr);
      else if (opts.w > 0 && opts.h > 0 && (Math.abs(opts.w - this.cssW) > 0.5 || Math.abs(opts.h - this.cssH) > 0.5)) this.resize(opts.w, opts.h, opts.dpr || this.dpr);
      const ls = opts.localSide === 1 ? 1 : (opts.localSide === 0 ? 0 : this.localSide);
      if (ls !== this.localSide) {
        this.localSide = ls;
        this._staticDirty = true; this._overlayDirty = true;
        for (let i = 0; i < this._towerSpr.length; i++) if (this._towerSpr[i]) freeCanvas(this._towerSpr[i].cv);
        this._towerSpr.length = 0;
      }
      this._setMapping();
      if (this._staticDirty) this._buildStatic();
      const eo = this.options.emotes;
      this._emotesOn = eo === 'auto' ? !(CR.UI && typeof CR.UI.BattleScreen === 'function') : eo !== false;
      if (opts.emotes === true || opts.emotes === false) this._emotesOn = opts.emotes;

      let a = +alpha;
      if (!(a >= 0)) a = 1;
      if (a > 1) a = 1;
      if (cur && typeof cur === 'object') {
        if (!prev || typeof prev !== 'object') prev = cur;
        this._checkRestart(cur);
        this._index(prev, cur);
        if (opts.autoEvents !== false && cur.events && cur.events.length) this.feedEvents(cur.events);
      } else cur = null;

      // screen shake
      this._shx = 0; this._shy = 0;
      const sk = (now - this._shakeT0) / this._shakeDur;
      if (sk >= 0 && sk < 1 && this._shakeAmp > 0) {
        const amp = this._shakeAmp * (1 - sk) * (1 - sk);
        this._shx = Math.sin(now * 0.093) * amp;
        this._shy = Math.cos(now * 0.117) * amp * 0.8;
      }

      const d = this.dpr;
      ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
      if (this._shx !== 0 || this._shy !== 0) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#2b5821';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, this.canvas.width, this.canvas.height);
      }
      if (this._static) ctx.drawImage(this._static, Math.round(this._shx * d), Math.round(this._shy * d));
      this._resetT();
      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.lineJoin = 'round';

      this._drawWater(now);
      const drag = cur && opts.drag && (opts.drag.cardId || opts.drag.card) ? opts.drag : null;
      if (cur) {
        this._collect(prev, cur, a, now);
        this._drawAreas(prev, cur, a, now);
        if (drag) this._drawDeployOverlay(drag, cur);
        this._drawGroundPass(now);
        this._drawProjectiles(prev, cur, a, now, true);
        this._sortRecs(this._ground, this._nGround);
        for (let i = 0; i < this._nGround; i++) {
          const r = this._ground[i];
          if (r.t === R_TOWER) this._drawTower(r, now);
          else this._drawUnit(r, now);
        }
        this._sortRecs(this._air, this._nAir);
        for (let i = 0; i < this._nAir; i++) this._drawUnit(this._air[i], now);
        this._drawBeams(now);
        this._drawProjectiles(prev, cur, a, now, false);
      }
      this._drawEffects(now, false);
      if (cur) this._drawBars(now);
      this._drawEffects(now, true);
      if (drag) this._drawGhost(drag, now);
      if (cur) this._drawCountdown(cur, now);
      this._drawBanners(now);

      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
      if ((this.frame & 15) === 0) {
        const f = this.frame;
        this._unitMemo.sweep(f); this._projMemo.sweep(f); this._areaMemo.sweep(f); this._towerMemo.sweep(f);
      }
    }

    _checkRestart(cur) {
      const tk = typeof cur.tick === 'number' ? cur.tick : -1;
      if (tk >= 0 && this._lastTick >= 0 && tk + 40 < this._lastTick) this.reset();
      if (tk >= 0) this._lastTick = tk;
    }

    _index(prev, cur) {
      if (cur !== this._curRef) {
        this._curRef = cur;
        const cu = this._curUnits;
        cu.clear();
        const us = cur.units || EMPTY;
        for (let i = 0; i < us.length; i++) if (us[i]) cu.set(us[i].id, us[i]);
        const ct = this._curTowers;
        ct.clear();
        const tw = cur.towers || EMPTY;
        for (let i = 0; i < tw.length; i++) if (tw[i]) ct.set(tw[i].id, tw[i]);
      }
      if (prev !== this._prevRef) {
        this._prevRef = prev;
        const pu = this._prevUnits, pp = this._prevProj, pa = this._prevAreas;
        pu.clear(); pp.clear(); pa.clear();
        const us = prev.units || EMPTY;
        for (let i = 0; i < us.length; i++) if (us[i]) pu.set(us[i].id, us[i]);
        const ps = prev.projectiles || EMPTY;
        for (let i = 0; i < ps.length; i++) if (ps[i]) pp.set(ps[i].id, ps[i]);
        const as = prev.areas || EMPTY;
        for (let i = 0; i < as.length; i++) if (as[i]) pa.set(as[i].id, as[i]);
      }
    }

    _rec() {
      let r = this._recs[this._nRecs];
      if (!r) { r = new Rec(); this._recs.push(r); }
      this._nRecs++;
      return r;
    }

    _sortRecs(arr, n) {
      for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        const r = arr[i], k = r.sort;
        let j = i - 1;
        while (j >= 0 && arr[j].sort > k) { arr[j + 1] = arr[j]; j--; }
        arr[j + 1] = r;
      }
    }

    _collect(prev, cur, a, now) {
      this._nRecs = 0; this._nGround = 0; this._nAir = 0;
      const ts = this.ts, mx = this._mx, my = this._my, bx = this._bx, by = this._by;
      const frame = this.frame;
      const flipX = this._mx < 0 ? -1 : 1;
      const us = cur.units || EMPTY;
      for (let i = 0; i < us.length; i++) {
        const u = us[i];
        if (!u) continue;
        const p = this._prevUnits.get(u.id);
        const m = this._unitMemo.get(u.id, now, frame);
        if (m.ukey !== u.unit) {
          m.ukey = u.unit;
          m.glyph = glyphFor(u.unit, u.card);
          m.scale = scaleFor(u.unit);
          m.spr = null;
        }
        let x = +u.x || 0, y = +u.y || 0, z = +u.z || 0;
        if (p !== undefined && p !== u) {
          const dx = x - p.x, dy = y - p.y;
          if (dx * dx + dy * dy < TELEPORT2) { x = p.x + dx * a; y = p.y + dy * a; }
          if (p.z || z) z = (+p.z || 0) + (z - (+p.z || 0)) * a;
        }
        const rad = u.radius > 0 ? u.radius : 0.5;
        m.dist = rad;
        const building = !!u.building;
        const air = !!u.air && !building;
        let size;
        if (building) size = (u.size > 0 ? u.size : rad * 2) * 0.92;
        else size = (0.75 + rad * 1.5) * m.scale;
        size = clamp(size, 0.8, 3.6);
        const fx = u.fx | 0;
        // fade-in of entities that first appeared in the newer view (time based, so it stays
        // continuous when the entity shows up in both views one tick later) + deploy translucency
        const age = now - m.born;
        let al = age < FADE_MS ? clamp(age / FADE_MS, 0, 1) : 1;
        const deploying = u.state === 'deploying';
        if (deploying) {
          const dl = +u.deployLeft || 0;
          if (dl > m.deployMax) m.deployMax = dl;
          al *= (fx & 32) ? 0.9 : 0.62;
        }
        // facing (screen space)
        const dir = +u.dir;
        if (dir === dir) {
          const c = Math.cos(dir) * flipX;
          if (c > 0.28) m.face = -1;
          else if (c < -0.28) m.face = 1;
        }
        // status transitions
        if ((fx & 1) && !(m.lastFx & 1)) m.stunMs = now;
        m.lastFx = fx;
        const r = this._rec();
        r.e = u; r.m = m;
        r.px = bx + x * mx; r.py = by + y * my;
        r.rad = rad; r.size = size; r.a = al; r.team = this._team(u.side);
        r.deploy = deploying;
        // lunge toward the target while winding up (melee feel), small recoil for ranged
        r.lx = 0; r.ly = 0;
        const ap = +u.attackProg || 0;
        if (ap > 0 && u.state === 'attacking' && !building && dir === dir) {
          const L = (ap < 0.75 ? -0.07 * (ap / 0.75) : -0.07 + 0.3 * ((ap - 0.75) / 0.25)) * (0.45 + rad * 0.6);
          r.lx = Math.cos(dir) * L * mx;
          r.ly = Math.sin(dir) * L * my;
        }
        if (air) {
          const bob = Math.sin(now * 0.0035 + (u.id | 0) * 1.7) * 0.07;
          r.z = AIR_LIFT + bob + z;
          r.t = R_AIR;
          this._air[this._nAir++] = r;
        } else {
          r.z = z;
          r.t = building ? R_BUILDING : R_UNIT;
          this._ground[this._nGround++] = r;
        }
        r.sort = r.py;
        r.top = r.py + r.ly - r.z * ts - size * ts * 0.9;
        m.lpx = r.px; m.lpy = r.py; m.llift = r.z;
      }
      const tw = cur.towers || EMPTY;
      for (let i = 0; i < tw.length; i++) {
        const t = tw[i];
        if (!t) continue;
        const m = this._towerMemo.get(t.id, now, frame);
        const r = this._rec();
        r.t = R_TOWER; r.e = t; r.m = m;
        r.px = bx + t.x * mx; r.py = by + t.y * my;
        r.lx = 0; r.ly = 0; r.z = 0;
        r.size = t.size > 0 ? t.size : (t.kind === 'king' ? 4 : 3);
        r.rad = r.size / 2; r.a = 1; r.team = this._team(t.side);
        r.sort = r.py + 0.2 * ts; r.deploy = false;
        r.top = r.py - (t.kind === 'king' ? 3.2 : 3.0) * ts;
        const ap = +t.attackProg || 0;
        if (m.lastProg > 0.5 && ap < m.lastProg - 0.3) m.shotMs = now;
        m.lastProg = ap;
        if ((t.fx & 1) && !(m.lastFx & 1)) m.stunMs = now;
        m.lastFx = t.fx | 0;
        this._ground[this._nGround++] = r;
      }
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- water
    _drawWater(now) {
      const ctx = this.ctx, ts = this.ts, W = this.W;
      const y0 = this.river.y0, y1 = this.river.y1, h = y1 - y0;
      if (!(h > 0)) return;
      const t = now / 1000;
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 0.07 * ts);
      const br = this.bridges;
      for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        const sp = (0.22 + hash01(i * 7 + 3) * 0.32) * ((i & 1) ? 1 : -1);
        let x = hash01(i * 13 + 1) * W + t * sp;
        x = ((x % W) + W) % W;
        const len = 0.35 + hash01(i * 5 + 2) * 0.55;
        let blocked = x + len > W;
        for (let b = 0; b < br.length && !blocked; b++) if (x + len > br[b].x0 - 0.1 && x < br[b].x1 + 0.1) blocked = true;
        if (blocked) continue;
        const y = y0 + h * (0.18 + hash01(i * 17 + 5) * 0.64);
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.12 + 0.3 * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * 2.2 + i * 1.7));
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(this._bx + x * this._mx, this._by + y * this._my);
        ctx.lineTo(this._bx + (x + len) * this._mx, this._by + y * this._my);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      // sparkles
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        const k = ((t * 0.6 + hash01(i * 23 + 7)) % 1);
        const x = hash01(i * 29 + Math.floor(t * 0.6 + hash01(i * 23 + 7)) * 3) * W;
        let blocked = false;
        for (let b = 0; b < br.length; b++) if (x > br[b].x0 - 0.2 && x < br[b].x1 + 0.2) blocked = true;
        if (blocked) continue;
        const y = y0 + h * (0.25 + hash01(i * 31 + 2) * 0.5);
        ctx.globalAlpha = Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * 0.7;
        fillStar4(ctx, this._bx + x * this._mx, this._by + y * this._my, (0.08 + 0.08 * Math.sin(k * Math.PI)) * ts);
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- areas
    _drawAreas(prev, cur, a, now) {
      const as = cur.areas || EMPTY;
      if (!as.length) return;
      const ctx = this.ctx, ts = this.ts, frame = this.frame;
      for (let i = 0; i < as.length; i++) {
        const ar = as[i];
        if (!ar) continue;
        const m = this._areaMemo.get(ar.id, now, frame);
        let x = +ar.x || 0, y = +ar.y || 0;
        const p = this._prevAreas.get(ar.id);
        if (p !== undefined && p !== ar) {
          const dx = x - p.x, dy = y - p.y;
          if (dx * dx + dy * dy < TELEPORT2) { x = p.x + dx * a; y = p.y + dy * a; }
        }
        const left = typeof ar.left === 'number' ? ar.left : 1;
        if (left > m.deployMax) m.deployMax = left;
        const fin = clamp((now - m.born) / 180, 0, 1);
        const fout = clamp(left / 0.35, 0, 1);
        const k = fin * fout;
        if (k <= 0.01) continue;
        const R = Math.max(0.2, +ar.radius || 1) * ts;
        const px = this._bx + x * this._mx, py = this._by + y * this._my;
        const st = AREA[ar.kind] !== undefined ? AREA[ar.kind] : A_GENERIC;
        const team = this._team(ar.side);
        const seed = (ar.id | 0) * 97;
        const tt = now / 1000;
        switch (st) {
          case A_POISON: {
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.24 * k; ctx.fillStyle = '#9bd23a'; fillCircle(ctx, px, py, R);
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7 * k; ctx.strokeStyle = '#d4ff6a'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, 0.07 * ts);
            ctx.setLineDash(DASH_A); ctx.lineDashOffset = -tt * 14; strokeCircle(ctx, px, py, R); ctx.setLineDash(DASH_NONE);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#e6ff8a';
            for (let j = 0; j < 10; j++) {
              const an = hash01(seed + j) * TAU, rr = Math.sqrt(hash01(seed + j * 3 + 1)) * R * 0.85;
              const ph = (tt * 0.8 + hash01(seed + j * 7)) % 1;
              ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - ph) * 0.75 * k;
              fillCircle(ctx, px + Math.cos(an) * rr, py + Math.sin(an) * rr * 0.8 - ph * 0.45 * ts, (0.05 + ph * 0.1) * ts);
            }
            break;
          }
          case A_FREEZE: {
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3 * k; ctx.fillStyle = '#aee6ff'; fillCircle(ctx, px, py, R);
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.8 * k; ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, 0.08 * ts); strokeCircle(ctx, px, py, R);
            ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 0.05 * ts);
            for (let j = 0; j < 7; j++) {
              const an = hash01(seed + j) * TAU, rr = Math.sqrt(hash01(seed + j * 5 + 2)) * R * 0.8;
              const cx = px + Math.cos(an) * rr, cy = py + Math.sin(an) * rr;
              const s = (0.16 + hash01(seed + j * 9) * 0.12) * ts, rot = tt * 0.6 + j;
              ctx.globalAlpha = (0.5 + 0.4 * Math.sin(tt * 3 + j)) * k;
              ctx.beginPath();
              for (let q = 0; q < 3; q++) {
                const aa = rot + q * Math.PI / 3, cs = Math.cos(aa) * s, sn = Math.sin(aa) * s;
                ctx.moveTo(cx - cs, cy - sn); ctx.lineTo(cx + cs, cy + sn);
              }
              ctx.stroke();
            }
            break;
          }
          case A_RAGE: {
            const pul = 0.92 + 0.08 * Math.sin(tt * 7);
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.22 * k; ctx.fillStyle = '#c04de0'; fillCircle(ctx, px, py, R);
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.75 * k; ctx.strokeStyle = '#ea8bff'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, 0.09 * ts); strokeCircle(ctx, px, py, R * pul);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#f6c2ff';
            for (let j = 0; j < 8; j++) {
              const an = hash01(seed + j) * TAU, rr = Math.sqrt(hash01(seed + j * 3)) * R * 0.85;
              const ph = (tt * 0.9 + hash01(seed + j * 11)) % 1;
              ctx.globalAlpha = Math.sin(ph * Math.PI) * 0.8 * k;
              fillStar4(ctx, px + Math.cos(an) * rr, py + Math.sin(an) * rr - ph * 0.5 * ts, (0.07 + 0.08 * Math.sin(ph * Math.PI)) * ts);
            }
            break;
          }
          case A_TORNADO: {
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.2 * k; ctx.fillStyle = '#a9bdd6'; fillCircle(ctx, px, py, R);
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#eef6ff'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, 0.08 * ts);
            for (let arm = 0; arm < 3; arm++) {
              ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6 * k;
              ctx.beginPath();
              const base = -tt * 5.5 + arm * TAU / 3;
              for (let q = 0; q <= 12; q++) {
                const f = q / 12, an = base + f * 2.6, rr = R * (0.15 + 0.8 * f);
                const xx = px + Math.cos(an) * rr, yy = py + Math.sin(an) * rr * 0.85;
                if (q === 0) ctx.moveTo(xx, yy); else ctx.lineTo(xx, yy);
              }
              ctx.stroke();
            }
            break;
          }
          case A_QUAKE: {
            const jx = Math.sin(tt * 47) * 0.04 * ts, jy = Math.cos(tt * 53) * 0.03 * ts;
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.26 * k; ctx.fillStyle = '#8a5a2b'; fillCircle(ctx, px + jx, py + jy, R);
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7 * k; ctx.strokeStyle = '#3e2712'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.2, 0.06 * ts);
            ctx.beginPath();
            for (let j = 0; j < 7; j++) {
              let an = j / 7 * TAU + hash01(seed + j) * 0.5;
              let cx = px + jx, cy = py + jy;
              ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);
              for (let q = 1; q <= 3; q++) {
                an += (hash01(seed + j * 5 + q) - 0.5) * 0.9;
                const rr = R * q / 3 * 0.92;
                cx = px + jx + Math.cos(an) * rr; cy = py + jy + Math.sin(an) * rr;
                ctx.lineTo(cx, cy);
              }
            }
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.55 * k; ctx.strokeStyle = '#c08a4a'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, 0.08 * ts);
            strokeCircle(ctx, px + jx, py + jy, R);
            break;
          }
          case A_GRAVE: {
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3 * k; ctx.fillStyle = '#3f3358'; fillCircle(ctx, px, py, R);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#7d6aa8';
            for (let j = 0; j < 7; j++) {
              const an = hash01(seed + j) * TAU + tt * 0.3 * ((j & 1) ? 1 : -1), rr = (0.3 + hash01(seed + j * 3) * 0.6) * R;
              ctx.globalAlpha = (0.25 + 0.15 * Math.sin(tt * 2 + j)) * k;
              fillEllipse(ctx, px + Math.cos(an) * rr, py + Math.sin(an) * rr * 0.8, R * 0.28, R * 0.18);
            }
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6 * k; ctx.strokeStyle = '#b9a6ff'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.2, 0.06 * ts);
            ctx.setLineDash(DASH_A); ctx.lineDashOffset = tt * 10; strokeCircle(ctx, px, py, R); ctx.setLineDash(DASH_NONE);
            break;
          }
          case A_HEAL: {
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.2 * k; ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe680'; fillCircle(ctx, px, py, R);
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6 * k; ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff3b0'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 0.06 * ts); strokeCircle(ctx, px, py, R);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
            for (let j = 0; j < 5; j++) {
              const an = hash01(seed + j) * TAU, rr = Math.sqrt(hash01(seed + j * 3)) * R * 0.8;
              const ph = (tt * 1.1 + hash01(seed + j * 11)) % 1, s = 0.1 * ts;
              const cx = px + Math.cos(an) * rr, cy = py + Math.sin(an) * rr - ph * 0.6 * ts;
              ctx.globalAlpha = Math.sin(ph * Math.PI) * 0.8 * k;
              ctx.fillRect(cx - s, cy - s * 0.3, s * 2, s * 0.6);
              ctx.fillRect(cx - s * 0.3, cy - s, s * 0.6, s * 2);
            }
            break;
          }
          case A_BOMB: {
            const urg = clamp(1 - left / Math.max(0.3, m.deployMax), 0, 1);
            const blink = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(tt * (8 + urg * 22));
            ctx.globalAlpha = (0.12 + 0.18 * blink) * k; ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4a3a'; fillCircle(ctx, px, py, R);
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.8 * k; ctx.strokeStyle = '#ff6b5e'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, 0.08 * ts);
            ctx.setLineDash(DASH_A); ctx.lineDashOffset = -tt * 20; strokeCircle(ctx, px, py, R); ctx.setLineDash(DASH_NONE);
            // the bomb itself
            const bs = 0.42 * ts;
            ctx.globalAlpha = k;
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)'; fillEllipse(ctx, px, py + bs * 0.6, bs, bs * 0.4);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#2b2f38'; fillCircle(ctx, px, py - bs * 0.3, bs);
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)'; fillCircle(ctx, px - bs * 0.35, py - bs * 0.65, bs * 0.28);
            ctx.fillStyle = blink > 0.5 ? '#ffe14d' : '#ff7a1a'; fillStar4(ctx, px + bs * 0.55, py - bs * 1.3, bs * (0.35 + 0.25 * blink));
            break;
          }
          case A_DELIVERY: {
            const total = Math.max(0.3, m.deployMax);
            const prog = clamp(1 - left / total, 0, 1);
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.18 * k; ctx.fillStyle = TEAM[team].main; fillCircle(ctx, px, py, R);
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.85 * k; ctx.strokeStyle = TEAM[team].light; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, 0.08 * ts); strokeCircle(ctx, px, py, R);
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6 * k; strokeCircle(ctx, px, py, R * (1 - prog * 0.85));
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.25 + prog * 0.35; ctx.fillStyle = '#000000'; fillEllipse(ctx, px, py, (0.3 + prog * 0.5) * ts, (0.18 + prog * 0.3) * ts);
            if (prog > 0.6) {
              const fall = (1 - (prog - 0.6) / 0.4);
              const cy = py - fall * 6 * ts - 0.5 * ts, s = 0.7 * ts;
              ctx.globalAlpha = k;
              ctx.fillStyle = '#c79a4a'; ctx.fillRect(px - s / 2, cy - s / 2, s, s);
              ctx.strokeStyle = '#7a5520'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 0.06 * ts); ctx.strokeRect(px - s / 2, cy - s / 2, s, s);
              ctx.fillStyle = TEAM[team].main; ctx.fillRect(px - s * 0.1, cy - s / 2, s * 0.2, s);
            }
            break;
          }
          case A_STRIKE: {
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.8 * k; ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff36b'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, 0.07 * ts);
            const s = 0.45 * ts * (0.8 + 0.2 * Math.sin(tt * 18));
            strokeCircle(ctx, px, py, s);
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(px - s * 1.4, py); ctx.lineTo(px + s * 1.4, py); ctx.moveTo(px, py - s * 1.4); ctx.lineTo(px, py + s * 1.4); ctx.stroke();
            break;
          }
          case A_ZAP: {
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.25 * k; ctx.fillStyle = '#9fe8ff'; fillCircle(ctx, px, py, R);
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.8 * k; ctx.strokeStyle = '#e8fbff'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, 0.07 * ts); strokeCircle(ctx, px, py, R);
            break;
          }
          case A_CLONE: {
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.22 * k; ctx.fillStyle = '#5fe0ff'; fillCircle(ctx, px, py, R);
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.75 * k; ctx.strokeStyle = '#b8f6ff'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, 0.07 * ts);
            ctx.setLineDash(DASH_A); ctx.lineDashOffset = tt * 16; strokeCircle(ctx, px, py, R); ctx.setLineDash(DASH_NONE);
            break;
          }
          case A_DRILL: {
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5 * k; ctx.fillStyle = '#5a3d22'; fillEllipse(ctx, px, py, R * 0.7, R * 0.45);
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6 * k; ctx.strokeStyle = TEAM[team].main; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, 0.07 * ts); strokeEllipse(ctx, px, py, R * 0.75, R * 0.5);
            break;
          }
          default: {
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.18 * k; ctx.fillStyle = TEAM[team].main; fillCircle(ctx, px, py, R);
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7 * k; ctx.strokeStyle = TEAM[team].light; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, 0.07 * ts);
            ctx.setLineDash(DASH_A); ctx.lineDashOffset = -tt * 12; strokeCircle(ctx, px, py, R); ctx.setLineDash(DASH_NONE);
          }
        }
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- deploy overlay
    _drawDeployOverlay(drag, cur) {
      const id = drag.cardId || drag.card;
      const card = cardOf(id);
      const A = CR.Arena;
      let kind = 'own';
      if (A && typeof A.placementKind === 'function') { try { kind = A.placementKind(card || id); } catch (e) { kind = 'own'; } }
      else kind = cardType(card, id) === 'spell' ? 'anywhere' : (cardType(card, id) === 'building' ? 'building' : 'own');
      if (kind === 'anywhere') return;
      // cheap signature of everything that changes the deployable area
      const kc = kind === 'building' ? 2 : (kind === 'anywhere-ground' ? 3 : 1);
      let sig = kc * 7919 + this.localSide * 131;
      const tw = cur.towers || EMPTY;
      for (let i = 0; i < tw.length; i++) sig = (Math.imul(sig, 31) + (tw[i].alive ? 1 : 2) + (tw[i].id | 0) * 7) | 0;
      const us = cur.units || EMPTY;
      for (let i = 0; i < us.length; i++) {
        const u = us[i];
        if (u && u.building) sig = (Math.imul(sig, 31) + Math.round(u.x * 4) * 131 + Math.round(u.y * 4) + (u.size | 0) * 17) | 0;
      }
      if (kind === 'building') sig = (Math.imul(sig, 31) + ((A && typeof A.footprintOf === 'function') ? (A.footprintOf(card || id) | 0) : 2)) | 0;
      if (this._overlayDirty || sig !== this._ovSig || !this._overlay) {
        this._ovSig = sig;
        this._overlayDirty = false;
        this._paintOverlay(card || id, kind, cur);
      }
      if (!this._overlay) return;
      const ctx = this.ctx;
      ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      const d = this.dpr;
      ctx.drawImage(this._overlay, Math.round(this._shx * d), Math.round(this._shy * d));
      this._resetT();
    }

    _simLikeFrom(cur) {
      const st = this._slTowers, su = this._slUnits;
      st.length = 0; su.length = 0;
      const tw = cur.towers || EMPTY;
      const T = CR.RULES && CR.RULES.towers;
      for (let i = 0; i < tw.length; i++) {
        const t = tw[i];
        const king = t.kind === 'king';
        const s = t.size > 0 ? t.size : (king ? ((T && T.king && T.king.size) || 4) : ((T && T.princess && T.princess.size) || 3));
        st.push({ id: t.id, side: t.side, kind: t.kind, lane: t.lane, alive: !!t.alive, x: t.x, y: t.y, size: s,
          x0: t.x - s / 2, y0: t.y - s / 2, x1: t.x + s / 2, y1: t.y + s / 2 });
      }
      const us = cur.units || EMPTY;
      for (let i = 0; i < us.length; i++) {
        const u = us[i];
        if (!u || !u.building) continue;
        const f = u.size > 0 ? u.size : Math.max(1, (u.radius || 1) * 2);
        su.push({ id: u.id, side: u.side, building: true, dead: false, x: u.x, y: u.y, x0: u.x - f / 2, y0: u.y - f / 2, x1: u.x + f / 2, y1: u.y + f / 2 });
      }
      return this._simLike;
    }

    _fallbackGrid(side, kind, cur) {
      const C = Math.round(this.W), Rr = Math.round(this.H);
      const grid = new Uint8Array(C * Rr);
      const sl = this._simLikeFrom(cur);
      const rv = this.river;
      for (let ty = 0; ty < Rr; ty++) {
        for (let tx = 0; tx < C; tx++) {
          const cx = tx + 0.5, cy = ty + 0.5;
          let ok = kind === 'anywhere-ground' ? true : (side === 0 ? cy < rv.y0 : cy >= rv.y1);
          if (cy >= rv.y0 && cy < rv.y1) ok = false;
          if (ok) {
            for (let i = 0; i < sl.towers.length; i++) {
              const t = sl.towers[i];
              if (t.alive && cx > t.x0 && cx < t.x1 && cy > t.y0 && cy < t.y1) { ok = false; break; }
            }
          }
          grid[ty * C + tx] = ok ? 1 : 0;
        }
      }
      return grid;
    }

    _paintOverlay(card, kind, cur) {
      const A = CR.Arena;
      const side = this.localSide;
      let grid = null;
      if (A && typeof A.deployGrid === 'function') {
        try { grid = A.deployGrid(side, this._simLikeFrom(cur), card); } catch (e) { grid = null; }
      }
      const C = Math.round(this.W), Rr = Math.round(this.H);
      if (!grid || grid.length < C * Rr) grid = this._fallbackGrid(side, kind, cur);
      this._ovGrid = grid;
      const d = this.dpr;
      const cw = Math.max(1, Math.round(this.cssW * d)), ch = Math.max(1, Math.round(this.cssH * d));
      let cv = this._overlay;
      if (!cv) { cv = makeCanvas(cw, ch); this._overlay = cv; }
      else if (cv.width !== cw || cv.height !== ch) { cv.width = cw; cv.height = ch; }
      if (!cv) return;
      const g = cv.getContext('2d');
      g.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
      g.clearRect(0, 0, cv.width, cv.height);
      g.setTransform(d, 0, 0, d, 0, 0);
      const mx = this._mx, my = this._my, bx = this._bx, by = this._by;
      // red tint on every non-deployable tile (row runs)
      g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,40,40,0.30)';
      for (let ty = 0; ty < Rr; ty++) {
        let tx = 0;
        while (tx < C) {
          if (grid[ty * C + tx]) { tx++; continue; }
          let ex = tx;
          while (ex < C && !grid[ty * C + ex]) ex++;
          const xa = bx + tx * mx, xb = bx + ex * mx, ya = by + ty * my, yb = by + (ty + 1) * my;
          g.fillRect(Math.min(xa, xb), Math.min(ya, yb), Math.abs(xb - xa) + 0.5, Math.abs(yb - ya) + 0.5);
          tx = ex;
        }
      }
      // diagonal hatch over the red area for clarity
      g.save();
      g.beginPath();
      for (let ty = 0; ty < Rr; ty++) {
        for (let tx = 0; tx < C; tx++) {
          if (grid[ty * C + tx]) continue;
          const xa = bx + tx * mx, xb = bx + (tx + 1) * mx, ya = by + ty * my, yb = by + (ty + 1) * my;
          g.rect(Math.min(xa, xb), Math.min(ya, yb), Math.abs(xb - xa) + 0.5, Math.abs(yb - ya) + 0.5);
        }
      }
      g.clip();
      g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,90,90,0.22)';
      g.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 0.08 * this.ts);
      g.beginPath();
      const step = 0.7 * this.ts, cwc = this.cssW, chc = this.cssH;
      for (let s = -chc; s < cwc + chc; s += step) { g.moveTo(s, 0); g.lineTo(s + chc, chc); }
      g.stroke();
      g.restore();
      // border between deployable and forbidden tiles
      g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.75)';
      g.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 0.06 * this.ts);
      g.beginPath();
      for (let ty = 0; ty < Rr; ty++) {
        for (let tx = 0; tx < C; tx++) {
          if (!grid[ty * C + tx]) continue;
          if (tx > 0 && !grid[ty * C + tx - 1]) { g.moveTo(bx + tx * mx, by + ty * my); g.lineTo(bx + tx * mx, by + (ty + 1) * my); }
          if (tx < C - 1 && !grid[ty * C + tx + 1]) { g.moveTo(bx + (tx + 1) * mx, by + ty * my); g.lineTo(bx + (tx + 1) * mx, by + (ty + 1) * my); }
          if (ty > 0 && !grid[(ty - 1) * C + tx]) { g.moveTo(bx + tx * mx, by + ty * my); g.lineTo(bx + (tx + 1) * mx, by + ty * my); }
          if (ty < Rr - 1 && !grid[(ty + 1) * C + tx]) { g.moveTo(bx + tx * mx, by + (ty + 1) * my); g.lineTo(bx + (tx + 1) * mx, by + (ty + 1) * my); }
        }
      }
      g.stroke();
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- ground pass
    _drawGroundPass(now) {
      const ctx = this.ctx, ts = this.ts;
      // buildings: footprint platforms
      for (let i = 0; i < this._nGround; i++) {
        const r = this._ground[i];
        if (r.t !== R_BUILDING) continue;
        const u = r.e;
        const f = (u.size > 0 ? u.size : r.rad * 2) * ts;
        ctx.globalAlpha = r.a;
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(70,52,34,0.34)';
        rrect(ctx, r.px - f / 2, r.py - f / 2, f, f, 0.22 * ts);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = TEAM[r.team].soft;
        ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, 0.08 * ts);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      // ground units: shadow + team ring; status ground decals
      for (let i = 0; i < this._nGround; i++) {
        const r = this._ground[i];
        if (r.t !== R_UNIT) continue;
        const u = r.e, fx = u.fx | 0;
        if (fx & 32) continue;
        const rx = Math.max(0.3, r.rad) * ts * 1.05, ry = rx * 0.6;
        const T = TEAM[r.team];
        ctx.globalAlpha = r.a * 0.3;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
        fillEllipse(ctx, r.px + 0.06 * ts, r.py + 0.05 * ts, rx * 1.05, ry * 1.05);
        if (fx & 128) this._drawGlow(chaosColor(u), r.px, r.py - r.size * ts * 0.35, r.size * ts * 0.95, r.a * (0.45 + 0.15 * Math.sin(now * 0.006 + (u.id | 0))));
        if (fx & 8) this._drawGlow('#c04de0', r.px, r.py - r.size * ts * 0.3, r.size * ts * (0.9 + 0.08 * Math.sin(now * 0.012)), r.a * 0.55);
        ctx.globalAlpha = r.a * 0.85;
        ctx.fillStyle = T.fill;
        fillEllipse(ctx, r.px, r.py, rx, ry);
        ctx.strokeStyle = (fx & 2) ? '#bfeeff' : (fx & 8 ? '#e58bff' : T.main);
        ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, 0.07 * ts);
        strokeEllipse(ctx, r.px, r.py, rx, ry);
        if (fx & 4) {
          ctx.globalAlpha = r.a * 0.75;
          ctx.strokeStyle = '#7fd8ff';
          ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 0.05 * ts);
          ctx.setLineDash(DASH_A);
          ctx.lineDashOffset = now * 0.01;
          strokeEllipse(ctx, r.px, r.py, rx * 1.3, ry * 1.3);
          ctx.setLineDash(DASH_NONE);
        }
        if ((fx & 16) && r.e.dir === r.e.dir) {
          // speed lines behind a charging unit
          const dir = +r.e.dir, cx = Math.cos(dir) * this._mx / ts, cy = Math.sin(dir) * this._my / ts;
          ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
          ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 0.06 * ts);
          for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
            const off = (j - 1) * 0.28 * ts, ph = ((now * 0.004) + j * 0.33) % 1;
            const sx = r.px - cx * (0.4 + ph * 0.5) * ts - cy * off, sy = r.py - r.size * ts * 0.35 - cy * (0.4 + ph * 0.5) * ts + cx * off;
            ctx.globalAlpha = r.a * (1 - ph) * 0.8;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(sx, sy);
            ctx.lineTo(sx - cx * 0.7 * ts, sy - cy * 0.7 * ts);
            ctx.stroke();
          }
        }
      }
      // buildings: glows
      for (let i = 0; i < this._nGround; i++) {
        const r = this._ground[i];
        if (r.t !== R_BUILDING) continue;
        const fx = r.e.fx | 0;
        if (fx & 128) this._drawGlow(chaosColor(r.e), r.px, r.py - r.size * ts * 0.3, r.size * ts * 0.8, r.a * 0.45);
        if (fx & 8) this._drawGlow('#c04de0', r.px, r.py - r.size * ts * 0.3, r.size * ts * 0.8, r.a * 0.45);
      }
      // air units: detached shadow on the ground
      for (let i = 0; i < this._nAir; i++) {
        const r = this._air[i];
        const rx = Math.max(0.3, r.rad) * ts * 0.95, ry = rx * 0.55;
        ctx.globalAlpha = r.a * 0.28;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
        fillEllipse(ctx, r.px, r.py, rx, ry);
        ctx.globalAlpha = r.a * 0.45;
        ctx.strokeStyle = TEAM[r.team].main;
        ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 0.05 * ts);
        strokeEllipse(ctx, r.px, r.py, rx, ry);
        const fx = r.e.fx | 0;
        if (fx & 128) this._drawGlow(chaosColor(r.e), r.px, r.py - r.z * ts - r.size * ts * 0.4, r.size * ts * 0.95, r.a * (0.45 + 0.15 * Math.sin(now * 0.006 + (r.e.id | 0))));
        if (fx & 8) this._drawGlow('#c04de0', r.px, r.py - r.z * ts - r.size * ts * 0.4, r.size * ts * 0.9, r.a * 0.5);
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- units
    _drawUnit(r, now) {
      const ctx = this.ctx, ts = this.ts, u = r.e, m = r.m;
      const fx = u.fx | 0;
      if (fx & 32) {
        if (u.building) this._drawHatch(r, now);
        else this._drawMound(r, now);
        return;
      }
      const variant = (fx & 2) ? V_ICE0 + r.team : V_TEAM0 + r.team;
      const spr = this._unitSprite(m, r.size * ts, variant, m.face < 0);
      if (!spr) return;
      const dw = spr.width / this.dpr, dh = spr.height / this.dpr;
      let cx = r.px + r.lx, cy = r.py + r.ly - r.z * ts - r.size * ts * (u.building ? 0.36 : 0.42);
      let al = r.a;
      // deploy drop-in (troops fall into the arena)
      if (r.deploy && !u.building) {
        const age = now - m.born;
        if (age < 260) { const q = 1 - age / 260; cy -= q * q * 1.6 * ts; al *= 1 - q * 0.4; }
      }
      // idle bob for ground troops, stronger squash while stunned/frozen is skipped
      if (!r.deploy && r.t === R_UNIT && u.state === 'moving' && !(fx & 3)) cy -= Math.abs(Math.sin(now * 0.012 + (u.id | 0))) * 0.06 * ts;
      ctx.globalAlpha = al;
      ctx.drawImage(spr, cx - dw / 2, cy - dh / 2, dw, dh);
      // hit / stun flash
      let fl = 1 - (now - m.hitMs) / 120;
      const sf = 1 - (now - m.stunMs) / 180;
      if (sf > fl) fl = sf;
      if (fl > 0) {
        ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
        ctx.globalAlpha = al * fl * 0.6;
        ctx.drawImage(spr, cx - dw / 2, cy - dh / 2, dw, dh);
        ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }

    _drawHatch(r, now) {
      const ctx = this.ctx, ts = this.ts;
      const R = Math.max(0.5, (r.e.size > 0 ? r.e.size : r.rad * 2) * 0.36) * ts;
      ctx.globalAlpha = r.a;
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
      fillEllipse(ctx, r.px + 0.05 * ts, r.py + 0.08 * ts, R * 1.05, R * 0.75);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#5e6572';
      fillEllipse(ctx, r.px, r.py, R, R * 0.7);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#7d8593';
      fillEllipse(ctx, r.px, r.py - R * 0.06, R * 0.8, R * 0.55);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(30,34,42,0.6)';
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 0.05 * ts);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(r.px - R * 0.7, r.py - R * 0.06); ctx.lineTo(r.px + R * 0.7, r.py - R * 0.06);
      ctx.moveTo(r.px, r.py - R * 0.55); ctx.lineTo(r.px, r.py + R * 0.45);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#c9ced8';
      for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
        const an = j * Math.PI / 2 + Math.PI / 4;
        fillCircle(ctx, r.px + Math.cos(an) * R * 0.62, r.py - R * 0.06 + Math.sin(an) * R * 0.42, Math.max(1, 0.06 * ts));
      }
      ctx.strokeStyle = TEAM[r.team].main;
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, 0.08 * ts);
      strokeEllipse(ctx, r.px, r.py, R, R * 0.7);
      // faint electric sparkle while waiting underground
      const k = (now * 0.002 + (r.e.id | 0) * 0.37) % 1;
      if (k < 0.25) {
        ctx.globalAlpha = r.a * (1 - k * 4) * 0.8;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#bff4ff';
        fillStar4(ctx, r.px + R * 0.3, r.py - R * 0.4, 0.12 * ts);
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }

    _drawMound(r, now) {
      const ctx = this.ctx, ts = this.ts;
      const R = Math.max(0.35, r.rad) * ts;
      ctx.globalAlpha = r.a;
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.25)';
      fillEllipse(ctx, r.px, r.py + 0.05 * ts, R * 1.1, R * 0.55);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#6b4a2b';
      fillEllipse(ctx, r.px, r.py - R * 0.1, R, R * 0.6);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#8f6a42';
      fillEllipse(ctx, r.px - R * 0.15, r.py - R * 0.25, R * 0.55, R * 0.32);
      // flying dirt clods
      ctx.fillStyle = '#5a3d22';
      for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
        const ph = (now * 0.003 + j / 3) % 1;
        const an = j * 2.1 + (r.e.id | 0);
        ctx.globalAlpha = r.a * (1 - ph);
        fillCircle(ctx, r.px + Math.cos(an) * R * (0.4 + ph), r.py - R * 0.3 - Math.sin(ph * Math.PI) * 0.5 * ts, Math.max(1, 0.07 * ts));
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = r.a * 0.8;
      ctx.strokeStyle = TEAM[r.team].main;
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 0.06 * ts);
      strokeEllipse(ctx, r.px, r.py, R * 1.1, R * 0.62);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- towers
    _drawTower(r, now) {
      const ctx = this.ctx, ts = this.ts, t = r.e, m = r.m;
      const king = t.kind === 'king';
      const state = !t.alive ? 2 : (king ? (t.active ? 1 : 0) : 0);
      const spr = this._towerSprite(king, r.team, state);
      if (!spr) return;
      const x = r.px - spr.ox, y = r.py - spr.oy;
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      ctx.drawImage(spr.cv, x, y, spr.w, spr.h);
      if (state === 2) {
        // lingering smoke for a while after the fall is handled by effects; idle rubble smoke
        const k = (now * 0.0004 + (t.id | 0) * 0.31) % 1;
        ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - k) * 0.22;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#5a5550';
        fillCircle(ctx, r.px + Math.sin(k * 5 + t.id) * 0.3 * ts, r.py - (0.3 + k * 1.6) * ts, (0.25 + k * 0.4) * ts);
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        return;
      }
      const hf = 1 - (now - m.hitMs) / 150;
      if (hf > 0) {
        ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
        ctx.globalAlpha = hf * 0.28;
        ctx.drawImage(spr.cv, x, y, spr.w, spr.h);
        ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      }
      if (!king || t.active) this._drawTurret(r, king, now);
      else this._drawZzz(r, now);
      const fx = t.fx | 0;
      if (fx & 2) {
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.36;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#a8e4ff';
        rrect(ctx, r.px - (king ? 1.7 : 1.1) * ts, r.py - (king ? 3.05 : 2.75) * ts, (king ? 3.4 : 2.2) * ts, (king ? 4.15 : 3.5) * ts, 0.3 * ts);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      }
    }

    _drawTurret(r, king, now) {
      const ctx = this.ctx, ts = this.ts, t = r.e, m = r.m, d = this.dpr;
      const cx = r.px, cy = r.py + (king ? -2.66 : -2.58) * ts;
      let target = r.team === 0 ? -Math.PI / 2 : Math.PI / 2;
      const tid = t.targetId | 0;
      let has = false;
      if (tid) {
        const tm = this._unitMemo.peek(tid);
        if (tm && tm.frame === this.frame) { target = Math.atan2(tm.lpy - tm.llift * ts * 0.6 - cy, tm.lpx - cx); has = true; }
        else {
          const tu = this._curUnits.get(tid);
          if (tu) { target = Math.atan2(this._by + tu.y * this._my - cy, this._bx + tu.x * this._mx - cx); has = true; }
        }
      }
      if (m.aim !== m.aim) m.aim = target;
      else if (has) m.aim += angleDiff(m.aim, target) * 0.35;
      const ang = m.aim;
      const rec = clamp(1 - (now - m.shotMs) / 170, 0, 1);
      const back = rec * rec * 0.16 * ts;
      const ca = Math.cos(ang), sa = Math.sin(ang);
      ctx.setTransform(d * ca, d * sa, -d * sa, d * ca, d * (cx + this._shx - ca * back), d * (cy + this._shy - sa * back));
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      if (king) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#3a3f47';
        rrect(ctx, -0.05 * ts, -0.17 * ts, 0.82 * ts, 0.34 * ts, 0.08 * ts);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#20242a';
        ctx.fillRect(0.64 * ts, -0.21 * ts, 0.17 * ts, 0.42 * ts);
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)';
        ctx.fillRect(0.05 * ts, -0.13 * ts, 0.55 * ts, 0.07 * ts);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#5a6272';
        fillCircle(ctx, 0, 0, 0.3 * ts);
        ctx.fillStyle = TEAM[r.team].main;
        fillCircle(ctx, 0, 0, 0.14 * ts);
        if (rec > 0.6) {
          ctx.globalAlpha = (rec - 0.6) * 2.2;
          ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe49a';
          fillCircle(ctx, 0.95 * ts, 0, 0.2 * ts);
        }
      } else {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#7a5230';
        rrect(ctx, -0.24 * ts, -0.08 * ts, 0.7 * ts, 0.16 * ts, 0.05 * ts);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#4a2f18';
        ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.2, 0.08 * ts);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0.16 * ts, 0, 0.36 * ts, -1.15, 1.15);
        ctx.stroke();
        const pull = (+t.attackProg || 0) * 0.14 * ts;
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
        ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(0.6, 0.03 * ts);
        const ex = 0.16 * ts + Math.cos(1.15) * 0.36 * ts, ey = Math.sin(1.15) * 0.36 * ts;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(ex, -ey);
        ctx.lineTo(ex - 0.12 * ts - pull, 0);
        ctx.lineTo(ex, ey);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle = TEAM[r.team].main;
        fillCircle(ctx, -0.2 * ts, 0, 0.13 * ts);
      }
      this._resetT();
    }

    _drawZzz(r, now) {
      const ctx = this.ctx, ts = this.ts;
      ctx.font = this._fonts.zzz;
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(20,30,60,0.85)';
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, 0.1 * ts);
      const base = r.team === 0 ? 3.5 : 2.4;
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        const k = ((now / 1800) + i / 3) % 1;
        const x = r.px + (0.6 + k * 0.7) * ts, y = r.py - (base + k * 1.0) * ts;
        ctx.globalAlpha = Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * 0.95;
        // v4 QA: a drawn Z (no letters in battle)
        const zs = 0.16 * ts;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x - zs, y - zs); ctx.lineTo(x + zs, y - zs); ctx.lineTo(x - zs, y + zs); ctx.lineTo(x + zs, y + zs);
        ctx.lineJoin = 'round'; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
        const lw = ctx.lineWidth;
        ctx.lineWidth = lw + 0.09 * ts; ctx.stroke();
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.09 * ts; ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff'; ctx.stroke();
        ctx.lineWidth = lw; ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(20,30,60,0.85)';
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- beams (inferno)
    _drawBeams(now) {
      const ctx = this.ctx, ts = this.ts;
      for (let pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {
        const list = pass === 0 ? this._ground : this._air, n = pass === 0 ? this._nGround : this._nAir;
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          const r = list[i];
          if (r.t === R_TOWER) continue;
          const u = r.e;
          if (u.state !== 'attacking' || !u.targetId || lineStyle(u.unit) !== 2) continue;
          const tm = this._unitMemo.peek(u.targetId);
          let tx, ty;
          if (tm && tm.frame === this.frame) { tx = tm.lpx; ty = tm.lpy - (tm.llift + 0.45) * ts; }
          else {
            const tt = this._entityPos(u.targetId);
            if (!tt) continue;
            tx = this._bx + tt.x * this._mx;
            ty = this._by + tt.y * this._my - ((tt.kind === 'king' || tt.kind === 'princess') ? 1.6 : 0.45) * ts;
          }
          const sx = r.px, sy = r.py - r.z * ts - r.size * ts * (u.building ? 0.75 : 0.55);
          const fl = 0.75 + 0.25 * Math.sin(now * 0.05 + i);
          ctx.globalAlpha = r.a * 0.5 * fl;
          ctx.strokeStyle = '#ff5a1a';
          ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, 0.22 * ts);
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sx, sy); ctx.lineTo(tx, ty); ctx.stroke();
          ctx.globalAlpha = r.a * 0.9 * fl;
          ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffe08a';
          ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 0.08 * ts);
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sx, sy); ctx.lineTo(tx, ty); ctx.stroke();
          ctx.fillStyle = '#fff2c0';
          fillCircle(ctx, tx, ty, 0.14 * ts * fl);
        }
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- projectiles
    _drawProjectiles(prev, cur, a, now, ground) {
      const ps = cur.projectiles || EMPTY;
      if (!ps.length) return;
      const ctx = this.ctx, ts = this.ts, frame = this.frame;
      const mx = this._mx, my = this._my, bx = this._bx, by = this._by;
      for (let i = 0; i < ps.length; i++) {
        const p = ps[i];
        if (!p) continue;
        const st = projStyle(p.kind);
        const cat = st[0];
        if ((cat === P_ROLL) !== ground) continue;
        const m = this._projMemo.get(p.id, now, frame);
        const q = this._prevProj.get(p.id);
        let x = +p.x || 0, y = +p.y || 0;
        if (q !== undefined && q !== p) {
          const dx = x - q.x, dy = y - q.y;
          if (dx * dx + dy * dy < TELEPORT2) { x = q.x + dx * a; y = q.y + dy * a; }
        }
        if (!m.started) {
          m.started = true;
          m.sx = q !== undefined && isFinite(q.x) ? +q.x : x;
          m.sy = q !== undefined && isFinite(q.y) ? +q.y : y;
          m.dist = 0;
          m.trailN = 0; m.trailHead = 0;
        }
        const fade = clamp((now - m.born) / 90, 0.25, 1);
        const hasT = typeof p.tx === 'number' && typeof p.ty === 'number' && (p.tx !== 0 || p.ty !== 0) && cat !== P_ROLL && cat !== P_AXE;
        // heights: start (shooter) / end (target) + arc
        const shooterAir = !!(unitData(p.kind) && unitData(p.kind).air);
        const h0 = st[4] >= 0 ? st[4] : (shooterAir ? AIR_LIFT : 0.6);
        const h1 = p.air && !shooterAir ? AIR_LIFT : 0.5;
        let k = 1, h = h0;
        if (hasT) {
          const dt0 = Math.sqrt((p.tx - m.sx) * (p.tx - m.sx) + (p.ty - m.sy) * (p.ty - m.sy));
          const dc = Math.sqrt((p.tx - x) * (p.tx - x) + (p.ty - y) * (p.ty - y));
