          k = dt0 > 1e-3 ? clamp(1 - dc / dt0, 0, 1) : 1;
          h = h0 + (h1 - h0) * k + st[3] * 4 * k * (1 - k) * clamp(dt0 / 6, 0.35, 1.25);
        } else if (cat === P_ROLL) h = 0;
        const gx = bx + x * mx, gy = by + y * my;
        const sxp = gx, syp = gy - h * ts;
        // trail sample
        const tr = m.trail;
        const lastI = ((m.trailHead - 1 + TRAIL_N) % TRAIL_N) * 3;
        if (m.trailN === 0 || Math.abs(tr[lastI] - x) + Math.abs(tr[lastI + 1] - y) + Math.abs(tr[lastI + 2] - h) > 0.06) {
          const wi = m.trailHead * 3;
          tr[wi] = x; tr[wi + 1] = y; tr[wi + 2] = h;
          m.trailHead = (m.trailHead + 1) % TRAIL_N;
          if (m.trailN < TRAIL_N) m.trailN++;
        }
        // screen direction
        let ang;
        if (hasT) {
          const gdx = (p.tx - m.sx) * mx, gdy = (p.ty - m.sy) * my;
          const dt0 = Math.sqrt((p.tx - m.sx) * (p.tx - m.sx) + (p.ty - m.sy) * (p.ty - m.sy));
          const dh = (h1 - h0) + st[3] * 4 * (1 - 2 * k) * clamp(dt0 / 6, 0.35, 1.25);
          ang = Math.atan2(gdy - dh * ts, gdx);
        } else if (cat === P_ROLL && typeof p.tx === 'number') {
          ang = Math.atan2((p.ty - p.y) * my, (p.tx - p.x) * mx);
        } else {
          const pi = ((m.trailHead - 2 + TRAIL_N * 2) % TRAIL_N) * 3;
          ang = m.trailN > 1 ? Math.atan2((y - tr[pi + 1]) * my - (h - tr[pi + 2]) * ts, (x - tr[pi]) * mx) : 0;
        }
        const team = this._team(p.side);
        // ground shadow for lobbed / airborne shots
        if (h > 0.3 && cat !== P_BOLT) {
          ctx.globalAlpha = fade * 0.22;
          ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
          const sr = Math.max(0.12, st[2] * 0.45) * ts;
          fillEllipse(ctx, gx, gy, sr, sr * 0.5);
        }
        this._drawTrail(m, cat, st, fade);
        this._drawProjBody(cat, st, sxp, syp, ang, fade, team, now, p, m);
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }

    _drawTrail(m, cat, st, fade) {
      if (m.trailN < 2 || cat === P_ROLL || cat === P_AXE) return;
      const ctx = this.ctx, ts = this.ts, tr = m.trail;
      const mx = this._mx, my = this._my, bx = this._bx, by = this._by;
      const n = m.trailN;
      if (cat === P_FIRE || cat === P_ROCKET || cat === P_ORB || cat === P_SNOW || cat === P_ICE) {
        ctx.fillStyle = cat === P_ROCKET ? '#d9d4cc' : st[1];
        for (let j = 0; j < n - 1; j++) {
          const idx = ((m.trailHead - n + j + TRAIL_N * 2) % TRAIL_N) * 3;
          const f = (j + 1) / n;
          ctx.globalAlpha = fade * f * (cat === P_ROCKET ? 0.45 : 0.35);
          const rr = Math.max(0.05, st[2] * (cat === P_ROCKET ? 0.4 + (1 - f) * 0.5 : 0.25 + f * 0.25)) * ts;
          fillCircle(ctx, bx + tr[idx] * mx, by + tr[idx + 1] * my - tr[idx + 2] * ts, rr);
        }
        return;
      }
      // line trail
      ctx.strokeStyle = cat === P_BOLT ? '#bff4ff' : '#ffffff';
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, (cat === P_BALL ? 0.1 : 0.05) * ts);
      const i0 = ((m.trailHead - n + TRAIL_N * 2) % TRAIL_N) * 3;
      const i1 = ((m.trailHead - 1 + TRAIL_N) % TRAIL_N) * 3;
      ctx.globalAlpha = fade * (cat === P_BALL ? 0.22 : 0.4);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(bx + tr[i0] * mx, by + tr[i0 + 1] * my - tr[i0 + 2] * ts);
      for (let j = 1; j < n; j++) {
        const idx = ((m.trailHead - n + j + TRAIL_N * 2) % TRAIL_N) * 3;
        ctx.lineTo(bx + tr[idx] * mx, by + tr[idx + 1] * my - tr[idx + 2] * ts);
      }
      ctx.lineTo(bx + tr[i1] * mx, by + tr[i1 + 1] * my - tr[i1 + 2] * ts);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    _drawProjBody(cat, st, x, y, ang, fade, team, now, p, m) {
      const ctx = this.ctx, ts = this.ts, d = this.dpr;
      const size = st[2] * ts;
      const ca = Math.cos(ang), sa = Math.sin(ang);
      ctx.globalAlpha = fade;
      switch (cat) {
        case P_ARROW:
        case P_SPEAR: {
          const L = size, hw = Math.max(1, 0.05 * ts);
          ctx.setTransform(d * ca, d * sa, -d * sa, d * ca, d * (x + this._shx), d * (y + this._shy));
          ctx.fillStyle = st[1];
          ctx.fillRect(-L * 0.5, -hw * 0.5, L * 0.85, hw);
          ctx.fillStyle = cat === P_SPEAR ? '#c9ced8' : '#e8e8e8';
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(L * 0.5, 0); ctx.lineTo(L * 0.3, -hw * 1.8); ctx.lineTo(L * 0.3, hw * 1.8);
          ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
          if (cat === P_ARROW) {
            ctx.fillStyle = TEAM[team].light;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(-L * 0.5, 0); ctx.lineTo(-L * 0.62, -hw * 1.8); ctx.lineTo(-L * 0.36, 0); ctx.lineTo(-L * 0.62, hw * 1.8);
            ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
          }
          this._resetT();
          break;
        }
        case P_BALL: {
          ctx.fillStyle = st[1];
          fillCircle(ctx, x, y, size);
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)';
          fillCircle(ctx, x - size * 0.35, y - size * 0.35, size * 0.35);
          break;
        }
        case P_FIRE: {
          this._drawGlow(st[1], x, y, size * 2.2, fade * 0.8);
          ctx.globalAlpha = fade;
          ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe9a8';
          fillCircle(ctx, x, y, size * 0.55);
          break;
        }
        case P_ORB: {
          this._drawGlow(st[1], x, y, size * 2.4, fade * 0.75);
          ctx.globalAlpha = fade;
          ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
          fillCircle(ctx, x, y, size * 0.45);
          break;
        }
        case P_ICE: {
          this._drawGlow('#a8e8ff', x, y, size * 2, fade * 0.6);
          ctx.setTransform(d * ca, d * sa, -d * sa, d * ca, d * (x + this._shx), d * (y + this._shy));
          ctx.globalAlpha = fade;
          ctx.fillStyle = '#e8fbff';
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(size * 0.9, 0); ctx.lineTo(0, -size * 0.35); ctx.lineTo(-size * 0.7, 0); ctx.lineTo(0, size * 0.35);
          ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
          this._resetT();
          break;
        }
        case P_SNOW: {
          ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
          fillCircle(ctx, x, y, size);
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(160,210,240,0.6)';
          fillCircle(ctx, x + size * 0.25, y + size * 0.25, size * 0.55);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
          fillCircle(ctx, x - size * 0.2, y - size * 0.2, size * 0.5);
          break;
        }
        case P_ROCKET: {
          this._drawGlow('#ffb03a', x - ca * size * 0.7, y - sa * size * 0.7, size * 1.3, fade * (0.6 + 0.3 * Math.sin(now * 0.05)));
          ctx.setTransform(d * ca, d * sa, -d * sa, d * ca, d * (x + this._shx), d * (y + this._shy));
          ctx.globalAlpha = fade;
          ctx.fillStyle = st[1];
          rrect(ctx, -size * 0.6, -size * 0.22, size * 1.1, size * 0.44, size * 0.2);
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
          ctx.fillRect(-size * 0.15, -size * 0.22, size * 0.16, size * 0.44);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#3a3f47';
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(size * 0.5, -size * 0.22); ctx.lineTo(size * 0.78, 0); ctx.lineTo(size * 0.5, size * 0.22); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
          this._resetT();
          break;
        }
        case P_BOLT: {
          this._drawGlow(st[1], x, y, size * 2.2, fade * 0.85);
          ctx.globalAlpha = fade;
          ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
          ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 0.05 * ts);
          ctx.beginPath();
          const s = size * 0.9;
          const ph = (now * 0.03) | 0;
          ctx.moveTo(x - s, y + (hash01(ph) - 0.5) * s);
          ctx.lineTo(x - s * 0.3, y + (hash01(ph + 1) - 0.5) * s);
          ctx.lineTo(x + s * 0.3, y + (hash01(ph + 2) - 0.5) * s);
          ctx.lineTo(x + s, y + (hash01(ph + 3) - 0.5) * s);
          ctx.stroke();
          break;
        }
        case P_AXE: {
          const spr = this._glyph('🪓', Math.max(8, Math.round(size * 1.3 * d / 2) * 2), V_PLAIN, false);
          if (spr) {
            const rot = now * 0.025;
            const cr = Math.cos(rot), sr = Math.sin(rot);
            ctx.setTransform(d * cr, d * sr, -d * sr, d * cr, d * (x + this._shx), d * (y + this._shy));
            ctx.globalAlpha = fade;
            const w = spr.width / d;
            ctx.drawImage(spr, -w / 2, -w / 2, w, w);
            this._resetT();
          }
          break;
        }
        case P_BARREL: {
          const rot = now * 0.012;
          const cr = Math.cos(rot), sr = Math.sin(rot);
          ctx.setTransform(d * cr, d * sr, -d * sr, d * cr, d * (x + this._shx), d * (y + this._shy));
          ctx.globalAlpha = fade;
          ctx.fillStyle = st[1];
          rrect(ctx, -size * 0.45, -size * 0.55, size * 0.9, size * 1.1, size * 0.3);
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillStyle = '#4a3220';
          ctx.fillRect(-size * 0.45, -size * 0.3, size * 0.9, size * 0.12);
          ctx.fillRect(-size * 0.45, size * 0.18, size * 0.9, size * 0.12);
          ctx.fillStyle = TEAM[team].main;
          fillCircle(ctx, 0, 0, size * 0.14);
          this._resetT();
          break;
        }
        case P_ROLL: {
          this._drawRoller(p, m, st, x, y, ang, fade, team);
          break;
        }
        default: {
          ctx.fillStyle = TEAM[team].light;
          fillCircle(ctx, x, y, size * 1.2);
          ctx.fillStyle = st[1];
          fillCircle(ctx, x, y, size * 0.7);
        }
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }

    _drawRoller(p, m, st, x, y, ang, fade, team) {
      const ctx = this.ctx, ts = this.ts, d = this.dpr;
      const ca = Math.cos(ang), sa = Math.sin(ang);
      // distance rolled (for the bark animation)
      const rolled = Math.sqrt((p.x - m.sx) * (p.x - m.sx) + (p.y - m.sy) * (p.y - m.sy));
      if (p.kind === 'boulder' || st[2] < 0.9) {
        const R = Math.max(0.25, st[2]) * ts;
        ctx.globalAlpha = fade * 0.3;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
        fillEllipse(ctx, x + 0.08 * ts, y + R * 0.6, R * 1.05, R * 0.45);
        ctx.globalAlpha = fade;
        ctx.fillStyle = st[1];
        fillCircle(ctx, x, y - R * 0.5, R);
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
        fillCircle(ctx, x - R * 0.3, y - R * 0.85, R * 0.35);
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(40,40,40,0.5)';
        ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 0.05 * ts);
        ctx.beginPath();
        const ra = rolled * 2.2;
        ctx.arc(x, y - R * 0.5, R * 0.6, ra, ra + 1.6);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        return;
      }
      // log / barrel: a cylinder lying across the travel direction
      const L = st[2] * 2 * ts, T = (p.kind === 'barbarian-barrel' ? 0.9 : 0.75) * ts;
      ctx.setTransform(d * ca, d * sa, -d * sa, d * ca, d * (x + this._shx), d * (y + this._shy));
      ctx.globalAlpha = fade * 0.3;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
      ctx.fillRect(-T * 0.35, -L / 2 + 0.1 * ts, T * 0.9, L);
      ctx.globalAlpha = fade;
      ctx.fillStyle = st[1];
      rrect(ctx, -T / 2, -L / 2, T, L, T * 0.45);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#4f321b';
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 0.06 * ts);
      ctx.stroke();
      // bark bands rolling
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(60,36,18,0.55)';
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 0.05 * ts);
      ctx.beginPath();
      const ph = (rolled * 1.6) % 1;
      for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
        const xx = -T / 2 + T * ((j / 3 + ph) % 1);
        ctx.moveTo(xx, -L / 2 + T * 0.3);
        ctx.lineTo(xx, L / 2 - T * 0.3);
      }
      ctx.stroke();
      if (p.kind === 'barbarian-barrel') {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#3e2a1a';
        ctx.fillRect(-T / 2, -L * 0.3, T, L * 0.07);
        ctx.fillRect(-T / 2, L * 0.23, T, L * 0.07);
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = '#c99a62';
      fillEllipse(ctx, 0, -L / 2 + T * 0.2, T * 0.42, T * 0.2);
      fillEllipse(ctx, 0, L / 2 - T * 0.2, T * 0.42, T * 0.2);
      ctx.fillStyle = TEAM[team].main;
      ctx.globalAlpha = fade * 0.9;
      ctx.fillRect(-T * 0.12, -L * 0.04, T * 0.24, L * 0.08);
      this._resetT();
      // dust behind
      ctx.globalAlpha = fade * 0.35;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#d9c7a0';
      for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
        const off = (j - 1) * L * 0.35;
        fillCircle(ctx, x - ca * T * 0.9 - sa * off, y - sa * T * 0.9 + ca * off, (0.18 + 0.1 * hash01(j + ((rolled * 3) | 0))) * ts);
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- bars & status overlays
    _drawBars(now) {
      const ctx = this.ctx, ts = this.ts;
      // towers
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      for (let i = 0; i < this._nGround; i++) {
        const r = this._ground[i];
        if (r.t === R_TOWER) this._towerBar(r, now);
      }
      // units
      for (let pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {
        const list = pass === 0 ? this._ground : this._air, n = pass === 0 ? this._nGround : this._nAir;
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          const r = list[i];
          if (r.t === R_TOWER) continue;
          const u = r.e, fx = u.fx | 0;
          const cx = r.px + r.lx;
          const maxHp = +u.maxHp || 0, hp = +u.hp || 0;
          const damaged = maxHp > 0 && hp < maxHp - 0.5;
          const shield = (+u.shield || 0) > 0 && (+u.maxShield || 0) > 0;
          let top = r.top;
          if ((damaged || shield) && !(fx & 32 && !u.building)) {
            const bw = clamp(r.rad * 2.3, 0.95, 2.4) * ts * (u.building ? 1.15 : 1), bh = Math.max(3.5, 0.2 * ts);
            const x0 = cx - bw / 2;
            let y0 = top - bh - 1;
            ctx.globalAlpha = r.a;
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,12,22,0.8)';
            ctx.fillRect(x0 - 1, y0 - 1, bw + 2, bh + 2);
            const frac = maxHp > 0 ? clamp(hp / maxHp, 0, 1) : 0;
            ctx.fillStyle = TEAM[r.team].bar;
            ctx.fillRect(x0, y0, bw * frac, bh);
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)';
            ctx.fillRect(x0, y0, bw * frac, Math.max(1, bh * 0.38));
            if (shield) {
              y0 -= bh + 1;
              const sf = clamp(u.shield / u.maxShield, 0, 1);
              ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,12,22,0.8)';
              ctx.fillRect(x0 - 1, y0 - 1, bw + 2, bh + 1);
              ctx.fillStyle = '#e3ebf4';
              ctx.fillRect(x0, y0, bw * sf, bh - 1);
            }
            if (fx & 128) {
              ctx.fillStyle = chaosColor(u);
              const s = Math.max(2.5, bh * 0.9);
              ctx.beginPath();
              ctx.moveTo(x0 - s - 2, y0 + bh / 2 - s); ctx.lineTo(x0 - 2, y0 + bh / 2); ctx.lineTo(x0 - s - 2, y0 + bh / 2 + s); ctx.lineTo(x0 - 2 * s - 2, y0 + bh / 2);
              ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
            }
            top = y0 - 2;
          }
          if (fx & 1) {
            // stun stars circling above the head
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe14d';
            const rr = Math.max(0.35, r.rad * 0.8) * ts;
            for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
              const an = now * 0.008 + j * TAU / 3;
              ctx.globalAlpha = r.a * (0.75 + 0.25 * Math.sin(an * 2));
              fillStar4(ctx, cx + Math.cos(an) * rr, top - 0.12 * ts + Math.sin(an) * rr * 0.3, 0.13 * ts);
            }
          }
          if (r.deploy && !(fx & 32)) {
            const total = r.m.deployMax > 0 ? r.m.deployMax : 1;
            const left = clamp(+u.deployLeft || 0, 0, total);
            const prog = 1 - left / total;
            const R = Math.max(0.32, Math.min(0.75, r.rad)) * ts;
            const cy = r.py - r.z * ts - r.size * ts * 0.42;
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.85;
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)';
            ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2.5, 0.13 * ts);
            strokeCircle(ctx, cx, cy, R);
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
            ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, 0.08 * ts);
            if (prog > 0.01) {
              ctx.beginPath();
              ctx.arc(cx, cy, R, -Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2 + prog * TAU);
              ctx.stroke();
            }
          }
        }
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }

    _towerBar(r, now) {
      const ctx = this.ctx, ts = this.ts, t = r.e, m = r.m;
      if (!t.alive) return;
      const king = t.kind === 'king';
      const bw = (king ? 2.9 : 2.35) * ts, bh = Math.max(8, (king ? 0.48 : 0.42) * ts);
      let cy = r.py + (king ? -2.98 : -2.92) * ts;
      if (cy - bh / 2 < 2) cy = 2 + bh / 2;
      const x0 = r.px - bw / 2, y0 = cy - bh / 2;
      const maxHp = +t.maxHp || 0, hp = Math.max(0, +t.hp || 0);
      const frac = maxHp > 0 ? clamp(hp / maxHp, 0, 1) : 0;
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,12,22,0.82)';
      rrect(ctx, x0 - 1.5, y0 - 1.5, bw + 3, bh + 3, (bh + 3) / 2);
      ctx.fill();
      if (frac > 0) {
        ctx.fillStyle = TEAM[r.team].bar;
        rrect(ctx, x0, y0, Math.max(bh, bw * frac), bh, bh / 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.32)';
        rrect(ctx, x0 + 1, y0 + 1, Math.max(bh - 2, bw * frac - 2), bh * 0.36, bh * 0.2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
      // flash of the lost chunk
      const hf = 1 - (now - m.hitMs) / 260;
      if (hf > 0 && frac < 1) {
        ctx.globalAlpha = hf * 0.7;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
        ctx.fillRect(x0 + bw * frac - 2, y0, 3, bh);
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      }
      const hv = Math.ceil(hp);
      if (m.hpVal !== hv) { m.hpVal = hv; m.hpTxt = String(hv); }
      ctx.font = king ? this._fonts.kingHp : this._fonts.towerHp;
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, 0.12 * ts);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(10,12,22,0.9)';
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.strokeText(m.hpTxt, r.px, cy + 0.5);
      ctx.fillText(m.hpTxt, r.px, cy + 0.5);
      if (king) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd23f';
        crownPath(ctx, x0 - 0.05 * ts, cy, bh * 1.15);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#8a5a10';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      if ((t.fx | 0) & 1) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe14d';
        for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
          const an = now * 0.008 + j * TAU / 3;
          fillStar4(ctx, r.px + Math.cos(an) * 0.9 * ts, y0 - 0.35 * ts + Math.sin(an) * 0.25 * ts, 0.16 * ts);
        }
      }
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- effects
    _drawEffects(now, top) {
      const ctx = this.ctx, ts = this.ts, F = this._fx;
      const mx = this._mx, my = this._my, bx = this._bx, by = this._by;
      for (let i = 0; i < FX_N; i++) {
        const e = F[i];
        if (!e.on) continue;
        const isTop = e.type === F_CROWN || e.type === F_EMOTE || e.type === F_ELIXIR || e.type === F_WAKE;
        if (isTop !== top) continue;
        const k = (now - e.t0) / e.dur;
        if (k >= 1) { e.on = false; continue; }
        if (k < 0) continue;
        const px = bx + e.x * mx, gy = by + e.y * my, py = gy - e.lift * ts;
        const seed = e.seed;
        switch (e.type) {
          case F_PUFF: {
            const rr = (0.16 + 0.3 * k) * ts * e.r;
            ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - k) * 0.8;
            ctx.fillStyle = PUFF_COL[e.c] || '#ffffff';
            fillCircle(ctx, px, py, rr);
            ctx.globalAlpha = 1 - k;
            for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
              const an = hash01(seed + j) * TAU, dd = (0.12 + 0.42 * k) * ts * e.r;
              fillCircle(ctx, px + Math.cos(an) * dd, py + Math.sin(an) * dd * 0.8, (1 - k) * 0.07 * ts * e.r + 0.5);
            }
            break;
          }
          case F_SMOKE: {
            const sz = e.r;
            for (let j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
              const an = hash01(seed + j) * TAU;
              const dist = (0.15 + 0.85 * easeOut(k)) * (0.3 + sz * 0.8) * ts * (0.6 + 0.4 * hash01(seed + j + 9));
              ctx.globalAlpha = Math.pow(1 - k, 1.4) * 0.75;
              ctx.fillStyle = (j & 1) ? '#c9c9c9' : '#f2f2f2';
              fillCircle(ctx, px + Math.cos(an) * dist, py + Math.sin(an) * dist * 0.7 - k * 0.45 * ts, (0.16 + 0.3 * k) * (0.6 + sz * 0.6) * ts);
            }
            if (e.c === 1) this._stones(px, gy, e.r, k, seed, 6, '#8d8a84');
            break;
          }
          case F_BOOM: {
            const R = e.r * ts, c = e.c & 3;
            if (k < 0.35) {
              const fk = k / 0.35;
              ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - fk) * 0.85;
              ctx.fillStyle = BOOM_FLASH[c];
              fillCircle(ctx, px, gy, R * (0.35 + 0.75 * fk));
            }
            ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, 1 - k * 1.7) * 0.9;
            ctx.fillStyle = BOOM_CORE[c];
            fillCircle(ctx, px, gy, R * (0.25 + 0.5 * k));
            ctx.fillStyle = BOOM_SMOKE[c];
            for (let j = 0; j < 8; j++) {
              const an = j / 8 * TAU + hash01(seed + j) * 0.6;
              const dd = R * (0.2 + 0.75 * easeOutCubic(k));
              ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - k) * 0.5;
              fillCircle(ctx, px + Math.cos(an) * dd, gy + Math.sin(an) * dd * 0.8 - k * 0.3 * ts, R * (0.16 + 0.2 * k));
            }
            ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - k) * 0.65;
            ctx.strokeStyle = BOOM_RING[c];
            ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 0.14 * ts * (1 - k));
            strokeCircle(ctx, px, gy, R * (0.5 + 0.6 * k));
            break;
          }
          case F_DEBRIS: {
            const R = e.r * ts;
            // dust cloud
            ctx.fillStyle = '#d8cbb0';
            for (let j = 0; j < 9; j++) {
              const an = j / 9 * TAU + hash01(seed + j) * 0.5;
              const dd = R * (0.2 + 0.8 * easeOutCubic(k));
              ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - k) * 0.55;
              fillCircle(ctx, px + Math.cos(an) * dd, gy - 0.6 * ts + Math.sin(an) * dd * 0.7, R * (0.3 + 0.35 * k));
            }
            this._stones(px, gy, e.r, k, seed, 16, '#8d8a84');
            // team coloured scraps
            ctx.fillStyle = TEAM[e.team].main;
            for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
              const an = hash01(seed + 50 + j) * TAU, v = (2 + hash01(seed + 60 + j) * 3) * ts;
              const tt = k * e.dur / 1000;
              const z = Math.max(0, (4 + hash01(seed + 70 + j) * 3) * tt - 7 * tt * tt) * ts;
              ctx.globalAlpha = 1 - k;
              ctx.fillRect(px + Math.cos(an) * v * tt, gy + Math.sin(an) * v * tt * 0.7 - z - 0.5 * ts, 0.22 * ts, 0.14 * ts);
            }
            break;
          }
          case F_CROWN: {
            const up = easeOutBack(Math.min(1, k / 0.4)) * 1.6 * ts;
            const sc = 0.7 + 0.5 * easeOutBack(Math.min(1, k / 0.35));
            const al = k < 0.75 ? 1 : 1 - (k - 0.75) / 0.25;
            const cy = py - up;
            this._drawGlow('#ffd23f', px, cy, 1.4 * ts * sc, al * 0.7);
            ctx.globalAlpha = al;
            const s = 1.1 * ts * sc;
            crownPath(ctx, px, cy, s);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd23f';
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#8a5a10';
            ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, 0.08 * ts);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.fillStyle = TEAM[e.team].main;
            fillCircle(ctx, px, cy + 0.08 * s, 0.12 * s);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
            fillCircle(ctx, px - 0.56 * s, cy - 0.24 * s, 0.07 * s);
            fillCircle(ctx, px, cy - 0.38 * s, 0.07 * s);
            fillCircle(ctx, px + 0.56 * s, cy - 0.24 * s, 0.07 * s);
            break;
          }
          case F_WAKE: {
            const T = TEAM[e.team];
            ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - k) * 0.8;
            ctx.strokeStyle = T.light;
            ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, 0.16 * ts * (1 - k));
            strokeEllipse(ctx, px, gy, (1.5 + 3 * easeOut(k)) * ts, (1.0 + 2 * easeOut(k)) * ts);
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
            ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 0.08 * ts * (1 - k));
            strokeEllipse(ctx, px, gy, (1.0 + 2.2 * easeOut(k)) * ts, (0.7 + 1.5 * easeOut(k)) * ts);
            const pop = easeOutBack(Math.min(1, k / 0.25));
            ctx.globalAlpha = k < 0.7 ? 1 : 1 - (k - 0.7) / 0.3;
            ctx.font = this._fonts.bang;
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
            ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(3, 0.18 * ts);
            ctx.strokeStyle = T.dark;
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe14d';
            const by2 = (e.team === 0 ? py - 1.6 * ts : py + 0.2 * ts) - pop * 0.4 * ts;
            ctx.strokeText('!', px, by2);
            ctx.fillText('!', px, by2);
            break;
          }
          case F_RING: {
            ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - k) * 0.85;
            ctx.strokeStyle = TEAM[e.team].light;
            ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, 0.1 * ts * (1 - k));
            strokeEllipse(ctx, px, gy, (0.4 + 0.8 * easeOut(k)) * ts, (0.25 + 0.5 * easeOut(k)) * ts);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#e8dcc0';
            for (let j = 0; j < 5; j++) {
              const an = j / 5 * TAU + hash01(seed + j);
              const dd = (0.3 + 0.6 * easeOut(k)) * ts;
              ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - k) * 0.6;
              fillCircle(ctx, px + Math.cos(an) * dd, gy + Math.sin(an) * dd * 0.6, (0.12 + 0.1 * k) * ts);
            }
            break;
          }
          case F_ZAP: {
            const R = e.r * ts;
            ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - k) * (1 - k) * 0.55;
            ctx.fillStyle = '#bff4ff';
            fillCircle(ctx, px, gy, R * (0.7 + 0.3 * k));
            ctx.globalAlpha = 1 - k;
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
            ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, 0.08 * ts);
            ctx.beginPath();
            const ph = (now * 0.03) | 0;
            for (let j = 0; j < 7; j++) {
              let an = j / 7 * TAU + hash01(seed + j) * 0.4;
              ctx.moveTo(px, gy);
              for (let q = 1; q <= 4; q++) {
                an += (hash01(seed + j * 13 + q + ph) - 0.5) * 0.7;
                const rr = R * q / 4;
                ctx.lineTo(px + Math.cos(an) * rr, gy + Math.sin(an) * rr * 0.85);
              }
            }
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - k) * 0.8;
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#7fe8ff';
            ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, 0.1 * ts);
            strokeCircle(ctx, px, gy, R);
            break;
          }
          case F_ICE: {
            const R = e.r * ts;
            ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - k) * 0.5;
            ctx.fillStyle = '#d6f4ff';
            fillCircle(ctx, px, gy, R * (0.6 + 0.4 * easeOut(k)));
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
            for (let j = 0; j < 10; j++) {
              const an = j / 10 * TAU + hash01(seed + j) * 0.5, dd = R * (0.2 + 0.9 * easeOut(k));
              ctx.globalAlpha = 1 - k;
              fillStar4(ctx, px + Math.cos(an) * dd, gy + Math.sin(an) * dd * 0.85, (0.12 + 0.12 * (1 - k)) * ts);
            }
            break;
          }
          case F_SNOW: {
            const R = e.r * ts;
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
            for (let j = 0; j < 9; j++) {
              const an = j / 9 * TAU + hash01(seed + j) * 0.5, dd = R * (0.15 + 0.8 * easeOut(k));
              ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - k) * 0.8;
              fillCircle(ctx, px + Math.cos(an) * dd, gy + Math.sin(an) * dd * 0.8, R * (0.18 + 0.12 * k));
            }
            ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - k) * 0.6;
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#cfefff';
            ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, 0.1 * ts);
            strokeCircle(ctx, px, gy, R * (0.6 + 0.4 * k));
            break;
          }
          case F_BOLT: {
            const ph = ((now * 0.04) | 0) & 3;
            const topY = gy - 9 * ts;
            ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - k) * 0.5;
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#9fe8ff';
            ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(3, 0.35 * ts);
            this._boltPath(px, topY, px, gy, seed + ph, 0.9 * ts);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.globalAlpha = 1 - k;
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
            ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, 0.12 * ts);
            this._boltPath(px, topY, px, gy, seed + ph, 0.9 * ts);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - k) * 0.7;
            ctx.fillStyle = '#e8fbff';
            fillCircle(ctx, px, gy, (0.5 + 0.6 * k) * ts);
            break;
          }
          case F_LINE: {
            const sx = bx + e.x * mx, sy = by + e.y * my - e.lift * ts;
            const tx = bx + e.x2 * mx, ty = by + e.y2 * my - e.n * ts;
            ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - k);
            if (e.c === 1) {
              ctx.strokeStyle = '#9fe8ff';
              ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2.5, 0.2 * ts);
              this._boltPath(sx, sy, tx, ty, seed + (((now * 0.05) | 0) & 3), 0.35 * ts);
              ctx.stroke();
              ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
              ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 0.07 * ts);
              this._boltPath(sx, sy, tx, ty, seed + (((now * 0.05) | 0) & 3), 0.35 * ts);
              ctx.stroke();
            } else {
              ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff3b0';
              ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 0.06 * ts);
              ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sx, sy); ctx.lineTo(tx, ty); ctx.stroke();
            }
            break;
          }
          case F_ELIXIR: {
            const rise = easeOut(k) * 1.2 * ts;
            const al = k < 0.7 ? 1 : 1 - (k - 0.7) / 0.3;
            const cx = px, cy = py - rise, s = 0.32 * ts;
            ctx.globalAlpha = al;
            ctx.fillStyle = ELIXIR;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(cx, cy - s * 1.3);
            ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx + s, cy - s * 0.1, cx + s * 0.75, cy + s * 0.45);
            ctx.arc(cx, cy + s * 0.25, s * 0.78, 0.3, Math.PI - 0.3);
            ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx - s, cy - s * 0.1, cx, cy - s * 1.3);
            ctx.closePath();
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
            fillCircle(ctx, cx - s * 0.28, cy + s * 0.05, s * 0.22);
            ctx.font = this._fonts.small;
            ctx.textAlign = 'left';
            ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
            ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, 0.1 * ts);
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#3a0d45';
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
            const txt = e.n === 1 ? '+1' : (e.n === 2 ? '+2' : '+' + e.n);
            ctx.strokeText(txt, cx + s * 1.0, cy);
            ctx.fillText(txt, cx + s * 1.0, cy);
            break;
          }
          case F_SPARKLE: {
            const R = e.r * ts;
            ctx.fillStyle = e.c === 1 ? SPARKLE_COL[e.tier & 3] : rarityColor(e.tier || 1);
            for (let j = 0; j < 12; j++) {
              const an = hash01(seed + j) * TAU, dd = Math.sqrt(hash01(seed + j * 3 + 1)) * R;
              const tw = Math.sin((k * 2 + hash01(seed + j * 7)) * Math.PI);
              ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, tw) * (1 - k * 0.6);
              fillStar4(ctx, px + Math.cos(an) * dd, py + Math.sin(an) * dd * 0.75 - k * 0.5 * ts, (0.1 + 0.12 * Math.max(0, tw)) * ts);
            }
            break;
          }
          case F_DUST: {
            const R = e.r * ts;
            ctx.fillStyle = e.c === 1 ? '#d9c7a0' : '#e8dcc0';
            const n = e.c === 1 ? 12 : 9;
            for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) {
              const an = hash01(seed + j) * TAU, dd = Math.sqrt(hash01(seed + j * 3 + 1)) * R;
              const kk = clamp(k * 1.3 - hash01(seed + j * 5) * 0.3, 0, 1);
              if (kk <= 0) continue;
              ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - kk) * 0.7;
              fillCircle(ctx, px + Math.cos(an) * dd, gy + Math.sin(an) * dd * 0.8 - kk * 0.2 * ts, (0.12 + 0.2 * kk) * ts);
            }
            if (e.c === 1) {
              // arrow shafts stuck in the ground
              ctx.strokeStyle = '#6b4a2b';
              ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 0.05 * ts);
              ctx.globalAlpha = 1 - k;
              ctx.beginPath();
              for (let j = 0; j < 8; j++) {
                const an = hash01(seed + j * 11) * TAU, dd = Math.sqrt(hash01(seed + j * 17)) * R * 0.9;
                const ax2 = px + Math.cos(an) * dd, ay2 = gy + Math.sin(an) * dd * 0.8;
                ctx.moveTo(ax2, ay2); ctx.lineTo(ax2 - 0.08 * ts, ay2 - 0.32 * ts);
              }
              ctx.stroke();
            }
            break;
          }
          case F_WOOD: {
            const tt = k * e.dur / 1000;
            ctx.fillStyle = e.c === 1 ? '#c79a4a' : '#8a5a2e';
            for (let j = 0; j < 8; j++) {
              const an = j / 8 * TAU + hash01(seed + j) * 0.6, v = (1.5 + hash01(seed + j * 3) * 2) * ts * e.r;
              const z = Math.max(0, (3 + hash01(seed + j * 5) * 2) * tt - 9 * tt * tt) * ts;
              const x = px + Math.cos(an) * v * tt, y = gy + Math.sin(an) * v * tt * 0.7 - z;
              ctx.globalAlpha = 1 - k;
              const rot = an + tt * 8;
              const cr = Math.cos(rot) * 0.2 * ts, sr = Math.sin(rot) * 0.2 * ts;
              ctx.beginPath();
              ctx.moveTo(x - cr, y - sr);
              ctx.lineTo(x + cr, y + sr);
              ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, 0.1 * ts);
              ctx.strokeStyle = ctx.fillStyle;
              ctx.stroke();
            }
            break;
          }
          case F_CAST: {
            ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - k) * 0.8;
            ctx.strokeStyle = e.s || '#ffffff';
            ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, 0.14 * ts * (1 - k));
            strokeCircle(ctx, px, gy, e.r * ts * (0.75 + 0.25 * easeOut(k)));
            break;
          }
          case F_EMOTE: {
            this._drawEmote(e, k, px, gy);
            break;
          }
          default: e.on = false;
        }
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }

    _stones(px, gy, r, k, seed, n, col) {
      const ctx = this.ctx, ts = this.ts;
      const tt = k * 1.1;
      for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) {
        const an = hash01(seed + j * 3) * TAU, v = (1.5 + hash01(seed + j * 7) * 3.2) * ts * Math.min(1.4, r * 0.7);
        const vz = 3 + hash01(seed + j * 11) * 4;
        const z = Math.max(0, vz * tt - 7 * tt * tt) * ts;
        const x = px + Math.cos(an) * v * tt, y = gy + Math.sin(an) * v * tt * 0.7 - z - 0.4 * ts;
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1 - k * k;
        ctx.fillStyle = (j & 1) ? col : '#a6a29a';
        const s = (0.1 + hash01(seed + j * 13) * 0.18) * ts;
        ctx.fillRect(x - s / 2, y - s / 2, s, s);
      }
    }

    _boltPath(x0, y0, x1, y1, seed, jag) {
      const ctx = this.ctx;
      const dx = x1 - x0, dy = y1 - y0;
      const len = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) || 1;
      const nx = -dy / len, ny = dx / len;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x0, y0);
      const segs = 7;
      for (let q = 1; q < segs; q++) {
        const f = q / segs, off = (hash01(seed * 7 + q) - 0.5) * 2 * jag;
        ctx.lineTo(x0 + dx * f + nx * off, y0 + dy * f + ny * off);
      }
      ctx.lineTo(x1, y1);
    }

    _drawEmote(e, k, px, gy) {
      const ctx = this.ctx, ts = this.ts;
      const own = e.team === 0;
      const pop = easeOutBack(Math.min(1, k / 0.15));
      const al = k < 0.85 ? 1 : 1 - (k - 0.85) / 0.15;
      const w = 2.3 * ts * pop, h = 1.75 * ts * pop;
      let cx = px, cy = own ? gy - 4.6 * ts : gy + 3.2 * ts;
      cx = clamp(cx, w / 2 + 4, this.cssW - w / 2 - 4);
      cy = clamp(cy, h / 2 + 4, this.cssH - h / 2 - 4);
      ctx.globalAlpha = al;
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.25)';
      rrect(ctx, cx - w / 2 + 2, cy - h / 2 + 3, w, h, 0.45 * ts);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      rrect(ctx, cx - w / 2, cy - h / 2, w, h, 0.45 * ts);
      ctx.fill();
      // tail toward the king
      ctx.beginPath();
      if (own) { ctx.moveTo(cx - 0.25 * ts, cy + h / 2 - 1); ctx.lineTo(cx, cy + h / 2 + 0.45 * ts * pop); ctx.lineTo(cx + 0.25 * ts, cy + h / 2 - 1); }
      else { ctx.moveTo(cx - 0.25 * ts, cy - h / 2 + 1); ctx.lineTo(cx, cy - h / 2 - 0.45 * ts * pop); ctx.lineTo(cx + 0.25 * ts, cy - h / 2 + 1); }
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = TEAM[e.team].main;
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, 0.1 * ts);
      rrect(ctx, cx - w / 2, cy - h / 2, w, h, 0.45 * ts);
      ctx.stroke();
      if (pop > 0.3) {
        const px2 = Math.max(8, Math.round(1.15 * ts * this.dpr / 2) * 2);
        const spr = this._glyph(e.s || '💬', px2, V_PLAIN, false);
        if (spr) {
          const sw = spr.width / this.dpr * pop;
          ctx.drawImage(spr, cx - sw / 2, cy - sw / 2, sw, sw);
        }
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- drag ghost
    _ghostFor(id, side) {
      const gh = this._ghost;
      if (gh.id === id && gh.side === side) return gh;
      gh.id = id; gh.side = side; gh.n = 0; gh.radius = 0; gh.roll = null; gh.foot = 0;
      const card = cardOf(id);
      gh.kind = cardType(card, id);
      gh.glyph = glyphFor(null, id);
      const items = gh.items;
      const push = function (unit, dx, dy) {
        let it = items[gh.n];
        if (!it) { it = { unit: '', glyph: '●', scale: 1, r: 0.5, dx: 0, dy: 0, air: false, building: false, size: 0, memo: new Memo() }; items[gh.n] = it; }
        const ud = unitData(unit);
        it.unit = unit; it.dx = dx; it.dy = dy;
        it.glyph = glyphFor(unit, id);
        it.scale = scaleFor(unit);
        it.r = ud && ud.radius > 0 ? ud.radius : 0.5;
        it.air = !!(ud && ud.air);
        it.building = gh.kind === 'building';
        it.size = 0;
        it.memo.init(0, 0);
        it.memo.glyph = it.glyph;
        gh.n++;
      };
      if (gh.kind === 'spell') {
        const sp = (card && card.spell) || {};
        gh.radius = typeof sp.radius === 'number' ? sp.radius : 0;
        if (sp.kind === 'roll') gh.roll = { width: typeof sp.width === 'number' ? sp.width : 1.95, range: typeof sp.range === 'number' ? sp.range : 10, back: typeof sp.backOffset === 'number' ? sp.backOffset : 0 };
        return gh;
      }
      const f = side === 0 ? 1 : -1;
      const summon = card && Array.isArray(card.summon) ? card.summon : null;
      if (gh.kind === 'building') {
        const A = CR.Arena;
        let foot = 0;
        if (A && typeof A.footprintOf === 'function') { try { foot = A.footprintOf(card || id) || 0; } catch (e) { foot = 0; } }
        const unit = summon && summon[0] ? summon[0].unit : id;
        if (!foot) { const ud = unitData(unit); foot = (ud && (ud.footprint || ud.size)) || 2; }
        gh.foot = foot;
        push(unit, 0, 0);
        items[0].size = foot;
        return gh;
      }
      if (summon && summon.length) {
        for (let s = 0; s < summon.length; s++) {
          const en = summon[s];
          if (!en || !en.unit) continue;
          const count = Math.max(1, en.count || 1);
          const rr = typeof en.radius === 'number' ? en.radius : 0.7;
          let offs = null;
          if (CR.Units && typeof CR.Units.formation === 'function') { try { offs = CR.Units.formation(count, rr, en.formation, en.width); } catch (e) { offs = null; } }
          if (!offs || !offs.length) {
            offs = [];
            if (count === 1) offs.push([0, 0]);
            else for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) { const an = Math.PI / 2 + i * TAU / count; offs.push([Math.cos(an) * rr, Math.sin(an) * rr]); }
          }
          const ox = typeof en.dx === 'number' ? en.dx : 0, oy = typeof en.dy === 'number' ? en.dy : 0;
          for (let i = 0; i < offs.length && gh.n < 40; i++) push(en.unit, (ox + offs[i][0]) * f, (oy + offs[i][1]) * f);
        }
      }
      if (!gh.n) {
        const cc = CR.CAST && typeof CR.CAST.resolveUnit === 'function' ? CR.CAST.resolveUnit(id) : null;
        push(cc || id, 0, 0);
      }
      return gh;
    }

    _drawGhost(drag, now) {
      const id = drag.cardId || drag.card;
      const x = +drag.x, y = +drag.y;
      if (!id || !(x === x) || !(y === y)) return;
      const ctx = this.ctx, ts = this.ts;
      const valid = drag.valid !== false;
      const gh = this._ghostFor(id, this.localSide);
      const px = this._bx + x * this._mx, py = this._by + y * this._my;
      const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(now * 0.008);
      const edge = valid ? '#ffffff' : '#ff4a3f';
      const fill = valid ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)' : 'rgba(255,60,50,0.25)';
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      if (gh.kind === 'spell') {
        if (gh.roll) {
          const f = this.localSide === 0 ? 1 : -1;
          const y0 = y - f * gh.roll.back, y1 = y0 + f * gh.roll.range;
          const xa = this._bx + (x - gh.roll.width) * this._mx, xb = this._bx + (x + gh.roll.width) * this._mx;
          const ya = this._by + y0 * this._my, yb = this._by + clamp(y1, 0, this.H) * this._my;
          ctx.fillStyle = fill;
          ctx.fillRect(Math.min(xa, xb), Math.min(ya, yb), Math.abs(xb - xa), Math.abs(yb - ya));
          ctx.strokeStyle = edge;
          ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, 0.08 * ts);
          ctx.setLineDash(DASH_A);
          ctx.lineDashOffset = -now * 0.02;
          ctx.strokeRect(Math.min(xa, xb), Math.min(ya, yb), Math.abs(xb - xa), Math.abs(yb - ya));
          ctx.setLineDash(DASH_NONE);
        }
        const R = (gh.radius > 0 ? gh.radius : 0.6) * ts;
        ctx.fillStyle = fill;
        fillCircle(ctx, px, py, R);
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.85 + 0.15 * pulse;
        ctx.strokeStyle = edge;
        ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, 0.1 * ts);
        strokeCircle(ctx, px, py, R);
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.8;
        ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 0.05 * ts);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(px - 0.3 * ts, py); ctx.lineTo(px + 0.3 * ts, py);
        ctx.moveTo(px, py - 0.3 * ts); ctx.lineTo(px, py + 0.3 * ts);
        ctx.stroke();
        // card glyph floating above the centre
        const spr = this._glyph(gh.glyph, Math.max(8, Math.round(1.1 * ts * this.dpr / 2) * 2), valid ? V_GHOST : V_BAD, false);
        if (spr) {
          const w = spr.width / this.dpr;
          ctx.globalAlpha = 0.75;
          ctx.drawImage(spr, px - w / 2, py - R - w * 0.55 - 0.1 * ts, w, w);
        }
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        return;
      }
      if (gh.kind === 'building') {
        const f = (gh.foot || 2) * ts;
        ctx.fillStyle = fill;
        rrect(ctx, px - f / 2, py - f / 2, f, f, 0.2 * ts);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = edge;
        ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, 0.1 * ts);
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.8 + 0.2 * pulse;
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      } else {
        // tile highlight under the drop point
        ctx.fillStyle = valid ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.28)' : 'rgba(255,60,50,0.3)';
        const tx = Math.floor(x), ty = Math.floor(y);
        const xa = this._bx + tx * this._mx, xb = this._bx + (tx + 1) * this._mx, ya = this._by + ty * this._my, yb = this._by + (ty + 1) * this._my;
        ctx.fillRect(Math.min(xa, xb), Math.min(ya, yb), Math.abs(xb - xa), Math.abs(yb - ya));
      }
      const variant = valid ? V_GHOST : V_BAD;
      for (let i = 0; i < gh.n; i++) {
        const it = gh.items[i];
        const ux = clamp(x + it.dx, 0.3, this.W - 0.3), uy = clamp(y + it.dy, 0.3, this.H - 0.3);
        const gx = this._bx + ux * this._mx, gy = this._by + uy * this._my;
        let size;
        if (it.building) size = (it.size || 2) * 0.92;
        else size = clamp((0.75 + it.r * 1.5) * it.scale, 0.8, 3.6);
        const lift = it.air ? AIR_LIFT : 0;
        const rx = Math.max(0.3, it.r) * ts * 1.05, ry = rx * 0.6;
        if (!it.building) {
          ctx.globalAlpha = 0.55;
          ctx.fillStyle = fill;
          fillEllipse(ctx, gx, gy, rx, ry);
          ctx.strokeStyle = edge;
          ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, 0.07 * ts);
          strokeEllipse(ctx, gx, gy, rx, ry);
        }
        const spr = this._unitSprite(it.memo, size * ts, variant, false);
        if (!spr) continue;
        const w = spr.width / this.dpr, h = spr.height / this.dpr;
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.62 + 0.12 * pulse;
        ctx.drawImage(spr, gx - w / 2, gy - lift * ts - size * ts * (it.building ? 0.36 : 0.42) - h / 2, w, h);
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- countdown & banners
    _drawCountdown(cur, now) {
      if (this.options.countdown === false) return;
      const c = cur.clock;
      if (!c || cur.over || c.phase === 'ended') return;
      const rem = +c.remaining;
      if (!(rem > 0 && rem <= 10)) return;
      const n = Math.min(10, Math.ceil(rem - 1e-6));
      if (n < 1) return;
      const frac = clamp(n - rem, 0, 1);
      const ctx = this.ctx, ts = this.ts;
      const cy = this._by + ((this.river.y0 + this.river.y1) / 2) * this._my;
      const cx = this.ax + this.W * ts / 2;
      const sc = 1.25 - 0.25 * easeOut(Math.min(1, frac * 4));
      const d = this.dpr;
      ctx.setTransform(d * sc, 0, 0, d * sc, d * (cx + this._shx), d * (cy + this._shy));
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5 * (1 - frac * 0.55);
      ctx.font = this._fonts.count;
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(3, 0.3 * ts);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(20,10,30,0.9)';
      ctx.fillStyle = n <= 3 ? '#ff6b5e' : '#ffffff';
      ctx.strokeText(DIGITS[n], 0, 0);
      ctx.fillText(DIGITS[n], 0, 0);
      this._resetT();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }

    _drawBanners(now) {
      const bs = this._banners;
      const ctx = this.ctx, ts = this.ts, d = this.dpr;
      for (let i = 0; i < bs.length; i++) {
        const b = bs[i];
        if (!b.on) continue;
        const k = (now - b.t0) / b.dur;
        if (k >= 1) { b.on = false; continue; }
        if (k < 0) continue;
        const cy = this._by + ((this.river.y0 + this.river.y1) / 2) * this._my;
        const w = this.cssW, h = (b.sub ? 2.5 : 1.9) * ts;
        const inK = Math.min(1, k / 0.12), outK = k > 0.84 ? (k - 0.84) / 0.16 : 0;
        const al = inK * (1 - outK);
        const slide = (1 - easeOutCubic(inK)) * w * 0.6 - easeOut(outK) * w * 0.6;
        // ribbon
        ctx.globalAlpha = al * 0.82;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#140c28';
        ctx.fillRect(slide, cy - h / 2, w, h);
        ctx.globalAlpha = al;
        ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
        ctx.fillRect(slide, cy - h / 2, w, Math.max(2, 0.08 * ts));
        ctx.fillRect(slide, cy + h / 2 - Math.max(2, 0.08 * ts), w, Math.max(2, 0.08 * ts));
        // text with a pop

/* 10-ui.js – Bust War app shell UI: menus, deck builder, lobbies, battle HUD, input
 * (drag & drop + tap-to-place), C.H.A.O.S picker, emotes, results, sound.
 *
 * v5 (docs/V5.md): the game is called "Bust War"; full-screen deck editor (big card grid, the
 * eight deck slots always visible); settings screen (music / effects volume, mute, vibration,
 * graphics, tempo) wired to CR.Audio (src/13-audio.js, optional); map choice "Klassisch" /
 * "Hügel" with small previews; 1v1 / 2v2 (Single-Modus: you + bot vs two bots; online: four
 * lobby slots, team choice Blau / Rot, bots for empty slots); the battle HUD follows the local
 * PLAYER (own hand, elixir and upgrades; the teammate's elixir small in 2v2); the card name sits
 * small under every hand card (the only words in the battle - the arena stays wordless).
 *
 * v6 (Touchdown): "Spielmodus" choice C.H.A.O.S / Touchdown (+ switch "Touchdown mit
 * C.H.A.O.S-Upgrades") in both menu panes and the host lobby; map previews of the Touchdown
 * field (end zones, no towers); deck editor greys cards Touchdown does not allow (CR.Sim.cardAllowed,
 * UI.deckForMode swaps them for the battle only); battle HUD with football counters + pips
 * instead of crowns, a wordless touchdown burst (team colour, score numbers) and the kick-off
 * countdown; result screen with footballs; German Touchdown rules (docs/TOUCHDOWN.md).
 *
 * v12: third game mode "Klassisch" (ohne C.H.A.O.S = CR.Sim({mode: 'classic'})) next to
 * C.H.A.O.S and Touchdown in both menu panes and the host lobby; third map "Tunnel" (flat, two
 * holes joined by an underground tunnel, CR.Arena.TUNNEL) with preview + rules text; maps are
 * gated per feature (UI.allowedMap: f.hill / f.tunnel); default Spieltempo "Original 1x"
 * (UI.migrateSettings switches a never-chosen stored 1,5x once to 1x; "Schnell" stays).
 *
 * v13: (1) Touchdown needs a BUILDING in every deck: UI.deckForMode -> UI.ensureBuilding puts
 * one in the last slot for the battle only (German hint in the menu panes and both lobbies via
 * UI.buildingSwap; with the draft CR.Draft guarantees it). (2) Ten emoji emotes (UI.EMOTES with
 * .emoji - the explicit user wish, the ONLY emoji in the UI, written as \u escapes); the bubble
 * shows the emoji above the player's king tower for UI.EMOTE_SHOW_MS (~2 s). (3) Switch
 * "Schnelles Elixier (1,5×)" (UI.boostToggle) in both menu panes and the host lobby ->
 * settings.elixirBoost (per device) -> options.elixirBoost = 1.5 (UI.elixirBoostOn, chips).
 *
 * v4 (user feedback): the battle screen is sized like Clash Royale on the phone (arena fills
 * the screen above a compact CR card panel, top info + crowns float on the arena) and shows NO
 * words or names during the fight - card art + cost, numbers and icons only (German text stays
 * in menus, lobbies, deck editor, results and in aria-labels).
 *
 * German UI text, English code. Nothing in this file touches the DOM at load time, so it can be
 * loaded under jsc for the pure-helper tests (tests/test-shell.js). All DOM work happens inside
 * functions that CR.App (11-main.js) calls at runtime.

  /** Two-letter monogram for placeholder card art ('Sir Robust' -> 'SR', 'Zap' -> 'ZA'). */
  UI.initials = function (name) {
    const words = String(name || '').replace(/[^A-Za-zÄÖÜäöüß0-9\s-]/g, '').split(/[\s-]+/).filter(Boolean);
    if (!words.length) return '?';
    if (words.length === 1) return words[0].slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
    return (words[0].charAt(0) + words[1].charAt(0)).toUpperCase();
  };

  // ----------------------------------------------------------------------- pure helpers

  /** Small persistent key/value store. Every localStorage access is wrapped in try/catch;
   *  values also live in memory so the app works when storage is blocked (artifact preview,
   *  private mode, jsc). */
  const memStore = Object.create(null);
  UI.store = {
    get(key, def) {
      let raw = null;
      try {
        const ls = G.localStorage;
        if (ls) raw = ls.getItem(STORE_PREFIX + key);
      } catch (e) { raw = null; }
      if (raw == null && key in memStore) raw = memStore[key];
      if (raw == null) return def;
      try { return JSON.parse(raw); } catch (e) { return def; }
    },
    set(key, value) {
      let raw;
      try { raw = JSON.stringify(value); } catch (e) { return false; }
      memStore[key] = raw;
      try {
        const ls = G.localStorage;
        if (ls) { ls.setItem(STORE_PREFIX + key, raw); return true; }
      } catch (e) { /* storage blocked or full – memory copy is enough */ }
      return false;
    },
  };

  /** Plausible join code (4-8 alphanumerics; CR.Net.isValidCode has the final word). */
  function validCode(c) {
    if (c.length < 4 || c.length > 8) return false;
    if (CR.Net && typeof CR.Net.isValidCode === 'function') {
      try { return !!CR.Net.isValidCode(c); } catch (e) { return true; }
    }
    return true;
  }

  /** Extracts a join code from a typed code, a '#join-CODE' / '#join=CODE' hash, a full link
   *  or pasted message text ("Code: K7P2Q"). Returns the upper-case code or null. */
  UI.parseJoinCode = function (input) {
    if (input == null) return null;
    let s = String(input).trim();
    if (!s) return null;
    const hashAt = s.lastIndexOf('#');
    if (hashAt >= 0) s = s.slice(hashAt + 1);
    else if (/^(?:[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:\/\/|www\.)\S*$/i.test(s)) return null; // a link without join token
    const m = /^\/?join[-=_:.~](.*)$/i.exec(s);
    if (m) s = m[1];
    else if (/^join/i.test(s) && s.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, '').length > 8) s = s.slice(4);
    const whole = s.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, '').toUpperCase();
    if (validCode(whole)) return whole;
    // Message text: the last word that is a valid code (preferring the standard length).
    const toks = s.split(/[^A-Za-z0-9]+/);
    let best = null;
    for (let i = toks.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const t = toks[i].toUpperCase();
      if (!validCode(t)) continue;
      if (t.length === CODE_LEN) return t;
      if (!best) best = t;
    }
    return best;
  };

  /** Join code from a location hash, only when the hash is a join token. */
  UI.joinCodeFromHash = function (hash) {
    if (!hash || !/^#?\/?join/i.test(String(hash))) return null;
    return UI.parseJoinCode(hash);
  };

  /** Hash token for a join link: only [A-Za-z0-9._~-] survive artifact hashes, so no '='. */
  UI.joinHash = function (code) { return '#join-' + String(code || '').toUpperCase(); };

  /** Best-effort shareable page URL (without hash). Inside an iframe (claude.ai artifact) the
   *  embedding page's URL is preferred when it is visible to us. */
  UI.pageBaseUrl = function () { return UI.pageUrlInfo().url; };

  /** { url, known }: the shareable page URL and whether it is trustworthy. Embedded in a
   *  cross-origin iframe (e.g. a claude.ai artifact) whose parent URL is not visible, the own
   *  URL is a sandbox address that would not work for the other player: known = false. */
  UI.pageUrlInfo = function () {
    let href = '';
    try { href = String(G.location && G.location.href || ''); } catch (e) { href = ''; }
    let inFrame = false;
    try { inFrame = G.self !== G.top; } catch (e) { inFrame = true; }
    if (inFrame) {
      try {
        const top = G.top.location.href;
        if (top) return { url: String(top).split('#')[0], known: true };
      } catch (e) { /* cross-origin parent */ }
      try {
        const ref = G.document && G.document.referrer;
        if (ref && /^https?:\/\/[^/]+\/[^#]+/.test(ref)) return { url: String(ref).split('#')[0], known: true };
      } catch (e) { /* no referrer */ }
      return { url: href.split('#')[0], known: false };
    }
    // file:// (opened locally), about:srcdoc or blob: pages have no address another phone can open.
    return { url: href.split('#')[0], known: /^https?:/i.test(href) };
  };

  /** True when the page runs from the home screen (no browser bars). */
  UI.isStandalone = function () {
    try {
      if (G.navigator && G.navigator.standalone === true) return true;
      if (G.matchMedia && (G.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)').matches || G.matchMedia('(display-mode: fullscreen)').matches)) return true;
    } catch (e) { /* no media queries */ }
    return false;
  };

  /** Which 'add to home screen' hint fits: 'ios' | 'android' | null (desktop, already
   *  standalone, embedded page or no web address). ua/touch are injectable for tests. */
  UI.homeHintPlatform = function (ua, touch, standalone, httpPage) {
    const u = String(ua == null ? (G.navigator && G.navigator.userAgent) || '' : ua);
    const isTouch = touch == null ? !!(G.matchMedia && G.matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches) : !!touch;
    const st = standalone == null ? UI.isStandalone() : !!standalone;
    const ok = httpPage == null ? UI.pageUrlInfo().known && (function () { try { return G.self === G.top; } catch (e) { return false; } })() : !!httpPage;
    if (st || !ok) return null;
    if (/iPhone|iPod|iPad/i.test(u) || (/Macintosh/i.test(u) && isTouch)) return 'ios';
    if (/Android/i.test(u)) return 'android';
    return null;
  };

  UI.joinLink = function (code, base) {
    return (base != null ? String(base).split('#')[0] : UI.pageBaseUrl()) + UI.joinHash(code);
  };

  /** Remaining seconds -> 'm:ss' (counts like CR: 180 -> 3:00, 179.2 -> 3:00, 179 -> 2:59). */
  UI.formatClock = function (sec) {
    if (!(sec > 0)) return '0:00';
    const s = Math.ceil(sec - 1e-6);
    const m = Math.floor(s / 60);
    const r = s % 60;
    return m + ':' + (r < 10 ? '0' : '') + r;
  };

  /** German decimal formatting (comma). */
  UI.formatDecimal = function (x, digits) {
    const d = digits == null ? 1 : digits;
    return (Number.isFinite(x) ? x : 0).toFixed(d).replace('.', ',');
  };

  UI.normRarity = function (r) {
    if (typeof r === 'number') return TIER_RARITY[Math.max(0, Math.min(4, r | 0))];
    const s = String(r || '').toLowerCase();
    if (RARITY[s]) return s;
    if (s.indexOf('legend') >= 0) return 'legendary';
    if (s.indexOf('champ') >= 0) return 'champion';
    if (s.indexOf('epic') >= 0 || s.indexOf('epis') >= 0) return 'epic';
    if (s.indexOf('rare') >= 0 || s.indexOf('selten') >= 0) return 'rare';
    return 'common';
  };

  UI.normType = function (t, card) {
    const s = String(t || '').toLowerCase();
    if (s.indexOf('spell') >= 0 || s.indexOf('zauber') >= 0) return 'spell';
    if (s.indexOf('build') >= 0 || s.indexOf('geb') >= 0) return 'building';
    if (s.indexOf('troop') >= 0 || s.indexOf('trupp') >= 0 || s.indexOf('champion') >= 0) return 'troop';
    if (card && card.spell && !card.summon) return 'spell';
    return 'troop';
  };

  function prettifyId(id) {
    return String(id || '?').split(/[-_]/).filter(Boolean)
      .map(function (w) { return w.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + w.slice(1); }).join(' ');
  }

  let catSrc = null;
  let catCache = null;

  /** Card catalogue built from CR.DATA.cards (cached per data identity). */
  UI.catalog = function () {
    const D = CR.DATA;
    let cards = D && D.cards;
    if (cards && !Array.isArray(cards) && typeof cards === 'object') cards = Object.keys(cards).map(function (k) { return cards[k]; });
    if (!Array.isArray(cards)) cards = EMPTY;
    if (catCache && catSrc === D && catCache.src === cards) return catCache;
    const byId = Object.create(null);
    const enabled = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
      const c = cards[i];
      if (!c || !c.id) continue;
      byId[c.id] = c;
      if (!c.disabled) enabled.push(c.id);
    }
    catSrc = D;
    catCache = { src: cards, byId: byId, enabled: enabled, infos: Object.create(null) };
    return catCache;
  };

  /** Merged visual + rules info for one card (CR.CAST visuals over CR.DATA numbers). */
  UI.cardInfo = function (id) {
    const cat = UI.catalog();
    const key = String(id);
    const hit = cat.infos[key];
    if (hit) return hit;
    const d = cat.byId[key] || NONE;
    let cast = NONE;
    if (CR.CAST) {
      if (typeof CR.CAST.get === 'function') {
        try { cast = CR.CAST.get(key) || NONE; } catch (e) { cast = NONE; }
      } else if (CR.CAST.cards && CR.CAST.cards[key]) {
        cast = CR.CAST.cards[key];
      }
      if (cast.fallback) cast = NONE; // our own fallback below is type-aware
    }
    const type = UI.normType(d.type || cast.kind, d);
    const name = String(cast.name || d.name || prettifyId(key));
    const info = {
      id: key,
      name: name,
      mirrors: String(cast.mirrors || d.name || ''),
      initials: UI.initials(name),
      color: String(cast.color || '#4c6fa8'),
      accent: String(cast.accent || '#ffd54a'),
      desc: String(cast.desc || ''),
      role: String(cast.role || ''),
      elixir: typeof d.elixir === 'number' ? d.elixir : null,
      rarity: UI.normRarity(d.rarity),
      type: type,
      known: d !== NONE,
      disabled: !!d.disabled,
    };
    cat.infos[key] = info;
    return info;
  };

  UI.enabledCardIds = function () { return UI.catalog().enabled.slice(); };

  /** Sorted list of enabled card ids for the collection view. */
  UI.sortedCardIds = function () {
    const ids = UI.enabledCardIds();
    ids.sort(function (a, b) {
      const A = UI.cardInfo(a); const B = UI.cardInfo(b);
      const ea = A.elixir == null ? 99 : A.elixir; const eb = B.elixir == null ? 99 : B.elixir;
      if (ea !== eb) return ea - eb;
      const ra = RARITY[A.rarity].order; const rb = RARITY[B.rarity].order;
      if (ra !== rb) return ra - rb;
      return A.name < B.name ? -1 : A.name > B.name ? 1 : 0;
    });
    return ids;
  };

  /** Preset decks from CR.CAST.presets, sanitized. */
  UI.presets = function () {
    const P = CR.CAST && Array.isArray(CR.CAST.presets) ? CR.CAST.presets : EMPTY;
    const out = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < P.length; i++) {
      const p = P[i];
      if (!p || !Array.isArray(p.cards)) continue;
      out.push({ name: String(p.name || ('Deck ' + (i + 1))), desc: p.desc ? String(p.desc) : '', cards: p.cards.slice() });
    }
    return out;
  };

  /** Returns a valid deck: 8 unique, enabled card ids. Keeps the given order, fills from
   *  `fallback` and then from the catalogue. With fewer than 8 enabled cards it returns all. */
  UI.sanitizeDeck = function (ids, fallback, enabledIds) {
    const enabled = enabledIds || UI.catalog().enabled;
    const allowed = Object.create(null);
    for (let i = 0; i < enabled.length; i++) allowed[enabled[i]] = true;
    const out = [];
    const take = function (list) {
      if (!Array.isArray(list)) return;
      for (let i = 0; i < list.length && out.length < 8; i++) {
        const id = list[i];
        if (typeof id === 'string' && allowed[id] && out.indexOf(id) < 0) out.push(id);
      }
    };
    take(ids);
    take(fallback);
    take(enabled);
    return out;
  };

  UI.defaultDeck = function () {
    const p = UI.presets();
    return UI.sanitizeDeck(p.length ? p[0].cards : EMPTY);
  };

  UI.avgElixir = function (ids) {
    let s = 0; let n = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < (ids || EMPTY).length; i++) {
      const e = UI.cardInfo(ids[i]).elixir;
      if (typeof e === 'number') { s += e; n++; }
    }
    return n ? s / n : 0;
  };

  UI.sanitizeName = function (name) {
    return String(name == null ? '' : name)
      .replace(/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f<>]/g, '')
      .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
      .trim()
      .slice(0, 16);
  };

  /** 'win' | 'loss' | 'draw' from the sim winner (0 | 1 | 'draw' | null). */
  UI.outcome = function (winner, localSide) {
    if (winner === 0 || winner === 1) return winner === localSide ? 'win' : 'loss';
    return 'draw';
  };

  /** German message for a rejected placement reason from sim.canPlay / sim.command. */
  UI.reasonText = function (reason) {
    const S = CR.Sim;
    if (reason && S && S.REASONS && typeof S.REASONS[reason] === 'string') return S.REASONS[reason];
    const r = String(reason || '').toLowerCase();
    if (r.indexOf('elixir') >= 0) return 'Nicht genug Elixier!';
    if (/zone|deploy|area|side|bound|river|water|block|tower|pos|place|range|invalid_xy|outside|occupied/.test(r)) return 'Hier kannst du das nicht platzieren';
    if (/pending|wait|busy/.test(r)) return 'Einen Moment …';
    if (/over|ended|finish/.test(r)) return 'Das Spiel ist vorbei';
    if (/hand|slot|card|cycle/.test(r)) return 'Karte nicht verfügbar';
    return 'Hier nicht möglich';
  };

  UI.isElixirReason = function (reason) { return String(reason || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('elixir') >= 0; };

  // C.H.A.O.S view helpers. The chaos module defines the exact data; these accept the common
  // shapes (ids or objects) so the picker keeps working when details change.
  UI.chaosOffers = function (chaos) {
    if (!chaos) return EMPTY;
    const o = chaos.offers || chaos.offer || chaos.options;
    return Array.isArray(o) ? o : EMPTY;
  };

  /** True when the chaos view marks the current offer as already decided. */
  UI.chaosPicked = function (chaos) {
    if (!chaos) return false;
    const keys = ['picked', 'chosen', 'choice', 'selected', 'pickedOption'];
    for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
      const v = chaos[keys[i]];
      if (v != null && v !== false && v !== -1) return true;
    }
    return false;
  };

  UI.chaosOwned = function (chaos) {
    if (!chaos) return EMPTY;
    const o = chaos.owned || chaos.upgrades || chaos.picks || chaos.picked || chaos.active;
    return Array.isArray(o) ? o : EMPTY;
  };

  function itemKey(o) {
    if (o == null) return '';
    if (typeof o !== 'object') return String(o);
    const k = o.id != null ? o.id : (o.key != null ? o.key : (o.upgrade != null ? o.upgrade : o.name));
    return String(k == null ? '' : k) + (o.card ? '@' + o.card : '') + (o.tier != null ? '#' + o.tier : '') +
      (o.stacks != null || o.count != null || o.level != null ? 'x' + (o.stacks || 0) + '.' + (o.count || 0) + '.' + (o.level || 0) : '');
  }

  UI.chaosSignature = function (chaos, list) {
    const items = list || UI.chaosOffers(chaos);
    const c = chaos || NONE;
    const round = c.offerId != null ? c.offerId : (c.round != null ? c.round : (c.offerSeq != null ? c.offerSeq : (c.wave != null ? c.wave : '')));
    let s = String(round) + '|';
    for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) s += itemKey(items[i]) + ',';
    return s;
  };

  function lookupInCollection(coll, id) {
    if (!coll) return null;
    if (Array.isArray(coll)) {
      for (let i = 0; i < coll.length; i++) {
        const u = coll[i];
        if (u && (u.id === id || u.key === id)) return u;
      }
      return null;
    }
    if (typeof coll === 'object') return coll[id] || null;
    return null;
  }

  function lookupChaosDef(id) {
    if (id == null) return null;
    const C = CR.Chaos || NONE;
    const DC = (CR.DATA && CR.DATA.chaos) || NONE;
    const sources = [C.UPGRADES, C.upgrades, C.catalog, C.defs, DC.upgrades, DC.items, DC.catalog, CR.CAST && CR.CAST.chaos];
    for (let i = 0; i < sources.length; i++) {
      const hit = lookupInCollection(sources[i], id);
      if (hit) return hit;
    }
    if (typeof C.describe === 'function') {
      try { const d = C.describe(id); if (d) return d; } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    }
    return null;
  }

  /** Display info for one offered / owned upgrade. */
  UI.chaosOptionInfo = function (o) {
    let src;
    if (o != null && typeof o === 'object') {
      const def = lookupChaosDef(o.id != null ? o.id : o.key);
      src = def ? Object.assign({}, def, o) : o;
    } else {
      src = lookupChaosDef(o) || { id: o };
    }
    const id = src.id != null ? String(src.id) : String(o);
    const cardId = src.card || src.cardId || null;
    const card = cardId ? UI.cardInfo(cardId) : null;
    // Rarity: `rarity` (name) or `tier` (0..3, ARCHITECTURE). `level`/`stacks` count copies.
    let rarity = src.rarity != null ? src.rarity : (src.tier != null ? src.tier : null);
    rarity = rarity == null ? (card ? card.rarity : 'common') : UI.normRarity(rarity);
    const stacks = Math.max(+src.stacks || 0, +src.count || 0, +src.level || 0, +src.n || 0);
    // `title` is the German display name in the chaos view (`name` may be the official English one).
    let name = src.title || src.name || src.label || '';
    if (!name) name = prettifyId(id);
    let text = src.desc || src.text || src.description || src.summary || '';
    if (card && !src.name && !src.title) name = card.name + ': ' + name;
    return {
      id: id,
      name: String(name),
      text: String(text),
      rarity: rarity,
      initials: card ? card.initials : UI.initials(String(src.title || src.name || prettifyId(id))),
      card: cardId,
      stacks: stacks > 1 ? Math.floor(stacks) : 1,
    };
  };

  /** Local bookkeeping of play commands that the authority has not reflected yet. Keeps the
   *  slot locked and its cost reserved so the guest cannot double-play or overspend. */
  function PendingPlays(timeoutMs) {
    this.timeoutMs = timeoutMs || 1500;
    this.items = [];
  }
  PendingPlays.prototype.add = function (slot, cardId, cost, nowMs) {
    this.items.push({ slot: slot, cardId: cardId, cost: cost > 0 ? cost : 0, t: nowMs });
  };
  /** Drops entries whose slot shows another card now (play applied) or that timed out. */
  PendingPlays.prototype.sync = function (hand, nowMs) {
    const it = this.items;
    let w = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < it.length; i++) {
      const p = it[i];
      if (hand && hand[p.slot] === p.cardId && nowMs - p.t < this.timeoutMs) it[w++] = p;
    }
    it.length = w;
  };
  PendingPlays.prototype.has = function (slot) {
    for (let i = 0; i < this.items.length; i++) if (this.items[i].slot === slot) return true;
    return false;
  };
  /** Forget the entry of one slot (the authority rejected that play). */
  PendingPlays.prototype.drop = function (slot) {
    const it = this.items;
    let w = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < it.length; i++) if (it[i].slot !== slot) it[w++] = it[i];
    it.length = w;
  };
  PendingPlays.prototype.cost = function () {
    let c = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < this.items.length; i++) c += this.items[i].cost;
    return c;
  };
  PendingPlays.prototype.clear = function () { this.items.length = 0; };
  UI.PendingPlays = PendingPlays;

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ card art (3D portraits)

  /**
   * Card art = CR.GFX.portrait(cardId) data URLs, rendered one at a time (each render is a
   * synchronous WebGL draw + readback; a queue keeps the UI responsive) and cached for the
   * session. Elements show a rarity-coloured monogram placeholder until their art arrives.
   * v3 (no lag): during a battle NOTHING is rendered (setHold(true)) except inside the short
   * grace window of the VS intro, while the simulation is still held; everything else waits in
   * the queue until the battle ends. The loading screen pre-renders the own deck first.
   */
  const Art = UI.Art = {
    cache: Object.create(null),   // key (id, or id@<width> for tiers > 0) -> data URL
    failed: Object.create(null),
    waiters: Object.create(null),
    urgent: Object.create(null),
    queue: [],
    busy: false,
    hold: false,      // during a battle no portrait is rendered (see graceUntil)
    graceUntil: 0,    // performance.now() until which urgent cards may render despite the hold
    TIERS: ART_TIERS,
    /** Pauses portrait rendering (each one is a synchronous WebGL draw + PNG encode).
     *  graceMs > 0: urgent (visible) cards may still render for that long (battle intro). */
    setHold: function (b, graceMs) {
      this.hold = !!b;
      this.graceUntil = this.hold && graceMs > 0 ? now() + graceMs : 0;
      this.pump();
    },
    /** True while a held queue may still render urgent cards. */
    inGrace: function () { return this.hold && this.graceUntil > 0 && now() < this.graceUntil; },
    /** While held: lets urgent cards render for `ms` more (the battle is paused, e.g. the
     *  C.H.A.O.S picker). No effect when nothing is held. */
    grace: function (ms) {
      if (!this.hold || !(ms > 0)) return;
      this.graceUntil = Math.max(this.graceUntil, now() + ms);
      this.pump();
    },
    available: function () {
      const X = CR.GFX;
      return !!(X && X.ready && typeof X.portrait === 'function');
    },
    /** Device pixels per CSS pixel (1..3). */
    dpr: function () {
      const d = +(G.devicePixelRatio || 1);
      return d > 3 ? 3 : (d >= 1 ? d : 1);
    },
    /** Smallest tier whose portrait covers a box of cssW x cssH CSS pixels (cover fit, 4:5). */
    tierFor: function (cssW, cssH) {
      const need = Math.max(+cssW || 0, (+cssH || 0) * 0.8) * this.dpr();
      for (let i = 0; i < ART_TIERS.length; i++) if (ART_TIERS[i][0] >= need * ART_FIT) return i;
      return ART_TIERS.length - 1;
    },
    keyOf: function (id, tier) {
      const t = tier > 0 ? Math.min(ART_TIERS.length - 1, tier | 0) : 0;
      return t ? String(id) + '@' + ART_TIERS[t][0] : String(id);
    },
    /** Cached URL of `id` best for `tier`: the smallest cached tier >= it, else the biggest below. */
    best: function (id, tier) {
      const t = tier > 0 ? Math.min(ART_TIERS.length - 1, tier | 0) : 0;
      for (let i = t; i < ART_TIERS.length; i++) { const u = this.cache[this.keyOf(id, i)]; if (u) return u; }
      for (let i = t - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const u = this.cache[this.keyOf(id, i)]; if (u) return u; }
      return null;
    },
    get: function (id, tier) { return this.best(String(id), tier || 0); },
    has: function (id) { return !!this.best(String(id), 0); },
    /** Promise<dataURL|null>. `urgent` moves the card to the front of the queue; `tier` picks the
     *  resolution (0 = default 256x320 ... 2 = 512x640). */
    load: function (id, urgent, tier) {
      const key = this.keyOf(id, tier);
      if (this.cache[key]) return Promise.resolve(this.cache[key]);
      if (this.failed[key] || !this.available()) return Promise.resolve(null);
      const self = this;
      return new Promise(function (resolve) {
        const w = self.waiters[key];
        if (urgent) self.urgent[key] = true;
        if (w) {
          w.push(resolve);
          if (urgent) {
            const i = self.queue.indexOf(key);
            if (i > 0) { self.queue.splice(i, 1); self.queue.unshift(key); }
          }
        } else {
          self.waiters[key] = [resolve];
          if (urgent) self.queue.unshift(key); else self.queue.push(key);
        }
        self.pump();
      });
    },
    /** Promise of the art of `id` in the tier a cssW x cssH box needs (see tierFor). */
    loadFor: function (id, cssW, cssH, urgent) {
      return this.load(id, urgent, this.tierFor(cssW, cssH));
    },
    pump: function () {
      if (this.busy || !this.queue.length) return;
      let qi = 0;
      if (this.hold) {
        if (!this.inGrace()) return;           // resumes with setHold(false)
        while (qi < this.queue.length && !this.urgent[this.queue[qi]]) qi++;
        if (qi >= this.queue.length) return;
      }
      const key = this.queue.splice(qi, 1)[0];
      delete this.urgent[key];
      const at = key.lastIndexOf('@');
      let pid = key, size = ART_TIERS[0];
      if (at > 0) {
        const wpx = +key.slice(at + 1);
        for (let i = 1; i < ART_TIERS.length; i++) if (ART_TIERS[i][0] === wpx) { pid = key.slice(0, at); size = ART_TIERS[i]; }
      }
      const self = this;
      this.busy = true;
      let done = false;
      let timer = 0;
      const finish = function (url) {
        if (done) return;
        done = true;
        if (timer) G.clearTimeout(timer);
        if (typeof url === 'string' && /^(data:|blob:|https?:)/.test(url)) self.cache[key] = url;
        else self.failed[key] = true;
        const ws = self.waiters[key] || EMPTY;
        delete self.waiters[key];
        const out = self.cache[key] || null;
        for (let i = 0; i < ws.length; i++) { try { ws[i](out); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ } }
        self.busy = false;
        // Yield to the browser between renders so taps and animations stay smooth.
        G.setTimeout(function () { self.pump(); }, 0);
      };
      let p = null;
      try { p = CR.GFX.portrait(pid, { w: size[0], h: size[1], side: 0 }); } catch (e) { p = null; }
      if (p && typeof p.then === 'function') {
        timer = G.setTimeout(function () { finish(null); }, PORTRAIT_TIMEOUT_MS * (size[0] > PORTRAIT_W ? 2 : 1));
        p.then(finish, function () { finish(null); });
      } else {
        finish(typeof p === 'string' ? p : null);
      }

    /** Renders every id in order; onProgress(done, total, id). Resolves when all are done. */
    preload: function (ids, onProgress) {
      const list = (ids || EMPTY).filter(function (id, i, a) { return a.indexOf(id) === i; });
      const total = list.length;
      let n = 0;
      const self = this;
      if (!total) return Promise.resolve(0);
      return new Promise(function (resolve) {
        list.forEach(function (id) {
          self.load(id, false).then(function () {
            n++;
            if (onProgress) { try { onProgress(n, total, id); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ } }
            if (n === total) resolve(n);
          });
        });
      });
    },
    /** Shows `url` in the art box `el` (a child .art-pic layer above the studio backdrop, so the
     *  rarity frame / backdrop stays CSS) and toggles `has-art` on `host`. */
    paint: function (el, url, host) {
      const hostEl = host || el;
      let pic = null;
      for (let c = el.firstElementChild; c; c = c.nextElementSibling) if (c.className === 'art-pic') { pic = c; break; }
      if (url) {
        if (!pic) {
          pic = G.document.createElement('span');
          pic.className = 'art-pic';
          pic.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
          el.appendChild(pic);
        }
        const css = 'url("' + url + '")';
        if (pic.style.backgroundImage !== css) pic.style.backgroundImage = css;

        hostEl.classList.add('has-art');

      }
      if (pic) pic.style.backgroundImage = '';
      el.classList.remove('art-on');
      hostEl.classList.remove('has-art');
    },
    /** Puts the art of `id` on `el` (a .card-art box) and toggles `has-art` on `host`. The box
     *  is measured after layout and upgraded to the tier its size x devicePixelRatio needs. */
    apply: function (el, id, host) {
      if (!el) return;
      const key = id ? String(id) : '';
      el.setAttribute('data-art', key);
      const url = key ? this.best(key, 0) : null;
      this.paint(el, url, host);
      if (!key || !this.available()) return;
      const self = this;
      if (!url && !this.failed[key]) {
        this.load(key, true).then(function (u) {
          if (u && el.getAttribute('data-art') === key && !el.classList.contains('art-on')) self.paint(el, u, host);
        });
      }
      this.measureLater(el, key, host);
    },
    // ---- size-aware upgrade: one batched read pass per animation frame
    pending: [],
    rafOn: false,
    measureLater: function (el, key, host) {
      for (let i = 0; i < this.pending.length; i++) {
        if (this.pending[i].el === el) { this.pending[i].key = key; this.pending[i].host = host; return; }
      }
      this.pending.push({ el: el, key: key, host: host, tries: 0 });

    },
    kick: function () {

      this.rafOn = true;
      const self = this;
      raf.call(G, function () { self.rafOn = false; self.measure(); });
    },
    measure: function () {
      const list = this.pending.splice(0, this.pending.length);
      const todo = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {          // read pass (no style writes in here)
        const it = list[i], el = it.el;
        if (el.getAttribute('data-art') !== it.key) continue;
        const w = el.isConnected ? el.offsetWidth : 0, hh = el.isConnected ? el.offsetHeight : 0;
        if (!(w > 0 && hh > 0)) {
          if (++it.tries < ART_MEASURE_TRIES) this.pending.push(it);

        }
        todo.push({ it: it, tier: this.tierFor(w * this.zoomOf(el), hh * this.zoomOf(el)) });
      }
      const self = this;
      for (let i = 0; i < todo.length; i++) {           // write pass
        const it = todo[i].it, tier = todo[i].tier, k = it.key;

        });
      }
      this.kick();
    },
    /** Extra magnification of the art inside its box (champion face: background-size 150 %). */
    zoomOf: function (el) {
