    },
  };

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------- DOM helpers

  function h(tag, props, children) {
    const el = G.document.createElement(tag);
    if (props) {
      for (const k in props) {
        const v = props[k];
        if (v == null || v === false) continue;
        if (k === 'class') el.className = v;
        else if (k === 'text') el.textContent = v;
        else if (k === 'html') el.innerHTML = v; // only used for static, trusted SVG icons
        else if (k.charCodeAt(0) === 111 && k.charCodeAt(1) === 110 && typeof v === 'function') el.addEventListener(k.slice(2), v);
        else el.setAttribute(k, v === true ? '' : String(v));
      }
    }
    if (children != null) append(el, children);
    return el;
  }
  function append(el, c) {
    if (c == null || c === false) return;
    if (Array.isArray(c)) { for (let i = 0; i < c.length; i++) append(el, c[i]); return; }
    if (typeof c === 'string' || typeof c === 'number') el.appendChild(G.document.createTextNode(String(c)));
    else el.appendChild(c);
  }
  function remove(el) { if (el && el.parentNode) el.parentNode.removeChild(el); }
  function now() { return G.performance && G.performance.now ? G.performance.now() : 0; }
  UI.h = h;

  UI.haptics = true;
  function vibrate(ms) {
    if (!UI.haptics) return;
    try { if (G.navigator && typeof G.navigator.vibrate === 'function') G.navigator.vibrate(ms); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
  }
  UI.vibrate = vibrate;
  UI.canVibrate = function () {
    try { return !!(G.navigator && typeof G.navigator.vibrate === 'function'); } catch (e) { return false; }
  };

  /** Restarts a CSS animation class on an element. */
  function replayClass(el, cls) {
    el.classList.remove(cls);
    void el.offsetWidth; // force reflow so the animation restarts
    el.classList.add(cls);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- sound

  /** Tiny WebAudio synth. Unlocked on the first user gesture; everything is optional. */
  const Sound = UI.Sound = {
    ctx: null,
    out: null,
    noiseBuf: null,
    muted: false,
    unlock: function () {
      if (this.ctx) {
        if (this.ctx.state === 'suspended' && this.ctx.resume) {
          try { const p = this.ctx.resume(); if (p && p.catch) p.catch(function () {}); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
        }
        return;
      }
      const AC = G.AudioContext || G.webkitAudioContext;
      if (!AC) return;
      try {
        this.ctx = new AC();
        this.out = this.ctx.createGain();
        this.out.gain.value = 0.22 * this.sfxVol / DEFAULT_SFX;
        this.out.connect(this.ctx.destination);
        if (this.ctx.state === 'suspended' && this.ctx.resume) {
          const p = this.ctx.resume(); if (p && p.catch) p.catch(function () {});
        }
      } catch (e) { this.ctx = null; this.out = null; }
    },
    sfxVol: DEFAULT_SFX,
    /** Effects volume 0..1 of this fallback synth (CR.Audio has its own settings). */
    setVolume: function (v) {
      this.sfxVol = vol01(v, DEFAULT_SFX);
      if (this.out) { try { this.out.gain.value = 0.22 * this.sfxVol / DEFAULT_SFX; } catch (e) { /* ignore */ } }
    },
    ready: function () { return !!(this.ctx && !this.muted && this.sfxVol > 0 && this.ctx.state === 'running'); },
    tone: function (freq, dur, o) {
      if (!this.ready()) return;
      const opt = o || NONE;
      try {
        const ctx = this.ctx;
        const t0 = ctx.currentTime + (opt.delay || 0);
        const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
        const g = ctx.createGain();
        osc.type = opt.type || 'sine';
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t0);
        if (opt.to) osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(opt.to, t0 + dur);
        const v = opt.vol == null ? 0.5 : opt.vol;
        g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t0);
        g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(v, t0 + Math.min(0.015, dur / 3));
        g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + dur);
        osc.connect(g); g.connect(this.out);
        osc.start(t0); osc.stop(t0 + dur + 0.03);
      } catch (e) { /* audio is optional */ }
    },
    noise: function (dur, o) {
      if (!this.ready()) return;
      const opt = o || NONE;
      try {
        const ctx = this.ctx;
        if (!this.noiseBuf) {
          const len = Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate * 0.6);
          this.noiseBuf = ctx.createBuffer(1, len, ctx.sampleRate);
          const ch = this.noiseBuf.getChannelData(0);
          for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) ch[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
        }
        const t0 = ctx.currentTime + (opt.delay || 0);
        const src = ctx.createBufferSource();
        src.buffer = this.noiseBuf;
        const f = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
        f.type = 'lowpass';
        f.frequency.setValueAtTime(opt.freq || 900, t0);
        const g = ctx.createGain();
        const v = opt.vol == null ? 0.4 : opt.vol;
        g.gain.setValueAtTime(v, t0);
        g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + dur);

        src.start(t0); src.stop(t0 + dur + 0.03);
      } catch (e) { /* audio is optional */ }
    },
    play: function (name) {
      // v5: with CR.Audio (src/13-audio.js) every sound comes from there; battle sounds that
      // CR.Audio.onEvents derives from the sim events are not played twice.
      if (UI.audio()) { UI.audioPlay(name); return; }
      if (!this.ready()) return;
      switch (name) {
        case 'tap': this.tone(620, 0.05, { type: 'triangle', vol: 0.18 }); break;
        case 'select': this.tone(880, 0.06, { type: 'triangle', vol: 0.22 }); break;
        case 'deploy':
          this.tone(330, 0.13, { type: 'square', vol: 0.16, to: 170 });
          this.noise(0.1, { freq: 1400, vol: 0.14 });
          break;
        case 'enemyDeploy': this.tone(240, 0.1, { type: 'triangle', vol: 0.1, to: 160 }); break;
        case 'deny':
          this.tone(190, 0.12, { type: 'sawtooth', vol: 0.14 });
          this.tone(150, 0.14, { type: 'sawtooth', vol: 0.14, delay: 0.1 });
          break;
        case 'tower':
          this.noise(0.55, { freq: 520, vol: 0.55 });
          this.tone(110, 0.5, { type: 'sine', vol: 0.45, to: 38 });
          break;
        case 'crown':
          this.tone(784, 0.1, { type: 'triangle', vol: 0.3 });
          this.tone(988, 0.1, { type: 'triangle', vol: 0.3, delay: 0.09 });
          this.tone(1319, 0.22, { type: 'triangle', vol: 0.3, delay: 0.18 });
          break;
        case 'touchdown':
          [523, 659, 784, 1047, 1319].forEach(function (f, i) { Sound.tone(f, 0.12, { type: 'square', vol: 0.16, delay: i * 0.07 }); });
          this.noise(0.4, { freq: 3200, vol: 0.18, delay: 0.3 });
          break;
        case 'touchdownLost':
          this.tone(330, 0.16, { type: 'sawtooth', vol: 0.14 });
          this.tone(247, 0.3, { type: 'sawtooth', vol: 0.14, delay: 0.14 });
          break;
        case 'crownLost':
          this.tone(392, 0.14, { type: 'sine', vol: 0.3 });
          this.tone(311, 0.24, { type: 'sine', vol: 0.3, delay: 0.12 });
          break;
        case 'phase':
          this.tone(523, 0.14, { type: 'triangle', vol: 0.28 });
          this.tone(784, 0.26, { type: 'triangle', vol: 0.28, delay: 0.12 });
          break;
        case 'chaos':
          for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) this.tone(1100 + i * 170, 0.09, { type: 'sine', vol: 0.12, delay: i * 0.045 });
          break;
        case 'emote': this.tone(520, 0.09, { type: 'sine', vol: 0.22, to: 880 }); break;
        case 'tick': this.tone(1250, 0.035, { type: 'square', vol: 0.06 }); break;
        case 'start':
          this.tone(262, 0.22, { type: 'sawtooth', vol: 0.1 });
          this.tone(392, 0.34, { type: 'sawtooth', vol: 0.1, delay: 0.16 });
          break;
        case 'whoosh':
          this.noise(0.32, { freq: 2400, vol: 0.22 });
          this.tone(180, 0.3, { type: 'sine', vol: 0.12, to: 520 });
          break;
        case 'fight':
          this.noise(0.25, { freq: 700, vol: 0.32 });
          this.tone(196, 0.16, { type: 'sawtooth', vol: 0.14 });
          this.tone(294, 0.16, { type: 'sawtooth', vol: 0.14, delay: 0.11 });
          this.tone(392, 0.42, { type: 'sawtooth', vol: 0.15, delay: 0.22 });
          this.tone(784, 0.42, { type: 'triangle', vol: 0.16, delay: 0.22 });
          break;
        case 'crownPop':
          this.tone(988, 0.08, { type: 'triangle', vol: 0.26 });
          this.tone(1480, 0.18, { type: 'triangle', vol: 0.22, delay: 0.06 });
          this.noise(0.12, { freq: 5000, vol: 0.08, delay: 0.02 });
          break;
        case 'ready':
          this.tone(660, 0.08, { type: 'triangle', vol: 0.2 });
          this.tone(990, 0.16, { type: 'triangle', vol: 0.2, delay: 0.08 });
          break;
        case 'win':
          [523, 659, 784, 1047].forEach(function (f, i) { Sound.tone(f, 0.18, { type: 'triangle', vol: 0.3, delay: i * 0.13 }); });
          this.tone(1319, 0.5, { type: 'triangle', vol: 0.25, delay: 0.55 });
          break;
        case 'loss':
          [392, 349, 311, 262].forEach(function (f, i) { Sound.tone(f, 0.24, { type: 'sine', vol: 0.3, delay: i * 0.18 }); });
          break;
        case 'draw':
          this.tone(523, 0.2, { type: 'triangle', vol: 0.25 });
          this.tone(523, 0.3, { type: 'triangle', vol: 0.25, delay: 0.22 });
          break;
        default: break;
      }
    },
  };

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ v5: CR.Audio bridge

  /** CR.Audio when the audio module is loaded and usable (guarded: it is optional). */
  let audioBroken = false;
  let audioErrors = 0;
  UI.audio = function () {
    if (audioBroken) return null;
    const A = CR.Audio;
    return A && typeof A.play === 'function' ? A : null;
  };
  function audioFail(e) {
    audioErrors++;
    if (audioErrors === 1) { try { G.console.error('[BustWar] CR.Audio:', e); } catch (err) { /* ignore */ } }
    if (audioErrors >= 25) audioBroken = true;    // the fallback synth takes over
  }
  /** Calls CR.Audio[fn](...args) safely; returns its result or undefined. */
  UI.audioCall = function (fn, args) {
    const A = UI.audio();
    if (!A || typeof A[fn] !== 'function') return undefined;
    try { return A[fn].apply(A, args || EMPTY); } catch (e) { audioFail(e); return undefined; }
  };
  // shell sound names -> CR.Audio: UI clicks / battle sounds the event mapping already plays
  const AUDIO_UI = { tap: 'click', select: 'select', deny: 'error' };
  // battle sounds CR.Audio.onEvents(events, side, view) already plays (incl. the countdown ticks)
  const AUDIO_FROM_EVENTS = { deploy: 1, enemyDeploy: 1, tower: 1, crown: 1, crownLost: 1, touchdown: 1, touchdownLost: 1, phase: 1, chaos: 1, tick: 1, win: 1, loss: 1, draw: 1 };
  // CR.Audio.play accepts the legacy synth names (fight, whoosh, emote, crownPop, ready ...)
  const AUDIO_ALIAS = { start: 'ready' };
  /** Which CR.Audio call a shell sound becomes: ['ui', name] | ['play', name] | null. Pure. */
  UI.audioRoute = function (name) {
    if (AUDIO_UI[name]) return ['ui', AUDIO_UI[name]];
    if (AUDIO_FROM_EVENTS[name]) return null;
    return ['play', AUDIO_ALIAS[name] || String(name)];
  };
  UI.audioPlay = function (name) {
    const r = UI.audioRoute(name);
    if (!r) return;
    UI.audioCall(r[0], [r[1]]);
  };
  /** Background music: 'menu' | 'battle' | 'overtime' | null (repeats are ignored here). */
  let musicNow;
  UI.music = function (track) {
    const t = track || null;
    if (t === musicNow) return;
    musicNow = t;
    UI.audioCall('music', [t]);
  };
  /** Re-sends the current track (after the first touch unlocked the audio). */
  UI.musicRefresh = function () { const t = musicNow; musicNow = undefined; UI.music(t); };
  /** Reads CR.Audio.settings -> { music, sfx, muted } (0..1) or null. */
  UI.audioSettings = function () {
    const A = UI.audio();
    const s = A && A.settings;
    if (!s || typeof s !== 'object') return null;
    return { music: vol01(s.music, DEFAULT_MUSIC), sfx: vol01(s.sfx, DEFAULT_SFX), muted: !!s.muted };
  };

    const A = UI.audio();

  };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- clipboard / share

  /** Copies text. Must be called synchronously inside the click handler. Falls back to
   *  selecting the text (and execCommand) when the async clipboard is blocked (sandboxed
   *  iframes such as claude.ai artifacts). Without an input element a temporary off-screen
   *  textarea is used for the selection. Resolves true when the text was copied. */
  UI.copyText = function (text, inputEl) {
    const str = String(text);
    const fallback = function () {
      let ok = false;
      let tmp = null;
      try {
        const doc = G.document;
        let el = inputEl;
        if (!el && doc && doc.body) {
          tmp = doc.createElement('textarea');
          tmp.value = str;
          tmp.setAttribute('readonly', '');
          tmp.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
          tmp.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:-9999px;top:0;opacity:0;font-size:16px';
          doc.body.appendChild(tmp);
          el = tmp;
        }
        if (el) {
          try { el.focus({ preventScroll: true }); } catch (e) { el.focus(); }
          el.select();
          if (el.setSelectionRange) el.setSelectionRange(0, String(el.value || '').length);
        }
        ok = !!(doc && doc.execCommand && doc.execCommand('copy'));
      } catch (e) { ok = false; }
      if (tmp && tmp.parentNode) tmp.parentNode.removeChild(tmp);
      return ok;
    };
    // Select the visible text right away (still inside the user gesture): even when every
    // copy path is blocked the player can copy it by hand.
    if (inputEl) {
      try { inputEl.select(); if (inputEl.setSelectionRange) inputEl.setSelectionRange(0, String(inputEl.value || '').length); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    }
    let p = null;
    try {
      const cb = G.navigator && G.navigator.clipboard;
      if (cb && typeof cb.writeText === 'function') p = cb.writeText(str);
    } catch (e) { p = null; }
    if (!p || typeof p.then !== 'function') return Promise.resolve(fallback());
    // Some embedded browsers never settle the promise (pending permission prompt): answer
    // after a short wait with the legacy path so the button always gives feedback.
    return new Promise(function (resolve) {
      let done = false;
      const finish = function (ok) { if (!done) { done = true; resolve(ok); } };
      const timer = G.setTimeout(function () { finish(fallback()); }, COPY_TIMEOUT_MS);
      p.then(function () { G.clearTimeout(timer); finish(true); },
        function () { G.clearTimeout(timer); finish(fallback()); });
    });
  };

  UI.canShare = function () {
    try { return !!(G.navigator && typeof G.navigator.share === 'function'); } catch (e) { return false; }
  };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- dialogs and toasts

  /** In-page modal dialog (never alert/confirm/prompt). Resolves with the chosen button's
   *  value (null when dismissed). The returned promise has .close(value). */
  UI.dialog = function (host, opts) {
    let closeFn = null;
    const p = new Promise(function (resolve) {
      const o = opts || NONE;
      let done = false;
      const btns = h('div', { class: 'dialog-btns' });
      const box = h('div', { class: 'dialog panel', role: 'dialog', 'aria-modal': 'true' }, [
        o.title ? h('div', { class: 'panel-title' }, o.title) : null,
        o.text ? h('p', { class: 'dialog-text' }, o.text) : null,
        o.body || null,
        btns,
      ]);
      const ov = h('div', { class: 'overlay' }, box);
      closeFn = function (v) {
        if (done) return;
        done = true;
        remove(ov);
        resolve(v === undefined ? null : v);
      };
      (o.buttons || [{ label: 'OK', value: true, cls: 'btn-blue' }]).forEach(function (b) {
        const el = h('button', { class: 'btn btn-block ' + (b.cls || 'btn-blue'), type: 'button' }, b.label);
        el.addEventListener('click', function () { closeFn(b.value); });
        btns.appendChild(el);
      });
      if (o.dismissable !== false) {
        ov.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (e.target === ov) closeFn(null); });
      }
      host.appendChild(ov);
      const first = btns.querySelector('button');
      if (first && first.focus) { try { first.focus({ preventScroll: true }); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ } }
    });
    p.close = function (v) { if (closeFn) closeFn(v); };
    return p;
  };

  UI.toast = function (host, msg, ms) {
    if (!host || !msg) return;
    const old = host.querySelector(':scope > .toast');
    if (old) remove(old);
    const el = h('div', { class: 'toast', role: 'status' }, msg);
    host.appendChild(el);
    G.setTimeout(function () { remove(el); }, ms || 2200);
  };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------- widgets

  function segmented(items, value, onChange, cls) {
    const el = h('div', { class: cls || 'seg', role: 'radiogroup' });
    const btns = items.map(function (it) {
      const content = it.icon || it.sub
        ? [it.icon ? icon(it.icon) : null, h('span', { class: 'seg-txt' }, [h('span', { class: 'seg-label' }, it.label), it.sub ? h('span', { class: 'seg-sub' }, it.sub) : null])]
        : it.label;
      const b = h('button', {
        type: 'button',
        role: 'radio',
        class: (it.id === value ? 'on ' : '') + (it.cls || ''),
        'aria-checked': it.id === value ? 'true' : 'false',
        'aria-label': it.sub ? it.label + ' ' + it.sub : null,
        disabled: !!it.disabled,
      }, content);
      b.addEventListener('click', function () {
        if (it.disabled) return;
        set(it.id);
        onChange(it.id);
      });
      el.appendChild(b);
      return b;
    });
    function set(v) {
      for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
        btns[i].classList.toggle('on', items[i].id === v);
        btns[i].setAttribute('aria-checked', items[i].id === v ? 'true' : 'false');
      }
    }
    return { el: el, set: set };
  }

  /** v12: the tunnel of the 'tunnel' map in sim tiles: {holes: [{x, y, r}], path: [{x, y}]}
   *  from CR.Arena.TUNNEL, else the documented layout (holes at x 9, y 8 and y 24). */
  UI.tunnelLayout = function () {
    const T = CR.Arena && CR.Arena.TUNNEL;
    const pt = function (p) {
      if (Array.isArray(p) && p.length >= 2) return { x: +p[0], y: +p[1], r: +p[2] };
      return p && typeof p === 'object' ? { x: +p.x, y: +p.y, r: +p.r } : null;
    };
    const ok = function (p) { return p && Number.isFinite(p.x) && Number.isFinite(p.y) && p.x >= 0 && p.x <= 18 && p.y >= 0 && p.y <= 32; };
    const holes = [];
    const path = [];
    if (T && Array.isArray(T.holes)) for (let i = 0; i < T.holes.length && holes.length < 4; i++) { const p = pt(T.holes[i]); if (ok(p)) holes.push({ x: p.x, y: p.y, r: Number.isFinite(p.r) && p.r > 0 ? Math.min(2.5, p.r) : 1 }); }
    if (T && Array.isArray(T.path)) for (let i = 0; i < T.path.length && path.length < 32; i++) { const p = pt(T.path[i]); if (ok(p)) path.push({ x: p.x, y: p.y }); }
    if (holes.length < 2) { holes.length = 0; holes.push({ x: 9, y: 8, r: 1 }, { x: 9, y: 24, r: 1 }); }
    if (path.length < 2) { path.length = 0; path.push({ x: holes[0].x, y: holes[0].y }, { x: holes[holes.length - 1].x, y: holes[holes.length - 1].y }); }
    return { holes: holes, path: path };
  };
  /** SVG of the tunnel (svg y = 32 - sim y): the underground path dashed, the holes as dark
   *  pits with a stone rim. */
  function tunnelSvg() {
    const L = UI.tunnelLayout();
    let d = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < L.path.length; i++) d += (i ? 'L' : 'M') + L.path[i].x.toFixed(2) + ' ' + (32 - L.path[i].y).toFixed(2);
    let b = '<path d="' + d + '" fill="none" stroke="#3b2a17" stroke-opacity=".55" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray=".9 .7"/>';
    for (let i = 0; i < L.holes.length; i++) {
      const hl = L.holes[i];
      const cx = hl.x.toFixed(2), cy = (32 - hl.y).toFixed(2), r = Math.max(0.8, hl.r);
      b += '<ellipse cx="' + cx + '" cy="' + cy + '" rx="' + (r + 0.45).toFixed(2) + '" ry="' + (r * 0.8 + 0.4).toFixed(2) + '" fill="#8a7a63" stroke="#4a3d2c" stroke-width=".3"/>' +
        '<ellipse class="tun-hole" cx="' + cx + '" cy="' + cy + '" rx="' + r.toFixed(2) + '" ry="' + (r * 0.8).toFixed(2) + '" fill="#140d08"/>';
    }
    return b;
  }

  /** Small top-down preview of a map (static SVG, sim coordinates 18 x 32, side 0 at the
   *  bottom): grass, towers, and either the river with two bridges, the hill ridge or
   *  (v12) the flat field with the two tunnel holes. */
  UI.mapPreviewSvg = function (mapId, mode) {
    const id = UI.normMap(mapId);
    const hill = id === 'hill';
    if (mode === 'touchdown') return tdPreviewSvg(id);
    let b = '<rect x="0" y="0" width="18" height="32" rx="1.2" fill="#5fae3a"/>' +
      '<path d="M0 4h18M0 8h18M0 12h18M0 20h18M0 24h18M0 28h18" stroke="#6cbc44" stroke-width="2"/>';
    if (id === 'tunnel') {
      b += '<path d="M0 16h18" stroke="#fff" stroke-opacity=".5" stroke-width=".25"/>' + tunnelSvg();
    } else if (hill) {
      // ridge across the whole width: slopes 13.5-15 / 17-18.5, plateau 15-17 (top view)
      b += '<rect x="0" y="13.5" width="18" height="5" fill="#4f9a30"/>' +
        '<rect x="0" y="15" width="18" height="2" fill="#83c95a"/>' +
        '<path d="M0 13.5h18M0 18.5h18" stroke="#3d7a24" stroke-width=".45"/>' +
        '<circle cx="3" cy="16" r=".7" fill="#9aa3ad"/><circle cx="8.6" cy="15.7" r=".55" fill="#9aa3ad"/><circle cx="13.2" cy="16.4" r=".8" fill="#8a939d"/><circle cx="16.4" cy="15.8" r=".5" fill="#9aa3ad"/>';
    } else {
      b += '<rect x="0" y="15" width="18" height="2" fill="#3d8fe0"/>' +
        '<path d="M0 16h18" stroke="#8fd0ff" stroke-width=".35" stroke-dasharray="1 1.4"/>' +
        '<rect x="2.5" y="14.4" width="2" height="3.2" rx=".3" fill="#b47a3c" stroke="#6b4218" stroke-width=".25"/>' +
        '<rect x="13.5" y="14.4" width="2" height="3.2" rx=".3" fill="#b47a3c" stroke="#6b4218" stroke-width=".25"/>';
    }
    const tower = function (x, y, s, c) {
      return '<rect x="' + (x - s / 2) + '" y="' + (y - s / 2) + '" width="' + s + '" height="' + s + '" rx=".35" fill="' + c + '" stroke="#1b1030" stroke-width=".3"/>';
    };
    // svg y = 32 - sim y: the red side (1) on top, the own blue side (0) at the bottom.
    // v12: the towers come from CR.Arena.towerLayout() (CR-like layout: king further back and
    // shallower), else the classic static positions.
    let lay = null;
    try { lay = CR.Arena && typeof CR.Arena.towerLayout === 'function' ? CR.Arena.towerLayout() : null; } catch (e) { lay = null; }
    const okLay = Array.isArray(lay) && lay.length >= 6 && lay.every(function (t) { return t && [t.x0, t.y0, t.x1, t.y1].every(Number.isFinite) && t.x1 > t.x0 && t.y1 > t.y0; });
    if (okLay) {
      for (let i = 0; i < lay.length; i++) {
        const t = lay[i];
        const king = t.kind === 'king';
        const c = t.side === 1 ? (king ? '#ff4c42' : '#ff6a5e') : (king ? '#3f9cff' : '#6cb8ff');
        // a little smaller than the footprint so neighbouring tiles stay readable
        const w = (t.x1 - t.x0) * 0.85, d = (t.y1 - t.y0) * 0.85;
        b += '<rect x="' + (t.x - w / 2).toFixed(2) + '" y="' + (32 - t.y - d / 2).toFixed(2) + '" width="' + w.toFixed(2) + '" height="' + d.toFixed(2) + '" rx=".35" fill="' + c + '" stroke="#1b1030" stroke-width=".3"/>';
      }
    } else {
      b += tower(3.5, 6.5, 2.4, '#ff6a5e') + tower(14.5, 6.5, 2.4, '#ff6a5e') + tower(9, 3, 3, '#ff4c42');
      b += tower(3.5, 25.5, 2.4, '#6cb8ff') + tower(14.5, 25.5, 2.4, '#6cb8ff') + tower(9, 29, 3, '#3f9cff');
    }
    return '<svg viewBox="0 0 18 32" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">' + b + '</svg>';
  };

  /** v6: end zone rects in sim tiles ({x0, y0, x1, y1}) from CR.Arena.endZones(side), else
   *  the CR Touchdown field (one zone across the full width at each end). */
  UI.endZoneRects = function () {
    const out = [];
    const A = CR.Arena;
    if (A && typeof A.endZones === 'function') {
      for (let s = 0; s < 2; s++) {
        let r = null;
        try { r = A.endZones(s); } catch (e) { r = null; }
        const list = Array.isArray(r) ? r : (r ? [r] : EMPTY);
        for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
          const z = list[i];
          if (!z || typeof z !== 'object') continue;
          const x0 = typeof z.x0 === 'number' ? z.x0 : z.x;
          const y0 = typeof z.y0 === 'number' ? z.y0 : z.y;
          const x1 = typeof z.x1 === 'number' ? z.x1 : (typeof z.w === 'number' ? x0 + z.w : NaN);
          const y1 = typeof z.y1 === 'number' ? z.y1 : (typeof z.h === 'number' ? y0 + z.h : NaN);
          if ([x0, y0, x1, y1].every(Number.isFinite) && x1 > x0 && y1 > y0) out.push({ x0: Math.max(0, x0), y0: Math.max(0, y0), x1: Math.min(18, x1), y1: Math.min(32, y1) });
        }
      }
    }
    if (!out.length) { out.push({ x0: 0, y0: 0, x1: 18, y1: 3 }); out.push({ x0: 0, y0: 29, x1: 18, y1: 32 }); }
    return out;
  };
  /** Touchdown field preview: striped grass, white yard lines, the two end zones (own blue at
   *  the bottom, red on top), no towers; 'hill' adds the ridge across the middle, 'tunnel'
   *  (v12) the two holes. Takes a map id (legacy: true = hill). */
  function tdPreviewSvg(mapId) {
    const id = mapId === true ? 'hill' : UI.normMap(mapId);
    const hill = id === 'hill';
    let b = '<rect x="0" y="0" width="18" height="32" rx="1.2" fill="#4fa83a"/>';
    for (let y = 0; y < 32; y += 4) b += '<rect x="0" y="' + y + '" width="18" height="2" fill="#5cb846"/>';
    if (hill) {
      b += '<rect x="0" y="13.5" width="18" height="5" fill="#45922e"/><rect x="0" y="15" width="18" height="2" fill="#83c95a"/>' +
        '<path d="M0 13.5h18M0 18.5h18" stroke="#3d7a24" stroke-width=".45"/>';
    }
    // yard lines + hash marks, the centre line a bit stronger
    for (let y = 4; y <= 28; y += 2) {
      const mid = y === 16;
      b += '<path d="M1 ' + y + 'h16" stroke="#fff" stroke-opacity="' + (mid ? '.95' : '.55') + '" stroke-width="' + (mid ? '.32' : '.18') + '"/>';
    }
    const zones = UI.endZoneRects();
    for (let i = 0; i < zones.length; i++) {
      const z = zones[i];
      const red = (z.y0 + z.y1) / 2 >= 16;        // svg y = 32 - sim y: red on top
      const sy = 32 - z.y1;
      const hgt = z.y1 - z.y0;
      const c1 = red ? '#e5463b' : '#2f7fe0';
      const c2 = red ? '#ff7a6e' : '#68b4ff';
      b += '<rect x="' + z.x0 + '" y="' + sy + '" width="' + (z.x1 - z.x0) + '" height="' + hgt + '" fill="' + c1 + '"/>';
      // diagonal stripes, clipped to the zone by hand (no clipPath ids in inline svgs)
      for (let x = z.x0 - hgt; x < z.x1; x += 1.6) {
        const t0 = Math.max(0, (z.x0 - x) / hgt), t1 = Math.min(1, (z.x1 - x) / hgt);
        if (t1 <= t0) continue;
        b += '<path d="M' + (x + t0 * hgt).toFixed(2) + ' ' + (sy + hgt - t0 * hgt).toFixed(2) + 'L' + (x + t1 * hgt).toFixed(2) + ' ' + (sy + hgt - t1 * hgt).toFixed(2) + '" stroke="' + c2 + '" stroke-width=".55"/>';
      }
      b += '<rect x="' + z.x0 + '" y="' + sy + '" width="' + (z.x1 - z.x0) + '" height="' + hgt + '" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width=".35"/>';
    }
    if (id === 'tunnel') b += tunnelSvg();
    return '<svg viewBox="0 0 18 32" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">' + b + '</svg>';
  }
  UI.tdPreviewSvg = tdPreviewSvg;
  /** Map sub-labels per mode (Touchdown: the CR field / the field with the hill). */
  function mapSub(m, mode) {
    if (mode !== 'touchdown') return m.sub;
    if (m.id === 'tunnel') return 'Football-Feld mit Tunnel';
    return m.id === 'hill' ? 'Feld mit Hügel in der Mitte' : 'Football-Feld mit Endzonen';
  }
  UI.mapSub = function (id, mode) { const m = MAPS.filter(function (x) { return x.id === UI.normMap(id); })[0]; return mapSub(m, mode); };

  /** Map choice: two buttons with a preview each. opts.mode ('touchdown' shows the touchdown
   *  fields). -> { el, set(id), setMode(mode) } */
  function mapPicker(value, onChange, opts) {
    const o = opts || NONE;
    let mode = o.mode === 'touchdown' ? 'touchdown' : 'chaos';
    const el = h('div', { class: 'map-pick' + (o.compact ? ' is-compact' : '') + (MAPS.length > 2 ? ' has-' + MAPS.length : ''), role: 'radiogroup', 'aria-label': 'Karte' });
    const isOff = function (id) { return !!(o.disabled && o.disabled(id, mode)); };
    const prevs = [];
    const subs = [];
    const btns = MAPS.map(function (m) {
      const prev = h('span', { class: 'map-prev', html: UI.mapPreviewSvg(m.id, mode) });
      const sub = h('span', { class: 'map-sub' }, mapSub(m, mode));
      prevs.push(prev);
      subs.push(sub);
      const b = h('button', {
        type: 'button', role: 'radio', class: 'map-opt map-' + m.id + (m.id === value ? ' on' : ''),
        'aria-checked': m.id === value ? 'true' : 'false', 'aria-label': 'Karte ' + m.label + ': ' + mapSub(m, mode), disabled: isOff(m.id),
      }, [prev, h('span', { class: 'map-txt' }, [h('span', { class: 'map-label' }, m.label), sub])]);
      b.addEventListener('click', function () {
        if (b.disabled) return;
        set(m.id);
        onChange(m.id);
      });
      el.appendChild(b);
      return b;
    });
    function set(v) {
      for (let i = 0; i < MAPS.length; i++) {
        btns[i].classList.toggle('on', MAPS[i].id === v);
        btns[i].setAttribute('aria-checked', MAPS[i].id === v ? 'true' : 'false');
      }
    }
    function setMode(md) {
      const next = md === 'touchdown' ? 'touchdown' : 'chaos';
      if (next === mode) return;
      mode = next;
      el.classList.toggle('is-td', mode === 'touchdown');
      for (let i = 0; i < MAPS.length; i++) {
        prevs[i].innerHTML = UI.mapPreviewSvg(MAPS[i].id, mode);
        subs[i].textContent = mapSub(MAPS[i], mode);
        btns[i].setAttribute('aria-label', 'Karte ' + MAPS[i].label + ': ' + mapSub(MAPS[i], mode));
        btns[i].disabled = isOff(MAPS[i].id);
      }
    }
    el.classList.toggle('is-td', mode === 'touchdown');
    return { el: el, set: set, setMode: setMode, buttons: btns };
  }

  /**
   * v6: game mode choice "C.H.A.O.S / Touchdown" plus the switch "Touchdown mit
   * C.H.A.O.S-Upgrades" (only visible for Touchdown). opts: { canTouchdown, canChaos,
   * tdNote, compact }. onChange(mode, tdChaos, tdDraft). -> { el, set(mode, tdChaos, tdDraft) }
   * v7: plus the switch "Touchdown mit Draft" (opts.tdDraft, default on; opts.canDraft ===
   * false hides it when the draft module is missing).
   */
  function modePicker(mode, tdChaos, onChange, opts) {
    const o = opts || NONE;
    let cur = UI.normGameMode(mode);
    let chaos = !!tdChaos;
    let draft = o.tdDraft !== false;
    const seg = segmented(GAME_MODES.map(function (m) {
      return { id: m.id, label: m.label, sub: m.sub, icon: m.icon, cls: 'gm-' + m.id, disabled: m.id === 'touchdown' && o.canTouchdown === false };
    }), cur, function (id) { cur = id; paint(); onChange(cur, chaos, draft); }, 'seg seg-mode' + (GAME_MODES.length > 2 ? ' has-' + GAME_MODES.length : ''));
    // v7: "Touchdown mit Draft" - both decks are drafted card by card before the battle
    const dKnob = h('span', { class: 'tg-knob', 'aria-hidden': 'true' });
    const dTog = h('button', { class: 'toggle tg-tddraft', type: 'button', role: 'switch', 'aria-checked': draft ? 'true' : 'false', hidden: o.canDraft === false },
      [h('span', { class: 'tg-track', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }, dKnob), icon('cards', 'tg-ico'), h('span', { class: 'tg-label' }, 'Touchdown mit Draft')]);
    dTog.addEventListener('click', function () {
      if (dTog.disabled) return;
      draft = !draft;
      paint();
      Sound.play('select');
      onChange(cur, chaos, draft);
    });
    const knob = h('span', { class: 'tg-knob', 'aria-hidden': 'true' });
    const tog = h('button', { class: 'toggle tg-tdchaos', type: 'button', role: 'switch', 'aria-checked': chaos ? 'true' : 'false', disabled: o.canChaos === false },
      [h('span', { class: 'tg-track', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }, knob), icon('bolt', 'tg-ico'), h('span', { class: 'tg-label' }, 'Touchdown mit C.H.A.O.S-Upgrades')]);
    tog.addEventListener('click', function () {
      if (tog.disabled) return;
      chaos = !chaos;
      paint();
      Sound.play('select');
      onChange(cur, chaos, draft);
    });
    const note = o.canTouchdown === false && o.tdNote ? h('div', { class: 'hint info' }, o.tdNote) : null;
    const el = h('div', { class: 'mode-pick' + (o.compact ? ' is-compact' : '') }, [seg.el, dTog, tog, note]);
    function paint() {
      tog.hidden = cur !== 'touchdown';
      tog.classList.toggle('on', chaos);
      tog.setAttribute('aria-checked', chaos ? 'true' : 'false');
      dTog.hidden = cur !== 'touchdown' || o.canDraft === false;
      dTog.classList.toggle('on', draft);
      dTog.setAttribute('aria-checked', draft ? 'true' : 'false');
      el.classList.toggle('is-td', cur === 'touchdown');
      el.classList.toggle('is-classic', cur === 'classic');
    }
    paint();
    return {
      el: el,
      set: function (m, c, d) {
        cur = UI.normGameMode(m);
        if (c != null) chaos = !!c;
        if (d != null) draft = !!d;
        seg.set(cur);
        paint();
      },
    };
  }
  UI.modePicker = modePicker;

  /**
   * v13: the switch "Schnelles Elixier (1,5×)" (menu panes + host lobby; keeps the toggle look of
   * the Touchdown switches). onChange(on). -> { el, set(on) }
   */
  function boostToggle(on, onChange, opts) {
    const o = opts || NONE;
    let cur = !!on;
    const knob = h('span', { class: 'tg-knob', 'aria-hidden': 'true' });
    const el = h('button', { class: 'toggle tg-boost', type: 'button', role: 'switch', 'aria-checked': cur ? 'true' : 'false', disabled: !!o.disabled },
      [h('span', { class: 'tg-track', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }, knob), icon('drop', 'tg-ico'), h('span', { class: 'tg-label' }, 'Schnelles Elixier (1,5×)')]);
    function paint() { el.classList.toggle('on', cur); el.setAttribute('aria-checked', cur ? 'true' : 'false'); }
    el.addEventListener('click', function () {
      if (el.disabled) return;
      cur = !cur;
      paint();
      Sound.play('select');
      if (onChange) onChange(cur);
    });
    paint();
    return { el: el, set: function (v) { cur = !!v; paint(); } };
  }
  UI.boostToggle = boostToggle;
  /** v13: German lobby hint when the own deck gets a building for a Touchdown battle ('' = none). */
  function buildingHintText(app, mode, options) {
    if (mode !== 'touchdown' || UI.draftOn(mode, options) || !app || typeof app.getDeck !== 'function') return '';
    const bs = UI.buildingSwap(app.getDeck(), 'touchdown');
    return bs ? 'Touchdown: Jedes Deck braucht ein Gebäude – für den Kampf ersetzt „' + UI.cardInfo(bs.in).name + '“ deine letzte Karte „' + UI.cardInfo(bs.out).name + '“.' : '';
  }
  function boostChip() { return h('span', { class: 'info-chip is-boost' }, [icon('drop'), 'Elixier 1,5×']); }
  UI.mapPicker = mapPicker;

  /** Volume slider 0..100 %. onInput(v 0..1) while dragging, onChange(v) at the end. */
  function slider(label, value, onInput, onChange) {
    const pct = h('span', { class: 'sl-pct' }, Math.round(value * 100) + ' %');
    const input = h('input', { class: 'sl-input', type: 'range', min: '0', max: '100', step: '5', value: String(Math.round(value * 100)), 'aria-label': label });
    const paint = function () {
      const v = (+input.value || 0);
      pct.textContent = v + ' %';
      input.style.setProperty('--p', v + '%');
    };
    paint();
    input.addEventListener('input', function () { paint(); if (onInput) onInput((+input.value || 0) / 100); });
    input.addEventListener('change', function () { paint(); if (onChange) onChange((+input.value || 0) / 100); });
    return { el: h('div', { class: 'sl' }, [input, pct]), input: input };
  }

  function costBadge(elixir) {
    return h('span', { class: 'cost' }, [h('i'), h('b', null, elixir == null ? '?' : String(elixir))]);
  }

  /** Card art box: monogram placeholder in the card colour, replaced by the 3D portrait. */
  function artBox(id, host) {
    const inf = UI.cardInfo(id);
    const el = h('span', { class: 'card-art' }, h('span', { class: 'art-ini' }, inf.initials));
    el.style.setProperty('--cc', inf.color);
    el.style.setProperty('--ca', inf.accent);
    Art.apply(el, id, host);
    return el;
  }
  UI.artBox = artBox;

  function cardTile(id, extraCls) {
    const inf = UI.cardInfo(id);
    const el = h('button', {
      type: 'button',
      class: 'card rar-' + inf.rarity + ' t-' + inf.type + (extraCls ? ' ' + extraCls : ''),
      'aria-label': inf.name + ', ' + (inf.elixir == null ? '?' : inf.elixir) + ' Elixier',
    });
    el.appendChild(artBox(id, el));
    el.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'card-shine', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }));
    const nm = h('span', { class: 'card-name' }, inf.name);
    UI.fitName(nm, inf.name);   // long names: two lines at a hyphen, else shrink to fit
    el.appendChild(nm);
    el.appendChild(costBadge(inf.elixir));
    el.style.setProperty('--cc', inf.color);
    return el;
  }

  function deckMini(ids) {
    return h('span', { class: 'deck-mini', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }, ids.map(function (id) {
      const inf = UI.cardInfo(id);
      const sp = h('span', { class: 'dm-card rar-' + inf.rarity });
      sp.appendChild(artBox(id, sp));
      return sp;
    }));
  }

  function backButton(onClick) {
    const b = h('button', { class: 'btn btn-grey btn-icon', type: 'button', 'aria-label': 'Zurück' }, icon('back'));
    b.addEventListener('click', onClick);
    return b;
  }

  function iconButton(name, label, cls, onClick) {
    const b = h('button', { class: 'btn btn-icon ' + (cls || 'btn-grey'), type: 'button', 'aria-label': label }, icon(name));
    if (onClick) b.addEventListener('click', onClick);
    return b;
  }

  function crownCounter(team) {
    const num = h('span', null, '0');
    const el = h('div', { class: 'crowns ' + team, 'aria-label': 'Kronen' });
    el.innerHTML = CROWN_SVG;
    el.appendChild(num);
    return {
      el: el,
      n: -1,
      set: function (n, animate, replayFn) {
        if (n === this.n) return;
        this.n = n;
        num.textContent = String(n);
        if (animate) (replayFn || replayClass)(el, 'bump');
      },
    };
  }

  /** v6 Touchdown score counter: football + number + one pip per touchdown needed. */
  function tdCounter(team) {
    const ball = h('span', { class: 'td-ball', html: ICON.football });
    const num = h('span', { class: 'td-num' }, '0');
    const pips = h('span', { class: 'td-pips' });
    const el = h('div', { class: 'td-count ' + team, 'aria-label': 'Touchdowns' }, [ball, num, pips]);
    return {
      el: el,
      n: -1,
      target: -1,
      set: function (n, target, animate, replayFn) {
        if (target !== this.target) {
          this.target = target;
          pips.textContent = '';
          for (let i = 0; i < target; i++) pips.appendChild(h('i'));
          this.n = -2;   // repaint the pips
        }
        if (n === this.n) return;
        this.n = n;
        num.textContent = String(n);
        for (let i = 0; i < pips.children.length; i++) pips.children[i].classList.toggle('on', i < n);
        if (animate) (replayFn || replayClass)(el, 'bump');
      },
    };
  }

  /** German status line. CR.Net messages are complete German sentences and shown as is. */
  function statusText(s, role) {
    const st = s && s.state;
    const msg = s && s.message ? String(s.message) : '';
    if (st === 'connecting') return msg || 'Verbinde …';
    if (st === 'waiting') return msg || (role === 'host' ? 'Warte auf Mitspieler …' : 'Warte auf Gastgeber …');
    if (st === 'connected') return 'Verbunden';
    if (st === 'lost') return 'Verbindung unterbrochen – verbinde neu …';
    if (st === 'error') return msg || 'Verbindungsfehler';
    return msg || 'Bereit';
  }
  UI.statusText = statusText;

  function transportLabel(t) {
    if (!t) return '';
    const s = String(t).toLowerCase();
    if (s === 'none') return '';
    if (s.indexOf('room') >= 0 || s.indexOf('claude') >= 0) return 'claude-Raum';
    if (s.indexOf('peer') >= 0 || s.indexOf('rtc') >= 0) return 'WebRTC';
    if (s.indexOf('loop') >= 0 || s.indexOf('broadcast') >= 0) return 'Lokal';
    return String(t);
  }

  function statusRow() {
    const dot = h('span', { class: 'status-dot' });
    const text = h('span', { class: 'status-text' }, '…');
    const tr = h('span', { class: 'status-transport' });
    const el = h('div', { class: 'status-row', role: 'status', 'aria-live': 'polite' }, [dot, text, tr]);
    return {
      el: el,
      set: function (s, role) {
        const st = (s && s.state) || 'connecting';
        dot.className = 'status-dot s-' + st;
        text.textContent = statusText(s, role);
        tr.textContent = transportLabel(s && s.transport);
      },
    };
  }

  // ======================================================================== MAIN MENU

  /** The three most valuable cards of a deck (highest rarity, then cost) for the hero fan. */
  function heroCards(deck) {
    const ids = (deck || EMPTY).slice();
    ids.sort(function (a, b) {
      const A = UI.cardInfo(a); const B = UI.cardInfo(b);
      const ra = RARITY[A.rarity].order; const rb = RARITY[B.rarity].order;
      if (ra !== rb) return rb - ra;
      return (B.elixir || 0) - (A.elixir || 0);
    });
    return ids.slice(0, 3);
  }

  function heroFan(deck) {
    const ids = heroCards(deck);
    // centre card = the best one, flanked by the next two
    const order = ids.length === 3 ? [ids[1], ids[0], ids[2]] : ids;
    return h('div', { class: 'hero', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }, order.map(function (id, i) {
      const inf = UI.cardInfo(id);
      const c = h('div', { class: 'hero-card rar-' + inf.rarity + ' hc-' + (order.length === 3 ? i : 1) });
      c.appendChild(artBox(id, c));
      c.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'card-shine' }));
      c.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'hero-name' }, inf.name));
      return c;
    }));
  }

  UI.MenuScreen = function (app) {
    const s = app.settings;
    const f = app.features;
    const notes = f.notes || NONE;

    const nameInput = h('input', {
      class: 'text-input', type: 'text', maxlength: '16', value: UI.isDefaultName(s.name) ? '' : s.name, placeholder: 'Dein Name',
      autocomplete: 'off', autocapitalize: 'words', spellcheck: 'false', enterkeyhint: 'done',
      'aria-label': 'Dein Name',
    });
    const commitName = function () {
      app.setName(nameInput.value);
      nameInput.value = UI.isDefaultName(app.settings.name) ? '' : app.settings.name;
    };
    nameInput.addEventListener('change', commitName);
    nameInput.addEventListener('blur', commitName);
    nameInput.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Enter') nameInput.blur(); });

    const muteBtn = iconButton(s.muted ? 'speakerOff' : 'speakerOn', 'Ton an/aus', 'btn-grey', function () {
      app.setMuted(!app.settings.muted);
      muteBtn.textContent = '';
      muteBtn.appendChild(icon(app.settings.muted ? 'speakerOff' : 'speakerOn'));
    });
    const settingsBtn = iconButton('gear', 'Einstellungen', 'btn-grey', function () {
      UI.openSettings(app, { onClose: function (changed) { if (changed && app.screen === api) app.showMenu(); } });
    });
    const syncMute = function () {
      muteBtn.textContent = '';
      muteBtn.appendChild(icon(app.settings.muted ? 'speakerOff' : 'speakerOn'));
    };

    // One hint per distinct problem (when the engine is missing every feature has the same note).
    const shown = Object.create(null);
    const hint = function (text, cls) {
      if (!text || shown[text]) return null;
      shown[text] = true;
      return h('div', { class: 'hint ' + (cls || 'warn') }, text);
    };
    const blocked = !f.play;
    const topHint = blocked ? hint(notes.play || notes.data || 'Spielen ist gerade nicht möglich.', 'err') : null;

    // ---- play type switch (one tap, remembered)
    const playSeg = segmented(PLAY_TYPES.map(function (p) {
      return { id: p.id, label: p.label, sub: p.sub, icon: p.icon, cls: 'pt-' + p.id };
    }), s.playType, function (id) { app.setPlayType(id); showPane(id); }, 'seg seg-play');

    // ---- v6: game mode (C.H.A.O.S / Touchdown, optionally Touchdown + C.H.A.O.S; v12: +
    // Klassisch ohne C.H.A.O.S), shared by both panes; the map previews follow the mode
    const canTd = !!f.touchdown;
    const gmNow = function () { return UI.allowedGameMode(app.settings.gameMode, f); };
    const mapOff = function (id) { return !UI.mapEnabled(id, f); };
    const modeOpts = { canTouchdown: canTd, canChaos: !!f.chaos, tdDraft: s.tdDraft !== false, canDraft: f.draft !== false, tdNote: notes.touchdown || 'Touchdown ist gerade nicht verfügbar.', compact: true };
    const pickers = [];
    function onGameMode(m, c, d) {
      app.setGameMode(m, c, d);
      const gm = gmNow();
      for (let i = 0; i < pickers.length; i++) pickers[i].set(gm, app.settings.tdChaos, app.settings.tdDraft);
      if (mapPick) mapPick.setMode(gm);
      if (duoMap) duoMap.setMode(gm);
      refreshModeUi();
    }
    // v13: "Schnelles Elixier (1,5×)" - one setting, a switch in each pane (kept in sync)
    const boosts = [];
    function onBoost(on) {
      app.setElixirBoost(on);
      for (let i = 0; i < boosts.length; i++) boosts[i].set(app.settings.elixirBoost);
    }
    boosts.push(boostToggle(s.elixirBoost, onBoost), boostToggle(s.elixirBoost, onBoost));
    const singleMode = modePicker(gmNow(), s.tdChaos, onGameMode, modeOpts);
    const duoMode = modePicker(gmNow(), s.tdChaos, onGameMode, modeOpts);
    pickers.push(singleMode, duoMode);
    // deck cards the Touchdown does not allow: a hint (they are swapped for the battle only)
    const tdDeckHints = [h('div', { class: 'hint info td-deck-hint', hidden: true }), h('div', { class: 'hint info td-deck-hint', hidden: true })];
    function refreshModeUi() {
      const td = gmNow() === 'touchdown';
      const bad = td ? UI.bannedCards(app.getDeck(), 'touchdown') : EMPTY;
      // v13: Touchdown needs a building in every deck (with the draft the draft guarantees it)
      const drafted = app.settings.tdDraft !== false && f.draft !== false;
      const bs = td && !drafted ? UI.buildingSwap(app.getDeck(), 'touchdown') : null;
      const parts = [];
      if (bad.length === 1) parts.push('„' + UI.cardInfo(bad[0]).name + '“ ist im Touchdown nicht erlaubt – für den Kampf kommt eine andere Karte ins Deck.');
      else if (bad.length) parts.push(bad.length + ' Karten deines Decks sind im Touchdown nicht erlaubt – für den Kampf kommen andere Karten ins Deck.');
      if (bs) parts.push('Im Touchdown braucht jedes Deck ein Gebäude – für den Kampf ersetzt „' + UI.cardInfo(bs.in).name + '“ deine letzte Karte „' + UI.cardInfo(bs.out).name + '“.');
      for (let i = 0; i < tdDeckHints.length; i++) {
        tdDeckHints[i].hidden = !parts.length;
        tdDeckHints[i].textContent = parts.join(' ');
      }
      if (rulesBadge) {
        const gm = gmNow();
        const chaosBadge = gm === 'chaos' && f.chaos;
        rulesBadge.textContent = td ? UI.modeLabel('touchdown', { chaos: app.settings.tdChaos && f.chaos }) : (chaosBadge ? 'C.H.A.O.S' : (gm === 'classic' ? 'Klassisch' : 'Grundregeln'));
        rulesBadge.classList.toggle('is-td', td);
        rulesBadge.classList.toggle('is-chaos', chaosBadge);
      }
    }

    // ---- Single-Modus
    const diffSeg = segmented(DIFFICULTIES, s.difficulty, function (id) { app.setDifficulty(id); }, 'seg seg-sm');
    // v5: 1 gegen 1 / 2 gegen 2 (you + bot vs two bots) and the map
    const can2 = !!f.team2;
    const teamSeg = segmented(TEAM_SIZES.map(function (t) { return { id: t.id, label: t.label, disabled: t.id === 2 && !can2 }; }),
      can2 ? s.teamSize : 1, function (id) { app.setTeamSize(id); refreshFight(); }, 'seg seg-sm seg-team');
    const mapPick = mapPicker(UI.allowedMap(s.map, f), function (id) { app.setMap(id); if (duoMap) duoMap.set(id); }, { compact: true, mode: gmNow(), disabled: mapOff });
    const fightSub = h('span', { class: 'btn-sub' }, '');
    const fightBtn = h('button', { class: 'btn btn-gold btn-xl btn-block btn-fight', type: 'button', disabled: !f.ai },
      [icon('swords', 'ico-lg'), h('span', { class: 'btn-stack' }, ['Kampf!', fightSub])]);
    fightBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { app.startVsAI(); });
    function refreshFight() {
      const two = can2 && app.settings.teamSize === 2;
      fightSub.textContent = two ? 'Du + Bot gegen 2 Bots' : 'Du gegen einen Bot';
    }
    refreshFight();
    const singlePane = h('div', { class: 'play-pane pane-single' }, [
      h('div', { class: 'menu-label' }, 'Spielmodus'),
      singleMode.el,
      tdDeckHints[0],
      boosts[0].el,
      h('div', { class: 'menu-label' }, 'KI-Stufe'),
      diffSeg.el,
      h('div', { class: 'menu-label' }, 'Modus'),
      teamSeg.el,
      can2 ? null : hint(notes.team2 || '2 gegen 2 ist gerade nicht verfügbar.', 'info'),
      h('div', { class: 'menu-label' }, 'Karte'),
      mapPick.el,
      f.hill ? null : hint(notes.hill || 'Die Hügel-Karte ist gerade nicht verfügbar.', 'info'),
      f.tunnel ? null : hint(notes.tunnel || 'Die Tunnel-Karte ist gerade nicht verfügbar.', 'info'),
      fightBtn,
      f.ai ? null : hint(notes.ai || 'Die KI ist gerade nicht verfügbar.'),
    ]);

    // ---- Mit Freunden: mode (1v1 with one friend / 2v2 with three friends) + map right here,
    // "Spiel erstellen" opens the lobby in that mode; joining with a code stays below.
    const duoTs = can2 ? UI.normTeamSize(s.duoTeamSize) : 1;
    const duoSeg = segmented(DUO_MODES.map(function (m) {
      return { id: m.id, label: m.label, sub: m.sub, icon: m.icon, cls: 'dm-' + m.id, disabled: m.id === 2 && !can2 };
    }), duoTs, function (id) { app.setDuoTeamSize(id); refreshHost(); }, 'seg seg-duo');
    const duoMap = mapPicker(UI.allowedMap(s.map, f), function (id) { app.setMap(id); mapPick.set(id); },
      { compact: true, mode: gmNow(), disabled: mapOff });
    const hostSub = h('span', { class: 'btn-sub' }, '');
    const hostBtn = h('button', { class: 'btn btn-blue btn-xl btn-block btn-host', type: 'button', disabled: !f.net }, [
      icon('people', 'ico-lg'),
      h('span', { class: 'btn-stack' }, ['Spiel erstellen', hostSub]),
    ]);
    function refreshHost() {
      const two = can2 && UI.normTeamSize(app.settings.duoTeamSize) === 2;
      hostSub.textContent = two ? 'Link an 3 Freunde schicken' : 'Link an 1 Freund schicken';
    }
    refreshHost();
    hostBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      app.startHost({ teamSize: can2 ? UI.normTeamSize(app.settings.duoTeamSize) : 1, map: UI.allowedMap(app.settings.map, f), gameMode: gmNow(), tdChaos: !!app.settings.tdChaos, tdDraft: app.settings.tdDraft !== false, elixirBoost: !!app.settings.elixirBoost });
    });
    const codeInput = h('input', {
      class: 'code-input code-inline', type: 'text', inputmode: 'text', maxlength: '120', placeholder: 'CODE',
      autocomplete: 'off', autocapitalize: 'characters', spellcheck: 'false', enterkeyhint: 'go',
      'aria-label': 'Spiel-Code eines Freundes', disabled: !f.net,
    });
    const codeErr = h('div', { class: 'hint err', hidden: true }, 'Ungültiger Code – bitte prüfen.');
    const joinBtn = h('button', { class: 'btn btn-green btn-join', type: 'button', disabled: !f.net }, 'Beitreten');
    const doJoin = function () {
      const code = UI.parseJoinCode(codeInput.value);
      if (!code) { codeErr.hidden = false; replayClass(codeInput, 'shake'); Sound.play('deny'); return; }
      codeInput.value = code;
      commitName();
      app.showJoin(code, { auto: true });
    };
    codeInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
      const v = codeInput.value;
      if (/[#/]|join/i.test(v)) { const c = UI.parseJoinCode(v); if (c) codeInput.value = c; }
      codeErr.hidden = true;
    });
    codeInput.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Enter') doJoin(); });
    joinBtn.addEventListener('click', doJoin);
    const duoPane = h('div', { class: 'play-pane pane-duo' }, [
      h('div', { class: 'menu-label' }, 'Spielmodus'),
      duoMode.el,
      tdDeckHints[1],
      boosts[1].el,
      h('div', { class: 'menu-label' }, 'Wie viele spielen?'),
      duoSeg.el,
      can2 ? null : hint(notes.team2 || '2 gegen 2 ist gerade nicht verfügbar.', 'info'),
      h('div', { class: 'menu-label' }, 'Karte'),
      duoMap.el,
      hostBtn,
      h('div', { class: 'or-line' }, h('span', null, 'oder Code eingeben')),
      h('div', { class: 'join-row' }, [codeInput, joinBtn]),
      codeErr,
      f.net ? null : hint(notes.net || 'Spielen mit Freunden ist gerade nicht möglich.'),
    ]);

    function showPane(id) {
      singlePane.hidden = id !== 'single';
      duoPane.hidden = id !== 'duo';
      panel.classList.toggle('is-duo', id === 'duo');
      const m = UI.allowedMap(app.settings.map, f);
      mapPick.set(m);
      duoMap.set(m);
    }

    // ---- rules badge (Spieltempo lives in the settings screen since v5)
    const rulesBadge = h('div', { class: 'rules-badge' + (f.chaos ? ' is-chaos' : '') }, f.chaos ? 'C.H.A.O.S' : 'Grundregeln');   // refreshModeUi sets the real label
    refreshModeUi();

    const panel = h('div', { class: 'menu-panel panel' }, [
      topHint,
      playSeg.el,
      singlePane,
      duoPane,
      f.chaos ? null : hint(notes.chaos || 'C.H.A.O.S ist gerade nicht verfügbar – es gelten die Grundregeln.'),
    ]);
    showPane(s.playType);

    const deck = app.getDeck();
    const deckBtn = h('button', { class: 'deck-btn', type: 'button', 'aria-label': 'Deck bearbeiten' }, [
      h('span', { class: 'deck-btn-text' }, [
        h('span', { class: 'deck-btn-title' }, [icon('cards'), 'Dein Deck']),
        h('span', { class: 'deck-btn-avg' }, 'Ø ' + UI.formatDecimal(UI.avgElixir(deck)) + ' Elixier · bearbeiten'),
      ]),
      deckMini(deck),
    ]);
    deckBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { app.showDeck(); });
    if (!f.data) deckBtn.disabled = true;

    const rulesBtn = iconButton('book', 'Regeln', 'btn-grey', function () { app.showRules(); });

    // One-time tip: start from the home screen for the biggest view (no browser bars).
    let homeHint = null;
    const hintPf = UI.homeHintPlatform();
    const hintSeen = +UI.store.get('homeHint', 0) || 0;
    if (hintPf && hintSeen < 1) {
      UI.store.set('homeHint', 1);
      const close = h('button', { class: 'home-hint-x', type: 'button', 'aria-label': 'Hinweis schließen' }, icon('check'));
      const shareIco = icon('share', 'hh-share');
      homeHint = h('div', { class: 'home-hint', role: 'note' }, [
        h('div', { class: 'hh-ico' }, icon('phone')),
        h('div', { class: 'hh-text' }, hintPf === 'ios'
          ? [h('b', null, 'Größte Ansicht: '), 'In Safari auf ', shareIco, ' (Teilen) tippen und „Zum Home-Bildschirm“ wählen. Dann startet das Spiel im Vollbild – ohne Browserleisten.']
          : [h('b', null, 'Größte Ansicht: '), 'Im Browser-Menü ⋮ „Zum Startbildschirm hinzufügen“ wählen. Dann startet das Spiel im Vollbild.']),
        close,
      ]);
      close.addEventListener('click', function () { remove(homeHint); });
    }

    const el = h('div', { class: 'screen screen-menu scroll' }, [
      homeHint,
      h('div', { class: 'menu-top' }, [
        h('div', { class: 'name-chip' }, [h('label', null, 'Name'), nameInput]),
        rulesBtn,
        settingsBtn,
        muteBtn,
      ]),
      h('div', { class: 'logo-wrap' }, [
        h('div', { class: 'logo' }, ['Bust', h('span', { class: 'logo-2' }, 'War')]),
        rulesBadge,
      ]),
      f.data ? heroFan(deck) : null,
      panel,
      deckBtn,
      f.data ? null : hint(notes.data || 'Kartendaten fehlen.', 'err'),
    ]);

    const api = { el: el, syncMute: syncMute, destroy: function () {} };
    return api;
  };

  // ======================================================================== SETTINGS

  /**
   * v5 settings screen (bottom sheet over the menu or the paused battle): Musik-Lautstärke,
   * Effekte-Lautstärke, Ton aus, Vibration, Grafik 3D / 2D, Spieltempo.
   * opts: { onClose(changed), inBattle (tempo applies from the next battle), onGfx(id) }.
   * Volumes and mute go to CR.Audio at once (live preview while dragging).
   */
  UI.openSettings = function (app, opts) {
    const o = opts || NONE;
    const s = app.settings;
    const f = app.features || NONE;
    let changed = false;
    const mark = function () { changed = true; };
    const can3d = !!f.gfx3d;
    const rows = [];
    const row = function (ic, label, control, note, cls) {
      const r = h('div', { class: 'set-row' + (cls ? ' ' + cls : '') }, [
        h('div', { class: 'set-label' }, [icon(ic), label]),
        control,
        note ? h('div', { class: 'hint set-note' }, note) : null,
      ]);
      rows.push(r);
      return r;
    };
    const hasAudio = !!UI.audio();
    // ---- sound
    const sect = function (t) { rows.push(h('div', { class: 'set-sect' }, t)); };
    sect('Ton');
    const music = slider('Musik-Lautstärke', s.musicVol, function (v) { app.setMusicVol(v, true); }, function (v) { app.setMusicVol(v); mark(); });
    row('speakerOn', 'Musik', music.el, hasAudio ? null : 'Musik gibt es, sobald das Ton-Modul geladen ist.', 'set-slider');
    const sfx = slider('Effekte-Lautstärke', s.sfxVol, function (v) { app.setSfxVol(v, true); }, function (v) { app.setSfxVol(v); mark(); Sound.play('select'); });
    row('bolt', 'Effekte', sfx.el, null, 'set-slider');
    const muteRow = row(s.muted ? 'speakerOff' : 'speakerOn', 'Ton aus', segmented([{ id: 'on', label: 'Ton an' }, { id: 'off', label: 'Ton aus' }],
      s.muted ? 'off' : 'on', function (id) {
        app.setMuted(id === 'off');
        mark();
        const ic = muteRow.querySelector && muteRow.querySelector('.set-label .ico');
        if (ic) ic.innerHTML = ICON[id === 'off' ? 'speakerOff' : 'speakerOn'];
        if (id === 'on') Sound.play('select');
      }, 'seg seg-sm').el);
    if (UI.canVibrate()) {
      row('vibrate', 'Vibration', segmented([{ id: 'on', label: 'An' }, { id: 'off', label: 'Aus' }],
        s.haptics ? 'on' : 'off', function (id) { app.setHaptics(id === 'on'); mark(); if (id === 'on') vibrate(20); }, 'seg seg-sm').el);
    }
    // ---- game
    sect('Spiel');
    row('cube', 'Grafik', segmented(GFX_MODES.map(function (g) { return { id: g.id, label: g.label, disabled: g.id === '3d' && !can3d }; }),
      can3d ? s.gfx : '2d', function (id) { app.setGfx(id); mark(); if (o.onGfx) o.onGfx(id); }, 'seg seg-sm').el,
      can3d ? '2D spart Akku auf älteren Handys.' : ((f.notes && f.notes.gfx3d) || '3D-Grafik ist auf diesem Gerät nicht verfügbar.'));
    row('forward', 'Spieltempo', segmented(SPEEDS.map(function (sp) { return { id: sp.id, label: sp.label, sub: sp.sub }; }),
      s.speed, function (id) { app.setSpeed(id); mark(); }, 'seg seg-sm').el,
      (o.inBattle ? 'Gilt ab dem nächsten Kampf. ' : '') + 'Original = Tempo wie im echten Spiel (Standard). Schnell = alles läuft 1,5-mal so schnell. Mit Freunden gilt das Tempo des Gastgebers.');
    const closeBtn = h('button', { class: 'btn btn-blue btn-block', type: 'button' }, 'Fertig');
    const sheet = h('div', { class: 'sheet sheet-settings scroll', role: 'dialog', 'aria-modal': 'true', 'aria-label': 'Einstellungen' }, [
      h('div', { class: 'sheet-grip', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }),
      h('div', { class: 'sheet-title' }, [icon('gear'), 'Einstellungen']),
      rows,
      closeBtn,
    ]);
    const back = h('div', { class: 'sheet-backdrop is-settings' }, sheet);
    let open = true;
    const close = function () {
      if (!open) return;
      open = false;
      remove(back);
      if (o.onClose) o.onClose(changed);
    };
    back.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (e.target === back) close(); });
    closeBtn.addEventListener('click', close);
    app.stage.appendChild(back);
    return { close: close, el: back };
  };

  // ========================================================================= LOADING

  const TIPS = [
    'Ziehe eine Karte in die Arena – oder tippe erst die Karte und dann das Feld.',
    'Im C.H.A.O.S-Modus wählst du mitten im Kampf Upgrades für deine Karten.',
    'Mit Freunden: 1 gegen 1 oder 2 gegen 2 wählen, Spiel erstellen, Link verschicken – deine Freunde öffnen ihn und los geht’s.',
    'In der letzten Minute fließt das Elixier doppelt so schnell.',
    'Der König-Turm wacht auf, sobald er getroffen wird oder ein Prinzessinnen-Turm fällt.',
    'Upgrades erkennst du an der farbigen Aura um die Einheit.',
  ];

  /** Boot screen: logo, progress bar while the 3D card portraits are rendered, tips. */
  UI.LoadingScreen = function () {
    const fill = h('div', { class: 'load-fill' });
    const label = h('div', { class: 'load-label' }, 'Arena wird aufgebaut …');
    const tip = h('div', { class: 'load-tip' }, TIPS[0]);
    let tipIdx = 0;
    const tipTimer = G.setInterval(function () {
      tipIdx = (tipIdx + 1) % TIPS.length;
      tip.textContent = TIPS[tipIdx];
      replayClass(tip, 'fade');
    }, 2600);
    const showcase = h('div', { class: 'load-cards', 'aria-hidden': 'true' });
    const el = h('div', { class: 'screen screen-loading' }, [
      h('div', { class: 'load-center' }, [
        h('div', { class: 'load-crest', 'aria-hidden': 'true', html: CROWN_SVG }),
        h('div', { class: 'logo' }, ['Bust', h('span', { class: 'logo-2' }, 'War')]),
        showcase,
      ]),
      h('div', { class: 'load-foot' }, [
        h('div', { class: 'load-bar', role: 'progressbar', 'aria-valuemin': '0', 'aria-valuemax': '100' }, [fill, h('div', { class: 'load-gloss' })]),
        label,
        tip,
      ]),
    ]);
    let lastK = -1;
    return {
      el: el,
      setProgress: function (done, total, text) {
        const k = total > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(done / total * 100))) : 100;
        if (k !== lastK) {
          fill.style.transform = SCALE_X[k * 5];
          el.querySelector('.load-bar').setAttribute('aria-valuenow', String(k));
          lastK = k;
        }
        if (text) label.textContent = text;
      },
      /** Pops the freshly rendered portrait of `id` into the showcase row (max 5 visible). */
      showCard: function (id) {
        if (!id || !Art.has(id)) return;
        const inf = UI.cardInfo(id);
        const c = h('div', { class: 'load-card rar-' + inf.rarity });
        c.appendChild(artBox(id, c));
        c.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'card-shine' }));
        showcase.appendChild(c);
        while (showcase.children.length > 4) showcase.removeChild(showcase.firstChild);
      },
      destroy: function () { G.clearInterval(tipTimer); },
    };
  };

  // ====================================================================== DECK EDITOR

  /**
   * v5 deck editor: uses the whole screen (the stage drops its portrait column, see
   * app.show / .stage.is-wide). Top: header with average elixir + count, the eight deck slots
   * in one row (always visible, sticky), filters + presets in one scrollable row; below a big
   * card grid that fills the rest. Smooth on phones: every collection tile is built once and
   * only its classes change afterwards (no rebuild of the grid per tap).
   */
  UI.DeckScreen = function (app) {
    let deck = UI.sanitizeDeck(app.getDeckDraft(), EMPTY).slice(0, 8);
    if (!deck.length) deck = app.getDeck().slice();
    let filter = 'all';
    let swapId = null;
    let sheet = null;
    const allIds = UI.sortedCardIds();
    // v6: with Touchdown selected in the menu, cards that mode does not allow are greyed out
    const tdMode = !!(app.features && app.features.touchdown) && UI.normGameMode(app.settings.gameMode) === 'touchdown';
    const bannedWhy = Object.create(null);
    if (tdMode) for (let i = 0; i < allIds.length; i++) { const r = UI.cardAllowed(allIds[i], 'touchdown'); if (!r.ok) bannedWhy[allIds[i]] = r.reason; }
    function markBanned(t, id) {
      if (!bannedWhy[id]) return t;
      t.classList.add('is-banned');
      t.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'ban-badge', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }, icon('noEntry')));
      t.setAttribute('aria-label', t.getAttribute('aria-label') + ' – ' + bannedWhy[id]);
      return t;
    }
    const tdHint = tdMode && Object.keys(bannedWhy).length
      ? h('div', { class: 'hint info td-deck-note' }, [icon('football'), 'Spielmodus Touchdown: Ausgegraute Karten sind dort nicht erlaubt und werden für den Kampf ersetzt.'])
      : null;

    const avgNum = h('b', null, '');
    const avgEl = h('span', { class: 'deck-avg', 'aria-label': 'Durchschnittliche Elixierkosten' }, [h('span', { class: 'cost' }, [h('i'), h('b')]), h('span', null, 'Ø'), avgNum]);
    const countEl = h('span', { class: 'deck-count' }, '');
    const slotsEl = h('div', { class: 'deck-slots', role: 'list', 'aria-label': 'Dein Deck' });
    const swapHint = h('div', { class: 'swap-hint', hidden: true }, [h('span', null, 'Tippe auf die Deck-Karte, die ersetzt werden soll'), h('button', { class: 'swap-x', type: 'button', 'aria-label': 'Tauschen abbrechen' }, icon('back'))]);
    swapHint.lastChild.addEventListener('click', function () { swapId = null; renderAll(); });
    const collection = h('div', { class: 'collection scroll', role: 'list', 'aria-label': 'Alle Karten' });

    const presets = UI.presets();
    const presetChips = presets.map(function (p) {
      const c = h('button', { class: 'chip', type: 'button' }, p.name);
      c.addEventListener('click', function () {
        deck = UI.sanitizeDeck(p.cards, EMPTY);
        swapId = null;
        save();
        renderAll();
        UI.toast(app.stage, 'Vorlage „' + p.name + '“ geladen' + (p.desc ? ' – ' + p.desc : ''), 3000);
      });
      return c;
    });

    const filterSeg = segmented([
      { id: 'all', label: 'Alle' },
      { id: 'troop', label: 'Truppen' },
      { id: 'spell', label: 'Zauber' },
      { id: 'building', label: 'Gebäude' },
    ], filter, function (id) { filter = id; applyFilter(); try { collection.scrollTop = 0; } catch (e) { /* ignore */ } }, 'seg seg-sm seg-filter');

    function save() { app.setDeck(deck.slice()); }

    function renderSlots() {
      slotsEl.textContent = '';
      for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        const id = deck[i];
        if (!id) {
          slotsEl.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'card is-empty is-mini', role: 'listitem', 'aria-label': 'Freier Platz' }, h('span', { class: 'empty-plus' }, '+')));
          continue;
        }
        const t = markBanned(cardTile(id, 'is-mini' + (swapId ? ' swap-target' : '')), id);
        t.setAttribute('role', 'listitem');
        t.addEventListener('click', (function (slot) {
          return function () {
            if (swapId) {
              deck[slot] = swapId;
              swapId = null;
              save();
              renderAll();
              Sound.play('select');
              return;
            }
            openSheet(deck[slot], true);
          };
        })(i));
        slotsEl.appendChild(t);
      }
      avgNum.textContent = UI.formatDecimal(UI.avgElixir(deck));
      countEl.textContent = deck.length + '/8';
      countEl.classList.toggle('is-full', deck.length >= 8);
      swapHint.hidden = !swapId;
      el.classList.toggle('is-swapping', !!swapId);
    }

    // collection tiles: built once, then only classes / hidden change
    const tiles = Object.create(null);
    for (let i = 0; i < allIds.length; i++) {
      const id = allIds[i];
      const t = markBanned(cardTile(id, ''), id);
      t.setAttribute('role', 'listitem');
      t.addEventListener('click', function () { openSheet(id, deck.indexOf(id) >= 0); });
      tiles[id] = t;
      collection.appendChild(t);
    }
    function applyFilter() {
      for (let i = 0; i < allIds.length; i++) {
        const id = allIds[i];
        const hide = filter !== 'all' && UI.cardInfo(id).type !== filter;
        if (tiles[id].hidden !== hide) tiles[id].hidden = hide;
      }
    }
    function renderCollection() {
      for (let i = 0; i < allIds.length; i++) {
        const id = allIds[i];
        const t = tiles[id];
        t.classList.toggle('in-deck', deck.indexOf(id) >= 0);
        t.classList.toggle('is-selected', swapId === id);
      }
    }

    function renderAll() { renderSlots(); renderCollection(); }

    function closeSheet() { if (sheet) { remove(sheet); sheet = null; } }

    function openSheet(id, inDeck) {
      closeSheet();
      if (swapId && !inDeck) swapId = null;
      const inf = UI.cardInfo(id);
      const big = cardTile(id, '');
      big.disabled = true;
      const tags = [
        h('span', { class: 'tag rar-' + inf.rarity }, RARITY[inf.rarity].label),
        h('span', { class: 'tag tag-type t-' + inf.type }, TYPE_LABEL[inf.type] || 'Karte'),
        h('span', { class: 'tag tag-ex' }, (inf.elixir == null ? '?' : inf.elixir) + ' Elixier'),
      ];
      const actions = h('div', { class: 'sheet-actions' });
      if (inDeck) {
        const rm = h('button', { class: 'btn btn-red', type: 'button' }, 'Entfernen');
        rm.addEventListener('click', function () {
          deck = deck.filter(function (x) { return x !== id; });
          save();
          closeSheet();
          renderAll();
        });
        actions.appendChild(rm);
      } else {
        const add = h('button', { class: 'btn btn-green', type: 'button' }, deck.length < 8 ? 'Ins Deck' : 'Tauschen');
        add.addEventListener('click', function () {
          closeSheet();
          if (deck.length < 8) {
            deck.push(id);
            save();
            renderAll();
          } else {
            swapId = id;
            renderAll();
          }
        });
        actions.appendChild(add);
      }
      const close = h('button', { class: 'btn btn-grey', type: 'button' }, 'Schließen');
      close.addEventListener('click', closeSheet);
      actions.appendChild(close);

      const sh = h('div', { class: 'sheet scroll', role: 'dialog', 'aria-modal': 'true' }, [
        h('div', { class: 'sheet-head' }, [
          big,
          h('div', { class: 'sheet-meta' }, [
            h('div', { class: 'sheet-name' }, inf.name),
            inf.mirrors ? h('div', { class: 'sheet-mirror' }, 'Vorbild: ' + inf.mirrors) : null,
            h('div', { class: 'sheet-tags' }, tags),
          ]),
        ]),
        h('p', { class: 'sheet-desc' }, inf.desc || 'Keine Beschreibung vorhanden.'),
        bannedWhy[id] ? h('div', { class: 'hint warn sheet-ban' }, [icon('noEntry'), bannedWhy[id]]) : null,
        actions,
      ]);
      sheet = h('div', { class: 'sheet-backdrop' }, sh);
      sheet.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (e.target === sheet) closeSheet(); });
      app.stage.appendChild(sheet);
    }

    function back() {
      if (sheet) { closeSheet(); return; }
      if (swapId) { swapId = null; renderAll(); return; }
      if (deck.length >= 8) { app.showMenu(); return; }
      UI.dialog(app.stage, {
        title: 'Deck unvollständig',
        text: 'Dein Deck hat erst ' + deck.length + ' von 8 Karten.',
        buttons: [
          { label: 'Automatisch auffüllen', value: 'fill', cls: 'btn-green' },
          { label: 'Weiter bearbeiten', value: null, cls: 'btn-grey' },
        ],
      }).then(function (v) {
        if (v !== 'fill') return;
        deck = UI.sanitizeDeck(deck, app.getDeck());
        save();
        app.showMenu();
      });
    }

    const el = h('div', { class: 'screen screen-deck is-wide' }, [
      h('div', { class: 'hdr hdr-deck' }, [backButton(back), h('div', { class: 'hdr-title' }, 'Deck bearbeiten'), h('div', { class: 'deck-stats' }, [avgEl, countEl])]),
      h('div', { class: 'deck-bar' }, [slotsEl, swapHint]),
      tdHint,
      h('div', { class: 'deck-tools' }, [
        filterSeg.el,
        presets.length ? h('div', { class: 'chips', 'aria-label': 'Vorlagen' }, [h('span', { class: 'chips-label' }, 'Vorlagen:')].concat(presetChips)) : null,
      ]),
      collection,
    ]);
    renderAll();

    return {
      el: el,
      back: back,
      destroy: function () { closeSheet(); },
    };
  };

  // ============================================================================ RULES

  // Rule sentences with numbers are generated from CR.RULES so the rules screen always matches
  // the engine (the fidelity pass changes numbers in one place). Fallbacks = live game values.
  function rnum(v, d) { return typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v) ? v : d; }
  /** '3 Minuten', '1 Minute', '90 Sekunden' */
  UI.durationText = function (sec) {
    const s = Math.round(sec);
    if (s >= 60 && s % 60 === 0) { const m = s / 60; return m + (m === 1 ? ' Minute' : ' Minuten'); }
    return s + (s === 1 ? ' Sekunde' : ' Sekunden');
  };
  /** 'In der letzten Minute', 'In den letzten 2 Minuten', 'In den letzten 30 Sekunden' */
  UI.lastText = function (sec) {
    const s = Math.round(sec);
    if (s === 60) return 'In der letzten Minute';
    if (s === 1) return 'In der letzten Sekunde';
    return 'In den letzten ' + UI.durationText(s);
  };
  function firstSegFrom(segs, minMult) {
    if (!Array.isArray(segs)) return null;
    for (let i = 0; i < segs.length; i++) if (segs[i] && segs[i].mult >= minMult) return rnum(segs[i].from, null);
    return null;
  }
  UI.timeRuleTexts = function () {
    const C = (CR.RULES && CR.RULES.clock) || NONE;
    const reg = rnum(C.regulation, 180);
    const x2 = firstSegFrom(C.segments, 2);
    const ot = rnum(C.overtime, 120);
    const otX2 = firstSegFrom(C.overtimeSegments, 2);
    const otX3 = firstSegFrom(C.overtimeSegments, 3);
    const out = [];
    out.push('Ein Kampf dauert <b>' + UI.durationText(reg) + '</b>.' +
      (x2 != null && x2 < reg ? ' ' + UI.lastText(reg - x2) + ' fließt das Elixier doppelt so schnell (<b>x2</b>).' : ''));
    if (ot > 0) {
      let t = 'Steht es danach unentschieden, folgt die <b>Verlängerung</b> (' + UI.durationText(ot) + ')' +
        (C.suddenDeath === false ? '.' : ': Die nächste Krone entscheidet.');
      if (otX3 != null && otX3 < ot) {
        const last = UI.lastText(ot - otX3);
        t += (otX2 === 0 ? ' Erst gibt es <b>x2</b> Elixier, ' + last.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + last.slice(1) + ' sogar <b>x3</b>.'
          : ' ' + last + ' gibt es sogar <b>x3</b> Elixier.');
      } else if (otX2 === 0) {
        t += ' Das Elixier fließt dabei doppelt so schnell (<b>x2</b>).';
      }
      out.push(t);
    }
    out.push(C.tiebreak === 'lowestTowerHp'
      ? 'Fällt ' + (ot > 0 ? 'auch in der Verlängerung' : 'bis zum Schluss') + ' keine Entscheidung, gewinnt, wessen schwächster Turm mehr Trefferpunkte hat – sonst Unentschieden.'
      : 'Fällt ' + (ot > 0 ? 'auch in der Verlängerung' : 'bis zum Schluss') + ' keine Entscheidung, endet der Kampf unentschieden.');
    return out;
  };
  UI.elixirRuleTexts = function () {
    const R = CR.RULES || NONE;
    const E = R.elixir || NONE;
    const K = R.cards || NONE;
    const start = rnum(E.start, 5);
    const max = rnum(E.max, 10);
    const regen = rnum(E.regenSeconds, 2.8);
    const deck = rnum(K.deckSize, 8);
    const hand = rnum(K.handSize, 4);
    return [
      'Du startest mit <b>' + UI.formatDecimal(start, start % 1 ? 1 : 0) + ' Elixier</b>, maximal sind <b>' + UI.formatDecimal(max, max % 1 ? 1 : 0) +
        '</b> möglich. Normal lädt alle ' + UI.formatDecimal(regen, regen % 1 ? 1 : 0) + ' Sekunden ein Elixier nach. Jede Karte kostet so viel Elixier, wie der Tropfen zeigt.',
      'Dein Deck hat <b>' + deck + ' Karten</b>, ' + hand + ' davon hast du auf der Hand. Eine gespielte Karte wandert ans Ende der Reihe – „Nächste“ zeigt, was nachkommt.',
      'Mit dem Schalter <b>„Schnelles Elixier (1,5×)“</b> im Menü (und in der Lobby des Gastgebers) lädt das Elixier in allen Phasen <b>1,5-mal so schnell</b> – auch zusammen mit doppeltem Elixier und C.H.A.O.S.',
    ];
  };

  /** v5: the two maps (Klassisch / Hügel) for the rules screen. */
  UI.mapRuleTexts = function () {
    return [
      'Vor dem Kampf wählst du die Karte. <b>Klassisch</b>: Fluss in der Mitte mit zwei Brücken – Bodentruppen kommen nur über die Brücken auf die andere Seite.',
      '<b>Hügel</b>: überall Rasen, kein Fluss und keine Brücken. Quer über die Mitte zieht sich ein Hügel, so hoch, wie Lufteinheiten fliegen. Bodentruppen können ihn überall überqueren.',
      'Bergauf laufen Bodentruppen <b>langsamer</b>, bergab und oben auf dem Hügel ganz normal.',
      'Oben auf dem Hügel stehen Bodentruppen auf <b>gleicher Höhe wie Lufteinheiten</b>: Dort treffen auch Nahkämpfer fliegende Gegner. Und fliegt eine Lufteinheit über dem Hügel, können sie auch Bodenkämpfer angreifen, die sonst nur Bodenziele treffen.',
    ].concat(UI.tunnelRuleTexts());
  };
  /** v12: the tunnel map for the rules screen (examples of troops too big for the tunnel
   *  come from the card data when those cards exist). */
  function escapeHtml(t) { return String(t).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) { return { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c]; }); }
  UI.tunnelRuleTexts = function () {
    const big = [];
    const ids = ['giant', 'golem', 'pekka', 'mega-knight'];
    for (let i = 0; i < ids.length && big.length < 3; i++) {
      let inf = null;
      try { inf = UI.catalog().byId[ids[i]] ? UI.cardInfo(ids[i]) : null; } catch (e) { inf = null; }
      if (inf && inf.name) big.push(escapeHtml(inf.name));
    }
    return [
      '<b>Tunnel</b>: ein flaches Feld ohne Fluss und ohne Hügel, mit den Türmen auf beiden Seiten. Auf jeder Hälfte liegt ein <b>Loch</b> – etwa drei Viertel des Weges zur anderen Seite. Unter dem Feld verbindet ein <b>Tunnel</b> die beiden Löcher.',
      'Kleine und mittlere <b>Bodentruppen</b> können in ein Loch hinein- und am anderen wieder herauslaufen – so kommen sie schnell und geschützt auf die andere Seite. <b>Große, schwere Truppen</b>' + (big.length ? ' (z. B. ' + big.join(', ') + ')' : '') + ' passen nicht hinein, <b>Lufteinheiten</b> fliegen einfach darüber.',
      'Im Tunnel kämpfen Truppen <b>nur gegeneinander</b>: Von oben kann sie niemand treffen – auch kein Turm und kein Zauber –, und sie greifen selbst nichts an der Oberfläche an, bis sie wieder herauskommen.',
    ];
  };
  /** v12: Klassisch (ohne C.H.A.O.S) for the rules screen. */
  UI.classicRuleTexts = function () {
    return [
      'Im Spielmodus <b>Klassisch</b> spielst du nach den normalen Regeln von Clash Royale – <b>ohne C.H.A.O.S</b>: keine Upgrade-Angebote, keine Upgrade-Abzeichen, nur deine Karten und dein Elixier.',
      'Türme, Kronen, Zeit und Elixier sind genau wie im C.H.A.O.S-Modus. Die besonderen Fähigkeiten der Karten selbst gibt es weiterhin.',
      'Wähle im Menü unter <b>Spielmodus</b> „Klassisch“ – im Single-Modus oder mit Freunden, im 1 gegen 1 oder 2 gegen 2 und auf jeder Karte (<b>Klassisch</b>, <b>Hügel</b> oder <b>Tunnel</b>).',
    ];
  };
  /** v5: 2 gegen 2 for the rules screen. */
  UI.teamRuleTexts = function () {
    return [
      'Im <b>2 gegen 2</b> kämpft ihr zu zweit gegen zwei. Jeder hat sein <b>eigenes Deck</b>, eigene Handkarten, eigenes <b>Elixier</b> und eigene C.H.A.O.S-Upgrades.',
      'Die Türme und eure Hälfte der Arena teilt ihr euch mit dem Teampartner – die Kronen zählen für das ganze Team.',
      'Das Elixier deines Partners siehst du klein über deiner Elixierleiste. Seine Einheiten tragen einen helleren Ring als deine.',
