      '<b>Single-Modus</b>: du und ein Bot gegen zwei Bots. <b>Mit Freunden</b>: bis zu vier Spieler mit einem Code – jeder wählt sein Team (<b>Blau</b> oder <b>Rot</b>), freie Plätze füllt der Gastgeber mit Bots.',
    ];
  };

  /**
   * v6: Touchdown for the rules screen (the CR event mode, docs/TOUCHDOWN.md). Numbers come
   * from CR.RULES.touchdown when the engine provides them ({target, regulation|duration,
   * overtime, elixirMult, resetDelay}); a rules list of the engine (CR.Touchdown.rules) wins.
   */
  UI.touchdownRuleTexts = function () {
    const T = CR.Touchdown;
    const src = T && (T.rulesDe || T.rules || T.rulesText);
    if (Array.isArray(src) && src.length) return src.map(String);
    const R = (CR.RULES && CR.RULES.touchdown) || NONE;
    const C = (CR.RULES && CR.RULES.clock) || NONE;
    const target = UI.touchdownTarget(null);
    const reg = rnum(R.regulation, rnum(C.regulation, 180));
    const ot = rnum(R.overtime, rnum(C.overtime, 120));
    const pause = rnum(R.resetPause, 3);
    const x2 = firstSegFrom(C.segments, 2);
    const names = function (ids) {
      const out = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < (ids || EMPTY).length; i++) { const inf = UI.cardInfo(ids[i]); if (inf.known) out.push(inf.name); }
      return out;
    };
    const join = function (list) { return list.length > 1 ? list.slice(0, -1).join(', ') + ' und ' + list[list.length - 1] : list.join(''); };
    const half = names(R.halfLineCards);
    const banned = names(R.banned);
    const out = [
      'Im <b>Touchdown</b> gibt es <b>keine Türme</b>, keinen Fluss und keine Brücken. Jedes Team verteidigt eine <b>Endzone</b> am hinteren Spielfeldrand – deine unten, die des Gegners oben.',
      'Erreicht eine deiner Truppen die <b>gegnerische Endzone</b> (auch Lufttruppen, aber nie Gebäude), ist das ein <b>Touchdown</b> – eine Krone. Wer zuerst <b>' + target + ' Touchdowns</b> erzielt, gewinnt sofort.',
      'Nach jedem Touchdown wird das Feld sofort <b>geräumt</b>: Alle Truppen, Gebäude und Zauber verschwinden, dein <b>Elixier bleibt</b>. Nach ' + UI.durationText(pause) + ' Anstoß-Pause geht es weiter.',
      'Truppen und Gebäude setzt du nur bis zur <b>zweiten weißen Linie</b> ein (ein Viertel des Feldes)' +
        (half.length ? ', ' + join(half) + ' bis zur <b>Mittellinie</b>' : '') + ', alle anderen Zauber <b>überall</b>.',
      'Ein Kampf dauert <b>' + UI.durationText(reg) + '</b>' + (x2 != null && x2 < reg ? '; ' + UI.lastText(reg - x2).charAt(0).toLowerCase() + UI.lastText(reg - x2).slice(1) + ' fließt das Elixier doppelt (<b>x2</b>)' : '') +
        '. Danach gewinnt, wer mehr Touchdowns hat' + (ot > 0 ? ' – bei Gleichstand folgt die <b>Verlängerung</b> (' + UI.durationText(ot) + '), in der der nächste Touchdown entscheidet. Fällt keiner, endet der Kampf unentschieden.' : '.'),
      'Truppen, die nur Gebäude angreifen, laufen ohne Gebäude in Sicht <b>direkt zur Endzone</b>. Verteidige deine eigene Endzone!',
      (banned.length ? 'Im Touchdown <b>nicht erlaubt</b>: ' + join(banned) + '. ' : 'Manche Karten sind im Touchdown nicht erlaubt. ') +
        'Im Deck-Editor sind sie ausgegraut, wenn Touchdown gewählt ist – für den Kampf kommen dann andere Karten ins Deck.',
      'Jedes Deck braucht im Touchdown <b>mindestens ein Gebäude</b>. Der Draft sorgt dafür (eine Gebäude-Runde, in der beide ein Gebäude bekommen); fehlt deinem eigenen Deck eins, ersetzt für den Kampf ein Gebäude deine <b>letzte Karte</b>.',
      'Wähle im Menü unter <b>Spielmodus</b> „Touchdown“ – im Single-Modus oder mit Freunden, im 1 gegen 1 oder 2 gegen 2 (gleiche Regeln, gleiches Elixier), auf der Karte <b>Klassisch</b>, <b>Hügel</b> oder <b>Tunnel</b>. Mit dem Schalter <b>„Touchdown mit C.H.A.O.S-Upgrades“</b> gibt es zusätzlich Upgrade-Angebote.',
    ];
    return out;
  };

  /** Rule texts. C.H.A.O.S text comes from the chaos module when it provides one. */
  UI.rulesSections = function () {
    const secs = [
      {
        title: 'Ziel',
        items: [
          'Zerstöre den <b>König-Turm</b> deines Gegners – das bringt sofort <b>3 Kronen</b> und den Sieg.',
          'Jeder zerstörte <b>Prinzessinnen-Turm</b> bringt eine Krone. Wer nach Ablauf der Zeit mehr Kronen hat, gewinnt.',
        ],
      },
      {
        title: 'Zeit',
        items: UI.timeRuleTexts(),
      },
      {
        title: 'Elixier & Karten',
        items: UI.elixirRuleTexts(),
      },
      {
        title: 'Platzieren',
        items: [
          '<b>Ziehe</b> eine Karte in die Arena oder <b>tippe</b> erst die Karte und dann die Stelle in der Arena an.',
          'Truppen und Gebäude nur auf <b>deiner Seite</b>. Ist ein gegnerischer Prinzessinnen-Turm gefallen, darfst du auch direkt dahinter platzieren.',
          '<b>Zauber</b> wirken überall. Lässt du eine Karte über einem ungültigen Feld los, wird sie nicht gespielt.',
        ],
      },
      {
        title: 'Türme',
        items: [
          'Der König-Turm schläft, bis er Schaden nimmt oder ein eigener Prinzessinnen-Turm fällt – dann greift er mit an.',
          'Truppen laufen zum nächsten Ziel und greifen es an; manche greifen nur Gebäude an.',
        ],
      },
      {
        title: 'Karten',
        map: true,
        items: UI.mapRuleTexts(),
      },
      {
        title: '2 gegen 2',
        items: UI.teamRuleTexts(),
      },
    ];
    const C = CR.Chaos;
    let chaosItems = null;
    if (C) {
      const src = C.rules || C.rulesText || C.description || null;
      if (Array.isArray(src)) chaosItems = src.map(String);
      else if (typeof src === 'string' && src) chaosItems = src.split(/\n+/).filter(Boolean);
    }
    // v2: C.H.A.O.S is the mode of every battle - its rules come right after the goal.
    secs.splice(1, 0, {
      title: 'C.H.A.O.S-Modus',
      chaos: true,
      items: chaosItems || [
        'Im C.H.A.O.S-Modus gelten alle normalen Regeln – zusätzlich bekommst du während des Kampfes <b>Upgrade-Angebote</b>.',
        'Erscheint ein Angebot, wählst du <b>eines</b> der Upgrades aus. Die Farbe zeigt die Seltenheit, der Countdown, wie lange du noch Zeit hast. Mit „Später wählen“ spielst du erst weiter.',
        'Deine Upgrades erscheinen als Abzeichen in der Arena – tippe eines an, um zu sehen, was es bewirkt. Verbesserte Einheiten tragen eine farbige Aura.',
        'Auch dein Gegner wählt Upgrades – seine Abzeichen siehst du ebenfalls.',
      ],
    });
    // v12: Klassisch (ohne C.H.A.O.S) right after C.H.A.O.S (index 2)
    secs.splice(2, 0, { title: 'Klassisch (ohne C.H.A.O.S)', classic: true, items: UI.classicRuleTexts() });
    // v6: Touchdown after that (index 3), with the touchdown fields
    const T = CR.Touchdown;
    const tdSrc = T && (T.rulesDe || T.rules || T.rulesText);
    secs.splice(3, 0, { title: 'Touchdown', touchdown: true, plain: Array.isArray(tdSrc) && tdSrc.length > 0, items: UI.touchdownRuleTexts() });
    secs.push({
      title: 'Mit Freunden spielen',
      items: [
        'Tippe im Menü auf <b>Mit Freunden</b>, wähle <b>1 gegen 1</b> (mit 1 Freund) oder <b>2 gegen 2</b> (mit 3 Freunden) und tippe auf <b>Spiel erstellen</b>. Du bekommst einen <b>Code</b> und einen <b>Link</b> – schick ihn deinen Freunden.',
        'Jeder Freund öffnet den Link auf seinem Handy (oder tippt den Code unter <b>Mit Freunden</b> ein) und drückt <b>Beitreten</b>. Sobald alle bereit sind, startest du den Kampf.',
        'Als Gastgeber kannst du Modus und <b>Karte</b> in der Lobby noch ändern und die Spieler per <b>Ziehen</b> (oder mit dem Pfeil) zwischen den Teams verschieben. Freie Plätze füllst du mit Bots.',
      ],
    });
    secs.push({
      title: 'Tempo',
      items: [
        'Standard ist <b>Original (1×)</b> – so schnell wie im echten Spiel. Im Tempo <b>Schnell (1,5×)</b> läuft der ganze Kampf 1,5-mal so schnell – auch die Uhr und das Elixier.',
        'Mit Freunden gilt das Tempo des Gastgebers. Umstellen kannst du es in den Einstellungen.',
      ],
    });
    return secs;
  };

  UI.RulesScreen = function (app) {
    const body = h('div', { class: 'rules-body scroll' });
    UI.rulesSections().forEach(function (sec) {
      const list = h('ul');
      sec.items.forEach(function (t) {
        const li = h('li');
        // Rule strings are static app text (or plain strings from the chaos module); only the
        // static strings carry <b> markup, chaos strings are escaped.
        if (sec.plain || (sec.chaos && CR.Chaos && (CR.Chaos.rules || CR.Chaos.rulesText || CR.Chaos.description))) li.textContent = t;
        else li.innerHTML = t;
        list.appendChild(li);
      });
      const maps = sec.map || sec.touchdown ? h('div', { class: 'rules-maps', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }, MAPS.map(function (m) {
        return h('div', { class: 'rules-map' }, [h('span', { class: 'map-prev', html: UI.mapPreviewSvg(m.id, sec.touchdown ? 'touchdown' : null) }), h('span', { class: 'map-label' }, m.label)]);
      })) : null;
      const hd = sec.touchdown ? h('h3', null, [icon('football', 'rules-ico'), sec.title]) : (sec.classic ? h('h3', null, [icon('tower', 'rules-ico'), sec.title]) : h('h3', null, sec.title));
      body.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'rules-sec' + (sec.chaos ? ' is-chaos' : '') + (sec.touchdown ? ' is-td' : '') + (sec.classic ? ' is-classic' : '') }, [hd, maps, list]));
    });
    const el = h('div', { class: 'screen screen-rules' }, [
      h('div', { class: 'hdr' }, [backButton(function () { app.showMenu(); }), h('div', { class: 'hdr-title' }, 'Regeln')]),
      body,
    ]);
    return { el: el, back: function () { app.showMenu(); }, destroy: function () {} };
  };

  // ======================================================================= HOST LOBBY

  function modeChip(mode, options) {
    const td = mode === 'touchdown';
    return h('span', { class: 'info-chip' + (UI.chaosOn(mode, options) ? ' is-chaos' : '') + (td ? ' is-td' : '') },
      td ? [icon('football'), UI.modeLabel(mode, options)] : UI.modeLabel(mode, options));
  }
  /** v7: is the Touchdown draft on for these battle options (default on)? */
  UI.draftOn = function (mode, options) { return mode === 'touchdown' && !(options && options.draft === false); };
  function draftChip() { return h('span', { class: 'info-chip is-draft' }, [icon('cards'), 'Draft']); }
  function infoChips(mode, speed, options) {
    return h('div', { class: 'info-chips' }, [
      modeChip(mode, options),
      UI.draftOn(mode, options) ? draftChip() : null,
      UI.elixirBoostOn(options) ? boostChip() : null,
      speed ? h('span', { class: 'info-chip is-tempo' }, [icon('bolt'), 'Tempo ' + UI.speedLabel(speed)]) : null,
    ]);
  }

  /** One lobby slot row (host + guest lobby). o = { me, onSwitch, onRemove, drag } */
  function slotRow(sl, o) {
    const opt = o || NONE;
    const kind = sl.kind || 'empty';
    const ic = kind === 'host' ? 'swords' : (kind === 'bot' ? 'bot' : (kind === 'guest' ? 'shield' : 'question'));
    const name = kind === 'empty' ? 'Frei' : UI.playerName(sl.name, sl.slot, kind);
    const state = kind === 'host' ? 'Gastgeber' : (kind === 'bot' ? 'Bot' : (kind === 'guest' ? (sl.ready ? 'Bereit!' : 'Noch nicht bereit') : 'Wartet auf Spieler'));
    const acts = h('div', { class: 'slot-acts' });
    if (opt.onSwitch) {
      const b = h('button', { class: 'btn btn-grey btn-sm btn-icon slot-switch', type: 'button', 'aria-label': 'Team wechseln' }, icon('forward'));
      b.addEventListener('click', function () { opt.onSwitch(sl); });
      acts.appendChild(b);
    }
    if (opt.onRemove) {
      const b = h('button', { class: 'btn btn-red btn-sm btn-icon slot-remove', type: 'button', 'aria-label': kind === 'bot' ? 'Bot entfernen' : 'Spieler entfernen' }, h('span', { class: 'slot-x', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }));
      b.addEventListener('click', function () { opt.onRemove(sl); });
      acts.appendChild(b);
    }
    const gd = kind === 'guest' && Array.isArray(sl.deck) ? UI.sanitizeDeck(sl.deck, EMPTY) : EMPTY;
    return h('div', {
      class: 'slot-row is-' + kind + (opt.me ? ' is-me' : '') + (kind === 'guest' && sl.ready ? ' is-ready' : '') + (opt.drag ? ' is-drag' : ''),
      'data-slot': String(sl.slot), 'data-team': String(sl.team === 1 ? 1 : 0),
    }, [
      opt.drag ? h('div', { class: 'slot-grip', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }) : null,
      h('div', { class: 'slot-ava' }, icon(ic)),
      h('div', { class: 'slot-info' }, [
        h('div', { class: 'slot-name' }, [name, opt.me ? h('span', { class: 'res-you-tag' }, 'Du') : null]),
        h('div', { class: 'slot-state' }, state),
        gd.length ? deckMini(gd) : null,
      ]),
      acts,
    ]);
  }

  /** Team columns: members of each team + free places (with "+ Bot" for the host).
   *  o = { teamSize, mySlot, host: bool, drag: bool, onAddBot(team), onSwitch(sl), onRemove(sl) }
   *  drag: player chips can be dragged onto the other team (see hostLobbyDrag). */
  function teamBoard(slots, o) {
    const ts = UI.normTeamSize(o.teamSize);
    const n = UI.lobbyUsedSlots(ts);
    const cols = [[], []];
    for (let i = 0; i < n && i < slots.length; i++) {
      const sl = slots[i];
      if (sl && sl.kind !== 'empty') cols[sl.team === 1 ? 1 : 0].push(sl);
    }
    return h('div', { class: 'team-board' + (ts === 2 ? ' is-2v2' : '') }, TEAMS.map(function (t) {
      const col = h('div', { class: 'team-col ' + t.cls, 'data-team': String(t.id) }, h('div', { class: 'team-head' }, 'Team ' + t.label + ' · ' + cols[t.id].length + '/' + ts));
      cols[t.id].forEach(function (sl) {
        const isMe = sl.slot === o.mySlot;
        col.appendChild(slotRow(sl, {
          me: isMe,
          drag: !!(o.host && o.drag && ts === 2),
          onSwitch: o.host && o.onSwitch && ts === 2 ? o.onSwitch : null,
          onRemove: o.host && o.onRemove && sl.kind === 'bot' ? o.onRemove : null,   // guests keep their seat (the network owns it)
        }));
      });
      for (let k = cols[t.id].length; k < ts; k++) {
        const free = h('div', { class: 'slot-row is-empty', 'data-team': String(t.id) }, [h('div', { class: 'slot-ava' }, icon('question')), h('div', { class: 'slot-info' }, [h('div', { class: 'slot-name' }, 'Frei'), h('div', { class: 'slot-state' }, 'Wartet auf Spieler')])]);
        if (o.host && o.onAddBot) {
          const b = h('button', { class: 'btn btn-blue btn-sm slot-bot', type: 'button', 'aria-label': 'Bot in Team ' + t.label }, [icon('bot'), h('span', null, '+ Bot')]);
          b.addEventListener('click', function () { o.onAddBot(t.id); });
          free.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'slot-acts' }, b));
        }
        col.appendChild(free);
      }
      return col;
    }));
  }

  /** Signature of the lobby state that matters for the slot board (skip re-renders). */
  UI.lobbySig = function (slots, teamSize, extra) {
    let sg = String(UI.normTeamSize(teamSize)) + '|' + (extra == null ? '' : extra) + '|';
    const list = slots || EMPTY;
    for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      const sl = list[i] || NONE;
      sg += sl.kind + ':' + (sl.team | 0) + ':' + (sl.ready ? 1 : 0) + ':' + UI.sanitizeName(sl.name) + ':' + (Array.isArray(sl.deck) ? sl.deck.join('.') : '') + ':' + (sl.req === 0 || sl.req === 1 ? sl.req : '') + ';';
    }
    return sg;
  };

  /**
   * Drag & drop of player chips in the host lobby (pointer events: mouse, touch, pen). Event
   * delegation on `wrap` (the board inside is rebuilt on every lobby change; listeners on the
   * window follow the pointer). A press on a '.slot-row.is-drag' that moves more than
   * DRAG_START_PX becomes a drag: a floating copy follows the finger, the target (another
   * chip / free place / team column) lights up, the drop calls onDrop(fromSlot, target) with
   * target = { slot } or { team }. o.onActive(bool) while a drag runs (the host lobby defers
   * re-renders until the drop).
   */
  function lobbyDrag(wrap, o) {
    let d = null;
    function targetAt(x, y) {
      const doc = G.document;
      let el = doc && doc.elementFromPoint ? doc.elementFromPoint(x, y) : null;
      if (!el || !wrap.contains(el)) return null;
      const row = el.closest ? el.closest('.slot-row') : null;
      if (row && row.getAttribute('data-slot') != null) return { el: row, t: { slot: +row.getAttribute('data-slot') } };
      if (row && row.getAttribute('data-team') != null) return { el: row, t: { team: +row.getAttribute('data-team') } };
      const col = el.closest ? el.closest('.team-col') : null;
      if (col && col.getAttribute('data-team') != null) return { el: col, t: { team: +col.getAttribute('data-team') } };
      return null;
    }
    function mark(tg) {
      const el = tg && o.accept(d.from, tg.t) ? tg.el : null;
      if (d.over === el) return;
      if (d.over) d.over.classList.remove('is-drop');
      d.over = el;
      if (el) el.classList.add('is-drop');
    }
    function move(e) {
      if (!d || e.pointerId !== d.id) return;
      const dx = e.clientX - d.x0, dy = e.clientY - d.y0;
      if (!d.on) {
        if (dx * dx + dy * dy < DRAG_START_PX * DRAG_START_PX) return;
        d.on = true;
        const r = d.row.getBoundingClientRect();
        d.ox = d.x0 - r.left; d.oy = d.y0 - r.top;
        const ghost = d.row.cloneNode(true);
        ghost.classList.add('slot-ghost');
        ghost.style.width = r.width + 'px';
        ghost.removeAttribute('data-slot');
        G.document.body.appendChild(ghost);
        d.ghost = ghost;
        d.row.classList.add('is-dragging');
        wrap.classList.add('is-dragging');
        if (o.onActive) o.onActive(true);
        vibrate(12);
      }
      if (e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
      d.ghost.style.transform = 'translate(' + Math.round(e.clientX - d.ox) + 'px,' + Math.round(e.clientY - d.oy) + 'px)';
      mark(targetAt(e.clientX, e.clientY));
    }
    function end(e, cancel) {
      if (!d || (e && e.pointerId !== d.id)) return;
      const cur = d;
      d = null;
      G.removeEventListener('pointermove', move, { passive: false });
      G.removeEventListener('pointerup', up);
      G.removeEventListener('pointercancel', cancelFn);
      if (!cur.on) return;
      if (cur.ghost && cur.ghost.parentNode) cur.ghost.parentNode.removeChild(cur.ghost);
      if (cur.over) cur.over.classList.remove('is-drop');
      cur.row.classList.remove('is-dragging');
      wrap.classList.remove('is-dragging');
      const tg = !cancel && e ? targetAt(e.clientX, e.clientY) : null;
      if (o.onActive) o.onActive(false);
      if (tg && o.accept(cur.from, tg.t)) o.onDrop(cur.from, tg.t);
    }
    function up(e) { end(e, false); }
    function cancelFn(e) { end(e, true); }
    wrap.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) {
      if (d || (e.pointerType === 'mouse' && e.button !== 0)) return;
      const t = e.target;
      if (!t || !t.closest || t.closest('button')) return;
      const row = t.closest('.slot-row.is-drag');
      if (!row || !wrap.contains(row)) return;
      d = { id: e.pointerId, row: row, from: +row.getAttribute('data-slot'), x0: e.clientX, y0: e.clientY, on: false, ghost: null, over: null, ox: 0, oy: 0 };
      G.addEventListener('pointermove', move, { passive: false });
      G.addEventListener('pointerup', up);
      G.addEventListener('pointercancel', cancelFn);
    });
    return { get active() { return !!(d && d.on); }, cancel: function () { if (d) end(null, true); } };
  }

  /**
   * ctl: { code, link, linkKnown, mode, speed, teamSize, map, can2v2, canHill, canBots, note2v2,
   *        onStart(), onCancel(), onRetry(), onTeamSize(n), onMap(id), onAddBot(team),
   *        onSwitch(slot), onRemove(slot), onDrop(fromSlot, {slot}|{team}),
   *        onSwapReq(slot, withSlot), onDeclineReq(slot) }
   * api: setStatus(s), setSlots(slots, teamSize), setCanStart({ok, reason}), setGuest(g) (legacy 1v1)
   */
  UI.HostLobbyScreen = function (app, ctl) {
    const status = statusRow();
    status.set({ state: 'connecting' }, 'host');
    // ctl.linkKnown === false: the page URL is not visible (embedded page) - share the code
    // instead of a link that would lead the other player to a sandbox address.
    const linkOk = ctl.linkKnown !== false && !!ctl.link;
    const shareText = linkOk
      ? 'Spiel mit mir ' + APP_NAME + '! Code: ' + ctl.code
      : 'Spiel mit mir ' + APP_NAME + '! Öffne die Seite, tippe auf „Mit Freunden“ und gib den Code ' + ctl.code + ' ein.';
    const linkInput = h('input', { class: 'link-input', type: 'text', readonly: true, value: linkOk ? ctl.link : shareText, 'aria-label': linkOk ? 'Einladungslink' : 'Einladung' });
    linkInput.addEventListener('focus', function () { try { linkInput.select(); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ } });
    const copyLabel = 'Kopieren';
    const copyTxt = h('span', null, copyLabel);
    const copyBtn = h('button', { class: 'btn btn-blue btn-sm', type: 'button' }, [icon('copy'), copyTxt]);
    function doCopy(labelEl, label, doneLabel) {
      UI.copyText(linkOk ? ctl.link : shareText, linkInput).then(function (ok) {
        if (ok) {
          labelEl.textContent = doneLabel;
          G.setTimeout(function () { labelEl.textContent = label; }, 1800);
        } else {
          UI.toast(app.stage, (linkOk ? 'Link' : 'Text') + ' markiert – bitte manuell kopieren');
        }
      });
    }
    copyBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { doCopy(copyTxt, copyLabel, 'Kopiert!'); });
    // v4: ONE big share button - the system share sheet (WhatsApp, SMS, ...) where available,
    // else the link is copied. The colleague just opens the link and is in the game.
    const shareLabel = linkOk ? 'Link teilen' : 'Einladung teilen';
    const shareTxt = h('span', null, shareLabel);
    const shareBtn = h('button', { class: 'btn btn-gold btn-xl btn-block btn-share', type: 'button' }, [icon('share', 'ico-lg'), shareTxt]);
    shareBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      if (UI.canShare()) {
        try {
          const data = linkOk ? { title: APP_NAME, text: shareText, url: ctl.link } : { title: APP_NAME, text: shareText };
          const p = G.navigator.share(data);
          if (p && p.catch) p.catch(function (e) { if (e && e.name !== 'AbortError') doCopy(shareTxt, shareLabel, 'Link kopiert!'); });
          return;
        } catch (e) { /* fall back to copying */ }
      }
      doCopy(shareTxt, shareLabel, linkOk ? 'Link kopiert!' : 'Text kopiert!');
    });

    // ---- v5: mode (1v1 / 2v2) + map, chosen by the host
    let teamSize = UI.normTeamSize(ctl.teamSize);
    const can2 = !!ctl.can2v2;
    const teamSeg = segmented(TEAM_SIZES.map(function (t) { return { id: t.id, label: t.label, disabled: t.id === 2 && !can2 }; }),
      can2 ? teamSize : 1, function (id) { if (ctl.onTeamSize) ctl.onTeamSize(id); }, 'seg seg-sm seg-team');
    // v6: game mode (C.H.A.O.S / Touchdown + switch; v12: + Klassisch) - the map previews follow it
    const lobbyFeat = { touchdown: !!ctl.canTouchdown, hill: !!ctl.canHill, tunnel: !!ctl.canTunnel };
    let gMode = UI.allowedGameMode(ctl.gameMode, lobbyFeat);
    let gChaos = !!ctl.tdChaos;
    let gDraft = ctl.tdDraft !== false;
    let gBoost = !!ctl.elixirBoost;   // v13 Schnelles Elixier
    const boostTog = boostToggle(gBoost, function (on) {
      gBoost = on;
      paintChips();
      if (ctl.onElixirBoost) ctl.onElixirBoost(on);
    });
    const mapPick = mapPicker(UI.allowedMap(ctl.map, lobbyFeat), function (id) { if (ctl.onMap) ctl.onMap(id); },
      { compact: true, mode: gMode, disabled: function (id) { return !UI.mapEnabled(id, lobbyFeat); } });
    const chipsWrap = h('div', { class: 'chips-wrap' });
    const bHint = h('div', { class: 'hint info td-deck-hint', hidden: true });
    function paintChips() {
      const bt = buildingHintText(app, gMode, { draft: gDraft && ctl.canDraft !== false });
      bHint.hidden = !bt;
      bHint.textContent = bt;
      chipsWrap.textContent = '';
      // classic: chosen, or the fallback when the C.H.A.O.S module is missing (ctl.mode)
      const bm = gMode === 'touchdown' ? 'touchdown' : (gMode === 'classic' || ctl.mode === 'classic' ? 'classic' : 'chaos');
      chipsWrap.appendChild(infoChips(bm, ctl.speed, { chaos: gMode === 'touchdown' && gChaos && ctl.canChaos !== false, draft: gDraft && ctl.canDraft !== false, elixirBoost: gBoost ? ELIXIR_BOOST : 0 }));
    }
    const modePick = modePicker(gMode, gChaos, function (m, c, d) {
      gMode = m; gChaos = c; gDraft = d !== false;
      mapPick.setMode(gMode);
      paintChips();
      if (ctl.onGameMode) ctl.onGameMode(m, c, gDraft);
    }, { canTouchdown: !!ctl.canTouchdown, canChaos: ctl.canChaos !== false, tdDraft: gDraft, canDraft: ctl.canDraft !== false, tdNote: ctl.noteTouchdown || 'Touchdown ist gerade nicht verfügbar.', compact: true });
    paintChips();
    const boardWrap = h('div', { class: 'board-wrap' });
    const reqWrap = h('div', { class: 'req-wrap' });
    const dragHint = h('div', { class: 'hint info drag-hint' }, 'Tipp: Ziehe einen Spieler ins andere Team (oder auf einen Spieler dort, um zu tauschen).');
    let boardSig = '';
    let boardDirty = false;
    let slots = UI.newLobbySlots(app.settings && app.settings.name, null);
    const declined = Object.create(null);   // 'slot:team:name' wishes the host said no to
    const drag = lobbyDrag(boardWrap, {
      accept: function (from, t) { return !!UI.lobbyDropAction(slots, teamSize, from, t); },
      onDrop: function (from, t) { if (ctl.onDrop) ctl.onDrop(from, t); Sound.play('select'); },
      onActive: function (on) { if (!on && boardDirty) { boardDirty = false; renderBoard(); } },
    });

    const startBtn = h('button', { class: 'btn btn-green btn-xl btn-block btn-fight', type: 'button', disabled: true }, [icon('swords', 'ico-lg'), h('span', null, 'Kampf starten')]);
    startBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { if (!startBtn.disabled) ctl.onStart(); });
    const startHint = h('div', { class: 'hint' }, 'Starten ist möglich, sobald alle bereit sind.');
    const inviteHint = h('div', { class: 'invite-hint' }, '');
    function paintInvite() {
      inviteHint.textContent = teamSize === 2
        ? 'Schick den Link an 3 Freunde – jeder öffnet ihn auf seinem Handy.'
        : 'Schick den Link an 1 Freund – er öffnet ihn auf seinem Handy.';
    }
    const retryBtn = h('button', { class: 'btn btn-gold btn-block', type: 'button', hidden: true }, 'Neuen Code erstellen');
    retryBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { if (ctl.onRetry) ctl.onRetry(); });

    const codeBtn = h('button', {
      class: 'code-big', type: 'button', title: 'Code kopieren',
      'aria-label': 'Spiel-Code ' + ctl.code.split('').join(' ') + ' – tippen zum Kopieren',
    }, ctl.code.split('').map(function (ch, i) {
      const t = h('span', { class: 'code-tile' }, ch);
      t.style.animationDelay = (0.05 + i * 0.07).toFixed(2) + 's';
      return t;
    }));
    codeBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      UI.copyText(ctl.code, null).then(function (ok) {
        UI.toast(app.stage, ok ? 'Code ' + ctl.code + ' kopiert' : 'Code: ' + ctl.code + ' – bitte abschreiben');
      });
    });

    const el = h('div', { class: 'screen screen-lobby' }, [
      h('div', { class: 'hdr' }, [backButton(function () { ctl.onCancel(); }), h('div', { class: 'hdr-title' }, 'Mit Freunden spielen')]),
      h('div', { class: 'lobby-body scroll' }, [
        h('div', { class: 'panel panel-code' }, [
          inviteHint,
          h('div', { class: 'lobby-label' }, 'Dein Spiel-Code'),
          codeBtn,
          shareBtn,
          h('div', { class: 'hint', style: 'margin-top:8px' }, linkOk
            ? 'Wer den Link öffnet, ist sofort in deiner Lobby – oder er tippt auf „Mit Freunden“ und gibt den Code ein.'
            : 'Schick deinen Freunden die Adresse dieser Seite und den Code. Sie tippen auf „Mit Freunden“ und geben den Code ein.'),
          h('div', { class: 'link-row' }, [linkInput, copyBtn]),
        ]),
        status.el,
        h('div', { class: 'panel panel-setup' }, [
          h('div', { class: 'lobby-label' }, 'Spielmodus'),
          modePick.el,
          bHint,
          boostTog.el,
          h('div', { class: 'lobby-label' }, 'Modus'),
          teamSeg.el,
          can2 ? null : h('div', { class: 'hint info' }, ctl.note2v2 || '2 gegen 2 ist gerade nicht verfügbar.'),
          h('div', { class: 'lobby-label' }, 'Karte'),
          mapPick.el,
        ]),
        reqWrap,
        boardWrap,
        dragHint,
        chipsWrap,
      ]),
      h('div', { class: 'lobby-actions' }, [retryBtn, startBtn, startHint]),
    ]);

    let lastState = 'connecting';
    let wasReady = false;
    let canStart = { ok: false, reason: 'Starten ist möglich, sobald alle bereit sind.' };
    function refreshStart() {
      const humans = slots.some(function (sl, i) { return i < UI.lobbyUsedSlots(teamSize) && sl.kind === 'guest'; });
      // with guests the connection must be up; a lobby of host + bots can start any time
      const netOk = !humans || lastState === 'connected';
      const ok = !!(canStart.ok && netOk);
      startBtn.disabled = !ok;
      startBtn.classList.toggle('is-ready', ok);
      if (ok && !wasReady) { Sound.play('ready'); vibrate(25); }
      wasReady = ok;
      startHint.textContent = ok ? 'Alles bereit – los geht’s!' : (canStart.ok ? 'Warte auf Verbindung …' : canStart.reason);
    }
    /** Open team wishes of guests whose team is full of humans: one-tap "Tauschen?" prompt. */
    function renderReqs() {
      reqWrap.textContent = '';
      if (teamSize !== 2) return;
      const n = UI.lobbyUsedSlots(teamSize);
      let any = false;
      for (let i = 0; i < n && i < slots.length; i++) {
        const sl = slots[i];
        if (!sl || sl.kind !== 'guest' || (sl.req !== 0 && sl.req !== 1) || sl.req === sl.team) continue;
        const key = i + ':' + sl.req + ':' + UI.sanitizeName(sl.name);
        if (declined[key]) continue;
        const to = sl.req;
        const who = UI.playerName(sl.name, i, sl.kind);
        const btns = [];
        for (let j = 0; j < n && j < slots.length; j++) {
          const o = slots[j];
          if (!o || j === i || o.kind === 'empty' || (o.team === 1 ? 1 : 0) !== to) continue;
          const b = h('button', { class: 'btn btn-gold btn-sm req-swap', type: 'button' }, 'Mit ' + UI.playerName(o.name, j, o.kind) + ' tauschen');
          b.addEventListener('click', (function (a, w) { return function () { if (ctl.onSwapReq) ctl.onSwapReq(a, w); Sound.play('select'); }; })(i, j));
          btns.push(b);
        }
        const no = h('button', { class: 'btn btn-grey btn-sm req-no', type: 'button' }, 'Nein');
        no.addEventListener('click', (function (k, a) { return function () { declined[k] = true; if (ctl.onDeclineReq) ctl.onDeclineReq(a); renderReqs(); }; })(key, i));
        btns.push(no);
        reqWrap.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'req-card', role: 'alert' }, [
          h('div', { class: 'req-text' }, [h('b', null, who), ' möchte zu Team ' + TEAMS[to].label + '. Tauschen?']),
          h('div', { class: 'req-btns' }, btns),
        ]));
        any = true;
      }
      if (any && !reqWrap.dataset.alerted) { reqWrap.dataset.alerted = '1'; Sound.play('ready'); vibrate(30); }
      if (!any) delete reqWrap.dataset.alerted;
    }
    function renderBoard() {
      const sig = UI.lobbySig(slots, teamSize);
      if (sig === boardSig) return;
      if (drag.active) { boardDirty = true; return; }   // the drop re-renders
      boardSig = sig;
      boardWrap.textContent = '';
      boardWrap.appendChild(teamBoard(slots, {
        teamSize: teamSize, mySlot: 0, host: true, drag: !!ctl.onDrop,
        onAddBot: ctl.canBots === false ? null : function (team) { if (ctl.onAddBot) ctl.onAddBot(team); },
        onSwitch: function (sl) { if (ctl.onSwitch) ctl.onSwitch(sl.slot); },
        onRemove: function (sl) { if (ctl.onRemove) ctl.onRemove(sl.slot); },
      }));
      dragHint.hidden = teamSize !== 2 || !ctl.onDrop;
      paintInvite();
      renderReqs();
    }
    function setSlots(list, ts) {
      if (Array.isArray(list)) slots = list;
      if (ts != null) { teamSize = UI.normTeamSize(ts); teamSeg.set(teamSize); }
      renderBoard();
      paintInvite();
      refreshStart();
    }
    function setStatus(s) {
      lastState = (s && s.state) || lastState;
      status.set(s, 'host');
      retryBtn.hidden = lastState !== 'error';
      refreshStart();
    }
    renderBoard();

    return {
      el: el,
      back: function () { ctl.onCancel(); },
      setStatus: setStatus,
      setSlots: setSlots,
      setMap: function (m) { mapPick.set(UI.allowedMap(m, lobbyFeat)); },
      /** v6: mode from the network lobby ('touchdown' | 'classic' (v12) | other, options {chaos}) */
      setGameMode: function (m, options) {
        const gm = UI.allowedGameMode(m, lobbyFeat);
        const c = gm === 'touchdown' ? !!(options && options.chaos) : gChaos;
        if (gm === gMode && c === gChaos) return;
        gMode = gm; gChaos = c;
        modePick.set(gMode, gChaos);
        mapPick.setMode(gMode);
        paintChips();
      },
      setCanStart: function (c) { canStart = c && typeof c === 'object' ? c : { ok: !!c, reason: '' }; refreshStart(); },
      /** legacy 1v1: one guest object (or null) -> slot 1 */
      setGuest: function (g) {
        const next = slots.slice();
        next[1] = g ? { slot: 1, name: g.name, team: 1, kind: 'guest', ready: !!g.ready, deck: g.deck || null } : { slot: 1, name: '', team: 1, kind: 'empty', ready: false, deck: null };
        setSlots(next, null);
      },
      destroy: function () { drag.cancel(); },
    };
  };

  // ====================================================================== GUEST LOBBY

  /** ctl: { code, name, auto, onName(name), onJoin(code), onReady(bool), onTeam(team), onCancel() }
   *  api: setStatus(s), setFailed(msg), setReady(b), setLobby({slots, teamSize, map, mySlot}) */
  UI.GuestLobbyScreen = function (app, ctl) {
    // v5.1: the name sits on top and stays editable in the lobby - every change goes to the
    // host at once (ctl.onName -> gs.setName); no name = "Spieler <slot>".
    const nameInput = h('input', {
      class: 'text-input name-big', type: 'text', maxlength: '16', value: UI.isDefaultName(ctl.name) ? '' : (ctl.name || ''), placeholder: 'z. B. Max',
      autocomplete: 'off', autocapitalize: 'words', spellcheck: 'false', enterkeyhint: 'done',
      'aria-label': 'Dein Name',
    });
    let sentName = UI.sanitizeName(nameInput.value);
    let nameTimer = 0;
    const commitName = function () {
      if (nameTimer) { G.clearTimeout(nameTimer); nameTimer = 0; }
      const v = UI.sanitizeName(nameInput.value);
      if (v !== nameInput.value.trim()) nameInput.value = v;
      if (v === sentName) return;
      sentName = v;
      if (ctl.onName) ctl.onName(v);
    };
    nameInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
      if (nameTimer) G.clearTimeout(nameTimer);
      nameTimer = G.setTimeout(function () { nameTimer = 0; commitName(); }, 450);
    });
    nameInput.addEventListener('change', commitName);
    nameInput.addEventListener('blur', commitName);
    nameInput.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Enter') nameInput.blur(); });
    const input = h('input', {
      class: 'code-input', type: 'text', inputmode: 'text', maxlength: '120', placeholder: 'CODE',
      autocomplete: 'off', autocapitalize: 'characters', spellcheck: 'false', enterkeyhint: 'go',
      'aria-label': 'Spiel-Code', value: ctl.code || '',
    });
    input.addEventListener('input', function () {
      const v = input.value;
      if (/[#/]|join/i.test(v)) {
        const c = UI.parseJoinCode(v);
        if (c) input.value = c;
      }
      errHint.hidden = true;
    });
    input.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Enter') join(); });
    const errHint = h('div', { class: 'hint err', hidden: true }, 'Ungültiger Code – bitte prüfen.');
    const joinBtn = h('button', { class: 'btn btn-blue btn-xl btn-block', type: 'button' }, 'Beitreten');
    joinBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { join(); });
    const status = statusRow();
    status.el.hidden = true;

    let ready = false;
    let joined = false;
    const readyTxt = h('span', null, 'Bereit!');
    const readyBtn = h('button', { class: 'btn btn-green btn-xl btn-block', type: 'button', hidden: true }, [readyTxt]);
    readyBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { setReady(!ready, true); });
    const waitHint = h('div', { class: 'hint', hidden: true }, 'Der Gastgeber startet den Kampf, sobald du bereit bist.');

    // ---- v5: lobby view (mode, map, teams) + own team choice (the host decides)
    const lobbyPanel = h('div', { class: 'panel panel-guest-lobby', hidden: true });
    const lobbyChips = h('div', { class: 'info-chips' });
    const teamBtns = TEAMS.map(function (t) {
      const b = h('button', { class: 'btn btn-team ' + t.cls, type: 'button', 'aria-pressed': 'false' }, 'Team ' + t.label);
      b.addEventListener('click', function () {
        if (t.id === myTeam && wantTeam < 0) return;
        if (ctl.onTeam) ctl.onTeam(t.id);
        wantTeam = t.id === myTeam ? -1 : t.id;
        reqSeen = false;
        declinedNote = false;
        paintTeam();
        Sound.play('select');
      });
      return b;
    });
    const teamRow = h('div', { class: 'team-pick' }, teamBtns);
    const teamHint = h('div', { class: 'hint' }, 'Wähle dein Team – der Gastgeber entscheidet.');
    const boardWrap = h('div', { class: 'board-wrap' });
    lobbyPanel.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'lobby-label' }, 'Lobby'));
    lobbyPanel.appendChild(lobbyChips);
    const bHint = h('div', { class: 'hint info td-deck-hint', hidden: true });
    lobbyPanel.appendChild(bHint);
    lobbyPanel.appendChild(teamRow);
    lobbyPanel.appendChild(teamHint);
    lobbyPanel.appendChild(boardWrap);
    let wantTeam = -1;
    let myTeam = -1;
    let reqSeen = false;     // the host showed our wish as open (so its end = a decision)
    let declinedNote = false;
    let lobbySig = '';
    function paintTeam() {
      for (let i = 0; i < teamBtns.length; i++) {
        const on = myTeam === i;
        teamBtns[i].classList.toggle('on', on);
        teamBtns[i].classList.toggle('is-wanted', wantTeam === i && !on);
        teamBtns[i].setAttribute('aria-pressed', on ? 'true' : 'false');
      }
      teamHint.textContent = wantTeam >= 0 && wantTeam !== myTeam
        ? (reqSeen ? 'Team ' + TEAMS[wantTeam].label + ' ist voll – der Gastgeber fragt, ob getauscht wird …' : 'Wechsel angefragt – der Gastgeber entscheidet …')
        : declinedNote ? 'Der Gastgeber hat nicht getauscht. Du bleibst in Team ' + (myTeam >= 0 ? TEAMS[myTeam].label : '') + '.'
          : (myTeam >= 0 ? 'Du spielst in Team ' + TEAMS[myTeam].label + '. Tippe auf das andere Team, um zu wechseln.' : 'Wähle dein Team – der Gastgeber entscheidet.');
    }
    function setLobby(lb) {
      if (!lb || !Array.isArray(lb.slots)) return;
      const ts = UI.normTeamSize(lb.teamSize);
      const mySlot = typeof lb.mySlot === 'number' ? lb.mySlot : -1;
      const me = mySlot >= 0 ? lb.slots[mySlot] : null;
      myTeam = me && me.kind !== 'empty' ? (me.team === 1 ? 1 : 0) : -1;
      if (wantTeam === myTeam) { wantTeam = -1; reqSeen = false; }
      if (wantTeam >= 0 && me) {
        if (me.req === wantTeam) reqSeen = true;
        else if (reqSeen && me.req !== wantTeam) { wantTeam = -1; reqSeen = false; declinedNote = true; }
      }
      // v6: the host's game mode (lb.gameMode: 'chaos' | 'touchdown' | 'classic', lb.options)
      const gm = lb.gameMode === 'touchdown' ? 'touchdown' : (lb.gameMode === 'classic' ? 'classic' : 'chaos');
      const gopt = lb.options && typeof lb.options === 'object' ? lb.options : NONE;
      const sig = UI.lobbySig(lb.slots, ts, String(mySlot) + UI.normMap(lb.map) + gm + (gopt.chaos ? 'c' : '') + (UI.draftOn(gm, gopt) ? 'd' : '') + (UI.elixirBoostOn(gopt) ? 'e' : ''));
      if (sig !== lobbySig) {
        lobbySig = sig;
        lobbyChips.textContent = '';
        lobbyChips.appendChild(modeChip(gm, gopt));
        if (UI.draftOn(gm, gopt)) lobbyChips.appendChild(draftChip());
        if (UI.elixirBoostOn(gopt)) lobbyChips.appendChild(boostChip());
        const bt = buildingHintText(app, gm, gopt);
        bHint.hidden = !bt;
        bHint.textContent = bt;
        lobbyChips.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'info-chip' }, ts === 2 ? '2 gegen 2' : '1 gegen 1'));
        lobbyChips.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'info-chip is-map' }, [h('span', { class: 'map-prev mini', html: UI.mapPreviewSvg(lb.map, gm) }), 'Karte: ' + UI.mapLabel(lb.map)]));
        boardWrap.textContent = '';
        boardWrap.appendChild(teamBoard(lb.slots, { teamSize: ts, mySlot: mySlot, host: false }));
      }
      teamRow.hidden = ts !== 2 || !!lb.full;
      teamHint.hidden = ts !== 2 && !lb.full;
      if (lb.full) teamHint.textContent = 'Die Lobby ist voll – du wartest, bis ein Platz frei wird.';
      lobbyPanel.hidden = false;
      if (!lb.full) paintTeam();
    }

    function setReady(b, user) {
      ready = !!b;
      readyBtn.textContent = '';
      if (ready) readyBtn.appendChild(icon('check'));
      readyBtn.appendChild(h('span', null, ready ? 'Bereit' : 'Bereit!'));
      readyBtn.className = 'btn btn-xl btn-block ' + (ready ? 'btn-grey is-ready-on' : 'btn-green');
      waitHint.textContent = ready ? 'Warte auf den Start durch den Gastgeber … (tippen = nicht bereit)' : 'Tippe auf „Bereit!“, damit der Gastgeber starten kann.';
      if (user) { ctl.onReady(ready); if (ready) Sound.play('ready'); }
    }

    function join() {
      if (joined) return;
      const code = UI.parseJoinCode(input.value);
      if (!code) { errHint.hidden = false; replayClass(input, 'shake'); Sound.play('deny'); return; }
      input.value = code;
      commitName();
      joined = true;
      input.disabled = true;
      joinBtn.disabled = true;
      joinBtn.textContent = 'Verbinde …';
      status.el.hidden = false;
      status.set({ state: 'connecting' }, 'guest');
      ctl.onJoin(code);
    }

    const el = h('div', { class: 'screen screen-lobby' }, [
      h('div', { class: 'hdr' }, [backButton(function () { ctl.onCancel(); }), h('div', { class: 'hdr-title' }, 'Beitreten')]),
      h('div', { class: 'lobby-body scroll' }, [
        h('div', { class: 'panel panel-name' }, [
          h('label', { class: 'lobby-label name-label' }, 'Dein Name'),
          nameInput,
          h('div', { class: 'hint' }, 'So sehen dich deine Freunde in der Lobby. Du kannst ihn jederzeit ändern.'),
        ]),
        h('div', { class: 'panel' }, [
          h('div', { class: 'lobby-label' }, 'Spiel-Code'),
          input,
          errHint,
          h('div', { class: 'hint', style: 'margin:8px 0 12px' }, 'Gib den Code vom Gastgeber ein – oder öffne einfach seinen Link.'),
          joinBtn,
        ]),
        status.el,
        lobbyPanel,
      ]),
      h('div', { class: 'lobby-actions' }, [readyBtn, waitHint]),
    ]);

    return {
      el: el,
      back: function () { ctl.onCancel(); },
      autoJoin: function () { join(); },
      setLobby: setLobby,
      setStatus: function (s) {
        status.el.hidden = false;
        status.set(s, 'guest');
        const st = s && s.state;
        if (st === 'connected') {
          joinBtn.textContent = 'Verbunden';
          readyBtn.hidden = false;
          waitHint.hidden = false;
        }
      },
      /** Join attempt failed: allow editing the code and retrying. */
      setFailed: function (message) {
        joined = false;
        input.disabled = false;
        joinBtn.disabled = false;
        joinBtn.textContent = 'Erneut versuchen';
        readyBtn.hidden = true;
        waitHint.hidden = true;
        lobbyPanel.hidden = true;
        status.el.hidden = false;
        status.set({ state: 'error', message: message || 'Verbindung fehlgeschlagen' }, 'guest');
      },
      setReady: function (b) { setReady(b, false); },
      destroy: function () {},
    };
  };

  // ============================================================================ DRAFT (v7)

  /**
   * Pure: German texts of the draft screen for a CR.Draft.viewFor() view.
   * -> { round: 'Runde 3 / 8', status, hint } (names = display name per player index).
   */
  UI.draftTexts = function (v, names) {
    const nm = function (i) { return (names && names[i]) || 'Gegner'; };
    if (!v) return { round: '', status: 'Draft wird vorbereitet …', hint: '' };
    const rounds = v.rounds || 8;
    const round = 'Runde ' + Math.min(rounds, (v.round | 0) + (v.done ? 0 : 1)) + ' / ' + rounds;
    if (v.allDone) return { round: round, status: 'Deck fertig! Gleich geht es los …', hint: 'Beide Decks stehen – viel Glück im Touchdown!' };
    if (v.done) return { round: round, status: 'Dein Deck ist fertig', hint: 'Warte, bis die anderen fertig gewählt haben …' };
    if (v.mine) return { round: round, status: 'Wähle eine Karte', hint: 'Die andere Karte bekommt ' + nm(v.opponent) + '.' };
    return { round: round, status: nm(v.opponent) + ' wählt …', hint: 'Die Karte, die übrig bleibt, kommt in dein Deck.' };
  };

  /** Average elixir of a deck list [{id}] or [id] (one decimal, German comma). */
  UI.draftAvg = function (list) {
    const ids = (list || EMPTY).map(function (c) { return typeof c === 'string' ? c : c && c.id; }).filter(Boolean);
    return ids.length ? UI.formatDecimal(UI.avgElixir(ids)) : '–';
  };

  /**
   * v7 Touchdown draft screen (phone portrait): round x/8, two big card portraits (name,
   * elixir, rarity, type) to tap, a pick timer ring (auto-pick by the authority on timeout),
   * the opponent's cards on top and the own deck at the bottom, fly / deal animations.
   * opts = { localPlayer, names: [per player], onPick(choice, round), onLeave(), online }.
   * api: setState(snapshot, { deadline: performance.now() ms | null, total: ms }),
   *      setStatus(netStatus), destroy().
   */
  UI.DraftScreen = function (app, opts) {
    const o = opts || NONE;
    const me = typeof o.localPlayer === 'number' ? o.localPlayer : 0;
    const names = Array.isArray(o.names) ? o.names : [];
    let destroyed = false;
    let view = null;
    let shown = null;          // { round, cards, done } currently on screen
    let pending = null;        // newest state while an animation runs
    let animTimer = 0;
    let picked = -1;           // own tap in this round (waits for the authority)
    let deadline = null;
    let total = 10000;
    let timerIv = 0;
    let lastSecs = -1;

    const leaveBtn = h('button', { class: 'btn btn-grey btn-icon dr-leave', type: 'button', 'aria-label': 'Draft verlassen' }, icon('home'));
    leaveBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { if (o.onLeave) o.onLeave(); });
    const roundEl = h('div', { class: 'dr-round' }, '');
    const C = 2 * Math.PI * 20;
    const ringFg = h('span', { class: 'dr-ring', html: '<svg viewBox="0 0 48 48" aria-hidden="true"><circle class="dr-ring-bg" cx="24" cy="24" r="20"/><circle class="dr-ring-fg" cx="24" cy="24" r="20" stroke-dasharray="' + C.toFixed(2) + '" stroke-dashoffset="0"/></svg>' });
    const secsEl = h('b', { class: 'dr-secs' }, '');
    const timerEl = h('div', { class: 'dr-timer', 'aria-label': 'Zeit für die Wahl' }, [ringFg, secsEl]);
    const top = h('div', { class: 'dr-top' }, [leaveBtn, h('div', { class: 'dr-title' }, [h('span', { class: 'dr-logo' }, [icon('cards'), 'Draft']), roundEl]), timerEl]);

    function strip(cls) {
      const slots = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) slots.push(h('span', { class: 'dr-slot is-empty' }));
      const wrap = h('div', { class: 'dr-strip ' + cls }, slots);
      return { el: wrap, slots: slots, ids: [] };
    }
    const oppStrip = strip('is-opp');
    const myStrip = strip('is-mine');
    const oppName = h('span', { class: 'dr-who' }, '');
    const oppAvg = h('span', { class: 'dr-avg' }, '');
    const myAvg = h('span', { class: 'dr-avg' }, '');
    const oppBox = h('div', { class: 'dr-deck dr-deck-opp' }, [h('div', { class: 'dr-deck-hd' }, [icon('people', 'dr-hd-ico'), oppName, oppAvg]), oppStrip.el]);
    const myBox = h('div', { class: 'dr-deck dr-deck-mine' }, [h('div', { class: 'dr-deck-hd' }, [icon('cards', 'dr-hd-ico'), h('span', { class: 'dr-who' }, 'Dein Deck'), myAvg]), myStrip.el]);

    const statusEl = h('div', { class: 'dr-status' }, 'Draft wird vorbereitet …');
    const hintEl = h('div', { class: 'dr-hint' }, '');
    const offerEl = h('div', { class: 'dr-offer' });
    const netEl = h('div', { class: 'dr-net', hidden: true, role: 'status' });
    const stage = h('div', { class: 'dr-stage' }, [statusEl, offerEl, hintEl]);
    const el = h('div', { class: 'screen screen-draft' }, [
      h('div', { class: 'dr-bg', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }),
      top, oppBox, stage, myBox, netEl,
    ]);

    function bigCard(id, idx, mine) {
      const inf = UI.cardInfo(id);
      const rar = RARITY[inf.rarity] || RARITY.common;
      const b = h('button', {
        type: 'button',
        class: 'dr-card rar-' + inf.rarity + ' t-' + inf.type + (mine ? ' is-mine' : ' is-theirs'),
        'aria-label': inf.name + ', ' + (inf.elixir == null ? '?' : inf.elixir) + ' Elixier, ' + rar.label + (mine ? ' – wählen' : ''),
        disabled: !mine,
      }, [
        h('span', { class: 'dr-card-glow', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }),
        h('span', { class: 'dr-card-frame' }, [artBox(id, null), h('span', { class: 'card-shine' })]),
        h('span', { class: 'dr-cost' }, [h('i'), h('b', null, inf.elixir == null ? '?' : String(inf.elixir))]),
        h('span', { class: 'dr-card-name' }, inf.name),
        h('span', { class: 'dr-card-meta' }, [h('span', { class: 'dr-rar' }, rar.label), ' · ', TYPE_LABEL[inf.type] || 'Truppe']),
      ]);
      b.style.setProperty('--cc', inf.color);
      b.style.setProperty('--i', String(idx));
      b.addEventListener('click', function () {
        if (!view || !view.mine || picked >= 0 || destroyed) return;
        picked = idx;
        b.classList.add('is-chosen');
        const other = offerEl.querySelectorAll('.dr-card')[1 - idx];
        if (other) other.classList.add('is-other');
        offerEl.classList.add('is-locked');
        vibrate(12);
        if (o.onPick) o.onPick(idx, view.round);
      });
      return b;
    }
    function fillSlot(sl, c, fresh) {
      const inf = UI.cardInfo(c.id);
      sl.className = 'dr-slot rar-' + inf.rarity + (c.how === 'gift' ? ' is-gift' : ' is-pick') + (fresh ? ' pop' : '');
      sl.textContent = '';
      sl.style.setProperty('--cc', inf.color);
      sl.setAttribute('aria-label', inf.name + (c.how === 'gift' ? ' (bekommen)' : ' (gewählt)'));
      sl.appendChild(artBox(c.id, sl));
      sl.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'dr-slot-cost' }, inf.elixir == null ? '?' : String(inf.elixir)));
      if (c.how === 'gift') sl.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'dr-slot-gift', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }));
    }
    function paintStrip(st, list) {
      for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        const c = list[i];
        const id = c ? c.id + ':' + c.how : '';
        if (st.ids[i] === id) continue;
        const fresh = st.ids[i] !== undefined && !!c;
        st.ids[i] = id;
        if (c) fillSlot(st.slots[i], c, fresh);
        else { st.slots[i].className = 'dr-slot is-empty'; st.slots[i].textContent = ''; }
      }
    }
    function renderOffer(v) {
      offerEl.textContent = '';
      offerEl.className = 'dr-offer' + (v.mine ? ' is-mine' : ' is-theirs');
      picked = -1;
      if (!v.cards) {
        offerEl.classList.add('is-empty');
        offerEl.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'dr-done-ico', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }, icon(v.allDone ? 'swords' : 'check')));
        return;
      }
      offerEl.appendChild(bigCard(v.cards[0], 0, v.mine));
      offerEl.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'dr-or', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }, 'oder'));
      offerEl.appendChild(bigCard(v.cards[1], 1, v.mine));
      replayClass(offerEl, 'deal');
    }
    function paint(v) {
      view = v;
      const t = UI.draftTexts(v, names);
      roundEl.textContent = t.round;
      statusEl.textContent = t.status;
      hintEl.textContent = t.hint;
      el.classList.toggle('is-mine', !!v.mine);
      el.classList.toggle('is-wait', !v.mine && !v.done);
      el.classList.toggle('is-done', !!v.done);
      oppName.textContent = (names[v.opponent] || 'Gegner');
      oppAvg.textContent = 'Ø ' + UI.draftAvg(v.oppDeck);
      myAvg.textContent = 'Ø ' + UI.draftAvg(v.myDeck);
      paintStrip(myStrip, v.myDeck);
      paintStrip(oppStrip, v.oppDeck);
      const key = v.done ? 'done' : v.round + ':' + v.cards.join(',');
      if (!shown || shown.key !== key) {
        shown = { key: key, round: v.round, cards: v.cards ? v.cards.slice() : null };
        renderOffer(v);
      }
      timerEl.hidden = !!v.done;
    }
    /** The round moved on: the card I got flies down, the other one up; then the next offer. */
    function animateTo(v) {
      const prev = shown && shown.cards;
      if (!prev || animTimer) return false;
      const mineIds = v.myDeck.map(function (c) { return c.id; });
      const btns = offerEl.querySelectorAll('.dr-card');
      if (btns.length !== 2) return false;
      for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        const down = mineIds.indexOf(prev[i]) >= 0;
        btns[i].classList.add(down ? 'fly-down' : 'fly-up');
        btns[i].disabled = true;
      }
      offerEl.classList.add('is-locked');
      animTimer = G.setTimeout(function () {
        animTimer = 0;
        if (destroyed) return;
        const nv = pending || v;
        pending = null;
        paint(nv);
      }, 480);
      return true;
    }
    function tickTimer() {
      if (destroyed) return;
      if (deadline === null || !view || view.done) { if (lastSecs !== -2) { secsEl.textContent = ''; lastSecs = -2; } return; }
      const left = Math.max(0, deadline - now());
      const frac = total > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, left / total)) : 0;
      const fg = ringFg.querySelector('.dr-ring-fg');
      if (fg) fg.setAttribute('stroke-dashoffset', (C * (1 - frac)).toFixed(2));
      const secs = Math.ceil(left / 1000);
      if (secs !== lastSecs) {
        lastSecs = secs;
        secsEl.textContent = String(secs);
        timerEl.classList.toggle('is-urgent', secs <= 3 && !!view.mine);
        if (secs <= 3 && secs > 0 && view.mine) replayClass(timerEl, 'beat');
      }
    }
    timerIv = G.setInterval(tickTimer, 100);

    const api = {
      el: el,
      back: function () { if (o.onLeave) o.onLeave(); },
      /** snap = CR.Draft snapshot; timing = { deadline (performance.now ms) | null, total ms }. */
      setState: function (snap, timing) {
        if (destroyed || !CR.Draft) return;
        const v = CR.Draft.viewFor(snap, me);
        if (!v) return;
        if (timing) {
          deadline = typeof timing.deadline === 'number' ? timing.deadline : null;
          if (timing.total > 0) total = timing.total;
          lastSecs = -1;
        }
        if (animTimer) { pending = v; return; }
        const moved = shown && shown.cards && (v.done || v.round !== shown.round);
        if (moved && animateTo(v)) { pending = v; return; }
        paint(v);
        tickTimer();
      },
      /** Network state (online): a small banner while the connection is gone. */
      setStatus: function (s) {
        const st = s && s.state;
        netEl.hidden = !(st === 'lost' || st === 'error');
        netEl.className = 'dr-net is-' + (st || 'ok');
        netEl.textContent = st === 'error' ? (s.message || 'Verbindung beendet') : 'Verbindung unterbrochen – verbinde neu …';
      },
      view: function () { return view; },
      destroy: function () {
        destroyed = true;
        if (timerIv) { G.clearInterval(timerIv); timerIv = 0; }
        if (animTimer) { G.clearTimeout(animTimer); animTimer = 0; }
      },
    };
    return api;
  };

  // =========================================================================== RESULT

  const CROWN_DELAY_S = 0.55;   // first crown pops after the title
  const CROWN_STEP_S = 0.32;

  /** info: { outcome, names:[n0,n1], crowns:[c0,c1], localSide, online, role, reason,
   *          touchdown: {target} | null (v6: crowns = touchdowns, footballs instead of crowns),
   *          onRematch(), onMenu() } */
  UI.ResultScreen = function (app, info) {
    const td = info.touchdown && typeof info.touchdown === 'object' ? info.touchdown : null;
    const slotsN = td ? Math.max(1, Math.min(9, td.target | 0 || TD_TARGET)) : 3;
    const side = info.localSide | 0;
    const opp = 1 - side;
    const names = info.names || ['Du', 'Gegner'];
    const crowns = info.crowns || [0, 0];
    const titles = { win: 'Sieg!', loss: 'Niederlage', draw: 'Unentschieden' };
    const outcome = info.outcome || 'draw';
    const title = h('div', { class: 'res-banner ' + outcome }, h('span', { class: 'res-title' }, titles[outcome] || 'Ende'));
    const sub = h('div', { class: 'res-sub' }, info.reason || ((crowns[side] | 0) + ' : ' + (crowns[opp] | 0) + (td ? ' Touchdowns' : ' Kronen')));
    const timers = [];

    let crownNo = 0;
    function sideRow(s, cls) {
      const n = Math.max(0, Math.min(slotsN, crowns[s] | 0));
      const c = h('div', { class: 'res-crowns' + (td ? ' is-td' : ''), 'aria-label': n + (td ? ' Touchdowns' : ' Kronen') });
      for (let i = 0; i < slotsN; i++) {
        const on = i < n;
        const k = h('span', { class: 'res-crown ' + (on ? 'on' : 'off') + (td ? ' res-td' : '') });
        k.innerHTML = td ? ICON.football : CROWN_SVG;
        if (on) {
          const delay = CROWN_DELAY_S + crownNo * CROWN_STEP_S;
          crownNo++;
          k.style.animationDelay = delay.toFixed(2) + 's';
          const mine = s === side;
          timers.push(G.setTimeout(function () { Sound.play('crownPop'); if (mine) vibrate(15); }, delay * 1000 + 180));
        }
        c.appendChild(k);
      }
      const isWinner = (outcome === 'win' && s === side) || (outcome === 'loss' && s === opp);
      return h('div', { class: 'res-side ' + cls + (isWinner ? ' is-winner' : '') }, [
        h('div', { class: 'res-who' }, [
          h('div', { class: 'res-name' }, UI.sanitizeName(names[s]) || (s === side ? 'Du' : 'Gegner')),
          isWinner ? h('span', { class: 'res-win-tag' }, 'Gewinner') : (s === side ? h('span', { class: 'res-you-tag' }, 'Du') : null),
        ]),
        c,
      ]);
    }

    const status = h('div', { class: 'hint res-status' }, info.online ? 'Beide müssen „Revanche“ drücken.' : '');
    const rematchBtn = h('button', { class: 'btn btn-gold btn-xl btn-block', type: 'button' }, 'Revanche');
    rematchBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { if (!rematchBtn.disabled) info.onRematch(); });
    const menuBtn = h('button', { class: 'btn btn-blue btn-block', type: 'button' }, 'Zum Menü');
    menuBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { info.onMenu(); });

    const oppRow = sideRow(opp, 'opp');
    const meRow = sideRow(side, 'me');
    const el = h('div', { class: 'screen screen-result res-' + outcome + (td ? ' is-td' : '') }, [
      h('div', { class: 'res-rays', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }),
      title,
      sub,
      h('div', { class: 'res-board panel' }, [oppRow, h('div', { class: 'res-vs' }, 'VS'), meRow]),
      status,
      h('div', { class: 'res-actions' }, [rematchBtn, menuBtn]),
    ]);
    if (outcome === 'win') {
      const conf = h('div', { class: 'confetti', 'aria-hidden': 'true' });
      const cols = ['#f2c84b', '#ff7a2c', '#ffb060', '#c4161c', '#fff1c4', '#e8963f'];   // v10: rising embers
      for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
        const p = h('i');
        p.style.left = ((i * 37) % 100) + '%';
        p.style.background = cols[i % cols.length];
        p.style.animationDelay = ((i * 0.13) % 1.6).toFixed(2) + 's';
        p.style.animationDuration = (2.4 + (i % 5) * 0.35).toFixed(2) + 's';
        conf.appendChild(p);
      }
      el.appendChild(conf);
    }

    return {
      el: el,
      back: function () { info.onMenu(); },
      /** 'none' | 'waiting' | 'opponent' | 'starting' | 'unavailable' */
      setRematchState: function (st, text) {
        if (st === 'waiting') {
          rematchBtn.disabled = true;
          rematchBtn.textContent = 'Warte auf Gegner …';
          status.textContent = text || 'Revanche angefragt – warte auf deinen Gegner.';
        } else if (st === 'opponent') {
          rematchBtn.disabled = false;
          rematchBtn.textContent = 'Revanche annehmen';
          status.textContent = text || 'Dein Gegner möchte eine Revanche!';
          replayClass(rematchBtn, 'shake');
        } else if (st === 'starting') {
          rematchBtn.disabled = true;
          rematchBtn.textContent = 'Starte …';
          status.textContent = text || '';
        } else if (st === 'unavailable') {
          rematchBtn.disabled = true;
          rematchBtn.textContent = 'Revanche';
          status.textContent = text || 'Dein Gegner hat das Spiel verlassen.';
        } else {
          rematchBtn.disabled = false;
          rematchBtn.textContent = 'Revanche';
          status.textContent = text || (info.online ? 'Beide müssen „Revanche“ drücken.' : '');
        }
      },
      destroy: function () { for (let i = 0; i < timers.length; i++) G.clearTimeout(timers[i]); },
    };
  };

  // =========================================================================== BATTLE

  const VS_MS = 1700;          // VS splash before the "Kampf!" banner (the authority holds the sim)
  const FIGHT_BANNER_MS = 1300;
  const CHAOS_UI_MAX_ERRORS = 20;
  const TD_BURST_MS = 2100;    // v6: wordless touchdown burst
  UI.VS_MS = VS_MS;

  // ---- v4 hand geometry (Clash Royale proportions, measured on the original game on an
  // iPhone: docs/ref/clash-royale-original.webp). Pure, tested in jsc (tests/test-shell.js).
  // Left column (17.5 % of the width): emote button on top, the small next card below it.
  // Right of it four cards (each ~18 % of the width, portrait 0.8, elixir drop at the bottom
  // centre of each card) and the elixir bar with its drop + number under the cards. The top
  // info (timer, crowns, menu) is an overlay on the arena: the arena gets everything else.
  const CARD_RATIO = 0.8;       // hand card width / height (CR card face)
  const ARENA_RATIO = 1.5;      // default: canvas height per canvas width the renderer needs to
                                // show the whole field at full width (corrected by measurement)
  const CARD_MAX_W = 104;
  const CARD_MIN_K = 0.86;      // cards give back at most 14 % of their height to the arena
  const HAND_BORDER = 2;        // .hand border-top (styles.css)
  const LEFT_COL = 0.175;       // emote + next card column, share of the width
  function clampi(v, a, b) { return Math.round(v < a ? a : (v > b ? b : v)); }
  UI.CARD_RATIO = CARD_RATIO;
  UI.ARENA_RATIO = ARENA_RATIO;

  /**
   * Battle HUD geometry for a battle screen of sw x sh CSS px.
   * o = { safeT, safeB (px), arenaRatio (canvas h per w the field needs at full width) }.
   * -> { cardW, cardH, nextW, nextH, leftW, emoteD, exH, footH, topH (0: overlay), nameH (v5:
   *      the small card name under each hand card), padX, gap, padTop, rowGap, padBot, handH,
   *      arenaW, arenaH, unit }
   * The arena = sh - safeT - handH (the top info floats over it). When that is too short to
   * show the whole field at full width, the cards shrink (never below 86 %).
   */
  UI.battleLayout = function (sw, sh, o) {
    const opt = o || NONE;
    const W = Math.max(240, Math.round(+sw) || 360);
    const H = Math.max(320, Math.round(+sh) || 640);
    const safeT = Math.max(0, +opt.safeT || 0);
    const safeB = Math.max(0, +opt.safeB || 0);
    const ratio = opt.arenaRatio > 0.6 && opt.arenaRatio < 3 ? +opt.arenaRatio : ARENA_RATIO;
    const padX = clampi(W * 0.02, 6, 12);
    const gap = clampi(W * 0.014, 4, 8);
    const leftW = clampi(W * LEFT_COL, 52, 92);
    const padTop = clampi(W * 0.016, 5, 8);
    const padBot = 4;
    const exFor = function (cw) { return clampi(cw * 0.37, 22, 34); };
    const rowFor = function (cw) { return clampi(cw * 0.15, 7, 14); };   // room for the cost drops
    const nameFor = function (cw) { return clampi(cw * 0.17, 10, 16); };  // v5: card name under each card
    const handFor = function (ch, cw) { return HAND_BORDER + padTop + ch + rowFor(cw) + nameFor(cw) + exFor(cw) + padBot + safeB; };
    let cardW = Math.min(CARD_MAX_W, Math.floor((W - 2 * padX - leftW - 4 * gap) / 4));
    let cardH = Math.round(cardW / CARD_RATIO);
    let arenaH = H - safeT - handFor(cardH, cardW);
    const need = Math.round(W * ratio);
    if (arenaH < need) {
      const minH = Math.round(cardH * CARD_MIN_K);
      const ch = Math.max(minH, Math.round(cardH - (need - arenaH) / 1.5));
      if (ch < cardH) {
        cardH = ch;
        cardW = Math.round(ch * CARD_RATIO);
        arenaH = H - safeT - handFor(cardH, cardW);
      }
    }
    const exH = exFor(cardW);
    const nextW = Math.min(Math.round(leftW * 0.6), Math.round(cardW * 0.6));
    const nextH = Math.round(nextW / CARD_RATIO);
    const emoteD = Math.max(44, Math.min(leftW - 8, Math.round(cardW * 0.66)));
    return {
      cardW: cardW, cardH: cardH, nextW: nextW, nextH: nextH, leftW: leftW, emoteD: emoteD,
      exH: exH, footH: exH, topH: 0, nameH: nameFor(cardW),
      padX: padX, gap: gap, padTop: padTop, rowGap: rowFor(cardW), padBot: padBot,
      handH: handFor(cardH, cardW), arenaW: W, arenaH: Math.max(0, arenaH), unit: W / 100,
    };
  };

  /** How a card name fits a card face (Lilita One averages ~0.54 em per character; the base
   *  size fits ~10 characters per line): names over 12 characters with a hyphen or space
   *  break into two lines at full size, other long names shrink (never below 74 %).
   *  -> { k: font scale 0.74..1, two: two lines } */
  const NAME_FITS = 10.3;
  UI.nameFit = function (name) {
    const t = String(name || '');
    const n = t.length;
    if (n <= 10) return { k: 1, two: false };
    const cut = n > 12 ? t.search(/[-\s]/) : -1;   // 11-12 characters: one line, slightly smaller
    if (cut > 0 && cut < n - 1) {
      const longest = Math.max(cut + 1, n - cut - 1);
      return { k: longest <= NAME_FITS ? 1 : Math.max(0.74, Math.round(NAME_FITS / longest * 100) / 100), two: true };
    }
    return { k: Math.max(0.74, Math.round(NAME_FITS / n * 100) / 100), two: false };
  };
  UI.nameScale = function (name) { return UI.nameFit(name).k; };
  /** v5: font scale of the one-line name under a hand card (~10 characters at full size,
   *  longer names shrink, never below 62 %; the rest is cut with an ellipsis). */
  UI.handNameScale = function (name) {
    const n = String(name || '').length;
    if (n <= 10) return 1;
    return Math.max(0.62, Math.round(10 / n * 100) / 100);
  };
  /** Applies UI.nameFit to a .card-name element. */
  function fitName(el, name) {
    const f = UI.nameFit(name);
    el.style.setProperty('--nk', String(f.k));
    el.classList.toggle('is-2l', f.two);
  }
  UI.fitName = fitName;

  /**
   * Battle HUD + input. opts:
   *   localSide, localPlayer (v5, default = localSide), names: [n0, n1], mode,
   *   role: 'local'|'host'|'guest', speed, teamSize (1 | 2),
   *   driver: { canPlay(slot,x,y) -> {ok,reason}, play(slot,x,y,cardId) -> {ok,reason},
   *             chaosPick(option), emote(id), sendCommand(cmd), isPending(slot), pendingCost(),
   *             onReject?(slot) },
   *   onMenu()
   * Returned api: el, canvas, arenaWrap, freshCanvas() -> new canvas, setRenderer(r),
   *   layout() -> {w,h}, update(prev, cur, alpha) -> drag state for the renderer (or null),
   *   handleEvents(events, nowMs), playIntro({onFight}), skipIntro(), introActive(),
   *   showMessage(text, cls) (v4: wordless icon, text = aria label; cls 'is-elixir' |
   *   'is-deny' | 'is-warn'), setNetBanner(text|null, actionLabel, action, kind 'lost'|'error'|
   *   'left') (icon + home button), setWaiting(text|null) (spinner only),
   *   cancelInput(), destroy()
   */
  UI.BattleScreen = function (app, opts) {
    const side = opts.localSide === 1 ? 1 : 0;
    // v5: the HUD follows the local PLAYER (own hand / elixir / upgrades); in 1v1 player == side
    const me = typeof opts.localPlayer === 'number' && opts.localPlayer >= 0 ? opts.localPlayer : side;
    let opp = 1 - side;          // first player of the other team (updated from the view)
    let mate = -1;               // teammate's player index in 2v2
    const driver = opts.driver;
    const names = opts.names || ['', ''];
    let renderer = null;
    let destroyed = false;

    // ---- v4 top overlay (no bar, no words): menu button top left, timer top right, the crown
    // counters at the right edge next to the river (like Clash Royale). Numbers + icons only.
    const oppCrowns = crownCounter('red');
    const myCrowns = crownCounter('blue');
    const timeEl = h('div', { class: 'tb-time' }, '3:00');
    const timeIco = h('span', { class: 'tb-ico', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }, [h('i'), h('i')]);
    const badgeEl = h('div', { class: 'tb-badge', hidden: true }, '×2');
    const timerBox = h('div', { class: 'tb-timer', 'aria-label': 'Restzeit' }, [badgeEl, timeIco, timeEl]);
    const menuBtn = h('button', { class: 'tb-btn', type: 'button', 'aria-label': 'Menü' }, h('span', null, h('i', { class: 'tb-burger' })));
    menuBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { cancelInput(); if (opts.onMenu) opts.onMenu(); });
    const crownCol = h('div', { class: 'crown-col', 'aria-label': 'Kronen' }, [oppCrowns.el, myCrowns.el]);
    // v6 Touchdown: football counters instead of the crowns (switched on by the first view)
    const chaosMode = UI.chaosOn(opts.mode, opts.options);
    let tdHud = false;
    const oppTd = tdCounter('red');
    const myTd = tdCounter('blue');
    const tdReset = h('div', { class: 'td-reset', hidden: true, 'aria-hidden': 'true' }, [icon('football', 'td-reset-ico'), h('b', null, '')]);
    let tdLast = null;          // last score seen [blue, red]
    let tdResetN = -1;
    let tdBurstEl = null;
    let tdBurstTimer = 0;
    const hudTop = h('div', { class: 'hud-top' }, [menuBtn, timerBox]);

    // ---- arena
    let canvas = h('canvas', { class: 'arena-canvas', 'aria-label': 'Arena' });
    const emoteBtn = h('button', { class: 'hud-btn emote-btn', type: 'button', 'aria-label': 'Emotes' }, icon('chat'));
    const emotePop = h('div', { class: 'emote-pop', hidden: true });
    let emoteCooldownUntil = 0;
    EMOTES.forEach(function (em) {
      // wordless like CR: the emoji is the whole emote (the text is only the label)
      const b = h('button', { type: 'button', 'aria-label': em.text, title: em.text }, h('span', { class: 'emote-face emote-emoji', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }, em.emoji));
      b.addEventListener('click', function () { sendEmote(em.id); });
      emotePop.appendChild(b);
    });
    emoteBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { emotePop.hidden = !emotePop.hidden; });

    // Fallback C.H.A.O.S picker (only used when CR.ChaosUI is not available) - wordless too.
    const ownBadges = h('div', { class: 'chaos-badges own' });
    const oppBadges = h('div', { class: 'chaos-badges opp' });
    const chaosTimer = h('div', { class: 'chaos-timer' }, '');
    const chaosOpts = h('div', { class: 'chaos-opts' });
    const chaosLater = h('button', { class: 'btn btn-grey btn-sm btn-icon chaos-later', type: 'button', 'aria-label': 'Später wählen' }, icon('back'));
    const chaosOv = h('div', { class: 'chaos-ov', hidden: true }, h('div', { class: 'chaos-box' }, [
      h('div', { class: 'chaos-title', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }, icon('bolt', 'chaos-title-ico')),
      chaosTimer,
      chaosOpts,
      chaosLater,
    ]));
    const chaosMiniN = h('b', null, '');
    const chaosMini = h('button', { class: 'chaos-mini', type: 'button', hidden: true, 'aria-label': 'C.H.A.O.S wählen' }, [icon('bolt'), chaosMiniN]);
    chaosLater.addEventListener('click', function () { chaosState = 'min'; applyChaosVisibility(); });
    chaosMini.addEventListener('click', function () { chaosState = 'open'; applyChaosVisibility(); });

    const waitText = h('span', { class: 'wait-text' }, '');
    const waitEl = h('div', { class: 'wait-overlay', hidden: true }, h('div', null, [h('span', { class: 'spinner' }), waitText]));
    const bannerIco = h('span', { class: 'nb-ico-wrap' }, icon('wifiOff', 'nb-ico'));
    const bannerSpin = h('span', { class: 'spinner nb-spin' });
    const bannerBtn = h('button', { class: 'btn btn-grey btn-sm btn-icon', type: 'button', 'aria-label': 'Menü' }, icon('home'));
    const netBanner = h('div', { class: 'net-banner', hidden: true, role: 'status' }, [bannerIco, bannerSpin, bannerBtn]);
    let bannerAction = null;
    bannerBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { if (bannerAction) bannerAction(); });

    // v5 2v2: the teammate's elixir, small (icon + number + thin bar) at the lower left of the arena
    const mateNum = h('b', null, '0');
    const mateFill = h('i', { class: 'mate-fill' });
    const mateEx = h('div', { class: 'mate-ex', hidden: true, 'aria-label': 'Elixier deines Partners' }, [
      icon('people', 'mate-ico'), h('span', { class: 'mate-drop' }), mateNum, h('span', { class: 'mate-bar' }, mateFill),
    ]);
    let mateK = -1;
    let mateN = -1;

    // v7: champion ability button (like CR champions): shown while the own champion is on the
    // field (view.players[me].champion); portrait + elixir cost, cooldown ring, glow when ready.
    // Wordless (the German text is the accessible label only).
    const champArt = h('span', { class: 'card-art' }, h('span', { class: 'art-ini' }));
    const champCost = h('b', null, '');
    const champRing = h('span', { class: 'champ-ring', 'aria-hidden': 'true' });
    const champSecs = h('span', { class: 'champ-secs', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }, '');
    const champBtn = h('button', { class: 'champ-btn', type: 'button', hidden: true, 'aria-label': 'Champion-Fähigkeit' },
      [h('span', { class: 'champ-face' }, [champArt, h('span', { class: 'card-shine' })]), champRing, champSecs, h('span', { class: 'champ-cost' }, [h('i'), champCost]), h('span', { class: 'champ-burst', 'aria-hidden': 'true' })]);
    const champ = { card: null, unitId: null, cdMax: 0, sig: '', cost: 0, ready: false, sentAt: -1e9 };
    champBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      if (e) e.stopPropagation();
      const c = champ;
      if (!c.card) return;
      if (!c.ready || elixirNow + 1e-6 < c.cost) {
        replay(champBtn, 'shake');
        Sound.play('deny');
        if (!c.ready) return;
        showMessage(UI.reasonText('not_enough_elixir'), 'is-elixir');
        return;
      }
      if (now() - c.sentAt < 400) return;
      c.sentAt = now();
      const r = sendCommand({ type: 'champion_ability' });
      if (r && r.ok === false) {
        // refused by the local authority (cooldown, wind-up, pause): wordless shake
        replay(champBtn, 'shake');
        Sound.play('deny');
        if (UI.isElixirReason(r.reason)) showMessage(UI.reasonText(r.reason), 'is-elixir');
        return;
      }
      replay(champBtn, 'fire');
      vibrate([14, 30, 24]);
    });
    champBtn.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) { if (e) e.stopPropagation(); });

    const arenaWrap = h('div', { class: 'arena-wrap' }, [canvas, hudTop, crownCol, tdReset, oppBadges, ownBadges, mateEx, champBtn, emotePop, chaosMini, chaosOv, waitEl, netBanner]);

    // ---- hand (v4, CR layout): [emote / next] [four cards with the cost at the bottom]
    //                                           [elixir drop + number | 10-segment bar  ]
    function makeSlot(small, slot) {
      const art = h('span', { class: 'card-art' }, h('span', { class: 'art-ini' }));
      const costB = h('b');
      const charge = small ? null : h('span', { class: 'hcard-charge' });
      const up = small ? null : h('span', { class: 'hcard-up', hidden: true }, icon('bolt'));
      // v5: the card name, small under the hand card (the only words in the battle)
      const nm = small ? null : h('span', { class: 'hcard-name', 'aria-hidden': 'true' });
      const el = h('div', {
        class: 'hcard is-empty' + (small ? ' small' : ''),
        'data-slot': small ? null : String(slot),
        role: small ? null : 'button',
        'aria-label': small ? 'Nächste Karte' : 'Karte ' + (slot + 1),
      }, [art, h('span', { class: 'card-shine' }), charge, up, h('span', { class: 'cost' }, [h('i'), costB]), nm]);
      return { el: el, art: art, costB: costB, charge: charge, up: up, nm: nm, upRar: '', small: small, id: undefined, cost: 0, poor: null, frac: -1, sel: null, pend: null, drag: null };
    }
    function setSlotCard(s, id) {
      s.id = id;
      s.poor = null; s.frac = -1; s.sel = null; s.pend = null; s.drag = null;
      if (!id) {
        s.el.className = 'hcard is-empty' + (s.small ? ' small' : '');
        Art.apply(s.art, null, s.el);
        if (s.nm) s.nm.textContent = '';
        return;
      }
      const inf = UI.cardInfo(id);
      s.cost = inf.elixir == null ? 0 : inf.elixir;
      s.el.className = 'hcard rar-' + inf.rarity + (s.small ? ' small' : '');
      s.el.style.setProperty('--cc', inf.color);
      s.art.style.setProperty('--cc', inf.color);
      s.art.style.setProperty('--ca', inf.accent);
      s.art.firstChild.textContent = '';   // no letters on battle cards: colour until the art arrives
      Art.apply(s.art, id, s.el);
      s.costB.textContent = inf.elixir == null ? '?' : String(inf.elixir);
      if (s.nm) {
        s.nm.textContent = inf.name;
        s.nm.style.setProperty('--nk', String(UI.handNameScale(inf.name)));
      }
      s.el.setAttribute('aria-label', (s.small ? 'Nächste Karte: ' : '') + inf.name + ', ' + s.costB.textContent + ' Elixier');
      if (s.up) { s.upRar = ''; s.up.hidden = true; }
    }
    const slots = [makeSlot(false, 0), makeSlot(false, 1), makeSlot(false, 2), makeSlot(false, 3)];
    const nextSlot = makeSlot(true, -1);
    const handCards = h('div', { class: 'hand-cards' }, slots.map(function (s) { return s.el; }));
    const exNum = h('span', { class: 'ex-num' }, '0');
    const exFill = h('div', { class: 'ex-fill' });
    const exMult = h('div', { class: 'ex-mult' }, '');
    const elixirEl = h('div', { class: 'elixir', 'aria-label': 'Elixier' }, [
      h('div', { class: 'ex-drop' }, [h('i'), exNum]),
      h('div', { class: 'ex-bar' }, [exFill, h('div', { class: 'ex-segs' }), exMult]),
    ]);
    const hand = h('div', { class: 'hand' }, [
      h('div', { class: 'hand-left' }, [emoteBtn, h('div', { class: 'next-wrap' }, nextSlot.el)]),
      h('div', { class: 'hand-main' }, [handCards, elixirEl]),
    ]);

    // floating card shown while a dragged card is still over the hand panel
    const floatArt = h('span', { class: 'card-art' }, h('span', { class: 'art-ini' }));
    const floatCost = h('b');
    const floatEl = h('div', { class: 'hcard hcard-float', hidden: true, 'aria-hidden': 'true' }, [floatArt, h('span', { class: 'card-shine' }), h('span', { class: 'cost' }, [h('i'), floatCost])]);
    // resolves env(safe-area-inset-*) for the layout maths
    const safeProbe = h('div', { class: 'safe-probe', 'aria-hidden': 'true' });

    const root = h('div', { class: 'screen screen-battle' }, [arenaWrap, hand, floatEl, safeProbe]);
    let geo = null;            // latest UI.battleLayout() result
    let rootBox = null;        // cached root rect while dragging (no layout reads per move)

    // ---- state
    let view = null;           // latest view (for hand + events)
    let elixirNow = 0;         // displayed (interpolated) elixir incl. pending deductions
    let lastExK = -1;
    let lastExN = -1;
    let lastSecs = -1;
    let lastLabel = '';
