    let lastBadge = '';
    let lastLow = null;
    let lastMult = '';
    let lastSeq = -Infinity;
    let lastOwnEmote = null;
    let chaosSig = null;
    let chaosState = 'none';   // none | open | min | picked
    let chaosLeft = null;
    let ownBadgeSig = '';
    let oppBadgeSig = '';
    let msgEl = null;
    let canvasRect = null;
    let arenaBox = null;
    let tileCache = 0;

    let sel = -1;              // selected hand slot (tap mode)
    let drag = null;           // active pointer interaction
    let hover = null;          // mouse hover over the arena while a card is selected
    const dragOut = { cardId: null, card: null, hand: -1, slot: -1, x: 0, y: 0, valid: false, reason: '' };
    let lastPaused = null;     // C.H.A.O.S pick pause shown in the timer box
    let ownedObj;              // last view.players[side].chaos.owned (upgrade badges on cards)
    const upByCard = Object.create(null);

    // Restarts CSS animations from the frame loop WITHOUT a forced synchronous reflow: the
    // class is removed now and re-added by the next update() (one painted frame later).
    const replayQ = [];
    function replay(el, cls) {
      for (let i = 0; i < replayQ.length; i += 2) if (replayQ[i] === el && replayQ[i + 1] === cls) return;
      if (el.classList.contains(cls)) { el.classList.remove(cls); replayQ.push(el, cls); }
      else el.classList.add(cls);
    }
    function flushReplay() {
      if (!replayQ.length) return;
      for (let i = 0; i < replayQ.length; i += 2) replayQ[i].classList.add(replayQ[i + 1]);
      replayQ.length = 0;
    }

    // ---- C.H.A.O.S UI module (src/12-chaos-ui.js); our own picker is only the fallback
    function sendCommand(cmd) {
      try {
        if (typeof driver.sendCommand === 'function') return driver.sendCommand(cmd);
        if (cmd && cmd.type === 'chaos_pick' && typeof driver.chaosPick === 'function') return driver.chaosPick(cmd.option);
      } catch (e) { /* the authority validates; errors surface through the next view */ }
      return null;
    }
    let chaosUi = null;        // { target, inst, errors }
    function mountChaosUI() {
      const CU = CR.ChaosUI;
      if (!CU || typeof CU.update !== 'function' || !chaosMode) return;
      try {
        let inst = null;
        if (typeof CU.mount === 'function') {
          // overlayRoot: the picker covers the whole battle screen (bigger cards, clear pause)
          inst = CU.mount(arenaWrap, { localSide: side, localPlayer: me, sendCommand: sendCommand, root: root, overlayRoot: root, stage: app.stage, sound: Sound, vibrate: vibrate, toast: function (t, ms) { UI.toast(app.stage, t, ms); } });
        }
        chaosUi = { target: inst && typeof inst.update === 'function' ? inst : CU, inst: inst, errors: 0 };
        root.classList.add('has-chaos-ui');
      } catch (e) {
        chaosUi = null;
        try { G.console.error('[BustWar] ChaosUI.mount:', e); } catch (err) { /* ignore */ }
      }
    }
    function unmountChaosUI() {
      const c = chaosUi;
      chaosUi = null;
      root.classList.remove('has-chaos-ui');
      if (!c) return;
      try {
        if (c.inst && typeof c.inst.destroy === 'function') c.inst.destroy();
        else if (c.inst && typeof c.inst.unmount === 'function') c.inst.unmount();
        else if (typeof CR.ChaosUI.unmount === 'function') CR.ChaosUI.unmount(arenaWrap);
        else if (typeof CR.ChaosUI.destroy === 'function') CR.ChaosUI.destroy();
      } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    }
    function updateChaosUI(cur) {
      const c = chaosUi;
      try {
        c.target.update(cur, side, sendCommand, me);
        c.errors = 0;
      } catch (e) {
        c.errors++;
        if (c.errors === 1) { try { G.console.error('[BustWar] ChaosUI.update:', e); } catch (err) { /* ignore */ } }
        if (c.errors >= CHAOS_UI_MAX_ERRORS) {
          unmountChaosUI(); // fall back to the built-in picker
          lastChaosObj = undefined; lastOppChaosObj = undefined;
        }
      }
    }

    // ---- helpers
    function rect() {
      if (!canvasRect) canvasRect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      return canvasRect;
    }
    function invalidateRects() { canvasRect = null; arenaBox = null; tileCache = 0; rootBox = null; }
    /** The playing field in client px: renderer.arenaRect() (CSS px on the canvas) when the
     *  renderer provides it, otherwise the whole canvas. */
    function arenaClient() {
      if (arenaBox) return arenaBox;
      const r = rect();
      let box = null;
      if (renderer && typeof renderer.arenaRect === 'function') {
        try {
          const a = renderer.arenaRect();
          if (a && a.w > 0 && a.h > 0 && Number.isFinite(a.x) && Number.isFinite(a.y)) {
            box = { left: r.left + a.x, top: r.top + a.y, right: r.left + a.x + a.w, bottom: r.top + a.y + a.h };
          }
        } catch (e) { box = null; }
      }
      if (!box) box = { left: r.left, top: r.top, right: r.right, bottom: r.bottom };
      arenaBox = box;
      return box;
    }
    function inBox(b, x, y) { return x >= b.left && x <= b.right && y >= b.top && y <= b.bottom; }
    function tilePx() {
      if (tileCache > 0) return tileCache;
      let d = 0;
      if (renderer && typeof renderer.simToScreen === 'function') {
        try {
          // measured near the own deploy zone, where the ghost is used most
          const a = renderer.simToScreen(9, side === 0 ? 8 : 24, side);
          const b = renderer.simToScreen(9, side === 0 ? 9 : 23, side);
          if (a && b) d = Math.sqrt((a.px - b.px) * (a.px - b.px) + (a.py - b.py) * (a.py - b.py));
        } catch (e) { d = 0; }
      }
      if (!(d > 0) || !Number.isFinite(d)) {
        const r = rect();
        d = Math.min(r.width / 18, r.height / 32) || 16;
      }
      tileCache = d;
      return d;
    }
    function toSim(px, py) {
      if (renderer && typeof renderer.screenToSim === 'function') {
        try {
          const s = renderer.screenToSim(px, py, side);
          if (s && Number.isFinite(s.x) && Number.isFinite(s.y)) return s;
        } catch (e) { /* fall through */ }
      }
      const r = rect();
      let x = px / (r.width || 1) * 18;
      let y = (1 - py / (r.height || 1)) * 32;
      if (side === 1) { x = 18 - x; y = 32 - y; }
      return { x: x, y: y };
    }
    function handCard(slot) {
      const p = view && view.players && view.players[me];
      return p && p.hand ? (p.hand[slot] || null) : null;
    }
    /** Placement position like the real game (tile grid / building footprint), via CR.Arena. */
    const snapped = { x: 0, y: 0 };
    function snapFor(cardId, x, y) {
      snapped.x = x; snapped.y = y;
      if (CR.Arena && typeof CR.Arena.snap === 'function') {
        try {
          const p = CR.Arena.snap(x, y, UI.catalog().byId[cardId] || cardId);
          if (p && Number.isFinite(p.x) && Number.isFinite(p.y)) { snapped.x = p.x; snapped.y = p.y; }
        } catch (e) { /* keep raw position */ }
      }
      return snapped;
    }
    function checkPlay(slot, x, y) {
      if (driver.isPending && driver.isPending(slot)) return { ok: false, reason: 'pending' };
      let r = null;
      try { r = driver.canPlay(slot, x, y); } catch (e) { r = { ok: false, reason: 'error' }; }
      return r || { ok: false, reason: '' };
    }

    /** v4: no words during the battle - a short icon signal (elixir drop / no-entry sign /
     *  warning); the text only goes to screen readers. kind: 'elixir' | 'deny' | 'warn'. */
    function showMessage(text, cls) {
      if (destroyed || !text) return;
      if (msgEl) remove(msgEl);
      const kind = /is-elixir/.test(cls || '') ? 'elixir' : (/is-deny/.test(cls || '') ? 'deny' : 'warn');
      msgEl = h('div', { class: 'battle-msg is-' + kind, role: 'status', 'aria-label': String(text) },
        kind === 'elixir' ? [h('span', { class: 'bm-drop' }, h('i')), icon('noEntry', 'bm-x')] : icon(kind === 'deny' ? 'noEntry' : 'warn', 'bm-ico'));
      arenaWrap.appendChild(msgEl);
      const el = msgEl;
      G.setTimeout(function () { if (msgEl === el) { remove(el); msgEl = null; } }, 1600);
    }

    // ---- intro: VS splash, then the "Kampf!" banner
    let introEl = null;
    let introTimers = [];
    let introFight = null;
    function nameOf(s) { return UI.sanitizeName(names[s]) || (s === side ? 'Du' : 'Gegner'); }
    function showFightBanner() {
      if (destroyed) return;
      const b = h('div', { class: 'fight-banner', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }, h('span', { class: 'fb-burst' }, icon('swords', 'fb-swords')));
      arenaWrap.appendChild(b);
      Sound.play('fight');
      vibrate(30);
      introTimers.push(G.setTimeout(function () { remove(b); }, FIGHT_BANNER_MS));
    }
    function fireFight(banner) {
      const f = introFight;
      introFight = null;
      if (introEl) introEl.classList.add('is-out');
      if (banner) showFightBanner();
      if (f) { try { f(); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ } }
    }
    function playIntro(o) {
      if (destroyed || introEl) return;
      const io = o || NONE;
      introFight = io.onFight || null;
      // v4: wordless - who plays is shown by icons (bot / colleague vs. you), no names.
      const chips = [];
      if (opts.mode === 'touchdown') chips.push(h('span', { class: 'info-chip is-td is-ico' }, icon('football')));
      if (chaosMode) chips.push(h('span', { class: 'info-chip is-chaos is-ico' }, icon('bolt')));
      if (UI.elixirBoostOn(opts.options)) chips.push(h('span', { class: 'info-chip is-boost' }, [icon('drop'), '1,5×']));
      if (opts.speed) chips.push(h('span', { class: 'info-chip is-tempo' }, [icon('bolt'), UI.speedLabel(opts.speed).replace(/^[^0-9]*/, '') || '1×']));
      introEl = h('div', { class: 'vs-intro', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }, [
        h('div', { class: 'vs-half vs-top' }, h('div', { class: 'vs-plate' }, icon(opts.role === 'local' ? 'bot' : 'people', 'vs-who'))),
        h('div', { class: 'vs-half vs-bot' }, h('div', { class: 'vs-plate' }, icon('shield', 'vs-who'))),
        h('div', { class: 'vs-badge' }, icon('swords', 'vs-swords')),
        h('div', { class: 'info-chips vs-chips' }, chips),
      ]);
      root.appendChild(introEl);
      Sound.play('whoosh');
      introTimers.push(G.setTimeout(function () { fireFight(true); }, VS_MS));
      introTimers.push(G.setTimeout(function () { remove(introEl); introEl = null; }, VS_MS + 650));
    }
    /** Ends the intro at once (guest rejoining a running battle). */
    function skipIntro() {
      for (let i = 0; i < introTimers.length; i++) G.clearTimeout(introTimers[i]);
      introTimers = [];
      if (introFight) fireFight(false);
      if (introEl) { remove(introEl); introEl = null; }
    }

    function shakeSlot(slot) {
      const s = slots[slot];
      if (s) replayClass(s.el, 'shake');
    }
    function flashElixir() { replayClass(elixirEl, 'flash'); }

    function reject(slot, reason) {
      shakeSlot(slot);
      const elix = UI.isElixirReason(reason);
      if (elix) flashElixir();
      showMessage(UI.reasonText(reason), elix ? 'is-elixir' : 'is-deny');
      Sound.play('deny');
      vibrate([8, 40, 8]);
    }

    function attemptPlay(slot, x, y, cardId) {
      const chk = checkPlay(slot, x, y);
      if (!chk.ok) { reject(slot, chk.reason); sel = slot; return false; }
      let res = null;
      try { res = driver.play(slot, x, y, cardId); } catch (e) { res = { ok: false, reason: 'error' }; }
      if (res && res.ok === false) { reject(slot, res.reason); sel = slot; return false; }
      sel = -1;
      hover = null;
      Sound.play('deploy');
      vibrate(14);
      const s = slots[slot];
      if (s) replayClass(s.el, 'played');
      return true;
    }

    // ---- floating card
    function showFloat(cardId) {
      const inf = UI.cardInfo(cardId);
      floatEl.className = 'hcard hcard-float rar-' + inf.rarity;
      floatEl.style.setProperty('--cc', inf.color);
      floatArt.style.setProperty('--cc', inf.color);
      floatArt.firstChild.textContent = '';
      Art.apply(floatArt, cardId, floatEl);
      floatCost.textContent = inf.elixir == null ? '?' : String(inf.elixir);
      floatEl.hidden = false;
    }
    /** Pointer-move path: only a transform write (size from the layout, root rect cached). */
    function moveFloat(cx, cy) {
      if (!rootBox) rootBox = root.getBoundingClientRect();
      const w = geo ? geo.cardW : 86;
      const hh = geo ? geo.cardH : 110;
      floatEl.style.transform = 'translate3d(' + Math.round(cx - rootBox.left - w / 2) + 'px,' + Math.round(cy - rootBox.top - hh * 0.75) + 'px,0) rotate(-4deg) scale(1.08)';
    }
    function hideFloat() { floatEl.hidden = true; }

    // ---- pointer input
    /**
     * Tracks a pointer interaction. For a touch drag that started on a hand card the
     * placement point (the ghost) sits TOUCH_GHOST_TILES above the finger so the finger
     * does not hide it; "over the arena" is decided by that point. Consequently the back
     * rows stay reachable while the finger rests on the top edge of the hand panel, and
     * dragging the card back down onto the hand cancels. Mouse/pen place at the cursor.
     */
    function updateDrag(cx, cy) {
      const d = drag;
      d.cx = cx; d.cy = cy;
      const box = arenaClient();
      if (d.fromCard && !d.moved) {
        const dx = cx - d.sx; const dy = cy - d.sy;
        if (dx * dx + dy * dy > DRAG_START_PX * DRAG_START_PX || inBox(box, cx, cy)) {
          d.moved = true;
          sel = d.slot;
          if (chaosState === 'open') { chaosState = 'min'; applyChaosVisibility(); }
          emotePop.hidden = true;
        }
      }
      if (!d.moved) return;
      const gy = d.fromCard && d.ptype === 'touch' ? cy - tilePx() * TOUCH_GHOST_TILES : cy;
      const over = inBox(box, cx, gy);
      d.over = over;
      if (d.fromCard) {
        if (over) hideFloat();
        else { if (floatEl.hidden) showFloat(d.cardId); moveFloat(cx, cy); }
      }
      if (!over) { d.valid = false; return; }
      const r = rect();
      const s = toSim(cx - r.left, gy - r.top);
      d.x = s.x; d.y = s.y;
    }

    function onCardDown(e) {
      if (destroyed || drag) return;
      if (e.pointerType === 'mouse' && e.button !== 0) return;
      const t = e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.hcard[data-slot]') : null;
      if (!t) return;
      const slot = +t.getAttribute('data-slot');
      const id = handCard(slot);
      if (!id) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      invalidateRects();
      if (driver.isPending && driver.isPending(slot)) { shakeSlot(slot); return; }
      drag = { pid: e.pointerId, slot: slot, cardId: id, fromCard: true, sx: e.clientX, sy: e.clientY, cx: e.clientX, cy: e.clientY, moved: false, over: false, x: 0, y: 0, valid: false, ptype: e.pointerType || 'mouse' };
      try { root.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (err) { /* ignore */ }
    }

    /** Taps on the arena: only on the renderer's canvases (not on HUD widgets / chaos UI). */
    function isArenaTarget(t) {
      if (!t) return false;
      if (t === arenaWrap || t === canvas) return true;
      return t.tagName === 'CANVAS' && t.parentNode === arenaWrap;
    }
    function onArenaDown(e) {
      if (destroyed) return;
      if (!isArenaTarget(e.target)) return;
      if (!emotePop.hidden) emotePop.hidden = true;
      if (drag) return;
      if (e.pointerType === 'mouse' && e.button !== 0) return;
      if (sel < 0) return;
      const id = handCard(sel);
      if (!id) { sel = -1; return; }
      e.preventDefault();
      invalidateRects();
      drag = { pid: e.pointerId, slot: sel, cardId: id, fromCard: false, sx: e.clientX, sy: e.clientY, cx: e.clientX, cy: e.clientY, moved: true, over: true, x: 0, y: 0, valid: false, ptype: e.pointerType || 'mouse' };
      try { root.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (err) { /* ignore */ }
      updateDrag(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    }

    function onMove(e) {
      if (destroyed) return;
      if (drag) {
        if (e.pointerId !== drag.pid) return;
        updateDrag(e.clientX, e.clientY);
        return;
      }
      if (e.pointerType === 'mouse' && sel >= 0) {
        if (!inBox(arenaClient(), e.clientX, e.clientY)) { hover = null; return; }
        const r = rect();
        const s = toSim(e.clientX - r.left, e.clientY - r.top);
        hover = hover || { x: 0, y: 0 };
        hover.x = s.x; hover.y = s.y;
      } else if (hover) {
        hover = null;
      }
    }

    function finishDrag(e, cancelled) {
      const d = drag;
      if (!d || (e && e.pointerId !== d.pid)) return;
      if (e && !cancelled) updateDrag(e.clientX, e.clientY);
      drag = null;
      hideFloat();
      try { if (e) root.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (err) { /* ignore */ }
      if (cancelled) return;
      if (d.fromCard && !d.moved) {
        // plain tap on a hand card: toggle selection
        sel = sel === d.slot ? -1 : d.slot;
        if (sel >= 0 && chaosState === 'open') { chaosState = 'min'; applyChaosVisibility(); }
        Sound.play('select');
        if (sel >= 0) vibrate(6);
        return;
      }
      if (!d.over) {
        // released outside the arena (back over the hand): cancel quietly
        if (d.fromCard) sel = -1;
        return;
      }
      if (handCard(d.slot) !== d.cardId) return; // hand changed meanwhile
      const p = snapFor(d.cardId, d.x, d.y);
      attemptPlay(d.slot, p.x, p.y, d.cardId);
    }

    function onUp(e) { finishDrag(e, false); }
    function onCancel(e) { finishDrag(e, true); }

    function cancelInput() {
      drag = null;
      hover = null;
      sel = -1;
      hideFloat();
    }

    function onKey(e) {
      if (destroyed || e.defaultPrevented) return;
      const t = e.target;
      if (t && (t.tagName === 'INPUT' || t.tagName === 'TEXTAREA')) return;
      if (e.key >= '1' && e.key <= '4') {
        const slot = e.key.charCodeAt(0) - 49;
        if (handCard(slot)) { sel = sel === slot ? -1 : slot; Sound.play('select'); }
      } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        if (!chaosOv.hidden) { chaosState = 'min'; applyChaosVisibility(); }
        else cancelInput();
      }
    }

    handCards.addEventListener('pointerdown', onCardDown);
    arenaWrap.addEventListener('pointerdown', onArenaDown);
    // Move/up never call preventDefault: passive listeners keep the input path lean.
    const PASSIVE = { passive: true };
    root.addEventListener('pointermove', onMove, PASSIVE);
    root.addEventListener('pointerup', onUp, PASSIVE);
    root.addEventListener('pointercancel', onCancel, PASSIVE);
    root.addEventListener('lostpointercapture', function (e) { if (drag && e.pointerId === drag.pid && !drag.moved) finishDrag(e, true); }, PASSIVE);
    root.addEventListener('contextmenu', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });
    root.addEventListener('pointerleave', function (e) { if (!drag && e.pointerType === 'mouse') hover = null; }, PASSIVE);
    G.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);

    // ---- emotes
    function sendEmote(id) {
      emotePop.hidden = true;
      const t = now();
      if (t < emoteCooldownUntil) return;
      emoteCooldownUntil = t + EMOTE_COOLDOWN_MS;
      try { driver.emote(id); } catch (e) { /* cosmetic */ }
      showEmote(side, id);
      lastOwnEmote = { id: id, t: t };
    }

    function towerPos(s) {
      const towers = view && view.towers;
      if (towers) {
        for (let i = 0; i < towers.length; i++) {
          const tw = towers[i];
          if (tw.side === s && tw.kind === 'king') return tw;
        }
      }
      return { x: 9, y: s === 0 ? 3 : 29 };
    }

    function showEmote(s, id) {
      if (destroyed) return;
      const em = UI.emoteById(id);
      const tw = towerPos(s);
      let px; let py;
      const tp = tilePx();
      const towardScreenTop = s === side;
      if (renderer && typeof renderer.simToScreen === 'function') {
        try {
          const p = renderer.simToScreen(tw.x, tw.y, side);
          px = p.px; py = p.py + (towardScreenTop ? -tp * 2.2 : tp * 4.2);
        } catch (e) { px = null; }
      }
      const r = rect();
      if (px == null || !Number.isFinite(px) || !Number.isFinite(py)) {
        px = r.width / 2;
        py = towardScreenTop ? r.height * 0.82 : r.height * 0.24;
      }
      px = Math.max(44, Math.min((r.width || 360) - 44, px));
      py = Math.max(90, Math.min((r.height || 640) - 10, py));
      // one bubble per side: a new emote replaces the old one
      const old = arenaWrap.querySelector('.bubble.s' + s);
      if (old) remove(old);
      const b = h('div', { class: 'bubble s' + s + (s === side ? '' : ' opp'), role: 'img', 'aria-label': em ? em.text : 'Emote' },
        em ? h('span', { class: 'bubble-face bubble-emoji', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }, em.emoji) : icon('chat', 'bubble-face'));
      b.style.left = Math.round(px) + 'px';
      b.style.top = Math.round(py) + 'px';
      arenaWrap.appendChild(b);
      Sound.play('emote');
      G.setTimeout(function () { remove(b); }, EMOTE_SHOW_MS);
    }

    // ---- fallback C.H.A.O.S picker
    function applyChaosVisibility() {
      chaosOv.hidden = chaosState !== 'open';
      chaosMini.hidden = chaosState !== 'min';
    }

    /** A pick normally resolves the offer within a few ticks. When the same offer is still
     *  shown (and not marked as picked) long after the pick, the command was lost or
     *  rejected: show the picker again instead of leaving the player without a choice. */
    let pickedAt = 0;
    function checkPickStuck() {
      if (!chaosSig || now() - pickedAt < CHAOS_PICK_TIMEOUT_MS) return;
      if (UI.chaosPicked(lastChaosObj)) return;
      chaosState = drag || sel >= 0 ? 'min' : 'open';
      applyChaosVisibility();
      showMessage('Bitte wähle dein Upgrade erneut', 'is-warn');
    }

    function chaosGem(inf, cls) {
      const g = h('span', { class: 'co-gem rar-' + inf.rarity + (cls ? ' ' + cls : '') });
      if (inf.card) {
        g.appendChild(artBox(inf.card, g));
      } else {
        g.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'co-gem-ini' }, inf.initials));
      }
      return g;
    }

    function buildChaosOptions(offers) {
      chaosOpts.textContent = '';
      chaosOpts.style.gridTemplateColumns = 'repeat(' + Math.max(1, Math.min(4, offers.length)) + ', minmax(0, 1fr))';
      offers.forEach(function (o, i) {
        const inf = UI.chaosOptionInfo(o);
        const b = h('button', { class: 'chaos-opt rar-' + inf.rarity, type: 'button', 'aria-label': inf.name + (inf.text ? ': ' + inf.text : '') }, [
          chaosGem(inf, 'co-icon'),
        ]);
        b.addEventListener('click', function () {
          if (chaosState === 'picked') return;
          chaosState = 'picked';
          pickedAt = now();
          applyChaosVisibility();
          try { driver.chaosPick(i); } catch (e) { /* surfaced by the next view */ }
          Sound.play('select');
          vibrate(18);
        });
        chaosOpts.appendChild(b);
      });
    }

    function renderBadges(container, list, interactive) {
      container.textContent = '';
      for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
        const inf = UI.chaosOptionInfo(list[i]);
        const b = h('button', { class: 'chaos-badge rar-' + inf.rarity, type: 'button', 'aria-label': inf.name + (inf.stacks > 1 ? ' ×' + inf.stacks : '') }, [
          chaosGem(inf, 'cb-gem'),
          inf.stacks > 1 ? h('b', { class: 'chaos-stack' }, '×' + inf.stacks) : null,
        ]);
        container.appendChild(b);
      }
    }

    let lastChaosObj;
    let lastOppChaosObj;
    function updateChaos(cur) {
      const p = cur.players && cur.players[me];
      const ch = (p && p.chaos) || null;
      const op = cur.players && cur.players[opp];
      const och = (op && op.chaos) || null;
      // Views are immutable snapshots: the same chaos object means nothing changed.
      if (ch === lastChaosObj && och === lastOppChaosObj) { if (chaosState === 'picked') checkPickStuck(); return; }
      lastChaosObj = ch;
      lastOppChaosObj = och;
      const offers = UI.chaosOffers(ch);
      if (offers.length) {
        const sig = UI.chaosSignature(ch, offers);
        if (sig !== chaosSig) {
          chaosSig = sig;
          chaosState = drag || sel >= 0 ? 'min' : 'open';
          chaosLeft = null;
          buildChaosOptions(offers);
          applyChaosVisibility();
          Sound.play('chaos');
          vibrate(20);
        }
        const tl = ch && typeof ch.offerTimeLeft === 'number' ? Math.max(0, Math.ceil(ch.offerTimeLeft - 1e-6)) : null;
        if (tl !== chaosLeft) {
          chaosLeft = tl;
          chaosTimer.textContent = tl == null ? '…' : String(tl);
          chaosTimer.classList.toggle('is-low', tl != null && tl <= 3);
          chaosMiniN.textContent = tl == null ? '' : String(tl);
        }
      } else if (chaosSig !== null) {
        chaosSig = null;
        chaosState = 'none';
        applyChaosVisibility();
      }
      if (chaosState === 'picked') checkPickStuck();
      const own = UI.chaosOwned(ch);
      const osig = UI.chaosSignature(null, own);
      if (osig !== ownBadgeSig) { ownBadgeSig = osig; renderBadges(ownBadges, own, true); }
      const oown = UI.chaosOwned(och);
      const psig = UI.chaosSignature(null, oown);
      if (psig !== oppBadgeSig) { oppBadgeSig = psig; renderBadges(oppBadges, oown, false); }
    }
    function hideFallbackChaos() {
      if (chaosState !== 'none' || chaosSig !== null) { chaosSig = null; chaosState = 'none'; applyChaosVisibility(); }
      if (ownBadgeSig) { ownBadgeSig = ''; ownBadges.textContent = ''; }
      if (oppBadgeSig) { oppBadgeSig = ''; oppBadges.textContent = ''; }
    }

    // ---- per-frame HUD update
    /** v7: champion button from view.players[me].champion = { unitId, card, ready, cost,
     *  cooldownLeft, active } | null. */
    function updateChampion(cur) {
      const ch = cur.players[me] && cur.players[me].champion;
      const c = champ;
      if (!ch || !ch.card) {
        if (c.card) { c.card = null; c.unitId = null; c.cdMax = 0; c.sig = ''; champBtn.hidden = true; }
        return;
      }
      if (c.card !== ch.card || c.unitId !== ch.unitId) {
        const first = !c.card;
        c.card = ch.card;
        c.unitId = ch.unitId;
        c.cdMax = 0;
        const inf = UI.cardInfo(ch.card);
        champBtn.style.setProperty('--cc', inf.color);
        champArt.style.setProperty('--cc', inf.color);
        champArt.style.setProperty('--ca', inf.accent);
        champArt.firstChild.textContent = '';
        Art.apply(champArt, ch.card, champBtn);
        champBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Fähigkeit: ' + inf.name);
        champBtn.hidden = false;
        if (first) replay(champBtn, 'appear');
      }
      const cd = typeof ch.cooldownLeft === 'number' && ch.cooldownLeft > 0 ? ch.cooldownLeft : 0;
      // full cooldown from the engine when it reports one, else the largest value seen
      if (typeof ch.cooldown === 'number' && ch.cooldown > 0) c.cdMax = Math.max(ch.cooldown, cd);
      else if (cd > c.cdMax) c.cdMax = cd;
      else if (cd <= 0) c.cdMax = 0;
      const cost = typeof ch.cost === 'number' && ch.cost >= 0 ? ch.cost : 0;
      c.cost = cost;
      const ready = !!ch.ready && cd <= 0 && !ch.active && !ch.deploying;
      c.ready = ready;
      const poor = elixirNow + 1e-6 < cost;
      const k = c.cdMax > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(cd / c.cdMax * 100))) : 0;
      const secs = cd > 0 ? Math.ceil(cd) : 0;
      const sig = cost + '|' + (ready ? 1 : 0) + (poor ? 1 : 0) + (ch.active ? 1 : 0) + '|' + k + '|' + secs;
      if (sig === c.sig) return;
      const wasReady = c.sig && c.sig.split('|')[1].charAt(0) === '1' && c.sig.split('|')[1].charAt(1) === '0';
      c.sig = sig;
      champCost.textContent = String(cost);
      champRing.style.setProperty('--cd', k + '%');
      champSecs.textContent = secs > 0 ? String(secs) : '';
      champBtn.classList.toggle('is-ready', ready && !poor);
      champBtn.classList.toggle('is-poor', ready && poor);
      champBtn.classList.toggle('is-cooldown', cd > 0);
      champBtn.classList.toggle('is-active', !!ch.active);
      if (ready && !poor && !wasReady) replay(champBtn, 'ping');
    }

    function updateElixir(prev, cur, alpha) {
      const p = cur.players[me];
      const ce = +p.elixir || 0;
      let e = ce;
      const pp = prev && prev.players && prev.players[me];
      if (pp) {
        const pe = +pp.elixir || 0;
        if (ce > pe) e = pe + (ce - pe) * (alpha > 1 ? 1 : alpha < 0 ? 0 : alpha);
      }
      const pc = driver.pendingCost ? driver.pendingCost() : 0;
      if (pc > 0) e = Math.max(0, e - pc);
      if (e > ELIXIR_MAX) e = ELIXIR_MAX;
      elixirNow = e;
      const k = Math.max(0, Math.min(500, Math.round(e / ELIXIR_MAX * 500)));
      if (k !== lastExK) { exFill.style.transform = SCALE_X[k]; lastExK = k; }
      const n = Math.floor(e + 1e-6);
      if (n !== lastExN) {
        exNum.textContent = String(n);
        elixirEl.classList.toggle('is-full', n >= ELIXIR_MAX);
        if (lastExN >= 0 && n > lastExN) replay(elixirEl, 'tick');
        lastExN = n;
      }
    }

    function updateHand() {
      const p = view.players[me];
      const hd = p.hand || EMPTY;
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        const s = slots[i];
        const id = hd[i] || null;
        if (s.id !== id) {
          const first = s.id === undefined;
          setSlotCard(s, id);
          if (!first && id) replay(s.el, 'deal');
          if (sel === i) sel = -1;
          if (drag && drag.slot === i) { drag = null; hideFloat(); }
        }
        if (!id) continue;
        const pend = !!(driver.isPending && driver.isPending(i));
        const poor = pend || elixirNow + 1e-6 < s.cost;
        if (s.poor !== poor) {
          const wasPoor = s.poor;
          s.el.classList.toggle('is-poor', poor);
          s.poor = poor; s.frac = -1;
          if (wasPoor === true && !poor) replay(s.el, 'ready');
        }
        if (poor && !pend) {
          const k = s.cost > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.floor(elixirNow / s.cost * 100))) : 100;
          if (k !== s.frac) { s.charge.style.transform = SCALE_Y[k]; s.frac = k; }
        }
        if (s.pend !== pend) { s.el.classList.toggle('is-pending', pend); s.pend = pend; }
        const isSel = sel === i;
        if (s.sel !== isSel) { s.el.classList.toggle('is-selected', isSel); s.sel = isSel; }
        const isDrag = !!(drag && drag.slot === i && drag.moved);
        if (s.drag !== isDrag) { s.el.classList.toggle('is-dragging', isDrag); s.drag = isDrag; }
        const ur = upByCard[id] || '';
        if (s.upRar !== ur) {
          s.upRar = ur;
          s.up.hidden = !ur;
          s.up.className = 'hcard-up' + (ur ? ' rar-' + ur : '');
        }
      }
      const nid = p.next || null;
      if (nextSlot.id !== nid) setSlotCard(nextSlot, nid);
    }

    /** Own C.H.A.O.S upgrades as a rarity badge on the hand cards (views are immutable: the
     *  owned list is only re-read when its object changes). */
    function updateUpgrades(cur) {
      const ch = cur.players[me].chaos;
      const owned = ch && Array.isArray(ch.owned) ? ch.owned : EMPTY;
      if (owned === ownedObj) return;
      ownedObj = owned;
      for (const k in upByCard) delete upByCard[k];
      for (let i = 0; i < owned.length; i++) {
        const o = owned[i];
        const card = o && (o.card || (typeof o.id === 'string' ? o.id.split(':')[0] : ''));
        const r = o && o.rarity;
        if (card && (r === 'common' || r === 'rare' || r === 'epic')) {
          const prev = upByCard[card];
          if (!prev || RARITY[r].order > RARITY[prev].order) upByCard[card] = r;
        }
      }
    }

    function updateClock(cur) {
      const c = cur.clock || NONE;
      const rem = typeof c.remaining === 'number' ? c.remaining : 0;
      const ended = !!cur.over || c.phase === 'ended';
      const secs = rem > 0 ? Math.ceil(rem - 1e-6) : 0;
      if (secs !== lastSecs) {
        timeEl.textContent = UI.formatClock(rem);
        if (lastSecs >= 0 && !ended && rem > 0 && rem <= 10.0001) Sound.play('tick');
        lastSecs = secs;
      }
      const ot = !!c.overtime;
      const pch = cur.players[me].chaos;
      const paused = !ended && !!(pch && pch.paused);
      const label = ended ? 'end' : (paused ? 'pause' : (ot ? 'ot' : 'run'));
      if (label !== lastLabel) {
        timerBox.classList.toggle('is-overtime', ot);
        timerBox.classList.toggle('is-ended', ended);
        lastLabel = label;
      }
      if (paused !== lastPaused) {
        timerBox.classList.toggle('is-paused', paused);
        root.classList.toggle('is-chaos-paused', paused);
        lastPaused = paused;
      }
      const mult = +c.elixirMult || 1;
      const badge = ended ? '' : (mult >= 3 ? 'x3' : (mult >= 2 ? 'x2' : ''));
      if (badge !== lastBadge) {
        badgeEl.hidden = !badge;
        badgeEl.textContent = badge ? '×' + badge.slice(1) : '';   // v4 QA: '×2' (no letter 'x' in battle)
        badgeEl.classList.toggle('x3', badge === 'x3');
        if (badge && lastBadge !== '' && badge !== lastBadge) replay(badgeEl, 'shake');
        elixirEl.classList.toggle('is-x2', badge === 'x2');
        elixirEl.classList.toggle('is-x3', badge === 'x3');
        lastBadge = badge;
      }
      const mtxt = badge ? '×' + badge.slice(1) : '';
      if (mtxt !== lastMult) { exMult.textContent = mtxt; lastMult = mtxt; }
      const low = !ended && rem > 0 && rem <= 10.0001;
      if (low !== lastLow) { timerBox.classList.toggle('is-low', low); lastLow = low; }
    }

    /** Team roles from the view: opponent + teammate indices (only when the player list changes). */
    let rolesFor = null;
    function updateRoles(cur) {
      const ps = cur.players;
      if (ps === rolesFor) return;
      rolesFor = ps;
      opp = UI.opponentOf(ps, me);
      const m = ps.length > 2 ? UI.teammateOf(ps, me) : -1;
      if (m !== mate) {
        mate = m;
        mateEx.hidden = m < 0;
        root.classList.toggle('is-2v2', m >= 0);
      }
    }
    function updateMate(cur) {
      if (mate < 0) return;
      const p = cur.players[mate];
      const e = p ? Math.max(0, Math.min(ELIXIR_MAX, +p.elixir || 0)) : 0;
      const k = Math.round(e / ELIXIR_MAX * 50);
      if (k !== mateK) { mateK = k; mateFill.style.transform = SCALE_X[k * 10]; }
      const n = Math.floor(e + 1e-6);
      if (n !== mateN) { mateN = n; mateNum.textContent = String(n); }
    }
    // team crowns (views carry each team's crowns on every player of that team)
    const tcrowns = [0, 0];
    function updateCrowns(cur) {
      const ps = cur.players;
      tcrowns[0] = 0; tcrowns[1] = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < ps.length; i++) {
        const p = ps[i];
        if (!p) continue;
        const ts = p.side === 1 || (p.side == null && i === 1) ? 1 : 0;
        const c = p.crowns | 0;
        if (c > tcrowns[ts]) tcrowns[ts] = c;
      }
      const mine = tcrowns[side];
      const theirs = tcrowns[1 - side];
      if (mine !== myCrowns.n) {
        const gained = myCrowns.n >= 0 && mine > myCrowns.n;
        myCrowns.set(mine, myCrowns.n >= 0, replay);
        if (gained) { Sound.play('crown'); vibrate([20, 60, 30]); }
      }
      if (theirs !== oppCrowns.n) {
        const lost = oppCrowns.n >= 0 && theirs > oppCrowns.n;
        oppCrowns.set(theirs, oppCrowns.n >= 0, replay);
        if (lost) { Sound.play('crownLost'); vibrate(40); }
      }
    }

    /** v6: switches the crown column to the touchdown counters (once, from the first view). */
    function setTdHud(on) {
      if (on === tdHud) return;
      tdHud = on;
      crownCol.textContent = '';
      if (on) { crownCol.appendChild(oppTd.el); crownCol.appendChild(myTd.el); }
      else { crownCol.appendChild(oppCrowns.el); crownCol.appendChild(myCrowns.el); }
      crownCol.classList.toggle('is-td', on);
      crownCol.setAttribute('aria-label', on ? 'Touchdowns' : 'Kronen');
      root.classList.toggle('is-touchdown', on);
    }
    /** Wordless touchdown moment: a big football burst in the scoring team's colour with the
     *  new score (numbers only), sound + vibration. */
    function showTouchdown(mine, score) {
      if (destroyed) return;
      if (tdBurstEl) { remove(tdBurstEl); tdBurstEl = null; }
      if (tdBurstTimer) { G.clearTimeout(tdBurstTimer); tdBurstTimer = 0; }
      const el = h('div', { class: 'td-burst ' + (mine ? 'is-mine' : 'is-theirs'), role: 'status', 'aria-label': mine ? 'Touchdown für dein Team!' : 'Touchdown für den Gegner' }, [
        h('span', { class: 'tdb-rays', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }),
        h('span', { class: 'tdb-ring', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }),
        h('span', { class: 'tdb-ball', 'aria-hidden': 'true', html: ICON.football }),
        h('span', { class: 'tdb-score', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }, [h('b', { class: 'tdb-a' }, String(score[side])), h('i', null, ':'), h('b', { class: 'tdb-b' }, String(score[1 - side]))]),
        h('span', { class: 'tdb-sparks', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }, [h('i'), h('i'), h('i'), h('i'), h('i'), h('i'), h('i'), h('i')]),
      ]);
      arenaWrap.appendChild(el);
      tdBurstEl = el;
      Sound.play(mine ? 'touchdown' : 'touchdownLost');
      vibrate(mine ? [30, 50, 30, 50, 90] : [60, 40, 60]);
      tdBurstTimer = G.setTimeout(function () { tdBurstTimer = 0; if (tdBurstEl === el) { remove(el); tdBurstEl = null; } }, TD_BURST_MS);
    }
    function updateTouchdown(cur) {
      const sc = UI.touchdownScore(cur) || [0, 0];
      const target = UI.touchdownTarget(cur);
      const mine = sc[side], theirs = sc[1 - side];
      const anim = myTd.n >= 0;
      myTd.set(mine, target, anim && mine !== myTd.n, replay);
      oppTd.set(theirs, target, anim && theirs !== oppTd.n, replay);
      if (tdLast) {
        if (sc[side] > tdLast[side]) showTouchdown(true, sc);
        else if (sc[1 - side] > tdLast[1 - side]) showTouchdown(false, sc);
      }
      if (!tdLast) tdLast = [0, 0];
      tdLast[0] = sc[0]; tdLast[1] = sc[1];
      // play resumes after the field reset: wordless countdown pill
      const td = cur.touchdown;
      // (after the burst: the big football and the countdown never overlap)
      const left = td && typeof td.resetIn === 'number' && td.resetIn > 0 && !cur.over && !tdBurstEl ? Math.ceil(td.resetIn - 1e-6) : 0;
      if (left !== tdResetN) {
        tdResetN = left;
        tdReset.hidden = left <= 0;
        if (left > 0) { tdReset.lastChild.textContent = String(left); replay(tdReset, 'tick'); }
      }
    }

    /** Crown counters at the right edge, centred on the river (CR). Runs once after a layout
     *  change (renderer maths only, one style write). */
    let crownsAt = -1;
    function placeCrowns() {
      let y = -1;
      try {
        const p = renderer.simToScreen(17.5, 16, side);
        if (p && Number.isFinite(p.py)) y = Math.round(p.py);
      } catch (e) { y = -1; }
      const hh = arenaWrap.clientHeight || 0;
      if (!(y > 40) || (hh && y > hh - 40)) y = Math.round((hh || 600) * 0.5);
      crownsAt = y;
      crownCol.style.top = y + 'px';
    }

    function dragState() {
      let src = null;
      if (drag && drag.moved && drag.over) src = drag;
      else if (!drag && sel >= 0 && hover) src = hover;
      if (!src) return null;
      const slot = src === hover ? sel : drag.slot;
      const id = handCard(slot);
      if (!id) return null;
      const p = snapFor(id, src.x, src.y);
      const chk = checkPlay(slot, p.x, p.y);
      if (src === drag) drag.valid = !!chk.ok;
      dragOut.cardId = id;
      dragOut.card = id;
      dragOut.hand = slot;
      dragOut.slot = slot;
      dragOut.x = p.x;
      dragOut.y = p.y;
      dragOut.valid = !!chk.ok;
      dragOut.reason = chk.ok ? '' : String(chk.reason || '');
      return dragOut;
    }

    mountChaosUI();

    const api = {
      el: root,
      canvas: canvas,
      arenaWrap: arenaWrap,
      /** Replaces the arena canvas with a fresh one (a canvas keeps its first context type:
       *  switching between WebGL and 2D needs a new element). */
      freshCanvas: function () {
        const c = h('canvas', { class: 'arena-canvas', 'aria-label': 'Arena' });
        if (canvas && canvas.style.width) { c.style.width = canvas.style.width; c.style.height = canvas.style.height; }
        if (canvas && canvas.parentNode === arenaWrap) arenaWrap.replaceChild(c, canvas);
        else arenaWrap.insertBefore(c, arenaWrap.firstChild);
        canvas = c;
        api.canvas = c;
        invalidateRects();
        return c;
      },
      setRenderer: function (r) { renderer = r; invalidateRects(); crownsAt = -1; },
      hasChaosUI: function () { return !!chaosUi; },
      /** Resize path only (never per frame): sizes the HUD from UI.battleLayout() and returns
       *  the exact arena canvas rect for the renderer. hint = { arenaRatio } (measured by the
       *  app loop from the renderer's field rect). */
      layout: function (hint) {
        const sw = root.clientWidth || 360;
        const sh = root.clientHeight || 640;
        let safeT = 0;
        let safeB = 0;
        try {
          const cs = G.getComputedStyle(safeProbe);
          safeT = parseFloat(cs.paddingTop) || 0;
          safeB = parseFloat(cs.paddingBottom) || 0;
        } catch (e) { /* no computed styles: no insets */ }
        const g = UI.battleLayout(sw, sh, { safeT: safeT, safeB: safeB, arenaRatio: hint && hint.arenaRatio });
        geo = g;
        const st = root.style;
        st.setProperty('--card-w', g.cardW + 'px');
        st.setProperty('--card-h', g.cardH + 'px');
        st.setProperty('--next-w', g.nextW + 'px');
        st.setProperty('--next-h', g.nextH + 'px');
        st.setProperty('--foot-h', g.footH + 'px');
        st.setProperty('--ex-h', g.exH + 'px');
        st.setProperty('--left-w', g.leftW + 'px');
        st.setProperty('--emote-d', g.emoteD + 'px');
        st.setProperty('--hand-px', g.padX + 'px');
        st.setProperty('--hand-gap', g.gap + 'px');
        st.setProperty('--hand-pt', g.padTop + 'px');
        st.setProperty('--hand-rg', g.rowGap + 'px');
        st.setProperty('--name-h', g.nameH + 'px');
        st.setProperty('--u', g.unit.toFixed(2) + 'px');
        invalidateRects();
        // exact integer CSS px for the canvas (no blurry fractional scaling of the backing store)
        const w = arenaWrap.clientWidth || sw;
        const hh = arenaWrap.clientHeight || Math.max(1, g.arenaH);
        canvas.style.width = w + 'px';
        canvas.style.height = hh + 'px';
        crownsAt = -1;   // re-placed next to the river after the renderer resized
        return { w: w, h: hh, geo: g };
      },
      geometry: function () { return geo; },
      update: function (prev, cur, alpha) {
        if (destroyed || !cur || !cur.players || !cur.players[me]) return null;
        if (!view && typeof cur.time === 'number' && cur.time > 3 && (introEl || introFight)) skipIntro();
        flushReplay();
        view = cur;
        updateRoles(cur);
        updateElixir(prev, cur, typeof alpha === 'number' ? alpha : 1);
        updateMate(cur);
        updateUpgrades(cur);
        updateHand();
        updateChampion(cur);
        updateClock(cur);
        if (!tdHud && (opts.mode === 'touchdown' || UI.isTouchdown(cur))) setTdHud(true);
        if (tdHud) updateTouchdown(cur); else updateCrowns(cur);
        if (crownsAt < 0 && renderer) placeCrowns();
        if (chaosUi) { updateChaosUI(cur); if (!chaosUi) updateChaos(cur); else hideFallbackChaos(); }
        else updateChaos(cur);
        return dragState();
      },
      handleEvents: function (events, nowMs) {
        if (destroyed || !events || !events.length) return;
        const t = nowMs || now();
        for (let i = 0; i < events.length; i++) {
          const ev = events[i];
          if (!ev) continue;
          if (typeof ev.seq === 'number') {
            if (ev.seq <= lastSeq) continue;
            lastSeq = ev.seq;
          }
          const evSide = ev.side != null ? ev.side : ev.player;
          // v5: the player who caused it (2v2); in 1v1 player == side
          const evPlayer = ev.player != null ? ev.player : (ev.owner != null ? ev.owner : evSide);
          switch (ev.t) {
            case 'emote':
              if (evPlayer === me && lastOwnEmote && t - lastOwnEmote.t < 2500) break;
              showEmote(evSide === 1 ? 1 : 0, ev.id);
              break;
            case 'deploy':
              if (evSide !== side) Sound.play('enemyDeploy');
              break;
            case 'reject':
              // A queued play became invalid when the authority applied it.
              if (evPlayer === me) {
                if (typeof ev.hand === 'number') {
                  shakeSlot(ev.hand);
                  if (typeof driver.onReject === 'function') driver.onReject(ev.hand);
                }
                showMessage(UI.reasonText(ev.reason), UI.isElixirReason(ev.reason) ? 'is-elixir' : 'is-deny');
                Sound.play('deny');
              }
              break;
            case 'tower_down':
              Sound.play('tower');
              vibrate(evSide === side ? [40, 50, 60] : 30);
              break;
            case 'phase':
              if (ev.phase !== 'ended') Sound.play('phase');
              break;
            default:
              break;
          }
        }
      },
      playIntro: playIntro,
      skipIntro: skipIntro,
      introActive: function () { return !!introEl; },
      showMessage: showMessage,
      /** Wordless connection banner: icon (+ spinner while reconnecting) and a home button;
       *  the German text is the accessible label only. kind: 'lost' | 'error' | 'left'. */
      setNetBanner: function (text, actionLabel, action, kind) {
        if (!text) { netBanner.hidden = true; bannerAction = null; return; }
        const k = kind || (/neu|reconnect/i.test(String(text)) ? 'lost' : 'error');
        netBanner.setAttribute('aria-label', String(text));
        netBanner.className = 'net-banner is-' + k;
        bannerIco.textContent = '';
        bannerIco.appendChild(icon(k === 'left' ? 'people' : (k === 'lost' ? 'wifiOff' : 'warn'), 'nb-ico'));
        bannerSpin.hidden = k !== 'lost';
        bannerBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', actionLabel || 'Menü');
        bannerBtn.hidden = !action;
        bannerAction = action || null;
        netBanner.hidden = false;
      },
      setWaiting: function (text) {
        waitEl.hidden = !text;
        if (text) waitEl.setAttribute('aria-label', String(text));
      },
      cancelInput: cancelInput,
      destroy: function () {
        destroyed = true;
        G.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
        for (let i = 0; i < introTimers.length; i++) G.clearTimeout(introTimers[i]);
        introTimers = [];
        if (tdBurstTimer) { G.clearTimeout(tdBurstTimer); tdBurstTimer = 0; }
        unmountChaosUI();
        drag = null;
      },
    };
    return api;
  };
})(globalThis.CR || (globalThis.CR = {}));

</script>
<script>
/* src/11-main.js */
/* 11-main.js – CR.App: bootstrap (loading screen with 3D portrait pre-render), screen
 * routing, game loop and wiring of the play types (Single-Modus vs bot, Mit Freunden as host
 * or guest). Battles always use the C.H.A.O.S rules (basic rules only when that module is
 * missing or broken).
 *
 * v5 (docs/V5.md): "Bust War"; maps (CR.Sim({map}) / CR.Arena.setMap, 'classic' | 'hill');
 * 1v1 and 2v2 (CR.Sim({players: [{name, deck, side, bot}]}), one CR.AI per bot player, the HUD
 * follows the local PLAYER); the online lobby has four slots with team choice and bots (host
 * decides, App.mergeGuests); sound through CR.Audio (unlock on the first touch, music per
 * screen, CR.Audio.onEvents(events, localSide) every battle frame). Every v5 engine / net /
 * audio feature is probed at boot and guarded: a missing part only disables its option.
 *
 *  - vs bot / host: local CR.Sim driven by a fixed-timestep accumulator on
 *    requestAnimationFrame (max 5 catch-up ticks per frame); the loop runs TICK_RATE * speed
 *    ticks per real second (Spieltempo 1x / 1,5x). The last two sim views are kept for
 *    interpolation. The host additionally calls hs.tick(sim) after every sim.tick() and keeps
 *    simulating via a setInterval fallback while the tab is hidden.
 *  - guest: renders gs.frame(performance.now()) (interpolation buffer of host snapshots) and
 *    sends commands through gs.sendCommand.
 *  - renderer: CR.Render3D (three.js) when available and wanted, else the 2D CR.Render; a
 *    failing 3D renderer is swapped for 2D mid-battle.
 *
 * v6: game mode Touchdown (the CR event mode: no towers, score in the end zone, first to 3) next
 * to C.H.A.O.S - chosen in the menu (Single-Modus and Mit Freunden) and in the host lobby,
 * combined with 1v1 / 2v2, the map (Klassisch / Hügel) and the switch "Touchdown mit
 * C.H.A.O.S-Upgrades" (options.chaos). new CR.Sim({mode: 'touchdown', options: {chaos}}); the
 * mode + options go through hs.startBattle / onBattleStart; decks are cleaned per mode
 * (UI.deckForMode: cards the mode does not allow are swapped for the battle only). The probe
 * f.touchdown disables the choice when the engine has no Touchdown yet.
 *
 * v12: game mode "Klassisch" (ohne C.H.A.O.S): the menu / lobby choice 'classic' runs
 * new CR.Sim({mode: 'classic'}) solo and online (battleMode keeps it; mode + map travel through
 * hs.setMode / setMap / startBattle). Third map 'tunnel' (App.normMap; probe f.tunnel: a
 * sim on map 'tunnel' must report it, else the choice is greyed). Default Spieltempo
 * "Original 1x": UI.migrateSettings runs once at boot before the settings are read, and
 * app.setSpeed marks 'speedChosen' so a tempo the player picks is never migrated.
 *
 * v13: "Schnelles Elixier (1,5×)": settings.elixirBoost (stored 'elixirBoost', default off) ->
 * battleOptions(..., boost) -> App.modeOptions adds { elixirBoost: 1.5 } in every mode (sim
 * option, see 03-sim.js); the host lobby switch (ctl.onElixirBoost) updates online.options and
 * hs.setMode, so it travels through the lobby / startBattle to the guests. Touchdown decks get
 * a building through UI.deckForMode (UI.ensureBuilding); drafted decks via CR.Draft.
 *
 * Nothing touches the DOM at load time (the pure helpers are tested under jsc).
 */
(function (CR) {
  'use strict';

  const G = globalThis;
  const App = CR.App || (CR.App = {});
  const EMPTY = Object.freeze([]);

  const END_DELAY_MS = 2600;       // keep rendering the final explosion before the result screen
  const DRAFT_DONE_MS = 1600;      // v7: "Deck fertig" moment between the last draft pick and the battle
  const BG_INTERVAL_MS = 250;      // host fallback timer while no frames are painted
  const RAF_STALL_MS = 400;        // no animation frame for this long = frames stalled
  const BG_MAX_CATCHUP_S = 3;      // never fast-forward more than this per fallback callback
  const MAX_FRAME_DT = 0.25;       // clamp long frames (tab switches, GC pauses)
  const FILL_SLACK = 0.015;        // field narrower than the best fill by more = height-limited
  const PERF_WINDOW = 120;         // frames per HUD timing window (dev stats)

  function nowMs() { return G.performance && G.performance.now ? G.performance.now() : 0; }
  function errMsg(e) {
    if (!e) return 'Unbekannter Fehler';
    if (typeof e === 'string') return e;
    return String(e.message || e.reason || e);
  }
  function logError(where, e) {
    try { if (G.console && G.console.error) G.console.error('[BustWar] ' + where + ':', e); } catch (err) { /* ignore */ }
  }
  function randomSeed() { return ((Math.random() * 0x7ffffffe) | 0) + 1; }
  function safeCall(fn, ctx, args) {
    try { return fn.apply(ctx, args || EMPTY); } catch (e) { logError('callback', e); return undefined; }
  }

  // ===================================================================== pure helpers

  /** Fixed-timestep accumulator: advance(elapsedSec, step) runs step() once per dt, at most
   *  maxSteps times per call; any larger backlog is dropped (the game slows down instead of
   *  spiralling). step() may return false to stop early. */
  function FixedStepper(dt, maxSteps) {
    this.dt = dt;
    this.maxSteps = maxSteps || 5;
    this.acc = 0;
  }
  FixedStepper.prototype.advance = function (elapsed, step) {
    if (!(elapsed > 0)) return 0;
    const dt = this.dt;
    const eps = 1e-9;
    this.acc += elapsed;
    let n = 0;
    while (this.acc + eps >= dt) {
      if (n >= this.maxSteps) {
        this.acc = this.acc % dt;
        if (this.acc + eps >= dt) this.acc = 0;
        break;
      }
      this.acc -= dt;
      n++;
      if (step() === false) { this.acc = 0; break; }
    }
    if (this.acc < 0) this.acc = 0;
    return n;
  };
  FixedStepper.prototype.alpha = function () {
    const a = this.acc / this.dt;
    return a < 0 ? 0 : (a > 1 ? 1 : a);
  };
  FixedStepper.prototype.reset = function () { this.acc = 0; };
  App.FixedStepper = FixedStepper;

  function tickDt() {
    if (typeof CR.DT === 'number' && CR.DT > 0) return CR.DT;
    return 1 / (CR.TICK_RATE || 20);
  }

  /** Result summary from a final view (+ optional authoritative result from the network). */
  App.resultFromView = function (view, extra) {
    const r = extra && typeof extra === 'object' ? extra : {};
    const v = view || {};
    const ps = v.players || EMPTY;
    let crowns = Array.isArray(r.crowns) ? r.crowns.slice(0, 2) : null;
    // v5: crowns are per team (2v2: players carry their team in `side`)
    if (!crowns) crowns = CR.UI && CR.UI.teamCrowns ? CR.UI.teamCrowns(ps) : [ps[0] ? ps[0].crowns | 0 : 0, ps[1] ? ps[1].crowns | 0 : 0];
    let winner = r.winner !== undefined ? r.winner : v.winner;
    if (winner === undefined || winner === null) {
      winner = crowns[0] > crowns[1] ? 0 : (crowns[1] > crowns[0] ? 1 : 'draw');
    }
    const overtime = r.overtime !== undefined ? !!r.overtime : !!(v.clock && v.clock.overtime);
    // reason: 'three_crown' | 'time' | 'sudden_death' | 'tiebreak' (CR.Sim endReason) or null
    const reason = typeof r.reason === 'string' ? r.reason : null;
    const out = { winner: winner, crowns: crowns, overtime: overtime, reason: reason };
    // v6 Touchdown: the "crowns" are the touchdowns (score of the view wins over a network copy)
    const td = r.mode === 'touchdown' || CR.UI.isTouchdown(v);
    if (td) {
      const sc = CR.UI.touchdownScore(v);
      if (sc && !Array.isArray(r.crowns)) out.crowns = sc;
      if (r.winner === undefined && (v.winner === undefined || v.winner === null)) {
        const c = out.crowns;
        out.winner = c[0] > c[1] ? 0 : (c[1] > c[0] ? 1 : 'draw');
      }
      out.mode = 'touchdown';
      out.target = typeof r.target === 'number' && r.target > 0 ? r.target : CR.UI.touchdownTarget(v);
    }
    return out;
  };

  /** German one-line explanation of how the match was decided (result screen). */
  App.resultReason = function (res, localSide) {
    const UI = CR.UI;
    const outcome = UI.outcome(res.winner, localSide);
    const crowns = res.crowns || [0, 0];
    const mine = crowns[localSide] | 0;
    const theirs = crowns[1 - localSide] | 0;
    if (res.mode === 'touchdown') {
      const target = res.target > 0 ? res.target : CR.UI.touchdownTarget(null);
      const tds = mine + ' : ' + theirs + ' Touchdowns';
      if (outcome === 'win' && mine >= target) return target + ' Touchdowns – Sieg!';
      if (outcome === 'loss' && theirs >= target) return 'Der Gegner hat ' + target + ' Touchdowns erzielt.';
      if (res.reason === 'sudden_death' || (res.overtime && outcome !== 'draw')) return tds + ' – Entscheidung in der Verlängerung';
      if (outcome === 'draw') return tds + ' – keiner war stärker.';
      return tds + ' – nach Ablauf der Zeit';
    }
    const score = mine + ' : ' + theirs + ' Kronen';
    if (outcome === 'win' && (mine >= 3 || res.reason === 'three_crown')) return 'König-Turm zerstört – 3 Kronen!';
    if (outcome === 'loss' && (theirs >= 3 || res.reason === 'three_crown')) return 'Dein König-Turm ist gefallen.';
    if (res.reason === 'tiebreak') {
      return outcome === 'draw' ? 'Gleichstand – auch die Türme sind gleich stark.'
        : score + ' – entschieden nach Turm-Trefferpunkten';
    }
    if (res.reason === 'sudden_death') return score + ' – Entscheidung in der Verlängerung';
    if (outcome === 'draw') return score + ' – keiner war stärker.';
    return score + (res.overtime ? ' (nach Verlängerung)' : '');
  };

  /** AI deck: a random preset that differs from the player's deck where possible. */
  App.pickAiDeck = function (playerDeck, rand) {
    const UI = CR.UI;
    const r = rand || Math.random;
    const presets = UI.presets().map(function (p) { return UI.sanitizeDeck(p.cards, EMPTY); })
      .filter(function (d) { return d.length === 8; });
    const key = (playerDeck || EMPTY).slice().sort().join(',');
    const others = presets.filter(function (d) { return d.slice().sort().join(',') !== key; });
    const pool = others.length ? others : presets;
    if (pool.length) return pool[Math.floor(r() * pool.length) % pool.length];
    // No presets: random enabled cards.
    const ids = UI.enabledCardIds();
    for (let i = ids.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(r() * (i + 1));
      const t = ids[i]; ids[i] = ids[j]; ids[j] = t;
    }
    return UI.sanitizeDeck(ids.slice(0, 8), EMPTY);
  };

  /** Display names per team [blue, red] ('Georg & Partner-KI' in 2v2). */
  App.teamNames = function (players) {
    const out = [[], []];
    for (let i = 0; i < (players || EMPTY).length; i++) {
      const p = players[i];
      if (!p) continue;
      const n = CR.UI.sanitizeName(p.name) || (p.bot ? 'Bot' : 'Spieler');
      out[p.side === 1 ? 1 : 0].push(n);
    }
    return [out[0].join(' & '), out[1].join(' & ')];
  };

  // ======================================================================= v5 lobby model

  function guestKey(g, i) {
    if (!g) return 'x' + i;
    if (g.id != null) return 'i:' + g.id;
    if (g.gid != null) return 'i:' + g.gid;
    if (g.peer != null) return 'i:' + g.peer;
    if (typeof g.slot === 'number') return 's:' + g.slot;
    return 'n:' + String(g.name || '') + ':' + i;
  }
  App.guestKey = guestKey;

  /**
   * Host decides (V5 net contract): merges the guests the network reports (list of
   * {id|gid, slot?, name, deck, ready, team? (requested)}) into the host's four slots.
   * Known guests keep their slot (name/deck/ready refreshed); a changed team request is
   * granted when that team has room; new guests take a free slot (requested team if it has
   * room, else the smaller team; 1v1: always the other team); guests that left free their
   * slot. Host and bot slots stay. Pure; returns a new array.
   */
  App.mergeGuests = function (slots, guests, teamSize) {
    const UI = CR.UI;
    const ts = UI.normTeamSize(teamSize);
    const used = UI.lobbyUsedSlots(ts);
    const out = (slots || EMPTY).map(function (sl) { return Object.assign({}, sl); });
    const list = Array.isArray(guests) ? guests.filter(function (g) { return g && g.kind !== 'host' && g.kind !== 'bot' && g.kind !== 'empty'; }) : EMPTY;
    const seen = Object.create(null);
    for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) seen[guestKey(list[i], i)] = list[i];
    // refresh / drop known guests
    for (let i = 0; i < out.length; i++) {
      const sl = out[i];
      if (sl.kind !== 'guest') continue;
      const g = seen[sl.id];
      if (!g) { out[i] = { slot: i, name: '', team: sl.team, kind: 'empty', ready: false, deck: null, id: null }; continue; }
      delete seen[sl.id];
      sl.name = UI.sanitizeName(g.name) || 'Gast';
      if (Array.isArray(g.deck)) sl.deck = g.deck.slice(0, 8);
      sl.ready = !!g.ready;
      const req = g.team === 0 || g.team === 1 ? g.team : null;
      if (req !== null && req !== sl.req) {
        sl.req = req;
        if (ts === 2 && req !== sl.team && UI.lobbyTeamCounts(out, ts)[req] < ts) sl.team = req;
      }
    }
    // place new guests
    const keys = Object.keys(seen);
    for (let k = 0; k < keys.length; k++) {
      const g = seen[keys[k]];
      let at = -1;
      if (typeof g.slot === 'number' && g.slot > 0 && g.slot < out.length && out[g.slot].kind === 'empty') at = g.slot;
      for (let i = 1; at < 0 && i < used && i < out.length; i++) if (out[i].kind === 'empty') at = i;
      for (let i = used; at < 0 && i < out.length; i++) if (out[i].kind === 'empty') at = i;
      if (at < 0) continue;   // lobby full: the network keeps the extra player waiting
      const req = g.team === 0 || g.team === 1 ? g.team : null;
      const team = ts === 1 ? (out[0].team === 1 ? 0 : 1) : UI.lobbyAutoTeam(out, ts, req);
      out[at] = { slot: at, name: UI.sanitizeName(g.name) || 'Gast', team: team, kind: 'guest', ready: !!g.ready, deck: Array.isArray(g.deck) ? g.deck.slice(0, 8) : null, id: keys[k], req: req };
    }
    return out;
  };

  /** Switch 1v1 <-> 2v2: occupied slots move into the used range (guests before bots),
   *  1v1 = host Blau vs one opponent Rot; 2v2 teams are rebalanced to at most two each. */
  App.lobbyResize = function (slots, teamSize) {
    const UI = CR.UI;
    const ts = UI.normTeamSize(teamSize);
    const used = UI.lobbyUsedSlots(ts);
    const host = Object.assign({}, slots[0]);
    const rest = slots.slice(1).filter(function (sl) { return sl && sl.kind !== 'empty'; })
      .sort(function (a, b) { return (a.kind === 'guest' ? 0 : 1) - (b.kind === 'guest' ? 0 : 1); });
    const out = [host];
    for (let i = 1; i < 4; i++) {
      const sl = rest[i - 1];
      out.push(sl ? Object.assign({}, sl, { slot: i }) : { slot: i, name: '', team: i % 2, kind: 'empty', ready: false, deck: null, id: null });
    }
    if (ts === 1) {
      host.team = 0;
      for (let i = 1; i < 4; i++) if (out[i].kind !== 'empty') out[i].team = 1;
    } else {
      for (let i = 1; i < used; i++) {
        const sl = out[i];
        if (sl.kind === 'empty') continue;
        const c = UI.lobbyTeamCounts(out.slice(0, i), ts);
        if (c[sl.team === 1 ? 1 : 0] >= ts) sl.team = sl.team === 1 ? 0 : 1;
      }
    }
    return out;
  };

  /** Network capabilities of a host session / the net module (V5 lobby with four slots). */
  App.hostLobbyFn = function (hs) {
    if (!hs) return null;
    const names = ['setLobby', 'updateLobby', 'setSlots'];
    for (let i = 0; i < names.length; i++) if (typeof hs[names[i]] === 'function') return names[i];
    return null;
  };
  /** V5 net module: the host session owns the lobby (seats, team requests, bots). */
  App.netOwnsLobby = function (hs) {
    return !!(hs && typeof hs.addBot === 'function' && typeof hs.setTeamSize === 'function' && typeof hs.setTeam === 'function' && typeof hs.lobbyPlayers === 'function');
  };
  App.netSupports2v2 = function () {
    const N = CR.Net;
    if (!N) return false;
    if (N.MAX_PLAYERS >= 4 || N.maxPlayers >= 4) return true;
    const P = N.HostSession && N.HostSession.prototype;
    return !!(P && (App.hostLobbyFn(P) || App.netOwnsLobby(P)));
  };
  /** v12: map id 'classic' | 'hill' | 'tunnel' (anything else: 'classic'). */
  function normMap(m) { return m === 'hill' || m === 'tunnel' ? m : 'classic'; }
  App.normMap = normMap;
  /** v6: 'classic' | 'chaos' | 'touchdown' (anything else: null) */
  function gameModeOf(m) { return m === 'touchdown' || m === 'chaos' || m === 'classic' ? m : null; }
  App.gameModeOf = gameModeOf;
  /** v6: battle options of a mode: Touchdown -> {chaos: bool, draft: bool (v7)}; other modes none.
   *  v13: + elixirBoost (1.5 = "Schnelles Elixier", every mode; only present while on - a mode
   *  without other options then gets { elixirBoost } instead of null). */
  App.modeOptions = function (mode, options) {
    // v7: + draft ("Touchdown mit Draft", default on)
    const eb = options && options.elixirBoost === CR.UI.ELIXIR_BOOST ? options.elixirBoost : 0;
    const o = mode === 'touchdown' ? { chaos: !!(options && options.chaos === true), draft: !(options && options.draft === false) } : (eb ? {} : null);
    if (eb) o.elixirBoost = eb;
    return o;
  };
  /** Public lobby blob for the network: {teamSize, mode ('1v1'|'2v2'), gameMode, options, map,
   *  slots:[{slot,name,team,kind,ready,id}]} */
  App.lobbyBlob = function (slots, teamSize, map, gameMode, options) {
    const ts = CR.UI.normTeamSize(teamSize);
    const gm = gameModeOf(gameMode) || 'chaos';
    return {
      teamSize: ts,
      mode: ts === 2 ? '2v2' : '1v1',
      gameMode: gm,
      options: App.modeOptions(gm, options),
      map: normMap(map),
      slots: (slots || EMPTY).map(function (sl, i) {
        return { slot: i, name: sl.name || '', team: sl.team === 1 ? 1 : 0, kind: sl.kind || 'empty', ready: !!sl.ready, id: sl.id || null };
      }),
    };
  };
  /** Guest side: a lobby blob from the network in any of the accepted shapes ->
   *  {slots, teamSize, map, mySlot} or null. */
  App.readLobby = function (lb) {
    if (!lb || typeof lb !== 'object') return null;
    const slots = Array.isArray(lb.slots) ? lb.slots : (Array.isArray(lb) ? lb : null);
    if (!slots) return null;
    const ts = lb.teamSize === 2 || lb.mode === '2v2' || lb.mode === 2 ? 2 : 1;
    let mySlot = -1;
    const cand = [lb.me, lb.mySlot, lb.localSlot, lb.yourSlot, lb.you, lb.slot];
    for (let i = 0; i < cand.length; i++) if (typeof cand[i] === 'number') { mySlot = cand[i]; break; }
    return {
      slots: slots.map(function (sl, i) {
        const s = sl || NONE_OBJ;
        return { slot: typeof s.slot === 'number' ? s.slot : i, name: String(s.name || ''), team: s.team === 1 ? 1 : 0, kind: ['host', 'guest', 'bot', 'empty'].indexOf(s.kind) >= 0 ? s.kind : 'empty', ready: !!s.ready, req: s.req === 0 || s.req === 1 ? s.req : -1, deck: Array.isArray(s.deck) ? s.deck : null };
      }),
      teamSize: ts,
      map: normMap(lb.map),
      // v6: the game mode (app blob: gameMode; V5 net lobby: mode = the game mode)
      gameMode: gameModeOf(lb.gameMode) || gameModeOf(lb.mode) || 'chaos',
      options: lb.options && typeof lb.options === 'object' ? App.lobbyOptions(lb.options) : null,
      mySlot: mySlot,
      full: !!lb.full,
    };
  };
  const NONE_OBJ = Object.freeze({});
  /** Lobby options from the network: {chaos, draft} (+ elixirBoost, v13, while on). */
  App.lobbyOptions = function (o) {
    const out = { chaos: o.chaos === true, draft: o.draft !== false };
    if (o.elixirBoost === CR.UI.ELIXIR_BOOST) out.elixirBoost = o.elixirBoost;
    return out;
  };

  // ============================================================================ drivers

  function cardObj(id) {
    const cat = CR.UI.catalog();
    return cat.byId[id] || id;
  }

  /**
   * Local authority (vs AI and host): owns the CR.Sim, the optional bot and host session.
   */
  /** Game speed factor (ARCHITECTURE v2 §3): 1 = original, 1.5 = "Schnell". */
  function normSpeed(s) { return typeof s === 'number' && s >= 0.25 && s <= 4 ? s : 1; }
  App.normSpeed = normSpeed;

  /** v5: sim config. cfg.players ([{name, deck, side, bot}], 2 or 4) -> the V5 players form;
   *  otherwise the legacy {decks, names}. options.bots lists the bot player indices. */
  App.simConfig = function (cfg) {
    const out = { seed: cfg.seed, mode: cfg.mode };
    if (cfg.map) out.map = normMap(cfg.map);
    let bots = null;
    if (Array.isArray(cfg.players) && cfg.players.length) {
      out.players = cfg.players.map(function (p) { return { name: p.name, deck: p.deck, side: p.side === 1 ? 1 : 0, bot: !!p.bot }; });
      bots = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < out.players.length; i++) if (out.players[i].bot) bots.push(i);
      // legacy fields as well (an engine without the players form still runs a 1v1)
      if (out.players.length === 2) {
        out.decks = [out.players[0].deck, out.players[1].deck];
        out.names = [out.players[0].name, out.players[1].name];
      }
    } else {
      out.decks = cfg.decks;
      out.names = cfg.names;
    }
    if (cfg.options && typeof cfg.options === 'object') out.options = Object.assign({}, cfg.options);
    if (bots && !(out.options && Array.isArray(out.options.bots))) { out.options = out.options || {}; out.options.bots = bots; }
    // C.H.A.O.S converts its real-time windows (pick timer, bot delay) with options.speed.
    if (typeof cfg.speed === 'number') { out.options = out.options || {}; out.options.speed = normSpeed(cfg.speed); }
    return out;
  };

  /** v6: tells CR.Arena the mode when it keeps one (Touchdown deploy zones / end zones for the
   *  guest's local validation and the renderers). Optional. */
  App.applyMode = function (mode) {
    const A = CR.Arena;
    if (!A || typeof A.setMode !== 'function') return false;
    try { A.setMode(mode === 'touchdown' ? 'touchdown' : (mode === 'classic' ? 'classic' : 'chaos')); return true; } catch (e) { logError('setMode', e); return false; }
  };

  /** Selects the map for everything that reads CR.Arena (renderers, guest validation). */
  App.applyMap = function (map) {
    const A = CR.Arena;
    if (!A || typeof A.setMap !== 'function') return false;
    try { A.setMap(normMap(map)); return true; } catch (e) { logError('setMap', e); return false; }
  };

  // ======================================================================= v7: draft runner

  /**
   * Authoritative Touchdown draft with timers (Single-Modus and online host): wraps CR.Draft.
   * cfg = { players: [{side, bot}], seed, pool?, rounds?, pickMs, botMs: [min, max], now() }.
   * Per pair: a pick deadline (now + pickMs) and, when a bot picks, its think time. tick(now)
   * lets bots pick and auto-picks for humans whose time ran out (CR.Draft.botChoice).
   * pick(player, choice, round) validates (turn, round). onChange(run) after every pick.
   * Pure (no DOM, the clock comes from cfg.now / tick arguments): tested under jsc.
   */
  function DraftRun(cfg) {
    const c = cfg || {};
    this.players = (c.players || EMPTY).map(function (p, i) { return { side: p && p.side === 1 ? 1 : (p && p.side === 0 ? 0 : i % 2), bot: !!(p && p.bot) }; });
    this.pickMs = c.pickMs > 0 ? c.pickMs : (CR.Draft.PICK_MS || 10000);
    this.botMs = Array.isArray(c.botMs) ? c.botMs : [700, 1700];
    this.now = typeof c.now === 'function' ? c.now : nowMs;
    this.rand = CR.rng ? CR.rng(((c.seed >>> 0) ^ 0x2545f491) >>> 0) : Math.random;
    this.draft = CR.Draft.create({ players: this.players, pool: c.pool, rounds: c.rounds || CR.Draft.ROUNDS, seed: c.seed });
    this.onChange = null;
    this.timers = [];
    const t = this.now();
    for (let k = 0; k < this.draft.pairs.length; k++) this.timers.push({ deadline: 0, botAt: 0, bot: false, live: false });
    for (let k = 0; k < this.draft.pairs.length; k++) this._arm(k, t);
  }
  DraftRun.prototype._arm = function (k, t) {
    const tm = this.timers[k];
    const d = this.draft;
    if (d.pairDone(k)) { tm.deadline = 0; tm.botAt = 0; tm.bot = false; tm.live = false; return; }
    tm.live = true;
    tm.deadline = t + this.pickMs;
    const ch = d.current(d.pairs[k][0]).chooser;
    tm.bot = !!(this.players[ch] && this.players[ch].bot);
    tm.botAt = tm.bot ? t + this.botMs[0] + Math.floor(this.rand() * Math.max(0, this.botMs[1] - this.botMs[0])) : 0;
  };
  /** A pick of `player` (choice 0|1) for its pair's round `round` (omitted: current). */
  DraftRun.prototype.pick = function (player, choice, round) {
    const d = this.draft;
    const cur = d.current(player);
    if (!cur) return { ok: false, reason: 'done' };
    if (!cur.mine) return { ok: false, reason: 'not_your_turn' };
    if (typeof round === 'number' && round !== cur.round) return { ok: false, reason: 'old_round' };
    const r = d.pick(player, choice);
    if (r.ok) {
      this._arm(r.pair, this.now());
      if (this.onChange) safeCall(this.onChange, null, [this, r]);
    }
    return r;
  };
  /** Bots and timeouts. Returns the number of picks made. */
  DraftRun.prototype.tick = function (t) {
    const now = typeof t === 'number' ? t : this.now();
    const d = this.draft;
    let n = 0;
    for (let k = 0; k < d.pairs.length; k++) {
      if (d.pairDone(k)) continue;
      const tm = this.timers[k];
      const cur = d.current(d.pairs[k][0]);
      const ch = cur.chooser;
      const due = tm.live && ((tm.bot && now >= tm.botAt) || now >= tm.deadline);
      if (!due) continue;
      const choice = CR.Draft.botChoice(cur.cards, d.deck(ch), this.rand);
      const r = d.pick(ch, choice);
      if (!r.ok) continue;
      n++;
      this._arm(k, now);
      r.auto = !(this.players[ch] && this.players[ch].bot);
      if (this.onChange) safeCall(this.onChange, null, [this, r]);
    }
    return n;
  };
  DraftRun.prototype.done = function () { return this.draft.done(); };
  DraftRun.prototype.snapshot = function () { return this.draft.snapshot(); };
  DraftRun.prototype.decks = function () { return this.draft.decks(); };
  /** ms left of each pair's pick timer. */
  DraftRun.prototype.left = function (t) {
    const now = typeof t === 'number' ? t : this.now();
    const d = this.draft;
    return this.timers.map(function (tm, k) { return d.pairDone(k) || !tm.live ? 0 : Math.max(0, tm.deadline - now); });
  };
  /** Timer of `player`'s pair for the draft screen: { deadline (same clock as now()), total }. */
  DraftRun.prototype.timing = function (player) {
    const k = this.draft.pairOf(player);
    const tm = k >= 0 ? this.timers[k] : null;
    return { deadline: tm && tm.live ? tm.deadline : null, total: this.pickMs };
  };
  App.DraftRun = DraftRun;

  /** v7: should this battle start with the Touchdown draft? (mode + options + module) */
  App.wantsDraft = function (mode, options) {
    return mode === 'touchdown' && !!(CR.Draft && typeof CR.Draft.create === 'function') && !(options && options.draft === false);
  };

  function LocalDriver(cfg) {
    // v5: the local player (host / Single-Modus = player 0) and its team colour
    this.localPlayer = typeof cfg.localPlayer === 'number' ? cfg.localPlayer : 0;
    const lp = Array.isArray(cfg.players) ? cfg.players[this.localPlayer] : null;
    this.localSide = lp ? (lp.side === 1 ? 1 : 0) : (this.localPlayer === 1 ? 1 : 0);
    this.mode = cfg.mode;
    this.options = App.modeOptions(cfg.mode, cfg.options);
    this.names = cfg.names;
    this.map = normMap(cfg.map);
    this.teamSize = Array.isArray(cfg.players) && cfg.players.length === 4 ? 2 : 1;
    // The sim always runs 1:1 in game time; `speed` only changes how many ticks the loop
    // runs per real second (TICK_RATE * speed).
    this.speed = normSpeed(cfg.speed);
    if (cfg.map) App.applyMap(this.map);
    App.applyMode(cfg.mode);
    this.sim = new CR.Sim(App.simConfig(cfg));
    // one CR.AI per bot player (1v1 legacy: aiLevel -> player 1)
    this.bots = [];
    const seed0 = (cfg.seed ^ 0x5bd1e995) >>> 0;
    if (Array.isArray(cfg.players)) {
      for (let i = 0; i < cfg.players.length; i++) {
        const p = cfg.players[i];
        if (!p.bot || i === this.localPlayer) continue;
        this.bots.push(new CR.AI({ player: i, side: p.side === 1 ? 1 : 0, level: p.level || cfg.aiLevel || 'normal', seed: (seed0 + i * 7919) >>> 0 }));
      }
    } else if (cfg.aiLevel) {
      this.bots.push(new CR.AI({ player: 1, side: 1, level: cfg.aiLevel, seed: seed0 }));
    }
    this.bot = this.bots[0] || null;   // legacy field (tests, dev pages)
    this.hs = cfg.hs || null;
    const wallDt = tickDt() / this.speed;   // real seconds per sim tick
    this.stepper = new FixedStepper(wallDt, 5);
    this.bgStepper = new FixedStepper(wallDt, Math.ceil(BG_MAX_CATCHUP_S / wallDt));
    this.prev = null;
    this.cur = this.sim.view();
    this.events = [];
    this.pending = new CR.UI.PendingPlays(1500);
    this.out = { prev: null, cur: null, alpha: 1 };
    this.paused = false;
    this.hold = false;      // battle intro: the clock has not started yet
    this.botError = null;
    this.netErrors = 0;
    this.onBotError = null;
    this.onNetError = null;
    const self = this;
    this._step = function () { return self.step(); };
  }
  LocalDriver.prototype.step = function () {
    const sim = this.sim;
    if (sim.over) return false;
    const bots = this.bots;
    for (let i = 0; i < bots.length; i++) {
      const b = bots[i];
      if (!b) continue;
      try { b.update(sim); } catch (e) {
        logError('AI', e);
        bots[i] = null;
        if (this.bot === b) this.bot = null;
        this.botError = e;
        if (this.onBotError) safeCall(this.onBotError, null, [e]);
      }
    }
    sim.tick();
    if (typeof sim.drainEvents === 'function') {
      const evs = sim.drainEvents();
      if (evs && evs.length) for (let i = 0; i < evs.length; i++) this.events.push(evs[i]);
    }
    if (this.hs) {
      try { this.hs.tick(sim); this.netErrors = 0; } catch (e) {
        this.netErrors++;
        if (this.netErrors === 1 || this.netErrors % 100 === 0) logError('host tick', e);
        if (this.netErrors === 20 && this.onNetError) safeCall(this.onNetError, null, [e]);
      }
    }
    this.prev = this.cur;
    this.cur = sim.view();
    if (typeof sim.drainEvents !== 'function' && this.cur && this.cur.events) {
      for (let i = 0; i < this.cur.events.length; i++) this.events.push(this.cur.events[i]);
    }
    this.pending.clear();
    return !sim.over;
  };
  /** Called once per animation frame. Returns the same (reused) object every frame. */
  LocalDriver.prototype.frame = function (t, dt) {
    if (this.paused || this.hold || this.sim.over) this.stepper.reset();
    else this.stepper.advance(dt, this._step);
    const out = this.out;
    out.prev = this.prev || this.cur;
    out.cur = this.cur;
    out.alpha = this.prev && !this.sim.over ? this.stepper.alpha() : 1;
    return out;
  };
  /** Hidden-tab fallback (host): catch up on wall time with a larger cap. */
  LocalDriver.prototype.background = function (dt) {
    if (this.paused || this.hold || this.sim.over) return 0;
    return this.bgStepper.advance(dt, this._step);
  };
  LocalDriver.prototype.takeEvents = function () {
    if (!this.events.length) return EMPTY;
    const out = this.events;
    this.events = [];
    return out;
  };
  LocalDriver.prototype.isOver = function () { return !!this.sim.over; };
  LocalDriver.prototype.result = function () {
    return App.resultFromView(this.cur, { winner: this.sim.winner, reason: this.sim.endReason || null });
  };
  // HUD driver API
  LocalDriver.prototype.canPlay = function (slot, x, y) {
    if (this.sim.over) return { ok: false, reason: 'over' };
    if (this.pending.has(slot)) return { ok: false, reason: 'pending' };
    const r = this.sim.canPlay(this.localPlayer, slot, x, y);
    return r || { ok: false, reason: '' };
  };
  LocalDriver.prototype.play = function (slot, x, y, cardId) {
    const chk = this.canPlay(slot, x, y);
    if (!chk.ok) return chk;
    const r = this.sim.command(this.localPlayer, { type: 'play', hand: slot, x: x, y: y, card: cardId });
    if (r && r.ok === false) return r;
    const info = CR.UI.cardInfo(cardId);
    this.pending.add(slot, cardId, info.elixir || 0, nowMs());
    return { ok: true };
  };
  LocalDriver.prototype.chaosPick = function (option) {
    return this.sim.command(this.localPlayer, { type: 'chaos_pick', option: option });
  };
  LocalDriver.prototype.emote = function (id) {
    return this.sim.command(this.localPlayer, { type: 'emote', id: id });
  };
  /** Generic command path (C.H.A.O.S UI: chaos_pick / chaos_use / ...). */
  LocalDriver.prototype.sendCommand = function (cmd) {
    if (!cmd || typeof cmd !== 'object') return { ok: false, reason: 'bad_command' };
    return this.sim.command(this.localPlayer, cmd);
  };
  LocalDriver.prototype.isPending = function (slot) { return this.pending.has(slot); };
