  LocalDriver.prototype.pendingCost = function () { return this.pending.cost(); };

  /**
   * Guest: renders host snapshots, validates locally (CR.Arena + elixir estimate) and sends
   * commands through the guest session.
   */
  function GuestDriver(gs, info) {
    this.gs = gs;
    this.localSide = info && info.localSide === 0 ? 0 : 1;
    // v5: own player index (2v2: 1..3); 1v1 legacy = the side
    this.localPlayer = info && typeof info.localPlayer === 'number' && info.localPlayer >= 0 ? info.localPlayer : this.localSide;
    this.map = normMap(info && info.map);
    this.speed = normSpeed(info && info.speed);   // host's speed (display only; gs.frame maps time)
    this.prev = null;
    this.cur = null;
    this.alpha = 1;
    this.pending = new CR.UI.PendingPlays(1500);
    this.out = { prev: null, cur: null, alpha: 1 };
    this.lastEventsOf = null;
    this.layout = null;
    this.pseudo = null;
    this.pseudoFor = null;
    this.resultInfo = null;
  }
  GuestDriver.prototype.frame = function (t) {
    let f = null;
    try { f = this.gs.frame(t); } catch (e) { logError('guest frame', e); f = null; }
    if (f && f.cur && f.cur.players) {
      this.cur = f.cur;
      this.prev = f.prev && f.prev.players ? f.prev : f.cur;
      this.alpha = typeof f.alpha === 'number' ? f.alpha : 1;
    }
    if (!this.cur) return null;
    const p = this.cur.players[this.localPlayer];
    this.pending.sync(p && p.hand, t);
    const out = this.out;
    out.prev = this.prev;
    out.cur = this.cur;
    out.alpha = this.alpha;
    return out;
  };
  GuestDriver.prototype.takeEvents = function () {
    const v = this.cur;
    if (!v || v === this.lastEventsOf) return EMPTY;
    this.lastEventsOf = v;
    return v.events || EMPTY;
  };
  GuestDriver.prototype.isOver = function () { return !!(this.cur && this.cur.over); };
  GuestDriver.prototype.result = function () { return App.resultFromView(this.cur, this.resultInfo); };
  /** A sim-like object for CR.Arena.checkDeploy built from the snapshot (towers with footprints,
   *  buildings as blocking rects). Rebuilt only when the view changes. */
  GuestDriver.prototype.pseudoSim = function (v) {
    if (this.pseudoFor === v && this.pseudo) return this.pseudo;
    if (!this.layout) {
      try { this.layout = CR.Arena.towerLayout(); } catch (e) { this.layout = []; }
    }
    const towers = [];
    const vt = v.towers || EMPTY;
    // v6 Touchdown: no crown towers (view.towers = []), so none block or open deploy pockets
    const noTowers = CR.UI.isTouchdown(v);
    for (let i = 0; !noTowers && i < this.layout.length; i++) {
      const L = this.layout[i];
      let alive = true;
      for (let j = 0; j < vt.length; j++) {
        const t = vt[j];
        if (t.id === L.id || (t.side === L.side && t.kind === L.kind && (t.kind === 'king' || t.lane === L.lane))) {
          alive = t.alive !== false && !(t.hp <= 0);
          break;
        }
      }
      towers.push({ id: L.id, side: L.side, kind: L.kind, lane: L.lane, x: L.x, y: L.y, x0: L.x0, y0: L.y0, x1: L.x1, y1: L.y1, alive: alive });
    }
    const units = [];
    const vu = v.units || EMPTY;
    for (let i = 0; i < vu.length; i++) {
      const u = vu[i];
      if (!u.building) continue;
      // Buildings block their tile footprint (view `size`, in tiles); radius as fallback.
      const half = u.size > 0 ? u.size / 2 : (u.radius > 0 ? u.radius : 1);
      units.push({ building: true, dead: false, x0: u.x - half, y0: u.y - half, x1: u.x + half, y1: u.y + half });
    }
    this.pseudo = { towers: towers, units: units, mode: v.mode || 'chaos', map: this.map, touchdown: v.touchdown || null };
    this.pseudoFor = v;
    return this.pseudo;
  };
  GuestDriver.prototype.canPlay = function (slot, x, y) {
    const v = this.cur;
    if (!v) return { ok: false, reason: 'wait' };
    if (v.over) return { ok: false, reason: 'over' };
    const p = v.players[this.localPlayer];
    const id = p && p.hand ? p.hand[slot] : null;
    if (!id) return { ok: false, reason: 'hand' };
    if (this.pending.has(slot)) return { ok: false, reason: 'pending' };
    if (v.mode === 'touchdown' && !CR.UI.cardAllowed(id, 'touchdown').ok) return { ok: false, reason: 'card_banned' };
    const cost = CR.UI.cardInfo(id).elixir || 0;
    const est = (+p.elixir || 0) - this.pending.cost();
    if (est + 1e-6 < cost) return { ok: false, reason: 'elixir' };
    if (CR.Arena && typeof CR.Arena.checkDeploy === 'function') {
      try {
        const r = CR.Arena.checkDeploy(this.localSide, x, y, cardObj(id), this.pseudoSim(v));
        if (r && !r.ok) return { ok: false, reason: r.reason || 'zone' };
      } catch (e) { /* the host validates authoritatively */ }
    } else if (CR.Arena && typeof CR.Arena.isDeployable === 'function') {
      try {
        if (!CR.Arena.isDeployable(this.localSide, x, y, cardObj(id), this.pseudoSim(v))) return { ok: false, reason: 'zone' };
      } catch (e) { /* the host validates authoritatively */ }
    }
    return { ok: true };
  };
  GuestDriver.prototype.play = function (slot, x, y, cardId) {
    const chk = this.canPlay(slot, x, y);
    if (!chk.ok) return chk;
    this.gs.sendCommand({ type: 'play', hand: slot, x: x, y: y, card: cardId });
    this.pending.add(slot, cardId, CR.UI.cardInfo(cardId).elixir || 0, nowMs());
    return { ok: true };
  };
  GuestDriver.prototype.chaosPick = function (option) { this.gs.sendCommand({ type: 'chaos_pick', option: option }); };
  GuestDriver.prototype.emote = function (id) { this.gs.sendCommand({ type: 'emote', id: id }); };
  GuestDriver.prototype.sendCommand = function (cmd) {
    if (!cmd || typeof cmd !== 'object') return { ok: false, reason: 'bad_command' };
    this.gs.sendCommand(cmd);
    return { ok: true };
  };
  GuestDriver.prototype.isPending = function (slot) { return this.pending.has(slot); };
  /** The host rejected a queued play of this slot: release it at once. */
  GuestDriver.prototype.onReject = function (slot) { this.pending.drop(slot); };
  GuestDriver.prototype.pendingCost = function () { return this.pending.cost(); };

  App.LocalDriver = LocalDriver;
  App.GuestDriver = GuestDriver;

  // =========================================================================== wake lock

  const WakeLock = {
    sentinel: null,
    want: false,
    acquire: function () {
      this.want = true;
      const self = this;
      try {
        const nav = G.navigator;
        if (!nav || !nav.wakeLock || typeof nav.wakeLock.request !== 'function') return;
        if (G.document.visibilityState !== 'visible' || this.sentinel) return;
        const p = nav.wakeLock.request('screen');
        if (!p || typeof p.then !== 'function') return;
        p.then(function (s) {
          if (!self.want) { try { s.release(); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ } return; }
          self.sentinel = s;
          if (s && s.addEventListener) s.addEventListener('release', function () { if (self.sentinel === s) self.sentinel = null; });
        }, function () { self.sentinel = null; });
      } catch (e) { this.sentinel = null; }
    },
    release: function () {
      this.want = false;
      const s = this.sentinel;
      this.sentinel = null;
      if (s) {
        try { const p = s.release(); if (p && p.catch) p.catch(function () {}); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
      }
    },
  };

  // ============================================================================= graphics

  let webglState = null;
  /** WebGL probe (cached); the probe context is released at once. */
  function webglOK() {
    if (webglState !== null) return webglState;
    webglState = false;
    try {
      const doc = G.document;
      if (!doc || typeof doc.createElement !== 'function') return false;
      const c = doc.createElement('canvas');
      const gl = c.getContext('webgl2') || c.getContext('webgl') || c.getContext('experimental-webgl');
      webglState = !!gl;
      if (gl && typeof gl.getExtension === 'function') {
        const ext = gl.getExtension('WEBGL_lose_context');
        if (ext) ext.loseContext();
      }
    } catch (e) { webglState = false; }
    return webglState;
  }
  App.webglOK = webglOK;
  /** 3D battle renderer usable: three.js + gfx modules loaded and WebGL works. */
  function gfx3DReady() {
    return !!(CR.GFX && CR.GFX.ready && typeof CR.Render3D === 'function') && webglOK();
  }
  App.gfx3DReady = gfx3DReady;

  /** Frees the WebGL context of a canvas that hosted the 3D renderer. */
  function loseContext(canvas) {
    if (!canvas || typeof canvas.getContext !== 'function') return;
    const types = ['webgl2', 'webgl'];
    for (let i = 0; i < types.length; i++) {
      try {
        const gl = canvas.getContext(types[i]);
        const ext = gl && gl.getExtension && gl.getExtension('WEBGL_lose_context');
        if (ext) { ext.loseContext(); return; }
      } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    }
  }

  // ============================================================================= battle

  /**
   * One running match: screen + renderer + loop around a driver.
   * cfg: { role: 'local'|'host'|'guest', names, mode, speed, gfx: '3d'|'2d', online,
   *        onOver(result), onFinished(result) }
   */
  function Battle(app, driver, cfg) {
    this.app = app;
    this.driver = driver;
    this.cfg = cfg;
    this.role = cfg.role;
    this.online = cfg.online || null;
    this.localSide = driver.localSide;
    this.localPlayer = typeof driver.localPlayer === 'number' ? driver.localPlayer : driver.localSide;
    this.running = false;
    this.music = null;      // current battle track ('battle' | 'overtime')
    this.audioErrors = 0;
    this.raf = 0;
    this.last = 0;          // wall time (ms) up to which the authority has been advanced
    this.lastRaf = 0;       // wall time of the latest animation frame
    this.watchTimer = 0;    // host only: keeps simulating while no frames are painted
    this.endTimer = 0;
    this.overHandled = false;
    this.finished = false;
    this.destroyed = false;
    this.needResize = true;
    this.size = { w: 0, h: 0, dpr: 1 };
    this.renderErrors = 0;
    this.lastView = null;
    this.pauseDialog = null;
    this.obscuredPause = false; // vs AI paused because the rotate hint covers the game
    this.renderer = null;
    this.is3d = false;
    this.knownCanvases = null;  // arena canvases that existed before the current renderer
    // HUD cost per frame (screen.update incl. ChaosUI), ms: running average + worst of the
    // current window. Read via CR.App.state.battle.perf (dev/preview).
    this.perf = { hudAvg: 0, hudMax: 0, hudLast: 0, frames: 0, winMax: 0, winN: 0 };
    const self = this;
    this.screen = CR.UI.BattleScreen(app, {
      localSide: driver.localSide,
      localPlayer: this.localPlayer,
      teamSize: cfg.teamSize || 1,
      names: cfg.names,
      mode: cfg.mode,
      options: cfg.options || null,
      role: cfg.role,
      speed: cfg.speed,
      driver: driver,
      onMenu: function () { self.openMenu(); },
    });
    app.show(this.screen);
    this.drawOpts = { localSide: driver.localSide, localPlayer: this.localPlayer, teamSize: cfg.teamSize || 1, map: cfg.map || 'classic', drag: null, nowMs: 0, w: 0, h: 0, dpr: 1 };
    this._frame = function (t) { self.frame(t); };
    this.createRenderer(cfg.gfx !== '2d' && !!(app.features && app.features.gfx3d));
    this.resize();
    if (cfg.role === 'guest') this.screen.setWaiting('Warte auf Spieldaten …');
  }

  /** 3D (CR.Render3D) when wanted and available, else the 2D canvas renderer. Throws only
   *  when no renderer at all can be created. */
  Battle.prototype.createRenderer = function (want3d) {
    const scr = this.screen;
    const wrap = scr.arenaWrap;
    let r = null;
    let is3d = false;
    const known = [];
    if (wrap && wrap.children) {
      for (let i = 0; i < wrap.children.length; i++) if (wrap.children[i].tagName === 'CANVAS') known.push(wrap.children[i]);
    }
    if (want3d && gfx3DReady()) {
      const c = scr.freshCanvas();
      try {
        r = new CR.Render3D(c);
        is3d = true;
      } catch (e) {
        logError('Render3D', e);
        r = null;
        loseContext(c);
        if (typeof this.app.noteGfxFailure === 'function') this.app.noteGfxFailure(e);
      }
    }
    if (!r) {
      if (typeof CR.Render !== 'function') throw new Error('Kein Grafikmodul verfügbar');
      r = new CR.Render(scr.freshCanvas());
    }
    // Emote bubbles are drawn by the HUD (as drawn faces), not by the renderer.
    // v6: the battle mode (Touchdown field) and map are known before the first frame
    if (typeof r.setOptions === 'function') { try { r.setOptions({ emotes: false, localSide: this.localSide, localPlayer: this.localPlayer, mode: this.cfg.mode || 'chaos', map: this.cfg.map || 'classic' }); } catch (e) { /* optional */ } }
    this.knownCanvases = known;
    this.renderer = r;
    this.is3d = is3d;
    this.renderErrors = 0;
    scr.setRenderer(r);
    scr.el.classList.toggle('is-3d', is3d);
    this.needResize = true;
  };

  Battle.prototype.disposeRenderer = function () {
    const r = this.renderer;
    if (!r) return;
    this.renderer = null;
    const scr = this.screen;
    const canvas = scr.canvas;
    try {
      if (typeof r.dispose === 'function') r.dispose();
      else if (typeof r.destroy === 'function') r.destroy();
    } catch (e) { logError('render dispose', e); }
    if (this.is3d) loseContext(canvas);
    // Extra canvases the renderer added (e.g. the 3D HUD overlay) must not stay on top.
    const wrap = scr.arenaWrap;
    const known = this.knownCanvases || EMPTY;
    if (wrap && wrap.children) {
      const kids = Array.prototype.slice.call(wrap.children);
      for (let i = 0; i < kids.length; i++) {
        const k = kids[i];
        if (k.tagName === 'CANVAS' && k !== canvas && known.indexOf(k) < 0 && k.parentNode) k.parentNode.removeChild(k);
      }
    }
    scr.setRenderer(null);
  };

  /** Live switch between 3D and 2D (pause menu, or automatic after 3D errors). */
  Battle.prototype.switchRenderer = function (want3d) {
    if (this.destroyed) return;
    this.disposeRenderer();
    try { this.createRenderer(want3d); } catch (e) { this.fail(e); return; }
    this.resize();
  };

  Battle.prototype.start = function () {
    if (this.running || this.destroyed) return;
    this.running = true;
    this.last = nowMs();
    this.lastRaf = this.last;
    this.raf = G.requestAnimationFrame(this._frame);
    if (this.role === 'host') {
      // The host is the authority for both players: it must keep simulating (and sending
      // snapshots) whenever animation frames stop - hidden tab, locked screen, or a browser
      // that stops painting while still reporting "visible".
      const self0 = this;
      this.watchTimer = G.setInterval(function () { self0.watch(); }, BG_INTERVAL_MS);
    }
    WakeLock.acquire();
    // VS intro: the authority holds the clock until "Kampf!" (the guest just watches, its
    // host holds the same way).
    const self = this;
    if (this.role !== 'guest') this.driver.hold = true;
    this.screen.playIntro({ onFight: function () { self.releaseHold(); } });
  };

  Battle.prototype.releaseHold = function () {
    const d = this.driver;
    if (!d || !d.hold || this.destroyed) return;
    d.hold = false;
    this.last = nowMs();
    if (d.stepper) d.stepper.reset();
    if (d.bgStepper) d.bgStepper.reset();
  };

  /** Canvas height per width the renderer needs to show the whole field at full width,
   *  measured from its field rect after a resize. A renderer fits the field to the width
   *  whenever the canvas is tall enough, so the widest fill seen (bestFill, per renderer type)
   *  is "full width"; a clearly narrower field means the fit was height-limited, and the fit
   *  then scales with the height: need = h/w * bestFill/fill. null = no correction. */
  App.measureArenaRatio = function (w, h, rect, bestFill) {
    if (!rect || !(w > 0) || !(h > 0) || !(rect.w > 0) || !(rect.h > 0) || !(bestFill > 0)) return null;
    const fill = rect.w / w;
    if (fill >= bestFill - FILL_SLACK) return null;  // (nearly) full width
    return (h / w) * (bestFill / fill);
  };
  const bestFill = { '3d': 0, '2d': 0 };     // widest field fill seen, per renderer type
  const arenaRatios = { '3d': 0, '2d': 0 };  // measured need (0 = UI default), per renderer type

  Battle.prototype.resize = function () {
    if (this.destroyed) return;
    this.layoutSize(0);
  };

  /** Layout -> exact canvas rect -> renderer.resize; one correction pass when the field turns
   *  out height-limited (the hand gives back some height, see UI.battleLayout). */
  Battle.prototype.layoutSize = function (pass) {
    const key = this.is3d ? '3d' : '2d';
    const sz = this.screen.layout({ arenaRatio: arenaRatios[key] || null });
    const dpr = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, G.devicePixelRatio || 1));
    const w = Math.max(1, Math.round(sz.w));
    const h = Math.max(1, Math.round(sz.h));
    this.size.w = w; this.size.h = h; this.size.dpr = dpr;
    const r = this.renderer;
    if (r) { try { r.resize(w, h, dpr); } catch (e) { logError('render resize', e); } }
    if (r && pass === 0 && typeof r.arenaRect === 'function') {
      let ratio = null;
      try {
        const rect = r.arenaRect();
        ratio = App.measureArenaRatio(w, h, rect, bestFill[key]);
        if (rect && rect.w > 0 && rect.w / w > bestFill[key]) bestFill[key] = Math.min(1, rect.w / w);
      } catch (e) { ratio = null; }
      if (ratio && Math.abs(ratio - (arenaRatios[key] || CR.UI.ARENA_RATIO)) > 0.02) {
        arenaRatios[key] = ratio;
        this.layoutSize(1);
        return;
      }
    }
    const c = this.screen.canvas;
    const bw = Math.round(w * dpr); const bh = Math.round(h * dpr);
    if (!this.is3d && c && (c.width !== bw || c.height !== bh)) {
      // Renderer did not size the backing store itself.
      if (c.width === 300 && c.height === 150) { c.width = bw; c.height = bh; }
    }
    this.drawOpts.w = w; this.drawOpts.h = h; this.drawOpts.dpr = dpr;
    this.needResize = false;
  };

  Battle.prototype.frame = function (t) {
    if (!this.running || this.destroyed) return;
    // exactly one pending animation frame, even when frame() is also driven by hand (dev pages)
    if (this.raf) G.cancelAnimationFrame(this.raf);
    this.raf = G.requestAnimationFrame(this._frame);
    this.lastRaf = nowMs();
    let dt = (t - this.last) / 1000;
    if (t > this.last) this.last = t;
    if (!(dt > 0)) dt = 0;
    if (dt > MAX_FRAME_DT) dt = MAX_FRAME_DT;
    if (this.needResize) this.resize();

    let f;
    try { f = this.driver.frame(t, dt); } catch (e) { this.fail(e); return; }
    if (!f || !f.cur) return;
    if (this.role === 'guest' && !this.lastView) this.screen.setWaiting(null);
    this.lastView = f.cur;

    const r = this.renderer;
    const evs = this.driver.takeEvents();
    if (evs.length) {
      try { if (r && r.feedEvents) r.feedEvents(evs); } catch (e) { logError('feedEvents', e); }
      this.screen.handleEvents(evs, t);
    }
    this.audioFrame(evs, f.cur);
    const pf = this.perf;
    const t0 = nowMs();
    const drag = this.screen.update(f.prev, f.cur, f.alpha);
    const hud = nowMs() - t0;
    pf.hudLast = hud;
    pf.frames++;
    pf.hudAvg += (hud - pf.hudAvg) * (pf.frames < 30 ? 1 / pf.frames : 0.03);
    if (hud > pf.winMax) pf.winMax = hud;
    if (++pf.winN >= PERF_WINDOW) { pf.hudMax = pf.winMax; pf.winMax = 0; pf.winN = 0; }
    const o = this.drawOpts;
    o.drag = drag;
    o.nowMs = t;
    if (r) {
      try {
        r.draw(f.prev, f.cur, f.alpha, o);
        this.renderErrors = 0;
      } catch (e) {
        this.renderErrors++;
        if (this.renderErrors === 1) logError('render', e);
        if (this.is3d && this.renderErrors > 5) {
          // A broken 3D frame must not end the match: continue in 2D for this session.
          if (typeof this.app.noteGfxFailure === 'function') this.app.noteGfxFailure(e);
          this.switchRenderer(false);   // silently: no words during the battle (v4)
          return;
        }
        if (this.renderErrors > 30) { this.fail(e); return; }
      }
    }
    this.checkOver();
  };

  /** v5: battle sounds + music through CR.Audio (optional). onEvents(events, side, view,
   *  player) runs every frame (with the view it also ticks the countdown, the full-elixir
   *  bloop and the double / triple elixir intensity); the track is 'battle', 'overtime' in
   *  the overtime. */
  Battle.prototype.audioFrame = function (evs, view) {
    if (this.audioErrors > 30) return;
    const A = CR.UI.audio ? CR.UI.audio() : null;
    if (!A) return;
    if (typeof A.onEvents === 'function') {
      try { A.onEvents(evs, this.localSide, view, this.localPlayer); } catch (e) {
        this.audioErrors++;
        if (this.audioErrors === 1) logError('Audio.onEvents', e);
      }
    }
    const c = view && view.clock;
    const track = view && view.over ? null : (c && c.overtime ? 'overtime' : 'battle');
    if (track !== this.music) {
      this.music = track;
      if (track) CR.UI.music(track);
    }
  };

  Battle.prototype.beginEnd = function (delayMs) {
    this.overHandled = true;
    this.screen.cancelInput();
    if (this.pauseDialog) { this.pauseDialog.close(null); this.pauseDialog = null; }
    const self = this;
    this.endTimer = G.setTimeout(function () { self.endTimer = 0; self.complete(); }, delayMs);
  };

  Battle.prototype.checkOver = function () {
    if (this.overHandled || !this.driver.isOver()) return;
    const res = this.driver.result();
    this.beginEnd(END_DELAY_MS);
    if (this.cfg.onOver) safeCall(this.cfg.onOver, null, [res]);
  };

  /** Authoritative end from the network (guest: gs.onBattleEnd). */
  Battle.prototype.finish = function (result) {
    if (this.finished || this.destroyed) return;
    if (result && typeof result === 'object' && 'resultInfo' in this.driver) this.driver.resultInfo = result;
    if (!this.overHandled) this.beginEnd(1200); // still show the final moment briefly
    else if (!this.endTimer) this.complete();
  };

  Battle.prototype.complete = function () {
    if (this.finished || this.destroyed) return;
    this.finished = true;
    const res = this.driver.result();
    if (this.cfg.onFinished) safeCall(this.cfg.onFinished, null, [res]);
  };

  Battle.prototype.fail = function (e) {
    logError('battle', e);
    if (this.destroyed) return;
    this.stop();
    const app = this.app;
    const msg = errMsg(e);
    // A C.H.A.O.S match that crashes falls back to the basic rules for this session.
    const chaos = this.cfg.mode === 'chaos' && typeof app.disableFeature === 'function';
    if (chaos) app.disableFeature('chaos', 'C.H.A.O.S ist nach einem Fehler für diese Sitzung deaktiviert – es wird nach den Grundregeln gespielt.');
    // v6: a crashing Touchdown match disables Touchdown for this session (C.H.A.O.S stays)
    if (this.cfg.mode === 'touchdown' && typeof app.disableFeature === 'function') app.disableFeature('touchdown', 'Touchdown ist nach einem Fehler für diese Sitzung deaktiviert.');
    // v12: a crashing match on the tunnel map greys that map for this session
    if (this.cfg.map === 'tunnel' && typeof app.disableFeature === 'function') app.disableFeature('tunnel', 'Die Tunnel-Karte ist nach einem Fehler für diese Sitzung deaktiviert.');
    app.dialog({
      title: 'Spielfehler',
      text: 'Der Kampf musste abgebrochen werden.' + (chaos ? ' C.H.A.O.S ist vorerst deaktiviert.' : '') + '\n(' + msg + ')',
      dismissable: false,
      buttons: [{ label: 'Zum Menü', value: 'menu', cls: 'btn-blue' }],
    }).then(function () { app.leaveToMenu(); });
  };

  Battle.prototype.stop = function () {
    this.running = false;
    if (this.raf) { G.cancelAnimationFrame(this.raf); this.raf = 0; }
    if (this.watchTimer) { G.clearInterval(this.watchTimer); this.watchTimer = 0; }
    WakeLock.release();
  };

  /** Host fallback timer: when the tab is hidden or no animation frame arrived for a while,
   *  advance the simulation on wall time (capped per call). Frames and this timer share
   *  `this.last`, so no time is simulated twice. */
  Battle.prototype.watch = function () {
    if (!this.running || this.destroyed || this.overHandled) return;
    const t = nowMs();
    // Step in the background only when requestAnimationFrame has really stalled. Some hosts
    // (embedded panes) report document.hidden while still painting; stepping here as well
    // would run the match at double speed.
    if (t - this.lastRaf < RAF_STALL_MS) return;
    let dt = (t - this.last) / 1000;
    this.last = t;
    if (!(dt > 0)) return;
    if (dt > BG_MAX_CATCHUP_S) dt = BG_MAX_CATCHUP_S;
    try { this.driver.background(dt); } catch (e) { this.fail(e); return; }
    this.driver.takeEvents(); // nothing is painted meanwhile
    this.lastView = this.driver.cur;
    this.checkOver();
  };

  Battle.prototype.onHidden = function () {
    if (this.running && this.role === 'host') this.watch();
  };

  Battle.prototype.onVisible = function () {
    if (!this.running) return;
    // Never fast-forward time during which the page was frozen: continue where it stopped.
    this.last = nowMs();
    this.lastRaf = this.last;
    if (this.driver.stepper) this.driver.stepper.reset();
    if (this.driver.bgStepper) this.driver.bgStepper.reset();
    this.needResize = true;
    WakeLock.acquire();
    if (this.role === 'guest' && this.driver.gs && typeof this.driver.gs.resync === 'function') {
      safeCall(this.driver.gs.resync, this.driver.gs);
    }
  };

  Battle.prototype.openMenu = function () {
    if (this.pauseDialog || this.settingsSheet || this.overHandled) return;
    const self = this;
    const local = this.role === 'local';
    if (local) this.driver.paused = true;
    const app = this.app;
    const buttons = [
      { label: 'Weiter', value: 'resume', cls: 'btn-green' },
      { label: 'Einstellungen', value: 'settings', cls: 'btn-blue' },
      { label: app.settings.muted ? 'Ton einschalten' : 'Ton ausschalten', value: 'mute', cls: 'btn-grey' },
    ];
    if (app.features && app.features.gfx3d) {
      buttons.push({ label: this.is3d ? 'Grafik: 2D (sparsam)' : 'Grafik: 3D', value: 'gfx', cls: 'btn-grey' });
    }
    buttons.push({ label: local ? 'Kampf beenden' : 'Spiel verlassen', value: 'leave', cls: 'btn-red' });
    const d = app.dialog({
      title: local ? 'Pause' : 'Menü',
      text: local ? '' : 'Das Spiel läuft weiter, während dieses Menü offen ist.',
      buttons: buttons,
    });
    this.pauseDialog = d;
    d.then(function (v) {
      self.pauseDialog = null;
      if (self.destroyed) return;
      if (v === 'mute') {
        app.setMuted(!app.settings.muted);
        self.openMenu();
        return;
      }
      if (v === 'settings') {
        // v5: the full settings screen over the (paused) battle; back to the pause menu after
        self.settingsSheet = CR.UI.openSettings(app, {
          inBattle: true,
          onGfx: function (id) {
            const want3d = id === '3d' && !!(app.features && app.features.gfx3d);
            if (want3d !== self.is3d) self.switchRenderer(want3d);
          },
          onClose: function () {
            self.settingsSheet = null;
            if (!self.destroyed && !self.overHandled) self.openMenu();
          },
        });
        return;
      }
      if (v === 'leave') { app.leaveToMenu(); return; }
      if (v === 'gfx') {
        const want3d = !self.is3d;
        app.setGfx(want3d ? '3d' : '2d');
        self.switchRenderer(want3d);
      }
      if (local) {
        self.driver.paused = false;
        self.last = nowMs();
      }
    });
  };

  /** The game is hidden behind the "rotate your phone" hint: a local match pauses until the
   *  phone is back in portrait (an online match cannot pause). */
  Battle.prototype.setObscured = function (obscured) {
    if (this.role !== 'local' || this.destroyed || this.overHandled) return;
    if (obscured) {
      if (!this.driver.paused) { this.driver.paused = true; this.obscuredPause = true; }
    } else if (this.obscuredPause) {
      this.obscuredPause = false;
      if (!this.pauseDialog) { this.driver.paused = false; this.last = nowMs(); }
    }
  };

  Battle.prototype.setNetStatus = function (s) {
    if (this.destroyed) return;
    const st = s && s.state;
    const app = this.app;
    const who = this.role === 'host' ? 'Gegner' : 'Gastgeber';
    // wordless banners (icon + home button); the German text is the accessible label
    const leave = function () { app.leaveToMenu(); };
    if (st === 'lost') this.screen.setNetBanner('Verbindung zum ' + who + ' unterbrochen – verbinde neu …', 'Menü', leave, 'lost');
    else if (st === 'error') this.screen.setNetBanner(s.message ? String(s.message) : 'Verbindungsfehler – das Spiel ist beendet.', 'Menü', leave, 'error');
    else if (st === 'waiting' && this.role === 'host') this.screen.setNetBanner('Dein Gegner hat das Spiel verlassen.', 'Menü', leave, 'left');
    else this.screen.setNetBanner(null);
  };

  Battle.prototype.destroy = function () {
    if (this.destroyed) return;
    this.stop();
    this.destroyed = true;
    if (this.endTimer) { G.clearTimeout(this.endTimer); this.endTimer = 0; }
    if (this.pauseDialog) { this.pauseDialog.close(null); this.pauseDialog = null; }
    if (this.settingsSheet) { const sh = this.settingsSheet; this.settingsSheet = null; try { sh.el && sh.el.parentNode && sh.el.parentNode.removeChild(sh.el); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ } }
    this.disposeRenderer();
    try { this.screen.destroy(); } catch (e) { logError('screen destroy', e); }
  };

  App.Battle = Battle;

  // ================================================================================ app

  const LOAD_MIN_MS = 700;     // the splash never just flashes
  const LOAD_MAX_MS = 6500;    // after this the menu opens; remaining portraits render in the background
  const GFX_WAIT_MS = 1500;    // max wait for CR.GFX.ready at boot

  /** Card ids in portrait pre-render order: the own deck first, then the collection. */
  App.portraitOrder = function (deck, all) {
    const out = [];
    const add = function (list) {
      for (let i = 0; i < (list || EMPTY).length; i++) {
        const id = list[i];
        if (typeof id === 'string' && out.indexOf(id) < 0) out.push(id);
      }
    };
    add(deck);
    add(all);
    return out;
  };

  let started = false;

  App.start = function (rootEl) {
    if (started) return App.state;
    started = true;
    const UI = CR.UI;
    const doc = G.document;
    const root = rootEl || doc.body;
    if (!UI || typeof UI.MenuScreen !== 'function') {
      root.textContent = 'Bust War konnte nicht geladen werden (UI-Modul fehlt).';
      return null;
    }
    const h = UI.h;
    root.textContent = '';
    const stage = h('div', { class: 'stage' }, h('div', { class: 'stage-bg', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }, h('div', { class: 'stage-rays' })));
    root.appendChild(stage);
    const rhIcon = h('div', { class: 'rh-icon' });
    rhIcon.innerHTML = UI.ICON.phone;
    const rotateHint = h('div', { class: 'rotate-hint' }, [rhIcon, h('div', null, 'Bitte drehe dein Handy ins Hochformat')]);
    root.appendChild(rotateHint);
    function isObscured() {
      try { return G.getComputedStyle(rotateHint).display !== 'none'; } catch (e) { return false; }
    }

    const store = UI.store;
    // v12: one-time migration (Spieltempo default 1,5x -> Original 1x unless the player chose it)
    try { UI.migrateSettings(store); } catch (e) { logError('migrateSettings', e); }
    const settings = UI.normalizeSettings({
      name: store.get('name', ''),
      playType: store.get('playType', 'single'),
      difficulty: store.get('difficulty', 'normal'),
      speed: store.get('speed', UI.DEFAULT_SPEED),
      gfx: store.get('gfx', '3d'),
      muted: store.get('muted', false),
      haptics: store.get('haptics', true),
      musicVol: store.get('musicVol', null),
      sfxVol: store.get('sfxVol', null),
      map: store.get('map', 'classic'),
      teamSize: store.get('teamSize', 1),
      duoTeamSize: store.get('duoTeamSize', null),
      gameMode: store.get('gameMode', 'chaos'),
      tdChaos: store.get('tdChaos', false),
      tdDraft: store.get('tdDraft', true),
      elixirBoost: store.get('elixirBoost', false),
    });
    UI.Sound.muted = settings.muted;
    UI.Sound.setVolume(settings.sfxVol);
    UI.haptics = settings.haptics;
    // v5: the app settings are the source of truth for CR.Audio (it persists its own copy)
    function pushAudioSettings() {
      UI.audioSet('music', settings.musicVol);
      UI.audioSet('sfx', settings.sfxVol);
      UI.audioSet('muted', settings.muted);
    }
    pushAudioSettings();

    const app = {
      root: root,
      stage: stage,
      settings: settings,
      features: null,
      screen: null,
      battle: null,
      online: null,
      dialogs: [],
      lastVsAI: null,
      draft: null,      // v7: running Touchdown draft { run?, screen, timer, online? }
    };
    App.state = app;

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- features

    function detectFeatures() {
      const f = { data: false, play: false, ai: false, net: false, chaos: false, gfx3d: false, hill: false, tunnel: false, team2: false, touchdown: false, draft: false, audio: !!UI.audio(), notes: {} };
      const cat = UI.catalog();
      f.data = cat.enabled.length >= 8;
      if (!f.data) f.notes.data = 'Kartendaten fehlen oder sind unvollständig – Spielen ist nicht möglich.';
      f.gfx3d = gfx3DReady();
      if (!f.gfx3d) {
        if (!G.THREE) f.notes.gfx3d = 'Die 3D-Grafik (three.js) wurde nicht geladen – es wird 2D verwendet.';
        else if (!webglOK()) f.notes.gfx3d = 'Dieses Gerät unterstützt kein WebGL – es wird 2D verwendet.';
        else f.notes.gfx3d = 'Die 3D-Grafik ist noch nicht verfügbar – es wird 2D verwendet.';
      }
      const hasSim = typeof CR.Sim === 'function';
      const hasRender = typeof CR.Render === 'function' || f.gfx3d;
      f.play = f.data && hasSim && hasRender;
      if (!hasSim) f.notes.play = 'Die Spiel-Engine wurde nicht geladen.';
      else if (!hasRender) f.notes.play = 'Das Grafikmodul wurde nicht geladen.';
      else if (!f.data) f.notes.play = f.notes.data;
      const deck = UI.defaultDeck();
      // Probe the engine once so a broken module disables its button instead of crashing later.
      if (f.play) {
        try {
          const s = new CR.Sim({ seed: 7, mode: 'classic', decks: [deck, deck], names: ['A', 'B'] });
          for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) s.tick();
          s.view();
        } catch (e) {
          logError('engine probe', e);
          f.play = false;
          f.notes.play = 'Die Spiel-Engine meldet einen Fehler: ' + errMsg(e);
        }
      }
      if (!f.play) {
        f.notes.ai = f.notes.play || 'Spielen ist gerade nicht möglich.';
        f.notes.net = f.notes.ai;
        f.notes.chaos = f.notes.ai;
        f.notes.touchdown = f.notes.ai;
        return f;
      }
      if (CR.Chaos) {
        try {
          const s = new CR.Sim({ seed: 13, mode: 'chaos', decks: [deck, deck], names: ['A', 'B'], options: { bots: [1] } });
          for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) s.tick();
          s.view();
          f.chaos = true;
        } catch (e) {
          logError('chaos probe', e);
          f.notes.chaos = 'Der C.H.A.O.S-Modus meldet einen Fehler – es wird nach den Grundregeln gespielt.';
        }
      } else {
        f.notes.chaos = 'Das C.H.A.O.S-Modul wurde nicht geladen – es wird nach den Grundregeln gespielt.';
      }
      if (typeof CR.AI === 'function') {
        try {
          const mode = f.chaos ? 'chaos' : 'classic';
          const s = new CR.Sim({ seed: 11, mode: mode, decks: [deck, deck], names: ['A', 'B'], options: { bots: [1] } });
          const bot = new CR.AI({ side: 1, level: 'normal', seed: 11 });
          for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { bot.update(s); s.tick(); }
          f.ai = true;
        } catch (e) {
          logError('AI probe', e);
          f.notes.ai = 'Die KI meldet einen Fehler und ist deaktiviert.';
        }
      } else {
        f.notes.ai = 'Das KI-Modul wurde nicht geladen – der Single-Modus ist deaktiviert.';
      }
      probeV5(f, deck);
      probeTouchdown(f, deck);
      probeDraft(f);
      if (CR.Net && typeof CR.Net.hostGame === 'function' && typeof CR.Net.joinGame === 'function' && typeof CR.Net.newCode === 'function') {
        f.net = true;
      } else {
        f.notes.net = 'Das Netzwerkmodul wurde nicht geladen – Spielen mit Freunden ist deaktiviert.';
      }
      return f;
    }

    /** v5 probes: the hill map (sim + CR.Arena.setMap) and 2v2 (sim with four players + an
     *  AI that drives a given player). Each failure only disables that option. */
    function probeV5(f, deck) {
      const mode = f.chaos ? 'chaos' : 'classic';
      if (CR.Arena && typeof CR.Arena.setMap === 'function') {
        try {
          const s = new CR.Sim({ seed: 21, mode: 'classic', map: 'hill', decks: [deck, deck], names: ['A', 'B'] });
          for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) s.tick();
          const v = s.view();
          f.hill = v.map === 'hill' || CR.Arena.map === 'hill';
          if (!f.hill) f.notes.hill = 'Die Hügel-Karte ist in dieser Version noch nicht verfügbar.';
        } catch (e) {
          logError('hill probe', e);
          f.notes.hill = 'Die Hügel-Karte meldet einen Fehler und ist deaktiviert.';
        }
        // v12: the tunnel map (flat field, two holes + underground tunnel)
        try {
          const s = new CR.Sim({ seed: 25, mode: 'classic', map: 'tunnel', decks: [deck, deck], names: ['A', 'B'] });
          for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) s.tick();
          const v = s.view();
          f.tunnel = v.map === 'tunnel' || CR.Arena.map === 'tunnel';
          if (!f.tunnel) f.notes.tunnel = 'Die Tunnel-Karte ist in dieser Version noch nicht verfügbar.';
        } catch (e) {
          logError('tunnel probe', e);
          f.notes.tunnel = 'Die Tunnel-Karte meldet einen Fehler und ist deaktiviert.';
        }
        App.applyMap('classic');
      } else {
        f.notes.hill = 'Die Hügel-Karte ist in dieser Version noch nicht verfügbar.';
        f.notes.tunnel = 'Die Tunnel-Karte ist in dieser Version noch nicht verfügbar.';
      }
      if (!f.ai) { f.notes.team2 = f.notes.ai || '2 gegen 2 braucht die KI.'; return; }
      try {
        const players = [0, 1, 2, 3].map(function (i) { return { name: 'P' + i, deck: deck, side: i < 2 ? 0 : 1, bot: i > 0 }; });
        const s = new CR.Sim({ seed: 23, mode: mode, map: 'classic', players: players, options: { bots: [1, 2, 3] } });
        const bot = new CR.AI({ player: 3, side: 1, level: 'normal', seed: 23 });
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { bot.update(s); s.tick(); }
        const v = s.view();
        const engine = Array.isArray(s.players) && s.players.length === 4 && v.players && v.players.length === 4 && v.players[3].side === 1;
        const ai = bot.player === 3 || bot.playerIndex === 3;
        f.team2 = engine && ai;
        if (!f.team2) f.notes.team2 = '2 gegen 2 ist in dieser Version noch nicht verfügbar.';
      } catch (e) {
        logError('2v2 probe', e);
        f.notes.team2 = '2 gegen 2 meldet einen Fehler und ist deaktiviert.';
      }
    }

    /** v6 probe: Touchdown (sim with mode 'touchdown' reports view.mode + view.touchdown). */
    function probeTouchdown(f, deck) {
      try {
        const d = UI.deckForMode(deck, 'touchdown');
        const s = new CR.Sim({ seed: 31, mode: 'touchdown', map: 'classic', decks: [d, d], names: ['A', 'B'], options: { bots: [1], chaos: false } });
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) s.tick();
        const v = s.view();
        f.touchdown = v.mode === 'touchdown' && !!v.touchdown && Array.isArray(v.touchdown.score);
        if (!f.touchdown) f.notes.touchdown = 'Touchdown ist in dieser Version noch nicht verfügbar.';
      } catch (e) {
        logError('touchdown probe', e);
        f.touchdown = false;
        f.notes.touchdown = 'Touchdown meldet einen Fehler und ist deaktiviert.';
      }
      App.applyMode('chaos');
      App.applyMap('classic');
    }

    /** v7 probe: the Touchdown draft module drafts two full decks (bots only). */
    function probeDraft(f) {
      if (!f.touchdown || !CR.Draft || typeof CR.Draft.create !== 'function') { f.notes.draft = 'Der Draft ist in dieser Version nicht verfügbar.'; return; }
      try {
        let t = 0;
        const run = new DraftRun({ players: [{ side: 0, bot: true }, { side: 1, bot: true }], seed: 41, botMs: [0, 1], now: function () { return t; } });
        for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !run.done(); i++) { t += 5; run.tick(t); }
        const dk = run.decks();
        f.draft = run.done() && dk.length === 2 && dk[0].length === 8 && dk[1].length === 8;
        if (!f.draft) f.notes.draft = 'Der Draft meldet einen Fehler und ist deaktiviert.';
      } catch (e) {
        logError('draft probe', e);
        f.draft = false;
        f.notes.draft = 'Der Draft meldet einen Fehler und ist deaktiviert.';
      }
    }

    function disableFeature(key, note) {
      const f = app.features;
      if (!f) return;
      const keys = key === 'play' ? ['play', 'ai', 'net', 'chaos', 'touchdown'] : [key];
      for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
        f[keys[i]] = false;
        f.notes[keys[i]] = note;
      }
    }

    app.disableFeature = disableFeature;
    /** A 3D failure switches this session to the 2D renderer. */
    app.noteGfxFailure = function (e) {
      if (!app.features || !app.features.gfx3d) return;
      logError('3D graphics', e);
      app.features.gfx3d = false;
      app.features.notes.gfx3d = '3D-Grafik hatte einen Fehler – für diese Sitzung wird 2D verwendet.';
    };

    /** Biggest view on Android phones: element fullscreen (hides the browser bars) on the tap
     *  that starts a match. iPhones have no element fullscreen - there the menu explains
     *  'Zum Home-Bildschirm' (standalone, see index.html). Never throws. */
    app.goFullscreen = function () {
      try {
        if (UI.isStandalone && UI.isStandalone()) return;
        if (doc.fullscreenElement || doc.webkitFullscreenElement) return;
        const nav = G.navigator || {};
        if (/iPhone|iPad|iPod/i.test(String(nav.userAgent || ''))) return;
        if (!(G.matchMedia && G.matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches)) return;
        const el = doc.documentElement;
        const fn = el.requestFullscreen || el.webkitRequestFullscreen;
        if (typeof fn !== 'function') return;
        const p = fn.call(el, { navigationUI: 'hide' });
        if (p && typeof p.catch === 'function') p.catch(function () { /* not allowed here (iframe) */ });
      } catch (e) { /* optional */ }
    };

    /** v2: the C.H.A.O.S rules; the basic rules only when the module is broken/missing.
     *  v6: Touchdown when chosen (gm, else the menu setting) and available.
     *  v12: 'classic' when chosen (Klassisch, ohne C.H.A.O.S). */
    function battleMode(gm) {
      const g = gm || settings.gameMode;
      if (g === 'touchdown' && app.features.touchdown) return 'touchdown';
      if (g === 'classic') return 'classic';
      return app.features.chaos ? 'chaos' : 'classic';
    }
    /** v12: the map a battle uses (a map this build cannot play -> 'classic'). */
    function battleMap(m) { return UI.allowedMap(m, app.features); }
    app.battleMap = battleMap;
    /** v6: options of the battle mode (Touchdown: {chaos} = with C.H.A.O.S upgrades). */
    function battleOptions(mode, tdChaos, tdDraft, boost) {
      // v13: + "Schnelles Elixier" (boost: bool; default = the menu setting)
      const eb = boost != null ? !!boost : !!settings.elixirBoost;
      return App.modeOptions(mode, { chaos: !!(tdChaos && app.features.chaos), draft: tdDraft !== false && !!app.features.draft, elixirBoost: eb ? UI.ELIXIR_BOOST : 0 });
    }
    app.battleMode = battleMode;
    function wantGfx() { return settings.gfx === '2d' || !app.features.gfx3d ? '2d' : '3d'; }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- settings

    app.getDeckDraft = function () {
      const d = store.get('deck', null);
      return Array.isArray(d) ? d.filter(function (x) { return typeof x === 'string'; }) : UI.defaultDeck();
    };
    app.getDeck = function () { return UI.sanitizeDeck(app.getDeckDraft(), UI.defaultDeck()); };
    app.setDeck = function (ids) { store.set('deck', (ids || EMPTY).slice(0, 8)); };
    app.setName = function (n) {
      const v = UI.sanitizeName(n) || 'Spieler';
      settings.name = v;
      store.set('name', v);
    };
    app.setPlayType = function (t) {
      settings.playType = t === 'duo' ? 'duo' : 'single';
      store.set('playType', settings.playType);
    };
    app.setDifficulty = function (d) {
      if (['leicht', 'normal', 'schwer'].indexOf(d) < 0) return;
      settings.difficulty = d;
      store.set('difficulty', d);
    };
    app.setSpeed = function (s) {
      settings.speed = UI.normalizeSettings({ speed: s }).speed;
      store.set('speed', settings.speed);
      store.set('speedChosen', true);   // v12: a picked tempo is never migrated
    };
    app.setGfx = function (g) {
      settings.gfx = g === '2d' ? '2d' : '3d';
      store.set('gfx', settings.gfx);
    };
    app.setMuted = function (b) {
      settings.muted = !!b;
      UI.Sound.muted = settings.muted;
      store.set('muted', settings.muted);
      UI.audioSet('muted', settings.muted);
      if (!settings.muted) UI.musicRefresh();
    };
    /** live = while the slider moves (CR.Audio only, stored at the end) */
    app.setMusicVol = function (v, live) {
      const n = UI.normalizeSettings({ musicVol: v }).musicVol;
      UI.audioSet('music', n);
      if (live) return;
      settings.musicVol = n;
      store.set('musicVol', n);
    };
    app.setSfxVol = function (v, live) {
      const n = UI.normalizeSettings({ sfxVol: v }).sfxVol;
      UI.audioSet('sfx', n);
      UI.Sound.setVolume(n);
      if (live) return;
      settings.sfxVol = n;
      store.set('sfxVol', n);
    };
    app.setMap = function (m) {
      settings.map = UI.normMap(m);
      store.set('map', settings.map);
    };
    /** v6: Spielmodus C.H.A.O.S / Touchdown + "Touchdown mit C.H.A.O.S-Upgrades" (remembered). */
    app.setGameMode = function (m, tdChaos, tdDraft) {
      settings.gameMode = UI.normGameMode(m);
      store.set('gameMode', settings.gameMode);
      if (tdChaos != null) {
        settings.tdChaos = !!tdChaos;
        store.set('tdChaos', settings.tdChaos);
      }
      if (tdDraft != null) {
        settings.tdDraft = !!tdDraft;
        store.set('tdDraft', settings.tdDraft);
      }
    };
    /** v13: "Schnelles Elixier (1,5×)" (remembered per device, default off). */
    app.setElixirBoost = function (b) {
      settings.elixirBoost = !!b;
      store.set('elixirBoost', settings.elixirBoost);
    };
    app.setTeamSize = function (n) {
      settings.teamSize = UI.normTeamSize(n);
      store.set('teamSize', settings.teamSize);
    };
    /** "Mit Freunden": 1 gegen 1 / 2 gegen 2 chosen in the menu (remembered). */
    app.setDuoTeamSize = function (n) {
      settings.duoTeamSize = UI.normTeamSize(n);
      store.set('duoTeamSize', settings.duoTeamSize);
    };
    app.setHaptics = function (b) {
      settings.haptics = !!b;
      UI.haptics = settings.haptics;
      store.set('haptics', settings.haptics);
    };

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- screens

    app.dialog = function (opts) {
      const d = UI.dialog(stage, opts);
      app.dialogs.push(d);
      d.then(function () {
        const i = app.dialogs.indexOf(d);
        if (i >= 0) app.dialogs.splice(i, 1);
      });
      return d;
    };

    function closeOverlays() {
      const ds = app.dialogs.slice();
      for (let i = 0; i < ds.length; i++) ds[i].close(null);
      const extra = stage.querySelectorAll('.sheet-backdrop, .overlay');
      for (let i = 0; i < extra.length; i++) extra[i].parentNode.removeChild(extra[i]);
    }

    app.show = function (screen) {
      const old = app.screen;
      if (old && old !== screen) {
        try { if (old.destroy) old.destroy(); } catch (e) { logError('screen destroy', e); }
        if (old.el && old.el.parentNode) old.el.parentNode.removeChild(old.el);
      }
      closeOverlays();
      app.screen = screen;
      stage.appendChild(screen.el);
      const cl = screen.el && screen.el.classList;
      const inBattle = !!(cl && cl.contains('screen-battle'));
      // the animated menu backdrop is fully covered in battle: stop it (no hidden GPU work)
      stage.classList.toggle('in-battle', inBattle);
      // v5: the deck editor uses the whole window (no portrait column on wide screens)
      stage.classList.toggle('is-wide', !!(cl && cl.contains('is-wide')));
      // music: menu track on menu screens, none on the result / loading screen; the battle
      // switches its own track (Battle.audioFrame)
      if (!inBattle) UI.music(cl && (cl.contains('screen-result') || cl.contains('screen-loading')) ? null : 'menu');
    };

    function endBattle() {
      stopDraft();
      if (app.battle) {
        app.battle.destroy();
        app.battle = null;
      }
      if (UI.Art && UI.Art.setHold) UI.Art.setHold(false);
    }
    /** v7: ends a running draft (its timer; the screen goes with the next app.show). */
    function stopDraft() {
      const d = app.draft;
      app.draft = null;
      if (!d) return;
      if (d.timer) { G.clearInterval(d.timer); d.timer = 0; }
      if (d.doneTimer) { G.clearTimeout(d.doneTimer); d.doneTimer = 0; }
      d.stopped = true;
    }

    /**
     * v7: the Touchdown draft before a battle (Single-Modus and online host). players =
     * [{name, side, bot}] in player index order; the local player is 0. Bots pick after a
     * short think, humans have CR.Draft.PICK_MS (then auto-pick). onDone(decks) once both
     * decks are full (after a short "Deck fertig" moment). o = { seed, hs (online host),
     * online, onPublish(run) }.
     */
    function runDraft(players, o, onDone) {
      stopDraft();
      const names = players.map(function (p, i) { return UI.sanitizeName(p.name) || (p.bot ? 'KI' : 'Spieler ' + (i + 1)); });
      const run = new DraftRun({ players: players, seed: o.seed });
      const d = { run: run, screen: null, timer: 0, doneTimer: 0, online: o.online || null, stopped: false };
      const screen = UI.DraftScreen(app, {
        localPlayer: 0,
        names: names,
        online: !!o.online,
        onPick: function (choice, round) {
          if (d.stopped) return;
          const r = run.pick(0, choice, round);
          if (!r.ok) d.screen.setState(run.snapshot(), run.timing(0));
        },
        onLeave: function () { app.leaveToMenu(); },
      });
      d.screen = screen;
      app.draft = d;
      app.show(screen);
      function publish() {
        if (d.stopped) return;
        const snap = run.snapshot();
        screen.setState(snap, run.timing(0));
        if (o.onPublish) safeCall(o.onPublish, null, [run, snap]);
        if (run.done() && !d.doneTimer) {
          d.doneTimer = G.setTimeout(function () {
            d.doneTimer = 0;
            if (d.stopped || app.draft !== d) return;
            const decks = run.decks();
            stopDraft();
            onDone(decks);
          }, DRAFT_DONE_MS);
        }
      }
      run.onChange = publish;
      d.timer = G.setInterval(function () { if (!d.stopped) run.tick(nowMs()); }, 100);
      publish();
      return d;
    }
    app.runDraft = runDraft;

    function leaveOnline() {
      const o = app.online;
      app.online = null;
      if (!o) return;
      const s = o.hs || o.gs;
      if (s && typeof s.close === 'function') safeCall(s.close, s);
    }

    function clearJoinHash() {
      try {
        if (UI.joinCodeFromHash(G.location.hash) && G.history && G.history.replaceState) {
          G.history.replaceState(null, '', G.location.pathname + G.location.search);
        }
      } catch (e) { /* sandboxed: ignore */ }
    }

    app.showMenu = function () {
      endBattle();
      app.show(UI.MenuScreen(app));
    };
    app.leaveToMenu = function () {
      endBattle();
      leaveOnline();
      clearJoinHash();
      app.showMenu();
    };
    app.showDeck = function () {
      if (!app.features.data) return;
      app.show(UI.DeckScreen(app));
    };
    app.showRules = function () { app.show(UI.RulesScreen(app)); };

    function featureBlocked(key) {
      if (app.features[key]) return false;
      UI.toast(stage, app.features.notes[key] || 'Gerade nicht verfügbar.');
      return true;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- battles

    function runBattle(driver, cfg) {
      endBattle();
      let battle;
      if (!cfg.gfx) cfg.gfx = wantGfx();
      try {
        battle = new Battle(app, driver, cfg);
      } catch (e) {
        logError('battle start', e);
        disableFeature('play', 'Das Grafikmodul meldet einen Fehler: ' + errMsg(e));
        app.dialog({ title: 'Start nicht möglich', text: 'Die Arena konnte nicht angezeigt werden.\n(' + errMsg(e) + ')', buttons: [{ label: 'OK', value: true }] })
          .then(function () { app.leaveToMenu(); });
        return null;
      }
      app.battle = battle;
      holdPortraits(cfg.decks);
      battle.start();
      battle.setObscured(isObscured());
      return battle;
    }

    /** No portrait renders while a battle runs (each is a synchronous WebGL draw + PNG encode
     *  = a dropped frame). Missing art of both decks is queued as urgent and may still render
     *  during the VS intro, while the simulation is held; the rest waits for the battle end. */
    function holdPortraits(decks) {
      const Art = UI.Art;
      if (!Art || typeof Art.setHold !== 'function') return;
      const ids = [];
      const add = function (list) { if (Array.isArray(list)) for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) if (typeof list[i] === 'string') ids.push(list[i]); };
      if (Array.isArray(decks)) { for (let i = 0; i < decks.length; i++) add(decks[i]); } else add(app.getDeck());
      for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) if (!Art.has(ids[i]) && Art.available()) Art.load(ids[i], true);
      Art.setHold(true, UI.VS_MS || 1700);
    }

    function showResult(res, ctx) {
      endBattle();
      const outcome = UI.outcome(res.winner, ctx.localSide);
      UI.Sound.play(outcome);
      UI.vibrate(outcome === 'win' ? [30, 60, 30, 60, 80] : 40);
      const crowns = res.crowns || [0, 0];
      const reason = App.resultReason(res, ctx.localSide);
      const scr = UI.ResultScreen(app, {
        outcome: outcome,
        names: ctx.names,
        crowns: crowns,
        localSide: ctx.localSide,
        online: ctx.role !== 'local',
        role: ctx.role,
        reason: reason,
        touchdown: res.mode === 'touchdown' ? { target: res.target || UI.touchdownTarget(null) } : null,
        onRematch: ctx.onRematch,
        onMenu: function () { app.leaveToMenu(); },
      });
      app.show(scr);
      return scr;
    }

    // Single-Modus (vs bot) ---------------------------------------------------
    /** v5: 1v1 = you vs a bot; 2v2 = you + bot (team Blau) vs two bots (team Rot). */
    app.startVsAI = function (rematch) {
      app.goFullscreen();
      if (featureBlocked('ai')) return;
      leaveOnline();
      clearJoinHash();
      const level = settings.difficulty;
      const mode = battleMode();
      const options = battleOptions(mode, settings.tdChaos, settings.tdDraft);
      const speed = settings.speed;
      const map = battleMap(settings.map);
      const two = app.features.team2 && settings.teamSize === 2;
      // v6: cards the mode does not allow are swapped for this battle (own deck stays)
      const myDeck = UI.deckForMode(app.getDeck(), mode);
      const last = rematch && app.lastVsAI && app.lastVsAI.two === two && app.lastVsAI.mode === mode ? app.lastVsAI : null;
      const diff = UI.DIFFICULTIES.filter(function (d) { return d.id === level; })[0];
      const botName = 'KI · ' + (diff ? diff.label : 'Normal');
      let players;
      if (two) {
        const decks = last ? last.decks : [0, 1, 2].map(function () { return UI.deckForMode(App.pickAiDeck(myDeck), mode); });
        players = [
          { name: settings.name, deck: myDeck, side: 0, bot: false },
          { name: 'Partner-KI', deck: decks[0], side: 0, bot: true, level: level },
          { name: botName, deck: decks[1], side: 1, bot: true, level: level },
          { name: botName, deck: decks[2], side: 1, bot: true, level: level },
        ];
      } else {
        const aiDeck = last ? last.decks[0] : UI.deckForMode(App.pickAiDeck(myDeck), mode);
        players = [
          { name: settings.name, deck: myDeck, side: 0, bot: false },
          { name: botName, deck: aiDeck, side: 1, bot: true, level: level },
        ];
      }
      const names = App.teamNames(players);
      const seed = randomSeed();
      // v7: Touchdown mit Draft - both (all four) decks come from the draft first
      if (App.wantsDraft(mode, options) && app.features.draft) {
        runDraft(players, { seed: seed }, function (decks) {
          for (let i = 0; i < players.length; i++) if (decks[i] && decks[i].length === 8) players[i].deck = decks[i];
          launchVsAI();
        });
        return;
      }
      launchVsAI();
      function launchVsAI() {
        let driver;
        try {
          // bots: the C.H.A.O.S module picks the bots' upgrades (options.bots from the players).
          driver = new LocalDriver({ seed: seed, mode: mode, options: options, map: map, players: players, localPlayer: 0, aiLevel: level, speed: speed });
        } catch (e) {
          logError('vsAI start', e);
          if (map === 'tunnel') disableFeature('tunnel', 'Die Tunnel-Karte meldet einen Fehler und ist deaktiviert.');
          else if (mode === 'touchdown') disableFeature('touchdown', 'Touchdown meldet einen Fehler und ist deaktiviert.');
          else if (two) disableFeature('team2', '2 gegen 2 meldet einen Fehler und ist deaktiviert.');
          else if (mode === 'chaos') disableFeature('chaos', 'Der C.H.A.O.S-Modus meldet einen Fehler – es wird nach den Grundregeln gespielt.');
          else disableFeature('ai', 'Die KI meldet einen Fehler und ist deaktiviert.');
          app.dialog({ title: 'Start nicht möglich', text: errMsg(e), buttons: [{ label: 'OK', value: true }] })
            .then(function () { app.showMenu(); });
          return;
        }
        app.lastVsAI = { two: two, mode: mode, decks: players.slice(1).map(function (p) { return p.deck; }) };
        driver.onBotError = function () {
          disableFeature('ai', 'Die KI meldet einen Fehler und ist deaktiviert.');
          if (app.battle) app.battle.screen.showMessage('Die KI hat einen Fehler und pausiert.', 'is-warn');
        };
        runBattle(driver, {
          role: 'local',
          names: names,
          decks: players.map(function (p) { return p.deck; }),
          mode: mode,
          options: options,
          map: map,
          teamSize: two ? 2 : 1,
          speed: speed,
          onFinished: function (res) {
            showResult(res, {
              role: 'local',
              localSide: 0,
              names: names,
              onRematch: function () { app.startVsAI(true); },
            });
          },
        });
      }
    };

    // Mit Freunden: host ------------------------------------------------------
    /** v5: the host lobby keeps four slots (App.mergeGuests); mode 1v1 / 2v2 and the map are
     *  chosen here; empty slots can take bots. Older net modules (one guest, onGuest) work
     *  in 1v1. */
    app.startHost = function (opts) {
      if (featureBlocked('net')) return;
      const o = opts && typeof opts === 'object' ? opts : {};
      app.goFullscreen();
      endBattle();
      leaveOnline();
      clearJoinHash();
      let code;
      try { code = String(CR.Net.newCode()); } catch (e) {
        disableFeature('net', 'Das Netzwerkmodul meldet einen Fehler: ' + errMsg(e));
        app.showMenu();
        return;
      }
      // v6: game mode of this lobby (menu choice, changeable in the lobby)
      const gameMode = UI.allowedGameMode(o.gameMode != null ? o.gameMode : settings.gameMode, app.features);
      const tdChaos = o.tdChaos != null ? !!o.tdChaos : !!settings.tdChaos;
      const tdDraft = o.tdDraft != null ? o.tdDraft !== false : settings.tdDraft !== false;
      const elixirBoost = o.elixirBoost != null ? !!o.elixirBoost : !!settings.elixirBoost;
      const mode = battleMode(gameMode);
      const net2 = App.netSupports2v2();
      const can2 = !!(app.features.team2 && net2);
      const online = {
        role: 'host', code: code, mode: mode, options: battleOptions(mode, tdChaos, tdDraft, elixirBoost), gameMode: gameMode, tdChaos: tdChaos, tdDraft: tdDraft, elixirBoost: elixirBoost,
        speed: settings.speed, hs: null, status: null,
        lobby: null, result: null, match: null, rematch: { host: false, guest: false },
        teamSize: can2 && UI.normTeamSize(o.teamSize != null ? o.teamSize : settings.duoTeamSize) === 2 ? 2 : 1,
        map: battleMap(o.map || settings.map),
        slots: UI.newLobbySlots(settings.name, app.getDeck()),
        guests: [], botNo: 0, can2: can2,
      };
      app.online = online;
      const page = UI.pageUrlInfo();
      const lobby = UI.HostLobbyScreen(app, {
        code: code,
        link: UI.joinLink(code, page.url),
        linkKnown: page.known,
        mode: mode,
        speed: online.speed,
        teamSize: online.teamSize,
        map: online.map,
        can2v2: can2,
        canHill: !!app.features.hill,
        canTunnel: !!app.features.tunnel,
        canBots: !!app.features.ai,
        gameMode: gameMode,
        tdChaos: tdChaos,
        tdDraft: tdDraft,
        elixirBoost: elixirBoost,
        canTouchdown: !!app.features.touchdown,
        canChaos: !!app.features.chaos,
        canDraft: !!app.features.draft,
        noteTouchdown: app.features.notes.touchdown || null,
        onGameMode: function (m, c, d) {
          app.setGameMode(m, c, d);
          online.gameMode = UI.allowedGameMode(m, app.features);
          online.tdChaos = !!c;
          if (d != null) online.tdDraft = d !== false;
          online.mode = battleMode(online.gameMode);
          online.options = battleOptions(online.mode, online.tdChaos, online.tdDraft, online.elixirBoost);
          if (online.netLobby) { try { online.hs.setMode(online.mode, online.options); } catch (e) { logError('setMode', e); } return; }
          lobbyChanged(online);
        },
        // v13: "Schnelles Elixier" in the host lobby (remembered like the menu switch)
        onElixirBoost: function (on) {
          app.setElixirBoost(on);
          online.elixirBoost = !!on;
          online.options = battleOptions(online.mode, online.tdChaos, online.tdDraft, online.elixirBoost);
          if (online.netLobby) { try { online.hs.setMode(online.mode, online.options); } catch (e) { logError('setMode', e); } return; }
          lobbyChanged(online);
        },
        note2v2: !app.features.team2 ? app.features.notes.team2 : (net2 ? null : '2 gegen 2 online braucht ein neueres Netzwerkmodul.'),
        onStart: function () { hostStart(online, false); },
        onCancel: function () { app.leaveToMenu(); },
        onRetry: function () { app.startHost({ teamSize: online.teamSize, map: online.map, gameMode: online.gameMode, tdChaos: online.tdChaos, tdDraft: online.tdDraft, elixirBoost: online.elixirBoost }); },
        onTeamSize: function (n) {
          const ts = can2 ? UI.normTeamSize(n) : 1;
          app.setDuoTeamSize(ts);
          if (online.netLobby) {
            let ok = false;
            try { ok = online.hs.setTeamSize(ts) !== false; } catch (e) { logError('setTeamSize', e); }
            if (!ok) {
              UI.toast(stage, 'Für 1 gegen 1 darf nur ein Freund in der Lobby sein.');
              if (online.lobby) online.lobby.setSlots(null, online.teamSize);
            }
            return;
          }
          online.teamSize = ts;
          online.slots = App.lobbyResize(online.slots, online.teamSize);
          online.slots = App.mergeGuests(online.slots, online.guests, online.teamSize);
          lobbyChanged(online);
        },
        onMap: function (m) {
          online.map = battleMap(m);
          settings.map = online.map;
          if (online.netLobby) { try { online.hs.setMap(online.map); } catch (e) { logError('setMap', e); } return; }
          lobbyChanged(online);
        },
        onAddBot: function (team) { hostAddBot(online, team); },
        onSwitch: function (slot) { hostSwitchTeam(online, slot); },
        onRemove: function (slot) { hostRemove(online, slot); },
        // drag & drop: onto a player of the other team = swap, onto the other team = move
        onDrop: function (from, target) {
          const act = UI.lobbyDropAction(online.slots, online.teamSize, from, target);
          if (!act) return;
          if (act.type === 'swap') hostSwapSlots(online, act.a, act.b);
          else hostMoveTeam(online, act.slot, act.team);
        },
        // a guest's wish for a full team: the host taps "Mit X tauschen" or "Nein"
        onSwapReq: function (slot, withSlot) { hostSwapSlots(online, slot, withSlot); },
        onDeclineReq: function (slot) {
          if (online.netLobby && typeof online.hs.declineTeam === 'function') { try { online.hs.declineTeam(slot); } catch (e) { logError('declineTeam', e); } }
        },
      });
      online.lobby = lobby;
      app.show(lobby);
      lobbyChanged(online);

      let p;
      try {
        p = CR.Net.hostGame({
          code: code,
          name: settings.name,
          deck: app.getDeck(),
          mode: online.mode,
          options: online.options,
          teamSize: online.teamSize,
          map: online.map,
          onStatus: function (s) { onHostStatus(online, s); },
        });
      } catch (e) { p = Promise.reject(e); }
      Promise.resolve(p).then(function (hs) {
        if (app.online !== online) { if (hs && hs.close) safeCall(hs.close, hs); return; }
        online.hs = hs;
        online.netLobby = App.netOwnsLobby(hs);
        if (online.netLobby) {
          // V5 net: the host session owns the slots (seats, team requests, bots); the screen
          // mirrors hs.lobby and every host decision goes through hs.*
          try { if (hs.teamSize !== online.teamSize) hs.setTeamSize(online.teamSize); } catch (e) { logError('setTeamSize', e); }
          try { hs.setMap(online.map); } catch (e) { logError('setMap', e); }
          try { if (typeof hs.setMode === 'function') hs.setMode(online.mode, online.options); } catch (e) { logError('setMode', e); }
          for (let i = 1; i < online.slots.length; i++) {
            const sl = online.slots[i];
            if (sl.kind === 'bot') { try { hs.addBot({ team: sl.team, name: sl.name, level: settings.difficulty, deck: sl.deck }); } catch (e) { logError('addBot', e); } }
          }
          hs.onLobby = function (lb) { onNetLobby(online, lb); };
        } else {
          // older net modules: the app keeps the slots (App.mergeGuests)
          hs.onGuest = function (g) { if (!online.multiSeen) onHostGuests(online, g ? [g] : []); };
          hs.onGuests = function (list) { online.multiSeen = true; onHostGuests(online, list); };
          pushLobby(online);
        }
        hs.onRematch = function (info) {
          // V5 net: info.all = every seated human asked; older modules: the one guest asked
          if (!info || typeof info !== 'object' || info.all !== false) online.rematch.guest = true;
          updateHostRematch(online);
        };
      }, function (e) {
        if (app.online !== online) return;
        logError('hostGame', e);
        onHostStatus(online, { state: 'error', message: errMsg(e) });
      });
    };

    function hostHasGuests(online) {
      const n = UI.lobbyUsedSlots(online.teamSize);
      for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) if (online.slots[i] && online.slots[i].kind === 'guest') return true;
      return false;
    }

    /** Publishes the host's lobby decision (V5 net) and refreshes the lobby screen. */
    function pushLobby(online) {
      const hs = online.hs;
      const fn = App.hostLobbyFn(hs);
      if (!fn) return;
      const blob = App.lobbyBlob(online.slots, online.teamSize, online.map, online.mode, online.options);
      try {
        if (fn === 'setSlots') hs.setSlots(blob.slots, blob);
        else hs[fn](blob);
      } catch (e) { logError('lobby ' + fn, e); }
    }
    function lobbyChanged(online) {
      if (app.online !== online) return;
      pushLobby(online);
      const lb = online.lobby;
      if (lb && app.screen === lb) {
        lb.setSlots(online.slots, online.teamSize);
        lb.setCanStart(online.netLobby && online.canStart ? online.canStart : UI.lobbyCanStart(online.slots, online.teamSize));
      }
    }
    function onHostGuests(online, list) {
      if (app.online !== online) return;
      online.guests = Array.isArray(list) ? list.slice() : [];
      online.slots = App.mergeGuests(online.slots, online.guests, online.teamSize);
      lobbyChanged(online);
    }
    /** V5 net lobby -> app state + screen. */
    function onNetLobby(online, lb) {
      if (app.online !== online || !lb || !Array.isArray(lb.slots)) return;
      online.teamSize = UI.normTeamSize(lb.teamSize);
      if (lb.map) online.map = UI.normMap(lb.map);
      const slots = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        const sl = lb.slots[i];
        slots.push(sl ? { slot: i, name: sl.name || '', team: sl.team === 1 ? 1 : 0, kind: sl.kind || 'empty', ready: !!sl.ready, online: sl.online !== false, req: sl.req === 0 || sl.req === 1 ? sl.req : -1, deck: null, id: null }
          : { slot: i, name: '', team: i % 2, kind: 'empty', ready: false, deck: null, id: null });
      }
      online.slots = slots;
      const c = lb.canStart || NONE_OBJ;
      online.canStart = { ok: !!c.ok, reason: c.ok ? '' : String(c.message || UI.lobbyCanStart(slots, online.teamSize).reason) };
      const scr = online.lobby;
      if (scr && app.screen === scr) {
        scr.setSlots(slots, online.teamSize);
        scr.setMap(online.map);
        scr.setCanStart(online.canStart);
      }
    }

    function hostAddBot(online, team) {
      if (online.netLobby) {
        let at = -1;
        try { at = online.hs.addBot({ team: team === 1 ? 1 : 0, level: settings.difficulty, deck: App.pickAiDeck(app.getDeck()) }); } catch (e) { logError('addBot', e); }
        if (at < 0) UI.toast(stage, 'Kein freier Platz in diesem Team.');
        return;
      }
      const n = UI.lobbyUsedSlots(online.teamSize);
      if (UI.lobbyTeamCounts(online.slots, online.teamSize)[team === 1 ? 1 : 0] >= online.teamSize) return;
      for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        if (online.slots[i].kind !== 'empty') continue;
        online.botNo++;
        const next = online.slots.slice();
        next[i] = { slot: i, name: 'Bot ' + online.botNo, team: team === 1 ? 1 : 0, kind: 'bot', ready: true, deck: App.pickAiDeck(app.getDeck()), id: null };
        online.slots = next;
        lobbyChanged(online);
        return;
      }
    }
    function hostSwitchTeam(online, slot) {
      const sl = online.slots[slot];
      if (!sl || sl.kind === 'empty') return;
      hostMoveTeam(online, slot, sl.team === 1 ? 0 : 1);
    }
    /** Two players of different teams trade places (drag & drop, "Tauschen?" prompt). */
    function hostSwapSlots(online, a, b) {
      if (online.teamSize !== 2 || a === b) return;
      const A = online.slots[a], B = online.slots[b];
      if (!A || !B || A.kind === 'empty' || B.kind === 'empty') return;
      if (online.netLobby) {
        const hs = online.hs;
        try {
          if (typeof hs.swapTeams === 'function') hs.swapTeams(a, b);
          else hs.setTeam(a, B.team === 1 ? 1 : 0);
        } catch (e) { logError('swapTeams', e); }
        return;
      }
      online.slots = UI.lobbySwapTeams(online.slots, a, b);
      lobbyChanged(online);
    }
    function hostMoveTeam(online, slot, to) {
      if (online.teamSize !== 2) return;
      const sl = online.slots[slot];
      if (!sl || sl.kind === 'empty') return;
      if ((sl.team === 1 ? 1 : 0) === to) return;
      if (online.netLobby) {
        try { online.hs.setTeam(slot, to); } catch (e) { logError('setTeam', e); }
        return;
      }
      const next = online.slots.slice();
      if (UI.lobbyTeamCounts(online.slots, 2)[to] >= 2) {
        // full: swap with the first member of the other team that is not this one
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
          const o = next[i];
          if (i !== slot && o.kind !== 'empty' && o.team === to) { next[i] = Object.assign({}, o, { team: sl.team }); break; }
        }
      }
      next[slot] = Object.assign({}, sl, { team: to });
      online.slots = next;
      lobbyChanged(online);
    }
    function hostRemove(online, slot) {
      const sl = online.slots[slot];
      if (!sl || sl.kind !== 'bot') return;   // guests are kept (the network owns their connection)
      if (online.netLobby) { try { online.hs.removeBot(slot); } catch (e) { logError('removeBot', e); } return; }
      const next = online.slots.slice();
      next[slot] = { slot: slot, name: '', team: sl.team, kind: 'empty', ready: false, deck: null, id: null };
      online.slots = next;
      lobbyChanged(online);
    }

    function onHostStatus(online, s) {
      if (app.online !== online) return;
      online.status = s;
      if (online.lobby && app.screen === online.lobby) online.lobby.setStatus(s);
      if (app.battle && app.battle.online === online && hostHasGuests(online)) app.battle.setNetStatus(s);
      if (app.draft && app.draft.online === online && app.screen === app.draft.screen && hostHasGuests(online)) app.draft.screen.setStatus(s);
      if (online.result && app.screen === online.result) {
        const st = s && s.state;
        if (!hostHasGuests(online)) return;
        if (st === 'waiting' || st === 'error') online.result.setRematchState('unavailable');
        else if (st === 'lost') online.result.setRematchState('none', 'Verbindung unterbrochen – verbinde neu …');
        else if (st === 'connected') updateHostRematch(online);
      }
    }

    function hostStart(online, isRematch) {
      if (app.online !== online || !online.hs) return;
      let players;
      if (isRematch && online.match) {
        players = online.match.players;
      } else if (online.netLobby) {
        // V5 net: player index = slot index (hs.lobbyPlayers), decks from the guests' blobs
        const chk = online.canStart || { ok: false, reason: '' };
        if (!chk.ok) { if (chk.reason) UI.toast(stage, chk.reason); return; }
        let lp = [];
        try { lp = online.hs.lobbyPlayers() || []; } catch (e) { logError('lobbyPlayers', e); }
        players = lp.map(function (p, i) {
          return { name: UI.sanitizeName(p.name) || (p.bot ? 'KI' : 'Gast'), deck: UI.sanitizeDeck(p.deck, App.pickAiDeck(app.getDeck())), side: p.side === 1 ? 1 : 0, bot: !!p.bot, slot: typeof p.slot === 'number' ? p.slot : i, level: p.level || settings.difficulty };
        });
        if (players.length < 2) { UI.toast(stage, 'Die Lobby ist noch nicht vollständig.'); return; }
        players[0].deck = app.getDeck();
        players[0].name = settings.name;
      } else {
        const chk = UI.lobbyCanStart(online.slots, online.teamSize);
        if (!chk.ok) { UI.toast(stage, chk.reason); return; }
        players = UI.lobbyPlayers(online.slots, online.teamSize, UI.defaultDeck());
        for (let i = 0; i < players.length; i++) {
          const sl = online.slots[players[i].slot];
          players[i].id = sl && sl.id ? sl.id : null;
          if (players[i].bot) players[i].level = settings.difficulty;
        }
        players[0].deck = app.getDeck();
      }
      // nobody picked a name: "Spieler 1..4" by lobby slot (host = Spieler 1), not "Spieler" x 4
      for (let i = 0; i < players.length; i++) {
        const p = players[i];
        if (!p.bot) p.name = UI.playerName(p.name, typeof p.slot === 'number' ? p.slot : i, i === 0 ? 'host' : 'guest');
      }
      // v7: Touchdown mit Draft - every player (host, guests, bots) drafts first
      if (App.wantsDraft(online.mode, online.options) && app.features.draft && typeof online.hs.startDraft === 'function') {
        hostDraft(online, players);
        return;
      }
      hostLaunch(online, players);
    }

    /** v7: the online draft. The host runs the authoritative CR.Draft (bots + timeouts), every
     *  change goes to the guests (hs.setDraft), guest picks arrive through hs.onDraftPick. */
    function hostDraft(online, players) {
      const hs = online.hs;
      const seed = randomSeed();
      const mode = online.mode;
      const options = online.options;
      // the online state of each human player decides nothing here: an offline guest simply
      // runs into its pick timer (auto-pick) and gets its seat back on reload
      const dp = players.map(function (p) { return { name: p.name, side: p.side, bot: !!p.bot, slot: p.slot }; });
      online.lobby = null;
      online.result = null;
      online.drafting = true;
      let started = false;
      const d = runDraft(players, {
        seed: seed,
        online: online,
        onPublish: function (run, snap) {
          if (app.online !== online) return;
          try {
            if (!started) {
              started = true;
              hs.startDraft({ players: dp, mode: mode, options: options, map: online.map, speed: online.speed, draft: snap, left: run.left() });
            } else hs.setDraft(snap, run.left());
          } catch (e) { logError('draft publish', e); }
        },
      }, function (decks) {
        online.drafting = false;
        if (app.online !== online) return;
        for (let i = 0; i < players.length; i++) if (decks[i] && decks[i].length === 8) players[i].deck = decks[i];
        hostLaunch(online, players, true);
      });
      hs.onDraftPick = function (player, round, choice) {
        if (app.draft !== d || d.stopped) return;
        d.run.pick(player, choice, round);
      };
      if (online.status && hostHasGuests(online) && d.screen.setStatus) d.screen.setStatus(online.status);
    }

    /** Starts the battle (after the lobby, the rematch or the draft). drafted: decks are final. */
    function hostLaunch(online, players, drafted) {
      if (app.online !== online || !online.hs) return;
      const seed = randomSeed();
      const speed = online.speed;
      const map = online.map;
      const mode = online.mode;
      const options = online.options;
      // v6: every deck (host, guests, bots) without the cards this mode does not allow
      if (!drafted) for (let i = 0; i < players.length; i++) players[i].deck = UI.deckForMode(players[i].deck, mode);
      const teamSize = players.length === 4 ? 2 : 1;
      const names = App.teamNames(players);
      let driver;
      try {
        driver = new LocalDriver({ seed: seed, mode: mode, options: options, map: map, players: players, localPlayer: 0, hs: online.hs, speed: speed, aiLevel: settings.difficulty });
      } catch (e) {
        logError('host sim', e);
        if (map === 'tunnel') disableFeature('tunnel', 'Die Tunnel-Karte meldet einen Fehler und ist deaktiviert.');
        else if (mode === 'touchdown') disableFeature('touchdown', 'Touchdown meldet einen Fehler und ist deaktiviert.');
