        else if (mode === 'chaos') disableFeature('chaos', 'Der C.H.A.O.S-Modus meldet einen Fehler – es wird nach den Grundregeln gespielt.');
        app.dialog({ title: 'Start nicht möglich', text: errMsg(e), buttons: [{ label: 'OK', value: true }] });
        return;
      }
      try {
        online.hs.startBattle({
          seed: seed, mode: mode, options: options, speed: speed, map: map, teamSize: teamSize,
          players: players.map(function (p) { return { name: p.name, deck: p.deck, side: p.side, bot: !!p.bot, slot: p.slot, id: p.id || null }; }),
          // legacy 1v1 fields (player i = side i)
          decks: players.map(function (p) { return p.deck; }),
          names: players.map(function (p) { return p.name; }),
        });
      } catch (e) {
        logError('startBattle', e);
        app.dialog({ title: 'Start nicht möglich', text: 'Das Spiel konnte nicht an deine Freunde gesendet werden.\n(' + errMsg(e) + ')', buttons: [{ label: 'OK', value: true }] });
        return;
      }
      online.match = { players: players };
      online.rematch.host = false;
      online.rematch.guest = false;
      online.result = null;
      online.lobby = null;
      driver.onNetError = function () {
        if (app.battle) app.battle.screen.setNetBanner('Netzwerkfehler – deine Mitspieler bekommen keine Updates.', 'Menü', function () { app.leaveToMenu(); }, 'error');
      };
      const battle = runBattle(driver, {
        role: 'host',
        names: names,
        decks: players.map(function (p) { return p.deck; }),
        mode: mode,
        options: options,
        map: map,
        teamSize: teamSize,
        speed: speed,
        online: online,
        onOver: function (res) {
          try { online.hs.endBattle(res); } catch (e) { logError('endBattle', e); }
        },
        onFinished: function (res) {
          if (app.online !== online) { app.leaveToMenu(); return; }
          online.result = showResult(res, {
            role: 'host',
            localSide: driver.localSide,
            names: names,
            onRematch: function () {
              online.rematch.host = true;
              if (online.hs && typeof online.hs.setRematch === 'function') { try { online.hs.setRematch(true); } catch (e) { logError('setRematch', e); } }
              updateHostRematch(online);
            },
          });
          if (online.status && online.status.state !== 'connected' && hostHasGuests(online)) onHostStatus(online, online.status);
          else updateHostRematch(online);
        },
      });
      if (battle && online.status && hostHasGuests(online)) battle.setNetStatus(online.status);
    }

    function updateHostRematch(online) {
      if (app.online !== online) return;
      const scr = online.result;
      if (!scr || app.screen !== scr) return;
      const humans = hostHasGuests(online);
      if (!humans) online.rematch.guest = true;   // host + bots only: no one else has to agree
      if (humans && online.status && (online.status.state === 'waiting' || online.status.state === 'error')) {
        scr.setRematchState('unavailable');
        return;
      }
      if (online.rematch.host && online.rematch.guest) {
        scr.setRematchState('starting');
        hostStart(online, true);
      } else if (online.rematch.host) scr.setRematchState('waiting');
      else if (online.rematch.guest) scr.setRematchState('opponent');
      else scr.setRematchState('none');
    }

    // Mit Freunden: guest -----------------------------------------------------
    /** o.auto: join at once (code typed in the menu, or a link opened by a returning player). */
    app.showJoin = function (code, o) {
      if (featureBlocked('net')) return;
      endBattle();
      leaveOnline();
      const lobby = UI.GuestLobbyScreen(app, {
        code: code || '',
        name: settings.name,
        onName: function (n) {
          app.setName(n);
          const on = app.online;
          // live: the host shows the new name at once (older net modules: on the next join)
          if (on && on.gs && typeof on.gs.setName === 'function') { try { on.gs.setName(UI.isDefaultName(n) ? '' : settings.name); } catch (e) { logError('setName', e); } }
        },
        onJoin: function (c) { guestJoin(c, lobby); },
        onReady: function (b) {
          const on = app.online;
          if (on && on.gs) { on.ready = b; try { on.gs.setReady(b); } catch (e) { logError('setReady', e); } }
        },
        onTeam: function (team) {
          const on = app.online;
          if (!on || !on.gs) return;
          const again = on.team === team;
          on.team = team;
          const gs = on.gs;
          try {
            if (typeof gs.setTeam === 'function') gs.setTeam(team);
            else if (typeof gs.requestTeam === 'function') {
              // the same wish again (the host said no before): withdraw it first so the host
              // sees a new request
              if (again && gs.teamReq === team) {
                gs.requestTeam(-1);
                G.setTimeout(function () { if (app.online === on && on.team === team) { try { gs.requestTeam(team); } catch (e) { logError('requestTeam', e); } } }, 400);
              } else gs.requestTeam(team);
            } else if (typeof gs.setRequest === 'function') gs.setRequest({ team: team });
          } catch (e) { logError('setTeam', e); }
        },
        onCancel: function () { app.leaveToMenu(); },
      });
      app.show(lobby);
      if (code && o && o.auto) lobby.autoJoin();
    };

    function guestJoin(code, lobby) {
      app.goFullscreen();
      leaveOnline();
      const online = { role: 'guest', code: code, gs: null, status: null, lobby: lobby, result: null, ready: false, names: null };
      app.online = online;
      let p;
      try {
        p = CR.Net.joinGame({
          code: code,
          name: settings.name,
          deck: app.getDeck(),
          onStatus: function (s) { onGuestStatus(online, s); },
        });
      } catch (e) { p = Promise.reject(e); }
      Promise.resolve(p).then(function (gs) {
        if (app.online !== online) { if (gs && gs.close) safeCall(gs.close, gs); return; }
        online.gs = gs;
        gs.onBattleStart = function (info) { guestBattleStart(online, info || {}); };
        // v7: the host's Touchdown draft (all players pick at the same time)
        gs.onDraft = function (info) { guestDraft(online, info || {}); };
        // v5: the host's lobby (slots, teams, mode, map)
        gs.onLobby = function (lb) {
          if (app.online !== online) return;
          const L = App.readLobby(lb);
          if (L && online.lobby && app.screen === online.lobby && typeof online.lobby.setLobby === 'function') online.lobby.setLobby(L);
        };
        gs.onBattleEnd = function (result) {
          if (app.online !== online) return;
          if (app.battle && app.battle.online === online) app.battle.finish(result);
        };
        // Joining via the code/link means "I want to play": start ready, the toggle can undo it.
        online.ready = true;
        try { gs.setReady(true); } catch (e) { logError('setReady', e); }
        if (app.screen === lobby) lobby.setReady(true);
      }, function (e) {
        if (app.online !== online) return;
        logError('joinGame', e);
        app.online = null;
        if (app.screen === lobby) lobby.setFailed(errMsg(e));
      });
    }

    function onGuestStatus(online, s) {
      if (app.online !== online) return;
      online.status = s;
      const st = s && s.state;
      if (online.lobby && app.screen === online.lobby) {
        if (st === 'error') {
          online.lobby.setFailed(s.message || 'Verbindung fehlgeschlagen');
          const gs = online.gs;
          app.online = null;
          if (gs && gs.close) safeCall(gs.close, gs);
          return;
        }
        online.lobby.setStatus(s);
      }
      if (app.battle && app.battle.online === online) app.battle.setNetStatus(s);
      if (online.draftScreen && app.screen === online.draftScreen) online.draftScreen.setStatus(s);
      if (online.result && app.screen === online.result) {
        if (st === 'error') online.result.setRematchState('unavailable', 'Die Verbindung zum Gastgeber ist beendet.');
        else if (st === 'lost') online.result.setRematchState('none', 'Verbindung unterbrochen – verbinde neu …');
      }
    }

    /** v7: draft state from the host -> the draft screen (created on the first one of a draft). */
    function guestDraft(online, info) {
      if (app.online !== online || !info.draft || !CR.Draft) return;
      if (app.battle && app.battle.online === online && !app.battle.finished) return;
      const lp = typeof info.localPlayer === 'number' ? info.localPlayer : -1;
      if (lp < 0) return;
      let scr = online.draftScreen;
      if (!scr || online.draftNo !== info.dn || app.screen !== scr) {
        endBattle();
        const names = (info.players || EMPTY).map(function (p, i) { return UI.sanitizeName(p && p.name) || (p && p.bot ? 'KI' : 'Spieler ' + (i + 1)); });
        online.draftNo = info.dn;
        online.lobby = null;
        online.result = null;
        scr = UI.DraftScreen(app, {
          localPlayer: lp,
          names: names,
          online: true,
          onPick: function (choice, round) {
            try { online.gs.draftPick(round, choice); } catch (e) { logError('draftPick', e); }
          },
          onLeave: function () { app.leaveToMenu(); },
        });
        online.draftScreen = scr;
        app.show(scr);
        if (online.status && online.status.state !== 'connected') scr.setStatus(online.status);
      }
      const v = CR.Draft.viewFor(info.draft, lp);
      const left = v && v.pair >= 0 && Array.isArray(info.left) ? info.left[v.pair] : null;
      scr.setState(info.draft, { deadline: typeof left === 'number' && !v.done ? nowMs() + left : null, total: CR.Draft.PICK_MS || 10000 });
    }

    function guestBattleStart(online, info) {
      if (app.online !== online) return;
      online.draftScreen = null;
      // v5: team names from the players list (2v2), else the legacy [host, guest] names
      let names;
      if (Array.isArray(info.players) && info.players.length >= 2 && info.players[0] && typeof info.players[0] === 'object') names = App.teamNames(info.players);
      else if (Array.isArray(info.names)) names = info.names.slice(0, 2).map(function (n) { return UI.sanitizeName(n) || ''; });
      else names = ['Gastgeber', settings.name];
      online.names = names;
      online.result = null;
      online.lobby = null;
      // the map comes from the host: every CR.Arena reader (renderer, deploy check) needs it
      const map = normMap(info.map);
      App.applyMap(map);
      // v6: the host's game mode (+ options: Touchdown with C.H.A.O.S upgrades)
      const mode = info.mode === 'classic' || info.mode === 'touchdown' ? info.mode : 'chaos';
      const options = App.modeOptions(mode, info.options);
      App.applyMode(mode);
      const driver = new GuestDriver(online.gs, info);
      const teamSize = info.teamSize === 2 || (Array.isArray(info.players) && info.players.length === 4) ? 2 : 1;
      const battle = runBattle(driver, {
        role: 'guest',
        names: names,
        decks: Array.isArray(info.decks) ? info.decks : null,
        mode: mode,
        options: options,
        map: map,
        teamSize: teamSize,
        speed: driver.speed,
        online: online,
        onFinished: function (res) {
          if (app.online !== online) { app.leaveToMenu(); return; }
          online.result = showResult(res, {
            role: 'guest',
            localSide: driver.localSide,
            names: names,
            onRematch: function () {
              try { online.gs.requestRematch(); } catch (e) { logError('requestRematch', e); }
              if (online.result) online.result.setRematchState('waiting', 'Revanche angefragt – warte auf den Gastgeber.');
            },
          });
          const st = online.status && online.status.state;
          if (st === 'error') online.result.setRematchState('unavailable', 'Die Verbindung zum Gastgeber ist beendet.');
        },
      });
      if (battle && online.status && online.status.state !== 'connected') battle.setNetStatus(online.status);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- global input guards

    const opt = { passive: false };
    doc.addEventListener('gesturestart', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); }, opt);
    doc.addEventListener('dblclick', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); }, opt);
    doc.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) {
      const t = e.target;
      if (e.touches && e.touches.length > 1) { e.preventDefault(); return; }
      if (t && t.closest && t.closest('.scroll, .chips, input, textarea')) return;
      e.preventDefault();
    }, opt);
    doc.addEventListener('contextmenu', function (e) {
      const t = e.target;
      if (t && t.closest && t.closest('input, textarea')) return;
      e.preventDefault();
    });
    doc.addEventListener('touchstart', function () {}, { passive: true }); // enables :active on iOS
    // v5: CR.Audio is unlocked on the first touch (browsers start WebAudio only from a
    // gesture); the current music track is (re)sent once it is.
    let audioUnlocked = false;
    const unlock = function () {
      UI.Sound.unlock();
      if (UI.audio()) {
        UI.audioCall('unlock');
        if (!audioUnlocked) { audioUnlocked = true; pushAudioSettings(); UI.musicRefresh(); }
      }
    };
    ['pointerdown', 'pointerup', 'touchend', 'click', 'keydown'].forEach(function (ev) {
      doc.addEventListener(ev, unlock, { capture: true, passive: true });
    });
    // Press feedback for every button outside the battle: sound + a short tick.
    stage.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      const b = e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('button') : null;
      if (b && !b.disabled && !b.closest('.screen-battle')) { UI.Sound.play('tap'); UI.vibrate(6); }
    });
    G.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (e.key !== 'Escape' || app.battle || app.dialogs.length) return;
      const scr = app.screen;
      if (scr && typeof scr.back === 'function') scr.back();
    });

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- resize / visibility

    let resizeQueued = false;
    function onResize() {
      if (resizeQueued) return;
      resizeQueued = true;
      G.requestAnimationFrame(function () {
        resizeQueued = false;
        if (app.battle) {
          app.battle.resize();
          app.battle.setObscured(isObscured());
        }
      });
    }
    G.addEventListener('resize', onResize);
    G.addEventListener('orientationchange', function () { onResize(); G.setTimeout(onResize, 300); });
    if (G.visualViewport && G.visualViewport.addEventListener) G.visualViewport.addEventListener('resize', onResize);
    if (typeof G.ResizeObserver === 'function') {
      try { new G.ResizeObserver(onResize).observe(stage); } catch (e) { /* optional */ }
    }

      const b = app.battle;
      if (!b) return;
      if (doc.hidden) b.onHidden(); else b.onVisible();
    });
    G.addEventListener('pagehide', function (e) {
      // The page is really being unloaded (not just cached or hidden): close the network
      // session so the other side notices at once. A page that may come back keeps it;
      // backgrounding is handled by visibilitychange.
      if (e && e.persisted) return;
      const o = app.online;
      if (o) { const s = o.hs || o.gs; if (s && s.close) safeCall(s.close, s); }
    });

    G.addEventListener('hashchange', function () {
      const c = UI.joinCodeFromHash(G.location.hash);
      if (!c || app.battle || !app.features.net || app.booting) return;
      if (app.online && app.online.code === c) return;
      app.showJoin(c, { auto: true });
    });

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- boot

    app.features = detectFeatures();

    function route() {
      app.booting = false;
      let joinCode = null;
      try { joinCode = UI.joinCodeFromHash(G.location.hash); } catch (e) { joinCode = null; }
      // A returning player (name known) joins a link at once; a new one may type a name first.
      if (joinCode && app.features.net) app.showJoin(joinCode, { auto: !!store.get('name', '') });
      else app.showMenu();
      const bootErrors = G.__crBootErrors;
      if (Array.isArray(bootErrors) && bootErrors.length) {
        logError('boot', bootErrors.join(' | '));
        UI.toast(stage, 'Hinweis: Ein Modul konnte nicht geladen werden – betroffene Funktionen sind deaktiviert.', 4200);
      }
    }

    // Loading screen: pre-render the 3D card portraits (own deck first) with a progress bar.
    app.booting = true;
    const loading = UI.LoadingScreen(app);
    app.show(loading);
    const t0 = nowMs();
    let routed = false;
    const finish = function () {
      if (routed) return;
      routed = true;
      const wait = Math.max(0, LOAD_MIN_MS - (nowMs() - t0));
      loading.setProgress(1, 1, 'Bereit!');
      G.setTimeout(function () { if (app.screen === loading) route(); else app.booting = false; }, wait);
    };
    // Invite link opened: connect right away - the card portraits keep rendering in the
    // background instead of holding the player on the loading screen.
    let bootJoin = null;
    try { bootJoin = UI.joinCodeFromHash(G.location.hash); } catch (e) { bootJoin = null; }
    if (bootJoin) G.setTimeout(finish, LOAD_MIN_MS);
    const Art = UI.Art;
    function preloadPortraits() {
      // the graphics kit may finish its setup a moment after loading
      app.features.gfx3d = gfx3DReady();
      if (app.features.gfx3d) delete app.features.notes.gfx3d;
      if (app.features.data && Art && Art.available()) {
        const ids = App.portraitOrder(app.getDeck(), UI.sortedCardIds());
        loading.setProgress(0, ids.length, 'Kämpfer werden vorbereitet … 0 / ' + ids.length);
        Art.preload(ids, function (n, total, id) {
          if (routed) return;
          loading.setProgress(n, total, 'Kämpfer werden vorbereitet … ' + n + ' / ' + total);
          loading.showCard(id);
        }).then(finish, finish);
        G.setTimeout(finish, LOAD_MAX_MS);
        return;
      }
      // No 3D portraits (no WebGL / gfx not loaded): short splash, monogram card art.
      let k = 0;
      const step = G.setInterval(function () {
        k += 1;
        loading.setProgress(k, 4, 'Arena wird aufgebaut …');
        if (k >= 4) { G.clearInterval(step); finish(); }
      }, 120);
    }
    if (CR.GFX && !CR.GFX.ready && G.THREE) {
      let waited = 0;
      const poll = G.setInterval(function () {
        waited += 100;
        if ((CR.GFX && CR.GFX.ready) || waited >= GFX_WAIT_MS) { G.clearInterval(poll); preloadPortraits(); }
      }, 100);
    } else {
      preloadPortraits();
    }
    return app;
  };

<script>
/* src/12-chaos-ui.js */
/* Bust War - 12-chaos-ui.js (app shell, v3 + v5)
 * C.H.A.O.S upgrade picker for phones: a full-screen "pick one of two" overlay with 3D card art
 * (CR.GFX.portrait / CR.UI.Art), rarity frames, German texts, countdown, skip button, plus
 * columns of owned upgrades for both players (own: top left under the info pill, blue ring;
 * opponent: top right, red ring - both on the far side, so nothing covers the own deploy
 * zone), an info pill (bolt + seconds to the next upgrade, top left next to the menu button)
 * and pick toasts. Self-contained: injects its own CSS (prefix .chx-), no emojis.
 * (v4: see below - all of it without words.)
 *
 * v4 (user: "no names or words during the battle"): everything is WORDLESS - the two options
 * are big card art in their rarity colour with rarity gems and one clear effect icon
 * (ChaosUI.effectOf: freeze, shock, fire, speed, more units, ...); the German title + text only
 * appear while a card (or an owned-upgrade chip) is pressed and held. The pause is an animated
 * pause emblem, waiting for the opponent is the opponent icon with bouncing dots, skip is a
 * fast-forward button with a x2 badge, the info pill is a bolt + countdown number and pick
 * toasts are card art + effect icon. German text stays in aria-labels only.
 * v3: the overlay covers the WHOLE battle screen (opts.overlayRoot). No lag: after the first frame of an offer,
 * update() only writes DOM when a value changed (timer bar = one transform write per 1/400
 * step), and infinite animations only run while the overlay is open.
 *
 *   const ui = CR.ChaosUI.mount(arenaEl, { localSide, sendCommand, sound, vibrate, overlayRoot });
 *   ui.update(view, localSide, sendCommand);   // every frame (cheap: DOM only changes on diffs)
 *   ui.destroy();
 *   CR.ChaosUI.update(view, localSide, sendCommand) / CR.ChaosUI.unmount() use the last mount.
 *
 * v5 (docs/V5.md): the pick cards show the card name, title and German description by default
 * (no press-and-hold); 2v2: opts.localPlayer / update(view, side, send, localPlayer) pick the
 * own player's offers, the opponent strip shows the first player of the other team.
 *
 * v12 (user: "three different abilities per card to choose from"): an offer has THREE options; with
 * three the cards are stacked as wide rows (art left, rarity name + title + German text right) so
 * the texts stay readable on a 390 px phone. After a skip the next offer is a bonus offer
 * (view picksLeft = 2): the first tap marks that card as taken (view offers[i].taken) and the
 * picker stays open for the second tap. Keys 1/2/3 pick.
 *
 * Reads view.players[i].chaos (see src/06-chaos.js / docs/CHAOS.md) and sends
 * {type:'chaos_pick', option} (option = index, or CR.Chaos.SKIP to skip).
 */
(function (CR) {

    common: { name: 'Gewöhnlich', c1: '#eef1f4', c2: '#8d959f', c3: '#2f343b', glow: 'rgba(190,200,212,0.55)', ink: '#14181d', aura: '#a9b1ba' },
    rare: { name: 'Selten', c1: '#ffe0b0', c2: '#d9852f', c3: '#5a2606', glow: 'rgba(234,148,60,0.72)', ink: '#3a1602', aura: '#e09a48' },
    epic: { name: 'Episch', c1: '#f0d2ff', c2: '#a24ce6', c3: '#2e0a52', glow: 'rgba(170,80,255,0.78)', ink: '#1e0638', aura: '#b764f2' },
  };
  function rar(r) { return RAR[r] || RAR.common; }
  // timer bar: pre-built transform strings (no per-frame string building / allocation)
  const FILL_STEPS = 400;
  const FILL = [];
  function fillScale(k) {
    if (!FILL.length) for (let i = 0; i <= FILL_STEPS; i++) FILL.push('scaleX(' + (i / FILL_STEPS).toFixed(4) + ')');

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ CSS
  const CSS = `
.chx-root{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:30;font-family:var(--font-body,"Nunito",system-ui,sans-serif);color:#fff;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;-webkit-touch-callout:none}

.chx-ov{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:40;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:0;padding:calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)) 12px calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));pointer-events:auto;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .22s ease,visibility 0s linear .22s;touch-action:manipulation;font-family:var(--font-body,"Nunito",system-ui,sans-serif);color:#fff;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;-webkit-touch-callout:none;overflow:hidden}
.chx-ov.is-open{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transition:opacity .2s ease}
.chx-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 42%,rgba(64,24,118,.7),rgba(6,10,30,.93) 72%);overflow:hidden}
.chx-bg:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:44%;width:160vmax;height:160vmax;margin:-80vmax 0 0 -80vmax;background:repeating-conic-gradient(from 0deg,rgba(255,210,90,.13) 0deg 7deg,rgba(255,210,90,0) 7deg 22.5deg)}

.chx-logo{position:relative;font-family:var(--font-display,"Lilita One",system-ui,sans-serif);font-size:clamp(40px,12vw,60px);line-height:1;letter-spacing:2px;color:#ffe35a;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff6b0 0%,#ffd23f 45%,#ff8a1e 100%);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:2px #4a1c00;filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 0 #2a0f00)}

.chx-pause-txt span{display:block;font-weight:900;font-size:16px;line-height:1.15;color:#efe4ff;text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.chx-sub{font-family:var(--font-display,"Lilita One",sans-serif);font-size:clamp(20px,6vw,26px);color:#fff;text-shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.chx-round{display:inline-block;margin-left:8px;padding:2px 10px 3px;border-radius:999px;font-size:16px;vertical-align:3px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#5b3bd6,#3a1f9a);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,.45),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
.chx-cards{position:relative;display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center;width:100%;max-width:520px;flex:0 1 auto;min-height:0}
.chx-card{position:relative;flex:1 1 0;min-width:0;max-width:250px;aspect-ratio:.62;max-height:min(58vh,440px);border:0;padding:5px;margin:0;border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(165deg,var(--c1),var(--c2) 45%,var(--c3));box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(0,0,0,.65),0 8px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.45);color:inherit;font:inherit;cursor:pointer;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;touch-action:manipulation;transition:transform .16s ease,opacity .2s ease;animation:chx-deal .55s cubic-bezier(.18,1.35,.42,1) both}
.chx-card:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-10px;z-index:-1;border-radius:26px;background:radial-gradient(closest-side,var(--glow),transparent);opacity:.9;pointer-events:none}
.chx-card:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.09s}
.chx-card:nth-child(1){--rot:-7deg}.chx-card:nth-child(2){--rot:7deg}
@keyframes chx-deal{0%{transform:translateY(70vh) rotate(var(--rot,0)) scale(.6);opacity:0}70%{opacity:1}100%{transform:none;opacity:1}}
@keyframes chx-drop{0%{transform:translateY(-40px) scale(.7);opacity:0}100%{transform:none;opacity:1}}
.chx-card:active{transform:scale(.96)}
.chx-in{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:100%;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#22345e,#0d1530 78%)}
.chx-art{position:relative;flex:0 0 46%;background:radial-gradient(85% 75% at 50% 42%,var(--glow),transparent 72%),linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.08),rgba(0,0,0,.25)),linear-gradient(160deg,var(--c3),#0d1530);overflow:hidden}

.chx-mono{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:var(--font-display,"Lilita One",sans-serif);font-size:64px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.9);-webkit-text-stroke:2px rgba(0,0,0,.45);text-shadow:0 4px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.35)}

.chx-ribbon{position:absolute;left:50%;top:-14px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:3;padding:4px 14px 5px;border-radius:9px;white-space:nowrap;font-family:var(--font-display,"Lilita One",sans-serif);font-size:16px;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--c2),var(--c3));box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,.6),0 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.4);text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.6)}

.chx-title{font-family:var(--font-display,"Lilita One",sans-serif);font-size:clamp(18px,5.3vw,24px);line-height:1.04;color:#ffd84a;text-shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.65)}
.chx-text{font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(16px,4.4vw,19px);line-height:1.22;color:#f2f5ff;text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.6)}

.chx-clock{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:min(88%,380px);margin-top:20px}
.chx-timer{position:relative;flex:1 1 auto;height:18px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(0,0,0,.55),inset 0 2px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.5);overflow:hidden}
.chx-fill{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-origin:left center;border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff1a0,#ffc93a 50%,#ff9a1e);will-change:transform}

.chx-ov.is-open .chx-timer.is-low .chx-fill{animation:chx-pulse .5s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes chx-pulse{to{opacity:.65}}
.chx-secs{position:relative;flex:0 0 auto;width:54px;height:54px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:50%;font-family:var(--font-display,"Lilita One",sans-serif);font-size:30px;line-height:1;background:rgba(0,0,0,.45);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #ffc93a;text-shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.chx-clock.is-low .chx-secs{box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #ff4d3a;color:#ffd0c8}
.chx-status{position:relative;min-height:24px;margin-top:10px;font-weight:900;font-size:18px;line-height:1.25;text-align:center;color:#dfe6ff;text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
.chx-skip{position:relative;margin-top:12px;min-height:56px;padding:8px 22px;border:0;border-radius:14px;font-family:var(--font-display,"Lilita One",sans-serif);font-size:20px;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#8494b8,#4f5d80);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,.6),0 5px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.45),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35);text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.6);cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
.chx-skip small{display:block;font-family:var(--font-body,"Nunito",sans-serif);font-weight:800;font-size:15px;opacity:.92}
.chx-skip:active{transform:translateY(3px);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,.6),0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.45)}
.chx-skip[hidden]{display:none}
.chx-wait{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:min(86%,360px);padding:18px 20px;border-radius:18px;text-align:center;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(40,24,90,.95),rgba(14,10,40,.95));box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(0,0,0,.6),0 0 0 6px rgba(180,76,255,.45);opacity:0;transition:opacity .2s}
.chx-wait.is-on{opacity:1}
.chx-wait b{display:block;font-family:var(--font-display,"Lilita One",sans-serif);font-size:34px;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:2px;color:#ffd84a;text-shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.chx-wait span{display:block;margin-top:4px;font-weight:900;font-size:18px;line-height:1.25}
.chx-dots i{display:inline-block;width:9px;height:9px;margin:10px 4px 0;border-radius:50%;background:#fff}
.chx-wait.is-on .chx-dots i{animation:chx-dot 1s ease-in-out infinite}
.chx-dots i:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.15s}.chx-dots i:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.3s}
@keyframes chx-dot{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0);opacity:.4}50%{transform:translateY(-6px);opacity:1}}
.chx-ov.is-waiting .chx-head,.chx-ov.is-waiting .chx-clock,.chx-ov.is-waiting .chx-status,.chx-ov.is-waiting .chx-cards{visibility:hidden}
.chx-pill{position:absolute;left:6px;top:6px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;max-width:62%;padding:4px 12px 5px 6px;border-radius:999px;white-space:nowrap;font-weight:900;font-size:15px;line-height:1.15;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(64,34,140,.92),rgba(28,16,70,.92));box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,.5),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.25);text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.6);transition:opacity .2s}
.chx-pill span{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.chx-pill svg{width:20px;height:20px;flex:0 0 auto}
.chx-pill:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-3px;border-radius:inherit;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #ffd23f,0 0 14px rgba(255,210,90,.9);opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.chx-pill.is-soon:after{animation:chx-soon .6s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes chx-soon{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
.chx-pill.is-hidden{opacity:0}
.chx-strip{position:absolute;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;pointer-events:auto}
.chx-strip.own{left:6px;top:44px}
.chx-strip.opp{right:6px;top:6px}
.chx-chip{position:relative;width:44px;height:44px;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:12px;cursor:pointer;background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--c1),var(--c2) 50%,var(--c3));box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,.6),0 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.4);touch-action:manipulation;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;animation:chx-pop .5s cubic-bezier(.2,1.7,.4,1) both}
.chx-strip.own .chx-chip{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,.6),0 0 0 4px #3f9cff,0 3px 0 4px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.chx-strip.opp .chx-chip{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,.6),0 0 0 4px #ff4c42,0 3px 0 4px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.chx-chip .chx-ci{position:absolute;inset:3px;border-radius:9px;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%,var(--glow),#101a36 75%)}
.chx-chip img{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:-6%;height:118%;transform:translateX(-50%)}
.chx-chip .chx-mono{font-size:20px;-webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
@keyframes chx-pop{0%{transform:scale(0)}100%{transform:scale(1)}}
.chx-tip{position:absolute;z-index:5;width:max-content;max-width:min(260px,72%);padding:10px 12px;border-radius:12px;font-weight:800;font-size:16px;line-height:1.3;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#22345e,#101a36);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--c2),0 6px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.5);opacity:0;transform:translateY(4px);transition:opacity .15s,transform .15s}
.chx-tip.is-on{opacity:1;transform:none}
.chx-tip b{display:block;font-family:var(--font-display,"Lilita One",sans-serif);font-weight:400;font-size:19px;color:#ffd84a;margin-bottom:3px}
.chx-tip i{display:block;font-style:normal;font-size:13px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.6px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--c1);margin-bottom:3px}
.chx-toasts{position:absolute;left:58px;right:58px;top:44px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px;pointer-events:none}
.chx-toast{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;max-width:100%;padding:6px 14px 6px 6px;border-radius:14px;font-weight:900;font-size:16px;line-height:1.2;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(24,34,70,.96),rgba(10,16,38,.96));box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--c2);animation:chx-toast 2.8s ease both}
.chx-toast .chx-ti{position:relative;flex:0 0 auto;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%,var(--glow),#101a36 75%)}
.chx-toast .chx-ti img{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:-6%;height:118%;transform:translateX(-50%)}
.chx-toast .chx-mono{font-size:20px}
.chx-toast small{display:block;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.6px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--c1)}
.chx-toast b{color:#ffd84a;font-weight:900}
@keyframes chx-toast{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-14px) scale(.9)}10%{opacity:1;transform:none}82%{opacity:1;transform:none}100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-8px)}}
.chx-burst{position:absolute;left:50%;top:44%;width:60vmin;height:60vmin;margin:-30vmin 0 0 -30vmin;border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(closest-side,rgba(255,255,255,.85),var(--glow) 45%,transparent 72%);opacity:0;transform:scale(.1);animation:chx-burst .7s ease-out forwards;will-change:transform,opacity}
@keyframes chx-burst{0%{opacity:1;transform:scale(.1)}100%{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.6)}}
@media (max-height:760px){.chx-logo{font-size:clamp(34px,10vw,46px)}.chx-head{margin-bottom:12px;gap:4px}.chx-art{flex-basis:38%}.chx-clock{margin-top:14px}.chx-skip{margin-top:8px;min-height:52px}.chx-status{margin-top:6px}.chx-pause{padding:5px 14px 6px 8px}}
@media (max-height:620px){.chx-logo{font-size:34px}.chx-pause-txt span{font-size:15px}.chx-card{aspect-ratio:.72}.chx-text{font-size:15px}.chx-skip small{display:none}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){.chx-bg:before,.chx-art img,.chx-art:after{animation:none}}
/* ---- v4: wordless */
.chx-emblem{position:relative;width:84px;height:84px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 32%,#b994ff,#6a35d8 55%,#2e0f78);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(0,0,0,.6),0 0 28px rgba(190,130,255,.85)}
.chx-emblem i{display:block;width:12px;height:36px;border-radius:3px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,.35),0 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.chx-emblem:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-11px;border-radius:50%;border:4px dashed #ffd23f;opacity:.9}
.chx-ov.is-open .chx-emblem{animation:chx-breathe 1.5s ease-in-out infinite}
.chx-ov.is-open .chx-emblem:before{animation:chx-spin 7s linear infinite}
@keyframes chx-breathe{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.07)}}
.chx-head .chx-round{margin:0;font-family:var(--font-display,"Lilita One",sans-serif);font-size:18px}
.chx-card .chx-art{flex-basis:44%}
.chx-cname{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:4px;z-index:2;padding:0 6px;text-align:center;font-family:var(--font-display,"Lilita One",sans-serif);font-size:clamp(14px,4vw,17px);line-height:1.05;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.75),0 0 6px rgba(0,0,0,.6);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.chx-fxwrap{position:absolute;right:6px;bottom:6px;z-index:2;width:46px;height:46px}
.chx-fxwrap .chx-fx{width:100%}
.chx-card .chx-body{justify-content:flex-start;gap:5px;padding:8px 8px 10px;overflow-y:auto}
.chx-card .chx-title{font-size:clamp(16px,4.6vw,21px)}
.chx-card .chx-text{font-size:clamp(14px,3.9vw,17px);line-height:1.2}
.chx-card.is-long .chx-text{font-size:clamp(13px,3.6vw,15px)}
.chx-gems{position:absolute;left:50%;top:-11px;z-index:3;display:flex;gap:5px;transform:translateX(-50%)}
.chx-gems i{display:block;width:17px;height:17px;border-radius:3px;transform:rotate(45deg);background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff 0%,var(--c1) 30%,var(--c2) 70%,var(--c3));box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,.75),0 0 8px var(--glow)}
.chx-fx{position:relative;width:min(76px,52%);aspect-ratio:1;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%,rgba(255,255,255,.3),var(--c2) 46%,var(--c3) 100%);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(0,0,0,.65),0 0 18px var(--glow),inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
.chx-fx svg{width:66%;height:66%;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.45))}
.chx-hold{position:absolute;right:7px;bottom:7px;width:22px;height:22px;opacity:.75}
.chx-hold svg{width:100%;height:100%}
.chx-info{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:6;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:14px 10px;border-radius:14px;text-align:center;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(26,34,78,.97),rgba(8,12,32,.97));box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px var(--c2);opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .12s ease,visibility 0s linear .12s;pointer-events:none}
.chx-card.is-info .chx-info{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transition:opacity .12s ease}
.chx-info i{font-style:normal;font-size:13px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.6px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--c1)}
.chx-info b{font-family:var(--font-display,"Lilita One",sans-serif);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(18px,5.2vw,23px);line-height:1.05;color:#ffd84a;text-shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.chx-info span{font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(15px,4.2vw,18px);line-height:1.25;color:#f2f5ff}
.chx-card.is-picked .chx-stamp{padding:8px}
.chx-stamp svg{width:34px;height:34px}
.chx-status{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:40px}
.chx-who{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ff8172,#c8261c);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(0,0,0,.55)}
.chx-who svg{width:72%;height:72%}
.chx-status .chx-dots i{margin-top:0}
.chx-ov.is-open .chx-status .chx-dots i{animation:chx-dot 1s ease-in-out infinite}
.chx-skip{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:72px;height:60px;min-height:0;padding:0}
.chx-skip svg{width:38px;height:38px}
.chx-x2{position:absolute;right:-10px;top:-10px;min-width:30px;height:26px;padding:0 6px;border-radius:9px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:var(--font-display,"Lilita One",sans-serif);font-size:16px;font-style:normal;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffd23f,#f4a414);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,.65);text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.chx-wait{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:14px;width:auto;padding:22px 26px}
.chx-wait .chx-who{width:54px;height:54px}
.chx-pill{gap:5px;padding:3px 10px 3px 4px;font-family:var(--font-display,"Lilita One",sans-serif);font-weight:400;font-size:18px}
.chx-pill svg{width:22px;height:22px}
.chx-pill .chx-x2{position:relative;right:auto;top:auto;min-width:0;height:20px;font-size:13px;padding:0 4px}
.chx-pill .chx-x2[hidden]{display:none}
.chx-toast{gap:6px;padding:5px;border-radius:14px}
.chx-toast.is-opp{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--c2),0 0 0 6px #ff4c42}
.chx-toast.is-own{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--c2),0 0 0 6px #3f9cff}
.chx-toast .chx-tfx{width:40px;height:40px}
.chx-toast .chx-tfx .chx-fx{width:100%}
/* v4 positions: the shell's menu button sits top left, the timer top right */
.chx-pill{left:48px;top:9px}
.chx-strip{gap:6px}
.chx-strip.own{left:6px;top:52px}
.chx-strip.opp{right:6px;top:48px}
.chx-chip{width:38px;height:38px}
/* ---- v10 grimdark: near-black + dark red smoke, dark metal with gold bevels, Cinzel titles */
.chx-bg{background:radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 42%,rgba(16,61,129,.6),rgba(5,7,12,.95) 72%)}
.chx-bg:before{background:repeating-conic-gradient(from 0deg,rgba(242,190,70,.075) 0deg 6deg,rgba(242,190,70,0) 6deg 22.5deg)}
.chx-bg:after{background:radial-gradient(60% 40% at 50% 46%,rgba(44,116,223,.2),transparent 70%)}
.chx-logo{font-family:var(--font-title,"Cinzel",serif);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:3px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff6d6 0%,#f3cf6e 32%,#a8761f 56%,#f6d77e 74%,#8a5c14 100%);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-stroke:0;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 0 #000) drop-shadow(0 0 14px rgba(27,103,216,.7))}
.chx-emblem{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 32%,#20375a,#0d1421 68%);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #e2bb66,0 0 0 4px #000,0 0 30px rgba(27,103,216,.75)}
.chx-emblem i{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff0b8,#d2a24a 60%,#8a6220);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #000,0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.chx-emblem:before{border:2px dashed rgba(226,187,102,.75)}
.chx-round,.chx-head .chx-round{border-radius:3px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1c2944,#0a0f19);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(214,172,92,.6),0 0 0 1px #000;font-family:var(--font-display,sans-serif);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.5px;color:#f3dfb0}
.chx-pause{border-radius:5px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1b2741,#0b101b);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(214,172,92,.55),0 0 0 1px #000,0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.chx-sub{font-family:var(--font-title,"Cinzel",serif);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:1px;color:#f3dfb0}
.chx-card{border-radius:12px;padding:4px;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #000,0 10px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.75)}
.chx-card:before{opacity:.7}
.chx-in{border-radius:9px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#121b2c,#080c13 78%);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.8)}
.chx-art{background:radial-gradient(80% 70% at 50% 44%,rgba(124,170,239,.3),transparent 70%),radial-gradient(130% 100% at 50% 40%,transparent 50%,rgba(0,0,0,.7) 100%),linear-gradient(160deg,#0f274c,#080c13)}
.chx-art:after{background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,236,190,.35),transparent)}
.chx-cname,.chx-cardname{font-family:var(--font-display,sans-serif);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.2px;color:#f6ead2;text-shadow:0 1px 0 #000,0 0 6px rgba(0,0,0,.9)}
.chx-title,.chx-card .chx-title{font-family:var(--font-display,sans-serif);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.2px;color:#f2c84b;text-shadow:0 1px 0 #000,0 0 10px rgba(27,103,216,.45)}
.chx-text,.chx-card .chx-text{font-weight:600;color:#e3d6c3;text-shadow:0 1px 0 #000}
.chx-body{border-top:1px solid rgba(214,172,92,.28)}
.chx-fx{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #000,0 0 0 3px rgba(226,187,102,.75),0 0 16px var(--glow),inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.25)}
.chx-gems i{box-shadow:0 0 0 1.5px #000,0 0 8px var(--glow)}
.chx-cost{font-family:var(--font-display,sans-serif);font-weight:800;-webkit-text-stroke:0;text-shadow:0 1px 0 #12021f,1px 0 0 #12021f,-1px 0 0 #12021f,0 -1px 0 #12021f,0 0 6px rgba(190,110,255,.85)}
.chx-card.is-picked{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #fff3c4,0 0 0 4px #a8761f,0 0 26px rgba(242,190,70,.6),0 10px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
.chx-stamp{border-radius:4px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f8e3a2,#c9963c 55%,#7a5214);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #000,0 0 0 2px #fff0b8 inset,0 6px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.chx-stamp svg path{stroke:#131b2c}
.chx-timer{height:14px;border-radius:2px;background:#080c13;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(214,172,92,.6),0 0 0 2px #000,inset 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.8)}
.chx-fill{border-radius:1px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,240,210,.35),rgba(255,255,255,0) 50%),linear-gradient(90deg,#0f3b7d,#1c6be2 55%,#f2c84b)}
.chx-timer.is-low .chx-fill{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,220,200,.35),rgba(255,255,255,0) 50%),linear-gradient(90deg,#4a0509,#ff3b30)}
.chx-secs{font-family:var(--font-display,sans-serif);font-weight:800;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 35%,#1b2741,#080c14 70%);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #e2bb66,0 0 0 4px #000,0 0 14px rgba(27,103,216,.5);color:#f6ead2}
.chx-clock.is-low .chx-secs{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #ff3b30,0 0 0 4px #000,0 0 16px rgba(255,59,48,.6);color:#ffb3a8}
.chx-status{font-weight:700;color:#d8cab4}
.chx-skip{border-radius:5px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1d2c48,#0a0f18);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(214,172,92,.7),0 0 0 1px #000,0 6px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.chx-skip:active{transform:translateY(2px);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #f6d77e,0 0 0 1px #000,0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.chx-skip svg path{fill:#f3d68a;stroke:#0c121d}
.chx-x2{border-radius:3px;font-family:var(--font-display,sans-serif);font-weight:800;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#d42a2e,#7a0c12);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #f6d77e,0 0 0 2px #000,0 0 8px rgba(190,18,26,.6)}
.chx-wait{border-radius:6px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(21,31,51,.97),rgba(8,12,19,.97));box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(214,172,92,.6),0 0 0 1px #000,0 0 30px rgba(21,82,173,.45)}
.chx-wait b{font-family:var(--font-title,"Cinzel",serif);font-weight:900;color:#f2c84b}
.chx-dots i{background:#e2bb66}
.chx-who{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#d42a2e,#6a070c);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #e2bb66,0 0 0 3px #000}
.chx-pill{border-radius:4px;font-family:var(--font-display,sans-serif);font-weight:800;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(21,31,51,.9),rgba(8,12,19,.9));box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(214,172,92,.55),0 0 0 1px #000,0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.chx-pill:after{border-radius:inherit;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #f2c84b,0 0 14px rgba(242,190,70,.85)}
.chx-chip{border-radius:6px}
.chx-chip .chx-ci{border-radius:4px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%,var(--glow),#0c111d 75%)}
.chx-tip,.chx-toast,.chx-info{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(21,31,51,.97),rgba(8,12,19,.97))}
.chx-tip{border-radius:6px;font-weight:600}
.chx-tip b,.chx-info b{font-family:var(--font-display,sans-serif);font-weight:800;color:#f2c84b}
.chx-toast{border-radius:6px;font-weight:700}
.chx-toast b{color:#f2c84b}
.chx-toast .chx-ti{border-radius:4px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%,var(--glow),#0c111d 75%)}
.chx-info span{font-weight:600;color:#e3d6c3}
.chx-mono{font-family:var(--font-title,"Cinzel",serif);font-weight:900;color:rgba(246,215,126,.9);-webkit-text-stroke:0}
.chx-burst{background:radial-gradient(closest-side,rgba(255,236,190,.85),var(--glow) 45%,transparent 72%)}
/* ---- v12: three options = stacked rows, rarity name, taken cards of a bonus offer */
.chx-rar{font-size:12px;font-weight:900;line-height:1;letter-spacing:.9px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--c1);text-shadow:0 1px 0 #000}
.chx-cards.is-n3{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:12px;max-width:460px}
.chx-cards.is-n3 .chx-card{--rot:0deg;flex:0 1 auto;width:100%;max-width:none;aspect-ratio:auto;height:clamp(112px,18.5vh,168px);max-height:none;padding:3px}
.chx-cards.is-n3 .chx-card:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.18s}
.chx-cards.is-n3 .chx-in{flex-direction:row}
.chx-cards.is-n3 .chx-art{flex:0 0 32%}
.chx-cards.is-n3 .chx-art img{height:118%}
.chx-cards.is-n3 .chx-body{align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;gap:4px;padding:6px 10px 6px 11px;text-align:left;border-top:0;border-left:1px solid rgba(214,172,92,.28)}
.chx-cards.is-n3 .chx-title{font-size:clamp(16px,4.4vw,20px)}
.chx-cards.is-n3 .chx-text{font-size:clamp(13px,3.6vw,15.5px);line-height:1.2}
.chx-cards.is-n3 .chx-card.is-long .chx-text{font-size:clamp(12.5px,3.4vw,14.5px)}
.chx-cards.is-n3 .chx-gems{left:16%;top:-9px}
.chx-cards.is-n3 .chx-gems i{width:13px;height:13px}
.chx-cards.is-n3 .chx-fxwrap{right:4px;bottom:4px;width:34px;height:34px}
.chx-cards.is-n3 .chx-cname{font-size:clamp(12px,3.3vw,14px);top:3px}
.chx-cards.is-n3 .chx-cost{left:3px;top:auto;bottom:3px;width:30px;height:34px;padding-top:5px;font-size:17px}
.chx-cards.is-n3 .chx-stamp{left:16%;top:50%}
.chx-card.is-taken{pointer-events:none}
.chx-picks{display:inline-block;margin-left:8px;padding:2px 9px 3px;border-radius:3px;font-family:var(--font-display,sans-serif);font-weight:800;font-size:16px;color:#fff;vertical-align:1px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#d42a2e,#7a0c12);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #f6d77e,0 0 0 2px #000}
@media (max-height:700px){.chx-cards.is-n3 .chx-card{height:clamp(100px,17vh,140px)}.chx-cards.is-n3 .chx-text{font-size:13px}.chx-cards.is-n3{gap:9px}}
`;

  const SVG_BOLT = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M13.6 1.5L4.2 13.4h6.1l-1.9 9.1 9.4-12h-6.1z" fill="#ffd23f" stroke="#5a2c00" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>';

  const INK = '#1b1030';

  const SVG_OPP = sv('<circle cx="12" cy="8" r="4.2" fill="#fff" stroke="' + INK + '" stroke-width="1.4"/><path d="M4 21c0-4.6 3.6-7.6 8-7.6s8 3 8 7.6z" fill="#fff" stroke="' + INK + '" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linejoin="round"/>');
  const SVG_HOLD = sv('<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9.5" fill="rgba(0,0,0,.35)" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="12" cy="7.4" r="1.6" fill="#fff"/><rect x="10.6" y="10.2" width="2.8" height="7.6" rx="1.2" fill="#fff"/>');
  // Wordless effect icons for upgrades (see effectOf)
  const FX = {
    freeze: sv('<g stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 2.5v19M3.8 7.2l16.4 9.6M3.8 16.8l16.4-9.6" stroke="' + INK + '" stroke-width="4.4"/><path d="M12 2.5v19M3.8 7.2l16.4 9.6M3.8 16.8l16.4-9.6" stroke="#d8f6ff" stroke-width="2.4"/>' +
      '<path d="M9.4 3.9L12 6.4l2.6-2.5M9.4 20.1L12 17.6l2.6 2.5" fill="none" stroke="#d8f6ff" stroke-width="2"/></g>'),
    shock: sv('<path d="M13.6 1.5L4.2 13.4h6.1l-1.9 9.1 9.4-12h-6.1z" fill="#ffe14a" stroke="' + INK + '" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linejoin="round"/>'),
    fire: sv('<path d="M12 1.8c1.2 4.4 6.4 6.3 6.4 12.2a6.4 6.4 0 0 1-12.8 0c0-3 1.6-4.9 3-6.2.2 2.3 1.2 3.4 2.5 3.9C10.4 8.3 10.9 5 12 1.8z" fill="#ff8a1e" stroke="' + INK + '" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>' +
      '<path d="M12 11.5c.6 2 3 2.9 3 5.3a3 3 0 0 1-6 0c0-1.6.9-2.4 1.5-3 .2.9.6 1.3 1.1 1.5-.1-1.4 0-2.6.4-3.8z" fill="#ffe14a"/>'),
    boom: sv('<path d="M12 1.5l2.3 5.4 5.3-2.4-2.4 5.3 5.3 2.2-5.3 2.3 2.4 5.3-5.3-2.4L12 22.5l-2.3-5.3-5.3 2.4 2.4-5.3L1.5 12l5.3-2.2-2.4-5.3 5.3 2.4z" fill="#ffb02e" stroke="' + INK + '" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linejoin="round"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4" fill="#fff3a6"/>'),
    speed: sv('<path d="M2.5 7.5h8M1.5 12h9M2.5 16.5h8" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M11.5 4.5l9.5 7.5-9.5 7.5z" fill="#7dffb0" stroke="' + INK + '" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linejoin="round"/>'),

    heal: sv('<path d="M9 3h6v6h6v6h-6v6H9v-6H3V9h6z" fill="#6dff8f" stroke="' + INK + '" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linejoin="round"/>'),
    multi: sv('<circle cx="7" cy="8" r="3" fill="#cfe3ff" stroke="' + INK + '" stroke-width="1.2"/><path d="M1.8 18c0-3.4 2.3-5.4 5.2-5.4s5.2 2 5.2 5.4z" fill="#cfe3ff" stroke="' + INK + '" stroke-width="1.2"/>' +
      '<circle cx="15.5" cy="7" r="3.4" fill="#fff" stroke="' + INK + '" stroke-width="1.3"/><path d="M9.6 19c0-3.8 2.6-6 5.9-6s5.9 2.2 5.9 6z" fill="#fff" stroke="' + INK + '" stroke-width="1.3"/><path d="M19.5 1.5v5M17 4h5" stroke="#7dffb0" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>'),

  };
  // keyword rules on the German title + text, first match wins (order matters)
  const FX_RULES = [
    ['elixir', /elixier/],
    ['heal', /heil/],
    ['tough', /trefferpunkt|\btp\b|leben|schild|zäh|panzer/],
    ['range', /reichweite|durchbohr/],
    ['hide', /unsichtbar|versteck/],
    ['multi', /statt (des|der|eines|einer|ein|in)\b|kommt als|\bkommen\b|trio|klon|bringt\b.*\bmit\b|bekommst du|schlüpft|beschwört|\bspringen\b.*\bab\b|armee|pack\b/],
    ['speed', /schnell|tempo|sprint|rückenwind|flink|eilig/],
    ['freeze', /einfrier|friert|frost|\beis|schnee|verlangsam|lähm|schnecke|kälte/],
    ['poison', /gift/],
    ['shock', /blitz|elektro|betäub|zapp|schock|strom|sparky/],
    ['fire', /feuer|flamm|brenn|inferno|funke/],
    ['boom', /explo|bombe|spreng|knall/],
    ['swirl', /tornado|zieht|wirbel|rückstoß|stoß/],
    ['jump', /spring|sprung|hüpf|landet/],
    ['speed', /wut|wüten/],
    ['multi', /zusätzlich|reitet|fledermäuse|welpen|goblins|skelette|mini-|dreifach|\bzwei\b|\bdrei\b|\bvier\b|\bsechs\b|ziele gleichzeitig/],
    ['range', /rollt|rollen|wandert|weit\b/],
    ['poison', /level|schwäch/],
    ['power', /schaden|stärker|treffer|doppelt|axt|äxte|kugel|pfeil|schuss|schüsse/],
  ];
  // v12: explicit icons where the keyword rules pick a misleading one (by modifier id 'card:rarity';
  // the custom cards' abilities included). Checked before the keyword rules.
  const FX_BY_ID = {
    'archers:common': 'poison', 'firecracker:epic': 'multi', 'balloon:rare': 'multi', 'battle-healer:epic': 'multi',
    'phoenix:rare': 'multi', 'musketeer:common': 'multi', 'goblin-barrel:common': 'boom', 'skeletons:epic': 'multi',
    'minions:common': 'power', 'minions:epic': 'multi', 'hog-rider:common': 'power', 'hog-rider:rare': 'multi',
    'lumberjack:rare': 'power', 'giant-skeleton:common': 'swirl', 'miner:epic': 'poison', 'electro-giant:rare': 'multi',
    'tombstone:rare': 'multi', 'tombstone:epic': 'multi', 'royal-delivery:common': 'multi', 'goblin-barrel:epic': 'speed',
    'skeleton-army:rare': 'multi', 'giant-skeleton:epic': 'boom', 'barbarians:rare': 'fire', 'barbarians:epic': 'multi',
    'kung-fu-legend:rare': 'swirl', 'kung-fu-legend:epic': 'multi',
    'cyborg-hunter:rare': 'tough', 'cyborg-hunter:epic': 'power',
    'black-blade-master:common': 'speed', 'black-blade-master:rare': 'power', 'black-blade-master:epic': 'power',
    'spiral-ninja:rare': 'multi', 'phoenix:common': 'speed', 'clone:common': 'tough',
  };
  /** Effect category of an upgrade {id?, title, text} for its wordless icon. */
  function effectOf(o) {
    const byId = o && o.id && FX_BY_ID[o.id];
    if (byId && FX[byId]) return byId;
    const t = (String((o && o.title) || '') + ' ' + String((o && o.text) || '')).toLowerCase();
    for (let i = 0; i < FX_RULES.length; i++) if (FX_RULES[i][1].test(t)) return FX_RULES[i][0];
    return 'star';
  }

    const b = el('div', 'chx-fx', FX[k] || FX.star);

  }

  let styleEl = null;
  function injectCss() {
    if (!doc) return;
    if (styleEl && styleEl.isConnected) return;
    const old = doc.getElementById('chx-style');
    if (old) { styleEl = old; return; }
    styleEl = doc.createElement('style');
    styleEl.id = 'chx-style';
    styleEl.textContent = CSS;
    (doc.head || doc.documentElement).appendChild(styleEl);
  }

  function el(tag, cls, html) {
    const e = doc.createElement(tag);
    if (cls) e.className = cls;
    if (html !== undefined) e.innerHTML = html;
    return e;
  }
  function setRar(e, r) {
    const R = rar(r);
    e.style.setProperty('--c1', R.c1); e.style.setProperty('--c2', R.c2); e.style.setProperty('--c3', R.c3); e.style.setProperty('--glow', R.glow);
  }
  function cardInfo(id) {
    let name = id, elixir = null;
    try { if (CR.UI && typeof CR.UI.cardInfo === 'function') { const c = CR.UI.cardInfo(id); if (c && c.name) name = c.name; if (c && typeof c.elixir === 'number') elixir = c.elixir; } } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    if (name === id) { const c = CR.CAST && CR.CAST.cards && CR.CAST.cards[id]; if (c && c.name) name = c.name; }
    if (elixir === null) { const d = CR.Sim && CR.Sim.cardById ? CR.Sim.cardById(id) : null; if (d) { elixir = d.elixir; if (name === id && d.name) name = d.name; } }
    return { name: String(name), elixir: elixir };
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ card art
  const artCache = Object.create(null);
  const artWait = Object.create(null);
  function loadArt(id, cb) {
    if (artCache[id] !== undefined) { cb(artCache[id]); return; }
    if (artWait[id]) { artWait[id].push(cb); return; }
    artWait[id] = [cb];
    const done = function (url) {
      artCache[id] = typeof url === 'string' && url ? url : null;
      const ws = artWait[id]; delete artWait[id];
      for (let i = 0; i < ws.length; i++) { try { ws[i](artCache[id]); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ } }
    };
    try {
      const Art = CR.UI && CR.UI.Art;
      if (Art && typeof Art.load === 'function' && (typeof Art.available !== 'function' || Art.available())) { Art.load(id, true).then(done, function () { done(null); }); return; }
      const X = CR.GFX;

        const p = X.portrait(id, { w: 256, h: 320, side: 0 });

  /** Fills `box` with the card's 3D portrait, or a rarity monogram until/if none exists. */
  function fillArt(box, id) {

    box.appendChild(mono);

    loadArt(id, function (url) {

      img.draggable = false;
