    });
  }
  /** v8 crisp art: after layout, swaps in the portrait tier the box needs (its CSS height x 1.18
   *  overscan x devicePixelRatio, see CR.UI.Art.tierFor). The picker only shows while the
   *  battle is paused, so a sharp render may use a short grace window of the battle hold. */
  function sharpenArt(box, id, img, tries) {
    const Art = CR.UI && CR.UI.Art;
    const raf = G.requestAnimationFrame;
    if (!Art || typeof Art.tierFor !== 'function' || typeof raf !== 'function') return;
    raf.call(G, function () {
      if (box.dataset.card !== id || img.parentNode !== box) return;
      const hh = box.isConnected ? box.offsetHeight : 0;
      if (!(hh > 0)) { if (tries < 40) sharpenArt(box, id, img, tries + 1); return; }
      const tier = Art.tierFor(hh * 1.18 * 0.8, hh * 1.18);
      if (!(tier > 0)) return;
      const have = Art.cache[Art.keyOf(id, tier)];
      const swap = function (u) { if (u && box.dataset.card === id && img.parentNode === box && img.src !== u) img.src = u; };
      if (have) { swap(have); return; }
      if (typeof Art.grace === 'function') Art.grace(1500);
      Art.load(id, true, tier).then(swap, function () {});
    });
  }

  /** Press-and-hold: show() after HOLD_MS, hide() on release. Sets data-held="1" so the
   *  click that follows a hold is ignored by the owner (a hold only explains). */
  const HOLD_MS = 380;
  function holdable(target, show, hide) {
    let timer = 0;
    let shown = false;
    const clear = function () { if (timer) { G.clearTimeout(timer); timer = 0; } };
    const end = function () { clear(); if (shown) { shown = false; hide(); } };
    target.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (ev) {
      if (ev && ev.pointerType === 'mouse' && ev.button !== 0) return;
      clear();
      target.dataset.held = '';
      timer = G.setTimeout(function () { timer = 0; shown = true; target.dataset.held = '1'; show(); }, HOLD_MS);
    });
    target.addEventListener('pointerup', end);
    target.addEventListener('pointercancel', end);
    target.addEventListener('pointerleave', end);
    target.addEventListener('contextmenu', function (ev) { if (ev && ev.preventDefault) ev.preventDefault(); });
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ instance
  function Instance(root, opts) {
    opts = opts || {};
    injectCss();
    this.opts = opts;
    this.host = root;
    this.side = opts.localSide === 1 ? 1 : 0;
    this.player = typeof opts.localPlayer === 'number' && opts.localPlayer >= 0 ? opts.localPlayer : null;   // v5 2v2
    this.send = typeof opts.sendCommand === 'function' ? opts.sendCommand : null;
    if (G.getComputedStyle && root && G.getComputedStyle(root).position === 'static') root.style.position = 'relative';
    const R = this.root = el('div', 'chx-root');
    // overlay (v3: over the whole battle screen when the shell passes overlayRoot)
    const ovHost = opts.overlayRoot && typeof opts.overlayRoot.appendChild === 'function' ? opts.overlayRoot : R;
    this.ov = el('div', 'chx-ov');
    this.ov.setAttribute('role', 'dialog');
    this.ov.setAttribute('aria-label', 'C.H.A.O.S Upgrade-Wahl, der Kampf ist pausiert');
    this.ov.appendChild(el('div', 'chx-bg'));
    const head = el('div', 'chx-head');
    // the pause is shown loud and clear, without words: a big pulsing pause emblem
    head.appendChild(el('div', 'chx-emblem', SVG_PAUSE2));
    this.sub = el('div', 'chx-sub');
    head.appendChild(this.sub);
    this.ov.appendChild(head);
    this.cards = el('div', 'chx-cards');
    this.ov.appendChild(this.cards);
    this.clock = el('div', 'chx-clock');
    this.timer = el('div', 'chx-timer');
    this.fill = el('div', 'chx-fill');
    this.timer.appendChild(this.fill);
    this.clock.appendChild(this.timer);
    this.secs = el('div', 'chx-secs');
    this.clock.appendChild(this.secs);
    this.ov.appendChild(this.clock);
    this.status = el('div', 'chx-status');
    this.ov.appendChild(this.status);
    this.skipBtn = el('button', 'chx-skip', SVG_FWD + '<i class="chx-x2">×2</i>');
    this.skipBtn.type = 'button';
    this.skipBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Überspringen – beim nächsten Mal zwei Upgrades wählen');
    this.skipBtn.hidden = true;
    this.ov.appendChild(this.skipBtn);
    this.wait = el('div', 'chx-wait', '<div class="chx-emblem">' + SVG_PAUSE2 + '</div><div class="chx-status is-wait"><span class="chx-who">' + SVG_OPP + '</span><span class="chx-dots"><i></i><i></i><i></i></span></div>');
    this.wait.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Pause: Der Gegner wählt ein Upgrade');
    this.ov.appendChild(this.wait);
    ovHost.appendChild(this.ov);
    // info pill, strips, toasts, tooltip
    this.pill = el('div', 'chx-pill is-hidden', SVG_BOLT + '<span></span><i class="chx-x2" hidden>×2</i>');
    this.pillText = this.pill.querySelector('span');
    this.pillX2 = this.pill.querySelector('.chx-x2');
    R.appendChild(this.pill);
    this.stripOwn = el('div', 'chx-strip own');
    this.stripOpp = el('div', 'chx-strip opp');
    R.appendChild(this.stripOwn);
    R.appendChild(this.stripOpp);
    this.toasts = el('div', 'chx-toasts');
    R.appendChild(this.toasts);
    this.tip = el('div', 'chx-tip');
    R.appendChild(this.tip);
    root.appendChild(R);

    this.sig = '';
    this.ownSig = ['', ''];
    this.ownedPrev = [null, null];
    this.open = false;
    this.cardEls = [];
    this.picked = null;
    this.taken = [];            // v12 bonus offer: options tapped so far (local, until the view confirms)
    this.picksLeft = 1;
    this.left = 0; this.leftAt = 0; this.rate = 1; this.total = 7;
    this.lastSecs = -1;
    // last written DOM values (update() writes only on change)
    this.dv = { clock: null, secsShown: null, fillK: -1, low: null, status: null, skip: null, wait: null };
    this.pillSig = '';
    this.tipTimer = 0;
    this.destroyed = false;

    const self = this;
    this.onSkip = function (ev) { if (ev) ev.preventDefault(); self.choose(SKIP); };
    this.skipBtn.addEventListener('click', this.onSkip);
    this.onKey = function (ev) {
      if (!self.open || self.picked !== null) return;
      if (ev.key === '1' || ev.key === 'ArrowLeft') self.choose(0);
      else if (ev.key === '2' || (ev.key === 'ArrowRight' && self.cardEls.length < 3)) self.choose(1);
      else if (ev.key === '3' || ev.key === 'ArrowRight') self.choose(self.cardEls.length - 1);
    };
    if (doc) doc.addEventListener('keydown', this.onKey);
    this.onDocDown = function (ev) {
      if (!self.tip.classList.contains('is-on')) return;
      if (ev.target && ev.target.closest && ev.target.closest('.chx-chip')) return;
      self.hideTip();
    };
    if (doc) doc.addEventListener('pointerdown', this.onDocDown, true);
  }

  Instance.prototype.destroy = function () {
    if (this.destroyed) return;
    this.destroyed = true;
    try { this.skipBtn.removeEventListener('click', this.onSkip); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    if (doc) { doc.removeEventListener('keydown', this.onKey); doc.removeEventListener('pointerdown', this.onDocDown, true); }
    if (this.tipTimer) G.clearTimeout(this.tipTimer);
    if (this.ov && this.ov.parentNode) this.ov.parentNode.removeChild(this.ov);
    if (this.root && this.root.parentNode) this.root.parentNode.removeChild(this.root);
    if (active === this) active = null;
  };
  Instance.prototype.unmount = Instance.prototype.destroy;

  Instance.prototype.sound = function (name) {
    const s = this.opts.sound;
    try { if (s && typeof s.play === 'function') s.play(name); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
  };
  Instance.prototype.buzz = function (ms) {
    try {
      if (typeof this.opts.vibrate === 'function') this.opts.vibrate(ms);
      else if (G.navigator && typeof G.navigator.vibrate === 'function') G.navigator.vibrate(ms);
    } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
  };

  Instance.prototype.choose = function (option) {
    if (!this.open || this.picked !== null || this.destroyed) return;
    if (option !== SKIP && (this.taken.indexOf(option) >= 0 || !(option >= 0 && option < this.cardEls.length))) return;
    if (option !== SKIP && this.picksLeft > 1) {
      // v12 bonus offer: the first of two picks - mark it, keep the picker open
      this.taken.push(option);
      this.picksLeft--;
      const c = this.cardEls[option];
      if (c) { c.classList.add('is-picked', 'is-taken'); }
      this.sound('select');
      this.buzz(18);
      const send0 = this.send;
      if (send0) { try { send0({ type: 'chaos_pick', option: option }); } catch (e) { /* the authority validates */ } }
      this.setSkip(false);
      return;
    }
    this.picked = option;
    if (option !== SKIP && this.taken.length) this.markPicked(this.taken.concat([option]));
    else this.markPicked(option);
    this.sound('select');
    this.buzz(18);
    const send = this.send;
    if (send) { try { send({ type: 'chaos_pick', option: option }); } catch (e) { /* the authority validates */ } }
    this.setStatus('');
    this.setSkip(false);
  };

  Instance.prototype.markPicked = function (option) {
    for (let i = 0; i < this.cardEls.length; i++) {
      const c = this.cardEls[i];
      const on = option === 'both' || option === i || (Array.isArray(option) && option.indexOf(i) >= 0);
      c.classList.toggle('is-picked', on);
      c.classList.toggle('is-dim', !on && option !== null && option !== undefined);
    }
    if (option === SKIP || option === 'skip') for (let i = 0; i < this.cardEls.length; i++) this.cardEls[i].classList.add('is-dim');
  };

  Instance.prototype.buildCards = function (list, round, rounds) {
    this.cards.textContent = '';
    this.cardEls = [];
    const self = this;
    for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      const o = list[i];
      const info = cardInfo(o.card);
      const R = rar(o.rarity);
      const b = el('button', 'chx-card' + (o.taken ? ' is-picked is-taken' : ''));
      b.type = 'button';
      setRar(b, o.rarity);
      b.setAttribute('aria-label', R.name + ' Upgrade für ' + info.name + ': ' + o.title + '. ' + o.text);
      const inner = el('div', 'chx-in');
      const art = el('div', 'chx-art');
      const pic = el('div', 'chx-pic');
      fillArt(pic, o.card);
      art.appendChild(pic);
      inner.appendChild(art);
      if (typeof info.elixir === 'number') { const cost = el('div', 'chx-cost', SVG_DROP + '<span>' + info.elixir + '</span>'); inner.appendChild(cost); }
      // v5 (docs/V5.md item 9): what the upgrade does is shown right away - card name,
      // effect icon, title and the German description (no press-and-hold needed any more)
      const cn = el('div', 'chx-cname'); cn.textContent = info.name; art.appendChild(cn);
      const fxWrap = el('div', 'chx-fxwrap'); fxWrap.appendChild(fxBadge(o)); art.appendChild(fxWrap);
      const body = el('div', 'chx-body');
      const rn = el('div', 'chx-rar'); rn.textContent = R.name; body.appendChild(rn);   // v12: rarity name
      const tb = el('div', 'chx-title'); tb.textContent = o.title || ''; body.appendChild(tb);
      const tx = el('div', 'chx-text'); tx.textContent = o.text || ''; body.appendChild(tx);
      if (String(o.text || '').length > 70) b.classList.add('is-long');
      inner.appendChild(body);
      b.appendChild(inner);
      // rarity as gems (1 common, 2 rare, 3 epic) instead of a word
      const gems = el('div', 'chx-gems', o.rarity === 'epic' ? '<i></i><i></i><i></i>' : (o.rarity === 'rare' ? '<i></i><i></i>' : '<i></i>'));
      b.appendChild(gems);
      const stamp = el('div', 'chx-stamp', SVG_CHECK); b.appendChild(stamp);
      b.addEventListener('click', function (ev) {
        if (ev) ev.preventDefault();
        self.choose(i);
      });
      this.cards.appendChild(b);
      this.cardEls.push(b);
    }
    this.cards.classList.toggle('is-n3', list.length >= 3);
    this.sub.textContent = '';
    if (rounds) { const r = el('span', 'chx-round'); r.textContent = (round || 1) + ' / ' + rounds; this.sub.appendChild(r); }
    this.picksEl = el('span', 'chx-picks');
    this.picksEl.hidden = true;
    this.sub.appendChild(this.picksEl);
  };

  /** '' or 'wait' (waiting for the opponent: opponent icon + bouncing dots, no words). */
  Instance.prototype.setStatus = function (state) {
    const v = state === 'wait' ? 'wait' : '';
    if (this.dv.status === v) return;
    this.dv.status = v;
    this.status.innerHTML = v ? '<span class="chx-who">' + SVG_OPP + '</span><span class="chx-dots"><i></i><i></i><i></i></span>' : '';
    this.status.setAttribute('aria-label', v ? 'Warte auf deinen Gegner' : '');
  };
  Instance.prototype.setSkip = function (on) {
    if (this.dv.skip === on) return;
    this.dv.skip = on;
    this.skipBtn.hidden = !on;
  };

  Instance.prototype.setOpen = function (on) {
    if (this.open === on) return;
    this.open = on;
    this.ov.classList.toggle('is-open', on);
    if (!on) { this.hideTip(); }
  };

  Instance.prototype.burst = function (r) {
    const b = el('div', 'chx-burst');
    setRar(b, r);
    this.root.appendChild(b);
    G.setTimeout(function () { if (b.parentNode) b.parentNode.removeChild(b); }, 800);
  };

  /** Wordless pick toast: card art + effect icon, ringed in the team colour. */
  Instance.prototype.toast = function (side, o) {
    const t = el('div', 'chx-toast ' + (side === this.side ? 'is-own' : 'is-opp'));
    setRar(t, o.rarity);
    t.setAttribute('aria-label', (side === this.side ? 'Dein Upgrade: ' : 'Gegner-Upgrade: ') + cardInfo(o.card).name + ' – ' + o.title);
    const ti = el('div', 'chx-ti');
    fillArt(ti, o.card);
    t.appendChild(ti);
    const fx = el('div', 'chx-tfx');
    fx.appendChild(fxBadge(o));
    t.appendChild(fx);
    this.toasts.appendChild(t);
    while (this.toasts.childNodes.length > 3) this.toasts.removeChild(this.toasts.firstChild);
    G.setTimeout(function () { if (t.parentNode) t.parentNode.removeChild(t); }, 2900);
  };

  Instance.prototype.showTip = function (chip, o, isOwn) {
    const tip = this.tip;
    setRar(tip, o.rarity);
    tip.innerHTML = '';
    const i = el('i'); i.textContent = (isOwn ? 'Dein Upgrade' : 'Gegner') + ' · ' + cardInfo(o.card).name + ' · ' + rar(o.rarity).name; tip.appendChild(i);
    const b = el('b'); b.textContent = o.title; tip.appendChild(b);
    tip.appendChild(doc.createTextNode(o.text));
    // tap handler only (layout reads are fine here): next to the chip, towards the centre
    const rr = this.root.getBoundingClientRect(), cr = chip.getBoundingClientRect();
    const leftSide = cr.left + cr.width / 2 < rr.left + rr.width / 2;
    tip.style.left = leftSide ? Math.round(cr.right - rr.left + 10) + 'px' : '';
    tip.style.right = leftSide ? '' : Math.round(rr.right - cr.left + 10) + 'px';
    tip.style.bottom = '';
    tip.style.top = Math.max(4, Math.round(cr.top - rr.top)) + 'px';
    tip.classList.add('is-on');
    if (this.tipTimer) G.clearTimeout(this.tipTimer);
    const self = this;
    this.tipTimer = G.setTimeout(function () { self.hideTip(); }, 6000);   // safety: release hides it
  };
  Instance.prototype.hideTip = function () { this.tip.classList.remove('is-on'); };

  Instance.prototype.renderStrip = function (strip, owned, isOwn) {
    strip.textContent = '';
    const self = this;
    for (let i = 0; i < owned.length; i++) {
      const o = owned[i];
      const chip = el('button', 'chx-chip');
      chip.type = 'button';
      setRar(chip, o.rarity);
      chip.setAttribute('aria-label', (isOwn ? 'Dein' : 'Gegnerisches') + ' Upgrade: ' + cardInfo(o.card).name + ' – ' + o.title);
      const ci = el('div', 'chx-ci');
      fillArt(ci, o.card);
      chip.appendChild(ci);
      // the text only while the chip is pressed and held (no words by default)
      holdable(chip, function () { self.showTip(chip, o, isOwn); }, function () { self.hideTip(); });
      chip.addEventListener('click', function (ev) { if (ev) ev.preventDefault(); chip.dataset.held = ''; });
      strip.appendChild(chip);
    }
  };

  /** First player of the other team (players[i].side, 1v1: index = side). */
  function opponentIndex(players, pi, side) {
    const me = players[pi];
    const ms = me && me.side != null ? me.side : side;
    for (let i = 0; i < players.length; i++) {
      const p = players[i];
      if (!p) continue;
      if ((p.side != null ? p.side : i) !== ms) return i;
    }
    return 1 - ms;
  }

  function ownedSig(owned) {
    let s = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < owned.length; i++) s += owned[i].id + ',';
    return s;
  }

  /** Called every frame by the app shell. */
  Instance.prototype.update = function (view, localSide, sendCommand, localPlayer) {
    if (this.destroyed || !view || !view.players) return;
    if (localSide === 0 || localSide === 1) this.side = localSide;
    if (typeof localPlayer === 'number' && localPlayer >= 0) this.player = localPlayer;
    if (typeof sendCommand === 'function') this.send = sendCommand;
    // v5 2v2: own = the local PLAYER, opponent strip = the first player of the other team
    const pi = this.player != null && view.players[this.player] ? this.player : this.side;
    const oi = opponentIndex(view.players, pi, this.side);
    const me = view.players[pi], opp = view.players[oi];
    const ch = me && me.chaos, och = opp && opp.chaos;
    if (!ch) { this.setOpen(false); this.pill.classList.add('is-hidden'); return; }
    const t = now();

    // ---- owned strips + toasts for new picks
    for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
      const s = k === 0 ? this.side : 1 - this.side;   // 0: own strip, 1: opponent strip
      const c = k === 0 ? ch : och;
      const owned = (c && Array.isArray(c.owned)) ? c.owned : [];
      const sig = ownedSig(owned);
      if (sig !== this.ownSig[k]) {
        const prev = this.ownedPrev[k];
        if (prev) {
          const had = Object.create(null);
          for (let i = 0; i < prev.length; i++) had[prev[i].id] = true;
          for (let i = 0; i < owned.length; i++) if (!had[owned[i].id]) {
            this.toast(s, owned[i]);
            if (s === this.side) { this.burst(owned[i].rarity); this.sound('chaos'); }
          }
        }
        this.ownSig[k] = sig;
        this.ownedPrev[k] = owned.slice();
        this.renderStrip(s === this.side ? this.stripOwn : this.stripOpp, owned, s === this.side);
      }
    }

    // ---- picker overlay
    const offers = Array.isArray(ch.offers) && ch.offers.length ? ch.offers : null;
    const dec = ch.decided && Array.isArray(ch.decided.options) ? ch.decided : null;
    const list = offers || (ch.paused && dec ? dec.options : null);
    const paused = !!ch.paused;
    if (paused) {
      const sig = 'r' + (ch.round || 0) + '|' + (list ? list.map(function (o) { return o.id; }).join(',') : '-');
      if (sig !== this.sig) {
        this.sig = sig;
        this.picked = null;
        this.taken = [];
        this.picksLeft = 1;
        this.decKey = '';
        if (list) {
          this.buildCards(list, ch.round, ch.rounds);
          if (!dec) { this.sound('chaos'); this.buzz(30); }
        } else { this.cards.textContent = ''; this.cardEls = []; this.sub.textContent = ''; }
        this.left = +ch.offerTimeLeft || 0; this.leftAt = t; this.rate = 1; this.lastSecs = -1;
        this.total = +ch.offerTotal || Math.max(1, this.left);
      }
      this.setOpen(true);
      // v12 bonus offer: options taken by the authority + picks left (badge "x2" / "x1")
      if (offers) {
        const pl = Math.max(1, +ch.picksLeft || 1);
        for (let i = 0; i < offers.length && i < this.cardEls.length; i++) {
          if (offers[i].taken && this.taken.indexOf(i) < 0) { this.taken.push(i); this.cardEls[i].classList.add('is-picked', 'is-taken'); }
        }
        if (this.taken.length === 0 || pl < this.picksLeft) this.picksLeft = pl;
        if (this.picksEl) {
          const show = pl > 1 || this.taken.length > 0;
          const txt = '×' + (this.picked !== null ? 0 : this.picksLeft);
          if (this.picksEl.hidden === show) this.picksEl.hidden = !show;
          if (this.picksEl.textContent !== txt) { this.picksEl.textContent = txt; this.picksEl.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Noch ' + this.picksLeft + ' Wahl' + (this.picksLeft === 1 ? '' : 'en')); }
        }
      }
      // decided (by tap, bot, timeout or skip): reflect the authority's state
      if (dec) {
        const pick = dec.pick === 'skip' ? SKIP : dec.pick;
        const many = Array.isArray(dec.picks) && dec.picks.length > 1;
        const dk = String(dec.pick) + '|' + (many ? dec.picks.join(',') : '');
        if (this.picked === null || this.picked !== pick || dk !== this.decKey) { this.decKey = dk; this.picked = pick; this.markPicked(dec.pick === 'skip' ? 'skip' : (many ? dec.picks : pick)); }
      }
      // countdown (values arrive in 0.25 s steps; interpolate locally with the observed rate)
      const val = +ch.offerTimeLeft || 0;
      if (Math.abs(val - this.left) > 1e-6) {
        const el2 = (t - this.leftAt) / 1000;
        if (val < this.left && el2 > 0.05) this.rate = CR.clamp ? CR.clamp((this.left - val) / el2, 0.3, 3) : (this.left - val) / el2;
        this.left = val; this.leftAt = t;
      }
      // never more than one 0.25 s step below the last authoritative value (paused host, lag)
      const shown = Math.max(0, this.left - 0.3, this.left - this.rate * (t - this.leftAt) / 1000);
      const total = this.total || 1;
      const dv = this.dv;
      const showTimer = !!offers || !!(dec && ch.waiting);
      if (dv.clock !== showTimer) { dv.clock = showTimer; this.clock.style.display = showTimer ? '' : 'none'; }
      const showSecs = !!offers;
      if (dv.secsShown !== showSecs) { dv.secsShown = showSecs; this.secs.style.visibility = showSecs ? '' : 'hidden'; }
      const k = Math.max(0, Math.min(FILL_STEPS, Math.round(shown / total * FILL_STEPS)));
      if (k !== dv.fillK) { dv.fillK = k; this.fill.style.transform = fillScale(k); }
      const low = shown <= 2.5;
      if (dv.low !== low) { dv.low = low; this.timer.classList.toggle('is-low', low); this.clock.classList.toggle('is-low', low); }
      const secs = Math.ceil(shown - 1e-3);
      if (secs !== this.lastSecs) {
        this.lastSecs = secs;
        this.secs.textContent = String(Math.max(0, secs));
        if (offers && secs <= 3 && secs > 0) this.sound('tick');
      }
      this.setStatus(this.picked !== null && ch.waiting ? 'wait' : '');
      this.setSkip(!!(offers && ch.canSkip && this.picked === null));
      const waiting = !list;
      if (dv.wait !== waiting) { dv.wait = waiting; this.wait.classList.toggle('is-on', waiting); this.ov.classList.toggle('is-waiting', waiting); }
    } else {
      if (this.open) { this.sig = ''; this.picked = null; }
      this.setOpen(false);
    }

    // ---- info pill
    // wordless: bolt + seconds to the next upgrade (+ x2 when a skip is banked)
    let pill = '';
    let soon = false;
    const x2 = !!ch.skipBanked;
    if (!paused && !view.over) {
      if (typeof ch.nextIn === 'number') { pill = String(ch.nextIn); soon = ch.nextIn <= 5; }
      else if (x2) pill = ' ';
    }
    const psig = pill + (soon ? '!' : '') + (x2 ? '2' : '');
    if (psig !== this.pillSig) {
      this.pillSig = psig;
      this.pillText.textContent = pill.trim();
      this.pillX2.hidden = !x2;
      this.pill.classList.toggle('is-hidden', !pill);
      this.pill.classList.toggle('is-soon', soon);
      this.pill.setAttribute('aria-label', pill.trim() ? 'Nächstes Upgrade in ' + pill.trim() + ' s' : '');
    }
  };

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ module API
  let active = null;
  const ChaosUI = {
    mount: function (rootEl, opts) {
      if (!doc || !rootEl) return null;
      if (active && active.host === rootEl && !active.destroyed) active.destroy();
      active = new Instance(rootEl, opts || {});
      return active;
    },
    update: function (view, localSide, sendCommand) { if (active) active.update(view, localSide, sendCommand); },
    unmount: function () { if (active) active.destroy(); active = null; },
    destroy: function () { ChaosUI.unmount(); },
    get active() { return active; },
    RARITY: RAR,
    effectOf: effectOf,
    FX_KINDS: Object.keys(FX),
  };
  CR.ChaosUI = ChaosUI;
})(globalThis.CR || (globalThis.CR = {}));

</script>
<script>
/* src/13-audio.js */
/*
 * src/13-audio.js - CR.Audio: synthesised sound effects and music for Bust War (v5, audio owner).
 *
 * Everything is generated at runtime with WebAudio (oscillators, a reused noise buffer, envelopes,
 * filters, one shared waveshaper and one shared short reverb). No audio files, no samples, no
 * copyrighted material - all melodies are original.
 *
 * API (docs/V5.md "Audio contract"):
 *   CR.Audio.unlock()                      call from a user gesture (also auto-installed on the
 *                                          first pointerdown/touchend/keydown when a document exists)
 *   CR.Audio.play(name, {x, pan, vol, pitch, side, n, rarity})   one SFX (x = sim x 0..18 -> stereo pan)
 *   CR.Audio.ui(name)                      'click' | 'select' | 'error' | 'back' | 'toggle' | 'ready' ...
 *   CR.Audio.onEvents(events, localSide, view?, localPlayer?)
 *                                          maps sim events to SFX (dedupes by seq; with a view it also
 *                                          identifies attackers, ticks the countdown and the full-elixir
 *                                          bloop). Returns the list of sound names it triggered.
 *   CR.Audio.music('menu' | 'battle' | 'overtime' | null)   crossfades between looping tracks
 *   CR.Audio.setIntensity(0..2)            battle loop layers (double elixir = 1, triple = 2)
 *   CR.Audio.settings = { master, music, sfx, muted }; CR.Audio.set(k, v) (persisted, try/catch)
 *   CR.Audio.onChange(fn)                  fn(settings) after every set()
 *   CR.Audio.map(ev, localSide, view?, localPlayer?) -> {name, opts} | null   (pure, for tests)
 *   CR.Audio.resetBattle()                 forget seen event seqs (also done on music('battle'))
 *   CR.Audio.names()                       every SFX name (preview page)
 * Legacy names of the v4 UI.Sound synth are accepted by play() as aliases (tap, deny, enemyDeploy,
 * crownLost, crownPop, fight, phase, chaos, tick, whoosh, win, lose, draw, tower, ready, emote).
 *
 * v6 (QA glue): 'touchdown' (crown event with touchdown: true, own team), Kung-Fu-Legende 'kiai'
 * (flying kick start), 'punch' (its melee hits, kick impact), 'one_inch' (kiai + heavy hit); the

      const c = [72, 76, 79, 84];
      for (let i = 0; i < c.length; i++) brass(d, t + 0.9, hz(c[i]) * p, 1.3, 0.15 * v, { bright: 3400 });
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) tone(o.dc, t + 0.9 - 0.3 + i * 0.05, 'sine', 100, 50, 0.12, 0.35 * v);
      noise(d, t + 0.9, 1.4, 0.2 * v, 'highpass', 5200, 0, { a: 0.01 });
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) ping(d, t + 1.0 + i * 0.07, hz([96, 100, 103, 108, 103, 108][i]) * p, 0.4, 0.06 * v);
    } },
    defeat: { pri: 2, gap: 1, max: 1, win: 2, fn: function (d, t, v, p, o) {
      const m = [69, 67, 65, 64];
      for (let i = 0; i < m.length; i++) brass(d, t + i * 0.3, hz(m[i]) * p, i === 3 ? 1.3 : 0.3, 0.16 * v, { bright: 1300 });
      const c = [50, 53, 57];
      for (let i = 0; i < c.length; i++) tone(d, t + 0.9, 'triangle', hz(c[i]) * p, 0, 1.5, 0.1 * v, { a: 0.1 });
      tone(o.dc, t + 0.9, 'sine', 70, 35, 0.6, 0.6 * v);
    } },
    draw: { pri: 2, gap: 1, max: 1, win: 2, fn: function (d, t, v, p) {
      brass(d, t, hz(67) * p, 0.18, 0.18 * v, { bright: 2000 });
      brass(d, t + 0.2, hz(72) * p, 0.18, 0.18 * v, { bright: 2000 });
      const c = [62, 67, 72, 74];
      for (let i = 0; i < c.length; i++) brass(d, t + 0.42, hz(c[i]) * p, 1.0, 0.12 * v, { bright: 2200 });
    } },

    // ---- UI
    click: { pri: 2, gap: 0.03, max: 4, win: 0.3, ui: true, fn: function (d, t, v, p) {
      tone(d, t, 'triangle', 760 * p, 600 * p, 0.05, 0.34 * v);
      noise(d, t, 0.015, 0.12 * v, 'highpass', 6000, 0);
    } },
    select: { pri: 2, gap: 0.03, max: 4, win: 0.3, ui: true, fn: function (d, t, v, p) {
      tone(d, t, 'triangle', 880 * p, 0, 0.05, 0.18 * v);
      tone(d, t + 0.045, 'triangle', 1320 * p, 0, 0.07, 0.16 * v);
    } },
    error: { pri: 2, gap: 0.12, max: 2, win: 0.5, ui: true, fn: function (d, t, v, p) {
      tone(d, t, 'square', 196 * p, 0, 0.09, 0.11 * v, { ft: 'lowpass', ff: 1200 });
      tone(d, t + 0.1, 'square', 147 * p, 0, 0.12, 0.11 * v, { ft: 'lowpass', ff: 1100 });
    } },
    back: { pri: 2, gap: 0.03, max: 4, win: 0.3, ui: true, fn: function (d, t, v, p) {
      tone(d, t, 'triangle', 660 * p, 440 * p, 0.07, 0.3 * v);
    } },
    toggle: { pri: 2, gap: 0.03, max: 4, win: 0.3, ui: true, fn: function (d, t, v, p) {
      tone(d, t, 'triangle', 1040 * p, 0, 0.045, 0.28 * v);
    } },
    ready: { pri: 2, gap: 0.1, max: 2, win: 0.5, ui: true, fn: function (d, t, v, p) {
      const n = [76, 79, 84];
      for (let i = 0; i < n.length; i++) tone(d, t + i * 0.06, 'triangle', hz(n[i]) * p, 0, 0.12, 0.16 * v);
    } },
    emote: { pri: 1, gap: 0.2, max: 2, win: 0.6, fn: function (d, t, v, p) {
      tone(d, t, 'triangle', 988 * p, 0, 0.06, 0.15 * v);
      tone(d, t + 0.06, 'triangle', 1319 * p, 0, 0.08, 0.13 * v);
    } },
  };

  const ALIAS = {
    tap: 'click', deny: 'error', enemyDeploy: 'deploy_enemy', crownLost: 'crown_lost', crownPop: 'crown_pop',
    tower: 'tower_down', chaos: 'chaos_offer', tick: 'countdown', win: 'victory', lose: 'defeat',
    loss: 'defeat', phase: 'double_elixir', open: 'select', close: 'back',
  };
  A.names = function () { return Object.keys(SFX); };
  A.has = function (name) { return !!SFX[ALIAS[name] || name]; };

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ play

  function panFor(o) {
    if (typeof o.pan === 'number' && isFinite(o.pan)) return Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, o.pan));
    if (typeof o.x === 'number' && isFinite(o.x)) {
      const side = (o.side === 0 || o.side === 1) ? o.side : A.localSide;
      const W = (CR.Arena && CR.Arena.W) || 18;
      let p = (o.x - W / 2) / (W / 2);
      if (side === 1) p = -p;
      return Math.max(-0.75, Math.min(0.75, p * 0.75));
    }
    return 0;
  }

  /** Rate limiting per sound name. Returns a volume factor (0 = drop). */
  function admit(name, def, now) {
    let L = S.limit[name];
    if (!L) L = S.limit[name] = { last: -1e9, times: [] };
    if (now - L.last < (def.gap || 0.03)) return 0;
    const win = def.win || 0.3;
    let w = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < L.times.length; i++) if (now - L.times[i] < win) L.times[w++] = L.times[i];
    L.times.length = w;
    if (w >= (def.max || 6)) return 0;
    L.last = now;
    L.times.push(now);
    return 1 / (1 + 0.28 * w);
  }

  /**
   * Plays one SFX. opts: {x, side, pan, vol, pitch, delay, n, rarity}. Returns true if scheduled.
   */
  A.play = function (name, opts) {
    const key = SFX[name] ? name : ALIAS[name];
    const def = key && SFX[key];
    if (!def) return false;
    if (!ctxReady() || A.settings.muted || A.settings.sfx <= 0 || A.settings.master <= 0) return false;
    const o = opts || NONE;
    const c = A.ctx;
    const now = c.currentTime;
    const live = liveVoices(now);
    if ((def.pri === 0 && live > VOICE_CAP * 0.6) || (def.pri === 1 && live > VOICE_CAP * 0.85) || live > VOICE_CAP * 1.6) return false;
    const f = admit(key, def, now);
    if (!f) return false;
    try {
      const pan = panFor(o);
      let dest = S.sfx, dc = S.crunch;
      if (pan && c.createStereoPanner) {
        const pn = c.createStereoPanner();
        pn.pan.setValueAtTime(pan, now);
        pn.connect(S.sfx);
        dest = pn;
        dc = pn;  // panned heavy sounds skip the shared clipper (keeps the pan)
      }
      const v = (o.vol == null ? 1 : Math.max(0, Number(o.vol) || 0)) * f;
      const p = (o.pitch || 1) * (def.pri === 0 ? rnd(0.95, 1.05) : 1);
      def.fn(dest, now + 0.005 + (o.delay || 0), v, p, { dc: dc, n: o.n, rarity: o.rarity });
    } catch (e) { return false; }
    A.log.push(key);
    if (A.log.length > 32) A.log.shift();
    return true;
  };

  A.ui = function (name) { return A.play(name || 'click'); };

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ event mapping

  // Attacker unit (or tower) -> hit sound.
  const SRC = {
    knight: 'hit_sword', guard: 'hit_sword', 'royal-recruit': 'hit_sword', bandit: 'hit_sword', barbarian: 'hit_sword',
    prince: 'hit_sword', miner: 'hit_axe', 'battle-healer': 'hit_sword', 'dark-prince': 'hit_heavy',
    'mini-pekka': 'hit_heavy', pekka: 'hit_heavy', giant: 'hit_heavy', golem: 'hit_heavy', golemite: 'hit_heavy',
    'elixir-golemite': 'hit_heavy', 'giant-skeleton': 'hit_heavy', 'mega-knight': 'hit_heavy', 'electro-giant': 'hit_heavy',
    'ice-golem': 'hit_heavy', 'battle-ram': 'hit_heavy', 'hog-rider': 'hit_heavy', 'royal-hog': 'hit_heavy', bowler: 'hit_heavy',
    valkyrie: 'hit_axe', lumberjack: 'hit_axe', executioner: 'hit_axe',
    skeleton: 'hit_light', goblin: 'hit_light', bat: 'hit_light', minion: 'hit_light', 'mega-minion': 'hit_light',
    'spear-goblin': 'arrow', archer: 'arrow', 'dart-goblin': 'arrow', 'x-bow': 'arrow', musketeer: 'shot',
    firecracker: 'boom_small', wizard: 'fire_hit', 'baby-dragon': 'fire_hit', 'fire-spirit': 'fire_hit',
    'lava-hound': 'fire_hit', 'lava-pup': 'fire_hit', phoenix: 'fire_hit', 'phoenix-reborn': 'fire_hit', witch: 'magic',
    'inferno-tower': 'burn', 'inferno-dragon': 'burn',
    bomber: 'boom_small', 'bomb-tower': 'boom_small', balloon: 'boom_small',
    cannon: 'cannon', mortar: 'cannon', 'royal-giant': 'cannon',
    sparky: 'zap', tesla: 'zap_small', 'electro-wizard': 'zap_small', 'electro-spirit': 'zap_small',
    'ice-wizard': 'ice_hit', 'ice-spirit': 'freeze',
    'electro-dragon': 'zap_small', 'kung-fu-legend': 'punch',   // v6
    'princess-tower': 'tower_shot', 'king-tower': 'cannon', 'tower:princess': 'tower_shot', 'tower:king': 'cannon',
  };
  const HIT_KIND = { melee: 'hit_sword', ranged: 'arrow', splash: 'boom_small', charge: 'charge_hit', jump: 'slam', reflect: 'zap_small' };
  const SPELL_CAST = {
    fireball: 'launch', rocket: 'launch', 'giant-snowball': 'launch', 'goblin-barrel': 'launch', arrows: 'bow_volley',
    'the-log': 'log', 'barbarian-barrel': 'log', tornado: 'tornado', earthquake: 'quake', poison: 'poison', rage: 'rage',
    freeze: 'freeze', zap: 'zap', graveyard: 'spooky', clone: 'magic', mirror: 'magic', 'royal-delivery': 'whoosh', heal: 'heal',
    lightning: null,
  };
  const SPELL_IMPACT = {
    fireball: 'explosion', rocket: 'rocket', arrows: 'arrows', 'giant-snowball': 'snowball', 'goblin-barrel': 'barrel',
    lightning: 'lightning', poison: 'poison_tick', earthquake: 'quake_tick', 'royal-delivery': 'slam', clone: 'magic',
    'barbarian-barrel': 'barrel', heal: null, freeze: null, zap: null, tornado: null, graveyard: null, rage: null,
  };
  const DEATH_BLAST = { 'ice-golem': 'freeze', 'giant-skeleton': 'rocket', balloon: 'boom_small', golem: 'slam', golemite: 'slam', 'lava-hound': 'fire_hit', 'electro-giant': 'zap_small' };
  const SPAWN_BLAST = { 'electro-wizard': 'zap', 'mega-knight': 'slam' };
  const ABILITY = {
    explosion: 'explosion', meteor: 'explosion', impact: 'boom_small', bounce: 'boom_small', zap: 'zap', chain: 'zap', storm: 'zap',
    strike: 'lightning', frost: 'freeze', snowstorm: 'freeze', shield: 'shield', transform: 'magic', grow: 'magic', hatch: 'magic',
    revive: 'magic', mirror: 'magic', random: 'magic', reveal: 'magic', leveldown: 'magic', split: 'magic', trio: 'magic',
    dash: 'whoosh', charge: 'charge_hit', jump: 'slam', slam: 'slam', quake: 'quake', launch: 'whoosh', throw: 'whoosh',
    tornado: 'tornado', pull: 'tornado', push: 'whoosh', spin: 'whoosh', roam: 'whoosh', volley: 'bow_volley',
    multiroll: 'log', longroll: 'log', pierce: 'arrow', poison: 'poison', graveyard: 'spooky', spawn: 'deploy_enemy',
  };

  function cardType(id) {
    const D = CR.DATA;
    if (!D || !D.cards) return null;
    if (!S.cardTypes) {
      S.cardTypes = {};
      for (let i = 0; i < D.cards.length; i++) {
        const c = D.cards[i];
        S.cardTypes[c.id] = { type: c.type, unit: c.summon && c.summon[0] ? String(c.summon[0].unit) : c.id };
      }
    }
    return S.cardTypes[id] || null;
  }

  /** Attacker id -> unit id (or 'tower:king' / 'tower:princess'). */
  function srcUnit(id, view) {
    if (!id) return null;
    if (view && (view.units || view.towers)) {
      if (S.idView !== view) {
        const m = {};
        const us = view.units || [];
        for (let i = 0; i < us.length; i++) m[us[i].id] = us[i].unit || us[i].card;
        const ts = view.towers || [];
        for (let i = 0; i < ts.length; i++) m[ts[i].id] = 'tower:' + ts[i].kind;
        S.idMap = m; S.idView = view;
      }
      if (S.idMap[id]) return S.idMap[id];
    }
    return S.deployMap[id] || null;
  }

  function mineP(ev, localPlayer, localSide) {
    if (ev.player != null) return ev.player === localPlayer;
    if (ev.owner != null) return ev.owner === localPlayer;
    return ev.side === localPlayer || (localPlayer === localSide && ev.side === localSide);
  }

  /** Pure mapping of one sim event -> {name, opts} | null. */
  A.map = function (ev, localSide, view, localPlayer) {
    if (!ev || !ev.t) return null;
    const ls = localSide === 1 ? 1 : 0;
    const lp = localPlayer == null ? ls : localPlayer;
    const pos = { x: ev.x, side: ls };
    switch (ev.t) {
      case 'deploy': {
        const ct = cardType(ev.card);
        if (ct && ct.type === 'spell') return null;
        return { name: mineP(ev, lp, ls) ? 'deploy' : 'deploy_enemy', opts: pos };
      }
      case 'spell': {
        if (ev.phase === 'cast') {
          if (ev.card in SPELL_CAST) return SPELL_CAST[ev.card] ? { name: SPELL_CAST[ev.card], opts: pos } : null;
          if (ev.kind === 'projectile') return { name: 'launch', opts: pos };
          if (ev.kind === 'roll') return { name: 'log', opts: pos };
          return { name: 'cast', opts: pos };
        }
        if (ev.kind === 'death') {
          const n = DEATH_BLAST[ev.unit] || 'boom_small';
          return { name: n, opts: pos };
        }
        if (ev.kind === 'spawn') return { name: SPAWN_BLAST[ev.unit] || 'slam', opts: pos };
        if (ev.kind === 'strike' || ev.kind === 'lightning') return { name: 'lightning', opts: pos };
        if (ev.kind === 'rage') return { name: 'rage', opts: pos };
        if (ev.card in SPELL_IMPACT) return SPELL_IMPACT[ev.card] ? { name: SPELL_IMPACT[ev.card], opts: pos } : null;
        if (ev.kind === 'projectile') return { name: 'boom_small', opts: pos };
        return null;
      }
      case 'hit': {
        if (ev.kind === 'elixir') return mineP(ev, lp, ls) ? { name: 'elixir', opts: pos } : null;
        if (ev.kind === 'spell' || ev.kind === 'death') return null;
        if (ev.kind === 'charge') return { name: 'charge_hit', opts: pos };
        if (ev.kind === 'jump') return { name: 'slam', opts: pos };
        const u = srcUnit(ev.src, view);
        const n = (u && SRC[u]) || HIT_KIND[ev.kind] || 'hit_sword';
        return { name: n, opts: { x: ev.x, side: ls, vol: 0.8 } };
      }
      case 'death': {
        if (ev.reason === 'transform' || ev.reason === 'kamikaze') return null;
        return { name: ev.building ? 'collapse' : 'poof', opts: pos };
      }
      case 'tower_down':
        if (ev.cascade) return null;
        return { name: ev.kind === 'king' ? 'king_down' : 'tower_down', opts: pos };
      case 'crown':
        if (ev.touchdown) return { name: ev.side === ls ? 'touchdown' : 'crown_lost', opts: NONE };   // v6
        return { name: ev.side === ls ? 'crown' : 'crown_lost', opts: NONE };
      case 'king_active':
        return { name: 'king_wake', opts: NONE };
      case 'phase': {
        if (ev.phase === 'ended') {
          const w = ev.winner;
          return { name: w === 'draw' || w == null ? 'draw' : (w === ls ? 'victory' : 'defeat'), opts: { delay: 0.35 } };
        }
        if (ev.phase === 'triple' || ev.elixirMult >= 3) return { name: 'triple_elixir', opts: NONE };
        if (ev.overtime && ev.phase === 'overtime') return { name: 'overtime', opts: NONE };
        if (ev.phase === 'double' || ev.elixirMult === 2) return { name: ev.overtime ? 'overtime' : 'double_elixir', opts: NONE };
        return null;
      }
      case 'chaos_offer':
        return mineP(ev, lp, ls) ? { name: 'chaos_offer', opts: NONE } : null;
      case 'chaos_pick':
        return mineP(ev, lp, ls)
          ? { name: 'chaos_pick', opts: { rarity: ({ common: 0, rare: 1, epic: 2, legendary: 3 })[ev.rarity] | 0 } }
          : { name: 'chaos_pick_enemy', opts: { vol: 0.7 } };
      case 'ability': {
        // v6: Kung-Fu-Legende - punches, one-inch punch with kiai, kiai on the flying kick
        if (ev.kind === 'combo') return null;   // the 'hit' event of the same punch already sounds
        if (ev.kind === 'one-inch') return { name: 'one_inch', opts: { x: ev.x, side: ls, vol: 0.9 } };
        if (ev.kind === 'dash' && ev.unit === 'kung-fu-legend') return ev.phase === 'impact' ? { name: 'punch', opts: { x: ev.x, side: ls, vol: 0.9 } } : { name: 'kiai', opts: { x: ev.x, side: ls, vol: 0.85 } };
        const n = ABILITY[ev.kind] || 'magic';
        return { name: n, opts: { x: ev.x, side: ls, vol: 0.85 } };
      }
      case 'emote':
        return { name: 'emote', opts: NONE };
      case 'reject':
        return mineP(ev, lp, ls) ? { name: 'error', opts: NONE } : null;
      default:
        return null;
    }
  };

  /** Plays the SFX for a batch of sim events (deduped by seq). Returns the names it triggered. */
  A.onEvents = function (events, localSide, view, localPlayer) {
    const out = [];
    A.localSide = localSide === 1 ? 1 : 0;
    const lp = localPlayer == null ? A.localSide : localPlayer;
    const seen = S.seen;
    if (view && typeof view.tick === 'number') {
      if (view.tick < seen.tick) A.resetBattle();
      seen.tick = view.tick;
    }
    if (events && events.length) {
      for (let i = 0; i < events.length; i++) {
        const ev = events[i];
        if (!ev) continue;
        if (typeof ev.seq === 'number') {
          if (ev.seq <= seen.last) {
            if (seen.last - ev.seq > 5000) A.resetBattle(); else continue;
          }
          seen.last = ev.seq;
        }
        if (ev.t === 'deploy' && ev.units && ev.units.length) {
          const ct = cardType(ev.card);
          for (let k = 0; k < ev.units.length; k++) S.deployMap[ev.units[k]] = ct ? ct.unit : ev.card;
        }
        const m = A.map(ev, A.localSide, view, lp);
        if (m) {
          out.push(m.name);
          A.play(m.name, m.opts);
        }
        if (ev.t === 'phase') phaseMusic(ev);
      }
    }
    if (view) viewCues(view, lp, out);
    return out;
  };

  /** Countdown beeps and the full-elixir bloop from the view. */
  function viewCues(view, lp, out) {
    const ck = view.clock;
    if (ck && typeof ck.remaining === 'number' && ck.phase !== 'ended' && !view.over) {
      const r = ck.remaining;
      if (S.lastRem != null && r < S.lastRem) {
        for (let n = 10; n >= 1; n--) {
          if (S.lastRem > n && r <= n) { out.push('countdown'); A.play('countdown', { n: n }); break; }
        }
      }
      S.lastRem = r;
    }
    const p = view.players && view.players[lp];
    if (p && typeof p.elixir === 'number') {
      const max = (CR.RULES && CR.RULES.elixir && CR.RULES.elixir.max) || 10;
      if (S.lastElixir != null && S.lastElixir < max - 1e-6 && p.elixir >= max - 1e-6) { out.push('elixir_full'); A.play('elixir_full'); }
      S.lastElixir = p.elixir;
    }
  }

  function phaseMusic(ev) {
    if (ev.phase === 'ended') { A.music(null); return; }
    if (A.current !== 'battle' && A.current !== 'overtime') return;
    if (ev.overtime && A.current === 'battle') A.music('overtime');
    A.setIntensity(ev.phase === 'triple' || ev.elixirMult >= 3 ? 2 : (ev.elixirMult >= 2 || ev.overtime ? 1 : 0));
  }

  A.resetBattle = function () {
    S.seen.last = -1; S.seen.tick = -1;
    S.deployMap = {}; S.idMap = null; S.idView = null;
    S.lastRem = null; S.lastElixir = null;
  };

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ music

  function mInst(style, kind, d, t, m, dur, vel) {
    const f = hz(m);
    switch (kind) {
      case 'lute':
        tone(d, t, 'sawtooth', f, 0, Math.min(0.9, dur + 0.25), 0.07 * vel, { a: 0.003, ft: 'lowpass', ff: 3200, ff2: 500, fdur: 0.22 });
        tone(d, t, 'triangle', f * 2, 0, 0.25, 0.03 * vel, { a: 0.002 });
        break;
      case 'flute':
        tone(d, t, 'triangle', f, 0, dur + 0.12, 0.12 * vel, { a: 0.05, hold: dur * 0.6, ft: 'lowpass', ff: 2600 });
        tone(d, t + 0.04, 'sine', f * 2, 0, dur, 0.025 * vel, { a: 0.06, hold: dur * 0.5, detune: 6 });
        break;
      case 'pad':
        tone(d, t, 'sawtooth', f, 0, dur, 0.022 * vel, { a: dur * 0.3, hold: dur * 0.35, detune: -8, ft: 'lowpass', ff: 900 });
        tone(d, t, 'sawtooth', f, 0, dur, 0.022 * vel, { a: dur * 0.3, hold: dur * 0.35, detune: 8, ft: 'lowpass', ff: 900 });
        break;
      case 'bass':
        if (style === 'menu') tone(d, t, 'triangle', f, 0, dur, 0.22 * vel, { a: 0.01, hold: dur * 0.5 });
        else tone(d, t, 'sawtooth', f, 0, dur, 0.13 * vel, { a: 0.004, hold: dur * 0.3, ft: 'lowpass', ff: 900, ff2: 260, fdur: dur });
        break;
      case 'lead':
        brass(d, t, f, dur + 0.05, 0.16 * vel, { bright: 2400, a: 0.015 });
        break;
      case 'arp':
        tone(d, t, 'square', f, 0, dur, 0.035 * vel, { a: 0.002, ft: 'lowpass', ff: 2600, ff2: 900 });
        break;
      case 'stab':
        tone(d, t, 'sawtooth', f, 0, dur, 0.05 * vel, { a: 0.003, ft: 'lowpass', ff: 2800, ff2: 700 });
        break;
      case 'kick':
        tone(d, t, 'sine', 150, 44, 0.24, 0.6 * vel, { glide: 0.11 });
        break;
      case 'snare':
        noise(d, t, 0.16, 0.26 * vel, 'bandpass', 1900, 1200, { q: 0.8 });
        tone(d, t, 'triangle', 210, 160, 0.08, 0.14 * vel);
        break;
      case 'hat':
        noise(d, t, dur, 0.09 * vel, 'highpass', 7200, 0);
        break;
      case 'tamb':

  function scheduleStep(p, step, t) {

    const bars = T.chords.length;

      if (s % 2 === 0) {
        const pat = [0, 2, 3, 1, 3, 2, 1, 2];
        const i = (s / 2) | 0;
        const tones = ch.tones;
        const idx = pat[i];
        const m = idx === 3 ? tones[0] + 12 : tones[Math.min(idx, tones.length - 1)];
        mInst('menu', 'lute', d, t, m + 12 + tr, sd * 2, i === 0 ? 1.1 : 0.85);
      }
      if (s === 0 || s === 8) mInst('menu', 'bass', d, t, ch.root - 12 + tr, sd * 7.5, 1);
      if (s === 0) for (let i = 0; i < ch.tones.length; i++) mInst('menu', 'pad', d, t, ch.tones[i] + 12 + tr, sd * 16, 1);
      if (s === 0 || s === 8) mInst('menu', 'drum', d, t, 0, 0, s === 0 ? 1 : 0.8);
      if (s === 6 || s === 11) mInst('menu', 'drum', d, t, 0, 0, 0.45);
      if (s === 4 || s === 12) mInst('menu', 'tamb', d, t, 0, 0, 1);
      if (s === 14) mInst('menu', 'tamb', d, t, 0, 0, 0.5);

    }

    // battle / overtime
    if (mel) mInst('battle', 'lead', d, t, mel.m + tr, mel.len * sd, 1);
    // drums
    const kickPat = lvl >= 2 ? [0, 4, 8, 10, 12] : [0, 6, 8, 10];
    if (kickPat.indexOf(s) >= 0) mInst('battle', 'kick', d, t, 0, 0, s === 0 ? 1 : 0.85);
    if (s === 4 || s === 12) mInst('battle', 'snare', d, t, 0, 0, 1);
    const lastBar = bar === bars - 1;
    if (lastBar && s >= 13) mInst('battle', 'snare', d, t, 0, 0, 0.45 + (s - 13) * 0.18);
    if (lvl >= 1 || s % 2 === 0) mInst('battle', 'hat', d, t, 0, s % 4 === 2 ? 0.09 : 0.04, s % 2 === 0 ? 1 : 0.6);
    // bass: driving eighths with octave jumps
    if (s % 2 === 0) {
      const up = (s === 6 || s === 14);
      mInst('battle', 'bass', d, t, ch.root - 12 + (up ? 12 : 0) + tr, sd * 1.8, s === 0 ? 1.1 : 0.9);
    }
    // intensity layers
    if (lvl >= 1) {
      const tones = ch.tones;
      const m = tones[s % tones.length] + 24 + (s % 8 >= 4 ? 12 : 0);
      mInst('battle', 'arp', d, t, m + tr, sd * 0.8, s % 4 === 0 ? 1 : 0.7);
    }
    if (lvl >= 2 && (s === 2 || s === 10)) {
      for (let i = 0; i < ch.tones.length; i++) mInst('battle', 'stab', d, t, ch.tones[i] + 12 + tr, sd * 1.5, 1);
    }
    if (lvl >= 2 && lastBar && s >= 8 && s < 13 && s % 2 === 0) mInst('battle', 'tom', d, t, 200 - (s - 8) * 18, 0, 0.8);
  }

  function silentMusic() {
    const st = A.settings;
    return st.muted || st.music <= 0 || st.master <= 0;
  }

  function schedulerTick() {
    if (!ctxReady()) return;
    const now = A.ctx.currentTime;
    const horizon = now + LOOKAHEAD;
    const silent = silentMusic();
    let w = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < S.players.length; i++) {
      const p = S.players[i];
      if (p.stopAt != null && now >= p.stopAt) {
        try { p.gain.disconnect(); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
        continue;
      }
      if (p.next < now - 0.1) p.next = now + 0.03;   // fell behind (throttled timer): skip, do not burst
      let guard = 0;

          try { scheduleStep(p, p.step, p.next); } catch (e) { /* keep looping */ }

    g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(1, now + (S.players.length ? fade : 0.6));

    S.players.push(p);

  A.music = function (id) {
    if (id && !TRACKS[id]) id = null;
    if (id === A.current) return;
    const prev = A.current;

  };

  A.setIntensity = function (n) {
    A.intensity = Math.max(0, Math.min(2, n | 0));
  };

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ settings API

  A.set = function (k, v) {
    if (!(k in DEFAULTS)) return A.settings;

    applyGains(false);

    return A.settings;
  };
  A.get = function (k) { return k ? A.settings[k] : Object.assign({}, A.settings); };
  A.onChange = function (fn) {
    if (typeof fn === 'function') S.listeners.push(fn);

  };
  A.normalizeSettings = normalizeSettings;

  A.DEFAULTS = Object.assign({}, DEFAULTS);

  A.state = function () {
    return {

  A._midi = midi;

<script>
/* src/14-draft.js */
/* Bust War - 14-draft.js (draft): the Touchdown DRAFT before the battle (v7).
 *
 * Rules (v7 request, German UI in 10-ui.js):
 *  - 8 rounds per draft pair. In every round the pair is offered TWO cards; the player whose
 *    turn it is picks one, the opponent of the pair gets the other one. The turn alternates
 *    every round (who starts is drawn from the seed), so after 8 rounds each player holds 8
 *    cards: 4 own picks + 4 cards the opponent left over. Both battle decks come from the draft.
 *  - Every card of the game that Touchdown allows can appear (pool = CR.Sim.enabledCards
 *    ('touchdown'), or an explicit pool). A card is offered at most once per pair, so no deck
 *    holds a card twice.
 *  - Offers are fair pairs: both cards of a round have the same kind (round plan per pair:
 *    4 troop rounds, 2 spell rounds, 1 building round, 1 free round - shuffled) and a similar
 *    elixir cost (difference <= 1 whenever the pool allows it).
 *  - Buildings (v13): every drafted deck holds at least one BUILDING. The plan of every pair
 *    has a building round (also with fewer rounds: a troop / free round becomes the building
 *    round) where both offered cards are buildings, so the picker and the opponent each get
 *    one. Safety net: when a player of the pair still has no building in the pair's last
 *    round, that round is forced to be a building round. (Only a pool with fewer than two
 *    buildings can break the guarantee.)
 *  - Champions: at most one per deck (only one champion per player can be on the field, v7).
 *    An offer never holds two champions, and no champion is offered once either player of the
 *    pair already owns one.
 *  - 1v1: one pair (player 0 vs player 1). 2v2: each player drafts against the opponent
 *    opposite them = the k-th player of team Blau against the k-th player of team Rot (player
 *    order of the players array). All pairs run at the same time and independently.
 *  - Bots and timeouts: CR.Draft.botChoice(offer, deck) picks sensibly (spells / anti-air /
 *    win condition / elixir curve); the app uses it for bots (after a short think) and for
 *    humans whose pick timer (PICK_MS) ran out (auto-pick).
 *
 * Pure module (no DOM, no Date.now, no Math.random - CR.rng): runs under jsc (tests/test-draft.js).
 * The app shell (11-main.js) owns the timers; online the HOST runs the authoritative draft and
 * publishes draft.snapshot() through the net session (08-net.js, phase 'draft'); every client
 * renders CR.Draft.viewFor(snapshot, localPlayer).
 *
 * API:
 *   CR.Draft.ROUNDS (8), CR.Draft.PICK_MS (10000)
 *   CR.Draft.defaultPool(mode = 'touchdown') -> [cardId]
 *   CR.Draft.pairsOf(players) -> [[playerA, playerB], ...]        (players: [{side}] | 2 | 4)
 *   const d = CR.Draft.create({ players, pool?, rounds: 8, seed })
 *   d.offer(p) -> [cardA, cardB] when it is p's turn, else null
 *   d.current(p) -> { round, cards, chooser, mine } | null (done)   (both players of the pair)
 *   d.pick(p, choice 0|1) -> { ok, reason?, card, gift, to, round, pair }  (the other card goes to the paired opponent)
 *   d.autoPick(p) -> pick result (CR.Draft.botChoice)
 *   CR.Draft.hasBuilding(deck) -> bool (v13: every drafted deck has >= 1 building)
 *   d.done(), d.pairDone(i), d.decks() -> [[8 ids] per player], d.deck(p), d.opponentOf(p), d.pairOf(p)
 *   d.snapshot() -> compact JSON-safe public state (also the network format)
 *   CR.Draft.readSnapshot(raw) -> validated snapshot | null (untrusted input)
 *   CR.Draft.viewFor(snapshot, p) -> { round, rounds, cards, mine, chooser, done, pairDone,
 *       myDeck: [{id, how: 'pick'|'gift'}], oppDeck: [...], opponent, mate }

(function (CR) {

  const RARITY_VALUE = { common: 0, rare: 0.15, epic: 0.3, legendary: 0.45, champion: 0.55 };

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ card data

  function cardsList() {

    return Array.isArray(cards) ? cards : EMPTY;

  let metaSrc = null;
  let metaCache = null;
  /** Rules info of a card for pairing and the bots: { id, elixir, type, rarity, champion,

  function meta(id) {
    const list = cardsList();
    if (metaSrc !== list) { metaSrc = list; metaCache = Object.create(null); }
    const hit = metaCache[id];

    let c = null;
    for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) if (list[i] && list[i].id === id) { c = list[i]; break; }
    const units = (CR.DATA && CR.DATA.units) || {};
    const type = c && (c.type === 'spell' || c.type === 'building') ? c.type : 'troop';
    const m = {
      id: id, elixir: c && typeof c.elixir === 'number' ? c.elixir : 3, type: type,
      rarity: c && typeof c.rarity === 'string' ? c.rarity : 'common',
      champion: !!(c && c.rarity === 'champion'),
      air: type === 'spell', flying: false, hp: 0, dps: 0, speed: 0, buildingsOnly: false, splash: false,
      spell: type === 'spell',
    };
    const sm = c && Array.isArray(c.summon) ? c.summon : EMPTY;
    for (let i = 0; i < sm.length; i++) {
      const u = sm[i] && units[sm[i].unit];
      if (!u) continue;
      const n = sm[i].count > 0 ? sm[i].count : 1;
      m.hp += (u.hp || 0) * n + (u.shield || 0) * n;
      if (u.hitSpeed > 0) m.dps += (u.damage || 0) / u.hitSpeed * n;
      if (u.targets === 'both' || u.targets === 'air') m.air = true;
      if (u.air) m.flying = true;
      if (u.buildingsOnly) m.buildingsOnly = true;
      if (u.splashRadius > 0) m.splash = true;

  }

  /** Every card the mode allows (Touchdown by default) that is enabled in the data. */
  Draft.defaultPool = function (mode) {
    const md = mode || 'touchdown';
    const S = CR.Sim;
    if (S && typeof S.enabledCards === 'function') {
      try { return S.enabledCards(md).map(function (c) { return c.id; }); } catch (e) { /* fall back */ }
    }
    return cardsList().filter(function (c) {
      if (!c || !c.id || c.disabled) return false;
      if (S && typeof S.cardAllowed === 'function') { try { return S.cardAllowed(c.id, md) !== false; } catch (e) { return true; } }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers

  function rngOf(seed) {
    const s = (Number(seed) >>> 0) || 1;

      if (typeof r === 'function') return r;
      if (r && typeof r.next === 'function') return function () { return r.next(); };
      if (r && typeof r.float === 'function') return function () { return r.float(); };
    }

    let a = s;
    return function () {
      a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0;
      let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
      t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    };
  }
  function shuffle(a, rand) {
    for (let i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(rand() * (i + 1)) % (i + 1);
      const t = a[i]; a[i] = a[j]; a[j] = t;
    }
    return a;
  }
  function sideOf(p, i) { return p && (p.side === 0 || p.side === 1) ? p.side : (i % 2); }
  function normPlayers(players) {
    if (typeof players === 'number') {
      const n = players === 4 ? 4 : 2;
      const out = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) out.push({ side: n === 4 ? (i < 2 ? 0 : 1) : i });
      return out;
    }
    const src = Array.isArray(players) ? players.slice(0, 4) : [];
    if (src.length !== 2 && src.length !== 4) return normPlayers(2);
    return src.map(function (p, i) { return { side: sideOf(p, i) }; });
  }

  /** v13: a round plan without a building round gets one (last troop round, else the last free
   *  round, else the last round) - no rng call, so the seed stream stays the same. */
  function ensureBuildingRound(plan) {
    if (!plan.length || plan.indexOf('building') >= 0) return plan;
    let i = plan.lastIndexOf('troop');
    if (i < 0) i = plan.lastIndexOf('any');
    if (i < 0) i = plan.length - 1;
    plan[i] = 'building';
    return plan;
  }

    return false;

  Draft.hasBuilding = function (deck) { return hasBuilding(Array.isArray(deck) ? deck : EMPTY); };

  /** Draft pairs: the k-th player of team 0 against the k-th player of team 1. */
  Draft.pairsOf = function (players) {
    const ps = normPlayers(players);
    const t0 = [], t1 = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < ps.length; i++) (ps[i].side === 1 ? t1 : t0).push(i);
    const pairs = [];
    const n = Math.min(t0.length, t1.length);
    for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) pairs.push([t0[k], t1[k]]);
    // unbalanced teams (should not happen): pair the rest with each other in order
    const rest = t0.slice(n).concat(t1.slice(n));
    for (let k = 0; k + 1 < rest.length; k += 2) pairs.push([rest[k], rest[k + 1]]);
    return pairs;
  };

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ bots

  /** Score of adding a card to a deck (higher = better). Pure. */
  function cardScore(id, deck) {
    const m = meta(id);
    const d = Array.isArray(deck) ? deck : EMPTY;
    let spells = 0, buildings = 0, air = 0, winCons = 0, champs = 0, elixir = 0, splash = 0, cheap = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) {
      const o = meta(d[i]);
      if (o.type === 'spell') spells++;
      if (o.type === 'building') buildings++;
      if (o.air && o.type !== 'spell') air++;
      if (o.buildingsOnly || o.hp >= 2500 || (o.speed >= 1.4 && o.hp >= 1000)) winCons++;
      if (o.champion) champs++;
      if (o.splash) splash++;
      if (o.elixir <= 2) cheap++;
      elixir += o.elixir;
    }
    const left = Math.max(1, 8 - d.length);   // cards still to come incl. this one
    let s = RARITY_VALUE[m.rarity] || 0;
    // raw value per elixir: hp and damage for troops, a flat bonus for spells
    if (m.type === 'troop') s += Math.min(1.2, (m.hp / 1800 + m.dps / 260) / Math.max(1, m.elixir) * 1.6);
    else if (m.type === 'spell') s += 0.55;

    if (m.splash && m.type !== 'spell') s += splash === 0 ? 0.35 : 0;

  function DraftState(cfg) {

    this.pool = pool0.slice();
    this.pairs = Draft.pairsOf(this.players);
    this.pairIdx = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < this.n; i++) this.pairIdx.push(-1);

    this.hows = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < this.n; i++) { this.decksL.push([]); this.hows.push([]); }
    const self = this;
    this.st = this.pairs.map(function (pr, k) {
      self.pairIdx[pr[0]] = k;
      self.pairIdx[pr[1]] = k;
      const plan = [];
      for (let r = 0; r < self.rounds; r++) plan.push(PLAN[r % PLAN.length]);
      shuffle(plan, self.rand);
