      return { round: 0, first: self.rand() < 0.5 ? 0 : 1, plan: plan, pool: shuffle(pool0.slice(), self.rand), offer: null };
    });
    for (let k = 0; k < this.st.length; k++) this._deal(k);
  }
  DraftState.prototype._chooserOf = function (k) {
    const s = this.st[k];
    return this.pairs[k][(s.first + s.round) % 2];
  };
  /** Creates the offer of pair k's current round (deterministic: seed + earlier picks). */
  DraftState.prototype._deal = function (k) {
    const s = this.st[k];
    s.offer = null;
    if (s.round >= this.rounds) return;
    const pr = this.pairs[k];
    const hasChamp = this.decksL[pr[0]].some(function (id) { return meta(id).champion; }) || this.decksL[pr[1]].some(function (id) { return meta(id).champion; });
    let kind = s.plan[s.round];
    // v13 safety net: the last round of the pair brings the missing building
    if (s.round === this.rounds - 1 && (!hasBuilding(this.decksL[pr[0]]) || !hasBuilding(this.decksL[pr[1]]))) kind = 'building';
    const okChamp = function (id) { return !hasChamp || !meta(id).champion; };
    let cand = s.pool.filter(function (id) { return okChamp(id) && (kind === 'any' || meta(id).type === kind); });
    if (cand.length < 2) cand = s.pool.filter(okChamp);
    if (cand.length < 2) cand = s.pool.slice();
    if (cand.length < 2) {
      // pool exhausted (tiny explicit pool): reuse cards nobody of this pair holds
      const held = this.decksL[pr[0]].concat(this.decksL[pr[1]]);
      cand = this.pool.filter(function (id) { return held.indexOf(id) < 0; });
      if (cand.length < 2) return;
      s.pool = cand.slice();
    }
    const a = cand[Math.floor(this.rand() * cand.length) % cand.length];
    const ma = meta(a);
    const rest = cand.filter(function (id) { return id !== a && !(ma.champion && meta(id).champion); });
    let near = rest.filter(function (id) { return Math.abs(meta(id).elixir - ma.elixir) <= 1; });
    if (!near.length) {
      let best = Infinity;
      for (let i = 0; i < rest.length; i++) best = Math.min(best, Math.abs(meta(rest[i]).elixir - ma.elixir));
      near = rest.filter(function (id) { return Math.abs(meta(id).elixir - ma.elixir) === best; });
    }
    if (!near.length) return;
    const b = near[Math.floor(this.rand() * near.length) % near.length];
    s.pool = s.pool.filter(function (id) { return id !== a && id !== b; });
    s.offer = this.rand() < 0.5 ? [a, b] : [b, a];
  };
  DraftState.prototype.pairOf = function (p) { return p >= 0 && p < this.n ? this.pairIdx[p] : -1; };
  DraftState.prototype.opponentOf = function (p) {
    const k = this.pairOf(p);
    if (k < 0) return -1;
    const pr = this.pairs[k];
    return pr[0] === p ? pr[1] : pr[0];
  };
  DraftState.prototype.pairDone = function (k) { const s = this.st[k]; return !s || s.round >= this.rounds || !s.offer; };
  DraftState.prototype.done = function () {
    for (let k = 0; k < this.st.length; k++) if (!this.pairDone(k)) return false;
    return true;
  };
  /** Round state of p's pair: { round (0-based), cards, chooser, mine } or null when done. */
  DraftState.prototype.current = function (p) {
    const k = this.pairOf(p);
    if (k < 0 || this.pairDone(k)) return null;
    const s = this.st[k];
    const ch = this._chooserOf(k);
    return { round: s.round, cards: s.offer.slice(), chooser: ch, mine: ch === p, pair: k };
  };
  /** The two cards offered to p (only while it is p's turn), else null. */
  DraftState.prototype.offer = function (p) {
    const c = this.current(p);
    return c && c.mine ? c.cards : null;
  };
  DraftState.prototype.isChooser = function (p) { const c = this.current(p); return !!(c && c.mine); };
  /** p picks offer[choice]; the other card goes to p's draft opponent. */
  DraftState.prototype.pick = function (p, choice) {
    const k = this.pairOf(p);
    if (k < 0) return { ok: false, reason: 'no_player' };
    if (this.pairDone(k)) return { ok: false, reason: 'done' };
    if (this._chooserOf(k) !== p) return { ok: false, reason: 'not_your_turn' };
    if (choice !== 0 && choice !== 1) return { ok: false, reason: 'bad_choice' };
    const s = this.st[k];
    const card = s.offer[choice];
    const gift = s.offer[1 - choice];
    const to = this.opponentOf(p);
    const round = s.round;
    this.decksL[p].push(card);
    this.hows[p].push('pick');
    this.decksL[to].push(gift);
    this.hows[to].push('gift');
    s.round++;
    this._deal(k);
    return { ok: true, card: card, gift: gift, to: to, round: round, pair: k, player: p };
  };
  DraftState.prototype.autoPick = function (p) {
    const o = this.offer(p);
    if (!o) return { ok: false, reason: 'not_your_turn' };
    return this.pick(p, Draft.botChoice(o, this.decksL[p], this.rand));
  };
  DraftState.prototype.deck = function (p) { return (this.decksL[p] || EMPTY).slice(); };
  DraftState.prototype.decks = function () { return this.decksL.map(function (d) { return d.slice(); }); };
  /** Compact public state (network format, JSON-safe):
   *  { v: 1, n: rounds, pl: [side per player], pr: [[a, b]], r: [round per pair],
   *    ch: [chooser per pair | -1], of: [[cardA, cardB] | null per pair],
   *    dk: [[cardId] per player], hw: ['pg..' per player: p = own pick, g = gift] } */
  DraftState.prototype.snapshot = function () {
    const self = this;
    return {
      v: 1, n: this.rounds,
      pl: this.players.map(function (p) { return p.side; }),
      pr: this.pairs.map(function (pr) { return pr.slice(); }),
      r: this.st.map(function (s) { return s.round; }),
      ch: this.st.map(function (s, k) { return self.pairDone(k) ? -1 : self._chooserOf(k); }),
      of: this.st.map(function (s, k) { return self.pairDone(k) ? null : s.offer.slice(); }),
      dk: this.decks(),
      hw: this.hows.map(function (h) { return h.map(function (x) { return x === 'pick' ? 'p' : 'g'; }).join(''); }),
    };
  };

  Draft.ROUNDS = ROUNDS;
  Draft.PICK_MS = PICK_MS;
  Draft.DraftState = DraftState;
  Draft.create = function (cfg) { return new DraftState(cfg); };

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ snapshots

  function intIn(v, lo, hi) { return Number.isInteger(v) && v >= lo && v <= hi ? v : null; }
  function cardId(v) { return typeof v === 'string' && ID_RE.test(v) ? v : null; }
  /** Validates an untrusted snapshot (from the network); null when unusable. */
  Draft.readSnapshot = function (raw) {
    if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object' || raw.v !== 1) return null;
    const n = intIn(raw.n, 1, 16);
    if (n === null || !Array.isArray(raw.pl) || (raw.pl.length !== 2 && raw.pl.length !== 4)) return null;
    const np = raw.pl.length;
    const pl = raw.pl.map(function (s, i) { return s === 0 || s === 1 ? s : i % 2; });
    const pr = [];
    if (!Array.isArray(raw.pr) || !raw.pr.length || raw.pr.length > 2) return null;
    for (let k = 0; k < raw.pr.length; k++) {
      const e = raw.pr[k];
      if (!Array.isArray(e)) return null;
      const a = intIn(e[0], 0, np - 1), b = intIn(e[1], 0, np - 1);
      if (a === null || b === null || a === b) return null;
      pr.push([a, b]);
    }
    const np2 = pr.length;
    const arrOf = function (v) { return Array.isArray(v) ? v : EMPTY; };
    const r = [], ch = [], of = [];
    for (let k = 0; k < np2; k++) {
      r.push(intIn(arrOf(raw.r)[k], 0, n) || 0);
      const c = intIn(arrOf(raw.ch)[k], -1, np - 1);
      ch.push(c === null ? -1 : c);
      const o = arrOf(raw.of)[k];
      of.push(Array.isArray(o) && cardId(o[0]) && cardId(o[1]) ? [o[0], o[1]] : null);
    }
    const dk = [], hw = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < np; i++) {
      const d = arrOf(arrOf(raw.dk)[i]).slice(0, 16).filter(function (x) { return !!cardId(x); });
      dk.push(d);
      const h = typeof arrOf(raw.hw)[i] === 'string' ? arrOf(raw.hw)[i].slice(0, 16).replace(/[^pg]/g, 'g') : '';
      hw.push(h);
    }
    return { v: 1, n: n, pl: pl, pr: pr, r: r, ch: ch, of: of, dk: dk, hw: hw };
  };

  /** What player p sees (pure): the round of its pair, the two cards, whose turn, both decks. */
  Draft.viewFor = function (snap, p) {
    const s = snap && snap.v === 1 ? snap : null;
    if (!s) return null;
    let k = -1;
    for (let i = 0; i < s.pr.length; i++) if (s.pr[i][0] === p || s.pr[i][1] === p) { k = i; break; }
    const deckOf = function (i) {
      const d = (s.dk && s.dk[i]) || EMPTY;
      const h = (s.hw && s.hw[i]) || '';
      return d.map(function (id, j) { return { id: id, how: h.charAt(j) === 'p' ? 'pick' : 'gift' }; });
    };
    let mate = -1;
    for (let i = 0; i < s.pl.length; i++) if (i !== p && s.pl[i] === s.pl[p]) mate = i;
    if (k < 0) {
      return { round: s.n, rounds: s.n, cards: null, mine: false, chooser: -1, done: true, pairDone: true, myDeck: deckOf(p), oppDeck: [], opponent: -1, mate: mate, allDone: true };
    }
    const pr = s.pr[k];
    const opp = pr[0] === p ? pr[1] : pr[0];
    const pairDone = !s.of[k] || s.ch[k] < 0 || s.r[k] >= s.n;
    let allDone = true;
    for (let i = 0; i < s.pr.length; i++) if (s.of[i] && s.ch[i] >= 0 && s.r[i] < s.n) allDone = false;
    return {
      round: Math.min(s.r[k], s.n), rounds: s.n,
      cards: pairDone ? null : s.of[k].slice(),
      chooser: pairDone ? -1 : s.ch[k],
      mine: !pairDone && s.ch[k] === p,
      done: pairDone, pairDone: pairDone, allDone: allDone,
      myDeck: deckOf(p), oppDeck: deckOf(opp), opponent: opp, mate: mate, pair: k,
    };
  };
})(globalThis.CR || (globalThis.CR = {}));

</script>
<script>
/* src/20-gfx-core.js */
/* Chaos Royale - 20-gfx-core.js (gfx-kit)
 * =====================================================================================
 * CR.GFX: the 3D foundation (three.js r158 UMD, global THREE). Contract: docs/GFX.md.
 * Designers read THIS HEADER + docs/GFX.md only. Never touch CR.GFX.kit outside build().
 *
 * ---- v4 (clean studio look, v8 of the game) in one paragraph ---------------------------
 *   Quality bar: Fall-Guys-CLEAN (only the quality bar - every design stays original): perfectly
 *   smooth rounded shapes, soft studio light, subtle specular, soft ambient occlusion, crisp
 *   high-resolution card art, readable costume details. Every unit is still ONE SkinnedMesh (one
 *   draw call, all pivots are bones of a rigid skin), now WELDED (indexed) with ONE shared
 *   physically based material (MeshStandardMaterial patched): per-vertex roughness / metalness /
 *   light wrap from surface tokens, baked per-vertex ambient occlusion (analytic sphere proxies of
 *   the model's own parts + ground contact), soft wrap diffuse, subtle rim, hue-preserving
 *   highlight shoulder, studio environment map (procedural PMREM, no files) + key / fill / rim
 *   lights. Tessellation follows a DETAIL PRESET (phone / desktop / high; card portraits always
 *   'high', supersampled). Outline shells still exist but are OFF by default (no ink lines).
 *   Animation system unchanged since v3 (key-pose attacks, run cycles, springs, faces, LOD).
 *
 * ---- v4.1 GRIMDARK (v10 of the game) - read this first, designers -------------------------
 *   Direction: premium dark fantasy card battler. Palette black / dark red / gold, dramatic light,
 *   menacing silhouettes. CLEAN shapes stay (the v4 quality bar): the detail goes into the
 *   CHARACTER (horns, spikes, scars, armour plates, glowing eyes), not into noise. Team colours
 *   (blue / red) stay clearly visible on cloth / trims of every unit (battle readability).
 *   1. Model look (per model, opt-in):  defineModel(id, { look: 'grim', ... })
 *        'grim'   darker worn palette + light grime + a little dried blood on the weapon
 *        'worn'   less dark, more wear (scuffed metal, grime towards the ground), no blood
 *        'bloody' grim + strong blood on the weapon tip / blade + a few splatters on the lower body
 *        'dark'   only the dark palette (almost no wear)        'clean' / null  v4 look (default)
 *        { preset: 'grim', grim: 0..1 (palette darkening), wear: 0..1, blood: 0..1, team: 0..1
 *          (share of the wear that team-coloured parts get, 0.2), bloodOn: ['weapon', 'jaw'] (pivots
 *          that get blood; default the trail pivot 'weapon'), seed }
 *      What it does: named palette colours are pulled towards darker battle-worn values (steel ->
 *      gunmetal, gold -> antique gold, leather / wood / cloth darker, skin a touch paler; see
 *      GRIM_MAP), then a wear pass on the finished mesh adds grime (noise + towards the ground),
 *      scuffs metal (rougher, a little tarnished) and paints dried blood from the hand to the
 *      weapon tip. Team tokens, eyes, glow and element colours are NEVER changed; team-coloured
 *      vertices get only look.team of the wear. Hex colours are not remapped (only wear applies).
 *      Same draw call, same triangles (vertex colours / surface only). CR.GFX.config.look sets a
 *      default for every model without its own look (then CR.GFX.rebuild()). kit.grim (0..1) and
 *      kit.look are readable inside build() to branch (e.g. extra spikes when kit.grim > 0).
 *   2. New palette names (any model, any look): blackSteel gunmetal scarSteel (metal), oldGold
 *      oldGoldLight oldGoldDark (gold trims), rust, grimLeather grimLeatherDark, ash ashLight,
 *      obsidian, crimson crimsonDark crimsonLight (cloth), blood bloodDried, boneDark, hellfire
 *      soulGlow (use with glow). Surfaces are inferred like the other names.
 *   3. Glow = menace: eyes, runes, blade edges, cores with { glow: 0.6..1 } bloom in the card art
 *      (glow pass, see portraits). Small glowing parts read best (eyes, edges); big glowing areas
 *      get less bloom automatically. Red / orange glowing eyes on villains, cold cyan on undead.
 *   4. Card art (CR.GFX.portrait) uses the 'grim' portrait style by default: warm key from high at
 *      the side, double rim from behind (v11c: element colour per card), dim cool fill, gold bounce (legendary), grimdark
 *      grade (contrast, desaturated / red-black darks), low hero camera, bloom, and for card art
 *      (no pose passed) a baked backdrop: element-coloured smoke, soft key light shaft, halo, gold aura +
 *      embers (legendary / champion), floor fog, vignette. Rarity comes from the card (CR.DATA).
 *      Portrait framing per model (portrait: { yaw, pitch, zoom, pose }) works as before; the
 *      hero camera lowers pitch by 0.19 rad (pitch 0.14 -> slightly below the chest).
 *   5. Battle (CR.Render3D owner): the battle look is UNCHANGED by default. Opt-ins:
 *      CR.GFX.config.mood = 'grim' (or addLights(scene, {mood: 'grim'}) / environment(r, s,
 *      {mood: 'grim'})): amber key, crimson + ember rims, dark red env; CR.GFX.setLook({contrast,
 *      darkDesat, crush, shadeTint, shadeColor, rimColor}) grades the shared material (identity
 *      = 1, 0, 0, 0). Keep team colours readable: test with tests/gallery.html?only=<id> (battle
 *      camera row) before switching the battle defaults.
 *
 * ---- Style rule (legal + quality) --------------------------------------------------------
 *   Stylised chunky characters with anime faces (big expressive eyes with glints, spiky
 *   stylised hair, headbands / scarves) built from smooth toy-like volumes. Every character is
 *   ORIGINAL: never recreate a specific copyrighted character, costume, logo or symbol (no Fall
 *   Guys costumes, no Supercell designs). Each model must read as its card archetype from the
 *   steep battle camera: big clear shapes first, crisp small details second.
 *
 * ---- How to build to the v4 bar (designers) ------------------------------------------------
 *   - Bodies / heads / boots / hands: kit.blob (jellybean superellipsoid) and spheres instead of
 *     raw cylinders; rims, belts, cuffs: kit.ring / kit.rcyl (rounded rims); never leave a hard
 *     edge on a big part. Plates and emblems: kit.extrude (gets a micro bevel automatically).
 *   - Give surfaces a material: { mat: 'cloth' | 'skin' | 'metal' | ... } (see Surfaces). Without
 *     one it is inferred from the palette colour name (steel -> metal, gold -> gold, skin ->
 *     skin, cloth* / team -> cloth, wood, leather, stone, ice, hair, eyes ...), hex colours get
 *     'soft' (vinyl toy). shine (0..1) still works: it lowers the roughness.
 *   - Write segment counts at the REFERENCE level (sphere seg 8-12, blob 10-12, tube radial 4-6):
 *     the detail preset multiplies them (bigger parts more). Do not crank seg yourself.
 *   - Layer details for readability (gold trim tubes on tabards, rivets only where they read,
 *     two-tone pauldrons, soles via part.paint) - the AO makes overlaps and creases pop.
 *   - Never add / remove PIVOTS depending on kit.detail (LOD swaps geometry under the same
 *     bones); adding small optional parts when kit.hi is fine.
 *   - Reference models at the end of this file: knight, archer, minion (?files=core in the
 *     gallery). Check budgets with tests/gallery.html?only=<id>&detail=phone.
 *
 * ---- Status ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *   CR.GFX.ready            true when THREE (r150+) and a DOM exist. When false, defineModel
 *                           still records definitions, createInstance() returns null and
 *                           portrait() resolves null (the app uses the 2D renderer).
 *   CR.GFX.options          { stars, speedLines, aura, badge, dust } (v12 defaults: speedLines and
 *                           aura false, the others true): instance
 *                           level extras; the renderer may switch off what it draws itself.
 *   CR.GFX.hooks            { land(inst, strength), impact(inst), poof(inst) } no-op defaults;
 *                           the renderer may replace them (dust / impact frames / death puffs).
 *
 * ---- Conventions -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *   1 unit = 1 tile. Model origin = ground point under the unit (feet at y=0; flyers too:
 *   the instance adds the flight altitude). The model FACES -Z; its RIGHT side is +X; up +Y.
 *   Build in real tile size: footprint radius ~ CR.DATA.units[id].radius, height in tiles.
 *   World: CR.GFX.simToWorld(x, y) -> {x: x-9, y: 0, z: 16-y}; CR.GFX.dirToYaw(dir) turns
 *   the sim facing angle into object rotation.y (dir = +PI/2 -> yaw 0 -> faces -Z).
 *
 * ---- Registry ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *   CR.GFX.defineModel(id, {
 *     build(kit, ctx) -> rig      ctx = { side, team (=teamColors[side]), id, data (CR.DATA unit
 *                                 or null), cast (CR.CAST unit or null), detail (preset name) }.
 *                                 Called once per side and detail preset; geometry is cached per
 *                                 (model, side, detail). Later calls override.
 *     height,                     tiles, top of the model (HP bar anchor); default = bbox top
 *     scale,                      optional uniform scale applied to the whole instance (1)
 *     outline,                    outline width in tiles at the reference scale (0.045) - only
 *                                 used when outline shells are built (setOutline({build:true}))
 *     ao,                         ground contact occlusion of the feet, 0..0.5 (0.22; walkers)
 *     occlusion,                  baked ambient occlusion strength of the model, 0..2 (1)
 *     anim: { body, walk, attack, tempo, weight, custom, ...optional tuning below },
 *     portrait: { yaw, pitch, zoom, pose: 'idle'|'attack', count }
 *   });
 *   CR.GFX.hasModel(id), CR.GFX.modelIds(), CR.GFX.getModel(id)
 *   CR.GFX.definePortrait(cardId, { model, count, yaw, pitch, zoom, pose }) (card art mapping)
 *   Lists for tools: CR.GFX.attackStyles(), walkStyles(), expressions().
 *
 * ---- Budget (v4, measured at detail 'phone', CR.GFX.templateInfo(id, side, 'phone')) -------
 *   1 draw call per unit (automatic). <= 32 pivots (bones). Triangles: small units <= 6000,
 *   medium <= 9000, big / buildings <= 14000 (towers may use more: only a few exist). Vertices
 *   are welded (templateInfo().verts, ~0.6 per triangle). 'desktop' is ~1.4x, 'high' (card art
 *   only) ~3x - no budget there. Each primitive costs roughly 100-350 tris at phone: prefer few,
 *   well-shaped parts over many tiny ones; tiny boxes: { micro: false } skips the auto bevel.
 *
 * ---- Kit (inside build only) --------------------------------------------------------------
 *   Every primitive returns a Part (triangles with normals, vertex colours, glow, surface).
 *   Common opts: { color, mat (surface token or { rough, metal, wrap, base }), rough (0..1),
 *   metal (0..1), glow (0..1 unlit/emissive), shine (0..1 glossier), grad (soft vertical colour
 *   gradient 0..1), outline (false | true | width multiplier 0..2; only used when outline shells
 *   are built), flat (faceted normals), shade (0..1 darken towards the part's bottom), scale
 *   (number|[x,y,z], baked first), rot [x,y,z], at [x,y,z], double (also render the inside; true
 *   or a hex colour for the inside), micro (false: no automatic micro bevel) }.
 *   Colours: hex number, '#rrggbb', palette name (kit.palette), or team tokens
 *   'team' | 'teamDark' | 'teamLight' | 'teamGlow' (resolved for the side being built).
 *   Surfaces (kit.mats = CR.GFX.matTokens; [roughness, metalness, light wrap]):
 *     soft (default vinyl) | matte | cloth | felt | fur | skin | hair | rubber | plastic | lacquer
 *     | leather | wood | stone | bone | metal | brushed | chrome | gold | gem | glass | ice | eye
 *     | goo | glow.  Inferred from palette names when no mat is given (see MAT_BY_COLOR).
 *   Detail: kit.detail ('low' | 'phone' | 'desktop' | 'high'), kit.detailMul, kit.hi (desktop+).
 *   Segment options below are REFERENCE counts; the preset scales them by part size.
 *     kit.box(w, h, d, {bevel = 18% of min side, seg = 2, micro})  rounded box, centred; bevel 0
 *                 boxes get a tiny rounded edge at phone+ unless micro: false
 *     kit.blob(w, h, d, {round (vertical squareness 0..1, 0.3), roundH, taper (top width
 *                 factor), bottom (bottom width factor), bulge (belly to the front 0..0.4),
 *                 flat (squash the lower half 0..1), seg = 12, hseg})  v4 jellybean body
 *     kit.rcyl(rTop, rBottom, h, {bevel (rim radius), seg = 14, open})   cylinder with rounded rims
 *     kit.sphere(r, {seg = 12, hseg, phi:[start,len], theta:[start,len]})
 *                 theta 0 = top; phi: x = -cos(phi), z = sin(phi) -> front (-Z) is phi 3PI/2
 *     kit.capsule(r, len, {seg = 8, capSeg = 3})              vertical, centred
 *     kit.cylinder(rTop, rBottom, h, {seg = 12, open})        vertical, centred (hard rims)
 *     kit.cone(r, h, {seg = 10})                              tip up, centred (seg <= 4 stays faceted)
 *     kit.torus(r, tube, {seg: [radial, tubular] | tubular, arc})   ring in the XY plane
 *     kit.ring(r, tube, {seg, arc})                           torus lying flat (XZ): belts, rims
 *     kit.disc(r, {seg = 12, theta:[start,len]})              flat circle FACING -Z (decals)
 *     kit.lathe([[x,y],...], {seg = 14, phi:[start,len], sharp, corner = 70})  profile bottom->
 *                 top revolved around Y; phi 0 = +Z (back), PI = -Z (front); partial phi =
 *                 shells (capes). v4: the profile is spline-smoothed (corners sharper than
 *                 `corner` degrees stay crisp); sharp: true keeps the polyline as given
 *     kit.extrude(shape, depth, {bevel, bevelSeg = 1, curveSeg = 6, smooth = 40})
 *                 shape = [[x,y],...] polygon or THREE.Shape (kit.shape(points, curved));
 *                 extruded along Z, centred on z = 0; no bevel given -> micro bevel (same size)
 *     kit.tube([[x,y,z],...], r | [r0,r1] | (u)=>r, {seg, radial = 6, caps = true | 'round' |
 *                 false, closed})  v4: caps are domed (round) at phone+
 *     kit.gem(r, {stretch = 1.35})        faceted octahedron (use mat 'gem')
 *     kit.rock(r, {detail, jitter, seed})  kit.star(points, rOuter, rInner, depth, opts)
 *     kit.eye(r, {iris, pupil, white, look:[x,y], glow, tall}) round cartoon eye looking -Z
 *   Anime helpers (v3):

  IP._biped = function (d, t, mv, ph, seed) {

  IP._quad = function (d, t, mv, ph, seed) {
    const R = this.R, L = this.L, A = this.A, W = d.weight, idle = 1 - mv;

      for (let i = 0; i < wl.length; i++) {
        const lag = i * 0.08, f = cs(C_FLAP, u - lag) * amp * (i ? 0.55 : 1), sw = 0.2 * cs(C_FLAP, u - lag - 0.25) * (i ? 0.6 : 1);
        wl[i].rz -= f; wl[i].ry += sw;
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < wr.length; i++) {
        const lag = i * 0.08, f = cs(C_FLAP, u - lag) * amp * (i ? 0.55 : 1), sw = 0.2 * cs(C_FLAP, u - lag - 0.25) * (i ? 0.6 : 1);
        wr[i].rz += f; wr[i].ry -= sw;
      }
      R.root.py += 0.045 * cs(C_FLIFT, u - 0.1);
      R.body.rx += 0.05 * cs(C_FLAP, u - 0.15);
    }
    for (const a of L.armsL) { a.rx += 0.25 * Math.sin(t * 3.1 + seed * 2) * idle + 0.2 * mv; a.rz -= 0.12; }
    for (const a of L.armsR) { a.rx += 0.25 * Math.sin(t * 3.1 + seed * 2 + 1.3) * idle + 0.2 * mv; a.rz += 0.12; }
    for (const l of L.legsL) l.rx += 0.18 * Math.sin(t * 2.6 + seed) - 0.45 * mv;
    for (const l of L.legsR) l.rx += 0.18 * Math.sin(t * 2.6 + seed + 0.9) - 0.45 * mv;
  };

  IP._blob = function (d, t, mv, ph, seed) {
    const R = this.R, A = this.A, idle = 1 - mv;
    const j = Math.sin(t * 3.3 + seed * 5);
    R.body.sy += 0.05 * j * idle; R.body.sx -= 0.03 * j * idle; R.body.sz -= 0.03 * j * idle;
    const look = Math.sin(t * 0.8 + seed * 9) * smooth01(Math.sin(t * 0.4 + seed * 4) * 2 - 0.5) * (1 - A.lodK);
    R.head.ry += 0.3 * look * idle;
    if (d.body === 'spirit') {
      R.root.py += 0.05 * Math.sin(t * 3.1 + seed * 6) * idle;
      R.root.ry += 0.15 * Math.sin(t * 1.9 + seed) * idle;
    }
    if (mv < 0.001) return;
    if (d.walk === 'float') {
      R.root.py += 0.07 * Math.sin(t * 4 + seed) * mv;
      R.root.rx -= 0.15 * mv;
      return;
    }
    // hop: anticipation squash, stretched rise, hang, landing squash
    const u = ((ph / Math.PI) % 1 + 1) % 1, hg = 4 * u * (1 - u);
    R.root.py += (d.hopHeight || 0.22) * hg * mv;
    R.root.rx -= 0.14 * hg * mv;
    A.sq += ((u < 0.15 ? (0.15 - u) / 0.15 : u > 0.9 ? (u - 0.9) / 0.1 * 0.6 : 0) * 0.24 - 0.12 * hg) * mv;
  };

  IP._roller = function (d, t, mv) {
    const R = this.R;
    R.body.py += 0.012 * Math.sin(t * 29) * mv;
    R.body.rz += 0.012 * Math.sin(t * 23) * mv;
    R.head.rx += 0.04 * Math.sin(t * 2) * (1 - mv);
  };

  IP._building = function (d, t, seed) {
    const R = this.R;
    R.turret.ry += this.A.turret;
    R.body.sy += 0.008 * Math.sin(t * 1.6 + seed * 4);
  };

  IP._look = function (d) {
    const A = this.A, R = this.R, k = A.look;
    if (k === 0) return;
    if (this.isBiped) { R.head.ry += 0.68 * k; R.body.ry += 0.22 * k; }
    else R.head.ry += 0.75 * k;
  };

  IP._fidget = function (d) {
    const A = this.A, R = this.R, L = this.L, f = A.fidgetT / 1.3;
    const e = smooth01(f / 0.22) * (1 - smooth01((f - 0.72) / 0.28));
    const sg = A.seed > 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
    if (this.isFlyer) {
      if (A.fidget === 0) R.root.rz += sg * TAU * smooth01((f - 0.15) / 0.5);  // barrel roll
      else if (A.fidget === 1) { R.head.ry += 0.7 * sg * e; R.body.ry += 0.2 * sg * e; }
      else R.root.py += 0.2 * Math.sin(clamp(f, 0, 1) * TAU) * e;
      return;
    }
    if (d.body === 'quadruped' || d.body === 'rider') {
      if (A.fidget === 0) R.head.ry += 0.35 * Math.sin(A.fidgetT * 16) * e;
      else if (A.fidget === 1) R.head.rx += 0.45 * e;
      else { for (const tl of L.tails) tl.ry += 0.5 * Math.sin(A.fidgetT * 14) * e; R.head.rx -= 0.2 * e; }
      return;
    }
    if (!this.isBiped) { A.sq += 0.12 * Math.sin(clamp(f, 0, 1) * TAU * 2) * e; R.root.py += 0.08 * Math.max(0, Math.sin(clamp(f, 0, 1) * TAU * 2)) * e; return; }
    if (A.fidget === 0) {          // look around (quick head turn, hold, back)
      R.head.ry += 0.75 * sg * e; R.body.ry += 0.16 * sg * e; R.head.rx -= 0.08 * e;
    } else if (A.fidget === 1) {   // stretch: lean back, arms out
      R.body.rx += 0.2 * e; R.head.rx += 0.18 * e;
      for (const a of L.armsL) { a.rz -= 0.65 * e; a.rx += 0.35 * e; }
      for (const a of L.armsR) { a.rz += 0.65 * e; a.rx += 0.35 * e; }
      A.sq -= 0.07 * e;
    } else {                       // ready bounce: two springy hops, fists up
      const b = Math.abs(Math.sin(clamp(f, 0, 1) * TAU * 1.5));
      R.root.py += 0.05 * b * e; A.sq += 0.06 * (0.5 - b) * e;
      for (const a of L.armsL) a.rx += 0.5 * e;
      for (const a of L.armsR) a.rx += 0.5 * e;
      R.body.rx -= 0.06 * e;
    }
  };

  // attack key poses: ready stance (aim) -> wind-up (attackProg) -> snap to impact (smear) ->
  // hold -> follow-through -> settle with overshoot
  const _co = new Float32Array(4);
  IP._attack = function (d) {
    const A = this.A, R = this.R, at = this.atk, T = A.strikeT;
    const total = at.tin + at.hold + at.out;
    const striking = A.strikes > 0 && T < total;
    const blend = striking ? Math.max(A.aim, 1 - smooth01((T - total * 0.75) / (total * 0.25))) : A.aim;
    if (blend < 0.001 && A.wu < 0.001) return;
    let r0 = 1, r1 = 0, r2 = 0, r3 = 0;
    if (striking) {
      const tf = at.out * 0.4, tsl = at.out * 0.6;
      if (T < at.tin) { const k = easeOutQuart(T / at.tin); r0 = 0; r1 = 1 - k; r2 = k; }
      else if (T < at.tin + at.hold) { r0 = 0; r2 = 1; }
      else if (T < at.tin + at.hold + tf) { const k = easeOutCubic((T - at.tin - at.hold) / tf); r0 = 0; r2 = 1 - k; r3 = k; }
      else { const k = settle((T - at.tin - at.hold - tf) / tsl); r3 = 1 - k; r0 = k; }
    }
    const w = smooth01(A.wu);
    _co[0] = r0 * (1 - w) * blend; _co[1] = (r1 * (1 - w) + w) * blend; _co[2] = r2 * (1 - w) * blend; _co[3] = r3 * (1 - w) * blend;
    const hand = this.hand;
    let pArm = R.arm, qArm = R.off, ps = 1;
    if (at.punch) {
      const useOff = striking ? A.strikeArm === 1 : A.nextArm === 1;
      if (useOff) { pArm = R.off; qArm = R.arm; ps = -1; }
    }
    const keys = this.atkKeys;
    for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
      const k = keys[i], v = k.v;
      let val = v[0] * _co[0] + v[1] * _co[1] + v[2] * _co[2] + v[3] * _co[3];
      if (k.t === 'sq') { A.sq += val; continue; }
      if (k.mir) val *= hand * (at.punch && k.t !== 'Q' ? ps : 1);
      if (k.list === null) { addCh(k.t === 'P' ? pArm : qArm, k.ch, val); continue; }
      const list = k.list;
      for (let j = 0; j < list.length; j++) addCh(list[j], k.ch, val);
    }
    if (at.spin && striking) {
      const sp = d.spinTime || 0.42, kk = clamp(T / sp, 0, 1);
      if (kk < 1) R.root.ry -= TAU * easeOutCubic(kk);
    }
    if (at.beam) {
      const vib = A.aim * (0.6 + 0.4 * A.wu);
      R.body.px += 0.01 * Math.sin(A.rt * 61) * vib;
      R.weapon.rz += 0.05 * Math.sin(A.rt * 47) * vib;
      R.turret.ry += 0.015 * Math.sin(A.rt * 53) * vib;
      for (const c of this.L.cores) { const q = 1 + 0.15 * vib * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(A.rt * 20)); c.sx *= q; c.sy *= q; c.sz *= q; }
    }
    if (at.kamikaze && A.strikes > 0) {
      const kk = clamp(T / 0.32, 0, 1);
      if (kk < 1) { R.root.py += 0.55 * Math.sin(Math.PI * kk); R.root.pz -= 0.45 * kk; A.sq -= 0.15 * Math.sin(Math.PI * kk); }
    }
  };

  IP._effects = function (d) {
    const A = this.A, R = this.R, L = this.L;
    const f = A.flinch;
    if (f !== 0) { R.body.rx += 0.5 * f; R.head.rx += 0.32 * f; R.root.pz += 0.07 * f; A.sq -= 0.1 * f; }
    if (A.stun > 0.001) {
      const k = A.stun, w = A.rt * 7.5;
      R.body.rz += 0.1 * Math.sin(w) * k;
      R.head.rz += 0.2 * Math.sin(w + 1.3) * k;
      R.head.rx += 0.16 * k;
      R.root.ry += 0.12 * Math.sin(w * 0.5) * k;
      for (const a of L.armsL) a.rz += 0.12 * k;
      for (const a of L.armsR) a.rz -= 0.12 * k;
    }
    if (A.charge > 0.001) {
      const c = A.charge;
      R.body.rx -= 0.26 * c;
      R.head.rx += 0.16 * c;
      if (d.body === 'rider') { R.rider.rx -= 0.25 * c; if (this.armIsWeapon) R.arm.rx += 1.0 * c; }
    }
  };

  // deploy: falling pose (arms up, legs tucked) then the anime hero landing crouch and rise
  IP._landPose = function (d) {
    const A = this.A, R = this.R, L = this.L;
    if (!this.isBiped) return;
    const W = 1 - d.weight * 0.4;
    if (A.intro === 1) {
      const k = smooth01(A.introT / 0.2);
      for (const a of L.armsL) { a.rz -= 0.55 * k; a.rx -= 0.25 * k; }
      for (const a of L.armsR) { a.rz += 0.55 * k; a.rx -= 0.25 * k; }
      for (const l of L.legsL) l.rx += 0.35 * k;
      for (const l of L.legsR) l.rx -= 0.2 * k;
      R.head.rx -= 0.15 * k;
      return;
    }
    const t = A.landT;
    const c = t < 0.05 ? smooth01(t / 0.05) : t < 0.2 ? 1 : 1 - settle((t - 0.2) / 0.45);
    const k = c * W;
    R.root.py -= 0.34 * this.hipY * k;
    R.body.rx -= 0.42 * k; R.head.rx += 0.34 * k;
    for (const a of L.armsL) { a.rz -= 0.75 * k; a.rx -= 0.35 * k; }
    for (const a of L.armsR) { a.rz += 0.25 * k; a.rx += 0.75 * k; }
    for (const l of L.legsL) l.rx += 0.7 * k;
    for (const l of L.legsR) l.rx -= 0.5 * k;
  };

  IP._koPose = function (d) {
    const A = this.A, R = this.R, L = this.L;
    const k = smooth01(A.deathT / (this.deathTime * 0.35));
    R.head.rx -= 0.35 * k; R.body.rx += 0.15 * k;
    for (const a of L.armsL) { a.rz -= 0.9 * k; a.rx += 0.6 * k; }
    for (const a of L.armsR) { a.rz += 0.9 * k; a.rx += 0.6 * k; }
    for (const l of L.legsL) l.rx += 0.5 * k;
    for (const l of L.legsR) l.rx -= 0.15 * k;
    for (const w of L.wingsL) w.rz += 0.5 * k;
    for (const w of L.wingsR) w.rz -= 0.5 * k;
  };

  // secondary motion: damped springs driven by the carrier's acceleration, speed (drag) and the
  // body's rotation (inertia), blended with cheap procedural sway at LOD 1
  IP._secondary = function (d, t, mv, ph, seed, adt) {
    const L = this.L, A = this.A, R = this.R, cv = A.cv;
    for (const w of L.wheels) w.rx -= A.roll % TAU;
    for (const sp of L.spins) sp.ry += (t * (d.spinRate || 1.5)) % TAU;
    for (const g of L.gears) g.rx += (t * 2.2) % TAU;
    for (const c of L.cores) { const k = 1 + 0.06 * Math.sin(t * 4 + seed * 6); c.sx *= k; c.sy *= k; c.sz *= k; }
    const sp = this.springs;
    if (!sp.length) return;
    const cheap = A.lodK, full = 1 - cheap;
    if (cheap > 0) {
      const k = cheap;
      for (const c of L.capes) { c.rx -= k * (0.06 + 0.5 * mv + 0.3 * A.charge + 0.06 * Math.sin(t * 6.5 + seed * 3) * (0.4 + mv)); c.rz += k * 0.04 * Math.sin(t * 3.3 + seed); }
      for (const c of L.scarves) { c.rx -= k * (0.08 + 0.7 * mv + 0.12 * Math.sin(t * 7 + seed * 3)); c.rz += k * 0.08 * Math.sin(t * 4.1 + seed); }
      for (const c of L.tails) { c.ry += k * (0.28 * Math.sin(t * 2.6 + seed * 4) * (1 - 0.5 * mv) + 0.2 * Math.sin(ph) * mv); c.rx += k * (0.06 * Math.sin(t * 3.1 + seed) - 0.15 * mv); }
      for (const c of L.flags) { c.ry += k * 0.22 * Math.sin(t * 4.2 + seed * 2); c.rz += k * 0.05 * Math.sin(t * 5.1 + seed); }
      for (const c of L.springs) { c.rx += k * (0.1 * Math.sin(t * 4.4 + seed * 5) + 0.12 * mv * Math.sin(ph * 2) - 0.12 * mv); c.rz += k * 0.08 * Math.sin(t * 3.3 + seed * 2); }
    }
    if (full <= 0 || !(adt > 1e-5)) {
      if (full <= 0) for (const s of sp) { s.ax = s.az = s.vx = s.vz = 0; }
      else for (const s of sp) { s.pose.rx += s.ax * full; s.pose.rz += s.az * full; }
      return;
    }
    // carrier signals (finite differences, smoothed): [0..2] body angles, [3..5] body ang vel,
    // [6..8] body ang acc, [9..17] same for the head chain, [18] height, [19] vUp, [20] aUp
    const bp = R.root.rx + R.body.rx, by = R.root.ry + R.body.ry, bz = R.root.rz + R.body.rz;
    const hp = bp + R.head.rx, hy = by + R.head.ry, hz = bz + R.head.rz;
    const h = this.lift + R.root.py + R.body.py;
    if (!A.cvInit) {
      cv.fill(0); cv[0] = bp; cv[1] = by; cv[2] = bz; cv[9] = hp; cv[10] = hy; cv[11] = hz; cv[18] = h; A.cvInit = true;
    }
    const inv = 1 / adt, sm = 1 - Math.exp(-28 * adt);
    const ang = [bp, by, bz, hp, hy, hz];
    for (let q = 0; q < 6; q++) {
      const o = q < 3 ? q : 9 + (q - 3);
      const vel = (ang[q] - cv[o]) * inv;
      const acc = (vel - cv[o + 3]) * inv;
      cv[o] = ang[q]; cv[o + 3] = vel; cv[o + 6] += (clamp(acc, -400, 400) - cv[o + 6]) * sm;
    }
    const vUp = (h - cv[18]) * inv;
    const aUp = clamp((vUp - cv[19]) * inv, -300, 300);
    cv[18] = h; cv[19] = vUp; cv[20] += (aUp - cv[20]) * sm;
    const aF = A.aFwd, aLat = A.vFwd * A.yawRate, v = A.vFwd + 1.2 * A.charge, aU = cv[20], rt = A.rt;
    const n = Math.min(4, Math.ceil(adt / 0.017)), hdt = adt / n;
    for (let si = 0; si < sp.length; si++) {
      const s = sp[si], P = s.P, dx = s.dx, dy = s.dy, dz = s.dz, w = s.w, w2 = w * w, zw = 2 * P.z * w;
      const ao = s.head ? 9 : 0, apx = cv[ao + 6], apy = cv[ao + 7], apz = cv[ao + 8];
      const fl = P.flutter * (0.3 + 0.45 * Math.min(2, v));
      const tx = P.bias * dy + P.drag * v * dy + P.accH * aF * dy + P.accV * aU * dz + fl * Math.sin(rt * 7.3 + seed * 5 + s.depth * 1.3);
      const tz = P.accH * aLat * dy - P.accV * aU * dx + fl * 0.6 * Math.sin(rt * 5.1 + seed * 3 + s.depth);
      const ix = -P.rot * apx, iz = -P.rot * apz + P.rot * apy * dz * dy;
      for (let q = 0; q < n; q++) {
        s.vx += (w2 * (tx - s.ax) - zw * s.vx + ix) * hdt;
        s.vz += (w2 * (tz - s.az) - zw * s.vz + iz) * hdt;
        s.ax += s.vx * hdt; s.az += s.vz * hdt;
      }
      if (s.ax > P.max) { s.ax = P.max; s.vx *= -0.3; } else if (s.ax < -P.max) { s.ax = -P.max; s.vx *= -0.3; }
      if (s.az > P.max) { s.az = P.max; s.vz *= -0.3; } else if (s.az < -P.max) { s.az = -P.max; s.vz *= -0.3; }
      s.pose.rx += s.ax * full; s.pose.rz += s.az * full;
      if (P.wag) s.pose.ry += full * (P.wag * Math.sin(t * 2.6 + seed * 4) * (1 - 0.5 * mv) + 0.2 * Math.sin(ph) * mv);
    }
  };

  // facial animation: expression targets (calm idle, determined walk, fierce attack, hurt squint,
  // stun, KO) + blinking; drives the 'eyes' (scale y), 'brows' / 'browL' / 'browR' and 'mouth'
  // pivots (or 'jaw' when there is no mouth). Skipped at LOD 1 (values hold, eyes open).
  IP._face = function (st, dt) {
    const A = this.A, R = this.R, F = A.face;
    if (A.lodK < 0.5 && A.frozen < 0.5) {
      let ex = null;
      if (typeof st.expr === 'string' && EXPR[st.expr]) ex = EXPR[st.expr];
      else if (A.dying) ex = EXPR.ko;
      else if (A.rt - A.lastHurt < 0.38) ex = EXPR.hurt;
      else if (A.stun > 0.3) ex = EXPR.stun;
      const se = this._strikeEnv();
      let e0, e1, e2, e3, e4;
      if (ex) { e0 = ex[0]; e1 = ex[1]; e2 = ex[2]; e3 = ex[3]; e4 = ex[4]; }
      else if (A.aim > 0.3 || se > 0.05) {
        e0 = 0.8 + 0.14 * se; e1 = 1; e2 = -0.5 + 0.12 * se; e3 = 0.12 + 0.2 * A.wu + 0.75 * se; e4 = 0.25 + 0.2 * se;
      } else if (A.move > 0.4 || A.charge > 0.3) {
        e0 = 0.9; e1 = 0.55; e2 = -0.25; e3 = 0.05 + 0.35 * A.charge; e4 = 0.15;
      } else {
        e0 = 1; e1 = 0; e2 = A.fidget === 0 ? 0.3 : 0; e3 = A.fidget === 1 ? 0.6 : 0; e4 = A.fidget === 2 ? 0.3 : 0;
      }
      const k = 1 - Math.exp(-16 * dt);
      F[0] += (e0 - F[0]) * k; F[1] += (e1 - F[1]) * k; F[2] += (e2 - F[2]) * k; F[3] += (e3 - F[3]) * k; F[4] += (e4 - F[4]) * k;
      // blink (sometimes double)
      if (A.blinkS < 0) {
        A.blinkT += dt;
        if (A.blinkT > A.nextBlink) { A.blinkS = 0; A.blinkT = 0; A.nextBlink = hash01(A.seed * 31 + A.rt) < 0.22 ? 0.16 : 2.2 + 2.6 * hash01(A.seed * 7 + A.rt); }
      } else { A.blinkS += dt; if (A.blinkS > 0.12) A.blinkS = -1; }
    } else A.blinkS = -1;
    const bl = A.blinkS >= 0 ? 1 - Math.sin(clamp(A.blinkS / 0.12, 0, 1) * Math.PI) * 0.94 : 1;
    const stw = A.stun > 0.05 ? 1 - 0.25 * A.stun * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(A.rt * 9)) : 1;
    R.eyes.sy *= Math.max(0.05, F[0] * bl * stw);
    const u = this.faceU;
    R.brows.py += F[2] * u; R.brows.rx += 0.22 * F[1]; R.brows.sy *= 1 + 0.3 * F[1];
    R.browL.rz -= 0.42 * F[1]; R.browR.rz += 0.42 * F[1]; R.browL.py += F[2] * u; R.browR.py += F[2] * u;
    R.mouth.sy *= 0.3 + 1.5 * F[3]; R.mouth.sx *= 1 + 0.35 * F[4] - 0.12 * F[3];
    if (this.tpl.roles.mouth < 0 && this.def.anim.attack !== 'bite') R.jaw.rx -= 0.28 * F[3];
  };

  // hero-landing dust ring (one extra draw call for ~0.45 s, only right after a deploy landing)
  let DUST_GEO = null, DUST_TEX = null;
  function dustMat() {
    if (!DUST_GEO) {
      DUST_GEO = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1, 1); DUST_GEO.rotateX(-HALF_PI);
      DUST_TEX = canvasTex(128, 128, (g, w) => {
        const gr = g.createRadialGradient(w / 2, w / 2, w * 0.18, w / 2, w / 2, w / 2);
        gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,248,232,0)'); gr.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(255,248,232,0.35)'); gr.addColorStop(0.75, 'rgba(255,250,240,0.9)');
        gr.addColorStop(0.88, 'rgba(255,250,240,0.4)'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,250,240,0)');
        g.fillStyle = gr; g.fillRect(0, 0, w, w);
        // puffy edge
        g.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-out';
        for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) { const a = i / 14 * TAU; g.beginPath(); g.arc(w / 2 + Math.cos(a) * w * 0.49, w / 2 + Math.sin(a) * w * 0.49, w * 0.07, 0, TAU); g.fill(); }
        g.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
      });
    }
    return new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: DUST_TEX, color: 0xf2e6cc, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, opacity: 0.8 });
  }

  IP._extras = function (st, fx, rdt) {

      const tailB = kit.tube([[0.08, 0.72, 0.14], [0.14, 0.62, 0.21], [0.17, 0.5, 0.26]], (u) => 0.042 - 0.014 * u, { color: 'teamLight', radial: 5, seg: 7, scale: [1, 1, 0.32] });

  // ---- archer (v4 reference): anime ninja archer. Spiky black hair, navy face mask, big sharp

        kit.ring(0.13, 0.04, { color: 'navyLight', seg: [6, 14], scale: [1, 0.7, 1] }).at(0, 0.66, 0),

        kit.ring(0.212, 0.012, { color: 'navyLight', seg: [4, 20] }).rot(0.25, 0, 0).at(0, HY - 0.032, -0.015),
        kit.ring(0.207, 0.03, { color: 'team', seg: [4, 16] }).rot(-0.2, 0, 0).at(0, HY + 0.085, 0.0),
        kit.box(0.115, 0.06, 0.024, { color: 'steelLight', bevel: 0.01, mat: 'chrome' }).rot(-0.32, 0, 0).at(0, HY + 0.11, -0.192),

      rig.add('hair', kit.hairSpikes(0.212, { color: 'hairBlack', at: [0, HY, 0], n: 10, len: 0.25, thick: 0.07, sweep: 0.9, front: 0.3, seed: 9, capTheta: 1.45, shine: 0.75, capSeg: 12, radial: 5, spikeSeg: 5 }));

      rig.add('browR', kit.brow(0.09, 0.026, { color: 'hairBlack', side: 1, arch: 0.1 }).at(0.028, EY + 0.075, EZ - 0.01));
      // headband tails (scarf spring: long, floppy)
      const tail = kit.tube([[0, HY + 0.06, 0.21], [-0.03, HY + 0.02, 0.33], [-0.07, HY - 0.07, 0.42], [-0.08, HY - 0.19, 0.47]], [0.034, 0.022], { color: 'team', radial: 5, seg: 8, scale: [0.42, 1, 1] });
      rig.add('scarf', tail, tail.clone().rot(0, 0.5, 0.25).at(0.02, -0.03, 0.01));

      // arms: team shoulder cap, navy sleeve, white wrist wrap, glove hand with fingers + thumb
      const armL = kit.merge([

        kit.capsule(0.024, 0.03, { color: 'skin', seg: 7 }).rot(0.4, 0, -0.5).at(HL[0] + 0.05, HL[1] + 0.02, HL[2] - 0.04),
      ]);
      rig.add('armL', armL);
      rig.add('armR', armL.mirror());

      const bx = HL[0], by = HL[1], bz = HL[2];

        kit.extrude([[0, 0], [0.034, 0.02], [0.034, 0.1], [0, 0.085]], 0.005, { color: 'team' }).rot(0, -2.1, 0).at(ax, ay - 0.04, az));

  // ---- minion (v4 reference): alien imp flyer. Jellybean body with a soft belly, huge glowing

  G.defineModel('minion', {

    portrait: { yaw: -0.4, pitch: 0.12, pose: 'attack' },

      rig.pivot('wingR', 'body', [0.1, 0.52, 0.1]);
      rig.pivot('wingR2', 'wingR', [-WT.x, WT.y, WT.z]);

      rig.add('hair', crestLocks(kit, [[0, 1.47, -0.07], [0, 1.53, -0.01], [0, 1.535, 0.06], [0, 1.5, 0.13], [0, 1.42, 0.19], [0, 1.31, 0.22], [0, 1.2, 0.22]], { col: 'team', n: 7, r: 0.026, spread: 0.035, seed: 4 }));

      // arms: layered pauldrons (team enamel top plate), mail sleeves, vambraces, gauntlets
      const A = heroArm(kit, 1, 0.24, SH - 0.02, { len: 0.5, r: 0.05, out: 0.05, fwd: 0.09, sleeve: 0x5d636c, sleeveMat: 'brushed', mail: true, rere: STEEL_B, fore: STEEL_B, bracer: STEEL_M, glove: IRON_B, gloveMat: PLATE, gauntlet: STEEL_M, elbow: STEEL_M });
      const armR = kit.merge([A.part, plateShoulder(kit, 0.275, SH + 0.03, 0.13, 1, { top: 'team', col: STEEL_B, spikes: 2, spikeLen: 0.85, lames: 2 })]);
      rig.pivot('weapon', 'armR', A.hand);
      // kite shield on the left forearm
      const sh = new THREE.Shape();
      sh.moveTo(-0.17, 0.2); sh.quadraticCurveTo(0, 0.25, 0.17, 0.2);
      sh.quadraticCurveTo(0.18, -0.08, 0, -0.3); sh.quadraticCurveTo(-0.18, -0.08, -0.17, 0.2);
      const rimPts = sh.getSpacedPoints(40).slice(0, -1).map(v => [v.x * 1.02, v.y * 1.02, -0.022]);
      const L = A.hand;
      const shield = kit.merge([
        kit.extrude(sh, 0.04, { color: 'team', bevel: 0.012, bevelSeg: 1, curveSeg: 4, mat: { base: 'lacquer', rough: 0.42 } }),
        kit.tube(rimPts, 0.019, { color: IRON_B, mat: PLATE, radial: 3, closed: true, seg: 12 }),
        // gilded chevron of fangs (original heraldry)
        kit.extrude([[-0.12, 0.1], [0, -0.02], [0.12, 0.1], [0.12, 0.04], [0, -0.09], [-0.12, 0.04]], 0.014, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, smooth: false }).at(0, 0.0, -0.034),
        kit.cone(0.018, 0.07, { color: GOLD_L, mat: GILT, seg: 4 }).rot(PI, 0, 0).at(-0.06, -0.06, -0.034),
        kit.cone(0.018, 0.07, { color: GOLD_L, mat: GILT, seg: 4 }).rot(PI, 0, 0).at(0.06, -0.06, -0.034),
        kit.sphere(0.035, { color: STEEL_M, seg: 7, hseg: 4, mat: PLATE }).at(0, 0.12, -0.04),
        rivetRow(kit, [[-0.13, 0.16, -0.03], [0.13, 0.16, -0.03], [0, -0.22, -0.03]], 0.011),
      ]).rot(0.06, 0.75, 0).at(-L[0] - 0.08, L[1] + 0.06, L[2] - 0.05);
      rig.add('armR', armR);
      rig.add('armL', armR.mirror(), shield);

      // longsword: fullered blade, swept gold quillons, wrapped grip, team-gem pommel
      const grip = [kit.cylinder(0.02, 0.022, 0.15, { color: 'leatherDark', seg: 7, mat: 'leather' })];
      for (let i = 0; i < 1; i++) grip.push(kit.ring(0.022, 0.005, { color: GOLD_D, seg: [3, 8] }).rot(0.25, 0, 0).at(0, -0.04 + i * 0.04, 0));
      rig.add('weapon', kit.merge([
        blade(kit, 0.9, 0.082, { tip: 0.14, thick: 0.02 }).at(0, 0.09, 0),
        kit.tube([[-0.15, 0.03, 0], [-0.1, 0.075, 0], [0, 0.08, 0], [0.1, 0.075, 0], [0.15, 0.03, 0]], (u) => 0.016 + 0.01 * Math.sin(PI * u), { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, radial: 5, seg: 6 }),
        kit.cone(0.016, 0.04, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, seg: 5 }).rot(0, 0, 2.2).at(-0.165, 0.018, 0),
        kit.cone(0.016, 0.04, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, seg: 5 }).rot(0, 0, -2.2).at(0.165, 0.018, 0),
        kit.gem(0.02, { color: 'team', mat: 'gem', glow: 0.4 }).rot(HALF_PI, 0, 0).at(0, 0.08, -0.026),
        grip,
        kit.sphere(0.032, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, seg: 9 }).at(0, -0.09, 0),
        kit.gem(0.022, { color: 'team', mat: 'gem', glow: 0.35 }).at(0, -0.12, 0),
      ]).rot(-0.95, 0, 0).at(A.hand[0], A.hand[1], A.hand[2]));
      return rig;
    },
  });

  // =====================================================================================
  // VALKYRIE - "Walküre" (v11): lean, muscular axe maiden. Copper braid (hair -> hair2 springs),
  // crimson war paint across narrow green eyes, iron circlet with swept blade-wings, black fur
  // mantle, blackened breastplate over a laced leather corset, torn two-tone team kilt with a
  // gold hem, spiked bracers, fur-cuffed boots. Giant double-bladed battle axe, whirlwind spin.
  // =====================================================================================
  define('valkyrie', {
    look: LOOK_BLADE,
    height: 1.54,
    outline: 0.05,
    anim: {
      body: 'biped', walk: 'march', attack: 'spin', tempo: 1.05, weight: 0.4, spinTime: 0.46,
      springs: { springs: { f: 3.2, max: 0.9, rot: 0.9 } },
      keys: { 'body.rx': [0, 0.22, -0.1, 0], 'root.py': [-0.02, -0.07, 0.04, 0], 'legsL.rx': [0.25, 0.4, 0.1, 0.1], 'legsR.rx': [-0.2, -0.35, -0.1, -0.1] },
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        // braid whips out sideways while spinning
        const sp = a.strikes > 0 && a.strikeT < 0.5 ? Math.sin(clamp(a.strikeT / 0.5, 0, 1) * PI) : 0;
        if (rig.hair) { rig.hair.rotation.x -= 0.9 * sp + 0.25 * a.windup; rig.hair.rotation.z += 0.5 * sp; }
        if (rig.hair2) rig.hair2.rotation.x -= 0.5 * sp;
      },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.5, pitch: 0.08, pose: 'idle', zoom: 2.2 },
    build(kit) {
      const rig = kit.rig();
      const HIP = 0.7, NY = 1.2, SH = 1.11, fur = 0x241c18, furL = 0x3a2e26, hairC = 0x8a2e14;
      rig.pivot('legL', 'root', [-0.095, HIP, 0]);
      rig.pivot('legR', 'root', [0.095, HIP, 0]);
      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, HIP + 0.02, 0]);
      rig.pivot('head', 'body', [0, NY, 0]);
      rig.pivot('hair', 'head', [0, 1.4, 0.1]);
      rig.pivot('hair2', 'hair', [0, 1.2, 0.17]);
      rig.pivot('armL', 'body', [-0.205, SH, 0]);
      rig.pivot('armR', 'body', [0.205, SH, 0]);

      const leg = heroLeg(kit, -0.095, { hip: HIP, r: 0.064, pants: 'leatherDark', knee: STEEL_B, boot: 'leatherDark', cuff: fur, sole: 0x120c0a });
      rig.add('legL', leg, kit.blob(0.15, 0.08, 0.15, { color: fur, mat: 'fur', round: 0.2, seg: 8 }).at(-0.099, 0.15, 0));
      rig.add('legR', leg.mirror(), kit.blob(0.15, 0.08, 0.15, { color: fur, mat: 'fur', round: 0.2, seg: 8 }).at(0.099, 0.15, 0));

      // torso: leather corset (laced) + blackened breastplate, team kilt, belt, fur mantle, sash
      const zs = 0.64;
      const lace = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        const y = 0.8 + i * 0.05;
        lace.push(seam(kit, [[-0.03, y, -0.135], [0.03, y + 0.025, -0.135]], 0.005, 'boneDark'), seam(kit, [[0.03, y, -0.135], [-0.03, y + 0.025, -0.135]], 0.005, 'boneDark'));
      }
      const bp = [[0.15, 0.93], [0.175, 1.0], [0.18, 1.06], [0.155, 1.12], [0.09, 1.17]];
      rig.add('body',
        torsoV(kit, 0.68, 1.2, 0.122, 0.168, 0.165, zs, { color: 'leather', mat: 'leather' }),
        lace,
        shell(kit, bp, 1.2, zs * 1.06, STEEL_B, { mat: PLATE }).scale(1.05, 1, 1),
        trim(kit, bp.map(q => [-q[0] * Math.sin(1.2) * 1.06, q[1], -q[0] * Math.cos(1.2) * zs * 1.08]), 0.007),
        trim(kit, bp.map(q => [q[0] * Math.sin(1.2) * 1.06, q[1], -q[0] * Math.cos(1.2) * zs * 1.08]), 0.007),
        trim(kit, arcPts(0.152, 0.93, PI - 1.2, PI + 1.2, 6, zs * 1.08), 0.008),
        kilt(kit, 0.79, 0.44, 0.16, 0.235, 0.78, 'team', 'teamDark', { teeth: 8, amp: 0.07 }),
        belt(kit, 0.135, 0.8, 0.72, { t: 0.024, col: 'leatherDark', buckle: GOLD_T }),
        kit.tube([[-0.16, 1.1, -0.07], [-0.06, 0.98, -0.135], [0.08, 0.86, -0.13], [0.15, 0.8, -0.06]], 0.022, { color: 'team', mat: 'cloth', radial: 5, seg: 8, scale: [1, 1, 0.7] }),
        furMantle(kit, 1.15, 0.15, 0.8, fur, furL, { tufts: 6 }),
        // short fur cape over the back with a team hem band (team from behind)
        tornCape(kit, [[0.24, 0.78], [0.225, 0.9], [0.2, 1.02], [0.17, 1.12]], 1.05, fur, 'team', 0.85, { amp: 0.06, n: 5, seed: 6 }).at(0, 0, 0.03),
        kit.lathe([[0.245, 0.8], [0.24, 0.84]], { color: 'team', mat: 'cloth', seg: kit.hi ? 12 : 6, phi: [-1.0, 2.0], scale: [1, 1, 0.86], double: 'teamDark', sharp: true }).at(0, 0, 0.03));

      // head: fierce face, war paint, copper hair + braid, iron circlet with blade-wings
      const F = grimFace(kit, rig, { NY, h: 0.255, w: 0.172, cz: -0.005, skin: 'skin', jaw: 0.94, chin: 0.92, cheek: 1.15, female: true, gaunt: 0.7, iris: 0x5a9a4a, browCol: 0x4a1810, warpaint: 0x4a0a0e, tilt: 0.28, ears: false, mouth: { w: 0.06, teeth: false, open: 0.5 } });
      const wingB = kit.extrude([[0, 0], [0.06, 0.03], [0.17, 0.13], [0.11, 0.035], [0.16, 0.02], [0.08, -0.01], [0.12, -0.04], [0.03, -0.03]], 0.012, { color: STEEL_M, mat: PLATE, smooth: false })
        .paint((px) => (px > 0.1 ? EDGE : null)).rot(0.1, -0.35, 0.15).at(F.rx * 0.95, F.cy + 0.03, 0.0);
      rig.add('head',
        kit.capsule(0.045, 0.05, { color: 'skinShade', mat: 'skin', seg: 6, capSeg: 1 }).at(0, NY + 0.02, 0.01),
        hairShell(kit, F, { col: hairC, line: { front: 0.79, temple: 0.72, side: 0.6, back: 0.22 }, thick: 0.075, teeth: 18, tooth: 0.05, frontTeeth: 0.12, drop: 0.3, flow: 'back' }),
        
        kit.ring(F.rx * 1.1, 0.011, { color: STEEL_B, mat: PLATE, seg: [4, 16] }).scale(1, 1, F.rz / F.rx * 1.08).rot(-0.18, 0, 0).at(0, F.cy + 0.045, F.cz),
        kit.gem(0.017, { color: 'team', mat: 'gem', glow: 0.5 }).rot(HALF_PI - 0.18, 0, 0).at(0, F.cy + 0.06, F.cz - F.rz * 1.1),
        wingB, wingB.mirror(),
        // loose side locks over the temples falling past the jaw
        hairLocks(kit, F, { col: hairC, n: 3, style: 'nape', a: [-1.75, -1.35], s: [0.62, 0.7], len: 0.2, thick: 0.017, grav: 0.2, lift: 0.08, seed: 2 }),
        hairLocks(kit, F, { col: hairC, n: 2, style: 'nape', a: [1.4, 1.7], s: [0.62, 0.7], len: 0.16, thick: 0.015, grav: 0.2, lift: 0.08, seed: 3 }));
      // two plaited braids (spring chain hair -> hair2) with leather ties and team ribbons
      const plait = (pts, r0, r1) => kit.tube(pts, (u) => (r0 + (r1 - r0) * u) * (1 + 0.2 * Math.sin(u * PI * (kit.hi ? 10 : 4))), { color: hairC, mat: { base: 'hair', rough: 0.45 }, radial: kit.hi ? 7 : 4, seg: kit.hi ? 16 : 4 })
        .paint((x, y, z, nx, ny) => (ny > 0.4 ? kit.lighten(hairC, 0.3) : ny < -0.4 ? kit.darken(hairC, 0.35) : null));
      const tie = (x, y, z, r) => kit.cylinder(r, r, r * 0.9, { color: 'leatherDark', mat: 'leather', seg: kit.hi ? 9 : 6 }).at(x, y, z);
      const ribbonT = (x, y, z, sd) => ribbon(kit, [[x, y, z], [x + sd * 0.02, y - 0.06, z + 0.03], [x + sd * 0.03, y - 0.13, z + 0.04]], 0.016, 0.01, 'team');
      rig.add('hair',
        plait([[-0.035, 1.41, 0.1], [-0.045, 1.33, 0.15], [-0.05, 1.2, 0.17]], 0.03, 0.026), plait([[0.035, 1.41, 0.1], [0.045, 1.33, 0.15], [0.05, 1.2, 0.17]], 0.03, 0.026),
        tie(-0.047, 1.26, 0.165, 0.03), tie(0.047, 1.26, 0.165, 0.03));
      rig.add('hair2',
        plait([[-0.05, 1.2, 0.17], [-0.048, 1.06, 0.19], [-0.04, 0.93, 0.17]], 0.026, 0.012), plait([[0.05, 1.2, 0.17], [0.05, 1.06, 0.19], [0.042, 0.93, 0.17]], 0.026, 0.012),
        tie(-0.042, 0.96, 0.172, 0.018), tie(0.044, 0.96, 0.172, 0.018),
        ribbonT(-0.042, 0.95, 0.18, -1), ribbonT(0.044, 0.95, 0.18, 1));

      // arms: bare muscular upper arms, steel pauldron with team enamel, spiked bracers
      const A = heroArm(kit, 1, 0.2, SH - 0.02, { len: 0.47, r: 0.046, bulge: 0.26, out: 0.05, fwd: 0.08, sleeve: 'skin', fore: 'skin', bracer: STEEL_B, bracerSpikes: 2, glove: 'leatherDark', gloveMat: 'leather', wraps: 'leatherDark', elbow: false });
      const armR = kit.merge([A.part,
        plateShoulder(kit, 0.215, SH + 0.025, 0.085, 1, { top: 'team', col: STEEL_B, lames: 1, spikes: 2, spikeLen: 0.8 }),
        kit.ring(0.05, 0.012, { color: 'team', seg: [3, 10] }).at(0.225, SH - 0.12, 0.005)]);
      rig.pivot('weapon', 'armR', A.hand);
      rig.add('armR', armR);
      rig.add('armL', armR.mirror());

      // giant double-bladed battle axe (bearded crescent blades, honed edges, iron spike)
      const blade = axeHead(kit, [[0.03, 0.12], [0.14, 0.21], [0.29, 0.29], [0.36, 0.1], [0.37, -0.08], [0.3, -0.29], [0.13, -0.2], [0.03, -0.11]], 0.026, 0.27, { rune: 0xd8a84a });
      rig.add('weapon', kit.merge([
        kit.rcyl(0.026, 0.026, 1.0, { color: 'woodDark', seg: 7 }).at(0, 0.3, 0),
        kit.cylinder(0.03, 0.03, 0.16, { color: 'leatherDark', seg: 7 }).at(0, 0.0, 0),
        blade.clone().rot(0, HALF_PI, 0).at(0, 0.66, 0), blade.clone().rot(0, HALF_PI, 0).at(0, 0.66, 0).mirror('z'),
        kit.rcyl(0.05, 0.05, 0.24, { color: IRON_B, mat: PLATE, seg: 9 }).at(0, 0.66, 0),
        kit.ring(0.054, 0.012, { color: 'team', seg: [3, 10] }).at(0, 0.71, 0),
        kit.cone(0.035, 0.2, { color: STEEL_L, mat: PLATE, seg: 6 }).at(0, 0.88, 0),
        kit.sphere(0.036, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, seg: 8 }).at(0, -0.2, 0),
        kit.cone(0.026, 0.09, { color: STEEL_L, mat: PLATE, seg: 5 }).rot(PI, 0, 0).at(0, -0.27, 0),
      ]).rot(-0.85, 0, -0.42).at(A.hand[0], A.hand[1], A.hand[2]));
      return rig;
    },
  });

  // =====================================================================================
  // BARBARIAN - "Barbar" (v11): hulking northern raider. Bare scarred torso (pecs, heavy arms),
  // horned iron half-helm with a nose guard and a team band, long braided beard with gold beads,
  // war-paint stripes, black fur mantle with a team cloak over the back, studded baldric, torn
  // team kilt, wrapped shins. Heavy notched cleaver-sword, overhead chop (swarm budget).
  // =====================================================================================
  define('barbarian', {
    look: LOOK_BLADE,
    height: 1.5,
    outline: 0.05,
    anim: {
      body: 'biped', walk: 'stomp', attack: 'swing', tempo: 1.15, weight: 0.55,
      keys: { 'body.rx': [0, 0.2, -0.4, -0.3], 'root.py': [-0.03, 0.03, -0.09, -0.07], 'off.rx': [0.5, 1.2, -0.2, 0] },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.4, pitch: 0.08, pose: 'attack', zoom: 1.9 },
    build(kit) {
      const rig = kit.rig();
      const HIP = 0.62, NY = 1.16, SH = 1.07, fur = 0x2a211b, furL = 0x46382c, hairC = 0x4a2412;
      rig.pivot('legL', 'root', [-0.12, HIP, 0]);
      rig.pivot('legR', 'root', [0.12, HIP, 0]);
      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, HIP + 0.02, 0]);
      rig.pivot('head', 'body', [0, NY, -0.02]);
      rig.pivot('hair', 'head', [0, 1.36, 0.11]);
      rig.pivot('armL', 'body', [-0.255, SH, 0]);
      rig.pivot('armR', 'body', [0.255, SH, 0]);

      const leg = heroLeg(kit, -0.12, { hip: HIP, r: 0.078, pants: 'leatherDark', shin: 0x6a5a44, boot: 'leatherDark', cuff: fur, sole: 0x120c0a });
      const wraps = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) wraps.push(kit.ring(0.06, 0.009, { color: 'boneDark', seg: [3, 9] }).rot(0.15, 0, 0).at(-0.126, 0.16 + i * 0.06, -0.003));
      rig.add('legL', leg, wraps);
      rig.add('legR', leg.mirror(), wraps.map(w => w.mirror()));

      // bare torso: V torso in skin, pecs, scars, studded baldric, belt, kilt, fur mantle, cloak
      const zs = 0.68;
      const studs = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const u = 0.15 + i * 0.22; studs.push(kit.sphere(0.012, { color: STEEL_L, mat: PLATE, seg: 6, hseg: 4 }).at(-0.2 + 0.4 * u, 1.1 - 0.36 * u, -0.162 - 0.035 * Math.sin(u * PI))); }
      rig.add('body',
        muscleTorso(kit, 0.62, 1.17, 0.17, 0.24, 0.215, zs, { k: 1.2 }),
        seam(kit, [[0.03, 1.0, -0.172], [0.1, 0.93, -0.17], [0.16, 0.86, -0.155]], 0.0035, 0xc49080),
        seam(kit, [[-0.12, 0.85, -0.155], [-0.06, 0.8, -0.158]], 0.0035, 0xc49080),
        kit.tube([[-0.21, 1.12, -0.06], [-0.12, 1.06, -0.17], [0.04, 0.9, -0.175], [0.18, 0.74, -0.12], [0.22, 0.72, 0.0]], 0.022, { color: 'leatherDark', mat: 'leather', radial: 5, seg: 10, scale: [1, 1, 0.6] }),
        kilt(kit, 0.72, 0.38, 0.185, 0.25, 0.78, 'team', 'teamDark', { teeth: 8, amp: 0.07, pleats: 10 }),
        belt(kit, 0.188, 0.73, 0.74, { t: 0.032, col: 'leatherDark', buckle: GOLD_T }),
        furMantle(kit, 1.12, 0.19, 0.8, fur, furL, { tufts: 9 }),
        tornCape(kit, [[0.29, 0.62], [0.27, 0.8], [0.24, 0.98], [0.2, 1.12]], 1.0, 'team', 'teamDark', 0.82, { amp: 0.08, n: 4, seed: 4 }).at(0, 0, 0.03));

      // head: brutal face, beard, horned iron half-helm (team band), braid at the back
      const F = grimFace(kit, rig, { NY, h: 0.25, w: 0.185, cz: -0.01, skin: 'skin', jaw: 1.15, chin: 1.1, gaunt: 1.2, iris: 0x6f8aa4, browCol: hairC, browThick: 0.011, stubble: hairC, scar: true, tilt: 0.3, helm: true, mouth: { w: 0.07, teeth: true, open: 0.7 } });
      const hx = F.rx * 1.15, hy = F.ry * 1.1, hz = F.rz * 1.12;
      const helm = kit.merge([
        kit.sphere(hx, { color: STEEL_B, mat: PLATE, seg: 10, hseg: 5, theta: [0, 1.62], scale: [1, hy / hx, hz / hx] }),
        kit.ring(hx * Math.sin(1.62), 0.016, { color: 'team', mat: 'cloth', seg: [3, 14] }).scale(1, 1, hz / hx).at(0, hy * Math.cos(1.62) + 0.01, 0),
        kit.tube([[0, hy * 0.5, -hz * 0.9], [0, hy * 1.02, 0], [0, hy * 0.5, hz * 0.9]], 0.013, { color: STEEL_M, mat: PLATE, radial: 4, seg: 6 }),
      ]).rot(0.2, 0, 0).at(0, F.cy, F.cz);
      const hornL = horn(kit, [-hx * 0.85, F.cy + 0.03, 0.0], [-hx * 1.9, F.cy + 0.07, -0.02], [-hx * 2.15, F.cy + 0.25, -0.09], 0.036, 'bone');
      rig.add('head',
        helm, hornL, hornL.mirror(),
        nasalBar(kit, F, STEEL_M, { y0: F.BY + 0.035 }),
        beardShell(kit, F, { col: hairC, len: 0.42, thick: 0.05, braids: 2, braidLen: 0.1, moustache: 'down' }),
        rivetRow(kit, [[-hx * 0.7, F.cy + 0.05, F.cz - hz * 0.7], [hx * 0.7, F.cy + 0.05, F.cz - hz * 0.7]], 0.009, STEEL_L));
      rig.add('hair',
        kit.tube([[0, 1.36, 0.11], [0, 1.28, 0.15], [0, 1.16, 0.15], [0, 1.06, 0.12]], (u) => 0.032 - 0.016 * u, { color: hairC, mat: 'hair', radial: 5, seg: 6 }),
        kit.ring(0.026, 0.007, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, seg: [3, 8] }).at(0, 1.12, 0.14));

      // arms: huge bare arms, leather + team wraps, iron bracer, one iron pauldron with spikes
      const A = heroArm(kit, 1, 0.25, SH - 0.02, { len: 0.47, r: 0.06, bulge: 0.28, out: 0.06, fwd: 0.08, sleeve: 'skin', fore: 'skin', bracer: 'leatherDark', bracerMat: 'leather', bracerTrim: 'team', glove: 'skin' });
      const armR = kit.merge([A.part, plateShoulder(kit, 0.265, SH + 0.03, 0.095, 1, { col: STEEL_B, top: STEEL_B, rim: STEEL_M, lames: 1, spikes: 3, spikeLen: 0.8, studs: false })]);

  // =====================================================================================
  // BANDIT - "Banditin" (v11): lean shadow assassin. Deep charcoal hood (the tip is the 'hair'
  // spring) lined in team colour, a cloth mask over the lower face, burning amber eyes in the
  // hood shadow; fitted black leather with straps and buckles, belt pouches, thigh sheath, long
  // two-part team scarf (scarf -> scarf2), bracers. Curved shadow blade with a glowing edge.
  // Low sprint while dashing.
  // =====================================================================================
  const PHANTOM = { suit: 0x1c1a20, suitL: 0x4a3426, hood: 0x1f1d24, hoodL: 0x2c2933, teal: AMBER };
  define('bandit', {
    height: 1.5,
    outline: 0.05,
    anim: {
      body: 'biped', walk: 'dash', attack: 'slash', tempo: 1.15, weight: 0.2, turnSpeed: 14,
      keys: { 'root.pz': [0, 0.14, -0.38, -0.3], 'body.rx': [0.05, 0.2, -0.35, -0.3] },
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        const m = rig.__m || (rig.__m = { d: 0 });
        const dashing = a.attacking && (+st.speed || 0) > 3 ? 1 : 0;
        m.d += (dashing - m.d) * Math.min(1, dt * 14);
        const d = m.d;
        if (d > 0.001) {
          const ph = a.rt * 22;
          rig.body.rotation.x -= 0.6 * d;
          rig.head.rotation.x += 0.4 * d;
          rig.legL.rotation.x += 0.9 * Math.sin(ph) * d;
          rig.legR.rotation.x -= 0.9 * Math.sin(ph) * d;
          rig.armL.rotation.x -= 1.2 * d; rig.armR.rotation.x -= 1.0 * d;
          rig.armL.rotation.z -= 0.3 * d; rig.armR.rotation.z += 0.3 * d;
          if (rig.scarf) rig.scarf.rotation.x -= 0.7 * d;
          if (rig.scarf2) rig.scarf2.rotation.x -= 0.3 * d;
        }
      },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.35, pitch: 0.08, pose: 'idle', zoom: 2.4 },
    build(kit) {
      const rig = kit.rig();
      const C = PHANTOM, HIP = 0.7, NY = 1.19, SH = 1.1;
      rig.pivot('legL', 'root', [-0.09, HIP, 0]);
      rig.pivot('legR', 'root', [0.09, HIP, 0]);
      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, HIP + 0.02, 0]);
      rig.pivot('head', 'body', [0, NY, 0]);
      rig.pivot('hair', 'head', [0, 1.45, 0.05]);
      rig.pivot('scarf', 'body', [0.05, 1.14, 0.1]);
      rig.pivot('scarf2', 'scarf', [0.1, 0.9, 0.28]);
      rig.pivot('armL', 'body', [-0.19, SH, 0]);
      rig.pivot('armR', 'body', [0.19, SH, 0]);

      const leg = heroLeg(kit, -0.09, { hip: HIP, r: 0.062, pants: C.suit, pantsMat: 'leather', shin: C.suit, knee: false, boot: 0x100e12, cuff: C.suitL, sole: 0x060506, buckle: GOLD_D });
      rig.add('legL', leg,
        kit.ring(0.066, 0.01, { color: 'leatherDark', seg: [3, 10] }).at(-0.093, 0.56, -0.005),
        kit.ring(0.064, 0.01, { color: 'leatherDark', seg: [3, 10] }).at(-0.094, 0.48, -0.006));
      // thigh sheath with a dagger hilt on the right leg
      rig.add('legR', leg.mirror(),
        kit.box(0.04, 0.16, 0.03, { color: 'leatherDark', bevel: 0.01, mat: 'leather' }).rot(0, 0, -0.1).at(0.16, 0.5, -0.01),
        kit.cylinder(0.011, 0.011, 0.06, { color: 'leather', seg: 6 }).rot(0, 0, -0.1).at(0.168, 0.6, -0.01),
        kit.ring(0.066, 0.01, { color: 'leatherDark', seg: [3, 10] }).at(0.093, 0.56, -0.005));

      // torso: fitted leather, cross straps with buckles, belt with pouches, short torn coat tails
      const zs = 0.62;
      const pouch = (x) => kit.blob(0.06, 0.06, 0.04, { color: 'leatherDark', mat: 'leather', round: 0.6, seg: 7 }).at(x, 0.76, -0.12);
      rig.add('body',
        torsoV(kit, 0.68, 1.19, 0.118, 0.158, 0.15, zs, { color: C.suit, mat: 'leather' }),
        shell(kit, [[0.13, 0.86], [0.155, 0.96], [0.162, 1.04], [0.14, 1.12]], 0.5, zs * 1.06, C.suitL, { mat: 'leather' }).scale(1.04, 1, 1),
        kit.tube([[-0.15, 1.1, -0.06], [-0.05, 1.0, -0.115], [0.08, 0.88, -0.11], [0.14, 0.82, -0.05]], 0.012, { color: 'leatherDark', mat: 'leather', radial: 4, seg: 8, scale: [1, 1, 0.6] }),
        kit.tube([[0.15, 1.1, -0.06], [0.05, 1.0, -0.115], [-0.08, 0.88, -0.11], [-0.14, 0.82, -0.05]], 0.012, { color: 'leatherDark', mat: 'leather', radial: 4, seg: 8, scale: [1, 1, 0.6] }),
        buckle(kit, 0.03, 0.026, GOLD_T).at(0, 0.98, -0.122),
        belt(kit, 0.13, 0.79, 0.72, { t: 0.02, col: 'leatherDark', buckle: GOLD_T }),
        pouch(-0.09), pouch(0.09),
        // layered torn shoulder mantle (team over teamDark), deep points, soft folds
        folds(tatter(kit.lathe([[0.205, 0.86], [0.2, 0.94], [0.18, 1.03], [0.145, 1.11], [0.1, 1.165]], { color: 'teamDark', mat: 'cloth', seg: kit.hi ? 22 : 6, phi: [-(PI - 0.75), 2 * (PI - 0.75)], scale: [1, 1, 0.8], double: 0x120e12 }), 0.97, 0.1, 9, 0, 5), 0.005, 7, 0, 0, 0.3),
        folds(tatter(kit.lathe([[0.235, 0.96], [0.22, 1.02], [0.185, 1.1], [0.125, 1.175]], { color: 'team', mat: 'cloth', seg: kit.hi ? 22 : 8, phi: [-(PI - 0.55), 2 * (PI - 0.55)], scale: [1, 1, 0.82], double: 'teamDark' }), 1.04, 0.07, 7, 0, 9), 0.005, 9, 0, 0, 1.0),
        trim(kit, [[-0.17, 0.97, -0.08], [-0.06, 0.92, -0.15], [0.06, 0.88, -0.145], [0.16, 0.84, -0.08]], 0.006, 'leatherDark'),
        // dagger handles on the belt (left hip) + strap buckles
        kit.cylinder(0.011, 0.011, 0.07, { color: 'leather', seg: 6 }).rot(0, 0, 0.5).at(-0.14, 0.82, -0.06),
        kit.box(0.05, 0.01, 0.02, { color: GOLD_D, mat: GILT, bevel: 0.003 }).rot(0, 0, 0.5).at(-0.125, 0.795, -0.06),
        tatter(kit.lathe([[0.19, 0.5], [0.165, 0.64], [0.14, 0.78]], { color: C.suitL, mat: 'leather', seg: 10, phi: [-1.3, 2.6], scale: [1, 1, 0.75], double: 'team', sharp: true }), 0.56, 0.08, 4, 0, 6));

      // head: hood + lining, mask over the lower face, glowing eyes in the shadow
      const F = grimFace(kit, rig, { NY, h: 0.24, w: 0.164, cz: 0, skin: 0x9a6a52, jaw: 0.92, chin: 0.9, iris: AMBER, glow: 0.85, tilt: 0.32, browCol: 0x140c0a, browThick: 0.0085, female: true, ears: false, helm: true, socket: 1.3, lips: false, mouth: { w: 0.05, teeth: false } });
      const hp = [[0.19, NY - 0.1], [0.15, NY - 0.03], [0.118, NY + 0.05], [0.11, NY + 0.13], [0.104, NY + 0.19], [0.086, NY + 0.24], [0.05, NY + 0.275], [0.012, NY + 0.288]];
      const HZ = 1.16, HO = 0.014, HG = 0.6;
      const hood = folds(kit.lathe(hp, { color: C.hood, mat: 'cloth', seg: kit.hi ? 24 : 12, phi: [PI + HG, TAU - 2 * HG], scale: [1, 1, HZ], double: 0x09080b }), 0.004, 9, 0, HO, 0.4).at(0, 0, HO);
      const edge = (sd) => hp.map(q => [sd * q[0] * Math.sin(HG), q[1], -q[0] * Math.cos(HG) * HZ + HO]);
      const rim = kit.tube(edge(-1).concat(edge(1).reverse().slice(1)), 0.012, { color: 'team', mat: 'cloth', radial: kit.hi ? 6 : 4, seg: kit.hi ? 24 : 12 });
      // cloth mask over the lower face: a shell on the head shape (follows nose + jaw), stitched rim
      const MS = F.S, mTop = MS.sOf(F.EY) - 0.115;
      const mask = headGrid(kit, (t, u) => {
        const a = t * 1.75, sv = 0.0 + mTop * u - 0.012 * Math.cos(a * 2) * u;
        const P = MS.pt(a, Math.max(0.002, sv)), N = headNormal(MS, P), tk = F.h * (0.012 - 0.02 * smooth01((Math.abs(t) - 0.9) / 0.1));
        return [P[0] + N[0] * tk, P[1] + N[1] * tk - F.h * 0.03 * Math.pow(1 - u, 2), P[2] + N[2] * tk];
      }, { col: 0x141118, mat: 'cloth', k: 0.5 });
      rig.add('head',
        hood, rim, mask,
        kit.sphere(F.rx * 0.98, { color: 0x09080b, mat: 'cloth', seg: 9, hseg: 5, scale: [1, 1.15, 1.1] }).at(0, F.cy + 0.01, F.cz + 0.04));
      // hood point (spring)
      rig.add('hair', kit.tube([[0, 1.45, 0.05], [0, 1.45, 0.13], [0, 1.38, 0.2], [0, 1.28, 0.22]], (u) => 0.05 * (1 - u) + 0.004, { color: C.hood, mat: 'cloth', radial: 5, seg: 6, scale: [1.2, 1, 0.8] }));
      // long team scarf: knot at the neck + two spring segments with torn ends
      rig.add('scarf',
        folds(kit.lathe([[0.115, 1.12], [0.12, 1.15], [0.105, 1.19], [0.085, 1.21]], { color: 'team', mat: 'cloth', seg: kit.hi ? 18 : 9, scale: [1, 1, 0.9] }), 0.006, 6, 0, 0, 0.8),
        kit.sphere(0.03, { color: 'teamDark', mat: 'cloth', seg: 7, hseg: 5, scale: [1.2, 0.9, 0.9] }).at(0.05, 1.15, 0.085),
        ribbon(kit, [[0.05, 1.15, 0.09], [0.08, 1.04, 0.19], [0.1, 0.9, 0.28]], 0.05, 0.045, 'team'),
        ribbon(kit, [[0.0, 1.15, 0.09], [-0.01, 1.05, 0.17], [0.0, 0.94, 0.23]], 0.04, 0.034, 'teamDark'));
      rig.add('scarf2',

      const A = heroArm(kit, 1, 0.185, SH - 0.02, { len: 0.47, r: 0.04, bulge: 0.12, out: 0.04, fwd: 0.08, sleeve: C.suit, sleeveMat: 'leather', fore: C.suit, bracer: C.suitL, bracerMat: 'leather', bracerTrim: 'team', glove: 0x0e0c10, gloveMat: 'leather', wraps: 'leatherDark' });
      const armR = kit.merge([A.part,

      rig.pivot('weapon', 'armR', A.hand);
      rig.add('armR', armR);
      rig.add('armL', armR.mirror());

      // curved shadow blade with a glowing amber edge, wrapped grip, small guard

          .paint((px, py) => (px > 0.012 + 0.0 * py ? AMBER : null)).at(0, 0.06, 0),
