        kit.box(0.09, 0.016, 0.03, { color: GOLD_D, bevel: 0.006, mat: GILT }).at(0, 0.05, 0),
        kit.cylinder(0.016, 0.017, 0.11, { color: 'leatherDark', seg: 6, mat: 'leather' }).at(0, -0.01, 0),
        kit.sphere(0.022, { color: GOLD_D, seg: 7, mat: GILT }).at(0, -0.075, 0),
      ]).rot(-0.95, 0, 0).at(A.hand[0], A.hand[1], A.hand[2]));
      return rig;
    },
  });

  // =====================================================================================
  // GUARD - "Wache" (v11): grim shield-wall footsoldier. Nasal helm with a short team crest
  // ('hair' spring) over a mail aventail, stubbled hard face, team tabard with gold piping over
  // mail, leather belt, round team shield with an iron rim, boss and spike (hidden once the sim
  // shield breaks), leaf-bladed spear thrust. Swarm budget.
  // =====================================================================================
  define('guard', {
    look: LOOK_BLADE,
    height: 1.34,
    outline: 0.05,
    anim: {
      body: 'biped', walk: 'march', attack: 'thrust', tempo: 1.2, weight: 0.3, turnSpeed: 13,
      keys: { 'root.pz': [0, 0.1, -0.28, -0.2], 'off.rx': [0.7, 0.8, 0.5, 0.6] },
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        const k = Math.max(a.aim, a.windup, a.strike);
        if (rig.weapon) rig.weapon.rotation.x -= 2.95 * k;
        const mem = rig.__m || (rig.__m = { brk: 0 });
        toggleShield(rig.shield, st, a, mem);
      },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.4, pitch: 0.08, pose: 'idle', zoom: 2.1 },
    build(kit) {
      const rig = kit.rig();
      const HIP = 0.58, NY = 1.04, SH = 0.97;
      rig.pivot('legL', 'root', [-0.09, HIP, 0]);
      rig.pivot('legR', 'root', [0.09, HIP, 0]);
      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, HIP + 0.02, 0]);
      rig.pivot('head', 'body', [0, NY, 0]);
      rig.pivot('hair', 'head', [0, 1.29, -0.01]);
      rig.pivot('armL', 'body', [-0.195, SH, 0]);
      rig.pivot('armR', 'body', [0.195, SH, 0]);

      const leg = heroLeg(kit, -0.09, { hip: HIP, r: 0.06, pants: 0x4c525b, pantsMat: 'brushed', mail: true, shin: 'leatherDark', knee: STEEL_M, boot: 'leatherDark', cuff: 'leather', sole: 0x120c0a });
      rig.add('legL', leg);
      rig.add('legR', leg.mirror());

      const zs = 0.64;
      const tp = [[0.17, 0.5], [0.15, 0.66], [0.15, 0.8], [0.185, 0.9], [0.18, 0.97]];
      rig.add('body',
        torsoV(kit, 0.56, 1.04, 0.13, 0.178, 0.165, zs, { color: 0x4c525b, mat: 'brushed' }),
        folds(tatter(shell(kit, tp, 0.7, zs * 1.1, 'team', { mat: 'cloth', double: 'teamDark', seg: kit.hi ? 14 : 7 }).scale(1.06, 1, 1), 0.56, 0.05, 3, 0, 2), 0.006, 10, 0, 0, 0.6),
        folds(tatter(shell(kit, tp, 0.7, zs * 1.1, 'team', { mat: 'cloth', double: 'teamDark', seg: kit.hi ? 14 : 7 }, true).scale(1.06, 1, 1), 0.56, 0.05, 3, 0, 5), 0.006, 10, 0, 0, 0.2),
        trim(kit, tp.map(q => [-q[0] * Math.sin(0.7) * 1.07, q[1], -q[0] * Math.cos(0.7) * zs * 1.12]), 0.007),
        trim(kit, tp.map(q => [q[0] * Math.sin(0.7) * 1.07, q[1], -q[0] * Math.cos(0.7) * zs * 1.12]), 0.007),
        kit.extrude([[-0.05, 0.04], [0, -0.025], [0.05, 0.04], [0.05, 0.012], [0, -0.06], [-0.05, 0.012]], 0.01, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, smooth: false }).rot(0.1, 0, 0).at(0, 0.84, -0.13),
        belt(kit, 0.142, 0.68, 0.74, { t: 0.022, col: 'leatherDark', buckle: GOLD_T }),
        // lamellar gorget over the shoulders (stepped riveted plates)
        lamellar(kit, 0.955, 1.075, 0.15, 0.084, 0.85, STEEL_M, { n: 3, edge: IRON_B }));

      const F = grimFace(kit, rig, { NY, h: 0.23, w: 0.162, cz: -0.004, skin: 'skin', iris: 0x6b5a44, browCol: 0x2a1a12, stubble: 0x4a3a30, scar: [[0.12, -0.12], [0.26, -0.32]], jaw: 1.1, gaunt: 1.2, tilt: 0.24, helm: true, mouth: { w: 0.055, teeth: false, open: 0.45 } });
      const hx = F.rx * 1.16, hy = F.ry * 1.15, hz = F.rz * 1.14;
      rig.add('head',
        kit.merge([
          kit.sphere(hx, { color: STEEL_M, mat: PLATE, seg: 10, hseg: 5, theta: [0, 1.62], scale: [1, hy / hx, hz / hx] }),
          kit.ring(hx * Math.sin(1.62), 0.011, { color: IRON_B, mat: PLATE, seg: [3, 14] }).scale(1, 1, hz / hx).at(0, hy * Math.cos(1.62), 0),
          kit.tube([[0, hy * 0.4, -hz * 0.95], [0, hy * 1.08, 0], [0, hy * 0.4, hz * 0.95]], (u) => 0.012 + 0.006 * Math.sin(PI * u), { color: IRON_B, mat: PLATE, radial: 4, seg: 6, scale: [0.7, 1, 1] }),
          // short forward brim with a rolled edge
          kit.lathe([[hx * 1.18, -0.008], [hx * 1.02, 0.004]], { color: STEEL_M, mat: PLATE, seg: kit.hi ? 18 : 8, phi: [PI - 1.0, 2.0], scale: [1, 1, hz / hx], sharp: true, double: IRON_B }).at(0, hy * Math.cos(1.62), 0),
          kit.ring(hx * Math.sin(1.62), 0.012, { color: 'team', mat: 'cloth', seg: [3, 14] }).scale(1, 1, hz / hx).at(0, hy * Math.cos(1.62) + 0.018, 0),
        ]).rot(0.18, 0, 0).at(0, F.cy, F.cz),
        nasalBar(kit, F, STEEL_M, { y0: F.BY + 0.035 }),
        // mail coif around the face
        kit.sphere(F.rx * 1.12, { color: 0x5d636c, mat: 'brushed', seg: 10, hseg: 4, theta: [1.45, 1.0], phi: [-0.55, PI + 1.1], scale: [1, 1.15, 1.15] }).at(0, F.cy - 0.01, F.cz + 0.005));
      rig.add('hair', crestLocks(kit, [[0, 1.29, -0.07], [0, 1.335, 0.0], [0, 1.32, 0.07], [0, 1.26, 0.13], [0, 1.18, 0.15]], { col: 'team', n: 5, r: 0.022, spread: 0.025, seed: 7 }));

      const A = heroArm(kit, 1, 0.19, SH - 0.02, { len: 0.42, r: 0.043, out: 0.04, fwd: 0.07, sleeve: 0x5d636c, sleeveMat: 'brushed', fore: 'leatherDark', bracer: 'leather', bracerMat: 'leather', glove: 'leatherDark', gloveMat: 'leather', mail: true, wraps: 'leatherDark' });
      const armR = kit.merge([A.part, plateShoulder(kit, 0.2, SH + 0.02, 0.075, 1, { col: STEEL_M, top: STEEL_M, rim: IRON_B, lames: 1, studs: false })]);
      const HR = A.hand, HL = [-A.hand[0], A.hand[1], A.hand[2]];
      rig.pivot('weapon', 'armR', HR);
      rig.pivot('shield', 'armL', HL);
      rig.add('armR', armR);
      rig.add('armL', armR.mirror());
      // leaf-bladed spear (vertical in the hand; custom() lowers it to thrust)
      rig.add('weapon', kit.merge([
        kit.rcyl(0.017, 0.017, 1.0, { color: 'woodDark', seg: 6 }).at(0, 0.26, 0),
        kit.ring(0.019, 0.005, { color: 'leatherDark', seg: [3, 8] }).at(0, 0.02, 0),
        kit.ring(0.019, 0.005, { color: 'leatherDark', seg: [3, 8] }).at(0, -0.03, 0),
        kit.extrude([[0, 0], [0.045, 0.08], [0.035, 0.18], [0, 0.32], [-0.035, 0.18], [-0.045, 0.08]], 0.018, { color: BLADE, mat: BLADE_MAT, bevel: 0.006, smooth: false })
          .paint((px) => (Math.abs(px) > 0.026 ? EDGE : null)).at(0, 0.76, 0),
        kit.rcyl(0.022, 0.018, 0.06, { color: IRON_B, seg: 7, mat: PLATE }).at(0, 0.745, 0),
        kit.ring(0.024, 0.009, { color: 'team', seg: [3, 8] }).at(0, 0.71, 0),
      ]).at(HR[0], HR[1], HR[2]));
      // round team shield: iron rim, gold rivets, boss + spike, painted cross band
      const sb = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { const an = i / 6 * TAU + 0.52; sb.push(kit.sphere(0.012, { color: GOLD_L, mat: GILT, seg: 5, hseg: 3 }).at(Math.cos(an) * 0.2, 0.026, Math.sin(an) * 0.2)); }
      rig.add('shield', kit.merge([
        kit.rcyl(0.235, 0.235, 0.04, { color: 'team', mat: { base: 'lacquer', rough: 0.45 }, seg: 14 })
          .paint((px, py, pz) => (Math.abs(px) < 0.04 && py > 0 ? kit.col('teamDark') : null)),
        kit.torus(0.235, 0.022, { color: IRON_B, mat: PLATE, seg: [4, 16] }).rot(HALF_PI, 0, 0),
        kit.torus(0.2, 0.006, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, seg: [3, 16] }).rot(HALF_PI, 0, 0).at(0, 0.022, 0),
        sb,
        kit.sphere(0.06, { color: STEEL_M, mat: PLATE, seg: 9, hseg: 4, theta: [0, HALF_PI] }).at(0, 0.02, 0),
        kit.cone(0.022, 0.08, { color: STEEL_L, mat: PLATE, seg: 6 }).at(0, 0.1, 0),
      ]).rot(-HALF_PI + 0.1, 0, 0).bake().rot(0, 0.45, 0).at(HL[0] - 0.04, HL[1] + 0.07, HL[2] - 0.07));
      return rig;
    },
  });

  // =====================================================================================
  // ROYAL RECRUIT - "Königsrekrut" (v11): grim heavy infantryman of the royal levy. Deep kettle
  // helm with a wide brim, team band and a gilded badge over a mail coif; square stubbled jaw;
  // dark quilted gambeson under a blackened breastplate, team sash and tassets, tall team pavise
  // with an iron rim, gilded chevrons and a spike (hidden once the sim shield breaks), halberd.
  // Swarm budget.
  // =====================================================================================
  define('royal-recruit', {
    look: LOOK_BLADE,
    height: 1.5,
    outline: 0.05,
    anim: {
      body: 'biped', walk: 'march', attack: 'swing', tempo: 1.05, weight: 0.45,
      keys: { 'off.rx': [0.7, 0.8, 0.6, 0.65], 'off.rz': [-0.15, -0.2, -0.1, -0.1] },
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        const mem = rig.__m || (rig.__m = { brk: 0 });
        toggleShield(rig.shield, st, a, mem);
      },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.4, pitch: 0.08, pose: 'idle', zoom: 2.0 },
    build(kit) {
      const rig = kit.rig();
      const HIP = 0.64, NY = 1.16, SH = 1.08, uni = 0x2a2b30, uniD = 0x1a1b1f;
      rig.pivot('legL', 'root', [-0.1, HIP, 0]);
      rig.pivot('legR', 'root', [0.1, HIP, 0]);
      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, HIP + 0.02, 0]);
      rig.pivot('head', 'body', [0, NY, 0]);
      rig.pivot('armL', 'body', [-0.225, SH, 0]);
      rig.pivot('armR', 'body', [0.225, SH, 0]);

      const leg = heroLeg(kit, -0.1, { hip: HIP, r: 0.066, pants: uni, pantsMat: 'cloth', greave: STEEL_B, knee: STEEL_M, boot: 'leatherDark', sole: 0x120c0a });
      rig.add('legL', leg);
      rig.add('legR', leg.mirror());

      // quilted gambeson (stitched rows painted), breastplate, team sash, tassets, belt
      const zs = 0.64;
      const quilt = (x, y) => ((Math.floor(y * 28) % 2) ? kit.col(uniD) : null);
      const bp = [[0.17, 0.84], [0.2, 0.93], [0.214, 1.0], [0.2, 1.08], [0.12, 1.14]];
      const tasset = (s) => kit.blob(0.13, 0.15, 0.05, { color: STEEL_B, mat: PLATE, round: 0.4, taper: 1.1, bottom: 0.9, seg: 7, hseg: 4 }).rot(0.1, s * 0.5, s * 0.12).at(s * 0.12, 0.6, -0.1);
      rig.add('body',
        torsoV(kit, 0.6, 1.16, 0.15, 0.205, 0.19, zs, { color: uni, mat: 'cloth' }).paint(quilt),
        kit.lathe([[0.2, 0.5], [0.185, 0.58], [0.16, 0.68]], { color: uni, mat: 'cloth', seg: 12, scale: [1, 1, 0.74], sharp: true }).paint(quilt),
        shell(kit, bp, 1.25, zs * 1.06, STEEL_B, { mat: PLATE }).scale(1.05, 1, 1),
        trim(kit, arcPts(0.172, 0.84, PI - 1.2, PI + 1.2, 6, zs * 1.1), 0.008),
        trim(kit, [[0, 1.12, -0.09], [0, 1.02, -0.145], [0, 0.9, -0.14]], 0.008),
        kit.tube([[-0.19, 1.1, -0.06], [-0.08, 1.0, -0.15], [0.08, 0.84, -0.14], [0.18, 0.72, -0.06]], 0.03, { color: 'team', mat: 'cloth', radial: 5, seg: 9, scale: [1, 1, 0.55] }),
        tasset(-1), tasset(1),
        // abdominal hoops (fauld lames) below the breastplate, gold edged
        [0, 1, 2].map(i => kit.lathe([[0.183 - i * 0.004, 0.83 - i * 0.045], [0.176 - i * 0.004, 0.86 - i * 0.045]], { color: i % 2 ? STEEL_M : STEEL_B, mat: PLATE, seg: kit.hi ? 18 : 8, phi: [PI - 1.25, 2.5], scale: [1, 1, zs * 1.12], sharp: true })),
        kit.detailMul >= 1.7 ? [0, 1, 2].map(i => trim(kit, arcPts(0.184 - i * 0.004, 0.83 - i * 0.045, PI - 1.2, PI + 1.2, 8, zs * 1.14), 0.004)) : [],
        belt(kit, 0.162, 0.7, 0.74, { t: 0.026, col: 'leatherDark', buckle: GOLD_T }),
        kit.lathe([[0.2, 1.02], [0.16, 1.08], [0.11, 1.14], [0.08, 1.18]], { color: 0x5d636c, mat: 'brushed', seg: 12, scale: [1, 1, 0.8] }));

      // head: kettle helm (wide brim, team band, gilded badge) over a mail coif
      const F = grimFace(kit, rig, { NY, h: 0.24, w: 0.168, cz: -0.004, skin: 'skin', iris: 0x5a6e82, browCol: 0x1d1512, stubble: 0x4a382e, jaw: 1.14, chin: 1.08, gaunt: 1.1, tilt: 0.24, helm: true, mouth: { w: 0.06, teeth: false, open: 0.45 } });
      const hx = F.rx * 1.18, hy = F.ry * 1.16, hz = F.rz * 1.16, by = F.cy + F.ry * 0.62;
      rig.add('head',
        // kettle hat: tall vaulted calotte with a comb, sloping brim with a rolled edge + rivets
        warp(kit.sphere(hx, { color: STEEL_B, mat: PLATE, seg: kit.hi ? 14 : 9, hseg: kit.hi ? 8 : 5, theta: [0, 1.25], scale: [1, hy * 1.12 / hx, hz / hx] }), (x, y, z) => [x, y * (1 + 0.12 * Math.max(0, y) / hy), z]).at(0, F.cy + 0.02, F.cz),
        kit.tube([[0, by + 0.01, F.cz - hz * 0.8], [0, F.cy + 0.02 + hy * 1.2, F.cz], [0, by + 0.01, F.cz + hz * 0.8]], (u) => 0.01 + 0.006 * Math.sin(PI * u), { color: STEEL_M, mat: PLATE, radial: 4, seg: kit.hi ? 10 : 5, scale: [0.7, 1, 1] }),
        kit.lathe([[hx * 1.5, by - 0.05], [hx * 1.32, by - 0.03], [hx * 1.1, by - 0.008], [hx * 0.98, by + 0.004]], { color: STEEL_B, mat: PLATE, seg: kit.hi ? 22 : 10, scale: [1, 1, hz / hx], double: IRON_B, sharp: true }).at(0, 0, F.cz),
        kit.ring(hx * 1.5, 0.008, { color: STEEL_M, mat: PLATE, seg: [4, kit.hi ? 24 : 12] }).scale(1, 1, hz / hx).at(0, by - 0.051, F.cz),
        kit.detailMul >= 1.7 ? rivetRow(kit, arcPts(hx * 1.28, by - 0.03, 0, TAU, 10, hz / hx, F.cz).slice(0, 10), 0.005, STEEL_L) : [],
        // team band of cloth around the calotte + gilded badge
        kit.lathe([[hx * 1.0, by + 0.006], [hx * 0.97, by + 0.04]], { color: 'team', mat: 'cloth', seg: kit.hi ? 18 : 10, scale: [1, 1, hz / hx], sharp: true }).at(0, 0, F.cz),
        kit.extrude([[0, 0.028], [0.024, 0.008], [0.016, -0.022], [-0.016, -0.022], [-0.024, 0.008]], 0.008, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT }).rot(-0.15, 0, 0).at(0, by + 0.024, F.cz - hz * 0.98),
        kit.sphere(F.rx * 1.12, { color: 0x5d636c, mat: 'brushed', seg: 10, hseg: 4, theta: [1.3, 1.15], phi: [-0.55, PI + 1.1], scale: [1, 1.15, 1.15] }).at(0, F.cy - 0.01, F.cz + 0.005));

      const A = heroArm(kit, 1, 0.22, SH - 0.02, { len: 0.47, r: 0.048, out: 0.045, fwd: 0.08, sleeve: uni, fore: uni, bracer: STEEL_B, glove: 'leatherDark', gloveMat: 'leather', elbow: STEEL_M });
      const armR = kit.merge([A.part, plateShoulder(kit, 0.235, SH + 0.025, 0.095, 1, { top: 'team', col: STEEL_B, lames: 2 })]);
      const HR = A.hand, HL = [-A.hand[0], A.hand[1], A.hand[2]];
      rig.pivot('weapon', 'armR', HR);
      rig.pivot('shield', 'armL', HL);
      rig.add('armR', armR);
      rig.add('armL', armR.mirror());

      // halberd: long haft, crescent axe blade, back hook, spike, team tassel ring
      rig.add('weapon', kit.merge([
        kit.rcyl(0.021, 0.021, 1.2, { color: 'woodDark', seg: 6 }).at(0, 0.32, 0),
        kit.ring(0.023, 0.006, { color: 'leather', seg: [3, 8] }).at(0, 0.02, 0),
        kit.ring(0.023, 0.006, { color: 'leather', seg: [3, 8] }).at(0, -0.04, 0),
        axeHead(kit, [[0, -0.03], [0.14, -0.13], [0.27, -0.06], [0.3, 0.08], [0.25, 0.22], [0.11, 0.17], [0, 0.15]], 0.02, 0.2, { runes: false }).at(0.02, 0.72, 0),
        // back hook (fullered, sharp) + long square spike
        axeHead(kit, [[0, 0.0], [-0.08, 0.025], [-0.15, 0.12], [-0.07, 0.065], [0, 0.1]], 0.016, -1, { runes: false }).at(-0.01, 0.75, 0),
        kit.cone(0.03, 0.3, { color: BLADE, mat: BLADE_MAT, seg: 4 }).paint((x, y) => (y > 0.08 ? EDGE : null)).at(0, 1.06, 0),
        kit.rcyl(0.03, 0.03, 0.06, { color: IRON_B, mat: PLATE, seg: 7 }).at(0, 0.88, 0),
        kit.ring(0.03, 0.012, { color: 'team', seg: [3, 8] }).at(0, 0.66, 0),
      ]).rot(-0.95, 0, 0).at(HR[0], HR[1], HR[2]));
      // tall pavise (team lacquer, iron rim, gilded chevrons, spike)
      const rimS = [[-0.19, -0.32], [0.19, -0.32], [0.21, 0.26], [0, 0.35], [-0.21, 0.26]];
      const rimPts = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < rimS.length; i++) { const p0 = rimS[i], p1 = rimS[(i + 1) % rimS.length]; for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) { const u = k / 3; rimPts.push([(p0[0] + (p1[0] - p0[0]) * u) * 1.03, (p0[1] + (p1[1] - p0[1]) * u) * 1.03, -0.024]); } }
      const chev = (y) => kit.extrude([[-0.13, 0.02], [0, 0.11], [0.13, 0.02], [0.13, -0.035], [0, 0.055], [-0.13, -0.035]], 0.014, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, smooth: false }).at(0, y, -0.032);
      rig.add('shield', kit.merge([
        kit.extrude(kit.shape(rimS), 0.04, { color: 'team', mat: { base: 'lacquer', rough: 0.45 }, bevel: 0.01, bevelSeg: 1, smooth: false }),
        kit.tube(rimPts, 0.02, { color: IRON_B, mat: PLATE, radial: 4, closed: true, seg: 15 }),
        chev(0.08), chev(-0.08),
        spike(kit, 0.028, 0.1, STEEL_L).rot(-HALF_PI, 0, 0).at(0, 0.0, -0.075),
        rivetRow(kit, [[-0.15, -0.26, -0.026], [0.15, -0.26, -0.026], [-0.16, 0.22, -0.026], [0.16, 0.22, -0.026]], 0.011),
      ]).rot(0.05, 0.55, 0).at(HL[0] - 0.06, HL[1] + 0.08, HL[2] - 0.07));
      return rig;
    },
  });

  // =====================================================================================
  // BATTLE HEALER - "Kampfheilerin" (v11): stern war-priestess in gilded black plate. Long
  // platinum hair (hair -> hair2 springs), a spiked sun-crown circlet, burning amber eyes,
  // layered gold-rimmed pauldrons, team tabard with a glowing sun sigil, two-part torn team cape
  // (cape -> cape2), heavy gauntlets with glowing heal runes. One-two punches.
  // =====================================================================================
  define('battle-healer', {
    height: 1.56,
    outline: 0.05,
    anim: {
      body: 'biped', walk: 'march', attack: 'punch', tempo: 1.0, weight: 0.4,
      keys: { 'root.pz': [0, 0.06, -0.14, -0.1], 'body.ry': [0, -0.55, 0.5, 0.4] },
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        if (rig.cape) rig.cape.rotation.x -= 0.15 * a.strike;
      },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.35, pitch: 0.08, pose: 'idle', zoom: 2.1 },
    build(kit) {
      const rig = kit.rig();
      const HIP = 0.7, NY = 1.2, SH = 1.11, hairC = 0xd8cfb8, holy = AMBER;
      rig.pivot('legL', 'root', [-0.095, HIP, 0]);
      rig.pivot('legR', 'root', [0.095, HIP, 0]);
      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, HIP + 0.02, 0]);
      rig.pivot('head', 'body', [0, NY, 0]);
      rig.pivot('hair', 'head', [0, 1.38, 0.08]);
      rig.pivot('hair2', 'hair', [0, 1.12, 0.15]);
      rig.pivot('cape', 'body', [0, SH + 0.03, 0.11]);
      rig.pivot('cape2', 'cape', [0, 0.78, 0.25]);
      rig.pivot('armL', 'body', [-0.205, SH, 0]);
      rig.pivot('armR', 'body', [0.205, SH, 0]);

      const leg = heroLeg(kit, -0.095, { hip: HIP, r: 0.064, pants: STEEL_B, pantsMat: PLATE, greave: STEEL_B, knee: GOLD_T, boot: IRON_B, toe: GOLD_D, sole: 0x0c0b0d });
      rig.add('legL', leg);
      rig.add('legR', leg.mirror());

      // gilded black plate, team tabard with a glowing sun sigil, belt, plate skirt
      const zs = 0.64;
      const tp = [[0.2, 0.46], [0.16, 0.62], [0.135, 0.78], [0.16, 0.9], [0.178, 1.0], [0.165, 1.08]];
      const sun = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { const an = i / 8 * TAU; sun.push(kit.cone(0.012, 0.045, { color: holy, glow: 0.8, seg: 3 }).rot(0, 0, -an).at(Math.sin(an) * 0.045, 0.95 + Math.cos(an) * 0.045, -0.138)); }
      rig.add('body',
        torsoV(kit, 0.68, 1.2, 0.122, 0.17, 0.165, zs, { color: STEEL_M, mat: PLATE }),
        // breastplate: centre ridge + engraved gilt scrollwork on gunmetal
        shell(kit, [[0.15, 0.9], [0.174, 0.98], [0.178, 1.05], [0.15, 1.12]], 1.15, zs * 1.09, STEEL_B, { mat: PLATE }).scale(1.04, 1, 1),
        trim(kit, [[0, 1.12, -0.1], [0, 1.04, -0.122], [0, 0.96, -0.12]], 0.006),
        kit.detailMul >= 1.7 ? [-1, 1].map(sd => trim(kit, [[sd * 0.02, 1.1, -0.118], [sd * 0.07, 1.06, -0.118], [sd * 0.1, 1.0, -0.106], [sd * 0.08, 0.95, -0.105]], 0.0035)) : [],
        shell(kit, tp, 0.55, zs * 1.12, 'team', { mat: 'cloth', double: 'teamDark' }).scale(1.06, 1, 1),
        trim(kit, tp.map(q => [-q[0] * Math.sin(0.55) * 1.07, q[1], -q[0] * Math.cos(0.55) * zs * 1.14]), 0.007),
        trim(kit, tp.map(q => [q[0] * Math.sin(0.55) * 1.07, q[1], -q[0] * Math.cos(0.55) * zs * 1.14]), 0.007),
        kit.sphere(0.032, { color: holy, glow: 0.9, seg: 8, scale: [1, 1, 0.5] }).at(0, 0.95, -0.14),
        sun,
        kit.lathe([[0.215, 0.56], [0.19, 0.64], [0.165, 0.72], [0.15, 0.78]], { color: STEEL_B, mat: PLATE, seg: 12, scale: [1, 1, 0.74], sharp: true }),
        kit.ring(0.214, 0.01, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, seg: [3, 14] }).scale(1, 1, 0.74).at(0, 0.56, 0),
        belt(kit, 0.135, 0.79, 0.72, { t: 0.022, col: GOLD_D, mat: GILT, buckle: GOLD_L }),
        kit.lathe([[0.15, 1.08], [0.13, 1.14], [0.095, 1.19], [0.08, 1.22]], { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, seg: 11, scale: [1, 1, 0.85] }));
      rig.add('cape',
        tornCape(kit, [[0.25, 0.78], [0.23, 0.9], [0.2, 1.03], [0.16, 1.14]], 1.15, 'team', 'teamDark', 0.8, { cut: 0.02, amp: 0.0001, n: 4 }),
        trim(kit, arcPts(0.165, 1.135, -1.1, 1.1, 6, 0.8), 0.012),
        kit.sphere(0.028, { color: holy, glow: 0.8, seg: 7 }).at(-0.15, 1.13, -0.04), kit.sphere(0.028, { color: holy, glow: 0.8, seg: 7 }).at(0.15, 1.13, -0.04));
      rig.add('cape2', tornCape(kit, [[0.31, 0.4], [0.29, 0.52], [0.27, 0.66], [0.25, 0.79]], 1.15, 'team', 'teamDark', 0.8, { amp: 0.1, n: 4, seed: 5 }));

      // head: stern face, amber glowing eyes, platinum hair, spiked sun-crown
      const F = grimFace(kit, rig, { NY, h: 0.25, w: 0.166, cz: -0.004, skin: 'skinLight', jaw: 0.94, chin: 0.9, cheek: 1.2, gaunt: 0.8, female: true, iris: holy, glow: 0.7, tilt: 0.26, browCol: 0x9a8a6a, ears: false, mouth: { w: 0.052, teeth: false, open: 0.45 } });
      const crown = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
        const an = (i - 3) * 0.42, L = 0.09 - Math.abs(i - 3) * 0.014;
        crown.push(kit.cone(0.012, L, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, seg: 4 }).rot(-0.2, 0, -an * 0.6).at(Math.sin(an) * F.rx * 1.1, F.cy + 0.07 + L * 0.45, F.cz - Math.cos(an) * F.rz * 1.06));
      }
      rig.add('head',
        kit.capsule(0.045, 0.05, { color: 'skinLight', mat: 'skin', seg: 6, capSeg: 1 }).at(0, NY + 0.02, 0.01),
        hairShell(kit, F, { col: hairC, line: { front: 0.8, temple: 0.7, side: 0.5, back: 0.2 }, thick: 0.07, teeth: 20, tooth: 0.07, frontTeeth: 0.3, part: 0.18, drop: 0.25, flow: 'back', shine: 0xffffff }),
        // long side locks framing the face (strands with pointed tips)
        hairLocks(kit, F, { col: hairC, n: 4, style: 'nape', a: [-1.7, -1.15], s: [0.62, 0.74], len: 0.28, thick: 0.02, grav: 0.25, lift: 0.08, seed: 4 }),
        hairLocks(kit, F, { col: hairC, n: 4, style: 'nape', a: [1.15, 1.7], s: [0.62, 0.74], len: 0.28, thick: 0.02, grav: 0.25, lift: 0.08, seed: 8 }),
        kit.ring(F.rx * 1.12, 0.011, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, seg: [3, 16] }).scale(1, 1, F.rz / F.rx * 1.08).rot(-0.16, 0, 0).at(0, F.cy + 0.06, F.cz),
        crown,
        kit.gem(0.02, { color: holy, mat: 'gem', glow: 0.8 }).rot(HALF_PI - 0.16, 0, 0).at(0, F.cy + 0.075, F.cz - F.rz * 1.12));
      // long hair down the back (two springs)
      rig.add('hair', crestLocks(kit, [[0, 1.4, 0.07], [0, 1.33, 0.12], [0, 1.24, 0.14], [0, 1.12, 0.15]], { col: hairC, n: 8, r: 0.03, spread: 0.07, mat: 'hair', seed: 2 }));
      rig.add('hair2', crestLocks(kit, [[0, 1.13, 0.15], [0, 1.03, 0.16], [0, 0.94, 0.165], [0, 0.86, 0.16]], { col: hairC, n: 7, r: 0.028, spread: 0.065, mat: 'hair', seed: 9 }));

      // arms: layered gold-rimmed pauldrons, plate sleeves, heavy gauntlets with heal runes
      const A = heroArm(kit, 1, 0.2, SH - 0.02, { len: 0.47, r: 0.045, out: 0.05, fwd: 0.08, sleeve: STEEL_B, sleeveMat: PLATE, fore: STEEL_B, bracer: GOLD_D, bracerMat: GILT, bracerTrim: holy, glove: IRON_B, gloveMat: PLATE, elbow: GOLD_T });
      const runes = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) runes.push(kit.box(0.012, 0.035, 0.008, { color: holy, glow: 1, bevel: 0, micro: false }).at(A.wrist[0] + 0.0, A.wrist[1] + 0.03 + i * 0.045, A.wrist[2] - 0.05));
      const armR = kit.merge([A.part, runes,
        kit.sphere(0.046, { color: holy, glow: 0.9, seg: 7, scale: [1, 0.7, 0.4] }).at(A.hand[0], A.hand[1] + 0.01, A.hand[2] - 0.04),
        plateShoulder(kit, 0.215, SH + 0.025, 0.09, 1, { top: GOLD_T, col: STEEL_B, lames: 2, spikes: 1, spikeCol: GOLD_L })]);
      rig.add('armR', armR);
      rig.add('armL', armR.mirror());
      return rig;
    },
  });

  // =====================================================================================
  // EXECUTIONER - "Scharfrichter" (v11): towering hooded headsman. Black pointed hood with eye
  // holes and burning ember eyes, a team-lined mantle with a gold hem over massive bare
  // shoulders, scarred chest under a leather harness with iron rings, blood-dark apron, heavy
  // belt, wrapped forearms. Huge bearded throwing axe that returns like a boomerang (ammo).
  // =====================================================================================
  define('executioner', {
    look: Object.assign({}, LOOK_BLADE, { bloodOn: ['ammo'], blood: 0.75 }),
    height: 1.72,

  // an armoured chamfron (spike or horn), glowing slit eyes, a floor-long team caparison with a

      limb(kit, [[-0.13, 0.6, -0.36], [-0.132, 0.48, -0.37], [-0.133, 0.37, -0.37]], 0.075, 0.05, o2(C, { radial: 5 })),
      limb(kit, [[-0.133, 0.38, -0.37], [-0.133, 0.25, -0.372], [-0.133, 0.14, -0.375]], 0.046, 0.042, o2(C, { radial: 5, caps: false })),
      hoof(-0.133, -0.375),
    ]);
    const hl = kit.merge([
      kit.blob(0.17, 0.36, 0.3, o2(C, { round: 0.3, taper: 0.75, seg: 7, hseg: 4 })).at(-0.13, 0.72, 0.38),
      limb(kit, [[-0.135, 0.62, 0.4], [-0.137, 0.5, 0.46], [-0.138, 0.4, 0.49]], 0.08, 0.05, o2(C, { radial: 5 })),
      limb(kit, [[-0.138, 0.41, 0.49], [-0.138, 0.27, 0.47], [-0.138, 0.14, 0.45]], 0.046, 0.042, o2(C, { radial: 5, caps: false })),
      hoof(-0.138, 0.45),
    ]);
    rig.add('armL', fl); rig.add('armR', fl.mirror());
    rig.add('legL', hl); rig.add('legR', hl.mirror());
    rig.add('tail',
      kit.tube([[0, 0.99, 0.55], [0, 0.95, 0.66], [0, 0.7, 0.72]], [0.06, 0.09], o2(maneMat, { radial: 6, seg: 4 })),
      kit.ring(0.06, 0.016, { color: trimC, mat: GILT, seg: [3, 10] }).rot(0.5, 0, 0).at(0, 0.97, 0.6));
    rig.add('tail2',
      kit.tube([[0, 0.7, 0.72], [0, 0.5, 0.74], [0, 0.3, 0.7]], [0.09, 0.015], o2(maneMat, { radial: 6, seg: 4 })),
      kit.tube([[0, 0.62, 0.74], [0.05, 0.45, 0.77], [0.07, 0.34, 0.72]], [0.035, 0.005], o2(maneMat, { radial: 5, seg: 3 })),
      kit.tube([[0, 0.62, 0.74], [-0.05, 0.45, 0.77], [-0.07, 0.34, 0.72]], [0.035, 0.005], o2(maneMat, { radial: 5, seg: 3 })));
  }
  // armoured rider legs astride the horse (thigh forward/out, shin down into the stirrup)
  function riderLegs(kit, o) {
    const S = SEAT;
    const l = kit.merge([
      limb(kit, [[-0.1, S + 0.04, 0.06], [-0.2, S - 0.02, -0.04], [-0.26, S - 0.13, -0.12]], 0.068, 0.052, { color: o.thigh || STEEL_B, mat: PLATE, radial: 5 }),
      kit.sphere(0.052, { color: o.knee || STEEL_M, mat: PLATE, seg: 7, hseg: 4 }).at(-0.265, S - 0.14, -0.14),
      kit.cone(0.02, 0.07, { color: STEEL_L, mat: PLATE, seg: 5 }).rot(-HALF_PI, 0, 0).at(-0.27, S - 0.14, -0.2),
      limb(kit, [[-0.265, S - 0.14, -0.12], [-0.28, S - 0.3, -0.08], [-0.29, S - 0.44, -0.04]], 0.05, 0.044, { color: o.greave || STEEL_B, mat: PLATE, radial: 5 }),
      kit.blob(0.09, 0.08, 0.2, { color: o.boot || IRON_B, mat: PLATE, round: 0.45, taper: 0.8, bulge: 0.12, seg: 8, hseg: 4 }).at(-0.295, S - 0.48, -0.08),
      kit.torus(0.05, 0.008, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, seg: [3, 8] }).rot(HALF_PI, 0, 0).at(-0.295, S - 0.5, -0.06),
    ]);
    return [l, l.mirror()];
  }

  // =====================================================================================
  // PRINCE - "Galopp-Graf" (v11): cold-eyed young war-count. Swept-back blond hair, pointed
  // beard, scar, gold spiked crown circlet with a team gem; black plate with gilded edges and a
  // team surcoat, layered pauldrons, torn two-part team cape over the rump, couched lance with
  // vamplate + tattered team pennant on a dark bay warhorse in a team caparison.
  // =====================================================================================
  define('prince', {
    height: 1.9,
    outline: 0.05,
    anim: {
      body: 'rider', walk: 'gallop', attack: 'thrust', arm: 'none', tempo: 1.0, weight: 0.5, turnSpeed: 9,
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        const L = rig.lance;
        if (L) {
          const lower = Math.max(a.aim, a.charge, a.windup);
          L.rotation.x -= 0.5 * lower;
          L.rotation.y += 0.14 * lower;
          L.position.z += 0.12 * a.windup - 0.3 * a.strike;
          L.position.y -= 0.03 * a.windup;
          L.rotation.x += 0.03 * Math.sin(a.phase) * a.move;
        }
        if (rig.rider) { rig.rider.rotation.x += 0.12 * a.charge - 0.12 * a.strike; rig.rider.position.z -= 0.05 * a.strike; }
        if (rig.cape) rig.cape.rotation.x -= 0.25 * a.charge;
      },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.6, pitch: 0.1, pose: 'attack', zoom: 2.2 },
    build(kit) {
      const rig = kit.rig();
      const S = SEAT;
      buildHorse(kit, rig, {
        coat: 0x2c1f19, muzzle: 0x1b1310, mane: 0x0f0c0d, fetlock: 0x16100e, hoof: 0x0d0b0c, plate: STEEL_B, trim: GOLD_T,
        iris: AMBER, eyeGlow: 0.55, emblem: 'fang',
        headExtra: [kit.cone(0.024, 0.16, { color: STEEL_L, mat: PLATE, seg: 5 }).rot(-0.95, 0, 0).at(0, 1.5, -0.86)],
      });
      const SHY = S + 0.47;
      rig.pivot('cape', 'rider', [0, SHY + 0.02, 0.13]);
      rig.pivot('cape2', 'cape', [0, S + 0.1, 0.32]);
      rig.pivot('lance', 'rider', [0.2, SHY, 0.03]);
      rig.pivot('hairR', 'rider', [0, S + 0.76, 0.06]);
      const zs = 0.66;
      // torso: black plate, gilded edges, team surcoat front + back, belt, gorget
      const sur = [[0.2, S - 0.2], [0.17, S + 0.0], [0.15, S + 0.12], [0.19, S + 0.3], [0.19, S + 0.4], [0.15, S + 0.47]];
      rig.add('rider',
        riderLegs(kit, {}),
        torsoV(kit, S - 0.02, S + 0.53, 0.13, 0.19, 0.17, zs, { color: STEEL_B, mat: PLATE, seg: 9 }),
        shell(kit, sur, 0.7, zs * 1.12, 'team', { mat: 'cloth', double: 'teamDark', seg: 6 }),
        trim(kit, sur.map(q => [-q[0] * Math.sin(0.7), q[1], -q[0] * Math.cos(0.7) * zs * 1.14]), 0.008),
        trim(kit, sur.map(q => [q[0] * Math.sin(0.7), q[1], -q[0] * Math.cos(0.7) * zs * 1.14]), 0.008),
        kit.star(6, 0.06, 0.024, 0.012, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT }).at(0, S + 0.28, -0.142),
        kit.gem(0.022, { color: 'team', mat: 'gem', glow: 0.4 }).rot(HALF_PI, 0, 0).at(0, S + 0.395, -0.142),
        belt(kit, 0.142, S + 0.1, 0.75, { t: 0.022, col: 'leatherDark', buckle: GOLD_T }),
        kit.lathe([[0.15, S + 0.42], [0.135, S + 0.48], [0.09, S + 0.54], [0.075, S + 0.57]], { color: STEEL_M, mat: PLATE, seg: 11, scale: [1, 1, 0.85] }),
        trim(kit, arcPts(0.138, S + 0.475, 0, TAU, 10, 0.85), 0.008));
      // head: young noble, cold blue eyes, pointed beard, scar
      const F = grimFace(kit, rig, { parent: 'rider', NY: S + 0.55, h: 0.22, cz: -0.005, skin: 'skin', iris: 0x6f9ad0, browCol: 0x6a4a1c, stubble: 0x8a6a28, scar: true, ears: true, jaw: 1.02, chin: 1.0, gaunt: 1.1, mouth: { w: 0.06 } });
      rig.add('rider',
        kit.capsule(0.045, 0.05, { color: 'skinShade', mat: 'skin', seg: 6, capSeg: 1 }).at(0, S + 0.56, 0.01),
        hairShell(kit, F, { col: 'hairBlond', line: { front: 0.8, temple: 0.72, side: 0.52, back: 0.22 }, thick: 0.08, teeth: 18, tooth: 0.06, frontTeeth: 0.25, drop: 0.18, flow: 'back', part: -0.3 }),
        kit.detailMul < 1.7 ? [] : hairLocks(kit, F, { col: 'hairBlond', n: 5, style: 'nape', a: [2.2, 4.1], s: [0.3, 0.45], len: 0.12, thick: 0.02, grav: 0.4, lift: 0.08, seed: 6 }),
        beardShell(kit, F, { col: 0x8a6a28, len: 0.16, thick: 0.035, wide: 0.6, side: 0.2, n: 3, moustache: 'thin', mThick: F.h * 0.02 }),
        // gold crown circlet with spikes and a team gem
        kit.ring(F.rx * 1.08, 0.012, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, seg: [3, 16] }).scale(1, 1, F.rz / F.rx).rot(-0.12, 0, 0).at(0, F.cy + F.h * 0.2, F.cz),
        [-2, -1, 0, 1, 2].map(i => { const an = i * 0.42; return kit.cone(0.014, 0.075 - Math.abs(i) * 0.012, { color: GOLD_L, mat: GILT, seg: 4 }).rot(-0.12 - Math.cos(an) * 0.15, 0, Math.sin(an) * 0.3).at(Math.sin(an) * F.rx * 1.08, F.cy + F.h * 0.25, F.cz - Math.cos(an) * F.rz * 1.06); }),
        kit.gem(0.016, { color: 'team', mat: 'gem', glow: 0.5 }).rot(HALF_PI, 0, 0).at(0, F.cy + F.h * 0.2, F.cz - F.rz * 1.1));
      rig.add('hairR', kit.tube([[0, F.top - 0.01, F.cz + 0.04], [0, F.top - 0.03, F.cz + 0.13], [0, F.cy - 0.02, F.cz + 0.17]], [0.04, 0.012], { color: 'hairBlond', mat: 'hair', radial: 5, seg: 4 }));
      // left arm: pauldron + reins hand
      const AL = armPath(kit, [-0.19, SHY - 0.02, 0.02], [-0.25, S + 0.24, -0.02], [-0.13, S + 0.12, -0.22], { side: -1, r: 0.054, elbow: STEEL_M, bracer: STEEL_M });
      rig.add('rider', AL.part, plateShoulder(kit, -0.2, SHY + 0.02, 0.09, -1, { top: 'team', col: STEEL_B, spikes: 2, spikeLen: 0.8, lames: 1 }),
        kit.tube([[-0.12, S + 0.1, -0.26], [-0.06, S + 0.02, -0.34], [0, S + 0.04, -0.44]], 0.008, { color: 0x1a1210, radial: 3, seg: 4 }));
      // cape (two parts, torn, team)
      rig.add('cape',
        tornCape(kit, [[0.24, S + 0.08], [0.22, S + 0.22], [0.2, S + 0.36], [0.15, SHY + 0.03]], 1.15, 'team', 'teamDark', 0.8, { amp: 0.04, n: 3, seed: 3, cut: 0.02 }).at(0, 0, 0.08),
        trim(kit, arcPts(0.155, SHY + 0.03, -1.1, 1.1, 6, 0.8, 0.08), 0.011),
        kit.sphere(0.024, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, seg: 8 }).at(-0.15, SHY + 0.02, 0.02), kit.sphere(0.024, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, seg: 8 }).at(0.15, SHY + 0.02, 0.02));
      rig.add('cape2', tornCape(kit, [[0.34, S - 0.32], [0.3, S - 0.12], [0.26, S + 0.0], [0.245, S + 0.1]], 1.15, 'team', 'teamDark', 0.8, { amp: 0.1, n: 4, seed: 5 }).at(0, 0, 0.08));
      // right arm couches the lance (lance pivot = right shoulder)
      const AR = armPath(kit, [0.19, SHY - 0.02, 0.02], [0.27, S + 0.26, 0.06], [0.25, S + 0.14, -0.12], { side: 1, r: 0.055, elbow: STEEL_M, bracer: STEEL_M });
      const H = AR.hand;
      const lance = kit.merge([
        kit.rcyl(0.024, 0.024, 0.34, { color: 'leatherDark', mat: 'leather', seg: 7 }).at(0, -0.12, 0),
        kit.lathe([[0.024, 0.02], [0.12, 0.06], [0.13, 0.08], [0.06, 0.2], [0.035, 0.26]], { color: STEEL_B, mat: PLATE, seg: 8 }),
        kit.ring(0.128, 0.01, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, seg: [3, 12] }).at(0, 0.075, 0),
        kit.cylinder(0.022, 0.05, 1.0, { color: 0x1a1614, mat: 'wood', seg: 7 }).at(0, 0.72, 0)
          .paint((px, py) => ((Math.floor((py + 5) * 6) % 2) ? kit.col('team') : null)),
        kit.ring(0.026, 0.008, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, seg: [3, 8] }).at(0, 1.22, 0),
        kit.extrude([[0, 0], [0.04, 0.05], [0.022, 0.09], [0.026, 0.15], [0, 0.34], [-0.026, 0.15], [-0.022, 0.09], [-0.04, 0.05]], 0.018, { color: BLADE, mat: BLADE_MAT, smooth: false }).paint((px) => (Math.abs(px) > 0.016 ? EDGE : null)).at(0, 1.22, 0),
        kit.extrude([[0, 0.0], [0, 0.2], [0.34, 0.14], [0.2, 0.1], [0.3, 0.03]], 0.01, { color: 'team', mat: 'cloth', smooth: false }).at(0.01, 0.92, 0),
      ]).rot(-0.62, 0, 0).at(H[0], H[1], H[2]);
      rig.add('lance', AR.part, plateShoulder(kit, 0.2, SHY + 0.02, 0.09, 1, { top: 'team', col: STEEL_B, spikes: 2, spikeLen: 0.8, lames: 1 }), lance);
      return rig;
    },
  });

  // =====================================================================================
  // DARK PRINCE - "Finster-Einhorn" (v11): faceless black knight in spiked full plate. Closed
  // great helm with a burning visor slit (glowing eyes), forward-curving ram horns, team
  // horsehair plume; team cape, spiked flanged mace, round spiked team shield (breaks) on a
  // black warhorse with a hellfire mane, ember eyes and a spiralled black horn on the chamfron.
  // =====================================================================================
  define('dark-prince', {
    look: Object.assign({ bloodOn: ['mace'] }, LOOK_BLADE),
    height: 1.95,
    outline: 0.05,
    anim: {
      body: 'rider', walk: 'gallop', attack: 'swing', arm: 'none', tempo: 1.0, weight: 0.55, turnSpeed: 9,
      strikeIn: 0.08, strikeHold: 0.06, strikeOut: 0.36,
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        const M = rig.mace;
        if (M) {
          const w = a.windup, s = a.strike;
          M.rotation.z += 0.95 * w + 0.5 * s;
          M.rotation.y += -0.95 * w + 1.6 * s;
          M.rotation.x += 0.55 * w - 0.35 * s;
          M.rotation.x += 0.35 * a.charge;
        }
        if (rig.rider) rig.rider.rotation.y += -0.2 * a.windup + 0.3 * a.strike;
        const mem = rig.__m || (rig.__m = { brk: 0 });
        toggleShield(rig.shield, st, a, mem);
        if (rig.shield) rig.shield.rotation.y -= 0.25 * a.charge;
      },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: 0.7, pitch: 0.1, pose: 'idle', zoom: 2.1 },
    build(kit) {
      const rig = kit.rig();
      const S = SEAT, glow = EMBER;
      const hornH = kit.tube([[0, 1.48, -0.86], [0, 1.6, -0.98], [0, 1.72, -1.06]], [0.032, 0.003], { color: 0x16131a, mat: 'bone', radial: 6, seg: 9 })
        .paint((px, py) => ((Math.floor(py * 45) % 2) ? 0x3a2a30 : null));
      buildHorse(kit, rig, {
        coat: 0x131216, muzzle: 0x1d1b21, mane: glow, maneGlow: 0.8, fetlock: 0x1a1012, hoof: 0x0a090b, plate: IRON_B, trim: GOLD_D,
        iris: glow, eyeGlow: 1, emblem: 'spike', saddle: 0x15121a,
        headExtra: [hornH],
      });
      const SHY = S + 0.48;
      rig.pivot('mace', 'rider', [0.21, SHY, 0.03]);
      rig.pivot('shield', 'rider', [-0.27, S + 0.22, -0.04]);
      rig.pivot('cape', 'rider', [0, SHY + 0.02, 0.13]);
      rig.pivot('cape2', 'cape', [0, S + 0.1, 0.32]);
      const zs = 0.68;
      const bp = [[0.15, S + 0.12], [0.18, S + 0.24], [0.205, S + 0.34], [0.2, S + 0.44], [0.13, S + 0.52]];
      rig.add('rider',
        riderLegs(kit, { thigh: IRON_B, greave: IRON_B, knee: STEEL_B, boot: IRON_B }),
        torsoV(kit, S - 0.02, S + 0.54, 0.135, 0.2, 0.18, zs, { color: IRON_B, mat: PLATE, seg: 9 }),
        shell(kit, bp, 1.25, zs * 1.06, STEEL_B, { mat: PLATE }),
        // ribbed black breastplate: gold-edged ridges + a team gem heart
        [0, 1, 2].map(i => trim(kit, arcPts(0.19 - i * 0.006, S + 0.25 + i * 0.08, PI - 1.05, PI + 1.05, 6, zs * 1.1), 0.007, GOLD_D)),
        kit.gem(0.03, { color: 'team', mat: 'gem', glow: 0.6, stretch: 1.4 }).rot(HALF_PI, 0, 0).at(0, S + 0.34, -0.15),
        // team tasset skirt (front + back), torn
        tatter(kit.lathe([[0.22, S - 0.22], [0.18, S - 0.05], [0.145, S + 0.1]], { color: 'team', mat: 'cloth', seg: 12, scale: [1, 1, 0.8], double: 'teamDark', sharp: true }), S - 0.12, 0.06, 6, 0, 7),
        belt(kit, 0.145, S + 0.1, 0.76, { t: 0.024, col: IRON_B, buckle: GOLD_D }),
        kit.lathe([[0.16, S + 0.42], [0.145, S + 0.49], [0.1, S + 0.56], [0.08, S + 0.6]], { color: STEEL_B, mat: PLATE, seg: 11, scale: [1, 1, 0.85] }));
      // closed great helm: faceted bucket, visor slit with burning eyes, ram horns, spikes, plume
      const NY = S + 0.56;
      grimFace(kit, rig, { parent: 'rider', NY, h: 0.24, cz: -0.01, skull: false, glow: 1, iris: glow, eyeR: 0.022, sep: 0.045, eyeY: 0.575, eyeIn: -0.038, tilt: 0.32, brows: false, mouth: false });
      const HC = [0, NY + 0.13, -0.005];
      const helm = kit.merge([
        kit.blob(0.2, 0.25, 0.22, { color: IRON_B, mat: PLATE, round: 0.4, roundH: 0.3, taper: 0.88, bottom: 0.95, bulge: 0.12, seg: 10, hseg: 6 }),
        kit.box(0.17, 0.022, 0.03, { color: 0x050405, mat: 'matte', bevel: 0.006 }).at(0, 0.01, -0.105),
        kit.tube([[0, 0.13, -0.06], [0, 0.11, -0.1], [0, 0.0, -0.118], [0, -0.1, -0.1]], 0.011, { color: GOLD_D, mat: GILT, radial: 4, seg: 6 }),
        kit.tube([[-0.1, 0.035, -0.08], [0, 0.04, -0.118], [0.1, 0.035, -0.08]], 0.008, { color: GOLD_D, mat: GILT, radial: 4, seg: 6 }),
        [-0.06, -0.03, 0.03, 0.06].map(x => kit.sphere(0.008, { color: 0x050405, seg: 4, hseg: 3 }).at(x, -0.055, -0.106)),
        kit.cone(0.022, 0.12, { color: STEEL_L, mat: PLATE, seg: 5 }).at(0, 0.17, 0.0),
        // stepped plate tiers: brow band + a raised crown ring, flared bevor at the chin
        kit.lathe([[0.112, 0.045], [0.118, 0.065], [0.11, 0.085]], { color: STEEL_B, mat: PLATE, seg: kit.hi ? 18 : 9, scale: [1, 1, 1.1], sharp: true }),
        kit.ring(0.1, 0.007, { color: GOLD_D, mat: GILT, seg: [3, 16] }).scale(1, 1, 1.1).at(0, 0.11, 0),
        kit.lathe([[0.12, -0.13], [0.112, -0.09], [0.1, -0.05]], { color: STEEL_B, mat: PLATE, seg: kit.hi ? 18 : 9, phi: [PI - 1.4, 2.8], scale: [1, 1, 1.12], sharp: true }),
        [-1, 1].map(sd => kit.cone(0.014, 0.06, { color: STEEL_L, mat: PLATE, seg: 4 }).rot(0, 0, -sd * 1.2).at(sd * 0.11, 0.065, -0.03)),
      ]).at(HC[0], HC[1], HC[2]);
      const rh = horn(kit, [0.09, NY + 0.2, 0.0], [0.2, NY + 0.27, 0.02], [0.24, NY + 0.15, -0.12], 0.03, 0x231d1c).paint((px, py, pz) => (pz < -0.06 ? 0x8a8070 : null));
      rig.add('rider', helm, rh, rh.mirror(),
        crestLocks(kit, [[0, NY + 0.27, -0.02], [0, NY + 0.31, 0.06], [0, NY + 0.28, 0.14], [0, NY + 0.18, 0.21], [0, NY + 0.04, 0.25], [0, NY - 0.1, 0.27], [0, NY - 0.22, 0.27]], { col: 'team', n: 8, r: 0.03, spread: 0.06, seed: 11 }));
      // left arm with the shield
      const AL = armPath(kit, [-0.2, SHY - 0.02, 0.02], [-0.27, S + 0.27, -0.02], [-0.22, S + 0.17, -0.18], { side: -1, r: 0.056, sleeve: IRON_B, fore: IRON_B, elbow: STEEL_B, bracer: STEEL_B, glove: IRON_B });
      rig.add('rider', AL.part, plateShoulder(kit, -0.21, SHY + 0.02, 0.1, -1, { top: STEEL_B, col: IRON_B, rim: GOLD_D, spikes: 3, spikeLen: 1.2, lames: 2 }));
      const sh = [
        kit.rcyl(0.2, 0.2, 0.04, { color: 'team', mat: { base: 'lacquer', rough: 0.42 }, seg: 16 }).rot(0, 0, HALF_PI),
        kit.torus(0.2, 0.022, { color: IRON_B, mat: PLATE, seg: [4, 16] }).rot(0, HALF_PI, 0),
        kit.ring(0.13, 0.008, { color: GOLD_D, mat: GILT, seg: [3, 14] }).rot(0, 0, HALF_PI).at(-0.022, 0, 0),
        kit.sphere(0.07, { color: STEEL_B, mat: PLATE, seg: 9, hseg: 4, theta: [0, HALF_PI] }).rot(0, 0, HALF_PI),
        kit.cone(0.03, 0.14, { color: STEEL_L, mat: PLATE, seg: 5 }).rot(0, 0, HALF_PI).at(-0.08, 0, 0),
      ];
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { const an = i / 6 * TAU; sh.push(kit.cone(0.02, 0.075, { color: STEEL_L, mat: PLATE, seg: 4 }).rot(an, 0, 0).at(0, Math.cos(an) * 0.215, -Math.sin(an) * 0.215)); }
      rig.add('shield', kit.merge(sh).rot(0, 0.35, 0).at(-0.3, S + 0.2, -0.08));
      rig.add('cape',
        tornCape(kit, [[0.24, S + 0.08], [0.22, S + 0.22], [0.2, S + 0.36], [0.15, SHY + 0.03]], 1.15, 'team', 'teamDark', 0.8, { amp: 0.04, n: 3, seed: 6, cut: 0.02 }).at(0, 0, 0.08),
        kit.sphere(0.026, { color: STEEL_L, mat: PLATE, seg: 7 }).at(-0.15, SHY + 0.02, 0.02), kit.sphere(0.026, { color: STEEL_L, mat: PLATE, seg: 7 }).at(0.15, SHY + 0.02, 0.02));
      rig.add('cape2', tornCape(kit, [[0.34, S - 0.32], [0.3, S - 0.12], [0.26, S + 0.0], [0.245, S + 0.1]], 1.15, 'team', 'teamDark', 0.8, { amp: 0.12, n: 5, seed: 8 }).at(0, 0, 0.08)
        .paint((px, py) => (py < S - 0.22 ? kit.col('teamDark') : null)));
      // right arm with a flanged, spiked mace
      const AR = armPath(kit, [0.2, SHY - 0.02, 0.02], [0.28, S + 0.27, 0.04], [0.27, S + 0.14, -0.12], { side: 1, r: 0.057, sleeve: IRON_B, fore: IRON_B, elbow: STEEL_B, bracer: STEEL_B, glove: IRON_B });
      const H = AR.hand;
      const head = [kit.sphere(0.07, { color: IRON_B, mat: PLATE, seg: 8, hseg: 6 })];
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        const an = i / 6 * TAU;
        head.push(kit.extrude([[0, -0.09], [0.07, -0.04], [0.08, 0.03], [0, 0.09]], 0.014, { color: STEEL_M, mat: PLATE, smooth: false }).paint((px) => (px > 0.06 ? EDGE : null)).rot(0, an, 0));
      }
      head.push(kit.cone(0.03, 0.14, { color: STEEL_L, mat: PLATE, seg: 5 }).at(0, 0.14, 0));
      const mace = kit.merge([
        kit.rcyl(0.022, 0.022, 0.6, { color: IRON_B, mat: PLATE, seg: 7 }).at(0, 0.15, 0),
        kit.tube([[0, -0.08, 0], [0, 0.06, 0]], 0.027, { color: 'team', mat: 'leather', radial: 6, seg: 1 }),
        kit.ring(0.03, 0.008, { color: GOLD_D, mat: GILT, seg: [3, 8] }).at(0, 0.08, 0),
        kit.sphere(0.034, { color: GOLD_D, mat: GILT, seg: 7 }).at(0, -0.12, 0),
        kit.merge(head).at(0, 0.5, 0),
      ]).rot(-0.9, 0, 0).at(H[0], H[1], H[2]);
      rig.add('mace', AR.part, plateShoulder(kit, 0.21, SHY + 0.02, 0.1, 1, { top: STEEL_B, col: IRON_B, rim: GOLD_D, spikes: 3, spikeLen: 1.2, lames: 2 }), mace);
      return rig;
    },
  });

  // =====================================================================================
  // MINI-PEKKA - "Flitz-Raptor" (v11): a lean killing machine. Horizontal raptor with a long
  // narrow skull under a blackened war-helm (team crest fin, swept horns, gold rim), burning
  // ember slit eyes under armoured brow plates (browL / browR), long jaws full of jagged teeth,
  // dark scaled hide with crimson stripes, gold-trimmed back plates over a team saddle-cloth,
  // torn team scarf (scarf -> scarf2), sickle-clawed feet and hands, bladed whip tail.
  // =====================================================================================
  const RAPTOR = { main: 0x2b302b, dark: 0x141716, belly: 0x6b6656, stripe: 0x6e1612 };
  define('mini-pekka', {
    look: LOOK_GRIM,
    height: 1.14,

      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {

      rig.pivot('browL', 'head', [-0.06, 1.035, -0.5]);
      rig.pivot('browR', 'head', [0.06, 1.035, -0.5]);
      rig.pivot('armL', 'body', [-0.11, 0.64, -0.22]);
      rig.pivot('armR', 'body', [0.11, 0.64, -0.22]);
      rig.pivot('tail', 'body', [0, 0.64, 0.3]);

      rig.pivot('scarf', 'body', [0, 0.8, -0.14]);
      rig.pivot('scarf2', 'scarf', [0.08, 0.74, 0.1]);
      const H = { color: C.main, mat: 'leather' };
      const stripe = (py, pz, k) => ((py > 0.62 && (Math.floor((pz + 2) * (k || 13)) % 3) === 0) ? C.stripe : null);

      // digitigrade legs: heavy thigh, backward shin, long metatarsus, sickle claw raised
      const x = -0.12;
      const leg = kit.merge([
        kit.blob(0.17, 0.3, 0.24, o2(H, { round: 0.35, taper: 0.75, bulge: 0.15, seg: 8, hseg: 5 })).rot(0.35, 0, 0).at(x, 0.42, 0.08)
          .paint((px, py, pz) => (py > 0.46 && (Math.floor(py * 30) % 3 === 0) ? C.stripe : null)),
        limb(kit, [[x, 0.32, 0.12], [x, 0.24, 0.17], [x, 0.17, 0.19]], 0.055, 0.036, o2(H, { radial: 6 })),
        limb(kit, [[x, 0.17, 0.19], [x, 0.09, 0.1], [x, 0.04, 0.02]], 0.034, 0.03, o2(H, { radial: 5 })),
        kit.ring(0.04, 0.014, { color: 'team', mat: 'cloth', seg: [3, 8] }).rot(0.9, 0, 0).at(x, 0.12, 0.14),
        kit.blob(0.09, 0.05, 0.13, { color: C.dark, mat: 'leather', round: 0.5, seg: 7, hseg: 4 }).at(x, 0.03, -0.03),
        [-0.025, 0.025].map(dx => kit.tube([[x + dx, 0.03, -0.08], [x + dx, 0.025, -0.13], [x + dx, 0.0, -0.15]], [0.014, 0.002], { color: 'boneDark', mat: 'bone', radial: 4, seg: 3 })),
        kit.tube([[x - 0.035, 0.06, -0.04], [x - 0.055, 0.15, -0.09], [x - 0.045, 0.17, -0.19]], [0.026, 0.002], { color: 0x2a2420, mat: 'bone', radial: 5, seg: 4 }),
      ]);
      rig.add('legL', leg);

      const torso = kit.blob(0.32, 0.32, 0.68, o2(H, { round: 0.35, taper: 0.85, bottom: 0.9, bulge: 0.05, seg: 10, hseg: 6 })).rot(-0.22, 0, 0).at(0, 0.62, 0.06)

      const plates = [0, 1, 2].map(i => kit.blob(0.2 - i * 0.02, 0.05, 0.16, { color: STEEL_B, mat: PLATE, round: 0.55, taper: 0.8, seg: 7, hseg: 3 })
        .paint((px, py, pz) => (pz > 0.05 ? kit.col(GOLD_T) : null)).rot(-0.32 + i * 0.12, 0, 0).at(0, 0.82 - i * 0.03, -0.1 + i * 0.13));
      const spines = [0, 1, 2, 3].map(i => kit.cone(0.022, 0.09 - i * 0.01, { color: 'bone', mat: 'bone', seg: 4 }).rot(0.7, 0, 0).at(0, 0.84 - i * 0.025, -0.06 + i * 0.12));
      rig.add('body',
        torso,
        kit.blob(0.22, 0.18, 0.5, { color: C.belly, mat: 'leather', round: 0.4, seg: 8, hseg: 4 }).rot(-0.22, 0, 0).at(0, 0.55, 0.02)
          .paint((px, py, pz) => ((Math.floor((pz + 2) * 22) % 2) ? kit.darken(C.belly, 0.12) : null)),
        tatter(kit.lathe([[0.2, 0.6], [0.19, 0.7], [0.15, 0.78], [0.1, 0.82]], { color: 'team', mat: 'cloth', seg: 8, phi: [-1.3, 2.6], scale: [1, 1, 1.5], double: 'teamDark' }), 0.66, 0.05, 4, 0, 3).at(0, 0, 0.12),
        trim(kit, arcPts(0.1, 0.815, -1.3, 1.3, 5, 1.5, 0.12), 0.008),
        plates, spines,
        // neck
        kit.tube([[0, 0.7, -0.18], [0, 0.8, -0.28], [0, 0.88, -0.36]], [0.1, 0.075], o2(H, { radial: 7, seg: 3 })).paint((px, py, pz) => stripe(py, pz, 20)));

      // head: long narrow skull + snout, war-helm with crest fin and horns, glowing slit eyes
      const crest0 = kit.extrude([[0, 0], [0.3, 0.0], [0.36, 0.05], [0.3, 0.07], [0.33, 0.13], [0.22, 0.08], [0.2, 0.15], [0.12, 0.07], [0.08, 0.11], [0.03, 0.04]], 0.022, { color: 'team', mat: { base: 'lacquer', rough: 0.4 }, smooth: false }).rot(0, -HALF_PI, 0);
      const crest = crest0;
      // long narrow predator skull (beastHead): brow ridge over deep sockets, slit nostrils,
      // jagged interlocking fangs, dark maw; war-helm on the cranium with a big team crest blade
      const BH = beastHead(kit, { C: [0, 0.93, -0.3], L: 0.44, W: 0.1, H: 0.12, jawH: 0.075, skin: C.main, skinD: kit.darken(C.main, 0.5), belly: C.belly, brow: 1.25, nT: 5, fang: 0.75, teeth: 0xcdbb92, seed: 5 });
      rig.add('head', BH.upper,
        kit.sphere(0.12, { color: STEEL_B, mat: PLATE, seg: 9, hseg: 4, theta: [0, 1.25], scale: [0.95, 0.7, 1.45] }).rot(0.08, 0, 0).at(0, 1.0, -0.42),
        kit.ring(0.114, 0.008, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, seg: [3, 12] }).scale(0.95, 1, 1.45).rot(0.08, 0, 0).at(0, 1.035, -0.42),
        crest.clone().scale(1.35, 1.6, 1).at(0, 1.05, -0.52),
        horn(kit, [-0.07, 1.04, -0.36], [-0.13, 1.09, -0.26], [-0.16, 1.17, -0.13], 0.026, 'boneShade'),
        horn(kit, [0.07, 1.04, -0.36], [0.13, 1.09, -0.26], [0.16, 1.17, -0.13], 0.026, 'boneShade'),
        rivetRow(kit, [[-0.1, 1.02, -0.34], [0.1, 1.02, -0.34]], 0.009));
      const eL = BH.eye(-1);
      const eye = slitEye(kit, 0.022, -1, { glow: 1, iris: EMBER, tilt: 0.4 }).rot(0, eL.ry, 0).at(eL.at[0] - 0.004, eL.at[1], eL.at[2]);
      rig.add('eyes', eye, eye.mirror());
      const bp = kit.box(0.075, 0.02, 0.05, { color: STEEL_M, mat: PLATE, bevel: 0.007 });
      rig.add('browL', bp.clone().rot(0, 0.6, -0.4).at(eL.at[0] + 0.012, eL.at[1] + 0.035, eL.at[2] + 0.005));
      rig.add('browR', bp.clone().rot(0, -0.6, 0.4).at(-eL.at[0] - 0.012, eL.at[1] + 0.035, eL.at[2] + 0.005));
      rig.add('jaw', BH.jaw);

      const arm = kit.merge([

        [-0.02, 0, 0.02].map(dx => kit.tube([[-0.14 + dx, 0.53, -0.3], [-0.142 + dx, 0.5, -0.34], [-0.14 + dx, 0.46, -0.34]], [0.011, 0.002], { color: 'bone', mat: 'bone', radial: 4, seg: 3 })),
      ]);
      rig.add('armL', arm);
      rig.add('armR', arm.mirror());

      rig.add('tail', kit.tube([[0, 0.64, 0.28], [0, 0.65, 0.42], [0, 0.66, 0.56]], [0.12, 0.08], o2(H, { radial: 7, seg: 3 })).paint((px, py, pz) => stripe(py, pz)),
        kit.cone(0.02, 0.07, { color: 'bone', mat: 'bone', seg: 4 }).rot(0.9, 0, 0).at(0, 0.74, 0.44));
      rig.add('tail2', kit.tube([[0, 0.66, 0.56], [0, 0.675, 0.68], [0, 0.69, 0.8]], [0.08, 0.048], o2(H, { radial: 7, seg: 3 })).paint((px, py, pz) => stripe(py, pz)),
        kit.ring(0.055, 0.016, { color: 'team', mat: 'cloth', seg: [3, 9] }).rot(HALF_PI, 0, 0).at(0, 0.68, 0.72));
      rig.add('tail3',

        kit.extrude([[0, 0], [0.06, 0.08], [0.02, 0.18], [0, 0.32], [-0.02, 0.18], [-0.06, 0.08]], 0.014, { color: BLADE, mat: BLADE_MAT, smooth: false }).paint((px) => (Math.abs(px) > 0.03 ? EDGE : null)).rot(HALF_PI, 0, 0).at(0, 0.71, 0.95),
        [-1, 1].map(sd => kit.extrude([[0, 0], [0.05, 0.03], [0, 0.09]], 0.01, { color: BLADE, mat: BLADE_MAT, smooth: false }).rot(HALF_PI, 0, sd * 0.9).at(sd * 0.03, 0.71, 0.9)));
      // torn team scarf around the neck, trailing back

        ribbon(kit, [[0.03, 0.82, -0.2], [0.06, 0.8, -0.06], [0.08, 0.75, 0.1]], 0.045, 0.04, 'team', 0.35));
      rig.add('scarf2', ribbon(kit, [[0.08, 0.75, 0.1], [0.1, 0.71, 0.22], [0.11, 0.66, 0.32]], 0.04, 0.012, 'teamDark', 0.35));
