  // =====================================================================================
  // PEKKA - "Panzer-Rex" (v11): an armoured tyrant lizard bred for war. Low, forward-thrust
  // skull locked in a blackened war-helm (gold rims, forward horns, team crest blades, armoured
  // brow plates = browL / browR), burning ember slit eyes, a maw of jagged fangs; heavy scaled
  // hide under layered gold-trimmed back plates with a row of steel spikes, team-enamel shoulder
  // plates and torn team war banners on both flanks, a caged hellfire core in the chest, greaved
  // legs with hooked claws and a spiked club tail.
  // =====================================================================================
  const REX = { skin: 0x2d3229, skinD: 0x171a16, belly: 0x6e6a58, glow: EMBER };
  define('pekka', {
    look: LOOK_GRIM,
    height: 2.14,
    outline: 0.06,
    anim: {
      body: 'biped', walk: 'stomp', attack: 'bite', tempo: 0.85, weight: 0.9, turnSpeed: 7,
      strikeIn: 0.09, strikeHold: 0.09, strikeOut: 0.4,
      springs: { tails: { f: 1.6, wag: 0.16, max: 0.6 } },
      keys: { 'body.rx': [0, 0.3, -0.42, -0.3], 'head.rx': [0, -0.32, 0.12, 0.05], 'root.pz': [0, 0.1, -0.24, -0.16], 'sq': [0, -0.06, 0.12, 0.04] },
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        if (rig.armL) { const k = 0.5 * a.windup + 0.8 * a.strike; rig.armL.rotation.x += k; rig.armR.rotation.x += k; }
        if (rig.core) rig.core.scale.multiplyScalar(1 + 0.25 * a.windup + 0.4 * a.strike);
      },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.6, pitch: 0.12, pose: 'attack', zoom: 1.4 },
    build(kit) {
      const rig = kit.rig();
      const C = REX;
      const Hd = { color: C.skin, mat: 'leather' };
      rig.pivot('legL', 'root', [-0.27, 0.8, 0.14]);
      rig.pivot('legR', 'root', [0.27, 0.8, 0.14]);
      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, 0.82, 0.12]);
      rig.pivot('core', 'body', [0, 1.12, -0.38]);
      rig.pivot('head', 'body', [0, 1.42, -0.26]);
      rig.pivot('jaw', 'head', [0, 1.62, -0.46]);
      rig.pivot('eyes', 'head', [0, 1.8, -0.84]);
      rig.pivot('browL', 'head', [-0.15, 1.87, -0.84]);
      rig.pivot('browR', 'head', [0.15, 1.87, -0.84]);
      rig.pivot('armL', 'body', [-0.3, 1.18, -0.3]);
      rig.pivot('armR', 'body', [0.3, 1.18, -0.3]);
      rig.pivot('tail', 'body', [0, 1.0, 0.5]);
      rig.pivot('tail2', 'tail', [0, 0.9, 0.76]);
      rig.pivot('tail3', 'tail2', [0, 0.8, 0.98]);
      const scales = (px, py, pz) => ((Math.floor((py + 3) * 14) + Math.floor((pz + 3) * 14)) % 4 === 0 ? kit.col(C.skinD) : null);

      // legs: massive thigh with a plate cuisse, backward shin, armoured greave, hooked claws
      const x = -0.28;
      const leg = kit.merge([
        kit.blob(0.32, 0.52, 0.46, o2(Hd, { round: 0.35, taper: 0.8, bulge: 0.15, seg: 9, hseg: 6 })).rot(0.25, 0, 0).at(x, 0.68, 0.14).paint(scales),
        limb(kit, [[x, 0.5, 0.22], [x, 0.36, 0.28], [x, 0.24, 0.3]], 0.12, 0.085, o2(Hd, { radial: 7 })),
        kit.blob(0.2, 0.26, 0.12, { color: STEEL_B, mat: PLATE, round: 0.4, taper: 0.85, seg: 7, hseg: 3 }).rot(0.25, 0, 0).at(x, 0.36, 0.18),
        kit.ring(0.1, 0.022, { color: 'team', mat: 'cloth', seg: [3, 10] }).rot(0.25, 0, 0).at(x, 0.25, 0.29),
        limb(kit, [[x, 0.24, 0.3], [x, 0.14, 0.18], [x, 0.08, 0.06]], 0.075, 0.065, o2(Hd, { radial: 6 })),
        kit.blob(0.24, 0.12, 0.32, { color: C.skinD, mat: 'leather', round: 0.45, seg: 8, hseg: 4 }).at(x, 0.06, -0.04),
        [-0.075, 0, 0.075].map((dx, i) => kit.tube([[x + dx, 0.07, -0.16], [x + dx * 1.15, 0.06, -0.25], [x + dx * 1.2, 0.0, -0.3]], [i === 1 ? 0.04 : 0.032, 0.003], { color: 0x1e1a18, mat: 'bone', radial: 5, seg: 4 })),
      ]);
      rig.add('legL', leg);
      rig.add('legR', leg.mirror());

      // body: heavy torso leaning forward, ridged belly, back plates + spikes, banners, core cage
      const plates = [0, 1, 2, 3].map(i => kit.sphere(0.4 - i * 0.04, { color: STEEL_B, mat: PLATE, seg: 9, hseg: 3, theta: [0, 1.05], scale: [1.05, 0.7, 0.75] })
        .paint((px, py) => (py < (0.4 - i * 0.04) * 0.38 ? kit.col(GOLD_T) : null)).rot(0.55 + i * 0.22, 0, 0).at(0, 1.4 - i * 0.12, 0.0 + i * 0.16));
      const spikes = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map(i => kit.cone(0.06 - 0.006 * i, 0.26 - 0.03 * i, { color: STEEL_L, mat: PLATE, seg: 5 }).rot(0.45 + 0.25 * i, 0, 0).at(0, 1.66 - 0.13 * i, -0.06 + 0.17 * i));
      const banner = tatter(kit.extrude([[-0.15, 0.2], [0.15, 0.2], [0.15, -0.28], [0, -0.36], [-0.15, -0.28]], 0.014, { color: 'team', mat: 'cloth', smooth: false }), -0.2, 0.08, 4, 0, 5);
      const bannerT = trim(kit, [[-0.15, 0.2, -0.01], [0.15, 0.2, -0.01]], 0.014);
      const flank = kit.merge([banner, bannerT, kit.star(4, 0.07, 0.025, 0.01, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT }).at(0, 0.0, -0.012)]).rot(0.1, HALF_PI - 0.15, 0.12).at(-0.42, 1.12, 0.2);
      rig.add('body',
        kit.blob(0.74, 0.78, 1.14, o2(Hd, { round: 0.26, taper: 0.72, bulge: 0.05, seg: 11, hseg: 7 })).rot(-0.2, 0, 0).at(0, 1.14, 0.18).paint(scales),
        kit.blob(0.42, 0.5, 0.24, { color: C.belly, mat: 'leather', round: 0.4, taper: 0.8, seg: 8, hseg: 5 }).rot(-0.25, 0, 0).at(0, 1.04, -0.3)
          .paint((px, py) => ((Math.floor((py + 3) * 13) % 2) ? kit.darken(C.belly, 0.18) : null)),
        plates, spikes, flank, flank.mirror(),
        // tall team war banner on a pole strapped across the back (team from behind / above)
        kit.rcyl(0.018, 0.018, 1.0, { color: 'woodDark', seg: 6 }).rot(-0.25, 0, 0).at(0.16, 1.85, 0.42),
        kit.sphere(0.03, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, seg: 7 }).at(0.16, 2.33, 0.3),
        folds(tatter(kit.extrude([[0, 0.0], [0.34, 0.0], [0.34, -0.5], [0.17, -0.62], [0, -0.5]], 0.012, { color: 'team', mat: 'cloth', smooth: false }), -0.5, 0.08, 3, 0.17, 4), 0.01, 5, 0.17, 0, 0).rot(-0.25, HALF_PI * 0.15, 0).at(0.165, 2.27, 0.32),
        kit.star(5, 0.08, 0.035, 0.012, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT }).rot(-0.25, HALF_PI * 0.15 + PI, 0).at(0.32, 2.03, 0.38),
        plateShoulder(kit, -0.36, 1.36, 0.2, -1, { top: 'team', col: STEEL_B, spikes: 3, spikeLen: 1.0, lames: 1, z: -0.12 }),
        plateShoulder(kit, 0.36, 1.36, 0.2, 1, { top: 'team', col: STEEL_B, spikes: 3, spikeLen: 1.0, lames: 1, z: -0.12 }),
        // neck
        kit.tube([[0, 1.36, -0.14], [0, 1.5, -0.32], [0, 1.6, -0.46]], [0.26, 0.2], o2(Hd, { radial: 8, seg: 3 })).paint(scales),
        // iron belt / cage around the core
        kit.ring(0.4, 0.035, { color: IRON_B, mat: PLATE, seg: [3, 13] }).scale(1, 1, 0.92).rot(-0.3, 0, 0).at(0, 0.82, 0.18),
        kit.ring(0.405, 0.012, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, seg: [3, 13] }).scale(1, 1, 0.92).rot(-0.3, 0, 0).at(0, 0.86, 0.17));
      rig.add('core',
        kit.gem(0.085, { color: C.glow, glow: 0.9, stretch: 1.3 }).rot(HALF_PI, 0, 0).at(0, 1.12, -0.44),
        kit.torus(0.1, 0.022, { color: IRON_B, mat: PLATE, seg: [4, 10] }).rot(-0.3, 0, 0).at(0, 1.12, -0.42),
        [0, 1, 2, 3].map(i => { const an = i / 4 * TAU + 0.785; return kit.box(0.02, 0.05, 0.02, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, bevel: 0.004 }).rot(-0.3, 0, an).at(Math.sin(an) * 0.11, 1.12 + Math.cos(an) * 0.11, -0.44); }));

      // head: long skull + snout, war-helm, horns, crest blades, glowing eyes, fangs
      const crest = [0, 1, 2].map(i => kit.extrude([[0, 0], [0.1, 0.0], [0.03, 0.2 - i * 0.03]], 0.024, { color: 'team', mat: { base: 'lacquer', rough: 0.4 }, smooth: false }).rot(0, -HALF_PI, 0).at(0, 2.02 - i * 0.04, -0.7 + i * 0.16));
      // massive tyrant skull (beastHead): heavy brow ridge, deep burning sockets, flared cheeks,
      // interlocking fangs, dark maw; blackened war-helm with forward horns and team crest blades
      const BH = beastHead(kit, { C: [0, 1.66, -0.44], L: 0.88, W: 0.27, H: 0.25, jawH: 0.17, skin: C.skin, skinD: C.skinD, belly: C.belly, brow: 1.35, snout: 0.95, nT: 6, fang: 0.85, teeth: 0xc8b890, seed: 9 });
      rig.add('head', BH.upper,
        kit.sphere(0.31, { color: STEEL_B, mat: PLATE, seg: 10, hseg: 4, theta: [0, 1.2], scale: [0.95, 0.72, 1.2] }).rot(0.1, 0, 0).at(0, 1.78, -0.56),
        kit.ring(0.292, 0.015, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, seg: [3, 14] }).scale(0.95, 1, 1.2).rot(0.1, 0, 0).at(0, 1.87, -0.57),
        kit.blob(0.12, 0.05, 0.4, { color: STEEL_M, mat: PLATE, round: 0.5, taper: 0.7, seg: 6, hseg: 3 }).rot(0.12, 0, 0).at(0, 1.89, -0.98),
        trim(kit, [[0, 1.93, -0.8], [0, 1.9, -1.0], [0, 1.84, -1.18]], 0.012),
        crest.map(c => c.clone().at(0, -0.06, 0.06)),
        horn(kit, [-0.2, 1.88, -0.52], [-0.38, 1.98, -0.66], [-0.44, 2.1, -0.92], 0.075, 0x2a2420),
        horn(kit, [0.2, 1.88, -0.52], [0.38, 1.98, -0.66], [0.44, 2.1, -0.92], 0.075, 0x2a2420),
        // scar across the snout (pale incised line)
        kit.tube([[-0.12, 1.86, -0.92], [-0.02, 1.88, -1.02], [0.1, 1.83, -1.12]], (u) => 0.01 * Math.sin(PI * u) + 0.002, { color: 0x8a7a6a, mat: 'skin', radial: 4, seg: 5 }),
        rivetRow(kit, [[-0.22, 1.79, -0.42], [0.22, 1.79, -0.42], [-0.24, 1.75, -0.6], [0.24, 1.75, -0.6]], 0.016));
      const eL = BH.eye(-1);
      const eye = slitEye(kit, 0.045, -1, { glow: 1, iris: C.glow, tilt: 0.42 }).rot(0, eL.ry, 0).at(eL.at[0] - 0.008, eL.at[1], eL.at[2]);
      rig.add('eyes', eye, eye.mirror());
      const bp = kit.box(0.17, 0.045, 0.1, { color: STEEL_M, mat: PLATE, bevel: 0.015 });
      rig.add('browL', bp.clone().rot(0.1, 0.55, -0.36).at(eL.at[0] + 0.03, eL.at[1] + 0.07, eL.at[2]));
      rig.add('browR', bp.clone().rot(0.1, -0.55, 0.36).at(-eL.at[0] - 0.03, eL.at[1] + 0.07, eL.at[2]));
      rig.add('jaw', BH.jaw);
      // short clawed arms with bracers
      const arm = kit.merge([
        limb(kit, [[-0.3, 1.18, -0.3], [-0.34, 1.08, -0.38], [-0.35, 1.0, -0.46]], 0.07, 0.05, o2(Hd, { radial: 6 })),
        limb(kit, [[-0.34, 1.07, -0.39], [-0.35, 1.01, -0.45]], 0.062, 0.062, { color: STEEL_B, mat: PLATE, radial: 6, seg: 1 }),
        [-0.04, 0.0, 0.04].map(dx => kit.tube([[-0.35 + dx, 0.99, -0.47], [-0.355 + dx, 0.94, -0.53], [-0.35 + dx, 0.88, -0.53]], [0.02, 0.002], { color: 0x1e1a18, mat: 'bone', radial: 4, seg: 3 })),
      ]);
      rig.add('armL', arm);
      rig.add('armR', arm.mirror());
      // tail: thick tapering segments with plates, spiked club
      const tplate = (r) => kit.sphere(r, { color: STEEL_B, mat: PLATE, seg: 8, hseg: 3, theta: [0, 1.0], scale: [1, 0.6, 1.2] }).paint((px, py) => (py < r * 0.45 ? kit.col(GOLD_T) : null));
      rig.add('tail',
        kit.tube([[0, 1.02, 0.46], [0, 0.96, 0.62], [0, 0.9, 0.76]], [0.3, 0.2], o2(Hd, { radial: 8, seg: 3 })).paint(scales),
        tplate(0.22).rot(-0.35, 0, 0).at(0, 1.1, 0.6),
        kit.cone(0.04, 0.16, { color: STEEL_L, mat: PLATE, seg: 5 }).rot(1.3, 0, 0).at(0, 1.22, 0.66));
      rig.add('tail2',
        kit.tube([[0, 0.9, 0.76], [0, 0.85, 0.88], [0, 0.8, 0.98]], [0.2, 0.13], o2(Hd, { radial: 8, seg: 3 })).paint(scales),
        tplate(0.16).rot(-0.25, 0, 0).at(0, 0.96, 0.86),
        kit.cone(0.032, 0.12, { color: STEEL_L, mat: PLATE, seg: 5 }).rot(1.3, 0, 0).at(0, 1.04, 0.9));
      const club = [kit.blob(0.28, 0.26, 0.3, { color: IRON_B, mat: PLATE, round: 0.5, seg: 8, hseg: 5 }).at(0, 0.76, 1.12),
        kit.ring(0.13, 0.016, { color: 'team', mat: 'cloth', seg: [3, 10] }).rot(HALF_PI, 0, 0).at(0, 0.77, 0.99)];
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        const an = i / 6 * TAU;
        club.push(kit.cone(0.04, 0.17, { color: STEEL_L, mat: PLATE, seg: 5 }).rot(Math.cos(an) * 1.3, 0, Math.sin(an) * 1.3).at(Math.sin(an) * -0.12, 0.76 + Math.cos(an) * 0.12, 1.12));
      }
      club.push(kit.cone(0.045, 0.2, { color: STEEL_L, mat: PLATE, seg: 5 }).rot(HALF_PI, 0, 0).at(0, 0.76, 1.3));
      rig.add('tail3', kit.tube([[0, 0.8, 0.98], [0, 0.78, 1.04], [0, 0.76, 1.08]], [0.13, 0.09], o2(Hd, { radial: 7, seg: 2 })), club);
      return rig;
    },
  });

  // =====================================================================================
  // MEGA KNIGHT - "Stampfosaurus" (v11): a dome-skulled saurian juggernaut in black siege
  // plate. Upright brute build (huge shoulders, short neck, heavy legs), iron dome-helm with a
  // ring of knob spikes and a gold crown band, ember slit eyes under plate brows, fanged snarl;
  // massive spiked pauldrons with team enamel, gilded breastplate, team tabard + champion belt,
  // spiked iron gauntlets, torn two-part team cape, armoured spiked tail. Jump pose unchanged.
  // =====================================================================================
  const STOMP = { skin: 0x283229, skinD: 0x151a16, belly: 0x5d5c4b };
  define('mega-knight', {
    look: LOOK_GRIM,
    height: 2.1,
    outline: 0.06,
    anim: {
      body: 'biped', walk: 'stomp', attack: 'smash', tempo: 0.9, weight: 0.85, turnSpeed: 8,
      keys: { 'root.py': [-0.03, 0.12, -0.12, -0.08], 'sq': [0, -0.08, 0.2, 0.1] },
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        const z = +st.z || 0;
        const air = clamp(z / 1.2, 0, 1);
        const m = rig.__m || (rig.__m = { pz: 0, vz: 0 });
        const vz = dt > 0 ? (z - m.pz) / Math.max(dt, 1e-3) : 0;
        m.pz = z;
        m.vz = m.vz + (vz - m.vz) * Math.min(1, dt * 12);
        const falling = m.vz < -0.5 ? 1 : 0;
        if (air > 0.001) {
          const up = air * (1 - 0.6 * falling);
          rig.armL.rotation.x += 2.6 * up + 0.4 * air * falling;
          rig.armR.rotation.x += 2.6 * up + 0.4 * air * falling;
          rig.armL.rotation.z += 0.3 * up; rig.armR.rotation.z -= 0.3 * up;
          rig.legL.rotation.x += 0.7 * air; rig.legR.rotation.x += 0.7 * air;
          rig.body.rotation.x -= 0.2 * up - 0.25 * air * falling;
          if (rig.cape) rig.cape.rotation.x -= (0.3 + 0.8 * falling) * air;
        }
      },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.45, pitch: 0.12, pose: 'attack', zoom: 1.35 },
    build(kit) {
      const rig = kit.rig();
      const C = STOMP;
      const HIP = 0.66, SH = 1.42, NY = 1.5;
      rig.pivot('legL', 'root', [-0.2, HIP, 0.02]);
      rig.pivot('legR', 'root', [0.2, HIP, 0.02]);
      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, HIP + 0.02, 0.02]);
      rig.pivot('head', 'body', [0, NY, -0.06]);
      rig.pivot('armL', 'body', [-0.44, SH, 0]);
      rig.pivot('armR', 'body', [0.44, SH, 0]);
      rig.pivot('tail', 'body', [0, 0.78, 0.24]);
      rig.pivot('tail2', 'tail', [0, 0.46, 0.66]);
      rig.pivot('cape', 'body', [0, SH + 0.04, 0.2]);
      rig.pivot('cape2', 'cape', [0, 0.98, 0.42]);
      const Sk = { color: C.skin, mat: 'leather' };
      const scales = (px, py, pz) => ((Math.floor((py + 3) * 16) + Math.floor((px + 3) * 16)) % 4 === 0 ? kit.col(C.skinD) : null);

      // legs: scaled thighs, plate greaves with spiked knee cops, clawed iron sabatons
      const leg = kit.merge([
        heroLeg(kit, -0.2, { hip: HIP, r: 0.13, pants: C.skin, pantsMat: 'leather', greave: STEEL_B, knee: STEEL_M, kneeSpike: true, boot: IRON_B, bootMat: PLATE, bootR: 0.125, toe: STEEL_M, sole: 0x0b0a0c }),
        kit.ring(0.11, 0.016, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, seg: [3, 10] }).at(-0.21, 0.32, -0.01),
        [-0.05, 0.05].map(dx => kit.tube([[-0.21 + dx, 0.06, -0.3], [-0.21 + dx * 1.2, 0.05, -0.37], [-0.21 + dx * 1.3, 0.0, -0.4]], [0.028, 0.002], { color: 'bone', mat: 'bone', radial: 4, seg: 3 })),
      ]);
      rig.add('legL', leg);
      rig.add('legR', leg.mirror());

      // torso: barrel-chested saurian body under a gilded black breastplate
      const zs = 0.72;
      const bp = [[0.36, 0.96], [0.42, 1.08], [0.45, 1.22], [0.42, 1.36], [0.3, 1.47]];
      rig.add('body',
        torsoV(kit, 0.62, 1.52, 0.3, 0.43, 0.38, zs, o2(Sk, { seg: 11 })).paint(scales),
        shell(kit, bp, 1.35, zs * 1.06, STEEL_B, { mat: PLATE }),
        trim(kit, arcPts(0.31, 1.465, PI - 1.3, PI + 1.3, 8, zs * 1.06), 0.014),
        trim(kit, bp.map(q => [0, q[1], -q[0] * zs * 1.06 - 0.008]).slice(1), 0.016),
        [0, 1].map(i => kit.lathe([[0.37 - i * 0.02, 0.8 + i * 0.09], [0.36 - i * 0.02, 0.86 + i * 0.09], [0.35 - i * 0.02, 0.9 + i * 0.09]], { color: STEEL_M, mat: PLATE, seg: 11, phi: [PI - 1.2, 2.4], scale: [1, 1, zs * 1.08], sharp: true })),
        rivetRow(kit, [[-0.22, 1.3, -0.33], [0.22, 1.3, -0.33], [-0.3, 1.12, -0.3], [0.3, 1.12, -0.3]], 0.016),
        // team tabard (front + back), torn hem, champion belt with a gilded plaque
        tatter(shell(kit, [[0.36, 0.3], [0.34, 0.5], [0.33, 0.66], [0.32, 0.78]], 0.55, zs * 1.12, 'team', { mat: 'cloth', double: 'teamDark', sharp: true }), 0.42, 0.07, 3, 0, 4),
        tatter(shell(kit, [[0.36, 0.34], [0.34, 0.5], [0.33, 0.66], [0.32, 0.78]], 0.6, zs * 1.12, 'team', { mat: 'cloth', double: 'teamDark', sharp: true }, true), 0.44, 0.07, 3, 0, 6),
        kit.ring(0.34, 0.05, { color: IRON_B, mat: PLATE, seg: [4, 14] }).scale(1, 1, zs * 1.08).at(0, 0.78, 0),
        kit.ring(0.345, 0.014, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, seg: [3, 14] }).scale(1, 1, zs * 1.08).at(0, 0.82, 0),
        kit.extrude([[-0.13, -0.09], [0.13, -0.09], [0.17, 0], [0.13, 0.09], [-0.13, 0.09], [-0.17, 0]], 0.04, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, bevel: 0.012, smooth: false }).at(0, 0.79, -0.27),
        kit.gem(0.045, { color: 'team', mat: 'gem', glow: 0.45, stretch: 1.1 }).rot(HALF_PI, 0, 0).at(0, 0.79, -0.3),
        // gorget
        kit.lathe([[0.32, 1.42], [0.28, 1.5], [0.2, 1.56], [0.16, 1.58]], { color: STEEL_M, mat: PLATE, seg: 12, scale: [1, 1, 0.85] }));
      rig.add('cape',
        tornCape(kit, [[0.46, 0.98], [0.44, 1.12], [0.4, 1.3], [0.3, 1.46]], 1.15, 'team', 'teamDark', 0.8, { amp: 0.04, n: 3, seed: 4, cut: 0.02 }).at(0, 0, 0.12),
        trim(kit, arcPts(0.31, 1.455, -1.1, 1.1, 6, 0.8, 0.12), 0.018));
      rig.add('cape2', tornCape(kit, [[0.54, 0.42], [0.51, 0.62], [0.48, 0.82], [0.46, 0.98]], 1.15, 'team', 'teamDark', 0.8, { amp: 0.12, n: 4, seed: 9 }).at(0, 0, 0.12));

      // head: saurian skull + short muzzle under an iron dome-helm with knob spikes
      const knobs = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
        const an = -2.1 + i / 6 * 4.2;
        knobs.push(kit.cone(0.035, 0.13, { color: STEEL_L, mat: PLATE, seg: 5 }).rot(Math.cos(an) * 1.2, 0, -Math.sin(an) * 1.2).at(Math.sin(an) * 0.23, 1.88, -0.12 + Math.cos(an) * 0.25));
      }
      // closed saurian great-helm: an armoured reptile skull of riveted plates (beastHead in
      // blackened steel) with a burning visor slit, fangs jutting from the sides of the jaw plates
      const BH = beastHead(kit, { C: [0, 1.6, -0.02], L: 0.56, W: 0.24, H: 0.2, jawH: 0.12, skin: STEEL_B, skinD: IRON_B, belly: STEEL_M, mouth: 0x120306, mat: PLATE, brow: 1.5, snout: 1.05, nT: 3, fang: 0.9, teeth: 0xc8b890, seed: 3, ridge: true });
      rig.add('head', BH.upper, BH.jaw,
        trim(kit, [[0, 1.82, -0.1], [0, 1.79, -0.3], [0, 1.72, -0.5]], 0.014),
        [-1, 1].map(sd => trim(kit, [[sd * 0.24, 1.6, -0.08], [sd * 0.2, 1.6, -0.3], [sd * 0.13, 1.59, -0.5]], 0.01)),
        rivetRow(kit, [[-0.2, 1.68, -0.18], [0.2, 1.68, -0.18], [-0.16, 1.64, -0.38], [0.16, 1.64, -0.38]], 0.014),
        kit.sphere(0.27, { color: STEEL_B, mat: PLATE, seg: 11, hseg: 5, theta: [0, 1.25], scale: [0.95, 0.9, 1.05] }).at(0, 1.74, -0.06),
        kit.ring(0.255, 0.02, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, seg: [3, 14] }).scale(0.95, 1, 1.05).at(0, 1.825, -0.06),
        knobs,
        kit.cone(0.04, 0.16, { color: STEEL_L, mat: PLATE, seg: 5 }).at(0, 2.06, -0.12));
      const eL = BH.eye(-1);
      rig.pivot('eyes', 'head', [0, eL.at[1], eL.at[2]]);
      const eye = slitEye(kit, 0.036, -1, { glow: 1, iris: EMBER, tilt: 0.4 }).rot(0, eL.ry * 0.8, 0).at(eL.at[0] - 0.006, eL.at[1], eL.at[2]);
      rig.add('eyes', eye, eye.mirror());
      rig.pivot('browL', 'head', [eL.at[0] + 0.02, eL.at[1] + 0.05, eL.at[2]]);
      rig.pivot('browR', 'head', [-eL.at[0] - 0.02, eL.at[1] + 0.05, eL.at[2]]);
      const brow = kit.box(0.13, 0.035, 0.07, { color: STEEL_M, mat: PLATE, bevel: 0.012 });
      rig.add('browL', brow.clone().rot(0, 0.5, -0.36).at(eL.at[0] + 0.02, eL.at[1] + 0.05, eL.at[2]));
      rig.add('browR', brow.clone().rot(0, -0.5, 0.36).at(-eL.at[0] - 0.02, eL.at[1] + 0.05, eL.at[2]));
      // the maw glows faintly between the jaw plates when it roars (mouth pivot)
      rig.pivot('mouth', 'head', [0, 1.5, -0.3]);
      rig.add('mouth', kit.box(0.16, 0.05, 0.3, { color: 0x3a0804, glow: 0.35, bevel: 0.01 }).at(0, 1.5, -0.3));

      // arms: massive, spiked pauldrons (team tops), plate vambraces, spiked iron gauntlets
      const A = heroArm(kit, 1, 0.47, SH - 0.02, { len: 0.62, r: 0.11, out: 0.08, fwd: 0.08, sleeve: C.skin, sleeveMat: 'leather', rere: STEEL_B, fore: STEEL_B, foreMat: PLATE, bracer: STEEL_B, bracerSpikes: 2, glove: IRON_B, gloveMat: PLATE, gauntlet: STEEL_M, elbow: STEEL_M, bulge: 0.25 });
      const fist = A.hand;
      const armR = kit.merge([A.part,
        kit.ring(0.12, 0.018, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, seg: [3, 12] }).at(fist[0], fist[1] + 0.13, fist[2] + 0.01),
        [-0.06, 0, 0.06].map(dx => kit.cone(0.026, 0.09, { color: STEEL_L, mat: PLATE, seg: 5 }).rot(-HALF_PI, 0, 0).at(fist[0] + dx, fist[1] + 0.04, fist[2] - 0.13)),
        plateShoulder(kit, 0.5, SH + 0.05, 0.22, 1, { top: 'team', col: STEEL_B, spikes: 3, spikeLen: 1.15 })]);
      rig.add('armR', armR);
      rig.add('armL', armR.mirror());

      // tail: thick armoured tail with a row of spikes
      rig.add('tail',
        kit.tube([[0, 0.8, 0.2], [0, 0.62, 0.46], [0, 0.46, 0.66]], [0.2, 0.13], o2(Sk, { radial: 8, seg: 3 })).paint(scales),
        kit.sphere(0.17, { color: STEEL_B, mat: PLATE, seg: 8, hseg: 3, theta: [0, 1.0], scale: [1, 0.6, 1.3] }).rot(0.65, 0, 0).at(0, 0.7, 0.42),
        kit.cone(0.04, 0.15, { color: STEEL_L, mat: PLATE, seg: 5 }).rot(0.5, 0, 0).at(0, 0.8, 0.46));
      rig.add('tail2',
        kit.tube([[0, 0.46, 0.66], [0, 0.32, 0.78], [0, 0.2, 0.86]], [0.13, 0.03], o2(Sk, { radial: 7, seg: 3 })).paint(scales),
        kit.cone(0.032, 0.12, { color: STEEL_L, mat: PLATE, seg: 5 }).rot(0.75, 0, 0).at(0, 0.5, 0.74),
        kit.cone(0.026, 0.1, { color: STEEL_L, mat: PLATE, seg: 5 }).rot(0.95, 0, 0).at(0, 0.34, 0.84));
      return rig;
    },
  });

  // =====================================================================================
  // LUMBERJACK - "Holzfäller" (v11): feral woodland berserker. Shaved head with a war topknot
  // ('hair' spring), wild red beard, rage-lit eyes, scarred brow; rolled-up team plaid shirt
  // under a shaggy fur vest, leather suspenders, a wolf-pelt tail hanging from the belt ('tail'
  // spring), glowing rage potion on the hip, wrapped forearms, heavy boots. Bearded felling axe.
  // =====================================================================================
  define('lumberjack', {
    look: LOOK_BLADE,
    height: 1.5,
    outline: 0.05,
    anim: {
      body: 'biped', walk: 'march', attack: 'swing', tempo: 1.25, weight: 0.35, strikeIn: 0.05, strikeOut: 0.24,
      keys: { 'body.ry': [-0.2, -0.7, 0.7, 0.55], 'root.py': [-0.03, 0.04, -0.06, -0.04] },
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        if (rig.tail) rig.tail.rotation.x += 0.15 * Math.sin(a.phase * 2) * a.move + 0.25 * a.strike;
      },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.4, pitch: 0.08, pose: 'idle', zoom: 2.1 },
    build(kit) {
      const rig = kit.rig();
      const HIP = 0.64, NY = 1.16, SH = 1.08, fur = 0x2c231c, furL = 0x4a3a2c, hairC = 0x7a2c12, rage = 0xff5a2a;
      rig.pivot('legL', 'root', [-0.105, HIP, 0]);
      rig.pivot('legR', 'root', [0.105, HIP, 0]);
      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, HIP + 0.02, 0]);
      rig.pivot('tail', 'body', [0, 0.74, 0.17]);
      rig.pivot('head', 'body', [0, NY, -0.01]);
      rig.pivot('hair', 'head', [0, 1.42, 0.02]);
      rig.pivot('armL', 'body', [-0.23, SH, 0]);
      rig.pivot('armR', 'body', [0.23, SH, 0]);

      const leg = heroLeg(kit, -0.105, { hip: HIP, r: 0.07, pants: 0x2e2a26, pantsMat: 'cloth', shin: 0x2e2a26, boot: 'leatherDark', cuff: fur, sole: 0x120c0a });
      rig.add('legL', leg);
      rig.add('legR', leg.mirror());

      // team plaid shirt (painted check), fur vest, suspenders, belt, rage potion
      const zs = 0.66;
      const tA = kit.col('team'), tD = kit.col('teamDark'), blk = kit.col(0x141216);
      const plaid = (x, y, z) => {
        const u = Math.floor((Math.atan2(x, z) + PI) / TAU * 18), v = Math.floor(y * 22);
        return (u % 3 === 0 && v % 3 === 0) ? blk : (u % 3 === 0 || v % 3 === 0) ? tD : tA;
      };
      const vest = kit.lathe([[0.235, 0.74], [0.235, 0.86], [0.24, 0.98], [0.22, 1.08], [0.14, 1.15]], { color: fur, mat: 'fur', seg: 12, phi: [PI + 0.42, TAU - 0.84], scale: [1, 1, zs * 1.12], double: 0x1a1410 });
      const R = kit.rand(11);
      warp(vest, (x, y, z) => { const k = 1 + 0.08 * Math.sin(Math.atan2(x, z) * 9 + y * 40) * (0.5 + R() * 0.5); return [x * k, y, z * k]; }, 80);
      rig.add('body',
        torsoV(kit, 0.62, 1.16, 0.16, 0.22, 0.2, zs, { color: 'team', mat: 'cloth' }).paint(plaid),
        tatter(vest, 0.8, 0.06, 7, 0, 5),
        kit.tube([[-0.07, 0.78, -0.15], [-0.08, 0.95, -0.165], [-0.1, 1.1, -0.1], [-0.08, 1.16, 0.06]], 0.012, { color: 'leatherDark', mat: 'leather', radial: 4, seg: 8, scale: [1.6, 1, 0.6] }),
        kit.tube([[0.07, 0.78, -0.15], [0.08, 0.95, -0.165], [0.1, 1.1, -0.1], [0.08, 1.16, 0.06]], 0.012, { color: 'leatherDark', mat: 'leather', radial: 4, seg: 8, scale: [1.6, 1, 0.6] }),
        belt(kit, 0.17, 0.74, 0.72, { t: 0.03, col: 'leatherDark', buckle: IRON_B }),
        // rage potion (glowing) on the hip
        kit.sphere(0.04, { color: 0xb02ae0, glow: 0.85, mat: 'glass', seg: 8 }).at(0.17, 0.66, -0.08),
        kit.cylinder(0.014, 0.016, 0.04, { color: 0x6a3cc0, glow: 0.6, seg: 6 }).at(0.17, 0.71, -0.08),
        kit.sphere(0.014, { color: 'woodLight', seg: 5 }).at(0.17, 0.735, -0.08),
        kit.lathe([[0.19, 0.52], [0.178, 0.62], [0.165, 0.7]], { color: 0x2e2a26, mat: 'cloth', seg: 12, scale: [1, 1, 0.74], sharp: true }));
      // wolf-pelt tail (spring)
      rig.add('tail', kit.tube([[0, 0.74, 0.17], [0.0, 0.6, 0.21], [0.02, 0.44, 0.2], [0.03, 0.34, 0.16]], (u) => 0.05 * Math.sin(PI * Math.min(1, 0.15 + u * 0.95)) + 0.006, { color: fur, mat: 'fur', radial: 6, seg: 8, scale: [1.2, 1, 0.8] })
        .paint((x, y) => (y < 0.42 ? kit.col(furL) : null)));

      // head: shaved scalp + topknot, wild beard, rage-lit narrow eyes, scarred brow
      const F = grimFace(kit, rig, { NY, h: 0.25, w: 0.18, cz: -0.01, skin: 'skin', jaw: 1.14, chin: 1.05, gaunt: 1.25, iris: rage, glow: 0.45, tilt: 0.32, browCol: hairC, browThick: 0.011, browRz: 0.15, scar: [[-0.3, 0.26], [-0.08, -0.22]], stubble: hairC, scalp: kit.mix(kit.col('skin'), hairC, 0.45), hairline: 0.62, warpaint: 0x2a1a3a, ears: true, mouth: { w: 0.07, teeth: true, open: 0.75 } });
      rig.add('head',
        // wild spiked crest of locks along the scalp (no single fin) + second scar on the cheek
        hairLocks(kit, F, { col: hairC, n: 11, style: 'wild', a: [-0.35, 0.35], s: [0.72, 0.99], len: 0.16, thick: 0.026, grav: 0.0, lift: 0.02, out: 0.1, seed: 13 }),
        scarLine(kit, F.S, [F.w * 0.18, F.EY - F.h * 0.06], [F.w * 0.32, F.EY - F.h * 0.22], { skin: 'skin', scarW: 0.8 }),
        beardShell(kit, F, { col: hairC, len: 0.5, thick: 0.06, braids: 1, braidLen: 0.1, beads: IRON_B, moustache: 'down', n: 8, seed: 9 }));
      rig.add('hair',
        kit.rcyl(0.022, 0.026, 0.03, { color: 'leatherDark', seg: 7 }).at(0, 1.43, 0.02),
        crestLocks(kit, [[0, 1.43, 0.02], [0, 1.5, 0.05], [0, 1.48, 0.12], [0, 1.39, 0.17], [0, 1.3, 0.19]], { col: hairC, n: 6, r: 0.026, spread: 0.04, mat: 'hair', seed: 5 }));

      // arms: rolled plaid sleeves, bare forearms, leather wraps, fingerless gloves
      const A = heroArm(kit, 1, 0.225, SH - 0.02, { len: 0.48, r: 0.056, bulge: 0.26, out: 0.055, fwd: 0.08, sleeve: 'team', fore: 'skin', bracer: 'leather', bracerMat: 'leather', bracerTrim: 'leatherDark', glove: 'skin' });
      const sleeveRoll = kit.ring(0.06, 0.02, { color: 'teamDark', mat: 'cloth', seg: [4, 10] }).at(A.elbow[0], A.elbow[1] + 0.01, A.elbow[2]);
      const armR = kit.merge([A.part.paint((x, y, z) => (y > A.elbow[1] ? plaid(x * 3, y, z) : null)), sleeveRoll,
        kit.sphere(0.075, { color: fur, mat: 'fur', seg: 7, hseg: 4, theta: [0, 1.5], scale: [1.15, 0.8, 1.1] }).rot(0, 0, -0.45).at(0.24, SH + 0.02, 0)]);
      rig.pivot('weapon', 'armR', A.hand);
      rig.add('armR', armR);
      rig.add('armL', armR.mirror());

      // bearded felling axe: long haft, broad bearded head with a honed edge, iron poll
      const ab = axeHead(kit, [[0, 0.05], [0.09, 0.1], [0.2, 0.14], [0.24, 0.0], [0.23, -0.16], [0.14, -0.2], [0.08, -0.09], [0, -0.04]], 0.024, 0.17, { runes: false });
      rig.add('weapon', kit.merge([
        kit.rcyl(0.022, 0.026, 0.82, { color: 'wood', seg: 6 }).at(0, 0.24, 0),
        kit.cylinder(0.026, 0.026, 0.12, { color: 'leatherDark', seg: 6 }).at(0, 0.0, 0),
        ab.rot(0, HALF_PI, 0).at(0, 0.6, 0),
        kit.box(0.05, 0.1, 0.06, { color: IRON_B, mat: PLATE, bevel: 0.012 }).at(0, 0.6, 0.0),
      ]).rot(-0.95, 0, 0).at(A.hand[0], A.hand[1], A.hand[2]));
      return rig;
    },
  });

  // =====================================================================================
  // GIANT - "Robo-Riese" (v11): a hunched iron war-colossus. Massive riveted black-iron torso
  // with a team-enamel chest plate around a caged furnace core (core pulses), small armoured
  // head thrust forward between the shoulders with a burning visor slit (eyes) and plate brows,
  // jaw grille; huge spiked pauldrons with team tops, piston forearms, spiked wrecking fists,
  // smoking exhaust stacks, a team war pennant on the back (antenna spring), team loin banner.
  // =====================================================================================
  const ROBO = { iron: 0x26292f, ironL: 0x3d424a, dark: 0x141518, glow: EMBER };
  define('giant', {
    look: LOOK_GRIM,
    height: 2.24,
    outline: 0.06,
    anim: {
      body: 'biped', walk: 'stomp', attack: 'punch', tempo: 0.85, weight: 0.9, turnSpeed: 7,
      strikeIn: 0.08, strikeHold: 0.08, strikeOut: 0.36,
      keys: { 'body.ry': [0, -0.55, 0.5, 0.4], 'root.pz': [0, 0.06, -0.14, -0.1], 'sq': [0, -0.03, 0.08, 0.03] },
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        if (rig.core) rig.core.scale.multiplyScalar(1 + 0.08 * Math.sin(a.rt * 4 + a.seed * 5) + 0.35 * a.strike);
      },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.4, pitch: 0.12, pose: 'attack', zoom: 1.35 },
    build(kit) {
      const rig = kit.rig();
      const C = ROBO;
      const M = { mat: PLATE };
      rig.pivot('legL', 'root', [-0.26, 0.66, 0.04]);
      rig.pivot('legR', 'root', [0.26, 0.66, 0.04]);
      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, 0.68, 0.02]);
      rig.pivot('core', 'body', [0, 1.3, -0.36]);
      rig.pivot('head', 'body', [0, 1.62, -0.16]);
      rig.pivot('eyes', 'head', [0, 1.8, -0.36]);
      rig.pivot('browL', 'head', [-0.07, 1.86, -0.36]);
      rig.pivot('browR', 'head', [0.07, 1.86, -0.36]);
      rig.pivot('antenna', 'body', [0.22, 1.72, 0.3]);
      rig.pivot('armL', 'body', [-0.58, 1.56, 0]);
      rig.pivot('armR', 'body', [0.58, 1.56, 0]);

      // legs: iron thigh, spiked knee plate, trimmed shin plate, heavy sabaton
      const x = -0.27;
      const leg = kit.merge([
        kit.rcyl(0.14, 0.12, 0.3, o2(M, { color: C.ironL, seg: 9 })).at(x, 0.56, 0.02),
        kit.cylinder(0.09, 0.09, 0.18, o2(M, { color: C.dark, seg: 8 })).rot(0, 0, HALF_PI).at(x, 0.4, 0.04),
        [-1, 1].map(sd => kit.rcyl(0.022, 0.022, 0.3, o2(M, { color: STEEL_L, seg: 6 })).rot(0.2, 0, 0).at(x + sd * 0.1, 0.42, 0.1)),
        [-1, 1].map(sd => kit.cylinder(0.035, 0.035, 0.12, o2(M, { color: C.iron, seg: 6 })).rot(0.2, 0, 0).at(x + sd * 0.1, 0.53, 0.12)),
        kit.blob(0.2, 0.18, 0.1, o2(M, { color: STEEL_B, round: 0.5, seg: 7, hseg: 4 })).at(x, 0.42, -0.1),
        kit.cone(0.04, 0.14, { color: STEEL_L, mat: PLATE, seg: 5 }).rot(-HALF_PI, 0, 0).at(x, 0.42, -0.19),
        kit.blob(0.26, 0.3, 0.28, o2(M, { color: C.iron, round: 0.35, taper: 1.15, seg: 8, hseg: 4 })).at(x, 0.24, 0.0),
        trim(kit, arcPts(0.13, 0.36, PI - 1.1, PI + 1.1, 5, 1.05, 0, x), 0.012),
        kit.ring(0.142, 0.024, { color: 'team', mat: { base: 'lacquer', rough: 0.45 }, seg: [3, 10] }).at(x, 0.15, 0.0),
        kit.blob(0.34, 0.14, 0.48, o2(M, { color: C.dark, round: 0.45, roundH: 0.3, flat: 0.4, seg: 9, hseg: 4 })).at(x, 0.07, -0.07),
        kit.blob(0.28, 0.08, 0.16, o2(M, { color: STEEL_M, round: 0.5, seg: 7, hseg: 3 })).at(x, 0.11, -0.25),
      ]);
      rig.add('legL', leg);
      rig.add('legR', leg.mirror());

      // torso: hunched iron chest (V), waist, team chest plate with gold trim, rivets, loin banner
      const chest = kit.blob(1.0, 0.78, 0.7, o2(M, { color: C.iron, round: 0.22, roundH: 0.18, taper: 1.12, bottom: 0.78, bulge: 0.12, seg: 8, hseg: 5 })).flat();
      const plateShape = [[-0.3, 0.2], [0.3, 0.2], [0.26, -0.08], [0, -0.26], [-0.26, -0.08]];
      rig.add('body',
        chest.rot(0.16, 0, 0).at(0, 1.34, 0.0),
        kit.blob(0.62, 0.3, 0.5, o2(M, { color: C.dark, round: 0.5, seg: 9, hseg: 4 })).at(0, 0.92, 0.02),
        kit.ring(0.3, 0.03, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, seg: [3, 14] }).scale(1, 1, 0.8).at(0, 0.98, 0.02),
        kit.blob(0.66, 0.2, 0.52, o2(M, { color: STEEL_B, round: 0.5, seg: 9, hseg: 4 })).at(0, 0.76, 0.02),
        kit.extrude(plateShape, 0.05, { color: 'team', mat: { base: 'lacquer', rough: 0.42 }, bevel: 0.012, smooth: false }).rot(0.16, 0, 0).at(0, 1.4, -0.37),
        trim(kit, plateShape.concat([plateShape[0]]).map(q => [q[0] * 1.03, q[1] * 1.03, 0]), 0.014).rot(0.16, 0, 0).at(0, 1.4, -0.4),
        rivetRow(kit, [[-0.38, 1.56, -0.3], [0.38, 1.56, -0.3], [-0.44, 1.3, -0.3], [0.44, 1.3, -0.3], [-0.3, 1.08, -0.3], [0.3, 1.08, -0.3]], 0.02, STEEL_L),
        // angular overlapping armour plates: pectoral slabs + stepped abdominal lames
        [-1, 1].map(sd => kit.extrude([[0, 0.16], [0.3, 0.12], [0.34, -0.06], [0.08, -0.14]], 0.04, { color: STEEL_B, mat: PLATE, bevel: 0.01, smooth: false }).rot(0.2, sd * 0.35, 0).at(sd * 0.02, 1.52, -0.33).bake().scale(sd, 1, 1)),
        [0, 1, 2].map(i => kit.extrude([[-0.28 + i * 0.02, 0.04], [0.28 - i * 0.02, 0.04], [0.25 - i * 0.02, -0.04], [-0.25 + i * 0.02, -0.04]], 0.05, { color: i % 2 ? C.ironL : STEEL_B, mat: PLATE, bevel: 0.01, smooth: false }).rot(0.12, 0, 0).at(0, 1.12 - i * 0.075, -0.3 + i * 0.01)),
        // glowing heat cracks radiating from the furnace core
        [[-0.12, 1.36, -0.39], [-0.24, 1.46, -0.36], [-0.32, 1.5, -0.33]].length ? [
          kit.tube([[-0.07, 1.34, -0.41], [-0.16, 1.42, -0.39], [-0.2, 1.5, -0.37], [-0.3, 1.55, -0.33]], (u) => 0.012 * (1 - 0.7 * u), { color: C.glow, glow: 1, radial: 3, seg: 6 }),
          kit.tube([[0.08, 1.26, -0.41], [0.18, 1.2, -0.39], [0.22, 1.12, -0.36]], (u) => 0.012 * (1 - 0.7 * u), { color: C.glow, glow: 1, radial: 3, seg: 5 }),
        ] : [],
        // team war banner on the back plate (team from behind)
        folds(tatter(kit.extrude([[-0.22, 0], [0.22, 0], [0.22, -0.5], [0, -0.6], [-0.22, -0.5]], 0.014, { color: 'team', mat: 'cloth', smooth: false }), -0.5, 0.07, 3, 0, 3), 0.01, 5, 0, 0, 0).rot(0.16, PI, 0).at(0, 1.64, 0.46),
        trim(kit, [[-0.22, 1.64, 0.47], [0.22, 1.64, 0.47]], 0.016),
        // back: exhaust stacks with spiked rims and ember glow
        [-0.22, 0.22].map(sx => [
          kit.rcyl(0.08, 0.1, 0.42, o2(M, { color: C.dark, seg: 9 })).rot(-0.25, 0, 0).at(sx, 1.7, 0.36),
          kit.ring(0.09, 0.016, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, seg: [3, 10] }).rot(-0.25, 0, 0).at(sx, 1.88, 0.41),
          kit.disc(0.07, { color: C.glow, seg: 10, glow: 0.9 }).rot(-HALF_PI - 0.25, 0, 0).at(sx, 1.91, 0.42),
          [0, 1, 2].map(i => { const an = i / 3 * TAU; return kit.cone(0.02, 0.08, { color: STEEL_L, mat: PLATE, seg: 4 }).rot(-0.25, 0, 0).at(sx + Math.sin(an) * 0.085, 1.94, 0.42 + Math.cos(an) * 0.085); }),
        ]),
        kit.blob(0.6, 0.5, 0.2, o2(M, { color: STEEL_B, round: 0.4, seg: 8, hseg: 4 })).rot(0.16, 0, 0).at(0, 1.42, 0.34),
        tatter(kit.extrude([[-0.18, 0.0], [0.18, 0.0], [0.17, -0.44], [0, -0.52], [-0.17, -0.44]], 0.016, { color: 'team', mat: 'cloth', smooth: false }), 0.4, 0.06, 3, 0, 2).at(0, 0.72, -0.3),
        trim(kit, [[-0.18, 0.72, -0.31], [0.18, 0.72, -0.31]], 0.014));
      // furnace core behind a gilded cage
      rig.add('core',
        kit.sphere(0.13, { color: C.glow, seg: 10, hseg: 7, glow: 1 }).at(0, 1.3, -0.39),
        kit.sphere(0.07, { color: 0xffe0a0, seg: 8, hseg: 5, glow: 1 }).at(0, 1.3, -0.45),
        kit.torus(0.145, 0.026, { color: C.dark, mat: PLATE, seg: [4, 14] }).rot(0.16, 0, 0).at(0, 1.3, -0.42),
        [-0.07, -0.025, 0.025, 0.07].map(dx => kit.box(0.014, 0.26, 0.016, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, bevel: 0.004 }).rot(0.16, 0, 0).at(dx, 1.3, -0.5)));

      // head: armoured skull-helm thrust forward, burning visor slit, jaw grille, crest fin
      rig.add('head',
        kit.rcyl(0.12, 0.14, 0.12, o2(M, { color: C.dark, seg: 9 })).at(0, 1.66, -0.16),
        kit.blob(0.34, 0.32, 0.36, o2(M, { color: C.iron, round: 0.45, roundH: 0.35, taper: 0.85, bulge: 0.15, seg: 9, hseg: 5 })).at(0, 1.82, -0.2),
        kit.box(0.24, 0.035, 0.04, { color: 0x060506, mat: 'matte', bevel: 0.008 }).at(0, 1.8, -0.375),
        kit.blob(0.26, 0.12, 0.2, o2(M, { color: STEEL_B, round: 0.5, taper: 1.1, seg: 8, hseg: 3 })).at(0, 1.7, -0.3),
        [-0.06, -0.02, 0.02, 0.06].map(dx => kit.box(0.018, 0.07, 0.02, { color: 0x060506, bevel: 0.004 }).at(dx, 1.7, -0.4)),
        kit.extrude([[0, 0], [0.26, 0], [0.18, 0.1], [0.04, 0.12]], 0.03, { color: 'team', mat: { base: 'lacquer', rough: 0.4 }, smooth: false }).rot(0, -HALF_PI, 0).at(0, 1.96, -0.34),
        trim(kit, arcPts(0.172, 1.9, PI - 1.4, PI + 1.4, 8, 1.04, -0.2), 0.012),
        horn(kit, [-0.15, 1.88, -0.18], [-0.27, 1.92, -0.2], [-0.32, 2.02, -0.3], 0.04, STEEL_L),
        horn(kit, [0.15, 1.88, -0.18], [0.27, 1.92, -0.2], [0.32, 2.02, -0.3], 0.04, STEEL_L));
      const eye = slitEye(kit, 0.03, -1, { glow: 1, iris: C.glow, tilt: 0.3 }).at(-0.06, 1.8, -0.385);
      rig.add('eyes', eye, eye.mirror());
      const brow = kit.box(0.1, 0.03, 0.05, { color: STEEL_M, mat: PLATE, bevel: 0.01 });
      rig.add('browL', brow.clone().rot(0, 0.25, -0.3).at(-0.07, 1.86, -0.37));
      rig.add('browR', brow.clone().rot(0, -0.25, 0.3).at(0.07, 1.86, -0.37));
      // team war pennant on a rod over the right shoulder (antenna spring)
      rig.add('antenna',
        kit.rcyl(0.014, 0.016, 0.62, o2(M, { color: C.dark, seg: 6 })).at(0.22, 2.0, 0.3),
        kit.cone(0.024, 0.08, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, seg: 5 }).at(0.22, 2.35, 0.3),
        kit.extrude([[0, 0], [0, -0.26], [0.2, -0.22], [0.12, -0.14], [0.3, -0.06]], 0.012, { color: 'team', mat: 'cloth', smooth: false }).rot(0, -HALF_PI, 0).at(0.22, 2.28, 0.31));
      // arms: shoulder ball, spiked pauldron, iron upper arm, piston forearm, wrecking fist
      const xa = 0.62;
      const armR = kit.merge([
        kit.sphere(0.16, o2(M, { color: C.dark, seg: 9, hseg: 6 })).at(xa, 1.54, 0),
        plateShoulder(kit, xa, 1.62, 0.27, 1, { top: 'team', col: C.iron, spikes: 3, spikeLen: 1.0 }),
        kit.rcyl(0.11, 0.1, 0.3, o2(M, { color: C.ironL, seg: 9 })).at(xa + 0.03, 1.3, 0),
        kit.cylinder(0.085, 0.085, 0.2, o2(M, { color: C.dark, seg: 8 })).rot(HALF_PI, 0, 0).at(xa + 0.04, 1.12, 0),
        kit.rcyl(0.022, 0.022, 0.34, o2(M, { color: STEEL_L, seg: 6 })).at(xa - 0.06, 1.12, 0.06),
        kit.cylinder(0.034, 0.034, 0.13, o2(M, { color: C.iron, seg: 6 })).at(xa - 0.06, 1.24, 0.06),
        kit.blob(0.28, 0.36, 0.3, o2(M, { color: C.iron, round: 0.35, taper: 1.2, seg: 8, hseg: 4 })).at(xa + 0.05, 0.94, -0.02),
        kit.rcyl(0.03, 0.03, 0.3, o2(M, { color: STEEL_L, seg: 6 })).at(xa + 0.17, 0.98, 0.02),
        kit.ring(0.15, 0.022, { color: GOLD_T, mat: GILT, seg: [3, 12] }).scale(1, 1, 1.05).at(xa + 0.05, 0.8, -0.02),
        fist(kit, [xa + 0.06, 0.62, -0.05], 0.11, C.dark, 1, { mat: PLATE, gauntlet: C.iron }),
        [-0.1, 0.0, 0.1].map(dx => kit.cone(0.03, 0.11, { color: STEEL_L, mat: PLATE, seg: 5 }).rot(-HALF_PI, 0, 0).at(xa + 0.06 + dx, 0.68, -0.22)),
      ]);
      rig.add('armR', armR);
      rig.add('armL', armR.mirror());
      return rig;
    },
  });

  // =====================================================================================
  // ROYAL GIANT - "Geschütz-Mech" (v11): a blackened-bronze siege walker. Riveted boiler hull
  // with gold bands, a furnace port and a team war banner (flag); in the open gilded cage on top
  // sits a grim veteran gunner (scarred, stubbled, goggles with ember lenses, team leather cap);
  // a long siege cannon with a fanged muzzle crown on the right shoulder, spiked team pauldrons,
  // claw hands, a turning brass cog on the flank (gear).
  // =====================================================================================
  const MECH = { brass: 0x4e3a26, brassD: 0x32251a, iron: 0x1d1f24, gold: GOLD_T };
  define('royal-giant', {
    look: LOOK_GRIM,
    height: 2.14,
    outline: 0.06,
    anim: {
      body: 'biped', walk: 'stomp', attack: 'cannon', tempo: 0.85, weight: 0.9, turnSpeed: 7,
      strikeIn: 0.04, strikeHold: 0.06, strikeOut: 0.5,
      keys: { 'body.rx': [0, -0.04, 0.14, 0.06], 'root.pz': [0, -0.02, 0.12, 0.05], 'sq': [0, 0.03, -0.06, 0] },
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        if (rig.weapon) rig.weapon.rotation.x += 0.12 * a.aim - 0.2 * a.strike;
        if (rig.head) { rig.head.position.y -= 0.05 * a.strike; rig.head.rotation.x += 0.12 * a.aim - 0.2 * a.strike; }
        if (rig.armR) rig.armR.rotation.x += 0.5 * a.aim;
      },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.6, pitch: 0.12, pose: 'attack', zoom: 1.3 },
    build(kit) {
      const rig = kit.rig();
      const C = MECH;
      rig.pivot('legL', 'root', [-0.27, 0.58, 0.02]);
      rig.pivot('legR', 'root', [0.27, 0.58, 0.02]);
      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, 0.6, 0]);
      rig.pivot('head', 'body', [0, 1.62, 0.0]);
      rig.pivot('armL', 'body', [-0.52, 1.34, 0]);
      rig.pivot('armR', 'body', [0.52, 1.34, 0]);
      rig.pivot('weapon', 'body', [0.44, 1.7, 0.06]);
      rig.pivot('gear', 'body', [-0.49, 1.05, 0.1]);
      rig.pivot('flag', 'body', [0, 0.9, -0.44]);
      const B = { mat: { base: 'gold', rough: 0.4, metal: 0.65 } }, I = { mat: PLATE }, Gd = { mat: GILT };

      // legs: bronze piston legs with gold bands, iron feet with claws
      const x = -0.28;
      const leg = kit.merge([
        kit.sphere(0.13, o2(I, { color: C.iron, seg: 8, hseg: 5 })).at(x, 0.55, 0),
        kit.rcyl(0.12, 0.11, 0.2, o2(B, { color: C.brass, seg: 9 })).at(x, 0.42, 0),
        kit.blob(0.2, 0.14, 0.1, o2(I, { color: C.iron, round: 0.5, seg: 7, hseg: 3 })).at(x, 0.34, -0.1),
        kit.cone(0.035, 0.12, { color: STEEL_L, mat: PLATE, seg: 5 }).rot(-HALF_PI, 0, 0).at(x, 0.34, -0.18),
        kit.rcyl(0.14, 0.19, 0.24, o2(B, { color: C.brassD, seg: 9 })).at(x, 0.2, 0),
        kit.ring(0.17, 0.02, o2(Gd, { color: C.gold, seg: [3, 12] })).at(x, 0.27, 0),
        rivets(kit, [-0.6, 0, 0.6].map(an => [x + Math.sin(an) * 0.18, 0.17, -Math.cos(an) * 0.18]), 0.016, GOLD_L, 0),
        kit.blob(0.34, 0.13, 0.46, o2(I, { color: C.iron, round: 0.45, roundH: 0.3, flat: 0.4, seg: 9, hseg: 4 })).at(x, 0.065, -0.05),
        [-0.08, 0, 0.08].map(dx => kit.cone(0.025, 0.09, { color: 'bone', mat: 'bone', seg: 4 }).rot(-HALF_PI - 0.25, 0, 0).at(x + dx, 0.05, -0.3)),
      ]);
      rig.add('legL', leg);
      rig.add('legR', leg.mirror());

      // hull: riveted boiler, gold bands, furnace port, cockpit ring + gilded cage, chimney
      const cage = [kit.ring(0.26, 0.032, o2(Gd, { color: C.gold, seg: [3, 14] })).at(0, 1.62, 0)];
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        const an = [0.95, 2.2, 4.08, 5.33][i];   // two bars at the back, two at the sides: the face stays free
        cage.push(kit.tube([[Math.sin(an) * 0.26, 1.62, Math.cos(an) * 0.26], [Math.sin(an) * 0.24, 1.86, Math.cos(an) * 0.24], [Math.sin(an) * 0.1, 2.04, Math.cos(an) * 0.1]], 0.014, o2(Gd, { color: C.gold, radial: 4, seg: 5, caps: false })));
      }
      cage.push(kit.cone(0.03, 0.1, o2(Gd, { color: GOLD_L, seg: 5 })).at(0, 2.08, 0));
      const rv = (y, r, n) => { const out = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const an = PI + (i - (n - 1) / 2) * 0.3; out.push([Math.sin(an) * r, y, Math.cos(an) * r * 0.9]); } return rivets(kit, out, 0.017, GOLD_L); };
      rig.add('body',

        kit.ring(0.52, 0.03, o2(Gd, { color: C.gold, seg: [3, 15] })).scale(1, 1, 0.9).at(0, 0.97, 0),
        kit.ring(0.51, 0.03, o2(Gd, { color: C.gold, seg: [3, 15] })).scale(1, 1, 0.9).at(0, 1.3, 0),

        kit.ring(0.42, 0.05, { color: 'team', mat: { base: 'lacquer', rough: 0.45 }, seg: [4, 15] }).scale(1, 1, 0.9).at(0, 0.74, 0),
        kit.rcyl(0.12, 0.12, 0.05, o2(I, { color: C.iron, seg: 10 })).rot(HALF_PI, 0, 0).at(0, 1.14, -0.47),
        kit.disc(0.085, { color: EMBER, seg: 12, glow: 0.85 }).at(0, 1.14, -0.5),
        [-0.04, 0, 0.04].map(dx => kit.box(0.014, 0.17, 0.016, { color: C.gold, mat: GILT, bevel: 0.004 }).at(dx, 1.14, -0.505)),

        kit.rcyl(0.07, 0.09, 0.36, o2(I, { color: C.iron, seg: 9 })).at(-0.22, 1.66, 0.34),

        kit.disc(0.06, { color: EMBER, seg: 9, glow: 0.7 }).rot(-HALF_PI, 0, 0).at(-0.22, 1.845, 0.34),
        // gunner torso in the cockpit: team leather coat, bandolier
        kit.blob(0.34, 0.26, 0.28, { color: 'team', mat: 'leather', round: 0.4, taper: 0.8, seg: 9, hseg: 4 }).at(0, 1.66, 0.02),
        kit.tube([[-0.14, 1.78, -0.08], [0, 1.68, -0.15], [0.14, 1.58, -0.1]], 0.016, { color: 'leatherDark', mat: 'leather', radial: 4, seg: 4 }),
        furMantle(kit, 1.76, 0.11, 0.9, 0x2a2018, 0x3a2e22, { tufts: 6 }),
        cage);
      // gunner head: grim veteran under a team leather cap with goggles (ember lenses)
      const F = grimFace(kit, rig, { NY: 1.78, h: 0.22, cz: -0.03, skin: 'skinTan', iris: 0x6a4a2a, browCol: 0x2a1a12, stubble: 0x3a2618, scar: true, ears: false, jaw: 1.12, chin: 1.05, gaunt: 1.2, mouth: { w: 0.06 } });
      const gog = (sx) => kit.merge([
        kit.torus(0.032, 0.012, o2(Gd, { color: C.gold, seg: [4, 10] })),
        kit.disc(0.026, { color: EMBER, seg: 10, glow: 0.8 }).at(0, 0, -0.006),
      ]).rot(-0.45, 0, 0).at(sx, F.cy + F.h * 0.22, F.cz - F.rz * 0.92);
      rig.add('head',
        kit.capsule(0.045, 0.04, { color: 'skinShade', mat: 'skin', seg: 6, capSeg: 1 }).at(0, 1.8, 0.0),
        kit.sphere(F.rx * 1.16, { color: 'team', mat: 'leather', seg: 10, hseg: 5, theta: [0, 1.55], scale: [1, F.ry / F.rx * 1.08, F.rz / F.rx * 1.1] }).rot(0.25, 0, 0).at(0, F.cy + 0.005, F.cz + 0.005),
        kit.blob(0.035, 0.11, 0.08, { color: 'team', mat: 'leather', round: 0.4, seg: 7, hseg: 4 }).at(-F.rx * 1.08, F.EY - 0.04, F.cz + 0.02),
        kit.blob(0.035, 0.11, 0.08, { color: 'team', mat: 'leather', round: 0.4, seg: 7, hseg: 4 }).at(F.rx * 1.08, F.EY - 0.04, F.cz + 0.02),
        kit.tube(arcPts(F.rx * 1.12, F.cy + F.h * 0.2, PI - 1.3, PI + 1.3, 6, F.rz / F.rx * 1.08, F.cz), 0.009, { color: 'leatherDark', mat: 'leather', radial: 4, seg: 8, caps: false }),
        gog(-0.042), gog(0.042),
        beardShell(kit, F, { col: 0x3a2618, len: 0.18, thick: 0.04, wide: 1.4, n: 5, moustache: 'down' }));
      // arms: team spiked pauldrons, bronze segments, iron claw hands
      const xa = 0.55;
      const finger = (dx, rz) => kit.tube([[xa + dx, 0.66, -0.05], [xa + dx * 1.2, 0.56, -0.1], [xa + dx * 1.1, 0.5, -0.05]], [0.035, 0.008], o2(I, { color: C.iron, radial: 5, seg: 4 }));
      const armR = kit.merge([
        kit.sphere(0.15, o2(B, { color: C.brassD, seg: 9, hseg: 6 })).at(xa, 1.34, 0),
        plateShoulder(kit, xa + 0.02, 1.42, 0.2, 1, { top: 'team', col: C.brassD, spikes: 3, spikeLen: 1.0, lames: 1 }),
        kit.rcyl(0.08, 0.08, 0.24, o2(B, { color: C.brass, seg: 9 })).at(xa + 0.04, 1.14, 0),
        kit.sphere(0.09, o2(I, { color: C.iron, seg: 8, hseg: 5 })).at(xa + 0.05, 1.0, 0),
        kit.rcyl(0.1, 0.13, 0.24, o2(B, { color: C.brass, seg: 9 })).at(xa + 0.06, 0.86, -0.02),
        kit.ring(0.122, 0.02, o2(Gd, { color: C.gold, seg: [3, 10] })).at(xa + 0.06, 0.78, -0.02),
        kit.blob(0.2, 0.16, 0.2, o2(I, { color: C.iron, round: 0.5, seg: 8, hseg: 4 })).at(xa + 0.06, 0.7, -0.03),
        finger(-0.04, 0.2), finger(0.08, -0.2), finger(0.02, 0),
      ]);
      rig.add('armR', armR);
      rig.add('armL', armR.mirror());
      // siege cannon: long iron barrel, gold bands, team ring, fanged muzzle crown, breech knob
      const fangs = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { const an = i / 8 * TAU; fangs.push(kit.cone(0.022, 0.08, { color: STEEL_L, mat: PLATE, seg: 4 }).rot(-HALF_PI, 0, 0).at(0.44 + Math.sin(an) * 0.17, 1.74 + Math.cos(an) * 0.17, -0.66)); }
      rig.add('weapon',
        kit.rcyl(0.12, 0.15, 0.86, o2(I, { color: C.iron, seg: 10 })).rot(HALF_PI, 0, 0).at(0.44, 1.74, -0.12),
        kit.lathe([[0.13, -0.08], [0.19, -0.05], [0.2, 0.0], [0.19, 0.05], [0.15, 0.07], [0.1, 0.06]], o2(I, { color: C.iron, seg: 11, double: 0x0a0a0c })).rot(-HALF_PI, 0, 0).at(0.44, 1.74, -0.6),
        kit.ring(0.16, 0.024, o2(Gd, { color: C.gold, seg: [3, 12] })).rot(HALF_PI, 0, 0).at(0.44, 1.74, 0.12),
        kit.ring(0.14, 0.024, o2(Gd, { color: C.gold, seg: [3, 12] })).rot(HALF_PI, 0, 0).at(0.44, 1.74, -0.28),
        kit.ring(0.152, 0.024, { color: 'team', mat: { base: 'lacquer', rough: 0.45 }, seg: [3, 12] }).rot(HALF_PI, 0, 0).at(0.44, 1.74, -0.46),
        fangs,
        kit.sphere(0.1, o2(I, { color: C.iron, seg: 8, hseg: 5 })).at(0.44, 1.74, 0.34),
        kit.disc(0.11, { color: 0x0a0a0c, mat: 'matte', seg: 12 }).at(0.44, 1.74, -0.64),
        kit.disc(0.05, { color: EMBER, seg: 8, glow: 0.6 }).at(0.44, 1.74, -0.62));
      const cog = [kit.rcyl(0.15, 0.15, 0.05, o2(Gd, { color: C.gold, seg: 12 })).rot(0, 0, HALF_PI),
        kit.sphere(0.05, o2(I, { color: C.iron, seg: 7 })).scale(0.8, 1, 1)];
      for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { const an = i / 8 * TAU; cog.push(kit.box(0.05, 0.06, 0.06, o2(Gd, { color: C.gold, bevel: 0, micro: false })).rot(an, 0, 0).at(0, Math.cos(an) * 0.17, Math.sin(an) * 0.17)); }
      rig.add('gear', kit.merge(cog).at(-0.52, 1.05, 0.1));
      // team war banner hanging from a gilded bar on the hull front
      const banner = [[-0.18, 0.18], [0.18, 0.18], [0.18, -0.24], [0.06, -0.3], [0, -0.36], [-0.06, -0.3], [-0.18, -0.24]];
      rig.add('flag',
        tatter(kit.extrude(banner, 0.02, { color: 'team', mat: 'cloth', smooth: false }), -0.2, 0.05, 3, 0, 4).at(0, 0.72, -0.47),
        trim(kit, [[-0.165, 0.89, -0.485], [-0.165, 0.5, -0.485]], 0.008), trim(kit, [[0.165, 0.89, -0.485], [0.165, 0.5, -0.485]], 0.008),
        kit.star(4, 0.08, 0.03, 0.02, o2(Gd, { color: C.gold })).at(0, 0.74, -0.49),
        kit.rcyl(0.016, 0.016, 0.42, o2(Gd, { color: C.gold, seg: 7 })).rot(0, 0, HALF_PI).at(0, 0.9, -0.47),
        kit.cone(0.024, 0.06, o2(Gd, { color: C.gold, seg: 5 })).rot(0, 0, HALF_PI).at(-0.235, 0.9, -0.47),
        kit.cone(0.024, 0.06, o2(Gd, { color: C.gold, seg: 5 })).rot(0, 0, -HALF_PI).at(0.235, 0.9, -0.47));
      return rig;

  });

  // =====================================================================================
  // GOLEM - "Fels-Titan" (v11): a hunched titan of faceted basalt held together by molten
  // fire. Heavy slab shoulders, a small skull sunk between them under a jutting brow ledge
  // (rock brows = browL / browR) with burning slit eyes, a lava-lit maw, glowing magma cracks
  // radiating from the chest core over the torso and arms, jagged team-coloured crystal shards
  // erupting from the back and shoulders, boulder fists with stone talons. GOLEMITE: the same
  // titan at half size (fewer facets / shards).
  // =====================================================================================
  const ROCKC = { rock: 0x3b3734, rockL: 0x4f4945, rockD: 0x25211e, glow: EMBER };
  function golemBody(kit, rig, k, small) {
    const C = ROCKC;
    const S = (v) => v * k;
    rig.pivot('legL', 'root', [S(-0.3), S(0.5), S(0.04)]);
    rig.pivot('legR', 'root', [S(0.3), S(0.5), S(0.04)]);
    rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, S(0.52), 0]);
    rig.pivot('core', 'body', [0, S(1.22), S(-0.5)]);
    rig.pivot('head', 'body', [0, S(1.62), S(-0.24)]);
    rig.pivot('eyes', 'head', [0, S(1.72), S(-0.5)]);
    rig.pivot('browL', 'head', [S(-0.1), S(1.79), S(-0.5)]);
    rig.pivot('browR', 'head', [S(0.1), S(1.79), S(-0.5)]);
    rig.pivot('armL', 'body', [S(-0.64), S(1.58), 0]);
    rig.pivot('armR', 'body', [S(0.64), S(1.58), 0]);
    const det = small ? 1 : 2;
    // faceted basalt (flat shaded), jittered
    const rk = (r, o) => kit.rock(S(r), Object.assign({ color: C.rock, mat: 'stone', detail: o && o.d !== undefined ? o.d : det, jitter: 0.2 }, o));
    // jagged, branching magma fissures (irregular zig-zag + side branches, tapering)
    const CR = kit.rand(small ? 77 : 33);
    const crack = (pts, r) => {
      const P = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
        const a = pts[i], b = pts[i + 1];
        for (let k2 = 0; k2 < 3; k2++) { const u = k2 / 3, j = (CR() - 0.5) * 0.05; P.push([a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * u + j, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * u + j * 0.6, a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * u - Math.abs(j) * 0.3]); }
      }
      P.push(pts[pts.length - 1]);
      const W = S(r || 0.018), out = [kit.tube(P.map(q => [S(q[0]), S(q[1]), S(q[2])]), (u) => W * (1.1 - 0.75 * u), { color: C.glow, radial: 4, seg: P.length, glow: 1 })];
      if (kit.detailMul >= 1.2) for (let bi = 1; bi < P.length - 2; bi += 3) {
        const q = P[bi], d = [(CR() - 0.5) * 0.2, (CR() - 0.5) * 0.16, -0.01];
        out.push(kit.tube([q, [q[0] + d[0] * 0.5, q[1] + d[1] * 0.5 + 0.01, q[2]], [q[0] + d[0], q[1] + d[1], q[2] + d[2]]].map(v => [S(v[0]), S(v[1]), S(v[2])]), (u) => W * 0.6 * (1 - u) + 0.001, { color: kit.lighten(C.glow, 0.2), radial: 3, seg: 2, glow: 1, caps: false }));
      }
      return out;
    };
    const shard = (x, y, z, r, rx, rz) => kit.gem(S(r), { color: 'team', mat: 'gem', glow: 0.45, stretch: 2.4 }).rot(rx, 0, rz).at(S(x), S(y), S(z));

    const leg = kit.merge([
      rk(0.25, { seed: 3, color: C.rockD }).scale(1, 1.15, 1).at(S(-0.31), S(0.4), S(0.02)),
      rk(0.22, { seed: 5, d: 1 }).scale(1.2, 0.6, 1.4).at(S(-0.31), S(0.11), S(-0.06)),
      crack([[-0.2, 0.46, -0.2], [-0.27, 0.36, -0.23], [-0.24, 0.26, -0.2]], 0.014),
    ]);
    rig.add('legL', leg);
    rig.add('legR', leg.mirror());

    const shards = [];
    shards.push(shard(-0.3, 1.95, 0.24, 0.13, 0.4, 0.45), shard(-0.12, 2.0, 0.34, 0.1, 0.7, 0.15), shard(0.22, 1.98, 0.3, 0.14, 0.6, -0.35), shard(0.05, 1.9, 0.44, 0.09, 1.0, 0.0));
    if (!small) shards.push(shard(-0.42, 1.8, 0.4, 0.08, 0.9, 0.7), shard(0.4, 1.78, 0.38, 0.09, 0.9, -0.7), shard(0.0, 1.66, 0.56, 0.08, 1.3, 0.2));
    rig.add('body',
      rk(0.34, { seed: 23, color: C.rockD }).scale(1.3, 0.7, 1.05).at(0, S(0.74), S(0.02)),
      rk(0.6, { seed: 11 }).scale(1.25, 0.95, 0.85).rot(0.2, 0, 0).at(0, S(1.3), S(0.06)),
      rk(0.38, { seed: 17, color: C.rockL }).scale(1.2, 0.9, 0.5).at(0, S(1.22), S(-0.3)),
      rk(0.4, { seed: 19, color: C.rockD }).scale(1.3, 0.8, 0.9).at(0, S(1.62), S(0.28)),
      shards,
      // molten inner mass: glows through the seams between the basalt plates

  // golemite (v11b): its own silhouette so a dying golem never reads as "two more golems":
  // hunched and front-heavy, few coarse slabs (detail 0 rocks), ONE big team crystal growing out
  // of the back, a much bigger right fist, no brows (burning eyes in a split skull)
  function golemiteBody(kit, rig) {
    const C = ROCKC, k = 0.52, S = (v) => v * k;
    rig.pivot('legL', 'root', [S(-0.3), S(0.5), S(0.04)]);
    rig.pivot('legR', 'root', [S(0.3), S(0.5), S(0.04)]);

    rig.pivot('browL', 'head', [S(-0.1), S(1.52), S(-0.7)]);
    rig.pivot('browR', 'head', [S(0.1), S(1.52), S(-0.7)]);
    rig.pivot('armL', 'body', [S(-0.6), S(1.46), S(-0.1)]);
    rig.pivot('armR', 'body', [S(0.64), S(1.5), S(-0.1)]);
    const rk = (r, o) => kit.rock(S(r), Object.assign({ color: C.rock, mat: 'stone', detail: 0, jitter: 0.28 }, o));
    const glowT = (pts, r) => kit.tube(pts.map(q => [S(q[0]), S(q[1]), S(q[2])]), (u) => S(r) * (1.1 - 0.7 * u), { color: C.glow, radial: 4, seg: pts.length * 2, glow: 1 });
    const leg = kit.merge([rk(0.24, { seed: 4, color: C.rockD }).scale(1, 1.1, 1).at(S(-0.3), S(0.36), S(0.04)), rk(0.2, { seed: 6 }).scale(1.25, 0.6, 1.4).at(S(-0.31), S(0.1), S(-0.05))]);
    rig.add('legL', leg);
    rig.add('legR', leg.mirror());
    rig.add('body',
      rk(0.62, { seed: 13 }).scale(1.2, 0.85, 1.0).rot(0.55, 0, 0).at(0, S(1.12), S(0.0)),
      rk(0.36, { seed: 29, color: C.rockD }).scale(1.3, 0.7, 1.0).at(0, S(0.72), S(0.06)),
      kit.sphere(S(0.38), { color: 0x7a1e04, glow: 0.5, seg: 8, hseg: 5, scale: [1.2, 0.9, 1] }).at(0, S(1.1), S(0.0)),
      // the big team crystal growing from the hunched back + two small ones
      kit.gem(S(0.26), { color: 'team', mat: 'gem', glow: 0.55, stretch: 2.2 }).rot(-0.55, 0, 0.15).at(S(0.05), S(1.62), S(0.36)),
      kit.gem(S(0.11), { color: 'team', mat: 'gem', glow: 0.45, stretch: 2.0 }).rot(-0.3, 0, 0.8).at(S(-0.28), S(1.42), S(0.34)),
      kit.gem(S(0.09), { color: 'teamLight', mat: 'gem', glow: 0.45, stretch: 2.0 }).rot(-0.9, 0, -0.6).at(S(0.3), S(1.38), S(0.4)),
      glowT([[-0.05, 1.18, -0.56], [-0.2, 1.3, -0.5], [-0.34, 1.36, -0.4]], 0.024),
      glowT([[0.05, 1.08, -0.58], [0.2, 0.98, -0.52], [0.3, 0.86, -0.4]], 0.022));
    rig.add('core', kit.gem(S(0.1), { color: C.glow, glow: 1, stretch: 1.3 }).rot(HALF_PI, 0, 0).at(0, S(1.12), S(-0.58)));
    // split skull thrust forward: two coarse slabs with a glowing seam, eyes burning in the gap
    rig.add('head',
      rk(0.2, { seed: 37 }).scale(1.25, 0.8, 1.1).at(0, S(1.5), S(-0.56)),
      rk(0.15, { seed: 43, color: C.rockD }).scale(1.5, 0.6, 1.0).at(0, S(1.36), S(-0.62)),
      glowT([[0, 1.62, -0.6], [0.02, 1.54, -0.7], [-0.01, 1.47, -0.74]], 0.016),
      kit.sphere(S(0.08), { color: C.glow, glow: 0.9, seg: 7, hseg: 4, scale: [1.3, 0.4, 0.5] }).at(0, S(1.36), S(-0.74)));
    const eye = slitEye(kit, S(0.045), -1, { glow: 1, iris: C.glow, tilt: 0.45 }).rot(0, 0.35, 0).at(S(-0.1), S(1.46), S(-0.72));
    rig.add('eyes', eye, eye.mirror());
    // arms: the right one is a huge boulder fist, the left a short jagged stump
    rig.add('armR', kit.merge([
      rk(0.3, { seed: 51 }).at(S(0.68), S(1.48), S(-0.1)),
      rk(0.26, { seed: 57, color: C.rockD }).scale(1, 1.3, 1).at(S(0.78), S(1.06), S(-0.16)),

      glowT([[0.7, 1.3, -0.3], [0.8, 1.0, -0.36], [0.84, 0.74, -0.5]], 0.018)]));

  define('golem', {

        kit.gem(0.05, { color: cold, glow: 0.7, stretch: 2.0 }).rot(HALF_PI - 0.4, 0, -0.7).at(-0.06, 0.71, -0.41),

      rig.add('browR', rk(0.07, { seed: 67, color: rime, mat: 'matte', detail: 0 }).scale(1.7, 0.5, 0.9).rot(0, 0, 0.35).at(0.08, 1.12, -0.39));
      rig.pivot('mouth', 'head', [0, 0.985, -0.43]);

  // =====================================================================================
  // ELECTRO GIANT - "Volt-Gorilla" (v11): a scarred silverback war-beast wired for battle.
  // Massive hunched shoulders, knuckle-walking long arms, low skull with a heavy brow ledge
  // (browL / browR), crackling volt-blue slit eyes, bared fangs (mouth shouts); blackened iron
  // harness with team-enamel pauldrons and chest plate, tesla-coil backpack with two pulsing
  // orbs (coreL / coreR), copper coil gauntlets with glowing knuckle studs.
  // =====================================================================================
  const GORI = { fur: 0x1f1e24, furL: 0x34323a, skin: 0x2a2730, skinL: 0x3c3843, volt: 0x6be4ff, copper: 0x9c5530 };
  define('electro-giant', {
    look: LOOK_GRIM,
    height: 2.12,
    outline: 0.06,
    anim: {
      body: 'biped', walk: 'stomp', attack: 'smash', tempo: 0.85, weight: 0.9, turnSpeed: 7,
      strikeIn: 0.09, strikeHold: 0.1, strikeOut: 0.42,
      keys: { 'body.rx': [0.05, 0.35, -0.5, -0.4], 'sq': [0, -0.08, 0.16, 0.08] },
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        const m = rig.__m || (rig.__m = { z: 0 });
        if (st && st.hurt) m.z = 1;
        m.z = Math.max(0, m.z - dt * 3);
        const buzz = 1 + 0.12 * Math.sin(a.rt * 31) + 0.45 * m.z + 0.25 * a.strike;
        for (const n of [rig.coreL, rig.coreR]) if (n) n.scale.multiplyScalar(buzz);

  // =====================================================================================
  // GIANT SKELETON - "Riesenskelett" (v11): a towering undead colossus of yellowed bone. Horned
  // skull with deep sockets burning cold cyan (eyes), cracked cranium, rusted iron half-crown,
  // hanging jaw full of teeth (jaw), heavy ribcage around a cold soul-fire, rusted team-enamel
  // pauldron, torn team loin banners on a spiked iron belt, a team rag tied round the arm,
  // long clawed bone hands, and the huge iron bomb strapped to its spine (lit fuse = core).

  const ZOMB = { bone: 0xcdbf9c, boneD: 0x8d7f62, rust: 0x4a3328, soul: 0x7ff3ff, socket: 0x050506 };
  define('giant-skeleton', {

        if (rig.core) rig.core.scale.multiplyScalar(0.8 + 0.4 * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(a.rt * 23 + a.seed * 5)));
      },
    },

      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, 0.68, 0.05]);
      rig.pivot('core', 'body', [0.12, 2.08, 0.6]);

        kit.sphere(r1, o2(Bn, { seg: 7, hseg: 5, scale: [1.1, 0.8, 1] })).at(b[0], b[1], b[2]),

        kit.blob(0.2, 0.07, 0.2, o2(Bn, { round: 0.5, seg: 7, hseg: 3 })).at(lx, 0.05, 0.0),
        [-0.05, 0, 0.05].map(dx => kit.tube([[lx + dx, 0.05, -0.06], [lx + dx * 1.3, 0.04, -0.15], [lx + dx * 1.4, 0.0, -0.2]], [0.018, 0.004], o2(Bn, { radial: 4, seg: 3 }))),
        kit.blob(0.15, 0.14, 0.08, { color: C.rust, mat: PLATE_D, round: 0.5, seg: 7, hseg: 3 }).at(lx - 0.01, 0.38, -0.08),

        kit.tube([[-0.5, 1.53, 0.0], [-0.24, 1.5, -0.16], [0, 1.48, -0.22], [0.24, 1.5, -0.16], [0.5, 1.53, 0.0]], 0.045, o2(Bn, { radial: 5, seg: 8 })),
        [-1, 1].map(sd => kit.blob(0.26, 0.3, 0.06, o2(Bn, { color: C.boneD, round: 0.5, taper: 0.6, seg: 7, hseg: 4 })).rot(0.2, 0, sd * 0.2).at(sd * 0.26, 1.34, 0.28)),
        kit.sphere(0.13, { color: C.soul, seg: 8, hseg: 6, glow: 0.7 }).at(0, 1.18, -0.02),
        kit.sphere(0.07, { color: 0xffffff, seg: 6, hseg: 4, glow: 1 }).at(0, 1.18, -0.06),
        // spiked iron belt + torn team loin banners (front / back)

    clothBlack: 0x18161c, clothBrown: 0x452e20, clothGrey: 0x53565e, navy: 0x1a2034, navyLight: 0x2d3650,

    wood: 'wood', woodLight: 'wood', woodDark: 'wood', leather: 'leather', leatherDark: 'leather', leatherLight: 'leather', fur: 'fur',

    if (o.team) parts.push(kit.sphere(r * 1.02, { color: o.team === true ? 'team' : o.team, seg: 12, theta: [0.38, 0.22], scale: [1.15, 0.8, 1.1], mat: 'cloth' }).rot(0, 0, -s * tilt).at(x, y + r * 0.01, z));
    if (o.rivets !== false) for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
      const an = i * 0.7;
      parts.push(kit.sphere(r * 0.075, { color: K.goldL, seg: 5, mat: 'gold' }).at(x + s * r * 0.95 * Math.cos(an) * 0.98, y - r * 0.1, z + r * 1.0 * Math.sin(an)));
    }
    const n = o.spikes || 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const f = n === 1 ? 0 : i / (n - 1) - 0.5;
      parts.push(spike(kit, [x + s * r * 0.3, y + r * 0.6, z + f * r * 1.1], [s * 0.45, 1, f * 0.6], r * (o.len || 1.0) * (1 - Math.abs(f) * 0.35), r * 0.2, o.spikeCol || K.steelL));
    }
    return kit.merge(parts);
  }
  // tattered cloth shell (cape / skirt / coat tail) revolved around Y: profile [[r, y], ...] from the
  // HEM (bottom) to the top; phi = [start, len] (0 = back +Z); jag = tatter depth; o.zs = depth scale
  function rag11(kit, prof, o) {
    o = o || {};
    const ybot = prof[0][1], jag = o.jag === undefined ? 0.07 : o.jag, n = o.teeth || 9, zone = o.zone || 0.16;
    const sh = kit.lathe(prof, { color: o.color || 'team', seg: o.seg || 16, phi: o.phi, double: o.inner || true, mat: o.mat || 'cloth', sharp: o.sharp });
    // v11 polish (G4): fabric folds - radial waves that open towards the hem (card art + desktop)
    const ytop = prof[prof.length - 1][1], FN = o.folds === false || !kit.hi ? 0 : (o.folds || 14), FA = o.foldAmp === undefined ? 0.075 : o.foldAmp;
    return bend(sh, (x, y, z) => {
      const d = y - ybot;
      if (FN) {
        const an = Math.atan2(x, z), w = clamp((ytop - y) / (ytop - ybot || 1), 0, 1);
        const k = 1 + FA * (0.25 + 0.75 * w) * (Math.sin(an * FN + (o.seed || 0)) * 0.75 + Math.sin(an * FN * 2.3 + 1.3) * 0.25);
        x *= k; z *= k;
      }
      if (d < zone) {
        const an = Math.atan2(x, z) * n + (o.seed || 0);
        const tri = Math.abs(((an / PI) % 2 + 2) % 2 - 1);           // 0..1 sawtooth
        const w = 1 - d / zone;
        y += jag * w * tri * (0.7 + 0.3 * Math.sin(an * 1.7));
      }
      return [x, y, z * (o.zs || 1)];
    }, 50);
  }
  // simple straight blade (flat, facing -Z / along +Y): length len, width w; o.serr = serrations
  function blade11(kit, len, w, o) {
    o = o || {};
    const pts = [[-w * 0.5, 0], [w * 0.5, 0]];
    if (o.serr) {
      const n = o.serr;
      for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) { const t = i / (n + 1); pts.push([w * 0.5 + w * 0.22 * (i % 2), len * t * 0.8]); }
    }
    pts.push([w * 0.5, len * 0.78], [0, len], [-w * 0.42, len * 0.8]);
    return kit.extrude(pts, o.depth || w * 0.16, { color: o.color || K.steelL, mat: 'metal', smooth: false, bevel: o.bevel });
  }
  // heroic torso parts from the hip height y0: pelvis, belly, V-shaped chest, neck.
  // o: { w (chest width 0.44), d (depth 0.27), h (hip -> neck 0.5), chest, belly, pelvis, neck,
  //      taper (shoulder flare), fem (narrow waist, wider hips), mat }
  function torso11(kit, y0, o) {
    const w = o.w || 0.44, d = o.d || 0.27, h = o.h || 0.5, m = o.mat, fem = o.fem ? 1 : 0;
    return [
      kit.blob(w * (0.74 + 0.1 * fem), h * 0.42, d * 0.84, { color: o.pelvis || o.belly || o.chest, round: 0.5, seg: 10, mat: o.pelvisMat || m }).at(0, y0 + h * 0.15, 0),
      kit.blob(w * (0.68 - 0.08 * fem), h * 0.4, d * 0.8, { color: o.belly || o.chest, round: 0.5, seg: 10, mat: o.bellyMat || m }).at(0, y0 + h * 0.4, 0),
      kit.blob(w, h * 0.56, d, { color: o.chest, round: 0.5, taper: o.taper || 1.15, bottom: 0.78, bulge: 0.14, seg: 12, mat: m }).at(0, y0 + h * 0.66, 0),
      kit.rcyl(w * 0.115, w * 0.13, h * 0.2, { color: o.neck || K.skin, seg: 9, mat: o.neckMat || 'skin' }).at(0, y0 + h * 0.96, 0.005),
    ];
  }

  // v11 goblin base: lean, hunched, sinewy, long pointed ears (ear spring), hooked nose, fanged
  // grin, glowing eyes, bare clawed feet with leg wraps, ragged team loincloth (tail spring).
  // Creates legL/legR, body, tail, head, ear, armL, armR + face pivots. Returns { HY, HR, ao }.
  function gob11(kit, rig, o) {
    const HIP = 0.44, HY = 0.9, HZ = -0.07, HR = 0.094, skin = o.skin, skinD = o.skinD;
    legs11(kit, rig, { x: 0.08, hip: HIP, r: 0.052, pants: skin, pantsMat: 'skin', boot: skinD, bootMat: 'skin', bootH: 0.3, bootL: 1.1, cuff: o.wrap || K.linen, claw: true, knee: kit.hi ? skinD : undefined, kneeMat: 'skin' });
    const mott = (x, y, z) => { const v = Math.sin(x * 157 + y * 61) * Math.sin(y * 131 - z * 83) + Math.sin(z * 149 + x * 47) * 0.5; return v > 1.05 ? mixH(skin, skinD, 0.75) : v < -1.2 ? mixH(skin, 0xd0c080, 0.22) : null; };
    rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, HIP, 0]);
    rig.pivot('tail', 'body', [0, 0.5, 0.1]);
    rig.pivot('head', 'body', [0, 0.8, -0.07]);
    rig.pivot('ear', 'head', [0, HY + 0.01, HZ]);
    rig.pivot('armL', 'body', [-0.155, 0.74, -0.03]);
    rig.pivot('armR', 'body', [0.155, 0.74, -0.03]);
    // hunched sinewy torso (leans forward), ribs, belt, ragged team loincloth
    rig.add('body',
      kit.blob(0.21, 0.17, 0.16, { color: skin, round: 0.5, seg: 10, mat: 'skin' }).at(0, 0.52, 0),
      kit.blob(0.3, 0.27, 0.21, { color: skin, round: 0.45, taper: 1.2, bottom: 0.62, bulge: 0.08, seg: 12, mat: 'skin' }).paint(mott).rot(0.42, 0, 0).at(0, 0.68, -0.04),
      // sinewy detail: ribs along the flanks, spine knobs on the hump
      (kit.hi ? [-1, 1] : []).map(sx => [0, 1, 2].map(i => kit.tube([[sx * 0.095, 0.72 - i * 0.04, -0.105 + i * 0.012], [sx * 0.125, 0.705 - i * 0.04, -0.075 + i * 0.01], [sx * 0.14, 0.69 - i * 0.04, -0.035]], 0.006, { color: mixH(skin, skinD, 0.5), radial: 4, seg: 4, mat: 'skin' }))),
      (kit.hi ? [0, 1, 2, 3] : [0, 2]).map(i => kit.sphere(0.016 - i * 0.002, { color: skinD, seg: 6, mat: 'skin' }).at(0, 0.84 - i * 0.07, 0.07 + i * 0.022)),
      kit.blob(0.2, 0.13, 0.12, { color: skinD, round: 0.6, seg: 9, mat: 'skin' }).rot(0.6, 0, 0).at(0, 0.77, 0.05),
      kit.rcyl(0.036, 0.044, 0.09, { color: skin, seg: 8, mat: 'skin' }).rot(0.9, 0, 0).at(0, 0.8, -0.07),
      kit.ring(0.115, 0.018, { color: K.leaD, seg: [4, 12], scale: [1, 1, 0.8], mat: 'leather' }).at(0, 0.49, 0),
      rag11(kit, [[0.13, 0.33], [0.125, 0.42], [0.118, 0.49]], { color: o.cloth || 'team', inner: 'teamDark', phi: [PI - 0.55, 1.1], jag: 0.05, teeth: 3, zone: 0.05 }),
      kit.tube([[-0.12, 0.79, -0.02], [-0.02, 0.68, -0.115], [0.1, 0.52, -0.08]], 0.014, { color: K.leaD, radial: 4, seg: 4, caps: false, mat: 'leather' }));
    // tattered team shoulder rag over the hunched back (team reads from the battle camera)
    if (o.mantle !== false) rig.add('body', rag11(kit, [[0.19, 0.6], [0.2, 0.7], [0.18, 0.8], [0.11, 0.87]], { color: o.cloth || 'team', inner: 'teamDark', phi: [-1.35, 2.7], jag: 0.06, teeth: 5, zone: 0.07, zs: 0.95, seg: 12 }).rot(-0.25, 0, 0).at(0, 0.0, 0.17));
    rig.add('tail', rag11(kit, [[0.13, 0.28], [0.126, 0.4], [0.118, 0.5]], { color: o.cloth || 'team', inner: 'teamDark', phi: [-0.6, 1.2], jag: 0.06, teeth: 3, zone: 0.07 }).at(0, 0, -0.02));
    const F = head11(kit, rig, { y: HY, z: HZ, r: HR, skin, jaw: 0.65, long: 1.02, wide: 0.95, glow: o.eyes || 0xffc23a, eyeW: 1.15, tilt: 0.36, brow: skinD, browK: 1.4, browRidge: 1.8, scowl: 0.5, mouth: HR * 0.85, teeth: false, snag: 5, fangs: 1.1, tusks: 1.25, noseK: 1.7, hook: 0.9, cheeks: 0.1, mask: o.mask,
      paint: (x, y, z, u, ax) => (u > 0.3 && u < 0.62 && Math.abs(Math.sin(u * 38)) < 0.22 && ax < 0.5 && z < 0 ? skinD : null) });
    rig.add('head', F.parts);
    const leaf = (L, W, c, d) => bend(kit.extrude([[0, -W * 0.5], [-L * 0.1, W * 0.45], [-L * 0.4, W * 0.38], [-L * 0.55, W * 0.12], [-L * 0.7, W * 0.2], [-L, W * 0.1], [-L * 0.75, -W * 0.25], [-L * 0.35, -W * 0.55]], d, { color: c, mat: 'skin' }),
      (x, y, z) => [x, y + x * x * 0.9, z + x * x * 1.2 - Math.abs(y) * 0.3], 45);
    const ear = kit.merge([
      leaf(HR * 1.9, HR * 0.62, skin, 0.014).rot(0, 0.35, -0.3).at(-HR * 0.8, HY + HR * 0.05, HZ + HR * 0.12),
      kit.ring(HR * 0.1, HR * 0.035, { color: K.gold, seg: [4, 8], mat: 'gold' }).rot(0.3, 0, 1.3).at(-HR * 1.25, HY + HR * 0.02, HZ + HR * 0.12),
    ]);
    rig.add('ear', ear, ear.mirror());
    const ao = { sx: 0.155, sy: 0.74, hx: 0.2, hy: 0.4, hz: -0.07, r: 0.036, sleeve: skin, mat: 'skin', bracer: o.wrap || K.linen, skin, fistMat: 'skin', fistR: 0.032, claws: K.horn, elbowOut: 0.04 };
    return { HY, HZ, HR, ao, F };
  }

  // =====================================================================================
  // ARCHER - "Ninja": anime ninja archer. Spiky blue-black hair with a high springy ponytail,
  // navy half mask, big sharp eyes, team headband with a PLAIN steel plate + long tails, team
  // neck scarf, team guard on the bow shoulder, quiver, big recurve bow
  // =====================================================================================
  define('archer', {
    tess: 0.72,
    height: 1.52,
    outline: 0.05,
    anim: {
      body: 'biped', walk: 'dash', attack: 'bow', tempo: 1.05, weight: 0.2, stringRest: 0.05, reload: 0.3,
      strikeHold: 0.08,
      keys: {
        'root.py': [-0.035, -0.06, -0.02, -0.03], 'legsL.rx': [0.32, 0.36, 0.28, 0.3], 'legsR.rx': [-0.28, -0.3, -0.24, -0.26],
        'body.rx': [0.04, 0.07, -0.04, 0.02], 'head.rx': [0.06, 0.1, 0.02, 0.05],
      },
      springs: { scarves: { max: 0.95 }, springs: { max: 0.7 } },
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        // carry the bow upright-ish while not aiming
        rig.weapon.rotation.x += 1.15 * (1 - a.aim);
        rig.weapon.rotation.z += 0.2 * (1 - a.aim);
        // release snap: the string hand flies back, torso recoils, ponytail whips
        const k = kick(a, 0.26);
        rig.armR.rotation.z += 0.32 * k;
        rig.body.rotation.x -= 0.05 * k;
        rig.hairTail.rotation.x -= 0.25 * k;
      },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.35, pitch: 0.12, zoom: 1.9, pose: "idle" },
    build(kit) {
      // v11: lean hooded ranger. Deep team hood (glint of narrow eyes in the shadow), leather
      // face mask, tattered team mantle, leather jerkin with a steel bow-shoulder pauldron,
      // bracers, quiver of black-fletched arrows, long blackened recurve bow with blade tips
      const rig = kit.rig();
      const HIP = 0.72, HY = 1.335, HR = 0.108;
      legs11(kit, rig, { x: 0.092, hip: HIP, r: 0.084, pants: K.cloth, boot: K.lea, cuff: K.leaL, knee: K.leaD, kneeMat: 'leather', bootH: 0.44 });
      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, HIP, 0]);
      rig.pivot('scarf', 'body', [0, 1.17, 0.11]);
      rig.pivot('head', 'body', [0, 1.21, 0]);
      rig.pivot('hair', 'head', [0, HY + 0.15, 0.03]);
      rig.pivot('hairTail', 'head', [0, HY + 0.08, 0.14]);
      rig.pivot('scarfB', 'head', [0, HY - 0.02, 0.1]);
      rig.pivot('armL', 'body', [-0.225, 1.13, 0]);
      rig.pivot('armR', 'body', [0.225, 1.13, 0]);
      const HL = [-0.275, 0.66, -0.05], HRh = [0.275, 0.66, -0.05];
      rig.pivot('weapon', 'armL', HL);
      rig.pivot('string', 'weapon', [HL[0], HL[1] + 0.18, HL[2]], { rot: [-HP, 0, 0] });
      rig.pivot('arrow', 'armR', HRh);

      // torso: leather jerkin over dark cloth, belt + gold buckle, team sash, team loin flaps
      const fin = (c) => kit.extrude([[0, 0], [0.034, 0.02], [0.036, 0.1], [0, 0.082]], 0.005, { color: c, mat: 'cloth' });
      const qp = [
        kit.rcyl(0.066, 0.054, 0.4, { color: K.lea, seg: 12, mat: 'leather' }),
        kit.ring(0.068, 0.01, { color: K.gold, seg: [4, 14], mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 0.17, 0),
        kit.ring(0.058, 0.01, { color: K.gold, seg: [4, 14], mat: 'gold' }).at(0, -0.15, 0),
      ];
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        const ax = (i - 1) * 0.026, az = (i % 2) * 0.014;
        qp.push(kit.cylinder(0.008, 0.008, 0.16, { color: K.woodD, seg: 6, open: true }).at(ax, 0.26 + i * 0.006, az));
        for (let f = 0; f < 3; f++) qp.push(fin(i === 1 ? 'team' : 0x15121a).rot(0, f * TAU / 3 + i, 0).at(ax, 0.29 + i * 0.006, az));
      }
      const quiver = kit.merge(qp).rot(0.18, 0, -0.45).at(0.07, 1.0, 0.17);
      const flap = (w, h, z, c) => bend(kit.extrude([[-w / 2, 0], [w / 2, 0], [w * 0.42, -h * 0.85], [w * 0.15, -h], [-w * 0.1, -h * 0.82], [-w * 0.45, -h * 0.95]], 0.012, { color: c, mat: 'cloth' }),
        (x, y, zz) => [x, y, zz + (z < 0 ? -1 : 1) * y * y * 0.6], 50).at(0, 0.87, z);
      rig.add('body',
        kit.blob(0.32, 0.21, 0.22, { color: K.cloth, round: 0.5, taper: 1.0, seg: 10 }).at(0, 0.8, 0),
        kit.blob(0.3, 0.2, 0.21, { color: K.lea, round: 0.5, seg: 10, mat: 'leather' }).at(0, 0.93, 0),
        kit.blob(0.45, 0.29, 0.27, { color: K.lea, round: 0.5, taper: 1.16, bottom: 0.78, bulge: 0.14, seg: 12, mat: 'leather' }).at(0, 1.06, 0),
        // belly lames under the cowl
        [0, 1].map(i => kit.lathe([[0.155 - i * 0.008, 0.0], [0.162 - i * 0.008, 0.035]], { color: i ? K.lea : K.leaL, seg: 12, phi: [PI * 0.55, PI * 0.9], mat: 'leather' }).scale(1, 1, 0.78).at(0, 0.96 - i * 0.045, -0.005)),
        // stitched seam + chest straps
        kit.tube([[-0.16, 1.15, -0.06], [-0.02, 1.02, -0.125], [0.13, 0.88, -0.1]], 0.016, { color: K.leaD, radial: 4, seg: 4, caps: false, mat: 'leather' }),
        kit.tube([[0.16, 1.16, -0.05], [0.04, 1.06, -0.13], [-0.1, 0.9, -0.1]], 0.024, { color: 'team', radial: 5, seg: 4, caps: false, mat: 'cloth' }),
        kit.ring(0.165, 0.024, { color: K.leaD, seg: [4, 14], scale: [1, 1, 0.78], mat: 'leather' }).at(0, 0.87, 0),
        kit.box(0.055, 0.045, 0.02, { color: K.gold, bevel: 0.008, mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 0.87, -0.135),
        flap(0.16, 0.3, -0.12, 'team'), flap(0.18, 0.34, 0.115, 'teamDark'),
        kit.rcyl(0.05, 0.056, 0.1, { color: K.leaD, seg: 9, mat: 'leather' }).at(0, 1.21, 0.0),
        // layered team shoulder cape, open at the front (the jerkin + straps stay visible), jagged
        // hem, folds; top view reads team
        rag11(kit, [[0.29, 0.96], [0.29, 1.04], [0.265, 1.12], [0.19, 1.19], [0.09, 1.235]], { color: 'team', inner: K.clothD, phi: [-2.25, 4.5], jag: 0.07, teeth: 9, zone: 0.08, zs: 0.82, seg: 18 }),
        rag11(kit, [[0.25, 1.07], [0.245, 1.12], [0.2, 1.18], [0.1, 1.23]], { color: 'teamDark', inner: K.clothD, phi: [-2.0, 4.0], jag: 0.05, teeth: 7, zone: 0.05, zs: 0.84, seg: kit.hi ? 16 : 10, seed: 1.3 }).scale(1.06, 1, 1.06),
        // gold clasp + chain across the open front
        kit.hi ? [[-1, 1].map(sx => kit.rcyl(0.022, 0.022, 0.012, { color: K.gold, seg: 10, mat: 'gold' }).rot(HP - 0.3, 0, 0).at(sx * 0.105, 1.19, -0.105)),
          kit.tube([[-0.1, 1.185, -0.118], [0, 1.16, -0.132], [0.1, 1.185, -0.118]], 0.006, { color: K.goldD, radial: 4, seg: 4, mat: 'gold' })] : [],
        quiver);
      // tattered team mantle (scarf spring)
      rig.add('scarf', rag11(kit, [[0.25, 0.76], [0.24, 0.9], [0.22, 1.04], [0.18, 1.15], [0.1, 1.2]], { phi: [-1.35, 2.7], jag: 0.09, teeth: 7, zs: 0.85, inner: 'teamDark' }).at(0, 0, 0.02));

      // head: angular face, leather mask, deep team hood with a gold-trimmed brim
      const F = head11(kit, rig, { y: HY, r: HR, jaw: 0.4, long: 1.16, eye: 0x8fa68a, eyeW: 1.08, mouth: false, mask: K.leaD, maskTrim: K.lea, brow: K.hairB, browK: 0.95, scowl: 0.38, cheeks: 0.06, scar: -1, hooded: 1 });
      rig.add('head', F.parts, hood11(kit, HR, 0, HY, 0, { color: 'team', inner: K.clothD, k: 1.32, peak: 0.75, rimW: 0.05, gap: 1.5, overhang: 0.8, drop: 2.55, flare: 0.75 }));
      rig.add('hair', kit.ring(0.03, 0.009, { color: K.gold, seg: [4, 10], mat: 'gold' }).rot(0.9, 0, 0).at(0, HY + 0.13, 0.12));
      // hood point (liripipe) bouncing behind
      rig.add('hairTail', lock(kit, [[0, HY + 0.09, 0.12], [0, HY + 0.02, 0.2], [0.02, HY - 0.12, 0.23], [0.03, HY - 0.26, 0.2]], 0.05, 0.012, 'team', { radial: 6, seg: 6 }));
      // mask tie tails
      const tail = lock(kit, [[0, HY - 0.02, HR * 0.95], [-0.02, HY - 0.07, HR * 1.3], [-0.04, HY - 0.15, HR * 1.5]], 0.016, 0.01, K.leaD, { radial: 4, seg: 4, scale: [0.45, 1, 1] });
      rig.add('scarfB', tail, tail.clone().rot(0, 0.5, 0.25).at(0.015, -0.01, 0.0));

      // arms: dark sleeves, leather bracers with gold rims, leather gloves; steel pauldron on the bow arm
      const ao = { sx: 0.225, sy: 1.13, hx: 0.275, hy: 0.66, hz: -0.05, r: 0.055, sleeve: K.cloth, bracer: K.lea, bracerTrim: K.gold, skin: K.leaD, fistR: 0.042 };
      rig.add('armL', arm11(kit, -1, ao), pauld11(kit, -1, -0.24, 1.16, 0, 0.1, { spikes: 2, len: 1.1, team: true }));
      rig.add('armR', arm11(kit, 1, ao), kit.sphere(0.08, { color: K.lea, seg: 10, theta: [0, 1.4], scale: [1.1, 0.8, 1.05], mat: 'leather' }).rot(0, 0, -0.5).at(0.235, 1.15, 0));

      // long recurve bow: blackened lacquer limbs, team grip, gold ferrules, blade-like tips
      const bx = HL[0], by = HL[1], bz = HL[2];
      const bowPath = [[0, 0.19, -0.6], [0, 0.07, -0.4], [0, -0.005, -0.14], [0, -0.015, 0], [0, -0.005, 0.14], [0, 0.07, 0.4], [0, 0.19, 0.6]]
        .map(q => [bx + q[0], by + q[1], bz + q[2]]);
      rig.add('weapon',
        kit.tube(bowPath, (u) => 0.012 + 0.02 * Math.sin(Math.PI * u), { color: 0x1a1416, radial: 6, seg: 20, mat: 'lacquer' }),
        kit.cylinder(0.03, 0.03, 0.12, { color: 'team', seg: 8, open: true }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(bx, by - 0.01, bz),
        [-1, 1].map(k => kit.ring(0.032, 0.008, { color: K.gold, seg: [4, 12], mat: 'gold' }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(bx, by - 0.01, bz + k * 0.062)),
