  // =====================================================================================
  // MUSKETEER - "Revolver-Rita": anime gunslinger girl. Big green eyes with lashes, confident

  // =====================================================================================
  define('musketeer', {

        rig.armL.rotation.x += 0.22 * a.aim;

        // shot: hat bounces, ponytail whips forward

        rig.hat.rotation.x -= 0.22 * k;
        rig.hairTail.rotation.x += 0.2 * k;
      },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.4, pitch: 0.12, zoom: 2.0, pose: "idle" },
    build(kit) {
      // v11: grim musketeer captain. Blackened steel cuirass with gold trim over a long split

      // auburn braid, scarred narrow-eyed face, long brass-banded musket with a bayonet
      const rig = kit.rig();
      const HIP = 0.74, HY = 1.315, HR = 0.1;

      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, HIP, 0]);

      rig.pivot('hat', 'head', [0, HY + 0.07, 0]);
      rig.pivot('hair', 'head', [0, HY + 0.06, 0]);

      rig.pivot('armL', 'body', [-0.205, 1.12, 0]);
      rig.pivot('armR', 'body', [0.205, 1.12, 0]);

        rag11(kit, [[0.19, 0.8], [0.17, 0.86], [0.158, 0.9]], { color: doub, inner: doubD, phi: [-2.7, 5.4], jag: 0.035, teeth: 8, zone: 0.04, zs: 0.82, seg: 18, folds: 10 }),

        kit.tube([[-0.17, 1.17, -0.06], [-0.04, 1.03, -0.15], [0.14, 0.86, -0.1]], 0.024, { color: 'team', radial: 5, seg: 4, caps: false, mat: 'cloth' }),

        kit.tube([[-0.05, 1.2, -0.11], [0.05, 1.12, -0.14], [0.15, 1.02, -0.12]], 0.01, { color: K.gold, radial: 4, seg: 4, mat: 'gold' }),
        kit.rcyl(0.022, 0.022, 0.014, { color: K.gold, seg: 12, mat: 'gold' }).rot(HP - 0.4, 0, 0).at(-0.06, 1.19, -0.115),
        kit.gem(0.013, { color: 'teamGlow', mat: 'gem', glow: 0.5 }).rot(HP - 0.4, 0, 0).at(-0.06, 1.192, -0.127));

      // head: lean angular face, scar, dark lips, auburn hair framing the face
      const F = head11(kit, rig, { y: HY, r: HR, jaw: 0.2, long: 1.12, eye: 0x4f8a4a, eyeW: 1.12, brow: 0x2a0e08, browK: 0.85, scowl: 0.26, cheeks: 0.07, mouth: 0.038, teeth: false, scar: 1, scalp: hairC, hairline: 0.5, lip: 0x7a2a2c });
      // hair in strands (G2.8): swept side parting under the hat, wavy locks framing the face down
      // to the shoulders, a braid with a gold ring behind
      const curl = (sx, k) => {
        const pts = [];
        for (let i = 0; i <= 7; i++) {
          const t = i / 7, w = Math.sin(t * PI * 2.2 + k) * 0.016 * (0.3 + t);
          pts.push([sx * (0.085 + 0.02 * k + 0.012 * t + w), HY + 0.06 - t * (0.22 + 0.04 * k), -0.05 + 0.045 * k + 0.04 * t + w * 0.6]);

      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i += kit.hi ? 1 : 2) braid.push(kit.sphere(0.03 - i * 0.0025, { color: i % 2 ? hairC : mixH(hairC, 0xe0a070, 0.18), seg: 8, scale: [1, 1.5, 0.8], mat: 'hair' }).rot(0, 0, (i % 2 ? 0.45 : -0.45)).at((i % 2 ? 0.007 : -0.007), HY - 0.05 - i * 0.05, 0.12 + i * 0.006));
      braid.push(kit.cone(0.018, 0.06, { color: hairC, seg: 6, mat: 'hair' }).rot(PI, 0, 0).at(0, HY - 0.36, 0.15));

  // =====================================================================================
  // WIZARD - "Kokel-Magier": hot-headed young fire mage. Big flame-orange spiky hair (tips
  // glow yellow) with a springy burning tuft, team circlet with a fire gem, glowing fire eyes,
  // popped high collar, team mage coat with gold trim, fireball swelling in his palm
  // =====================================================================================
  define('wizard', {
    tess: 0.5,
    height: 1.6,
    outline: 0.05,
    anim: {
      body: 'biped', walk: 'march', attack: 'cast', tempo: 1, weight: 0.3, strikeHold: 0.08, strikeOut: 0.5,
      keys: Object.assign({}, NO_ARMS, {
        // wind-up: right palm pulled back beside the ear, torso coiled; impact: palm shoved forward
        'arm.rx': [0.6, 2.2, 1.55, 1.25], 'arm.rz': [0.1, 0.25, -0.2, -0.1], 'off.rx': [0.5, 0.7, 1.2, 0.95], 'off.rz': [-0.15, -0.45, -0.1, -0.15],

        'legsL.rx': [0.15, 0.1, 0.45, 0.35], 'legsR.rx': [-0.12, -0.05, -0.4, -0.3], 'root.pz': [0, 0.06, -0.14, -0.1],
      }),

      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {

        const fb = (0.7 + 0.9 * a.windup) * (1 - 0.85 * rel) * (1 + 0.07 * Math.sin(t * 17 + a.seed * 9));
        rig.coreR.scale.set(fb, fb * (1 + 0.06 * Math.sin(t * 23)), fb);
        const fl = 0.85 + 0.5 * a.windup + 0.08 * Math.sin(t * 19 + a.seed * 3);
        rig.coreL.scale.set(fl, fl, fl);
        // keep the flames pointing up whatever the arm does
        rig.coreR.rotation.x = -rig.armR.rotation.x - rig.body.rotation.x;
        rig.coreR.rotation.z = -rig.armR.rotation.z;
        rig.coreL.rotation.x = -rig.armL.rotation.x - rig.body.rotation.x;
        // burning hair flickers
        rig.hair.scale.y *= 1 + 0.05 * Math.sin(t * 13 + a.seed * 5) + 0.12 * a.windup;
      },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.45, pitch: 0.12, zoom: 1.95, pose: "attack" },
    build(kit) {
      // v11: gaunt battle-pyromancer. Shaved skull under a black iron circlet crowned with living

      rig.pivot('hair', 'head', [0, HY + 0.085, 0]);
      rig.pivot('hairTip', 'head', [0, HY + 0.12, 0.03]);
      rig.pivot('armL', 'body', [-0.215, 1.13, 0]);
      rig.pivot('armR', 'body', [0.215, 1.13, 0]);

      rig.pivot('coreR', 'armR', [HRh[0], HRh[1] - 0.02, HRh[2] - 0.09]);

      const robe = deepTeam(kit, 0.4), robeD = deepTeam(kit, 0.72);

        (x, y, z) => [x, y, z - y * y * 0.5], 50);
      const rune = kit.extrude([[0, 0.05], [0.025, 0.0], [0.012, 0.0], [0.02, -0.04], [0, -0.015], [-0.02, -0.04], [-0.012, 0], [-0.025, 0]], 0.006, { color: 0xffa020, glow: 0.95, smooth: false });
      rig.add('body',

        kit.tube([[-0.13, 0.92, -0.12], [-0.16, 0.6, -0.17], [-0.2, 0.3, -0.21], [-0.23, 0.1, -0.22]], 0.011, { color: K.gold, radial: 4, seg: 6, mat: 'gold' }),
        kit.tube([[0.13, 0.92, -0.12], [0.16, 0.6, -0.17], [0.2, 0.3, -0.21], [0.23, 0.1, -0.22]], 0.011, { color: K.gold, radial: 4, seg: 6, mat: 'gold' }),
        // upper robe over the chest + belt + tabard
        kit.blob(0.42, 0.3, 0.27, { color: robe, round: 0.5, taper: 1.18, bottom: 0.82, bulge: 0.1, seg: 12, mat: 'cloth' }).at(0, 1.05, 0.006),

        [-1, 1].map(sx => bend(kit.extrude([[sx * 0.02, 0], [sx * 0.085, 0.015], [sx * 0.095, -0.05], [sx * 0.04, -0.22], [sx * 0.018, -0.24]], 0.01, { color: robeD, mat: 'cloth' }), (x, y, z) => [x, y, z - x * x * 2.6], 50).at(0, 1.2, -0.14)),
        [-1, 1].map(sx => kit.tube([[sx * 0.11, 1.22, -0.125], [sx * 0.08, 1.06, -0.15], [sx * 0.025, 0.9, -0.14]], 0.008, { color: K.gold, radial: 4, seg: 6, mat: 'gold' })),
        kit.hi ? [-1, 1].map(sx => kit.tube([[sx * 0.17, 1.13, -0.1], [sx * 0.14, 1.0, -0.125], [sx * 0.12, 0.9, -0.12]], 0.006, { color: robeD, radial: 3, seg: 4, mat: 'cloth' })) : [],
        kit.ring(0.165, 0.026, { color: K.leaD, seg: [4, 14], scale: [1, 1, 0.8], mat: 'leather' }).at(0, 0.88, 0),

        tab.at(0, 0.87, -0.14), rune.at(0, 0.7, -0.165),
        // high spiked collar behind the head

        [-0.9, -0.3, 0.3, 0.9].map(an => spike(kit, [Math.sin(an) * 0.19, 1.4, Math.cos(an) * 0.17], [Math.sin(an) * 0.4, 1, Math.cos(an) * 0.5], 0.1, 0.018, K.steelD)),
        kit.tube([-1.4, -0.9, -0.45, 0, 0.45, 0.9, 1.4].map(an => [Math.sin(an) * 0.2, 1.42, Math.cos(an) * 0.18]), 0.01, { color: K.gold, radial: 4, seg: 12, mat: 'gold' }),
        // v11 polish: belt with a chained grimoire (left hip) and a hanging skull (right hip)
        kit.hi ? [kit.box(0.1, 0.13, 0.04, { color: 0x2a1410, bevel: 0.008, mat: 'leather' }).rot(0.1, 0.5, 0.12).at(-0.19, 0.78, -0.07),
        kit.box(0.104, 0.12, 0.03, { color: 0xbab0a0, bevel: 0.004, mat: 'cloth' }).rot(0.1, 0.5, 0.12).at(-0.186, 0.78, -0.07),
        [-1, 1].map(k => kit.box(0.022, 0.022, 0.046, { color: K.gold, bevel: 0.004, mat: 'gold' }).rot(0.1, 0.5, 0.12).at(-0.19 + k * 0.036, 0.78 + k * 0.055, -0.07 - k * 0.02)),

      // head: gaunt, shaved, ember eyes, black goatee, iron circlet
      const F = head11(kit, rig, { y: HY, r: HR, skin: K.skinPale, jaw: 0.35, long: 1.2, glow: 0xff8a1a, eyeW: 1.05, brow: 0x1a0c08, scowl: 0.38, cheeks: 0.13, mouth: 0.04, teeth: true, beard: 0x1a0f0a, beardL: 0.9, stache: 'up', ears: 'human', stubble: 0x7d6e66, scar: 1 });

      const fl = [];

  // =====================================================================================
  // WITCH - "Grusel-Gräfin": gothic vampire countess gliding above the ground. Pale face,
  // sharp violet glowing eyes, little fangs, long violet twin tails (springs) with team bows,
  // huge spiky collar, team cape, crescent-moon staff with a glowing orb, two orbiting bats
  // =====================================================================================
  define('witch', {
    tess: 0.8,
    height: 1.66,
    outline: 0.05,
    anim: {
      body: 'biped', walk: 'float', attack: 'cast', tempo: 1, weight: 0.25, spinRate: 2.2, strikeHold: 0.1, strikeOut: 0.55,
      keys: Object.assign({}, NO_ARMS, {
        // staff raised high (wind-up), slammed forward on the summon, off hand flung wide
        'arm.rx': [0.5, 2.2, 1.1, 0.85], 'arm.rz': [0.05, 0.15, -0.05, 0], 'off.rx': [0.3, 0.8, 0.5, 0.4], 'off.rz': [-0.2, -0.5, -0.9, -0.75],
        'body.rx': [0, -0.1, -0.1, -0.05], 'head.rx': [0, -0.12, 0.05, 0.03], 'root.py': [0, 0.08, -0.03, 0],
        'weapon.rx': [0, 0.2, -0.4, -0.3],
      }),
      springs: { capes: { max: 0.7 }, springs: { max: 0.8, f: 3.4 } },
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        // hover: she never touches the ground; gown sways
        rig.root.position.y += 0.06 + 0.03 * Math.sin(t * 2.2 + a.seed * 6);
        rig.body.rotation.z += 0.03 * Math.sin(t * 1.7 + a.seed);
        // orb charges with the windup and flares on release
        const o = 1 + 0.7 * a.windup + 0.6 * kick(a, 0.3) + 0.08 * Math.sin(t * 6 + a.seed * 4);
        rig.core.scale.set(o, o, o);
        rig.spinBats.position.y += 0.05 * Math.sin(t * 3.3 + a.seed * 7);
        rig.spinBats.rotation.z = 0.12 * Math.sin(t * 2.7 + a.seed * 3);

    portrait: { yaw: -0.4, pitch: 0.12, zoom: 1.7, pose: "attack" },
    build(kit) {
      // v11: gaunt necromancer queen hovering over the ground. Ashen skin, violet soul-fire eyes,
      // crown of black horns, long raven hair, tall spiked collar, black gown with team panels and
      // a tattered team cape, corset with gold lacing, clawed fingers, skull staff with a soul orb,
      // two red-eyed bats circling
      const rig = kit.rig();
      const HY = 1.35, HR = 0.098, skin = K.skinAsh, hairC = 0x0c0a10, gown = 0x141017, gownD = 0x0a080c;
      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, 0.72, 0]);
      rig.pivot('cape', 'body', [0, 1.16, 0.1]);
      rig.pivot('head', 'body', [0, 1.22, 0]);

      rig.pivot('armL', 'body', [-0.19, 1.12, 0]);
      rig.pivot('armR', 'body', [0.19, 1.12, 0]);
      const HRh = [0.25, 0.68, -0.06];
      rig.pivot('weapon', 'armR', HRh);
      rig.pivot('core', 'weapon', [HRh[0], HRh[1] + 0.82, HRh[2] - 0.03]);
      rig.pivot('spinBats', 'root', [0, HY + 0.05, 0]);

      // gown: tattered bell skirt, team front panel + hem band, corset, spiked collar
      const panel = bend(kit.extrude([[-0.08, 0], [0.08, 0], [0.14, -0.66], [0.06, -0.72], [0, -0.68], [-0.07, -0.74], [-0.14, -0.66]], 0.012, { color: 'team', mat: 'cloth' }),
        (x, y, z) => [x, y, z - y * y * 0.16], 50);
      rig.add('body',
        torso11(kit, 0.72, { w: 0.34, d: 0.22, h: 0.5, chest: gown, belly: K.lea, pelvis: gown, neck: skin, fem: true, bellyMat: 'leather' }),
        rag11(kit, [[0.36, 0.04], [0.33, 0.2], [0.27, 0.45], [0.2, 0.72], [0.16, 0.86]], { color: gown, inner: gownD, jag: 0.09, teeth: 12, zone: 0.14, zs: 0.9, seg: 22 }),
        rag11(kit, [[0.335, 0.2], [0.33, 0.25]], { color: 'team', inner: 'teamDark', jag: 0.0, zone: 0.01, zs: 0.9, seg: 22 }),
        panel.at(0, 0.84, -0.17),
        // corset lacing + gold busk
        [0.84, 0.9, 0.96, 1.02].map(y => kit.tube([[-0.035, y, -0.112], [0.035, y + 0.03, -0.112]], 0.005, { color: K.gold, radial: 3, seg: 1, mat: 'gold' })),
        kit.ring(0.15, 0.012, { color: K.gold, seg: [4, 16], scale: [1.05, 1, 0.75], mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 1.03, 0),
        kit.gem(0.026, { color: 'teamGlow', glow: 0.7, mat: 'gem' }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(0, 1.16, -0.1),
        kit.lathe([[0.09, 1.16], [0.15, 1.28], [0.21, 1.44], [0.25, 1.56]], { color: gownD, seg: 14, phi: [-1.5, 3.0], double: 'teamDark', mat: 'cloth' }).scale(1, 1, 0.85),
        [-1.25, -0.62, 0, 0.62, 1.25].map(an => spike(kit, [Math.sin(an) * 0.24, 1.53, Math.cos(an) * 0.2], [Math.sin(an) * 0.55, 1, Math.cos(an) * 0.6], 0.12, 0.018, K.steelD)));
      rig.add('cape', rag11(kit, [[0.36, 0.06], [0.32, 0.3], [0.27, 0.6], [0.22, 0.9], [0.17, 1.1], [0.1, 1.17]], { color: 'team', inner: 'teamDark', phi: [-1.25, 2.5], jag: 0.13, teeth: 7, zone: 0.22, zs: 0.82 }).at(0, 0, 0.04));

      // head: ashen, gaunt, soul-fire eyes, dark lips + fangs, horn crown
      const F = head11(kit, rig, { y: HY, r: HR, skin, jaw: 0.15, long: 1.16, glow: 0xc45cff, eyeW: 1.12, brow: hairC, browK: 0.85, scowl: 0.4, cheeks: 0.15, mouth: 0.038, teeth: 'fangs', scalp: hairC, hairline: 0.6, lip: 0x2a0c1e });
      rig.add('head', F.parts,
        [-1, 1].map(sx => kit.tube([[sx * 0.05, HY + 0.08, -0.05], [sx * 0.1, HY + 0.16, -0.03], [sx * 0.13, HY + 0.25, 0.03], [sx * 0.11, HY + 0.31, 0.1]], (u) => 0.022 * (1 - u) + 0.003, { color: K.horn, radial: 7, seg: 8, mat: 'lacquer' })),
        [-1, 1].map(sx => spike(kit, [sx * 0.025, HY + 0.1, -0.075], [sx * 0.2, 1, -0.15], 0.07, 0.011, K.horn, { mat: 'lacquer' })),
        kit.ring(HR * 0.9, 0.008, { color: K.gold, seg: [4, 16], scale: [0.9, 1, 1], mat: 'gold' }).rot(-0.25, 0, 0).at(0, HY + 0.07, 0.0),
        kit.gem(0.014, { color: 0xc45cff, glow: 0.9, mat: 'gem' }).at(0, HY + 0.075, -0.093));
      // raven hair in strands, parted in the middle and swept back off the face (eyes free)
      rig.add('hair', hair12(kit, F, { color: hairC, n: 18, from: 0.42, to: 2.2, arc: [-1.45, 1.45], part: 0, lift: 0.1, r0: 0.12, sweep: 0.85, fall: 1.2, sheen: 0x5a4a6a }));
      // long raven locks (hair springs)
      const tw = (s) => [
        lock(kit, [[s * 0.07, HY + 0.03, 0.04], [s * 0.1, HY - 0.08, 0.07], [s * 0.12, HY - 0.25, 0.08], [s * 0.12, HY - 0.45, 0.09], [s * 0.1, HY - 0.6, 0.1]], 0.05, 0.012, hairC, { radial: 6, seg: 9 }),
        lock(kit, [[s * 0.08, HY + 0.02, -0.02], [s * 0.1, HY - 0.08, -0.04], [s * 0.1, HY - 0.2, -0.03]], 0.026, 0.008, hairC, { radial: 5, seg: 5 }),
      ];
      rig.add('hairL', tw(-1));
      rig.add('hairR', tw(1));

      // arms: tight black sleeves with flared team-lined cuffs, ashen clawed hands
      const ao = { sx: 0.19, sy: 1.12, hx: 0.25, hy: 0.68, hz: -0.06, r: 0.043, sleeve: gown, bracer: gownD, bracerTrim: K.gold, skin, fistR: 0.034, claws: 0x0e0c10 };
      for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
        rig.add(s < 0 ? 'armL' : 'armR', arm11(kit, s, ao),
          kit.sphere(0.075, { color: gownD, seg: 10, theta: [0, 1.4], scale: [1.1, 0.85, 1.05], mat: 'cloth' }).rot(0, 0, -s * 0.5).at(s * 0.2, 1.14, 0),
          spike(kit, [s * 0.23, 1.18, 0], [s * 0.5, 1, 0.1], 0.08, 0.016, K.steelD));
      }

      // skull staff: black shaft, gold rings, horned skull cradling the soul orb
      const [hx, hy, hz] = HRh;
      rig.add('weapon', kit.merge([
        kit.rcyl(0.016, 0.02, 1.08, { color: 0x1c1418, seg: 8, mat: 'wood' }).at(0, 0.2, 0),

        kit.cone(0.024, 0.1, { color: K.steelD, seg: 6, mat: 'brushed' }).rot(PI, 0, 0).at(0, -0.39, 0),
        kit.sphere(0.06, { color: K.bone, seg: 10, scale: [0.9, 1, 1.05], mat: 'bone' }).at(0, 0.73, 0),
        kit.sphere(0.04, { color: K.bone, seg: 8, scale: [1, 0.7, 1], mat: 'bone' }).at(0, 0.69, -0.035),
        [-1, 1].map(sx => kit.sphere(0.016, { color: 0xc45cff, seg: 6, glow: 1 }).at(sx * 0.022, 0.735, -0.05)),
        [-1, 1].map(sx => kit.tube([[sx * 0.04, 0.77, 0], [sx * 0.09, 0.82, 0.0], [sx * 0.08, 0.9, -0.02]], (u) => 0.016 * (1 - u) + 0.003, { color: K.horn, radial: 6, seg: 5, mat: 'lacquer' })),
      ]).rot(-0.1, 0, 0).at(hx, hy, hz));
      rig.add('core',

        kit.sphere(0.028, { color: 0xf0c8ff, seg: 8, glow: 1 }).at(hx - 0.012, hy + 0.835, hz - 0.06));

        return kit.merge([

          [-1, 1].map(sx => kit.sphere(0.009, { color: 0xff2a1e, seg: 5, glow: 1 }).at(sx * 0.015, 0.012, -0.042)),
          w.clone().at(0.025, 0, 0), w.mirror('x').at(-0.025, 0, 0),

      };

  // =====================================================================================
  // ELECTRO-WIZARD - "Blitz-Dschinn": floating storm genie. Glowing white spiky hair that
  // stands up like static, electric anime eyes, pointed (springy) ears, cocky grin, team vest +
  // sash, gold shoulder plates, a team-tinted storm-cloud tail, crackling lightning palms
  // =====================================================================================
  define('electro-wizard', {
    tess: 0.78,
    height: 1.62,
    outline: 0.05,
    anim: {
      body: 'biped', walk: 'float', attack: 'cast', tempo: 1.1, weight: 0.22, strikeIn: 0.04, strikeHold: 0.07, strikeOut: 0.3,
      keys: Object.assign({}, NO_ARMS, {
        // both palms charged at the hips (wind-up), then thrust forward in a V that splits the bolt
        'armsL.rx': [0.6, 0.15, 1.5, 1.35], 'armsR.rx': [0.6, 0.15, 1.5, 1.35], 'armsL.rz': [-0.2, -0.75, -0.45, -0.35], 'armsR.rz': [0.2, 0.75, 0.45, 0.35],
        'body.rx': [0, 0.22, -0.22, -0.15], 'head.rx': [0, 0.16, -0.12, -0.08], 'root.py': [0, 0.08, -0.04, 0], 'root.pz': [0, 0.06, -0.12, -0.08],
      }),
      springs: { tails: { max: 0.6 }, springs: { max: 0.5 } },
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        // hover + swirling smoke tail
        rig.root.position.y += 0.07 + 0.035 * Math.sin(t * 2.6 + a.seed * 5);
        rig.tail.rotation.y += 0.3 * Math.sin(t * 2.3 + a.seed * 4);
        rig.tail2.rotation.y += 0.45 * Math.sin(t * 2.3 + a.seed * 4 - 0.9);
        // lightning orbs: jittery crackle, grow with the windup, flash on release
        const fl = kick(a, 0.22);
        for (const k of ['coreL', 'coreR']) {
          const n = rig[k], j = k === 'coreL' ? 1.7 : 0;
          const s = (0.75 + 0.55 * a.windup + 0.9 * fl) * (1 + 0.12 * Math.sin(t * 37 + j) * Math.sin(t * 23 + j * 2));
          n.scale.set(s, s, s);
          n.rotation.y = t * 9 + j;
        }
        // static hair crackles and stands up while charging
        rig.hair.scale.y *= 1 + 0.04 * Math.sin(t * 31 + a.seed * 3) + 0.15 * a.windup;
      },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.4, pitch: 0.12, zoom: 1.8, pose: "idle" },
    build(kit) {
      // v11: storm warlock riding his own thundercloud. Horned black half-helm with a crackling
      // lightning crest, cold electric eyes over an iron face mask, team stole with gold trim over
      // a dark coat, copper-coiled gauntlets with lightning orbs, robe dissolving into storm smoke
      const rig = kit.rig();
      const HIP = 0.66, HY = 1.275, HR = 0.1, skin = 0x7d8790, coat = K.cloth;
      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, HIP, 0]);
      rig.pivot('tail', 'body', [0, 0.62, 0.02]);
      rig.pivot('tail2', 'tail', [0.02, 0.3, 0.12]);
      rig.pivot('head', 'body', [0, 1.16, 0]);
      rig.pivot('hair', 'head', [0, HY + 0.1, 0.01]);
      rig.pivot('ear', 'head', [0, HY + 0.04, 0]);
      rig.pivot('armL', 'body', [-0.23, 1.07, 0]);
      rig.pivot('armR', 'body', [0.23, 1.07, 0]);
      const HLh = [-0.29, 0.6, -0.05], HRh = [0.29, 0.6, -0.05];
      rig.pivot('coreL', 'armL', [HLh[0], HLh[1] - 0.05, HLh[2] - 0.03]);
      rig.pivot('coreR', 'armR', [HRh[0], HRh[1] - 0.05, HRh[2] - 0.03]);
      const cloud = kit.mix('teamDark', 0x1c2028, 0.55), cloudD = kit.mix('team', 0x12141a, 0.7);

      // torso: dark coat, team stole with gold trim + lightning sigil, belt, robe skirt
      const stole = (s) => bend(kit.extrude([[-0.04, 0], [0.04, 0], [0.05, -0.36], [0.0, -0.42], [-0.05, -0.36]], 0.012, { color: 'team', mat: 'cloth' }),
        (x, y, z) => [x, y, z - y * y * 0.4], 50).rot(0, 0, s * 0.06).at(s * 0.085, 1.12, -0.135);

        const g = 1 + 0.5 * a.windup + 0.5 * kick(a, 0.3) + 0.06 * Math.sin(t * 5 + a.seed * 3);
        rig.core.scale.set(g, g, g);
        rig.core.rotation.y = t * 2.2;

        (kit.hi ? [-1.7, -0.9, 0, 0.9, 1.7] : []).map(an => kit.sphere(0.035, { color: 0xdfeef6, seg: 7, scale: [1.6, 0.5, 1.2], mat: 'matte' }).at(Math.sin(an) * 0.24, 1.16, Math.cos(an) * 0.2)),

  define('bomber', {

        'body.rx': [0, -0.22, 0.32, 0.22], 'body.ry': [0, -0.2, 0.25, 0.2], 'head.rx': [0, -0.2, 0.12, 0.06],

        rig.core.scale.set(sp, sp, sp);

      // v11: mad demolitionist. Wiry, hunched, scarred scalp with a burnt mohawk, brass goggles

      const rig = kit.rig();
      const HIP = 0.68, HY = 1.27, HR = 0.1, hairC = 0x1a1210;

      // torso: dark shirt, scorched leather apron, team neckerchief, bandolier of bombs
      const bombs = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        const x = -0.15 + i * 0.075, y = 1.07 - i * 0.075;
        bombs.push(kit.sphere(0.03, { color: K.iron, seg: 8, mat: 'brushed' }).at(x, y, -0.155 + Math.abs(i - 1.5) * 0.01),
          kit.rcyl(0.01, 0.01, 0.014, { color: K.gold, seg: 6, mat: 'gold' }).at(x + 0.01, y + 0.03, -0.155));

      const apron = kit.merge([
        rag11(kit, [[0.235, 0.6], [0.228, 0.72], [0.215, 0.86], [0.2, 0.98], [0.17, 1.06]], { color: K.lea, inner: K.leaD, phi: [PI - 0.95, 1.9], jag: 0.06, teeth: 4, zone: 0.08, zs: 0.78, mat: 'leather' }),
        [-1, 1].map(sx => kit.tube([[sx * 0.15, 1.02, -0.13], [sx * 0.17, 0.8, -0.17], [sx * 0.17, 0.64, -0.17]], 0.008, { color: K.gold, radial: 4, seg: 4, mat: 'gold' })),
        [0.95, 0.85, 0.75].map(y => kit.sphere(0.012, { color: K.goldL, seg: 5, mat: 'gold' }).at(0, y, -0.205)),
        kit.blob(0.09, 0.07, 0.02, { color: 0x140e0c, round: 0.6, seg: 7 }).at(-0.07, 0.7, -0.2),
      ]);
      rig.add('body',
        torso11(kit, HIP, { w: 0.42, d: 0.27, h: 0.48, chest: 0x2a2523, belly: 0x231f1d, pelvis: 'teamDark', neck: K.skin }),
        apron,
        kit.ring(0.165, 0.022, { color: K.leaD, seg: [4, 14], scale: [1, 1, 0.8], mat: 'leather' }).at(0, 0.82, 0),
        kit.tube([[-0.18, 1.11, -0.06], [-0.04, 1.0, -0.16], [0.15, 0.82, -0.11]], 0.02, { color: K.leaD, radial: 5, seg: 4, caps: false, mat: 'leather' }),
        bombs,
        // team neckerchief knotted at the throat
        scarf12(kit, 0, 1.13, 0, 0.088, 0.078, 0.026, 'team', { knot: 0.45 }),
        pauld11(kit, -1, -0.235, 1.08, 0, 0.09, { spikes: 2, color: K.steelD, team: true }));

      // head: scarred, burnt mohawk, goggles with amber lenses, leather mask snout
      const F = head11(kit, rig, { y: HY, r: HR, jaw: 0.55, long: 1.15, glow: 0xffa030, eyeW: 0.95, brow: hairC, scowl: 0.4, mouth: false, mask: K.leaD, maskTrim: K.gold, scar: -1, ears: 'human', scalp: 0x6a4a3a, hairline: 0.6,
        paint: (x, y, z, u, ax) => { const sc = Math.abs(x - HR * 0.35 + (z + HR * 0.2) * 0.5); if (u > 0.55 && sc < HR * 0.035) return 0xb08a78; if (u > 0.55 && sc < HR * 0.11 && Math.sin(z * 260) > 0.75) return 0x3a2420; const so = g2(ax - 0.62, 0.2) * g2(u - 0.1, 0.3) * 0.5; return so > 0.08 ? mixH(K.skin, 0x2a201c, so) : null; } });
      const lens = (s) => [kit.rcyl(0.034, 0.034, 0.026, { color: K.gold, seg: 12, mat: 'gold' }).rot(HP, s * 0.35, 0).at(s * 0.036, HY + 0.003, -0.098),
        kit.disc(0.026, { color: 0xffa030, glow: 0.8, seg: 12 }).rot(0, s * 0.35, 0).at(s * 0.038, HY + 0.003, -0.113)];
      rig.add('head', F.parts, lens(-1), lens(1),
        kit.ring(HR * 0.92, 0.012, { color: K.leaD, seg: [4, 16], scale: [0.92, 1, 1.02], mat: 'leather' }).rot(-0.05, 0, 0).at(0, HY + 0.005, 0.0),
        // gas-mask snout + filter
        kit.rcyl(0.032, 0.04, 0.05, { color: K.iron, seg: 10, mat: 'brushed' }).rot(HP + 0.3, 0, 0).at(0, HY - 0.075, -0.1),
        kit.ring(0.036, 0.006, { color: K.gold, seg: [4, 10], mat: 'gold' }).rot(HP + 0.3, 0, 0).at(0, HY - 0.082, -0.122));
      // burnt mohawk (hair spring): flattened spikes front to back
      const mh = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) mh.push(kit.cone(0.024, 0.11 - Math.abs(i - 1.5) * 0.015, { color: hairC, seg: 5, scale: [0.45, 1, 1], mat: 'hair' }).rot(-0.4 + i * 0.25, 0, 0).at(0, HY + 0.1 - Math.abs(i - 2) * 0.008, -0.06 + i * 0.035));
      rig.add('hair', mh);

      // arms: rolled sleeves (bare scarred forearms), leather gloves, bracers
      const ao = { sx: 0.22, sy: 1.06, hx: 0.27, hy: 0.62, hz: -0.05, r: 0.054, sleeve: 0x2a2523, short: true, armSkin: K.skin, bracer: K.lea, bracerTrim: K.gold, skin: K.leaD, fistR: 0.04 };
      rig.add('armL', arm11(kit, -1, ao));
      rig.add('armR', arm11(kit, 1, ao));
      // spiked iron bomb with a team band, brass fuse cap, rope fuse
      const [hx, hy, hz] = HRh, by = hy + 0.11;
      rig.add('ammo',
        kit.sphere(0.13, { color: K.iron, seg: 12, mat: 'brushed' }).at(hx, by, hz - 0.03),
        kit.ring(0.132, 0.02, { color: 'team', seg: [4, 14], mat: 'cloth' }).rot(0.4, 0, 0.3).at(hx, by, hz - 0.03),
        [[1, 0.2, 0], [-1, 0.2, 0], [0, 0.3, -1], [0.7, -0.6, -0.6], [-0.7, -0.6, -0.6], [0, -0.5, 0.9], [0.6, 0.6, 0.6], [-0.6, 0.6, 0.6]]
          .map(d => { const l = Math.hypot(d[0], d[1], d[2]); return spike(kit, [hx + d[0] / l * 0.12, by + d[1] / l * 0.12, hz - 0.03 + d[2] / l * 0.12], d, 0.08, 0.022, K.steelL); }),
        kit.rcyl(0.04, 0.045, 0.045, { color: K.gold, seg: 10, mat: 'gold' }).rot(0, 0, -0.5).at(hx + 0.055, by + 0.115, hz - 0.03),
        kit.tube([[hx + 0.065, by + 0.135, hz - 0.03], [hx + 0.085, by + 0.18, hz - 0.02], [hx + 0.05, by + 0.21, hz - 0.02]], 0.01, { color: K.linen, radial: 4, seg: 3 }));
      rig.add('core',
        flame(kit, 0.035, 0.09, 0xffd23f, { glow: 1 }).at(hx + 0.05, by + 0.21, hz - 0.02),
        kit.star(4, 0.045, 0.012, 0.008, { color: 0xffffff, glow: 1 }).at(hx + 0.05, by + 0.24, hz - 0.03));
      return rig;
    },
  });

  // =====================================================================================
  // DART-GOBLIN - "Pfeilfrosch": golden poison-dart frog. Bulging anime eyes, wide frog grin,
  // black poison spots, team headband with long tails, puffing throat sac (core), bent frog
  // legs with big webbed feet, bamboo blowpipe with a team wrap
  // =====================================================================================
  define('dart-goblin', {
    tess: 0.92,
    height: 1.08,
    outline: 0.05,
    anim: {
      body: 'biped', walk: 'hop', attack: 'gun', tempo: 1.25, weight: 0.15, hopHeight: 0.22, strikeIn: 0.03, strikeHold: 0.04, strikeOut: 0.2,
      keys: { 'head.rx': [0.1, 0.18, -0.1, 0], 'body.rx': [0.05, 0.12, -0.12, -0.05], 'root.py': [-0.03, -0.06, 0.02, -0.02], 'sq': [0, -0.08, 0.1, 0.02] },
      springs: { scarves: { max: 0.9 } },
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        // throat sac inflates with the wind-up and empties on the shot; idle croak puffs
        const croak = Math.max(0, Math.sin(t * 1.3 + a.seed * 6) - 0.75) * 4 * (1 - a.aim);
        const p = 0.75 + 0.75 * a.windup * (1 - after(a, 0.25)) + 0.35 * croak;
        rig.core.scale.set(p, p, p);
      },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.4, pitch: 0.12, zoom: 1.8, pose: "attack" },
    build(kit) {
      // v11: goblin poison-hunter. Ash-grey hide with toxic glowing spots, leather hood with
      // team trim, bone-tooth necklace, glowing poison bladder on the chest strap (core puffs),
      // long blackened blowpipe with a team wrap and a skull mouthpiece
      const rig = kit.rig();
      const B = gob11(kit, rig, { skin: 0x4a5236, skinD: 0x272c1a, eyes: 0xb8ff3a, wrap: K.lea });
      const HY = B.HY, HZ = B.HZ, HR = B.HR, tox = 0x9be340;
      rig.pivot('core', 'body', [0.06, 0.66, -0.13]);
      rig.pivot('scarf', 'head', [0, HY + 0.02, HZ + 0.1]);
      const HRh = [B.ao.hx, B.ao.hy, B.ao.hz];
      rig.pivot('weapon', 'armR', HRh);
      // leather hood (ears poke out at the sides), team rim
      rig.add('head', hood11(kit, HR, 0, HY, HZ, { color: K.lea, inner: K.leaD, peak: 0.5, gap: 2.0, drop: 2.2, rim: 'team', rimW: 0.04, overhang: 0.45 }),
        [[-0.07, 0.7, -0.09], [0.09, 0.58, -0.07], [-0.1, 0.52, -0.05], [0.12, 0.74, -0.02]].map(q => kit.sphere(0.012, { color: tox, glow: 0.8, seg: 6 }).at(q[0], q[1] + 0.0, q[2] - 0.035)));
      rig.add('body', [0.71, 0.6, 0.5].map((y, i) => kit.sphere(0.014, { color: tox, glow: 0.8, seg: 6 }).at(i % 2 ? 0.11 : -0.1, y, -0.08 + i * 0.01)),
        [-2, -1, 0, 1, 2].map(i => kit.cone(0.009, 0.035, { color: K.bone, seg: 5, mat: 'bone' }).rot(PI, 0, 0).at(i * 0.026, 0.76 - Math.abs(i) * 0.006, -0.12 + Math.abs(i) * 0.012)));
      // poison bladder (core): glowing sac in a leather net
      rig.add('core', kit.sphere(0.045, { color: tox, glow: 0.8, seg: 10, scale: [1, 1.15, 0.9] }).at(0.06, 0.66, -0.13),
        kit.ring(0.044, 0.006, { color: K.leaD, seg: [4, 12] }).at(0.06, 0.66, -0.13),
        kit.rcyl(0.014, 0.016, 0.02, { color: K.gold, seg: 8, mat: 'gold' }).at(0.06, 0.715, -0.13));
      const tl = lock(kit, [[0, HY + 0.02, HZ + 0.1], [0.02, HY - 0.05, HZ + 0.16], [0.03, HY - 0.15, HZ + 0.18]], 0.022, 0.012, 'team', { radial: 4, seg: 4, scale: [0.45, 1, 1] });
      rig.add('scarf', tl, tl.clone().rot(0, -0.5, -0.3).at(-0.02, -0.01, 0.01));
      rig.add('armL', arm11(kit, -1, B.ao));
      rig.add('armR', arm11(kit, 1, B.ao));
      // blowpipe (gun convention: along -Y from the hand)
      const [hx, hy, hz] = HRh;
      rig.add('weapon',
        kit.rcyl(0.016, 0.019, 0.62, { color: 0x1c1812, seg: 8, mat: 'wood' }).at(hx, hy - 0.2, hz - 0.01),
        [0.05, -0.12, -0.44].map(d => kit.ring(0.02, 0.006, { color: d === -0.12 ? 'team' : K.gold, seg: [4, 10], mat: d === -0.12 ? 'cloth' : 'gold' }).at(hx, hy + d, hz - 0.01)),
        kit.sphere(0.03, { color: K.bone, seg: 9, scale: [0.9, 1, 1.05], mat: 'bone' }).at(hx, hy + 0.12, hz - 0.01),
        [-1, 1].map(sx => kit.sphere(0.008, { color: tox, glow: 1, seg: 5 }).at(hx + sx * 0.011, hy + 0.125, hz - 0.036)),
        kit.lathe([[0.016, -0.52], [0.024, -0.54]], { color: K.gold, seg: 10, mat: 'gold' }).at(hx, hy, hz - 0.01));
      return rig;
    },
  });

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Kobold base (goblin / spear-goblin): lizard imp with a big anime head + snout, spiky
  // fins as springy ears, clawed digitigrade feet, springy tail; o = { skin, skinD, belly,
  // iris, tunic }
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const KOB_HY = 0.6;
  function koboldBase(kit, rig, o) {
    const HY = KOB_HY, HR = 0.2;
    legs(kit, rig, { x: 0.085, hip: 0.2, r: 0.055, pants: o.skin, boot: o.skinD, bootScale: [0.9, 0.55, 1.5], bootR: 0.065,
      extra: (x) => [-1, 0, 1].map(k => kit.cone(0.016, 0.05, { color: 'bone', seg: 3, outline: false }).rot(-HP, 0, 0).at(x + k * 0.03, 0.025, -0.135))});
    rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, 0.21, 0]);
    rig.pivot('tail', 'body', [0, 0.25, 0.12]);
    rig.pivot('head', 'body', [0, 0.45, 0]);
    rig.pivot('ear', 'head', [0, HY + 0.02, 0.02]);
    rig.pivot('armL', 'body', [-0.16, 0.42, 0]);
    rig.pivot('armR', 'body', [0.16, 0.42, 0]);
    // torso: small skin body, pale belly, ragged team tunic with a rope belt
    const hem = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
      const an = (i / 7) * TAU;
      hem.push(kit.cone(0.045, 0.07, { color: o.tunic || 'team', seg: 3, outline: false }).rot(PI, 0, 0).at(Math.sin(an) * 0.15, 0.17, Math.cos(an) * 0.13));
    }
    rig.add('body',
      kit.lathe([[0, 0.15], [0.13, 0.16], [0.16, 0.24], [0.15, 0.36], [0.11, 0.44], [0, 0.46]], { color: o.skin, seg: 8, scale: [1, 1, 0.88] }),
      kit.lathe([[0.15, 0.18], [0.165, 0.26], [0.16, 0.35], [0.125, 0.42]], { color: o.tunic || 'team', seg: 9, scale: [1, 1, 0.9] }),
      hem,
      kit.ring(0.158, 0.016, { color: 'rope', seg: [3, 9], scale: [1, 1, 0.9], outline: false }).at(0, 0.25, 0));
    rig.add('tail', lock(kit, [[0, 0.26, 0.1], [0, 0.2, 0.22], [0.03, 0.17, 0.34], [0.08, 0.2, 0.44]], 0.055, 0.012, o.skin, { radial: 5, seg: 5 }),
      spike(kit, [0.0, 0.25, 0.2], [0, 1, 0.3], 0.06, 0.018, BONE_Y, { mat: 'bone' }), spike(kit, [0.03, 0.21, 0.33], [0.1, 1, 0.3], 0.05, 0.015, BONE_Y, { mat: 'bone' }));
    // head: round skull, snout, big anime eyes, fanged mouth on the snout
    const F = face(kit, rig, { y: HY, r: HR, sz: 0.95, eyeR: 0.06, eyeX: 0.078, eyeDy: 0.035, glowEyes: o.glowEyes, glowDark: o.glowDark, tall: 1.2, tilt: 0.26,
      brow: kit.darken(o.skinD, 0.45), browThick: 0.025, browArch: 0.05, mouth: false, blush: false });
    rig.add('head',
      kit.sphere(HR, { color: o.skin, seg: 10, hseg: 7, scale: [1.05, 0.95, 0.95] }).at(0, HY, 0),
      kit.sphere(0.12, { color: o.skin, seg: 8, hseg: 5, scale: [1.15, 0.72, 1] }).at(0, HY - 0.075, -0.15),
      kit.sphere(0.1, { color: o.belly, seg: 7, hseg: 3, theta: [1.6, 1.5], scale: [1.1, 0.7, 0.95], outline: false }).at(0, HY - 0.085, -0.155),
      kit.sphere(0.014, { color: o.skinD, seg: 4, hseg: 2, outline: false }).at(-0.035, HY - 0.05, -0.265),
      kit.sphere(0.014, { color: o.skinD, seg: 4, hseg: 2, outline: false }).at(0.035, HY - 0.05, -0.265),
      // v10: ridge of bone spikes over the skull and two short horns
      [0, 1, 2].map(i => spike(kit, [0, HY + 0.19 - i * 0.03, -0.04 + i * 0.09], [0, 1, 0.35 + i * 0.35], 0.09 - i * 0.015, 0.024, BONE_Y, { mat: 'bone' })),
      [-1, 1].map(sx => spike(kit, [sx * 0.1, HY + 0.15, -0.1], [sx * 0.6, 1, 0.3], 0.1, 0.022, HORN, { mat: 'lacquer' })),
      F.parts);
    rig.pivot('mouth', 'head', [0, HY - 0.105, -0.245]);
    rig.add('mouth', kit.mouth(0.12, { teeth: 'fangs' }).rot(-0.25, 0, 0).at(0, HY - 0.105, -0.245));
    const fin = kit.merge([
      kit.cone(0.06, 0.2, { color: o.skin, seg: 4, scale: [1, 1, 0.35] }).rot(0.2, 0, 1.35).at(-0.24, HY + 0.03, 0.03),
      kit.cone(0.04, 0.13, { color: o.skinD, seg: 4, scale: [1, 1, 0.35] }).rot(0.4, 0, 1.75).at(-0.22, HY - 0.05, 0.05),
    ]);
    rig.add('ear', fin, fin.mirror());
    // arms: skinny skin arms, clawed mitts
    const ao = { sx: 0.16, sy: 0.42, hx: 0.21, hy: 0.24, hz: -0.04, r: 0.042, sleeve: o.skin, skin: o.skin, handR: 0.055, shoulder: o.tunic || 'team', shoulderR: 0.06 };
    return { HY, HR, ao };
  }

  // =====================================================================================
  // GOBLIN - "Kobold": green lizard kobold sprinting in a team bandana (knot tails), ragged
  // team tunic, golden anime eyes, fangs, curved dagger: quick horizontal anime slash
  // =====================================================================================
  define('goblin', {
    tess: 0.79,
    look: LOOK_BLOOD,
    height: 1.05,
    outline: 0.045,
    anim: {
      body: 'biped', walk: 'dash', attack: 'slash', tempo: 1.3, weight: 0.12, strikeIn: 0.04, strikeHold: 0.05, strikeOut: 0.22, turnSpeed: 14,
      keys: { 'root.py': [-0.04, -0.07, -0.06, -0.05], 'head.rx': [0.1, 0.12, 0.05, 0.08] },
      springs: { scarves: { max: 0.9 }, tails: { max: 0.7 } },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.4, pitch: 0.12, zoom: 1.2, pose: "attack" },
    build(kit) {
      // v11: feral goblin cutthroat. Hunched, sinewy, long torn ears, hooked nose, fanged grin,
      // burning yellow eyes, team bandana with knot tails, ragged team loincloth, leg wraps,
      // serrated cleaver-dagger
      const rig = kit.rig();
      const B = gob11(kit, rig, { skin: K.gob, skinD: K.gobD });
      const HY = B.HY, HZ = B.HZ, HR = B.HR;
      rig.pivot('scarf', 'head', [0, HY - 0.025, HZ + 0.1]);
      const HRh = [B.ao.hx, B.ao.hy, B.ao.hz];
      rig.pivot('weapon', 'armR', HRh);
      // knotted team bandana (G4): wrinkled cloth tied low over the brow, rolled edge, fat knot
      // at the back, iron studs; the tails fly on the scarf spring
      const band = bend(kit.sphere(HR * 1.045, { color: 'team', seg: kit.hi ? 14 : 10, theta: [0, 1.56], mat: 'cloth' }), (x, y, z) => {
        const an = Math.atan2(x, z), k = 1 + 0.035 * Math.sin(an * 7 + 1) * (1 - y / (HR * 1.045)) + 0.02 * Math.sin(an * 13 + y * 90);
        return [x * k * 0.98, y, z * k * 1.04];
      }, 60).rot(0.33, 0, 0).at(0, HY + 0.008, HZ + 0.004);
      const edge = [];
      for (let i = 0; i <= 12; i++) { const an = i / 12 * TAU, c = Math.cos(an); edge.push([Math.sin(an) * HR * 1.03, HY + 0.008 - c * HR * 0.33, HZ + 0.004 + c * HR * 0.98]); }
      rig.add('head', band, kit.tube(edge, 0.012, { color: 'teamDark', radial: kit.hi ? 5 : 4, seg: kit.hi ? 24 : 12, mat: 'cloth' }),
        kit.sphere(0.028, { color: 'team', seg: 8, scale: [1.2, 0.9, 0.9], mat: 'cloth' }).at(0, HY - 0.025, HZ + 0.105),
        kit.sphere(0.02, { color: 'teamDark', seg: 7, scale: [1, 1.2, 0.8], mat: 'cloth' }).rot(0, 0, 0.6).at(0.024, HY - 0.034, HZ + 0.108),
      );
      const tl = lock(kit, [[0, HY - 0.025, HZ + 0.1], [0.03, HY - 0.07, HZ + 0.15], [0.05, HY - 0.15, HZ + 0.18]], 0.024, 0.012, 'team', { radial: 4, seg: 4, scale: [0.45, 1, 1] });
      rig.add('scarf', tl, tl.clone().rot(0, -0.5, -0.3).at(-0.025, -0.015, 0.01));
      rig.add('armL', arm11(kit, -1, B.ao));
      rig.add('armR', arm11(kit, 1, B.ao), kit.sphere(0.05, { color: K.lea, seg: 9, theta: [0, 1.4], scale: [1.1, 0.8, 1.05], mat: 'leather' }).rot(0, 0, -0.5).at(0.16, 0.755, -0.03));
      // serrated cleaver-dagger held forward-up
      rig.add('weapon', kit.merge([
        kit.extrude([[-0.028, 0], [0.03, 0], [0.05, 0.06], [0.036, 0.08], [0.054, 0.13], [0.036, 0.15], [0.044, 0.21], [0.02, 0.29], [-0.024, 0.16]], 0.014, { color: K.steelD, smooth: false, mat: 'brushed' }).at(0, 0.05, 0),
        kit.extrude([[-0.032, 0.02], [-0.02, 0.02], [-0.013, 0.16], [0.02, 0.275], [0.012, 0.29], [-0.028, 0.16]], 0.018, { color: K.steelL, smooth: false, mat: 'metal' }).at(0, 0.05, 0),
        kit.box(0.09, 0.02, 0.03, { color: K.gold, bevel: 0.004, mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 0.045, 0),
        kit.rcyl(0.014, 0.014, 0.07, { color: K.leaD, seg: 6, mat: 'leather' }).at(0, 0.0, 0),
      ]).rot(-0.95, 0, 0).at(HRh[0], HRh[1], HRh[2]));
      return rig;
    },
  });

  // =====================================================================================
  // SPEAR-GOBLIN - "Speer-Kobold": ochre lizard kobold with a springy feather crest (team
  // tips), team headband, spare spears on the back; hurls a javelin (ammo) overhead
  // =====================================================================================
  define('spear-goblin', {
    tess: 0.72,
    look: Object.assign({ bloodOn: ['ammo'] }, LOOK_BLOOD),
    height: 1.12,
    outline: 0.045,
    anim: {
      body: 'biped', walk: 'march', attack: 'throw', tempo: 1.3, weight: 0.12, reload: 0.55, strikeIn: 0.05, strikeHold: 0.05, strikeOut: 0.3, turnSpeed: 13,
      keys: { 'body.ry': [-0.15, -0.6, 0.32, 0.22], 'head.ry': [0.1, 0.35, -0.15, -0.1], 'off.rx': [0.4, 1.3, -0.2, -0.1], 'off.rz': [-0.2, -0.5, 0, -0.1], 'legsL.rx': [0.2, 0.15, 0.5, 0.4], 'legsR.rx': [-0.2, -0.15, -0.45, -0.35] },
      springs: { springs: { max: 0.8 }, tails: { max: 0.7 } },
    },

      const rig = kit.rig();

        // rusted spiked pauldron (left)

      });
      const teeth = [];
      if (SKH) for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { const f = (i + 0.5) / 6 * 2 - 1; teeth.push(kit.box(HR * 0.1, HR * (0.2 + 0.04 * (i % 2)), HR * 0.09, { color: i === 2 ? 0x8a8070 : bone, bevel: HR * 0.025, mat: 'bone' }).rot(0, f * 0.6, 0).at(f * HR * 0.3, HY - HR * 0.66, -HR * 0.58 + Math.abs(f) * HR * 0.1)); }
      else teeth.push(teethRow(kit, HR * 0.62, HR * 0.22, 5, bone).at(0, HY - HR * 0.58, -HR * 0.58));
      // dark socket inserts (angular, sunk where the skull is pushed in) + nasal cavity
      const sock = [-1, 1].map(s => kit.sphere(HR * 0.16, { color: 0x060406, seg: 9, scale: [1.4, 0.82, 0.45], mat: 'matte' }).rot(0, -s * 0.3, s * 0.42).at(s * HR * 0.35, HY + HR * 0.0, -HR * 0.68));
      const nasal = kit.extrude([[0, 0.0], [HR * 0.1, -HR * 0.06], [HR * 0.05, -HR * 0.26], [0, -HR * 0.2], [-HR * 0.05, -HR * 0.26], [-HR * 0.1, -HR * 0.06]], HR * 0.06, { color: 0x060406, mat: 'matte' }).rot(-0.25, 0, 0).at(0, HY - HR * 0.22, -HR * 0.74);
      rig.add('head', cran.at(0, HY, 0), teeth, sock, nasal,
        kit.tube([[HR * 0.15, HY + HR * 0.85, -HR * 0.4], [HR * 0.28, HY + HR * 0.55, -HR * 0.62], [HR * 0.2, HY + HR * 0.32, -HR * 0.72]], 0.004, { color: 0x2a2018, radial: 3, seg: 3 }),
        kit.sphere(HR * 1.1, { color: rust, seg: 12, theta: [0, 1.1], scale: [0.92, 1.0, 1.05], mat: 'brushed' }).rot(0.35, 0, 0).at(0, HY + 0.005, 0.005),
        kit.ring(HR * 1.0, 0.008, { color: 0x3a2618, seg: [4, 14], scale: [0.92, 1, 1.05], mat: 'brushed' }).rot(0.35, 0, 0).at(0, HY + 0.045, 0.02),
        [-1, 1].map(sx => spike(kit, [sx * HR * 0.7, HY + HR * 0.7, 0.0], [sx * 0.8, 1, 0.1], 0.08, 0.016, K.steelD)));
      rig.pivot('eyes', 'head', [0, HY - HR * 0.0, -HR * 0.76]);
      rig.add('eyes', [-1, 1].map(s => kit.sphere(HR * 0.08, { color: soul, glow: 1, seg: 7, scale: [1.2, 0.8, 0.6] }).rot(0, 0, s * 0.35).at(s * HR * 0.35, HY - HR * 0.0, -HR * 0.76)));
      rig.add('jaw', bend(kit.sphere(HR * 0.62, { color: bone, seg: 10, theta: [1.55, 1.3], mat: 'bone' }), (x, y, z) => [x * 1.15, y * 0.8, z < 0 ? z * 1.15 : z * 0.5], 60).at(0, HY - HR * 0.55, -HR * 0.22),
        teethRow(kit, HR * 0.72, HR * 0.2, 5, bone).rot(0, 0, PI).at(0, HY - HR * 0.92, -HR * 0.6));
      // tattered team scarf: knot at the neck + two tails (scarf spring)
      const tl = lock(kit, [[0, HY - 0.07, 0.06], [0.03, HY - 0.11, 0.12], [0.05, HY - 0.2, 0.15]], 0.026, 0.016, 'team', { radial: 4, seg: 4, scale: [0.45, 1, 1] });
      rig.add('scarf', tl, tl.clone().rot(0, -0.5, -0.3).at(-0.025, -0.015, 0.01));
      // torn team scarf knotted round the neck (no ring) + a tattered team
      // banner-cape hanging from the shoulder blades (team reads from behind)
      rig.add('body', scarf12(kit, 0, 0.885, 0.0, 0.06, 0.052, 0.017, 'team', { knot: -0.6, seg: 16 }),
        rag11(kit, [[0.13, 0.5], [0.135, 0.62], [0.13, 0.74], [0.1, 0.86]], { color: 'team', inner: 'teamDark', phi: [-1.15, 2.3], jag: 0.1, teeth: 4, zone: 0.14, zs: 0.7, seg: 10 }).at(0, 0, 0.04));
      // bone arms with clawed fingers
      const armP = (s) => {
        const hx = HRh[0] * s, hy = HRh[1], hz = HRh[2], ex = s * 0.165, ey = 0.66;
        const parts = [knob([s * 0.14, 0.84, 0], 0.025), bt([s * 0.142, 0.83, 0], [ex, ey, 0.02], 0.014), knob([ex, ey, 0.02], 0.02),

        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) parts.push(kit.cone(0.008, 0.05, { color: bone, seg: 4, mat: 'bone' }).rot(PI - 0.4, 0, 0).at(hx + (i - 1) * 0.016, hy - 0.035, hz - 0.02));
        return kit.merge(parts);
      };
      rig.add('armL', armP(-1));
      rig.add('armR', armP(1));

      rig.add('weapon', kit.merge([
        kit.extrude([[-0.022, 0], [0.022, 0], [0.026, 0.12], [0.034, 0.15], [0.022, 0.2], [0.03, 0.26], [0, 0.34], [-0.024, 0.24], [-0.018, 0.13]], 0.01, { color: 0x6a5a4a, smooth: false, mat: 'brushed' }).at(0, 0.04, 0),
        kit.box(0.08, 0.016, 0.022, { color: rust, bevel: 0.004, mat: 'brushed' }).at(0, 0.035, 0),
        kit.rcyl(0.012, 0.012, 0.07, { color: K.leaD, seg: 6, mat: 'leather' }).at(0, -0.005, 0),
        kit.sphere(0.016, { color: rust, seg: 6, mat: 'brushed' }).at(0, -0.045, 0),
      ]).rot(-0.95, 0, 0).at(HRh[0], HRh[1], HRh[2]));

    },
  });

  // =====================================================================================
  // SPARKY - "Akku-Kanone": grumpy battery cannon on a team cart. Bronze face plate with big
  // glowing anime eyes under heavy iron brows (expression pivots: they scowl while charging),
  // coil barrel with a flared muzzle, spinning tesla crown, glass charge meter that fills
  // =====================================================================================
  const SPK_WR = 0.32;
  define('sparky', {
    tess: 0.66,
    height: 1.66,
    outline: 0.055,
    anim: {
      body: 'roller', walk: 'roll', attack: 'cannon', tempo: 1, weight: 0.95, wheelRadius: SPK_WR, spinRate: 2.2,
      turnSpeed: 5, strikeIn: 0.05, strikeHold: 0.1, strikeOut: 0.65,
      keys: { 'head.rx': [0, 0.14, -0.2, -0.1], 'root.pz': [0, -0.03, 0.18, 0.08], 'body.rx': [0, -0.03, 0.1, 0.04], 'sq': [0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.03] },
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        const w = a.windup, k = kick(a, 0.55), rel = after(a, 0.35);
        // charge meter fills with the wind-up and empties on the shot
        rig.meter.scale.z = 0.05 + 0.95 * w * (1 - rel);
        // tesla crown spins up, swells while charging
        const ud = rig.spinCoil.userData;
        ud.acc = ((ud.acc || 0) + dt * (1 + 16 * w * w)) % TAU;
        rig.spinCoil.rotation.y = ud.acc;
        rig.spinCoil.scale.set(1, 1 + 0.12 * w, 1);
        // the whole cart hums and shakes while charging
        rig.body.position.x += 0.012 * Math.sin(t * 63) * w * w;
        rig.body.position.y += 0.008 * Math.sin(t * 71) * w;
        // barrel coils pulse
        const o = 1 + 0.55 * w + 0.7 * k + 0.06 * Math.sin(t * 37) * (0.3 + w);
        rig.weapon.scale.set(o * 0.08 + 0.92, o * 0.08 + 0.92, 1);
        // eyes squint into the charge (extra on top of the expression)
        rig.eyes.scale.y *= 1 - 0.3 * w * (1 - rel);
      },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.75, pitch: 0.25, zoom: 1.25, pose: 'attack' },
    build(kit) {
      // v11: infernal lightning siege engine. Blackened iron war cart on bladed spiked wheels,
      // riveted hull with gold trims and team war plates, armoured reactor drum split by glowing
      // storm cracks, a horned iron demon-skull mask (glowing eyes, iron brows, fanged glowing
      // grille), long coil barrel with a fanged muzzle, spiked tesla crown, team war banner
      const rig = kit.rig();
      const WR = SPK_WR, ZF = -0.44, ZB = 0.5, WX = 0.6;
      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, 0.45, 0]);
      rig.pivot('wheelF', 'root', [0, WR, ZF]);
      rig.pivot('wheelB', 'root', [0, WR, ZB]);
      rig.pivot('head', 'body', [0, 1.1, -0.3]);
      const EY = 1.16, EZ = -0.47, EX = 0.12;
      rig.pivot('eyes', 'head', [0, EY, EZ]);
      rig.pivot('browL', 'head', [-0.04, EY + 0.075, EZ - 0.01]);
      rig.pivot('browR', 'head', [0.04, EY + 0.075, EZ - 0.01]);
      rig.pivot('weapon', 'body', [0, 0.86, -0.42]);
      rig.pivot('spinCoil', 'body', [0, 1.26, 0.24]);
      rig.pivot('meter', 'body', [-0.23, 1.2, 0.44]);
      rig.pivot('flag', 'body', [0.44, 0.62, 0.66]);
      const IRON = K.iron, IRONL = 0x3a3e46, COP = 0x8a4a26, STORM = 'electric';

      // wheels: iron tyre with studs, dark spokes, team hub + gold cap, bladed hub spike
      const wheel = (x) => {
        const s = Math.sign(x), p = [
          kit.rcyl(WR, WR, 0.14, { color: 0x1c1e22, seg: 16, mat: 'brushed' }).rot(0, 0, HP).at(x, 0, 0),
          kit.rcyl(WR * 0.8, WR * 0.8, 0.15, { color: IRONL, seg: 14, mat: 'brushed' }).rot(0, 0, HP).at(x, 0, 0),
          [0, 1, 2].map(i => kit.box(0.04, 0.05, WR * 1.55, { color: K.woodD, bevel: 0.01, mat: 'wood' }).rot(i * PI / 3, 0, 0).at(x + s * 0.02, 0, 0)),
          kit.rcyl(0.1, 0.1, 0.18, { color: 'team', seg: 12, mat: 'cloth' }).rot(0, 0, HP).at(x, 0, 0),
          kit.ring(0.1, 0.012, { color: K.gold, seg: [4, 14], mat: 'gold' }).rot(0, 0, HP).at(x + s * 0.09, 0, 0),
          spike(kit, [x + s * 0.1, 0, 0], [s, 0, 0], 0.16, 0.045, K.steelL),
        ];
        for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { const a = i * TAU / 8; p.push(spike(kit, [x, Math.sin(a) * WR, Math.cos(a) * WR], [0, Math.sin(a), Math.cos(a)], 0.06, 0.02, IRONL)); }
        return kit.merge(p);

      rig.add('wheelB', wheel(-WX), wheel(WX));

      // hull: riveted iron tub, gold trim, team war plates on the flanks + deck, ram blades
      const rivets = [];

      const crack = (pts) => kit.tube(pts, 0.012, { color: STORM, glow: 1, radial: 4, seg: pts.length * 2 });
      rig.add('body',
        kit.box(1.0, 0.22, 1.5, { color: IRON, bevel: 0.05, seg: 1, mat: 'brushed' }).at(0, 0.45, 0.04),

        [-1, 1].map(s => kit.box(0.03, 0.13, 1.2, { color: 'team', bevel: 0.01, mat: 'cloth' }).at(s * 0.505, 0.44, 0.04)),
        kit.box(0.94, 0.03, 1.4, { color: 'team', bevel: 0.01, mat: 'cloth' }).at(0, 0.585, 0.04),
        rivets,
        // riveted iron corner brackets on the hull
        [-1, 1].map(sx => [-1, 1].map(sz => kit.box(0.08, 0.2, 0.08, { color: IRONL, bevel: 0.012, mat: 'brushed' }).at(sx * 0.49, 0.46, 0.04 + sz * 0.73))),
        // team tarp lashed over the back of the reactor (reads from behind + from above): arched
        // sheet with sagging flaps, folds, rope lashings
        bend(kit.extrude((() => { const p = []; for (let i = 0; i <= 10; i++) { const a = lerp(-1.95, 1.95, i / 10); p.push([Math.sin(a) * 0.375, Math.cos(a) * 0.375]); } for (let i = 10; i >= 0; i--) { const a = lerp(-1.95, 1.95, i / 10); p.push([Math.sin(a) * 0.355, Math.cos(a) * 0.355]); } return p; })(), 0.42, { color: 'team', mat: 'cloth', smooth: 50 }),
          (x, y, z) => { const sag = Math.cos(z / 0.21 * HP) * 0.0; return [x * (1 + 0.04 * Math.sin(z * 30)), y - (y < 0 ? 0.03 * (1 + Math.sin(x * 25)) : 0) - sag, z]; }, 50).at(0, 0.9, 0.36),
        // tattered team drape hanging over the back of the reactor (team from behind)
        bend(kit.extrude([[-0.26, 0], [0.26, 0], [0.24, -0.26], [0.16, -0.2], [0.1, -0.31], [0.02, -0.22], [-0.06, -0.33], [-0.14, -0.21], [-0.2, -0.29], [-0.25, -0.22]], 0.014, { color: 'team', mat: 'cloth', smooth: 40 }),
          (x, y, z) => [x, y, z + 0.02 * Math.sin(x * 26) - y * 0.15], 40).at(0, 1.2, 0.59),
        kit.tube([[-0.27, 1.205, 0.6], [0, 1.25, 0.6], [0.27, 1.205, 0.6]], 0.012, { color: K.gold, radial: 4, seg: 6, mat: 'gold' }),
        [0.2, 0.52].map(z => kit.torus(0.38, 0.01, { color: 0x8a744a, seg: [4, 18], arc: 3.9 }).rot(0, 0, HP - 1.95).at(0, 0.9, z)),
        kit.cylinder(0.05, 0.05, 1.15, { color: IRON, seg: 8, open: true }).rot(0, 0, HP).at(0, WR, ZB),
        kit.box(0.8, 0.12, 0.1, { color: IRONL, bevel: 0.02, mat: 'brushed' }).at(0, 0.4, -0.74),
        [-0.3, -0.1, 0.1, 0.3].map(x => spike(kit, [x, 0.4, -0.78], [0, 0.08, -1], 0.22, 0.04, K.steelL)),
        // reactor drum: dark iron, gold bands, wide team band, glowing storm cracks + vents
        kit.cylinder(0.34, 0.34, 0.95, { color: 0x1c1f25, seg: 18, mat: 'brushed' }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(0, 0.9, 0.12),
        kit.rcyl(0.348, 0.348, 0.3, { color: 'team', seg: 18, mat: 'cloth' }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(0, 0.9, 0.2),
        [-0.18, 0.37, 0.6].map(z => kit.ring(0.352, 0.022, { color: z < 0 ? IRONL : K.gold, seg: [5, 18], mat: z < 0 ? 'brushed' : 'gold' }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(0, 0.9, z)),
        crack([[-0.25, 1.15, -0.05], [-0.18, 1.1, -0.1], [-0.2, 1.02, -0.14]]),
        crack([[0.27, 1.12, -0.12], [0.31, 1.0, -0.08], [0.33, 0.9, -0.12]]),
        crack([[-0.3, 0.8, 0.45], [-0.32, 0.92, 0.5], [-0.28, 1.0, 0.54]]),
        kit.cylinder(0.3, 0.3, 0.06, { color: IRONL, seg: 16 }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(0, 0.9, 0.6),
        [-1, 0, 1].map(k => kit.box(0.2, 0.022, 0.03, { color: STORM, bevel: 0, glow: 0.9, micro: false }).at(0, 0.9 + k * 0.06, 0.64)),
        // support struts + cables
        [-1, 1].map(s => kit.box(0.08, 0.32, 0.06, { color: IRONL, bevel: 0.01, mat: 'brushed' }).at(s * 0.33, 0.68, -0.18)),
        kit.tube([[0.18, 1.18, 0.32], [0.22, 1.3, 0.1], [0.14, 1.22, -0.2], [0.12, 1.04, -0.4]], 0.024, { color: 0x14121a, radial: 5, seg: 8 }),
        kit.cylinder(0.05, 0.05, 0.66, { color: 0x101418, seg: 8 }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(-0.23, 1.2, 0.11),
        [0.44, -0.24].map(z => kit.rcyl(0.06, 0.06, 0.05, { color: K.gold, seg: 10, mat: 'gold' }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(-0.23, 1.2, z)));

      const horn = (s) => kit.tube([[s * 0.2, 1.26, -0.4], [s * 0.32, 1.34, -0.34], [s * 0.38, 1.46, -0.22], [s * 0.36, 1.58, -0.1]],
        (u) => 0.055 * (1 - u) + 0.006, { color: K.horn, radial: 7, seg: 10, mat: 'lacquer' }).paint((x, y) => (y > 1.5 ? K.bone : null));
      rig.add('head',

        // glowing fanged grille jaw
        kit.box(0.26, 0.07, 0.04, { color: 0x0e0c10, bevel: 0.01, mat: 'matte' }).at(0, 0.98, -0.475),

        [-1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5].map(i => kit.cone(0.012, 0.04, { color: K.steelL, seg: 4, mat: 'metal' }).at(i * 0.045, 0.955, -0.5)),
        horn(-1), horn(1),
        spike(kit, [0, 1.3, -0.45], [0, 1, -0.3], 0.12, 0.03, K.steelL));
      // narrow visor slit (no round eyes): one hard glowing bar under the iron brows, two hot cores
      rig.add('eyes', kit.box(0.3, 0.02, 0.02, { color: STORM, bevel: 0.006, glow: 1 }).at(0, EY - 0.005, EZ - 0.01),
        [-1, 1].map(s => kit.sphere(0.018, { color: 0xeaffff, seg: 6, scale: [1.6, 0.6, 0.6], glow: 1 }).rot(0, 0, s * 0.3).at(s * EX, EY - 0.003, EZ - 0.022)));
      const brow = (s) => kit.box(0.17, 0.045, 0.06, { color: IRON, bevel: 0.012, seg: 1, mat: 'brushed' }).rot(0, -s * 0.2, -s * 0.38).at(s * 0.115, EY + 0.075, EZ - 0.01);
      rig.add('browL', brow(-1));
      rig.add('browR', brow(1));

      // coil barrel: blackened tube, copper coils, gold bands, fanged muzzle, glowing emitter
      rig.add('weapon',
        kit.cylinder(0.12, 0.15, 0.6, { color: 0x1a1c22, seg: 14, mat: 'brushed' }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(0, 0.86, -0.7),
        [-0.52, -0.64, -0.76, -0.88].map(z => kit.ring(0.16, 0.03, { color: COP, seg: [5, 14], mat: 'gold' }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(0, 0.86, z)),

        kit.ring(0.19, 0.014, { color: K.gold, seg: [4, 16], mat: 'gold' }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(0, 0.86, -1.08),
        [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(i => { const a = i * TAU / 6; return spike(kit, [Math.cos(a) * 0.17, 0.86 + Math.sin(a) * 0.17, -1.1], [Math.cos(a) * 0.35, Math.sin(a) * 0.35, -1], 0.12, 0.025, K.steelL); }),
        kit.sphere(0.1, { color: STORM, seg: 10, glow: 1 }).at(0, 0.86, -1.08),
        kit.sphere(0.05, { color: 0xffffff, seg: 7, glow: 1 }).at(0, 0.86, -1.14));
      // tesla crown: iron post, copper rings, glowing orb, spiked prongs
      const prong = kit.tube([[0, 0.3, 0], [0.12, 0.34, 0], [0.17, 0.46, 0]], [0.018, 0.006], { color: K.steelL, radial: 5, seg: 4, mat: 'metal' });
      rig.add('spinCoil',
        kit.cylinder(0.06, 0.085, 0.32, { color: IRON, seg: 10 }).at(0, 1.26 + 0.12, 0.24),
        [0.06, 0.13, 0.2].map(y => kit.ring(0.1 - y * 0.15, 0.028, { color: COP, seg: [4, 12], mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 1.26 + y, 0.24)),

        [0, 1, 2].map(i => prong.clone().rot(0, i * TAU / 3, 0).at(0, 1.26, 0.24)),
        [0, 1, 2].map(i => kit.sphere(0.028, { color: STORM, seg: 6, glow: 1 }).at(Math.cos(i * TAU / 3) * 0.17, 1.26 + 0.46, 0.24 - Math.sin(i * TAU / 3) * 0.17)));
      rig.add('meter', kit.cylinder(0.038, 0.038, 0.62, { color: STORM, seg: 8, glow: 1 }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(-0.23, 1.2, 0.13));
      // tattered team war banner on a spiked pole

      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        const atk = a.aim;
        // "Yeehaw": mallet raised and twirled while riding, chopped down on buildings
        const whoop = 1.85 + 0.22 * Math.sin(t * 3.1 + a.seed * 4) + 0.25 * Math.sin(a.phase * 2) * a.move;
        rig.riderArm.rotation.x += whoop * (1 - atk) + (0.4 + 2.35 * a.windup + 1.0 * a.strike) * atk;
        rig.riderArm.rotation.z += (0.3 + 0.15 * Math.sin(t * 6.2 + a.seed)) * (1 - atk) + 0.12 * atk;
        rig.weapon.rotation.x -= 0.25 * (1 - atk) + (0.55 * a.windup + 1.3 * a.strike) * atk;
        rig.weapon.rotation.y += 0.6 * Math.sin(t * 6.2 + a.seed) * (1 - atk) * (0.4 + 0.6 * a.move);
        rig.rider.rotation.x += 0.12 * a.windup - 0.22 * a.strike;
        rig.rider.rotation.y += 0.25 * a.windup - 0.3 * a.strike;
        // bull: snorts (head toss), lowers its head while charging into buildings
        const snort = Math.max(0, Math.sin(t * 1.1 + a.seed * 7) - 0.8) * 5;
        rig.head.rotation.x += 0.1 * snort * Math.sin(t * 22) - 0.12 * a.windup + 0.2 * a.strike;
        rig.head.rotation.z += 0.05 * Math.sin(t * 2.3 + a.seed * 3);
      },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.8, pitch: 0.12, zoom: 1.1, pose: "idle" },
    build(kit) {
      // v11: brutal war-boar rider. Massive black-bristled war boar (shoulder hump, bristle mane,

      // caparison with gold piping), ridden by a bearded shaven-headed berserker with a topknot,
      // scarred face, leather harness over a bare muscular chest, fur mantle + team cloak, spiked
      // pauldron and a spiked iron war hammer with a team-wrapped haft
      const rig = kit.rig();
      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, 0.62, 0]);
      rig.pivot('head', 'body', [0, 0.8, -0.44]);
      rig.pivot('armL', 'body', [-0.2, 0.6, -0.3]);
      rig.pivot('armR', 'body', [0.2, 0.6, -0.3]);
      rig.pivot('legL', 'body', [-0.2, 0.58, 0.32]);
      rig.pivot('legR', 'body', [0.2, 0.58, 0.32]);

      rig.pivot('rider', 'body', [0, 0.98, 0.06]);
      const HY = 1.6, HR = 0.1;

      rig.pivot('scarf', 'rider', [0, 1.44, 0.15]);
      rig.pivot('riderArm', 'rider', [0.23, 1.42, 0.06]);
      const HRh = [0.3, 1.1, -0.03];
      rig.pivot('weapon', 'riderArm', HRh);
      const FUR = 0x2a201b, FURD = 0x140f0c, SNOUT = 0x4a3530, HOOF = 0x120e10;

      // ---- war boar --------------------------------------------------------------------
      const legP = (x, z, hind) => {
        const s = Math.sign(x);
        const p = [
          kit.tube([[x, 0.66, z], [x + s * 0.01, 0.44, z + (hind ? 0.07 : -0.02)], [x, 0.24, z + (hind ? -0.01 : 0.02)], [x, 0.11, z]], (u) => 0.15 - 0.085 * Math.pow(u, 0.7),
            { color: FUR, radial: 9, seg: 8, mat: 'fur' }),
          kit.sphere(0.075, { color: FURD, seg: 8, scale: [1.15, 0.85, 1.2], mat: 'fur' }).at(x, 0.15, z + 0.01),
          kit.blob(0.13, 0.1, 0.15, { color: HOOF, round: 0.4, taper: 0.8, seg: 9, mat: 'lacquer' }).at(x, 0.05, z - 0.01),
          kit.box(0.014, 0.08, 0.06, { color: 0x060406, bevel: 0.004, micro: false }).at(x, 0.05, z - 0.075),
        ];
        if (!hind) {
          p.push(kit.rcyl(0.104, 0.098, 0.07, { color: K.iron, seg: 12, mat: 'brushed' }).at(x, 0.36, z - 0.01),
            kit.ring(0.105, 0.01, { color: K.gold, seg: [4, 14], mat: 'gold' }).at(x, 0.395, z - 0.01),
            spike(kit, [x + s * 0.09, 0.36, z - 0.02], [s, 0.25, -0.35], 0.1, 0.026, K.steelL));
        }
        return kit.merge(p);
      };
      rig.add('armL', legP(-0.2, -0.3)); rig.add('armR', legP(0.2, -0.3));
      rig.add('legL', legP(-0.2, 0.32, true)); rig.add('legR', legP(0.2, 0.32, true));

      // team caparison: draped shell over the back with a tattered hem, gold piping + rivets
      const BR = 0.35, BY = 0.66, BZ = 0.13, BL = 0.62, BT = 1.62;
      const hemY = BY + Math.cos(BT) * BR;
      const capar = bend(kit.cylinder(BR, BR, BL, { color: 'team', open: true, theta: [-BT, 2 * BT], seg: 16, double: 'teamDark', mat: 'cloth', hard: true })
        .rot(-HP, 0, 0).at(0, BY, BZ), (x, y, z) => {
        const d = y - hemY;
        if (d < 0.12) { const t = Math.abs(((z - BZ) * 16 / PI % 2 + 2) % 2 - 1); y -= (1 - d / 0.12) * 0.1 * t * (0.7 + 0.3 * Math.sin(z * 37)); }
        return [x * 1.0, y, z];
      }, 50);
      const arc = (z) => { const pts = []; for (let i = 0; i <= 10; i++) { const a = -BT + i / 10 * 2 * BT; pts.push([Math.sin(a) * (BR + 0.008), BY + Math.cos(a) * (BR + 0.008), z]); } return pts; };
      const bristles = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {

        for (const sx of (i % 2 ? [-0.045, 0.045] : [0])) bristles.push(kit.cone(0.045, 0.27 - Math.abs(sx) * 1.2, { color: i % 2 ? FURD : FUR, seg: 5, mat: 'fur' }).rot(0.75, 0, sx * 3).at(sx, top, z + 0.04));
      }

      rig.add('body',

        bristles,

        [-1, 1].map(s => pauld11(kit, s, s * 0.27, 0.98, -0.32, 0.19, { color: K.iron, spikes: 2, len: 0.9, tilt: 1.05 })),

        // saddle: dark leather seat with a bone-horn pommel and iron studs
        kit.blob(0.34, 0.09, 0.4, { color: K.leaD, round: 0.5, taper: 0.92, seg: 12, mat: 'leather' }).at(0, 0.99, 0.08),
        kit.ring(0.16, 0.012, { color: K.gold, seg: [4, 18], scale: [1, 1, 1.18], mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 1.02, 0.08),
        kit.tube([[0, 1.02, -0.11], [0, 1.1, -0.13], [0.0, 1.16, -0.1]], [0.035, 0.012], { color: K.bone, radial: 6, seg: 4, mat: 'bone' }),
        kit.tube([[-0.15, 1.0, 0.3], [-0.05, 1.03, 0.3], [0.05, 1.03, 0.3], [0.15, 1.0, 0.3]], 0.03, { color: K.lea, radial: 6, seg: 6, mat: 'leather' }));

      // boar head: heavy skull, long wrinkled snout, flat nose disc, huge curved tusks, ember

      const tusk = (s) => kit.tube([[s * 0.075, 0.62, -0.86], [s * 0.13, 0.62, -0.93], [s * 0.18, 0.7, -0.96], [s * 0.19, 0.81, -0.92], [s * 0.15, 0.89, -0.86]],
        (u) => 0.034 * (1 - u) + 0.004, { color: K.bone, radial: 7, seg: 10, mat: 'bone' }).paint((x, y) => (y < 0.66 ? K.boneD : null));
      const ear = (s) => bend(kit.cone(0.075, 0.2, { color: FUR, seg: 6, scale: [1, 1, 0.35], mat: 'fur' }), (x, y, z) => [x, y, z + y * y * 0.5], 40)
        .rot(0.45, 0, -s * 0.6).at(s * 0.17, 0.96, -0.5);
      const plate = kit.merge([

        kit.gem(0.034, { color: 'teamGlow', glow: 0.75, mat: 'gem' }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(0, 0.03, 0.0),

      const eye = (s) => kit.merge([

        kit.sphere(0.036, { color: 0xff6a1a, seg: 7, scale: [1.45, 0.5, 0.55], glow: 1 }).rot(0, -s * 0.5, s * 0.35).at(s * 0.134, 0.82, -0.785),
        kit.blob(0.1, 0.04, 0.06, { color: FURD, round: 0.6, seg: 7, mat: 'fur' }).rot(0.2, -s * 0.5, s * 0.45).at(s * 0.12, 0.87, -0.77),

      const BH = boarHead12(kit, { at: [0, 0.82, -0.6], k: 1.45, fur: FUR, furD: FURD, snout: SNOUT });
      rig.add('head', BH.head, BH.eyes, BH.jaw,

      rig.add('tail',
        kit.tube([[0, 0.8, 0.52], [0, 0.72, 0.6], [0.02, 0.58, 0.63]], [0.026, 0.014], { color: FUR, radial: 5, seg: 5, mat: 'fur' }),
        kit.cone(0.045, 0.16, { color: FURD, seg: 6, mat: 'fur' }).rot(PI, 0, 0).at(0.02, 0.5, 0.63));

        kit.tube([[-0.33, 0.93, -0.04], [-0.37, 0.8, -0.02], [-0.38, 0.68, 0.0]], [0.058, 0.05], { color: K.leaD, radial: 8, seg: 4, mat: 'leather' }),

        mouth: HR * 0.42, teeth: true, beard: BEARD, beardL: 0.95, ears: 'human', scar: 1, cheeks: 0.08, scalp: 0x6e4a36, hairline: 0.5 });
      const strap = (pts) => kit.tube(pts, 0.018, { color: K.leaD, radial: 5, seg: 6, caps: false, mat: 'leather' });
      rig.add('rider',

        kit.blob(0.27, 0.18, 0.2, { color: SK, round: 0.5, seg: 10, mat: 'skin' }).paint((x, y, z) => (z < -0.05 && (Math.abs(x) < 0.008 || Math.abs(Math.sin(y * 57)) < 0.12 && Math.abs(x) < 0.07) ? SKD : null)).at(0, 1.17, 0.05),
        kit.blob(0.46, 0.27, 0.27, { color: SK, round: 0.5, taper: 1.18, bottom: 0.75, bulge: 0.16, seg: 12, mat: 'skin' }).rot(0.12, 0, 0).at(0, 1.33, 0.04),
        [-1, 1].map(s => kit.blob(0.17, 0.11, 0.07, { color: SK, round: 0.6, seg: 9, mat: 'skin' }).rot(0.25, s * 0.3, 0).at(s * 0.085, 1.37, -0.08)),
        kit.rcyl(0.05, 0.058, 0.09, { color: SK, seg: 9, mat: 'skin' }).at(0, 1.48, 0.03),

        strap([[-0.2, 1.43, 0.0], [-0.05, 1.3, -0.1], [0.12, 1.14, -0.06]]), strap([[0.2, 1.43, 0.0], [0.05, 1.3, -0.1], [-0.12, 1.14, -0.06]]),
        strap([[-0.2, 1.43, 0.08], [0, 1.3, 0.2], [0.12, 1.14, 0.16]]),

        kit.ring(0.155, 0.03, { color: 'team', seg: [5, 16], scale: [1, 1, 0.85], mat: 'cloth' }).at(0, 1.1, 0.05),
        kit.box(0.06, 0.05, 0.02, { color: K.gold, bevel: 0.008, mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 1.1, -0.085),

        // rein arm (bare, leather bracer) + reins to the boar's chamfron
        arm11(kit, -1, { sx: 0.22, sy: 1.42, hx: 0.17, hy: 1.12, hz: -0.25, r: 0.05, sleeve: SK, mat: 'skin', bracer: K.leaD, bracerTrim: K.gold, skin: K.leaD, fistR: 0.038 }),
        kit.tube([[-0.17, 1.1, -0.29], [-0.12, 1.0, -0.42], [-0.07, 0.9, -0.55]], 0.009, { color: K.leaD, radial: 4, seg: 4, mat: 'leather' }),
        kit.tube([[-0.15, 1.1, -0.29], [0.0, 0.98, -0.42], [0.07, 0.9, -0.55]], 0.009, { color: K.leaD, radial: 4, seg: 4, mat: 'leather' }),
        // head
        F.parts,
        kit.ring(0.022, 0.008, { color: K.gold, seg: [4, 10], mat: 'gold' }).at(0, HY - 0.19, -0.105),

      // topknot + long braid (springy)
      rig.add('hair',

        kit.tube([[0, HY + 0.12, 0.06], [0, HY + 0.1, 0.14], [0.01, HY - 0.02, 0.2], [0.02, HY - 0.16, 0.2]], [0.03, 0.012], { color: BEARD, radial: 6, seg: 8, mat: 'hair' }));
      // tattered team cloak from the mantle

      // hammer arm: bare, bracer, spiked iron pauldron with team cloth
      rig.add('riderArm',

        pauld11(kit, 1, 0.24, 1.45, 0.05, 0.1, { spikes: 3, color: K.iron, team: true, len: 1.1 }));
      // spiked iron war hammer: team-wrapped haft, gold bands, spiked striking face + back pick

  // =====================================================================================
  // ROYAL-HOG - "Renn-Ferkel": round racing piglet. Big shiny anime eyes, cheeky grin, team
  // racing helmet with a white stripe + goggles, floppy springy ears, team saddle cloth with a
  // start-number disc, propeller curly tail (swarm budget)
  // =====================================================================================
  define('royal-hog', {
    tess: 0.92,
    height: 0.88,
    outline: 0.05,
    anim: {
      body: 'quadruped', walk: 'gallop', attack: 'bite', tempo: 1.4, weight: 0.25, turnSpeed: 12, strikeIn: 0.05, strikeHold: 0.05, strikeOut: 0.24,
      keys: { 'root.py': [0, 0.06, -0.04, 0], 'sq': [0, -0.08, 0.12, 0.04] },
      springs: { springs: { max: 0.8 } },
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        // curly tail spins like a propeller while racing, wiggles at rest
        const ud = rig.tail.userData;
        ud.spin = ((ud.spin || 0) + dt * 16 * a.move * a.move) % TAU;
        rig.tail.rotation.z += ud.spin + 0.4 * Math.sin(t * 5 + a.seed * 3) * (1 - a.move);
        rig.head.rotation.z += 0.05 * Math.sin(t * 3 + a.seed * 6) * (1 - a.move);
      },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.6, pitch: 0.14, zoom: 1.35, pose: "idle" },
    build(kit) {
      // v11: vicious royal war-piglet. Lean bristled young boar with a high shoulder ridge, wedge
      // head with ember eyes under a bony brow, snapping fanged jaw, curved tusks, torn ears,
      // spiked gold war crown with a team gem, iron spiked collar, team caparison with gold

  define('battle-ram', {

      const viking = (cx, suf, o) => {

        const outA = arm11(kit, -si, { sx: 0.2, sy: 0.96, hx: -0.27, hy: LY + 0.05, hz: -0.36, r: 0.058, sleeve: o.skin, mat: 'skin', bracer: K.leaD, bracerTrim: K.gold, bracerSpike: K.steelL, skin: K.leaD, fistR: 0.046, elbowOut: 0.06 });
        body.push(inA.at(cx, 0, 0), outA.at(cx, 0, 0));

        const horn = (s) => kit.tube([[cx + s * 0.1, HY + 0.07, 0], [cx + s * 0.19, HY + 0.1, -0.02], [cx + s * 0.25, HY + 0.2, -0.05], [cx + s * 0.24, HY + 0.31, -0.1]],
