      const band = (z, r) => kit.rcyl(r, r, 0.05, { color: K.iron, seg: 14, mat: 'brushed' }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(0, LY, z);
      const ramHorn = (s) => {
        const pts = [];
        for (let i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
          const u = i / 9, an = u * TAU * 0.95, r = 0.12 * (1 - u * 0.55);
          pts.push([s * (0.11 + 0.07 * u + r * 0.3), LY + 0.07 + Math.cos(an) * r, -0.86 + Math.sin(an) * r]);
        }
        return kit.tube(pts, (u) => 0.05 * (1 - u) + 0.012, { color: K.horn, radial: 7, seg: 14, mat: 'lacquer' });
      };
      const spikes = [];
      for (const z of [0.3, -0.2]) for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const a = i * TAU / 4 + 0.78; spikes.push(spike(kit, [Math.cos(a) * 0.13, LY + Math.sin(a) * 0.13, z], [Math.cos(a), Math.sin(a), 0], 0.09, 0.024, K.steelL)); }
      rig.add('body', VA.body, VB.body,
        kit.cylinder(0.12, 0.13, 1.36, { color: K.woodD, seg: 12, mat: 'wood' }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(0, LY, -0.12),
        band(0.5, 0.135), band(0.3, 0.13), band(-0.2, 0.128), band(-0.72, 0.15),
        spikes,
        kit.rcyl(0.133, 0.133, 0.16, { color: 'team', seg: 14, mat: 'cloth' }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(0, LY, 0.05),
        kit.ring(0.134, 0.01, { color: K.gold, seg: [4, 16], mat: 'gold' }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(0, LY, 0.13),
        kit.ring(0.134, 0.01, { color: K.gold, seg: [4, 16], mat: 'gold' }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(0, LY, -0.03),
        kit.disc(0.11, { color: K.wood, seg: 12 }).rot(0, PI, 0).at(0, LY, 0.561),
        // spiked collar behind the ram skull
        [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(i => { const a = i * TAU / 6 + 0.26; return spike(kit, [Math.cos(a) * 0.15, LY + Math.sin(a) * 0.15, -0.74], [Math.cos(a), Math.sin(a), -0.4], 0.11, 0.026, K.steelL); }),
        // iron ram skull: domed brow, long muzzle, deep sockets with glowing team eyes, teeth
        kit.blob(0.28, 0.26, 0.32, { color: K.iron, round: 0.35, taper: 0.9, seg: 12, mat: 'brushed' }).at(0, LY + 0.035, -0.9),
        kit.blob(0.18, 0.15, 0.22, { color: K.iron, round: 0.4, taper: 0.8, seg: 11, mat: 'brushed' }).at(0, LY - 0.03, -1.05),
        kit.tube([[-0.12, LY + 0.1, -0.98], [-0.05, LY + 0.13, -1.03], [0.05, LY + 0.13, -1.03], [0.12, LY + 0.1, -0.98]], 0.026, { color: K.steelD, radial: 7, seg: 8, mat: 'brushed' }),
        kit.tube([[-0.13, LY + 0.04, -0.83], [0, LY + 0.17, -0.87], [0.13, LY + 0.04, -0.83]], 0.01, { color: K.gold, radial: 5, seg: 8, mat: 'gold' }),
        [-1, 1].map(sx => kit.sphere(0.04, { color: K.socket, seg: 7, scale: [1.2, 0.8, 0.6], mat: 'matte' }).at(sx * 0.072, LY + 0.065, -1.02)),
        [-1, 1].map(sx => kit.sphere(0.03, { color: 'teamGlow', seg: 8, scale: [1.2, 0.7, 0.6], glow: 1 }).at(sx * 0.073, LY + 0.065, -1.032)),
        [-1, 1].map(sx => kit.sphere(0.016, { color: K.socket, seg: 6, scale: [1, 0.7, 0.6] }).at(sx * 0.035, LY - 0.02, -1.155)),
        [-2, -1, 0, 1, 2].map(i => kit.cone(0.012, 0.04, { color: K.bone, seg: 4, mat: 'bone' }).rot(PI, 0, 0).at(i * 0.025, LY - 0.09, -1.12 + Math.abs(i) * 0.012)),
        ramHorn(-1), ramHorn(1));
      // team war pennant on a spear shaft at the back of the log
      rig.add('flag',
        kit.cylinder(0.015, 0.015, 0.62, { color: K.woodD, seg: 6 }).at(0, LY + 0.38, 0.5),
        kit.cone(0.025, 0.09, { color: K.steelL, seg: 5, mat: 'metal' }).at(0, LY + 0.73, 0.5),
        kit.extrude([[0, 0], [0, -0.24], [0.3, -0.2], [0.22, -0.14], [0.34, -0.1], [0.24, -0.06], [0.32, -0.01]], 0.012, { color: 'team', smooth: false, mat: 'cloth' }).rot(0, -HP, 0).at(0, LY + 0.67, 0.5),
        kit.cylinder(0.008, 0.008, 0.34, { color: K.gold, seg: 5, mat: 'gold' }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(0, LY + 0.67, 0.67));
      return rig;
    },
  });

  // =====================================================================================
  // ICE-SPIRIT - "Frostbeule": shivering snowball. Huge worried anime eyes, chattering teeth,
  // icy blue blush, team beanie with a springy pompom, team scarf tails, team mittens
  // =====================================================================================
  define('ice-spirit', {
    height: 0.74,
    outline: 0.045,
    anim: {
      body: 'spirit', walk: 'hop', attack: 'kamikaze', tempo: 1.35, weight: 0.1, hopHeight: 0.3, turnSpeed: 14,
      springs: { scarves: { max: 0.9 }, springs: { max: 0.8 } },
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        // constant shivering + chattering teeth
        const calm = 1 - 0.6 * a.move;
        rig.body.position.x += 0.011 * Math.sin(t * 57 + a.seed * 9) * calm;
        rig.body.rotation.z += 0.03 * Math.sin(t * 43 + a.seed * 5) * calm;
        rig.mouth.scale.y *= 0.7 + 0.5 * Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 38 + a.seed * 3));
        // mittens rubbed together when idle, flung out while hopping, raised before the leap
        const rub = Math.sin(t * 14 + a.seed * 2) * calm;
        rig.armL.rotation.y -= 0.35 * calm + 0.12 * rub;
        rig.armR.rotation.y += 0.35 * calm - 0.12 * rub;
        rig.armL.rotation.z -= 0.6 * a.move * Math.abs(Math.sin(a.phase)) + 1.2 * a.windup;
        rig.armR.rotation.z += 0.6 * a.move * Math.abs(Math.sin(a.phase)) + 1.2 * a.windup;
        const p = 1 + 0.12 * a.windup;
        rig.body.scale.x *= p; rig.body.scale.z *= p;
      },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.45, pitch: 0.16, zoom: 1.0, pose: 'idle' },
    build(kit) {
      // v11: frost wraith. Faceted ice skull with a frozen glowing core, deep sockets with cold
      // cyan eyes, jagged ice brow shards, fanged icicle maw, crown of ice spikes, ice-shard
      // claws, a frost-mist tail below and a tattered team scarf with a glowing team rune
      const rig = kit.rig();
      const HY = 0.4, HR = 0.24, ICE = 0xb6dceb, ICED = 0x5e93b0, COLD = 0xa8f4ff;
      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, 0.1, 0]);
      rig.pivot('head', 'body', [0, 0.3, 0]);
      rig.pivot('hair', 'head', [0, HY + 0.2, 0.02]);
      rig.pivot('scarf', 'body', [0.05, 0.22, 0.17]);
      rig.pivot('armL', 'body', [-0.22, 0.3, 0]);
      rig.pivot('armR', 'body', [0.22, 0.3, 0]);
      rig.pivot('eyes', 'head', [0, HY + 0.02, -HR * 0.86]);
      rig.pivot('browL', 'head', [-0.03, HY + 0.085, -HR * 0.9]);
      rig.pivot('browR', 'head', [0.03, HY + 0.085, -HR * 0.9]);
      rig.pivot('mouth', 'head', [0, HY - 0.11, -HR * 0.8]);
      const shard = (b, d, len, r, col, g) => spike(kit, b, d, len, r, col, { mat: 'ice', glow: g || 0, seg: 5 });
      rig.add('body',
        // frost-mist tail tapering to the ground
        kit.lathe([[0, 0.02], [0.05, 0.05], [0.1, 0.12], [0.15, 0.2], [0.17, 0.27]], { color: ICED, seg: 12, mat: 'ice', grad: 0.4 }).paint((x, y) => (y < 0.1 ? 0x3a6a88 : null)),
        [0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map(i => { const a = i * TAU / 5 + 0.3; return shard([Math.sin(a) * 0.11, 0.12, Math.cos(a) * 0.11], [Math.sin(a), -0.6, Math.cos(a)], 0.1, 0.03, ICED); }),
        // frozen team scarf knotted round the neck (no ring) + team ice crystals in it
        scarf12(kit, 0, 0.24, 0, 0.17, 0.16, 0.05, 'team', { knot: 0.5 }),
        [-0.9, 0.1, 1.1].map((a, i) => kit.gem(0.034 - i * 0.004, { color: 'teamGlow', glow: 0.8, mat: 'gem', stretch: 2.2 }).rot(0.3, 0, a * 0.5).at(Math.sin(a) * 0.17, 0.27 + i * 0.01, -Math.cos(a) * 0.16)));
      rig.add('scarf', rag11(kit, [[0.06, 0.02], [0.07, 0.12], [0.07, 0.22]], { color: 'team', inner: 'teamDark', phi: [-0.5, 1.0], jag: 0.05, teeth: 2, zone: 0.06 }).at(0.05, 0, 0.13));
      // faceted ice skull + glowing frozen core
      const skull = kit.rock(HR, { color: ICE, detail: 1, jitter: 0.06, seed: 5, mat: 'ice' }).scale(1.0, 1.02, 0.95);
      rig.add('head',
        skull.at(0, HY, 0),
        kit.sphere(HR * 0.62, { color: COLD, seg: 10, glow: 0.55 }).at(0, HY + 0.02, 0.02),
        kit.blob(HR * 1.3, HR * 0.5, HR * 0.9, { color: ICE, round: 0.5, taper: 0.8, seg: 9, mat: 'ice' }).at(0, HY - HR * 0.6, -HR * 0.15),
        [-1, 1].map(s => kit.sphere(HR * 0.19, { color: 0x0a1420, seg: 8, scale: [1.5, 0.48, 0.5], mat: 'matte' }).rot(0, -s * 0.35, s * 0.5).at(s * HR * 0.36, HY + 0.02, -HR * 0.86)),
        kit.extrude([[0, 0], [HR * 0.06, -HR * 0.05], [0, -HR * 0.14], [-HR * 0.06, -HR * 0.05]], HR * 0.06, { color: 0x0a1420, mat: 'matte' }).at(0, HY - 0.04, -HR * 0.93),
        [-1, 1].map(s => shard([s * HR * 0.8, HY - 0.02, -0.02], [s, 0.25, 0.3], 0.12, 0.035, ICED)));
      rig.add('eyes', [-1, 1].map(s => kit.sphere(HR * 0.15, { color: COLD, seg: 8, scale: [1.7, 0.3, 0.45], glow: 1 }).rot(0, -s * 0.35, s * 0.5).at(s * HR * 0.37, HY + 0.02, -HR * 0.92)));
      for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
        const nm = s < 0 ? 'browL' : 'browR';
        rig.add(nm, kit.extrude([[0, 0], [HR * 0.55, HR * 0.02], [HR * 0.62, HR * 0.14], [HR * 0.3, HR * 0.1]], 0.02, { color: ICED, mat: 'ice' }).rot(0, -s * 0.35, -s * 0.32).scale(s, 1, 1).at(s * 0.03, HY + 0.075, -HR * 0.9));
      }
      rig.add('mouth', maw12(kit, HR * 0.66, { color: 0x081018, fang: 0xe4f6ff, fangMat: 'ice', fangGlow: 0.15, n: kit.hi ? 6 : 4 }).at(0, HY - 0.11, -HR * 0.84));
      // crown of jagged ice spikes
      rig.add('hair', [[0, 1, 0.05, 0.2], [0.55, 1, 0.1, 0.14], [-0.55, 1, 0.1, 0.14], [0.3, 1, 0.75, 0.12], [-0.3, 1, 0.75, 0.12], [1, 0.7, -0.1, 0.1], [-1, 0.7, -0.1, 0.1]].map(d =>
        shard([d[0] * 0.08, HY + 0.17, 0.02 + d[2] * 0.06], [d[0], d[1], d[2]], d[3], 0.035, d[3] > 0.15 ? COLD : 0xcdeefa, d[3] > 0.15 ? 0.35 : 0.15)));
      // ice-shard claws
      const claw = (s) => kit.merge([
        kit.rock(0.06, { color: ICED, detail: 0, jitter: 0.1, seed: 3, mat: 'ice' }).at(s * 0.27, 0.27, -0.03),
        [-1, 0, 1].map(i => shard([s * 0.29, 0.25, -0.06 + i * 0.03], [s * 0.4, -0.6, -0.8 + i * 0.3], 0.11, 0.022, 0xd8f2ff)),
      ]);
      rig.add('armL', claw(-1));
      rig.add('armR', claw(1));
      return rig;
    },
  });

  // =====================================================================================
  // FIRE-SPIRIT - "Hitzkopf": furious flame blob. Glowing fierce anime eyes, fanged shout,
  // flickering flame crown (springy), team sweatband, stubby flame arms, orbiting embers
  // =====================================================================================
  define('fire-spirit', {
    height: 0.82,
    outline: 0.045,
    anim: {
      body: 'spirit', walk: 'hop', attack: 'kamikaze', tempo: 1.4, weight: 0.1, hopHeight: 0.32, turnSpeed: 14, spinRate: 3.2,
      springs: { springs: { max: 0.9, f: 5 } },
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        // flame crown flickers, the whole blob throbs with rage
        const f = 1 + 0.08 * Math.sin(t * 13 + a.seed * 5) + 0.05 * Math.sin(t * 29) + 0.25 * a.windup;
        rig.hair.scale.set(2 - f, f, 2 - f);
        const th = 1 + 0.03 * Math.sin(t * 9 + a.seed) + 0.08 * a.windup;
        rig.body.scale.x *= th; rig.body.scale.z *= th;
        rig.armL.rotation.z -= 0.4 * Math.sin(t * 11 + a.seed) * 0.3 + 1.0 * a.windup;
        rig.armR.rotation.z += 0.4 * Math.sin(t * 11 + a.seed + 1) * 0.3 + 1.0 * a.windup;
      },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.45, pitch: 0.16, zoom: 1.0, pose: 'idle' },
    build(kit) {
      // v11: hellfire imp skull. Charred horned skull cracked with molten glow, deep sockets with
      // white-hot eyes, fanged burning maw, crown of hellfire (springy), flame claws, orbiting
      // embers, iron circlet with a team gem and a tattered team rag around the jaw
      const rig = kit.rig();
      const HY = 0.36, HR = 0.22, CHAR = 0x3a2c28, CHARL = 0x54403a;
      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, 0.1, 0]);
      rig.pivot('head', 'body', [0, 0.3, 0]);
      rig.pivot('hair', 'head', [0, HY + 0.16, 0.03]);
      rig.pivot('armL', 'body', [-0.22, 0.3, 0]);
      rig.pivot('armR', 'body', [0.22, 0.3, 0]);
      rig.pivot('spinEmbers', 'root', [0, 0.38, 0]);
      rig.pivot('eyes', 'head', [0, HY + 0.02, -HR * 0.86]);
      rig.pivot('browL', 'head', [-0.03, HY + 0.08, -HR * 0.9]);
      rig.pivot('browR', 'head', [0.03, HY + 0.08, -HR * 0.9]);
      rig.pivot('mouth', 'head', [0, HY - 0.12, -HR * 0.78]);
      const crack = (pts) => kit.tube(pts, 0.008, { color: 'fireLight', glow: 1, radial: 4, seg: pts.length * 2 });
      rig.add('body',
        // molten flame body below the skull
        flame(kit, 0.2, 0.36, 'fire', { glow: 0.75 }).rot(PI, 0, 0).at(0, 0.36, 0.02),
        flame(kit, 0.13, 0.26, 'fireLight', { glow: 1 }).rot(PI, 0, 0).at(0, 0.32, -0.02),
        // team rag tied around the jaw
        rag11(kit, [[0.17, 0.1], [0.19, 0.18], [0.19, 0.26], [0.17, 0.3]], { color: 'team', inner: 'teamDark', jag: 0.07, teeth: 6, zone: 0.07 }));
      // charred skull: deformed head, molten cracks, cheek bones, horns, iron circlet + team gem
      const F = { parts: [] };
      const sk = bend(kit.sphere(HR, { color: CHAR, seg: 14, mat: 'stone' }), (x, y, z) => {
        const u = y / HR; let X = x, Z = z;
        if (u < -0.2) { X *= 1 - 0.25 * (-u - 0.2); }
        if (z < 0) Z = z * 0.92;
        return [X, y * 1.05, Z];
      }, 70).paint((x, y, z) => (y < -HR * 0.62 ? 0xb8401a : y < -HR * 0.4 ? CHARL : null));
      const horn = (s) => kit.tube([[s * 0.13, HY + 0.12, -0.02], [s * 0.21, HY + 0.18, -0.0], [s * 0.25, HY + 0.29, 0.04], [s * 0.21, HY + 0.4, 0.08]],
        (u) => 0.042 * (1 - u) + 0.004, { color: 0x14100e, radial: 7, seg: 9, mat: 'lacquer' }).paint((x, y) => (y > HY + 0.34 ? 'fireLight' : null));
      rig.add('head',
        sk.at(0, HY, 0),
        crack([[-0.1, HY + 0.18, -0.12], [-0.06, HY + 0.1, -0.18], [-0.09, HY + 0.02, -0.19]]),
        crack([[0.12, HY + 0.15, -0.14], [0.09, HY + 0.06, -0.19]]),
        crack([[0.15, HY - 0.05, -0.14], [0.11, HY - 0.12, -0.16], [0.06, HY - 0.15, -0.17]]),
        [-1, 1].map(s => kit.sphere(HR * 0.2, { color: 0x080404, seg: 8, scale: [1.5, 0.5, 0.5], mat: 'matte' }).rot(0, -s * 0.35, s * 0.5).at(s * HR * 0.37, HY + 0.02, -HR * 0.9)),
        kit.sphere(HR * 0.1, { color: 0x080404, seg: 6, scale: [1, 1.3, 0.5] }).at(0, HY - 0.06, -HR * 0.94),
        kit.ring(HR * 0.98, 0.016, { color: K.iron, seg: [5, 16], mat: 'brushed' }).rot(0.25, 0, 0).at(0, HY + 0.1, 0.01),
        kit.gem(0.03, { color: 'teamGlow', glow: 0.9, mat: 'gem' }).at(0, HY + 0.12, -HR * 0.96),
        horn(-1), horn(1));
      rig.add('eyes', [-1, 1].map(s => kit.sphere(HR * 0.15, { color: 0xfff2a0, seg: 8, scale: [1.7, 0.3, 0.45], glow: 1 }).rot(0, -s * 0.35, s * 0.5).at(s * HR * 0.38, HY + 0.02, -HR * 0.97)));
      for (const s of [-1, 1]) rig.add(s < 0 ? 'browL' : 'browR', kit.blob(HR * 0.55, HR * 0.14, HR * 0.2, { color: CHARL, round: 0.6, seg: 7, mat: 'stone' }).rot(0, -s * 0.35, s * 0.42).at(s * HR * 0.34, HY + 0.08, -HR * 0.88));
      // wide burning grin: dark maw with a molten throat and charred fangs
      rig.add('mouth', maw12(kit, HR * 0.78, { color: 0x2a0604, inner: 0xff7a1a, fang: 0x2a2220, fangMat: 'stone', n: kit.hi ? 7 : 4 }).rot(0, 0, 0).at(0, HY - 0.12, -HR * 0.82),
        [-1, 1].map(s => kit.tube([[s * HR * 0.28, HY - 0.12, -HR * 0.8], [s * HR * 0.38, HY - 0.08, -HR * 0.74]], 0.006, { color: 'fireLight', glow: 1, radial: 3, seg: 2 })));
      // hellfire crown
      rig.add('hair',
        flame(kit, 0.11, 0.34, 'fire', { glow: 0.75 }).at(0, HY + 0.12, 0.04),
        flame(kit, 0.07, 0.24, 'fireDeep', { glow: 0.65 }).rot(0.25, 0, 0.5).at(-0.1, HY + 0.1, 0.04),
        flame(kit, 0.07, 0.24, 'fireDeep', { glow: 0.65 }).rot(0.25, 0, -0.5).at(0.1, HY + 0.1, 0.04),
        flame(kit, 0.06, 0.2, 'fire', { glow: 0.75 }).rot(0.8, 0, 0).at(0, HY + 0.08, 0.14),
        flame(kit, 0.05, 0.2, 'fireLight', { glow: 1 }).at(0, HY + 0.16, 0.0));
      // flame claws
      const claw = (s) => kit.merge([
        flame(kit, 0.05, 0.2, 'fire', { glow: 0.75 }).rot(-0.3, 0, s * -0.9).at(s * 0.25, 0.28, -0.03),
        [-1, 0, 1].map(i => kit.cone(0.013, 0.08, { color: 0x14100e, seg: 4, mat: 'lacquer' }).rot(-HP + 0.5, 0, s * 0.3).at(s * 0.27 + i * 0.012, 0.26 + i * 0.02, -0.08)),
      ]);
      rig.add('armL', claw(-1));
      rig.add('armR', claw(1));
      rig.add('spinEmbers', [0, 1, 2].map(i => { const an = i * TAU / 3; return kit.gem(0.03, { color: i & 1 ? 'fireLight' : 'ember', glow: 1 }).at(Math.cos(an) * 0.34, 0.38 + 0.12 * Math.sin(i * 2.1), Math.sin(an) * 0.34); }));
      return rig;
    },
  });

  // =====================================================================================
  // ELECTRO-SPIRIT - "Wackelkontakt": dizzy light bulb. Glowing glass head with big googly
  // anime eyes, filament, team screw base, crooked team lampshade (springy), plug-cable
  // tail, loose-contact flicker + orbiting sparks
  // =====================================================================================
  define('electro-spirit', {
    height: 0.82,
    outline: 0.045,
    anim: {
      body: 'spirit', walk: 'hop', attack: 'kamikaze', tempo: 1.4, weight: 0.08, hopHeight: 0.3, turnSpeed: 14, spinRate: 5,
      springs: { springs: { max: 0.8 }, tails: { max: 0.8 } },
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        // loose contact: the glow core flickers off now and then, sparks swell with the wind-up
        const on = flick(t, a.seed) || a.windup > 0.5 ? 1 : 0.35;
        const g = (0.9 + 0.1 * Math.sin(t * 40)) * on + 0.4 * a.windup;
        rig.core.scale.set(g, g, g);
        const s = 0.8 + 0.6 * a.windup + 0.2 * Math.sin(t * 31);
        rig.spinSparks.scale.set(s, s, s);
        // dizzy wobble of the head
        rig.head.rotation.z += 0.08 * Math.sin(t * 2.3 + a.seed * 4) * (1 - a.move);
      },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.45, pitch: 0.16, zoom: 1.2, pose: 'idle' },
    build(kit) {
      // v11: caged storm wraith. A spiked iron lantern cage (team-coloured bands, gold rivets)
      // imprisons a crackling lightning soul whose glowing slit eyes and fanged grin burn through
      // the bars; horned iron cap, tattered team rag skirt, chained spiked tail, orbiting bolts
      const rig = kit.rig();
      const HY = 0.44, HR = 0.21, IRON = K.iron;
      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, 0.08, 0]);
      rig.pivot('head', 'body', [0, 0.24, 0]);
      rig.pivot('core', 'head', [0, HY, 0]);
      rig.pivot('hair', 'head', [0, HY + 0.2, 0.0]);
      rig.pivot('tail', 'body', [0, 0.14, 0.1]);
      rig.pivot('spinSparks', 'root', [0, 0.4, 0]);
      rig.pivot('eyes', 'head', [0, HY + 0.03, -HR * 0.8]);

  defineModel('mega-minion', {

      const hull = kit.lathe(prof, { seg: 18, color: COL.olive, mat: 'metal' });
      const tm = kit.col('team');
      hull.paint(function (x, y, z) { return y > 0.36 ? COL.oliveDark : y > 0.28 ? tm : z < -0.15 ? COL.oliveDark : null; });
      const pod = hull.scale(1, 1, 0.95).rot(-HP, 0, 0).at(0, 0.45, 0.0);
      // shark mouth: dark grin band on the lower nose + white zigzag teeth
      const grin = [], zig = [];

  // =====================================================================================
  // balloon - "Ballon-Pirat": striped team balloon with a gold anchor emblem, patched gore and

  // hair, team bandana with long tails, eye patch, gold earring, team vest) who hurls lit
  // bombs: lean back with the bomb high, whip it over the rim, hang over the edge.

  defineModel('balloon', {

        rig.gondola.rotation.z += 0.06 * Math.sin(t * 1.1 + a.seed * 3);
        rig.envelope.rotation.z += 0.025 * Math.sin(t * 0.9 + a.seed * 2);

      },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.5, pitch: 0.1, pose: 'attack', zoom: 1.12 },
    build(kit0) {
      const kit = lite(kit0, 0.62);

      rig.pivot('gondola', 'root', [0, RY, 0]);
      rig.pivot('envelope', 'root', [0, RY, 0]);

      rig.pivot('scarf', 'head', [0, HY + 0.07, 0.15]);
      rig.pivot('armL', 'body', [-0.175, 0.64, -0.02]);
      rig.pivot('armR', 'body', [0.175, 0.64, -0.02]);
      rig.pivot('ammo', 'armR', [0.26, 0.42, -0.12]);
      rig.pivot('prop', 'gondola', [0, 0.2, 0.31]);
      // envelope: 8 gores (team / cream), gold equator band, gold anchor emblem, sewn patch
      const prof = [[0.14, 1.12], [0.2, 1.18], [0.36, 1.34], [0.53, 1.58], [0.62, 1.84], [0.61, 2.04], [0.52, 2.22], [0.34, 2.34], [0.14, 2.39], [0, 2.4]];
      const env = [];
      for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) env.push(kit.lathe(prof, { seg: 22, mat: k % 2 ? 'leather' : 'cloth', phi: [PI + (k - 0.5) * TAU / 8, TAU / 8], color: k % 2 ? COL.gore : 'team' }));
      // v11: bone skull + crossed bones war emblem on a gold-rimmed iron plate
      const anchor = kit.merge([

        kit.tube([[-0.13, -0.13, -0.01], [0.13, 0.13, -0.01]], 0.018, { color: COL.bone, radial: 6, seg: 2, caps: 'round', mat: 'bone' }),
        kit.tube([[0.13, -0.13, -0.01], [-0.13, 0.13, -0.01]], 0.018, { color: COL.bone, radial: 6, seg: 2, caps: 'round', mat: 'bone' }),
        kit.sphere(0.085, { color: COL.bone, seg: 12, scale: [1, 1, 0.45], mat: 'bone' }).at(0, 0.025, -0.02),
        kit.box(0.08, 0.05, 0.03, { color: COL.bone, bevel: 0.01, mat: 'bone' }).at(0, -0.055, -0.02),
        kit.disc(0.024, { color: 0x0a0606, seg: 8 }).at(-0.033, 0.03, -0.06),

        seams.push(kit.tube(pts, 0.007, { color: 0x1a1214, radial: 3, seg: kit.hi ? 24 : 8, caps: false, mat: 'leather' }));

        for (let k = 0; k < 16; k++) {

          seams.push(kit.tube(pts, 0.005, { color: 'rope', radial: 3, seg: 12, caps: false }));
        }

      }
      function k2(a) { return a > 0 ? 0x4a3428 : 0x2a2a30; }
      rig.add('envelope', env, anchor, seams,
        kit.ring(0.622, 0.03, { color: COL.gold, seg: [6, 40], mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 1.84, 0),
        kit.ring(0.155, 0.035, { color: COL.iron, seg: [6, 18], mat: 'metal' }).at(0, 1.13, 0),
        kit.rcyl(0.17, 0.19, 0.05, { color: COL.iron, seg: 18, mat: 'metal' }).at(0, 2.39, 0),
        kit.cylinder(0.018, 0.022, 0.26, { color: COL.iron, seg: 10, open: true, mat: 'metal' }).at(0, 2.53, 0),
        kit.cone(0.04, 0.12, { color: COL.gold, seg: 8, mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 2.7, 0),
        kit.box(0.17, 0.15, 0.02, { color: 0x3a2a22, bevel: 0.008, mat: 'leather' }).rot(0.08, patchA, 0.1).at(Math.sin(patchA) * 0.6, 2.0, Math.cos(patchA) * 0.6),
        kit.box(0.012, 0.11, 0.024, { color: 'rope', bevel: 0.005 }).rot(0.08, patchA, 0.1).at(Math.sin(patchA) * 0.605, 2.0, Math.cos(patchA) * 0.605));
      rig.add('flag', kit.extrude([[0, 0], [0.44, -0.05], [0.35, -0.12], [0.44, -0.2], [0, -0.21]], 0.008, { color: 'team', bevel: 0.006, bevelSeg: 2, smooth: 30, mat: 'cloth' }).rot(0, -HP, 0).at(0, 2.63, 0.02));

      // gondola: barrel (alternating staves, dark inside), iron hoops, ropes, spare bombs
      const bprof = [[0.17, 0.0], [0.22, 0.03], [0.255, 0.12], [0.265, 0.24], [0.255, 0.34], [0.235, 0.41]];
      const staves = [];

  // =====================================================================================
  // Whale helpers (lava-hound "Himmelswal" and lava-pup "Walkälbchen")
  // =====================================================================================
  /** Whale hull: lathe along the forward axis; slate-blue back, warm belly, glowing lava along
   *  the mouth line (world y below mouthY in the front half). */
  function whaleHull(kit, prof, cy, cz, vs, seg, mouthY) {
    const hull = kit.lathe(prof, { seg: Math.round(seg * 1.5), color: COL.whale, scale: [1, 1, vs], mat: 'soft' });
    const top = kit.col(COL.whaleTop), mid = kit.col(COL.whale), belly = kit.col(COL.whaleBelly), lava = kit.col(COL.lava);
    const my = mouthY - cy, ln = prof[prof.length - 1][1];
    // v8: soft blends (no jagged colour steps): lava lip glow fades in over a narrow band
    const lip = function (y, z) { return smooth01((my - z) / 0.014 + 0.5) * smooth01((y - 0.05 * ln) / 0.06); };
    hull.paint(function (x, y, z) {
      const r = Math.max(1e-3, hullR(prof, y) * vs), h = clamp(z / r, -1, 1);
      const base = h > 0.5 ? kit.mix(mid, top, (h - 0.5) / 0.5) : h > -0.3 ? mid : kit.mix(mid, belly, smooth01((-0.3 - h) / 0.35));
      const k = lip(y, z);
      return k > 0.001 ? kit.mix(base, lava, k) : base;
    });
    glowBy(hull, function (x, y, z) { return lip(y, z); });
    return hull.rot(-HP, 0, 0).at(0, cy, cz);
  }
  /** Paddle fin (left) lying in XZ, root at origin, tip team-coloured. */
  function whaleFin(kit, pts, thick, tipX) {
    const f = kit.extrude(arcShape(pts.map(function (q) { return [q[0], -q[1]]; }), -0.06), thick * 0.5, { color: COL.whale, bevel: thick * 0.32, bevelSeg: 3, curveSeg: 5, smooth: 50 }).rot(-HP, 0, 0).bake();
    const team = kit.col('team'), belly = kit.col(COL.whaleBelly);
    f.paint(function (x, y, z, nx, ny) { return x < tipX ? team : ny < -0.4 ? belly : null; });
    return f;
  }
  /** Euler that turns local sx*X (sx = -1 | 1) onto the direction a -> b (brows along a surface). */
  function alongEuler(a, b, sx) {
    const d = new THREE.Vector3(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1], b[2] - a[2]).normalize();
    const q = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(sx || -1, 0, 0), d);
    const e = new THREE.Euler().setFromQuaternion(q);
    return [e.x, e.y, e.z];
  }
  /** Whale face: two big anime eyes on the hull + thick basalt brows lying along the head. */
  function whaleFace(kit, rig, H, o) {
    const eq = H(o.u, o.ang, -o.r * 0.45);
    rig.pivot('eyes', 'body', [0, eq[1], eq[2]]);
    const eo = function (sd) { return { color: COL.lava, core: COL.emberHot, lid: COL.lavaRock, side: sd, tilt: o.tilt + 0.25, tall: 0.72 }; };
    rig.add('eyes',
      grimEye(kit, o.r * 1.12, eo(-1)).rot(o.rx, o.ry, 0).at(eq[0], eq[1], eq[2]),
      grimEye(kit, o.r * 1.12, eo(1)).rot(o.rx, -o.ry, 0).at(-eq[0], eq[1], eq[2]));
    const bi = H(o.u + o.bu, o.ang + o.bIn, 0.004), bo = H(o.u + o.bu * 0.4, o.ang + o.bOut, 0.004);
    const eL = alongEuler(bi, bo, -1), eR = alongEuler([-bi[0], bi[1], bi[2]], [-bo[0], bo[1], bo[2]], 1);
    const len = Math.hypot(bo[0] - bi[0], bo[1] - bi[1], bo[2] - bi[2]) * 1.05;
    rig.pivot('browL', 'body', bi, { rot: eL });
    rig.pivot('browR', 'body', [-bi[0], bi[1], bi[2]], { rot: eR });
    rig.add('browL', kit.brow(len, o.bThick, { color: COL.lavaRock, side: -1, arch: 0.2 }).outline(0.8).rot(eL[0], eL[1], eL[2]).at(bi[0], bi[1], bi[2]));
    rig.add('browR', kit.brow(len, o.bThick, { color: COL.lavaRock, side: 1, arch: 0.2 }).outline(0.8).rot(eR[0], eR[1], eR[2]).at(-bi[0], bi[1], bi[2]));
    return eq;
  }

  // =====================================================================================
  // phoenix-egg - "Feuer-Ei": glowing egg with gold swirls in an ember nest (team ember
  // stones), fiery cracks and a springy flame on top; the chick's big glowing anime eyes and
  // tiny brows peek out of a hole. It rocks harder and harder until it hatches.
  // =====================================================================================
  const EGG_PROF = [[0, 0.08], [0.16, 0.1], [0.255, 0.19], [0.3, 0.33], [0.295, 0.48], [0.25, 0.63], [0.16, 0.75], [0.07, 0.8], [0, 0.815]];
  defineModel('phoenix-egg', {
    height: 0.98,
    ao: 0.1,
    outline: 0.05,
    anim: {
      body: 'blob', walk: 'hop', attack: 'none', weight: 0.55,
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        const g = clamp(0.35 + a.rt * 0.25, 0.35, 1);
        const burst = Math.pow(0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * (1.9 + g) + a.seed * 6), 6) * g;
        rig.body.rotation.z += 0.17 * burst * Math.sin(t * 17);
        rig.body.rotation.x += 0.06 * burst * Math.sin(t * 13 + 1.2);
        rig.body.position.y += 0.035 * burst * Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 17));
        rig.hair.scale.y *= 1 + 0.25 * flick(t, a.seed) + 0.3 * burst;
        rig.cracks.scale.x *= 1 + 0.03 * burst; rig.cracks.scale.z *= 1 + 0.03 * burst;
        rig.eyes.position.x += 0.012 * Math.sin(t * 0.9 + a.seed * 3);
        rig.eyes.position.y += 0.006 * Math.sin(t * 1.3 + a.seed);
        rig.eyes.scale.y *= 1 - 0.35 * burst;   // squeeze the eyes while pushing
      },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.3, pitch: 0.2, zoom: 1.15 },
    build(kit0) {
      const kit = lite(kit0, 0.7);
      const rig = kit.rig();
      rig.pivot('nest', 'root', [0, 0, 0]);
      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, 0.1, 0]);
      rig.pivot('cracks', 'body', [0, 0.45, 0]);
      rig.pivot('hair', 'body', [0, 0.8, 0]);
      // v11p: one burning eye peering through the split in the shell (no cute pair of eyes)
      const V = G.__cdV11;
      rig.pivot('eyes', 'body', [0.02, 0.5, -0.272]);
      rig.add('eyes', V.heroEye(kit, 0.04, { iris: 0xffb020, irisDark: 0xa04000, irisLight: 0xffffd0, white: 0xc05a10, ballGlow: 0.8, glow: 1, side: 1, lid: 0x0e0606, lash: 0x050202, open: 0.14, low: 0.26, slit: 0.12, irisA: 0.75, pupilR: 0.2 }).rot(0, 0, 0.35).at(0.02, 0.5, -0.272));
      // shell shards lifting at the split (on the brow pivots: they twitch with the expressions)
      rig.pivot('browL', 'body', [-0.03, 0.56, -0.29]);
      rig.pivot('browR', 'body', [0.06, 0.55, -0.285]);
      rig.add('browL', kit.extrude([[0, 0], [0.06, 0.02], [0.03, 0.07], [-0.02, 0.05]], 0.015, { color: 0x120a0a, bevel: 0.004, mat: 'lacquer' }).rot(-0.3, 0.2, 0.3).at(-0.05, 0.54, -0.29));
      rig.add('browR', kit.extrude([[0, 0], [0.05, -0.01], [0.04, 0.05], [0.0, 0.06]], 0.015, { color: 0x120a0a, bevel: 0.004, mat: 'lacquer' }).rot(-0.3, -0.2, -0.2).at(0.06, 0.54, -0.285));

      // nest: twig rings, ash bed, sticks, team ember stones, orange embers
      const nest = [
        kit.sphere(0.32, { color: 0x1e1a1c, seg: 16, scale: [1, 0.16, 1], mat: 'stone' }).at(0, 0.03, 0),
        kit.ring(0.34, 0.075, { color: 0x1a120e, seg: [8, 26], mat: 'wood' }).at(0, 0.07, 0),
        kit.ring(0.29, 0.05, { color: 0x2e1e16, seg: [7, 24], mat: 'wood' }).rot(0.08, 0, -0.06).at(0, 0.11, 0),
      ];
      for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
        const ang = i / 7 * TAU + 0.3;
        nest.push(kit.capsule(0.015, 0.22, { color: i % 2 ? 0x3a2618 : 0x1a120e, seg: 7, capSeg: 2, mat: 'wood' }).rot(0, 0, HP).bake().rot(0, -ang, 0.25 * ((i % 3) - 1)).at(Math.cos(ang) * 0.33, 0.12, Math.sin(ang) * 0.33));
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const ang = i / 5 * TAU + 0.6;
        nest.push(kit.rock(0.06, { color: 'teamGlow', glow: 0.7, detail: 0, seed: i + 3 }).at(Math.cos(ang) * 0.37, 0.12, Math.sin(ang) * 0.37));
        nest.push(kit.gem(0.025, { color: COL.lava, glow: 1, outline: false }).at(Math.cos(ang + 0.6) * 0.3, 0.13, Math.sin(ang + 0.6) * 0.3));
      }
      rig.add('nest', nest);

      // egg shell: dark red bottom -> orange top, gold swirl stripes; dark hole at the front
      // obsidian shell split by branching glowing cracks
      const egg = kit.lathe(EGG_PROF, { seg: 22, color: 0x140c0e, mat: 'lacquer' });
      const o0 = kit.col(0x0a0608), o1 = kit.col(0x2a1416);
      egg.paint(function (x, y, z) { return kit.mix(o0, o1, smooth01((0.75 - y) / 0.6) * 0.8); });
      // v11: obsidian spikes jutting from the shell (menacing silhouette)
      const espk = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
        const ph = 0.45 + i / 7 * TAU, y = 0.3 + 0.28 * ((i * 3) % 4) / 3, r = hullR(EGG_PROF, y);
        if (Math.abs(((ph % TAU) + TAU) % TAU - PI) < 0.5) continue;
        espk.push(kit.cone(0.05, 0.2, { color: 0x1a0e0e, seg: 6, mat: 'lacquer' }).rot(HP, 0, 0).bake().rot(-0.3, ph, 0).at(Math.sin(ph) * r * 0.98, y, Math.cos(ph) * r * 0.98));
      }
      rig.add('body', egg, espk,
        kit.sphere(0.12, { color: 0x0a0505, seg: 14, scale: [0.5, 1.1, 0.4], mat: 'rubber' }).rot(0, 0, 0.3).at(0.02, 0.5, -0.262),
        kit.sphere(0.05, { color: COL.ember, seg: 8, scale: [0.4, 1.6, 0.3], glow: 0.6, outline: false }).rot(0, 0, 0.3).at(0.0, 0.45, -0.27));
      const E = function (ph, y) { const r = hullR(EGG_PROF, y) + 0.004; return [Math.sin(ph) * r, y, Math.cos(ph) * r]; };
      const crack = function (list) { return kit.tube(list.map(function (q) { return E(q[0], q[1]); }), 0.016, { color: COL.ember, radial: 6, seg: list.length * 3, glow: 1, caps: 'round' }); };
      rig.add('cracks',
        crack([[PI - 0.42, 0.53], [PI - 0.6, 0.59], [PI - 0.55, 0.67], [PI - 0.78, 0.73]]),
        crack([[PI + 0.42, 0.44], [PI + 0.62, 0.36], [PI + 0.56, 0.28], [PI + 0.82, 0.21]]),
        crack([[PI + 0.32, 0.56], [PI + 0.46, 0.65], [PI + 0.36, 0.74]]),
        crack([[0.5, 0.3], [0.3, 0.42], [0.46, 0.55], [0.2, 0.64]]),
        crack([[PI - 0.1, 0.66], [PI - 0.25, 0.72], [PI - 0.18, 0.78]]), crack([[PI + 0.15, 0.32], [PI + 0.05, 0.24], [PI + 0.2, 0.16]]),
        crack([[1.6, 0.25], [1.75, 0.38], [1.6, 0.5], [1.8, 0.62]]), crack([[-1.6, 0.6], [-1.75, 0.48], [-1.55, 0.36], [-1.7, 0.24]]),
        crack([[2.4, 0.45], [2.25, 0.55], [2.4, 0.68]]), crack([[-2.4, 0.3], [-2.2, 0.42], [-2.35, 0.55]]));
      rig.add('hair',
        flame(kit, 0.22, 0.065).outline(false).at(0, 0.79, 0),
        flame(kit, 0.13, 0.042).outline(false).rot(0, 0, 0.5).at(-0.04, 0.78, 0.01),
        flame(kit, 0.13, 0.042).outline(false).rot(0, 0, -0.5).at(0.04, 0.78, 0.01));
      return rig;
    },
  });

  // =====================================================================================
  // tower-archer - princess tower crew: young anime ranger. Spiky golden hair with long side
  // bangs and a springy ponytail (team ribbon), team feather hair clip, big green eyes, team
  // neckerchief with tails, team tunic + leather corset, leather pauldron on the bow arm,
  // longbow (archer bow rig: weapon in armL, drawable string, nocked arrow in armR). Legs are
  // merged into the body mesh: the crew never walks and the parapet hides them anyway.
  // =====================================================================================
  defineModel('tower-archer', {
    height: 1.3,
    scale: 1.12,
    outline: 0.05,
    anim: {
      body: 'biped', walk: 'march', attack: 'bow', tempo: 1, weight: 0.25, stringRest: 0.05, reload: 0.22, strikeHold: 0.07,

    portrait: { yaw: -0.55, pitch: 0.12, pose: 'attack', zoom: 1.3 },
    build(kit0) {

      // v11: hooded dark ranger, adult proportions (head ~1/5.5); legs stay merged into the body

      const s = 0.91, R = 0.096, HY = 1.43 * s - R * 1.2, HIP = 0.74 * s, SH = 1.13 * s, SX = 0.175, LX = 0.085;

      rig.pivot('armR', 'body', [SX, SH, 0]);

      const LEA = 0x2a1c16, LEAD = 0x16100c, TUN = 0x1e1a20, STEEL = 0x3a3e46;

        kit.rcyl(0.06, 0.054, 0.3, { color: LEAD, seg: 11, mat: 'leather' }).at(-LX - 0.005, 0.22, -0.004),
        kit.cylinder(0.072, 0.066, 0.06, { color: LEA, seg: 11, mat: 'leather' }).at(-LX - 0.005, 0.37, -0.006),
        V.shoe(kit, [-LX - 0.005, 0, -0.04], 0.11, 0.22, 0.08, LEAD, 0x0a0808, { mat: 'leather' }),
        kit.box(0.03, 0.02, 0.012, { color: COL.gold, bevel: 0.005, mat: 'gold' }).at(-LX - 0.005, 0.3, -0.062),
      ]);
      // ---- torso: lean V in a dark tunic, layered leather cuirass with gold rivets, belt with

      const cy0 = HIP + 0.03;
      const tun = kit.blob(0.3, SH - cy0 + 0.1, 0.21, { color: TUN, round: 0.3, taper: 1.18, bottom: 0.8, bulge: 0.08, seg: 12, mat: 'cloth' });
      const cuir = kit.blob(0.305, 0.3, 0.215, { color: LEA, round: 0.35, taper: 1.15, bottom: 0.85, bulge: 0.1, seg: 12, mat: 'leather' });
      const quiver = kit.merge([
        kit.rcyl(0.06, 0.05, 0.42, { color: LEAD, seg: 12, mat: 'leather' }),
        kit.ring(0.06, 0.01, { color: COL.gold, seg: [5, 14], mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 0.17, 0),
        kit.ring(0.054, 0.01, { color: COL.gold, seg: [5, 14], mat: 'gold' }).at(0, -0.15, 0),
        kit.cylinder(0.008, 0.008, 0.16, { color: 0x3a2a20, seg: 8, open: true }).at(-0.022, 0.27, 0.0),
        kit.cylinder(0.008, 0.008, 0.16, { color: 0x3a2a20, seg: 8, open: true }).at(0.022, 0.28, 0.012),
        kit.box(0.01, 0.08, 0.05, { color: 'team', bevel: 0.004, mat: 'cloth' }).at(-0.022, 0.33, 0.0),

      ]).rot(0.12, 0, 0.45).at(-0.02, (cy0 + SH) / 2 + 0.06, 0.15);

      rig.add('body', leg, leg.mirror(),

        kit.hi ? kit.tube([[-0.13, cy0 + 0.26, -0.11], [0, cy0 + 0.22, -0.125], [0.13, cy0 + 0.26, -0.11]], 0.008, { color: COL.gold, radial: 5, seg: 6, caps: 'round', mat: 'gold' }) : null,
        kit.ring(0.152, 0.025, { color: LEAD, seg: [4, 16], scale: [1, 1, 0.8], mat: 'leather' }).at(0, cy0 + 0.04, 0),

        kit.blob(0.07, 0.06, 0.05, { color: LEA, round: 0.4, seg: 9, mat: 'leather' }).at(0.12, cy0 + 0.0, -0.06),
        // tabard flaps over the thighs (team)

      // ---- head: lean scarred face in the shadow of a pointed TEAM hood, narrow faintly glowing
      // eyes, loose dark strands, a dark scarf over the chin
      const head = V.heroHead(kit, rig, HY, R, { skin: 0xb0805f, shade: 0x6a4030, iris: 0x7ad05a, irisDark: 0x1a4a10, irisLight: 0xc8ff9a, eyeGlow: 0.35, lash: 0x0a0606, brow: 0x16121a, browW: 1.2, browTilt: 0.55, tilt: 0.5, open: 0.24, eyeR: 0.18,
        cheek: 0.8, socket: 0.6, nose: 0.85, hook: 0.5, ridge: 1.35, cheekbone: 1.5, jaw: 0.95, long: 0.95, chinW: 0.6, gaunt: 1.6, mouthW: 0.3, lips: 0x8a5048, blush: 0.08,
        scalp: 0x16121a, hairline: 0.6, sideburn: -0.1, scars: [[[-0.22, 0.46], [-0.3, 0.27]], [[-0.38, -0.02], [-0.48, -0.3]]] });
      // cloth hood with stoff thickness: rolled rim around the face, fold creases, drooping point
      const rim = [], folds = [];
      for (let k = 0; k <= 12; k++) { const t = lerp(-2.25, 2.25, k / 12); rim.push([Math.sin(t) * R * 1.02, HY + R * 0.08 + Math.cos(t) * R * 1.12, -R * 0.72 + Math.abs(Math.sin(t)) * R * 0.18]); }
      if (kit.hi) for (const q of [[-0.75, 0.6], [0.75, 0.6], [-0.5, 0.95], [0.5, 0.95]]) folds.push(kit.tube([[q[0] * R * 1.1, HY + R * q[1], -R * 0.2], [q[0] * R * 1.25, HY + R * (q[1] - 0.25), R * 0.3], [q[0] * R * 1.2, HY + R * (q[1] - 0.6), R * 0.75]], R * 0.04, { color: 'teamDark', radial: 4, seg: 6, caps: 'round', mat: 'cloth' }));
      const hl = [];

        hl.push(V.lock(kit, head, [x, 0.78, -0.62], [x * 1.35, 0.4, -0.9], R * 0.06, 0x16121a, { n: 2, l0: 0.06, l1: 0.07, tail: [[R * 0.05 * Math.sign(x || 1), -R * 0.32, -R * 0.03]], hi: 0x4a4048, root: 0.8 }));
      }
      rig.add('head', head.parts, hl, folds,
        V.hood(kit, HY + R * 0.05, R * 0.08, R, { color: 'team', inner: 0x0e0a0c, gap: 0.9, peak: 0.0, len: 2.25, scale: 1.24 }),
        kit.tube(rim, R * 0.09, { color: 'team', radial: 6, seg: 20, caps: 'round', mat: 'cloth' }),
        kit.blob(R * 1.5, R * 0.6, R * 1.25, { color: 0x1a1418, round: 0.45, taper: 1.2, seg: 10, mat: 'cloth' }).at(0, HY - R * 1.05, R * 0.05));
      rig.add('hair', null);

      rig.add('hairTail', V.spike(kit, [0, HY + R * 1.0, R * 0.7], [0, HY + R * 1.05, R * 1.3], [0, HY + R * 0.55, R * 1.9], R * 0.5, 'team', { mat: 'cloth', radial: 6, seg: 6 }));

      // ---- arms: leather bracers with gold rims, gloves; steel pauldron with a gold spike on the
      // bow arm
      const arm = function (sx) {
        const S0 = [sx * SX, SH, 0], E = [sx * (SX + 0.025), 0.8, 0.0], Hh = sx < 0 ? HL : HR;
        return kit.merge([
          kit.sphere(0.06, { color: TUN, seg: 10, mat: 'cloth' }).at(S0[0] + sx * 0.004, SH - 0.012, 0),
          V.limb(kit, [S0[0] + sx * 0.006, SH - 0.02, 0], E, 0.054, 0.045, TUN, { mat: 'cloth', bulge: 0.1 }),
          V.bracer(kit, E, [Hh[0], Hh[1] + 0.06, Hh[2] + 0.01], 0.044, { color: LEA, trim: COL.gold, mat: 'leather' }),

      const bx = HL[0], by = HL[1], bz = HL[2];
      const bowPath = [[0, 0.2, -0.56], [0, 0.12, -0.5], [0, 0.04, -0.34], [0, -0.012, -0.12], [0, -0.02, 0], [0, -0.012, 0.12], [0, 0.04, 0.34], [0, 0.12, 0.5], [0, 0.2, 0.56]].map(function (q) { return [bx + q[0], by + q[1], bz + q[2]]; });

  // =====================================================================================
  // CROWN TOWERS

  // v3 princess tower: authored for the 2.5 x 2.5 footprint of CR.Arena.towerLayout() (v3
