      spike(kit, h * 1.1 + 0.06, 0.038, { gold: true }).at(0, h + h * 0.16, 0),
    ];
    if (o.slit) parts.push(kit.extrude(archPath(0.06, h * 0.5, 2), 0.02, { color: COL.warm, glow: 0.8, bevel: 0, smooth: false }).at(0, h * 0.25, -d / 2 - 0.006));
    return kit.merge(parts);
  }
  /** Diagonal corner buttress of a square keep (corner sx, sz of half width hw) from y0 to y1:
   *  tapered stone pier, gold band, sloped cap and a black steel spike pointing out + up. */
  function buttress(kit, sx, sz, hw, y0, y1, o) {
    o = o || {};
    const w = o.w || 0.26, h = y1 - y0, yaw = Math.atan2(sx, sz);
    const pier = kit.merge([
      polyLathe(kit, [[w * 0.62, 0], [w * 0.56, h * 0.3], [w * 0.44, h * 0.92], [w * 0.4, h]], { color: COL.wallShade, mat: 'stone', rough: 0.76, rc: 0.025, crease: 40 }),
      polyLathe(kit, [[w * 0.5, h * 0.52], [w * 0.53, h * 0.535], [w * 0.53, h * 0.58], [w * 0.5, h * 0.6]], { color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold', rc: 0.02, open: true }),
      kit.cone(w * 0.58, w * 0.62, { seg: 4, color: COL.quoin, mat: 'stone' }).rot(0, Math.PI / 4, 0).at(0, h + w * 0.3, 0),
      spike(kit, o.spike || 0.32, 0.045, { gold: true }).rot(0.75, 0, 0).at(0, h + w * 0.2, w * 0.18),
      polyLathe(kit, [[w * 0.66, 0], [w * 0.66, 0.08]], { color: COL.plinth, mat: 'stone', rc: 0.03 }),
    ]);
    return pier.rot(0, yaw, 0).at(sx * (hw + 0.03), y0, sz * (hw + 0.03));
  }
  /** Mortar courses (thin dark bands) around a square keep at the given heights. */
  function courseLines(kit, hw, ys, rc) {
    return ys.map(y => polyLathe(kit, [[hw + 0.002, y - 0.012], [hw + 0.008, y], [hw + 0.002, y + 0.012]], { color: COL.mortarLine, mat: 'stone', rc: rc || 0.1, open: true, crease: 80 }));
  }
  /** v11 rv: ashlar masonry on the four faces of a square keep (front face z = -hw, copied):
   *  vertical mortar joints in running bond between the course heights ys (bottom -> top), bed
   *  joints at o.beds, and (card art) a few proud worn blocks with chipped corners. */
  function ashlar(kit, hw, ys, o) {
    o = o || {};
    const bw = o.bw || 0.34, rnd = kit.rand(o.seed || 11), lim = hw - (o.edge || 0.14), z = -hw - 0.004, parts = [];
    for (let k = 0; k < ys.length - 1; k++) {
      const y0 = ys[k], y1 = ys[k + 1], h = y1 - y0;
      if (h < 0.06) continue;
      const xs = [];
      for (let x = -lim + (k % 2 ? bw * 0.5 : bw * 0.15); x < lim; x += bw * (0.8 + rnd() * 0.4)) xs.push(x);
      for (const x of xs) parts.push(kit.box(0.016, h - 0.02, 0.012, { bevel: 0, micro: false, color: COL.mortarLine }).at(x, y0 + h / 2, z));
      if (kit.hi) for (let j = 0; j + 1 < xs.length; j++) {
        if (rnd() > 0.45) continue;
        const cx = (xs[j] + xs[j + 1]) / 2, w = xs[j + 1] - xs[j] - 0.03;
        parts.push(kit.box(w, h - 0.03, 0.022, { bevel: 0.01, seg: 1, color: rnd() < 0.5 ? COL.quoinShade : COL.wallShade, mat: 'stone', rough: 0.8 }).at(cx, y0 + h / 2, z - 0.006));
        parts.push(kit.sphere(0.035, { seg: 5, hseg: 3, color: COL.wallDark, mat: 'stone', scale: [1, 0.8, 0.35] }).at(cx + (rnd() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1) * w * 0.46, y0 + (rnd() < 0.5 ? 0.02 : h - 0.03), z - 0.017));
      }
    }
    for (const y of (o.beds || [])) parts.push(kit.box(2 * lim + 0.1, 0.014, 0.012, { bevel: 0, micro: false, color: COL.mortarLine }).at(0, y, z));
    return fourFaces(kit, kit.merge(parts));
  }
  /** Team spire roof apron of a square keep: from the eave (apothem SO at y sk0) up to the wall
   *  (apothem aw at y sk1); black steel ridge bands, a sawtooth teamDark valance, gold roll. */
  function roofApron(kit, aw, SO, sk0, sk1, o) {
    o = o || {};
    const parts = [];
    const ey = sk0 + 0.075;
    parts.push(polyLathe(kit, [[aw - 0.04, sk0 - 0.02], [SO - 0.07, sk0 - 0.01], [SO, sk0 + 0.025], [SO - 0.012, ey], [aw + 0.02, sk1]],
      { color: 'team', mat: TS, rc: o.rc || 0.16, open: true, crease: 40 }));
    for (const t of [0.36, 0.68]) {
      const a = SO - 0.012 + (aw + 0.02 - (SO - 0.012)) * t, y = ey + (sk1 - ey) * t;
      parts.push(polyLathe(kit, [[a - 0.004, y - 0.02], [a + 0.016, y - 0.004], [a + 0.006, y + 0.016], [a - 0.02, y + 0.02]], { color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal', rc: (o.rc || 0.16) * 0.8, open: true, crease: 70 }));
    }
    // sawtooth valance (pointed teamDark teeth, one extruded strip per side)
    const ns = (o.scallops || 5) + 2, THREE = T3(), sw = 2 * SO / ns, sh = new THREE.Shape();
    sh.moveTo(-SO, 0.05);
    for (let k = 0; k < ns; k++) { const x0 = -SO + sw * k; sh.lineTo(x0, 0); sh.lineTo(x0 + sw / 2, -sw * 1.1); sh.lineTo(x0 + sw, 0); }
    sh.lineTo(SO, 0.05); sh.lineTo(-SO, 0.05);
    const val = kit.extrude(sh, 0.035, { color: 'teamDark', mat: TS, curveSeg: 3, bevel: 0, smooth: false }).scale(1, 0.6, 1);
    for (let f = 0; f < 4; f++) parts.push(kit.merge([val.clone().at(0, sk0 - 0.005, -SO + 0.025)]).rot(0, f * HP, 0));
    // gold eave lip + gold roll at the wall
    parts.push(polyLathe(kit, [[SO - 0.02, sk0 + 0.012], [SO + 0.012, sk0 + 0.024], [SO - 0.004, sk0 + 0.04]], { color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold', rc: o.rc || 0.16, open: true, crease: 80 }));
    parts.push(polyLathe(kit, [[aw - 0.01, sk1 - 0.035], [aw + 0.06, sk1 - 0.012], [aw + 0.07, sk1 + 0.02], [aw + 0.03, sk1 + 0.045], [aw - 0.01, sk1 + 0.05]],
      { color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold', rc: (o.rc || 0.16) * 0.7, open: true, crease: 80 }));
    return parts;
  }
  /** Parapet with a dark coping + blackened plank deck + team rug with a spiked star (F = top). */
  function parapetDeck(kit, PH, y0, F, rug, o) {
    o = o || {};
    const parts = [
      polyLathe(kit, [[PH - 0.02, y0], [PH, y0 + 0.02], [PH, F - 0.05]], { color: COL.wallShade, mat: 'stone', rough: 0.74, rc: 0.18, open: true }),
      polyLathe(kit, [[PH - 0.005, F - 0.07], [PH + 0.03, F - 0.05], [PH + 0.04, F - 0.015], [PH + 0.015, F + 0.02], [PH - 0.16, F + 0.02], [PH - 0.17, F - 0.02]],
        { color: COL.quoin, mat: 'stone', rough: 0.68, rc: 0.2, openBottom: true, crease: 60 }),
    ];
    const dw = PH - 0.17, np = o.planks || 6, pw = 2 * dw / np;
    for (let i = 0; i < np; i++) {
      parts.push(kit.box(pw - 0.018, 0.05, 2 * dw - 0.02, { bevel: 0.012, seg: 1, color: i % 2 ? 'woodDark' : 'grimLeatherDark', mat: 'wood' }).at(-dw + pw * (i + 0.5), F - 0.02, 0));
    }
    // iron deck straps
    for (const k of [-1, 1]) parts.push(kit.box(2 * dw - 0.04, 0.012, 0.05, { bevel: 0, micro: false, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(0, F + 0.007, k * dw * 0.72));
    // round team rug, gold border, inner ring, spiked eight-point star
    parts.push(kit.cylinder(rug, rug, 0.03, { seg: 20, color: 'team', mat: 'cloth' }).at(0, F + 0.02, 0));
    parts.push(kit.ring(rug - 0.005, 0.026, { seg: [3, 22], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, F + 0.036, 0));
    parts.push(kit.ring(rug * 0.66, 0.014, { seg: [3, 18], color: 'teamDark', mat: 'cloth' }).at(0, F + 0.036, 0));
    parts.push(kit.star(8, rug * 0.5, rug * 0.16, 0.012, { color: 'teamLight', mat: 'cloth' }).rot(-HP, 0, 0).at(0, F + 0.042, 0));
    parts.push(kit.star(4, rug * 0.24, rug * 0.08, 0.012, { color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).rot(-HP, 0, Math.PI / 4).at(0, F + 0.05, 0));
    return parts;
  }
  /** Round turret (origin at the base centre): dark stone shaft, corbelled machicolation with a
   *  gold band, tall ribbed team spire with eave spikes and a barbed finial, ember arrow slit. */
  function turret(kit, r, h, roofR, roofH, o) {
    o = o || {};
    const f0 = h - Math.min(h * 0.4, 0.34), f1 = h - Math.min(h * 0.18, 0.14);
    const parts = [
      kit.lathe([[r * 1.06, 0], [r * 1.0, Math.min(0.12, h * 0.2)], [r, f0], [r * 1.16, f1], [r * 1.16, h], [r * 0.9, h + 0.01]], { seg: 12, color: o.wall || COL.wallShade, mat: 'stone', rough: 0.74, corner: 50 }),
      kit.ring(r * 1.17, 0.024, { seg: [3, 14], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, f1 + 0.01, 0),
      coneRoof(kit, roofR, roofH * 1.34, { seg: 12, ribs: o.ribs || 4 }).at(0, h - 0.02, 0),
      kit.ring(roofR * 0.97, 0.02, { seg: [3, 14], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, h + 0.012, 0),
      spikeRing(kit, o.spikes || 6, roofR * 0.9, h - 0.005, roofR * 0.42, roofR * 0.07, { tilt: HP + 0.4, off: 0.5 }),
    ];
    if (o.finial !== false) parts.push(finial(kit, o.fs || 1).at(0, h - 0.02 + roofH * 1.34 * 0.97, 0));
    if (o.window) parts.push(slitWindow(kit, 0, h * 0.5, -r - 0.005, 0, o.window).rot(0, o.wyaw || 0, 0));
    return kit.merge(parts);
  }

  /** Dark crown-tower keep for the KING (square walls, team roof skirt, parapet, rug). */
  function towerShell(kit, P, king) {
    const hw = P.hw, B = P.plinth, F = P.floor;
    const parts = [];
    const wallTop = F - 0.5;              // skirt starts here
    // plinth: two rounded basalt tiers with a team inlay band and a gold lip
    parts.push(rslab(kit, B, B - 0.03, 0, 0.26, 0.08, { color: COL.plinthDark, mat: 'stone', rc: 0.4 }));
    parts.push(polyLathe(kit, [[B - 0.02, 0.1], [B - 0.006, 0.12], [B - 0.006, 0.16], [B - 0.02, 0.18]], { color: 'team', mat: TM, rc: 0.4, open: true }));
    parts.push(rslab(kit, B - 0.15, B - 0.17, 0.24, 0.38, 0.05, { color: COL.plinth, mat: 'stone', rc: 0.32 }));
    parts.push(polyLathe(kit, [[B - 0.185, 0.36], [B - 0.165, 0.372], [B - 0.175, 0.39]], { color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold', rc: 0.3, open: true }));
    // walls (rounded edges) + base course + mortar courses + a gold string course
    const wy0 = 0.36, wh = wallTop - wy0;
    parts.push(kit.box(hw * 2, wh, hw * 2, { bevel: 0.12, seg: 2, color: COL.wall, mat: 'stone', rough: 0.76 }).at(0, wy0 + wh / 2, 0));
    parts.push(rslab(kit, hw + 0.08, hw + 0.06, wy0, wy0 + 0.22, 0.06, { color: COL.wallShade, rc: 0.18 }));
    courseLines(kit, hw, [wy0 + wh * 0.3, wy0 + wh * 0.72], 0.14).forEach(q => parts.push(q));
    parts.push(ashlar(kit, hw, [wy0 + 0.22, wy0 + wh * 0.15, wy0 + wh * 0.3, wy0 + wh * 0.41, wy0 + wh * 0.52, wy0 + wh * 0.62, wy0 + wh * 0.72, wy0 + wh * 0.86, wallTop - 0.1], { beds: [wy0 + wh * 0.15, wy0 + wh * 0.41, wy0 + wh * 0.62, wy0 + wh * 0.86], seed: 8, bw: 0.4, edge: 0.18 }));
    parts.push(polyLathe(kit, [[hw - 0.01, wy0 + wh * 0.52], [hw + 0.03, wy0 + wh * 0.52 + 0.02], [hw + 0.03, wy0 + wh * 0.52 + 0.07], [hw - 0.01, wy0 + wh * 0.52 + 0.09]], { color: COL.wallShade, rc: 0.15, open: true }));
    parts.push(polyLathe(kit, [[hw + 0.025, wy0 + wh * 0.52 + 0.035], [hw + 0.04, wy0 + wh * 0.52 + 0.045], [hw + 0.025, wy0 + wh * 0.52 + 0.055]], { color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold', rc: 0.15, open: true }));
    // skirt + parapet + deck
    const sk0 = wallTop - 0.06, sk1 = wallTop + 0.3, SO = hw + 0.44;
    parts.push(polyLathe(kit, [[hw - 0.01, sk0 - 0.12], [hw + 0.04, sk0 - 0.08], [hw + 0.14, sk0 + 0.0]], { color: COL.wallShade, rc: 0.18, open: true }));
    roofApron(kit, hw + 0.13, SO, sk0, sk1, { scallops: 7, rc: 0.2 }).forEach(q => parts.push(q));
    parapetDeck(kit, hw + 0.11, sk1 - 0.02, F, 0.86, { planks: 8 }).forEach(q => parts.push(q));
    return { parts, wallTop, sk0, sk1 };
  }

  /** Fanged merlons around the king platform. */
  function merlons(kit, P) {
    const hw = P.hw + 0.11, F = P.floor, parts = [];
    const per = 3;
    for (let f = 0; f < 4; f++) {
      for (let k = 1; k <= per; k++) {
        const u = -hw + k * (2 * hw / (per + 1));
        const p = fangMerlon(kit, 0.4, 0.32, 0.24, { slit: k === 2 });
        if (f === 0) p.at(u, F, -hw + 0.13); else if (f === 1) p.rot(0, Math.PI, 0).at(u, F, hw - 0.13);
        else if (f === 2) p.rot(0, HP, 0).at(-hw + 0.13, F, u); else p.rot(0, -HP, 0).at(hw - 0.13, F, u);
        parts.push(p);
      }
    }
    return parts;
  }

  /** Pointed gate (front face z = -hw): dark recess with an ember glow, black iron portcullis with
   *  spiked teeth, stone arch with a gold inner trim, keystone and a horned skull. */
  function towerDoor(kit, hw, w, h, king, y0) {
    const Y = y0 === undefined ? 0.36 : y0, z = -hw;
    const parts = [
      kit.extrude(archPath(w + 0.04, h + 0.03, 5), 0.05, { color: 0x0b0708, bevel: 0, smooth: false }).at(0, Y, z - 0.005),
      kit.box(w * 0.86, h * 0.34, 0.012, { bevel: 0, micro: false, color: COL.ember, glow: 0.7 }).paint((x, y) => y > 0 ? 0x2a0804 : null).at(0, Y + h * 0.17, z - 0.032),
    ];
    // portcullis: vertical bars ending in spikes + two cross bars
    const nb = king ? 5 : 3;
    for (let i = 0; i < nb; i++) {
      const x = (i - (nb - 1) / 2) * (w * 0.82 / nb), top = archTop(w, h, x) - 0.03, y1 = Y + h * 0.12;
      parts.push(kit.box(0.032, top - h * 0.12, 0.03, { bevel: 0, micro: false, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(x, y1 + (top - h * 0.12) / 2, z - 0.045));
      parts.push(kit.cone(0.024, 0.09, { seg: 4, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).rot(Math.PI, 0, 0).at(x, y1 - 0.04, z - 0.045));
    }
    for (const fy of [0.38, 0.7]) parts.push(kit.box(w * 0.86, 0.03, 0.03, { bevel: 0, micro: false, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(0, Y + h * fy, z - 0.055));
    // stone arch surround + gold inner trim + jamb plinths + keystone
    const frame = archPath(w + 0.12, h + 0.08, 6).map(p => [p[0], Y + p[1], z - 0.02]);
    parts.push(kit.tube(frame, 0.06, { color: COL.quoin, mat: 'stone', radial: 5, seg: 16, caps: false, scale: [1, 1, 0.8] }));
    parts.push(kit.tube(archPath(w + 0.02, h + 0.02, 6).map(p => [p[0], Y + p[1], z - 0.06]), 0.014, { color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold', radial: 4, seg: 16, caps: false }));
    for (const k of [-1, 1]) parts.push(kit.box(0.16, 0.14, 0.14, { bevel: 0.03, seg: 1, color: COL.quoinShade, mat: 'stone' }).at(k * (w / 2 + 0.07), Y + 0.07, z - 0.03));
    parts.push(kit.extrude([[-0.08, 0], [0.08, 0], [0.05, 0.2], [0, 0.26], [-0.05, 0.2]], 0.1, { color: COL.quoinShade, mat: 'stone', bevel: 0.012, smooth: false }).at(0, Y + h + 0.0, z - 0.03));
    // a horned skull with ember eyes guards every gate
    parts.push(skull(kit, king ? 0.13 : 0.095, { hornLen: 1.7 }).at(0, Y + h + 0.2, z - 0.12));
    parts.push(kit.box(w + 0.42, 0.08, 0.22, { bevel: kit.hi ? 0.03 : 0, seg: 1, color: COL.plinth, mat: 'stone' }).at(0, Y + 0.04, z - 0.1));
    return kit.merge(parts);
  }
  /** Tattered team war banner (gold backing, sawtooth hem) on a black steel rod with spike
   *  tips; front face (z = -hw). 'crystal' = glowing team gem in a spiked black-and-gold star,
   *  'crown' = spiked gold crown with a team gem. */
  function towerBanner(kit, hw, y, w, h, emblem) {
    const z = -hw - 0.06, rod = w + 0.24;
    const parts = [
      cloth(kit, w + 0.08, h + 0.06, { color: 'oldGold', inner: 'oldGoldDark', teeth: 4, teethD: 0.16, rag: true, ragSeed: 3, sy: 3, wave: 0.02, mat: 'gold' }).at(0, y, z + 0.012),
      cloth(kit, w, h, { color: 'team', inner: 'teamDark', teeth: 5, teethD: 0.2, rag: true, ragSeed: 1, sy: 4, wave: 0.024 }).at(0, y - 0.01, z),
      kit.cylinder(0.026, 0.026, rod, { seg: 8, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).rot(0, 0, HP).at(0, y + 0.01, z - 0.01),
      spike(kit, 0.13, 0.03, { gold: true }).rot(0, 0, -HP).at(rod / 2, y + 0.01, z - 0.01),
      spike(kit, 0.13, 0.03, { gold: true }).rot(0, 0, HP).at(-rod / 2, y + 0.01, z - 0.01),
      kit.box(w * 0.86, 0.035, 0.012, { bevel: 0, micro: false, color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, y - 0.1, z - 0.012),
    ];
    const ey = y - h * 0.5;
    if (emblem === 'crown') {
      const cw = w * 0.6, ch = cw * 0.7;
      const pts = [[-cw / 2, 0], [cw / 2, 0], [cw * 0.54, ch * 1.1], [cw * 0.27, ch * 0.5], [cw * 0.12, ch * 0.62], [0, ch * 1.3], [-cw * 0.12, ch * 0.62], [-cw * 0.27, ch * 0.5], [-cw * 0.54, ch * 1.1]];
      parts.push(kit.extrude(pts, 0.03, { color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold', bevel: 0.008, smooth: false }).at(0, ey - ch * 0.4, z - 0.03));
      parts.push(kit.box(cw * 1.02, ch * 0.18, 0.02, { bevel: 0, micro: false, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(0, ey - ch * 0.3, z - 0.05));
      parts.push(kit.gem(0.055, { color: 'teamGlow', mat: 'gem', glow: 0.55 }).at(0, ey - ch * 0.05, z - 0.065));
    } else {
      parts.push(kit.star(8, w * 0.4, w * 0.15, 0.03, { color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, ey, z - 0.03));
      parts.push(kit.star(8, w * 0.32, w * 0.12, 0.026, { color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).rot(0, 0, Math.PI / 8).at(0, ey, z - 0.04));
      parts.push(kit.ring(w * 0.14, 0.012, { seg: [4, 16], color: 'oldGoldLight', mat: 'gold' }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(0, ey, z - 0.06));
      parts.push(kit.gem(w * 0.13, { color: 'teamGlow', mat: 'gem', glow: 0.6, stretch: 1.45 }).at(0, ey, z - 0.075));
    }
    return kit.merge(parts);
  }
  /** Pointed ember arrow slit with a stone frame, iron cross bars and a sill (front face). */
  function slitWindow(kit, x, y, z, rotY, s) {
    s = s || 1;
    const W = 0.2 * s, H = 0.46 * s;
    return kit.merge([
      kit.extrude(archPath(W + 0.06 * s, H + 0.05 * s, 4), 0.05, { color: COL.quoin, mat: 'stone', bevel: kit.hi ? undefined : 0, smooth: false }).at(0, -H / 2, 0),
      kit.extrude(archPath(W * 0.5, H * 0.86, 3), 0.03, { color: COL.warm, glow: 0.85, bevel: 0, smooth: false }).at(0, -H / 2 + 0.03 * s, -0.022),
      kit.box(0.014 * s, H * 0.78, 0.014, { bevel: 0, micro: false, color: 'blackSteel' }).at(0, -0.01 * s, -0.04),
      kit.box(W * 0.62, 0.014 * s, 0.014, { bevel: 0, micro: false, color: 'blackSteel' }).at(0, 0.02 * s, -0.04),
      kit.box(W + 0.12 * s, 0.05 * s, 0.09, { bevel: 0.015, seg: 1, color: COL.quoinShade, mat: 'stone' }).at(0, -H / 2 - 0.02 * s, -0.025),
    ]).rot(0, rotY, 0).at(x, y, z);
  }
  /** Four-fold copy of a part designed for the front face (z = -hw). */
  function fourFaces(kit, part, only2) {
    const out = [part.clone(), part.clone().rot(0, Math.PI, 0)];
    if (!only2) { out.push(part.clone().rot(0, HP, 0)); out.push(part.clone().rot(0, -HP, 0)); }
    return kit.merge(out);
  }
  /** Cracks (dark tapered tubes, glowing ember cores when heavy) on the four walls; heavier = more
   *  + soot + fallen stones. */
  function towerCracks(kit, P, heavy, seed, y0, y1) {
    const hw = P.hw, rnd = kit.rand(seed), parts = [];
    const lo = y0 === undefined ? 0.6 : y0, hi = y1 === undefined ? P.floor - 0.8 : y1;
    for (let f = 0; f < 4; f++) {
      let x = (rnd() * 2 - 1) * (hw - 0.35), y = lo + rnd() * (hi - lo);
      const pts = [];
      for (let s = 0; s < 5; s++) { pts.push([x, y, -hw - 0.012]); x += (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.3; y -= 0.09 + rnd() * 0.12; }
      let c = kit.tube(pts, [0.034, 0.008], { color: COL.crack, radial: 3, seg: 5, caps: false, scale: [1, 1, 0.5] });
      if (heavy) c = kit.merge([c, kit.tube(pts.map(p => [p[0], p[1], p[2] - 0.006]), [0.012, 0.003], { color: COL.ember, glow: 0.9, radial: 3, seg: 5, caps: false, scale: [1, 1, 0.5] })]);
      if (kit.hi) c = kit.merge([c, kit.tube([pts[2], [pts[2][0] + 0.12, pts[2][1] - 0.08, -hw - 0.012]], [0.02, 0.006], { color: COL.crack, radial: 4, seg: 1, scale: [1, 1, 0.5] })]);
      if (heavy) c = kit.merge([c, kit.sphere(0.16, { seg: 7, hseg: 5, color: COL.soot, mat: 'matte', scale: [1.3, 0.9, 0.12] }).at(pts[1][0], pts[1][1], -hw - 0.006)]);
      if (f === 1) c.rot(0, Math.PI, 0); else if (f === 2) c.rot(0, HP, 0); else if (f === 3) c.rot(0, -HP, 0);
      parts.push(c);
    }
    if (heavy) {
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        const a = rnd() * TAU, r = P.plinth * (0.78 + rnd() * 0.14), s = 0.08 + rnd() * 0.07;
        parts.push(pebble(kit, s, { seed: 40 + i, seg: 6, color: rnd() < 0.5 ? COL.wallShade : COL.wallDark }).at(Math.sin(a) * r, 0.3 + s * 0.4, Math.cos(a) * r));
      }
    }
    return kit.merge(parts);
  }
  function towerSmoke(kit, y) {
    return kit.merge([
      kit.sphere(0.2, { seg: 9, color: 0x3a3436, mat: 'matte' }).at(0, y, 0),
      kit.sphere(0.15, { seg: 8, color: 0x4a4346, mat: 'matte' }).at(0.14, y + 0.12, 0.05),
      kit.sphere(0.11, { seg: 7, color: 0x5a5356, mat: 'matte' }).at(-0.1, y + 0.2, -0.04),
    ]);
  }
  /** Wall lantern: curved black steel bracket, spiked cap, frame; the glowing glass is added to the
   *  core pivot. */
  function wallLantern(kit, x, y, z0) {
    return [
      kit.tube([[x, y + 0.2, z0 + 0.01], [x, y + 0.26, z0 - 0.08], [x, y + 0.2, z0 - 0.16]], 0.016, { color: 'blackSteel', radial: 4, seg: 4, caps: false }),
      kit.lathe([[0.0, 0.0], [0.09, 0.0], [0.095, 0.02], [0.05, 0.07], [0.014, 0.12], [0, 0.2]], { seg: 6, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal', sharp: true }).at(x, y + 0.08, z0 - 0.16),
      kit.cylinder(0.055, 0.065, 0.035, { seg: 6, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(x, y - 0.085, z0 - 0.16),
      kit.cone(0.02, 0.1, { seg: 4, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).rot(Math.PI, 0, 0).at(x, y - 0.15, z0 - 0.16),
    ];
  }
  function lanternGlass(kit, x, y, z0) {
    return [
      kit.lathe([[0.04, -0.07], [0.065, -0.05], [0.07, 0.03], [0.05, 0.075], [0.03, 0.08]], { seg: 6, color: COL.warm, glow: 0.9, sharp: true }).at(x, y, z0 - 0.16),
    ];
  }

  function towerCustom(rig, st, t, dt, a, king) {
    const hp = st && st.hpFrac >= 0 ? st.hpFrac : 1;
    if (rig.crack1) rig.crack1.visible = hp < 0.62;
    if (rig.crack2) rig.crack2.visible = hp < 0.3;
    if (rig.fireA) { rig.fireA.visible = hp < 0.3; if (hp < 0.3) flicker(rig.fireA, a.rt, a.seed * 3 + 1, 1); }
    if (rig.smokeA) {
      rig.smokeA.visible = hp < 0.3;
      if (hp < 0.3) puff(rig.smokeA, a.rt, 1.9, a.seed, 0.9, 1.25);
    }
    // banners sway in the wind (pivot = banner rod); heavier sway once the tower is hurt
    const w = 1 + (hp < 0.62 ? 0.6 : 0);
    if (rig.banF) { rig.banF.rotation.x += 0.05 * w * Math.sin(a.rt * 1.7 + a.seed * 5) - 0.02; rig.banF.rotation.z += 0.025 * Math.sin(a.rt * 1.1 + a.seed); }
    if (rig.banB) { rig.banB.rotation.x -= 0.05 * w * Math.sin(a.rt * 1.7 + a.seed * 5 + 1.3) - 0.02; rig.banB.rotation.z += 0.025 * Math.sin(a.rt * 1.2 + 2); }
    // team crystals breathe (magic glow)
    if (rig.coreGem) { const k = 1 + 0.08 * Math.sin(a.rt * 2.6 + a.seed * 3); rig.coreGem.scale.set(k, k, k); }
    // lanterns / braziers
    const awake = king ? !(st && (st.asleep || st.sleeping)) : true;
    a._lit = a._lit === undefined ? (awake ? 1 : 0) : a._lit + ((awake ? 1 : 0) - a._lit) * Math.min(1, dt * 4);
    const lit = Math.max(0.001, a._lit);
    flicker(rig.coreF, a.rt, a.seed, king ? 0.15 + 0.85 * lit : 1);
    flicker(rig.coreB, a.rt + 1.3, a.seed + 0.4, king ? 0.15 + 0.85 * lit : 1);
    if (king && rig.coreF) { rig.coreF.visible = lit > 0.02; rig.coreB.visible = lit > 0.02; }
  }

  defineModel('princess-tower', {
    height: PT.floor / 0.82, mount: PT.floor, ao: 0.16, prop: 'tower',
    anim: {
      body: 'building', attack: 'none', weight: 1,
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) { towerCustom(rig, st, t, dt, a, false); },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.62, pitch: 0.34, zoom: 1.0 },
    build(kit) {
      const rig = kit.rig();
      const P = PT, hw = P.hw, B = P.plinth, F = P.floor;
      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, 0, 0]);
      const parts = [];
      // plinth (= the 2.5 footprint): two rounded basalt tiers, team inlay band, gold lip and a
      // big black steel spike jutting out of every corner
      parts.push(rslab(kit, B, B - 0.03, 0, 0.2, 0.07, { color: COL.plinthDark, mat: 'stone', rc: 0.3 }));
      parts.push(polyLathe(kit, [[B - 0.025, 0.085], [B - 0.01, 0.1], [B - 0.01, 0.135], [B - 0.025, 0.15]], { color: 'team', mat: TM, rc: 0.3, open: true }));
      parts.push(rslab(kit, B - 0.14, B - 0.16, 0.18, 0.32, 0.05, { color: COL.plinth, mat: 'stone', rc: 0.24 }));
      parts.push(polyLathe(kit, [[B - 0.175, 0.3], [B - 0.155, 0.312], [B - 0.165, 0.33]], { color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold', rc: 0.22, open: true }));
      for (let c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
        const sx = c & 1 ? 1 : -1, sz = c & 2 ? 1 : -1, a = Math.atan2(sx, sz);
        parts.push(spike(kit, 0.4, 0.07, { gold: true }).rot(0.95, 0, 0).bake().rot(0, a, 0).at(sx * (B - 0.3), 0.3, sz * (B - 0.3)));
      }
      // slim keep: dark walls, base course, mortar courses, diagonal spiked corner buttresses
      const wy0 = 0.32, wy1 = 1.56, wh = wy1 - wy0;
      parts.push(kit.box(hw * 2, wh, hw * 2, { bevel: 0.09, seg: 2, color: COL.wall, mat: 'stone', rough: 0.76 }).at(0, wy0 + wh / 2, 0));
      parts.push(rslab(kit, hw + 0.07, hw + 0.05, wy0, wy0 + 0.19, 0.05, { color: COL.wallShade, rc: 0.14 }));
      courseLines(kit, hw, [wy0 + 0.48, wy0 + 0.86], 0.1).forEach(q => parts.push(q));
      parts.push(ashlar(kit, hw, [wy0 + 0.19, wy0 + 0.33, wy0 + 0.48, wy0 + 0.67, wy0 + 0.86, wy0 + 1.04, wy1 - 0.12], { beds: [wy0 + 0.33, wy0 + 0.67, wy0 + 1.04], seed: 5 }));
      for (let c = 0; c < 4; c++) parts.push(buttress(kit, c & 1 ? 1 : -1, c & 2 ? 1 : -1, hw, wy0 + 0.05, wy1 - 0.42, { w: 0.28, spike: 0.3 }));
      // corbel band with a gold string, team spire apron with steel ridges, sawtooth valance
      parts.push(polyLathe(kit, [[hw - 0.01, wy1 - 0.12], [hw + 0.03, wy1 - 0.08], [hw + 0.12, wy1 + 0.02], [hw + 0.12, wy1 + 0.06]], { color: COL.wallShade, rc: 0.14, open: true }));
      parts.push(polyLathe(kit, [[hw + 0.06, wy1 - 0.035], [hw + 0.085, wy1 - 0.02], [hw + 0.1, wy1 + 0.0]], { color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold', rc: 0.14, open: true }));
      const sk0 = wy1 + 0.04, sk1 = sk0 + 0.3, SO = 1.16;
      roofApron(kit, hw + 0.12, SO, sk0, sk1, { scallops: 5 }).forEach(q => parts.push(q));
      // parapet with coping, plank deck, team rug
      const PH = hw + 0.16;
      parapetDeck(kit, PH, sk1 - 0.02, F, 0.6, { planks: 6 }).forEach(q => parts.push(q));
      // fanged merlons: one per side
      for (let f = 0; f < 4; f++) {
        const p = fangMerlon(kit, 0.38, 0.26, 0.2, { slit: true });
        if (f === 0) p.at(0, F, -PH + 0.11); else if (f === 1) p.rot(0, Math.PI, 0).at(0, F, PH - 0.11);
        else if (f === 2) p.rot(0, HP, 0).at(-PH + 0.11, F, 0); else p.rot(0, -HP, 0).at(PH - 0.11, F, 0);
        parts.push(p);
      }
      // four round corner turrets with tall ribbed team spires (flag turrets carry a pole
      // instead of the finial)
      const tx = PH - 0.17;
      for (let c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
        const sx = c & 1 ? 1 : -1, sz = c & 2 ? 1 : -1, flagT = sx === sz;
        parts.push(turret(kit, 0.19, 0.42, 0.27, 0.46, { finial: !flagT, spikes: 5 }).at(sx * tx, F - 0.03, sz * tx));
      }
      // sides (+-X): pointed gate + ember arrow slit
      const side = kit.merge([
        towerDoor(kit, hw, 0.44, 0.64, false, 0.32),
        slitWindow(kit, 0, 1.28, -hw - 0.02, 0, 0.9),
      ]);
      parts.push(side.clone().rot(0, HP, 0), side.clone().rot(0, -HP, 0));
      // front + back: lantern brackets beside the banner
      parts.push(fourFaces(kit, kit.merge(wallLantern(kit, -0.56, 0.9, -hw).concat(wallLantern(kit, 0.56, 0.9, -hw))), true));
      // flag poles on the two diagonal corner turrets (flags fold inwards: stay in the footprint)
      const fx = tx;
      for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
        parts.push(kit.rcyl(0.024, 0.032, 0.9, { seg: 8, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal', bevel: 0.01 }).at(s * fx, F + 0.8 + 0.45, s * fx));
        parts.push(kit.ring(0.036, 0.012, { seg: [4, 10], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(s * fx, F + 0.86, s * fx));
        parts.push(finial(kit, 0.75).at(s * fx, F + 1.68, s * fx));
      }
      rig.add('body', parts);
      // banners (front + back) on their own pivots: sway around the rod
      const by = sk0 - 0.02;
      rig.pivot('banF', 'body', [0, by, -hw - 0.06]);
      rig.pivot('banB', 'body', [0, by, hw + 0.06]);
      const ban = towerBanner(kit, hw, by, 0.6, 0.86, 'crystal');
      rig.add('banF', ban.clone());
      rig.add('banB', ban.clone().rot(0, Math.PI, 0));
      rig.pivot('flagA', 'body', [-fx, F + 1.52, -fx]);
      rig.pivot('flagB', 'body', [fx, F + 1.52, fx]);
      const fl = kit.merge([
        flag(kit, 0.58, 0.36, { color: 'team', inner: 'teamDark', notchX: 0.22 }),
        flag(kit, 0.58, 0.05, { color: 'oldGold', inner: 'oldGoldDark', notchX: 0.0, mat: 'gold' }).at(0, -0.31, -0.004),
        kit.star(8, 0.08, 0.03, 0.012, { color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0.2, -0.17, -0.03),
        kit.gem(0.035, { color: 'teamGlow', mat: 'gem', glow: 0.45 }).at(0.2, -0.17, -0.045),
      ]);
      rig.add('flagA', fl.clone().at(-fx, F + 1.52, -fx));
      rig.add('flagB', fl.clone().rot(0, Math.PI, 0).at(fx, F + 1.52, fx));
      // lantern glass + flames (front / back)
      rig.pivot('coreF', 'body', [0, 0.88, -hw - 0.16]);
      rig.pivot('coreB', 'body', [0, 0.88, hw + 0.16]);
      const gl = kit.merge(lanternGlass(kit, -0.56, 0.9, -hw).concat(lanternGlass(kit, 0.56, 0.9, -hw)));
      rig.add('coreF', gl);
      rig.add('coreB', gl.clone().rot(0, Math.PI, 0));
      // damage states
      rig.pivot('crack1', 'body', [0, 0, 0]);
      rig.pivot('crack2', 'body', [0, 0, 0]);
      rig.add('crack1', towerCracks(kit, P, false, 5, 0.7, 1.45));
      rig.add('crack2', towerCracks(kit, P, true, 9, 0.7, 1.45));
      rig.pivot('fireA', 'body', [0.4, F + 0.02, 0.3]);
      rig.add('fireA', kit.merge([flame(kit, 0.34, { seg: 7 }).at(0.4, F + 0.02, 0.3), flame(kit, 0.22, { seg: 6 }).at(0.6, F + 0.02, 0.1)]));
      rig.pivot('smokeA', 'body', [0.45, F + 0.5, 0.25]);
      rig.add('smokeA', towerSmoke(kit, F + 0.5).at(0.45, 0, 0.25));
      return rig;
    },
  });

  // King tower: 4x4. A wide dark keep with gold trims, four massive round corner towers under tall
  // ribbed team spires, fanged merlons, crown war banners with glowing team gems, horned crest
  // shields, pointed royal gates with spiked portcullises and spiked braziers that light up when
  // the king wakes.
  defineModel('king-tower', {
    height: KT.floor / 0.82, mount: KT.floor, ao: 0.16, prop: 'tower',
    anim: {
      body: 'building', attack: 'none', weight: 1,
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) { towerCustom(rig, st, t, dt, a, true); },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.62, pitch: 0.34, zoom: 1.0 },
    build(kit) {
      const rig = kit.rig();
      const P = KT, hw = P.hw, F = P.floor;
      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, 0, 0]);
      const sh = towerShell(kit, P, true);
      const parts = sh.parts.concat(merlons(kit, P));
      parts.push(fourFaces(kit, towerDoor(kit, hw, 0.72, 1.1, true), true));
      parts.push(fourFaces(kit, towerBanner(kit, hw, sh.sk0 - 0.02, 0.6, 0.92, 'crown').at(-0.8, 0, 0), true));
      parts.push(fourFaces(kit, towerBanner(kit, hw, sh.sk0 - 0.02, 0.6, 0.92, 'crown').at(0.8, 0, 0), true));
      // sides: two arrow slits + a horned royal crest shield (team) with a gold crown
      const THREE = T3();
      const crest = new THREE.Shape();
      crest.moveTo(-0.26, 0.22); crest.lineTo(-0.1, 0.18); crest.lineTo(0, 0.28); crest.lineTo(0.1, 0.18); crest.lineTo(0.26, 0.22); crest.quadraticCurveTo(0.27, -0.06, 0, -0.34); crest.quadraticCurveTo(-0.27, -0.06, -0.26, 0.22);
      const crestRim = crest.getSpacedPoints(30).slice(0, -1).map(v => [v.x * 1.05, v.y * 1.05 + 1.4, -hw - 0.075]);
      const side = kit.merge([
        slitWindow(kit, -0.62, 1.35, -hw - 0.02, 0), slitWindow(kit, 0.62, 1.35, -hw - 0.02, 0),
        kit.extrude(crest, 0.05, { color: 'team', mat: TS, bevel: 0.015, bevelSeg: 1, curveSeg: 4 }).at(0, 1.4, -hw - 0.04),
        kit.tube(crestRim, 0.018, { color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold', radial: 4, closed: true, seg: 16 }),
        kit.extrude([[-0.13, 0], [0.13, 0], [0.14, 0.14], [0.065, 0.06], [0, 0.17], [-0.065, 0.06], [-0.14, 0.14]], 0.03, { color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold', bevel: 0.006, smooth: false }).at(0, 1.34, -hw - 0.09),
        kit.gem(0.045, { color: 'teamGlow', mat: 'gem', glow: 0.5 }).at(0, 1.22, -hw - 0.1),
        horn(kit, 0.32, 0.05, { side: 1, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(0.24, 1.6, -hw - 0.07),
        horn(kit, 0.32, 0.05, { side: -1, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(-0.24, 1.6, -hw - 0.07),
      ]);
      parts.push(side.clone().rot(0, HP, 0), side.clone().rot(0, -HP, 0));
      // massive round corner towers with tall ribbed team spires
      for (let c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
        const sx = c & 1 ? 1 : -1, sz = c & 2 ? 1 : -1, flagT = sx === sz;
        const x = sx * (hw + 0.02), z = sz * (hw + 0.02);
        parts.push(polyLathe(kit, rimProf(0.54, 0.5, 0.3, 0.46, 0.04, 2), { n: 8, rc: 0.2, color: COL.plinth, mat: 'stone' }).at(x, 0, z));
        parts.push(turret(kit, 0.45, F + 0.5 - 0.4, 0.6, 0.72, { finial: !flagT, fs: 1.2, ribs: 6, spikes: 8 }).at(x, 0.4, z));
        parts.push(slitWindow(kit, x + sx * 0.33, 1.75, z + sz * 0.33, faceYaw(sx, sz)));
        parts.push(kit.ring(0.46, 0.03, { seg: [5, 22], color: COL.wallDark, mat: 'stone' }).at(x, 1.3, z));
        parts.push(kit.ring(0.462, 0.016, { seg: [3, 22], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(x, 1.36, z));
        parts.push(spike(kit, 0.44, 0.07, { gold: true }).rot(0.95, 0, 0).bake().rot(0, Math.atan2(sx, sz), 0).at(x + sx * 0.36, 0.42, z + sz * 0.36));
      }
      rig.add('body', parts);
      // flags on two turrets
      for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
        rig.add('body',
          kit.rcyl(0.025, 0.032, 0.56, { seg: 8, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal', bevel: 0.01 }).at(s * (hw + 0.02), F + 1.6, s * (hw + 0.02)),
          finial(kit, 0.75).at(s * (hw + 0.02), F + 1.87, s * (hw + 0.02)));
      }
      rig.pivot('flagA', 'body', [-(hw + 0.02), F + 1.84, -(hw + 0.02)]);
      rig.pivot('flagB', 'body', [hw + 0.02, F + 1.84, hw + 0.02]);
      const fl = kit.merge([flag(kit, 0.7, 0.42, { color: 'team', inner: 'teamDark', notchX: 0.26 }),
        flag(kit, 0.7, 0.05, { color: 'oldGold', inner: 'oldGoldDark', notchX: 0.0, mat: 'gold' }).at(0, -0.37, -0.004),
        kit.extrude([[-0.1, 0], [0.1, 0], [0.11, 0.1], [0.05, 0.045], [0, 0.12], [-0.05, 0.045], [-0.11, 0.1]], 0.02, { color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold', smooth: false }).at(0.28, -0.27, -0.03)]);
      rig.add('flagA', fl.clone().rot(0, 0.5, 0).at(-(hw + 0.02), F + 1.84, -(hw + 0.02)));
      rig.add('flagB', fl.clone().rot(0, 0.5 + Math.PI, 0).at(hw + 0.02, F + 1.84, hw + 0.02));
      // spiked braziers on the front + back merlon line (lit when awake)
      const braz = (x, z) => [
        kit.lathe([[0.0, -0.07], [0.1, -0.07], [0.17, -0.01], [0.18, 0.06], [0.15, 0.07], [0.0, 0.07]], { seg: 8, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal', sharp: !kit.hi }).at(x, F + 0.47, z),
        kit.ring(0.175, 0.018, { seg: [3, 12], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(x, F + 0.53, z),
        spikeRing(kit, 5, 0.17, F + 0.5, 0.12, 0.022, { tilt: 0.5 }).at(x, 0, z),
        kit.cylinder(0.045, 0.06, 0.14, { seg: 6, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(x, F + 0.36, z),
      ];
      const bz = hw - 0.02;
      rig.add('body', braz(-0.92, -bz), braz(0.92, -bz), braz(-0.92, bz), braz(0.92, bz));
      rig.pivot('coreF', 'body', [0, F + 0.54, -bz]);
      rig.pivot('coreB', 'body', [0, F + 0.54, bz]);
      rig.add('coreF', flame(kit, 0.36, { seg: 8 }).at(-0.92, F + 0.52, -bz), flame(kit, 0.36, { seg: 8 }).at(0.92, F + 0.52, -bz));
      rig.add('coreB', flame(kit, 0.36, { seg: 8 }).at(-0.92, F + 0.52, bz), flame(kit, 0.36, { seg: 8 }).at(0.92, F + 0.52, bz));
      rig.pivot('crack1', 'body', [0, 0, 0]);
      rig.pivot('crack2', 'body', [0, 0, 0]);
      rig.add('crack1', towerCracks(kit, P, false, 15));
      rig.add('crack2', towerCracks(kit, P, true, 19));
      rig.pivot('fireA', 'body', [0.7, F + 0.02, 0.5]);
      rig.add('fireA', kit.merge([flame(kit, 0.42, { seg: 7 }).at(0.7, F + 0.02, 0.5), flame(kit, 0.28, { seg: 6 }).at(0.98, F + 0.02, 0.24), flame(kit, 0.3, { seg: 6 }).at(-0.8, F + 0.02, -0.6)]));
      rig.pivot('smokeA', 'body', [0.75, F + 0.6, 0.45]);
      rig.add('smokeA', towerSmoke(kit, F + 0.6).at(0.75, 0, 0.45));
      return rig;
    },
  });

  // Rubble after a crown tower falls: broken basalt plinth with snapped corner spikes, cracked
  // wall stumps, a heap of dark stones with smouldering embers, a fallen ribbed team spire,
  // charred beams, a skull and the torn team banner.
  // P = { hw: wall half width, plinth: plinth half width }.
  function rubble(kit, P, king, seed) {
    const rnd = kit.rand(seed), hw = P.hw, B = P.plinth, parts = [];
    parts.push(rslab(kit, B, B - 0.03, 0, 0.2, 0.07, { color: COL.plinthDark, mat: 'stone', rc: king ? 0.4 : 0.3 }));
    parts.push(polyLathe(kit, [[B - 0.025, 0.085], [B - 0.01, 0.1], [B - 0.01, 0.135], [B - 0.025, 0.15]], { color: 'teamDark', mat: TM, rc: king ? 0.4 : 0.3, open: true }));
    parts.push(rslab(kit, B - 0.14, B - 0.16, 0.18, 0.3, 0.05, { color: COL.plinth, mat: 'stone', rc: 0.24 }));
    // snapped corner spikes (two still standing)
    for (let c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
      const sx = c & 1 ? 1 : -1, sz = c & 2 ? 1 : -1, a = Math.atan2(sx, sz), whole = c === 0 || c === 3;
      parts.push(spike(kit, whole ? 0.36 : 0.16, 0.065, { gold: true }).rot(whole ? 0.95 : 0.6, 0, 0).bake().rot(0, a, 0).at(sx * (B - 0.3), 0.28, sz * (B - 0.3)));
    }
    // wall stumps along the edges (irregular heights, broken tops)
    const per = king ? 5 : 3;
    for (let f = 0; f < 4; f++) {
      for (let k = 0; k < per; k++) {
        const u = -hw + (k + 0.5) * (2 * hw / per);
        const h = 0.15 + rnd() * (king ? 0.75 : 0.55) * (k === 0 || k === per - 1 ? 1.3 : 0.8);
        const tone = rnd(), bw = 2 * hw / per - 0.05;
        // v11 rv: jagged broken top (zig-zag break line), crisp facets, scorched towards the top
        const jag = [[-bw / 2, 0], [bw / 2, 0]], nj = 5;
        for (let j = 0; j <= nj; j++) { const x = bw / 2 - j * bw / nj; jag.push([x, h * (j % 2 ? 0.62 + rnd() * 0.22 : 0.86 + rnd() * 0.3)]); }
        const baseC = tone < 0.4 ? COL.wallShade : tone < 0.75 ? COL.wallDark : COL.wall, sootC = kit.mix(baseC, COL.soot, 0.7);
        const p = kit.merge([
          kit.extrude(jag, 0.3, { color: baseC, mat: 'stone', rough: 0.8, bevel: 0.008, smooth: false }).paint((x, y) => y > h * 0.55 ? kit.mix(baseC, sootC, smooth01((y - h * 0.55) / (h * 0.5))) : null),
          kit.extrude([[-0.06, 0], [0.07, 0], [0.02, 0.13 + rnd() * 0.08]], 0.12, { color: COL.quoinShade, mat: 'stone', bevel: 0, smooth: false }).rot(0, 0, (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.6).at((rnd() - 0.5) * bw * 0.5, h * 0.8, (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.1),
          kit.box(bw * 0.9, 0.012, 0.31, { bevel: 0, micro: false, color: COL.soot }).at(0, h * 0.38, 0),
        ]).rot((rnd() - 0.5) * 0.12, 0, (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.16);
        if (f === 0) p.at(u, 0.3, -hw + 0.15); else if (f === 1) p.at(u, 0.3, hw - 0.15);
        else if (f === 2) p.rot(0, HP, 0).at(-hw + 0.15, 0.3, u); else p.rot(0, HP, 0).at(hw - 0.15, 0.3, u);
        parts.push(p);
      }
    }
    // rubble heap in the middle: dark stones, glowing embers in the gaps
    const cols = [COL.wall, COL.wallShade, COL.quoin, COL.plinth];
    parts.push(kit.sphere(hw * 0.75, { seg: 12, hseg: 4, theta: [0, 1.2], color: COL.wallDark, mat: 'stone', scale: [1, 0.32, 1] }).at(0, 0.18, 0));
    for (let i = 0; i < (king ? 10 : 7); i++) {
      const a = rnd() * TAU, r = Math.sqrt(rnd()) * hw * 0.75;
      const s = (king ? 0.17 : 0.14) + rnd() * 0.14;
      const blk = rnd() < 0.5;
      parts.push((blk ? kit.box(s * 1.6, s * 0.9, s * 1.1, { bevel: 0.012, seg: 1, color: cols[(rnd() * 4) | 0], mat: 'stone', flat: true })
        : pebble(kit, s, { seed: seed * 10 + i, seg: 7, cut: 0.42, soft: 0.012, planes: 9, color: cols[(rnd() * 4) | 0] })).rot(rnd() * 0.5, rnd() * 3, rnd() * 0.4).at(Math.sin(a) * r, 0.3 + s * 0.45 + (1 - r / hw) * 0.16, Math.cos(a) * r));
    }
    // v11 rv: sharp stone splinters jutting out of the heap, scorch marks, glowing ember cracks
    for (let i = 0; i < (king ? 9 : 6); i++) {
      const a = rnd() * TAU, r = (0.25 + rnd() * 0.6) * hw * 0.8, L = 0.16 + rnd() * 0.22;
      parts.push(kit.cone(0.05 + rnd() * 0.04, L, { seg: 3, color: rnd() < 0.5 ? COL.quoin : COL.wallShade, mat: 'stone', flat: true }).rot((rnd() - 0.5) * 1.2, rnd() * 3, (rnd() - 0.5) * 1.2).at(Math.sin(a) * r, 0.42 + (1 - r / hw) * 0.12, Math.cos(a) * r));
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      const a = (i + rnd() * 0.5) / 4 * TAU, r = B * (0.62 + rnd() * 0.2);
      parts.push(kit.sphere(0.2 + rnd() * 0.12, { seg: 8, hseg: 3, theta: [0, 0.5], color: COL.soot, mat: 'matte', scale: [1.4, 0.06, 1] }).rot(0, rnd() * 3, 0).at(Math.sin(a) * r, 0.296, Math.cos(a) * r));
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < (king ? 4 : 3); i++) {
      const a = rnd() * TAU, r = Math.sqrt(rnd()) * hw * 0.55, pts = [];
      let x = Math.sin(a) * r, z = Math.cos(a) * r;
      for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) { pts.push([x, 0.33 + (1 - Math.hypot(x, z) / hw) * 0.14, z]); x += (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.3; z += (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.3; }
      parts.push(kit.tube(pts, [0.022, 0.006], { color: COL.lavaHot, glow: 0.95, radial: 3, seg: 4, caps: false }));
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < (king ? 5 : 3); i++) {
      const a = rnd() * TAU, r = Math.sqrt(rnd()) * hw * 0.6;
      parts.push(kit.sphere(0.045 + rnd() * 0.03, { seg: 6, hseg: 4, color: i % 2 ? COL.lavaHot : COL.ember, glow: 0.9, scale: [1.4, 0.5, 1.2] }).at(Math.sin(a) * r, 0.42 + (1 - r / hw) * 0.1, Math.cos(a) * r));
    }
    // scattered stones (inside the plinth)
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      const a = rnd() * TAU, r = B * (0.82 + rnd() * 0.1), s = 0.07 + rnd() * 0.06;
      parts.push(pebble(kit, s, { seed: seed * 20 + i, seg: 6, cut: 0.62, color: COL.wallShade }).at(Math.sin(a) * r, 0.22 + s * 0.35, Math.cos(a) * r));
    }
    // a fallen ribbed team spire lying on the heap
    const sR = king ? 0.36 : 0.2, sH = king ? 0.76 : 0.44;
    parts.push(kit.merge([coneRoof(kit, sR, sH, { seg: 10, ribs: 4 }), finial(kit, king ? 1 : 0.7).at(0, sH * 0.97, 0)]).rot(0, 0, -1.3).bake().rot(0, 0.7, 0).at(-hw * 0.3, 0.52, -hw * 0.2));
    // charred beams + torn team banner + a skull on the heap
    const L = king ? 1.4 : 1.05;
    parts.push(kit.box(L, 0.1, 0.16, { bevel: 0.035, seg: 2, color: 0x2a1c14, mat: 'wood' }).rot(0.2, 0.6, 0.15).at(-0.1, 0.58, 0.1));
    parts.push(kit.box(L * 0.8, 0.1, 0.14, { bevel: 0.035, seg: 2, color: 0x22170f, mat: 'wood' }).rot(-0.15, -0.9, -0.1).at(0.25, 0.56, -0.2));
    parts.push(kit.sphere(0.05, { seg: 8, color: COL.lava, glow: 0.9 }).at(0.1, 0.62, 0.32));
    parts.push(cloth(kit, 0.6, 0.7, { color: 'team', inner: 'teamDark', teeth: 3, teethD: 0.18, sy: 3, wave: 0.03 }).rot(-1.3, 0.4, 0).at(0.3, 0.6, 0.4));
    parts.push(kit.gem(0.08, { color: 'teamGlow', mat: 'gem', glow: 0.4 }).rot(-1.3, 0.4, 0).at(0.32, 0.65, 0.22));
    parts.push(skull(kit, king ? 0.11 : 0.085, { hornLen: 1.5 }).rot(-0.3, 0.5, 0.2).at(0.35, 0.62, -0.42));
    return parts;

  defineModel('princess-tower-rubble', {

  // =====================================================================================
  // DEFENSIVE BUILDINGS

  // v11 building helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  /** Team clasp (v11, replaces the v3 ribbon bow): black steel diamond plate with an old-gold rim
   *  and a glowing team gem, facing -Z at the origin. */
  function teamClasp(kit, s) {
    return kit.merge([
      kit.extrude([[0, 0.14 * s], [0.1 * s, 0], [0, -0.14 * s], [-0.1 * s, 0]], 0.03 * s, { color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold', smooth: false, bevel: 0.006 * s }),
      kit.extrude([[0, 0.1 * s], [0.072 * s, 0], [0, -0.1 * s], [-0.072 * s, 0]], 0.03 * s, { color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal', smooth: false }).at(0, 0, -0.014 * s),
      kit.gem(0.045 * s, { color: 'teamGlow', mat: 'gem', glow: 0.6 }).at(0, 0, -0.036 * s),
    ]);
  }
  /** Tattered team pennant tails (v11, replaces the ribbon tails) hanging from the origin. */
  function tatterTails(kit, len, o) {
    o = o || {};
    const w = (o.w || 0.06) * 1.8;
    return kit.merge([
      cloth(kit, w, len, { color: 'team', inner: 'teamDark', teeth: 2, teethD: len * 0.28, sy: 3, wave: 0.02 }).rot(0, 0, 0.14).at(-w * 0.42, 0, 0),
      cloth(kit, w * 0.85, len * 0.82, { color: 'teamDark', inner: 'team', teeth: 2, teethD: len * 0.26, sy: 3, wave: 0.02 }).rot(0, 0, -0.14).at(w * 0.42, 0, 0.012),
    ]);
  }
  /** Tattered team war flag on a black steel pole (pole along +Y from the origin, cloth +X). */
  function warFlag(kit, w, h, o) {
    o = o || {};
    return kit.merge([
      flag(kit, w, h, { color: 'team', inner: 'teamDark', notchX: w * 0.3, wave: 0.03 }),
      flag(kit, w, h * 0.14, { color: 'oldGold', inner: 'oldGoldDark', notchX: 0, mat: 'gold' }).at(0, -h * 0.86, -0.004),
      kit.gem(Math.min(w, h) * 0.12, { color: 'teamGlow', mat: 'gem', glow: 0.5 }).at(w * 0.34, -h * 0.45, -0.02),
    ]);
  }

  // ---- cannon "Kanonen-Bunker" (2x2, v11): a spiked basalt bastion ringed with black steel
  // pavise shields; a black iron carriage with spiked cheeks carries a fanged beast-maw barrel
  // with horns, ember eyes, gold rings and team bands; tattered team flag on the carriage.
  defineModel('cannon', {
    height: 1.1, ao: 0.2, prop: 'building',
    anim: {
      body: 'building', attack: 'cannon', weight: 1, strikeIn: 0.05, strikeHold: 0.04, strikeOut: 0.38,
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        rig.weapon.rotation.x += 0.14 * a.strike - 0.04 * a.windup;
        rig.turret.position.y -= 0.03 * a.strike;
        // recoil: the carriage squashes on the shot, the barrel swells on the wind-up
        const sq = 0.09 * a.strike - 0.035 * a.windup;
        rig.turret.scale.set(1 + sq * 0.6, 1 - sq, 1 + sq * 0.6);
        rig.weapon.scale.set(1 + 0.06 * a.windup, 1 + 0.06 * a.windup, 1 - 0.05 * a.strike);
        ribbonSway(rig.ribbonC, a, 0.22 + 0.5 * a.strike, 2.4);
      },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.8, pitch: 0.2, zoom: 1.45, pose: 'idle' },
    build(kit) {
      const rig = kit.rig();
      const brick = grimHex(kit, castCol('cannon', 'color', '#8a4b3a'), 0.6);
      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, 0, 0]);
      rig.pivot('turret', 'body', [0, 0.42, 0]);
      rig.pivot('weapon', 'turret', [0, 0.8, 0.04]);
      rig.pivot('flagT', 'turret', [0.3, 1.18, 0.38]);
      rig.pivot('ribbonC', 'weapon', [0, 1.04, 0.24]);
      // octagonal basalt bastion: scorched brick core, team band, gold lip, dark top
      const body = [
        polyLathe(kit, rimProf(0.93, 0.87, 0, 0.34, 0.06), { n: 8, rcK: 0.16, color: brick, mat: 'stone', rough: 0.74 }),
        polyLathe(kit, [[0.915, 0.185], [0.935, 0.2], [0.935, 0.245], [0.91, 0.26]], { n: 8, rcK: 0.16, color: 'team', mat: TM, open: true }),
        polyLathe(kit, [[0.88, 0.322], [0.9, 0.332], [0.885, 0.346]], { n: 8, rcK: 0.16, color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold', open: true }),
        rslab(kit, 0.84, 0.8, 0.32, 0.38, 0.025, { n: 8, rcK: 0.16, color: COL.plinth, mat: 'stone' }),
      ];
      // ring of black steel pavise shields with a gold rim and a spike each (gap at the back)
      for (let i = 0; i < 11; i++) {
        const a = (i + 0.5) / 12 * TAU + Math.PI / 12;
        if (Math.abs(Math.cos(a) - 1) < 0.15) continue;
        const sh = kit.merge([
          kit.extrude([[-0.1, 0], [0.1, 0], [0.075, 0.3], [0, 0.46], [-0.075, 0.3]], 0.05, { color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal', bevel: 0.012, smooth: false }),
          kit.extrude([[-0.115, -0.01], [0.115, -0.01], [0.088, 0.31], [0, 0.49], [-0.088, 0.31]], 0.03, { color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold', smooth: false }).at(0, 0, 0.016),
          kit.box(0.16, 0.035, 0.03, { bevel: 0, micro: false, color: 'team', mat: TM }).at(0, 0.12, -0.03),
        ]).rot(-0.32, 0, 0);
        body.push(sh.rot(0, a + Math.PI, 0).bake().at(Math.sin(a) * 0.72, 0.36, Math.cos(a) * 0.72));
      }
      // big black steel spikes jutting out of the bastion
      body.push(spikeRing(kit, 8, 0.9, 0.2, 0.3, 0.05, { tilt: 1.25, off: 0.5, gold: true }));
      // iron ammo coffer with cannonballs at the back
      body.push(kit.box(0.36, 0.17, 0.26, { bevel: 0.03, seg: 1, color: 'grimLeatherDark', mat: 'wood' }).at(0, 0.46, 0.7));
      body.push(kit.box(0.38, 0.035, 0.27, { bevel: 0.01, seg: 1, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(0, 0.5, 0.7));
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) body.push(kit.sphere(0.075, { seg: 10, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(-0.1 + i * 0.1, 0.6, 0.7));
      body.push(kit.sphere(0.075, { seg: 10, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(-0.05, 0.71, 0.7));
      rig.add('body', body);
      // turret: iron turntable + black iron carriage cheeks with gold bolts and spikes
      const cheekPts = [[0.34, 0], [-0.3, 0], [-0.3, 0.14], [-0.2, 0.34], [-0.1, 0.5], [-0.04, 0.4], [0.08, 0.42], [0.2, 0.28], [0.34, 0.2]];
      const cheek = kit.merge([
        kit.extrude(cheekPts, 0.1, { color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal', bevel: 0.018, bevelSeg: 1, smooth: 35 }),
        kit.box(0.62, 0.035, 0.11, { bevel: 0.01, seg: 1, color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0.02, 0.08, 0),
      ]).rot(0, HP, 0);
      const tur = [
        kit.rcyl(0.5, 0.54, 0.1, { seg: 18, color: 'gunmetal', mat: 'metal', bevel: 0.03 }).at(0, 0.44, 0),
        kit.ring(0.535, 0.022, { seg: [4, 18], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 0.47, 0),
        cheek.clone().at(-0.27, 0.48, 0.02), cheek.clone().at(0.27, 0.48, 0.02),
        kit.box(0.05, 0.035, 0.5, { bevel: 0.012, seg: 1, color: 'team', mat: TM }).at(-0.33, 0.68, 0.06), kit.box(0.05, 0.035, 0.5, { bevel: 0.012, seg: 1, color: 'team', mat: TM }).at(0.33, 0.68, 0.06),
        kit.rcyl(0.075, 0.075, 0.06, { seg: 12, color: 'gunmetal', mat: 'metal' }).rot(0, 0, HP).at(-0.35, 0.8, 0.04), kit.rcyl(0.075, 0.075, 0.06, { seg: 12, color: 'gunmetal', mat: 'metal' }).rot(0, 0, HP).at(0.35, 0.8, 0.04),
        kit.sphere(0.035, { seg: 8, color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(-0.38, 0.8, 0.04), kit.sphere(0.035, { seg: 8, color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0.38, 0.8, 0.04),
        kit.box(0.5, 0.08, 0.16, { bevel: 0.025, seg: 1, color: 'gunmetal', mat: 'metal' }).at(0, 0.53, 0.28),
        kit.rcyl(0.02, 0.025, 0.66, { seg: 8, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal', bevel: 0.008 }).at(0.3, 0.88, 0.38),
        spike(kit, 0.12, 0.026, { gold: true }).at(0.3, 1.2, 0.38),
      ];
      for (const sx of [-1, 1]) {
        for (const z of [-0.18, 0.24]) tur.push(kit.sphere(0.026, { seg: 7, color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(sx * 0.33, 0.58, z));
        tur.push(spike(kit, 0.2, 0.035).rot(-0.5, 0, 0).at(sx * 0.27, 0.95, -0.12));
        tur.push(spike(kit, 0.16, 0.03).rot(0.3, 0, 0).at(sx * 0.27, 0.9, 0.12));
      }
      rig.add('turret', tur);
      rig.add('flagT', warFlag(kit, 0.36, 0.24).rot(0, 1.2, 0).at(0.3, 1.18, 0.38));
      // barrel: black iron lathe along +Y (breech at -Y), turned to point -Z, slight elevation;
      // the muzzle is a fanged beast maw with horns and ember eyes on top
      const barrel = kit.merge([
        kit.lathe([[0, -0.4], [0.09, -0.4], [0.17, -0.35], [0.22, -0.26], [0.235, -0.12], [0.215, 0.2], [0.195, 0.46], [0.22, 0.54], [0.27, 0.62], [0.275, 0.72], [0.23, 0.77], [0.15, 0.77], [0.13, 0.6]], { seg: 16, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal', corner: 60 }),
        kit.disc(0.135, { seg: 14, color: 0x0c0808, mat: 'matte' }).rot(-HP, 0, 0).at(0, 0.62, 0),
        kit.ring(0.11, 0.02, { seg: [4, 14], color: 'ember', glow: 0.85 }).at(0, 0.6, 0),
        kit.sphere(0.075, { seg: 10, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(0, -0.46, 0),
        spike(kit, 0.14, 0.04, { gold: true }).rot(Math.PI, 0, 0).at(0, -0.5, 0),
        kit.ring(0.24, 0.033, { seg: [5, 18], color: 'team', mat: TM }).at(0, -0.1, 0),
        kit.ring(0.21, 0.03, { seg: [5, 18], color: 'team', mat: TM }).at(0, 0.32, 0),
        kit.ring(0.275, 0.026, { seg: [5, 18], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 0.7, 0),
        fangRing(kit, 8, 0.19, 0.12, 0.034).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(0, 0.76, 0),
        kit.ring(0.236, 0.016, { seg: [4, 18], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 0.04, 0),
        kit.gem(0.05, { color: 'teamGlow', mat: 'gem', glow: 0.5 }).at(0, 0.23, -0.21),
        teamClasp(kit, 0.8).rot(-HP, 0, 0).rot(0, Math.PI, 0).at(0, -0.12, 0.24),
      ]);
      const face = [];
      for (const sx of [-1, 1]) {
        face.push(horn(kit, 0.34, 0.055, { side: sx, color: 'boneDark' }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(sx * 0.2, 0.5, 0.05));
        face.push(slitEye(kit, 0.04, { side: sx, color: COL.ember, tilt: 0.45 }).bake().rot(HP, 0, 0).at(sx * 0.09, 0.6, 0.235));
        face.push(kit.box(0.12, 0.03, 0.03, { bevel: 0.008, seg: 1, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).rot(0, 0, sx * 0.4).at(sx * 0.085, 0.565, 0.245));
      }

  // ---- tesla "Funkenmast" (2x2, v11): a black steel gothic pylon on a spiked hatch ring; team
  // warding plates with glowing bolt runes and a horned skull, a team/black insulator stack, a
  // gold coil and three hooked steel talons clutching the storm orb; hides underground (fx 32):
  // the hatch ring stays, the talons poke out.
  const TESLA_H = 2.15;
  defineModel('tesla', {
    height: TESLA_H, ao: 0.15, prop: 'building',
    anim: {
      body: 'building', attack: 'none', weight: 1, spinRate: 2.2,
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        rig.base.position.y += 0.85 * TESLA_H * a.hidden;          // hatch stays on the ground
        const zap = Math.max(a.strike, 0.35 * a.windup);
        const k = (1 - 0.45 * a.hidden) * (1 + 0.55 * zap + 0.06 * Math.sin(a.rt * 31) * (0.3 + a.aim));
        rig.core.scale.set(k, k, k);
        rig.spinRing.rotation.y += a.rt * 9 * a.aim;
        rig.spinRing.rotation.z = 0.25 * Math.sin(a.rt * 3.1);
        rig.turret.rotation.y += 0.25 * Math.sin(a.rt * 47) * a.strike;
        // charge-up anticipation: the stack crouches, then snaps up on the zap
        rig.turret.scale.set(1 + 0.05 * a.windup, 1 - 0.07 * a.windup + 0.1 * a.strike, 1 + 0.05 * a.windup);
        ribbonSway(rig.ribbonT, a, 0.2 + 0.6 * a.strike, 3.1);
      },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.55, pitch: 0.14, zoom: 1.2, pose: 'attack' },
    build(kit) {
      const rig = kit.rig();
      const steel = grimHex(kit, castCol('tesla', 'color', '#3d5a80'), 0.62), glowC = castCol('tesla', 'accent', '#9ef0ff');
      rig.pivot('base', 'root', [0, 0, 0]);
      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, 0, 0]);
      rig.pivot('turret', 'body', [0, 1.62, 0]);
      rig.pivot('spinRing', 'turret', [0, 1.98, 0]);
      rig.pivot('core', 'turret', [0, 1.98, 0]);
      rig.pivot('ribbonT', 'turret', [0, 1.72, -0.24]);
      // hatch ring (ground): black steel ring, team band, gold/team tiles, dark shaft, spikes
      const base = [
        kit.lathe(rimProf(0.9, 0.85, 0, 0.13, 0.04, 3).concat([[0.6, 0.13], [0.58, 0.1]]), { seg: 22, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal', sharp: true }),
        kit.ring(0.88, 0.028, { seg: [4, 24], color: 'team', mat: TM }).at(0, 0.07, 0),
        kit.cylinder(0.58, 0.58, 0.02, { seg: 22, color: 0x0a0c12, mat: 'matte' }).at(0, 0.1, 0),
        kit.ring(0.6, 0.04, { seg: [5, 22], color: 'gunmetal', mat: 'metal' }).at(0, 0.13, 0),
        kit.ring(0.5, 0.014, { seg: [3, 22], color: glowC, glow: 0.6 }).at(0, 0.115, 0),
      ];
      for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        const a = (i + 0.5) / 8 * TAU;
        base.push(kit.box(0.13, 0.04, 0.15, { bevel: 0.014, seg: 1, color: i % 2 ? 'team' : 'oldGold', mat: i % 2 ? TM : 'gold' }).rot(0, a, 0).at(Math.sin(a) * 0.74, 0.14, Math.cos(a) * 0.74));
      }
      base.push(spikeRing(kit, 8, 0.86, 0.08, 0.26, 0.05, { tilt: 1.2, off: 0.5 }));
      rig.add('base', base);
      // gothic lattice pylon: black steel legs with clawed feet, strut rings, cross braces
      const body = [];
      const legs = [[-1, -1], [1, -1], [1, 1], [-1, 1]];
      const y0 = 0.12, y1 = 1.58, r0 = 0.44, r1 = 0.17;
      const at = (q, y) => { const k = (y - y0) / (y1 - y0), r = r0 + (r1 - r0) * k; return [q[0] * r, y, q[1] * r]; };
      for (const q of legs) {
        body.push(kit.tube([at(q, y0), at(q, y1)], [0.055, 0.035], { color: steel, mat: 'metal', radial: 6, seg: 1 }));
        body.push(kit.rcyl(0.08, 0.09, 0.05, { seg: 8, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(q[0] * r0, y0 + 0.02, q[1] * r0));
        const a = Math.atan2(q[0], q[1]);
        body.push(spike(kit, 0.2, 0.04).rot(1.25, 0, 0).bake().rot(0, a, 0).at(q[0] * r0 * 1.12, y0 + 0.03, q[1] * r0 * 1.12));
      }
      const lv = [0.12, 0.55, 0.98, 1.36, 1.58];
      for (let l = 0; l < lv.length; l++) {
        for (let f = 0; f < 4; f++) {
          const A = legs[f], B = legs[(f + 1) % 4];
          if (l > 0) body.push(kit.tube([at(A, lv[l]), at(B, lv[l])], 0.025, { color: kit.darken(steel, 0.25), mat: 'metal', radial: 5, seg: 1, caps: false }));
          if (l < lv.length - 1) {
            body.push(kit.tube([at(A, lv[l]), at(B, lv[l + 1])], 0.018, { color: 'gunmetal', mat: 'metal', radial: 4, seg: 1, caps: false }));
            body.push(kit.tube([at(B, lv[l]), at(A, lv[l + 1])], 0.018, { color: 'gunmetal', mat: 'metal', radial: 4, seg: 1, caps: false }));
          }
        }
        if (l > 0 && kit.hi) for (const q of legs) body.push(kit.sphere(0.034, { seg: 8, color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(...at(q, lv[l])));
      }
      // team warding plates (gold rim, glowing bolt rune) + a horned skull on the front plate
      for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
        body.push(kit.extrude([[-0.21, 0.14], [0.21, 0.14], [0.21, -0.06], [0, -0.2], [-0.21, -0.06]], 0.04, { color: 'team', mat: TM, smooth: false, bevel: 0.01 }).at(0, 0.78, s * 0.33));
        body.push(kit.extrude([[-0.235, 0.16], [0.235, 0.16], [0.235, -0.07], [0, -0.235], [-0.235, -0.07]], 0.02, { color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold', smooth: false }).at(0, 0.78, s * 0.345));
      }
      body.push(boltShape(kit, 0.2, 0.12, { color: glowC, glow: 0.85, depth: 0.02, bevel: 0.005 }).at(0.0, 0.86, -0.36));
      body.push(boltShape(kit, 0.2, 0.12, { color: glowC, glow: 0.85, depth: 0.02, bevel: 0.005 }).rot(0, Math.PI, 0).at(0.0, 0.86, 0.36));
      body.push(skull(kit, 0.075, { eye: glowC, hornLen: 1.6, hornColor: 'blackSteel' }).at(0, 1.08, -0.3));
      body.push(kit.rcyl(0.3, 0.3, 0.06, { seg: 16, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(0, 1.6, 0));
      body.push(kit.ring(0.305, 0.014, { seg: [3, 16], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 1.63, 0));
      body.push(spikeRing(kit, 8, 0.3, 1.6, 0.24, 0.035, { tilt: 1.05, gold: true }));
      rig.add('body', body);
      // turret: insulator stack, gold coil, three hooked talons around the orb, emitter arm (-Z)
      const tur = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) tur.push(kit.rcyl(0.2 - i * 0.02, 0.22 - i * 0.02, 0.07, { seg: 16, color: i % 2 ? 'blackSteel' : 'team', mat: i % 2 ? 'metal' : TM, bevel: 0.025 }).at(0, 1.67 + i * 0.075, 0));
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) tur.push(kit.ring(0.13, 0.024, { seg: [5, 16], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 1.86 + i * 0.045, 0));
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        const a = i / 3 * TAU + Math.PI / 3, c = Math.sin(a), d = Math.cos(a);
        tur.push(kit.tube([[c * 0.12, 1.84, d * 0.12], [c * 0.34, 1.98, d * 0.34], [c * 0.3, 2.2, d * 0.3], [c * 0.14, 2.3, d * 0.14]], [0.04, 0.012], { color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal', radial: 6, seg: 8 }));
        tur.push(kit.cone(0.022, 0.12, { seg: 5, color: 'scarSteel', mat: 'chrome' }).rot(-2.2, 0, 0).bake().rot(0, a, 0).at(c * 0.12, 2.28, d * 0.12));
        tur.push(kit.sphere(0.035, { seg: 8, color: glowC, glow: 0.95 }).at(c * 0.3, 2.2, d * 0.3));
      }
      tur.push(kit.rcyl(0.025, 0.025, 0.42, { seg: 8, color: 'gunmetal', mat: 'metal' }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(0, 1.78, -0.26));
      tur.push(spike(kit, 0.12, 0.04).rot(-HP, 0, 0).at(0, 1.78, -0.48));
      tur.push(kit.sphere(0.05, { seg: 10, color: glowC, glow: 0.95 }).at(0, 1.78, -0.46));
      tur.push(kit.ring(0.06, 0.012, { seg: [4, 12], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(0, 1.78, -0.43));
      tur.push(teamClasp(kit, 0.8).at(0, 1.72, -0.235));
      rig.add('turret', tur);
      rig.add('ribbonT', tatterTails(kit, 0.42, { w: 0.055 }).at(0, 1.72, -0.24));
      rig.add('core', kit.sphere(0.17, { seg: 14, color: glowC, glow: 1 }).at(0, 1.98, 0), kit.sphere(0.1, { seg: 10, color: 0xffffff, glow: 1 }).at(0, 1.98, 0));
      rig.add('spinRing', kit.ring(0.27, 0.018, { seg: [4, 22], color: glowC, glow: 1 }).at(0, 1.98, 0),
        boltShape(kit, 0.18, 0.1, { color: glowC, depth: 0.015 }).rot(0, 0, 0.9).at(0.3, 2.02, 0),
        boltShape(kit, 0.18, 0.1, { color: glowC, depth: 0.015 }).rot(0, Math.PI, -0.9).at(-0.3, 2.02, 0));
      return rig;
    },
  });

  // ---- inferno-tower "Lava-Turm" (3x3, v11): a jagged obsidian volcano spire in a ring of
  // basalt shards over a lava moat; glowing rivulets, team iron collars with gold rivets, huge
  // swept demon horns, a burning horned skull, a clawed cradle with a spinning magma crystal
  // and a fanged beam nozzle (turret).
  defineModel('inferno-tower', {
    height: 2.7, ao: 0.12, prop: 'building',
    anim: {
      body: 'building', attack: 'beam', weight: 1, spinRate: 1.4,
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        const heat = 0.5 + 0.5 * a.aim;
        const k = 1 + 0.07 * Math.sin(a.rt * 5 + a.seed * 4) + 0.12 * a.aim * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(a.rt * 23));
        rig.core.scale.set(k, k, k);
        rig.spinGem.rotation.y += a.rt * 4 * a.aim;
        rig.spinGem.position.y += 0.04 * Math.sin(a.rt * 2.4) * heat;
        rig.weapon.rotation.x -= 0.18 * a.aim;
        // flame aura: flickers, flares up while the beam is locked on
        const fa = 0.75 + 0.45 * a.aim + 0.08 * Math.sin(a.rt * 13 + a.seed * 4);
        rig.coreAura.scale.set(1 + 0.15 * a.aim, fa, 1 + 0.15 * a.aim);
        rig.coreAura.rotation.y -= a.rt * (1.2 + 3 * a.aim);
      },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.55, pitch: 0.12, zoom: 1.3, pose: 'attack' },
    build(kit) {
      const rig = kit.rig();
      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, 0, 0]);
      rig.pivot('turret', 'body', [0, 1.72, 0]);
      rig.pivot('spinGem', 'turret', [0, 2.22, 0]);
      rig.pivot('core', 'turret', [0, 2.22, 0]);
      rig.pivot('weapon', 'turret', [0, 2.0, -0.32]);
      rig.pivot('coreAura', 'turret', [0, 2.0, 0]);
      const body = [];
      // glowing lava moat + a ring of jagged basalt shards
      body.push(kit.rcyl(1.14, 1.18, 0.08, { seg: 24, color: COL.lava, glow: 0.85, bevel: 0.03 }).at(0, 0.04, 0));
      const rnd = kit.rand(21);
      for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        const a = i / 10 * TAU + rnd() * 0.3, r = 1.0 + rnd() * 0.12, s = 0.22 + rnd() * 0.1;
        body.push(pebble(kit, s, { seed: 30 + i, seg: 8, cut: 0.6, color: rnd() < 0.5 ? COL.basalt : COL.basaltLight, scale: [1.1, 0.75, 1.0] }).rot(0, a, 0).at(Math.sin(a) * r, s * 0.4, Math.cos(a) * r));
        const sh = 0.36 + rnd() * 0.3;
        body.push(kit.cone(0.1 + rnd() * 0.04, sh, { seg: 4, color: i % 2 ? COL.basalt : 0x141116, mat: 'stone', rough: 0.4 }).at(0, sh / 2, 0).bake().rot(0.5 + rnd() * 0.3, 0, 0).bake().rot(0, a, 0).at(Math.sin(a) * (r - 0.12), 0.08, Math.cos(a) * (r - 0.12)));
      }
      // jagged obsidian volcano spire with a lighter stone band
      body.push(kit.lathe([[1.02, 0.02], [0.98, 0.25], [0.86, 0.58], [0.7, 1.0], [0.6, 1.32], [0.52, 1.6], [0.44, 1.72], [0, 1.72]], { seg: 9, color: COL.basalt, mat: 'stone', rough: 0.5, corner: 40, sharp: true }).flat());
      body.push(kit.lathe([[1.0, 0.18], [0.995, 0.22], [0.93, 0.44], [0.9, 0.48]], { seg: 9, color: COL.basaltLight, mat: 'stone', sharp: true }).flat());
      // glowing lava rivulets
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        const a = i / 6 * TAU + 0.3;
        const pts = [];
        for (let k = 0; k <= 4; k++) {
          const y = 1.66 - k * 0.38, r = 0.5 + (1.66 - y) * 0.31 + 0.02, w = Math.sin(k * 1.7 + i) * 0.12;
          pts.push([Math.sin(a + w) * r, y, Math.cos(a + w) * r]);
        }
        body.push(kit.tube(pts, [0.035, 0.06], { color: COL.lava, glow: 0.95, radial: 5, seg: 8 }));
      }
      // team iron collars with gold rivets and spikes
      body.push(kit.rcyl(0.86, 0.88, 0.13, { seg: 20, color: 'team', mat: TM, open: true, bevel: 0.03 }).at(0, 0.66, 0));
      body.push(studRing(kit, 10, 0.885, 0.66, 0.03, 'oldGold'));
      body.push(spikeRing(kit, 10, 0.88, 0.66, 0.22, 0.04, { tilt: 1.3, off: 0.5 }));
      body.push(kit.rcyl(0.55, 0.58, 0.12, { seg: 18, color: 'team', mat: TM, open: true, bevel: 0.03 }).at(0, 1.46, 0));
      body.push(studRing(kit, 8, 0.585, 1.46, 0.025, 'oldGold'));
      body.push(kit.rcyl(0.46, 0.5, 0.1, { seg: 18, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(0, 1.74, 0));
      // huge swept demon horns + a burning horned skull on the spire
      for (const k of [-1, 1]) body.push(horn(kit, 1.0, 0.13, { side: k, color: 'boneDark' }).at(k * 0.56, 1.24, 0.02));
      body.push(skull(kit, 0.2, { eye: COL.lavaHot, hornLen: 1.4, hornColor: 'blackSteel' }).rot(0.35, 0, 0).at(0, 1.06, -0.74));
      rig.add('body', body);
      // turret: clawed cradle + nozzle mount
      const tur = [kit.rcyl(0.4, 0.44, 0.14, { seg: 18, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(0, 1.84, 0), kit.ring(0.42, 0.03, { seg: [5, 20], color: 'team', mat: TM }).at(0, 1.9, 0)];
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        const a = i / 4 * TAU + Math.PI / 4, c = Math.sin(a), d = Math.cos(a);
        tur.push(kit.tube([[c * 0.32, 1.9, d * 0.32], [c * 0.48, 2.15, d * 0.48], [c * 0.36, 2.46, d * 0.36], [c * 0.18, 2.58, d * 0.18]], [0.075, 0.018], { color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal', radial: 6, seg: 9 }));
        tur.push(kit.cone(0.03, 0.14, { seg: 5, color: 'scarSteel', mat: 'chrome' }).rot(-2.3, 0, 0).bake().rot(0, a, 0).at(c * 0.16, 2.56, d * 0.16));
        tur.push(kit.box(0.13, 0.15, 0.045, { bevel: 0.015, seg: 1, color: 'team', mat: TM }).rot(0, a, 0).at(c * 0.46, 2.12, d * 0.46));
        tur.push(kit.sphere(0.022, { seg: 7, color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(c * 0.485, 2.12, d * 0.485));
      }
      rig.add('turret', tur);
      rig.add('spinGem', kit.gem(0.27, { color: COL.lava, glow: 0.75, stretch: 1.45 }).at(0, 2.22, 0));
      // flame aura: curved fire spikes licking up around the crystal
      const aura = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        const an = i / 6 * TAU, c = Math.sin(an), d = Math.cos(an), L = 0.42 + (i % 2) * 0.16;
        aura.push(kit.tube([[c * 0.2, 2.0, d * 0.2], [c * 0.3, 2.0 + L * 0.45, d * 0.3], [c * 0.22, 2.0 + L * 0.8, d * 0.22], [c * 0.1 + d * 0.06, 2.0 + L, d * 0.1 - c * 0.06]], (u) => 0.075 * (1 - u) + 0.008, { color: i % 2 ? COL.lavaHot : 'fire', glow: 1, radial: 6, seg: 8 }));
      }
      rig.add('coreAura', aura);
      rig.add('core', kit.sphere(0.13, { seg: 12, color: COL.lavaHot, glow: 1 }).at(0, 2.22, 0.0), kit.ring(0.3, 0.02, { seg: [4, 20], color: COL.lavaHot, glow: 1 }).at(0, 2.22, 0));
      rig.add('weapon',
        kit.lathe([[0.1, -0.12], [0.13, -0.05], [0.12, 0.1], [0.17, 0.22], [0.21, 0.3], [0.14, 0.31], [0.06, 0.18]], { seg: 12, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).rot(-HP, 0, 0).at(0, 2.0, -0.32),
        fangRing(kit, 7, 0.15, 0.09, 0.028).at(0, 2.0, -0.62),
        kit.ring(0.18, 0.025, { seg: [4, 16], color: COL.lavaHot, glow: 1 }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(0, 2.0, -0.6),
        kit.ring(0.21, 0.016, { seg: [4, 16], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(0, 2.0, -0.56),
        kit.rcyl(0.05, 0.05, 0.28, { seg: 8, color: 'gunmetal', mat: 'metal' }).rot(-0.6, 0, 0).at(0, 2.1, -0.18));
      return rig;
    },
  });

  // ---- bomb-tower "Bomben-Burg" (3x3, v11): a squat round basalt keep with spiked buttresses, a
  // pointed portcullis gate under a horned skull, a team roof ring with a sawtooth valance and
  // fanged crenels; on the roof a black iron catapult flings a lit skull bomb (ammo reloads).
  defineModel('bomb-tower', {
    height: 2.35, ao: 0.16, prop: 'building',
    anim: {
      body: 'building', attack: 'none', weight: 1, reload: 0.55, strikeIn: 0.08, strikeHold: 0.07, strikeOut: 0.55,
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        faceViewer(rig, st, a, ['turret']);
        rig.weapon.rotation.x += 0.35 * a.windup - 2.05 * a.strike;
        rig.turret.position.y -= 0.03 * a.strike;
        flicker(rig.coreFuse, a.rt, a.seed, 1);
        // the whole keep tenses up on the wind-up and bounces on the throw
        const sq = 0.05 * a.strike - 0.025 * a.windup;
        rig.body.scale.set(1 - sq * 0.5, 1 + sq, 1 - sq * 0.5);
      },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.6, pitch: 0.22, zoom: 1.3, pose: 'idle' },
    build(kit) {
      const rig = kit.rig();
      const grey = grimHex(kit, castCol('bomb-tower', 'color', '#646a78'), 0.62), orange = castCol('bomb-tower', 'accent', '#ff8a3d');
      const stoneL = kit.lighten(grey, 0.16), stoneM = kit.lighten(grey, 0.08), stoneD = kit.darken(grey, 0.15);
      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, 0, 0]);
      rig.pivot('turret', 'body', [0, 1.62, 0]);
      rig.pivot('weapon', 'turret', [0, 1.98, 0.12]);
      rig.pivot('ammo', 'weapon', [0, 2.04, 0.82]);
      rig.pivot('coreFuse', 'ammo', [0, 2.3, 0.82]);
      // round keep of dark ashlar on a rounded footing with a team band
      const body = [
        kit.lathe(rimProf(1.22, 1.17, 0, 0.24, 0.07, 3), { seg: 24, color: stoneD, mat: 'stone', sharp: true }),
        kit.ring(1.215, 0.03, { seg: [4, 26], color: 'team', mat: TM }).at(0, 0.12, 0),
        kit.rcyl(1.0, 1.06, 1.12, { seg: 24, color: stoneM, mat: 'stone', rough: 0.78, open: true }).at(0, 0.78, 0),
        kit.rcyl(1.09, 1.1, 0.13, { seg: 24, color: stoneL, mat: 'stone', bevel: 0.04 }).at(0, 0.3, 0),
        kit.ring(1.1, 0.016, { seg: [3, 26], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 0.37, 0),
      ];
      const rnd = kit.rand(4);
      for (let c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
        const n = 8;
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          const a = (i + (c % 2) * 0.5) / n * TAU + rnd() * 0.06, y = 0.52 + c * 0.3, r = 1.04 - c * 0.012;
          if (c < 2 && Math.abs(Math.sin(a)) < 0.3 && Math.cos(a) < 0) continue;   // keep the gate free
          body.push(kit.box(0.64, 0.24, 0.07, { bevel: kit.hi ? 0.03 : 0, seg: 1, micro: kit.hi, color: rnd() < 0.5 ? stoneL : stoneM, mat: 'stone' }).rot(0, a, 0).at(Math.sin(a) * r, y, Math.cos(a) * r));
        }
      }
      // spiked buttresses on the four diagonals
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        const a = (i + 0.5) / 4 * TAU;
        body.push(kit.merge([
          kit.box(0.2, 1.0, 0.24, { bevel: 0.03, seg: 1, color: stoneD, mat: 'stone' }).rot(-0.12, 0, 0).at(0, 0.62, 0.04),
          kit.box(0.22, 0.04, 0.26, { bevel: 0.01, seg: 1, color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 0.82, 0.02),
          spike(kit, 0.3, 0.05).rot(1.0, 0, 0).at(0, 1.08, 0.06),
        ]).rot(0, a, 0).bake().at(Math.sin(a) * 1.06, 0, Math.cos(a) * 1.06));
      }
      // pointed gate with a black iron portcullis over an ember glow, horned skull above
      body.push(kit.extrude(archPath(0.66, 0.86, 5), 0.08, { color: stoneL, mat: 'stone', smooth: false }).at(0, 0.36, -1.0));
      body.push(kit.extrude(archPath(0.5, 0.74, 5), 0.06, { color: 0x0b0708, smooth: false }).at(0, 0.37, -1.035));
      body.push(kit.box(0.44, 0.22, 0.012, { bevel: 0, micro: false, color: COL.ember, glow: 0.7 }).paint((x, y) => y > 0 ? 0x2a0804 : null).at(0, 0.48, -1.07));
      for (let k = -1; k <= 1; k++) {
        const x = k * 0.13, top = archTop(0.5, 0.74, x) - 0.03;
        body.push(kit.box(0.03, top - 0.08, 0.03, { bevel: 0, micro: false, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(x, 0.37 + 0.08 + (top - 0.08) / 2, -1.08));

      body.push(skull(kit, 0.1, { hornLen: 1.6 }).at(0, 1.32, -1.07));
      // v11 rv: the team roof is a tattered war tarp - ten sagging cloth panels with torn hems

      const NP = 10, tarpTop = 1.585, tarpR0 = 0.98;

        const b2 = i / NP * TAU, c = Math.sin(b2), d = Math.cos(b2);

        body.push(kit.sphere(0.026, { seg: 5, hseg: 3, color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(c * 1.14, 1.45, d * 1.14));
      }
      body.push(kit.ring(0.99, 0.035, { seg: [3, 20], color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(0, 1.585, 0));
      body.push(kit.ring(1.0, 0.014, { seg: [3, 18], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 1.615, 0));
      body.push(kit.rcyl(0.98, 0.98, 0.1, { seg: 16, color: stoneL, mat: 'stone' }).at(0, 1.6, 0));
      // big fanged merlons with spikes (8) around the battlement
      for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {

        body.push(kit.merge([

          kit.box(w + 0.04, 0.035, 0.26, { bevel: 0, micro: false, color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, h, 0),
          kit.cone(0.07, 0.17, { seg: 4, color: COL.quoin, mat: 'stone' }).rot(0, Math.PI / 4, -0.22).at(-w * 0.34, h + 0.08, 0),
          kit.cone(0.07, 0.17, { seg: 4, color: COL.quoin, mat: 'stone' }).rot(0, Math.PI / 4, 0.22).at(w * 0.34, h + 0.08, 0),

      }

      if (kit.hi) for (const k of [-1, 1]) {

        body.push(kit.merge(ch), skull(kit, 0.085, { hornLen: 1.3 }).rot(0, -k * HP, 0).at(k * 1.13, 0.93, 0));

      // tattered team war banners hanging from the roof ring (front + back) with a bomb emblem
      const ban = kit.merge([

        kit.box(0.5, 0.1, 0.1, { bevel: 0.03, seg: 1, color: 'team', mat: TM }).at(0, 1.8, -0.3));

  // ---- mortar "Kürbiswerfer" (3x3, v11): a huge black-veined demon pumpkin bound with spiked
  // iron bands on an octagonal basalt platform; narrow burning eyes, a jagged fanged grin and
  // black thorn vines; its stem is the black iron mortar barrel. Grim pumpkin shells at the back.
  defineModel('mortar', {
    height: 1.85, ao: 0.16, prop: 'building',
    anim: {
      body: 'building', attack: 'cannon', weight: 1, strikeIn: 0.05, strikeHold: 0.05, strikeOut: 0.45,
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {

        const sq = 0.08 * a.strike - 0.03 * a.windup;

        const fk = 1 + 0.05 * Math.sin(a.rt * 13 + a.seed * 5) + 0.03 * Math.sin(a.rt * 29);
        rig.coreFace.scale.set(fk, fk * (1 + 0.12 * a.strike - 0.06 * a.windup), 1);
        rig.coreFace.position.y += 0.03 * a.strike;

      const orange = grimHex(kit, castCol('mortar', 'color', '#b35e18'), 0.38);
      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, 0, 0]);
      rig.pivot('turret', 'body', [0, 0.32, 0]);
      rig.pivot('weapon', 'turret', [0, 1.36, 0.08]);
      rig.pivot('coreFace', 'turret', [0, 0.82, -0.78]);
      // octagonal basalt platform with a team band, a gold lip and corner spikes
      const body = [
        polyLathe(kit, rimProf(1.14, 1.1, 0, 0.22, 0.05), { n: 8, rcK: 0.14, color: COL.plinthDark, mat: 'stone' }),
        polyLathe(kit, [[1.13, 0.12], [1.145, 0.13], [1.145, 0.18], [1.125, 0.19]], { n: 8, rcK: 0.14, color: 'team', mat: TM, open: true }),
        rslab(kit, 1.0, 0.98, 0.2, 0.26, 0.02, { n: 8, rcK: 0.14, color: COL.plinth, mat: 'stone' }),
        polyLathe(kit, [[0.985, 0.25], [1.0, 0.258], [0.99, 0.27]], { n: 8, rcK: 0.14, color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold', open: true }),

      // black thorn vine around the rim

      // grim pumpkin shell pile at the back
      const mini = (x, z, r) => {
        const p = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) { const a = i / 5 * TAU; p.push(kit.sphere(r * 0.62, { seg: 7, hseg: 5, color: i % 2 ? COL.pumpkinDark : kit.darken(COL.pumpkin, 0.25), mat: TM, scale: [0.8, 0.95, 0.8] }).at(x + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.42, 0.26 + r * 0.8, z + Math.cos(a) * r * 0.42)); }
        p.push(kit.rcyl(0.025, 0.035, 0.1, { seg: 6, color: 0x1a1612 }).at(x, 0.26 + r * 1.55, z));
        p.push(kit.extrude([[-0.5, 0], [0.5, 0], [0, 0.4]], 0.02, { color: COL.ember, glow: 0.9, smooth: false }).scale(r * 0.3).at(x, 0.26 + r * 0.9, z - r * 0.74));
        return p;
      };
      body.push(mini(-0.75, 0.55, 0.2), mini(-0.45, 0.8, 0.17), mini(-0.82, 0.18, 0.15));
      rig.add('body', body);
      // the demon pumpkin (8 lobes, black veins), spiked iron bands, team band
      const R = 0.72, PY = 0.8;
      const tur = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        const a = i / 8 * TAU;
        tur.push(kit.sphere(R * 0.56, { seg: 10, hseg: 9, color: i % 2 ? orange : kit.lighten(orange, 0.1), mat: TM, scale: [0.72, 1.12, 0.72] }).at(Math.sin(a) * R * 0.45, PY, Math.cos(a) * R * 0.45));
        const b = (i + 0.5) / 8 * TAU, pts = [];
        for (let k = 0; k <= 4; k++) { const th = 0.5 + k / 4 * 2.0; pts.push([Math.sin(b) * Math.sin(th) * R * 0.84, PY + Math.cos(th) * R * 0.78, Math.cos(b) * Math.sin(th) * R * 0.84]); }
        tur.push(kit.tube(pts, 0.014, { color: 0x1a0c06, radial: 3, seg: 6, caps: false }));
      }
      tur.push(kit.sphere(R * 0.8, { seg: 10, hseg: 4, theta: [0, 0.7], color: kit.darken(orange, 0.2), mat: TM, scale: [1, 0.95, 1] }).at(0, PY, 0));
      tur.push(kit.ring(0.78, 0.05, { seg: [5, 24], color: 'team', mat: TM }).at(0, PY - 0.28, 0));
      tur.push(kit.ring(0.8, 0.018, { seg: [4, 24], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, PY - 0.22, 0));
      tur.push(spikeRing(kit, 10, 0.8, PY - 0.28, 0.2, 0.035, { tilt: 1.35, off: 0.5 }));
      tur.push(kit.ring(0.62, 0.035, { seg: [4, 22], color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(0, PY + 0.4, 0));
      tur.push(spikeRing(kit, 8, 0.62, PY + 0.4, 0.18, 0.03, { tilt: 0.9 }));
      tur.push(kit.rcyl(0.3, 0.36, 0.12, { seg: 14, color: 0x1a1612, mat: 'wood' }).at(0, PY + 0.58, 0.05));
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const a = i / 4 * TAU + 0.4; tur.push(kit.tube([[Math.sin(a) * 0.3, PY + 0.58, 0.05 + Math.cos(a) * 0.3], [Math.sin(a) * 0.46, PY + 0.66, 0.05 + Math.cos(a) * 0.46], [Math.sin(a) * 0.52, PY + 0.86, 0.05 + Math.cos(a) * 0.52]], [0.03, 0.006], { color: 0x1a1612, radial: 4, seg: 5 })); }
      rig.add('turret', tur);
      // demonic carved face (glowing; flickers in coreFace): narrow burning eyes, heavy brows,
      // a jagged grin full of fangs
      const eyeHex = COL.flame;
      rig.add('coreFace',
        carvedEye(kit, 0.19, { side: -1, color: eyeHex }).rot(0.12, 0.3, -0.22).at(-0.25, PY + 0.14, -0.73),
        carvedEye(kit, 0.19, { side: 1, color: eyeHex }).rot(0.12, -0.3, 0.22).at(0.25, PY + 0.14, -0.73),
        fierceBrow(kit, 0.26, { side: -1, color: 0x1a0c06, depth: 0.06 }).rot(0.1, 0.3, -0.12).at(-0.22, PY + 0.3, -0.71),
        fierceBrow(kit, 0.26, { side: 1, color: 0x1a0c06, depth: 0.06 }).rot(0.1, -0.3, 0.12).at(0.22, PY + 0.3, -0.71),
        // v11 rv: wider, crueller jagged grin (saw-tooth upper and lower edge, corners hooked up)
        kit.extrude([[-0.46, 0.18], [-0.36, 0.02], [-0.3, 0.1], [-0.22, -0.02], [-0.15, 0.08], [-0.07, -0.04], [0, 0.07], [0.07, -0.04], [0.15, 0.08], [0.22, -0.02], [0.3, 0.1], [0.36, 0.02], [0.46, 0.18], [0.38, -0.12], [0.28, -0.05], [0.2, -0.2], [0.12, -0.1], [0.04, -0.26], [-0.04, -0.26], [-0.12, -0.1], [-0.2, -0.2], [-0.28, -0.05], [-0.38, -0.12]], 0.05, { color: COL.flame, glow: 1, smooth: false }).at(0, PY - 0.14, -0.75).rot(0.25, 0, 0),
        kit.extrude([[-0.14, 0], [-0.05, -0.07], [0.05, -0.07], [0.14, 0]], 0.03, { color: COL.flameCore, glow: 1, smooth: false }).at(0, PY - 0.21, -0.79).rot(0.25, 0, 0),
        [-0.3, -0.16, -0.05, 0.05, 0.16, 0.3].map((x, i) => kit.cone(0.03, i === 1 || i === 4 ? 0.13 : 0.08, { seg: 4, color: 'boneDark', mat: 'bone' }).rot(Math.PI, 0, 0).at(x, PY - 0.1, -0.8)),
        [-0.1, 0.1].map(x => kit.cone(0.028, 0.08, { seg: 4, color: 'boneDark', mat: 'bone' }).at(x, PY - 0.3, -0.79)));
      // mortar barrel = the stem (faces -Z, ~50 deg up): black iron, team rings, gold muzzle
      rig.add('weapon', kit.merge([
        kit.lathe([[0, -0.36], [0.22, -0.36], [0.28, -0.22], [0.26, 0.3], [0.3, 0.5], [0.34, 0.62], [0.25, 0.65], [0.21, 0.45]], { seg: 14, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal', corner: 60, sharp: !kit.hi }),
        kit.disc(0.21, { seg: 14, color: 0x0c0808, mat: 'matte' }).rot(-HP, 0, 0).at(0, 0.5, 0),

        fangRing(kit, 7, 0.27, 0.1, 0.03).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(0, 0.64, 0),

        ...[-0.22, -0.06, 0.2, 0.42].map(y => kit.ring(0.29 + (y > 0.3 ? 0.02 : 0), 0.026, { seg: [4, 16], color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(0, y, 0)),
        studRing(kit, 8, 0.31, -0.06, 0.018, 'oldGold'), studRing(kit, 8, 0.3, 0.2, 0.018, 'oldGold', 0.5),

      ]).rot(-0.82, 0, 0).at(0, 1.36, 0.08));

  // ---- x-bow "Turm-Armbrust" (3x3, v11): a giant black steel siege ballista on a spiked basalt
  // pedestal: blackened stock with iron plates and a horned skull ram, barbed steel spike,
  // recurve black steel limbs with team wraps and bone spikes, drawable string, barbed bolt.
  defineModel('x-bow', {
    height: 1.75, ao: 0.16, prop: 'building',
    anim: {
      body: 'building', attack: 'cannon', weight: 1, stringRest: 0.08, reload: 0.1, strikeIn: 0.04, strikeHold: 0.02, strikeOut: 0.18,
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        rig.weapon.rotation.x += 0.05 + 0.03 * a.strike;
        rig.gearCrank.rotation.x += a.windup * 2.5;
        ribbonSway(rig.ribbonX, a, 0.2 + 0.5 * a.strike, 2.8);

    portrait: { yaw: -0.75, pitch: 0.42, zoom: 1.4, pose: 'attack' },

      const rig = kit.rig();
