      rig.pivot('ribbonX', 'weapon', [0, Y + 0.08, 0.72]);

      rig.add('body',

        kit.lathe(rimProf(0.92, 0.78, 0.22, 0.58, 0.05, 3), { seg: 22, color: COL.wall, mat: 'stone', sharp: true }),
        kit.rcyl(0.935, 0.935, 0.08, { seg: 22, color: 'team', mat: TM, open: true, bevel: 0.025 }).at(0, 0.3, 0),

        spike(kit, 0.16, 0.03).at(-0.2, 1.44, 0.05), spike(kit, 0.16, 0.03).at(0.2, 1.44, 0.05),
        kit.box(0.52, 0.06, 0.04, { bevel: 0.015, seg: 1, color: 'team', mat: TM }).at(0, 1.18, -0.21),
      ];

      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) wheel.push(kit.box(0.03, 0.3, 0.03, { bevel: 0.008, seg: 1, color: 'gunmetal', mat: 'metal' }).rot(i / 4 * Math.PI, 0, 0));
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) wheel.push(kit.cone(0.018, 0.06, { seg: 4, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(0, 0.18, 0).bake().rot(i / 6 * TAU, 0, 0));
      wheel.push(kit.rcyl(0.045, 0.045, 0.12, { seg: 10, color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).rot(0, 0, HP));

        kit.lathe([[0, 0], [0.13, 0], [0.11, 0.08], [0.03, 0.4], [0, 0.48]], { seg: 6, color: 'scarSteel', mat: 'chrome', sharp: true }).rot(-HP, 0, Math.PI / 6).at(0, Y, -0.92),
        ram.at(0, Y + 0.17, -0.74),

        kit.ring(0.08, 0.012, { seg: [3, 10], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).rot(0, 0, HP).at(0.56, Y + 0.04, -0.66), kit.ring(0.08, 0.012, { seg: [3, 10], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).rot(0, 0, HP).at(-0.56, Y + 0.04, -0.66),
        kit.cone(0.05, 0.2, { seg: 6, color: bone, mat: 'bone' }).rot(0, 0, -HP).at(1.14, Y + 0.02, -0.46), kit.cone(0.05, 0.2, { seg: 6, color: bone, mat: 'bone' }).rot(0, 0, HP).at(-1.14, Y + 0.02, -0.46),

        kit.gem(0.07, { color: 'teamGlow', mat: 'gem', glow: 0.5 }).at(0, Y + 0.12, -0.6));
      rig.add('ribbonX', tatterTails(kit, 0.36, { w: 0.055 }).at(0, Y + 0.08, 0.76));
      // string: V fully drawn (nock pulled back to z = +0.42), scaled along Z from the limb line

        [0, 1, 2].map(i => kit.merge([kit.extrude([[0, 0], [0.11, 0.04], [0.11, 0.2], [0, 0.17]], 0.012, { color: i ? 'team' : 'teamDark', mat: 'cloth' }).rot(-HP, 0, 0)]).rot(0, 0, HP + i * TAU / 3).at(0, Y + 0.12, 0.5)));

  // =====================================================================================
  // SPAWNERS + ECONOMY
  // =====================================================================================
  /** Dark stone / dirt foot ring shared by the spawner buildings (team trim readable from above,
   *  gold lip, optional stones and outward spikes). */
  function footRing(kit, r, o) {
    o = o || {};
    const parts = [
      kit.lathe(rimProf(r + 0.06, r, 0, 0.17, 0.05, 3), { seg: 22, color: o.color || COL.plinthDark, mat: 'stone', sharp: true }),
      kit.ring(r + 0.045, 0.032, { seg: [4, 24], color: 'team', mat: TM }).at(0, 0.095, 0),
      kit.ring(r + 0.01, 0.012, { seg: [3, 24], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 0.165, 0),
      kit.lathe(rimProf(r - 0.02, r - 0.08, 0.15, 0.21, 0.025, 2), { seg: 22, color: o.top || COL.dirtDark, mat: 'matte', sharp: true }),
    ];
    const rnd = kit.rand(o.seed || 3), n = o.stones || 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const a = (i + rnd() * 0.4) / n * TAU, s = 0.11 + rnd() * 0.06;
      parts.push(pebble(kit, s, { seed: 60 + i + (o.seed || 0), seg: 7, cut: 0.66, color: rnd() < 0.5 ? COL.basalt : COL.basaltLight, scale: [1.2, 0.7, 1.1] }).rot(0, a, 0).at(Math.sin(a) * (r + 0.02), 0.15, Math.cos(a) * (r + 0.02)));
    }
    if (o.spikes) parts.push(spikeRing(kit, o.spikes, r + 0.04, 0.12, 0.24, 0.04, { tilt: 1.25, off: 0.5 }));
    return parts;
  }
  /** Skull impaled on a black steel stake (stake base at the origin). */
  function skullPike(kit, h, s, o) {
    o = o || {};
    return kit.merge([
      kit.rcyl(0.022, 0.03, h, { seg: 6, color: o.pole || 'woodDark', mat: 'wood' }).at(0, h / 2, 0),
      skull(kit, s, { horns: o.horns !== undefined ? o.horns : false, eye: o.eye || COL.ember, hornLen: 1.4, lo: o.lo }).at(0, h + s * 0.2, 0),
      spike(kit, s * 1.4, 0.016).at(0, h + s * 0.9, 0.02),
    ]);
  }
  /** Small red toadstool (decoration: mushroom cluster). */
  function toadstool(kit, x, z, s, rot) {
    return kit.merge([
      kit.rcyl(0.035 * s, 0.05 * s, 0.14 * s, { seg: 8, color: 'clothWhite', mat: 'soft' }).at(0, 0.07 * s, 0),
      kit.lathe([[0.0, 0.0], [0.1, 0.0], [0.105, 0.02], [0.08, 0.06], [0.03, 0.078], [0, 0.08]].map(q => [q[0] * s, q[1] * s]), { seg: 12, color: COL.crimson, mat: TM }).at(0, 0.12 * s, 0),
      kit.sphere(0.02 * s, { seg: 6, color: 'clothWhite', scale: [1, 0.5, 1] }).at(0.04 * s, 0.19 * s, -0.03 * s),
      kit.sphere(0.016 * s, { seg: 6, color: 'clothWhite', scale: [1, 0.5, 1] }).at(-0.05 * s, 0.185 * s, 0.02 * s),
    ]).rot(0, rot || 0, 0).at(x, 0.18, z);
  }
  /** Spear (goblin style): shaft along +Y from the origin, barbed black iron head, team rag. */
  function goblinSpear(kit, len, o) {
    o = o || {};
    return kit.merge([
      kit.rcyl(0.026, 0.03, len, { seg: 6, color: 'woodDark', mat: 'wood' }).at(0, len / 2, 0),
      kit.lathe([[0, 0], [0.07, 0.05], [0.04, 0.1], [0.06, 0.16], [0, 0.3]], { seg: 4, color: o.head || 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal', sharp: true }).scale(1, 1, 0.5).at(0, len, 0),
      kit.rcyl(0.04, 0.04, 0.05, { seg: 6, color: 'rope', mat: 'cloth' }).at(0, len - 0.02, 0),
      cloth(kit, 0.1, 0.22, { color: o.tuft || 'team', inner: 'teamDark', teeth: 2, teethD: 0.06, sy: 2, wave: 0.02 }).at(0.05, len - 0.04, 0),
    ]);
  }

  // ---- goblin-hut "Kobold-Bude" (3x3, v11): a squat war hut of sharpened palisade stakes under a
  // ragged dark thatch roof with a team band, crowned by bone horns; spears rammed through the
  // thatch, skulls on pikes, a horned beast skull over the black doorway where narrow glowing
  // goblin eyes glare out (they blink and look around), a green spirit lantern, chimney smoke.
  defineModel('goblin-hut', {
    height: 2.5, ao: 0.16, prop: 'building',
    anim: {
      body: 'building', attack: 'none', weight: 1,
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        faceViewer(rig, st, a);
        const look = Math.sin(a.rt * 0.9 + a.seed * 6);
        rig.eyes.position.x += 0.08 * (look > 0.35 ? 1 : look < -0.35 ? -1 : look / 0.35);
        rig.eyes.position.y += 0.015 * Math.sin(a.rt * 2.3);
        propBlink(rig.eyes, a, 3.1);
        rig.roof.rotation.z += 0.018 * Math.sin(a.rt * 1.7 + a.seed * 3);
        rig.roof.rotation.x += 0.012 * Math.sin(a.rt * 1.3);
        rig.coreLamp.rotation.z += 0.16 * Math.sin(a.rt * 2.1 + a.seed);
        puff(rig.smoke, a.rt, 2.4, a.seed, 0.8, 1.2);
      },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.42, pitch: 0.2, zoom: 1.3 },
    build(kit) {
      const rig = kit.rig();
      const wood = grimHex(kit, castCol('goblin-hut', 'color', '#7a6a3a'), 0.58), green = castCol('goblin-hut', 'accent', '#a8d65a');
      const straw = kit.darken(COL.straw, 0.35), strawD = kit.darken(COL.strawDark, 0.3);
      const DY = 0.26;                                  // roof lift above the original eave
      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, 0, 0]);
      rig.pivot('roof', 'body', [0, 1.1 + DY, 0]);
      rig.pivot('flagTop', 'roof', [0.05, 2.28 + DY, 0.05]);
      rig.pivot('eyes', 'body', [0, 0.74, -1.02]);
      rig.pivot('coreLamp', 'body', [0.7, 1.32, -0.86]);
      rig.pivot('smoke', 'roof', [0.05, 2.35 + DY, 0.05]);
      const body = footRing(kit, 1.28, { stones: 5, seed: 5, spikes: 0 });
      // walls: barrel of sharpened palisade stakes (pointed tops poke above the eave line)
      body.push(kit.lathe([[0.9, 0.18], [0.97, 0.5], [0.96, 1.0], [0.88, 1.4], [0, 1.4]], { seg: 14, color: kit.darken(wood, 0.2), mat: 'wood' }));
      for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        const an = (i + 0.5) / 16 * TAU;
        if (Math.abs(Math.sin(an)) < 0.36 && Math.cos(an) < 0) continue;     // keep the doorway free
        const h = 1.02 + (i % 3) * 0.06;
        body.push(kit.capsule(0.075, h, { seg: 5, capSeg: 1, color: i % 2 ? wood : kit.lighten(wood, 0.1), mat: 'wood' }).at(Math.sin(an) * 0.95, 0.2 + h / 2 + 0.04, Math.cos(an) * 0.95));
      }
      body.push(kit.ring(0.98, 0.04, { seg: [3, 16], color: 'rope' }).at(0, 0.46, 0));
      body.push(kit.ring(0.98, 0.035, { seg: [3, 16], color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(0, 1.08, 0));
      // doorway: black pointed arch, bone tusk frame, beast skull with horns over it
      body.push(kit.extrude(archPath(0.68, 0.92, 5), 0.1, { color: 0x080605, smooth: false }).at(0, 0.18, -0.94));
      body.push(kit.tube(archPath(0.8, 1.0, 5).map(p => [p[0], 0.18 + p[1], -1.0]), 0.05, { color: 'boneDark', mat: 'bone', radial: 5, seg: 14, caps: false }));
      for (const k of [-1, 1]) body.push(kit.tube([[k * 0.4, 0.2, -1.02], [k * 0.52, 0.5, -1.1], [k * 0.46, 0.8, -1.16]], [0.06, 0.01], { color: 'boneDark', mat: 'bone', radial: 5, seg: 6 }));
      body.push(skull(kit, 0.13, { hornLen: 2.0, hornColor: 'boneDark', eye: green, lo: !kit.hi }).at(0, 1.3, -1.08));
      // spiked team war shield hung beside the door
      body.push(kit.rcyl(0.25, 0.25, 0.05, { seg: 16, color: 'team', mat: TM }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(-0.66, 0.74, -0.76));
      body.push(kit.torus(0.25, 0.03, { seg: [3, 12], color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).rot(0, 0.6, 0).at(-0.66, 0.74, -0.78));
      body.push(spike(kit, 0.16, 0.05, { gold: true }).rot(-HP, 0.6, 0).at(-0.68, 0.74, -0.8));
      for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) body.push(kit.box(0.02, 0.34, 0.02, { bevel: 0, micro: false, color: 'teamDark' }).rot(0, 0.6, k * Math.PI / 3).at(-0.66, 0.74, -0.79));
      // spear + skull pikes + a bone pile
      body.push(goblinSpear(kit, 1.25).rot(0.25, 0, -0.22).at(0.98, 0.18, -0.35));
      body.push(skullPike(kit, 0.9, 0.09, { eye: green, lo: !kit.hi }).rot(0.12, 0, 0.1).at(0.62, 0.18, -1.02));
      // v11 rv: a skull totem (two skulls stacked on a horned pole, team rag) at the back left
      body.push(kit.merge([
        kit.cylinder(0.035, 0.045, 1.5, { seg: 6, color: 'woodDark', mat: 'wood' }).at(0, 0.75, 0),
        skull(kit, 0.1, { horns: false, eye: green, lo: !kit.hi }).at(0, 1.18, -0.02),
        skull(kit, 0.12, { hornLen: 1.8, hornColor: 'boneDark', eye: green, lo: !kit.hi }).at(0, 1.48, -0.02),
        spike(kit, 0.2, 0.025).at(0, 1.6, 0),
        cloth(kit, 0.14, 0.34, { color: 'team', inner: 'teamDark', teeth: 2, teethD: 0.1, rag: true, sy: 2, wave: 0.02 }).at(0.06, 1.02, 0.02),
      ]).rot(0, 0.5, 0.06).at(-1.08, 0.16, 0.55));
      // ring of sharpened palisade stakes leaning outwards (the doorway stays free)
      for (let i = 0; i < 11; i++) {
        const an = (i + 0.5) / 11 * TAU;
        if (Math.abs(Math.sin(an)) < 0.42 && Math.cos(an) < 0) continue;
        const L = 0.5 + (i % 3) * 0.08;
        body.push(kit.merge([kit.cylinder(0.035, 0.042, L, { seg: 5, open: true, color: i % 2 ? 'woodDark' : wood, mat: 'wood' }).at(0, L / 2, 0), kit.cone(0.035, 0.16, { seg: 5, open: true, color: kit.lighten(wood, 0.15), mat: 'wood' }).at(0, L + 0.08, 0)])
          .rot(-0.5, 0, 0).bake().rot(0, an + Math.PI, 0).at(Math.sin(an) * 1.3, 0.14, Math.cos(an) * 1.3));
      }
      body.push(kit.box(0.34, 0.26, 0.3, { bevel: 0.03, seg: 1, color: kit.darken(wood, 0.1), mat: 'wood' }).rot(0, 0.4, 0).at(0.95, 0.31, 0.45));
      body.push(kit.box(0.36, 0.04, 0.05, { bevel: 0, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).rot(0, 0.4, 0).at(0.95, 0.38, 0.45));
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) body.push(kit.capsule(0.025, 0.2, { seg: 5, capSeg: 1, color: 'boneDark', mat: 'bone' }).rot(0, i * 1.3, HP).at(-0.8 + i * 0.08, 0.22, 0.75 - i * 0.05));
      rig.add('body', body);
      // narrow glowing goblin eyes in the dark doorway (heavy angry brows)
      rig.add('eyes',
        slitEye(kit, 0.07, { side: -1, color: green, core: 0xfaffd0, tilt: 0.5, open: 0.42 }).at(-0.13, 0.74, -1.04),
        slitEye(kit, 0.07, { side: 1, color: green, core: 0xfaffd0, tilt: 0.5, open: 0.42 }).at(0.13, 0.74, -1.04),
        fierceBrow(kit, 0.16, { side: -1, color: kit.darken(green, 0.5), glow: 0.4 }).rot(0, 0, -0.15).at(-0.12, 0.83, -1.05),
        fierceBrow(kit, 0.16, { side: 1, color: kit.darken(green, 0.5), glow: 0.4 }).rot(0, 0, 0.15).at(0.12, 0.83, -1.05));
      // ragged dark thatch roof (two layers + jagged fringe), team band, spears, bone horns
      const roof = [
        kit.lathe([[1.26, 1.02], [1.22, 1.12], [0.96, 1.44], [0.62, 1.82], [0.34, 2.1], [0.2, 2.24], [0.17, 2.27]], { seg: 14, color: straw, mat: 'matte', double: strawD }),
        kit.cylinder(0.17, 0.17, 0.02, { seg: 10, color: COL.ember, glow: 0.85 }).at(0.0, 2.17, 0.0),
        kit.cylinder(0.1, 0.1, 0.02, { seg: 8, color: COL.lavaHot, glow: 1 }).at(0.0, 2.19, 0.0),
        kit.lathe([[1.36, 0.96], [1.32, 1.05], [1.18, 1.16], [0.9, 1.2]], { seg: 14, color: strawD, mat: 'matte' }),
        kit.lathe([[0.86, 1.6], [0.8, 1.7], [0.6, 1.86], [0.45, 1.88]], { seg: 14, color: kit.lighten(straw, 0.1), mat: 'matte' }),
        kit.cylinder(0.82, 0.92, 0.13, { seg: 14, open: true, color: 'team', double: 'teamDark', mat: TM }).at(0, 1.66, 0),
        kit.ring(0.92, 0.016, { seg: [3, 14], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 1.6, 0),
        kit.cylinder(0.2, 0.22, 0.16, { seg: 8, open: true, color: strawD, mat: 'matte', double: 0x1a0c06 }).at(0.0, 2.3, 0.0),
        kit.ring(0.2, 0.03, { seg: [3, 10], color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(0.0, 2.37, 0.0),
      ];
      for (let i = 0; i < 13; i++) {
        const an = (i + 0.5) / 13 * TAU, r = 1.24 + (i % 3) * 0.03;
        const sc = Math.sin(an), cc = Math.cos(an);
        roof.push(strawSpike(kit, [sc * (r - 0.06), 1.05, cc * (r - 0.06)], [sc * 0.3, -0.95, cc * 0.3], 0.32 + (i % 2) * 0.12, 0.09, i % 3 ? straw : strawD));
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        const an = (i + 0.25) / 10 * TAU, c = Math.sin(an), d = Math.cos(an);
        roof.push(kit.tube([[c * 1.22, 1.13, d * 1.22], [c * 0.98, 1.44, d * 0.98], [c * 0.62, 1.8, d * 0.62], [c * 0.3, 2.07, d * 0.3]], 0.022, { color: i % 2 ? strawD : kit.lighten(straw, 0.15), radial: 3, seg: 5, caps: false }));
      }
      roof.push(goblinSpear(kit, 1.2).rot(-0.8, 0, 0.5).at(-0.35, 1.2, 0.5));

  // ---- tombstone "Spuk-Grab" (2x2, v11): a tall gothic pointed headstone with spired corner
  // pinnacles and a horned skull relief whose narrow sockets burn ghost-green, a glowing crack,
  // iron chains, a tattered team shroud, grave stakes, candles, hooded wraith wisps circling and
  // a long-clawed skeleton hand that keeps clawing its way out of the grave.
  defineModel('tombstone', {
    height: 1.55, ao: 0.14, prop: 'building',
    anim: {
      body: 'building', attack: 'none', weight: 1, spinRate: 1.6,
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        faceViewer(rig, st, a);
        const cyc = (a.rt * 0.42 + a.seed) % 1;
        const up = cyc < 0.55 ? smooth01(cyc / 0.25) : 1 - smooth01((cyc - 0.55) / 0.3);
        rig.claw.position.y += -0.32 + 0.32 * up;
        rig.claw.rotation.z += 0.18 * Math.sin(a.rt * 7) * up;
        rig.claw.rotation.x += 0.12 * Math.sin(a.rt * 5.3) * up;

        rig.coreGlow.scale.set(g, g, 1);

      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, 0, 0]);
      rig.pivot('claw', 'body', [-0.42, 0.22, -0.42]);
      rig.pivot('spinWisp', 'body', [0, 1.0, 0.12]);
      rig.pivot('coreCandle', 'body', [0.52, 0.42, -0.3]);
      rig.pivot('coreGlow', 'body', [0, 1.05, -0.02]);

      body.push(kit.cylinder(0.945, 0.945, 0.04, { seg: 14, open: true, color: 'team', mat: TM }).at(0, 0.06, 0));
      body.push(kit.ring(0.95, 0.012, { seg: [3, 14], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 0.09, 0));
      body.push(kit.sphere(0.8, { seg: 14, hseg: 5, theta: [0, HP], color: COL.dirt, mat: 'matte', scale: [1, 0.3, 0.95] }).at(0, 0.09, -0.05));
      const rnd = kit.rand(8);
      for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {

        if (i % 2 === 0) body.push(tuft(kit, 0.17 + rnd() * 0.08, { n: 3, seed: 20 + i, color: 0x3a3a22, c2: 0x2a2a18 }).rot(0, an, 0).at(Math.sin(an) * r, 0.12, Math.cos(an) * r));
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) body.push(pebble(kit, 0.07 + rnd() * 0.05, { seed: 80 + i, seg: 7, color: COL.basaltLight }).at((rnd() - 0.5) * 1.3, 0.12, -0.5 - rnd() * 0.3));
      // gothic headstone: pointed slab, darker face inset, inscription lines, corner pinnacles
      body.push(kit.box(1.02, 0.16, 0.42, { bevel: 0.04, seg: 1, color: kit.darken(grey, 0.2), mat: 'stone' }).at(0, 0.2, 0.18));
      body.push(kit.extrude(archPath(0.86, 1.42, 6), 0.24, { color: grey, mat: 'stone', bevel: 0.03, smooth: 30 }).rot(-0.06, 0, 0.04).at(0, 0.26, 0.18));
      body.push(kit.extrude(archPath(0.66, 1.18, 6), 0.04, { color: kit.darken(grey, 0.18), mat: 'stone', smooth: false }).rot(-0.06, 0, 0.04).at(0, 0.34, 0.03));
      for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) body.push(kit.box(0.4 - k * 0.08, 0.03, 0.02, { bevel: 0, color: kit.darken(grey, 0.45) }).rot(-0.06, 0, 0.04).at(0.005, 0.56 - k * 0.09, 0.0));
      for (const k of [-1, 1]) {
        body.push(kit.box(0.1, 0.9, 0.12, { bevel: 0.02, seg: 1, color: kit.darken(grey, 0.1), mat: 'stone' }).rot(-0.06, 0, 0.04).at(k * 0.47, 0.72, 0.14));
        body.push(kit.cone(0.075, 0.34, { seg: 4, color: grey, mat: 'stone' }).rot(-0.06, Math.PI / 4, 0.04).at(k * 0.49, 1.33, 0.12));
        body.push(spike(kit, 0.16, 0.02).at(k * 0.5, 1.48, 0.11));
      }
      body.push(spike(kit, 0.26, 0.035, { gold: true }).rot(-0.06, 0, 0.04).at(0.06, 1.66, 0.16));
      body.push(kit.sphere(0.18, { seg: 10, color: 0x2a3322, mat: 'felt', scale: [1.3, 0.4, 0.8] }).at(-0.22, 1.48, 0.17));
      // horned skull relief with deep sockets (glowing eyes live in coreGlow)

      // ghostly crack down the stone
      body.push(kit.tube([[0.3, 1.25, -0.0], [0.2, 1.05, -0.01], [0.27, 0.86, -0.01], [0.17, 0.62, -0.0], [0.22, 0.4, 0.0]], [0.03, 0.012], { color: ghost, glow: 0.9, radial: 3, seg: 10 }));
      // iron chains across the stone
      for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
        const u = i / 8, x = -0.5 + u, y = 0.78 - 0.16 * Math.sin(u * Math.PI);
        body.push(kit.torus(0.04, 0.012, { seg: [3, 6], color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal', scale: [1.3, 0.9, 1] }).rot(0, i % 2 ? HP : 0, 0.3 * (u - 0.5)).at(x, y, -0.06));
      }
      // tattered team shroud over the shoulder
      body.push(kit.tube([[-0.47, 0.95, 0.06], [-0.4, 1.32, 0.12], [-0.15, 1.58, 0.18], [0.02, 1.6, 0.2]], 0.045, { color: 'team', mat: 'cloth', radial: 4, seg: 10 }));
      body.push(cloth(kit, 0.16, 0.42, { color: 'team', inner: 'teamDark', teeth: 2, teethD: 0.1, sy: 2 }).rot(0, 0, 0.2).at(-0.49, 0.96, -0.02));
      body.push(cloth(kit, 0.14, 0.34, { color: 'teamDark', inner: 'team', teeth: 2, teethD: 0.08, sy: 2 }).rot(0, 0, -0.2).at(-0.38, 0.96, -0.03));
      // blackened grave stakes with gold collars
      for (const k of [-1, 1]) body.push(spike(kit, 0.6, 0.05, { gold: true }).rot(0.12, 0, k * 0.12).at(k * 0.66, 0.08, 0.34));
      // candle stubs on a stone + scattered bones
      body.push(kit.cylinder(0.11, 0.13, 0.12, { seg: 7, color: COL.basaltLight, mat: 'stone' }).at(0.52, 0.2, -0.3));
      body.push(kit.cylinder(0.05, 0.055, 0.16, { seg: 7, color: 0x8a8070 }).at(0.52, 0.34, -0.3));
      body.push(kit.cylinder(0.035, 0.04, 0.09, { seg: 6, color: 0x8a8070 }).at(0.62, 0.3, -0.24));
      body.push(kit.capsule(0.025, 0.2, { seg: 5, capSeg: 1, color: 'boneDark', mat: 'bone' }).rot(0, 0.5, HP).at(0.25, 0.2, -0.68));
      body.push(kit.sphere(0.035, { seg: 5, hseg: 3, color: 'boneDark' }).at(0.15, 0.2, -0.62), kit.sphere(0.035, { seg: 5, hseg: 3, color: 'boneDark' }).at(0.34, 0.2, -0.74));
      rig.add('body', body);
      // narrow ghost-green eyes burning in the skull sockets
      rig.add('coreGlow',
        slitEye(kit, 0.045, { side: -1, color: ghost, core: 0xffffff, tilt: 0.4, open: 0.5 }).at(-0.068, 1.01, -0.27),
        slitEye(kit, 0.045, { side: 1, color: ghost, core: 0xffffff, tilt: 0.4, open: 0.5 }).at(0.068, 1.01, -0.27));
      rig.add('coreCandle', flame(kit, 0.13, { color: 0x9dffc8, core: 0xe8fff4 }).at(0.52, 0.42, -0.3));
      // hooded wraith wisps (orbit via spin*): tapering tails, faceless hoods, slit eyes
      const wisps = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        const an = i / 3 * TAU, r = 0.62, y = 1.0 + (i - 1) * 0.12;
        const gx = Math.sin(an) * r, gz = 0.12 + Math.cos(an) * r, ox = Math.sin(an), oz = Math.cos(an), tx = Math.cos(an), tz = -Math.sin(an);
        wisps.push(kit.sphere(0.1, { seg: 8, hseg: 6, color: ghost, glow: 0.7, scale: [1, 1.15, 1] }).at(gx, y, gz));
        wisps.push(kit.cone(0.1, 0.4, { seg: 6, color: ghost, glow: 0.55 }).rot(HP, an + HP, 0).at(gx + tx * 0.22, y - 0.04, gz + tz * 0.22));
        wisps.push(kit.cone(0.075, 0.2, { seg: 6, color: ghost, glow: 0.6 }).rot(0.5, an, 0).at(gx - ox * 0.03, y + 0.13, gz - oz * 0.03));
        wisps.push(kit.sphere(0.065, { seg: 6, hseg: 4, color: 0x04080a, scale: [1, 1, 0.5] }).at(gx + ox * 0.07, y + 0.01, gz + oz * 0.07));
        for (const e of [-1, 1]) wisps.push(slitEye(kit, 0.018, { side: e, color: 0xffffff, core: 0xffffff, tilt: 0.5, open: 0.45 }).bake().rot(0, faceYaw(ox, oz), 0).at(gx + ox * 0.1 - tx * 0.03 * e, y + 0.02, gz + oz * 0.1 - tz * 0.03 * e));

        hand.push(kit.cone(0.014, 0.08, { seg: 4, color: 0x1a1414, mat: 'bone' }).rot(-0.9, 0, 0).at(ex, 0.64, -0.55));

      rig.add('claw', hand);

  // ---- furnace "Glut-Fabrik" (3x3, v11): a horned demon kiln of scorched brick with spiked iron
  // bands; carved burning eyes under iron brows, a fanged roaring maw behind a grate, a chimney
  // with a spiked crown and team cap puffing smoke, a pumping bellows and a smouldering coal pile.
  defineModel('furnace', {
    height: 2.3, ao: 0.15, prop: 'building',
    anim: {
      body: 'building', attack: 'none', weight: 1,
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        faceViewer(rig, st, a);
        const pump = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(a.rt * 3.2 + a.seed * 5);
        rig.bellows.scale.y = 0.65 + 0.45 * pump;
        rig.bellows.rotation.z += 0.04 * pump;
        const roar = 1 + 0.1 * (1 - pump) + 0.05 * Math.sin(a.rt * 19 + a.seed);
        rig.coreMouth.scale.set(roar, 0.96 + 0.08 * (1 - pump), 1);
        puff(rig.smoke1, a.rt, 2.2, a.seed, 1.0, 1.35);
        puff(rig.smoke2, a.rt, 2.2, a.seed + 0.5, 1.0, 1.2);
        flicker(rig.coreEmber, a.rt, a.seed + 0.3, 1);
        rig.eyes.scale.set(1, 0.9 + 0.14 * (1 - pump), 1);
        propBlink(rig.eyes, a, 3.8);
      },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.55, pitch: 0.2, zoom: 1.3 },
    build(kit) {
      const rig = kit.rig();
      const brick = grimHex(kit, castCol('furnace', 'color', '#5a3a33'), 0.42), fire = castCol('furnace', 'accent', '#ff7a3a');
      const brickL = kit.lighten(brick, 0.22), brickM = kit.lighten(brick, 0.12), dome = kit.lighten(brick, 0.04);
      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, 0, 0]);
      rig.pivot('coreMouth', 'body', [0, 0.62, -0.95]);
      rig.pivot('bellows', 'body', [1.02, 0.42, 0.1]);
      rig.pivot('smoke1', 'body', [0.42, 2.3, 0.42]);
      rig.pivot('smoke2', 'body', [0.42, 2.3, 0.42]);
      rig.pivot('coreEmber', 'body', [-0.95, 0.3, -0.5]);
      rig.pivot('eyes', 'body', [0, 1.15, -0.95]);
      const body = [
        polyLathe(kit, rimProf(1.2, 1.15, 0, 0.21, 0.05), { n: 8, rcK: 0.14, color: COL.plinthDark, mat: 'stone' }),
        polyLathe(kit, [[1.185, 0.11], [1.2, 0.12], [1.2, 0.165], [1.18, 0.175]], { n: 8, rcK: 0.14, color: 'team', mat: TM, open: true }),
        rslab(kit, 1.1, 1.06, 0.19, 0.26, 0.025, { n: 8, rcK: 0.14, color: COL.plinth, mat: 'stone' }),
        polyLathe(kit, [[1.055, 0.25], [1.07, 0.258], [1.06, 0.27]], { n: 8, rcK: 0.14, color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold', open: true }),
        kit.lathe([[1.0, 0.24], [1.03, 0.55], [0.97, 0.95], [0.82, 1.3], [0.58, 1.56], [0.3, 1.68], [0, 1.7]], { seg: 20, color: dome, mat: 'stone', rough: 0.74 }),
      ];
      // brick courses (staggered blocks)
      const rows = [[0.4, 1.03], [0.66, 1.02], [0.92, 0.98], [1.18, 0.86], [1.42, 0.66], [1.6, 0.42]];
      rows.forEach((rw, k) => {
        const n = Math.round(14 - k * 1.6);
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          const an = (i + (k % 2) * 0.5) / n * TAU;
          if (k < 3 && Math.abs(an - Math.PI) < 0.42) continue;          // mouth
          const tilt = k > 2 ? 0.35 + (k - 3) * 0.3 : 0;
          body.push(kit.box(0.36 - k * 0.025, 0.17, 0.07, { bevel: kit.hi ? 0.025 : 0, seg: 1, micro: kit.hi, color: (i + k) % 3 ? brickL : brickM, mat: 'stone' }).rot(-tilt, an, 0).at(Math.sin(an) * rw[1], rw[0], Math.cos(an) * rw[1]));
        }
      });
      // glowing heat cracks between the bricks
      for (const q of [[[0.7, 0.5, 0.72], [0.62, 0.8, 0.7], [0.66, 1.05, 0.55]], [[-0.8, 0.55, 0.55], [-0.72, 0.86, 0.5]], [[0.3, 1.3, 0.72], [0.12, 1.48, 0.6]]])
        body.push(kit.tube(q, 0.016, { color: COL.ember, glow: 0.9, radial: 3, seg: 4, caps: false }));
      body.push(kit.ring(1.04, 0.045, { seg: [4, 16], color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(0, 0.28, 0));
      body.push(kit.cylinder(0.24, 0.3, 0.12, { seg: 8, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(-0.12, 1.68, -0.1));
      body.push(kit.cylinder(0.17, 0.17, 0.02, { seg: 8, color: fire, glow: 1 }).at(-0.12, 1.745, -0.1));
      for (let k = -1; k <= 1; k++) body.push(kit.box(0.36, 0.03, 0.035, { bevel: 0, color: 'blackSteel' }).at(-0.12, 1.76, -0.1 + k * 0.1));
      body.push(kit.ring(0.95, 0.04, { seg: [4, 16], color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(0, 1.02, 0));
      body.push(studRing(kit, 10, 0.97, 1.02, 0.03, 'oldGold'));
      body.push(spikeRing(kit, 8, 0.96, 1.02, 0.2, 0.035, { tilt: 1.2, off: 0.5 }));
      // huge iron demon horns + bone fangs in the maw arch + a spiked chimney crown
      for (const k of [-1, 1]) body.push(horn(kit, 0.86, 0.12, { side: k, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(k * 0.7, 1.26, -0.12));
      for (const x of [-0.27, -0.16, -0.06, 0.06, 0.16, 0.27]) body.push(kit.cone(0.042, Math.abs(x) > 0.2 || Math.abs(x) < 0.1 ? 0.12 : 0.18, { seg: 4, color: 'boneDark', mat: 'bone' }).rot(Math.PI, 0, 0).at(x, 0.62 + Math.sqrt(0.36 * 0.36 - x * x) - 0.08, -1.06));
      for (const x of [-0.22, 0.22]) body.push(kit.cone(0.04, 0.14, { seg: 4, color: 'boneDark', mat: 'bone' }).at(x, 0.4, -1.08));
      body.push(spikeRing(kit, 6, 0.3, 2.29, 0.22, 0.035, { tilt: 0.45 }).at(0.42, 0, 0.42));
      // maw: dark arch, iron frame + grate
      const THREE = T3();
      const arch = new THREE.Shape();
      arch.moveTo(-0.36, 0); arch.lineTo(0.36, 0); arch.lineTo(0.36, 0.3); arch.absarc(0, 0.3, 0.36, 0, Math.PI, false); arch.lineTo(-0.36, 0);
      body.push(kit.extrude(arch, 0.14, { color: 0x1c0806, curveSeg: 7 }).at(0, 0.32, -0.97));
      body.push(kit.torus(0.42, 0.06, { seg: [4, 10], arc: Math.PI, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(0, 0.62, -1.02));
      body.push(kit.box(0.1, 0.32, 0.1, { bevel: 0.02, seg: 1, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(-0.42, 0.46, -1.02), kit.box(0.1, 0.32, 0.1, { bevel: 0.02, seg: 1, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(0.42, 0.46, -1.02));
      body.push(kit.box(1.0, 0.1, 0.24, { bevel: 0.03, seg: 1, color: COL.plinth, mat: 'stone' }).at(0, 0.3, -1.08));
      for (let k = -2; k <= 2; k++) body.push(kit.cylinder(0.022, 0.022, 0.62, { seg: 4, color: 'blackSteel' }).at(k * 0.13, 0.62, -1.05));
      body.push(kit.box(0.72, 0.035, 0.035, { bevel: 0, color: 'blackSteel' }).at(0, 0.62, -1.06));
      // chimney (back right) with team cap and gold band
      body.push(kit.cylinder(0.24, 0.28, 0.9, { seg: 8, color: brickM, mat: 'stone' }).at(0.42, 1.72, 0.42));
      body.push(kit.cylinder(0.3, 0.3, 0.12, { seg: 8, color: 'team', mat: TM }).at(0.42, 2.2, 0.42));
      body.push(kit.cylinder(0.32, 0.3, 0.06, { seg: 8, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(0.42, 2.28, 0.42));
      body.push(kit.cylinder(0.18, 0.18, 0.04, { seg: 8, color: 0x140a08 }).at(0.42, 2.31, 0.42));
      body.push(kit.ring(0.27, 0.025, { seg: [3, 10], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0.42, 1.92, 0.42));
      // bellows frame (static) + iron pipe into the kiln
      body.push(kit.box(0.08, 0.06, 0.62, { bevel: 0.015, seg: 1, color: 'woodDark', mat: 'wood' }).at(1.02, 0.3, 0.1));
      body.push(kit.tube([[1.02, 0.42, -0.25], [1.0, 0.5, -0.4], [0.9, 0.55, -0.48]], 0.04, { color: 'gunmetal', mat: 'metal', radial: 5, seg: 5 }));
      // coal pile with embers (left front)

  // ---- elixir-collector "Elixier-Pumpe" (3x3, v11): a glass globe of glowing elixir clutched by
  // four black steel talons on a dark basalt plinth, old-gold meridians, a spiked crown cap; a
  // flywheel drives a piston on top, bubbles rise inside, a fanged spout drips elixir into a
  // basin. Team band + tattered team pennant.
  defineModel('elixir-collector', {

      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {

      const body = [

        studRing(kit, 12, 1.25, 0.16, 0.03, 'oldGold'),
        spikeRing(kit, 8, 1.2, 0.1, 0.24, 0.045, { tilt: 1.25, off: 0.5 }),

      }
      body.push(kit.merge(rivets));
      body.push(kit.ring(GR * 0.86, 0.045, { seg: [4, 18], color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(0, GY + Math.cos(0.98) * GR, 0));

      body.push(kit.tube([[-0.36, GY + 0.38, -0.38], [-0.47, GY + 0.18, -0.38], [-0.5, GY - 0.03, -0.33]], 0.022, { color: 0xd8ccf0, glow: 0.45, radial: 4, seg: 6 }));
      // v11 rv: feed pipes from the globe into the plinth with iron valve wheels + a gauge
      for (const k of [-1, 1]) {
        const x0 = k * (GR * 0.72), pipe = [[x0, GY - GR * 0.55, -0.12], [k * 0.66, GY - 0.6, -0.16], [k * 0.78, 0.86, -0.1], [k * 0.8, 0.58, -0.06]];
        body.push(kit.tube(pipe, 0.045, { color: 'gunmetal', mat: 'metal', radial: 6, seg: 10 }));

        body.push(kit.rcyl(0.062, 0.062, 0.05, { seg: 8, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).rot(0, 0, HP).at(k * 0.72, 1.02, -0.12));
        const vw = [kit.torus(0.09, 0.014, { seg: [3, 12], color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).rot(0, HP, 0)];
        for (let j = 0; j < 2; j++) vw.push(kit.box(0.012, 0.18, 0.012, { bevel: 0, micro: false, color: brass, mat: 'gold' }).rot(j * HP, 0, 0));
        body.push(kit.merge(vw).at(k * 0.79, 1.02, -0.12));
      }
      body.push(kit.rcyl(0.085, 0.085, 0.035, { seg: 12, color: brass, mat: 'gold' }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(0.42, 0.78, -0.62));
      body.push(kit.disc(0.068, { seg: 12, color: 0x1a1220 }).at(0.42, 0.78, -0.642));
      body.push(kit.box(0.008, 0.06, 0.006, { bevel: 0, micro: false, color: light, glow: 0.9 }).rot(0, 0, -0.7).at(0.43, 0.79, -0.648));
      body.push(kit.tube([[0.42, 0.74, -0.6], [0.5, 0.66, -0.5], [0.66, 0.66, -0.3]], 0.02, { color: 'gunmetal', mat: 'metal', radial: 4, seg: 5 }));

      body.push(spikeRing(kit, 8, 0.38, GY + GR + 0.06, 0.24, 0.032, { tilt: 0.75, gold: true }));

      body.push(kit.box(0.08, 0.5, 0.1, { bevel: 0.02, seg: 1, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(-0.5, 1.72, 0.1));
      body.push(kit.box(1.1, 0.08, 0.12, { bevel: 0.02, seg: 1, color: 'gunmetal', mat: 'metal' }).at(0, 1.98, 0.1));
      for (const k of [-1, 1]) body.push(spike(kit, 0.14, 0.026).rot(0, 0, -k * HP).at(k * 0.55, 1.98, 0.1));
      body.push(kit.cylinder(0.1, 0.1, 0.26, { seg: 8, open: true, color: 'blackSteel' }).at(0, 2.04, 0));

      body.push(kit.cylinder(0.08, 0.06, 0.06, { seg: 8, color: brass, mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 0.7, -0.92));

      body.push(kit.cylinder(0.26, 0.2, 0.14, { seg: 10, open: true, color: 'blackSteel', double: 'gunmetal', mat: 'metal' }).at(0, 0.3, -0.92));
      body.push(kit.cylinder(0.24, 0.24, 0.02, { seg: 10, color: liquid, glow: 0.7 }).at(0, 0.34, -0.92));
      body.push(kit.ring(0.26, 0.025, { seg: [3, 12], color: brass, mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 0.37, -0.92));

      const liq = kit.sphere(GR * 0.99, { seg: 18, hseg: 10, theta: [0.98, Math.PI - 0.98 - 0.62], color: liquid, glow: 0.34, mat: 'goo' }).paint((x, y, z) => {

  // ---- barbarian-hut "Wikinger-Zelt" (3x3, v11): a dark A-frame war tent of stitched hides with
  // team stripes behind a row of sharpened stakes; crossed gable poles ending in bone horns, a
  // horned beast skull over the black entrance, a spiked round team shield, a horned helmet on a
  // pike, a crackling fire pit, a swaying hide door flap and a tattered war banner.
  defineModel('barbarian-hut', {
    height: 2.45, ao: 0.15, prop: 'building',
    anim: {
      body: 'building', attack: 'none', weight: 1,
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        faceViewer(rig, st, a);
        flicker(rig.coreFire, a.rt, a.seed, 1);
        puff(rig.smoke, a.rt, 2.6, a.seed, 0.9, 1.15);
        rig.capeFlap.rotation.x += 0.08 * Math.sin(a.rt * 1.9 + a.seed * 2) - 0.05;
      },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.6, pitch: 0.22, zoom: 1.3 },
    build(kit) {
      const rig = kit.rig();
      const hide = grimHex(kit, castCol('barbarian-hut', 'color', '#8a6a3c'), 0.55), gold = 'oldGold';
      const hideL = kit.lighten(hide, 0.22), hideM = kit.lighten(hide, 0.12);
      const RY = 1.95, HW = 1.08, L = 1.0, BY = 0.24;
      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, 0, 0]);
      rig.pivot('capeFlap', 'body', [-0.02, 1.02, -L - 0.03]);
      rig.pivot('flagW', 'body', [0.98, 2.52, 0.78]);
      rig.pivot('coreFire', 'body', [0.88, 0.3, -1.0]);
      rig.pivot('smoke', 'body', [0, RY + 0.15, 0.3]);
      const body = footRing(kit, 1.32, { color: COL.plinthDark, top: COL.dirtDark, stones: 0 });
      // blackened plank floor
      for (let k = -3; k <= 3; k++) body.push(kit.box(0.3, 0.05, 2.3, { bevel: 0.015, seg: 1, color: k % 2 ? 'woodDark' : 'grimLeatherDark', mat: 'wood' }).at(k * 0.31, 0.22, 0));
      // v11 rv: two sagging stitched hide roofs (sheets, not boards): they sag between the rib
      // poles, have a torn eave hem, painted team stripes + a gold seam; a shaggy fur pelt over the
      // ridge at the back; rib poles, fur rolls along the eaves
      const ang = Math.atan2(HW, RY - BY);
      const tm = 'team', gd = 'oldGold', hd = kit.col(hideM), hdD = kit.darken(hideM, 0.3);
      const U = [0, 0.08, 0.2, 0.27, 0.28, 0.35, 0.36, 0.45, 0.46, 0.475, 0.49, 0.58, 0.59, 0.66, 0.67, 0.8, 0.92, 1];
      const NV = kit.hi ? 18 : 9, zA = -L - 0.07, zB = L + 0.07, jr = kit.rand(23), jag = [];
      for (let j = 0; j <= NV; j++) jag.push(j % 2 ? 0.05 + jr() * 0.07 : jr() * 0.02);
      for (const sx of [-1, 1]) {
        const nx = sx * Math.cos(ang), ny = Math.sin(ang);
        const roofPt = (u, v, off) => {
          const z = lerp(zA, zB, v), zf = (z + 0.62) / 0.62, sag = 0.045 * Math.sin(Math.PI * u) * Math.abs(Math.sin(Math.PI * zf)) * (Math.abs(z) < 0.62 ? 1 : 0.6);
          const hem = u === 0 ? jag[Math.round(v * NV)] : 0;
          const x = sx * HW * (1 - u) + sx * hem * Math.sin(ang), y = BY + (RY - BY) * u - hem * Math.cos(ang);
          return [x + nx * (0.04 + off - sag), y + ny * (0.04 + off - sag), z];
        };
        body.push(sheet(kit, U.length - 1, NV, (uu, v) => roofPt(U[Math.round(uu * (U.length - 1))], v, 0), { color: hideM, mat: 'leather', double: kit.darken(hide, 0.4), inside: [0, BY + 0.3, 0] })
          .paint((x, y) => kit.mix(hd, hdD, smooth01((BY + (RY - BY) * 0.22 - y) / ((RY - BY) * 0.22)) * 0.5)));
        // painted team stripes + gold seam (thin strips riding on the hide)
        for (const st of [[0.28, 0.35, tm], [0.59, 0.66, tm], [0.458, 0.476, gd]]) {
          body.push(sheet(kit, 1, NV, (u, v) => roofPt(lerp(st[0], st[1], u), v, 0.004), { color: st[2], mat: st[2] === gd ? 'gold' : 'cloth', inside: [0, BY + 0.3, 0] }));
        }
        for (const z of [-0.62, 0.0, 0.62]) {
          body.push(kit.tube([[sx * (HW + 0.02) + nx * 0.05, BY + ny * 0.05, z], [sx * 0.04 + nx * 0.05, RY - 0.02 + ny * 0.05, z]], 0.035, { color: 'woodDark', radial: 5, seg: 1 }));
        }
        body.push(kit.capsule(0.11, 2 * L - 0.05, { seg: 7, capSeg: 2, color: 0x2a221c, mat: 'fur' }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(sx * (HW + 0.02), BY + 0.08, 0));
        if (kit.hi) for (const z of [-0.3, 0.32]) {      // stitched seams across the hide
          const pts = []; for (let k = 0; k <= 6; k++) { const u = 0.08 + k / 6 * 0.85; pts.push([sx * HW * (1 - u) + nx * 0.046, BY + (RY - BY) * u + ny * 0.046, z + 0.02 * Math.sin(k * 2.1)]); }
          body.push(kit.tube(pts, 0.008, { color: kit.darken(hide, 0.55), radial: 3, seg: 12, caps: false }));
        }
      }
      // shaggy fur pelt slung over the ridge at the back (tattered edges, lighter tips)
      const fr = kit.rand(29), fj = []; for (let j = 0; j <= 12; j++) fj.push(0.03 + fr() * 0.09);
      const furC = kit.col(0x3a2c22), furT = kit.col(0x6a5442);
      body.push(sheet(kit, 12, kit.hi ? 8 : 4, (u, v) => {
        const w = u * 2 - 1, sx = w < 0 ? -1 : 1, j = fj[Math.round(u * 12)], aw = Math.abs(w) * 0.62 + j * Math.abs(w) * 0.8;
        const nx = sx * Math.cos(ang), ny = Math.sin(ang);
        return [sx * HW * aw + nx * 0.075, BY + (RY - BY) * (1 - aw) + ny * 0.075 + 0.02, lerp(0.12, 0.9, v) + (v === 1 ? j * 0.6 : 0) - (v === 0 ? j * 0.5 : 0)];
      }, { color: furC, mat: 'fur', double: 0x1a120c, inside: [0, BY, 0.5] }).paint((x) => kit.mix(furC, furT, smooth01((Math.abs(x) - HW * 0.45) / (HW * 0.25)) * 0.7)));
      // gable triangles (front with a black entrance), ridge pole
      const tri = [[-HW + 0.06, 0], [HW - 0.06, 0], [0, RY - BY - 0.06]];
      body.push(kit.extrude(tri, 0.05, { color: hideL, mat: 'leather', smooth: false }).at(0, BY, -L));
      body.push(kit.extrude(tri, 0.05, { color: hideL, mat: 'leather', smooth: false }).at(0, BY, L));
      body.push(kit.extrude([[-0.36, 0], [0.36, 0], [0, 0.92]], 0.03, { color: 0x0a0705, smooth: false }).at(0, BY, -L - 0.035));
      body.push(kit.cylinder(0.07, 0.07, 2 * L + 0.5, { seg: 6, color: 'woodDark' }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(0, RY + 0.02, 0));
      // horned beast skull nailed over the entrance
      body.push(skull(kit, 0.14, { hornLen: 2.1, hornColor: 'boneDark', eye: COL.ember }).at(0, RY - 0.14, -L - 0.26));
      // crossed gable poles ending in curved bone horns + team cloth wraps
      for (const z of [-L - 0.07, L + 0.07]) {
        for (const sx of [-1, 1]) {
          const x0 = sx * (HW + 0.04), y0 = BY;
          const tipX = -sx * 0.22, tipY = RY + 0.22 * (RY - BY) / HW;
          body.push(kit.tube([[x0, y0, z], [tipX, tipY, z]], [0.055, 0.045], { color: 'woodDark', radial: 6, seg: 1 }));
          body.push(kit.tube([[tipX, tipY, z], [tipX - sx * 0.12, tipY + 0.16, z], [tipX - sx * 0.28, tipY + 0.2, z], [tipX - sx * 0.36, tipY + 0.1, z]], [0.05, 0.008], { color: 'boneDark', mat: 'bone', radial: 5, seg: 8 }));
          body.push(kit.rcyl(0.06, 0.06, 0.1, { seg: 6, color: 'team', mat: 'cloth' }).rot(0, 0, sx * ang).at(tipX + sx * 0.08, tipY - 0.12, z));
        }
      }
      // sharpened stakes in front of the tent (leaning outwards)
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        const x = [-1.08, -0.62, 0.36, 1.12][i];
        body.push(kit.merge([kit.rcyl(0.04, 0.045, 0.5, { seg: 5, color: 'woodDark', mat: 'wood' }).at(0, 0.25, 0), kit.cone(0.045, 0.16, { seg: 5, color: 'wood', mat: 'wood' }).at(0, 0.58, 0)]).rot(-0.4, 0, (i - 1.5) * 0.08).at(x, 0.2, -1.16));
      }
      // spiked round team shield on the front gable + horned helmet on a pike
      body.push(kit.cylinder(0.3, 0.3, 0.06, { seg: 14, color: 'team', mat: TM }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(-0.58, 0.72, -L - 0.12));
      for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) body.push(kit.box(0.02, 0.56, 0.02, { bevel: 0, color: 'teamDark' }).rot(0, 0, k * Math.PI / 4).at(-0.58, 0.72, -L - 0.155));
      body.push(kit.torus(0.3, 0.035, { seg: [3, 14], color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(-0.58, 0.72, -L - 0.15));
      body.push(spike(kit, 0.18, 0.07, { gold: true }).rot(-HP, 0, 0).at(-0.58, 0.72, -L - 0.17));
      body.push(kit.cylinder(0.035, 0.045, 0.9, { seg: 6, color: 'woodDark' }).at(-1.02, 0.67, -0.82));
      body.push(kit.sphere(0.16, { seg: 10, hseg: 5, theta: [0, HP], color: 'gunmetal', mat: 'metal' }).at(-1.02, 1.1, -0.82));
      body.push(kit.ring(0.16, 0.025, { seg: [3, 10], color: gold, mat: 'gold' }).at(-1.02, 1.11, -0.82));
      body.push(kit.box(0.04, 0.16, 0.03, { bevel: 0, micro: false, color: 'gunmetal', mat: 'metal' }).at(-1.02, 1.04, -0.97));
      body.push(kit.tube([[-1.16, 1.16, -0.82], [-1.34, 1.24, -0.84], [-1.4, 1.48, -0.9]], [0.05, 0.008], { color: 'boneDark', mat: 'bone', radial: 5, seg: 6 }));
      body.push(kit.tube([[-0.88, 1.16, -0.82], [-0.7, 1.24, -0.84], [-0.64, 1.48, -0.9]], [0.05, 0.008], { color: 'boneDark', mat: 'bone', radial: 5, seg: 6 }));
      // fire pit (front right): basalt ring + logs
      for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) { const an = i / 7 * TAU; body.push(pebble(kit, 0.08, { seed: 120 + i, seg: 7, color: i % 2 ? COL.basalt : COL.basaltLight }).at(0.88 + Math.sin(an) * 0.24, 0.26, -1.0 + Math.cos(an) * 0.24)); }
      body.push(kit.cylinder(0.04, 0.04, 0.36, { seg: 5, color: 0x1a120c }).rot(HP, 0.6, 0).at(0.88, 0.28, -1.0), kit.cylinder(0.04, 0.04, 0.36, { seg: 5, color: 0x1a120c }).rot(HP, -0.6, 0).at(0.88, 0.28, -1.0));
      // v11 rv: rope lashings on the gable crossings, guy ropes down to pegs, plank grain
      for (const z of [-L - 0.07, L + 0.07]) {
        const tipY = RY + 0.22 * (RY - BY) / HW;
        body.push(kit.torus(0.07, 0.018, { seg: [3, 10], color: 'rope', mat: 'cloth' }).at(0, RY + 0.02, z));
        body.push(kit.torus(0.075, 0.016, { seg: [3, 10], color: 'rope', mat: 'cloth' }).rot(0, 0, 0.9).at(0, RY + 0.04, z));
        for (const sx of [-1, 1]) {
          const peg = [sx * (HW + 0.32), 0.2, z + Math.sign(z) * 0.18];
          body.push(kit.tube([[sx * 0.1, tipY - 0.18, z], [sx * (HW * 0.75 + 0.12), (tipY + 0.2) * 0.42, z + Math.sign(z) * 0.1], peg], 0.011, { color: 'rope', mat: 'cloth', radial: 3, seg: 8, caps: false }));
          body.push(kit.cone(0.03, 0.16, { seg: 4, color: 'woodDark', mat: 'wood' }).rot(Math.PI, 0, 0).at(peg[0], peg[1] + 0.02, peg[2]));
        }
      }
      if (kit.hi) for (let k = -3; k <= 3; k++) for (const dx of [-0.07, 0.05]) body.push(kit.box(0.008, 0.004, 2.1, { bevel: 0, micro: false, color: 0x120c08 }).at(k * 0.31 + dx, 0.2475, (k % 2) * 0.05));
      // banner pole (back right), war drum (back left)
      body.push(kit.cylinder(0.035, 0.045, 2.4, { seg: 6, color: 'woodDark' }).at(0.98, 1.4, 0.78), spike(kit, 0.2, 0.05, { gold: true }).at(0.98, 2.6, 0.78));
      body.push(kit.cylinder(0.24, 0.24, 0.3, { seg: 10, color: 'grimLeather', mat: 'leather' }).at(-0.98, 0.37, 0.72), kit.cylinder(0.26, 0.26, 0.04, { seg: 10, color: 'team', mat: TM }).at(-0.98, 0.52, 0.72), kit.cylinder(0.26, 0.26, 0.04, { seg: 10, color: 'team', mat: TM }).at(-0.98, 0.22, 0.72));
      rig.add('body', body);
      rig.add('capeFlap', cloth(kit, 0.62, 0.82, { color: hide, inner: kit.darken(hide, 0.3), teeth: 3, teethD: 0.12, sy: 3, wave: 0.03, mat: 'leather' }).rot(-0.05, 0, 0).at(-0.02, 1.02, -L - 0.06));
      const fl = kit.merge([warFlag(kit, 0.62, 0.44),
        kit.tube([[0.18, -0.26, -0.03], [0.26, -0.16, -0.03], [0.32, -0.08, -0.03]], [0.03, 0.008], { color: 'boneDark', radial: 4, seg: 4 }),
        kit.tube([[0.46, -0.26, -0.03], [0.38, -0.16, -0.03], [0.32, -0.08, -0.03]], [0.03, 0.008], { color: 'boneDark', radial: 4, seg: 4 })]);
      rig.add('flagW', fl.rot(0, 0.7, 0).at(0.98, 2.52, 0.78));
      rig.add('coreFire', flame(kit, 0.4).at(0.88, 0.3, -1.0), flame(kit, 0.26, { color: COL.flame }).at(0.98, 0.3, -0.92), flame(kit, 0.24).at(0.78, 0.3, -1.06));
      rig.add('smoke', kit.sphere(0.16, { seg: 7, hseg: 5, color: 0x3e3a36 }).at(0, RY + 0.15, 0.3));
      return rig;
    },
  });

  // ---- goblin-cage "Krawall-Kiste" (3x3, v11): a rattling black-banded war crate with spiked
  // iron corners, heavy chains and a barred hatch; narrow furious eyes glare from the dark and a
  // clawed black steel gauntlet with a team cuff punches out between the bars.
  defineModel('goblin-cage', {
    height: 1.7, ao: 0.16, prop: 'building',
    anim: {
      body: 'building', attack: 'none', weight: 1,
      custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
        faceViewer(rig, st, a);
        const per = 1.7, u = ((a.rt / per + a.seed) % 1 + 1) % 1;
        const p = u < 0.08 ? smooth01(u / 0.08) : u < 0.2 ? 1 : 1 - smooth01((u - 0.2) / 0.2);
        rig.weapon.position.z -= 0.38 * p;
        rig.weapon.rotation.z += 0.3 * p;
        const shake = Math.exp(-((u - 0.06) * (u - 0.06)) / 0.002) + 0.4 * Math.exp(-((u - 0.55) * (u - 0.55)) / 0.003);
        rig.crate.rotation.z += 0.06 * shake * Math.sin(a.rt * 40);
        rig.crate.position.y += 0.05 * shake;
        rig.crate.rotation.x -= 0.04 * p;
        rig.eyes.position.x += 0.04 * Math.sin(a.rt * 1.3 + a.seed * 5);
        propBlink(rig.eyes, a, 2.7);
      },
    },
    portrait: { yaw: -0.5, pitch: 0.22, zoom: 1.4 },
    build(kit) {
      const rig = kit.rig();
      const wood = grimHex(kit, castCol('goblin-cage', 'color', '#956d41'), 0.6), acc = castCol('goblin-cage', 'accent', '#ffd27a');
      const woodL = kit.lighten(wood, 0.14), woodD = kit.darken(wood, 0.3);
      const S = 0.66, CY = 0.3 + S;
      rig.pivot('body', 'root', [0, 0, 0]);
      rig.pivot('crate', 'body', [0, 0.3, 0]);
      rig.pivot('eyes', 'crate', [0, CY + 0.08, -S - 0.03]);
      rig.pivot('weapon', 'crate', [0.0, CY - 0.12, -S + 0.1]);
      const body = footRing(kit, 1.15, { color: COL.plinthDark, top: kit.darken(COL.straw, 0.45), stones: 6, seed: 9, spikes: 8 });
      const rnd = kit.rand(31);
      for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) { const an = rnd() * TAU, r = 0.75 + rnd() * 0.32; body.push(kit.box(0.26, 0.02, 0.03, { bevel: 0, color: rnd() < 0.5 ? kit.darken(COL.straw, 0.3) : COL.strawDark }).rot(0, an, 0).at(Math.sin(an) * r, 0.215, Math.cos(an) * r)); }
      body.push(skull(kit, 0.07, { horns: false, eye: 0x0a0808 }).rot(0.2, 0.8, 0).at(0.78, 0.26, -0.62));
      rig.add('body', body);
      const cr = [kit.box(2 * S, 2 * S, 2 * S, { bevel: 0.05, seg: 1, color: wood, mat: 'wood' }).at(0, CY, 0)];
      // planks: horizontal on the sides, cross braces
      for (const f of [[0, 1], [0, -1], [1, 0], [-1, 0]]) {
        for (let k = -1; k <= 1; k += 2) {
          const p = kit.box(2 * S - 0.06, 0.06, 0.04, { bevel: 0, color: woodD });
          if (f[1]) p.at(0, CY + k * 0.22, f[1] * (S + 0.01)); else p.rot(0, HP, 0).at(f[0] * (S + 0.01), CY + k * 0.22, 0);
          cr.push(p);
        }
        if (f[1] === 1 || f[0]) {
          const d = kit.box(2 * S * 1.25, 0.12, 0.05, { bevel: 0.01, seg: 1, color: woodL, mat: 'wood' });
          if (f[1]) d.rot(0, 0, 0.78).at(0, CY, S + 0.02); else d.rot(0.78 * f[0], HP, 0).at(f[0] * (S + 0.02), CY, 0);
          cr.push(d);
        }
      }
      // black iron corner brackets with spikes + gold bolts
      for (let c = 0; c < 8; c++) {
        const sx = c & 1 ? 1 : -1, sy = c & 2 ? 1 : -1, sz = c & 4 ? 1 : -1;
        cr.push(kit.box(0.24, 0.24, 0.24, { bevel: 0.04, seg: 1, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(sx * (S - 0.1), CY + sy * (S - 0.1), sz * (S - 0.1)));
        if (sy > 0) cr.push(spike(kit, 0.3, 0.06, { gold: true }).rot(0.4 * sz, 0, -0.4 * sx).at(sx * (S - 0.08), CY + S + 0.01, sz * (S - 0.08)));
        else cr.push(spike(kit, 0.16, 0.045).rot(0, 0, -sx * (HP + 0.4)).at(sx * (S + 0.02), CY - S + 0.12, sz * (S - 0.1)));
        cr.push(kit.sphere(0.03, { seg: 5, hseg: 3, color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(sx * (S - 0.06), CY + sy * (S - 0.06), sz * (S + 0.03)));
      }
      // front hatch: black window with iron bars
      cr.push(kit.box(0.84, 0.66, 0.04, { bevel: 0, color: 0x0a0705 }).at(0, CY + 0.02, -S - 0.005));
      cr.push(kit.box(0.96, 0.08, 0.1, { bevel: 0.02, seg: 1, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(0, CY + 0.37, -S - 0.05), kit.box(0.96, 0.08, 0.1, { bevel: 0.02, seg: 1, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(0, CY - 0.33, -S - 0.05));
      for (let k = -2; k <= 2; k++) if (k !== 0) cr.push(kit.cylinder(0.03, 0.03, 0.66, { seg: 6, color: 'gunmetal', mat: 'metal' }).at(k * 0.17, CY + 0.02, -S - 0.08));
      // padlock + heavy chains crossing the crate
      cr.push(kit.box(0.18, 0.16, 0.08, { bevel: 0.03, seg: 1, color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0.0, CY - 0.5, -S - 0.06));
      cr.push(kit.torus(0.06, 0.018, { seg: [3, 8], arc: Math.PI, color: 'scarSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(0.0, CY - 0.42, -S - 0.06));
      for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        const z = -S + 0.08 + i * 0.13;
        cr.push(kit.torus(0.05, 0.016, { seg: [3, 6], color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal', scale: [0.8, 1.25, 1] }).rot(HP, i % 2 ? HP : 0, 0).at(S + 0.03, CY + 0.5, z));
        cr.push(kit.torus(0.05, 0.016, { seg: [3, 6], color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal', scale: [0.8, 1.25, 1] }).rot(HP, i % 2 ? HP : 0, 0).at(-S - 0.03, CY - 0.1, z));
      }
      // team stripes on the sides with a gold edge, straw sticking out of the top
      cr.push(kit.box(0.04, 0.3, 2 * S + 0.02, { bevel: 0, color: 'team', mat: TM }).at(-S - 0.02, CY - 0.36, 0));
      cr.push(kit.box(0.04, 0.3, 2 * S + 0.02, { bevel: 0, color: 'team', mat: TM }).at(S + 0.02, CY - 0.36, 0));
      cr.push(kit.box(2 * S + 0.02, 0.3, 0.04, { bevel: 0, color: 'team', mat: TM }).at(0, CY - 0.36, S + 0.02));
      for (const k of [-1, 1]) cr.push(kit.box(0.045, 0.03, 2 * S + 0.03, { bevel: 0, micro: false, color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(k * (S + 0.022), CY - 0.2, 0));
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { const x = (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.9, z = (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.9, a = rnd() * TAU; cr.push(strawSpike(kit, [x, CY + S - 0.02, z], [Math.sin(a) * 0.5, 0.86, Math.cos(a) * 0.5], 0.26, 0.04, i % 2 ? kit.darken(COL.straw, 0.3) : COL.strawDark)); }
      // lid: iron cross straps, team seal with a gold rim, gold fist sigil
      cr.push(kit.box(2 * S + 0.04, 0.04, 0.09, { bevel: 0, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).rot(0, Math.PI / 4, 0).at(0, CY + S + 0.02, 0));
      cr.push(kit.box(2 * S + 0.04, 0.04, 0.09, { bevel: 0, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).rot(0, -Math.PI / 4, 0).at(0, CY + S + 0.02, 0));
      cr.push(kit.cylinder(0.3, 0.3, 0.03, { seg: 14, color: 'team', mat: TM }).at(0, CY + S + 0.035, 0));
      cr.push(kit.ring(0.3, 0.03, { seg: [3, 14], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, CY + S + 0.05, 0));
      cr.push(kit.star(8, 0.2, 0.08, 0.02, { color: 'teamLight', mat: 'cloth' }).rot(-HP, 0, 0).at(0, CY + S + 0.055, 0));
      rig.add('crate', cr);
      // narrow furious eyes in the dark (blink via 'eyes')
      rig.add('eyes',
        slitEye(kit, 0.065, { side: -1, color: acc, core: 0xffffff, tilt: 0.5, open: 0.42 }).at(-0.14, CY + 0.08, -S - 0.04),
        slitEye(kit, 0.065, { side: 1, color: acc, core: 0xffffff, tilt: 0.5, open: 0.42 }).at(0.14, CY + 0.08, -S - 0.04),
        fierceBrow(kit, 0.15, { side: -1, color: 0x3a2a12, glow: 0.3, depth: 0.02 }).rot(0, 0, -0.18).at(-0.13, CY + 0.17, -S - 0.045),
        fierceBrow(kit, 0.15, { side: 1, color: 0x3a2a12, glow: 0.3, depth: 0.02 }).rot(0, 0, 0.18).at(0.13, CY + 0.17, -S - 0.045));
      // clawed black steel gauntlet with a team cuff, punches out between the bars
      rig.add('weapon',
        gauntletFist(kit, 0.95).at(0.0, CY - 0.12, -S + 0.1),
        kit.cylinder(0.13, 0.14, 0.14, { seg: 10, color: 'team', mat: TM }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(0.0, CY - 0.12, -S + 0.3),
        kit.ring(0.14, 0.02, { seg: [3, 10], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(0.0, CY - 0.12, -S + 0.23),
        spike(kit, 0.1, 0.025).rot(0, 0, HP).at(-0.14, CY - 0.12, -S + 0.3), spike(kit, 0.1, 0.025).rot(0, 0, -HP).at(0.14, CY - 0.12, -S + 0.3));
      return rig;
    },
  });

  // =====================================================================================
  // PROJECTILES (centred on the origin, flying towards -Z; the renderer bakes them into
  // instanced meshes, so everything readable is in the geometry itself)
  // =====================================================================================
  function arrowParts(kit, o) {
    o = o || {};
    const L = o.len || 0.9, k = L / 0.9, z0 = 0.45 * k;

  /** Wooden barrel lying along X (rolls around X), radius ~0.42, length ~0.94. */

    const prof = [[0.33, -0.47], [0.39, -0.32], [0.42, -0.12], [0.425, 0], [0.42, 0.12], [0.39, 0.32], [0.33, 0.47]];

    for (const x of [-0.14, 0.14]) parts.push(kit.torus(0.423, 0.024, { seg: [5, 20], color: o.band || 'team', mat: TM }).rot(0, HP, 0).at(x, 0, 0));

  // Giant snowball "Curling-Stein": frosted granite curling stone with a team handle.
  /** v11 rv: packed giant snowball (radius r, centred): lumpy snow with a cool blue underside,
   *  jagged ice chunks frozen in, a few frost crust lumps. */
  function snowballParts(kit, r, seed) {
    const rnd = kit.rand(seed || 3), sn = kit.col(0xa8c4e6), sh = kit.col(0x2a4470), sd = kit.col(0x7896bc);
    const parts = [pebble(kit, r, { seed: seed || 3, planes: 16, cut: 0.86, soft: 0.04, bottom: false, seg: 14, color: sn, mat: 'matte' })
      .paint((x, y, z) => {
        const n = Math.sin(x * 23 / r + z * 9 / r) * Math.sin(y * 19 / r - x * 7 / r);
        return kit.mix(kit.mix(sn, sd, n > 0.35 ? 0.55 : 0), sh, smooth01((-y + r * 0.1) / (r * 1.1)) * 0.8);
      })];
    // jagged ice shards frozen into the ball and jutting out of it (blue, sharp, faceted)
    for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
      const an = i / 9 * TAU + (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.4, zf = (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.7, d0 = [Math.cos(an), Math.sin(an) * 0.9, zf], dl = Math.hypot(d0[0], d0[1], d0[2]), d = [d0[0] / dl, d0[1] / dl, d0[2] / dl];
      const L = r * (0.36 + rnd() * 0.4), yaw = Math.atan2(d[0], d[2]), pit = Math.acos(clamp(d[1], -1, 1));
      parts.push(kit.cone(r * (0.1 + rnd() * 0.06), L, { seg: 4, color: i % 3 ? 'iceDeep' : 0x2a5a8e, mat: 'ice', glow: 0.1, flat: true }).at(0, L * 0.5, 0).bake().rot(pit, yaw, 0).at(d[0] * r * 0.86, d[1] * r * 0.86, d[2] * r * 0.86));
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      const an = rnd() * TAU, u = rnd() * 1.4 - 0.7, q = Math.sqrt(1 - u * u);
      parts.push(kit.gem(r * (0.1 + rnd() * 0.08), { color: 'ice', mat: 'ice', stretch: 1.6 + rnd(), glow: 0.15 }).rot(rnd() * 3, rnd() * 3, rnd() * 3).at(Math.cos(an) * q * r * 0.95, u * r * 0.95, Math.sin(an) * q * r * 0.95));
    }
    return parts;
  }
  defProjectile('snowball', 0.5, (kit) => { const rig = kit.rig(); rig.add('root', snowballParts(kit, 0.24, 5)); return rig; });

  // Mortar shell: small carved pumpkin with a glowing face (faces -Z, flies -Z).
  defProjectile('pumpkin', 0.5, (kit) => {

    parts.push(fierceEye(kit, 0.045, { side: -1, color: COL.flame, lid: false, depth: 0.02 }).at(-0.06, 0.03, -0.19));
    parts.push(fierceEye(kit, 0.045, { side: 1, color: COL.flame, lid: false, depth: 0.02 }).at(0.06, 0.03, -0.19));
    parts.push(kit.extrude([[-0.09, 0.01], [0.09, 0.01], [0.05, -0.05], [-0.05, -0.05]], 0.02, { color: COL.flame, glow: 1, smooth: false }).at(0, -0.05, -0.19));
    rig.add('root', parts);
    return rig;
  });

  // Royal Delivery crate (falls from the sky): gold-cornered crate, team ribbons, crown seal.
  function royalCrate(kit, s) {
    const parts = [kit.box(1.0 * s, 0.86 * s, 1.0 * s, { bevel: 0.06 * s, seg: 1, color: 0x5a3a22, mat: 'wood' })];
    for (let k = -1; k <= 1; k += 2) {
      parts.push(kit.box(1.02 * s, 0.1 * s, 1.02 * s, { bevel: 0.03 * s, seg: 1, color: COL.iron, mat: 'metal' }).at(0, k * 0.2 * s, 0));
    }
    for (let c = 0; c < 8; c++) {
      const sx = c & 1 ? 1 : -1, sy = c & 2 ? 1 : -1, sz = c & 4 ? 1 : -1;
      parts.push(kit.box(0.18 * s, 0.18 * s, 0.18 * s, { bevel: 0.05 * s, seg: 1, color: 'gold', mat: 'gold' }).at(sx * 0.44 * s, sy * 0.37 * s, sz * 0.44 * s));
    }
    parts.push(kit.box(0.22 * s, 0.9 * s, 1.04 * s, { bevel: 0.025 * s, seg: 1, color: 'team', mat: 'cloth' }), kit.box(1.04 * s, 0.9 * s, 0.22 * s, { bevel: 0.025 * s, seg: 1, color: 'team', mat: 'cloth' }));
    parts.push(kit.box(0.26 * s, 0.03 * s, 1.05 * s, { bevel: 0, color: 'gold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 0.44 * s, 0), kit.box(1.05 * s, 0.03 * s, 0.26 * s, { bevel: 0, color: 'gold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 0.44 * s, 0));
    const cw = 0.3 * s, ch = 0.2 * s;
    parts.push(kit.extrude([[-cw / 2, 0], [cw / 2, 0], [cw / 2, ch], [cw * 0.25, ch * 0.55], [0, ch * 1.05], [-cw * 0.25, ch * 0.55], [-cw / 2, ch]], 0.06 * s, { color: 'gold', smooth: false }).rot(-HP, 0, 0).at(0, 0.47 * s, 0.1 * s));
    parts.push(kit.gem(0.05 * s, { color: 'teamLight' }).at(0, 0.53 * s, 0));
    return parts;
  }
  defProjectile('royal-delivery-box', 0.9, (kit) => { const rig = kit.rig(); rig.add('root', royalCrate(kit, 1)); return rig; });

  // =====================================================================================
  // SPELL HEROES (one model per spell card = its card art; also usable as a 3D prop)
  // Compositions face -Z (the portrait camera), roughly 1.4 - 2.2 tiles tall.
  // =====================================================================================
  // v3: every hero sits in front of a manga impact burst (jagged star with a bold dark rim,
  // element colour, bright core, radial speed streaks), so the card art pops like an anime
  // action frame. [colour, rim, y (share of height), r (share of height), z, spikes]
  // [core colour, rim colour, centre y (x height), radius (x height), z, points, style]
  // v11 rv: the backdrop differs per spell instead of one spiked sun disc behind every card:
  // 'sigil' obsidian war sigil, 'rune' thin rune circle with glowing glyphs, 'rays' radiating
  // glowing shards only, 'none' (the composition carries the card on its own)
  const HERO_BURST = {
    'fireball-hero': [0xffd23f, 0xd8341c, 0.5, 0.44, 0.75, 14, 'sigil'], arrows: [0xfff1b0, 0xc4891a, 0.55, 0.42, 0.6, 12, 'rays'],
    zap: [0x9ff4ff, 0x2fb5ff, 0.5, 0.42, 0.45, 16, 'rays'], 'the-log': [0xffe0a0, 0x9a6236, 0.48, 0.62, 0.75, 12, 'none'],
    'rocket-hero': [0xffd9a0, 0xd8341c, 0.5, 0.4, 0.5, 14, 'rays'], poison: [0xd4ff8a, 0x4e8a28, 0.5, 0.42, 0.55, 12, 'rune'],
    freeze: [0xe8fbff, 0x3a8fc9, 0.5, 0.42, 0.55, 16, 'rune'], rage: [0xf0b0ff, 0x7b45c9, 0.5, 0.42, 0.5, 14, 'sigil'],
    lightning: [0xfff27a, 0x43308a, 0.48, 0.4, 0.55, 16, 'none'], 'goblin-barrel': [0xd6f59a, 0x4e8a28, 0.5, 0.44, 0.6, 12, 'none'],
    tornado: [0xdff3ff, 0x5f8fb0, 0.5, 0.42, 0.7, 14, 'none'], earthquake: [0xffcf8a, 0x6e3226, 0.45, 0.46, 0.6, 12, 'rays'],
    'giant-snowball': [0xffffff, 0x6fc6ea, 0.45, 0.55, 0.65, 14, 'none'], 'barbarian-barrel': [0xffe38a, 0x9a6236, 0.48, 0.5, 0.65, 12, 'none'],
    graveyard: [0xc9fff0, 0x43308a, 0.5, 0.42, 0.75, 12, 'none'], 'royal-delivery': ['teamLight', 'teamDark', 0.55, 0.38, 0.5, 14, 'rays'],
    mirror: [0xfff6c8, 0xc4891a, 0.5, 0.4, 0.4, 16, 'rune'], clone: [0xbff6ff, 0x2fb5ff, 0.5, 0.45, 0.5, 14, 'rune'],
  };
  /** v11 rv: thin rune circle (two old-gold rings, glowing angular glyphs in the element colour,
   *  four small black steel points) facing -Z, radius r. */
  function runeCircle(kit, r, o) {
    const rnd = kit.rand(o.seed || 9), c = kit.lighten(o.color, 0.1), n = o.n || 14, parts = [
      kit.ring(r, r * 0.018, { seg: [3, 32], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).rot(HP, 0, 0),
      kit.ring(r * 0.78, r * 0.012, { seg: [3, 28], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).rot(HP, 0, 0),
      kit.ring(r * 0.89, r * 0.006, { seg: [3, 28], color: c, glow: 0.6 }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(0, 0, -0.006),
    ];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const an = (i + 0.5) / n * TAU, w = r * 0.035, hh = r * (0.06 + rnd() * 0.03), k = (rnd() * 3) | 0;
      const g = k === 0 ? [[-w, -hh], [w, -hh * 0.2], [-w * 0.2, hh], [-w * 0.6, hh * 0.1]] : k === 1 ? [[-w, -hh], [w * 0.3, -hh], [w, hh], [-w * 0.3, hh * 0.3]] : [[0, -hh], [w, 0], [0, hh], [-w * 0.4, 0]];
      parts.push(kit.extrude(g, 0.01, { color: c, glow: 0.85, bevel: 0, smooth: false }).rot(0, 0, -an).at(Math.sin(an) * r * 0.89, Math.cos(an) * r * 0.89, -0.01));
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      const an = i * HP;
      parts.push(kit.cone(r * 0.04, r * 0.2, { seg: 4, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).rot(0, 0, -an).at(Math.sin(an) * r * 1.08, Math.cos(an) * r * 1.08, 0));
    }
    return kit.merge(parts);
  }
  /** v11 rv: radiating glowing shards only (no disc), facing -Z, radius r. */
  function rayBurst(kit, r, o) {
    const rnd = kit.rand(o.seed || 5), n = o.n || 12, parts = [], c = kit.lighten(o.color, 0.15);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const an = (i + 0.5) / n * TAU + (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.35, r0 = r * (0.45 + 0.15 * rnd()), r1 = r * (0.95 + 0.4 * rnd());
      const cs = Math.cos(an), sn = Math.sin(an), w = r * (0.02 + 0.02 * rnd());
      parts.push(kit.extrude([[sn * r0, cs * r0], [sn * (r0 + r1) * 0.5 + cs * w, cs * (r0 + r1) * 0.5 - sn * w], [sn * r1, cs * r1], [sn * (r0 + r1) * 0.5 - cs * w, cs * (r0 + r1) * 0.5 + sn * w]], 0.012,
        { color: i % 3 ? c : 0xffffff, glow: i % 3 ? 0.7 : 0.9, smooth: false, bevel: 0 }));
    }
    return kit.merge(parts);
  }
  function burst(kit, r, o) {
    o = o || {};
    // v10 grimdark: an obsidian war sigil instead of the glossy manga badge - sharp blackened
    // spikes with an old-gold edge, a smouldering element-coloured core and thin glowing shards
    const n = o.n || 12, rnd = kit.rand(o.seed || 7), d = 0.03;
    const pts = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n * 2; i++) {
      const an = i / (n * 2) * TAU + 0.13;
      const rr = i % 2 ? r * 0.5 * (0.94 + 0.1 * rnd()) : r * (0.84 + 0.3 * rnd());
      pts.push([Math.sin(an) * rr, Math.cos(an) * rr]);
    }
    const sc = (k) => pts.map(q => [q[0] * k, q[1] * k]);
    const ember = kit.mix(o.color, 0x8c0f16, 0.35);
    const parts = [
      kit.extrude(pts, d, { color: 'gold', mat: 'gold', bevel: 0.008, smooth: false }),
      kit.extrude(sc(0.93), d, { color: 0x16131a, mat: 'metal', rough: 0.45, bevel: 0.01, smooth: false }).at(0, 0, -d * 0.8),
      kit.ring(r * 0.58, r * 0.022, { seg: [3, 28], color: 'gold', mat: 'gold' }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(0, 0, -d * 1.7),
      kit.disc(r * 0.52, { seg: 24, color: ember, glow: 0.38 }).at(0, 0, -d * 1.9),
      kit.disc(r * 0.24, { seg: 20, color: kit.lighten(o.color, 0.2), glow: 0.7 }).at(0, 0, -d * 2.1),
    ];
    for (let i = 0; i < Math.round(n * 0.6); i++) {
      const an = (i + 0.5) / Math.round(n * 0.6) * TAU + 0.13 + (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.3, r0 = r * (0.6 + 0.1 * rnd()), r1 = r * (0.95 + 0.22 * rnd());
      const c = Math.cos(an), sn = Math.sin(an), w = r * 0.022;
      parts.push(kit.extrude([[sn * r0, c * r0], [sn * r1 + c * w, c * r1 - sn * w], [sn * (r1 + w * 2), c * (r1 + w * 2)], [sn * r1 - c * w, c * r1 + sn * w]], 0.012, { color: kit.lighten(o.color, 0.2), glow: 0.7, smooth: false, bevel: 0 }).at(0, 0, -d * 2.0));
    }
    return kit.merge(parts);
  }
  function defHero(id, height, build, portrait, custom) {
    const B = HERO_BURST[id];
    defineModel(id, {
      height, ao: 0, prop: 'spell',
      anim: {
        body: 'static', attack: 'none', weight: 0.5,
        custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
          if (rig.burstFx) { rig.burstFx.rotation.z += 0.05 * Math.sin(a.rt * 0.7); const k = 1 + 0.03 * Math.sin(a.rt * 3.3); rig.burstFx.scale.set(k, k, 1); }
          if (custom) custom(rig, st, t, dt, a);
        },
      },
      portrait: Object.assign({ yaw: -0.35, pitch: 0.22, zoom: 1.0, pose: 'idle' }, portrait || {}),
      build(kit, ctx) {
        const rig = build(kit, ctx);
        if (B && rig && B[6] !== 'none') {
          const y = height * B[2];
          rig.pivot('burstFx', 'root', [0, y, B[4]]);
          const bo = { color: B[0], rim: B[1], n: B[5], seed: id.length * 3 }, st = B[6] || 'sigil';
          rig.add('burstFx', (st === 'rune' ? runeCircle(kit, height * B[3], bo) : st === 'rays' ? rayBurst(kit, height * B[3], bo) : burst(kit, height * B[3], bo)).at(0, y, B[4]));
        }
        return rig;
      },
    });
  }
  /** Group helper: merge parts and give the group one rotation / offset. */
  function grp(kit, parts, rot, at) {
    const m = kit.merge(parts);
    if (rot) m.rot(rot[0], rot[1], rot[2]);
    if (at) m.at(at[0], at[1], at[2]);
    return m;
  }
  function sparkle(kit, x, y, z, s, c) {
    return kit.merge([kit.star(4, 0.09 * s, 0.025 * s, 0.02 * s, { color: c || 0xffffff, glow: 1 }), kit.star(4, 0.05 * s, 0.015 * s, 0.02 * s, { color: c || 0xffffff, glow: 1 }).rot(0, 0, Math.PI / 4)]).at(x, y, z);
  }
  function spinSparkles(rig, st, t, dt, a) {
    if (rig.spinFx) rig.spinFx.rotation.y += a.rt * 0.6;
    if (rig.coreFx) { const k = 1 + 0.06 * Math.sin(a.rt * 5 + a.seed * 3); rig.coreFx.scale.set(k, k, k); }
  }

  // ---- fireball "Flammenkugel" (v11): a horned, charred demon skull wreathed in a roaring
  // fireball, glowing cracks and eyes, flame licks streaming up and back
  defHero('fireball-hero', 1.9, (kit) => {
    const rig = kit.rig();
    rig.pivot('coreFx', 'root', [0, 0.95, 0]);
    const licks = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      const a = i / 10 * TAU + 0.2, r0 = 0.34, len = 0.85 + (i % 3) * 0.32, pts = [];
      for (let k = 0; k <= 5; k++) {
        const u = k / 5, rr = r0 + 0.12 * Math.sin(u * Math.PI) + u * 0.08, w = 0.28 * Math.sin(u * 3.2 + i);
        pts.push([Math.cos(a + w) * rr, Math.sin(a + w) * rr, 0.1 + u * len]);
      }
      licks.push(kit.tube(pts, (u) => 0.19 * (1 - u) + 0.012, { color: i % 3 === 0 ? 'fireDeep' : i % 3 === 1 ? 'fire' : 'fireLight', glow: 0.95, radial: 6, seg: 12 }));
    }
    const ball = [
      grp(kit, licks, [-0.95, 0, 0]),
      kit.sphere(0.5, { seg: 16, hseg: 12, color: 'fire', glow: 0.95 }).paint((x, y, z) => z > 0.22 ? 'fireDeep' : (y > 0.25 ? 'fireLight' : null)).at(0, 0.02, 0.12),
      kit.sphere(0.34, { seg: 12, hseg: 9, color: 0xfff0b0, glow: 1 }).at(0, 0.04, -0.08),
      // charred horned skull bursting out of the front
      skull(kit, 0.3, { color: 0x3a2a22, eye: 0xfff0a0, dark: 0x1a0604, hornColor: 0x1b1416, hornLen: 1.8 }).rot(0.12, 0, 0).at(0, 0.02, -0.36),
    ];
    // glowing cracks over the charred bone
    for (const q of [[[-0.12, 0.3, -0.58], [-0.05, 0.2, -0.64], [-0.08, 0.1, -0.65]], [[0.16, 0.28, -0.56], [0.1, 0.18, -0.63]], [[0.02, 0.33, -0.55], [0.04, 0.24, -0.62]]])
      ball.push(kit.tube(q, 0.012, { color: 0xffb02e, glow: 1, radial: 3, seg: 3, caps: false }));
    rig.add('coreFx', grp(kit, ball, [0, 0.22, 0.22], [0, 0.95, 0]));
    const em = [], rnd = kit.rand(5);
    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) em.push(kit.cone(0.025 + rnd() * 0.03, 0.08 + rnd() * 0.08, { seg: 4, color: rnd() < 0.5 ? 'fireLight' : 'ember', glow: 1 }).rot(rnd() * 3, rnd() * 3, rnd() * 3).at((rnd() - 0.3) * 1.6, 0.35 + rnd() * 1.7, (rnd() - 0.2) * 0.6));
    rig.add('root', em);
    return rig;
  }, { yaw: 0.1, pitch: 0.12, zoom: 1.05 }, spinSparkles);
  G.definePortrait('fireball', { model: 'fireball-hero' });

  // ---- arrows "Pfeilregen" (v11): a volley of black barbed war arrows diving down in a fan,
  // crimson streaks behind them
  defHero('arrows', 1.8, (kit) => {
    const rig = kit.rig();
    const list = [[0, 1.0, 0, 0], [-0.42, 1.25, 0.25, 0.12], [0.42, 1.2, 0.2, -0.12], [-0.22, 0.65, -0.3, 0.06], [0.25, 0.7, -0.28, -0.08], [0.0, 1.45, 0.5, 0], [-0.62, 0.85, 0.1, 0.16], [0.6, 0.9, 0.05, -0.16]];
    const parts = [];
    for (const q of list) parts.push(grp(kit, arrowParts(kit, { len: 1.25 }), [-1.05, 0, q[3]], [q[0], q[1], q[2]]));
    for (const q of list) parts.push(kit.cone(0.035, 0.75, { seg: 4, color: 0xff5a3a, glow: 0.7 }).rot(0.52, 0, q[3]).at(q[0] - q[3] * 0.3, q[1] + 0.64, q[2] + 0.37));
    rig.add('root', parts);
    return rig;
  }, { yaw: -0.5, pitch: 0.15 });

  // ---- zap "Kurzschluss" (v11): a clawed black-steel storm gauntlet grips a jagged lightning
  // bolt like a dagger and drives it down into a crackling impact
  defHero('zap', 1.9, (kit) => {
    const rig = kit.rig();
    const yel = castCol('zap', 'accent', '#fff36b'), blue = grimHex(kit, castCol('zap', 'color', '#2f62d6'), 0.3);
    rig.pivot('coreFx', 'root', [0, 0.25, 0]);
    rig.pivot('spinFx', 'root', [0, 0.25, 0]);
    rig.add('root',
      boltShape(kit, 1.45, 0.62, { color: yel, depth: 0.12, glow: 0.7, bevel: 0.025 }).rot(0, 0, 0.1).at(-0.02, 1.62, 0),
      boltShape(kit, 1.56, 0.74, { color: blue, depth: 0.08, glow: 0.35, bevel: 0.02 }).rot(0, 0, 0.1).at(-0.04, 1.68, 0.08),
      boltShape(kit, 0.55, 0.26, { color: 'electric', depth: 0.06 }).rot(0, 0, -0.8).at(0.5, 1.2, -0.05),
      boltShape(kit, 0.48, 0.24, { color: 'electric', depth: 0.06 }).rot(0, 0, 0.95).at(-0.5, 0.95, -0.05),
      // the gauntlet: fist around the top of the bolt, plated wrist, vambrace up-right out of frame
      gauntletFist(kit, 1.5).rot(0.15, 0, 0).at(0.02, 1.76, -0.02),
      kit.rcyl(0.16, 0.15, 0.16, { seg: 12, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal', bevel: 0.03 }).rot(0, 0, -0.55).at(0.18, 1.98, 0.02),
      kit.ring(0.165, 0.022, { seg: [4, 14], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).rot(0, 0, -0.55).at(0.16, 1.95, 0.02),
      kit.tube([[0.18, 1.98, 0.02], [0.45, 2.22, 0.12], [0.75, 2.4, 0.22]], [0.15, 0.18], { color: 'gunmetal', mat: 'metal', radial: 9, seg: 5 }),
      kit.ring(0.175, 0.02, { seg: [4, 14], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).rot(0, 0, -0.85).at(0.46, 2.22, 0.12),
      kit.tube([[0.3, 2.06, -0.12], [0.55, 2.28, -0.05]], 0.055, { color: 'team', mat: 'cloth', radial: 5, seg: 2 }),
      spike(kit, 0.24, 0.045, { color: 'blackSteel' }).rot(-0.6, 0, -1.0).at(0.4, 2.2, -0.08),
      spike(kit, 0.2, 0.04, { color: 'blackSteel' }).rot(-0.4, 0, -0.75).at(0.6, 2.32, -0.02));
    rig.add('coreFx',
      kit.star(8, 0.55, 0.2, 0.06, { color: 0xffffff, glow: 1 }).at(0, 0.25, -0.05),
      kit.star(8, 0.72, 0.28, 0.04, { color: yel, glow: 1 }).rot(0, 0, 0.2).at(0, 0.25, 0.0),
      kit.ring(0.62, 0.035, { seg: [3, 20], color: 'electric', glow: 1 }).at(0, 0.05, 0));
    rig.add('spinFx', sparkle(kit, 0.75, 0.6, 0, 1.3, 'electric'), sparkle(kit, -0.7, 0.45, 0.1, 1.0, yel), sparkle(kit, -0.4, 1.6, 0.1, 0.9, 'electric'));
    return rig;
  }, { yaw: 0, pitch: 0.05 }, spinSparkles);

  // ---- the-log "Holzwalze" (v11): a black-barked battering log bristling with iron spikes on
  // team-painted iron bands, capped with spiked iron end plates, rolling at the viewer
  defHero('the-log', 1.2, (kit) => {
    const rig = kit.rig();
    const bark = grimHex(kit, castCol('the-log', 'color', '#8b5a2b'), 0.5), inner = grimHex(kit, castCol('the-log', 'accent', '#e8c590'), 0.45);
    const R = 0.5, L = 2.1;
    const p = [kit.rcyl(R, R, L, { seg: 22, color: bark, mat: 'wood', bevel: 0.05 }).rot(0, 0, HP)];
    for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
      const a = (i + 0.5) / 14 * TAU;
      p.push(kit.box(L - 0.04, 0.08, 0.07, { bevel: 0, color: i % 2 ? kit.darken(bark, 0.35) : kit.lighten(bark, 0.06) }).rot(a, 0, 0).at(0, Math.cos(a) * (R - 0.005), Math.sin(a) * (R - 0.005)));
    }
    for (const sx of [-1, 1]) {
      // spiked iron end cap with a gold rim and a centre spike
      p.push(kit.disc(R - 0.02, { seg: 16, color: inner }).rot(0, -sx * HP, 0).at(sx * (L / 2 + 0.005), 0, 0));
      for (const rr of [0.3, 0.16]) p.push(kit.torus(rr, 0.02, { seg: [3, 12], color: kit.darken(inner, 0.3) }).rot(0, HP, 0).at(sx * (L / 2 + 0.008), 0, 0));
      p.push(kit.torus(R, 0.06, { seg: [4, 16], color: COL.iron, mat: 'metal' }).rot(0, HP, 0).at(sx * (L / 2 - 0.02), 0, 0));
      p.push(kit.torus(R + 0.02, 0.022, { seg: [3, 16], color: 'gold', mat: 'gold' }).rot(0, HP, 0).at(sx * (L / 2 - 0.08), 0, 0));
      p.push(spike(kit, 0.26, 0.07, { gold: true }).rot(0, 0, -sx * HP).at(sx * (L / 2 + 0.01), 0, 0));
      // team-painted iron band with a ring of spikes
      p.push(kit.cylinder(R + 0.025, R + 0.025, 0.16, { seg: 16, open: true, color: 'team', mat: TM }).rot(0, 0, HP).at(sx * 0.6, 0, 0));
      p.push(kit.cylinder(R + 0.035, R + 0.035, 0.035, { seg: 16, open: true, color: 'gold', mat: 'gold' }).rot(0, 0, HP).at(sx * 0.69, 0, 0));
      p.push(kit.cylinder(R + 0.035, R + 0.035, 0.035, { seg: 16, open: true, color: 'gold', mat: 'gold' }).rot(0, 0, HP).at(sx * 0.51, 0, 0));
      for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { const a = (i + (sx > 0 ? 0.5 : 0)) / 8 * TAU; p.push(spike(kit, 0.24, 0.05).rot(a, 0, 0).at(sx * 0.6, Math.cos(a) * (R + 0.02), Math.sin(a) * (R + 0.02))); }
    }
    // a few iron spikes driven into the bark in between
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { const a = i / 6 * TAU + 0.3, x = -0.3 + (i % 3) * 0.3; p.push(spike(kit, 0.18, 0.04).rot(a, 0, 0).at(x, Math.cos(a) * R, Math.sin(a) * R)); }
    rig.add('root', grp(kit, p, [0.0, 0.95, 0.12], [0, R + 0.1, 0]));
    const chips = [], rnd = kit.rand(9);
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) chips.push(kit.box(0.1, 0.04, 0.06, { bevel: 0, color: rnd() < 0.5 ? inner : 'woodLight' }).rot(rnd() * 3, rnd() * 3, rnd() * 3).at((rnd() - 0.5) * 2.0, 0.1 + rnd() * 0.5, 0.45 + rnd() * 0.4));
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) chips.push(pebble(kit, 0.14 + rnd() * 0.08, { seed: 90 + i, seg: 7, color: 0x4a4038 }).at((rnd() - 0.5) * 2.0, 0.12, 0.55 + rnd() * 0.3));
    rig.add('root', chips);
    return rig;
  }, { yaw: -0.1, pitch: 0.28, zoom: 1.3 });

  // ---- rocket "Mondrakete" (v11): a black-iron war rocket with a spiked crimson warhead,
  // painted fanged maw and glowing eye, gold rivet rings, team band, crimson fins
  defHero('rocket-hero', 2.2, (kit) => {
    const rig = kit.rig();
    const red = grimHex(kit, castCol('rocket', 'color', '#a8364a'), 0.3);
    const k = 1.9;
    const body = [
      kit.lathe([[0, -0.62], [0.06, -0.58], [0.12, -0.48], [0.155, -0.36], [0.165, -0.2], [0.165, 0.38], [0.13, 0.48]], { seg: 14, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }),
      kit.lathe([[0, -0.62], [0.06, -0.58], [0.12, -0.48], [0.145, -0.4]], { seg: 14, color: red, mat: 'lacquer' }).scale(1.012),
      kit.cone(0.025, 0.14, { seg: 6, color: 'scarSteel', mat: 'chrome' }).rot(Math.PI, 0, 0).at(0, -0.66, 0),
      kit.ring(0.168, 0.016, { seg: [3, 14], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, -0.36, 0),
      kit.ring(0.168, 0.016, { seg: [3, 14], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 0.36, 0),
      kit.cylinder(0.172, 0.172, 0.07, { seg: 14, color: 'team', mat: TM }).at(0, 0.24, 0),
      // fanged maw painted on both sides of the warhead + a glowing eye
      kit.cylinder(0.13, 0.13, 0.03, { seg: 6, color: COL.iron, mat: 'metal' }).at(0, 0.53, 0),
      kit.cylinder(0.12, 0.1, 0.12, { seg: 12, color: 'darkMetal', mat: 'metal' }).at(0, 0.53, 0),
    ];
    for (const sx of [-1, 1]) {
      body.push(kit.sphere(0.04, { seg: 8, color: COL.eye, glow: 1, scale: [1, 0.5, 0.4] }).rot(0, sx * HP, 0).at(sx * 0.15, -0.3, -0.04));
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) body.push(kit.cone(0.018, 0.06, { seg: 3, color: 0xd8cba8, mat: 'bone' }).rot(0, 0, i % 2 ? 0 : Math.PI).rot(0, sx * HP, 0).at(sx * 0.163, -0.15 + (i % 2) * 0.03, -0.06 + i * 0.03));
    }
    const fins = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) fins.push(kit.merge([kit.extrude([[0.12, 0.18], [0.12, 0.5], [0.4, 0.62], [0.3, 0.36]], 0.035, { color: red, smooth: false }),
      kit.tube([[0.3, 0.36], [0.4, 0.62]].map(q => [q[0], q[1], 0]), 0.014, { color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold', radial: 4, seg: 2 })]).rot(0, i / 4 * TAU + Math.PI / 4, 0));
    const flameP = [kit.cone(0.13, 0.6, { seg: 8, color: 'fire', glow: 1 }).at(0, 0.88, 0), kit.cone(0.075, 0.38, { seg: 6, color: 'fireLight', glow: 1 }).at(0, 0.78, 0)];
    rig.pivot('coreFx', 'root', [0, 1.1, 0]);
    rig.add('coreFx', grp(kit, body.concat(fins, flameP), [0.15, 0, 0.55 + Math.PI], [0, 1.1, 0]).scale(k));
    const smoke = [], rnd = kit.rand(2);
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) smoke.push(kit.sphere(0.16 + i * 0.035, { seg: 8, hseg: 6, color: i % 2 ? 0x2e2a2c : 0x221e20 }).at(0.45 + i * 0.13 + (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.1, 0.42 - i * 0.07, 0.1 + i * 0.05));
    rig.add('root', smoke);
    return rig;
  }, { yaw: 0.0, pitch: 0.12, zoom: 1.0 }, spinSparkles);
  G.definePortrait('rocket', { model: 'rocket-hero' });

  // ---- poison "Giftnebel" (v11): a black-glass flask of glowing venom caged in spiked iron,
  // a horned bone skull fused to its front, toxic fumes and a poison mist ring
  defHero('poison', 1.75, (kit) => {
    const rig = kit.rig();
    const green = castCol('poison', 'accent', '#c8ff5a'), dark = grimHex(kit, castCol('poison', 'color', '#48822b'), 0.35);
    rig.pivot('coreFx', 'root', [0, 0.72, 0]);
    rig.pivot('spinFx', 'root', [0, 0.2, 0]);
    const root = [
      kit.sphere(0.58, { seg: 20, hseg: 7, theta: [0, 1.05], color: 0x2e382c, mat: 'glass' }).at(0, 0.72, 0),
      kit.rcyl(0.16, 0.2, 0.42, { seg: 16, color: 0x2e382c, mat: 'glass', open: true }).at(0, 1.42, 0),
      kit.rcyl(0.21, 0.21, 0.07, { seg: 16, color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 1.64, 0),
      kit.rcyl(0.15, 0.17, 0.2, { seg: 12, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(0, 1.76, 0),
      spike(kit, 0.22, 0.05, { color: 'blackSteel', gold: true }).at(0, 1.86, 0),
      kit.sphere(0.13, { seg: 10, hseg: 6, color: 'team', mat: 'lacquer', scale: [1.25, 0.5, 1.25] }).at(0, 1.6, 0),
      kit.cylinder(0.04, 0.05, 0.22, { seg: 5, color: 'teamDark' }).rot(0.2, 0, 0.3).at(0.12, 1.45, -0.13),
      kit.ring(0.6, 0.03, { seg: [4, 24], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 0.72, 0),
      kit.ring(0.4, 0.03, { seg: [4, 20], color: COL.iron, mat: 'metal' }).at(0, 1.14, 0),
      spikeRing(kit, 8, 0.58, 0.72, 0.18, 0.04, { tilt: HP, off: 0.5 }),
      kit.tube([[-0.3, 1.04, -0.42], [-0.44, 0.86, -0.38], [-0.48, 0.66, -0.3]], 0.03, { color: 0xffffff, glow: 0.7, radial: 4, seg: 6 }),
    ];
    // iron cage straps over the bulb
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      const a = i / 6 * TAU + 0.26, pts = [];
      for (let k = 0; k <= 6; k++) { const th = 0.45 + k / 6 * 2.4; pts.push([Math.sin(a) * Math.sin(th) * 0.6, 0.72 + Math.cos(th) * 0.6, Math.cos(a) * Math.sin(th) * 0.6]); }
      root.push(kit.tube(pts, 0.022, { color: COL.iron, mat: 'metal', radial: 4, seg: 10, caps: false }));
    }
    rig.add('root', root);
    rig.add('coreFx',
      kit.sphere(0.56, { seg: 20, hseg: 10, theta: [1.0, Math.PI - 1.0], color: dark, glow: 0.55, mat: 'goo' }).at(0, 0.72, 0),
      kit.cylinder(Math.sin(1.0) * 0.56, Math.sin(1.0) * 0.56, 0.015, { seg: 16, color: green, glow: 0.9 }).at(0, 0.72 + Math.cos(1.0) * 0.56, 0),
      kit.sphere(0.06, { seg: 6, hseg: 4, color: green, glow: 1 }).at(0.3, 0.5, -0.46), kit.sphere(0.045, { seg: 6, hseg: 4, color: green, glow: 1 }).at(-0.32, 0.46, -0.45),
      kit.sphere(0.09, { seg: 7, hseg: 5, color: green, glow: 1 }).at(0.06, 2.1, 0), kit.sphere(0.06, { seg: 6, hseg: 4, color: green, glow: 1 }).at(-0.1, 2.26, 0.02), kit.sphere(0.045, { seg: 5, hseg: 3, color: green, glow: 1 }).at(0.06, 2.38, 0),
      skull(kit, 0.21, { eye: green, color: 'boneDark', hornColor: 'boneDark', hornLen: 1.2 }).at(0, 0.72, -0.62));
    const mist = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) { const a = i / 10 * TAU; mist.push(kit.sphere(0.22 + (i % 3) * 0.05, { seg: 8, hseg: 6, color: i % 2 ? kit.lighten(dark, 0.08) : kit.mix(dark, green, 0.3), glow: 0.35 }).at(Math.sin(a) * 0.68, 0.16 + (i % 2) * 0.06, Math.cos(a) * 0.52)); }
    rig.add('spinFx', mist);
    return rig;
  }, { yaw: -0.2, pitch: 0.2 }, spinSparkles);

  // ---- freeze "Schockfrost" (v11): a field of razor ice shards around a frost-bitten horned
  // skull locked in ice, under a jagged glowing frost sigil
  defHero('freeze', 1.9, (kit) => {
    const rig = kit.rig();
    const ice = castCol('freeze', 'accent', '#e6fbff'), deep = grimHex(kit, castCol('freeze', 'color', '#327aa9'), 0.3);
    rig.pivot('spinFx', 'root', [0, 1.35, 0]);
    const cr = [kit.rcyl(0.85, 0.95, 0.12, { seg: 26, color: 'iceDeep', mat: 'ice', bevel: 0.04 }).at(0, 0.06, 0), kit.sphere(0.8, { seg: 20, hseg: 5, theta: [0, 0.5], color: 0x9fb8c8, mat: 'matte' }).at(0, -0.46, 0)];
    const crystal = (r, h, c) => kit.merge([
      kit.lathe([[0, 0], [r * 0.8, 0], [r, h * 0.12], [r * 0.9, h * 0.7], [r * 0.12, h * 0.99], [0, h]], { seg: 5, color: c, mat: 'ice', glow: 0.18, sharp: true }).flat(),
      kit.lathe([[0, h * 0.2], [r * 0.42, h * 0.24], [r * 0.4, h * 0.66], [0, h * 0.82]], { seg: 5, color: 0xffffff, glow: 0.55, sharp: true }).rot(0, 0.3, 0),
    ]);
    const gems = [[-0.12, 0.02, 0.18, 0.24, 1.65, 0.12, 0], [-0.5, 0.05, 0.08, 0.17, 1.05, 0.48, 0.1], [0.5, 0.05, 0.05, 0.19, 1.15, -0.45, -0.1], [-0.38, 0.05, -0.34, 0.12, 0.66, 0.4, -0.35], [0.38, 0.05, -0.36, 0.12, 0.6, -0.42, -0.3], [0.16, 0.05, 0.42, 0.15, 1.25, -0.16, 0.3], [-0.72, 0.04, -0.1, 0.1, 0.55, 0.75, 0], [0.72, 0.04, -0.12, 0.1, 0.6, -0.75, 0]];
