    gems.forEach((q, i) => cr.push(crystal(q[3], q[4], i % 2 ? ice : 'ice').rot(q[6], i * 0.7, q[5]).at(q[0], q[1], q[2])));
    // the frozen skull, half sunk in a block of clear ice
    cr.push(skull(kit, 0.22, { color: 0xb9cdd6, eye: 0x8ff4ff, dark: 0x0c2230, hornColor: 0x6fa8c8, hornLen: 1.5 }).rot(-0.12, 0, 0).at(0, 0.42, -0.4));
    cr.push(kit.box(0.62, 0.5, 0.44, { bevel: 0.06, seg: 2, color: 0xcff4ff, mat: 'glass', glow: 0.1 }).rot(0.1, 0.2, 0.05).at(0.02, 0.28, -0.36));
    rig.add('root', cr);
    // jagged six-armed frost sigil (glow), slowly turning
    const fl = [kit.cylinder(0.12, 0.12, 0.04, { seg: 6, color: 0xffffff, glow: 1 }).rot(HP, 0, 0)];
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      const arm = [kit.extrude([[0, 0.06], [0.05, 0.3], [0, 0.78], [-0.05, 0.3]], 0.04, { color: ice, glow: 0.85, smooth: false }),
        kit.extrude([[0, 0], [0.035, 0.03], [0.2, 0.16], [0.02, 0.08]], 0.03, { color: ice, glow: 0.85, smooth: false }).at(0.02, 0.4, 0),
        kit.extrude([[0, 0], [-0.035, 0.03], [-0.2, 0.16], [-0.02, 0.08]], 0.03, { color: ice, glow: 0.85, smooth: false }).at(-0.02, 0.4, 0),
        kit.gem(0.05, { color: 0xffffff, glow: 1 }).at(0, 0.62, 0)];
      fl.push(grp(kit, arm, [0, 0, i / 6 * TAU]));
    }
    rig.add('spinFx', grp(kit, fl, [0, 0, 0], [0, 1.4, -0.2]), sparkle(kit, 0.7, 1.6, -0.2, 1, 0xffffff), sparkle(kit, -0.75, 0.9, -0.2, 0.8, ice));
    rig.add('root', kit.ring(0.92, 0.035, { seg: [3, 18], color: deep, glow: 0.45 }).at(0, 0.12, 0));
    return rig;
  }, { yaw: -0.15, pitch: 0.2 }, function (rig, st, t, dt, a) { rig.spinFx.rotation.y = 0.15 * Math.sin(a.rt * 0.8); });

  // ---- rage "Wutanfall" (v11): a horned berserker demon skull with burning eyes rises roaring
  // out of the boiling purple fumes of a spiked black-iron war flask
  defHero('rage', 1.9, (kit) => {
    const rig = kit.rig();
    const purple = grimHex(kit, castCol('rage', 'color', '#8b3bd6'), 0.25), pink = castCol('rage', 'accent', '#ff5f8f');
    rig.pivot('coreFx', 'root', [0, 0.5, 0]);
    rig.pivot('spinFx', 'root', [0, 1.6, 0]);
    rig.add('root',
      kit.lathe([[0.35, 0.6], [0.22, 0.92], [0.16, 1.02], [0.16, 1.14], [0.21, 1.18], [0.2, 1.24]], { seg: 20, color: 0x2a1a34, mat: 'glass' }),
      kit.rcyl(0.22, 0.22, 0.06, { seg: 14, color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 1.2, 0),
      kit.ring(0.66, 0.035, { seg: [4, 24], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 0.08, 0),
      kit.ring(0.4, 0.04, { seg: [4, 20], color: 'team', mat: TM }).at(0, 0.6, 0),
      spikeRing(kit, 7, 0.64, 0.14, 0.2, 0.045, { tilt: 1.2, color: 'blackSteel' }),
      kit.tube([[-0.36, 0.25, -0.42], [-0.26, 0.5, -0.32]], 0.025, { color: 0xffffff, glow: 0.7, radial: 4, seg: 3 }));
    rig.add('coreFx',
      kit.lathe([[0, 0.0], [0.62, 0.0], [0.64, 0.06], [0.6, 0.14], [0.35, 0.62], [0, 0.62]], { seg: 22, color: purple, glow: 0.5, mat: 'goo' }),
      // a glowing berserker rune on the flask
      kit.extrude([[0, 0.16], [0.07, 0.02], [0.03, 0.02], [0.08, -0.14], [-0.02, 0.0], [0.02, 0.0], [-0.04, 0.16]], 0.02, { color: pink, glow: 1, smooth: false }).rot(0.55, 0, 0).at(0, 0.3, -0.48));
    const steam = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) steam.push(kit.sphere(0.15 + i * 0.03, { seg: 8, hseg: 6, color: i % 2 ? kit.mix(pink, purple, 0.5) : kit.lighten(purple, 0.15), glow: 0.5 }).at(Math.sin(i * 1.7) * 0.22, 1.25 + i * 0.12, Math.cos(i * 1.7) * 0.12 + 0.08));
    steam.push(skull(kit, 0.25, { color: 0x4a3046, eye: 0xff3a5a, dark: 0x16050c, hornColor: 0x16121a, hornLen: 2.0 }).rot(0.18, 0, 0).at(0, 1.66, -0.12));
    steam.push(boltShape(kit, 0.42, 0.2, { color: pink, depth: 0.04 }).rot(0, 0, 0.6).at(0.6, 1.62, 0), boltShape(kit, 0.36, 0.18, { color: kit.lighten(purple, 0.3), depth: 0.04 }).rot(0, 0, -0.7).at(-0.6, 1.5, 0));
    rig.add('spinFx', steam);
    return rig;
  }, { yaw: -0.15, pitch: 0.18 }, function (rig, st, t, dt, a) { rig.spinFx.rotation.y = 0.18 * Math.sin(a.rt * 1.4); const k = 1 + 0.05 * Math.sin(a.rt * 6); rig.coreFx.scale.set(k, 1, k); });

  // ---- lightning "Donnerschlag" (v11): a black storm anvil with narrow burning eyes hurls
  // three jagged bolts down onto a spiked iron lightning rod
  defHero('lightning', 2.2, (kit) => {
    const rig = kit.rig();
    const navy = grimHex(kit, castCol('lightning', 'color', '#3949ab'), 0.62), yel = castCol('lightning', 'accent', '#ffe14d');
    rig.pivot('coreFx', 'root', [0, 1.0, 0]);
    const cloud = [];
    // v11 rv: a faceless, menacing storm front - a towering bruised anvil cloud with jagged
    // facets, a black underbelly and crackling veins of light inside (no face, no eyes)
    const blobs = [[0, 1.92, 0, 0.5], [-0.52, 1.8, 0.05, 0.4], [0.55, 1.82, 0.02, 0.42], [-0.25, 2.18, 0.1, 0.38], [0.28, 2.16, 0.08, 0.36], [-0.92, 1.7, 0.1, 0.28], [0.94, 1.72, 0.12, 0.3], [0, 1.66, -0.2, 0.36], [0.05, 2.42, 0.18, 0.3], [-0.62, 2.02, 0.2, 0.3], [0.66, 2.04, 0.2, 0.3]];
    const cTop = kit.lighten(navy, 0.16), cMid = navy, cLow = kit.darken(navy, 0.55);
    blobs.forEach((b, i) => cloud.push(pebble(kit, b[3], { seed: 70 + i, planes: 9, cut: 0.8, soft: 0.05, bottom: false, seg: 11, color: i % 2 ? cMid : cTop, mat: 'matte' })
      .paint((x, y) => y < -b[3] * 0.1 ? kit.mix(kit.col(i % 2 ? cMid : cTop), kit.col(cLow), smooth01((-y - b[3] * 0.1) / (b[3] * 0.7))) : null).at(b[0], b[1], b[2])));
    // anvil shelf + black underbelly with hanging mammatus lumps
    cloud.push(kit.sphere(0.5, { seg: 14, hseg: 4, theta: [0, 0.9], color: kit.lighten(navy, 0.08), mat: 'matte', scale: [2.6, 0.32, 1.3] }).at(0, 2.5, 0.12));
    cloud.push(kit.sphere(0.42, { seg: 12, hseg: 6, theta: [HP, HP], color: kit.darken(navy, 0.7), mat: 'matte', scale: [2.7, 0.42, 1.05] }).at(0, 1.64, 0.04));
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) cloud.push(kit.sphere(0.11, { seg: 7, hseg: 5, color: kit.darken(navy, 0.62), mat: 'matte', scale: [1.2, 0.9, 1] }).at(-0.7 + i * 0.35, 1.54 - (i % 2) * 0.04, -0.1 + (i % 2) * 0.12));
    // crackling veins of light inside the cloud front
    const vrnd = kit.rand(31);
    for (let v = 0; v < 4; v++) {
      let x = -0.7 + v * 0.46, y = 2.2 - (v % 2) * 0.18; const pts = [];
      for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) { pts.push([x, y, -0.5 + Math.abs(x) * 0.18]); x += (vrnd() - 0.5) * 0.26; y -= 0.08 + vrnd() * 0.07; }
      cloud.push(kit.tube(pts, [0.018, 0.006], { color: v % 2 ? 0xffffff : yel, glow: 1, radial: 3, seg: 5, caps: false }));
    }
    cloud.push(kit.sphere(0.2, { seg: 8, hseg: 5, color: kit.mix(navy, yel, 0.25), glow: 0.35, scale: [2.4, 0.35, 0.4] }).at(0, 1.64, -0.4));
    rig.add('root', cloud);
    // spiked iron lightning rod on a cracked plinth
    rig.add('root',
      pebble(kit, 0.34, { seed: 12, seg: 9, color: 0x2a2630, scale: [1.3, 0.45, 1.1] }).at(-0.1, 0.08, 0),
      kit.rcyl(0.035, 0.05, 0.6, { seg: 8, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }).at(-0.1, 0.42, 0),
      kit.ring(0.06, 0.02, { seg: [3, 10], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(-0.1, 0.5, 0),
      spike(kit, 0.22, 0.04, { color: 'scarSteel' }).at(-0.1, 0.72, 0),
      spike(kit, 0.12, 0.025, { color: 'blackSteel' }).rot(0, 0, 0.9).at(-0.13, 0.6, 0), spike(kit, 0.12, 0.025, { color: 'blackSteel' }).rot(0, 0, -0.9).at(-0.07, 0.6, 0));
    rig.add('coreFx',
      boltShape(kit, 1.0, 0.4, { color: yel, depth: 0.07, bevel: 0.018 }).at(-0.08, 1.62, -0.2),
      boltShape(kit, 1.0, 0.34, { color: yel, depth: 0.06, bevel: 0.015 }).rot(0, 0, -0.35).at(-0.6, 1.58, -0.12),
      boltShape(kit, 1.1, 0.36, { color: yel, depth: 0.06, bevel: 0.015 }).rot(0, 0, 0.3).at(0.55, 1.58, -0.12),
      kit.star(6, 0.26, 0.09, 0.04, { color: 0xffffff, glow: 1 }).at(-0.1, 0.86, -0.12),
      kit.star(6, 0.2, 0.08, 0.04, { color: 0xffffff, glow: 1 }).at(-0.98, 0.6, -0.12),
      kit.star(6, 0.2, 0.08, 0.04, { color: 0xffffff, glow: 1 }).at(0.92, 0.55, -0.12));
    return rig;
  }, { yaw: 0, pitch: 0.08 }, spinSparkles);

  // ---- goblin-barrel "Kobold-Fass" (v11): a spiked, iron-bound war barrel; under the lifted lid
  // a vicious goblin cutthroat leers out - long blade ears, hooked nose, tusks, narrow burning
  // eyes, team hood - clawed hands on the rim, a curved dagger ready
  defHero('goblin-barrel', 1.75, (kit) => {
    const rig = kit.rig();
    const skin = grimHex(kit, castCol('goblin-barrel', 'accent', '#8ed65a'), 0.42);
    const HC = [0, 1.36, -0.1], R = 0.25;
    rig.pivot('eyes', 'root', [0, HC[1], -0.3]);
    const head = goblinHead(kit, HC, R, { skin, eye: 0xffc21e, ear: 2.2 });
    rig.add('root',
      grp(kit, barrelParts(kit, { wood: 0x3e2816, hoop: COL.iron }), [0, 0, HP], [0, 0.62, 0]).scale(1.3),
      spikeRing(kit, 9, 0.55, 0.13, 0.16, 0.04, { tilt: 1.35 }),
      spikeRing(kit, 9, 0.55, 1.1, 0.16, 0.04, { tilt: 1.35, off: 0.5 }),
      // lifted, splintered lid on the back of the head
      kit.rcyl(0.46, 0.46, 0.07, { seg: 22, color: 0x3a2616, mat: 'wood' }).rot(1.1, 0, 0.7).at(0.3, 1.5, 0.42),
      kit.ring(0.46, 0.03, { seg: [4, 22], color: COL.iron, mat: 'metal' }).rot(1.1, 0, 0.7).at(0.3, 1.5, 0.42),
      // team hood over the cranium (open face), tattered edge on the shoulders
      hood(kit, 0.29, 0.6, { color: 'team', inner: 0x0a0607, gap: 2.1 }).rot(-0.15, 0, 0).at(0, 1.43, -0.04),
      tatterCloth(kit, { a0: -1.9, a1: 1.9, y0: 1.2, y1: 0.98, r0: 0.26, r1: 0.42, color: 'teamDark', tatter: 0.06, n: 6, seed: 3, cz: 0.04 }),
      // clawed hands gripping the rim
      [-1, 1].map(sx => kit.merge([
        kit.sphere(0.085, { seg: 10, color: skin, mat: 'skin', scale: [1.2, 0.7, 1.0] }).at(sx * 0.42, 1.12, -0.28),
        ...[0, 1, 2].map(f => kit.tube([[sx * (0.36 + f * 0.05), 1.14, -0.32], [sx * (0.36 + f * 0.05), 1.12, -0.4], [sx * (0.36 + f * 0.05), 1.04, -0.43]], 0.02, { color: skin, mat: 'skin', radial: 5, seg: 4 })),
        ...[0, 1, 2].map(f => kit.cone(0.014, 0.06, { seg: 4, color: 0x14100c, mat: 'bone' }).rot(Math.PI, 0, 0).at(sx * (0.36 + f * 0.05), 1.0, -0.43)),
        kit.box(0.14, 0.05, 0.12, { bevel: 0.015, seg: 1, color: 'grimLeather', mat: 'leather' }).at(sx * 0.44, 1.08, -0.22),
      ])),
      // curved dagger in the right hand, blade up past the cheek
      bladePart(kit, 0.42, 0.04, { curve: -0.06 }).rot(0, 0.3, 0.25).at(0.44, 1.16, -0.4),
      kit.box(0.16, 0.03, 0.04, { bevel: 0.01, seg: 1, color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).rot(0, 0.3, 0.25).at(0.44, 1.15, -0.4),
      head.parts);
    rig.add('eyes', head.eyes);
    return rig;
  }, { yaw: -0.3, pitch: 0.2 });

  // ---- tornado "Wirbelsturm" (v11): a black storm funnel with lightning in its throat, tearing
  // up stones, planks and bones
  defHero('tornado', 2.2, (kit) => {
    const rig = kit.rig();
    const blue = grimHex(kit, castCol('tornado', 'color', '#5378a0'), 0.55), light = grimHex(kit, castCol('tornado', 'accent', '#cfe6ff'), 0.4);
    rig.pivot('spinFx', 'root', [0, 0, 0]);
    const R = (y) => 0.12 + 0.2 * y + 0.13 * y * y, OX = (y) => 0.16 * Math.sin(y * 1.9);
    const funnel = [], prof = [];
    for (let i = 0; i <= 10; i++) { const y = 0.05 + i * 0.21; prof.push([R(y) * 0.82, y]); }
    funnel.push(kit.lathe(prof, { seg: 16, color: kit.lighten(blue, 0.12), double: kit.darken(blue, 0.4), mat: 'matte' }));
    for (let b = 0; b < 4; b++) {
      const pts = [];
      for (let i = 0; i <= 26; i++) { const u = i / 26, y = 0.12 + u * 2.0, a = b / 4 * TAU + u * TAU * 1.6; pts.push([Math.sin(a) * R(y) + OX(y), y, Math.cos(a) * R(y)]); }
      funnel.push(kit.tube(pts, (u) => 0.035 + 0.05 * u, { color: b % 2 ? 0x5a6270 : light, radial: 5, seg: 40, glow: b % 2 ? 0.15 : 0.08 }));
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { const y = 0.2 + i * 0.36; funnel.push(kit.torus(R(y) * 0.98, 0.025, { seg: [3, 16], color: kit.mix(light, blue, 0.45) }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(OX(y) * 0.5, y, 0)); }
    // lightning crackling inside the throat
    funnel.push(boltShape(kit, 0.8, 0.26, { color: 0xbff4ff, depth: 0.04 }).rot(0, 0, 0.2).at(0.05, 1.9, -0.1));
    const rnd = kit.rand(3);
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      const a = i / 10 * TAU * 2.1, y = 0.4 + (i / 10) * 1.6, r = R(y) + 0.22, x = Math.sin(a) * r, z = Math.cos(a) * r;
      if (i % 3 === 0) funnel.push(pebble(kit, 0.09, { seed: i, seg: 8, color: 0x3a3640 }).at(x, y, z));
      else if (i % 3 === 1) funnel.push(kit.box(0.26, 0.05, 0.08, { bevel: 0, color: 'woodDark' }).rot(rnd() * 3, a, rnd()).at(x, y, z));
      else funnel.push(kit.capsule(0.022, 0.16, { seg: 5, color: 'boneDark', mat: 'bone' }).rot(rnd() * 3, rnd() * 3, 0).at(x, y, z));
    }
    funnel.push(skull(kit, 0.08, { horns: false, eye: 0x9ff4ff }).rot(0.3, 0.6, 0.2).at(R(1.3) + 0.2, 1.3, -0.2));
    rig.add('spinFx', funnel);
    rig.add('root', kit.cylinder(0.55, 0.7, 0.06, { seg: 16, color: kit.lighten(blue, 0.2), mat: 'matte' }).at(0, 0.03, 0));
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { const a = i / 6 * TAU; rig.add('root', pebble(kit, 0.14, { seed: 20 + i, seg: 7, color: 0x3e3a42 }).at(Math.sin(a) * 0.6, 0.1, Math.cos(a) * 0.6)); }
    return rig;
  }, { yaw: 0, pitch: 0.18, zoom: 1.05 }, function (rig, st, t, dt, a) { rig.spinFx.rotation.y += a.rt * 2.2; });

  // ---- earthquake "Rüttelhammer" (v11): a colossal black-steel war maul with spiked faces, gold
  // trims and a burning rune smashes the ground open - molten cracks and flying rocks
  defHero('earthquake', 1.9, (kit) => {
    const rig = kit.rig();
    const brown = grimHex(kit, castCol('earthquake', 'color', '#7a5c3e'), 0.55), orange = castCol('earthquake', 'accent', '#ffb347');
    rig.pivot('coreFx', 'root', [0, 0.1, 0]);
    const slab = [], rnd = kit.rand(6);
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
      const a = i / 7 * TAU + 0.2;
      slab.push(pebble(kit, 0.42, { seed: 50 + i, seg: 10, cut: 0.62, color: i % 2 ? brown : kit.lighten(brown, 0.12), scale: [1.1, 0.4, 1.1] }).rot(0, a, (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.3).at(Math.sin(a) * 0.55, 0.08 + rnd() * 0.08, Math.cos(a) * 0.48));
    }
    rig.add('root', slab);
    rig.add('coreFx', kit.cylinder(0.75, 0.8, 0.04, { seg: 14, color: COL.lava, glow: 1 }).at(0, 0.02, 0), kit.star(7, 0.44, 0.13, 0.03, { color: COL.lavaHot, glow: 1 }).rot(HP, 0, 0).at(0, 0.2, -0.05));
    const hm = [
      kit.box(0.66, 0.5, 0.5, { bevel: 0.08, seg: 2, color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal' }),
      kit.box(0.7, 0.08, 0.54, { bevel: 0.03, seg: 2, color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 0.17, 0), kit.box(0.7, 0.08, 0.54, { bevel: 0.03, seg: 2, color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, -0.17, 0),
      kit.box(0.2, 0.54, 0.56, { bevel: 0.03, seg: 2, color: 'gunmetal', mat: 'metal' }),
      kit.extrude([[0, 0.13], [0.05, 0.02], [0.02, 0.02], [0.06, -0.12], [-0.02, -0.0], [0.01, -0.0], [-0.03, 0.13]], 0.02, { color: orange, glow: 1, smooth: false }).at(0, 0, -0.29),
      kit.rcyl(0.055, 0.065, 1.4, { seg: 10, color: 0x2a1c14, mat: 'wood' }).at(0, 0.95, 0),
      kit.rcyl(0.075, 0.075, 0.36, { seg: 10, color: 'team', mat: 'leather' }).at(0, 1.42, 0),
      kit.ring(0.08, 0.02, { seg: [3, 10], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 1.24, 0), kit.ring(0.08, 0.02, { seg: [3, 10], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 1.6, 0),
      spike(kit, 0.18, 0.05, { color: 'blackSteel', gold: true }).at(0, 1.62, 0),
    ];
    // spiked striking faces (both ends) + a spike crown on top
    for (const sx of [-1, 1]) for (const q of [[0.12, 0.12], [-0.12, 0.12], [0.12, -0.12], [-0.12, -0.12], [0, 0]]) hm.push(spike(kit, q[0] || q[1] ? 0.14 : 0.2, 0.05, { color: 'scarSteel' }).rot(0, 0, -sx * HP).at(sx * 0.33, q[0], q[1]));
    rig.add('root', grp(kit, hm, [0.35, 0.2, -0.75], [0.12, 0.5, 0]).scale(1.35));
    const chunks = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) chunks.push(pebble(kit, 0.07 + rnd() * 0.07, { seed: 70 + i, seg: 7, cut: 0.6, color: rnd() < 0.5 ? brown : 0x3a3036 }).at((rnd() - 0.5) * 1.3, 0.25 + rnd() * 0.5, (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.6 - 0.2));
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) chunks.push(kit.sphere(0.03, { seg: 5, hseg: 3, color: COL.lavaHot, glow: 1 }).at((rnd() - 0.5) * 1.1, 0.3 + rnd() * 0.6, -0.3 + rnd() * 0.2));
    rig.add('root', chunks);
    return rig;
  }, { yaw: -0.2, pitch: 0.26, zoom: 1.2 }, spinSparkles);

  // ---- giant-snowball "Curling-Stein" (v11): a black granite curling stone with an iron spike
  // rim and a team grip, smashing out of a frost spray with razor ice shards
  defHero('giant-snowball', 1.4, (kit) => {
    // v11 rv: a real giant snowball - packed lumpy snow with a blue-shadowed underside, jagged ice
    // chunks frozen into it, a frost crust, rolling over an icy team-rimmed patch, snow spray behind
    const rig = kit.rig();
    rig.add('root',
      kit.cylinder(0.8, 0.8, 0.04, { seg: 20, color: 0x4a5a68, mat: 'ice' }).at(0, 0.02, 0),
      kit.ring(0.72, 0.035, { seg: [3, 24], color: 'team', mat: TM }).at(0, 0.05, 0),
      kit.cylinder(0.6, 0.6, 0.045, { seg: 20, color: 0x8fb6cc, mat: 'ice' }).at(0, 0.03, 0),
      grp(kit, snowballParts(kit, 0.6, 11), [0.2, -0.4, 0.1], [0.0, 0.62, -0.05]));
    const rnd = kit.rand(4), snow = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) { const u = i / 10; snow.push(pebble(kit, 0.07 + u * 0.08, { seed: 90 + i, planes: 6, cut: 0.8, bottom: false, seg: 7, color: i % 2 ? 0xc4d6ea : 0x8aa6c4, mat: 'matte' }).at(0.3 + u * 0.5 + (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.2, 0.1 + u * 0.3, 0.55 + u * 0.35)); }
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) snow.push(kit.gem(0.05 + rnd() * 0.04, { color: 'ice', mat: 'ice', stretch: 2.4, glow: 0.3 }).rot(rnd() * 3, rnd() * 3, rnd() * 3).at(-0.7 + rnd() * 1.4, 0.2 + rnd() * 1.0, -0.3 + rnd() * 0.3));
    snow.push(sparkle(kit, -0.62, 0.95, -0.4, 1.0, 0xffffff), sparkle(kit, 0.7, 1.15, -0.2, 0.8, 'ice'));
    rig.add('root', snow);
    return rig;
  }, { yaw: -0.25, pitch: 0.3, zoom: 1.25 });

  // ---- barbarian-barrel "Met-Fass" (v11): an iron-bound mead barrel on its side; behind it a
  // hulking barbarian rises - horned iron helm, scowling scarred face, braided beard, fur
  // mantle, team sash - and raises a notched greatsword
  defHero('barbarian-barrel', 2.0, (kit) => {
    const rig = kit.rig();
    const wood = grimHex(kit, castCol('barbarian-barrel', 'color', '#9c6b1a'), 0.5), gold = grimHex(kit, castCol('barbarian-barrel', 'accent', '#ffd56b'), 0.3);
    const RY = 0.75, ex = -Math.cos(RY), ez = Math.sin(RY);
    const E = (d, y) => [ex * d, y, ez * d];
    rig.add('root',
      grp(kit, barrelParts(kit, { wood: kit.lighten(wood, 0.05), hoop: COL.iron, band: 'team' }), [0, RY, 0], [0, 0.48, -0.2]).scale(1.12),
      kit.cylinder(0.05, 0.05, 0.24, { seg: 6, color: 'woodDark' }).rot(0, RY, HP).at(...E(0.72, 0.32)),
      kit.sphere(0.15, { seg: 8, hseg: 6, color: gold, glow: 0.3, scale: [1, 0.5, 1] }).at(...E(0.92, 0.05)),
      kit.sphere(0.09, { seg: 7, hseg: 5, color: 0xe8dcc0 }).at(...E(0.86, 0.12)));
    // barbarian bust behind the barrel (shoulders ~0.95 wide), head radius 0.15 at y 1.3
    // v11 rv (G2/G3): sculpted scowling face, braided beard + long locks in strands, V torso with
    // shaped pecs / abs (paint), trapezius, deltoids, tapering arms with bracers and real fists
    const HY = 1.42, Rh = 0.15, bz = 0.42;
    const skin = 0x8e6650, skD = kit.mix(skin, 0x2a1008, 0.5), beard = 0x4a2612, beardL = 0x7a4422, fur = 0x3a2e24;
    const head = grimHead(kit, HY, Rh, { skin, stubble: beard, jaw: 1.2, chin: 1.1, ridge: 1.3, gaunt: 0.8, long: 0.35, iris: 0x4a6a7a, scar: 1, brow: 0x2a140a, lips: 0x6a2a24 });
    const sk = kit.col(skin);
    const torso = kit.blob(0.84, 0.74, 0.5, { round: 0.3, taper: 1.35, bottom: 0.62, bulge: 0.1, seg: 16, color: skin, mat: 'skin' }).paint((x, y, z) => {
      if (z > 0.05) return kit.mix(sk, skD, 0.3);
      const ax = Math.abs(x);
      let c = sk;
      c = kit.mix(c, skD, Math.exp(-Math.pow((y - 0.0) / 0.06, 2)) * smooth01((0.34 - ax) / 0.1) * 0.75);   // under the pecs
      c = kit.mix(c, skD, Math.exp(-Math.pow(x / 0.025, 2)) * smooth01((0.12 - y) / 0.1) * 0.5);           // linea alba
      for (const yy of [-0.14, -0.22]) c = kit.mix(c, skD, Math.exp(-Math.pow((y - yy) / 0.018, 2)) * smooth01((0.13 - ax) / 0.05) * 0.35);
      c = kit.mix(c, skD, smooth01((ax - 0.3) / 0.12) * 0.45);                                              // flanks
      return c;
    });
    const arm = (sx, pts) => kit.tube(pts, (u) => 0.072 + 0.022 * Math.exp(-Math.pow((u - 0.28) / 0.16, 2)) - 0.018 * Math.exp(-Math.pow((u - 0.52) / 0.08, 2)) + 0.012 * Math.exp(-Math.pow((u - 0.68) / 0.1, 2)) - 0.02 * u, { color: skin, mat: 'skin', radial: 10, seg: 12 });
    const fist = (c, sx, s) => kit.merge([
      kit.blob(s * 0.9, s * 0.85, s * 0.95, { color: skin, round: 0.4, seg: 10, mat: 'skin' }).at(c[0], c[1], c[2]),
      ...[0, 1, 2, 3].map(k => kit.sphere(s * 0.14, { color: kit.mix(sk, 0xb4463a, 0.15), seg: 7, mat: 'skin', scale: [0.9, 0.85, 1] }).at(c[0] + (k - 1.5) * s * 0.21, c[1] + s * 0.28, c[2] - s * 0.4)),
      kit.tube([[c[0] - sx * s * 0.42, c[1], c[2]], [c[0] - sx * s * 0.42, c[1] + s * 0.12, c[2] - s * 0.32]], [s * 0.16, s * 0.12], { color: skin, mat: 'skin', radial: 6, seg: 2, caps: 'round' })]);
    const bracer = (a2, b2, r) => kit.merge([
      kit.tube([a2, b2], (u) => r * (1 + 0.15 * u), { color: 'grimLeatherDark', mat: 'leather', radial: 9, seg: 2, caps: false }),
      kit.tube([a2, [lerp(a2[0], b2[0], 0.1), lerp(a2[1], b2[1], 0.1), lerp(a2[2], b2[2], 0.1)]], r * 1.1, { color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold', radial: 9, seg: 1, caps: false }),
      kit.tube([[lerp(a2[0], b2[0], 0.92), lerp(a2[1], b2[1], 0.92), lerp(a2[2], b2[2], 0.92)], b2], r * 1.22, { color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold', radial: 9, seg: 1, caps: false }),
      kit.tube([[lerp(a2[0], b2[0], 0.42), lerp(a2[1], b2[1], 0.42), lerp(a2[2], b2[2], 0.42)], [lerp(a2[0], b2[0], 0.58), lerp(a2[1], b2[1], 0.58), lerp(a2[2], b2[2], 0.58)]], r * 1.14, { color: 'team', mat: TM, radial: 9, seg: 1, caps: false })]);
    const bust = [
      torso.at(0, 0.8, 0.02),
      kit.blob(0.32, 0.22, 0.15, { round: 0.45, seg: 11, color: skin, mat: 'skin' }).rot(0, 0, 0.18).at(-0.15, 0.93, -0.19),
      kit.blob(0.32, 0.22, 0.15, { round: 0.45, seg: 11, color: skin, mat: 'skin' }).rot(0, 0, -0.18).at(0.15, 0.93, -0.19),
      kit.rcyl(0.1, 0.135, 0.3, { seg: 12, color: skin, mat: 'skin' }).at(0, 1.2, 0.02),
      kit.tube([[-0.07, 1.18, 0.02], [-0.22, 1.11, 0.02], [-0.36, 1.06, 0.02]], [0.075, 0.05], { color: skin, mat: 'skin', radial: 8, seg: 5 }),
      kit.tube([[0.07, 1.18, 0.02], [0.22, 1.11, 0.02], [0.36, 1.06, 0.02]], [0.075, 0.05], { color: skin, mat: 'skin', radial: 8, seg: 5 }),
      kit.sphere(0.11, { seg: 12, color: skin, mat: 'skin', scale: [1, 1.05, 1] }).at(0.4, 1.03, 0),
      // fur mantle over the shoulders + team sash across the chest
      tatterCloth(kit, { a0: -Math.PI, a1: Math.PI, y0: 1.2, y1: 0.86, r0: 0.18, r1: 0.5, bow: 0.6, tatter: 0.12, n: 11, seed: 6, folds: 6, fold: 0.1, color: fur, mat: 'fur', sz: 0.8, cz: 0.05 }),
      // layered spiked pauldron on the left shoulder: three lamellae with gold rims + rivets
      ...[0, 1, 2].map(k => kit.sphere(0.2 - k * 0.025, { seg: 12, hseg: 6, theta: [0, 1.5], color: k === 1 ? 'team' : 'gunmetal', mat: k === 1 ? TM : 'metal', scale: [1.1, 0.75, 1.0] }).rot(0, 0, 0.5 + k * 0.18).at(-0.4 - k * 0.04, 1.08 - k * 0.07, 0.0)),
      ...[0, 1, 2].map(k => kit.torus(0.19 - k * 0.025, 0.012, { seg: [3, 14], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).rot(HP, 0, 0.5 + k * 0.18).at(-0.41 - k * 0.04, 1.03 - k * 0.07, 0.0)),
      spike(kit, 0.2, 0.035).rot(0, 0, 0.8).at(-0.48, 1.18, 0.0), spike(kit, 0.15, 0.03).rot(0, 0, 1.2).at(-0.56, 1.06, 0.0),
      kit.tube([[0.36, 1.08, -0.16], [0.05, 0.86, -0.27], [-0.3, 0.62, -0.2]], 0.035, { color: 'grimLeatherDark', mat: 'leather', radial: 5, seg: 6, scale: [1, 1, 0.6] }),
      kit.tube([[-0.36, 1.08, -0.18], [-0.05, 0.86, -0.27], [0.3, 0.64, -0.22]], 0.06, { color: 'team', mat: 'cloth', radial: 6, seg: 6, scale: [1, 1, 0.6] }),
      kit.sphere(0.05, { seg: 8, color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(-0.05, 0.86, -0.3),
      ...head.parts, ...head.eyes,
    ];
    // braided beard: fine pointed locks from the jaw line sweeping into a three-strand braid with
    // gold rings; drooping moustache locks; long fine locks from under the helm
    const brnd = kit.rand(17);
    for (let row = 0; row < 2; row++) for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
      const u = (i / 8 - 0.5) * (row ? 1.2 : 1.5), r0 = head.pt(u, -0.48 - Math.abs(u) * 0.32 - row * 0.12, -0.8, -0.02 - row * 0.03);
      const tip = [u * Rh * 0.25, HY - Rh * (1.55 + row * 0.2) - brnd() * 0.02, -Rh * (0.78 - row * 0.05)];
      const mid = [lerp(r0[0], tip[0], 0.45) + u * 0.02, lerp(r0[1], tip[1], 0.55), Math.min(r0[2], tip[2]) - Rh * 0.12];
      bust.push(kit.tube([r0, mid, tip], (t) => Rh * (0.06 - 0.054 * t), { color: (i + row) % 2 ? beard : beardL, mat: 'hair', radial: 5, seg: 7, caps: 'round' }));
    }
    // beard mass under the locks (follows the jaw, tapers into the braid)
    bust.push(kit.blob(Rh * 1.3, Rh * 1.0, Rh * 0.8, { round: 0.35, taper: 1.15, bottom: 0.35, bulge: 0.08, seg: 12, color: kit.darken(beard, 0.08), mat: 'hair' }).at(0, HY - Rh * 1.08, -Rh * 0.36));
    for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
      const pts = [];
      for (let j = 0; j <= 10; j++) { const t = j / 10, ph = t * 10 + k * TAU / 3; pts.push([Math.sin(ph) * Rh * 0.08, HY - Rh * (1.55 + t * 1.25), -Rh * 0.72 + Math.cos(ph) * Rh * 0.05]); }
      bust.push(kit.tube(pts, (t) => Rh * (0.075 - 0.04 * t), { color: k === 1 ? beardL : beard, mat: 'hair', radial: 5, seg: 20, caps: 'round' }));
    }
    bust.push(kit.ring(Rh * 0.12, Rh * 0.04, { seg: [4, 12], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, HY - Rh * 1.95, -Rh * 0.72), kit.ring(Rh * 0.1, Rh * 0.035, { seg: [4, 12], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, HY - Rh * 2.55, -Rh * 0.72));
    for (const sx of [-1, 1]) for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
      const r0 = head.pt(sx * (0.04 + j * 0.05), -0.42, -0.96, -0.04), m1 = head.pt(sx * (0.26 + j * 0.03), -0.54, -0.88, -0.1), m2 = [sx * Rh * (0.34 + j * 0.03), HY - Rh * (1.0 + j * 0.1), -Rh * 0.8];
      bust.push(kit.tube([r0, m1, m2], (t) => Rh * (0.05 - 0.045 * t), { color: j % 2 ? beardL : beard, mat: 'hair', radial: 5, seg: 6, caps: 'round' }));
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < 24; i++) {
      const an = (i / 23 - 0.5) * 3.9, c = Math.sin(an), d = Math.cos(an), L = 0.24 + brnd() * 0.12;
      const r0 = [c * Rh * 0.9, HY + Rh * 0.12, d * Rh * 0.9], m = [c * Rh * 1.12, HY - Rh * 0.6, d * Rh * 1.12], t2 = [c * Rh * (1.35 + brnd() * 0.2), HY - L, d * Rh * 1.4 + 0.03];
      bust.push(kit.tube([r0, m, t2], (t) => Rh * (0.06 - 0.055 * t), { color: i % 3 ? beard : beardL, mat: 'hair', radial: 5, seg: 6, caps: 'round' }));
    }
    // horned iron helm: ridge, gold brow band with rivets, tapered nasal with gold edge
    const hc = [0, HY + Rh * 0.2, Rh * 0.02];
    bust.push(kit.sphere(Rh * 1.08, { seg: 18, theta: [0, 1.42], color: 'gunmetal', mat: 'metal', scale: [0.9, 1.0, 1.02] }).at(hc[0], hc[1], hc[2]));
    bust.push(kit.tube([[0, HY + Rh * 0.55, -Rh * 0.98], [0, HY + Rh * 1.22, -Rh * 0.2], [0, HY + Rh * 1.12, Rh * 0.6]], Rh * 0.06, { color: 'blackSteel', mat: 'metal', radial: 4, seg: 8 }));
    bust.push(kit.ring(Rh * 0.98, Rh * 0.07, { seg: [4, 20], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold', scale: [0.92, 1, 1.04] }).at(0, HY + Rh * 0.3, Rh * 0.02));
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) { const an = (i + 0.5) / 10 * TAU; bust.push(kit.sphere(Rh * 0.035, { seg: 5, hseg: 3, color: 'oldGoldLight', mat: 'gold' }).at(Math.sin(an) * Rh * 0.92, HY + Rh * 0.3, Math.cos(an) * Rh * 1.02 + Rh * 0.02)); }
    bust.push(kit.extrude([[-Rh * 0.05, 0], [Rh * 0.05, 0], [Rh * 0.022, -Rh * 0.5], [0, -Rh * 0.58], [-Rh * 0.022, -Rh * 0.5]], Rh * 0.035, { color: 'gunmetal', mat: 'metal', bevel: Rh * 0.008, smooth: false }).rot(0.2, 0, 0).at(0, HY + Rh * 0.34, -Rh * 1.1));
    bust.push(kit.tube([[-Rh * 0.05, HY + Rh * 0.33, -Rh * 1.13], [0, HY - Rh * 0.24, -Rh * 1.24], [Rh * 0.05, HY + Rh * 0.33, -Rh * 1.13]], Rh * 0.012, { color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold', radial: 3, seg: 6, caps: false }));
    bust.push(horn(kit, 0.36, 0.055, { side: -1, color: 'boneDark' }).at(-Rh * 0.82, HY + Rh * 0.42, 0));
    bust.push(horn(kit, 0.36, 0.055, { side: 1, color: 'boneDark' }).at(Rh * 0.82, HY + Rh * 0.42, 0));
    // right arm raising a notched greatsword overhead, left fist on the barrel
    bust.push(arm(1, [[0.4, 1.04, 0], [0.52, 1.14, -0.02], [0.6, 1.3, -0.04], [0.52, 1.5, -0.06]]));
    bust.push(bracer([0.59, 1.32, -0.045], [0.53, 1.49, -0.06], 0.062));
    bust.push(fist([0.5, 1.57, -0.06], 1, 0.15));
    bust.push(grp(kit, [bladePart(kit, 1.05, 0.08, { color: 0x3a3e46 }), kit.box(0.32, 0.05, 0.065, { bevel: 0.014, seg: 1, color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }), kit.rcyl(0.026, 0.026, 0.22, { seg: 6, color: 'grimLeatherDark', mat: 'leather' }).at(0, -0.11, 0)], [0.35, 0, 1.0], [0.5, 1.6, -0.06]));
    bust.push(arm(-1, [[-0.4, 1.02, 0], [-0.47, 0.9, -0.08], [-0.48, 0.78, -0.18], [-0.4, 0.66, -0.34]]));
    bust.push(bracer([-0.47, 0.78, -0.19], [-0.41, 0.67, -0.33], 0.064));
    bust.push(fist([-0.37, 0.62, -0.4], -1, 0.16));
    rig.add('root', grp(kit, bust, [0, -0.2, 0], [0, -0.42, bz]).scale(1.38));
    return rig;
  }, { yaw: -0.3, pitch: 0.1, zoom: 1.8 });

  // ---- graveyard "Geisterstunde" (v11): a cursed grave hill under a blood moon; a hooded wraith
  // with burning eyes rises behind the skull headstone, a skeletal claw tears out of the dirt
  // and lesser spirits circle in the mist
  defHero('graveyard', 2.1, (kit) => {
    const rig = kit.rig();
    const purple = grimHex(kit, castCol('graveyard', 'color', '#40385a'), 0.45), light = castCol('graveyard', 'accent', '#c8bfff');
    const THREE = T3();
    rig.pivot('spinFx', 'root', [0, 0.5, 0]);
    rig.pivot('claw', 'root', [0.42, 0.18, -0.5]);
    const slab = (w, h) => { const s = new THREE.Shape(); s.moveTo(-w / 2, 0); s.lineTo(w / 2, 0); s.lineTo(w / 2, h - w / 2); s.absarc(0, h - w / 2, w / 2, 0, Math.PI, false); s.lineTo(-w / 2, 0); return s; };
    const stone = 0x3e414c, stoneD = 0x2c2e36;
    const parts = [kit.sphere(1.0, { seg: 16, hseg: 5, theta: [0, HP], color: 0x1e1812, scale: [1.05, 0.26, 0.85] })];
    parts.push(kit.cylinder(1.05, 1.08, 0.06, { seg: 16, color: kit.darken(purple, 0.1) }).at(0, 0.0, 0));
    // the wraith (behind the main stone, arms reaching over it)
    parts.push(reaper(kit, 0.78, { eye: 0xc8fff0 }).at(0.05, 1.62, 0.42));
    // main headstone with a horned skull + iron spikes on top
    parts.push(kit.extrude(slab(0.66, 1.08), 0.16, { color: stone, bevel: 0.035, curveSeg: 8 }).rot(-0.06, 0.05, 0.05).at(-0.05, 0.16, 0.12));
    parts.push(kit.extrude(slab(0.5, 0.9), 0.04, { color: kit.lighten(stone, 0.12), curveSeg: 8 }).rot(-0.06, 0.05, 0.05).at(-0.045, 0.24, 0.02));
    parts.push(skull(kit, 0.13, { eye: light, hornLen: 1.4, hornColor: 0x16141a }).at(-0.04, 0.84, -0.06));
    for (const k of [-1, 0, 1]) parts.push(spike(kit, k ? 0.16 : 0.22, 0.03).rot(0, 0, -k * 0.35).at(-0.05 + k * 0.18, 1.2 - Math.abs(k) * 0.08, 0.12));
    // left: broken leaning slab + crack, right: smaller headstone + a grave stake
    parts.push(kit.box(0.48, 0.66, 0.13, { bevel: 0.04, seg: 1, color: stoneD }).rot(0, 0.35, -0.2).at(-0.68, 0.4, 0.02));
    parts.push(kit.tube([[-0.62, 0.68, -0.07], [-0.7, 0.5, -0.08], [-0.64, 0.32, -0.08]], 0.02, { color: 0x14121a, radial: 3, seg: 4 }));
    parts.push(kit.extrude(slab(0.46, 0.66), 0.13, { color: kit.lighten(stoneD, 0.08), bevel: 0.03, curveSeg: 6 }).rot(0.05, -0.4, 0.14).at(0.68, 0.12, 0.05));
    parts.push(kit.cylinder(0.025, 0.035, 0.6, { seg: 5, color: 'woodDark' }).rot(0, 0, 0.25).at(0.95, 0.3, -0.2));
    // blood moon crescent
    parts.push(kit.extrude(kit.shape([[0, 0.36], [0.24, 0.27], [0.34, 0], [0.24, -0.27], [0, -0.36], [0.15, -0.15], [0.18, 0], [0.15, 0.15]], true), 0.08, { color: 0xd0402a, glow: 0.85 }).at(0.72, 1.9, 0.4));
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) parts.push(tuft(kit, 0.2, { n: 3, seed: 30 + i, color: 0x4a4432, c2: 0x34301e }).at(Math.sin(i * 2.3) * 0.8, 0.1, Math.cos(i * 2.3) * 0.55));
    rig.add('root', parts);
    // low mist + three lesser spirits (tiny hooded wraiths) circling
    const mist = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { const a = i / 8 * TAU; mist.push(kit.sphere(0.2 + (i % 3) * 0.04, { seg: 8, hseg: 5, color: i % 2 ? purple : kit.lighten(purple, 0.12), glow: 0.18, scale: [1.4, 0.45, 1.1] }).at(Math.sin(a) * 1.0, 0.08 + (i % 2) * 0.05, Math.cos(a) * 0.82)); }
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const a = i / 3 * TAU + 0.5;
      mist.push(wraith(kit, 0.2, { color: kit.mix(light, purple, 0.55), eye: 0xffffff, glow: 0.45 }).rot(0, a + Math.PI, 0).at(Math.sin(a) * 0.9, 0.55 + i * 0.2, Math.cos(a) * 0.66));
    }
    rig.add('spinFx', mist);
    // skeletal claw: forearm bones, knuckles, long hooked finger bones
    const hand = [kit.capsule(0.035, 0.26, { seg: 6, capSeg: 1, color: 'boneDark', mat: 'bone' }).at(0.39, 0.28, -0.5), kit.capsule(0.03, 0.26, { seg: 6, capSeg: 1, color: 'boneDark', mat: 'bone' }).at(0.45, 0.28, -0.5),
      kit.sphere(0.08, { seg: 7, hseg: 5, color: 'boneDark', mat: 'bone', scale: [1.15, 0.6, 0.8] }).at(0.42, 0.47, -0.5)];
    for (let f = 0; f < 4; f++) { const fx = 0.42 + (f - 1.5) * 0.05; hand.push(kit.tube([[fx, 0.5, -0.5], [fx + (f - 1.5) * 0.03, 0.66, -0.53], [fx + (f - 1.5) * 0.035, 0.76, -0.6], [fx + (f - 1.5) * 0.035, 0.76, -0.68]], (u) => 0.02 * (1 - u * 0.7), { color: 'boneDark', mat: 'bone', radial: 4, seg: 5 })); }
    hand.push(pebble(kit, 0.1, { seed: 33, seg: 6, color: 0x2a2018 }).at(0.32, 0.12, -0.46), pebble(kit, 0.08, { seed: 34, seg: 6, color: 0x2a2018 }).at(0.53, 0.12, -0.52));
    rig.add('claw', hand);
    return rig;
  }, { yaw: -0.15, pitch: 0.22, zoom: 1.15 }, function (rig, st, t, dt, a) { rig.spinFx.rotation.y += a.rt * 0.5; rig.claw.rotation.z = 0.15 * Math.sin(a.rt * 3); });

  // ---- royal-delivery "Paket-Abwurf" (v11): an iron-bound black war coffer with spiked gold
  // corners and team straps drops under a black-and-team war chute
  defHero('royal-delivery', 2.3, (kit) => {
    const rig = kit.rig();
    rig.pivot('capeChute', 'root', [0, 1.6, 0]);
    rig.add('root', grp(kit, royalCrate(kit, 0.8), [0.08, 0.3, 0.05], [0, 0.42, 0]));
    const ch = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) ch.push(kit.lathe([[1.0, 1.55], [0.92, 1.85], [0.7, 2.08], [0.38, 2.22], [0, 2.26]], { seg: 4, phi: [i / 8 * TAU, TAU / 8], color: i % 2 ? 'team' : 0x17151b, mat: 'cloth', double: i % 2 ? 'teamDark' : 0x0e0c10 }));
    ch.push(kit.ring(1.0, 0.03, { seg: [3, 16], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 1.55, 0));
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { const a = (i + 0.5) / 8 * TAU; ch.push(kit.cone(0.05, 0.16, { seg: 4, color: 0x17151b, mat: 'cloth' }).rot(Math.PI, 0, 0).at(Math.sin(a) * 1.0, 1.47, Math.cos(a) * 1.0)); }
    ch.push(spike(kit, 0.3, 0.05, { gold: true }).at(0, 2.24, 0));
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const a = i / 4 * TAU + Math.PI / 4; ch.push(kit.tube([[Math.sin(a) * 0.98, 1.55, Math.cos(a) * 0.98], [Math.sin(a) * 0.3, 0.78, Math.cos(a) * 0.3]], 0.012, { color: 0x3a3026, radial: 3, seg: 1 })); }
    rig.add('capeChute', ch);
    return rig;
  }, { yaw: -0.3, pitch: 0.15 }, function (rig, st, t, dt, a) { rig.capeChute.rotation.y = 0.1 * Math.sin(a.rt * 1.3); });

  // ---- mirror "Spiegelbild" (v11): a cursed obsidian mirror in a thorned black-and-gold frame;
  // in its smoky glass a spectral horned face stares back with burning eyes
  defHero('mirror', 2.0, (kit) => {
    const rig = kit.rig();
    const blue = grimHex(kit, castCol('mirror', 'color', '#4a6a8a'), 0.55), light = castCol('mirror', 'accent', '#e6f2ff');
    rig.pivot('spinFx', 'root', [0, 1.3, 0]);
    const glass = kit.disc(0.5, { seg: 22, color: kit.mix(blue, 0x0a0c12, 0.35), glow: 0.22 }).scale(1, 1.25, 1).paint((x, y) => (x + y > 0.2 && x + y < 0.3) || (x + y > 0.46 && x + y < 0.5) ? kit.mix(light, blue, 0.4) : null);
    const parts = [
      glass.at(0, 1.3, -0.05),
      kit.disc(0.52, { seg: 20, color: 0x16141a }).scale(1, 1.25, 1).rot(0, Math.PI, 0).at(0, 1.3, 0.02),
      kit.torus(0.56, 0.07, { seg: [5, 26], color: 0x1b1a20, mat: 'metal' }).scale(1, 1.25, 1).at(0, 1.3, -0.02),
      kit.torus(0.5, 0.022, { seg: [3, 26], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).scale(1, 1.25, 1).at(0, 1.3, -0.08),
      kit.torus(0.63, 0.018, { seg: [3, 26], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).scale(1, 1.25, 1).at(0, 1.3, -0.04),
      // horned crest with a team gem + thorns all around the frame
      horn(kit, 0.36, 0.05, { side: -1, color: 0x16141a, mat: 'metal' }).at(-0.12, 1.98, -0.02),
      horn(kit, 0.36, 0.05, { side: 1, color: 0x16141a, mat: 'metal' }).at(0.12, 1.98, -0.02),
      kit.gem(0.1, { color: 'teamGlow', mat: 'gem', glow: 0.5 }).at(0, 2.02, -0.08),
      // handle: black steel with gold rings, team grip, spiked pommel
      kit.rcyl(0.07, 0.09, 0.55, { seg: 10, color: 0x1b1a20, mat: 'metal' }).at(0, 0.38, 0),
      kit.rcyl(0.1, 0.1, 0.16, { seg: 10, color: 'team', mat: 'leather' }).at(0, 0.4, 0),
      kit.ring(0.1, 0.022, { seg: [3, 12], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 0.62, 0), kit.ring(0.1, 0.022, { seg: [3, 12], color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 0.18, 0),
      kit.sphere(0.12, { seg: 10, hseg: 7, color: 'oldGold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 0.7, 0),
      spike(kit, 0.2, 0.06, { color: 0x1b1a20 }).rot(Math.PI, 0, 0).at(0, 0.12, 0),
    ];
    for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
      const a = (i + 0.5) / 14 * TAU;
      if (Math.abs(Math.sin(a)) < 0.25 && Math.cos(a) > 0) continue;   // leave the crest free
      parts.push(spike(kit, 0.16 + (i % 2) * 0.08, 0.035, { color: 0x1b1a20 }).rot(0, 0, -a).at(Math.sin(a) * 0.6, 1.3 + Math.cos(a) * 0.75, -0.02));
    }
    // the spectral face inside the glass
    parts.push(skull(kit, 0.2, { color: kit.mix(light, blue, 0.5), eye: 0xff4a2a, dark: 0x05070c, hornColor: kit.mix(light, blue, 0.6), hornLen: 1.4 }).scale(1, 1, 0.35).at(0, 1.32, -0.08));
    rig.add('root', parts);
    rig.add('spinFx', sparkle(kit, 0.45, 1.75, -0.12, 1.1, light), sparkle(kit, -0.3, 0.95, -0.12, 0.8, 0xffffff));
    return rig;
  }, { yaw: -0.3, pitch: 0.1 }, function (rig, st, t, dt, a) { const k = 0.85 + 0.15 * Math.sin(a.rt * 3); rig.spinFx.scale.set(k, k, k); });

  // ---- clone "Klonstrahl" (v11): a hooded dark warrior with a planted greatsword and his glowing
  // spectral double, bound by a spiralling clone beam
  defHero('clone', 1.7, (kit) => {
    const rig = kit.rig();
    const teal = grimHex(kit, castCol('clone', 'color', '#268181'), 0.35), cyan = castCol('clone', 'accent', '#7ff0ff');
    rig.pivot('spinFx', 'root', [0, 0.8, 0]);
    rig.add('root', hoodedWarrior(kit).rot(0, 0.25, 0).at(-0.48, 0, 0.05));
    rig.add('root', hoodedWarrior(kit, { spectral: true, color: cyan }).rot(0, -0.25, 0).at(0.52, 0.06, -0.12));
    const sp = [];
    for (let i = 0; i <= 14; i++) {
      const u = i / 14, a = u * TAU * 1.5;
      sp.push(kit.sphere(0.04 + 0.02 * Math.sin(u * Math.PI), { seg: 5, hseg: 3, color: i % 2 ? cyan : 0xffffff, glow: 1 }).at(-0.45 + u * 0.95, 0.95 + Math.sin(a) * 0.36, Math.cos(a) * 0.36));
    }
    sp.push(sparkle(kit, 0.95, 1.5, -0.1, 1.0, cyan), sparkle(kit, -0.05, 1.6, -0.1, 0.8, 0xffffff));
    rig.add('spinFx', sp);
    rig.add('root', kit.ring(0.5, 0.03, { seg: [3, 18], color: teal, glow: 0.6 }).at(0.52, 0.02, -0.12), kit.cylinder(0.48, 0.48, 0.02, { seg: 18, color: kit.mix(teal, cyan, 0.3), glow: 0.4 }).at(0.52, 0.01, -0.12));
    return rig;
  }, { yaw: -0.15, pitch: 0.15 }, function (rig, st, t, dt, a) { rig.spinFx.position.y += 0.04 * Math.sin(a.rt * 2); });

  // =====================================================================================
  // ARENA DECORATION (feet at y = 0; low triangle counts, the renderer bakes many copies)
  // =====================================================================================
  // tree: chunky round broadleaf with a twisted trunk and root flares (~2.4 tiles)
  defDeco('tree', 2.5, (kit) => {
    const rig = kit.rig();
    // v8: smooth tapered trunk with a branch and root flares, glossy round canopy puffs
    const p = [
      kit.lathe([[0.26, 0], [0.2, 0.08], [0.15, 0.3], [0.13, 0.9], [0.12, 1.25], [0, 1.3]], { seg: 10, color: COL.trunk, mat: 'wood' }).rot(0, 0, 0.05).at(0.02, 0, 0),
      kit.tube([[0.06, 0.95, 0], [0.22, 1.12, 0.02], [0.34, 1.32, 0.04]], [0.07, 0.045], { color: COL.trunk, mat: 'wood', radial: 7, seg: 5 }),
    ];
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const a = i / 4 * TAU + 0.4; p.push(kit.tube([[Math.sin(a) * 0.08, 0.2, Math.cos(a) * 0.08], [Math.sin(a) * 0.22, 0.05, Math.cos(a) * 0.22], [Math.sin(a) * 0.3, 0.01, Math.cos(a) * 0.3]], [0.07, 0.03], { color: COL.trunkDark, mat: 'wood', radial: 6, seg: 4 })); }
    const blobs = [[0, 1.75, 0, 0.78, COL.leafB], [0.5, 1.45, 0.18, 0.55, COL.leafA], [-0.48, 1.5, -0.16, 0.58, COL.leafD], [0.12, 2.22, -0.08, 0.52, COL.leafC], [-0.2, 1.62, 0.42, 0.48, COL.leafA], [0.22, 1.55, -0.45, 0.46, COL.leafB]];
    for (const b of blobs) p.push(kit.sphere(b[3], { seg: 12, color: b[4], mat: 'soft', grad: 0.25 }).at(b[0], b[1], b[2]));
    p.push(kit.sphere(0.3, { seg: 10, color: kit.lighten(COL.leafC, 0.18), mat: 'soft' }).at(-0.12, 2.4, 0.12));
    for (const q of [[0.42, 1.9, -0.42], [-0.5, 1.75, -0.3], [0.1, 1.62, -0.72]]) p.push(kit.sphere(0.06, { seg: 8, color: COL.crimson, mat: TM }).at(q[0], q[1], q[2]));
    rig.add('root', p);
    return rig;
  });
  // pine: three drooping tiers on a short trunk (~2.7 tiles)
  defDeco('pine', 2.7, (kit) => {
    const rig = kit.rig();
    const p = [kit.lathe([[0.16, 0], [0.12, 0.1], [0.1, 0.7], [0, 0.72]], { seg: 9, color: COL.trunkDark, mat: 'wood' })];
    // smooth drooping tiers with a soft rolled rim (no faceted cones)
    const tiers = [[0.6, 0.95, 0.95, COL.pineA], [1.2, 0.78, 0.85, COL.pineB], [1.75, 0.58, 0.75, COL.pineC], [2.22, 0.36, 0.6, kit.lighten(COL.pineC, 0.12)]];
    tiers.forEach((q, i) => {
      p.push(kit.lathe([[0, -0.06], [q[1] * 0.9, -0.04], [q[1], 0.02], [q[1] * 0.9, 0.1], [q[1] * 0.5, q[2] * 0.5], [q[1] * 0.16, q[2] * 0.86], [0, q[2]]], { seg: 14, color: q[3], mat: 'soft', grad: 0.25 }).rot(0, i * 0.6, 0).at(0, q[0], 0));
    });
    p.push(kit.sphere(0.06, { seg: 8, color: 'gold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 2.84, 0));
    rig.add('root', p);
    return rig;
  });
  // bush: three leafy puffs with a few berries
  defDeco('bush', 0.8, (kit) => {
    const rig = kit.rig();
    rig.add('root',
      kit.sphere(0.5, { seg: 12, color: COL.leafB, mat: 'soft', grad: 0.3, scale: [1, 0.82, 1] }).at(0, 0.32, 0),
      kit.sphere(0.36, { seg: 11, color: COL.leafA, mat: 'soft', grad: 0.3, scale: [1, 0.85, 1] }).at(0.4, 0.24, 0.1),
      kit.sphere(0.34, { seg: 11, color: COL.leafC, mat: 'soft', grad: 0.3, scale: [1, 0.85, 1] }).at(-0.36, 0.22, -0.12),
      kit.sphere(0.055, { seg: 8, color: COL.crimson, mat: TM }).at(0.18, 0.62, -0.25),
      kit.sphere(0.05, { seg: 8, color: COL.crimson, mat: TM }).at(-0.25, 0.5, -0.36),
      kit.sphere(0.05, { seg: 8, color: COL.crimson, mat: TM }).at(0.52, 0.44, -0.18),
      kit.sphere(0.045, { seg: 8, color: COL.crimson, mat: TM }).at(-0.05, 0.6, -0.36));
    return rig;
  });
  // rock: two faceted stones with a moss cap
  defDeco('rock', 0.6, (kit) => {
    const rig = kit.rig();
    rig.add('root',
      pebble(kit, 0.45, { seed: 21, seg: 12, cut: 0.62, color: 0x8f969e, scale: [1.15, 0.72, 1] }).at(0, 0.22, 0),
      pebble(kit, 0.22, { seed: 22, seg: 9, cut: 0.62, color: 'stoneDark', scale: [1.1, 0.7, 1] }).at(0.45, 0.1, 0.22),
      kit.sphere(0.22, { seg: 10, color: COL.leafD, mat: 'felt', scale: [1.3, 0.32, 1.1] }).at(-0.05, 0.47, 0.02));
    return rig;
  });
  // rock-big: a craggy boulder pile
  defDeco('rock-big', 1.4, (kit) => {
    const rig = kit.rig();
    rig.add('root',
      pebble(kit, 0.85, { seed: 31, seg: 14, cut: 0.6, color: 0x8f969e, scale: [1.15, 0.85, 1] }).at(0, 0.55, 0),
      pebble(kit, 0.48, { seed: 32, seg: 11, cut: 0.62, color: 'stoneDark', scale: [1.1, 0.8, 1] }).at(0.85, 0.28, 0.3),
      pebble(kit, 0.36, { seed: 33, seg: 10, cut: 0.62, color: 'stoneLight' }).at(-0.8, 0.2, -0.35),
      kit.sphere(0.42, { seg: 12, color: COL.leafD, mat: 'felt', scale: [1.3, 0.26, 1.15] }).rot(0.1, 0, -0.12).at(-0.08, 1.12, 0.05),
      tuft(kit, 0.24, { n: 4, seed: 7 }).at(0.55, 0.02, -0.6), tuft(kit, 0.2, { n: 3, seed: 8 }).at(-0.5, 0.02, -0.75));
    return rig;
  });
  // fence: a 2-tile segment along X (x = -1 .. 1), three posts with pointed tops
  defDeco('fence', 0.8, (kit) => {
    const rig = kit.rig();
    const p = [];
    for (const x of [-0.95, 0, 0.95]) {
      p.push(kit.box(0.14, 0.62, 0.14, { bevel: 0.035, seg: 1, color: 'wood', mat: 'wood' }).at(x, 0.31, 0));
      p.push(kit.lathe([[0.1, 0], [0.1, 0.02], [0.02, 0.15], [0, 0.16]], { seg: 4, color: 'woodLight', mat: 'wood', sharp: true }).rot(0, Math.PI / 4, 0).at(x, 0.62, 0));
    }
    p.push(kit.box(2.0, 0.09, 0.07, { bevel: 0.025, seg: 1, color: 'woodLight', mat: 'wood' }).rot(0, 0, 0.02).at(0, 0.48, -0.08));
    p.push(kit.box(2.0, 0.09, 0.07, { bevel: 0.025, seg: 1, color: 'wood', mat: 'wood' }).rot(0, 0, -0.03).at(0, 0.24, -0.08));
    p.push(kit.rcyl(0.06, 0.06, 0.12, { seg: 8, color: 'rope', mat: 'cloth' }).rot(0, 0, HP).at(-0.95, 0.48, -0.09), kit.rcyl(0.06, 0.06, 0.12, { seg: 8, color: 'rope', mat: 'cloth' }).rot(0, 0, HP).at(0.95, 0.48, -0.09));
    rig.add('root', p);
    return rig;
  }, { ao: 0.12 });
  // banner: team war banner on a crossbar pole (cloth waves via the flag pivot)
  defDeco('banner', 2.6, (kit) => {
    const rig = kit.rig();
    rig.pivot('flagB', 'root', [0, 2.2, -0.05]);
    rig.add('root',
      kit.rcyl(0.05, 0.065, 2.5, { seg: 10, color: 'woodDark', mat: 'wood', bevel: 0.015 }).at(0, 1.25, 0),
      kit.rcyl(0.035, 0.035, 0.9, { seg: 8, color: 'wood', mat: 'wood' }).rot(0, 0, HP).at(0, 2.22, -0.05),
      finial(kit, 1).at(0, 2.5, 0),
      kit.sphere(0.045, { seg: 8, color: 'gold', mat: 'gold' }).at(-0.46, 2.22, -0.05), kit.sphere(0.045, { seg: 8, color: 'gold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0.46, 2.22, -0.05),
      kit.lathe(rimProf(0.22, 0.12, 0, 0.14, 0.04, 2), { seg: 12, color: 'stoneDark', mat: 'stone', sharp: true }));
    rig.add('flagB',
      cloth(kit, 0.84, 1.2, { color: 'gold', inner: 'goldDark', point: 0.24, sx: 3, sy: 4, wave: 0.03, mat: 'lacquer' }).at(0, 2.2, -0.07),
      cloth(kit, 0.74, 1.1, { color: 'team', inner: 'teamDark', point: 0.22, sx: 4, sy: 4, wave: 0.03 }).at(0, 2.19, -0.1),
      cloth(kit, 0.74, 1.1, { color: 'team', inner: 'teamDark', point: 0.22, sx: 4, sy: 4, wave: 0.03 }).rot(0, Math.PI, 0).at(0, 2.19, -0.04),
      kit.star(5, 0.17, 0.07, 0.04, { color: 'gold', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 1.62, -0.13),
      kit.star(5, 0.17, 0.07, 0.04, { color: 'gold', mat: 'gold' }).rot(0, Math.PI, 0).at(0, 1.62, 0.0));
    return rig;
  }, { anim: { body: 'static', attack: 'none', weight: 1 } });
  // torch: iron brazier on a post, flickering flame
  defDeco('torch', 1.6, (kit) => {
    const rig = kit.rig();
    rig.pivot('coreFlame', 'root', [0, 1.34, 0]);
    rig.add('root',
      kit.rcyl(0.06, 0.09, 1.2, { seg: 10, color: 'woodDark', mat: 'wood' }).at(0, 0.6, 0),
      kit.ring(0.085, 0.025, { seg: [4, 12], color: 'iron', mat: 'metal' }).at(0, 0.9, 0),
      kit.ring(0.078, 0.02, { seg: [4, 12], color: 'iron', mat: 'metal' }).at(0, 0.5, 0),
      kit.lathe([[0.08, 0], [0.12, 0.04], [0.2, 0.16], [0.21, 0.2], [0.17, 0.2], [0.1, 0.08], [0, 0.08]], { seg: 14, color: 'darkMetal', mat: 'metal', sharp: true }).at(0, 1.18, 0),
      kit.ring(0.2, 0.022, { seg: [4, 14], color: 'goldDark', mat: 'gold' }).at(0, 1.37, 0),
      kit.sphere(0.15, { seg: 10, theta: [0, HP], color: 'ember', glow: 0.85 }).at(0, 1.3, 0),
      kit.lathe(rimProf(0.18, 0.1, 0, 0.12, 0.035, 2), { seg: 12, color: 'stoneDark', mat: 'stone', sharp: true }));
    rig.add('coreFlame', flame(kit, 0.46).at(0, 1.34, 0));
    return rig;
  }, { anim: { body: 'static', attack: 'none', weight: 1, custom(rig, st, t, dt, a) { flicker(rig.coreFlame, a.rt, a.seed, 1); } } });
  // crate: banded wooden supply crate
  defDeco('crate', 0.75, (kit) => {
    const rig = kit.rig();
    const S = 0.36;
    const p = [kit.box(2 * S, 2 * S, 2 * S, { bevel: 0.05, seg: 2, color: 'woodLight', mat: 'wood' }).at(0, S, 0)];
    for (const f of [[0, 1], [0, -1], [1, 0], [-1, 0]]) {
      const d = kit.box(2 * S * 1.2, 0.09, 0.03, { bevel: 0.012, seg: 1, color: 'wood', mat: 'wood' });
      if (f[1]) d.rot(0, 0, f[1] * 0.78).at(0, S, f[1] * (S + 0.01)); else d.rot(f[0] * 0.78, HP, 0).at(f[0] * (S + 0.01), S, 0);
      p.push(d);
    }
    p.push(kit.box(2 * S + 0.03, 0.07, 2 * S + 0.03, { bevel: 0.02, seg: 1, color: 'woodDark', mat: 'wood' }).at(0, 2 * S - 0.05, 0));
    p.push(kit.box(2 * S + 0.03, 0.07, 2 * S + 0.03, { bevel: 0.02, seg: 1, color: 'woodDark', mat: 'wood' }).at(0, 0.05, 0));
    for (let c = 0; c < 4; c++) { const sx = c & 1 ? 1 : -1, sz = c & 2 ? 1 : -1; p.push(kit.sphere(0.022, { seg: 7, color: 'iron', mat: 'metal' }).at(sx * (S - 0.06), 2 * S - 0.05, sz * (S + 0.018))); }
    rig.add('root', p);
    return rig;
  });
  // mushroom: a cluster of red toadstools
  defDeco('mushroom', 0.5, (kit) => {
    const rig = kit.rig();
    const m = (x, z, s, ry) => toadstool(kit, x, z, s, ry).at(x, 0, z);
    rig.add('root', m(0, 0, 2.2, 0), m(0.3, 0.15, 1.5, 1.2), m(-0.22, 0.25, 1.2, 2.5), tuft(kit, 0.16, { n: 3, seed: 3 }).at(0.12, 0.0, -0.2), tuft(kit, 0.14, { n: 3, seed: 4 }).at(-0.18, 0.0, -0.1));
    return rig;
  });
  // flowers: a clump of grass with colourful blossoms
  defDeco('flowers', 0.45, (kit) => {
    const rig = kit.rig();
    const p = [];
    const rnd = kit.rand(44);
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const a = rnd() * TAU, r = rnd() * 0.28; p.push(tuft(kit, 0.24 + rnd() * 0.1, { n: 3, seed: 50 + i }).at(Math.sin(a) * r, 0.0, Math.cos(a) * r)); }
    const cols = [0xff6a8a, 0xffe14d, 0xffffff, 0xb48cff, 0xff9a3d];
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      const a = i / 5 * TAU + rnd(), r = 0.1 + rnd() * 0.22, y = 0.24 + rnd() * 0.12, x = Math.sin(a) * r, z = Math.cos(a) * r;
      p.push(kit.tube([[x * 0.6, 0, z * 0.6], [x * 0.85, y * 0.5, z * 0.85], [x, y, z]], 0.012, { color: 'grassDark', mat: 'soft', radial: 4, seg: 3, caps: false }));
      // five rounded petals around a glossy centre
      const fl = [kit.sphere(0.032, { seg: 8, color: 0xffd23f, mat: TM }).at(0, 0.012, 0)];
      for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) { const b = k / 5 * TAU; fl.push(kit.sphere(0.035, { seg: 7, color: cols[i], mat: 'soft', scale: [0.65, 0.35, 1] }).rot(0, b, 0).at(Math.sin(b) * 0.042, 0, Math.cos(b) * 0.042)); }
      p.push(kit.merge(fl).rot(0.25, a, 0).at(x, y, z));
    }
    rig.add('root', p);
    return rig;
  });
})(globalThis.CR || (globalThis.CR = {}));

</script>
<script>
/* src/25-gfx-vfx.js */
/* Chaos Royale - 25-gfx-vfx.js (render3d)
 * CR.VFX: GPU-cheap effects for the 3D battle renderer (CR.Render3D).
 *
 *   const fx = CR.VFX.create(scene, { reducedMotion, quality: 'high'|'low', unitScale });
 *   fx.setUnitScale(s);            // renderer troop scale (v3 ~1.6): deploy dust, death puffs grow
 *   fx.hooks = { shake(amp, dur), label(text, wx, wy, wz, color, size, dur, kind), flash(color, alpha, dur) };
 *     v4: labels are wordless (kind 'star' | 'wake' | 'crown' | 'elixir' with a number): no names
 *     or words are ever drawn during a battle (user requirement).
 *   fx.onEvent(ev, ctx);           // sim event -> effects (ctx: renderer lookups, see Render3D._ctx)
 *   fx.update(dt, camera);         // simulate + upload (dt = game seconds)
 *   fx.burst(name, wx, wy, wz, scale, color);  // named one-shot effect (see EFFECTS)
 *   fx.area(id, kind, team, wx, wz, radius, left, total);  // lasting zone visual, call every frame
 *   fx.beam(x0,y0,z0, x1,y1,z1, color, width, jag, core);  // one-frame beam (inferno, ...)
 *   fx.zap(x0,y0,z0, x1,y1,z1, color, width, dur);         // timed lightning ribbon
 *   fx.swing(x,y,z, dx,dz, reach, color, width, dur, span)  // melee swing smear (timed arc)
 *   fx.sprite(wx, wy, wz, size, color, alpha, tile, add);   // one-frame glow sprite
 *   fx.trail(cat, wx, wy, wz, vx, vy, vz, dt, team);       // projectile trail emission
 *   fx.projectileEnd(kind, cat, wx, wy, wz, team);          // impact when a projectile vanishes
 *   fx.unitFx(...)                 // per-unit status emitters (charging, tunnel, rage, aura, ...)
 *   fx.setTerrain(fn, uniforms)    // v5 hill map: fn(wx, wz) -> ground height (null = flat), uniforms =
 *                                  //   { crHillH: {value: Float32Array(65)}, crHillP: {value: Vector3(on, z0, 1/dz)} }
 *   fx.touchdown(wx, wz, team, zoneWorld)  // v6: touchdown celebration in an end zone
 *   fx.sweep(z0, z1, dur, team)    // v6: team light band sweeping over the field (field reset)
 *   fx.setBraziers(list)           // v10: [{x, y, z, k, gy}] world positions of the arena brazier fires (gy: ground)
 *   fx.reset(); fx.dispose();
 * v10 grimdark: fx.setBraziers([{x, y, z, k}]) - flickering brazier fires on the arena pillars
 * (flame + tongue + core sprites, halo, warm ground light pool, rising embers; real-time flicker
 * also while the game is paused); ambient = embers drifting up near the walls, falling ash and
 * dark mist wisps along the walls (was pollen / leaves); darker earth dust, ash-grey death puffs
 * with gold motes and embers, gold deploy rings, darker smoke / debris, hotter sparks. Team
 * colours of shots / rings / smears are unchanged (readability).
 * v8: sprite atlas painted at 256 px per cell (1024 x 1024, mipmapped, 4x anisotropic) so big
 * flames, smoke, stars and ground decals stay crisp at DPR 3.
 * v12: unitFx draws no walking dust / speed streaks any more (a charge keeps a few faint streaks),
 * idle C.H.A.O.S tier auras only for legendary (faint ground glow), a subtler champion marker;
 * bursts 'tunnelPuff' (tunnel map enter / exit) and 'clonePoof' (shadow clones); card ability
 * events {base: true} 'shadow_clone' | 'dodge' | 'whirlwind' | 'parry' | 'lock_on' (_v12Ability),
 * other card abilities without a rarity get a compact effect (_cardAbilityLite, no chaos burst).
 * v6 card abilities: Elektrodrache hits (src unit 'electro-dragon') and its {t:'ability', kind:
 * 'chain', units, pts} events are collected per frame and drawn hop by hop from the jaws (thick
 * cyan bolt, white core, team tint, thinning along the chain) with stun sparks on every target;
 * Kung-Fu-Legende hits get gold-white impact stars + radial streaks + punch / kick smears, 'combo'
 * shows 1-2 wordless combo pips, 'one-inch' a point-blank shockwave with a knockback blast,
 * 'dash' (phase start / impact) a take-off dust burst and a yellow flying-kick streak with
 * after-images. Abilities of these cards that carry a C.H.A.O.S rarity keep the chaos look.
 * v7 cards ({t:'ability', kind, unitId, x, y, tx, ty, ...}; hits by src unit):
 *   'shotgun' (Cyborg-Jäger): muzzle flash + star, a cone of 12 hot pellet streaks
 *     over the spread (some team-tinted), sparks where they land, smoke cloud, warm ground fan;
 *     hits without an event draw the same blast once per shot (deduped both ways).
 *   'pump': smoke wisp + an ejected red shell bouncing on the grass.
 *   'endoskeleton': red flash, cracked ground, a fountain of hot sparks, jacket shreds, chrome
 *     glints, red arcs, delayed red eye glow.
 *   'champion_slash' (Schwarzklingen-Meister): a huge dark crescent (team underglow, black body
 *     with a dark-ribbon mode, violet aura, bright leading edge) travels in a line across the
 *     arena (ev.speed / range / width or defaults 13 t/s, 12 tiles, 3.6 wide) with fading
 *     after-images, violet sparks, dark smoke, cut grass and ground scars; melee hits get a dark
 *     crescent smear, wave hits a violet cut star.
 *   'sphere' (Wirbel-Ninja): blue spinning energy ball (deep-blue body, layered glow, counter-
 *     rotating swirls, orbiting sparks, swirl rings) flies to tx, ty and bursts (flash, swirl
 *     decal, radial streaks, double shock + team ring = knockback, dust).
 *   Travelling waves / spheres are stand-ins ("movers") unless the sim flies a projectile of that
 *   kind (projStyle cat 'wave' / 'sphere' - drawn by trail() then, and the stand-in stands down).
 *   fx.championAura(entity, team, ready, active, dt): champion marker (faint gold ring on cooldown,
 *   bright pulsing gold ring + glow + rising motes when READY, violet while ACTIVE).
 *   CR.VFX.projStyle(kind) -> { cat, color, size, arc, h0 }  // shared projectile table
 *
 * Building blocks (all pooled, allocation-free per frame):
 *   - one instanced-quad particle system (single draw call). Premultiplied blending lets
 *     additive glows and alpha-blended smoke share one material. Modes: camera billboard,
 *     ground-aligned decal (rings, scorch, cracks) and velocity-stretched streaks (sparks,
 *     speed lines). Soft sprites live in a 4x4 atlas painted on a canvas at start-up.
 *   - one camera-facing ribbon batch (single draw call) for lightning, chain zaps, inferno
 *     beams and the sky bolts of Lightning.
 *   - pooled ground discs + domes with an animated pattern shader for lasting areas
 *     (poison, freeze, rage, tornado, earthquake, graveyard, heal, bombs, delivery, ...).
 * Colours are sRGB hex values and written to the framebuffer unchanged (stylised look).
 * v4: attacks readable for both teams - team-coloured halo + white-hot streak + comet tail on
 * every shot (TEAM_TRAIL), melee swing smears (fx.swing: solid team-coloured ribbon arcs, full
 * circle for spinners), alpha-blended team impact rings under every hit and damaging spell,
 * team-tinted hit stars; the particle material is double-sided so ground decals (shock rings,
 * scorch, cracks) are actually visible from the battle camera. Labels are wordless.
 * v3: death puffs are sized from the dying entity (bigger troops), the hot paths (particle
 * swap-remove, area emitters, area updates) run without per-frame allocations.
 * v5 (hill map): with fx.setTerrain(fn, uniforms) every emission whose y lies below the ground at
 * its (x, z) is treated as ground-relative and lifted onto the terrain (constant "ground" heights
 * like 0.05 keep working on the ridge; entity heights from the renderer are absolute and already
 * above the ground), bouncing debris lands on the terrain, ground decals (M_GROUND) and area
 * discs are draped over the ridge in the vertex shader (crHill profile, same samples as the
 * renderer's terrain mesh) and area domes sit on the ground at their centre.
 * World space: 1 unit = 1 tile, worldX = simX - 9, worldZ = 16 - simY, y up (docs/GFX.md).
 * Loads without THREE (then CR.VFX.available() === false and create() returns null).
 */
(function (CR) {
  'use strict';

  const G = globalThis;
  const TAU = Math.PI * 2;
  const VFX = {};
  CR.VFX = VFX;

  VFX.available = function () {
    const T = G.THREE;
    return !!(T && typeof T.InstancedBufferGeometry === 'function' && typeof T.ShaderMaterial === 'function');
  };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Tiles of the sprite atlas (4 x 4)
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const T_GLOW = 0, T_DISC = 1, T_RING = 2, T_SMOKE = 3, T_STREAK = 4, T_STAR4 = 5, T_STAR5 = 6, T_PLUS = 7,
    T_FLAKE = 8, T_BUBBLE = 9, T_CHUNK = 10, T_FLAME = 11, T_CRACK = 12, T_SCORCH = 13, T_SWIRL = 14, T_SHARD = 15;
  VFX.TILES = { glow: T_GLOW, disc: T_DISC, ring: T_RING, smoke: T_SMOKE, streak: T_STREAK, star4: T_STAR4, star5: T_STAR5,
    plus: T_PLUS, flake: T_FLAKE, bubble: T_BUBBLE, chunk: T_CHUNK, flame: T_FLAME, crack: T_CRACK, scorch: T_SCORCH,
    swirl: T_SWIRL, shard: T_SHARD };

  const M_BB = 0, M_GROUND = 1, M_STRETCH = 2;
  const S_POINT = 0, S_SPHERE = 1, S_DISC = 2, S_RING = 3, S_CYL = 4;

  // Team colours (index = colour team: 0 = local / blue, 1 = opponent / red)
  const TEAM = [
    { main: 0x1f5eff, light: 0x7fb0ff, dark: 0x0f33b8 },   // v11: royal blue as strong as the red (= CR.GFX.teamColors)
    { main: 0xe5322b, light: 0xffa49a, dark: 0x8a1714 },
  ];
  // C.H.A.O.S rarity colours (tier 1..3), docs/GFX.md
  const RARITY = [0xffffff, 0x9fb4c7, 0xff9a2e, 0xb44cff, 0x41d9c7];
  VFX.rarityColor = function (tier) { return RARITY[Math.max(0, Math.min(4, tier | 0))]; };
  VFX.rarityCss = function (tier) { return '#' + ('000000' + RARITY[Math.max(0, Math.min(4, tier | 0))].toString(16)).slice(-6); };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Projectile style table (shared with the renderer)
  //   cat: visual category (model id for CR.GFX or fallback mesh), color, size (tiles),
  //   arc: extra apex height (tiles), h0: launch height (-1 = from the shooter).
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const PROJ = {
    'princess-tower': ['arrow', 0x7a5532, 1.0, 0.35, -1],
    'king-tower': ['cannonball', 0x2b2f36, 1.0, 0.5, -1],
    fireball: ['fireball', 0xff7a1a, 1.25, 3.2, -1],
    rocket: ['rocket', 0xd8342c, 1.7, 2.4, -1],
    arrows: ['volley', 0x7a5532, 1.0, 3.0, -1],
    'giant-snowball': ['snowball', 0xf4fbff, 1.1, 2.0, -1],
    'goblin-barrel': ['barrel', 0x8a5a2e, 1.0, 4.0, -1],
    'the-log': ['log', 0x8a5a2e, 1.95, 0, 0],
    'barbarian-barrel': ['barrel-roll', 0x9b6a3a, 1.3, 0, 0],
    boulder: ['boulder', 0x8b8f96, 1.0, 0, 0],
    spark: ['spark', 0xffcf3a, 0.5, 0.15, 0.4],
    archer: ['arrow', 0x7a5532, 0.85, 0.35, -1],
    'magic-archer': ['arrow', 0x62d8ff, 0.9, 0.05, -1],
    'dart-goblin': ['dart', 0x3f8f3a, 0.8, 0.15, -1],
    'spear-goblin': ['spear', 0x7a5a3a, 0.9, 0.7, -1],
    'x-bow': ['arrow', 0x4a3a2a, 1.25, 0.05, -1],
    musketeer: ['bullet', 0xffd27a, 0.6, 0, -1],
    hunter: ['bullet', 0xffd27a, 0.5, 0, -1],
    princess: ['fireball', 0xff8a1a, 0.6, 2.2, -1],
    wizard: ['fireball', 0xff8a1a, 0.62, 0.2, -1],
    'baby-dragon': ['fireball', 0xff6a1a, 0.62, 0.1, -1],
    'inferno-dragon': ['fireball', 0xff5a1a, 0.5, 0, -1],
    witch: ['orb', 0xc25bff, 0.6, 0.2, -1],
    minion: ['orb', 0x7aa8ff, 0.42, 0, -1],
    'mega-minion': ['orb', 0x9a6cff, 0.55, 0, -1],
    'battle-healer': ['orb', 0xffe680, 0.45, 0, -1],
    phoenix: ['fireball', 0xff8a1a, 0.55, 0, -1],
    'phoenix-reborn': ['fireball', 0xff8a1a, 0.55, 0, -1],
    bomber: ['bomb', 0x30343c, 0.9, 1.8, -1],
    'bomb-tower': ['bomb', 0x30343c, 1.05, 2.0, -1],
    mortar: ['cannonball', 0x3a3e46, 1.3, 5.0, -1],
    cannon: ['cannonball', 0x2b2f36, 0.95, 0.05, -1],
    'cannon-cart': ['cannonball', 0x2b2f36, 0.9, 0.05, -1],
    'royal-giant': ['cannonball', 0x2b2f36, 1.0, 0.3, -1],
    'ice-wizard': ['shard', 0xa8e8ff, 0.8, 0.1, -1],
    'ice-spirit': ['spirit', 0xbfefff, 1.0, 1.4, -1],
    'fire-spirit': ['spirit', 0xff7a1a, 1.0, 1.4, -1],
    'electro-spirit': ['spirit', 0x7fe8ff, 1.0, 0.8, -1],
    'electro-wizard': ['bolt', 0x7fe8ff, 0.7, 0, -1],
    'electro-dragon': ['bolt', 0x7fe8ff, 0.7, 0, -1],
    sparky: ['bolt', 0x8ff0ff, 1.35, 0.1, -1],
    chain: ['chain', 0xbff4ff, 0.6, 0, -1],
    zap: ['chain', 0xbff4ff, 0.6, 0, -1],
    firecracker: ['firework', 0xff4fa0, 0.8, 1.6, -1],
    axe: ['axe', 0x9aa3ad, 1.0, 0, -1],
    executioner: ['axe', 0x9aa3ad, 1.0, 0, -1],
    'lava-hound': ['lava', 0xff7a2a, 0.62, 0.1, -1],
    'lava-pup': ['lava', 0xff8a3a, 0.45, 0.05, -1],
    shot: ['bullet', 0xfff3b0, 0.5, 0, -1],
    // v7 cards: Wirbel-Ninja energy sphere, Cyborg pellets, champion slash wave (any of the names)
    'spiral-ninja': ['sphere', 0x5ec8ff, 1.0, 0.25, -1], sphere: ['sphere', 0x5ec8ff, 1.0, 0.25, -1], 'spiral-sphere': ['sphere', 0x5ec8ff, 1.0, 0.25, -1],
    wirbelkugel: ['sphere', 0x5ec8ff, 1.0, 0.25, -1],
    'cyborg-hunter': ['pellets', 0xffd27a, 0.5, 0, -1],
    champion_slash: ['wave', 0x2a1238, 2.4, 0, 0.9], 'slash-wave': ['wave', 0x2a1238, 2.4, 0, 0.9], 'black-blade-wave': ['wave', 0x2a1238, 2.4, 0, 0.9],
  };
  const PROJ_DEFAULT = ['bullet', 0xfff3b0, 0.5, 0, -1];
  // v4: team-tinted halo + streak behind shots (weight per visual category; 0 = none)
  const TEAM_TRAIL = { arrow: 1.15, dart: 1, spear: 1.1, bullet: 1.1, cannonball: 1.2, bomb: 1.1, orb: 0.9, shard: 0.95,
    bolt: 0.9, fireball: 1, firework: 0.9, lava: 0.85, axe: 1.1, rocket: 1.3, snowball: 1, barrel: 1, spirit: 0.9, sphere: 0.8, pellets: 0.5 };
  const projCache = new Map();
  VFX.projStyle = function (kind) {
    let s = projCache.get(kind);
    if (s) return s;
    let row = PROJ[kind];
    if (!row) {
      const D = CR.DATA;
      const u = D && D.units ? D.units[kind] : null;
      let card = null;
      if (CR.Sim && typeof CR.Sim.cardById === 'function') { try { card = CR.Sim.cardById(kind); } catch (e) { card = null; } }
      if (card && card.type === 'spell') row = card.spell && card.spell.kind === 'roll' ? ['log', 0x8a5a2e, card.spell.width || 1.5, 0, 0] : ['fireball', 0xffb04a, 1.0, 2.5, -1];
      else if (u && u.splashRadius > 0) row = ['bomb', 0x30343c, 0.8, 1.0, -1];
      else row = PROJ_DEFAULT;
    }
    s = { cat: row[0], color: row[1], size: row[2], arc: row[3], h0: row[4] };
    if (s.cat === 'log' || s.cat === 'barrel-roll') {
      let card = null;
      if (CR.Sim && typeof CR.Sim.cardById === 'function') { try { card = CR.Sim.cardById(kind); } catch (e) { card = null; } }
      if (card && card.spell && typeof card.spell.width === 'number') s.size = card.spell.width;
    }
    projCache.set(kind, s);
    return s;
  };
  /** Impact category of an attacker (for hit sparks of instant / projectile hits). */
  VFX.attackCat = function (unitId) {
    if (!unitId) return 'melee';
    if (unitId.indexOf('inferno') >= 0) return 'inferno';
    if (unitId === 'tesla' || unitId.indexOf('electro') >= 0) return 'bolt';
    const p = PROJ[unitId];
    if (p) return p[0];
    return 'melee';
  };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Small helpers
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  function clamp(v, a, b) { return v < a ? a : (v > b ? b : v); }
  function smooth(e0, e1, x) { const t = clamp((x - e0) / (e1 - e0), 0, 1); return t * t * (3 - 2 * t); }
  let rs = 0x2545f491;
  function rnd() { rs ^= rs << 13; rs ^= rs >>> 17; rs ^= rs << 5; return ((rs >>> 0) % 1000003) / 1000003; }
  function rr(a, b) { return a + (b - a) * rnd(); }
  function hexR(h) { return ((h >> 16) & 255) / 255; }
  function hexG(h) { return ((h >> 8) & 255) / 255; }
  function hexB(h) { return (h & 255) / 255; }
  function mixHex(a, b, t) {
    const r = Math.round(((a >> 16) & 255) * (1 - t) + ((b >> 16) & 255) * t);
    const g = Math.round(((a >> 8) & 255) * (1 - t) + ((b >> 8) & 255) * t);
    const bl = Math.round((a & 255) * (1 - t) + (b & 255) * t);
    return (r << 16) | (g << 8) | bl;
  }
  VFX.mixHex = mixHex;
  function makeCanvas(w, h) {
    const d = G.document;
    let c = null;
    if (d && typeof d.createElement === 'function') { try { c = d.createElement('canvas'); } catch (e) { c = null; } }
    if (!c && typeof G.OffscreenCanvas === 'function') { try { c = new G.OffscreenCanvas(w, h); } catch (e) { c = null; } }
    if (!c) return null;
    c.width = w; c.height = h;
    return c;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Atlas painting (white sprites, tinted per particle)
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // v8: 256 px cells (1024 x 1024 atlas, mipmapped): big flames, smoke and stars stay crisp at
  // DPR 3; all hand-tuned pixel sizes below are scaled by K (authored at 128 px)
  const CELL = 256;
  const K = CELL / 128;
  function paintAtlas() {
    const cv = makeCanvas(CELL * 4, CELL * 4);
    if (!cv) return null;
    const g = cv.getContext('2d');
    g.clearRect(0, 0, cv.width, cv.height);
    const C = CELL, H = C / 2;
    let seed = 1234567;
    const rand = function () { seed = (seed * 16807) % 2147483647; return seed / 2147483647; };
    function cell(i, fn) {
      g.save();
      g.translate((i % 4) * C, Math.floor(i / 4) * C);
      g.beginPath(); g.rect(0, 0, C, C); g.clip();
      fn();
      g.restore();
    }
    function radial(x, y, r, stops) {
      const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r);
      for (let i = 0; i < stops.length; i += 2) gr.addColorStop(stops[i], stops[i + 1]);
      return gr;
    }
    function star(x, y, n, r0, r1, rot) {
      g.beginPath();
      for (let i = 0; i < n * 2; i++) {
        const a = rot + i * Math.PI / n;
        const r = i % 2 ? r1 : r0;
        if (i === 0) g.moveTo(x + Math.cos(a) * r, y + Math.sin(a) * r);
        else g.lineTo(x + Math.cos(a) * r, y + Math.sin(a) * r);
      }
      g.closePath();
    }
    // 0 glow
    cell(T_GLOW, function () {
      g.fillStyle = radial(H, H, H, [0, 'rgba(255,255,255,1)', 0.18, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)', 0.45, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.32)', 0.75, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)', 1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)']);
      g.fillRect(0, 0, C, C);
    });
    // 1 disc
    cell(T_DISC, function () {
      g.fillStyle = radial(H, H, H - 2 * K, [0, 'rgba(255,255,255,1)', 0.86, 'rgba(255,255,255,1)', 1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)']);
      g.fillRect(0, 0, C, C);
    });
    // 2 ring
    cell(T_RING, function () {
      g.fillStyle = radial(H, H, H - 1 * K, [0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)', 0.58, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)', 0.8, 'rgba(255,255,255,1)', 0.9, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.75)', 1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)']);
      g.fillRect(0, 0, C, C);
    });
    // 3 smoke puff
    cell(T_SMOKE, function () {
      for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
        const a = rand() * TAU, d = rand() * C * 0.16;
        const x = H + Math.cos(a) * d, y = H + Math.sin(a) * d, r = C * (0.2 + rand() * 0.16);
        g.fillStyle = radial(x, y, r, [0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.55)', 0.6, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)', 1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)']);
        g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, TAU); g.fill();
      }
      // darker underside for volume
      g.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-atop';
      const lg = g.createLinearGradient(0, C * 0.2, 0, C * 0.9);
      lg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); lg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(150,150,160,0.55)');
      g.fillStyle = lg; g.fillRect(0, 0, C, C);
      g.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
    });
    // 4 streak (vertical soft line, tapered)
    cell(T_STREAK, function () {
      const lg = g.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, C);
      lg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); lg.addColorStop(0.3, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)');
      lg.addColorStop(0.6, 'rgba(255,255,255,1)'); lg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
      g.fillStyle = lg;
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(H, 2 * K); g.quadraticCurveTo(H + C * 0.16, H, H, C - 2 * K); g.quadraticCurveTo(H - C * 0.16, H, H, 2 * K);
      g.fill();
      g.fillStyle = radial(H, H * 1.1, C * 0.12, [0, 'rgba(255,255,255,1)', 1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)']);
      g.fillRect(0, 0, C, C);
    });
    // 5 four-point star with glow
    cell(T_STAR4, function () {
      g.fillStyle = radial(H, H, H * 0.6, [0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)', 1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)']);
      g.fillRect(0, 0, C, C);
      g.fillStyle = '#fff';
      star(H, H, 4, H * 0.95, H * 0.16, -Math.PI / 2);
      g.fill();
    });
    // 6 five-point star (solid)
    cell(T_STAR5, function () {
      g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,1)';
      star(H, H + 3 * K, 5, H * 0.86, H * 0.4, -Math.PI / 2);
      g.fill();
      g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)'; g.lineWidth = 4 * K; g.stroke();
    });
    // 7 plus (heal)
    cell(T_PLUS, function () {
      g.fillStyle = radial(H, H, H * 0.9, [0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.55)', 1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)']);
      g.fillRect(0, 0, C, C);
      g.fillStyle = '#fff';
      const w = C * 0.17, l = C * 0.36;
      g.beginPath();
      g.rect(H - w, H - l, w * 2, l * 2); g.rect(H - l, H - w, l * 2, w * 2);
      g.fill();
    });
    // 8 snow flake / ice crystal
    cell(T_FLAKE, function () {
      g.fillStyle = radial(H, H, H * 0.7, [0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)', 1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)']);
      g.fillRect(0, 0, C, C);
      g.strokeStyle = '#fff'; g.lineCap = 'round';
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        const a = i * Math.PI / 3;
        const ex = H + Math.cos(a) * H * 0.82, ey = H + Math.sin(a) * H * 0.82;
        g.lineWidth = 9 * K;
        g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(H, H); g.lineTo(ex, ey); g.stroke();
        g.lineWidth = 6 * K;
        for (let k = 1; k <= 2; k++) {
          const t = 0.35 + k * 0.2;
          const bx = H + Math.cos(a) * H * 0.82 * t, by = H + Math.sin(a) * H * 0.82 * t;
          for (let s = -1; s <= 1; s += 2) {
            const b = a + s * 0.8;
            g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(bx, by); g.lineTo(bx + Math.cos(b) * H * 0.2, by + Math.sin(b) * H * 0.2); g.stroke();
          }
        }
      }
    });
    // 9 bubble
    cell(T_BUBBLE, function () {
      g.fillStyle = radial(H, H, H * 0.86, [0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)', 0.75, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)', 0.92, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.95)', 1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)']);
      g.beginPath(); g.arc(H, H, H * 0.86, 0, TAU); g.fill();
      g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.95)';
      g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(H - H * 0.32, H - H * 0.34, H * 0.18, H * 0.11, -0.7, 0, TAU); g.fill();
    });
    // 10 chunk (irregular rock/wood bit with shading)
    cell(T_CHUNK, function () {
      g.beginPath();
      const n = 7;
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const a = i * TAU / n + rand() * 0.4;
        const r = H * (0.6 + rand() * 0.3);
        if (i === 0) g.moveTo(H + Math.cos(a) * r, H + Math.sin(a) * r); else g.lineTo(H + Math.cos(a) * r, H + Math.sin(a) * r);
      }
      g.closePath();
      const lg = g.createLinearGradient(H * 0.3, H * 0.3, C * 0.85, C * 0.85);
      lg.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff'); lg.addColorStop(0.55, '#d8d8d8'); lg.addColorStop(1, '#8a8a8a');
      g.fillStyle = lg; g.fill();
      g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(60,60,60,0.9)'; g.lineWidth = 5 * K; g.stroke();
    });
    // 11 flame (teardrop)
    cell(T_FLAME, function () {
      g.save();
      g.translate(H, H * 1.15);
      g.scale(1, 1.45);
      g.fillStyle = radial(0, 0, H * 0.62, [0, 'rgba(255,255,255,1)', 0.45, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.75)', 1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)']);
      g.beginPath(); g.arc(0, 0, H * 0.62, 0, TAU); g.fill();
      g.restore();
      g.fillStyle = radial(H, H * 0.55, H * 0.3, [0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)', 1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)']);
      g.fillRect(0, 0, C, C);
    });
    // 12 cracks (branching jagged lines)
    cell(T_CRACK, function () {
      g.strokeStyle = '#fff'; g.lineCap = 'round'; g.lineJoin = 'round';
      function branch(x, y, a, len, w, depth) {
        g.lineWidth = w;
        g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x, y);
        let cx = x, cy = y;
        const steps = 4;
        for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
          a += (rand() - 0.5) * 0.9;
          cx += Math.cos(a) * len / steps; cy += Math.sin(a) * len / steps;
          g.lineTo(cx, cy);
        }
        g.stroke();
        if (depth > 0) {
          branch(cx, cy, a + 0.6, len * 0.55, w * 0.6, depth - 1);
          branch(cx, cy, a - 0.6, len * 0.5, w * 0.6, depth - 1);
        }
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) branch(H, H, i * TAU / 6 + rand() * 0.5, H * 0.5, 6 * K, 1);
    });
    // 13 scorch decal
    cell(T_SCORCH, function () {
      g.fillStyle = radial(H, H, H * 0.95, [0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.95)', 0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.75)', 0.8, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)', 1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)']);
      g.fillRect(0, 0, C, C);
      g.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-out';
      for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
        const a = rand() * TAU, d = H * (0.55 + rand() * 0.45), r = C * (0.03 + rand() * 0.07);
        g.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.8)';
        g.beginPath(); g.arc(H + Math.cos(a) * d, H + Math.sin(a) * d, r, 0, TAU); g.fill();
      }
      g.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
    });
    // 14 swirl (spiral arc)
    cell(T_SWIRL, function () {
      g.strokeStyle = '#fff'; g.lineCap = 'round';
      for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
        g.lineWidth = (7 - k * 1.5) * K;
        g.globalAlpha = 1 - k * 0.25;
        g.beginPath();
        for (let i = 0; i <= 40; i++) {
          const t = i / 40;
          const a = k * TAU / 3 + t * Math.PI * 1.4;
          const r = H * (0.15 + t * 0.75);
          const x = H + Math.cos(a) * r, y = H + Math.sin(a) * r;
          if (i === 0) g.moveTo(x, y); else g.lineTo(x, y);
        }
        g.stroke();
      }
      g.globalAlpha = 1;
    });
    // 15 shard (elongated diamond)
    cell(T_SHARD, function () {
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(H, 4 * K); g.lineTo(H + C * 0.15, H * 0.9); g.lineTo(H, C - 4 * K); g.lineTo(H - C * 0.15, H * 0.9);
      g.closePath();
      const lg = g.createLinearGradient(H - C * 0.15, 0, H + C * 0.15, 0);
      lg.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff'); lg.addColorStop(0.5, '#f0f0f0'); lg.addColorStop(1, '#a8a8a8');
      g.fillStyle = lg; g.fill();
    });
    return cv;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Shaders
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // v5 hill terrain profile (world z -> ground height), piecewise linear over 65 samples; the
  // renderer fills the same samples its terrain mesh uses (crHillP = (on, z0, 1 / dz)).
  const HILL_GLSL = [
    'uniform float crHillH[65];', 'uniform vec3 crHillP;',
    'float crHill(float wz) {',
    '  if (crHillP.x < 0.5) return 0.0;',
    '  float f = (wz - crHillP.y) * crHillP.z;',
    '  if (f <= 0.0 || f >= 64.0) return 0.0;',
    '  float fi = floor(f);',
    '  int i = int(fi);',
    '  return mix(crHillH[i], crHillH[i + 1], f - fi);',
    '}',
  ].join('\n');
  VFX.HILL_GLSL = HILL_GLSL;
  VFX.HILL_N = 64;
  function hillUniforms(THREE) {
    return { crHillH: { value: new Float32Array(65) }, crHillP: { value: new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1) } };
  }
  VFX.hillUniforms = hillUniforms;

  const PARTICLE_VS = [
    HILL_GLSL,
    'attribute vec4 iPS;', 'attribute vec4 iCol;', 'attribute vec4 iMisc;', 'attribute vec3 iDir;',
    'varying vec2 vUv;', 'varying vec4 vCol;', 'varying float vAdd;',
    'void main() {',
    '  float mode = iMisc.z;',
    '  float add = step(3.5, mode);',
    '  mode -= add * 4.0;',
    '  vec2 c = position.xy;',
    '  float s = sin(iMisc.x), co = cos(iMisc.x);',
    '  vec2 rc = vec2(c.x * co - c.y * s, c.x * s + c.y * co);',
    '  if (mode < 0.5) {',
    '    vec4 mv = viewMatrix * vec4(iPS.xyz, 1.0);',
    '    mv.xy += rc * iPS.w;',
    '    gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mv;',
    '  } else if (mode < 1.5) {',
    '    vec3 wp = iPS.xyz + vec3(rc.x, 0.0, rc.y) * iPS.w;',
    '    wp.y += crHill(wp.z) - crHill(iPS.z);',
    '    gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * vec4(wp, 1.0);',
    '  } else {',
    '    vec4 mv = viewMatrix * vec4(iPS.xyz, 1.0);',
    '    vec3 vd = (viewMatrix * vec4(iDir, 0.0)).xyz;',
    '    vec2 d = vd.xy;',
    '    float dl = length(d);',
    '    d = dl > 1e-5 ? d / dl : vec2(0.0, 1.0);',
    '    vec2 n = vec2(-d.y, d.x);',
    '    mv.xy += d * c.y * iPS.w * iMisc.w + n * c.x * iPS.w;',
    '    gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mv;',
    '  }',
    '  float tile = iMisc.y;',
    '  vec2 t = vec2(mod(tile, 4.0), 3.0 - floor(tile / 4.0));',
    '  vUv = (t + uv) * 0.25;',
    '  vCol = iCol;',
    '  vAdd = add;',
    '}',
  ].join('\n');
  const PARTICLE_FS = [
    'uniform sampler2D uMap;',
    'varying vec2 vUv;', 'varying vec4 vCol;', 'varying float vAdd;',
    'void main() {',
    '  vec4 tx = texture2D(uMap, vUv);',
    '  float a = tx.a * vCol.a;',
    '  if (a < 0.003) discard;',
    '  gl_FragColor = vec4(tx.rgb * vCol.rgb * a, a * (1.0 - vAdd));',
    '}',
  ].join('\n');

  const RIBBON_VS = [
    'attribute vec4 aCol;', 'attribute vec3 aUv;',
    'varying vec4 vCol;', 'varying vec3 vUv;',
    'void main() { vCol = aCol; vUv = aUv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0); }',
  ].join('\n');
  const RIBBON_FS = [
    'varying vec4 vCol;', 'varying vec3 vUv;',
    'void main() {',
    '  float d = abs(vUv.y * 2.0 - 1.0);',
    '  float glow = pow(max(0.0, 1.0 - d), 1.6);',
