    // core < -0.5: "solid" ribbon (alpha-blended true colour + white core, e.g. team-coloured
    // swing smears that must read on the green grass); otherwise additive glow
    '  float sv = step(vUv.z, -0.5);',
    // core < -1.5: solid ribbon WITHOUT the white core (v7 dark slash wave / dark smears)
    '  float core = smoothstep(0.42, 0.0, d) * mix(vUv.z, 0.85, sv) * (1.0 - step(vUv.z, -1.5));',
    '  vec3 c = mix(vCol.rgb, vec3(1.0), core);',
    '  float a = clamp(mix(glow, smoothstep(1.0, 0.55, d), sv) * vCol.a + core * vCol.a, 0.0, 1.0);',
    '  gl_FragColor = vec4(c * a, a * sv);',
    '}',
  ].join('\n');

  // Area ground disc: pattern per kind (uKind), premultiplied output.
  const AREA_VS = [
    HILL_GLSL,
    'uniform float uDome;',
    'varying vec2 vP;', 'varying vec3 vN;', 'varying vec3 vV;',
    'void main() {',
    '  vP = position.xz;',
    '  vec4 wp = modelMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);',
    '  wp.y += uDome > 0.5 ? crHill(modelMatrix[3].z) : crHill(wp.z);',
    '  vN = normalize(mat3(modelMatrix) * normal);',
    '  vV = normalize(cameraPosition - wp.xyz);',
    '  gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * wp;',
    '}',
  ].join('\n');
  const AREA_FS = [
    'uniform vec3 uC1;', 'uniform vec3 uC2;', 'uniform float uT;', 'uniform float uA;', 'uniform float uK;', 'uniform float uP;', 'uniform float uDome;',
    'varying vec2 vP;', 'varying vec3 vN;', 'varying vec3 vV;',
    'float h21(vec2 p) { p = fract(p * vec2(123.34, 456.21)); p += dot(p, p + 45.32); return fract(p.x * p.y); }',
    'float vn(vec2 p) { vec2 i = floor(p), f = fract(p); f = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);',
    '  return mix(mix(h21(i), h21(i + vec2(1.0, 0.0)), f.x), mix(h21(i + vec2(0.0, 1.0)), h21(i + vec2(1.0, 1.0)), f.x), f.y); }',
    'float fbm(vec2 p) { return vn(p) * 0.6 + vn(p * 2.1 + 3.7) * 0.3 + vn(p * 4.3 + 7.1) * 0.1; }',
    'void main() {',
    '  float r = length(vP);',
    '  float an = atan(vP.y, vP.x);',
    '  float a = 0.0; float hi = 0.0;',
    '  if (uDome > 0.5) {',
    '    float fr = 1.0 - abs(dot(normalize(vN), normalize(vV)));',
    '    float band = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(vP.y * 9.0 + uT * 3.0 + an * 2.0);',
    '    float n = fbm(vec2(an * 2.0, vN.y * 3.0 - uT * 0.6));',
    '    a = pow(fr, 2.2) * 0.85 + 0.12 * band * fr + 0.1 * n;',
    '    hi = pow(fr, 4.0) * 0.6;',
    '    if (uK > 0.5 && uK < 1.5) { a += 0.1 * smoothstep(0.6, 0.9, n); }',
    '    if (uK > 1.5 && uK < 2.5) { a = pow(fr, 1.6) * 0.95 + 0.18 * smoothstep(0.55, 0.8, fbm(vec2(an * 4.0, vN.y * 5.0))); hi = pow(fr, 3.0); }',
    '    if (uK > 3.5 && uK < 4.5) {',
    '      float sp = fract((an / 6.2832) * 3.0 + vN.y * 1.6 - uT * 1.4);',
    '      a = smoothstep(0.0, 0.25, sp) * smoothstep(0.65, 0.3, sp) * 0.75 * (0.3 + 0.7 * fr);',
    '      hi = a * 0.4;',
    '    }',
    '  } else {',
    '    float edge = smoothstep(0.86, 0.97, r) * smoothstep(1.0, 0.97, r);',
    '    float fill = smoothstep(1.0, 0.9, r);',
    '    if (uK < 0.5) { a = edge + fill * 0.12; }',
    '    else if (uK < 1.5) {',
    '      float n = fbm(vP * 2.6 + vec2(uT * 0.25, -uT * 0.18));',
    '      float b = smoothstep(0.55, 0.75, fbm(vP * 4.5 - uT * 0.4));',
    '      a = fill * (0.28 + 0.3 * n) + edge * 0.9 + fill * b * 0.25; hi = fill * b * 0.25 + edge * 0.3;',
    '    } else if (uK < 2.5) {',
    '      float n = fbm(vec2(an * 3.0, r * 6.0));',
    '      float cr = smoothstep(0.08, 0.0, abs(fract(an * 1.9 + n * 0.9) - 0.5) - 0.42 + r * 0.02);',
    '      a = fill * (0.38 + 0.25 * n) + edge + fill * cr * 0.5; hi = cr * fill * 0.6 + edge * 0.5;',
    '    } else if (uK < 3.5) {',
    '      float pulse = fract(r * 1.2 - uT * 0.9);',
    '      float ring = smoothstep(0.0, 0.06, pulse) * smoothstep(0.22, 0.06, pulse);',
    '      a = fill * (0.2 + ring * 0.45) + edge; hi = ring * fill * 0.4;',
    '    } else if (uK < 4.5) {',
    '      float sp = fract(an / 6.2832 * 4.0 + r * 2.2 - uT * 1.6);',
    '      float arm = smoothstep(0.0, 0.2, sp) * smoothstep(0.55, 0.2, sp);',
    '      a = fill * (0.15 + arm * 0.55 * (0.4 + r)) + edge * 0.7; hi = arm * fill * 0.35;',
    '    } else if (uK < 5.5) {',
    '      vec2 q = vP * 2.2;',
    '      float n = fbm(q * 1.4);',
    '      float cr = smoothstep(0.035, 0.0, abs(fract(n * 5.0 + r * 0.6) - 0.5) - 0.44);',
    '      a = fill * (0.22 + cr * 0.9) + edge * 0.6; hi = 0.0;',
    '    } else if (uK < 6.5) {',
    '      float n = fbm(vP * 1.8 + vec2(uT * 0.2, uT * 0.12));',
    '      a = fill * (0.35 + 0.35 * n) + edge * 0.5; hi = fill * smoothstep(0.65, 0.85, n) * 0.3;',
    '    } else if (uK < 7.5) {',
    '      float pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(uT * 6.0 - r * 7.0);',
    '      a = fill * (0.15 + 0.25 * pulse * (1.0 - r)) + edge * 0.8; hi = fill * pulse * 0.25;',
    '    } else if (uK < 8.5) {',
    '      float blink = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(uT * (8.0 + uP * 18.0));',
    '      float inner = smoothstep(uP + 0.02, uP - 0.02, r);',
    '      a = edge * (0.6 + 0.4 * blink) + inner * 0.3 + fill * 0.1; hi = edge * blink * 0.4;',
    '    } else if (uK < 9.5) {',
    '      float rr = 1.0 - uP * 0.75;',
    '      float ring = smoothstep(0.06, 0.0, abs(r - rr));',
    '      float cross = (smoothstep(0.05, 0.0, abs(vP.x)) + smoothstep(0.05, 0.0, abs(vP.y))) * smoothstep(rr, rr * 0.6, r);',
    '      a = ring + edge * 0.6 + cross * 0.6 + fill * 0.12; hi = ring * 0.5;',
    '    } else {',
    '      float n = vn(vec2(an * 6.0, r * 8.0 - uT * 2.0));',
    '      a = fill * (0.2 + 0.3 * n) + edge; hi = edge * 0.5;',
    '    }',
    '  }',
    '  a = clamp(a * uA, 0.0, 1.0);',
    '  if (a < 0.003) discard;',
    '  vec3 c = mix(uC1, uC2, clamp(hi * 2.0, 0.0, 1.0));',
    '  gl_FragColor = vec4(c * a, a * 0.85);',
    '}',
  ].join('\n');

  // Area kinds -> shader kind index + colours + dome

    zap: [AK_SHIMMER, 0x7fe8ff, 0xffffff, 0],
    clone: [AK_SHIMMER, 0x4ad8ff, 0xffffff, 0],

    return d;

          crHillH: this.hill.crHillH, crHillP: this.hill.crHillP,
        },
        vertexShader: AREA_VS, fragmentShader: AREA_FS,
        transparent: true, depthWrite: false, depthTest: true, side: THREE.DoubleSide,
        blending: THREE.CustomBlending, blendEquation: THREE.AddEquation,

      this.zapNext = 0;

      this.gh = typeof fn === 'function' ? fn : null;

      if (this.gh && uniforms && uniforms.crHillH && uniforms.crHillP) {

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ primitives
    emit(name, x, y, z, scale, count, col, col1) {
      const pr = typeof name === 'string' ? PRE[name] : name;
      if (!pr) return;
      let n = count >= 0 ? count : pr.n;
      if (this.q < 1 && n > 2) n = Math.max(1, Math.round(n * this.q));
      this.parts.emit(pr, x, y, z, scale, n, col === undefined ? -1 : col, col1 === undefined ? -1 : col1);
    }
    sprite(x, y, z, size, col, alpha, tile, add, mode, rot) {
      this.parts.sprite(x, y, z, size, col, alpha, tile === undefined ? T_GLOW : tile, mode || M_BB, add === undefined ? 1 : add, rot || 0);
    }
    zap(x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1, col, width, dur, jag, core) {
      if (this.gh !== null) { const g0 = this.gh(x0, z0), g1 = this.gh(x1, z1); if (y0 < g0) y0 += g0; if (y1 < g1) y1 += g1; }
      const z = this.zaps[this.zapNext];

      z.on = true; z.x0 = x0; z.y0 = y0; z.z0 = z0; z.x1 = x1; z.y1 = y1; z.z1 = z1;
      z.col = col; z.w = width; z.t0 = this.t; z.dur = dur; z.jag = jag === undefined ? 1 : jag; z.core = core === undefined ? 1 : core;
      const dx = x1 - x0, dy = y1 - y0, dz = z1 - z0;

    beam(x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1, col, width, jag, core) {

      const dx = x1 - x0, dy = y1 - y0, dz = z1 - z0;

    /** Named one-shot effects. x,y,z = world position; s = scale (~radius in tiles); c = colour override. */

        case 'hitHeavy':

        case 'hitSmall': E.emit('sparks', x, y, z, 0.7 * s, 4); E.emit('hitFlash', x, y, z, 0.45 * s); break;
        case 'slash': E.emit('sparks', x, y, z, s, 6, 0xffffff, 0xb0c8ff); E.emit('hitStar', x, y, z, s, 1, 0xdfe8ff); break;
        case 'arrowHit': E.burst('hitSmall', x, y, z, s); E.emit('hitFlash', x, y, z, 0.55 * s); E.emit('planks', x, y, z, 0.35 * s, 3); break;
        case 'fireHit':
          E.emit('fireCore', x, y, z, 0.45 * s, 7); E.emit('embers', x, y, z, 0.5 * s, 5); E.emit('hitFlash', x, y, z, 0.9 * s, 1, 0xffd080); break;
        case 'fireSplash':
          E.emit('boomFlash', x, y, z, 0.45 * s); E.emit('fireCore', x, y, z, 0.55 * s, 10); E.emit('embers', x, y, z, 0.6 * s, 8);
          E.emit('shock', x, 0.06, z, 0.4 * s, 1, 0xffb060); E.emit('smoke', x, y, z, 0.5 * s, 4); break;
        case 'boltHit':
          E.emit('zapSparks', x, y, z, 0.8 * s, 8); E.emit('zapGlow', x, y, z, 0.6 * s); break;
        case 'iceHit':

        case 'orbHit':
          E.emit('sparkle', x, y, z, 0.45 * s, 6, c >= 0 ? c : 0xffffff, c >= 0 ? c : 0xc25bff); E.emit('hitFlash', x, y, z, 0.6 * s, 1, c >= 0 ? c : 0xe0a0ff); break;
        case 'cannonHit':

        case 'explosion':

          E.emit('boomSmoke', x, y + 0.2, z, s, 10); E.emit('shock', x, 0.06, z, s); E.emit('debris', x, 0.2, z, 0.8 * s, 10);

          E.emit('boomSmoke', x, y + 0.3, z, s * 1.2, 16); E.emit('shock', x, 0.06, z, s * 1.2); E.emit('shock', x, 0.08, z, s * 0.7, 1, 0xffffff);
          E.emit('debris', x, 0.2, z, s, 16); E.emit('scorch', x, 0, z, s * 1.1); E.emit('dustRing', x, 0.05, z, s * 1.4);

          E.emit('shock', x, 0.06, z, s, 1, 0xfff0c0); E.emit('debris', x, 0.2, z, s * 0.7, 8); E.emit('scorch', x, 0, z, s * 0.8);
          break;

        case 'deployBig':

        case 'land':

        case 'slam':

          E.emit('dust', x, 0.05, z, s * 0.9, 18); E.emit('debris', x, 0.1, z, s * 0.6, 12, 0x8a7a5a);

        case 'collapse':

          }
          for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {

          }

        case 'freeze':

          E.emit('shock', x, 0.06, z, s, 1, 0xbff0ff); E.emit('snow', x, 0.3, z, s * 0.6, 10, 0xeaffff); break;
        case 'frostNova':
          E.emit('frost', x, 0.5, z, s * 0.8, 14); E.emit('shock', x, 0.06, z, s, 1, 0xbff0ff); E.emit('snow', x, 0.3, z, s * 0.5, 8); E.emit('iceShards', x, 0.3, z, s * 0.6, 8); break;
        case 'elecNova':
          E.emit('zapGlow', x, 0.6, z, s); E.emit('shock', x, 0.06, z, s, 1, 0x9fe8ff); E.emit('zapSparks', x, 0.5, z, s, 14);
          for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) { const a = i * TAU / 7 + rnd() * 0.4; E.zap(x, 0.6, z, x + Math.cos(a) * s, 0.15, z + Math.sin(a) * s, 0x9fe8ff, 0.2, 0.3, 1.3, 1); }
          break;
        case 'fireNova':
          E.emit('boomFlash', x, 0.6, z, s * 0.8, 1, 0xffd080); E.emit('fireCore', x, 0.5, z, s * 0.8, 18); E.emit('embers', x, 0.5, z, s, 14); E.emit('shock', x, 0.06, z, s, 1, 0xffa040); break;
        case 'snowball':
          E.emit('snow', x, 0.4, z, s, 22); E.emit('snowChunks', x, 0.4, z, s * 0.7, 12); E.emit('shock', x, 0.06, z, s, 1, 0xffffff); E.emit('frost', x, 0.5, z, s * 0.6, 8); break;

        case 'cast': E.emit('shock', x, 0.06, z, s, 1, c >= 0 ? c : 0xffffff); E.emit('rise', x, 0.1, z, s * 0.8, 10, c >= 0 ? c : 0xffffff); break;
        case 'heal': E.emit('heal', x, 0.2, z, s, 6); break;
        case 'elixir':
          E.emit('sparkle', x, 1.2, z, 0.6, 10, 0xffffff, 0xd64ee8); E.emit('rise', x, 0.8, z, 0.5, 6, 0xe070ff); E.emit('hitFlash', x, 1.4, z, 0.9, 1, 0xe070ff); break;

          E.emit('sparkle', x, 1, z, s, 22, 0xffffff, col); E.emit('rise', x, 0.2, z, s, 16, col); E.emit('hitFlash', x, 1.2, z, s * 2, 1, col);

      }
    }

    /** Element-specific part of a C.H.A.O.S ability (on top of the rarity burst). */
    _abilityFlavor(kind, x, y, z, R, ev, ctx) {
      const el = ABILITY_ELEMENT[kind] || '';
      const hy = y + 0.6;
      switch (el) {
        case 'fire': this.burst(R > 1.6 ? 'explosion' : 'fireSplash', x, Math.max(0.4, hy), z, R); break;
        case 'elec': this.burst('elecNova', x, 0, z, R); break;
        case 'ice': this.burst('frostNova', x, 0, z, R); break;
        case 'poison': this.emit('bubbles', x, 0.1, z, R, 10); this.emit('shock', x, 0.06, z, R, 1, 0x9be340); this.emit('smoke', x, 0.3, z, R * 0.5, 5, 0x7ab828, 0xa8e060); break;
        case 'wind': this.emit('shock', x, 0.06, z, R, 1, 0xe8f4ff); this.emit('dust', x, 0.05, z, R * 0.6, 12); break;
        case 'slam': this.burst('slam', x, 0, z, R); break;
        case 'holy': this.emit('heal', x, 0.2, z, R, 10); this.emit('shock', x, 0.06, z, R, 1, 0xffe680); this.emit('rise', x, 0.1, z, R, 10, 0xffe680); break;
        case 'spawn': this.burst('poof', x, 0.4, z, Math.max(1, R * 0.7)); this.emit('dustRing', x, 0.04, z, R); break;
        case 'wood': this.burst('woodBurst', x, 0.4, z, Math.max(1, R * 0.7)); break;
        case 'dark': this.emit('smoke', x, 0.3, z, R * 0.6, 10, 0x2a2040, 0x4a3a6a); this.emit('sparkle', x, 0.6, z, R * 0.6, 10, 0xffffff, 0x9a86ff); break;
        default: break;
      }
      // directed abilities (dash, throw, chain, pierce, ...) get a streak to their target point
      if (typeof ev.tx === 'number' && typeof ev.ty === 'number' && ctx) {
        const tx = ctx.wx(ev.tx), tz = ctx.wz(ev.ty);
        if (el === 'elec') this.zap(x, hy, z, tx, 0.6, tz, 0x9fe8ff, 0.3, 0.3, 1.2, 1);
        else this.zap(x, hy, z, tx, 0.6, tz, RARITY[clamp(tierOf(ev) || 3, 1, 4)], 0.35, 0.35, 0.15, 1);
        this.emit('hitFlash', tx, 0.6, tz, 1.1, 1, RARITY[clamp(tierOf(ev) || 3, 1, 4)]);
      }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ v6 card abilities
    /**
     * Abilities of the v6 cards (sim events {t:'ability', kind, unitId|id|src, x, y, tx, ty,
     * targets: [id | {id, x, y, air}], ...}): 'chain' (Elektrodrache), 'dash' / 'combo' /
     * 'one-inch' (Kung-Fu-Legende). Returns true when handled (no C.H.A.O.S rarity burst).
     */
    _cardAbility(ev, ctx) {
      const kind = ev.kind;
      if (V7_KINDS[kind] === 1 && !(ev.rarity || ev.tier)) return this._v7Ability(ev, ctx);
      if (V12_KINDS[kind] === 1 && !(ev.rarity || ev.tier)) { this._v12Ability(ev, ctx); return true; }
      if (kind !== 'chain' && kind !== 'dash' && kind !== 'combo' && kind !== 'one-inch') {
        // v12: card abilities without a C.H.A.O.S rarity (the custom cards' extra abilities) get a
        // compact effect at the unit (element flavour + team ring) - no chaos pillar, no badge
        if (!tierOf(ev) && !ev.upgrade && !ev.option && !ev.chaos && typeof kind === 'string' && kind) { this._cardAbilityLite(ev, ctx); return true; }
        return false;
      }
      const uid = ev.unitId || ev.id || ev.src;
      const e = uid ? ctx.ent(uid) : null;
      const unit = ev.unit || (e && e.unit) || ev.card || '';
      if (unit !== 'electro-dragon' && unit !== 'kung-fu-legend') return false;
      if (ev.rarity || ev.tier) return false;      // a C.H.A.O.S upgrade of these cards keeps its own look
      const side = ev.side === 1 ? 1 : 0;
      const team = ctx.team(side), TC = TEAM[team === 1 ? 1 : 0];
      const sx = e ? e.x : ctx.wx(+ev.x || 0), sz = e ? e.z : ctx.wz(+ev.y || 0);
      const sy = e ? e.y + e.h * 0.55 : 0.8;
      const tl = this._targetsOf(ev, ctx);
      if (kind === 'chain') {
        if (!tl.length) return true;
        for (let i = 0; i < tl.length; i++) this._chainAdd(uid, e, tl[i].x, tl[i].y, tl[i].z, true, team, i === 0 ? { x: sx, y: sy, z: sz } : null);
        return true;
      }
      // direction of the move (towards the target, else the unit's facing)
      let tx = sx, ty = sy, tz = sz - 1;
      if (tl.length) { tx = tl[0].x; ty = tl[0].y; tz = tl[0].z; }
      let dx = tx - sx, dz = tz - sz;
      const dl = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz) || 1;
      dx /= dl; dz /= dl;
      if (kind === 'dash') {
        const h = (e ? e.h : 1.4) * 0.55 + 0.35;
        if (ev.phase === 'start') {
          // take-off: dust kick-up, a gold flash and a first burst of speed lines
          this.emit('dust', sx, 0.05, sz, 0.7, 8);
          this.emit('dustRing', sx, 0.05, sz, 1.0);
          this.emit('hitFlash', sx, h, sz, 0.8, 1, 0xffe9a0);
          for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) this.emit('speedLine', sx - dx * 0.3 * i, h + rr(-0.3, 0.3), sz - dz * 0.3 * i, 1.2, 1);
          return true;
        }
        // flying kick impact: yellow speed streak from the take-off to the target, after-images
        const x0 = typeof ev.tx === 'number' ? ctx.wx(ev.tx) : sx - dx * 3, z0 = typeof ev.ty === 'number' ? ctx.wz(ev.ty) : sz - dz * 3;
        this.zap(x0, h, z0, tx, h, tz, 0xffd84a, 0.6 * this.uk, 0.4, 0, 0.55);
        this.zap(x0, h, z0, tx, h, tz, 0xffffff, 0.22 * this.uk, 0.3, 0, 1);
        const n = Math.max(3, Math.min(7, Math.round(dl * 1.2)));
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          const k = (i + 0.5) / n;
          const j = this.parts.one(x0 + (tx - x0) * k, h, z0 + (tz - z0) * k, 0, 0, 0, 0.22 + 0.25 * k, 0.9 * this.uk, 0.5 * this.uk, 0xffe066, TC.light, 0.55, T_GLOW, M_BB, 1, 0, 0, 1);
          this.parts.fin[j] = 0.01;
          this.emit('speedLine', x0 + (tx - x0) * k, h + rr(-0.3, 0.3), z0 + (tz - z0) * k, 1.2, 1);
        }
        this.emit('dust', x0, 0.05, z0, 0.6, 6);
        this.burst('hitHeavy', tx, Math.max(0.6, ty), tz, this.uk);
        this.emit('hitStar', tx, Math.max(0.6, ty), tz, 1.3 * this.uk, 1, 0xffe14a);
        this.emit('shock', tx, 0.06, tz, 1.0, 1, TC.light);
        this.shake(0.2, 0.16);
        return true;
      }
      if (kind === 'combo') {
        // combo hit 1 / 2 of 3: wordless combo pips (1 or 2 gold stars) pop above the target,
        // plus fist after-images in front of the fighter (the hit sparks come with the hit event)
        const nHit = clamp(ev.hit | 0, 1, 2);
        const top = Math.max(1.2, ty + 0.9);
        for (let i = 0; i < nHit; i++) {
          const ox = (i - (nHit - 1) / 2) * 0.42;
          const j = this.parts.one(tx - dz * ox, top, tz + dx * ox, 0, 1.1, 0, 0.5, 0.42 * this.uk, 0.3 * this.uk, 0xffe14a, 0xffffff, 1, T_STAR5, M_BB, 1, 0, 2.5, 1);
          this.parts.fin[j] = 0.01; this.parts.fout[j] = 0.35;
        }
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
          const ox = -dz * (i & 1 ? 0.22 : -0.22);
          const j = this.parts.one(sx + dx * 0.55 + ox, sy + 0.05 * i, sz + dz * 0.55 + dx * (i & 1 ? 0.22 : -0.22), dx * 2, 0, dz * 2, 0.18, 0.4, 0.25, 0xfff1b0, 0xffd84a, 0.7, T_GLOW, M_BB, 1, 0, 2, 1);
          this.parts.fin[j] = 0.01;
        }
        return true;
      }
      // one-inch punch: point-blank shockwave + knockback blast along the punch line
      const py = Math.max(0.55, ty);
      this.emit('boomFlash', tx, py, tz, 0.9 * this.uk, 1, 0xfff4c0);
      this.emit('hitStar', tx, py, tz, 1.6 * this.uk, 1, 0xffffff);
      this.emit('shock', tx, 0.07, tz, 1.4, 1, 0xffe9a0);
      this.emit('hitRing', tx, 0.07, tz, 1.1, 1, TC.light);
      this._later.push({ at: this.t + 0.09, k: 'ring', x: tx, y: 0.07, z: tz, s: 2.0, c: 0xffffff });
      this._later.push({ at: this.t + 0.18, k: 'ring', x: tx + dx * 0.6, y: 0.07, z: tz + dz * 0.6, s: 2.4, c: TC.light });
      for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
        const a = rr(-0.45, 0.45), cs = Math.cos(a), sn = Math.sin(a);
        const vx = (dx * cs - dz * sn) * rr(7, 12), vz = (dz * cs + dx * sn) * rr(7, 12);
        this.parts.one(tx, py + rr(-0.2, 0.3), tz, vx, rr(-0.5, 1.5), vz, rr(0.14, 0.24), 0.12, 0.06, 0xffffff, 0xffd84a, 0.95, T_STREAK, M_STRETCH, 1, 0, 4, 8);
      }
      // a ripple through the air in front of the fist
      this.emit('zapGlow', sx + dx * 0.5, sy, sz + dz * 0.5, 0.6, 1, 0xfff0b0);
      this.emit('dust', tx, 0.05, tz, 0.9, 10);
      this.shake(0.35, 0.22);
      this.flash(0xfff4d0, 0.08, 0.12);
      return true;
    }

    /** v12 generic card ability: element flavour (by kind) + a team-coloured shock ring + flash,
     *  throttled per unit and kind. */
    _cardAbilityLite(ev, ctx) {
      const uid = ev.unitId || ev.id || ev.src;
      const e = uid ? ctx.ent(uid) : null;
      const team = ctx.team(ev.side === 1 ? 1 : 0);
      const atPt = typeof ev.x === 'number' && (ABILITY_AT_POINT[ev.kind] === 1 || !e);
      const x = atPt ? ctx.wx(ev.x) : e.x, z = atPt ? ctx.wz(+ev.y || 0) : e.z, y = e && !atPt ? e.y : 0, h = e ? e.h : 1.4;
      const key = (uid || 0) + ':' + ev.kind;
      if (this.t - (this._abilT.get(key) || -9) < 0.3) return;
      this._abilT.set(key, this.t);
      if (this._abilT.size > 300) this._abilT.clear();
      const R = typeof ev.radius === 'number' && ev.radius > 0 ? Math.min(4, ev.radius) : 1.2;
      const TC = TEAM[team === 1 ? 1 : 0];
      this._abilityFlavor(ev.kind, x, y, z, R, ev, ctx);
      this.emit('teamRing', x, 0.07, z, Math.max(0.7, R * 0.8), 1, TC.light);
      this.emit('hitFlash', x, y + h * 0.5, z, 0.9, 1, TC.light);
    }

    /**
     * v12 extra abilities of the custom cards ({t:'ability', base: true, kind, unitId, x, y, tx, ty}):
     *  'shadow_clone' (Wirbel-Ninja; phase 'spawn' with units [ids]: ninja smoke puff at the caster,
     *    the clones get theirs when they appear (renderer 'clonePoof'); phase 'fade': puff where a
     *    clone vanishes), 'dodge' (Kung-Fu-Legende evades a shot: white after-images to the side),
     *  'whirlwind' (Kung-Fu-Legende spinning kick: swirl ring + tangential streaks), 'parry'
     *  (Schwarzklingen-Meister: steel clash sparks between blade and attacker, riposte arc),
     *  'lock_on' (Cyborg-Jaeger: red reticle ring on the target, bigger per stack). Compact,
     *  throttled per unit + kind (attack / ability effects only, nothing while walking).
     */
    _v12Ability(ev, ctx) {
      const kind = ev.kind;
      const uid = ev.unitId || ev.id || ev.src;
      const e = uid ? ctx.ent(uid) : null;
      const team = ctx.team(ev.side === 1 ? 1 : 0), TC = TEAM[team === 1 ? 1 : 0];
      const px = typeof ev.x === 'number' ? ctx.wx(ev.x) : (e ? e.x : 0), pz = typeof ev.y === 'number' ? ctx.wz(ev.y) : (e ? e.z : 0);
      const sx = e ? e.x : px, sz = e ? e.z : pz, h = e ? e.h : 1.4, by = e ? e.y : 0;
      const key = (uid || 0) + ':' + kind + ':' + (ev.phase || '');
      if (this.t - (this._abilT.get(key) || -9) < (kind === 'lock_on' ? 0.15 : 0.3)) return;
      this._abilT.set(key, this.t);
      if (this._abilT.size > 300) this._abilT.clear();
      const hasT = typeof ev.tx === 'number' && typeof ev.ty === 'number';
      const tx = hasT ? ctx.wx(ev.tx) : sx, tz = hasT ? ctx.wz(ev.ty) : sz;
      switch (kind) {
        case 'shadow_clone': {
          if (ev.phase === 'fade') { this.burst('clonePoof', px, 0, pz, 0.8); return; }
          this.burst('clonePoof', sx, 0, sz, 1.2);
          this.emit('shock', sx, 0.06, sz, 1.1, 1, 0xcfe0ff);
          const L = ev.clones || ev.positions;
          if (Array.isArray(L)) for (let i = 0; i < L.length && i < 8; i++) { const c = L[i]; if (c && typeof c.x === 'number' && typeof c.y === 'number') this.burst('clonePoof', ctx.wx(c.x), 0, ctx.wz(c.y), 1); }
          return;
        }
        case 'dodge': {
          // sidestep: two fading after-images to the side away from the shot + a white whiff
          let dx = sx - tx, dz = sz - tz;
          const l = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz) || 1;
          dx /= l; dz /= l;
          const nx = -dz, nz = dx, y = by + h * 0.5;
          for (let i = 1; i <= 2; i++) {
            const j = this.parts.one(sx + nx * 0.35 * i, y, sz + nz * 0.35 * i, nx * 1.5, 0, nz * 1.5, 0.22, h * 0.5 * this.uk, h * 0.42 * this.uk, 0xffffff, TC.light, 0.42 / i, T_GLOW, M_BB, 1, 0, 0, 1);
            this.parts.fin[j] = 0.01;
          }
          this.emit('hitStar', sx - dx * 0.3, y, sz - dz * 0.3, 0.6 * this.uk, 1, 0xffffff);
          return;
        }
        case 'whirlwind': {
          const R = typeof ev.radius === 'number' && ev.radius > 0 ? Math.min(3, ev.radius) : 1.6;
          this.emit('hitRing', sx, 0.06, sz, R * 0.9, 1, 0xffe9a0);
          this.emit('teamRing', sx, 0.07, sz, R * 0.75, 1, TC.light);
          this.emit('dustRing', sx, 0.05, sz, R * 0.8);
          if (typeof this.swing === 'function') this.swing(sx, by + h * 0.35, sz, 1, 0, R * 0.8, TC.light, 0.28 * this.uk, 0.22, TAU);
          for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            const a = i / 10 * TAU, cx = Math.cos(a), cz = Math.sin(a);
            this.parts.one(sx + cx * R * 0.7, by + rr(0.2, h * 0.5), sz + cz * R * 0.7, -cz * 7, 0, cx * 7, rr(0.12, 0.2), 0.1, 0.05, 0xffffff, 0xffd84a, 0.9, T_STREAK, M_STRETCH, 1, 0, 3, 7);
          }
          this.shake(0.15, 0.12);
          return;
        }
        case 'parry': {
          // clash point between the blade and the attacker
          const cx = sx + (tx - sx) * 0.45, cz = sz + (tz - sz) * 0.45, y = by + h * 0.55;
          this.emit('hitFlash', cx, y, cz, 1.0, 1, 0xd8c8ff);
          this.emit('hitStar', cx, y, cz, 1.1 * this.uk, 1, 0xffffff);
          this.emit('sparks', cx, y, cz, 1.0, 10, 0xffffff, 0xb48cff);
          if (+ev.riposte > 0 && hasT) {
            let dx = tx - sx, dz = tz - sz;
            const l = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz) || 1;
            if (typeof this.swing === 'function') this.swing(sx, y, sz, dx / l, dz / l, Math.min(1.6, l), 0x9a6cff, 0.3 * this.uk, 0.2, 2.2);
          }
          return;
        }
        case 'lock_on': {
          // engine: x, y = target, tx, ty = the shooter; stacks 1..max
          const k = clamp(+ev.stacks || 1, 1, 4);
          this.emit('hitRing', px, 0.07, pz, 0.45 + 0.12 * k, 1, 0xff3020);
          this.emit('hitFlash', px, 0.5, pz, 0.35 + 0.08 * k, 1, 0xff4a30);
          return;
        }
        default: return;
      }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ v7 cards
    /**
     * v7 ability events ({t:'ability', kind, unitId, x, y, tx, ty, ...}, docs V7 contract):
     * 'shotgun' (Cyborg-Jäger blast: muzzle flash, spread pellets, smoke), 'pump' (reload: smoke
     * wisp + ejected red shell), 'endoskeleton' (the chrome skeleton rises: sparks fountain,
     * cracks, jacket shreds, red arcs), 'champion_slash' (Schwarzklingen-Meister: a huge dark
     * crescent travelling in a line across the arena with a violet trail and ground scars),
     * 'sphere' (Wirbel-Ninja: blue spinning energy ball with a swirl trail, burst + knockback ring
     * on impact). Travelling waves / spheres are drawn as stand-ins ("movers") unless the sim
     * flies a real projectile of that kind (projStyle cat 'wave' / 'sphere'), which wins.
     */
    _v7Ability(ev, ctx) {
      const kind = ev.kind;
      const uid = ev.unitId || ev.id || ev.src;
      const e = uid ? ctx.ent(uid) : null;
      const side = ev.side === 1 ? 1 : 0;
      const team = ctx.team(side);
      const hasT = typeof ev.tx === 'number' && typeof ev.ty === 'number';
      const px = typeof ev.x === 'number' ? ctx.wx(ev.x) : (e ? e.x : 0), pz = typeof ev.y === 'number' ? ctx.wz(ev.y) : (e ? e.z : 0);
      const sx = e ? e.x : px, sz = e ? e.z : pz;
      // direction: towards (tx, ty), else the unit's facing, else towards the enemy side
      let dx = 0, dz = side === 0 ? -1 : 1;
      if (hasT) { dx = ctx.wx(ev.tx) - sx; dz = ctx.wz(ev.ty) - sz; } else if (e && (e.fdx || e.fdz)) { dx = e.fdx; dz = e.fdz; }
      let dl = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz);
      if (dl < 1e-3) { dx = 0; dz = side === 0 ? -1 : 1; dl = hasT ? 0 : 1; }
      const ux = dx / (dl || 1), uz = dz / (dl || 1);
      const h = e ? e.h : 1.5, by = e ? e.y : 0, uk = this.uk;
      switch (kind) {
        case 'shotgun': {
          // engine: x, y = shooter, tx, ty = aimed target, radius = cone reach, angle = half spread
          this._gunT.set(uid || 0, this.t);
          if (this._gunT.size > 200) { this._gunT.clear(); this._gunHit.clear(); }
          const reach = +ev.radius > 0 ? +ev.radius : 5.5;
          const range = clamp(hasT ? Math.min(dl + 0.7, reach) : reach * 0.6, 1.2, 6);
          this._shotgun(sx + ux * 0.6 * uk, by + h * 0.55, sz + uz * 0.6 * uk, ux, uz, range, +ev.angle || +ev.spread || 0.5, team);
          return true;
        }
        case 'pump': this._pump(sx, by + h * 0.5, sz, ux, uz); return true;
        case 'endoskeleton': this._endoRise(typeof ev.x === 'number' ? px : sx, typeof ev.y === 'number' ? pz : sz, team); return true;
        case 'champion_slash': {
          if (ev.phase === 'windup') {
            // wind-up: darkness gathers around the raised blade (violet motes drawn inwards, a dark
            // ring tightening on the ground)
            const hy = by + h * 0.75;
            for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
              const a = rnd() * TAU, r = rr(0.9, 1.5);
              const j = this.parts.one(sx + Math.cos(a) * r, hy + rr(-0.4, 0.6), sz + Math.sin(a) * r, -Math.cos(a) * r * 3, rr(-0.5, 0.5), -Math.sin(a) * r * 3, rr(0.28, 0.34), 0.2, 0.06, 0xe6ccff, 0x7a2cc8, 0.95, T_STAR4, M_BB, 1, 0, 0, 1);
              this.parts.fin[j] = 0.05;
            }
            const g = this.parts.one(sx, 0.07, sz, 0, 0, 0, 0.36, 3.2, 1.2, 0x7a2cc8, 0x150a20, 0.7, T_RING, M_GROUND, 1, 0, 0, 1);
            this.parts.fin[g] = 0.05;
            this.emit('zapGlow', sx, hy, sz, 1.0, 1, 0xb46cff);
            return true;
          }
          // launch (engine: x, y = wave start, tx, ty = its end; the 'slash-wave' projectile flies it,
          // the stand-in mover only runs when no projectile shows up)
          const wx0 = typeof ev.x === 'number' && ev.phase === 'launch' ? px : sx + ux * 0.5, wz0 = typeof ev.y === 'number' && ev.phase === 'launch' ? pz : sz + uz * 0.5;
          let wdx = ux, wdz = uz, wl = 0;
          if (hasT && ev.phase === 'launch') { wdx = ctx.wx(ev.tx) - wx0; wdz = ctx.wz(ev.ty) - wz0; wl = Math.sqrt(wdx * wdx + wdz * wdz); if (wl > 1e-3) { wdx /= wl; wdz /= wl; } else { wdx = ux; wdz = uz; } }
          const len = +ev.range || +ev.length || +ev.dist || wl || (hasT ? Math.max(3, dl) : 12);
          const w = +ev.width || (+ev.radius > 0 ? ev.radius * 2 + 1.2 : 3.6);
          this._launch('wave', wx0, by + 0.9, wz0, wdx, wdz, len, +ev.speed || 13, clamp(w, 1.6, 6), team, 0.02);
          this.emit('boomFlash', sx + ux * 0.8, by + h * 0.5, sz + uz * 0.8, 1.2 * uk, 1, 0xc9a0ff);
          this.emit('shock', sx, 0.07, sz, 1.8, 1, 0xb46cff);
          this.emit('shock', sx, 0.08, sz, 1.1, 1, 0xffffff);
          this.emit('dustRing', sx, 0.05, sz, 1.4);
          this.shake(0.45, 0.3);
          this.flash(0x2a1040, 0.12, 0.18);
          return true;
        }
        case 'sphere': {
          // impact event (or one without a flight) -> burst at the point; launch -> fly to tx, ty
          // engine: phase 'throw' (x, y = ninja, tx, ty = target) / 'impact' (x, y = impact point,
          // tx, ty = where it was thrown from)
          const near = !e || ((px - e.x) * (px - e.x) + (pz - e.z) * (pz - e.z) < 1.0);
          if (ev.phase === 'impact' || ev.impact || (!hasT && !near)) {
            this._sphImp = this.t;
            this._sphereBurst(px, 0.7, pz, team, +ev.radius || 1.2);
            return true;
          }
          const hy = by + h * 0.5;
          this.emit('zapGlow', sx + ux * 0.45, hy, sz + uz * 0.45, 0.9, 1, 0x9fe6ff);
          this.emit('sparkle', sx + ux * 0.45, hy, sz + uz * 0.45, 0.4, 5, 0xffffff, 0x5ec8ff);
          this._launch('sphere', sx + ux * 0.5 * uk, hy, sz + uz * 0.5 * uk, ux, uz, hasT ? Math.max(0.5, dl - 0.4) : 5, +ev.speed || 9, +ev.radius || 1.2, team, 0.03);
          return true;
        }
        default: return false;
      }
    }

    /** Hits of the v7 cards (src = shooter / fighter entity). Returns true when handled. */
    _v7Hit(ev, src, tx, hy, tz, k, TC, team) {
      const u = src.unit, kind = ev.kind;
      if (u === 'cyborg-endoskeleton') {
        // chrome claw strike: white-hot scrape sparks, a cold steel star, a short claw smear
        this.emit('sparks', tx, hy, tz, 0.75 * k, 7, 0xffffff, 0xff7a40);
        this.emit('hitStar', tx, hy, tz, 0.95 * k, 1, 0xe8f0ff);
        const dx = tx - src.x, dz = tz - src.z, dl = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz) || 1;
        this.swing(src.x, src.y + src.h * 0.5, src.z, dx, dz, clamp(dl * 0.9, 0.5, 1.4), 0xd3dbe5, 0.16 * Math.max(1, this.uk * 0.85), 0.18, 1.1);
        return true;
      }
      if (u === 'cyborg-hunter') {
        // pellet impacts on every target of the spread
        this.emit('sparks', tx, hy, tz, 0.55 * k, 4, 0xfff3c0, 0xffa040);
        this.emit('hitFlash', tx, hy, tz, 0.5 * k, 1, 0xffd27a);
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) this.emit('hitStar', tx + rr(-0.28, 0.28), hy + rr(-0.2, 0.25), tz + rr(-0.28, 0.28), 0.42 * k, 1, TC.light);
        // once per shot: a fallback blast, drawn next update unless a 'shotgun' event (which the
        // engine sends right after the hits) arrived for this shooter by then
        const last = this._gunHit.get(ev.src);
        if (last === undefined || this.t - last > 0.3) {
          this._gunHit.set(ev.src, this.t);
          if (this._gunHit.size > 200) { this._gunHit.clear(); this._gunT.clear(); }
          const dx = tx - src.x, dz = tz - src.z, dl = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz) || 1;
          this._later.push({ at: this.t, k: 'gunFb', id: ev.src, t0: this.t, x: src.x + dx / dl * 0.6 * this.uk, y: src.y + src.h * 0.55, z: src.z + dz / dl * 0.6 * this.uk,
            dx: dx / dl, dz: dz / dl, s: clamp(dl + 0.5, 1.2, 6), c: team });
        }
        return true;
      }
      if (u === 'black-blade-master') {
        if (kind === 'melee') { this._bladeHit(src, tx, hy, tz, k, TC); return true; }
        // slash-wave cuts (any other hit of the champion)
        this.emit('hitStar', tx, hy, tz, 1.25 * k, 1, 0xe6ccff);
        this.emit('sparks', tx, hy, tz, 0.8 * k, 7, 0xffffff, 0xb46cff);
        this.emit('hitFlash', tx, hy, tz, 0.7 * k, 1, 0xc9a0ff);
        this.emit('shock', tx, 0.07, tz, 0.7 * k, 1, 0xb46cff);
        return true;
      }
      if (u === 'spiral-ninja') {
        this.emit('sparkle', tx, hy, tz, 0.5 * k, 6, 0xffffff, 0x5ec8ff);
        this.emit('hitFlash', tx, hy, tz, 0.6 * k, 1, 0xbff2ff);
        this.emit('hitStar', tx, hy, tz, 0.8 * k, 1, 0xdff8ff);
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    }

    /** Shotgun blast from the muzzle (mx, my, mz) along (dx, dz): flash, a cone of hot pellets
     *  (streaks fanning out over the spread angle), sparks where they land, a smoke cloud and a
     *  short warm glow fanned over the ground. */
    _shotgun(mx, my, mz, dx, dz, range, spread, team) {
      const P = this.parts, uk = this.uk;
      const TC = TEAM[team === 1 ? 1 : 0];
      this.emit('boomFlash', mx, my, mz, 0.95 * uk, 1, 0xffe9a0);
      this.emit('hitStar', mx, my, mz, 1.4 * uk, 1, 0xfff4c0);
      this.emit('hitFlash', mx + dx * 0.3, my, mz + dz * 0.3, 0.9 * uk, 1, 0xffd27a);
      const sp = clamp(spread, 0.2, 0.9);
      const n = Math.max(6, Math.round(12 * this.q));
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const a = (i / (n - 1) - 0.5) * 2 * sp + rr(-0.06, 0.06), c = Math.cos(a), s = Math.sin(a);
        const vx = dx * c - dz * s, vz = dz * c + dx * s, v = rr(9, 12);
        const L = range * rr(0.8, 1.05);
        P.one(mx, my, mz, vx * v, rr(-1.6, 0.2), vz * v, L / v, 0.22, 0.12, i % 3 === 1 ? TC.light : 0xfff4c0, 0xffa040, 1, T_STREAK, M_STRETCH, 1, 0, 0, 10);
        if (i % 2 === 0) this._later.push({ at: this.t + L / v, k: 'pellet', x: mx + vx * L, y: Math.max(0.25, my - 0.3), z: mz + vz * L, s: 0.5, c: TC.light });
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        const j = P.one(mx + dx * 0.25, my, mz + dz * 0.25, dx * rr(1.2, 3.2) + rr(-0.5, 0.5), rr(0.2, 0.7), dz * rr(1.2, 3.2) + rr(-0.5, 0.5), rr(0.7, 1.0), 0.35, 1.0, 0xd0c8c0, 0x8e8a86, 0.6, T_SMOKE, M_BB, 0, -0.4, 2.4, 1);
        P.fin[j] = 0.05;
      }
      for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
        const f = i / 3.4, g = P.one(mx + dx * range * f, 0.06, mz + dz * range * f, 0, 0, 0, 0.3, range * (0.35 + 0.45 * f), range * (0.45 + 0.5 * f), 0xffc860, -1, 0.55, T_GLOW, M_GROUND, 1, 0, 0, 1);
        P.fin[g] = 0.01;
      }
      this.emit('sparks', mx, my, mz, 0.5, 4, 0xffffff, 0xffc060);
      this.shake(0.1, 0.08);
    }

    /** Pump reload: a smoke wisp from the fore-end and a red shell ejected to the right. */
    _pump(x, y, z, dx, dz) {
      const P = this.parts;
      const rx = -dz, rz = dx;
      const j = P.one(x + rx * 0.28 + dx * 0.2, y + 0.1, z + rz * 0.28 + dz * 0.2, rx * rr(1.4, 2.4) - dx * 0.5, rr(2.6, 3.6), rz * rr(1.4, 2.4) - dz * 0.5, rr(0.8, 1.0), 0.17, 0.17, 0xd8342c, 0xa0201a, 1, T_CHUNK, M_BB, 0, 14, 0.3, 1);
      P.bounce[j] = 1; P.floor[j] = 0.03 + P.lastG; P.spin[j] = rr(-16, 16); P.fin[j] = 0.01; P.fout[j] = 0.3;
      const s = P.one(x + dx * 0.55, y + 0.05, z + dz * 0.55, dx * 0.3, rr(0.5, 0.9), dz * 0.3, rr(0.7, 0.9), 0.22, 0.7, 0xd0c8c0, 0x9a9490, 0.5, T_SMOKE, M_BB, 0, -0.3, 1.5, 1);
      P.fin[s] = 0.1;
      this.emit('sparks', x + dx * 0.3, y, z + dz * 0.3, 0.22, 2, 0xffffff, 0xffd27a);
    }

    /** The Cyborg-Jäger falls and the chrome endoskeleton rises: red flash, cracked ground, a
     *  fountain of hot sparks, flying jacket shreds, chrome glints and short red arcs. */
    _endoRise(x, z, team) {
      const P = this.parts;
      void team;
      this.emit('boomFlash', x, 0.9, z, 1.0, 1, 0xff6a50);
      this.emit('shock', x, 0.07, z, 1.6, 1, 0xff5a3a);
      this.emit('shock', x, 0.08, z, 0.9, 1, 0xffffff);
      const c = P.one(x, 0.045, z, 0, 0, 0, 2.6, 1.6, 1.7, 0x2a1c14, -1, 0.75, T_CRACK, M_GROUND, 0, 0, 0, 1);
      P.fin[c] = 0.01;
      this.emit('scorch', x, 0, z, 0.8);
      const n = Math.max(8, Math.round(18 * this.q));
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const j = P.one(x + rr(-0.3, 0.3), 0.3, z + rr(-0.3, 0.3), rr(-2.4, 2.4), rr(5, 9.5), rr(-2.4, 2.4), rr(0.5, 0.9), 0.1, 0.06, 0xfff0c0, 0xff6a20, 1, T_STREAK, M_STRETCH, 1, 14, 0.4, 6);
        P.fout[j] = 0.4;
      }
      this.emit('debris', x, 0.7, z, 0.8, 10, 0x2b2427, 0x4b3f42);
      this.emit('sparkle', x, 0.9, z, 0.7, 8, 0xffffff, 0xd3dbe5);
      this.emit('smoke', x, 0.3, z, 0.6, 6);
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        const a = rnd() * TAU;
        this.zap(x + Math.cos(a) * 0.5, 0.15, z + Math.sin(a) * 0.5, x + Math.cos(a) * 0.1, rr(0.9, 1.4), z + Math.sin(a) * 0.1, 0xff7a60, 0.12, 0.4, 1.5, 1);
      }
      this._later.push({ at: this.t + 0.45, k: 'endoEyes', x: x, y: 1.35, z: z, s: 1, c: 0xff2a14 });
      this.shake(0.3, 0.25);
    }

    /** Schwarzklingen-Meister melee: a dark wide crescent smear with a violet edge, cut star,
     *  violet shock ring. */
    _bladeHit(src, x, y, z, k, TC) {
      const dx = x - src.x, dz = z - src.z, dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz) || 1;
      const wy = src.y + src.h * 0.5, reach = clamp(dist * 0.95, 0.8, 3), wk = Math.max(1, this.uk * 0.85);
      const z1 = this.swing(src.x, wy, src.z, dx, dz, reach, 0x150a20, 0.6 * wk, 0.36, 2.7);
      z1.core = -2;
      this.swing(src.x, wy + 0.03, src.z, dx, dz, reach * 1.05, TC.main, 0.22 * wk, 0.3, 2.5);
      this.swing(src.x, wy + 0.05, src.z, dx, dz, reach * 1.1, 0xc9a0ff, 0.12 * wk, 0.3, 2.6).core = 1;
      this.burst('slash', x, y, z, 1.3 * k);
      this.emit('hitStar', x, y, z, 1.5 * k, 1, 0xe6ccff);
      this.emit('shock', x, 0.07, z, 1.0 * k, 1, 0xb46cff);
      this.emit('sparks', x, y, z, 0.9 * k, 6, 0xffffff, 0xb46cff);
      this.shake(0.18, 0.12);
    }

    /** Spinning energy sphere at (x, y, z) moving with (vx, vz): layered blue glow, white core,
     *  two counter-rotating swirl sprites, an orbiting spark trail and swirl rings left behind. */
    _sphereDraw(x, y, z, vx, vz, dt, team, s) {
      s = s || 1;
      const P = this.parts, t = this.t;
      // alpha-blended deep-blue body first (keeps the blue on the green grass), additive glow on top
      this.sprite(x, y, z, 1.25 * s, 0x1f6fe8, 0.75, T_GLOW, 0);
      this.sprite(x, 0.06, z, 1.4 * s, 0x2f8cff, 0.35, T_GLOW, 0, M_GROUND, 0);
      this.sprite(x, y, z, 2.0 * s, 0x2f8cff, 0.55, T_GLOW, 1);
      this.sprite(x, y, z, 1.0 * s, 0x7fdcff, 0.9, T_GLOW, 1);
      this.sprite(x, y, z, 0.45 * s, 0xffffff, 1, T_GLOW, 1);
      this.sprite(x, y, z, 1.4 * s, 0xbff2ff, 0.85, T_SWIRL, 1, M_BB, t * 15);
      this.sprite(x, y, z, 0.95 * s, 0xffffff, 0.7, T_SWIRL, 1, M_BB, -t * 10);
      const k = dt * 60 * this.q;
      for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        if (rnd() >= 0.8 * k) continue;
        const a = t * 22 + i * Math.PI + rr(-0.3, 0.3), ox = Math.cos(a) * 0.32 * s, oy = Math.sin(a) * 0.32 * s;
        const j = P.one(x + ox, y + oy, z + ox * 0.4, -vx * 0.06 + ox * 2.5, oy * 2.5, -vz * 0.06 - ox, rr(0.3, 0.45), 0.2 * s, 0.04, 0xdff8ff, 0x2f8cff, 0.95, T_STAR4, M_BB, 1, 0, 2, 1);
        P.fin[j] = 0.01;
      }
      if (rnd() < 0.35 * k) {
        const j = P.one(x, y, z, 0, 0.1, 0, 0.32, 0.5 * s, 1.15 * s, 0x7fdcff, 0x2f8cff, 0.5, T_SWIRL, M_BB, 1, 0, 0, 1);
        P.spin[j] = rr(8, 14); P.fin[j] = 0.01;
      }
      if (team >= 0) {
        const sp = Math.sqrt(vx * vx + vz * vz) || 1;
        this._teamTrail(x, y, z, vx, 0, vz, sp, k, s, team, 0.8);
      }
    }

    /** Sphere impact: blue flash, swirl decal on the ground, radial streaks, double shock ring
     *  (knockback) + dust, a delayed outer team ring. R = blast radius (tiles). */
    _sphereBurst(x, y, z, team, R) {
      const P = this.parts;
      const TC = TEAM[team === 1 ? 1 : 0];
      R = clamp(R || 1.2, 0.6, 3);
      this.emit('boomFlash', x, y, z, 1.1 * R, 1, 0xbff2ff);
      this.emit('zapGlow', x, y, z, 1.2, 1, 0x9fe6ff);
      this.emit('hitStar', x, y, z, 1.5, 1, 0xffffff);
      this.emit('shock', x, 0.07, z, 1.2 * R, 1, 0xffffff);
      this.emit('shock', x, 0.08, z, 0.8 * R, 1, 0x5ec8ff);
      this.emit('teamRing', x, 0.07, z, 1.5 * R, 1, 0x1f6fe8);
      const b = P.one(x, y, z, 0, 0, 0, 0.35, 1.2 * R, 2.2 * R, 0x1f6fe8, -1, 0.6, T_GLOW, M_BB, 0, 0, 0, 1);
      P.fin[b] = 0.01;
      this._later.push({ at: this.t + 0.1, k: 'ring', x: x, y: 0.07, z: z, s: 1.7 * R, c: TC.light });
      const d = P.one(x, 0.05, z, 0, 0, 0, 0.65, R * 0.9, R * 2.3, 0x9fe6ff, 0x2f8cff, 0.9, T_SWIRL, M_GROUND, 1, 0, 0, 1);
      P.spin[d] = 9; P.fin[d] = 0.01;
      const n = Math.max(8, Math.round(14 * this.q));
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const a = i / n * TAU + rr(-0.15, 0.15), v = rr(6, 11);
        P.one(x, y, z, Math.cos(a) * v, rr(-0.3, 1.2), Math.sin(a) * v, rr(0.16, 0.26), 0.12, 0.05, 0xffffff, 0x5ec8ff, 0.95, T_STREAK, M_STRETCH, 1, 0, 4, 8);
      }
      this.emit('sparkle', x, y, z, 0.8, 12, 0xffffff, 0x5ec8ff);
      this.emit('dustRing', x, 0.05, z, R * 1.1);
      this.emit('dust', x, 0.05, z, 0.8, 8);
      this.shake(0.25, 0.18);
    }

    /** Champion slash wave at (x, y, z) heading (dx, dz): a huge dark crescent (team-tinted
     *  underglow, black body, violet aura, bright leading edge) bulging forward with trailing horns;
     *  dark smoke and violet sparks peel off, cut grass flies, scars stay on the ground. */
    _wave(x, y, z, dx, dz, w, alpha, team, dt) {
      if (alpha <= 0.01) return;
      const TC = TEAM[team === 1 ? 1 : 0];
      const R = this.ribbons, pts = this.ptsBuf, N = 15;
      const half = w * 0.5, bulge = half * 0.72, px = -dz, pz = dx;
      crescent(pts, N, x, y, z, dx, dz, half, bulge, -0.2, 1.06, -0.05); R.add(pts, N, 1.4, TC.main, 0.45 * alpha, -2, 1);
      crescent(pts, N, x, y, z, dx, dz, half, bulge, -0.05, 1.02, 0); R.add(pts, N, 2.1, 0x7a2cc8, 0.5 * alpha, 0.15, 1);
      crescent(pts, N, x, y, z, dx, dz, half, bulge, 0, 1, 0); R.add(pts, N, 1.0, 0x150a20, 0.96 * alpha, -2, 1);
      crescent(pts, N, x, y, z, dx, dz, half, bulge, 0.42, 0.95, 0.03); R.add(pts, N, 0.24, 0xf0e0ff, 0.95 * alpha, 1, 1);
      this.sprite(x + dx * 0.3, 0.06, z + dz * 0.3, w * 1.15, 0x7a2cc8, 0.45 * alpha, T_GLOW, 1, M_GROUND, 0);
      // after-images: fading dark-violet copies left behind every ~0.07 s (fixed timed ribbons)
      this._waveGhost = (this._waveGhost || 0) + dt;
      if (this._waveGhost > 0.07 && alpha > 0.3) {
        this._waveGhost = 0;
        const zp = this.zap(x, y, z, x, y, z, 0x3a1460, 0.8, 0.24, 0, -2);
        crescent(zp.pts, N, x, y, z, dx, dz, half * 0.97, bulge, -0.1, 1, -0.02);
        zp.n = N; zp.next = 1e12;
      }
      const P = this.parts, k = dt * 60 * this.q;
      if (rnd() < 0.35 * k) {
        const s = rr(-1, 1) * 1.2, o = half * Math.sin(s);
        const j = P.one(x + px * o - dx * 0.2, y - 0.2, z + pz * o - dz * 0.2, -dx * 1.4, rr(0.3, 0.8), -dz * 1.4, rr(0.4, 0.6), 0.3, 0.8, 0x2a1838, 0x4a2a68, 0.35 * alpha, T_SMOKE, M_BB, 0, -0.3, 1.5, 1);
        P.fin[j] = 0.05;
      }
      if (rnd() < 0.7 * k) {
        const sg = rnd() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1, o = half * rr(0.3, 1) * sg;
        P.one(x + px * o, y, z + pz * o, px * sg * rr(2, 5) - dx * 2, rr(-0.5, 1.5), pz * sg * rr(2, 5) - dz * 2, rr(0.2, 0.35), 0.1, 0.04, 0xffffff, 0xb46cff, 0.95 * alpha, T_STREAK, M_STRETCH, 1, 0, 2, 6);
      }
      if (rnd() < 0.45 * k) {
        const o = half * rr(-0.8, 0.8);
        const j = P.one(x + px * o + dx * 0.3, 0.1, z + pz * o + dz * 0.3, rr(-1.5, 1.5) + dx * 3, rr(2, 4), rr(-1.5, 1.5) + dz * 3, rr(0.5, 0.8), 0.13, 0.13, 0x6dbd48, 0x4f9a32, 1, T_SHARD, M_BB, 0, 12, 0.4, 1);
        P.bounce[j] = 1; P.floor[j] = 0.03 + P.lastG; P.spin[j] = rr(-9, 9);
      }
      if (rnd() < 0.4 * k) {
        const j = P.one(x, 0.045, z, 0, 0, 0, rr(1.8, 2.4), w * 0.5, w * 0.55, 0x1a1020, -1, 0.5 * alpha, T_SCORCH, M_GROUND, 0, 0, 0, 1);
        P.fin[j] = 0.02;
      }
    }

    _waveEnd(x, y, z) {
      this.emit('smoke', x, y - 0.3, z, 0.9, 7, 0x1a1024, 0x3a2850);
      this.emit('sparkle', x, y, z, 1.0, 10, 0xffffff, 0xb46cff);
      this.emit('shock', x, 0.07, z, 1.2, 1, 0xb46cff);
    }

    /** Start a travelling stand-in effect ('wave' | 'sphere'). */
    _launch(k, x, y, z, dx, dz, len, speed, w, team, delay) {
      const M = this._movers;
      if (M.length >= 12) M.shift();
      M.push({ k: k, t0: this.t + (delay || 0), born: this.t, x: x, y: y, z: z, dx: dx, dz: dz, len: Math.max(0.3, len), sp: Math.max(1, speed), w: w, team: team });
    }

    _updateMovers(dt) {
      const M = this._movers;
      for (let i = M.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const m = M[i];
        const age = this.t - m.t0;
        if (age < 0) continue;
        // the sim flies a real projectile of this kind near the start: it wins over the stand-in
        const sn = this._seen[m.k];
        if (sn && sn.t >= m.born - 0.05 && age < 0.4 && (sn.x - m.x) * (sn.x - m.x) + (sn.z - m.z) * (sn.z - m.z) < 9) { M.splice(i, 1); continue; }
        const d = Math.min(m.len, age * m.sp);
        const x = m.x + m.dx * d, z = m.z + m.dz * d;
        const done = age * m.sp >= m.len;
        if (m.k === 'wave') {
          const fade = Math.min(1, age * 10) * (1 - smooth(0.85, 1, d / m.len));
          if (!done) this._wave(x, m.y, z, m.dx, m.dz, m.w, fade, m.team, dt);
          else { this._waveEnd(x, m.y, z); M.splice(i, 1); }
        } else {
          const hy = m.y + Math.sin(Math.PI * d / m.len) * 0.25;
          if (!done) this._sphereDraw(x, hy, z, m.dx * m.sp, m.dz * m.sp, dt, m.team, 1);
          else { this._sphereBurst(x, Math.max(0.5, hy), z, m.team, m.w); M.splice(i, 1); }
        }
      }
    }

    /**
     * v7 champion marker on the unit (call every frame while a player's champion is on the field):
     * a faint gold ground ring during the cooldown; when the ability is READY a bright pulsing
     * gold ring, a soft body glow and rising gold motes; while ACTIVE the same in violet.
     */
    championAura(e, team, ready, active, dt) {
      if (!e) return;
      const P = this.parts;
      const x = e.x, z = e.z, r = Math.max(0.5, e.r || 0.6), h = e.h || 1.5;
      const col = active ? 0xb46cff : 0xffd23f;
      void team;
      if (!ready && !active) { this.sprite(x, 0.065, z, r * 2.7, 0xffd23f, 0.22, T_RING, 1, M_GROUND, 0); return; }
      // v12: subtler (fewer idle effects): softer ring, glow and body halo, fewer motes
      const pul = 0.88 + 0.12 * Math.sin(this.t * (active ? 9 : 4.5));
      this.sprite(x, 0.07, z, r * 3.0 * pul, col, active ? 0.7 : 0.55, T_RING, 1, M_GROUND, this.t * 0.8);
      this.sprite(x, 0.06, z, r * 2.8, col, 0.18, T_GLOW, 1, M_GROUND, 0);
      this.sprite(x, e.y + h * 0.55, z, h * 1.1 * pul, col, active ? 0.14 : 0.08, T_GLOW, 1);
      if (rnd() < dt * (active ? 10 : 5) * this.q) {
        const a = rnd() * TAU;
        const j = P.one(x + Math.cos(a) * r * 1.1, e.y + rr(0.1, h * 0.6), z + Math.sin(a) * r * 1.1, 0, rr(1.2, 2.2), 0, rr(0.5, 0.8), 0.17, 0.05, 0xffffff, col, 0.9, T_STAR4, M_BB, 1, 0, 0.6, 1);
        P.fin[j] = 0.15;
      }
    }

    /** Targets of an ability event in world space: [{x, y (hit height), z}]. */
    _targetsOf(ev, ctx) {
      const out = this._tgtBuf || (this._tgtBuf = []);
      out.length = 0;
      const list = ev.units || ev.targets || ev.chain || ev.ids || null;
      const push = function (e, sx, sy, air) {
        if (e) out.push({ x: e.x, y: e.y + e.h * (e.tower ? 0.55 : 0.5), z: e.z });
        else if (typeof sx === 'number' && typeof sy === 'number') out.push({ x: ctx.wx(sx), y: air ? 2.6 : 0.6, z: ctx.wz(sy) });
      };
      if (Array.isArray(list)) {
        for (let i = 0; i < list.length && out.length < 6; i++) {
          const it = list[i];
          if (it === null || it === undefined) continue;
          if (typeof it === 'object') {
            const id = it.id !== undefined ? it.id : it.unitId;
            push(id !== undefined ? ctx.ent(id) : null, it.x, it.y, !!it.air);
          } else push(ctx.ent(it), undefined, undefined, false);
        }
      }
      // engine chain events also carry the hop positions as a flat [x, y, x, y, ...] list
      if (Array.isArray(ev.pts) && ev.pts.length >= 2 && out.length < ev.pts.length / 2) {
        out.length = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i + 1 < ev.pts.length && out.length < 8; i += 2) {
          const id = Array.isArray(ev.units) ? ev.units[i / 2] : undefined;
          push(id !== undefined ? ctx.ent(id) : null, +ev.pts[i], +ev.pts[i + 1], false);
        }
      }
      if (!out.length && (ev.targetId || ev.target)) push(ctx.ent(ev.targetId || ev.target), undefined, undefined, false);
      if (!out.length && typeof ev.tx === 'number' && typeof ev.ty === 'number' && ev.kind === 'chain') {
        const te = ctx.at ? ctx.at(ev.tx, ev.ty) : null;
        push(te, ev.tx, ev.ty, false);
      }
      // kung-fu events: x, y = the target's position (tx, ty = the fighter / take-off point)
      if (!out.length && ev.kind !== 'chain' && typeof ev.x === 'number' && typeof ev.y === 'number') {
        const te = ctx.at ? ctx.at(ev.x, ev.y) : null;
        push(te, ev.x, ev.y, false);
      }
      return out;
    }

    /** Collect one chain-lightning target for source id `sid` (flushed in update()). fromEv: the
     *  hop list came from a chain event (it wins over hits of the same frame). */
    _chainAdd(sid, src, x, y, z, fromEv, team, start) {
      let q = null;
      for (let i = 0; i < this._chainQ.length; i++) if (this._chainQ[i].sid === sid && this._chainQ[i].ev === fromEv) { q = this._chainQ[i]; break; }
      if (!q) {
        q = this._chainFree.pop() || { sid: 0, ev: false, team: 0, sx: 0, sy: 0, sz: 0, has: false, pts: [] };
        q.sid = sid; q.ev = fromEv; q.team = team | 0; q.pts.length = 0; q.has = false;
        if (src) { q.sx = src.x; q.sy = src.y + src.h * 0.6; q.sz = src.z; q.has = true; }
        else if (start) { q.sx = start.x; q.sy = start.y; q.sz = start.z; q.has = true; }
        this._chainQ.push(q);
      }
      if (q.pts.length < 18) q.pts.push(x, y, z);
    }

    /** Draw the collected chains: mouth -> 1st target -> next ... (up to 3+ hops), each hop a
     *  thick cyan bolt with a white core that thins along the chain, glow + sparks per target. */
    _flushChains() {
      const Q = this._chainQ;
      if (!Q.length) return;
      for (let i = 0; i < Q.length; i++) {
        const q = Q[i];
        // an event list for this source wins over the hits collected in the same frame
        let skip = false;
        if (!q.ev) for (let j = 0; j < Q.length; j++) if (j !== i && Q[j].sid === q.sid && Q[j].ev) { skip = true; break; }
        const last = this._chainT.get(q.sid);
        if (skip || (last !== undefined && this.t - last < 0.12 && !q.ev)) continue;
        this._chainT.set(q.sid, this.t);
        if (this._chainT.size > 200) this._chainT.clear();
        const P = q.pts, n = P.length / 3;
        if (!n) continue;
        // order the hit targets by nearest neighbour from the source (event lists keep their order)
        if (!q.ev && n > 1) {
          let cx = q.has ? q.sx : P[0], cz = q.has ? q.sz : P[2];
          for (let a = 0; a < n; a++) {
            let best = a, bd = 1e9;
            for (let b = a; b < n; b++) { const d = (P[b * 3] - cx) * (P[b * 3] - cx) + (P[b * 3 + 2] - cz) * (P[b * 3 + 2] - cz); if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = b; } }
            if (best !== a) for (let c = 0; c < 3; c++) { const tmp = P[a * 3 + c]; P[a * 3 + c] = P[best * 3 + c]; P[best * 3 + c] = tmp; }
            cx = P[a * 3]; cz = P[a * 3 + 2];
          }
        }
        let px = q.has ? q.sx : P[0], py = q.has ? q.sy : P[1], pz = q.has ? q.sz : P[2];
        if (q.has && n) {
          // start a little in front of the dragon's jaws
          const dx = P[0] - px, dz = P[2] - pz, dl = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz) || 1;
          px += dx / dl * 0.55; pz += dz / dl * 0.55; py += 0.1;
          this.emit('zapGlow', px, py, pz, 0.9, 1, 0xdff8ff);
          this.emit('zapSparks', px, py, pz, 0.7, 6);
        }
        const TC = TEAM[q.team === 1 ? 1 : 0];
        for (let k = q.has ? 0 : 1; k < n; k++) {
          const x = P[k * 3], y = P[k * 3 + 1], z = P[k * 3 + 2];
          const w = Math.max(0.2, 0.5 - k * 0.1) * this.uk;
          this.zap(px, py, pz, x, y, z, 0x5fd8ff, w, 0.4, 1.35, 0.8);
          this.zap(px, py, pz, x, y, z, 0xffffff, w * 0.36, 0.3, 1.7, 1);
          this.zap(px, py, pz, x, y, z, TC.light, w * 0.45, 0.22, 2.4, 0.6);
          this.emit('zapGlow', x, y, z, 1.0 - k * 0.12, 1);
          this.emit('zapSparks', (px + x) / 2, (py + y) / 2, (pz + z) / 2, 0.5, 4);
          px = x; py = y; pz = z;
        }
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < Q.length; i++) this._chainFree.push(Q[i]);
      Q.length = 0;
    }

    /** Electro stun on a chain target: crackling sparks, a cyan ring and two short arcs. */
    _stunSparks(x, y, z, k) {
      this.burst('boltHit', x, y, z, 1.1 * k);
      this.emit('shock', x, 0.07, z, 0.8 * k, 1, 0x9fe8ff);
      for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        const a = rnd() * TAU;
        this.zap(x + Math.cos(a) * 0.35, y + 0.35, z + Math.sin(a) * 0.35, x - Math.cos(a) * 0.3, y - 0.25, z - Math.sin(a) * 0.3, 0xbff4ff, 0.1, 0.22, 1.8, 1);
      }
    }

    /** Kung-Fu-Legende impact: gold-white star, radial streaks, a short team smear; strike 3 of
     *  every combo (the high kick) and dash / jump hits are bigger with a ground shock. */
    _kungFuHit(src, x, y, z, k, TC, heavy) {
      const n = this._kfN = (this._kfN + 1) % 3;
      const big = heavy || n === 0;
      this.emit('hitStar', x, y, z, (big ? 1.45 : 1.0) * k, 1, n === 2 ? 0xffffff : 0xffe14a);
      this.emit('hitFlash', x, y, z, (big ? 1.0 : 0.6) * k, 1, 0xfff4c0);
      this.emit('kfStreak', x, y, z, k, big ? 9 : 6);
      this.emit('sparks', x, y, z, 0.8 * k, 5, 0xffffff, 0xffd84a);
      if (big) { this.emit('shock', x, 0.07, z, 0.9 * k, 1, TC.light); this.shake(0.12, 0.1); }
      // smear: a kick arc (big) or a straight punch line
      const dx = x - src.x, dz = z - src.z, dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz) || 1;
      const wy = src.y + src.h * (big ? 0.62 : 0.48);
      this.swing(src.x, wy, src.z, dx, dz, clamp(dist * 0.9, 0.5, 1.8), TC.main, (big ? 0.42 : 0.26) * Math.max(1, this.uk * 0.85), big ? 0.3 : 0.2, big ? 2.4 : 0.8);
    }

    /** v6 Touchdown celebration in an end zone: confetti in the scorer's team colours + gold,
     *  light pillars along the goal line, shock rings, a flash and delayed firework bursts.
     *  zone = world rect {x0, x1, z0, z1, goalZ} (or null: around x, z). */
    touchdown(x, z, team, zone) {
      const TC = TEAM[team === 1 ? 1 : 0];
      const cols = [TC.main, TC.light, 0xffd23f, 0xffffff];
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) this.emit('confetti', x, 0.4, z, 1.2, -1, cols[i]);
      this.emit('boomFlash', x, 1.2, z, 2.2, 1, TC.light);
      this.emit('shock', x, 0.07, z, 3.2, 1, TC.light);
      this.emit('shock', x, 0.08, z, 2.0, 1, 0xffffff);
      this.emit('dustRing', x, 0.05, z, 2.4);
      this.emit('hitStar', x, 1.4, z, 3.0, 1, 0xffe9a0);
      this.emit('rise', x, 0.2, z, 1.6, 16, TC.light);
      if (zone) {
        const w = zone.x1 - zone.x0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
          const px = zone.x0 + w * (i + 0.5) / 7;
          this.emit('pillar', px, 0.1, zone.goalZ, 1.3, 1, i & 1 ? 0xffffff : TC.light);
          this.emit('confetti', px, 0.3, (zone.z0 + zone.z1) / 2, 0.8, 7, cols[i & 3]);
        }
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        const fx = x + rr(-3.5, 3.5), fz = z + rr(-1.2, 1.2), fy = rr(2.6, 3.8);
        this._later.push({ at: this.t + 0.22 + i * 0.22, k: 'firework', x: fx, y: fy, z: fz, s: 1.3, c: cols[i & 3] });
      }
      this.shake(0.6, 0.5);
    }

    /** Team-coloured light band sweeping over the field from world z0 to z1 in dur seconds (the
     *  touchdown field reset). */
    sweep(z0, z1, dur, team) {
      let s = null;
      for (let i = 0; i < this._sweeps.length; i++) if (!this._sweeps[i].on) { s = this._sweeps[i]; break; }
      if (!s) { if (this._sweeps.length >= 3) s = this._sweeps[0]; else { s = {}; this._sweeps.push(s); } }
      s.on = true; s.t0 = this.t + 0.35; s.dur = dur > 0 ? dur : 1.2; s.z0 = z0; s.z1 = z1; s.col = TEAM[team === 1 ? 1 : 0].light;
    }

    _updateLater() {
      const L = this._later;
      for (let i = L.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const it = L[i];
        if (this.t < it.at) continue;
        L[i] = L[L.length - 1]; L.pop();
        if (it.k === 'kfHit') {
          this.emit('hitStar', it.x, it.y, it.z, it.s, 1, it.i & 1 ? 0xffffff : 0xffe14a);
          this.emit('kfStreak', it.x, it.y, it.z, it.s, 4);
          this.emit('hitFlash', it.x, it.y, it.z, 0.5 * it.s, 1, 0xfff4c0);
          if (it.s > 1.2) { this.emit('shock', it.x, 0.07, it.z, 1.1, 1, it.c); this.shake(0.14, 0.1); }
        } else if (it.k === 'ring') this.emit('shock', it.x, it.y, it.z, it.s, 1, it.c);
        else if (it.k === 'gunFb') {
          const ge = this._gunT.get(it.id);
          if (ge === undefined || ge < it.t0 - 0.05) this._shotgun(it.x, it.y, it.z, it.dx, it.dz, it.s, 0.5, it.c);
        } else if (it.k === 'pellet') {
          this.emit('sparks', it.x, it.y, it.z, it.s, 2, 0xfff3c0, 0xffa040);
          this.emit('hitFlash', it.x, it.y, it.z, 0.3, 1, 0xffd27a);
        } else if (it.k === 'endoEyes') {
          const j = this.parts.one(it.x, it.y, it.z, 0, 0.2, 0, 0.55, 0.9, 1.3, it.c, -1, 0.8, T_GLOW, M_BB, 1, 0, 0, 1);
          this.parts.fin[j] = 0.05;
          this.emit('sparkle', it.x, it.y, it.z, 0.4, 4, 0xffffff, it.c);
        }
        else if (it.k === 'firework') {
          this.emit('boomFlash', it.x, it.y, it.z, 1.0 * it.s, 1, it.c);
          this.emit('sparkle', it.x, it.y, it.z, 1.4 * it.s, 16, 0xffffff, it.c);
          this.emit('embers', it.x, it.y, it.z, 0.5, 8);
        }
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < this._sweeps.length; i++) {
        const s = this._sweeps[i];
        if (!s.on) continue;
        const k = (this.t - s.t0) / s.dur;
        if (k < 0) continue;
        if (k >= 1) { s.on = false; continue; }
        const e = k * k * (3 - 2 * k);
        const z = s.z0 + (s.z1 - s.z0) * e, a = 0.6 * Math.sin(Math.PI * Math.min(1, k * 1.15));
        for (let x = -8.4; x <= 8.5; x += 1.2) {
          this.sprite(x, 0.07, z, 2.4, s.col, a * 0.8, T_GLOW, 1, M_GROUND, 0);
          this.sprite(x + 0.6, 0.08, z, 1.1, 0xffffff, a * 0.7, T_GLOW, 1, M_GROUND, 0);
        }
        if (rnd() < 0.7) this.emit('sparkle', rr(-8.5, 8.5), 0.3, z, 0.5, 2, 0xffffff, s.col);
      }
    }

    /** Lightning bolt from the sky onto (x, z). */
    skyBolt(x, z, s, hy) {
      const top = SKY_H;
      const y1 = hy > 0 ? hy : 0.1;
      this.zap(x + rr(-0.8, 0.8), top, z + rr(0, 1.2), x, y1, z, 0xbff4ff, 0.95 * s, 0.4, 0.9, 1);
      this.zap(x + rr(-0.8, 0.8), top * 0.85, z + rr(-0.4, 1), x, y1, z, 0x7fd0ff, 0.5 * s, 0.32, 1.3, 1);
      this.zap(x, top * 0.6, z + 0.4, x, y1, z, 0xffffff, 0.22 * s, 0.22, 1.6, 1);
      this.emit('boomFlash', x, y1 + 0.4, z, 1.3 * s, 1, 0xdff8ff);
      this.emit('zapSparks', x, y1 + 0.2, z, 1.2 * s, 18);
      this.emit('shock', x, 0.06, z, 1.4 * s, 1, 0xbff0ff);
      this.emit('scorch', x, 0, z, 0.7 * s);
      this.emit('smoke', x, 0.3, z, 0.6 * s, 5);
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const a = rnd() * TAU; this.zap(x, 0.3, z, x + Math.cos(a) * 1.3 * s, 0.1, z + Math.sin(a) * 1.3 * s, 0x9fe8ff, 0.16, 0.28, 1.4, 1); }
    }

    /** Volley of arrows landing in a disc (Arrows spell impact). */
    arrowRain(x, z, R) {
      const n = Math.round(18 * this.q);
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const a = rnd() * TAU, r = R * Math.sqrt(rnd()) * 0.92;
        const px = x + Math.cos(a) * r, pz = z + Math.sin(a) * r;
        this.emit('footDust', px, 0.05, pz, 2.2, 1, 0xe0d0a8);
        if (i % 2 === 0) this.emit('sparks', px, 0.2, pz, 0.7, 3, 0xffffff, 0xd0b080);
        if (i % 3 === 0) this.emit('planks', px, 0.15, pz, 0.3, 2, 0xc89a60, 0x8a6038);
      }
      this.emit('dustRing', x, 0.04, z, R * 0.95);
      this.emit('shock', x, 0.06, z, R * 0.8, 1, 0xfff0d0);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ sim events
    /**
     * ctx (renderer): team(side) -> colour team, ent(id) -> {x,y,z,h,air,building,unit,side,r} | null (world),
     * wx(simX), wz(simY), kingTop(side) -> {x,y,z}
     */
    onEvent(ev, ctx) {
      const t = ev.t;
      const side = ev.side === 1 ? 1 : 0;
      const team = ctx.team(side);
      const x = ctx.wx(+ev.x || 0), z = ctx.wz(+ev.y || 0);
      switch (t) {
        case 'hit': this._onHit(ev, ctx, x, z, team); break;
        case 'death': this._onDeath(ev, ctx, x, z, team); break;
        case 'spell': this._onSpell(ev, ctx, x, z, team); break;
        case 'deploy': {
          if (!ev.units || !ev.units.length) break;
          const card = ev.card ? cardOf(ev.card) : null;
          const big = card && card.type === 'building';
          this.burst(big ? 'deployBig' : 'deploy', x, 0, z, big ? 1.4 : this.uk);
          break;
        }
        case 'tower_down': {
          const king = ev.kind === 'king';
          this.burst('towerCollapse', x, king ? 3 : 2.4, z, king ? 2.0 : 1.6, TEAM[team].main);
          this.emit('scorch', x, 0, z, king ? 2 : 1.5, 1, 0x1c1610);
          this.shake(king ? 1.0 : 0.7, king ? 0.7 : 0.5);
          this.flash(0xffffff, 0.18, 0.25);
          break;
        }
        case 'king_active': {
          const k = ctx.kingTop(side);
          if (k) {
            this.burst('wake', k.x, k.y, k.z, 1.6);
            this.label('', k.x, k.y + 1.2, k.z, '#ffd23f', 2.0, 1.1, 'wake');
          }
          break;
        }
        case 'chaos_offer': {
          const k = ctx.kingTop(side);
          if (k) this.emit('sparkle', k.x, k.y, k.z, 1.4, 10, 0xffffff, 0xb44cff);
          break;
        }
        case 'chaos_pick': {
          const tier = tierOf(ev);
          const col = RARITY[clamp(tier, 1, 4)];
          const k = ctx.kingTop(side);
          if (k) {
            this.burst('chaos', k.x, 0, k.z, 2.2, col);
            // v4: no words in battle - a rarity-coloured star badge instead of the upgrade's name
            this.label('', k.x, k.y + 1.6, k.z, VFX.rarityCss(tier || 3), 1.3, 1.6, 'star');
          }
          this.shake(0.25, 0.25);
          break;
        }
        case 'ability': {
          if (this._cardAbility(ev, ctx)) break;
          const tier = tierOf(ev) || 3;
          const col = RARITY[clamp(tier, 1, 4)];
          let px = x, pz = z, py = 0, h = 1.6;
          const uid = ev.unitId || ev.id;
          const e = uid ? ctx.ent(uid) : null;
          if (e && !(ev.x !== undefined && ev.kind && ABILITY_AT_POINT[ev.kind])) { px = e.x; pz = e.z; py = e.y; h = e.h; }
          const R = typeof ev.radius === 'number' && ev.radius > 0 ? Math.min(4, ev.radius) : 1.4;
          const key = (uid || 0) + ':' + (ev.kind || '');
          const last = this._abilT.get(key) || -9;
          const fresh = this.t - last > 0.35;
          if (fresh) {
            this._abilT.set(key, this.t);
            if (this._abilT.size > 300) this._abilT.clear();
            this._abilityFlavor(ev.kind || '', px, py, pz, R, ev, ctx);
            this.burst('chaos', px, py, pz, Math.max(0.9, R * 0.8), col);
            this.shake(0.15, 0.15);
          }
          // v4: wordless trigger badge (rarity-coloured star popping above the unit; throttled per
          // unit + upgrade) - no ability names during the battle
          const lk = (uid || 0) + ':' + (ev.card || '') + ':' + (ev.rarity || '');
          const ll = this._abilL.get(lk) || -9;
          if (this.t - ll > 1.6 && this._lblFrame < 3) {
            this._abilL.set(lk, this.t); this._lblFrame++;
            if (this._abilL.size > 300) this._abilL.clear();
            this.label('', px, py + h + 0.6, pz, VFX.rarityCss(tier), 0.9, 1.1, 'star');
          }
          break;
        }
        default: break;
      }
    }

    _onHit(ev, ctx, x, z, team) {
      const kind = ev.kind;
      if (kind === 'decay') return;
      if (kind === 'elixir') {
        const e = ctx.ent(ev.id);
        const h = e ? e.h : 1.4;
        this.burst('elixir', e ? e.x : x, h, e ? e.z : z, 1);
        this.label('+' + (typeof ev.elixir === 'number' ? ev.elixir : 1), e ? e.x : x, h + 0.6, e ? e.z : z, '#e46cff', 1.0, 1.1, 'elixir');
        return;
      }
      const tgt = ctx.ent(ev.id);
      const src = ev.src ? ctx.ent(ev.src) : null;
      let hy = 0.6, tx = x, tz = z;
      if (tgt) { tx = tgt.x; tz = tgt.z; hy = tgt.y + tgt.h * (tgt.tower ? 0.55 : 0.5); }
      const cat = src ? VFX.attackCat(src.unit) : 'melee';
      const k = tgt && (tgt.tower || tgt.building) ? 1.15 : this.uk;   // hit flashes follow the troop size
      const TC = TEAM[team === 1 ? 1 : 0];
      // v4: every damaging hit gets a team-tinted impact ring on the ground under the target, so
      // who hits whom reads at a glance for both sides
      if (ev.dmg > 0 && kind !== 'spell' && kind !== 'death') this.emit('teamRing', tx, 0.07, tz, (tgt && tgt.tower ? 1.0 : 0.6) * k, 1, TC.main);
      // v7 cards: shotgun pellets, black-blade cuts, energy-sphere sparks
      if (src && V7_UNITS[src.unit] === 1 && kind !== 'spell' && kind !== 'death' && this._v7Hit(ev, src, tx, hy, tz, k, TC, team)) return;
      // v6 Elektrodrache: every hit of one attack joins a chain (drawn hop by hop in update())
      if (src && src.unit === 'electro-dragon' && kind !== 'spell' && kind !== 'death') {
        this._chainAdd(ev.src, src, tx, hy, tz, false, team);
        this._stunSparks(tx, hy, tz, k);
        return;
      }
      // v6 Kung-Fu-Legende: snappy martial-arts impacts (alternating punch / nunchaku / kick)
      if (src && src.unit === 'kung-fu-legend' && (kind === 'melee' || kind === 'charge' || kind === 'jump')) {
        this._kungFuHit(src, tx, hy, tz, k, TC, kind !== 'melee');
        return;
      }
      switch (kind) {
        case 'melee': {
          const heavy = !!(src && HEAVY_MELEE[src.unit]);
          const spin = !!(src && SPIN_MELEE[src.unit]);
          if (heavy) { this.burst('hitHeavy', tx, hy, tz, k); this.emit('shock', tx, 0.07, tz, 0.55 * k, 1, TC.light); }
          else if (spin) { this.burst('hit', tx, hy, tz, k, TC.light); this.emit('hitRing', src.x, 0.06, src.z, 1.4, 1, TC.light); }
          else this.burst('hit', tx, hy, tz, k, TC.light);
          if (src) {
            // swing smear around the attacker through the target (full circle for spinners)
            const dx = tx - src.x, dz = tz - src.z;
            const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz);
            const reach = clamp(dist * 0.85, 0.55, 2.6);
            const wy = src.y + src.h * (src.building ? 0.6 : 0.42);
            const wd = (heavy ? 0.5 : 0.36) * Math.max(1, this.uk * 0.85);
            this.swing(src.x, wy, src.z, dist > 0.01 ? dx : 0, dist > 0.01 ? dz : -1, spin ? Math.max(1.1, reach) : reach, TC.main, wd, heavy ? 0.34 : 0.28, spin ? 5.6 : (heavy ? 2.2 : 1.8));
          }
          if (tgt && !tgt.tower && !tgt.building) this.emit('footDust', tx, 0.05, tz, 0.8, 1);
          break;
        }
        case 'ranged': {
          if (cat === 'bolt' || cat === 'chain') {
            this.burst('boltHit', tx, hy, tz, 1);
            if (src) {
              // instant electric attackers: draw the zap from the source
              const sy = src.y + src.h * (src.building ? 0.95 : 0.7);
              this.zap(src.x, sy, src.z, tx, hy, tz, 0x9fe8ff, src.unit === 'tesla' ? 0.34 : 0.26, 0.2, 1.1, 1);
              this.zap(src.x, sy, src.z, tx, hy, tz, 0xffffff, 0.12, 0.14, 1.5, 1);
            }
          } else if (cat === 'inferno') {
            this.emit('embers', tx, hy, tz, 0.3, 2);
          } else if (cat === 'fireball' || cat === 'firework' || cat === 'spark' || cat === 'lava') this.burst('fireHit', tx, hy, tz, cat === 'spark' ? 0.6 : 1);
          else if (cat === 'shard' || cat === 'spirit' && src && src.unit === 'ice-spirit') this.burst('iceHit', tx, hy, tz, 1);
          else if (cat === 'orb') this.burst('orbHit', tx, hy, tz, 1, VFX.projStyle(src.unit).color);
          else if (cat === 'cannonball' || cat === 'bomb') this.burst('cannonHit', tx, hy, tz, 0.8);
          else if (cat === 'arrow' || cat === 'dart' || cat === 'spear') this.burst('arrowHit', tx, hy, tz, k);
          else this.burst('hitSmall', tx, hy, tz, k);
          // attacker-team star on every ranged impact (tower arrows included)
          this.emit('hitStar', tx, hy, tz, 0.75 * k, 1, TC.light);
          break;
        }
        case 'splash': {
          if (cat === 'bolt' || cat === 'chain' || (src && src.unit === 'electro-spirit')) this.burst('boltHit', tx, hy, tz, 1);
          else if (src && src.unit === 'ice-spirit') this.burst('iceHit', tx, hy, tz, 1);
          else this.burst('hitSmall', tx, hy, tz, k);
          break;
        }
        case 'charge': {
          this.burst('hitHeavy', tx, hy, tz, k);
          this.emit('shock', tx, 0.06, tz, 0.8, 1, TC.light);
          this.shake(0.22, 0.18);
          break;
        }
        case 'jump': this.burst('hitHeavy', tx, hy, tz, k); this.emit('shock', tx, 0.07, tz, 0.7 * k, 1, TC.light); break;
        case 'reflect': {
          this.burst('boltHit', tx, hy, tz, 0.9);
          if (src) {
            this.zap(src.x, src.y + src.h * 0.6, src.z, tx, hy, tz, 0x9fe8ff, 0.3, 0.26, 1.3, 1);
            this.emit('zapGlow', src.x, src.y + src.h * 0.6, src.z, 0.8);
          }
          break;
        }
        case 'spell': this.emit('hitFlash', tx, hy, tz, 0.7); this.emit('sparks', tx, hy, tz, 0.6, 3); break;
        case 'death': this.emit('hitFlash', tx, hy, tz, 0.6); break;
        default: this.burst('hitSmall', tx, hy, tz, k);
      }
    }

    _onDeath(ev, ctx, x, z, team) {
      const reason = ev.reason;
      if (reason === 'transform' || reason === 'kamikaze') return;
      const unit = ev.unit || '';
      // the entity is still known on the frame its death arrives: size the puff to the model
      const de = ev.id ? ctx.ent(ev.id) : null;
      const y = de ? de.y + de.h * 0.45 : (ev.air ? 2.2 : 0.4);
      const k = de ? clamp(de.r * 1.35, 0.7, 2.4) : this.uk;
      if (ev.building) { this.burst('collapse', x, 0.4, z, 1.1); this.shake(0.2, 0.2); return; }
      if (unit === 'golem' || unit === 'elixir-golem') { this.burst('collapse', x, 0.5, z, 1.3); this.emit('debris', x, 1, z, 1.2, 14, 0x8a8278, 0x5e574e); this.shake(0.35, 0.3); return; }
      if (unit === 'lava-hound') { this.emit('fireCore', x, y, z, 1.2, 16); this.emit('embers', x, y, z, 1.2, 14); this.emit('boomSmoke', x, y, z, 1, 8); this.emit('debris', x, y, z, 1, 10, 0x6a3a2a, 0x2a1a14); return; }
      if (unit === 'ice-golem') { this.burst('frostNova', x, 0, z, 1.2); return; }
      if (unit === 'phoenix' || unit === 'phoenix-reborn') { this.burst('fireNova', x, y - 1.2, z, 1.2); return; }
      if (unit === 'phoenix-egg') { this.burst('poof', x, 0.4, z, 1, 0xffa040); return; }
      if (unit === 'balloon') { this.burst('poof', x, y, z, 1.1); this.emit('planks', x, y, z, 0.6, 6); return; }
      if (unit === 'giant' || unit === 'giant-skeleton' || unit === 'pekka' || unit === 'mega-knight' || unit === 'royal-giant' || unit === 'electro-giant') {
        this.burst('poof', x, y + 0.3, z, Math.max(1.4, k), TEAM[team].light); this.emit('dustRing', x, 0.05, z, Math.max(1.2, k)); return;
      }
      this.burst('poof', x, y, z, k * (ev.air ? 0.9 : 0.8), TEAM[team].light);
    }

    _onSpell(ev, ctx, x, z, team) {
      const card = ev.card || '';
      const kind = ev.kind || '';
      const phase = ev.phase || 'impact';
      // burst visuals are capped at 5 tiles: C.H.A.O.S upgrades can grow a spell far beyond (a
      // 15-tile rage), its lasting area disc still shows the real size
      const R = typeof ev.radius === 'number' && ev.radius > 0 ? Math.min(5, ev.radius) : 0;
      if (phase === 'cast') {
        if (card === 'zap' || (kind === 'instant' && card.indexOf('zap') >= 0)) { this.burst('zap', x, 0, z, R || 2.5); this.shake(0.18, 0.15); this.flash(0xbff4ff, 0.12, 0.15); return; }
        if (card === 'freeze') { this.burst('freeze', x, 0, z, R || 3); this.flash(0xdff8ff, 0.14, 0.25); return; }
        if (kind === 'instant') { this.burst(R > 0 ? 'explosion' : 'hit', x, 0.4, z, R || 1); return; }
        if (kind === 'area') {
          const st = AREA_STYLE[card];
          this.burst('cast', x, 0, z, R || 2, st ? st[1] : TEAM[team].light);
          if (card === 'earthquake') {
            this.shake(0.35, 0.45);
            const j = this.parts.one(x, 0.05, z, 0, 0, 0, 3.4, (R || 3.5) * 2.1, (R || 3.5) * 2.2, 0x2a1c10, -1, 0.85, T_CRACK, M_GROUND, 0, 0, 0, 1);
            this.parts.fin[j] = 0.05; this.parts.fout[j] = 0.35;
            this.emit('dust', x, 0.05, z, (R || 3.5) * 0.7, 18, 0xc8ae84);
          }
          return;
        }
        if (kind === 'lightning') {
          // storm clouds gathering over the target area
          for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
            const a = rnd() * TAU, r = R * Math.sqrt(rnd()) * 0.8;
            const j = this.parts.one(x + Math.cos(a) * r, 6.2 + rnd() * 0.8, z + Math.sin(a) * r - 1, rr(-0.3, 0.3), rr(-0.1, 0.1), rr(-0.3, 0.3), rr(1.3, 1.8), rr(1.4, 2.0), rr(2.2, 2.8), 0x9aa2c0, 0xc8d0e8, 0.55, T_SMOKE, M_BB, 0, 0, 0.5, 1);
            this.parts.fin[j] = 0.25; this.parts.fout[j] = 0.45;
          }
          this.emit('shock', x, 0.06, z, R * 0.9, 1, 0x9fe8ff);
          this.flash(0x203050, 0.08, 0.35);
          return;
        }
        if (kind === 'roll') { this.burst('land', x, 0, z, 1.2); return; }
        if (kind === 'projectile') {
          const k = ctx.kingTop(ev.side === 1 ? 1 : 0);
          if (k) this.emit('poof', k.x, k.y, k.z, 0.5, 4);
          return;
        }
        if (kind === 'delivery') { this.emit('sparkle', x, 3, z, 1.2, 8, 0xffffff, 0xffd23f); return; }
        if (kind === 'clone') return;
        return;
      }
      // impact - v4: a team-coloured shock ring + bright flash under every damaging spell (whose
      // spell hit where reads for both sides)
      if (R > 0 && kind !== 'clone' && kind !== 'heal' && kind !== 'rage') {
        this.emit('teamRing', x, 0.08, z, R * 1.1, 1, TEAM[team === 1 ? 1 : 0].main);
        this.emit('boomFlash', x, 0.8, z, Math.min(2.2, 0.35 + R * 0.35), 1, 0xffffff);
      }
      if (card === 'fireball') { this.burst('explosion', x, 0.5, z, R || 2.5); this.shake(0.4, 0.3); return; }
      if (card === 'rocket') { this.burst('bigExplosion', x, 0.6, z, (R || 2) * 1.1); this.shake(0.8, 0.5); this.flash(0xfff0c0, 0.2, 0.25); return; }
      if (card === 'arrows') { this.arrowRain(x, z, R || 4); return; }
      if (card === 'giant-snowball') { this.burst('snowball', x, 0, z, R || 2.5); this.shake(0.2, 0.2); return; }
      if (card === 'goblin-barrel') { this.burst('woodBurst', x, 0.5, z, 1.1); this.emit('shock', x, 0.06, z, 1.4, 1, 0xd9c7a0); return; }
      if (kind === 'strike' || card === 'lightning') {
        const e = ctx.at ? ctx.at(+ev.x || 0, +ev.y || 0) : null;
        this.skyBolt(e ? e.x : x, e ? e.z : z, 1, e ? e.y + e.h * (e.tower ? 0.85 : 0.75) : 0.1);
        this.shake(0.3, 0.2); this.flash(0xdff8ff, 0.22, 0.12);
        return;
      }
      if (kind === 'royal-delivery' || card === 'royal-delivery') {
        this.burst('slam', x, 0, z, R || 3); this.burst('woodBurst', x, 0.6, z, 1.2); this.emit('sparkle', x, 1, z, 1.5, 12, 0xffffff, 0xffd23f); this.shake(0.4, 0.3); return;
      }
      if (kind === 'spawn') {
        const u = ev.unit || card;
        if (u === 'electro-wizard') { this.burst('elecNova', x, 0, z, R || 3); this.shake(0.15, 0.15); return; }
        if (u === 'ice-wizard') { this.burst('frostNova', x, 0, z, R || 3); return; }
        if (u === 'mega-knight') { this.burst('slam', x, 0, z, R || 2.2); this.shake(0.55, 0.35); return; }
        this.burst('slam', x, 0, z, R || 2);
        return;
      }
      if (kind === 'death') {
        const u = ev.unit || card;
        if (u === 'ice-golem') { this.burst('frostNova', x, 0, z, R || 2); return; }
        if (u === 'phoenix' || u === 'phoenix-reborn') { this.burst('fireNova', x, 0, z, R || 2); return; }
        if (u === 'golem' || u === 'elixir-golem') { this.burst('slam', x, 0, z, R || 2); this.shake(0.4, 0.3); return; }
        if (u === 'lava-hound') { this.burst('fireSplash', x, 1, z, R || 2); return; }
        this.burst('bomb', x, 0.4, z, R || 2);
        this.shake(0.3, 0.25);
        return;
      }
      if (kind === 'bomb') { this.burst('bigExplosion', x, 0.5, z, R || 3); this.shake(0.6, 0.4); return; }
      if (kind === 'rage') { this.burst('rage', x, 0, z, R || 3); this.emit('planks', x, 0.4, z, 0.4, 5, 0xc07cff, 0x7a3aa8); return; }
      if (kind === 'clone') { this.burst('clone', x, 0, z, R || 3); return; }
      if (kind === 'heal') { this.burst('heal', x, 0, z, R || 2); return; }
      if (R > 0) this.burst('bomb', x, 0.4, z, R);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ continuous emitters
    /** Projectile trail. cat from projStyle; (x,y,z) world, v velocity (tiles/s), size scale. */
    trail(cat, x, y, z, vx, vy, vz, dt, size, team, color) {
      const P = this.parts;
      const sp = Math.sqrt(vx * vx + vy * vy + vz * vz) || 1;
      const bx = -vx / sp, by = -vy / sp, bz = -vz / sp;
      const k = dt * 60 * this.q;
      const s = size || 1;
      switch (cat) {
        case 'fireball': {
          if (rnd() < 0.9 * k) P.one(x + bx * 0.15 * s, y + by * 0.15 * s, z + bz * 0.15 * s, rr(-0.4, 0.4), rr(0.2, 0.8), rr(-0.4, 0.4), rr(0.22, 0.35), 0.55 * s, 0.25 * s, 0xffd060, 0xff3a00, 0.95, T_FLAME, M_BB, 1, -1, 2, 1);
          if (rnd() < 0.35 * k) P.one(x + bx * 0.4 * s, y + by * 0.4 * s, z + bz * 0.4 * s, rr(-0.3, 0.3), rr(0.4, 0.9), rr(-0.3, 0.3), rr(0.5, 0.8), 0.35 * s, 0.8 * s, 0x5a504a, 0x8a8480, 0.5, T_SMOKE, M_BB, 0, -0.5, 1.5, 1);
          if (rnd() < 0.3 * k) P.one(x, y, z, rr(-1.5, 1.5) + bx * 2, rr(0, 1.5), rr(-1.5, 1.5) + bz * 2, rr(0.3, 0.5), 0.08 * s, 0.04 * s, 0xffe080, 0xff5010, 1, T_GLOW, M_BB, 1, 4, 1, 1);
          this.sprite(x, y, z, 1.25 * s, 0xffa040, 0.7, T_GLOW, 1);
          break;
        }
        case 'rocket': {
