          if (rnd() < 1.0 * k) P.one(x + bx * 0.5, y + by * 0.5, z + bz * 0.5, rr(-0.3, 0.3), rr(0.1, 0.5), rr(-0.3, 0.3), rr(0.7, 1.1), 0.4 * s, 1.0 * s, 0xb8b0a8, 0xe0dcd8, 0.7, T_SMOKE, M_BB, 0, -0.4, 1.2, 1);
          if (rnd() < 0.8 * k) P.one(x + bx * 0.45, y + by * 0.45, z + bz * 0.45, bx * 2, by * 2, bz * 2, rr(0.08, 0.14), 0.45 * s, 0.15 * s, 0xfff0a0, 0xff5010, 1, T_FLAME, M_BB, 1, 0, 1, 1);
          this.sprite(x + bx * 0.5, y + by * 0.5, z + bz * 0.5, 0.9 * s, 0xffa040, 0.8, T_GLOW, 1);
          break;
        }
        case 'firework': {
          if (rnd() < 0.8 * k) P.one(x + bx * 0.2, y, z + bz * 0.2, rr(-0.8, 0.8), rr(-0.2, 0.6), rr(-0.8, 0.8), rr(0.25, 0.45), 0.14, 0.05, 0xffffff, 0xff4fa0, 1, T_STAR4, M_BB, 1, 2, 1, 1);
          if (rnd() < 0.4 * k) P.one(x + bx * 0.3, y, z + bz * 0.3, 0, 0.3, 0, 0.5, 0.18, 0.4, 0xc0b8c0, 0xe8e0e8, 0.45, T_SMOKE, M_BB, 0, -0.3, 1, 1);
          this.sprite(x, y, z, 0.6, 0xff6ab0, 0.7, T_GLOW, 1);
          break;
        }
        case 'spark': {
          this.sprite(x, y, z, 0.5, 0xffc030, 0.9, T_GLOW, 1);
          if (rnd() < 0.5 * k) P.one(x, y, z, rr(-0.5, 0.5), rr(0, 1), rr(-0.5, 0.5), 0.2, 0.08, 0.03, 0xffe080, 0xff6010, 1, T_GLOW, M_BB, 1, 3, 1, 1);
          break;
        }
        case 'bolt': {
          this.sprite(x, y, z, 1.4 * s, 0x6fd8ff, 0.85, T_GLOW, 1);
          this.sprite(x, y, z, 0.55 * s, 0xffffff, 1, T_GLOW, 1);
          if (rnd() < 0.7 * k) {
            const a = rnd() * TAU;
            this.zap(x, y, z, x + Math.cos(a) * 0.7 * s, y + rr(-0.4, 0.4), z + Math.sin(a) * 0.7 * s, 0x9fe8ff, 0.12, 0.08, 1.4, 1);
          }
          break;
        }
        case 'orb': {
          const c = color || 0xc25bff;
          this.sprite(x, y, z, 0.75 * s, c, 0.85, T_GLOW, 1);
          this.sprite(x, y, z, 0.3 * s, 0xffffff, 0.9, T_GLOW, 1);
          if (rnd() < 0.6 * k) P.one(x, y, z, rr(-0.3, 0.3), rr(-0.1, 0.4), rr(-0.3, 0.3), rr(0.2, 0.35), 0.2 * s, 0.05, c, -1, 0.8, T_STAR4, M_BB, 1, 0, 1, 1);
          break;
        }
        case 'lava': {
          this.sprite(x, y, z, 0.8 * s, 0xff7a2a, 0.8, T_GLOW, 1);
          if (rnd() < 0.7 * k) P.one(x, y, z, rr(-0.3, 0.3), rr(-0.4, 0.2), rr(-0.3, 0.3), rr(0.25, 0.4), 0.3 * s, 0.1, 0xffd060, 0xff3a00, 0.9, T_FLAME, M_BB, 1, 2, 1, 1);
          break;
        }
        case 'shard': {
          this.sprite(x, y, z, 0.7 * s, 0x9fe4ff, 0.7, T_GLOW, 1);
          if (rnd() < 0.6 * k) P.one(x, y, z, rr(-0.4, 0.4), rr(-0.2, 0.3), rr(-0.4, 0.4), rr(0.3, 0.5), 0.16, 0.05, 0xffffff, 0x9fe4ff, 0.9, T_FLAKE, M_BB, 1, 0.5, 1, 1);
          break;
        }
        case 'snowball': {
          if (rnd() < 0.7 * k) P.one(x + bx * 0.4 * s, y + by * 0.4 * s, z + bz * 0.4 * s, rr(-0.4, 0.4), rr(0, 0.5), rr(-0.4, 0.4), rr(0.4, 0.6), 0.35 * s, 0.6 * s, 0xffffff, 0xdff4ff, 0.75, T_SMOKE, M_BB, 0, 0.5, 2, 1);
          if (rnd() < 0.5 * k) P.one(x, y, z, rr(-0.6, 0.6), rr(0, 0.6), rr(-0.6, 0.6), rr(0.4, 0.6), 0.14, 0.06, 0xffffff, 0xbfe8ff, 1, T_FLAKE, M_BB, 1, 1, 1, 1);
          break;
        }
        case 'arrow': case 'dart': case 'spear': case 'volley': {
          if (rnd() < 0.6 * k) P.one(x + bx * 0.3, y + by * 0.3, z + bz * 0.3, vx * 0.05, vy * 0.05, vz * 0.05, 0.12, 0.05 * s, 0.03 * s, 0xffffff, -1, 0.45, T_STREAK, M_STRETCH, 1, 0, 0, 9);
          break;
        }
        case 'bullet': {
          this.sprite(x, y, z, 0.2, 0xfff0a0, 1, T_STREAK, 1, M_STRETCH);
          this.parts.sprite(x, y, z, 0.14, 0xfff0a0, 1, T_STREAK, M_STRETCH, 1, 0, vx, vy, vz, 7);
          break;
        }
        case 'cannonball': case 'bomb': {
          if (rnd() < 0.45 * k) P.one(x + bx * 0.25, y + by * 0.25, z + bz * 0.25, rr(-0.2, 0.2), rr(0.1, 0.4), rr(-0.2, 0.2), rr(0.35, 0.55), 0.16 * s, 0.38 * s, 0xb8b0a8, 0xdcd8d4, 0.45, T_SMOKE, M_BB, 0, -0.3, 1.5, 1);
          if (cat === 'bomb' && rnd() < 0.7 * k) P.one(x, y + 0.25 * s, z, rr(-0.8, 0.8), rr(0.5, 1.5), rr(-0.8, 0.8), 0.22, 0.12, 0.04, 0xffffff, 0xffa020, 1, T_STAR4, M_BB, 1, 4, 1, 1);
          break;
        }
        case 'barrel': {
          if (rnd() < 0.3 * k) P.one(x + bx * 0.3, y, z + bz * 0.3, 0, 0.2, 0, 0.4, 0.2, 0.4, 0xd8ccb0, -1, 0.4, T_SMOKE, M_BB, 0, 0, 1, 1);
          break;
        }
        case 'log': case 'barrel-roll': case 'boulder': {
          // ground roll: dust and pebbles behind
          const w = cat === 'log' ? s : (cat === 'boulder' ? 0.4 : 0.6 * s);
          if (rnd() < 1.2 * k) {
            const o = rr(-w, w);
            const px = -bz * o, pz = bx * o;
            P.one(x + px + bx * 0.4, 0.15, z + pz + bz * 0.4, rr(-0.4, 0.4), rr(0.3, 0.9), rr(-0.4, 0.4), rr(0.4, 0.7), 0.35, 0.75, 0xd9c7a0, 0xc8b690, 0.6, T_SMOKE, M_BB, 0, 0, 2.5, 1);
          }
          if (rnd() < 0.6 * k) {
            const o = rr(-w, w);
            const i = P.one(x - bz * o, 0.1, z + bx * o, rr(-1.5, 1.5) + bx, rr(1.5, 3), rr(-1.5, 1.5) + bz, rr(0.4, 0.6), 0.1, 0.1, cat === 'log' ? 0x6aa040 : 0x8a7a5a, -1, 1, cat === 'log' ? T_SHARD : T_CHUNK, M_BB, 0, 12, 0.5, 1);
            P.bounce[i] = 1; P.floor[i] = 0.03 + P.lastG; P.spin[i] = rr(-8, 8);
          }
          break;
        }
        case 'axe': {
          if (rnd() < 0.5 * k) P.one(x, y, z, 0, 0, 0, 0.12, 0.9, 0.9, 0xdfe8ff, -1, 0.18, T_SWIRL, M_GROUND, 1, 0, 0, 1);
          break;
        }
        case 'chain': {
          this.sprite(x, y, z, 0.9, 0x7fe8ff, 0.8, T_GLOW, 1);
          break;
        }
        case 'sphere': {
          // v7 Wirbelkugel flown by the sim (the stand-in mover then stands down)
          this._seenAt('sphere', x, z);
          this._sphereDraw(x, y, z, vx, vz, dt, -1, Math.max(0.8, s));
          break;
        }
        case 'wave': {
          this._seenAt('wave', x, z);
          const sp2 = Math.sqrt(vx * vx + vz * vz);
          if (sp2 < 0.5) return;   // first frame: no heading yet
          this._wave(x, Math.max(0.85, y), z, vx / sp2, vz / sp2, Math.max(1.6, s), 1, team, dt);
          return;
        }
        case 'pellets': {
          this.parts.sprite(x, y, z, 0.12, 0xfff0a0, 1, T_STREAK, M_STRETCH, 1, 0, vx, vy, vz, 6);
          break;
        }
        default: break;
      }
      if (TEAM_TRAIL[cat] && team >= 0) this._teamTrail(x, y, z, vx, vy, vz, sp, k, s, team, TEAM_TRAIL[cat]);
    }

    /**
     * v4 "attacks visible from both sides": every troop / tower / spell shot gets a bright halo
     * and a glowing streak in its team colour (blue = mine, red = the opponent's), so incoming
     * shots read as clearly as outgoing ones at the new zoom. w = per-category weight.
     */
    _teamTrail(x, y, z, vx, vy, vz, sp, k, s, team, w) {
      const T = TEAM[team === 1 ? 1 : 0];
      const P = this.parts;
      const sz = Math.max(0.55, s) * w;
      // team-coloured halo (alpha-blended: true blue / red on the grass) + white-hot streak
      P.sprite(x, y, z, 0.7 * sz, T.main, 0.55, T_GLOW, M_BB, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1);
      if (sp > 0.5) P.sprite(x, y, z, 0.2 * sz, T.light, 1, T_STREAK, M_STRETCH, 1, 0, vx / sp, vy / sp, vz / sp, 7);
      // fading comet tail in the team colour
      if (rnd() < 1.5 * k) {
        const i = P.one(x, y, z, vx * 0.04, vy * 0.04 + 0.1, vz * 0.04, rr(0.22, 0.32), 0.32 * sz, 0.08 * sz, T.main, T.dark, 0.8, T_GLOW, M_BB, 0, 0, 2, 1);
        P.fin[i] = 0.01; P.fout[i] = 0.7;
      }
    }

    /**
     * Melee swing smear: a bright arc around the attacker sweeping through the target direction
     * (team coloured, white core). (x, y, z) attacker world pos at weapon height, (dx, dz) towards
     * the target, r = reach, span = arc angle (rad).
     */
    swing(x, y, z, dx, dz, r, col, width, dur, span) {
      const zp = this.zap(x, y, z, x, y, z, col, width, dur, 0, -1);   // solid team colour
      const a0 = Math.atan2(dz, dx), half = (span || 1.8) / 2;
      const n = 12;
      const pts = zp.pts;
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const t = i / (n - 1);
        const a = a0 - half + t * half * 2;
        const rr2 = r * (0.82 + 0.18 * Math.sin(t * Math.PI));
        pts[i * 3] = x + Math.cos(a) * rr2; pts[i * 3 + 1] = y + (t - 0.5) * 0.25; pts[i * 3 + 2] = z + Math.sin(a) * rr2;
      }
      zp.n = n; zp.next = 1e12;   // fixed shape: never re-jittered
      return zp;
    }

    /** A projectile vanished: show its impact (spell projectiles are handled by spell events). */
    projectileEnd(kind, cat, x, y, z, team) {
      switch (cat) {
        case 'fireball': {
          if (kind === 'fireball') return;
          const D = CR.DATA && CR.DATA.units ? CR.DATA.units[kind] : null;
          const R = D && D.splashRadius > 0 ? D.splashRadius : 0.8;
          this.burst('fireSplash', x, Math.max(0.3, y), z, R);
          return;
        }
        case 'bolt': if (kind === 'sparky') { this.burst('bomb', x, Math.max(0.4, y), z, 1.6); this.burst('elecNova', x, 0, z, 1.8); this.shake(0.4, 0.3); } return;
        case 'bomb': {
          const D = CR.DATA && CR.DATA.units ? CR.DATA.units[kind] : null;
          const R = D && D.splashRadius > 0 ? D.splashRadius : 1.5;
          this.burst('bomb', x, 0.3, z, R * 0.8);
          this.shake(0.12, 0.12);
          return;
        }
        case 'cannonball': {
          if (kind === 'mortar') { this.burst('bomb', x, 0.3, z, 1.6); this.shake(0.2, 0.18); return; }
          return;
        }
        case 'barrel-roll': this.burst('woodBurst', x, 0.4, z, 1); return;
        case 'firework': this.emit('sparkle', x, y, z, 0.8, 10, 0xffffff, 0xff4fa0); this.emit('hitFlash', x, y, z, 0.8, 1, 0xff8ac0); return;
        case 'orb': case 'lava': return;
        case 'sphere': if (this.t - this._sphImp > 0.3) this._sphereBurst(x, Math.max(0.5, y), z, team, 1.2); return;
        case 'wave': this._waveEnd(x, Math.max(0.85, y), z); return;
        case 'pellets': this.emit('sparks', x, Math.max(0.3, y), z, 0.3, 2); return;
        case 'snowball': return;
        case 'spirit': {
          if (kind === 'ice-spirit') this.burst('frostNova', x, 0, z, 1.5);
          else if (kind === 'fire-spirit') this.burst('fireNova', x, 0, z, 2.0);
          else if (kind === 'electro-spirit') this.burst('boltHit', x, Math.max(0.5, y), z, 1.2);
          return;
        }
        default: return;
      }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ areas
    area(id, kind, team, x, z, radius, left, total) {
      let a = this.areas.get(id);
      if (!a) {
        a = this.areaFree.pop() || new AreaVis(this.THREE, this.discGeo, this.domeGeo, this.areaMat);
        const st = AREA_STYLE[kind] || [AK_GENERIC, TEAM[team].light, 0xffffff, 0];
        a.id = id; a.kind = kind; a.team = team; a.k = st[0];
        a.t = 0; a.fade = 0; a.emit = 0; a.pulseT = 0;
        a.total = total > 0 ? total : Math.max(0.5, left);
        a.domeMode = st[3];
        const u1 = a.disc.material.uniforms, u2 = a.dome.material.uniforms;
        u1.uC1.value.set(hexR(st[1]), hexG(st[1]), hexB(st[1])); u1.uC2.value.set(hexR(st[2]), hexG(st[2]), hexB(st[2]));
        u2.uC1.value.set(hexR(st[1]), hexG(st[1]), hexB(st[1])); u2.uC2.value.set(hexR(st[2]), hexG(st[2]), hexB(st[2]));
        u1.uK.value = st[0]; u2.uK.value = st[0];
        this.scene.add(a.disc);
        if (a.domeMode) this.scene.add(a.dome);
        a.on = true;
        this.areas.set(id, a);
      }
      a.seen = this.frame;
      a.x = x; a.z = z; a.r = radius > 0 ? radius : 1; a.left = left;
      if (a.t === 0) {
        // place immediately (the per-frame update runs before the renderer feeds areas)
        a.disc.position.set(x, 0.05, z); a.disc.scale.set(a.r * 0.6, 1, a.r * 0.6);
        a.dome.position.set(x, 0.02, z); a.dome.scale.set(a.r * 0.6, a.r * 0.3, a.r * 0.6);
        a.disc.material.uniforms.uA.value = 0; a.dome.material.uniforms.uA.value = 0;
      }
    }

    _updateAreas(dt) {
      // (Map iteration without a per-frame closure; deleting the current key is safe)
      for (const ent of this.areas) {
        const id = ent[0], a = ent[1];
        // area() for this frame is called after update(): live = fed during the previous frame
        const live = a.seen >= this.frame - 1;
        a.t += dt;
        a.fade = live ? Math.min(1, a.fade + dt * 6) : a.fade - dt * 3.5;
        if (a.fade <= 0) {
          this.scene.remove(a.disc); this.scene.remove(a.dome);
          a.on = false;
          this.areas.delete(id);
          this.areaFree.push(a);
          continue;
        }
        const prog = clamp(1 - a.left / Math.max(0.01, a.total), 0, 1);
        const R = a.r;
        let rs = R;
        // pop-in scale
        const pop = Math.min(1, a.t / 0.18);
        rs = R * (0.6 + 0.4 * (1 - (1 - pop) * (1 - pop)));
        a.disc.position.set(a.x, 0.05, a.z);
        a.disc.scale.set(rs, 1, rs);
        const u = a.disc.material.uniforms;
        u.uT.value = a.t; u.uA.value = a.fade; u.uP.value = prog;
        if (a.domeMode) {
          const ud = a.dome.material.uniforms;
          ud.uT.value = a.t;
          let ha = 0.7, hy = 0.45;
          if (a.k === AK_FREEZE) { ha = 0.38 * (a.t < 0.5 ? 1 + (0.5 - a.t) * 2.4 : 1); hy = 0.5; }
          if (a.k === AK_TORNADO) { ha = 0.8; hy = 1.1; }
          if (a.k === AK_POISON) { ha = 0.45; hy = 0.42; }
          ud.uA.value = a.fade * ha;
          a.dome.position.set(a.x, 0.02, a.z);
          a.dome.scale.set(rs, rs * hy, rs);
          if (a.k === AK_TORNADO) a.dome.rotation.y -= dt * 5;
        }
        this._areaEmit(a, dt, prog);
      }
    }

    _areaEmit(a, dt, prog) {
      const P = this.parts, x = a.x, z = a.z, R = a.r;
      a.pulseT += dt;
      const k = a.k;
      const q = this.q;
      // fractional emission accumulator (one rate per area kind; no closure per frame)
      const rate = areaRate;
      areaRateA = a; areaRateDt = dt * q;
      let n;
      switch (k) {
        case AK_POISON:
          n = rate(16 * R / 3);
          for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) this.parts.emit(PRE.bubbles, x, 0.05, z, R, 1, -1, -1);
          if (rnd() < dt * 6) this.parts.emit(PRE.smoke, x + rr(-R, R) * 0.6, 0.2, z + rr(-R, R) * 0.6, 0.6, 1, 0x7ab828, 0xa8e060);
          break;
        case AK_FREEZE:
          n = rate(8);
          for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            const an = rnd() * TAU, r = R * Math.sqrt(rnd());
            P.one(x + Math.cos(an) * r, rr(0.1, 1.8), z + Math.sin(an) * r, 0, -0.3, 0, rr(0.6, 1.1), 0.18, 0.1, 0xffffff, 0xa8e8ff, 0.9, T_FLAKE, M_BB, 1, 0.2, 0.5, 1);
          }
          break;
        case AK_RAGE:
          n = rate(14 * R / 3);
          for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            const an = rnd() * TAU, r = R * Math.sqrt(rnd());
            P.one(x + Math.cos(an) * r, 0.1, z + Math.sin(an) * r, 0, rr(1.2, 2.6), 0, rr(0.6, 1.0), 0.16, 0.06, 0xff9af0, 0xb43cff, 0.9, T_GLOW, M_BB, 1, 0, 0.5, 1);
          }
          if (a.pulseT > 0.55) { a.pulseT = 0; P.emit(PRE.shock, x, 0.07, z, R * 0.45, 1, 0xd070ff, -1); }
          break;
        case AK_TORNADO:
          n = rate(30);
          for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            const an = rnd() * TAU, r = R * rr(0.25, 1);
            const sp = 6 + (1 - r / R) * 4;
            // tangential velocity (counter-clockwise) + inward + up
            const c = Math.cos(an), s = Math.sin(an);
            const j = P.one(x + c * r, rr(0.1, 1.2), z + s * r, -s * sp - c * 1.2, rr(0.8, 2.2), c * sp - s * 1.2, rr(0.35, 0.6), rr(0.25, 0.5), 0.15, 0xffffff, 0xcfe0f0, 0.55, T_STREAK, M_STRETCH, 1, 0, 0.3, 5);
            P.fin[j] = 0.2;
          }
          if (rnd() < dt * 10) P.emit(PRE.dust, x, 0.05, z, R * 0.35, 2, -1, -1);
          if (rnd() < dt * 3) P.one(x, 0.06, z, 0, 0, 0, 0.6, R * 1.6, R * 1.4, 0xffffff, -1, 0.35, T_SWIRL, M_GROUND, 1, 0, 0, 1);
          break;
        case AK_QUAKE:
          if (a.pulseT > 0.5) {
            a.pulseT = 0;
            P.emit(PRE.dust, x, 0.05, z, R * 0.65, 14, 0xc8ae84, -1);
            P.emit(PRE.debris, x, 0.1, z, R * 0.45, 10, 0x7a6a54, 0x4a3a28);
            P.emit(PRE.dustRing, x, 0.05, z, R * 0.8, 1, 0xd8c8a8, -1);
            this.shake(0.25, 0.3);
          }
          n = rate(16);
          for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            const an = rnd() * TAU, r = R * Math.sqrt(rnd());
            const j = P.one(x + Math.cos(an) * r, 0.05, z + Math.sin(an) * r, rr(-0.5, 0.5), rr(1.5, 3), rr(-0.5, 0.5), rr(0.35, 0.6), 0.09, 0.09, 0x8a7458, -1, 1, T_CHUNK, M_BB, 0, 12, 0.5, 1);
            P.bounce[j] = 1; P.floor[j] = 0.03 + P.lastG; P.spin[j] = rr(-8, 8);
          }
          break;
        case AK_GRAVE:
          n = rate(10);
          for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            const an = rnd() * TAU, r = R * Math.sqrt(rnd());
            P.one(x + Math.cos(an) * r, rr(0.1, 0.6), z + Math.sin(an) * r, rr(-0.2, 0.2), rr(0.05, 0.3), rr(-0.2, 0.2), rr(1.2, 2), rr(0.8, 1.3), 1.8, 0x2a2040, 0x4a3a6a, 0.45, T_SMOKE, M_BB, 0, 0, 0.5, 1);
          }
          break;
        case AK_HEAL:
          n = rate(10);
          for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) P.emit(PRE.heal, x, 0.2, z, R * 0.8, 1, -1, -1);
          break;
        case AK_BOMB:
          // fuse sparkle at the centre
          this.sprite(x, 0.5, z, 0.6 + 0.3 * Math.sin(a.t * 30), 0xffc040, 0.9, T_STAR4, 1, M_BB, a.t * 6);
          break;
        case AK_DELIVERY:
          if (a.kind === 'royal-delivery') {
            // falling crate shadow is drawn by the renderer; sparkle trail from the sky
            const h = 0.4 + (1 - prog) * 12;
            if (rnd() < dt * 18) P.one(x + rr(-0.4, 0.4), h + 0.8, z + rr(-0.4, 0.4), 0, 2, 0, 0.5, 0.25, 0.08, 0xffffff, 0xffd23f, 0.9, T_STAR4, M_BB, 1, 0, 1, 1);
          } else this.sprite(x, 0.2, z, 0.8, 0x9ff0ff, 0.6, T_GLOW, 1);
          break;
        default:
          if (rnd() < dt * 8) P.emit(PRE.sparkle, x, 0.3, z, R * 0.6, 1, 0xffffff, -1);
      }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ per-unit status emitters
    /**
     * Called by the renderer per unit per frame. fx = view bitmask, e = {x,y,z,h,r}, moving speed (tiles/s),
     * dir (sim angle) for speed lines, tier (chaos rarity).
     */
    unitFx(e, fx, speed, vx, vz, tier, dt, unit, flags) {
      const P = this.parts;
      const k = dt * this.q;
      const x = e.x, y = e.y, z = e.z, r = e.r || 0.5, h = e.h || 1.4;
      // v12 (user: "fewer effects around the units, attack effects yes, walking effects less"):
      // no foot dust / speed streaks while walking or dashing any more; a charge (an attack
      // wind-up) keeps a few faint streaks; status effects (rage, freeze, stun) stay.
      if ((fx & 16) && speed > 0.5) {
        if (rnd() < k * ((flags & 4) ? 3 : 6)) {
          const sp = Math.max(0.1, speed);
          const ox = rr(-r, r) * 1.2, oy = rr(0.2, h * 0.9);
          P.one(x + ox - vx / sp * 0.4, y + oy, z + rr(-r, r) * 1.2 - vz / sp * 0.4, vx * 0.3, 0, vz * 0.3, 0.14, 0.05, 0.03, 0xffffff, -1, 0.45, T_STREAK, M_STRETCH, 1, 0, 0, 10);
        }
      }
      if ((fx & 32) && speed > 0.3) {
        // tunnelling (Miner): moving mound of dirt (the only sign of the unit: kept, lighter)
        if (rnd() < k * 14) P.emit(PRE.dirt, x, 0.05, z, 0.5, 1, -1, -1);
        this.sprite(x, 0.04, z, 1.1, 0x4a3420, 0.5, T_SMOKE, 0, M_GROUND, 0);
      }
      if (fx & 8) {
        if (rnd() < k * 10) P.one(x + rr(-r, r), y + rr(0.1, h), z + rr(-r, r), 0, rr(0.8, 1.6), 0, rr(0.4, 0.7), 0.16, 0.05, 0xff9af0, 0xb43cff, 0.9, T_GLOW, M_BB, 1, 0, 0.5, 1);
      }
      if (fx & 2) {
        if (rnd() < k * 4) P.one(x + rr(-r, r), y + rr(0.2, h), z + rr(-r, r), 0, 0.2, 0, 0.6, 0.18, 0.1, 0xffffff, 0x9fe4ff, 0.9, T_FLAKE, M_BB, 1, 0, 0.5, 1);
      }
      if (fx & 1) {
        if (rnd() < k * 5) {
          const a = rnd() * TAU;
          this.zap(x + Math.cos(a) * r * 0.6, y + h * 0.7, z + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.6, x - Math.cos(a) * r * 0.6, y + h * rr(0.3, 0.9), z - Math.sin(a) * r * 0.6, 0x9fe8ff, 0.08, 0.1, 1.6, 1);
        }
      }
      if (tier >= 4) {
        // v12: idle C.H.A.O.S auras only for the legendary tier, as a faint ground glow (no pulsing
        // ring, no rising motes); lower tiers show just the model's small badge
        this.sprite(x, 0.05, z, r * 2.4, RARITY[4], 0.12, T_GLOW, 1, M_GROUND, 0);
      }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ frame
    update(dt, camera) {
      this.frame++;
      this._lblFrame = 0;
      if (!(dt >= 0)) dt = 0;
      if (dt > 0.1) dt = 0.1;
      this.t += dt;
      if (camera) { this.camPos.x = camera.position.x; this.camPos.y = camera.position.y; this.camPos.z = camera.position.z; }
      this._flushChains();
      if (this._later.length || this._sweeps.length) this._updateLater();
      this.parts.update(dt);
      if (dt > 0 && !this.opts.noAmbient) this._ambient(dt);
      this._fire(dt);
      this._updateAreas(dt);
      // ribbons: timed zaps (re-jitter at ~25 Hz for flicker)
      this.ribbons.begin(this.camPos);
      for (let i = 0; i < this.zaps.length; i++) {
        const zp = this.zaps[i];
        if (!zp.on) continue;
        const k = (this.t - zp.t0) / zp.dur;
        if (k >= 1) { zp.on = false; continue; }
        if (this.t >= zp.next) {
          boltPts(zp.pts, zp.x0, zp.y0, zp.z0, zp.x1, zp.y1, zp.z1, zp.n, zp.jag);
          zp.next = this.t + 0.04;
        }
        const al = k < 0.15 ? 1 : 1 - (k - 0.15) / 0.85;
        this.ribbons.add(zp.pts, zp.n, zp.w * (1 - k * 0.3), zp.col, al, zp.core, 0.3);
      }
      if (this._movers.length) this._updateMovers(dt);
    }

    /** A real v7 projectile ('wave' | 'sphere') was drawn at (x, z) this frame. */
    _seenAt(k, x, z) {
      let s = this._seen[k];
      if (!s) s = this._seen[k] = { t: 0, x: 0, z: 0 };
      s.t = this.t; s.x = x; s.z = z;
    }

    /** v10 grimdark ambient: hot embers drifting up over the arena, a little falling ash and dark
     *  mist wisps creeping along the side walls (all in the one particle draw call). */
    _ambient(dt) {
      const P = this.parts;
      this._ambP = (this._ambP || 0) + dt * 2.4 * this.q;
      while (this._ambP >= 1) {
        this._ambP -= 1;
        const side = rnd() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
        // embers rise mostly near the walls, a few over the field
        const x = rnd() < 0.7 ? side * rr(6.5, 9.6) : rr(-8, 8);
        const j = P.one(x, rr(0.2, 1.4), rr(-16.5, 16.5), rr(-0.12, 0.12), rr(0.25, 0.55), rr(-0.12, 0.12), rr(3.2, 5.2), 0.075, 0.035, 0xffc060, 0xff3a12, 0.85, T_GLOW, M_BB, 1, -0.03, 0.15, 1);
        P.fin[j] = 0.15; P.fout[j] = 0.5;
      }
      this._ambA = (this._ambA || 0) + dt * 0.9 * this.q;
      while (this._ambA >= 1) {
        this._ambA -= 1;
        const j = P.one(rr(-9.5, 9.5), rr(2.6, 3.6), rr(-16, 16), rr(0.05, 0.25), rr(-0.32, -0.18), rr(-0.1, 0.1), rr(4, 6), 0.05, 0.05, 0x8a8080, 0x5a5254, 0.7, T_GLOW, M_BB, 0, 0, 0.05, 1);
        P.fin[j] = 0.2; P.fout[j] = 0.3; P.bounce[j] = 0; P.floor[j] = 0.02 + P.lastG;
      }
      this._ambF = (this._ambF || 0) + dt * 1.3 * this.q;
      while (this._ambF >= 1) {
        this._ambF -= 1;
        const side = rnd() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
        const lr = rnd() < 0.8;   // along the side walls (else along the back walls)
        const x = lr ? side * rr(8.6, 10.2) : rr(-8, 8), z = lr ? rr(-16, 16) : side * rr(15.6, 16.8);
        const s0 = rr(1.8, 2.8);
        const j = P.one(x, rr(0.25, 0.6), z, lr ? -side * rr(0.04, 0.12) : rr(-0.15, 0.15), rr(0.01, 0.05), lr ? rr(-0.18, 0.18) : -side * rr(0.03, 0.08), rr(6, 9), s0, s0 * 1.5, 0x3c3844, 0x262230, 0.3, T_SMOKE, M_BB, 0, 0, 0.02, 1);
        P.spin[j] = rr(-0.15, 0.15); P.fin[j] = 0.3; P.fout[j] = 0.45;
      }
    }

    /** v10: brazier fires on the arena pillars [{x, y, z, k}] (world, k = size); drawn every frame
     *  by _fire (flame sprites, halo, warm light pool on the ground, rising embers). */
    setBraziers(list) {
      const out = this._braz || (this._braz = []);
      out.length = 0;
      for (let i = 0; list && i < list.length; i++) { const b = list[i]; if (b && isFinite(b.x) && isFinite(b.z)) out.push({ x: +b.x, y: +b.y || 0, z: +b.z, k: b.k > 0 ? +b.k : 1, gy: isFinite(b.gy) ? +b.gy : 0, ph: i * 1.731 }); }
      return out.length;
    }
    _fire(dt) {
      const B = this._braz;
      if (!B || !B.length) return;
      const P = this.parts;
      this._fireT = (this._fireT || 0) + Math.min(0.1, dt > 0 ? dt : 1 / 60);
      const t = this._fireT, calm = this.reduced ? 0.35 : 1;
      this._fireE = (this._fireE || 0) + (dt > 0 ? dt : 0) * 4.5 * this.q * B.length;
      for (let i = 0; i < B.length; i++) {
        const b = B[i], k = b.k, ph = b.ph;
        const f = 1 + calm * (0.11 * Math.sin(t * 13.1 + ph) * Math.sin(t * 7.7 + ph * 2.3) + 0.06 * Math.sin(t * 23.3 + ph * 0.7));
        const sway = calm * 0.05 * Math.sin(t * 5.3 + ph);
        P.sprite(b.x, b.y - 0.27 * k, b.z, 3.4 * k * (0.97 + 0.03 * f), 0xff7424, 0.2 * f, T_GLOW, M_GROUND, 1, 0);   // light pool
        // v11: flickering warm torch light pool on the field at the pillar's foot (dusk mood)
        P.sprite(b.x, b.gy + 0.035, b.z, 5.6 * k * (0.96 + 0.04 * f), 0xff8a3a, 0.085 * f * f, T_GLOW, M_GROUND, 1, 0);
        P.sprite(b.x, b.y + 0.15 * k, b.z, 2.0 * k * f, 0xff4a12, 0.3 * f, T_GLOW, M_BB, 1, 0);                     // halo
        P.sprite(b.x, b.y + 0.36 * k, b.z, 1.2 * k * f, 0xff4a10, 0.85, T_FLAME, M_BB, 1, sway);                    // flame
        P.sprite(b.x + sway * 0.6, b.y + 0.42 * k, b.z, 0.72 * k * (2 - f), 0xff8a24, 0.75, T_FLAME, M_BB, 1, -sway * 1.6);  // tongue
        P.sprite(b.x, b.y + 0.18 * k, b.z, 0.4 * k, 0xffc860, 0.6, T_FLAME, M_BB, 1, 0);                            // hot core
      }
      while (this._fireE >= 1) {
        this._fireE -= 1;
        const b = B[(rnd() * B.length) | 0];
        const j = P.one(b.x + rr(-0.12, 0.12) * b.k, b.y + 0.25 * b.k, b.z + rr(-0.12, 0.12) * b.k, rr(-0.35, 0.35), rr(0.9, 1.9), rr(-0.35, 0.35), rr(0.9, 1.8), 0.08 * b.k, 0.03, 0xffd070, 0xff3a10, 1, T_GLOW, M_BB, 1, -0.2, 0.6, 1);
        P.fin[j] = 0.05; P.fout[j] = 0.55;
      }
    }

    /** Finish the frame: upload particles + ribbons (call after all beams/sprites of this frame). */
    commit() {
      this.parts.upload();
      this.ribbons.end();
      this.stats.particles = this.parts.drawn || 0;
      this.stats.ribbons = this.ribbons.n;
      this.stats.areas = this.areas.size;
    }

    reset() {
      this.parts.clear();
      this._chainQ.length = 0; this._later.length = 0; this._chainT.clear();
      this._movers.length = 0; this._gunT.clear(); this._gunHit.clear();
      for (let i = 0; i < this._sweeps.length; i++) this._sweeps[i].on = false;
      const self = this;
      this.areas.forEach(function (a) { self.scene.remove(a.disc); self.scene.remove(a.dome); a.on = false; self.areaFree.push(a); });
      this.areas.clear();
      for (let i = 0; i < this.zaps.length; i++) this.zaps[i].on = false;
      this.ribbons.n = 0;
      this.ribbons.end();
    }

    dispose() {
      this.reset();
      this.scene.remove(this.parts.mesh);
      this.scene.remove(this.ribbons.mesh);
      this.parts.dispose();
      this.ribbons.dispose();
      this.discGeo.dispose(); this.domeGeo.dispose(); this.areaMat.dispose();
      for (let i = 0; i < this.areaFree.length; i++) { this.areaFree[i].disc.material.dispose(); this.areaFree[i].dome.material.dispose(); }
      this.areaFree.length = 0;
      if (this.atlas) this.atlas.dispose();
    }
  }

  function cardOf(id) {
    if (CR.Sim && typeof CR.Sim.cardById === 'function') { try { return CR.Sim.cardById(id) || null; } catch (e) { return null; } }
    return null;
  }
  function tierOf(ev) {
    if (!ev) return 0;
    const up = ev.upgrade && typeof ev.upgrade === 'object' ? ev.upgrade : (ev.option && typeof ev.option === 'object' ? ev.option : null);
    let r;
    if (up && up.rarity !== undefined) r = up.rarity;
    else if (up && up.tier !== undefined) r = up.tier;
    else if (ev.rarity !== undefined) r = ev.rarity;
    else r = ev.tier;
    if (typeof r === 'number') return r | 0;
    const s = String(r || '').toLowerCase();
    if (s === 'epic') return 3;
    if (s === 'rare') return 2;
    if (s === 'common') return 1;
    if (s === 'legendary' || s === 'champion') return 4;
    return 0;
  }
  VFX.tierOf = tierOf;
  // C.H.A.O.S ability kinds -> element of the extra effect; kinds positioned at the event point
  const ABILITY_ELEMENT = {
    explosion: 'fire', meteor: 'fire', bomb: 'fire', burn: 'fire', barrage: 'fire',
    zap: 'elec', chain: 'elec', storm: 'elec', strike: 'elec',
    frost: 'ice', snowstorm: 'ice',
    poison: 'poison', cloud: 'poison',
    tornado: 'wind', pull: 'wind', push: 'wind', spin: 'wind',
    quake: 'slam', slam: 'slam', jump: 'slam', impact: 'slam', bounce: 'slam', grow: 'slam', 'break': 'slam',
    shield: 'holy', revive: 'holy', elixir: 'holy', double: 'holy', reveal: 'holy', leveldown: 'dark',
    spawn: 'spawn', graveyard: 'dark', bats: 'spawn', clone: 'spawn', mirror: 'spawn', egg: 'spawn', hatch: 'spawn',
    split: 'spawn', trio: 'spawn', transform: 'spawn', random: 'spawn', roam: 'spawn',
    barrel: 'wood', multiroll: 'wood', longroll: 'wood', drop: 'wood', volley: 'wood', throw: 'wood', boomerang: 'wood', launch: 'wood',
    dash: '', charge: '', pierce: '',
  };
  const HEAVY_MELEE = { pekka: 1, 'mini-pekka': 1, 'giant-skeleton': 1, golem: 1, giant: 1, 'electro-giant': 1, 'royal-giant': 1, 'ice-golem': 1,
    'mega-knight': 1, prince: 1, 'goblin-giant': 1, 'elixir-golem': 1, lumberjack: 1, 'battle-ram': 1, 'ram-rider': 1, 'hog-rider': 1, 'royal-hogs': 1, 'royal-hog': 1 };
  const SPIN_MELEE = { valkyrie: 1, 'dark-prince': 1, executioner: 1, bowler: 1 };
  // v7 cards (contract: docs/V7 shared contract in the 26-gfx-render3d.js header)
  const V7_KINDS = { shotgun: 1, pump: 1, endoskeleton: 1, champion_slash: 1, sphere: 1 };
  // v12 custom-card extra abilities (contract: SHARED CONTRACT v12, src/04-units.js abilityEvent)
  const V12_KINDS = { shadow_clone: 1, dodge: 1, whirlwind: 1, parry: 1, lock_on: 1 };
  const V7_UNITS = { 'cyborg-hunter': 1, 'cyborg-endoskeleton': 1, 'black-blade-master': 1, 'spiral-ninja': 1 };
  /** Crescent polyline (champion slash wave) into pts: N points bulging forward along (dx, dz). */
  function crescent(pts, N, x, y, z, dx, dz, half, bulge, off, sc, lift) {
    const px = -dz, pz = dx;
    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
      const a = (i / (N - 1) * 2 - 1) * 1.3, s = Math.sin(a), c = Math.cos(a);
      const f = bulge * (c - 0.6) + off;
      pts[i * 3] = x + px * half * sc * s + dx * f;
      pts[i * 3 + 1] = y + lift - 0.3 * (1 - c);
      pts[i * 3 + 2] = z + pz * half * sc * s + dz * f;
    }
  }
  const ABILITY_AT_POINT = { explosion: 1, meteor: 1, bomb: 1, strike: 1, storm: 1, quake: 1, tornado: 1, poison: 1, cloud: 1, graveyard: 1, snowstorm: 1, drop: 1, spawn: 1, barrage: 1, volley: 1 };
  function upgradeName(ev) {
    if (!ev) return null;
    const up = ev.upgrade && typeof ev.upgrade === 'object' ? ev.upgrade : (ev.option && typeof ev.option === 'object' ? ev.option : null);
    let n = ev.label || ev.text || ev.title || ev.name || (up && (up.label || up.name || up.title)) || ev.ability || null;
    if (!n && CR.Chaos && typeof CR.Chaos.describe === 'function') {
      try {
        const id = typeof ev.id === 'string' && ev.id.indexOf(':') > 0 ? ev.id : (ev.card && ev.rarity ? ev.card + ':' + ev.rarity : null);
        const d = id ? CR.Chaos.describe(id) : null;
        if (d && d.title) n = d.title;
      } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    }
    if (typeof n === 'string' && n) return n.length > 34 ? n.slice(0, 33) + '…' : n;
    return ev.t === 'chaos_pick' ? 'Upgrade!' : null;
  }
  VFX.upgradeName = upgradeName;

  VFX.create = function (scene, opts) {
    if (!VFX.available() || !scene) return null;
    return new System(scene, opts);
  };
  VFX.System = System;
})(globalThis.CR || (globalThis.CR = {}));

</script>
<script>
/* src/26-gfx-render3d.js */
/* Chaos Royale - 26-gfx-render3d.js (render3d)
 * CR.Render3D: three.js battle renderer with the same API as the 2D CR.Render.
 *
 *   const r = new CR.Render3D(canvas [, { emotes: 'auto'|true|false, colorMode: 'relative'|'absolute',
 *                                         countdown: true, shake: true, quality: 'auto'|'high'|'low',
 *                                         preserveDrawingBuffer: false, unitScale: 2.0, fov: 6,
 *                                         pitchMin: 38, pitchMax: 56, marginX: 0.012,
 *                                         antialias: auto, batch: true }]);
 *   r.resize(cssW, cssH, dpr);       // backing store + camera fit (DPR policy below)
 *   r.draw(prevView, curView, alpha, { localSide, localPlayer, drag, nowMs, w, h, dpr, autoEvents });
 *   r.feedEvents(events);            // dedupe by seq -> state flags, banners, CR.VFX effects
 *   r.screenToSim(px, py [, side]) -> {x, y}   // raycast onto the ground (hill map: the terrain)
 *   r.simToScreen(x, y [, side])   -> {px, py}  // ground point (hill map: on the terrain)
 *   r.setMap('classic' | 'hill' | 'tunnel')  // also automatic from view.map (else CR.Arena.map)
 *   r.arenaRect() -> {x, y, w, h}    // CSS px bounding box of the 18x32 field (without stone edge)
 *   r.tileSize(); r.setOptions(o); r.reset(); r.dispose() (alias destroy())
 *   r.prewarm(cardOrUnitIds)          // build model templates up front (also done from the hands)
 *   r.stats() -> { fps, ms, drawMs, calls, triangles, dpr, units, particles, batched }   (dev)
 *   r.snapshot() -> canvas            // 3D + overlay composite (dev screenshots)
 *   CR.Render3D.isSupported() -> bool // THREE present and a WebGL context can be created
 *   r.setMode('chaos' | 'touchdown')  // v6, also automatic from view.mode / view.touchdown
 *
 * v12 (SHARED CONTRACT v12):
 *  - Map 'tunnel' (setMap('tunnel'), view.map): flat field like Touchdown's (no river / bridges /
 *    ridge, continuous side walls, mid-wall pillars), crown towers; CR.Arena.TUNNEL (else the
 *    RULES map, else holes at (9, 8) / (9, 24)) is drawn as: a darker earth strip with timber ribs
 *    along the path painted into the field + one translucent strip mesh over it (amber edges),
 *    per hole a painted pit (ramp darkening towards the tunnel, plank steps), a horseshoe of rim
 *    stones open at the ramp entrance and a timber portal with a black mouth at its far end
 *    (static scenery mesh). Units with view.tunnel === true (or .underground) are underground:
 *    dark translucent silhouettes (setGhost) sunk 0.22 below the ground, no shadow, a team ring,
 *    no status emitters, so tunnel fights stay readable. Enter / exit: a small dirt puff
 *    ({t:'tunnel'} event, else the view flag changing). Helpers: CR.Render3D.tunnel.
 *  - Layout: lanes and plazas follow CR.Arena.towerLayout() (princess further back, king pad with
 *    its `depth`); the king model is scaled to width x depth and drawn a little lower (KING_H).
 *  - Fewer effects around units (user request): the VFX draw no walking dust / speed streaks and
 *    no idle C.H.A.O.S auras (legendary: faint glow), CR.GFX.options speedLines / aura default off.
 *  - Custom card abilities: Wirbel-Ninja shadow clones (ids from the 'shadow_clone' spawn event)
 *    are light-blue translucent and vanish in a smoke puff on reason 'expired'; dodge / parry /
 *    whirlwind / lock_on effects live in CR.VFX.
 *
 * v11 (menacing dark fantasy, design only): darker desaturated moss / olive field (same checker
 *    contrast, slightly lighter grid lines, subtle dark-earth patches; hill slopes / meadow and
 *    touchdown mowing bands toned to the same dusk), wider warm torch pools at the corner and
 *    mid-wall braziers (baked + a flickering CR.VFX ground pool, brazier entries carry gy),
 *    deeper screen vignette, saturated royal blue team colours (TEAM_CSS / TEAM_HEX = CR.GFX
 *    teamColors = CR.VFX team), a thin team-coloured ground ring under every unit (one instanced
 *    draw call; own units brightest, foes dimmer; options.teamRings false = off).
 *
 * v10 (grimdark / dark fantasy premium look, design only - mechanics untouched):
 *  - Dusk mood: near-black backdrop, screen vignette (overlay CSS background, composited into
 *    snapshot(); options.vignette false = off), kit lights graded to a warm low amber key, cool
 *    blue fill, ember rim, dim cool-sky / warm-earth hemisphere (_duskGrade; options.mood 'day' or
 *    CR.GFX.config.battleMood 'kit' = keep the kit's lights and tower colours).
 *  - Field: deeper, richer two-green checker with clearly visible tile lines, dark worn-earth
 *    lanes, sparse blood-red / dry-gold blossoms, dark slate tower plazas with a gold inlay,
 *    baked dusk grade (edge darkening, scorched patches, warm brazier pools in the corners).
 *    Hill: darker ridge paint, dark cobbles, dimmed meadow props. Touchdown: deeper team end
 *    zones with gold trim / emblem, chalk lines stay white (readability).
 *  - Scenery: dark cool stone walls under a dark coping with a thin gold inlay; gold-ringed stone
 *    pillars at the corners and the river ends (hill / touchdown: mid side walls) crowned by iron
 *    braziers with glowing coals; CR.VFX draws their flickering flames, halos, ground light pools
 *    and embers (fx.setBraziers(this._braziers)). Dark wet bank stones, dark timber bridges with
 *    riveted wrought-iron straps, iron post caps; dark-teal water with glowing caustic veins.
 *  - Crown towers keep their team colours; their stone / timber is darkened in the template
 *    geometry once (grimTowerGeo; skipped when the model's stone is already dark).
 *  - Cost: same draw calls (scenery stays one mesh; fire = sprites in the VFX particle call),
 *    +~18k static triangles.
 *
 * v8 (user feedback "looks cheap / for babies", target: clean, crisp, high resolution):
 *  - Resolution: the renderer owns the DPR policy - it renders at the device ratio (the caller's
 *    capped dpr is raised; options.dprMode 'caller' keeps it) up to 3 on capable devices (WebGL2 +
 *    8k textures; else 2) under a 3.8 Mpx budget, MSAA always on (except quality 'low'), and steps
 *    3 -> 2.5 -> 2 -> 1.5 -> 1.25 when frames run long. The 2D overlay (HP bars, tower numbers,
 *    badges) always uses the full device ratio (r.odpr) with device-pixel-snapped bars.
 *  - Arena: field painted at 64 px per tile (1152 x 2048, mipmaps + up to 16x anisotropic): clean
 *    two-green checker with clearly visible tiles and thin light grid lines (bevel), ~40k fine
 *    grass blades in colour buckets, crisp sand lanes with pebbles, five-petal flowers, bevelled
 *    flagstone plazas; bevelled (rounded-edge) wall stones, caps, bank stones, bridge planks with
 *    nail heads, rails with post caps; smooth pillars / corner turrets; new water shader (flowing
 *    anti-aliased caustic cells, deeper centre, bank shadow, crisp wavy foam lines, glints);
 *    deploy overlay / end zones / footprint squares at double resolution; 256 px soft contact
 *    shadows (dense core + smooth penumbra, instanced as before).
 *  - Colour: sRGB output; ACES filmic tone mapping when the kit has PBR materials
 *    (CR.GFX.environment present, or a CR.GFX.toneMapping / options.toneMapping hint 'aces' |
 *    'none' | { mapping, exposure }); painted / unlit renderer surfaces are not tone-mapped.
 *    CR.GFX.environment(renderer, scene) (or a Texture) becomes scene.environment; lights come
 *    from CR.GFX.addLights(scene, { renderer }) as before (own fallback rig otherwise).
 *
 * v6 (docs/TOUCHDOWN.md, contract "SHARED CONTRACT v6"):
 *  - Touchdown field (view.mode 'touchdown'): no crown towers (tower memos hidden: no shadows, bars,
 *    batching), no river / bridges, continuous side walls; a football-style painted field (mowing
 *    bands, white sidelines, bold goal lines, the engine's CR.Arena.FIELD_LINES with thicker deploy
 *    lines at the quarter lines, a thicker halfway line with ring + diamond (not on the hill ridge), hash marks, wordless
 *    direction chevrons); one painted plane per end zone (CR.Arena.endZones, classified by
 *    position) in the viewer-relative team colour with diagonal stripes, chevron band and star
 *    emblem, team pylons at the corners and a team banner on the back wall. Map 'hill' = the same
 *    field over the v5 ridge (terrain mesh, ridge decor without the lane paths).
 *  - Scoring (event 'touchdown' / 'score', else view.touchdown.score rising): confetti + light
 *    pillars + shock rings + fireworks in the end zone (fx.touchdown), crown pop, flash + shake, the
 *    scored zone flashes, a team-coloured sweep runs over the field (fx.sweep) and the cleared
 *    troops vanish in poofs (no death animation); both zones pulse while touchdown.resetIn > 0. The
 *    celebration runs on real time (the sim pauses for the kick-off). Score digits are HUD only.
 *  - Card abilities ({t:'ability', kind: 'chain'|'dash'|'combo'|'one-inch', unitId, ...}) are passed
 *    to the unit's instance as st.ability / st.abilityT / st.abilityN (models in 27-gfx-chars-d.js)
 *    and drawn by CR.VFX (chain lightning hops, combo pips, one-inch shockwave, flying-kick streak).
 *  - CR.Render3D.touchdown = pure helpers { zones, lines, rect, scoreZone, arenaKey, isTouchdown }.
 *
 * v7 (SHARED CONTRACT v7: champions, three new cards):
 *  - view.players[i].champion = { unitId, card, ready, cost, cooldownLeft, active } | null is indexed
 *    per view (_champIndex): that unit's instance gets st.champReady / st.champActive (model aura)
 *    and CR.VFX.championAura draws the champion marker under it every frame.
 *  - Ability events {t:'ability', kind: 'champion_slash'|'shotgun'|'pump'|'endoskeleton'|'sphere',
 *    unitId, x, y, tx, ty} -> st.ability for the model pose (pump action, slash pose, 'rise' for the
 *    endoskeleton) + CR.VFX effects. Events for units that are not in the views yet are kept
 *    (_pendAbil, 1.5 s) and applied when the unit appears. A new 'cyborg-endoskeleton' unit always
 *    rises ('rise' pose; burst from here when no 'endoskeleton' event came); a unit whose type
 *    changes under the same id (Cyborg-Jäger -> endoskeleton) swaps its model (_retypeUnit).
 *  - Entities carry their world facing (e.fdx, e.fdz) for aimed effects; the cyborg's red eye gets a
 *    glow sprite, the Wirbel-Ninja's forming sphere a palm glow while winding up.
 *
 * v5 (docs/V5.md "Renderer contract"):
 *  - Map 'hill': complete grass field, no river / bridges / water; a grassy ridge spans the full
 *    width where the river was (CR.Arena.RIDGE: slopes y 13.5..15 / 17..18.5, plateau y 15..17
 *    at the flying height 2.2), smoothstep profile sampled from CR.Arena.heightAt into 65 rows
 *    (one terrain mesh with baked slope light / crest highlight / foot occlusion, a paved path
 *    over the ridge on both lanes, rocks, bushes, flowers and grass tufts on the slopes, the
 *    side walls climbing the ridge). The view's map (view.map, else CR.Arena.map) switches the
 *    arena at run time (setMap). 'classic' is built exactly as before.
 *  - Ground units stand on the terrain (smoothly climbing / descending, buildings sit on the
 *    lowest point of their footprint), air units keep their flying height, so on the plateau
 *    both meet on one level. Blob shadows, team rings, drag ghost rings / tiles / footprints and
 *    the deploy-zone overlay drape over the ridge (vertex shader "crHill" with the same profile
 *    samples; the overlay is a terrain-shaped mesh). CR.VFX gets the terrain (fx.setTerrain):
 *    ground-level effects, decals and spell areas follow the ridge. Rolling projectiles (log,
 *    barrel, boulder) roll over it; spells land on it.
 *  - Picking on the raised terrain: screenToSim marches the camera ray against the profile
 *    (then bisects), simToScreen projects the ground point at its height.
 *  - King tower: 3x3 footprint (CR.Arena.towerLayout()); the model and its crew are scaled to it.
 *  - 2v2: draw opts.localPlayer; with view.teamSize 2 the local player's units get a thin team-
 *    blue ring and the teammate's units a lighter ring (same blue team colour otherwise).
 *
 * v4 (user feedback "the original Clash Royale is twice as big", "no words in battle",
 *     "attacks visible from both sides"):
 *  - Clash Royale framing: the 18-tile field spans the full canvas width (1.2 % margin, the
 *    stone walls run off the sides), so a tile is ~21 CSS px on a 390 px phone like in CR; long
 *    lens (FOV 6: far side only ~5 % narrower); pitch 38..64 deg solved to fill the height (CR
 *    itself is ~50-55 deg). The app overlays its HUD on the arena, so the canvas is nearly the
 *    whole screen above the card panel; a taller canvas keeps its slack at the TOP (HUD room).
 *    arenaRect() = CSS px box of the 18x32 ground. Princess towers ~2.7 tiles wide (3x3 hit box).
 *  - No words during the battle: phase changes are icon strips (elixir drops + x2 / x3, an
 *    hourglass for overtime), ability / upgrade triggers are rarity-coloured star badges, the
 *    king wake-up a gold burst, emotes are drawn faces, the sleeping-king "z" marks are strokes.
 *    _label() turns any text with letters into a star badge (numbers like "+1" stay).
 *  - Attacks readable for both teams: bigger projectiles, team-coloured halos/streaks/tails on
 *    every shot (CR.VFX), team-tinted muzzle flashes on crown-tower and troop shots, swing
 *    smears + team impact rings for melee, ground decals (shock rings, scorch) now visible.
 *
 * v3 (user feedback "bigger, no borders, no lag"):
 *  - Camera frames ONLY the 18x32 field incl. its stone edge, as large as possible: the width is
 *    fitted with a thin margin (2.5 % per side), the pitch (45..62 deg) is solved so the field
 *    also fills the height between the app's top bar and hand panel (a taller canvas keeps a
 *    thin centred margin); the long lens (FOV 16) keeps the CR-like tilt with a mildly narrower
 *    far side. No forest / decoration ring any more: the
 *    canvas outside the stone edge is a flat backdrop colour (zero draw calls).
 *  - Troops are drawn ~1.6x their v2 size (option unitScale; big models taper so giants do not
 *    dwarf the towers), flyers get a slightly higher flight line; buildings are scaled to their
 *    sim footprint; crown towers to CR.Arena.towerLayout() sizes (re-read on resize/reset), the
 *    princess tower model additionally 13 % smaller than its footprint so units walk past cleanly.
 *  - Performance: every opaque mesh of every CR.GFX instance (units, towers, crews) that shares a
 *    material is re-drawn through one InstancedMesh per (geometry, material) ("batcher"): a
 *    60-unit battle costs ~1/3 of the draw calls of v2. Flashing / tinted / translucent instances
 *    fall back to normal drawing automatically. All shader variants (toon, instanced toon,
 *    translucent toon, particles, ribbons, areas, aura extras) are compiled at start-up; model
 *    templates of the cards in both hands are prewarmed. DPR policy: cap 2, start at 1.5 on
 *    devicePixelRatio >= 3 phones, drop 2 -> 1.5 -> 1.25 when frames run long; MSAA only below
 *    DPR 2. The 2D overlay is skipped when nothing on it changed.
 *
 * Scene (docs/GFX.md): 1 world unit = 1 tile, worldX = simX - W/2, worldZ = H/2 - simY. Local
 * side 1 rotates the camera 180 deg around the arena centre (geometry is never mirrored).
 * Battle intro: 1.1 s swoop.
 * Arena: painted grass field (tile checker, worn lane paths, tower plazas), raised stone border,
