        m.renderOrder = 1;
        group.add(m);
      }
      // ---- water
      this._waterMat = new T.ShaderMaterial({
        uniforms: { uT: { value: 0 }, uZ0: { value: zr0 }, uZ1: { value: zr1 } },
        vertexShader: WATER_VS, fragmentShader: WATER_FS,
        extensions: { derivatives: true },
      });
      const wg = new T.PlaneGeometry(W + EDGE * 2, zr1 - zr0, 1, 1);
      wg.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
      wg.translate(0, -0.34, (zr0 + zr1) / 2);
      this._arenaGeos.push(wg);
      const water = new T.Mesh(wg, this._waterMat);
      group.add(water);
      // ---- static toon scenery: border, banks, bridges (one mesh)
      const gb = new GeoBuf(T);
      this._buildBorder(gb);
      this._buildBanks(gb);
      this._buildBridges(gb);
      if (!gb.empty()) {
        const sg = gb.build();
        this._arenaGeos.push(sg);
        const sm = new T.Mesh(sg, this.matScenery);
        group.add(sm);
      }
      // ---- deploy overlay plane (forbidden tiles while dragging)
      const og = new T.PlaneGeometry(W, H);
      og.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
      og.translate(0, 0.045, 0);
      this._makeOverlay(group, og, aniso);
      // static scenery: no per-frame matrix recomposition
      group.traverse(function (o) { o.updateMatrix(); o.matrixAutoUpdate = false; });
    }

    /** Deploy-zone overlay (forbidden tiles while dragging) on geometry og. */
    _makeOverlay(group, og, aniso) {
      const T = this.T;
      const ocv = this._ovCanvas || makeCanvas(this.W * 32, this.H * 32);
      this._ovCanvas = ocv;
      this._ovTex = ocv ? new T.CanvasTexture(ocv) : null;
      if (this._ovTex) { if (T.SRGBColorSpace) this._ovTex.colorSpace = T.SRGBColorSpace; this._ovTex.anisotropy = aniso; this._arenaTex.push(this._ovTex); }
      this._arenaGeos.push(og);
      this._ovMesh = new T.Mesh(og, new T.MeshBasicMaterial({ toneMapped: false, map: this._ovTex, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, polygonOffset: true, polygonOffsetFactor: -1, polygonOffsetUnits: -1 }));
      this._ovMesh.visible = false;
      this._ovMesh.renderOrder = 3;
      group.add(this._ovMesh);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- v5 hill map
    /** Hill arena: one terrain mesh (painted field + baked slope light), stone walls climbing
     *  the ridge, ridge decoration (rocks, bushes, flowers, grass tufts, path pebbles). */
    _buildHillArena() {
      const T = this.T, W = this.W, H = this.H;
      this._zr0 = 0; this._zr1 = 0;
      const group = new T.Group();
      this.arena = group;
      this.scene.add(group);
      this._arenaGeos = [];
      this._arenaTex = [];
      const aniso = this._maxAniso || 1;
      const fcv = paintField(W, H, this.layout, this._laneBridges, this.river, null, this.ridge, this.td ? this.zones : null, this._fieldPx, this.tunnel);
      const ftex = fcv ? new T.CanvasTexture(fcv) : null;
      this._fieldCanvas = fcv; this._fieldTex = ftex;
      if (ftex) {
        ftex.anisotropy = aniso;
        if (T.SRGBColorSpace) ftex.colorSpace = T.SRGBColorSpace;
        this._arenaTex.push(ftex);
      }
      this._fieldMat = new T.MeshBasicMaterial({ toneMapped: false, map: ftex, color: ftex ? 0xffffff : 0x86c24b, vertexColors: true });
      this._waterMat = null;
      const fg = this._terrainGeo(0, true, 0.1);
      this._arenaGeos.push(fg);
      const field = new T.Mesh(fg, this._fieldMat);
      field.renderOrder = 1;
      group.add(field);
      const gb = new GeoBuf(T);
      this._buildBorder(gb);
      this._buildHillDecor(gb);
      if (this.tunnelOn) this._buildTunnelDecor(gb);
      if (!gb.empty()) {
        const sg = gb.build();
        this._arenaGeos.push(sg);
        group.add(new T.Mesh(sg, this.matScenery));
      }
      if (this.td) this._buildEndZones(group, aniso);
      if (this.tunnelOn) this._buildTunnelStrip(group);
      this._makeOverlay(group, this._terrainGeo(0.045, false, 0), aniso);
      group.traverse(function (o) { o.updateMatrix(); o.matrixAutoUpdate = false; });
    }

    /**
     * Terrain-shaped field geometry: rows every tile on the flat parts and on every profile sample
     * over the ridge, lifted by `lift`; uv = (x / W, y / H) like the painted field. With `shade`,
     * vertex colours carry the slope light (slopes facing the default camera / sun brighter, the
     * far slopes darker) and a slightly sunnier plateau. pad: extra width under the side walls.
     */
    _terrainGeo(lift, shade, pad) {
      const T = this.T, W = this.W, H = this.H, hw = this.hw, hh = this.hh;
      const R = this.ridge;
      const ys = [];
      for (let y = 0; y < HILL_Y0 - 1e-6; y += 1) ys.push(y);
      for (let i = 0; i <= HILL_N; i++) ys.push(HILL_Y0 + i * HILL_DY);
      for (let y = HILL_Y1 + 1; y <= H + 1e-6; y += 1) ys.push(y);
      if (ys[ys.length - 1] < H - 1e-6) ys.push(H);
      const x0 = -hw - (pad || 0), x1 = hw + (pad || 0);
      const n = ys.length;
      const pos = new Float32Array(n * 6), uv = new Float32Array(n * 4), col = shade ? new Float32Array(n * 6) : null;
      const nrm = new Float32Array(n * 6);
      for (let r = 0; r < n; r++) {
        const y = ys[r], z = hh - y, h = this._ghs(9, y) + lift;
        pos[r * 6] = x0; pos[r * 6 + 1] = h; pos[r * 6 + 2] = z;
        pos[r * 6 + 3] = x1; pos[r * 6 + 4] = h; pos[r * 6 + 5] = z;
        uv[r * 4] = (x0 + hw) / W; uv[r * 4 + 1] = y / H; uv[r * 4 + 2] = (x1 + hw) / W; uv[r * 4 + 3] = y / H;
        const sl = (this._ghs(9, y + HILL_DY / 2) - this._ghs(9, y - HILL_DY / 2)) / HILL_DY;
        const L = Math.sqrt(1 + sl * sl);
        nrm[r * 6] = 0; nrm[r * 6 + 1] = 1 / L; nrm[r * 6 + 2] = sl / L;
        nrm[r * 6 + 3] = 0; nrm[r * 6 + 4] = 1 / L; nrm[r * 6 + 5] = sl / L;
        if (col) {
          const f = sl / L, k = 1 - 1 / L;
          let c = 1 - 0.16 * k + 0.26 * f;
          if (R && y >= R.top0 - 1e-6 && y <= R.top1 + 1e-6) c *= 1.035;
          col[r * 6] = col[r * 6 + 3] = c;
          col[r * 6 + 1] = col[r * 6 + 4] = c;
          col[r * 6 + 2] = col[r * 6 + 5] = c * (f < 0 ? 1.04 : 1);   // far slopes: a cool shadow tint
        }
      }
      const idx = [];
      for (let r = 0; r < n - 1; r++) {
        const a = r * 2, b = r * 2 + 1, c = (r + 1) * 2 + 1, d = (r + 1) * 2;
        idx.push(a, b, c, a, c, d);
      }
      const g = new T.BufferGeometry();
      g.setAttribute('position', new T.BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
      g.setAttribute('normal', new T.BufferAttribute(nrm, 3));
      g.setAttribute('uv', new T.BufferAttribute(uv, 2));
      if (col) g.setAttribute('color', new T.BufferAttribute(col, 3));
      g.setIndex(idx);
      g.computeBoundingSphere();
      return g;
    }

    /** v6 Touchdown end zones: one painted, team-coloured plane per zone (diagonal stripes,
     *  chevron band, star emblem; repainted on recolour), four team pylons at its corners and a
     *  team banner along the back wall. The plane brightens when a touchdown lands in it. */
    _buildEndZones(group, aniso) {
      const T = this.T;
      this._zoneVis = [];
      const box = new T.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
      this._arenaGeos.push(box);
      for (let home = 0; home < 2; home++) {
        const Z = this.zones[home];
        const w = Z.x1 - Z.x0, h = Z.y1 - Z.y0;
        const zpx = Math.min(64, this._fieldPx || 48);
        const cv = makeCanvas(Math.max(8, Math.round(w * zpx)), Math.max(8, Math.round(h * zpx)));
        const tex = cv ? new T.CanvasTexture(cv) : null;
        if (tex) { if (T.SRGBColorSpace) tex.colorSpace = T.SRGBColorSpace; tex.anisotropy = aniso; this._arenaTex.push(tex); }
        const mat = new T.MeshBasicMaterial({ toneMapped: false, map: tex, color: 0xffffff, polygonOffset: true, polygonOffsetFactor: -1, polygonOffsetUnits: -1 });
        const g = new T.PlaneGeometry(w, h);
        g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
        const cx = (Z.x0 + Z.x1) / 2 - this.hw, cz = this.hh - (Z.y0 + Z.y1) / 2;
        const gy = this._ghs((Z.x0 + Z.x1) / 2, (Z.y0 + Z.y1) / 2);
        g.translate(cx, gy + 0.012, cz);
        this._arenaGeos.push(g);
        const mesh = new T.Mesh(g, mat);
        mesh.renderOrder = 2;
        group.add(mesh);
        // pylons + back-wall banner (lit, team colour)
        const pmat = new T.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: TEAM_HEX[0] });
        const goalZ = home === 0 ? this.hh - Z.y1 : this.hh - Z.y0, endZ = home === 0 ? this.hh - Z.y0 : this.hh - Z.y1;
        const xs = [Z.x0 - this.hw + 0.22, Z.x1 - this.hw - 0.22];
        for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
          for (const pz of [goalZ, endZ - (home === 0 ? 0.25 : -0.25)]) {
            const pm = new T.Mesh(box, pmat);
            pm.scale.set(0.22, 0.48, 0.22); pm.position.set(xs[i], this._gh(xs[i], pz) + 0.24, pz);
            group.add(pm);
            const cap = new T.Mesh(box, this._zoneCapMat || (this._zoneCapMat = new T.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xffffff })));
            cap.scale.set(0.24, 0.07, 0.24); cap.position.set(xs[i], this._gh(xs[i], pz) + 0.5, pz);
            group.add(cap);
          }
        }
        const bz = (this.hh + 0.62 / 2 + 0.02) * (home === 0 ? 1 : -1);
        const ban = new T.Mesh(box, pmat);
        ban.scale.set(this.W * 0.62, 0.3, 0.05); ban.position.set(0, 0.32, bz - (home === 0 ? 0.34 : -0.34));
        group.add(ban);
        this._zoneVis.push({ home: home, cv: cv, tex: tex, mat: mat, pmat: pmat, w: w, h: h, cs: -1, k: 0 });
      }
      this._recolorZones();
    }

    /** Paint the end zones / pylons in the viewer-relative team colours. */
    _recolorZones() {
      const zv = this._zoneVis || EMPTY;
      for (let i = 0; i < zv.length; i++) {
        const z = zv[i], cs = this._cside(z.home);
        if (cs === z.cs) continue;
        z.cs = cs;
        if (z.cv) { paintZone(z.cv, z.w, z.h, cs, z.home); if (z.tex) z.tex.needsUpdate = true; }
        z.pmat.color.setHex(TEAM_HEX[cs]);
      }
    }

    /** Ridge decoration, mirrored 180 deg for the far side (fair look from both cameras): props
     *  of CR.GFX (rock, rock-big, bush, flowers, mushroom) baked into the scenery mesh, grass tufts
     *  with wind sway, pebbles lining the paths over the ridge. Nothing on the lane centres. */
    _buildHillDecor(gb) {
      const T = this.T, R = this.ridge, hw = this.hw, hh = this.hh, W = this.W, H = this.H;
      if (!R) return;
      const X = gfx();
      const self = this;
      const rnd = seeded(57);
      const insts = {};
      const geo = { ico: new T.IcosahedronGeometry(1, 0), sph: new T.SphereGeometry(1, 8, 6), cone: new T.ConeGeometry(1, 1, 4) };
      const inst = function (id) {
        if (insts[id] !== undefined) return insts[id];
        let it = null;
        if (X && gfxHas(id)) {
          try {
            it = X.createInstance(id, 0);
            if (it && it.object3d) {
              it._noIntro = true;
              try { it.update(0, { state: 'idle', moving: false, dir: Math.PI / 2, attackProg: 0, hit: false, fx: 0, hpFrac: 1, tier: 0, z: 0, deployLeft: 0, deployTotal: 0, speed: 0, hurt: false }); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
              const o = it.object3d;
              o.position.set(0, 0, 0); o.rotation.set(0, 0, 0); o.scale.set(1, 1, 1);
              o.updateMatrixWorld(true);
              it._crInv = new T.Matrix4().copy(o.matrixWorld).invert();
            } else it = null;
          } catch (e) { it = null; }
        }
        insts[id] = it;
        return it;
      };
      // one prop (sim coords, plus its 180-degree mirror): sink = part of the size pushed into the slope
      const put = function (id, x, y, s, ry, sink, mirror) {
        for (let m = 0; m < (mirror === false ? 1 : 2); m++) {
          const px = m ? W - x : x, py = m ? H - y : y, rot = (ry || 0) + (m ? Math.PI : 0);
          const h = self._ghs(px, py) - (sink || 0) * s;
          const it = inst(id);
          if (it) {
            const c0 = gb.c.length;
            gb.addObject(it.object3d, it._crInv, px - hw, h, hh - py, rot, s);
            // v10 grimdark: the kit's bright meadow props sink into the dusk (darker, a bit desaturated)
            const k = DECOR_DIM[id] || 0.55;
            for (let q = c0; q < gb.c.length; q += 3) {
              const L = (gb.c[q] + gb.c[q + 1] + gb.c[q + 2]) / 3;
              gb.c[q] = (gb.c[q] * 0.8 + L * 0.2) * k; gb.c[q + 1] = (gb.c[q + 1] * 0.8 + L * 0.2) * k; gb.c[q + 2] = (gb.c[q + 2] * 0.8 + L * 0.2) * k * 1.04;
            }
            continue;
          }
          // fallbacks without CR.GFX
          if (id === 'bush') {
            gb.add(geo.sph, px - hw, h + 0.3 * s, hh - py, 0, rot, 0, 0.5 * s, 0.4 * s, 0.5 * s, 0x2e5a22, [h, h + 0.7 * s, 0.7]);
            gb.add(geo.sph, px - hw + 0.35 * s, h + 0.22 * s, hh - py + 0.1, 0, rot, 0, 0.34 * s, 0.3 * s, 0.34 * s, 0x3a6a2a, null);
          } else if (id === 'flowers' || id === 'mushroom') {
            for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) gb.add(geo.sph, px - hw + (k - 1.5) * 0.12 * s, h + 0.2 * s, hh - py + ((k & 1) - 0.5) * 0.14 * s, 0, 0, 0, 0.06 * s, 0.05 * s, 0.06 * s, [0xff6a8a, 0xffe14d, 0xffffff, 0xb48cff][k], null);
          } else {
            const big = id === 'rock-big' ? 1.6 : 1;
            gb.add(geo.ico, px - hw, h + 0.2 * s * big, hh - py, rnd() * 3, rot, rnd(), 0.5 * s * big, 0.36 * s * big, 0.45 * s * big, 0x4a4850, [h, h + 0.6 * s * big, 0.7]);
          }
        }
      };
      const y0 = R.y0, t0 = R.top0, t1 = R.top1, y1 = R.y1;
      const sm = (y0 + t0) / 2, pm = (t0 + t1) / 2;   // slope middle (south), plateau middle
      // big rock piles where the ridge meets the side walls, small stones on the slopes
      put('rock-big', 0.75, sm + 0.1, 0.72, 0.6, 0.32);
      put('rock', 17.25, sm - 0.05, 0.95, 2.1, 0.22);
      put('rock', 6.6, y0 + 0.35, 0.55, 1.2, 0.18);
      put('rock', 11.6, sm + 0.25, 0.5, 4.0, 0.2);
      put('rock', 1.55, t0 + 0.25, 0.6, 0.3, 0.15);
      // plateau: bushes at the walls, flower clumps, a mushroom ring near the left bush
      put('bush', 0.62, pm - 0.45, 0.95, 0.4, 0.05);
      put('bush', 17.45, pm - 0.35, 0.8, 2.6, 0.05);
      put('mushroom', 1.35, pm + 0.55, 0.9, 1.0, 0);
      put('flowers', 6.3, pm - 0.5, 1.0, 0.0, 0);
      put('flowers', 9.0, pm - 0.6, 0.85, 1.7, 0);
      put('flowers', 11.7, pm + 0.35, 1.0, 3.1, 0);
      put('flowers', 7.6, sm, 0.9, 0.8, 0);
      put('flowers', 16.2, y0 + 0.2, 0.9, 2.2, 0);
      // grass tufts on both slopes (not on the paths), swaying in the wind
      const lanes = this._laneBridges.map(function (b) { return (b.x0 + b.x1) / 2; });
      const onPath = function (x) { for (let i = 0; i < lanes.length; i++) if (Math.abs(x - lanes[i]) < 1.25) return true; return false; };
      const greens = [0x3a6a26, 0x46782c, 0x30581e, 0x527e30];   // v10: dusk greens
      for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
        let x = 0.3 + rnd() * (W - 0.6);
        if (onPath(x)) x = (x + 2.6) % (W - 0.6) + 0.3;
        if (onPath(x)) continue;
        const y = y0 + 0.15 + rnd() * (t0 - y0 - 0.2);
        for (let m = 0; m < 2; m++) {
          const px = m ? W - x : x, py = m ? H - y : y;
          const h = this._ghs(px, py);
          gb.sway = 1.1; gb.swayY0 = h;
          for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
            const a = k * 2.1 + rnd(), hh2 = 0.2 + rnd() * 0.16;
            gb.add(geo.cone, px - hw + Math.cos(a) * 0.07, h + hh2 / 2 - 0.02, hh - py + Math.sin(a) * 0.07, (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.5, a, (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.5, 0.05, hh2, 0.05, greens[(rnd() * 4) | 0], [h, h + hh2, 0.65]);
          }
          gb.sway = 0; gb.swayY0 = undefined;
        }
      }
      // pebbles lining the paths over the ridge (no lane paths on the touchdown field)
      const stones = [0x4a4642, 0x3e3a37, 0x56514b];
      for (let l = 0; l < (this.td ? 0 : lanes.length); l++) {
        for (let s = -1; s <= 1; s += 2) {
          for (let y = y0 - 0.2; y <= y1 + 0.2; y += 0.42) {
            const x = lanes[l] + s * (0.98 + (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.1), yy = y + (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.12;
            const r = 0.08 + rnd() * 0.07;
            const h = this._ghs(x, yy);
            gb.add(geo.ico, x - hw, h + r * 0.25, hh - yy, rnd() * 3, rnd() * 3, rnd() * 3, r * 1.2, r * 0.7, r, stones[(rnd() * 3) | 0], [h, h + r, 0.75]);
          }
        }
      }
      for (const k in insts) { const it = insts[k]; if (it) { try { if (it.object3d.parent) it.object3d.parent.remove(it.object3d); it.release(); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ } } }
      geo.ico.dispose(); geo.sph.dispose(); geo.cone.dispose();
    }

    /** v10 grimdark border: dark weathered stone wall under a dark coping with a thin gold inlay,
     *  gold-ringed stone pillars at the corners (and where the river leaves the arena) crowned by
     *  iron braziers with glowing coals; the flames, light pools and embers are drawn by CR.VFX
     *  (fx.setBraziers) from this._braziers. */
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- v12 tunnel map
    /** Tunnel holes (static scenery mesh): a horseshoe of dark rim stones open towards the ramp
     *  entrance, a timber portal (two posts, lintel, braces) over the far end of the ramp where
     *  the tunnel goes under ground, a black mouth inside the portal and a few loose rocks. */
    _buildTunnelDecor(gb) {
      const tun = this.tunnel;
      if (!tun) return;
      const T = this.T, hw = this.hw, hh = this.hh;
      const rnd = seeded(91);
      const STONE = [0x2c2a2e, 0x252328, 0x332f31, 0x1f1d21], WOOD = 0x4a321e, WOOD_D = 0x33220f, IRON = 0x1c1c20;
      const ico = new T.IcosahedronGeometry(1, 0);
      for (let i = 0; i < tun.holes.length; i++) {
        const h = tun.holes[i], r = h.r, d = tunnelDir(tun, i);
        const cx = h.x - hw, cz = hh - h.y;
        // world direction towards the tunnel (sim +y = world -z)
        const dx = d.x, dz = -d.y, px = -dz, pz = dx;
        const ang = Math.atan2(dz, dx);
        // rim stones (gap of ~110 deg at the back where troops walk down the ramp)
        const n = 13;
        for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
          const a = ang + (k / (n - 1) - 0.5) * (TAU - 1.95);
          const rr = r * 1.04;
          const sx = cx + Math.cos(a) * rr, sz = cz + Math.sin(a) * rr;
          const w = 0.34 + rnd() * 0.14, ht = 0.16 + rnd() * 0.09;
          gb.rbox(sx, ht / 2 - 0.02, sz, 0, -a + (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.2, 0, 0.26 + rnd() * 0.08, ht, w, 0.06, STONE[(rnd() * 4) | 0], [-0.02, ht, 0.5]);
        }
        // timber portal across the far end of the ramp
        const fx = cx + dx * r * 0.72, fz = cz + dz * r * 0.72;
        const span = r * 0.86, ph = 0.92, ry = -Math.atan2(pz, px);
        for (let s = -1; s <= 1; s += 2) {
          const qx = fx + px * span * s, qz = fz + pz * span * s;
          gb.rbox(qx, ph / 2 - 0.02, qz, 0, ry + 0.05 * s, 0, 0.17, ph, 0.17, 0.035, WOOD, [0, ph, 0.55]);
          // diagonal brace into the lintel
          gb.rbox(qx - px * 0.2 * s, ph - 0.2, qz - pz * 0.2 * s, 0, ry, 0.75 * s, 0.07, 0.42, 0.08, 0.02, WOOD_D, null);
          // iron strap
          gb.rbox(qx, ph * 0.62, qz, 0, ry, 0, 0.19, 0.04, 0.19, 0.01, IRON, null);
        }
        gb.rbox(fx, ph + 0.05, fz, 0, ry, 0, span * 2 + 0.42, 0.15, 0.2, 0.04, WOOD, null);
        gb.rbox(fx, ph + 0.15, fz, 0, ry, 0, span * 2 + 0.1, 0.05, 0.12, 0.015, WOOD_D, null);
        // black mouth inside the portal (a thin dark slab facing the ramp)
        gb.rbox(fx + dx * 0.1, ph / 2 - 0.12, fz + dz * 0.1, 0, ry, 0, span * 2 - 0.12, ph - 0.12, 0.05, 0.01, 0x030202, null);
        // loose rocks beside the hole
        for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
          const a = ang + Math.PI * (0.5 + (k & 1)) + (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.6, rr = r * (1.35 + rnd() * 0.4), s = 0.1 + rnd() * 0.08;
          gb.add(ico, cx + Math.cos(a) * rr, s * 0.5, cz + Math.sin(a) * rr, rnd() * 3, rnd() * 3, 0, s * 1.3, s, s * 1.1, STONE[(rnd() * 4) | 0], [0, s, 0.6]);
        }
      }
      ico.dispose();
    }

    /** Translucent tunnel strip over the path (one transparent mesh, soft dark interior with faint
     *  amber edge lines): troops underground are drawn as dimmed silhouettes inside it. */
    _buildTunnelStrip(group) {
      const tun = this.tunnel;
      if (!tun) return;
      const T = this.T, hw = this.hw, hh = this.hh, P = tun.path, w = tun.width;
      const cv = makeCanvas(64, 4);
      let tex = null;
      if (cv) {
        const g = cv.getContext('2d');
        const gr = g.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 64, 0);
        gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); gr.addColorStop(0.06, 'rgba(214,150,70,0.55)'); gr.addColorStop(0.11, 'rgba(10,8,6,0.5)');
        gr.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(6,5,4,0.62)'); gr.addColorStop(0.89, 'rgba(10,8,6,0.5)'); gr.addColorStop(0.94, 'rgba(214,150,70,0.55)'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
        g.fillStyle = gr; g.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 4);
        tex = new T.CanvasTexture(cv);
        if (T.SRGBColorSpace) tex.colorSpace = T.SRGBColorSpace;
        this._arenaTex.push(tex);
      }
      const pos = [], uv = [], idx = [];
      // the strip stops short of the hole centres (the pits are painted / framed there)
      for (let i = 0; i < P.length - 1; i++) {
        let ax = P[i].x, ay = P[i].y, bx = P[i + 1].x, by = P[i + 1].y;
        const len = Math.sqrt((bx - ax) * (bx - ax) + (by - ay) * (by - ay)) || 1;
        const ux = (bx - ax) / len, uy = (by - ay) / len;
        if (i === 0) { const c = Math.min(len * 0.4, tun.holes[0].r * 0.75); ax += ux * c; ay += uy * c; }
        if (i === P.length - 2) { const c = Math.min(len * 0.4, tun.holes[tun.holes.length - 1].r * 0.75); bx -= ux * c; by -= uy * c; }
        const nx = -uy * w / 2, ny = ux * w / 2, b = pos.length / 3;
        const pts = [[ax - nx, ay - ny, 0], [ax + nx, ay + ny, 1], [bx + nx, by + ny, 1], [bx - nx, by - ny, 0]];
        for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) { pos.push(pts[k][0] - hw, 0.03, hh - pts[k][1]); uv.push(pts[k][2], k < 2 ? 0 : 1); }
        idx.push(b, b + 1, b + 2, b, b + 2, b + 3);
      }
      if (!pos.length) return;
      const geo = new T.BufferGeometry();
      geo.setAttribute('position', new T.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
      geo.setAttribute('uv', new T.Float32BufferAttribute(uv, 2));
      geo.setIndex(idx);
      geo.computeBoundingSphere();
      this._arenaGeos.push(geo);
      const mat = new T.MeshBasicMaterial({ toneMapped: false, map: tex, color: tex ? 0xffffff : 0x0a0806, transparent: true, opacity: tex ? 0.7 : 0.3, depthWrite: false, polygonOffset: true, polygonOffsetFactor: -1, polygonOffsetUnits: -1 });
      this._tunnelMat = mat;
      const mesh = new T.Mesh(geo, mat);
      mesh.renderOrder = 2;
      group.add(mesh);
    }

    _buildBorder(gb) {
      const T = this.T, hw = this.hw, hh = this.hh;
      const rnd = seeded(31);
      const stones = [0x27252b, 0x222026, 0x2d2a2f, 0x1f1d22];
      const th = 0.62, ht = 0.5;
      const GOLD = 0xc99a3c, GOLD_D = 0x8a6424, IRON = 0x1e1e22, COPE = 0x35323a;
      const zr0 = this._zr0, zr1 = this._zr1;
      const self = this;
      const braz = this._braziers = [];
      // (hill map: the stones stand on the terrain - the wall climbs the ridge in short blocks
      // under a coping that follows the slope)
      const seg = function (x0, z0, x1, z1, step) {
        const len = Math.sqrt((x1 - x0) * (x1 - x0) + (z1 - z0) * (z1 - z0));
        const n = Math.max(1, Math.round(len / (step || 1.45)));
        const horiz = Math.abs(z1 - z0) < 1e-6;
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          const t0 = i / n, t1 = (i + 1) / n;
          const cx = lerp(x0, x1, (t0 + t1) / 2), cz = lerp(z0, z1, (t0 + t1) / 2);
          const L = len / n - (step ? 0.02 : 0.06);
          const g0 = self._gh(cx, cz);
          const h = ht + (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.1 + g0;
          const col = stones[(rnd() * stones.length) | 0];
          const w = horiz ? L : th, d = horiz ? th : L;
          gb.rbox(cx, h / 2 - 0.05, cz, 0, (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.03, 0, w, h, d, 0.075, col, [-0.05, h, 0.5]);
          let tilt = 0;
          if (g0 > 0 && !horiz) { const sl = (self._gh(cx, cz + 0.05) - self._gh(cx, cz - 0.05)) / 0.1; tilt = -Math.atan(sl); }
          gb.rbox(cx, h + 0.03, cz, tilt, 0, 0, w + 0.06, 0.11, (d + 0.06) / Math.cos(tilt), 0.045, COPE, null);
          // thin gold inlay along the coping (not on the short ridge steps)
          if (!step) gb.rbox(cx, h + 0.09, cz, tilt, 0, 0, horiz ? w - 0.1 : 0.05, 0.02, horiz ? 0.05 : (d - 0.1) / Math.cos(tilt), 0.01, GOLD, null);
        }
      };
      const bx = hw + th / 2 + 0.02, bz = hh + th / 2 + 0.02;
      if (this.hillOn && this.ridge) {
        // continuous side walls climbing the ridge
        const za = hh - (this.ridge.y1 + 0.3), zb = hh - (this.ridge.y0 - 0.3);
        for (let s = -1; s <= 1; s += 2) {
          seg(s * bx, -bz - th / 2, s * bx, za);
          seg(s * bx, za, s * bx, zb, 0.3);
          seg(s * bx, zb, s * bx, bz + th / 2);
        }
      } else if (!this.riverOn) {
        // touchdown / v12 tunnel map: continuous side walls (no river)
        seg(-bx, -bz - th / 2, -bx, bz + th / 2);
        seg(bx, -bz - th / 2, bx, bz + th / 2);
      } else {
        // left/right walls, interrupted by the river
        seg(-bx, -bz - th / 2, -bx, zr0 - 0.25);
        seg(-bx, zr1 + 0.25, -bx, bz + th / 2);
        seg(bx, -bz - th / 2, bx, zr0 - 0.25);
        seg(bx, zr1 + 0.25, bx, bz + th / 2);
      }
      // back walls
      seg(-bx, -bz, bx, -bz);
      seg(-bx, bz, bx, bz);
      // iron brazier with glowing coals on top of a pillar at height y (radius r)
      const bowl = new T.CylinderGeometry(0.34, 0.2, 0.22, 14);
      const rim = new T.TorusGeometry(0.33, 0.035, 6, 18);
      const coal = new T.SphereGeometry(0.27, 12, 6, 0, TAU, 0, Math.PI / 2);
      const ring = new T.CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 1, 22);
      const brazier = function (x, y, z, k) {
        gb.add(bowl, x, y + 0.11 * k, z, 0, 0, 0, k, k, k, IRON, [y, y + 0.22 * k, 0.55]);
        gb.add(rim, x, y + 0.22 * k, z, Math.PI / 2, 0, 0, k, k, k, GOLD_D, null);
        gb.glow = 1;
        gb.add(coal, x, y + 0.14 * k, z, 0, 0, 0, k, 0.55 * k, k, 0xff7a24, null);
        gb.glow = 0;
        braz.push({ x: x, y: y + 0.3 * k, z: z, k: k, gy: self._gh(x, z) });   // (gy: ground under the pillar)
      };
      // stone pillar with gold rings (base at ground height gy)
      const pillar = function (x, z, r, hgt, k) {
        const gy = self._gh(x, z);
        gb.add(ring, x, gy + 0.08, z, 0, 0, 0, r * 1.18, 0.16, r * 1.18, 0x1c1a19, null);              // plinth
        gb.add(ring, x, gy + hgt / 2, z, 0, Math.PI / 11, 0, r, hgt, r, 0x2c2826, [gy, gy + hgt, 0.45]);  // shaft
        gb.add(ring, x, gy + 0.22, z, 0, 0, 0, r * 1.06, 0.07, r * 1.06, GOLD, null);                  // gold bands
        gb.add(ring, x, gy + hgt - 0.12, z, 0, 0, 0, r * 1.06, 0.07, r * 1.06, GOLD, null);
        gb.add(ring, x, gy + hgt + 0.04, z, 0, 0, 0, r * 1.14, 0.09, r * 1.14, 0x34302d, null);         // capital
        brazier(x, gy + hgt + 0.08, z, k);
      };
      // pillars where the river leaves the arena
      for (let s = -1; s <= 1 && this.riverOn; s += 2) {
        for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) pillar(s * bx, k === 0 ? zr0 - 0.22 : zr1 + 0.22, 0.42, 0.8, 0.95);
      }
      // hill / touchdown: a pillar halfway along each side wall (on the ridge crest on the hill)
      if (!this.riverOn) for (let s = -1; s <= 1; s += 2) pillar(s * bx, 0, 0.4, 0.75, 0.9);
      // corner towers: tall gold-ringed pillars with braziers
      for (let sx = -1; sx <= 1; sx += 2) {
        for (let sz = -1; sz <= 1; sz += 2) pillar(sx * bx, sz * bz, 0.56, 1.05, 1.15);
      }
      bowl.dispose(); rim.dispose(); coal.dispose(); ring.dispose();
      if (this.fx && typeof this.fx.setBraziers === 'function') this.fx.setBraziers(braz);
    }

    _buildBanks(gb) {
      const T = this.T, hw = this.hw;
      const zr0 = this._zr0, zr1 = this._zr1;
      const rnd = seeded(13);
      const box = new T.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
      const span = hw + EDGE;   // banks end at the outer face of the side walls
      for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
        const z = k === 0 ? zr0 : zr1;
        const out = k === 0 ? -1 : 1;
        let x = -span;
        while (x < span - 0.05) {
          const L = Math.min(0.7 + rnd() * 0.6, span - x);
          const cx = x + L / 2;
          const col = [0x34302e, 0x3c3734, 0x2c2827][(rnd() * 3) | 0];   // v10: dark wet stone
          // wall face down to the water
          gb.rbox(cx, -0.3, z + out * 0.14, 0, 0, 0, L - 0.04, 0.62, 0.3, 0.05, col, [-0.6, 0, 0.55]);
          // capstone on the bank edge
          gb.rbox(cx, 0.02, z + out * 0.18, 0, (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.06, 0, L - 0.05, 0.12, 0.42, 0.045, 0x4f4843, null);
          x += L;
        }
      }
      // river bed (dark) under the water
      gb.add(box, 0, -0.62, (zr0 + zr1) / 2, 0, 0, 0, span * 2, 0.04, zr1 - zr0, 0x061a1c, null);
    }

    _buildBridges(gb) {
      const T = this.T, hw = this.hw;
      const zr0 = this._zr0, zr1 = this._zr1;
      const box = new T.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
      const rnd = seeded(21);
      const woods = [0x4e3423, 0x452e1f, 0x573a27, 0x3d291c];   // v10: dark, aged timber
      const IRON = 0x2a2a2f, RIVET = 0x6b6a70;
      for (let i = 0; i < this.bridges.length; i++) {
        const b = this.bridges[i];
        const x0 = b.x0 - hw, x1 = b.x1 - hw;
        const cx = (x0 + x1) / 2, w = x1 - x0;
        const z0 = zr0 - 0.55, z1 = zr1 + 0.55;
        // stringers
        gb.rbox(x0 + 0.22, -0.12, (z0 + z1) / 2, 0, 0, 0, 0.26, 0.26, z1 - z0, 0.06, 0x2a1c13, null);
        gb.rbox(x1 - 0.22, -0.12, (z0 + z1) / 2, 0, 0, 0, 0.26, 0.26, z1 - z0, 0.06, 0x2a1c13, null);
        // planks (bevelled, slightly irregular, darker towards their underside, nailed)
        const nail = new T.CylinderGeometry(0.028, 0.032, 0.02, 6);
        const n = Math.round((z1 - z0) / 0.34);
        for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
          const z = z0 + (k + 0.5) * (z1 - z0) / n;
          const arch = Math.sin(Math.PI * (k + 0.5) / n) * 0.08;
          const pw = w - 0.1 + (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.1, pcx = cx + (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.06, pd = (z1 - z0) / n - 0.045, pry = (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.04, prx = (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.03;
          gb.rbox(pcx, 0.03 + arch, z, prx, pry, 0, pw, 0.11, pd, 0.035, woods[(rnd() * woods.length) | 0], [-0.03 + arch, 0.09 + arch, 0.72]);
          // two nail heads at each plank end (into the stringers)
          for (let e = -1; e <= 1; e += 2) {
            for (let q = -1; q <= 1; q += 2) gb.add(nail, pcx + e * (pw / 2 - 0.16), 0.09 + arch, z + q * pd * 0.22, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1, RIVET, null);
          }
          // v10: wrought-iron straps across every third plank (riveted at both ends)
          if (k % 3 === 1) {
            gb.rbox(pcx, 0.092 + arch, z, prx, pry, 0, pw + 0.02, 0.024, 0.09, 0.01, IRON, null);
            for (let e = -1; e <= 1; e += 2) gb.add(nail, pcx + e * (pw / 2 - 0.05), 0.106 + arch, z, 0, 0, 0, 1.2, 1, 1.2, RIVET, null);
          }
        }
        // rails with posts
        const post = new T.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
        for (let s = 0; s < 2; s++) {
          const px = s === 0 ? x0 + 0.1 : x1 - 0.1;
          const posts = [z0 + 0.1, zr0 + 0.15, (zr0 + zr1) / 2, zr1 - 0.15, z1 - 0.1];
          for (let k = 0; k < posts.length; k++) {
            gb.rbox(px, 0.3, posts[k], 0, 0, 0, 0.17, 0.62, 0.17, 0.04, 0x3a271a, [0, 0.6, 0.6]);
            gb.rbox(px, 0.63, posts[k], 0, 0, 0, 0.21, 0.07, 0.21, 0.02, IRON, null);   // iron post cap
            gb.rbox(px, 0.44, posts[k], 0, 0, 0, 0.19, 0.04, 0.19, 0.012, IRON, null);   // iron band
          }
          gb.rbox(px, 0.56, (z0 + z1) / 2, 0, 0, 0, 0.13, 0.1, z1 - z0 - 0.05, 0.035, 0x4e3423, [0.51, 0.61, 0.75]);
          gb.rbox(px, 0.3, (z0 + z1) / 2, 0, 0, 0, 0.09, 0.075, z1 - z0 - 0.1, 0.025, 0x3d291c, null);
        }
      }
    }

    _buildShadows() {
      const T = this.T;
      const bcv = paintBlob();
      this._blobTex = bcv ? new T.CanvasTexture(bcv) : null;
      if (this._blobTex) this._blobTex.anisotropy = Math.min(4, this._maxAniso || 1);
      const g = new T.PlaneGeometry(1, 1, 1, 6);   // (rows along z: drapes over the hill ridge)
      g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
      this._shadowGeo = g;
      this._shadowMat = conformMaterial(new T.MeshBasicMaterial({ toneMapped: false, map: this._blobTex, color: 0x0a1806, transparent: true, opacity: 0.52, depthWrite: false, polygonOffset: true, polygonOffsetFactor: -1, polygonOffsetUnits: -1 }), this._hillU);
      this.shadows = new T.InstancedMesh(g, this._shadowMat, 220);
      this.shadows.count = 0;
      this.shadows.frustumCulled = false;
      this.shadows.renderOrder = 2;
      if (this.shadows.instanceMatrix.setUsage) this.shadows.instanceMatrix.setUsage(T.DynamicDrawUsage);
      this.scene.add(this.shadows);
    }

    _shadow(x, z, sx, sz, ry) {
      const n = this._shadowN;
      if (n >= 220) return;
      this._e.set(0, ry || 0, 0);
      this._q.setFromEuler(this._e);
      this._pos.set(x, 0.012 + (n % 7) * 0.0006, z);
      this._sc.set(sx, 1, sz);
      this._m4.compose(this._pos, this._q, this._sc);
      this.shadows.setMatrixAt(n, this._m4);
      this._shadowN = n + 1;
    }

    /** v11: a thin team-coloured ground ring under EVERY unit (both teams; the local player's own
     *  units slightly brighter, the 2v2 teammate's a lighter tint). One instanced mesh with
     *  per-instance colours (one draw call for all rings), painted soft-edged ring texture, drapes
     *  over the hill ridge like the blob shadows. */
    _buildTeamRings() {
      const T = this.T;
      const g = new T.PlaneGeometry(2, 2, 1, 6);   // (rows along z: drapes over the hill ridge)
      g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
      this._ringGeo = g;
      const rcv = paintRingTex();
      this._ringTex = rcv ? new T.CanvasTexture(rcv) : null;
      if (this._ringTex) this._ringTex.anisotropy = Math.min(4, this._maxAniso || 1);
      const mat = conformMaterial(new T.MeshBasicMaterial({ toneMapped: false, map: this._ringTex, color: 0xffffff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.92, depthWrite: false, polygonOffset: true, polygonOffsetFactor: -2, polygonOffsetUnits: -2 }), this._hillU);
      this._ringMats = [mat];
      const m = new T.InstancedMesh(g, mat, 240);
      m.count = 0;
      m.frustumCulled = false;
      m.renderOrder = 3;
      if (m.instanceMatrix.setUsage) m.instanceMatrix.setUsage(T.DynamicDrawUsage);
      const white = new T.Color(1, 1, 1);
      for (let i = 0; i < 240; i++) m.setColorAt(i, white);
      if (m.instanceColor && m.instanceColor.setUsage) m.instanceColor.setUsage(T.DynamicDrawUsage);
      this.scene.add(m);
      this._ringMeshes = [m];
      this._ringN = [0, 0];
      // ring colours per slot (ringSlot): [blue own, blue mate, blue foe, red own, red mate, red foe]
      const hex = [RING_OWN, RING_MATE, TEAM_HEX[0], 0xff5a48, RING_ALLY_R, RING_FOE];
      this._ringCols = hex.map(function (h, i) {
        const c = new T.Color(h);
        if (T.ColorManagement && T.ColorManagement.enabled === false) return c;
        // linear working space: scale by the slot opacity (own brightest, foes a little dimmer)
        const op = [RING_OP[0], RING_OP[1], RING_OP[2], RING_OP[0], RING_OP[3], RING_OP[2]][i];
        return c.multiplyScalar(op);
      });
    }

    _teamRing(slot, x, z, r) {
      const n = this._ringN[0];
      if (n >= 240) return;
      this._q.set(0, 0, 0, 1);
      this._pos.set(x, 0.022, z);
      this._sc.set(r, 1, r);
      this._m4.compose(this._pos, this._q, this._sc);
      const rm = this._ringMeshes[0];
      rm.setMatrixAt(n, this._m4);
      rm.setColorAt(n, this._ringCols[slot] || this._ringCols[0]);
      this._ringN[0] = n + 1;
    }

    _buildGhostRig() {
      const T = this.T;
      const g = new T.Group();
      g.visible = false;
      this.ghost = g;
      this.scene.add(g);
      const ringG = new T.RingGeometry(0.93, 1, 64);
      ringG.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
      // (v5: subdivided so rings, discs, tiles and footprints drape over the hill ridge)
      const discG = new T.RingGeometry(0, 1, 48, 8);
      discG.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
      const planeG = new T.PlaneGeometry(1, 1, 1, 12);
      planeG.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
      const rectG = new T.PlaneGeometry(1, 1, 1, 64);
      rectG.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
      this._ghostGeos = [ringG, discG, planeG, rectG];
      const U = this._hillU;
      const mk = function (col, op) { return conformMaterial(new T.MeshBasicMaterial({ toneMapped: false, color: col, transparent: true, opacity: op, depthWrite: false, polygonOffset: true, polygonOffsetFactor: -2, polygonOffsetUnits: -2 }), U); };
      this._gRingMat = mk(0xffffff, 0.9);
      this._gFillMat = mk(0xffffff, 0.18);
      this._gTileMat = mk(0xffffff, 0.3);
      const sqc = paintSquare(false), sqd = paintSquare(true);
      this._sqTex = sqc ? new T.CanvasTexture(sqc) : null;
      this._sqdTex = sqd ? new T.CanvasTexture(sqd) : null;
      this._gSquareMat = conformMaterial(new T.MeshBasicMaterial({ toneMapped: false, map: this._sqTex, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, color: 0xffffff, polygonOffset: true, polygonOffsetFactor: -2, polygonOffsetUnits: -2 }), U);
      this._gRectMat = conformMaterial(new T.MeshBasicMaterial({ toneMapped: false, map: this._sqdTex, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, color: 0xffffff, polygonOffset: true, polygonOffsetFactor: -2, polygonOffsetUnits: -2 }), U);
      this.gRing = new T.Mesh(ringG, this._gRingMat);
      this.gFill = new T.Mesh(discG, this._gFillMat);
      this.gTile = new T.Mesh(planeG, this._gTileMat);
      this.gSquare = new T.Mesh(planeG, this._gSquareMat);
      this.gRect = new T.Mesh(rectG, this._gRectMat);
      [this.gRing, this.gFill, this.gTile, this.gSquare, this.gRect].forEach(function (m) { m.renderOrder = 4; g.add(m); });
      this._ghostUnits = [];
      this._ghostGeoCache = new Map();
      this._ghostKey = '';
      this._ghostItems = [];
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- towers
    _towerTopY(king) { return king ? 3.05 : 2.75; }

    _buildTowers() {
      const T = this.T;
      for (let i = 0; i < this.layout.length; i++) {
        const L = this.layout[i];
        const tm = {
          id: L.id, side: L.side, kind: L.kind, king: L.kind === 'king', x: L.x, y: L.y, size: L.size || (L.kind === 'king' ? 4 : 3), depth: L.depth || L.size || 0, depthK: 1, hitSize: L.hitSize || L.size || (L.kind === 'king' ? 4 : 3),
          group: new T.Group(), body: null, crew: null, bodyInst: null, crewInst: null, rubble: null, alive: true,
          topY: 0, crewY: 0, cside: -1, e: { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0, h: 3, r: 1.5, air: false, building: true, tower: true, unit: L.kind === 'king' ? 'king-tower' : 'princess-tower', side: L.side, id: L.id },
          st: { state: 'idle', moving: false, dir: L.side === 0 ? Math.PI / 2 : -Math.PI / 2, attackProg: 0, hit: false, fx: 0, hpFrac: 1, tier: 0, z: 0, deployLeft: 0, deployTotal: 0, speed: 0, hurt: false, asleep: false, side: L.side, unit: '' },
          cst: { state: 'idle', moving: false, dir: L.side === 0 ? Math.PI / 2 : -Math.PI / 2, attackProg: 0, hit: false, fx: 0, hpFrac: 1, tier: 0, z: 0, deployLeft: 0, deployTotal: 0, speed: 0, hurt: false, asleep: false, side: L.side, unit: '' },
          hitFlag: false, hurt: false, hitMs: -1e9, hpVal: -1, hpTxt: '', dirS: L.side === 0 ? Math.PI / 2 : -Math.PI / 2, active: L.kind !== 'king', downT: -1e9,
          ts: 1, cs: 1, crewH: 1.4, bodyMeshes: null, crewMeshes: null, rubbleSz: 1,
        };
        tm.e.x = L.x - this.hw; tm.e.z = this.hh - L.y;
        tm.group.position.set(tm.e.x, 0, tm.e.z);
        this.scene.add(tm.group);
        this._towers.set(L.id, tm);
        this._towerList.push(tm);
      }
    }

    /** Model footprint and height of a CR.GFX model, measured once from a fresh instance in its
     *  rest pose: w = widest horizontal extent, h = height, foot = width of the model's base (all
     *  vertices below 0.35 tiles: plinth / footing - flags, banners and lanterns sticking out
     *  higher up do not count). Works for per-pivot meshes and for one merged / skinned mesh. */
    _measure(modelId) {
      let r = this._visCache.get(modelId);
      if (r) return r;
      r = { w: 0, h: 0, foot: 0 };
      const X = gfx();
      const T = this.T;
      if (X && gfxHas(modelId)) {
        let inst = null;
        try {
          inst = X.createInstance(modelId, 0);
          if (inst && inst.object3d) {
            const o = inst.object3d;
            o.position.set(0, 0, 0); o.scale.set(1, 1, 1);
            o.updateMatrixWorld(true);
            // rig meshes only, visible ones (pooled instances may carry hidden status extras)
            const list = [];
            const vis = function (m) { let p = m; while (p && p !== o) { if (!p.visible) return false; p = p.parent; } return true; };
            const rig = Array.isArray(inst.meshes) && inst.meshes.length ? inst.meshes : null;
            if (rig) { for (let i = 0; i < rig.length; i++) if (vis(rig[i])) list.push(rig[i]); }
            else o.traverse(function (m) { if (m.isMesh && vis(m)) list.push(m); });
            const v = new T.Vector3();
            let bx0 = 1e9, bx1 = -1e9, by0 = 1e9, by1 = -1e9, bz0 = 1e9, bz1 = -1e9;
            for (let k = 0; k < list.length; k++) {
              const mesh = list[k];
              const P = mesh.geometry && mesh.geometry.attributes.position;
              if (!P) continue;
              const me = mesh.matrixWorld;
              for (let i = 0; i < P.count; i++) {
                v.set(P.getX(i), P.getY(i), P.getZ(i)).applyMatrix4(me);
                if (v.x < bx0) bx0 = v.x; if (v.x > bx1) bx1 = v.x; if (v.y < by0) by0 = v.y; if (v.y > by1) by1 = v.y; if (v.z < bz0) bz0 = v.z; if (v.z > bz1) bz1 = v.z;
              }
            }
            if (bx1 > bx0) {
              r.w = Math.max(bx1 - bx0, bz1 - bz0);
              const alt = +inst.altitude || 0;
              r.h = Math.max(0.2, alt > 0 || inst.isFlyer ? by1 - by0 : by1 - Math.max(0, Math.min(by0, 0)));
            }
            const lim = Math.min(by1, (by0 > 0 ? by0 : 0) + 0.35);
            let x0 = 1e9, x1 = -1e9, z0 = 1e9, z1 = -1e9;
            for (let k = 0; k < list.length; k++) {
              const mesh = list[k];
              const P = mesh.geometry && mesh.geometry.attributes.position;
              if (!P) continue;
              const me = mesh.matrixWorld;
              for (let i = 0; i < P.count; i++) {
                v.set(P.getX(i), P.getY(i), P.getZ(i)).applyMatrix4(me);
                if (v.y > lim) continue;
                if (v.x < x0) x0 = v.x; if (v.x > x1) x1 = v.x; if (v.z < z0) z0 = v.z; if (v.z > z1) z1 = v.z;
              }
            }
            r.foot = x1 > x0 ? Math.max(x1 - x0, z1 - z0) : r.w;
          }
        } catch (e) { /* keep defaults */ }
        if (inst) { try { inst.release(); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ } }
      }
      this._visCache.set(modelId, r);
      return r;
    }

    /** (Re)build the tower visuals for its current colour side. */
    _dressTower(tm) {
      const T = this.T;
      const cs = this._cside(tm.side);
      if (tm.cside === cs && (tm.body || tm.bodyInst)) return;
      this._undressTower(tm);
      tm.cside = cs;
      const X = gfx();
      const bodyId = tm.king ? 'king-tower' : 'princess-tower';
      const crewId = tm.king ? 'king' : 'tower-archer';
      const yaw = (CR.GFX && typeof CR.GFX.dirToYaw === 'function') ? CR.GFX.dirToYaw(tm.side === 0 ? Math.PI / 2 : -Math.PI / 2) : (tm.side === 0 ? 0 : Math.PI);
      tm.yaw = yaw;
      // visual footprint (v4, CR size): king = its 4x4 footprint; princess = ~90 % of its 3x3 hit
      // box (CR draws it ~3 tiles wide; the sim's blocking footprint is only 2.5)
      const target = tm.king ? tm.size * KING_VIS : Math.max(tm.size, tm.hitSize || tm.size) * PRINCESS_VIS;
      tm.depthK = tm.king && tm.depth > 0 ? clamp(tm.depth / tm.size, 0.6, 1.2) : 1;   // v12 king 3 x 2.5
      tm.rubbleSz = target / ((tm.king ? 3.5 : 2.6) + 0.5);
      if (X && gfxHas(bodyId)) {
        try {
          // the crown tower models are designed on 3x3 / 4x4 tiles; their measured base (plinth +
          // footing stones) is TOWER_REF_FOOT then. A model rebuilt to another base still fits.
          const meas = this._measure(bodyId);
          const design = tm.king ? 4 : 3, ref = TOWER_REF_FOOT[tm.king ? 1 : 0];
          tm.ts = target / design * (meas.foot > 0.5 ? clamp(ref / meas.foot, 0.6, 1.6) : 1);
          tm.bodyInst = X.createInstance(bodyId, cs);
          const kh = tm.king ? KING_H : 1, kd = tm.king ? tm.depthK : 1;
          tm.bodyInst.object3d.scale.set(tm.ts, tm.ts * kh, tm.ts * kd);
          tm.group.add(tm.bodyInst.object3d);
          tm.bodyMeshes = instMeshes(tm.bodyInst);
          const info = gfxModelInfo(bodyId);
          const h = (tm.bodyInst.height || (info && info.height)) || (tm.king ? 3.6 : 3.2);
          const src = info && info.src ? info.src : null;
          const mount = (info && (info.mount || info.crewY)) || (src && (src.mount || src.crewY || src.crew)) || tm.bodyInst.mount || null;
          const my = typeof mount === 'number' ? mount : (mount && typeof mount.y === 'number' ? mount.y : (Array.isArray(mount) ? mount[1] : h * 0.82));
          tm.crewY = my * tm.ts * kh;
          tm.topY = h * tm.ts * kh;
        } catch (e) { tm.bodyInst = null; tm.bodyMeshes = null; }
      }
      if (!tm.bodyInst) {
        tm.ts = target / ((tm.king ? 3.5 : 2.6) + 0.5);
        const geo = this._towerGeo(tm.king, cs);
        tm.body = new T.Mesh(geo, this.matToon);
        tm.body.rotation.y = yaw;
        const kh = tm.king ? KING_H : 1, kd = tm.king ? tm.depthK : 1;
        tm.body.scale.set(tm.ts, tm.ts * kh, tm.ts * kd);
        tm.group.add(tm.body);
        tm.crewY = this._towerTopY(tm.king) * tm.ts * kh;
        tm.topY = tm.crewY + 1.2;
      }
      tm.cs = CREW_VIS[tm.king ? 0 : 1];
      if (X && gfxHas(crewId)) {
        try {
          tm.crewInst = X.createInstance(crewId, cs);
          tm.crewInst.object3d.position.set(0, tm.crewY, 0);
          tm.crewInst.object3d.scale.setScalar(tm.cs);
          tm.group.add(tm.crewInst.object3d);
          tm.crewMeshes = instMeshes(tm.crewInst);
          const h = tm.crewInst.height || ((gfxModelInfo(crewId) || {}).height) || 1.4;
          tm.crewH = h * tm.cs;
          tm.topY = Math.max(tm.topY, tm.crewY + tm.crewH);
        } catch (e) { tm.crewInst = null; tm.crewMeshes = null; }
      }
      if (!tm.crewInst) {
        tm.crew = new T.Mesh(this._crewGeo(tm.king, cs), this.matToon);
        tm.crew.position.set(0, tm.crewY, 0);
        tm.crew.rotation.y = yaw;
        tm.crew.scale.setScalar(tm.cs);
        tm.group.add(tm.crew);
        tm.crewH = (tm.king ? 1.45 : 1.25) * tm.cs;
        tm.topY = Math.max(tm.topY, tm.crewY + tm.crewH);
      }
      if (tm.rubble) tm.rubble.scale.setScalar(tm.rubbleSz);
      if (this._grim && tm.bodyInst) grimInst(tm.bodyInst);   // v10 grimdark: dark stone, team colours kept
      this._towerLod(tm, (this._crowd || this._weak) ? 1 : 0);   // v9 (pooled instances keep their LOD)
      tm.e.h = tm.topY;
      tm.e.y = 0;
      tm.e.r = target / 2;
      tm.yawCur = yaw;
      if (!tm.alive) this._setTowerDown(tm, true);
    }

    _undressTower(tm) {
      if (tm.bodyInst) {
        Batcher.restore(tm.bodyMeshes);
        try { if (tm.bodyInst.object3d.parent) tm.bodyInst.object3d.parent.remove(tm.bodyInst.object3d); tm.bodyInst.release(); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
        tm.bodyInst = null; tm.bodyMeshes = null;
      }
      if (tm.crewInst) {
        Batcher.restore(tm.crewMeshes);
        try { if (tm.crewInst.object3d.parent) tm.crewInst.object3d.parent.remove(tm.crewInst.object3d); tm.crewInst.release(); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
        tm.crewInst = null; tm.crewMeshes = null;
      }
      if (tm.body) { tm.group.remove(tm.body); tm.body = null; }
      if (tm.crew) { tm.group.remove(tm.crew); tm.crew = null; }
    }

    _towerGeo(king, cs) {
      const key = (king ? 'k' : 'p') + cs;
      this._towerGeoCache = this._towerGeoCache || {};
      if (this._towerGeoCache[key]) return this._towerGeoCache[key];
      const T = this.T;
      const gb = new GeoBuf(T);
      const box = new T.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
      const rnd = seeded(king ? 5 : 3);
      const team = TEAM_HEX[cs], dark = TEAM_DARK[cs];
      const B = king ? 3.5 : 2.6, Ht = king ? 2.55 : 2.3, top = this._towerTopY(king);
      const stones = [0xc8c0b0, 0xbab2a2, 0xd2cabb, 0xb0a898];
      // plinth
      gb.add(box, 0, 0.14, 0, 0, 0, 0, B + 0.5, 0.28, B + 0.5, 0x8a857a, [0, 0.28, 0.75]);
      // stone courses (slightly irregular blocks)
      const courses = king ? 5 : 4;
      const ch = (Ht - 0.28) / courses;
      for (let c = 0; c < courses; c++) {
        const y = 0.28 + ch * (c + 0.5);
        const taper = 1 - c * 0.012;
        const per = (c & 1) ? 4 : 3;
        const side = B * taper;
        const len = side / per - 0.04;
        const e = side / 2 - 0.12;
        for (let f = 0; f < 4; f++) {
          for (let k = 0; k < per; k++) {
            const along = ((k + 0.5) / per - 0.5) * side;
            const col = stones[(rnd() * stones.length) | 0];
            const out = (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.03;
            if (f === 0) gb.add(box, e + out, y, along, 0, 0, 0, 0.26, ch - 0.045, len, col, [0.28, Ht, 0.8]);
            else if (f === 1) gb.add(box, along, y, e + out, 0, 0, 0, len, ch - 0.045, 0.26, col, [0.28, Ht, 0.8]);
            else if (f === 2) gb.add(box, -e - out, y, along, 0, 0, 0, 0.26, ch - 0.045, len, col, [0.28, Ht, 0.8]);
            else gb.add(box, along, y, -e - out, 0, 0, 0, len, ch - 0.045, 0.26, col, [0.28, Ht, 0.8]);
          }
        }
        // mortar core
        gb.add(box, 0, y, 0, 0, 0, 0, side - 0.2, ch, side - 0.2, 0x8a8274, null);
      }
      // overhang / wooden walkway
      gb.add(box, 0, top - 0.16, 0, 0, 0, 0, B + 0.42, 0.22, B + 0.42, 0x8a6038, null);
      gb.add(box, 0, top - 0.32, 0, 0, 0, 0, B + 0.2, 0.12, B + 0.2, 0x6e4a2c, null);
      // merlons
      const nm = king ? 4 : 3;
      for (let f = 0; f < 4; f++) {
        for (let k = 0; k < nm; k++) {
          const t = (k + 0.5) / nm - 0.5;
          const e = (B + 0.3) / 2;
          let px = 0, pz = 0;
          if (f === 0) { px = t * (B + 0.3); pz = e; } else if (f === 1) { px = e; pz = t * (B + 0.3); } else if (f === 2) { px = t * (B + 0.3); pz = -e; } else { px = -e; pz = t * (B + 0.3); }
          gb.add(box, px, top + 0.14, pz, 0, 0, 0, 0.42, 0.38, 0.42, stones[(rnd() * stones.length) | 0], [top, top + 0.4, 0.85]);
          gb.add(box, px, top + 0.36, pz, 0, 0, 0, 0.46, 0.07, 0.46, team, null);
        }
      }
      // team banners hanging on the front (towards -Z in model space = enemy) and back
      for (let s = -1; s <= 1; s += 2) {
        for (let k = -1; k <= 1; k += 2) {
          if (!king && k === 1 && s === 1) { /* keep symmetric */ }
          const bx = k * B * 0.24;
          const bz = s * (B / 2 + 0.03);
          gb.add(box, bx, top - 0.85, bz, 0, 0, 0, 0.58, 1.05, 0.05, team, [top - 1.4, top - 0.3, 0.7]);
          gb.add(box, bx, top - 0.36, bz + s * 0.02, 0, 0, 0, 0.66, 0.1, 0.07, dark, null);
          gb.add(box, bx, top - 1.42, bz, 0, 0, Math.PI / 4, 0.4, 0.4, 0.04, team, null);
          gb.add(box, bx, top - 0.85, bz + s * 0.035, 0, 0, Math.PI / 4, 0.2, 0.2, 0.02, 0xffd23f, null);
        }
      }
      // door on the back side (towards own king)
      gb.add(box, 0, 0.62, B / 2 + 0.02, 0, 0, 0, 0.7, 0.9, 0.06, 0x6e4a2c, null);
      gb.add(box, 0, 1.1, B / 2 + 0.03, 0, 0, 0, 0.78, 0.1, 0.07, 0x4a3420, null);
      if (king) {
        // crown emblem on the front
        gb.add(box, 0, 1.4, -B / 2 - 0.04, 0, 0, Math.PI / 4, 0.7, 0.7, 0.06, 0xffd23f, null);
        gb.add(box, 0, 1.4, -B / 2 - 0.07, 0, 0, Math.PI / 4, 0.42, 0.42, 0.04, team, null);
      }
      box.dispose();
      const geo = gb.build();
      this._towerGeoCache[key] = geo;
      return geo;
    }

    _crewGeo(king, cs) {
      const key = (king ? 'K' : 'P') + cs;
      this._towerGeoCache = this._towerGeoCache || {};
      if (this._towerGeoCache[key]) return this._towerGeoCache[key];
      const T = this.T;
      const gb = new GeoBuf(T);
      const sph = new T.SphereGeometry(1, 14, 10), cyl = new T.CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 1, 12), cone = new T.ConeGeometry(1, 1, 12), box = new T.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
      const tor = new T.TorusGeometry(0.42, 0.035, 6, 14, Math.PI);
      const team = TEAM_HEX[cs], light = TEAM_LIGHT[cs];
      if (king) {
        gb.add(cone, 0, 0.45, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0.55, 0.9, 0.55, team, [0, 0.9, 0.7]);
        gb.add(cyl, 0, 0.92, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0.36, 0.2, 0.36, 0xf2f2f2, null);
        gb.add(sph, 0, 1.12, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 0xf2c49a, null);
        gb.add(sph, 0, 0.98, -0.18, 0, 0, 0, 0.22, 0.18, 0.14, 0xf8f8f8, null);
        gb.add(cyl, 0, 1.42, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0.24, 0.18, 0.24, 0xffd23f, null);
        for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) { const a = i * TAU / 5; gb.add(cone, Math.cos(a) * 0.2, 1.57, Math.sin(a) * 0.2, 0, 0, 0, 0.06, 0.14, 0.06, 0xffd23f, null); }
        // cannon beside the king
        gb.add(cyl, 0.75, 0.38, -0.1, Math.PI / 2 - 0.2, 0, 0, 0.17, 0.9, 0.17, 0x3a3e46, null);
        gb.add(cyl, 0.75, 0.2, 0.15, 0, 0, Math.PI / 2, 0.16, 0.08, 0.16, 0x6e4a2c, null);
        gb.add(box, 0.75, 0.16, 0.05, 0, 0, 0, 0.4, 0.14, 0.5, 0x6e4a2c, null);
      } else {
        gb.add(cone, 0, 0.36, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0.38, 0.72, 0.38, team, [0, 0.7, 0.7]);
        gb.add(sph, 0, 0.88, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0xf2c49a, null);
        gb.add(sph, 0, 0.96, 0.05, 0, 0, 0, 0.27, 0.22, 0.27, 0xff8a3a, null);
        gb.add(sph, 0, 1.1, 0.16, 0, 0, 0, 0.12, 0.12, 0.12, 0xff8a3a, null);
        gb.add(tor, 0.3, 0.6, -0.12, 0, Math.PI / 2, Math.PI / 2, 1, 1, 1, 0x8a5a30, null);
        gb.add(box, 0, 0.55, 0.02, 0, 0, 0, 0.5, 0.08, 0.3, light, null);
      }
      sph.dispose(); cyl.dispose(); cone.dispose(); box.dispose(); tor.dispose();
      const geo = gb.build();
      this._towerGeoCache[key] = geo;
      return geo;
    }

    _rubbleGeo(king, cs) {
      const key = (king ? 'rk' : 'rp') + cs;
      this._towerGeoCache = this._towerGeoCache || {};
      if (this._towerGeoCache[key]) return this._towerGeoCache[key];
      const T = this.T;
      const gb = new GeoBuf(T);
      const box = new T.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1), ico = new T.IcosahedronGeometry(1, 0);
      const rnd = seeded(king ? 17 : 11);
      const B = king ? 3.5 : 2.6;
      gb.add(box, 0, 0.14, 0, 0, 0, 0, B + 0.5, 0.28, B + 0.5, 0x7a756a, [0, 0.28, 0.75]);
      // broken wall stumps
      for (let f = 0; f < 4; f++) {
        for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
          const t = (k + 0.5) / 4 - 0.5;
          const e = B / 2 - 0.15;
          let px, pz;
          if (f === 0) { px = t * B; pz = e; } else if (f === 1) { px = e; pz = t * B; } else if (f === 2) { px = t * B; pz = -e; } else { px = -e; pz = t * B; }
          const h = 0.25 + rnd() * (king ? 1.0 : 0.8);
          gb.add(box, px, 0.28 + h / 2, pz, (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.2, (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.4, (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.2, 0.62, h, 0.5, [0xb8b0a0, 0xa8a090, 0xc4bcac][(rnd() * 3) | 0], [0.28, 1.4, 0.7]);
        }
      }
      // rubble pile + scattered stones
      for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
        const a = rnd() * TAU, r = rnd() * B * 0.75;
        const s = 0.15 + rnd() * 0.32;
        gb.add(ico, Math.cos(a) * r, 0.3 + s * 0.4, Math.sin(a) * r, rnd() * 3, rnd() * 3, rnd() * 3, s, s * 0.75, s, [0xb0a898, 0x9a9282, 0x8a8272][(rnd() * 3) | 0], null);
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        const a = rnd() * TAU, r = B * 0.6 + rnd() * 1.2;
        const s = 0.1 + rnd() * 0.18;
        gb.add(ico, Math.cos(a) * r, s * 0.4, Math.sin(a) * r, rnd() * 3, rnd() * 3, rnd() * 3, s, s * 0.7, s, 0xa09888, null);
      }
      // charred planks + torn team cloth
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const a = rnd() * TAU, r = rnd() * B * 0.4;
        gb.add(box, Math.cos(a) * r, 0.5, Math.sin(a) * r, (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.6, rnd() * 3, (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.6, 1.1, 0.08, 0.2, 0x4a3422, null);
      }
      gb.add(box, B * 0.25, 0.4, B * 0.2, 0.3, 0.6, 0.1, 0.6, 0.04, 0.5, TEAM_DARK[cs], null);
      box.dispose(); ico.dispose();
      const geo = gb.build();
      this._towerGeoCache[key] = geo;
      return geo;
    }

    _setTowerDown(tm, down) {
      const T = this.T;
      if (down) {
        if (tm.body) tm.body.visible = false;
        if (tm.crew) tm.crew.visible = false;
        if (tm.bodyInst) tm.bodyInst.object3d.visible = false;
        if (tm.crewInst) tm.crewInst.object3d.visible = false;
        if (!tm.rubble) {
          tm.rubble = new T.Mesh(this._rubbleGeo(tm.king, tm.cside), this.matToon);
          tm.rubble.rotation.y = tm.yaw || 0;
          tm.rubble.scale.setScalar(tm.rubbleSz || 1);
          tm.group.add(tm.rubble);
        }
        tm.rubble.visible = true;
        tm.e.h = 1.0;
      } else {
        if (tm.body) tm.body.visible = true;
        if (tm.crew) tm.crew.visible = true;
        if (tm.bodyInst) tm.bodyInst.object3d.visible = true;
        if (tm.crewInst) tm.crewInst.object3d.visible = true;
        if (tm.rubble) tm.rubble.visible = false;
        tm.e.h = tm.topY;
      }
    }

    // ================================================================ options & lifecycle
    setOptions(o) {
      if (!o || typeof o !== 'object') return;
      const op = this.options;
      if (o.emotes !== undefined) op.emotes = o.emotes;
      if (o.colorMode === 'absolute' || o.colorMode === 'relative') { if (op.colorMode !== o.colorMode) { op.colorMode = o.colorMode; this._recolor(); } }
      if (o.countdown !== undefined) op.countdown = !!o.countdown;
      if (o.shake !== undefined) op.shake = !!o.shake;
      if (o.localSide === 0 || o.localSide === 1) this._setLocalSide(o.localSide);
      if (typeof o.localPlayer === 'number') this.localPlayer = o.localPlayer;
      if (o.map === 'classic' || o.map === 'hill' || o.map === 'tunnel') this.setMap(o.map);
      if (typeof o.mode === 'string') this.setMode(o.mode);
    }

    _cside(side) {
      if (this.options.colorMode === 'absolute') return side === 1 ? 1 : 0;
      return side === this.localSide ? 0 : 1;
    }

    _setLocalSide(ls) {
      if (ls === this.localSide) return;
      this.localSide = ls;
      this._fitCamera();
      this._recolor();
      this._ovDirty = true; this._ovHash = -2;
    }

    _recolor() {
      // team colours are relative to the viewer: rebuild every coloured instance
      const self = this;
      this._quietUntil = this.frame + 3;
      this._units.forEach(function (m) { self._releaseUnit(m, true); });
      this._units.clear();
      this._unitList.length = 0;
      this._towers.forEach(function (tm) { self._dressTower(tm); });
      this._projs.forEach(function (pm) { pm.cside = self._cside(pm.side); });
      this._recolorZones();
      this._ghostKey = '';
    }

    /** Forget all transient state (effects, memos, event dedupe) - e.g. for a new battle. */
    reset() {
      const self = this;
      this._units.forEach(function (m) { self._releaseUnit(m, true); });
      this._units.clear();
      this._unitList.length = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < this._dying.length; i++) this._finishDie(this._dying[i]);
      this._dying.length = 0;
      this._projs.forEach(function (p) { self._projFree.push(p); });
      this._projs.clear();
      this._areaTotals.clear();
      if (this.fx) this.fx.reset();
      this._seqRing.fill(-1); this._maxSeq = -1; this._lastTick = -1;
      this._deathReason.clear(); this._deployIds.clear(); this._rings.length = 0;
      if (this._cloneIds) this._cloneIds.clear();
      if (this._tunEv) this._tunEv.clear();
      for (let i = 0; i < this._labels.length; i++) this._labels[i].on = false;
      for (let i = 0; i < this._banners.length; i++) this._banners[i].on = false;
      this._bubbles[0].on = false; this._bubbles[1].on = false;
      this._prevRef = null; this._curRef = null;
      this._prevUnits.clear(); this._prevProj.clear(); this._curUnits.clear(); this._curTowers.clear();
      this._towers.forEach(function (tm) { tm.alive = true; tm.active = !tm.king; self._setTowerDown(tm, false); tm.hpVal = -1; tm.absent = false; tm.group.visible = true; });
      this._refreshLayout();
      this._applyMode();

      this._shakeT0 = -1e9; this._flash.t0 = -1e9;

    }

    dispose() {

      this._clearGhostUnits();
      this._ghostGeoCache.forEach(function (g) { if (g) g.dispose(); });
      this._projBatches.forEach(function (b) { if (!b) return; if (b.mesh.parent) b.mesh.parent.remove(b.mesh); if (b.ownGeo) b.geo.dispose(); b.mesh.dispose && b.mesh.dispose(); });
      if (this.fx) this.fx.dispose();

      const tex = this._arenaTex || [];
      for (let i = 0; i < tex.length; i++) tex[i].dispose();
      if (this._towerGeoCache) for (const k in this._towerGeoCache) this._towerGeoCache[k].dispose();
      if (this._batcher) this._batcher.dispose();
      if (this._ownToon) this.matToon.dispose();
      if (this.matScenery) this.matScenery.dispose();
      [this.matGlow, this.matGhost, this.matGhostBad, this._fieldMat, this._waterMat, this._shadowMat,
        this._gRingMat, this._gFillMat, this._gTileMat, this._gSquareMat, this._gRectMat, this._fbMat[0], this._fbMat[1], this._fbSkin].forEach(function (m) { if (m) m.dispose(); });
      if (this._ovMesh) this._ovMesh.material.dispose();
      [this._blobTex, this._sqTex, this._sqdTex, this._ownGrad].forEach(function (t) { if (t) t.dispose(); });
      this._shadowGeo.dispose(); this._fbBody.dispose(); this._fbHead.dispose();
      if (this._ringGeo) this._ringGeo.dispose();
      if (this._ringMats) this._ringMats.forEach(function (m) { m.dispose(); });
      if (this._ringTex) this._ringTex.dispose();

    destroy() { this.dispose(); }

    // ================================================================ geometry / camera
    resize(cssW, cssH, dpr) {
      if (this._destroyed) return;
      let w = +cssW, h = +cssH;
      const cv = this.canvas;
      if (!(w > 0)) w = (cv && cv.clientWidth) || 360;
      if (!(h > 0)) h = (cv && cv.clientHeight) || 640;
      // v8: the renderer owns the DPR policy - the caller's ratio (the app caps it at 2) is
      // raised to the device ratio unless options.dprMode === 'caller'
      const dev = +G.devicePixelRatio || 1;
      let d = +dpr;
      if (!(d > 0)) d = dev;
      if (this.options.dprMode !== 'caller' && dev > d) d = dev;
      const od = clamp(d, 1, MAX_DPR);   // overlay: full device ratio (crisp bars / numbers)
      d = clamp(d, 1, Math.min(MAX_DPR, this._dprCap));
      if (w * h * d * d > PIXEL_BUDGET) d = Math.max(1, Math.sqrt(PIXEL_BUDGET / (w * h)));
      d = Math.round(d * 100) / 100;
      this._reqDpr = +dpr > 0 ? +dpr : dev;
      const same = w === this.cssW && h === this.cssH && d === this.dpr && od === this.odpr;
      this.cssW = w; this.cssH = h; this.dpr = d; this.odpr = od;
      if (!same) {
        this.gl.setPixelRatio(d);
        this.gl.setSize(w, h, false);

          this.overlay.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(w * od));
          this.overlay.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(h * od));
          if (this.overlay.style && cv) {
            this.overlay.style.left = (cv.offsetLeft || 0) + 'px';
            this.overlay.style.top = (cv.offsetTop || 0) + 'px';
            this.overlay.style.width = w + 'px';
            this.overlay.style.height = h + 'px';
          }
        }
        this._ovHash = -2;
      }
      if (!this._refreshLayout()) this._fitCamera();
    }

    /**
     * v4 camera fit (Clash Royale framing, user feedback "the original is twice as big"):
     *  - the 18-tile field spans the FULL canvas width: its near ground corners sit at a 1.2 %
     *    margin (the stone walls run off the sides like CR's decoration), so on a 390 px phone
     *    one tile is ~21 px, the princess tower ~3 tiles, the king tower ~4 tiles wide;
     *  - long lens (FOV 6) => the far side is only slightly narrower, as in CR;
     *  - the pitch (38..64 deg; CR itself is ~50-55) is solved so the field incl.
     *    the far crown towers (+ their HP bars) fills the canvas height: the app overlays its top
     *    HUD on the arena (behind the enemy king tower, like CR), so the canvas is nearly the
     *    whole screen above the card panel and no margin is kept at the top;
     *  - a canvas taller than the 64 deg view keeps the slack at the TOP (room for the HUD);
     *    one too flat even for 38 deg backs the camera off until the height fits.
     */
    _fitCamera() {
      const cam = this.pickCam;
      const w = this.cssW || 360, h = this.cssH || 640;
      cam.fov = +this.options.fov > 3 ? +this.options.fov : FOV; cam.aspect = w / h; cam.near = 1; cam.far = 4000;
      cam.updateProjectionMatrix();
      const fx = this.hw, nz = this.hh + NEAR_PAD, fz = this.hh;
      // points in the side-0 frame (far side = -z); the field is symmetric so side 1 just rotates
      const P = this._fitPts || (this._fitPts = []);
      P.length = 0;
      const nW = 4;   // the first nW points decide the width (ground corners of the field)
      P.push(-fx, 0, this.hh, fx, 0, this.hh, -fx, 0, -fz, fx, 0, -fz);
      P.push(0, 0, nz);                                   // a sliver of the near wall
      // far towers incl. their HP bars (and the crew on top)
      let nT = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < this._towerList.length; i++) {
        const tm = this._towerList[i];
        if (tm.e.z > 0 || tm.absent) continue;
        P.push(tm.e.x, (tm.topY || 4) + FAR_BAR_Y, tm.e.z);
        nT++;
      }
      if (!nT) P.push(0, 5.4, -(this.hh - 3), -5.5, 5.0, -(this.hh - 6.5), 5.5, 5.0, -(this.hh - 6.5));
      const n = P.length / 3;
      const v = this._v3;
      const mx = +this.options.marginX >= 0 ? +this.options.marginX : MARGIN_X;
      const xMax = 1 - 2 * mx, yTop = 1 - 2 * MARGIN_T, yBot = -1 + 2 * MARGIN_B;
      const b = { x: 0, top: 0, bot: 0 };
      const bounds = function (pitch, d, tz) {
        const sp = Math.sin(pitch), cp = Math.cos(pitch);
        cam.position.set(0, d * sp, tz + d * cp);
        cam.lookAt(0, 0, tz);
        cam.updateMatrixWorld(true);
        cam.matrixWorldInverse.copy(cam.matrixWorld).invert();
        b.x = 0; b.top = -9; b.bot = 9;
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          v.set(P[i * 3], P[i * 3 + 1], P[i * 3 + 2]).project(cam);
          const ax = Math.abs(v.x);
          if (i < nW && ax > b.x) b.x = ax;
          if (v.y > b.top) b.top = v.y;
          if (v.y < b.bot) b.bot = v.y;
        }
        return b;
      };
      // distance at which the widest point touches the side margin (for a target tz)
      const solveD = function (pitch, tz, limitY) {
        let lo = 8, hi = 3000;
        for (let k = 0; k < 30; k++) {
          const mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
          bounds(pitch, mid, tz);
          const ok = b.x <= xMax && (!limitY || (b.top <= yTop && b.bot >= yBot));
          if (ok) hi = mid; else lo = mid;
        }
        return hi;
      };
      const fit = { d: 80, tz: 1, top: 0, bot: 0 };
      const tanH = Math.tan(cam.fov * Math.PI / 360);
      // anchor: 0 = centre the vertical extent, 1 = bottom edge on the bottom margin
      const place = function (pitch, limitY, anchor) {
        let tz = 1, d = 80;
        for (let it = 0; it < 16; it++) {
          d = solveD(pitch, tz, limitY);
          bounds(pitch, d, tz);
          const err = anchor ? b.bot - yBot : (b.top + b.bot) / 2 - (yTop + yBot) / 2;
          if (Math.abs(err) < 0.001) break;
          // NDC -> ground shift at the look-at point (slightly damped)
          tz -= err * d * tanH / Math.max(0.3, Math.sin(pitch)) * 0.85;
        }
        bounds(pitch, d, tz);
        fit.d = d; fit.tz = tz; fit.top = b.top; fit.bot = b.bot;
        return (fit.top - fit.bot) - (yTop - yBot);   // > 0: too tall, < 0: slack
      };
      const pMin = this.options.pitchMin > 20 ? this.options.pitchMin * Math.PI / 180 : PITCH_MIN;
      const pMax = Math.max(pMin, this.options.pitchMax > 20 ? this.options.pitchMax * Math.PI / 180 : PITCH_MAX);
      let pitch;
      if (place(pMax, false, 0) <= 0) { pitch = pMax; place(pitch, false, 1); }
      else if (place(pMin, false, 0) >= 0) { pitch = pMin; place(pitch, true, 0); }
      else {
        let lo = pMin, hi = pMax;
        for (let k = 0; k < 16; k++) { const mid = (lo + hi) / 2; if (place(mid, false, 0) > 0) hi = mid; else lo = mid; }
        pitch = lo; place(pitch, false, 0);

      const sp = Math.sin(pitch), cp = Math.cos(pitch);
      const sgn = this.localSide === 1 ? -1 : 1;
      const B = this._camBase;
      B.px = 0; B.py = D * sp; B.pz = sgn * (tz + D * cp);
      B.tx = 0; B.ty = 0; B.tz = sgn * tz;
      B.d = D; B.pitch = pitch;

      cam.near = Math.max(1, D * 0.55); cam.far = D * 1.5 + 60;
      cam.updateProjectionMatrix();

      cam.up.set(0, 1, 0);
      cam.lookAt(B.tx, B.ty, B.tz);
      cam.updateMatrixWorld(true);
      cam.matrixWorldInverse.copy(cam.matrixWorld).invert();
      const c = this.camera;
      c.fov = cam.fov; c.aspect = cam.aspect; c.near = cam.near; c.far = cam.far;
      c.updateProjectionMatrix();

      c.updateMatrixWorld(true);

      const corners = [[-this.hw, -this.hh], [this.hw, -this.hh], [this.hw, this.hh], [-this.hw, this.hh]];
      let x0 = 1e9, y0 = 1e9, x1 = -1e9, y1 = -1e9;
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {

        if (px < x0) x0 = px; if (px > x1) x1 = px; if (py < y0) y0 = py; if (py > y1) y1 = py;
      }
      this._arenaRect = { x: x0, y: y0, w: x1 - x0, h: y1 - y0 };
      this._ovDirty = true;
      this._ovHash = -2;
    }

    _updateCamera(now, dt) {
      const c = this.camera, B = this._camBase;
      let px = B.px, py = B.py, pz = B.pz;
      // battle intro swoop

        const e = easeOutCubic(k);

        const rot = lerp(this.reduced ? 0 : 0.22, 0, e);
        const cr = Math.cos(rot), sr = Math.sin(rot);
        px = B.tx + (ox * cr - oz * sr) * sc; py = B.ty + oy * sc + lerp(4, 0, e); pz = B.tz + (ox * sr + oz * cr) * sc;
        if (k >= 1) this._introDone = true;
      }

      let sx = 0, sy = 0, sz = 0;
      if (sk >= 0 && sk < 1 && this._shakeAmp > 0 && this.options.shake && !this.reduced) {
        const amp = this._shakeAmp * (1 - sk) * (1 - sk);
        sx = Math.sin(now * 0.071) * amp; sy = Math.cos(now * 0.093) * amp * 0.6; sz = Math.sin(now * 0.057 + 1.3) * amp * 0.5;
      }
      c.position.set(px + sx, py + sy, pz + sz);
      c.lookAt(B.tx + sx * 0.6, B.ty, B.tz + sz * 0.6);
      c.updateMatrixWorld(true);
      c.matrixWorldInverse.copy(c.matrixWorld).invert();
    }

    _shake(amp, dur) {
      if (!this.options.shake || this.reduced) return;
      const now = this.now;
      const left = this._shakeT0 + this._shakeDur * 1000 - now;
      if (left > 0 && this._shakeAmp * (left / (this._shakeDur * 1000)) > amp) return;
      this._shakeT0 = now; this._shakeDur = dur; this._shakeAmp = amp;
    }
    _flashScreen(col, a, dur) {
      if (this.reduced) return;
      const f = this._flash;
      f.t0 = this.now; f.dur = dur; f.a = Math.min(0.3, a);
      f.col = typeof col === 'number' ? '#' + ('000000' + col.toString(16)).slice(-6) : (col || '#ffffff');
    }

    screenToSim(px, py, side) {
      const w = this.cssW || 1, h = this.cssH || 1;
      this._v2.set(px / w * 2 - 1, -(py / h) * 2 + 1);
      this.raycaster.setFromCamera(this._v2, this.pickCam);
      const ray = this.raycaster.ray;
      let x, y;
      const th = this._pickHit || (this._pickHit = { x: 0, z: 0 });
      if (this.hillOn && rayTerrain(ray.origin.x, ray.origin.y, ray.origin.z, ray.direction.x, ray.direction.y, ray.direction.z, this._ghFn, this._hillMax, th)) {

      if ((side === 0 || side === 1) && side !== this.localSide) { x = this.W - x; y = this.H - y; }
