    }

    simToScreen(x, y, side) {
      if ((side === 0 || side === 1) && side !== this.localSide) { x = this.W - x; y = this.H - y; }
      const v = this._v3b.set(x - this.hw, this._ghs(x, y), this.hh - y).project(this.pickCam);
      return { px: (v.x + 1) / 2 * (this.cssW || 1), py: (1 - v.y) / 2 * (this.cssH || 1) };
    }

    arenaRect() {
      const r = this._arenaRect || { x: 0, y: 0, w: this.cssW, h: this.cssH };
      return { x: r.x, y: r.y, w: r.w, h: r.h };
    }

    tileSize() {
      const a = this.simToScreen(9, 10), b = this.simToScreen(9, 11);
      return Math.sqrt((a.px - b.px) * (a.px - b.px) + (a.py - b.py) * (a.py - b.py)) || 16;
    }

    /** Project world point -> CSS px into this._proj (x, y, s = px per tile at that depth). */
    _project(x, y, z) {
      const c = this.camera, e = c.matrixWorldInverse.elements, p = c.projectionMatrix.elements;
      const vx = e[0] * x + e[4] * y + e[8] * z + e[12];
      const vy = e[1] * x + e[5] * y + e[9] * z + e[13];
      const vz = e[2] * x + e[6] * y + e[10] * z + e[14];
      const o = this._proj;
      const d = -vz;
      if (d < 0.1) { o.ok = false; return o; }
      const cx = p[0] * vx + p[8] * vz, cy = p[5] * vy + p[9] * vz;
      o.x = (cx / d + 1) / 2 * this.cssW;
      o.y = (1 - cy / d) / 2 * this.cssH;
      o.s = p[5] * this.cssH / 2 / d;
      o.d = d;
      o.ok = true;
      return o;
    }

    // ================================================================ events
    feedEvents(events) {
      if (!events || !events.length || this._destroyed) return;
      const ring = this._seqRing;
      for (let i = 0; i < events.length; i++) {
        const ev = events[i];
        if (!ev || typeof ev !== 'object') continue;
        const s = ev.seq;
        if (typeof s === 'number' && isFinite(s)) {
          const si = s | 0;
          if (this._maxSeq >= 0 && si < this._maxSeq - SEQ_MASK) continue;
          const slot = si & SEQ_MASK;
          if (ring[slot] === si) continue;
          ring[slot] = si;
          if (si > this._maxSeq) this._maxSeq = si;
        }
        try { this._onEvent(ev); } catch (e) { /* a malformed event must never break rendering */ }
        if (this.fx) { try { this.fx.onEvent(ev, this._ctx); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ } }
      }
    }

    _onEvent(ev) {
      const now = this.now || perfNow();
      const side = ev.side === 1 ? 1 : 0;
      switch (ev.t) {
        case 'hit': {
          if (ev.kind === 'elixir' || ev.kind === 'decay') return;
          const m = this._units.get(ev.id);
          if (m && ev.dmg > 0) { m.hurt = true; m.hurtMs = now; }
          const tm = this._towers.get(ev.id);
          if (tm && ev.dmg > 0) { tm.hurt = true; tm.hitMs = now; }
          if (ev.src) {
            const sm = this._units.get(ev.src);
            if (sm) {
              const k = ev.kind;
              if (k === 'melee' || k === 'charge' || k === 'jump' || ((k === 'ranged' || k === 'splash') && !hasProjectile(sm.unit))) this._flagHit(sm, now);
            }
          }
          return;
        }
        case 'death':
          if (ev.id) this._deathReason.set(ev.id, ev.reason || 'killed');
          if (this._deathReason.size > 400) this._deathReason.clear();
          return;
        case 'deploy': {
          if (!ev.units || !ev.units.length) return;
          const ring = { ids: ev.units.slice(), x: +ev.x || 0, y: +ev.y || 0, total: 0, t0: now, card: ev.card, side: side, done: false };
          for (let i = 0; i < ev.units.length; i++) this._deployIds.set(ev.units[i], now);
          if (this._deployIds.size > 600) this._deployIds.clear();
          this._rings.push(ring);
          if (this._rings.length > 24) this._rings.shift();
          return;
        }
        case 'tower_down': {
          const tm = this._towers.get(ev.id);
          if (tm) { tm.downT = now; }
          const x = (+ev.x || 0) - this.hw, z = this.hh - (+ev.y || 0);
          this._label('', x, tm ? tm.topY : 3, z, '#ffd23f', 1.6, 1.8, 'crown');
          return;
        }
        case 'king_active': {
          const tm = ev.id ? this._towers.get(ev.id) : null;
          if (tm) tm.active = true;
          return;
        }
        case 'spell': {
          if (ev.card === 'arrows' && ev.phase === 'impact') {
            // arrows stuck in the ground for a moment
            const R = (+ev.radius || 4) * 0.9;
            const cx = (+ev.x || 0) - this.hw, cz = this.hh - (+ev.y || 0);
            const st = this._stuck || (this._stuck = []);
            for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
              const a = Math.random() * TAU, r = R * Math.sqrt(Math.random());
              if (st.length > 60) st.shift();
              st.push({ x: cx + Math.cos(a) * r, z: cz + Math.sin(a) * r, ry: Math.random() * TAU, tilt: 0.9 + Math.random() * 0.35, t0: now + i * 12, cs: this._cside(side) });
            }
          }
          return;
        }
        case 'phase': this._onPhase(ev, now); return;
        case 'touchdown': case 'score': {
          // v6 Touchdown scored (the view's touchdown.score is the fallback detector)
          if (!this.td) return;
          this._tdEvMs = now;
          this._onTouchdown(side, ev.x, ev.y, now);
          return;
        }
        case 'ability': {
          // v6 card abilities (Elektrodrache chain, Kung-Fu-Legende dash / combo / one-inch) and v7
          // (Cyborg-Jäger shotgun / pump / endoskeleton, Schwarzklingen-Meister champion_slash,
          // Wirbel-Ninja sphere): the model plays a matching pose from st.ability / st.abilityT
          const uid = ev.unitId || ev.id || ev.src;
          const m = this._units.get(uid);
          if (typeof ev.kind !== 'string') return;
          if (ev.kind === 'shadow_clone' && Array.isArray(ev.units)) {
            if (this._cloneIds.size > 300) this._cloneIds.clear();
            for (let i = 0; i < ev.units.length; i++) this._cloneIds.add(ev.units[i]);
            return;
          }
          if (ev.kind === 'shadow_clone') return;
          let kind = ev.kind === 'dash' && ev.phase === 'impact' ? 'dash-end' : ev.kind;
          if (kind === 'endoskeleton') {
            kind = 'rise';
            this._endoMs = now;
            // the endoskeleton may be a NEW unit that the views only show after this event
            const nid = ev.newId || ev.spawnId || ev.endoId || uid;
            const nm = this._units.get(nid);
            if (nm && nm.unit === 'cyborg-endoskeleton') { nm.abil = 'rise'; nm.abilMs = now; }
            else if (nid !== undefined) { this._pendAbil.set(nid, { kind: 'rise', ms: now }); if (this._pendAbil.size > 64) this._pendAbil.clear(); }
            return;
          }
          // the champion slash comes as 'windup' then 'launch': one pose for both
          if (m && kind === 'champion_slash' && ev.phase === 'launch' && m.abil === kind && now - m.abilMs < 1200) return;
          if (m) { m.abil = kind; m.abilMs = now; m.abilN = +ev.hit || 0; }
          else if (uid !== undefined) { this._pendAbil.set(uid, { kind: kind, ms: now }); if (this._pendAbil.size > 64) this._pendAbil.clear(); }
          return;
        }
        case 'emote': {
          if (!this._emotesOn) return;
          const b = this._bubbles[side];
          b.on = true; b.t0 = now; b.side = side; b.text = ''; b.mood = this._emoteMood(ev.id, this._emoteText(ev.id));
          return;
        }
        case 'tunnel': {
          // v12 tunnel map: a troop walks into / out of a tunnel hole -> dirt puff at the hole
          const uid = ev.unitId || ev.id;
          if (uid !== undefined) { this._tunEv.set(uid, now); if (this._tunEv.size > 200) this._tunEv.clear(); }
          const tm = uid !== undefined ? this._units.get(uid) : null;
          if (this.fx && typeof ev.x === 'number' && typeof ev.y === 'number') this.fx.burst('tunnelPuff', ev.x - this.hw, 0, this.hh - ev.y, tm ? Math.min(1.3, Math.max(0.8, tm.vs * 0.6)) : 1);
          return;
        }
        case 'chaos_pick':
          // v4: no banner strip any more (it covered the river for 2 s on every pick of either
          // player): CR.VFX shows a wordless rarity star + pillar burst at that side's king tower
          return;
        default: return;
      }
    }

    /** v6: detect a scored touchdown from the view (score sum went up) unless an event did. */
    _tdCheck(cur, now) {
      const T = cur.touchdown;
      if (!T || typeof T !== 'object') return;
      const sc = T.score || EMPTY;
      const sum = (+sc[0] || 0) + (+sc[1] || 0);
      this._tdReset = +T.resetIn > 0 ? +T.resetIn : 0;
      if (this._tdSum < 0 || sum < this._tdSum) { this._tdSum = sum; return; }
      if (sum > this._tdSum) {
        this._tdSum = sum;
        if (now - this._tdEvMs < 2500) return;
        const L = T.lastScore;
        let side = L && (L.side === 0 || L.side === 1) ? L.side : -1;
        if (side < 0) side = (+sc[1] || 0) > (this._tdLast1 || 0) ? 1 : 0;
        this._onTouchdown(side, L ? L.x : undefined, L ? L.y : undefined, now);
      }
      this._tdLast1 = +sc[1] || 0;
    }

    /** Touchdown celebration: burst in the end zone (confetti, team light pillars along the goal
     *  line, shock rings, a crown pop), screen flash + shake, the zone lights up and a team-coloured
     *  sweep runs back over the whole field while it is cleared (units vanish in poofs). */
    _onTouchdown(side, x, y, now) {
      side = side === 1 ? 1 : 0;
      const zi = tdScoreZone(side);
      const Z = this.zones && this.zones[zi];
      if (!Z) return;
      const zw = this._zoneWorld(zi);
      if (!(x >= Z.x0 && x <= Z.x1)) x = (Z.x0 + Z.x1) / 2;
      if (!(y >= Z.y0 - 0.6 && y <= Z.y1 + 0.6)) y = (Z.y0 + Z.y1) / 2;
      const wx = x - this.hw, wz = this.hh - clamp(y, Z.y0 + 0.3, Z.y1 - 0.3);
      const cs = this._cside(side);
      this._tdMs = now; this._tdZone = zi;
      if (this.fx && typeof this.fx.touchdown === 'function') {
        this.fx.touchdown(wx, wz, cs, zw);
        const other = this._zoneWorld(1 - zi);
        if (typeof this.fx.sweep === 'function' && other) this.fx.sweep(zw.goalZ, other.goalZ, 1.25, cs);
      }
      this._label('', wx, 2.4 + this._gh(wx, wz), wz, '#ffd23f', 2.2, 2.0, 'crown');
      this._shake(0.75, 0.55);
      this._flashScreen(TEAM_CSS[cs].light, 0.22, 0.45);
    }

    /** End-zone glow: the scored zone flashes for ~2.5 s, both pulse softly during a reset pause. */
    _updateZones(now) {
      const zv = this._zoneVis;
      if (!zv || !zv.length) return;
      const t = (now - this._tdMs) / 1000;
      for (let i = 0; i < zv.length; i++) {
        const z = zv[i];
        let k = 0;
        if (z.home === this._tdZone && t >= 0 && t < 2.6) k = (1 - t / 2.6) * (0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(t * 16));
        if (this._tdReset > 0) k = Math.max(k, 0.12 + 0.12 * Math.sin(now * 0.008));
        if (Math.abs(k - z.k) < 0.004) continue;
        z.k = k;
        z.mat.color.setScalar(1 + 0.85 * k);
      }
    }

    _flagHit(m, now) {
      if (now - m.lastHitMs < 120) return;
      m.hitFlag = true; m.lastHitMs = now;
    }

    /** v4: phase changes are WORDLESS icon flashes (elixir drop + x2 / x3, overtime hourglass);
     *  the last 10 s are shown by the big countdown numbers only. */
    _onPhase(ev, now) {
      const ph = String(ev.phase || '');
      if (ph === 'double') this._banner('x2', 2, '#f07bff', now);
      else if (ph === 'triple') this._banner('x3', 3, '#ff5fd2', now);
      else if (ph === 'overtime') this._banner('overtime', 0, '#ffb13b', now);
      else if (typeof ev.banner === 'string' && ev.banner) this._banner('chaos', -1, '#ffe14d', now);
    }

    /** Wordless banner: icon = 'x2' | 'x3' | 'overtime' | 'chaos'; val = multiplier / colour team. */
    _banner(icon, val, color, now) {
      const bs = this._banners;
      let start = now, free = null;
      for (let i = 0; i < bs.length; i++) {
        const b = bs[i];
        if (b.on) {
          if (b.icon === icon && b.val === val && now - b.t0 < 800) return;
          const end = b.t0 + b.dur;
          if (end - 250 > start) start = end - 250;
        } else if (!free) free = b;
      }
      if (!free) { free = bs[0]; for (let i = 1; i < bs.length; i++) if (bs[i].t0 < free.t0) free = bs[i]; }
      free.on = true; free.icon = String(icon || 'chaos'); free.val = val; free.color = color; free.t0 = start; free.dur = 1900;
    }

    /** Floating world-space marker. v4: never a word - any text with letters becomes a 'star' badge
     *  (numbers such as '+1' elixir stay). */
    _label(text, x, y, z, col, size, dur, kind) {
      text = text == null ? '' : String(text);
      if (LETTER_RE.test(text) || (text && kind !== 'elixir')) { text = ''; if (kind !== 'crown' && kind !== 'wake') kind = 'star'; }
      let L = null, oldest = null;
      for (let i = 0; i < this._labels.length; i++) {
        const l = this._labels[i];
        if (!l.on) { L = l; break; }
        if (!oldest || l.t0 < oldest.t0) oldest = l;
      }
      if (!L) L = oldest;
      L.on = true; L.text = text; L.x = x; L.y = y; L.z = z; L.col = col || '#ffffff'; L.size = size || 1;
      L.t0 = this.now || perfNow(); L.dur = (dur || 1.2) * 1000; L.kind = kind || '';
    }

    _emoteText(id) {
      const UI = CR.UI;
      if (UI && Array.isArray(UI.EMOTES)) {
        for (let i = 0; i < UI.EMOTES.length; i++) {
          const em = UI.EMOTES[i];
          if (em && em.id === id) return String(em.text || em.label || id);
        }
      }
      const T = { gg: 'Gut gespielt!', haha: 'Haha!', wow: 'Wow!', grr: 'Grrr!', thumbs: 'Super!', laugh: 'Haha!', cry: 'Oh nein!', angry: 'Grrr!' };
      return T[id] || String(id || '…').slice(0, 16);
    }

    /** v4: emote bubbles show a drawn face (no words in battle). Maps an emote id/text to a mood. */
    _emoteMood(id, text) {
      const s = (String(id || '') + ' ' + String(text || '')).toLowerCase();
      if (/cry|sad|nein|wein|traurig|oops|ups/.test(s)) return 'sad';
      if (/grr|angry|wut|böse|boese|mad/.test(s)) return 'angry';
      if (/wow|oh|staun|surpr|whoa/.test(s)) return 'wow';
      if (/thumb|gg|gut|super|good|nice|daumen|top|well/.test(s)) return 'thumbs';
      return 'happy';
    }

    _ent(id) {
      const m = this._units.get(id);
      if (m) return m.e;
      const tm = this._towers.get(id);
      if (tm) return tm.e;
      return null;
    }
    /** Nearest unit / tower around a sim point (within ~1 tile), world entity record or null. */
    _entAt(x, y) {
      let best = null, bd = 1.3;
      const L = this._unitList;
      for (let i = 0; i < L.length; i++) {
        const m = L[i];
        if (!m.u) continue;
        const d = (m.u.x - x) * (m.u.x - x) + (m.u.y - y) * (m.u.y - y);
        if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = m.e; }
      }
      if (best) return best;
      const TL = this._towerList;
      for (let i = 0; i < TL.length; i++) {
        const tm = TL[i];
        if (!tm.alive) continue;
        if (Math.abs(tm.x - x) <= tm.size / 2 + 0.2 && Math.abs(tm.y - y) <= tm.size / 2 + 0.2) best = tm.e;
      }
      return best;
    }

    _kingTop(side) {
      if (this.td) {
        // touchdown: no king tower - side effects (chaos picks, ...) rise from the own end zone
        const Z = this._zoneWorld(side);
        if (!Z) return null;
        const o = this._kt || (this._kt = { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 });
        o.x = Z.cx; o.y = 0.8 + this._gh(Z.cx, Z.cz); o.z = Z.cz;
        return o;
      }
      let k = null;
      this._towers.forEach(function (tm) { if (!k && tm.side === side && tm.king) k = tm; });
      if (!k) return null;
      const o = this._kt || (this._kt = { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 });
      o.x = k.e.x; o.y = k.alive ? k.topY : 1; o.z = k.e.z;
      return o;
    }

    // ================================================================ frame
    draw(prev, cur, alpha, opts) {
      if (this._destroyed || this._lost) return;
      const t0 = perfNow();
      opts = opts || NO_OPTS;
      const now = typeof opts.nowMs === 'number' && isFinite(opts.nowMs) ? opts.nowMs : perfNow();
      let dtR = this._lastNow > 0 ? (now - this._lastNow) / 1000 : 1 / 60;
      if (!(dtR >= 0)) dtR = 0;
      if (dtR > 0.1) dtR = 0.1;
      this._lastNow = now;
      this.now = now;
      this.frame++;
      if (!(this.cssW > 0)) this.resize(opts.w, opts.h, opts.dpr);
      else if (opts.w > 0 && opts.h > 0 && (Math.abs(opts.w - this.cssW) > 0.5 || Math.abs(opts.h - this.cssH) > 0.5)) this.resize(opts.w, opts.h, opts.dpr || this.dpr);
      const ls = opts.localSide === 1 ? 1 : (opts.localSide === 0 ? 0 : this.localSide);
      if (ls !== this.localSide) this._setLocalSide(ls);
      if (typeof opts.localPlayer === 'number') this.localPlayer = opts.localPlayer;
      // v5: map of the battle (view.map, else the arena's current map)
      if (cur && typeof cur === 'object') {
        const mid = typeof cur.map === 'string' ? cur.map : ((CR.Arena && CR.Arena.map) || this.map);
        const tdv = isTouchdown(cur);
        if (arenaKey(mid, tdv) !== this.arenaKey) this.setMap(mid, tdv);
        this._teamMode = cur.teamSize === 2 || !!(cur.players && cur.players.length === 4);
      }
      const eo = this.options.emotes;
      this._emotesOn = eo === 'auto' ? !(CR.UI && typeof CR.UI.BattleScreen === 'function') : eo === true;
      if (opts.emotes === true || opts.emotes === false) this._emotesOn = opts.emotes;

      let a = +alpha;
      if (!(a >= 0)) a = 1;
      if (a > 1) a = 1;
      if (cur && typeof cur === 'object') {
        if (!prev || typeof prev !== 'object') prev = cur;
        this._checkRestart(cur);
        this._index(prev, cur);
        if (opts.autoEvents !== false && cur.events && cur.events.length) this.feedEvents(cur.events);
        if (this.td) this._tdCheck(cur, now);
      } else cur = null;

      // game time (drives unit / effect animation: 1.5x speed and pauses follow the sim)
      let dtG = 0;
      if (cur) {
        const tp = +prev.time || 0, tc = +cur.time || 0;
        const tv = prev !== cur ? tp + (tc - tp) * a : tc;
        if (this._tv >= 0) dtG = clamp(tv - this._tv, 0, 0.25);
        this._tv = tv;
        if (this._introT0 < 0) { this._introT0 = now; if (tc > 3) this._introDone = true; }
      }
      const over = !!(cur && cur.over);
      // v6: the touchdown celebration / field reset runs on real time (the sim may pause)
      const celeb = this.td && (now - this._tdMs < 3500 || this._tdReset > 0);
      const dtFx = over || celeb ? dtR : dtG;

      this._updateCamera(now, dtR);
      if (this.td) this._updateZones(now);
      if (this._waterMat) this._waterMat.uniforms.uT.value += dtR;
      if (this._windU) this._windU.value += dtR;
      if (this.fx) this.fx.update(dtFx, this.camera);
      this._shadowN = 0;
      this._ringN[0] = 0; this._ringN[1] = 0;
      if (cur) {
        this._syncTowers(prev, cur, a, dtG, dtR, now);
        this._syncUnits(prev, cur, a, dtG, over ? dtR : dtG, now);
        this._syncProjectiles(prev, cur, a, dtG, now);
        this._syncAreas(cur, dtG);
      } else {
        for (let i = 0; i < this._towerList.length; i++) { const tm = this._towerList[i]; if (tm.alive) this._shadow(tm.e.x, tm.e.z, tm.e.r * 2.6, tm.e.r * 2.6, 0); }
      }
      this._updateDying(over || celeb ? dtR : dtG);
      const drag = cur && opts.drag && (opts.drag.cardId || opts.drag.card) ? opts.drag : null;
      this._updateGhost(drag, cur, now);
      this.shadows.count = this._shadowN;
      if (this._shadowN > 0) updRange(this.shadows.instanceMatrix, this._shadowN * 16);
      {
        const rm = this._ringMeshes[0], rn = this._ringN[0];
        rm.count = rn;
        rm.visible = rn > 0;
        if (rn > 0) { updRange(rm.instanceMatrix, rn * 16); if (rm.instanceColor) updRange(rm.instanceColor, rn * 3); }
      }
      if (this.fx) this.fx.commit();

      // one matrix pass for the whole scene, then the batcher re-draws the rig meshes instanced
      this.scene.updateMatrixWorld();
      this._collectBatches();
      if (!this._compiled) this._compileAll();
      this.gl.render(this.scene, this.camera);
      this._drawOverlay(cur, now, drag);
      this._perf(dtR, now, perfNow() - t0);
      if ((this.frame & 63) === 0) this._sweep(now);
      if (cur) this._warmStep(cur);
    }

    _collectBatches() {
      const B = this._batcher;
      B.begin();
      const L = this._unitList;
      for (let i = 0; i < L.length; i++) { const m = L[i]; if (m.inst && m.meshes) B.add(m.inst.object3d, m.meshes); }
      const D = this._dying;
      for (let i = 0; i < D.length; i++) { const m = D[i]; if (m.inst && m.meshes) B.add(m.inst.object3d, m.meshes); }
      const TL = this._towerList;
      for (let i = 0; i < TL.length; i++) {
        const tm = TL[i];
        if (tm.bodyInst && tm.bodyMeshes) B.add(tm.bodyInst.object3d, tm.bodyMeshes);
        if (tm.crewInst && tm.crewMeshes) B.add(tm.crewInst.object3d, tm.crewMeshes);
      }
      B.end();
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- prewarm / compile
    /** Build CR.GFX templates (both colour sides) + visual measurements for cards / units now,
     *  so the first deploy of a card does not stall the frame. */
    prewarm(ids) {
      if (!ids) return 0;
      const list = Array.isArray(ids) ? ids : [ids];
      const set = new Set();
      for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) if (list[i]) unitsOf(String(list[i]), set);
      let n = 0;
      const self = this;
      set.forEach(function (u) { if (self._warmUnit(u)) n++; });
      return n;
    }

    _warmUnit(u) {
      if (this._warmed.has(u)) return false;
      this._warmed.add(u);
      const X = gfx();
      if (!X) return false;
      try { if (typeof X.prewarm === 'function') X.prewarm([u]); } catch (e) { /* optional */ }
      this._measure(u);
      return true;
    }

    /** Hands + next cards of both players: queue their units, build one per frame. */
    _warmStep(cur) {
      const ps = cur.players;
      if (ps && (this.frame & 7) === 1) {
        for (let s = 0; s < ps.length; s++) {
          const p = ps[s];
          if (!p) continue;
          const h = p.hand || EMPTY;
          for (let i = 0; i <= h.length; i++) {
            const cid = i < h.length ? h[i] : p.next;
            if (!cid || typeof cid !== 'string' || this._warmedCards.has(cid)) continue;
            this._warmedCards.add(cid);
            const set = unitsOf(cid, new Set());
            const q = this._warmQ;
            set.forEach(function (u) { q.push(u); });
          }
        }
      }
      // one unit per frame (both colour sides), never while the frame was already long
      if (this._warmQ.length && this._drawAvg < 12) {
        let guard = 4;
        while (this._warmQ.length && guard-- > 0) { if (this._warmUnit(this._warmQ.shift())) break; }
      }
    }

    /** Compile every shader variant the battle can need (no program link mid-battle). */
    _compileAll() {
      this._compiled = true;
      const T = this.T, X = gfx();
      const tmp = [];
      const own = [];
      const insts = [];
      const geo = new T.BoxGeometry(0.01, 0.01, 0.01);
      try {
        const toon = (CR.GFX && CR.GFX.toonMaterial) || this.matToon;
        tmp.push(new T.InstancedMesh(geo, toon, 1));                  // batched rigs + projectiles
        tmp.push(new T.InstancedMesh(geo, this.matGlow, 1));          // glowing projectiles
        if (X && typeof X.createToonMaterial === 'function') {
          const tt = X.createToonMaterial(); tt.transparent = true; tt.opacity = 0.5; own.push(tt);
          tmp.push(new T.Mesh(geo, tt));                               // translucent static meshes
        }
        if (this.fx && this.fx.areaMat && this.fx.discGeo) tmp.push(new T.Mesh(this.fx.discGeo, this.fx.areaMat));
        if (X) {
          const id = firstModel(['knight', 'barbarian', 'skeleton']) || 'knight';
          const st = { state: 'moving', moving: true, dir: Math.PI / 2, attackProg: 0, hit: false, fx: 1 | 16 | 128, hpFrac: 0.5, tier: 3, z: 0, deployLeft: 0, deployTotal: 0, speed: 1, hurt: true, timeScale: 1 };
          // a) every status extra (stars, speed lines, rarity ring / column / badge) + hurt flash
          const a = X.createInstance(id, 0);
          if (a && a.object3d) { a._noIntro = true; for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) a.update(0.05, st); insts.push(a); }
          // b) translucent rig (drag ghosts, hidden / fading units)
          const b = X.createInstance(id, 1);
          if (b && b.object3d) {
            if (typeof b.setGhost === 'function') b.setGhost(0.5, 0xff4a3f);
            st.fx = 0; st.tier = 0; st.hurt = false;
            b.update(0.05, st);
            insts.push(b);
          }
          for (let i = 0; i < insts.length; i++) tmp.push(insts[i].object3d);
        }
        for (let i = 0; i < tmp.length; i++) { tmp[i].position.set(0, -50, 0); this.scene.add(tmp[i]); }
        this.scene.updateMatrixWorld();
        this.gl.compile(this.scene, this.camera);
      } catch (e) { /* compiling ahead is an optimisation only */ }
      for (let i = 0; i < tmp.length; i++) { if (tmp[i].parent) tmp[i].parent.remove(tmp[i]); if (tmp[i].isInstancedMesh) tmp[i].dispose(); }
      for (let i = 0; i < insts.length; i++) {
        try { if (typeof insts[i].setGhost === 'function') insts[i].setGhost(0); insts[i].release(); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < own.length; i++) own[i].dispose();
      geo.dispose();
    }

    _checkRestart(cur) {
      const tk = typeof cur.tick === 'number' ? cur.tick : -1;
      if (tk >= 0 && this._lastTick >= 0 && tk + 40 < this._lastTick) this.reset();
      if (tk >= 0) this._lastTick = tk;
    }

    _index(prev, cur) {
      if (cur !== this._curRef) {
        this._curRef = cur;
        const cu = this._curUnits; cu.clear();
        const us = cur.units || EMPTY;
        for (let i = 0; i < us.length; i++) if (us[i]) cu.set(us[i].id, us[i]);
        const ct = this._curTowers; ct.clear();
        const tw = cur.towers || EMPTY;
        for (let i = 0; i < tw.length; i++) if (tw[i]) ct.set(tw[i].id, tw[i]);
      }
      if (prev !== this._prevRef) {
        this._prevRef = prev;
        const pu = this._prevUnits, pp = this._prevProj;
        pu.clear(); pp.clear();
        const us = prev.units || EMPTY;
        for (let i = 0; i < us.length; i++) if (us[i]) pu.set(us[i].id, us[i]);
        const ps = prev.projectiles || EMPTY;
        for (let i = 0; i < ps.length; i++) if (ps[i]) pp.set(ps[i].id, ps[i]);
      }
    }

    _sweep(now) {
      // forget old deploy groups / ids
      const self = this;
      this._deployIds.forEach(function (t, id) { if (now - t > 6000) self._deployIds.delete(id); });
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- towers per frame
    _syncTowers(prev, cur, a, dtG, dtR, now) {
      const tw = cur.towers || EMPTY;
      for (let i = 0; i < tw.length; i++) {
        const t = tw[i];
        const tm = this._towers.get(t.id);
        if (!tm) continue;
        if (tm.alive && !t.alive) { tm.alive = false; this._setTowerDown(tm, true); }
        else if (!tm.alive && t.alive) { tm.alive = true; this._setTowerDown(tm, false); }
        tm.active = !!t.active;
        tm.hp = t.hp; tm.maxHp = t.maxHp; tm.fx = t.fx | 0;
        if (tm.alive) this._shadow(tm.e.x, tm.e.z, tm.e.r * 2.6, tm.e.r * 2.6, 0);
        else {
          this._shadow(tm.e.x, tm.e.z, tm.e.r * 2.5, tm.e.r * 2.5, 0);
          // rubble keeps smoking for a while after the collapse
          if (this.fx && now - tm.downT < 9000 && Math.random() < dtR * 3) this.fx.emit('smoke', tm.e.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * tm.size * 0.6, 0.6, tm.e.z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * tm.size * 0.6, 0.5, 1, 0x5a5550, 0x9a9690);
          continue;
        }
        const hpk = t.maxHp > 0 ? t.hp / t.maxHp : 1;
        if (this.fx && hpk < 0.35 && dtR > 0) {
          const k = (0.35 - hpk) / 0.35;
          if (Math.random() < dtR * (1.5 + k * 4)) this.fx.emit('smoke', tm.e.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * tm.size * 0.5, tm.crewY * 0.9, tm.e.z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * tm.size * 0.5, 0.45, 1, 0x4a4542, 0x8a8682);
          if (k > 0.4 && Math.random() < dtR * 3) this.fx.emit('embers', tm.e.x, tm.crewY * 0.8, tm.e.z, 0.35, 1);
        }
        // aim the crew at its target

        tm.dirS += angleDiff(tm.dirS, dir) * Math.min(1, dtR * 10);

        st.dir = tm.dirS; st.attackProg = +t.attackProg || 0; st.hit = tm.hitFlag; st.fx = tm.fx;
        st.hpFrac = t.maxHp > 0 ? t.hp / t.maxHp : 1; st.hurt = tm.hurt; st.asleep = asleep; st.sleeping = asleep;
        tm.hitFlag = false;

    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- units per frame
    _newUnitMemo(u, now) {
      const m = this._unitFree.pop() || new UnitMemo();
      m.id = u.id; m.unit = u.unit; m.side = u.side; m.cside = this._cside(u.side);
      m.seen = this.frame; m.born = now; m.dying = false;
      m.hitFlag = false; m.lastHitMs = -1e9; m.hurt = false; m.lastCur = null;
      m.lastProg = 0; m.lastZ = u.z || 0; m.lastFx = u.fx | 0; m.lastState = u.state; m.deployTotal = 0;
      m.lockId = 0; m.lockT = 0; m.speed = 0; m.vx = 0; m.vz = 0; m.abil = ''; m.abilMs = -1e9;
      m.st.ability = ''; m.st.abilityT = -1; m.st.champReady = false; m.st.champActive = false;
      m.under = false; m.look = 0;
      m.dirS = typeof u.dir === 'number' ? u.dir : (u.side === 0 ? Math.PI / 2 : -Math.PI / 2);
      const pa = this._pendAbil.size ? this._pendAbil.get(u.id) : null;
      if (pa) { this._pendAbil.delete(u.id); if (now - pa.ms < 1500) { m.abil = pa.kind; m.abilMs = pa.ms; } }
      if (u.unit === 'cyborg-endoskeleton') this._endoRise(m, u, now);
      const e = m.e;
      e.id = u.id; e.unit = u.unit; e.side = u.side; e.air = !!u.air; e.building = !!u.building; e.tower = false;
      const r = u.radius > 0 ? u.radius : 0.5;

      if (m.inst && u.unit === 'cyborg-endoskeleton') m.inst._noIntro = true;
      m.lod = -1;
      this._applyVis(m, m.inst, u, r);
      e.r = m.rv;
      if (m.inst && m.inst.object3d) this.scene.add(m.inst.object3d);
      m.meshes = m.inst && !(m.inst instanceof FallbackUnit) ? instMeshes(m.inst) : null;

      if (!fromDeploy && this.fx && this._tv > 0.2 && !(this.frame < (this._quietUntil || 0))) {
        const wx = u.x - this.hw, wz = this.hh - u.y;
        if (u.unit === 'cyborg-endoskeleton') { /* risen from the wreck: _endoRise */ }

        else if (u.unit === 'phoenix-egg') this.fx.burst('fireNova', wx, 0, wz, 0.9);
        else if (isClone(u) || this._cloneIds.has(u.id)) this.fx.burst('clonePoof', wx, 0, wz, Math.min(1.4, m.vs));
        else if (isUnderground(u)) { /* appears inside the tunnel: no spawn puff */ }
        else if (!((u.fx | 0) & 32)) this.fx.burst('spawn', wx, 0, wz, (u.unit === 'golemite' || u.unit === 'lava-pup' ? 1.4 : 1) * Math.min(1.4, m.vs));

    }

    /** Visual scale of a unit model: troops ~1.55x (tall ones tapered), buildings fitted to their
     *  sim footprint; flyers keep a sensible flight line (o.oy compensates the scaled altitude). */
    _unitScale(unitId, inst, u) {
      const key = unitId + (u && u.building ? ':b' : '');
      const memo = this._visCache.get('s:' + key);
      if (memo) return memo;
      const out = { vs: 1, oy: 0, small: false };
      if (inst && !(inst instanceof FallbackUnit)) {
        const meas = this._measure(unitId);
        const ud = unitData(unitId) || {};
        const S = +this.options.unitScale > 0 ? +this.options.unitScale : UNIT_SCALE;
        if (u && u.building) {
          let foot = (u.size > 0 ? u.size : 0) || ud.footprint || ud.size || 0;
          if (!(foot > 0)) foot = Math.max(1, (ud.radius || 0.6) * 2);
          out.vs = meas.w > 0.3 ? clamp(foot * 0.92 / meas.w, 0.8, 1.35) : 1;
        } else {
          const h = meas.h > 0.2 ? meas.h : (inst.height || 1.2);

          if (H > TALL_H) H = TALL_H + (H - TALL_H) * TALL_K;

        }
      }

    }

    _applyVis(m, inst, u, r) {
      const sc = this._unitScale(u.unit, inst, u);
      m.vs = sc.vs; m.oy = sc.oy;
      m.rv = r * sc.vs;

      }
    }

    /** Lighter animation (kit LOD 1: cheap secondary motion) for swarm units and crowded fields. */
    _setLod(m, lod) {
      const inst = m.inst;
      if (!inst || m.lod === lod) return;
      m.lod = lod;
      try { if (typeof inst.setLod === 'function') inst.setLod(lod); else if ('lod' in inst) inst.lod = lod; } catch (e) { /* optional */ }
    }

    /** v9: many units on the field (or a weak device) -> every unit, crown tower and tower crew
     *  uses LOD 1 (the kit's 'low' geometry, ~0.45x the triangles, + cheaper animation). */
    _updateLod(force) {
      const n = this._unitList.length;
      const crowd = this._crowd ? n > 22 : n > 30;     // hysteresis
      if (crowd === this._crowd && !force) return;
      this._crowd = crowd;
      const low = crowd || this._weak;
      const L = this._unitList;
      for (let i = 0; i < L.length; i++) this._setLod(L[i], (L[i].small || low) ? 1 : 0);
      const TL = this._towerList || EMPTY;
      for (let i = 0; i < TL.length; i++) this._towerLod(TL[i], low ? 1 : 0);
    }

    _towerLod(tm, lod) {
      const a = [tm.bodyInst, tm.crewInst];
      for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        const inst = a[i];
        if (!inst || typeof inst.setLod !== 'function') continue;
        try { inst.setLod(lod); } catch (e) { /* optional */ }
        if (i === 0 && this._grim) grimInst(inst);   // v10: the 'low' geometry too
      }
    }

    /** v9: weak-device mode (see _perf): new battle templates at the 'low' preset, LOD 1 on all. */
    _setWeak(on, init) {
      on = !!on;
      if (on === this._weak) return;
      this._weak = on;
      const X = gfx();
      if (X && typeof X.setDetail === 'function') {
        try {
          if (on) { if (!this._detailPrev) this._detailPrev = (X.config && X.config.detail) || null; X.setDetail('low'); }
          else if (this._detailPrev) { X.setDetail(this._detailPrev); this._detailPrev = null; }
        } catch (e) { /* optional */ }
      }
      if (!init) this._updateLod(true);
    }

    _createInstance(unitId, cs, u) {
      const X = gfx();
      if (X) {
        try {
          const inst = X.createInstance(unitId, cs);
          if (inst && inst.object3d) return inst;
        } catch (e) { /* fall back */ }
      }
      return new FallbackUnit(this, unitId, cs);
    }

    _heightOf(unitId, inst, u) {
      if (inst && inst.height > 0) return inst.height;
      const info = gfxModelInfo(unitId);
      if (info && info.height > 0) return info.height;
      const r = u && u.radius > 0 ? u.radius : 0.5;
      if (u && u.building) return 1.2 + r * 1.2;
      return 0.9 + r * 1.4;
    }

    /** Current base height of an instance in world units (flight altitude, jumps, drop-in: owned
     *  by the instance, local units -> scaled by the visual scale + flight offset). */
    _baseY(m) {
      const inst = m.inst;
      if (inst && typeof inst.lift === 'number' && isFinite(inst.lift)) return m.oy + inst.lift * m.vs;
      return m.e.air ? AIR_Y : 0;
    }
    _topY(m) {
      const inst = m.inst;
      if (inst && typeof inst.top === 'number' && isFinite(inst.top)) return m.oy + inst.top * m.vs;
      return this._baseY(m) + m.h;
    }

    _syncUnits(prev, cur, a, dtG, dtAnim, now) {
      const us = cur.units || EMPTY;
      const newView = cur !== this._unitsCurRef;
      this._unitsCurRef = cur;
      if (newView) this._champIndex(cur);
      const dtv = Math.max(1e-3, (+cur.time || 0) - (+prev.time || 0));
      const fx = this.fx;
      for (let i = 0; i < us.length; i++) {
        const u = us[i];
        if (!u) continue;
        let m = this._units.get(u.id);
        if (!m) { m = this._newUnitMemo(u, now); this._units.set(u.id, m); }
        else if (u.unit && m.unit !== u.unit && !m.dying) this._retypeUnit(m, u, now);
        m.seen = this.frame;
        m.u = u;
        const p = this._prevUnits.get(u.id);

        if (p && p !== u) {

          z = (p.z || 0) + ((u.z || 0) - (p.z || 0)) * a;
          if (typeof p.dir === 'number' && typeof u.dir === 'number') dir = p.dir + angleDiff(p.dir, u.dir) * a;
          if (prog > (+p.attackProg || 0)) prog = (+p.attackProg || 0) + (prog - (+p.attackProg || 0)) * a;

            m.vx = dx / dtv; m.vz = -dy / dtv;
            const pp = +p.attackProg || 0;
            if (pp >= 0.55 && (+u.attackProg || 0) < pp - 0.3) this._flagHit(m, now);
            if ((p.z || 0) > 0.45 && !(u.z > 0.05) && fx) {

              if (!big) fx.burst('land', u.x - this.hw, 0, this.hh - u.y, Math.max(1, m.rv * 2));
            }
            if (((p.fx | 0) & 32) && !(fxb & 32) && fx && !u.building) { fx.burst('emerge', u.x - this.hw, 0, this.hh - u.y, 1.2 * Math.min(1.4, m.vs)); }
            if (((p.fx | 0) & 32) && !(fxb & 32) && fx && u.building) { fx.burst('land', u.x - this.hw, 0, this.hh - u.y, 1.2); }

            }
          } else if (!p) { m.speed = 0; }

          // inferno lock time
          if (u.targetId && u.state === 'attacking') { if (u.targetId === m.lockId) m.lockT += dtv; else { m.lockId = u.targetId; m.lockT = 0; } }
          else { m.lockId = 0; m.lockT = 0; }
        }
        // facing smoothing
        if (typeof dir === 'number') m.dirS += angleDiff(m.dirS, dir) * Math.min(1, dtAnim * 14 + (dtAnim > 0 ? 0.05 : 0));
        const e = m.e;
        const wx = x - this.hw, wz = this.hh - y;
        // ground under the unit: classic = bridge planks; hill = the terrain (ground units climb
        // it, buildings sit on the lowest point of their footprint, flyers keep their altitude)

        } else if (!u.air && this._onBridge(x, y)) by = 0.09;
        if (under) by -= TUNNEL_SINK;   // v12: inside the tunnel (dimmed silhouette, feet below the ground)
        e.x = wx; e.z = wz; e.under = under;
        m.hp = u.hp; m.maxHp = u.maxHp; m.shield = u.shield || 0; m.maxShield = u.maxShield || 0;
        const st = m.st;
        st.state = u.state; st.moving = m.speed > 0.15 && u.state === 'moving'; st.dir = m.dirS;

        st.hit = m.hitFlag; m.hitFlag = false;
        st.fx = fxb; st.hpFrac = u.maxHp > 0 ? clamp(u.hp / u.maxHp, 0, 1) : 1;
        st.tier = u.tier | 0; st.z = z / m.vs; st.deployLeft = +u.deployLeft || 0; st.deployTotal = m.deployTotal;
        st.speed = m.speed / m.vs; st.hurt = m.hurt; m.hurt = false; st.side = u.side; st.unit = u.unit; st.timeScale = 1;
        if (m.abil) {
          const at = (now - m.abilMs) / 1000;
          if (at > 2.5) { m.abil = ''; st.ability = ''; st.abilityT = -1; } else { st.ability = m.abil; st.abilityT = at; st.abilityN = m.abilN; }
        } else if (st.ability) { st.ability = ''; st.abilityT = -1; }
        // v7 champion: ready / active ability state from view.players[i].champion
        const ch = this._champ.size ? this._champ.get(u.id) : null;
        st.champReady = !!(ch && ch.ready); st.champActive = !!(ch && ch.active);
        e.fdx = Math.cos(m.dirS); e.fdz = -Math.sin(m.dirS);
        if (m.inst) {
          const o = m.inst.object3d;
          // v12 ghost looks: underground (dark translucent silhouette), shadow clone (light blue)
          const look = under ? 1 : (isClone(u) || (this._cloneIds.size && this._cloneIds.has(u.id)) ? 2 : 0);
          if (look !== m.look && typeof m.inst.setGhost === 'function') {
            m.look = look;
            try { m.inst.setGhost(look === 1 ? TUNNEL_GHOST : (look === 2 ? CLONE_GHOST : 0), look === 1 ? TUNNEL_TINT : (look === 2 ? CLONE_TINT : null)); } catch (err) { /* optional */ }
          }

        }

        const hz = base - (this.hillOn ? gy : by);

        if (!((fxb & 32) && !u.building) && !under) {
          this._shadow(wx, wz, ss, ss * (u.building ? 1 : 0.9), 0);
          // v11: team ring under every unit (own brightest, 2v2 teammate lighter, foes dimmer)
          if (this.options.teamRings !== false) {
            const rs = ringSlot(u, m.cside, this.localSide, this.localPlayer, this._teamMode);
            this._teamRing(rs, wx, wz, u.building ? (u.size > 0 ? u.size * 0.62 : rr * 1.3) : Math.max(0.46, rr * 1.12));
          }
        }
        // status / ability emitters
        if (under && this.options.teamRings !== false) {
          // underground: a dimmed team ring keeps both sides readable in tunnel fights
          this._teamRing(ringSlot(u, m.cside, this.localSide, this.localPlayer, this._teamMode), wx, wz, Math.max(0.42, rr * 1.0));
        }

          this._unitAbilityFx(m, u, e, prog, dtG, now);

        }
      }
      if ((this.frame & 15) === 0) this._updateLod();
      // removed units -> death animation / release
      const L = this._unitList;
      for (let i = L.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const m = L[i];
        if (m.seen === this.frame) continue;
        this._unlistUnit(m, i);
        this._units.delete(m.id);
        const reason = this._deathReason.get(m.id);
        this._deathReason.delete(m.id);
        if (this._cloneIds.size && this._cloneIds.delete(m.id) && reason === 'expired') {
          // v12: a shadow clone fades in a puff of smoke (no death animation)
          if (fx) fx.burst('clonePoof', m.e.x, 0, m.e.z, Math.min(1.2, m.vs));
          this._releaseUnit(m, true);
        } else if (reason === 'kamikaze' || reason === 'transform' || !m.inst) this._releaseUnit(m, true);
        else if (this.td && (now - this._tdMs < 3500 || reason === 'touchdown' || reason === 'reset' || reason === 'clear')) {
          // touchdown field reset: troops vanish in a team-coloured poof instead of dying
          if (fx) {
            fx.burst('poof', m.e.x, m.e.y + m.h * 0.45, m.e.z, Math.max(0.8, m.h * 0.6));
            fx.emit('sparkle', m.e.x, m.e.y + m.h * 0.5, m.e.z, 0.6, 6, 0xffffff, TEAM_HEX[m.cside]);
          }
